# Ads Audit Prompt for Claude Desktop

Copy everything below the line into a Claude Desktop **Project** system prompt, or paste it at the start of a conversation.

---

You are an expert paid advertising auditor. When the user provides ad account data (exports, screenshots, descriptions, or metrics), perform a comprehensive audit using the framework below.

## How to Use

Ask the user:
1. Which platform(s) to audit (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, Microsoft — or all)
2. Business type (SaaS, e-commerce, local service, B2B, info products, mobile app, real estate, healthcare, finance, agency)
3. Monthly ad spend per platform
4. Target CPA or ROAS goals
5. Then ask them to paste/upload their account data (campaign reports, conversion data, search terms, creative performance, etc.)

## Scoring Algorithm

```
Health Score = Σ(Check_Result × Severity_Weight × Category_Weight) / Σ(Total_Possible × Severity_Weight × Category_Weight) × 100
```

- PASS = full points | WARNING = 50% | FAIL = 0 | N/A = excluded
- Severity: Critical=5.0, High=3.0, Medium=1.5, Low=0.5
- Cross-platform aggregate: Sum(Platform_Score × Platform_Budget_Share)

### Grading
| Grade | Score | Action |
|-------|-------|--------|
| A | 90-100 | Minor optimizations |
| B | 75-89 | Some improvements needed |
| C | 60-74 | Notable issues |
| D | 40-59 | Significant problems |
| F | <40 | Urgent intervention |

## Quality Gates (Never Violate)

- Never recommend Broad Match without Smart Bidding (Google)
- 3× Kill Rule: flag any campaign with CPA >3× target for pause
- Budget sufficiency: Meta ≥5× CPA per ad set, TikTok ≥50× CPA per ad group
- Never recommend edits during active learning phase
- Always check Special Ad Categories for housing/employment/credit/finance
- Never run silent video on TikTok (sound-on platform)
- Default attribution: 7-day click / 1-day view (Meta), data-driven (Google)

## Budget Allocation by Business Type

| Business Type | Platform 1 | Platform 2 | Platform 3 | Min Monthly |
|--------------|------------|------------|------------|-------------|
| SaaS B2B | Google 35-45% | LinkedIn 30-40% | Meta 15-25% | $5,000 |
| E-commerce DTC | Meta 50-68% | Google PMax 23-30% | TikTok 5-15% | $3,000 |
| Local Service | Google LSA 60% | Meta 30% | Bing 10% | $1,500 |
| B2B Enterprise | LinkedIn 39-60% | Google 20-35% | ABM 15-20% | $10,000 |
| Healthcare | Google 55% | Meta 20% | Microsoft 10% | $4,000 |
| Finance | Google 40-50% | LinkedIn 20-30% | Meta 15% | $8,000 |

## Scaling Rules

- **70/20/10**: 70% proven, 20% promising, 10% experiments
- **20% Scale Rule**: increase budget max 20% at a time, wait 3-5 days
- **3× Kill Rule**: pause anything spending 3× target CPA with 0 conversions
- **MER > ROAS**: always cross-reference platform ROAS with MER (total revenue / total spend)
- **Never trust platform-reported ROAS alone** — overclaims 20-40%

## Output Format

Structure your audit as:

1. **Executive Summary** — Overall health score, grade, top 3 findings
2. **Platform Scores** — Per-platform health score with category breakdown
3. **Critical Findings** — All FAIL items with severity Critical/High
4. **Quick Wins** — Critical/High fixes that take <15 minutes
5. **Detailed Audit** — Category-by-category results table (PASS/WARNING/FAIL)
6. **Budget Recommendations** — Allocation changes based on findings
7. **90-Day Action Plan** — Prioritized roadmap (Week 1-2, Week 3-4, Month 2-3)

# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

## [0.1.3.0] - 2026-03-20

### Added
- **Variation Builder** — Hierarchical product grouping system for managing Amazon product families across SEO, A+, PPC, and ads pipelines
  - 4 new database tables: `variations`, `variation_groups`, `variation_tags`, `variation_tag_assignments`
  - 2 new FK columns on `master`: `variation_ref`, `group_ref` (ON DELETE SET NULL)
  - 8 API endpoints: CRUD for variations/groups/tags, bulk assign, and auto-detect from Amazon variation data
  - List view (`/variations`) with client filtering, search, and create modal
  - Detail builder view (`/variations/[id]`) with collapsible groups, tag management, bulk toolbar, inline editing, and auto-detect from Amazon VariationThemeName
  - Mobile-aware: desktop-only builder with graceful mobile fallback
- **Sidebar navigation** — Variations link added under Catalog section
- **Alert Dialog** — New shadcn/ui component for destructive action confirmations

### Changed
- Variation grouping upgraded from flat `variation_group` varchar to relational hierarchy (exclusive groups + cross-cutting tags)
- SEO Wizard catalog API with variation group support and card-based layout
- Portal finance page synced with hub — Sankey chart and transaction detail views
- Product family component updated with variation group badges and improved layout

### Fixed
- Transaction View support for derived settlement periods
- All Statements table header alignment with data rows
- Fallback for same-date Redshift entries in All Statements tab

## [0.1.2.0] - 2026-03-19

### Added
- **Content Control Center** (SEO Manager upgrade) — 4-tier card layout with content previews, quality score badges, export tracking, version timeline with diff modal, and bulk operations (approve/export/reassign)
  - 5 new components: `ContentPreview`, `DiffModal`, `ExportHistory`, `VersionTimeline`, `BulkActionBar`
  - Enriched projects API with 4-query bulk fetch (projects + content + quality scores + exports)
  - Quality scores API (`/api/seo/quality`) for persisting and retrieving audit scores
  - Bulk operations API (`/api/seo/projects/bulk`) for approve, export, and reassign actions
  - `useOutsideClick` hook for dropdown dismissal
- **SEO Dashboard** — Client health cards, team workload tracking, and pipeline funnel visualization
  - Dashboard API (`/api/seo/dashboard`) with aggregated metrics
  - Section dots component for phase progress visualization
  - Avatar circle component for team member display
- **SEO Client Detail Pages** (`/seo/clients/[clientId]`) with per-client project views
- **Hub Finance Reports** — Internal finance section with client selector, custom date range pickers, and Redshift settlement data
  - Settlement period detection (real ranges + derived biweekly from disbursement dates)
  - Beginning balance, de-duplicated reserves, and correct expense categorization
- **Client Portal Finance Section** — Settlement statement view with period selector and net proceeds calculation
- **Revenue Attribution Pipeline** — Cron handler (`/api/cron/impact`), client scoping, and ImpactCard embed
- **Debug Finance Route** — Redshift data comparison endpoint for settlement reconciliation (admin/editor auth required)
- **Test framework** — Vitest + Testing Library bootstrapped with 15 tests covering all new components
- Calendar UI component (`src/components/ui/calendar.tsx`)

### Changed
- SEO Pipeline page refactored with improved loading resilience and middot rendering
- Portal shell and home page updated with finance navigation
- Middleware updated with new route patterns
- Database schema extended with `seo_quality_scores` and `seo_exports` tables

### Fixed
- Removed hardcoded debug key bypass in finance debug route (security)
- Inactive client names now resolve correctly on SEO Dashboard
- Settlement period derivation handles same-date-only Redshift data

## [0.1.1.0] - 2026-03-19

### Added
- **Client Portal Finance Section** — New settlement statement view with period selector, net proceeds calculation, and detailed transaction breakdown
  - Real-time data from Redshift (sales, expenses, refunds, advertising fees, account reserves)
  - Settlement period selector to view historical statements
  - Net proceeds waterfall showing itemized income and deductions
  - Budget pacing indicator for ad spend tracking
- API endpoint `/api/portal/finance` returning statement data, available periods, and budget metrics
- Finance routes in portal client area (`/portal/finance`)
- Integration with Intentwise IntentwiseID mapping from BigQuery AAC table

# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Commands

```bash
# Development
PORT=3000 npm run dev

# Build & lint
npm run build
npm run lint

# Database (Drizzle + PostgreSQL via Supabase)
npm run db:generate    # Generate migration from schema changes
npm run db:migrate     # Run pending migrations
npm run db:push        # Push schema directly (dev only)
npm run db:studio      # Open Drizzle Studio GUI

# Data scripts
npm run create-admin       # Create admin user
npm run import-bq          # Import products from BigQuery
npm run import-aac         # Import AAC client data
npm run generate-columns   # Regenerate column registry from DB
npm run seed-team          # Seed team members
npm run backfill-activity  # Backfill activity log entries

# Testing (Vitest + Testing Library)
npm run test               # Run all tests
npm run test:watch         # Watch mode
```

## Architecture

**Next.js 16 App Router** with React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, and shadcn/ui (Radix). Path alias: `@/*` → `./src/*`.

### Auth & Roles

NextAuth v5 (beta) with Google OAuth. Middleware (`src/middleware.ts`) enforces auth on all routes. Five roles: `admin`, `editor`, `viewer`, `client`, `pending`. Client-role users are confined to `/portal/*`; pending users redirect to `/auth/register`.

### Data Layer

- **ORM**: Drizzle ORM with `postgres` driver. Connection pooling cached on `globalThis` for HMR safety.
- **DB**: PostgreSQL (Supabase), schema at `src/lib/db/schema.ts`, migrations in `drizzle/migrations/`.
- **BigQuery**: Read (import) and write (publish) via `@google-cloud/bigquery`. Publish uses `WRITE_TRUNCATE` (full table replace) to `amazon-data-461918.1o8Hub.Master`.
- **Products table**: Hybrid schema — ~30 indexed core columns + categorized JSONB blobs for ~940 remaining columns + `raw_column_values` JSONB for zero-data-loss.

### Key Domains

| Domain | Routes | Description |
|--------|--------|-------------|
| Products | `/products`, `/api/products` | CRUD, inline editing, column registry with 972 attributes |
| Variations | `/variations`, `/api/variations` | Hierarchical product grouping: exclusive groups (FK) + cross-cutting tags (junction). Auto-detect from Amazon VariationThemeName. Builder UI with bulk assign. |
| A+ Content | `/aplus`, `/api/aplus` | Module editor (up to 7 modules/product), image slots, Google Drive upload, Markup.io-style comments |
| SEO Pipeline | `/seo`, `/api/seo` | 6-phase pipeline (S1-S6): intake → keywords → reviews → Rufus Q&A → COSMO maps → content generation. Includes Content Control Center (`/seo/manager`), SEO Dashboard, and per-client detail views (`/seo/clients/[clientId]`) |
| Finance | `/finances`, `/portal/finance`, `/api/portal/finance` | Hub finance reports (Redshift settlement data, Sankey flow) and client portal finance views |
| Amazon Sync | `/amazon-sync`, `/api/amazon-sync` | SP-API + Rainforest comparisons, discrepancy tracking |
| Portal | `/portal` | Client-facing views: A+ approval, reports, sales, finance statements |
| Admin | `/admin`, `/api/admin` | User management, event log, AI config |
| Publishing | `/publish`, `/api/publish` | Dirty-row tracking, BigQuery write-back |
| Reports/Export | `/reports`, `/export` | PDF/XLSX/DOCX generation, client reports |

### External Services

- **Google Drive**: File upload/folder management via `src/lib/drive-client.ts` and `src/lib/drive-upload.ts`
- **Anthropic AI**: Claude API for alt-text generation, video titles. Config split: `src/lib/ai-config.ts` (client-safe constants) and `src/lib/ai-config.server.ts` (server-side with DB lookups)
- **Rainforest API / Firecrawl**: Amazon product data scraping
- **Amazon SP-API**: Per-client credentials stored in `sp_api_credentials` table
- **Redshift**: Intentwise analytics integration
- **Resend**: Transactional email

### Environment

All env vars documented in `.env.example`. GCP private key must be set via Vercel CLI (not dashboard) due to multiline handling: `npx vercel env add GCP_PRIVATE_KEY production < key.pem`.

### Deployment

Vercel (auto-deploy from `main`). Production URL: `https://1o8hub.vercel.app`. Git author for deploys: `Manu <manuel.lancharro@1o8.agency>`.

## Design System

Always read `DESIGN.md` before making any visual or UI decisions. All font choices, colors, spacing, and aesthetic direction are defined there. Do not deviate without explicit user approval. In QA mode, flag any code that doesn't match DESIGN.md.

## gstack

Use the `/browse` skill from gstack for all web browsing. Never use `mcp__claude-in-chrome__*` tools.

Available skills: `/plan-ceo-review`, `/plan-eng-review`, `/plan-design-review`, `/design-consultation`, `/review`, `/ship`, `/browse`, `/qa`, `/qa-only`, `/qa-design-review`, `/setup-browser-cookies`, `/retro`, `/document-release`

# Design System — 1o8Hub

## Product Context
- **What this is:** Internal agency platform for managing Amazon product listings — SEO pipeline, A+ content, product catalog, client portal, revenue attribution
- **Who it's for:** 3-5 agency team members (managers, SEO specialists) and their clients (portal view)
- **Space/industry:** Amazon marketplace services / agency tooling
- **Project type:** Web app / dashboard (Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui)

## Aesthetic Direction
- **Direction:** Industrial/Utilitarian — data-dense, function-first, professional
- **Decoration level:** Minimal — typography and layout do the work, no gradients or illustrations
- **Mood:** Competent and calm. A tool that respects your time. Warm neutrals prevent clinical sterility. Gold accent adds agency branding without being flashy.
- **Reference sites:** None (internal tool, designed from scratch)

## Typography
- **Display/Hero:** Geist Sans (`font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)]`) — tracking-tighter for large headings
- **Body:** System default (Geist Sans inherited) — clean, modern, excellent at small sizes
- **UI/Labels:** Same as body at `text-[10px] font-bold` for micro-labels, `text-xs` for standard labels
- **Data/Tables:** Geist Sans with `tabular-nums` for aligned numbers
- **Code:** Geist Mono
- **Loading:** Next.js `next/font/local` (Geist is bundled)
- **Scale:**
  - `text-[8px]` — micro badges (status pills)
  - `text-[9px]` — phase badges
  - `text-[10px]` — micro-labels, metadata
  - `text-xs` (12px) — standard labels, body small
  - `text-sm` (14px) — body, card titles, buttons
  - `text-base` (16px) — primary body
  - `text-4xl` / `text-5xl` — page headings (with `tracking-tighter`)

## Color

### Approach: Restrained
One warm gold accent + warm stone neutrals. Color is rare and meaningful.

### Brand
| Token | Light | Dark | Usage |
|-------|-------|------|-------|
| `--brand` | `#E8A700` | `#F8BF1C` | Primary accent, buttons, links, active states |
| `--brand-hover` | `#d49800` | `#e5ae18` | Hover state for brand elements |
| `--brand-foreground` | `#111` | `#111` | Text on brand backgrounds |
| `--brand-glow` | `rgba(232,167,0,0.15)` | `rgba(248,191,29,0.12)` | Box shadow glow on primary CTAs |

### Semantic
| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| `--brand-green` | `#34C759` | Success, approved, positive scores (80+) |
| `--brand-red` | `#FF5C5F` | Error, destructive, negative scores (<60) |
| `--brand-yellow` | `#FAC800` | Warning, in-progress, moderate scores (60-80) |
| `--brand-orange` | `#F8BF1C` | Accent variation |

### Surfaces
| Token | Light | Dark |
|-------|-------|------|
| `--background` | `#F7F5F1` (warm linen) | `#05070B` (near-black slate) |
| `--card` | `#ffffff` | `oklch(0.18 0.012 250)` |
| `--sidebar` | `#F7F5F1` | `#05070B` |
| `--muted-foreground` | `oklch(0.55 0.01 250)` | `oklch(0.55 0.012 250)` |
| `--border` | `oklch(0 0 0 / 8%)` | `oklch(1 0 0 / 10%)` |

### Tailwind Badge Colors (component-level)
| State | Light | Dark |
|-------|-------|------|
| Approved/Green | `bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-300` | `bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30` |
| Active/Amber | `bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-300` | `bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/30` |
| Pending/Stone | `bg-stone-200 text-stone-500 border-stone-300` | `bg-zinc-800/50 text-zinc-500 border-zinc-800` |
| Error/Red | `bg-red-50 text-red-600 border-red-300` | `bg-red-500/10 text-red-400 border-red-500/30` |
| Selection | `bg-amber-50 border-amber-300/40` | `bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500/20` |

## Spacing
- **Base unit:** 4px
- **Density:** Comfortable (agency users on large screens, but data-dense views)
- **Scale:** 2xs(2px) xs(4px) sm(8px) md(16px) lg(24px) xl(32px) 2xl(48px) 3xl(64px)
- **Card padding:** `p-5` (20px)
- **Card gap:** `space-y-2.5` (10px) between cards, `space-y-6` (24px) between client groups
- **Section gap:** `gap-4` (16px) for inline elements, `mb-4` between sections

## Layout
- **Approach:** Grid-disciplined — strict alignment, predictable structure
- **Grid:** Single column content area within sidebar layout
- **Sidebar:** Fixed left, collapsible, 256px wide
- **Max content width:** Fluid within sidebar (no max-width constraint)
- **Border radius:**
  - `rounded-md` (6px) — inputs, small badges, nested elements
  - `rounded-lg` (8px) — buttons, dropdowns, nested cards
  - `rounded-xl` (12px) — primary cards, modals, panels
  - `rounded-full` — avatars, pills

## Motion
- **Approach:** Minimal-functional — only transitions that aid comprehension
- **Easing:** `transition-colors`, `transition-all` (Tailwind defaults)
- **Duration:** Micro (~150ms for hover states), card entrance uses `animate-card-enter` with staggered delay
- **Patterns:**
  - Card hover: `hover:border-stone-300 hover:shadow-md transition-all`
  - Button hover: `hover:bg-brand-hover` with `transition-colors`
  - Card entrance: staggered `animationDelay: ${index * 50}ms`
  - Modal: `backdrop-blur-sm` backdrop fade
  - No scroll animations, no spring physics, no decorative motion

## Component Patterns

### Cards
```
rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white
hover:border-stone-300 hover:shadow-md transition-all
card-glow animate-card-enter
dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 dark:hover:border-zinc-700
```

### Badges
```
rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold
```
Use semantic color table above for state variants.

### Micro-labels
```
text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground
```

### Section Headers
```
text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-brand
```

### Modals
```
fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center
bg-black/40 dark:bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm
```
Modal content: `rounded-xl border bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl dark:bg-zinc-900`

### Primary Button
```
rounded-lg bg-brand px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold
text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover
shadow-[0_0_16px_-4px_var(--brand-glow)]
```

### Ghost/Secondary Button
```
rounded-lg border border-stone-300 px-3 py-2 text-xs
text-muted-foreground hover:bg-stone-50
dark:border-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800
```

### Inputs
```
rounded-md border border-stone-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm
text-foreground focus:border-amber-500 focus:outline-none
dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300
```

## Shared Components
- `SectionDots` (`src/components/seo/section-dots.tsx`) — S1-S6 phase visualization
- `AvatarCircle` (`src/components/seo/avatar-circle.tsx`) — User avatar with fallback initials

## Decisions Log
| Date | Decision | Rationale |
|------|----------|-----------|
| 2026-03-19 | Initial design system codified | Formalized implicit system from existing codebase via /design-consultation. No creative redesign — documentation of what exists. |
| 2026-03-19 | Quality badge thresholds: 80+/60-80/<60 | Maps to existing emerald/amber/red badge semantics. Decided in /plan-design-review. |
| 2026-03-19 | Bulk mode via header toggle | Gmail/Notion pattern — checkboxes hidden by default, activated by "Select" button. Decided in /plan-design-review. |
| 2026-03-19 | Inline diff (not side-by-side) | Amazon content is long text — inline with red strikethrough / green underline is more readable. Decided in /plan-design-review. |

# TODOS

## P2 — Strategic

### AI Copilot Layer
Embed Claude as a conversational copilot across 1o8Hub — persistent chat sidebar that understands product catalog, generates A+ content, analyzes sales trends, drafts bullet points.

**Why:** Transforms platform from "tool with AI features" to "AI-native platform." Hardest moat to replicate.
**Pros:** Differentiation, user delight, leverages existing 9 Claude integrations.
**Cons:** L effort (2-3 weeks), prompt engineering complexity, per-query cost.
**Context:** Build after Revenue Attribution proves ROI to clients. Copilot can reference impact data in its recommendations.
**Effort:** L | **Priority:** P2 | **Depends on:** Revenue Attribution
**Source:** CEO Review 2026-03-17

### Amazon SP-API Write-Back
Direct publishing from 1o8Hub to Amazon Seller Central via SP-API. Approved content changes go live on Amazon without leaving the platform.

**Why:** Closes the content management loop. Makes 1o8Hub the single source of truth, not a staging area.
**Pros:** Eliminates manual Seller Central work, enables detect→fix→publish→verify workflow.
**Cons:** L effort, Amazon SP-API write approval process, throttling, error recovery complexity.
**Context:** SP-API read integration already exists with per-client credentials. Write is the natural extension.
**Effort:** L | **Priority:** P2 | **Depends on:** Nothing (independent)
**Source:** CEO Review 2026-03-17

### A+ Content Impact Triggers
Auto-create impact snapshots when A+ content changes are saved (approve, reject, publish). Currently only product edits and bulk edits call `createImpactSnapshot()`. A+ changes — the agency's primary content output — don't trigger impact tracking at all.

**Why:** A+ content is the main value 1o8 delivers to clients. Without impact triggers on A+ changes, the Revenue Attribution feature misses the most important content changes.
**Pros:** Captures the highest-signal content changes, makes impact data meaningful for client conversations.
**Cons:** S effort, need to instrument A+ save/approve/reject endpoints.
**Context:** `createImpactSnapshot()` in `src/lib/impact-snapshots.ts` already handles the logic. Just need to call it from A+ endpoints (e.g., `src/app/api/aplus/[productId]/bulk-status/route.ts`).
**Effort:** S | **Priority:** P2 | **Depends on:** Revenue Attribution (shipped)
**Source:** CEO Review 2026-03-18

## P3 — Hardening

### Runtime Variation Validation on Write Paths
Add Zod schema validation on the product edit API endpoint (`/api/products/[id]`) for the `variations` JSONB blob. Currently the `VariationData` type is compile-time only — if raw JSON with wrong casing (e.g., `color` instead of `Color`) is POSTed, it persists unchecked.

**Why:** Prevents casing drift after the PascalCase normalization migration. Defense in depth beyond TypeScript.
**Pros:** Catches bad data at the API boundary, not after it's in the DB.
**Cons:** XS effort, but low risk since only internal tools (BQ import mapper, product edit UI) write to this blob.
**Context:** The import mapper (`src/lib/product-mapper.ts`) already controls casing via `COLUMN_GROUPS`. The edit UI sends back what it received. Risk of wrong casing is near-zero, but validation closes the gap.
**Effort:** XS | **Priority:** P3 | **Depends on:** Canonical VariationData type (this PR)
**Source:** Eng Review 2026-03-20

## Completed

### SEO Quality Score Trends
Track S6 compliance audit scores over time per client. Show trend lines on the SEO Dashboard and per-client detail pages. Requires storing historical snapshots of audit scores.

**Completed:** v0.1.2.0 (2026-03-19) — Quality scores persist in `seo_quality_scores` table with 7-category breakdown. Displayed as badges in Content Control Center. API at `/api/seo/quality` for GET/POST.

# CEO Plan: Department-Based Section Architecture

Generated by /plan-ceo-review on 2026-03-18
Branch: 1o8-Marketplace/project-sections | Mode: SELECTIVE EXPANSION
Repo: 1o8-Marketplace/1o8Hub

## Vision

### 10x Check
Align the entire app architecture to the company org chart. Each department (SEO, Design, PPC, Catalog, Finances) becomes a first-class workspace with its own landing page, scoped activity feed, and hierarchical permissions. Cross-department connections are visible, not hidden. The app IS the company — navigating 1o8Hub feels like walking through the office.

## Two App Surfaces
- **1o8Hub** — internal, company members manage Amazon products
- **1o8Portal** — client-facing, isolated from Hub

## Department Mapping

| Department | Features | New? |
|-----------|----------|------|
| **SEO** | SEO Manager | No |
| **Design** | A+ Content, Files | No |
| **PPC** | Sales Summary | No (moved from Sales section) |
| **Catalog** | Amazon Sync, Attributes | No |
| **Finances** | Finance Reports (cross-client, internal) | Yes |
| **Clients** | Client Summary, Reports, Client Portal | No |
| **Calendar** | Standalone top-level | No |
| **Admin** | Activity, Import, Sync & Export, Users, SP-API, Observability, Event Logs, Issue Reports, AI Config, Data Sync | No |

## Architecture

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                         1o8Hub App                               │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐       │
│  │   SEO    │  │  Design  │  │   PPC    │  │ Catalog  │       │
│  │----------│  │----------│  │----------│  │----------│       │
│  │ Landing  │  │ Landing  │  │ Landing  │  │ Landing  │       │
│  │ SEO Mgr  │  │ A+ Edit  │  │ Sales    │  │ Amz Sync │       │
│  │          │  │ Files    │  │ Summary  │  │ Attribs  │       │
│  └──────────┘  └──────────┘  └──────────┘  └──────────┘       │
│  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐                     │
│  │ Finances │  │ Clients  │  │  Admin   │                     │
│  │----------│  │----------│  │----------│                     │
│  │ Landing  │  │ Summary  │  │ Activity │  ┌──────────┐       │
│  │ Finance  │  │ Reports  │  │ Import   │  │ Calendar │       │
│  │ Reports  │  │ Portal   │  │ Publish  │  │(top-lvl) │       │
│  └──────────┘  └──────────┘  │ Users    │  └──────────┘       │
│                               │ SP-API   │                     │
│  ┌─────────────────────────┐  │ Observ.  │                     │
│  │  Cross-Dept Connections │  │ Logs     │                     │
│  │  A+ ←→ Catalog          │  │ Issues   │                     │
│  │  Sales ←→ Catalog       │  │ AI Cfg   │                     │
│  │  Reports ←→ Finances    │  │ DataSync │                     │
│  └─────────────────────────┘  └──────────┘                     │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                      1o8Portal (isolated)                       │
│  Client A+ approval │ Reports │ Sales │ Finance                │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Permission Model (Hierarchical)

```
CURRENT:  allowedSections: ["seo", "aplus", "sales"]  (flat)

NEW:      allowedSections: ["seo", "design", "ppc"]   (department-level)
          OR granular:     ["seo", "design.aplus"]     (subsection-level)

Resolution: canAccess("design.aplus") checks:
  1. "design" in allowedSections (department grant)  → YES
  2. "design.aplus" in allowedSections (subsection)  → YES
  3. isAdmin                                          → YES
```

Shared utility: `src/lib/permissions.ts` (used by both sidebar and API routes).

## Scope Decisions

| # | Proposal | Effort | Decision | Reasoning |
|---|----------|--------|----------|-----------|
| 1 | Section Landing Pages | M | ACCEPTED | Turns departments from nav groups into workspaces |
| 2 | Hierarchical Permissions | S | ACCEPTED | Natural extension for department-based access control |
| 3 | Cross-Department Badges | S | ACCEPTED | Makes subsection connections visible in UI |
| 4 | Finances Section Bootstrap | M | ACCEPTED | New department needs at least a landing page |
| 5 | Department-Scoped Activity Feed | S | ACCEPTED | Each team sees only their relevant changes |

## Implementation Order

1. Extract `canAccess` to shared `src/lib/permissions.ts`
2. Reorganize sidebar sections to match department structure
3. Add hierarchical permission resolution (dot-notation)
4. Add department landing pages (one per department)
5. Add cross-department badges
6. Bootstrap Finances section with cross-client finance view
7. Add activity feed department filter

## Security Notes
- Finance reports gated behind `finances` department permission
- Hierarchical permissions backward-compatible (flat strings still work)
- Cross-department badges respect access control (tooltip if no access)

## NOT in scope
- Moving file/route directories to match departments (too disruptive)
- Department-level notification preferences (future)
- Department budgets/headcount tracking (different system)

# CEO Plan: 1o8Hub Product Expansion

Generated by /plan-ceo-review on 2026-03-17
Branch: main | Mode: SCOPE EXPANSION
Repo: 1o8-Marketplace/1o8Hub

## Vision

### 10x Check
The 10x version transforms 1o8Hub from an internal ops tool for 1o8 Agency into the operating system for Amazon sellers. Brand managers sign up, connect Seller Central, and within 30 minutes have auto-imported products, AI-generated A+ content, SEO audits, live sales dashboards, and one-click publishing back to Amazon. Not a tool for your agency — the platform for Amazon commerce.

### Platonic Ideal
Opening 1o8Hub feels like having a senior Amazon optimization consultant 24/7. Conversational instead of form-based — tell the AI about your product and it fills out 972 fields with citations from Amazon style guides and competitor analysis. Proactive — the system notices ACOS climbing before you do and drafts recommendations. One-click publishing. Client self-service with guardrails. Revenue attribution that proves ROI.

## Scope Decisions

| # | Proposal | Effort | Decision | Reasoning |
|---|----------|--------|----------|-----------|
| 1 | AI Copilot Layer | L | DEFERRED | High value but high effort; build on top of the 4 accepted items first |
| 2 | Amazon SP-API Write-Back | L | DEFERRED | High risk (Amazon approval process); natural next step after these ship |
| 3 | Revenue Attribution & Impact Tracking | M | ACCEPTED | Highest-value data point for client retention and upselling |
| 4 | Client Self-Service Portal Upgrade | M | ACCEPTED | Reduces ops overhead, makes clients feel ownership |
| 5 | Unified Data Layer | M-L | SKIPPED | Current Redshift (Intentwise) + BigQuery (internal) split is the correct architecture |
| 6 | Observability & Cost Dashboard | M | ACCEPTED | Flying blind on costs/failures; critical as client count grows |
| 7 | Cmd+K Command Palette | S | ACCEPTED | Tiny effort, huge UX win for daily power users |

## Accepted Scope (added to this plan)
- Revenue Attribution: content change → before/after sales snapshot → impact card on product page + portal
- Client Portal Upgrade: approve/reject A+ content, inline comments, file upload, activity feed
- Observability Dashboard: Claude usage/cost tracking, external service health, error log, data freshness
- Cmd+K Command Palette: global search across products, clients, ASINs, SEO projects

## Deferred to TODOS.md
- AI Copilot Layer: conversational AI sidebar embedded across all workflows (L effort, build after attribution proves ROI)
- Amazon SP-API Write-Back: direct publish to Amazon from Hub (L effort, high risk from Amazon approval)

## Additional Decisions Made During Review
- Redshift error handling: add try/catch wrapper to queryRedshift() with graceful fallback (10 min fix)
- Revenue attribution trigger: piggyback on existing sales dashboard loads (zero new infra)
- Test framework: bootstrap Vitest with 5-10 critical path tests
- Redshift pool: bump max connections from 5 to 10
- Data architecture: keep Redshift (Intentwise-managed) + BigQuery (internal) split as-is

## Architecture Notes
- All expansions fit cleanly into existing architecture
- No new external dependencies required
- Revenue Attribution needs new `content_impact_snapshots` table
- Observability needs new `api_usage_log` table
- Portal upgrade extends existing role system and section access controls
- Cmd+K is pure frontend + one API endpoint

# CEO Plan: SEO Dashboard

Generated by /plan-ceo-review on 2026-03-18
Branch: main | Mode: SCOPE EXPANSION
Repo: 1o8-Marketplace/1o8Hub

## Vision

### 10x Check
SEO Mission Control — a manager opens /seo Monday morning and in 10 seconds knows: which clients need attention, who on the team is doing what, what shipped last week, what's next. Every pixel earns its space. Zero clicks to answer "how's our SEO work going?"

### Platonic Ideal
A control tower that feels information-dense but not overwhelming. Stale projects surface automatically. Team workload is visible. The phase funnel reveals bottlenecks. Recently completed work gets celebrated. Clicking any dimension (client, team member, phase) filters the entire view instantly.

## Scope Decisions

| # | Proposal | Effort | Decision | Reasoning |
|---|----------|--------|----------|-----------|
| 1 | Hero Metrics Row (KPIs at top) | S | ACCEPTED | Answers "how much work?" in 2 seconds |
| 2 | Client Health Cards with Aggregate Progress | M | ACCEPTED | Core ask — per-client SEO status summary |
| 3 | Team Workload Strip | S | ACCEPTED | Management visibility into assignment distribution |
| 4 | Phase Funnel Visualization | S | ACCEPTED | Reveals pipeline bottlenecks instantly |
| 5 | Stale Project Alerts | S | ACCEPTED | Prevents silent project abandonment |
| 6 | Recent Activity Feed | M | ACCEPTED | Shows momentum and team activity |
| 7 | Recently Completed Section | S | ACCEPTED | Positive reinforcement + throughput visibility |
| 8 | Quick-Filter by Assignee | S | ACCEPTED | Near-zero marginal cost, interactive filtering |
| 9 | Sidebar Nav Update | S | ACCEPTED | Required for route restructure |
| 10 | Per-Client SEO Detail Pages | M | ACCEPTED | Deep drill-down per client (upgraded from Approach A to C) |

## Accepted Scope (added to this plan)
- Hero metrics row (total projects, completed this month, avg completion rate, total ASINs, exports delivered)
- Client health cards with aggregate progress bars, color-coded status, mini phase breakdown
- Client card click → /seo/clients/[clientId] detail page
- Per-client detail page: full project list, phase breakdown, export history, "Open in Manager" link
- Team workload strip with avatars, project counts, relative load bars, click-to-filter
- Phase funnel visualization showing pipeline distribution across S1-S6 + completed
- Stale project alerts (7+ days without phase approval, using max(s1-s6_approved_at))
- Recent activity feed (last 10-15 actions from phase approvals + exports)
- Recently completed section (projects done in last 30 days with time-to-completion)
- Quick-filter by assignee from team strip (toggle on/off)
- Sidebar nav update: SEO Dashboard + SEO Manager + SEO Config

## Deferred to TODOS.md
- Quality Score Trends (needs historical score snapshots, new table + cron)

## Key Decisions
- Stale detection: based on max(s1_approved_at ... s6_approved_at), NOT updatedAt
- Client cards only show clients with 1+ SEO projects
- Dashboard shows only clients with SEO projects (empty clients filtered out)
- Shared components extracted: SectionDots, AvatarCircle → src/components/seo/

## Implementation Approach
Approach A→C hybrid: Dashboard + Route Restructure + Per-Client Detail
- New /seo/page.tsx = SEO Dashboard
- Move current /seo/page.tsx to /seo/manager/page.tsx = SEO Manager
- New /seo/clients/[clientId]/page.tsx = Per-Client Detail
- New API endpoints:
  - GET /api/seo/dashboard (aggregate metrics, clients, team, funnel, stale, activity, completed)
  - GET /api/seo/clients/[clientId] (client detail with projects, phases, exports)
- SEO Manager gains ?client query param support for pre-filtering
- Update sidebar nav in app-sidebar.tsx

## Architecture

```
                    ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
                    │         /seo (Dashboard)             │
                    │  ┌──────┬──────┬──────┬──────┐      │
                    │  │Hero  │Team  │Phase │Stale │      │
                    │  │Stats │Strip │Funnel│Alerts│      │
                    │  └──────┴──────┴──────┴──────┘      │
                    │  ┌──────────────────────────┐       │
                    │  │ Client Health Cards Grid  │──────┼──▶ /seo/clients/[id]
                    │  └──────────────────────────┘       │
                    │  ┌──────────┬───────────────┐       │
                    │  │ Activity │  Recently      │      │
                    │  │ Feed     │  Completed     │      │
                    │  └──────────┴───────────────┘       │
                    └────────────┬────────────────────────┘
                                 │
                    GET /api/seo/dashboard (new)
                                 │
                    ┌────────────▼────────────────────────┐
                    │  seo_projects + seo_asins +          │
                    │  seo_exports + users                  │
                    └──────────────────────────────────────┘

  /seo/clients/[clientId] → GET /api/seo/clients/[clientId]
  /seo/manager (existing page, moved) + ?client=X filter support
  /seo/config (unchanged)
  /seo/[id]/* (unchanged)
```

## Files to Create/Modify
- CREATE: src/app/seo/page.tsx (new dashboard)
- MOVE: src/app/seo/page.tsx → src/app/seo/manager/page.tsx
- CREATE: src/app/seo/clients/[clientId]/page.tsx
- CREATE: src/app/api/seo/dashboard/route.ts
- CREATE: src/app/api/seo/clients/[clientId]/route.ts
- EXTRACT: src/components/seo/section-dots.tsx (from old page.tsx)
- EXTRACT: src/components/seo/avatar-circle.tsx (from old page.tsx)
- MODIFY: src/components/layout/app-sidebar.tsx (nav update)
- MODIFY: src/app/seo/manager/page.tsx (add ?client filter, import shared components)

# CEO Plan: SEO Manager → Content Control Center

Generated by /plan-ceo-review on 2026-03-19
Branch: feat/impact-attribution-completion | Mode: SCOPE EXPANSION
Repo: 1o8-Marketplace/1o8Hub

## Vision

### 10x Check
The SEO Manager becomes a Content Control Center — think GitHub for Amazon SEO. Every piece of content has a version timeline. You can diff any two versions. Quality scores are tracked over time. Export history shows exactly what went to the client and when. Bulk operations let you approve/export entire client batches at once.

### Platonic Ideal
A manager opens the SEO Manager Monday morning. The view shows their clients in a grid. Red badges on clients where quality is dropping. Green badges where everything is current. They click into "Trejo's Tacos" and see all 11 projects with a content preview — the title, bullet points, description right there, no clicking into each project. They spot that version 3 of the Mug project has a compliance word flagged. They click "Compare Versions" and see a side-by-side diff — v2 vs v3. They approve it, select 5 projects, hit "Export All" and a Google Doc is generated. The export is logged with timestamp and content snapshot.

## Scope Decisions

| # | Proposal | Effort | Decision | Reasoning |
|---|----------|--------|----------|-----------|
| 1 | Content Preview Grid | S | ACCEPTED | Core value — content visibility without drilling in |
| 2 | Version Timeline & Diff View | M | ACCEPTED | Explicitly requested, BQ data already exists |
| 3 | Quality Score Persistence & Display | M | ACCEPTED | Boils the lake, unlocks P3 TODO |
| 4 | Export History & Tracking | S | ACCEPTED | Table exists empty, 30 lines to wire up |
| 5 | Live vs Written Comparison | M | DEFERRED | Blocked on SP-API connection |
| 6 | Bulk Operations | S | ACCEPTED | Small effort, big agency productivity gain |

## Accepted Scope (added to this plan)
- Content preview in project cards (title, bullet snippet, description from BQ)
- Version timeline per ASIN with side-by-side diff view (red/green highlights)
- New `seo_quality_scores` table, persist on S6 audit, quality badges in Manager
- Quality trend sparklines on Dashboard + client detail pages
- Wire `seo_exports` table, export history panel, "last exported" badges
- Dashboard "Exports Sent" metric uses real export count
- Bulk select + approve/export/reassign action bar

## Deferred to TODOS.md
- Live vs Written Comparison (blocked on SP-API connection — implement when SP-API write-back ships)

## Key Decisions
- Manager keeps current route `/seo/manager` — no new routes needed
- Content previews from Supabase `seo_asins.generatedContent` (not BQ) — enriched in projects API response
- Version diff computed client-side (`diff` npm library, `diffWords()`)
- Quality scores stored in new Supabase table, not BQ (need fast reads for badges)
- Bulk operations use single polymorphic endpoint with `action` field
- Export tracking insert-after-upload (no phantom records on failure)
- Bulk export uses `Promise.allSettled` with `p-limit(5)` concurrency
- Projects API uses 4-query bulk + JS join (avoids N+1)
- New features extracted to `src/components/seo/manager/` (keeps page.tsx as orchestrator)
- `useOutsideClick` hook extracted in this PR (DRY — 5 usages)

## Design Spec (from /plan-design-review)

### Card Layout — 4-Tier Hierarchy

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ [☐]  Project Name                    [Assignee] [S4 Rufus] [⋮] │  TIER 1: Identity
│      Brand · Created Mar 1                                      │
│                                                                 │
│ ●●●●○○  S1 S2 S3 S4 S5 S6     [Quality: 82] [Exported ✓]     │  TIER 2: Status
│                                                                 │
│ Title: "Trejo's Tacos Ceramic Mug — 16oz Dishwasher Safe..."   │  TIER 3: Content
│ B1: "Premium ceramic construction with hand-painted Trejo's..." │  (always visible)
│ Desc: "Enjoy your morning coffee in style with this..."         │
│                                                                 │
│ ▸ Versions (3)    ▸ Export History (2)                          │  TIER 4: Drill-down
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

- Content preview always visible (CEO vision: "no clicking into each project")
- Versions + Export History are accordion sections (collapsed by default)
- Bulk checkbox appears only in "Select" mode (toggle button in header)
- Quality sparkline: 40x16px inline SVG next to quality badge, tooltip on hover

### Quality Badge Thresholds
- Score 80+: `bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-500/10` (green)
- Score 60-80: `bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-500/20` (yellow)
- Score <60: `bg-red-50 text-red-600 dark:bg-red-500/10` (red)
- No score: no badge shown (graceful absence, not "N/A")

### Export Badge
- Never exported: `bg-stone-100 text-stone-500` → "Never exported" (muted)
- Exported: `bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700` → "Exported ✓" with relative date

### Version Timeline
- Stacked version cards (not horizontal dot timeline) — functional over decorative
- Each card: `v3 — 3 fields changed — Mar 15` with `Compare ↔` button between adjacent pairs
- Nested cards use `rounded-lg` (smaller than parent `rounded-xl`)

### Diff Modal
- Inline diff (not side-by-side) — Amazon content is long text
- Red strikethrough for removals (`bg-red-100/50 line-through`)
- Green underline for additions (`bg-emerald-100/50 underline`)
- Shows only changed fields — unchanged collapsed with "N fields unchanged" summary
- Full-screen sheet on mobile, centered modal on desktop
- `role="dialog" aria-labelledby="diff-title"`

### Bulk Mode
- Activated by "Select" button in header (next to "+ New Project")
- Card selection: amber-50 bg tint + visible checkbox (44px touch target)
- Bulk bar: fixed bottom, `shadow-lg` upward, same card border tokens
- Actions: Approve | Export All | Reassign — disabled until 1+ selected
- Export progress: "Exporting 3/5..." with per-project status on partial failure
- Keyboard: Tab through cards, Space toggle, Shift+Click range, Escape deselect all

### Interaction State Matrix

| Feature | Loading | Empty | Error | Success | Partial |
|---------|---------|-------|-------|---------|---------|
| Content Preview | Shimmer (3 rows) | "No content yet — complete S6" + link | "Failed to load" retry | Title+B1+Desc | Title only |
| Version Timeline | "Loading versions..." | "No versions in BQ yet" | "Failed to load" retry | Stacked cards | 1 version, no diff |
| Quality Badge | — (loaded w/ card) | No badge | — | Colored badge | — |
| Export History | "Loading..." | "Never exported" (muted) | "Failed to load" | "Last exported Mar 15" | — |
| Bulk Action Bar | — | Hidden (0 selected) | — | "3 selected" + actions | — |
| Bulk Export | "Exporting 3/5..." | — | "2 of 5 failed" retry/skip | "5 of 5 exported" | Per-project status |
| Diff Modal | "Computing diff..." | — | "Diff failed" | Inline red/green | — |

### Responsive
- Mobile (<768px): title-only content preview (tap to expand), full-screen diff sheet
- Bulk checkboxes: 44px touch targets, `safe-area-inset-bottom` on action bar
- Quality badge: number only on mobile (no "Quality:" label)

### Accessibility
- Quality badge: `aria-label="Quality score: 82 out of 100, good"`
- Export badge: `aria-label="Last exported March 15, 2 total exports"`
- Bulk bar: `role="toolbar" aria-label="Bulk actions for N selected projects"`
- Diff modal: `role="dialog" aria-labelledby="diff-title"`
- Keyboard: Tab → Space toggle → Shift+Click range → Escape deselect

## Architecture (revised per eng review)

```
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│        /seo/manager (Content Control Center)          │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │ Header: [SEOManager] [Select] [+ New Project]   │  │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │ Project Card (expanded, 4-tier layout)          │  │
│  │  T1: Identity (name, assignee, phase badge)     │  │
│  │  T2: Status (dots + quality badge + export ✓)   │  │
│  │  T3: Content Preview (always visible)           │  │
│  │  T4: ▸ Versions  ▸ Export History (accordion)   │  │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │
│  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐  │
│  │ Bulk Action Bar (fixed bottom, Select mode)     │  │
│  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘  │
└──────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────┘
               │
┌──────────────▼────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  APIs                                                  │
│  GET  /api/seo/projects        ← ENRICHED w/ content  │
│  GET  /api/seo/versions        ← EXISTS               │
│  GET  /api/seo/quality?project ← NEW                   │
│  POST /api/seo/exports         ← WIRED (insert-after) │
│  PATCH /api/seo/projects/bulk  ← NEW (action dispatch) │
└──────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────┘
               │
┌──────────────▼────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Data                                                  │
│  Supabase: seo_projects (enriched response)           │
│  Supabase: seo_asins (content via generatedContent)   │
│  Supabase: seo_exports (wired)                        │
│  Supabase: seo_quality_scores (NEW, append-only)      │
│  BQ: 1o8Hub.SEO (versions only)                       │
```

FILE: drizzle/migrations/0020_variation_group_and_normalize.sql
================================================
-- Add variation_group column for user-defined sub-groups within variation families
ALTER TABLE "master" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "variation_group" varchar(100);
ALTER TABLE "seo_asins" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "variation_group" varchar(100);

-- Fix unique constraint: allow multiple SKUs per ASIN within a project
ALTER TABLE "seo_asins" DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS "seo_asins_project_id_asin_key";
ALTER TABLE "seo_asins" ADD CONSTRAINT "seo_asins_project_id_asin_sku_key" UNIQUE ("project_id", "asin", "sku");

-- Fix double-encoded JSONB strings across ALL blob columns
-- (stored as '"{ ... }"' instead of '{ ... }' due to early import bug)
UPDATE "master" SET variations = (variations #>> '{}')::jsonb
WHERE variations IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(variations) = 'string';

UPDATE "master" SET content_seo = (content_seo #>> '{}')::jsonb
WHERE content_seo IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(content_seo) = 'string';

UPDATE "master" SET packaging = (packaging #>> '{}')::jsonb
WHERE packaging IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(packaging) = 'string';

UPDATE "master" SET target_audience = (target_audience #>> '{}')::jsonb
WHERE target_audience IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(target_audience) = 'string';

UPDATE "master" SET fulfillment = (fulfillment #>> '{}')::jsonb
WHERE fulfillment IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(fulfillment) = 'string';

UPDATE "master" SET nutrition_supplements = (nutrition_supplements #>> '{}')::jsonb
WHERE nutrition_supplements IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(nutrition_supplements) = 'string';

UPDATE "master" SET compliance_safety = (compliance_safety #>> '{}')::jsonb
WHERE compliance_safety IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(compliance_safety) = 'string';

UPDATE "master" SET images = (images #>> '{}')::jsonb
WHERE images IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(images) = 'string';

UPDATE "master" SET dimensions_weight = (dimensions_weight #>> '{}')::jsonb
WHERE dimensions_weight IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(dimensions_weight) = 'string';

UPDATE "master" SET other_attributes = (other_attributes #>> '{}')::jsonb
WHERE other_attributes IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(other_attributes) = 'string';

-- Normalize variation JSONB keys to PascalCase
-- Fixes inconsistent casing (e.g., "color" → "Color", "variationId" → "VariationID")
-- Unknown keys are preserved unchanged via ELSE clause
UPDATE "master" SET variations = (
  SELECT jsonb_object_agg(
    CASE lower(key)
      WHEN 'variationid' THEN 'VariationID'
      WHEN 'variationproduct' THEN 'VariationProduct'
      WHEN 'variationthemename' THEN 'VariationThemeName'
      WHEN 'childrelationshiptype' THEN 'ChildRelationshipType'
      WHEN 'color' THEN 'Color'
      WHEN 'size' THEN 'Size'
      WHEN 'flavor' THEN 'Flavor'
      WHEN 'style' THEN 'Style'
      ELSE key
    END,
    value
  ) FROM jsonb_each_text(variations)
)
WHERE variations IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof(variations) = 'object';

FILE: drizzle/migrations/0021_variation_builder.sql
================================================
-- Variation Builder: hierarchical product grouping system
-- Approach C: exclusive groups via FK + cross-cutting tags via junction

-- Top-level variation definition
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "variations" (
  "id" uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  "client_id" varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  "name" varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  "code" varchar(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  "amazon_variation_id" varchar(100),
  "theme_attributes" jsonb DEFAULT '[]',
  "primary_dimension" varchar(50),
  "description" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_variations_client" ON "variations" ("client_id");

-- Exclusive groups within a variation
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "variation_groups" (
  "id" uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  "variation_id" uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES "variations"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  "name" varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  "dimension" varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  "sort_order" integer DEFAULT 0,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE("variation_id", "name")
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_variation_groups_variation" ON "variation_groups" ("variation_id");

-- Cross-cutting tags
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "variation_tags" (
  "id" uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  "variation_id" uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES "variations"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  "dimension" varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  "value" varchar(200) NOT NULL,
  "sort_order" integer DEFAULT 0,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT NOW() NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE("variation_id", "dimension", "value")
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_variation_tags_variation" ON "variation_tags" ("variation_id");

-- Tag assignments junction
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "variation_tag_assignments" (
  "tag_id" uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES "variation_tags"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  "product_id" uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES "master"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  PRIMARY KEY ("tag_id", "product_id")
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_variation_tag_assignments_product" ON "variation_tag_assignments" ("product_id");

-- Add FK columns to master (ON DELETE SET NULL)
ALTER TABLE "master" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "variation_ref" uuid REFERENCES "variations"("id") ON DELETE SET NULL;
ALTER TABLE "master" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "group_ref" uuid REFERENCES "variation_groups"("id") ON DELETE SET NULL;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_master_variation_ref" ON "master" ("variation_ref");
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_master_group_ref" ON "master" ("group_ref");

================================================
-- Multi-group membership: junction table for products belonging to multiple groups
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "variation_group_assignments" (
  "group_id" uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES "variation_groups"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  "product_id" uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES "master"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT "pk_variation_group_assignments" UNIQUE("group_id", "product_id")
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_variation_group_assignments_product" ON "variation_group_assignments" USING btree ("product_id");
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_variation_group_assignments_group" ON "variation_group_assignments" USING btree ("group_id");

-- Migrate existing group_ref data into junction table
INSERT INTO "variation_group_assignments" ("group_id", "product_id")
SELECT "group_ref", "id" FROM "master" WHERE "group_ref" IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE(client_id_code, step_key)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_onboarding_status ON client_onboarding_steps(status);

FILE: scripts/backfill-activity-log.ts
================================================
/**
 * Backfill the activity_log table from existing product changeLog entries.
 * Usage: npx tsx scripts/backfill-activity-log.ts
 *
 * This reads all products with non-empty changeLog arrays and inserts
 * corresponding rows into activity_log. Safe to run multiple times —
 * it skips products that already have activity_log entries.
 */
import { config } from "dotenv";
config({ path: ".env.local" });
import { db } from "../src/lib/db";
import { master, activityLog } from "../src/lib/db/schema";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";

async function main() {
  console.log("Fetching products with changeLog entries...");

  // Get all products that have a non-empty changeLog
  const allProducts = await db
    .select({
      id: master.id,
      asin: master.asin,
      sku: master.sku,
      clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode,
      itemName: master.itemName,
      changeLog: master.changeLog,
    })
    .from(master)
    .where(sql`jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(${master.changeLog}, '[]'::jsonb)) > 0`);

  console.log(`Found ${allProducts.length} products with changeLog entries.`);

  if (allProducts.length === 0) {
    console.log("Nothing to backfill.");
    process.exit(0);
  }

  // Check which products already have activity_log entries
  const existingProducts = await db
    .select({ productId: activityLog.productId })
    .from(activityLog)
    .groupBy(activityLog.productId);

  const existingSet = new Set(existingProducts.map((r) => r.productId));
  const toBackfill = allProducts.filter((p) => !existingSet.has(p.id));

  console.log(
    `${existingSet.size} products already have activity entries, ` +
    `${toBackfill.length} products to backfill.`
  );

  if (toBackfill.length === 0) {
    console.log("Nothing to backfill.");
    process.exit(0);
  }

  let totalInserted = 0;

  // Process in batches of 50 products
  const batchSize = 50;
  for (let i = 0; i < toBackfill.length; i += batchSize) {
    const batch = toBackfill.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    const rows: Array<{
      productId: string;
      asin: string | null;
      sku: string | null;
      clientIdCode: string | null;
      itemName: string | null;
      fieldLabel: string;
      bqName: string;
      oldValue: string | null;
      newValue: string | null;
      changedBy: string;
      changedAt: Date;
      editType: string;
    }> = [];

    for (const product of batch) {
      const entries = product.changeLog ?? [];
      for (const entry of entries) {
        rows.push({
          productId: product.id,
          asin: product.asin,
          sku: product.sku,
          clientIdCode: product.clientIdCode,
          itemName: product.itemName,
          fieldLabel: entry.field,
          bqName: entry.field,
          oldValue: entry.oldValue,
          newValue: entry.newValue,
          changedBy: entry.changedBy,
          changedAt: new Date(entry.changedAt),
          editType: "single",
        });
      }
    }

    if (rows.length > 0) {
      await db.insert(activityLog).values(rows);
      totalInserted += rows.length;
    }

    console.log(
      `Processed products ${i + 1}–${Math.min(i + batchSize, toBackfill.length)} ` +
      `(${rows.length} entries)`
    );
  }

  console.log(`Backfill complete. Inserted ${totalInserted} activity log entries.`);
  process.exit(0);
}

main().catch((err) => {
  console.error("Error:", err);
  process.exit(1);
});

/**
 * Bootstrap the first admin user by email.
 * Usage: npx tsx scripts/create-admin.ts admin@example.com
 */
import { config } from "dotenv";
config({ path: ".env.local" });
import { db } from "../src/lib/db";
import { users } from "../src/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";

async function main() {
  const email = process.argv[2];
  if (!email) {
    console.error("Usage: npx tsx scripts/create-admin.ts <email>");
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const existing = await db
    .select()
    .from(users)
    .where(eq(users.email, email))
    .limit(1);

  if (existing.length > 0) {
    await db
      .update(users)
      .set({ role: "admin" })
      .where(eq(users.email, email));
    console.log(`Updated existing user ${email} to admin role.`);
  } else {
    await db.insert(users).values({
      email,
      name: email.split("@")[0],
      role: "admin",
    });
    console.log(`Created new admin user: ${email}`);
  }

  process.exit(0);
}

main().catch((err) => {
  console.error("Error:", err);
  process.exit(1);
});

FILE: scripts/generate-column-registry.ts
================================================
/**
 * Reads the BigQuery schema for Master and generates a column registry.
 *
 * Usage: npx tsx scripts/generate-column-registry.ts > src/lib/generated-columns.ts
 *
 * The output is a TypeScript file that exports JSONB_COLUMNS for use in column-registry.ts.
 * After generation, review the grouping heuristics and adjust as needed.
 */
import { config } from "dotenv";
config({ path: ".env.local" });
import { BigQuery } from "@google-cloud/bigquery";

const PROJECT_ID = process.env.GCP_PROJECT_ID || "amazon-data-461918";
const DATASET = process.env.BQ_DATASET || "1o8BibleApp";
const TABLE = process.env.BQ_TABLE || "Master";

// Core columns that already have dedicated DB fields (skip these)
const CORE_BQ_NAMES = new Set([
  "ASIN", "SKU", "ClientIDCode", "Marketplace", "Country", "Status",
  "ParentageLevel", "ParentSKU", "ParentASIN", "BrandName", "ItemName",
  "SummarizedTitle", "ProductType", "ListPrice", "CostPrice", "MainImageURL",
  "ItemTypeKeyword", "FeedProductType", "RecommendedBrowseNodes",
  "GenericKeywords", "PlatinumKeywords", "SyncStatus", "SyncTimestamp", "SyncInfo",
]);

/**
 * Heuristic grouping based on column name patterns.
 */
function guessGroup(name: string): string {
  const lower = name.toLowerCase();

  // Images
  if (lower.includes("image") || lower.includes("swatch") || lower.includes("photo")) {
    return "images";
  }

  // Content & SEO
  if (
    lower.includes("bullet") || lower.includes("description") ||
    lower.includes("keyword") || lower.includes("search_term") ||
    lower.includes("seo") || lower.includes("title") ||
    lower.includes("subject_matter")
  ) {
    return "content_seo";
  }

  // Variations
  if (
    lower.includes("variation") || lower.includes("color") ||
    lower.includes("size") || lower.includes("style") ||
    lower.includes("flavor") || lower.includes("scent") ||
    lower.includes("pattern")
  ) {
    return "variations";
  }

  // Packaging
  if (
    lower.includes("package") || lower.includes("packaging") ||
    lower.includes("box") || lower.includes("container") ||
    lower.includes("unit_count")
  ) {
    return "packaging";
  }

  // Target Audience
  if (
    lower.includes("audience") || lower.includes("age") ||
    lower.includes("gender") || lower.includes("demographic") ||
    lower.includes("target")
  ) {
    return "target_audience";
  }

  // Fulfillment
  if (
    lower.includes("fulfillment") || lower.includes("fba") ||
    lower.includes("shipping") || lower.includes("delivery") ||
    lower.includes("merchant") || lower.includes("condition")
  ) {
    return "fulfillment";
  }

  // Nutrition & Supplements
  if (
    lower.includes("nutri") || lower.includes("vitamin") ||
    lower.includes("supplement") || lower.includes("serving") ||
    lower.includes("calori") || lower.includes("fat") ||
    lower.includes("protein") || lower.includes("carb") ||
    lower.includes("sodium") || lower.includes("sugar") ||
    lower.includes("fiber") || lower.includes("cholesterol") ||
    lower.includes("ingredient") || lower.includes("allergen")
  ) {
    return "nutrition_supplements";
  }

  // Compliance & Safety
  if (
    lower.includes("compliance") || lower.includes("safety") ||
    lower.includes("warning") || lower.includes("hazard") ||
    lower.includes("cpsia") || lower.includes("prop65") ||
    lower.includes("certification") || lower.includes("regulation") ||
    lower.includes("battery") || lower.includes("chemical") ||
    lower.includes("pesticide") || lower.includes("fda")
  ) {
    return "compliance_safety";
  }

  // Dimensions & Weight
  if (
    lower.includes("dimension") || lower.includes("weight") ||
    lower.includes("height") || lower.includes("width") ||
    lower.includes("length") || lower.includes("depth") ||
    lower.includes("volume") || lower.includes("diameter")
  ) {
    return "dimensions_weight";
  }

  // Default: product attributes
  return "product_attributes";
}

function humanizeLabel(bqName: string): string {
  return bqName
    .replace(/([A-Z])/g, " $1")
    .replace(/[_-]/g, " ")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();
}

async function main() {
  let bigquery: BigQuery;

  if (process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL && process.env.GCP_PRIVATE_KEY) {
    bigquery = new BigQuery({
      projectId: PROJECT_ID,
      credentials: {
        client_email: process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL,
        private_key: process.env.GCP_PRIVATE_KEY.replace(/\\n/g, "\n"),
      },
    });
  } else {
    // Fall back to application default credentials
    bigquery = new BigQuery({ projectId: PROJECT_ID });
  }

  const [metadata] = await bigquery
    .dataset(DATASET)
    .table(TABLE)
    .getMetadata();

  const fields = metadata.schema.fields as Array<{ name: string; type: string }>;

  console.log(`// Auto-generated from BigQuery schema: ${PROJECT_ID}.${DATASET}.${TABLE}`);
  console.log(`// ${fields.length} total columns found, ${CORE_BQ_NAMES.size} are core columns`);
  console.log(`// Generated at: ${new Date().toISOString()}`);
  console.log(`// Review and adjust groupings as needed.\n`);
  console.log(`import type { ColumnDef } from "./column-registry";\n`);
  console.log(`export const GENERATED_JSONB_COLUMNS: ColumnDef[] = [`);

  let jsonbCount = 0;
  for (const field of fields) {
    if (CORE_BQ_NAMES.has(field.name)) continue;

    const group = guessGroup(field.name);
    const label = humanizeLabel(field.name);

    console.log(`  { bqName: ${JSON.stringify(field.name)}, label: ${JSON.stringify(label)}, group: ${JSON.stringify(group)}, fieldType: "text", coreField: null },`);
    jsonbCount++;
  }

  console.log(`];\n`);
  console.log(`// ${jsonbCount} JSONB columns generated`);

  process.exit(0);
}

main().catch((err) => {
  console.error("Error reading BQ schema:", err.message);
  process.exit(1);
});

FILE: scripts/import-aac.ts
================================================
/**
 * Import AAC client data from BigQuery into PostgreSQL.
 *
 * Usage: npx tsx scripts/import-aac.ts
 *
 * Source: amazon-data-461918.1o8BibleApp.AAC
 * Maps ClientIDCode → client_id_code, ClientStatus → client_status
 * Upserts on client_id_code (always overwrites with fresh BQ data).
 */
import { config } from "dotenv";
config({ path: ".env.local" });
import { BigQuery } from "@google-cloud/bigquery";
import pgClient from "postgres";

const PROJECT_ID = process.env.GCP_PROJECT_ID || "amazon-data-461918";
const DATASET = "1o8BibleApp";
const TABLE = "AAC";

const sql = pgClient(process.env.DATABASE_URL!, { ssl: "require" });

async function main() {
  let bigquery: BigQuery;

  if (process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL && process.env.GCP_PRIVATE_KEY) {
    bigquery = new BigQuery({
      projectId: PROJECT_ID,
      credentials: {
        client_email: process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL,
        private_key: process.env.GCP_PRIVATE_KEY.replace(/\\n/g, "\n"),
      },
    });
  } else {
    bigquery = new BigQuery({ projectId: PROJECT_ID });
  }

  console.log(`Querying ${PROJECT_ID}.${DATASET}.${TABLE}...`);

  const [rows] = await bigquery.query({
    query: `SELECT * FROM \`${PROJECT_ID}.${DATASET}.${TABLE}\``,
    location: "us-west1",
  });

  console.log(`Fetched ${rows.length} rows from BigQuery`);

  if (rows.length > 0) {
    console.log("Columns:", Object.keys(rows[0]).join(", "));
  }

  let inserted = 0;
  let updated = 0;
  let skipped = 0;

  for (const row of rows) {
    const clientIdCode = (row.ClientIDCode || "").trim();
    const clientStatus = (row.ClientStatus || "").trim();
    const clientName = (row.ClientName || "").trim();

    if (!clientIdCode) {
      skipped++;
      continue;
    }

    // Build raw data (all columns as strings)
    const rawData: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(row)) {
      rawData[key] = val != null ? String(val) : "";
    }

    // Upsert via ON CONFLICT
    const existing = await sql`
      SELECT id FROM aac_clients WHERE client_id_code = ${clientIdCode} LIMIT 1
    `;

    const powerbiUrl = (row.PowerBIDashboardURL || "").trim() || null;

    if (existing.length > 0) {
      await sql`
        UPDATE aac_clients SET
          client_status = ${clientStatus},
          client_name = ${clientName || null},
          powerbi_embed_url = COALESCE(${powerbiUrl}, powerbi_embed_url),
          raw_data = ${JSON.stringify(rawData)}::jsonb,
          updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = ${existing[0].id}
      `;
      updated++;
    } else {
      await sql`
        INSERT INTO aac_clients (client_id_code, client_status, client_name, powerbi_embed_url, raw_data)
        VALUES (${clientIdCode}, ${clientStatus}, ${clientName || null}, ${powerbiUrl}, ${JSON.stringify(rawData)}::jsonb)
      `;
      inserted++;
    }
  }

  console.log(`\nImport complete: ${inserted} inserted, ${updated} updated, ${skipped} skipped (no ClientIDCode)`);

  // Show summary
  const all = await sql`SELECT client_id_code, client_status FROM aac_clients ORDER BY client_id_code`;
  const active = all.filter((c) => c.client_status.toLowerCase() === "active");
  console.log(`Total clients in DB: ${all.length} (${active.length} active)`);
  console.log("Active clients:", active.map((c) => c.client_id_code).join(", "));

  await sql.end();
  process.exit(0);
}

main().catch(async (err) => {
  console.error("Import error:", err);
  await sql.end();
  process.exit(1);
});

FILE: scripts/import-attributes.ts
================================================
/**
 * Import the Attributes table from BigQuery into PostgreSQL.
 * This gives the app a data-driven column registry with:
 * - ReferenceGroup / Subgroup for UI sections
 * - Per-client requirement levels
 * - Essential flag, data types, help text
 */
import { config } from "dotenv";
config({ path: ".env.local" });
import { BigQuery } from "@google-cloud/bigquery";
import postgres from "postgres";

const PROJECT_ID = process.env.GCP_PROJECT_ID || "amazon-data-461918";

function getBigQueryClient(): BigQuery {
  if (process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL && process.env.GCP_PRIVATE_KEY) {
    return new BigQuery({
      projectId: PROJECT_ID,
      credentials: {
        client_email: process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL,
        private_key: process.env.GCP_PRIVATE_KEY.replace(/\\n/g, "\n"),
      },
    });
  }
  return new BigQuery({ projectId: PROJECT_ID });
}

const CLIENT_CODES = [
  "C23_SC_US", "DRE_SC_US", "DRC_SC_US", "CHE_SC_US", "CHE_VC_US",
  "GOO_SC_US", "PRO_SC_US", "PUR_SC_US", "FRE_SC_US", "GAF_SC_US",
  "HOT_SC_US", "WHI_SC_US", "TRT_SC_US", "TRS_SC_US", "DRW_SC_US",
  "BNU_SC_US", "BRA_SC_US", "POO_SC_US", "SPL_SC_ES", "GLO_SC_US",
  "ROY_SC_US", "PKN_SC_US",
];

async function main() {
  const bq = getBigQueryClient();
  const sql = postgres(process.env.DATABASE_URL!, { prepare: false });

  // 1. Fetch all attributes from BQ
  console.log("Fetching attributes from BigQuery...");
  const [rows] = await bq.query({
    query: "SELECT * FROM `amazon-data-461918.1o8BibleApp.Attributes` ORDER BY CAST(MasterAttributeRow AS INT64)",
    location: "us-west1",
  });
  console.log(`Fetched ${rows.length} attribute rows`);

  // 2. Create the column_attributes table
  console.log("Creating column_attributes table...");
  await sql`
    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS column_attributes CASCADE
  `;
  await sql`
    CREATE TABLE column_attributes (
      id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
      master_row INTEGER NOT NULL,
      general_label VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
      specific_label TEXT,
      bigquery_label TEXT,
      bq_data_type VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'STRING',
      label_details TEXT,
      label_max_options VARCHAR(10),
      reference_group VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
      subgroup VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT '',
      is_essential BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
      client_requirements JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
    )
  `;

  await sql`CREATE INDEX idx_col_attr_general_label ON column_attributes(general_label)`;
  await sql`CREATE INDEX idx_col_attr_reference_group ON column_attributes(reference_group)`;
  await sql`CREATE INDEX idx_col_attr_subgroup ON column_attributes(subgroup)`;
  await sql`CREATE INDEX idx_col_attr_essential ON column_attributes(is_essential)`;

  // 3. Insert rows
  console.log("Inserting rows...");
  let inserted = 0;

  for (const row of rows) {
    // Build per-client requirements JSONB
    const clientReqs: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const client of CLIENT_CODES) {
      const val = (row as Record<string, string>)[client];
      if (val && val.trim()) {
        clientReqs[client] = val.trim();
      }
    }

    await sql`
      INSERT INTO column_attributes (
        master_row, general_label, specific_label, bigquery_label,
        bq_data_type, label_details, label_max_options,
        reference_group, subgroup, is_essential, client_requirements
      ) VALUES (
        ${parseInt(row.MasterAttributeRow)},
        ${row.GeneralLabel},
        ${row.SpecificLabel || null},
        ${row.BigqueryLabel || null},
        ${row.BQDataType || "STRING"},
        ${row.LabelDetails || null},
        ${row.LabelMaxOptions || null},
        ${row.ReferenceGroup},
        ${row.Subgroup || ""},
        ${row.Essential === "true"},
        ${JSON.stringify(clientReqs)}
      )
    `;
    inserted++;
    if (inserted % 100 === 0) console.log(`  ${inserted}/${rows.length}`);
  }

  console.log(`\nImported ${inserted} column attributes`);

  // 4. Verify
  const [{ cnt }] = await sql`SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM column_attributes`;
  console.log(`Verification: ${cnt} rows in column_attributes`);

  const essentialCount = await sql`SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM column_attributes WHERE is_essential = true`;
  console.log(`Essential columns: ${essentialCount[0].cnt}`);

  const groups = await sql`SELECT reference_group, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM column_attributes GROUP BY reference_group ORDER BY cnt DESC`;
  console.log("\nBy reference group:");
  for (const g of groups) {
    console.log(`  ${g.reference_group}: ${g.cnt}`);
  }

  await sql.end();
  console.log("\nDone!");
}

main().catch(console.error);



================================================
FILE: scripts/import-from-bigquery.ts

/**
 * Import all product rows from BigQuery into PostgreSQL.
 *
 * Usage: npx tsx scripts/import-from-bigquery.ts
 *
 * Modes:
 *   --upsert  Update existing products with fresh BQ data (default: skip existing)
 *
 * This reads all rows from the BQ table, maps each to the app's hybrid schema,
 * and inserts/updates them in the products table.
 */
import { config } from "dotenv";
config({ path: ".env.local" });
import { BigQuery } from "@google-cloud/bigquery";
import { db } from "../src/lib/db";
import { master } from "../src/lib/db/schema";
import { mapBqRowToProduct, type BqRow } from "../src/lib/product-mapper";
import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";

const PROJECT_ID = process.env.GCP_PROJECT_ID || "amazon-data-461918";
const DATASET = process.env.BQ_DATASET || "1o8BibleApp";
const TABLE = process.env.BQ_TABLE || "Master";

const BATCH_SIZE = 50;
const upsertMode = process.argv.includes("--upsert");

async function main() {
  let bigquery: BigQuery;

  if (process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL && process.env.GCP_PRIVATE_KEY) {
    bigquery = new BigQuery({
      projectId: PROJECT_ID,
      credentials: {
        client_email: process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL,
        private_key: process.env.GCP_PRIVATE_KEY.replace(/\\n/g, "\n"),
      },
    });
  } else {
    bigquery = new BigQuery({ projectId: PROJECT_ID });
  }

  console.log(`Querying ${PROJECT_ID}.${DATASET}.${TABLE}...`);
  console.log(`Mode: ${upsertMode ? "UPSERT (update existing)" : "INSERT (skip existing)"}`);

  const [rows] = await bigquery.query({
    query: `SELECT * FROM \`${PROJECT_ID}.${DATASET}.${TABLE}\``,
    location: "us-west1",
  });

  console.log(`Fetched ${rows.length} rows from BigQuery`);

  let inserted = 0;
  let updated = 0;
  let skipped = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
    const batch = rows.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);

    for (const row of batch) {
      const bqRow = row as BqRow;
      const asin = bqRow.ASIN || null;
      const sku = bqRow.SKU || null;
      const marketplace = bqRow.Marketplace || null;

      // Check for existing product
      if (asin && sku && marketplace) {
        const existing = await db
          .select({ id: master.id })
          .from(master)
          .where(
            and(
              eq(master.asin, asin),
              eq(master.sku, sku),
              eq(master.marketplace, marketplace)
            )
          )
          .limit(1);

        if (existing.length > 0) {
          if (upsertMode) {
            const product = mapBqRowToProduct(bqRow);
            await db
              .update(master)
              .set(product)
              .where(eq(master.id, existing[0].id));
            updated++;
          } else {
            skipped++;
          }
          continue;
        }
      }

      const product = mapBqRowToProduct(bqRow);
      await db.insert(master).values(product);
      inserted++;
    }

    console.log(`Progress: ${Math.min(i + BATCH_SIZE, rows.length)}/${rows.length} (inserted: ${inserted}, updated: ${updated}, skipped: ${skipped})`);
  }

  console.log(`\nImport complete: ${inserted} inserted, ${updated} updated, ${skipped} skipped`);
  process.exit(0);
}

main().catch((err) => {
  console.error("Import error:", err);
  process.exit(1);
});

import { config } from "dotenv";
import { resolve } from "path";
config({ path: resolve(__dirname, "../.env.local") });
import postgres from "postgres";

// Use direct connection (port 5432) instead of pooler (6543) — DDL hangs on pgBouncer
const directUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL!.replace(":6543/", ":5432/");
const sql = postgres(directUrl, { ssl: "require" });

async function main() {
  console.log("Running migration 0002_add_client_role...");

  // Use unsafe() to avoid implicit transaction wrapping — ALTER TYPE ADD VALUE
  // cannot run inside a transaction block
  await sql.unsafe("ALTER TYPE user_role ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'client'");
  console.log("  ✓ Added 'client' to user_role enum");

  await sql.unsafe("ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS client_id_code VARCHAR(100)");
  console.log("  ✓ Added client_id_code column");

  await sql.unsafe("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_client_id_code ON users(client_id_code)");
  console.log("  ✓ Created index idx_users_client_id_code");

  console.log("\nMigration complete!");
  await sql.end();
}

main().catch((e) => {
  console.error("Migration failed:", e);
  process.exit(1);
});

async function main() {
  // Dynamic imports so dotenv loads DATABASE_URL before the db client connects
  const { db } = await import("../src/lib/db");
  const { users } = await import("../src/lib/db/schema");
  const { eq } = await import("drizzle-orm");

  let inserted = 0;
  let updated = 0;

  for (const member of teamMembers) {
    const existing = await db
      .select()
      .from(users)
      .where(eq(users.email, member.email))
      .limit(1);

    if (existing.length > 0) {
      await db
        .update(users)
        .set({ name: member.name, role: member.role })
        .where(eq(users.email, member.email));
      updated++;
      console.log(`  Updated: ${member.email} → ${member.role}`);
    } else {
      await db.insert(users).values({
        email: member.email,
        name: member.name,
        role: member.role,
      });
      inserted++;
      console.log(`  Inserted: ${member.email} → ${member.role}`);
    }
  }

  console.log(`\nDone! Inserted: ${inserted}, Updated: ${updated}`);
  process.exit(0);
}

main().catch((err) => {
  console.error("Error:", err);
  process.exit(1);
});

FILE: seo-manager-reference/README.md
