# 1o8 SEO Manager

Amazon Listing Optimization — RUFUS & COSMO AI System

A standalone web application for managing the full 7-phase Amazon SEO workflow:
S1 Intake → S2 Keywords → S3 Reviews → S4 Rufus → S5 COSMO → S6 Compliance → S7 SEO Content

## Quick Start

### 1. Prerequisites
- Node.js 18+
- A [Supabase](https://supabase.com) account (free tier)
- An [Anthropic](https://console.anthropic.com) API key
- A Google Cloud project with OAuth2 credentials

### 2. Setup

```bash
# Clone the repo
git clone <your-repo-url>
cd 1o8-seo-manager

# Install dependencies
npm install

# Copy env template
cp .env.local.example .env.local
# Edit .env.local with your API keys
```

### 3. Database Setup

1. Create a new Supabase project at [supabase.com](https://supabase.com)
2. Go to SQL Editor
3. Paste and run the contents of `supabase-schema.sql`
4. Copy your Supabase URL and keys into `.env.local`

### 4. Google OAuth Setup

1. Go to [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com)
2. Create a new project or select existing
3. Enable the Google Docs API and Google Drive API
4. Go to Credentials → Create OAuth 2.0 Client ID
5. Add `http://localhost:3000/api/auth/callback/google` as redirect URI
6. Copy Client ID and Secret into `.env.local`

### 5. Run

```bash
npm run dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000)

## Deploy to Vercel

```bash
# Install Vercel CLI
npm i -g vercel

# Deploy
vercel

# Set environment variables in Vercel dashboard
```

## Project Structure

```
app/                    # Next.js App Router pages
├── page.tsx            # Dashboard (project list)
├── projects/
│   ├── new/            # Create new project
│   └── [id]/           # Project workspace
│       ├── intake/     # S1 - Intake & Discovery
│       ├── keywords/   # S2 - Keyword Tiering
│       ├── reviews/    # S3 - Review Analysis
│       ├── rufus/      # S4 - Rufus Intelligence
│       ├── cosmo/      # S5 - COSMO Mapping
│       ├── compliance/ # S6 - Compliance Check
│       ├── seo/        # S7 - Content Generation
│       └── export/     # Export to Google Docs
│
components/             # Reusable React components
lib/
├── types.ts            # TypeScript definitions
├── db.ts               # Supabase client
├── parsers/            # CSV/TSV parsers
│   ├── intake.ts       # INTAKE tab parser
│   ├── cerebro.ts      # Helium 10 Cerebro parser
│   └── reviews.ts      # Amazon review parser
└── prompts/            # Claude API prompt builders
```

## Tech Stack

- **Next.js 14** — React framework
- **Tailwind CSS** — Styling
- **Supabase** — PostgreSQL database + auth
- **Anthropic Claude API** — AI content generation
- **Google APIs** — Docs/Drive export
- **Vercel** — Hosting

## Configuration

The SEO optimization rules come from `AMAZON_SEO_GPT_v5_COMPLETE.md` — the authoritative 4,446-line configuration that governs all character limits, compliance rules, keyword tiers, and content generation standards.

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createAuthMiddlewareClient } from "@/lib/auth";

export async function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  const response = NextResponse.next({ request });
  const supabase = createAuthMiddlewareClient(request, response);

  // Refresh the session (extends expiry, syncs cookies)
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();

  // Allow public routes through
  const { pathname } = request.nextUrl;
  const isPublicRoute =
    pathname === "/login" ||
    pathname.startsWith("/api/") ||
    pathname.startsWith("/_next/") ||
    pathname.startsWith("/favicon") ||
    pathname === "/logo.png";

  if (!user && !isPublicRoute) {
    const loginUrl = new URL("/login", request.url);
    return NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl);
  }

  // If logged in and visiting /login, redirect to dashboard
  if (user && pathname === "/login") {
    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL("/", request.url));
  }

  return response;
}

export const config = {
  matcher: [
    // Match all routes except static files and Next.js internals
    "/((?!_next/static|_next/image|favicon.ico).*)",
  ],
};

-- Migration: Add missing columns to projects table
-- Run this in Supabase SQL Editor

-- Brand guidelines text (was being saved but column didn't exist)
ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS brand_guidelines TEXT DEFAULT '';

-- Brand guidelines lock state (locked / not_applicable / pending)
ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS brand_guidelines_lock JSONB;

-- Variety pack details (was being saved but column didn't exist)
ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS variety_pack_details TEXT;

-- Compliance summary (used by S6 SEO Content)
ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS compliance_summary JSONB;

-- SEO config (used by S6 SEO Content)
ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS seo_config JSONB;

-- Update current_phase constraint to reflect new numbering (S6 = SEO Content)
ALTER TABLE projects DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS projects_current_phase_check;
ALTER TABLE projects ADD CONSTRAINT projects_current_phase_check
  CHECK (current_phase IN ('S1','S2','S3','S4','S5','S6','S7','S8'));

FILE: seo-manager-reference/supabase-schema.sql

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 1o8 SEO Manager — Database Schema (Supabase/PostgreSQL)
-- Run this in Supabase SQL Editor to create all tables
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

-- Projects
CREATE TABLE projects (
  id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'in_progress', 'completed', 'archived')),
  current_phase TEXT DEFAULT 'S1' CHECK (current_phase IN ('S1','S2','S3','S4','S5','S6','S7','S8')),

  -- S1 Metadata
  date TEXT,
  client_id_code TEXT,
  brand_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  client_name TEXT,
  client_bible_url TEXT,
  brand_url TEXT,

  -- Competitors (JSONB array)
  competitors JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,

  -- Variation
  variation_theme TEXT,
  size_present BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,

  -- Brand Guidelines
  brand_guidelines TEXT DEFAULT '',
  brand_guidelines_lock JSONB,

  -- Variety Pack
  variety_pack_details TEXT,

  -- Phase approvals
  s1_approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  s2_approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  s3_approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  s4_approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  s5_approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  s6_approved_at TIMESTAMPTZ,

  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- ASINs
CREATE TABLE asins (
  id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  project_id UUID REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  asin TEXT NOT NULL,
  sku TEXT NOT NULL,
  amazon_url TEXT,
  website_url TEXT,
  variation_id TEXT,
  variation_product TEXT,
  parentage_level TEXT CHECK (parentage_level IN ('Parent', 'Child')),
  variation_theme_name TEXT,
  flavor TEXT,
  style TEXT,
  color TEXT,
  size TEXT,

  -- Existing content (JSONB — columns M-AM)
  existing_content JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,

  -- Baseline analysis
  baseline_analysis JSONB,

  -- Generated content (S7 output)
  generated_content JSONB,

  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE(project_id, asin)
);

-- Keywords (S2 — OUT_KEY)
CREATE TABLE keywords (
  id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  project_id UUID REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  text TEXT NOT NULL,
  search_volume INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  priority_tier TEXT CHECK (priority_tier IN ('T1', 'T2', 'T3', 'T4')),
  search_intent TEXT,
  primary_use_location TEXT,
  match_type TEXT,
  cosmo_relationship TEXT,
  buyer_stage TEXT CHECK (buyer_stage IN ('Awareness', 'Consideration', 'Decision')),
  notes TEXT DEFAULT '',
  keyword_source TEXT DEFAULT 'Client',

  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- Reviews (S3 — OUT_REV)
CREATE TABLE reviews (
  id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  project_id UUID REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  review_id TEXT,
  date TEXT,
  reviewer_name TEXT,
  asin TEXT,
  product_variation TEXT,
  star_rating INTEGER,
  title TEXT,
  text TEXT,
  sentiment TEXT,
  key_themes TEXT,
  usage_mentioned TEXT,
  packaging_feedback TEXT,
  price_feedback TEXT,
  heat_level_feedback TEXT,
  rufus_usable_insight TEXT,
  bullet_mapping TEXT,
  helpful_votes INTEGER DEFAULT 0,

  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- Rufus Data (S4 — OUT_RUF)
CREATE TABLE rufus_data (
  id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  project_id UUID REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE UNIQUE,
  phase1_questions JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  phase1_answers JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  phase2_questions JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  phase2_answers JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  phase3_questions JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  phase3_answers JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  optimization_summary JSONB,

  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- COSMO Map (S5 — OUT_COS)
CREATE TABLE cosmo_maps (
  id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  project_id UUID REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE UNIQUE,
  triples JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  keyword_coverage JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  competitive_positioning TEXT,

  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- Compliance Reports (S6)
CREATE TABLE compliance_reports (
  id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  project_id UUID REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  issues JSONB DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'clean' CHECK (status IN ('clean', 'has_issues', 'bypassed')),

  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- Export History
CREATE TABLE exports (
  id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
  project_id UUID REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  type TEXT CHECK (type IN ('google_doc', 'csv', 'tsv')),
  url TEXT,
  content_snapshot JSONB,

  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

-- Indexes
CREATE INDEX idx_asins_project ON asins(project_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_keywords_project ON keywords(project_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_reviews_project ON reviews(project_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_projects_user ON projects(user_id);

-- Updated_at trigger
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  NEW.updated_at = now();
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER projects_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON projects
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();

CREATE TRIGGER rufus_data_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON rufus_data
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();

CREATE TRIGGER cosmo_maps_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON cosmo_maps
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at();

import { ImageResponse } from "next/og";

export const size = { width: 180, height: 180 };
export const contentType = "image/png";

export default function AppleIcon() {
  return new ImageResponse(
    (
      <div
        style={{
          width: 180,
          height: 180,

FILE: seo-manager-reference/app/page.tsx

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createAuthBrowserClient } from "@/lib/auth-browser";

interface ProjectSummary {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  brand_name: string;
  status: string;
  current_phase: string;
  created_at: string;
  s1_approved_at: string | null;
  s2_approved_at: string | null;
  s3_approved_at: string | null;
  s4_approved_at: string | null;
  s5_approved_at: string | null;
  s6_approved_at: string | null;
}

const SECTIONS = [
  { key: "s1", code: "S1", label: "Intake" },
  { key: "s2", code: "S2", label: "Keywords" },
  { key: "s3", code: "S3", label: "Reviews" },
  { key: "s4", code: "S4", label: "Rufus" },
  { key: "s5", code: "S5", label: "COSMO" },
  { key: "s6", code: "S6", label: "SEO Content" },
];

function Logo() {
  return <img src="/logo.png" alt="1o8 Agency" width={48} height={48} className="rounded-lg" />;
}

function SectionDots({ project }: { project: ProjectSummary }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
      {SECTIONS.map((s, i) => {
        const approvedKey = `${s.key}_approved_at` as keyof ProjectSummary;
        const isApproved = !!project[approvedKey];
        const isCurrent = project.current_phase === s.code;
        return (
          <div key={s.key} className="flex flex-col items-center gap-0.5">
            <span className={`text-[8px] font-bold leading-none ${
              isApproved ? "text-emerald-500/70" : isCurrent ? "text-amber-500/70" : "text-zinc-700"
            }`}>{s.code}</span>
            <div className={`w-5 h-5 rounded flex items-center justify-center text-[8px] font-bold transition-colors ${
              isApproved ? "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30" :
              isCurrent ? "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30" :
              "bg-zinc-800/50 text-zinc-600 border border-zinc-800"
            }`}>
              {isApproved ? "✓" : i + 1}
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Context Menu ─────────────────────────────────────────────
function ProjectMenu({
  project,
  onRename,
  onDelete,
  onDuplicate,
  onClose,
}: {
  project: ProjectSummary;
  onRename: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
  onDuplicate: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    function handleClick(e: MouseEvent) {
      if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target as Node)) onClose();
    }
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClick);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClick);
  }, [onClose]);

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className="absolute right-0 top-full mt-1 z-20 w-44 rounded-lg border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900 shadow-xl py-1">
      <button onClick={onRename} className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors">
        <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-500" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M11 5H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v11a2 2 0 002 2h11a2 2 0 002-2v-5m-1.414-9.414a2 2 0 112.828 2.828L11.828 15H9v-2.828l8.586-8.586z" /></svg>
        Rename
      </button>
      <button onClick={onDuplicate} className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors">
        <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-zinc-500" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M8 16H6a2 2 0 01-2-2V6a2 2 0 012-2h8a2 2 0 012 2v2m-6 12h8a2 2 0 002-2v-8a2 2 0 00-2-2h-8a2 2 0 00-2 2v8a2 2 0 002 2z" /></svg>
        Duplicate
      </button>
      <div className="my-1 border-t border-zinc-800" />
      <button onClick={onDelete} className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-red-400 hover:bg-red-500/10 transition-colors">
        <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16" /></svg>
        Delete Project
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Rename Modal ─────────────────────────────────────────────
function RenameModal({
  project,
  onSave,
  onClose,
}: {
  project: ProjectSummary;
  onSave: (name: string, brand: string) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const [name, setName] = useState(project.name);
  const [brand, setBrand] = useState(project.brand_name);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => { inputRef.current?.select(); }, []);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-xl border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900 p-6 shadow-2xl" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-200 mb-4">Rename Project</h3>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div>
            <label className="text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-500 mb-1 block">Project Name</label>
            <input ref={inputRef} value={name} onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-800 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-200 focus:border-amber-500 focus:outline-none"
              onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === "Enter") onSave(name, brand); }} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-500 mb-1 block">Brand Name</label>
            <input value={brand} onChange={e => setBrand(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-800 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-200 focus:border-amber-500 focus:outline-none"
              onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === "Enter") onSave(name, brand); }} />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 mt-5">
          <button onClick={onClose} className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-700 px-4 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-800">Cancel</button>
          <button onClick={() => onSave(name, brand)} disabled={!name.trim()} className="rounded-lg bg-amber-500 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-black hover:bg-amber-400 disabled:opacity-50">Save</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Delete Confirmation ──────────────────────────────────────
function DeleteModal({
  project,
  onConfirm,
  onClose,
}: {
  project: ProjectSummary;
  onConfirm: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const [typed, setTyped] = useState("");
  const needsConfirm = typed.toLowerCase() === "delete";

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-xl border border-red-500/30 bg-zinc-900 p-6 shadow-2xl" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-red-400 mb-2">Delete Project</h3>
        <p className="text-xs text-zinc-400 mb-1">
          This will permanently delete <span className="font-bold text-zinc-200">{project.name}</span> and all its data (ASINs, keywords, reviews, Rufus, COSMO).
        </p>
        <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 mb-4">This action cannot be undone.</p>
        <div>
          <label className="text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-500 mb-1 block">Type <span className="text-red-400">delete</span> to confirm</label>
          <input value={typed} onChange={e => setTyped(e.target.value)} placeholder="delete"
            className="w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-800 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-200 focus:border-red-500 focus:outline-none"
            onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === "Enter" && needsConfirm) onConfirm(); }} />
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 mt-5">
          <button onClick={onClose} className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-700 px-4 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-800">Cancel</button>
          <button onClick={onConfirm} disabled={!needsConfirm} className="rounded-lg bg-red-500 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-red-400 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed">Delete Permanently</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// DASHBOARD
// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
export default function Dashboard() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<ProjectSummary[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState("");
  const [newBrand, setNewBrand] = useState("");
  const [showCreate, setShowCreate] = useState(false);
  const [dbConnected, setDbConnected] = useState<boolean | null>(null);

  // Action states
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [renaming, setRenaming] = useState<ProjectSummary | null>(null);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState<ProjectSummary | null>(null);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(false);
  const [signingOut, setSigningOut] = useState(false);

  async function handleSignOut() {
    setSigningOut(true);
    const supabase = createAuthBrowserClient();
    await supabase.auth.signOut();
    router.push("/login");
    router.refresh();
  }

  useEffect(() => { loadProjects(); }, []);

  async function loadProjects() {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/projects");
      if (res.ok) { setProjects(await res.json()); setDbConnected(true); }
      else setDbConnected(false);
    } catch { setDbConnected(false); }
    setLoading(false);
  }

  async function createProject() {
    if (!newName.trim()) return;
    setCreating(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/projects", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ name: newName, brand_name: newBrand }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const project = await res.json();
        router.push(`/projects/${project.id}/intake`);
      }
    } catch {}
    setCreating(false);
  }

  async function renameProject(id: string, name: string, brand: string) {
    setActionLoading(true);
    try {
      await fetch(`/api/projects/${id}`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ name, brand_name: brand }),
      });
      setProjects(prev => prev.map(p => p.id === id ? { ...p, name, brand_name: brand } : p));
    } catch {}
    setRenaming(null);
    setActionLoading(false);
  }

  async function deleteProject(id: string) {
    setActionLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" });
      if (res.ok) {
        setProjects(prev => prev.filter(p => p.id !== id));
      }
    } catch {}
    setDeleting(null);
    setActionLoading(false);
  }

  async function duplicateProject(project: ProjectSummary) {
    setActionLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/projects", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ name: `${project.name} (copy)`, brand_name: project.brand_name }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        await loadProjects();
      }
    } catch {}
    setMenuOpen(null);
    setActionLoading(false);
  }

  const phaseLabel: Record<string, string> = {
    S1: "Intake", S2: "Keywords", S3: "Reviews", S4: "Rufus",
    S5: "COSMO", S6: "SEO Content",
  };

  const sectionRoute: Record<string, string> = {
    S1: "intake", S2: "keywords", S3: "reviews", S4: "rufus",
    S5: "cosmo", S6: "seo",
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-zinc-950 text-zinc-200">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-5xl px-6 py-10">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-10">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Logo />
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-2xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-zinc-100">1o8 Marketplace SEO Manager</h1>
              <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 mt-0.5">Amazon Listing Optimization — RUFUS & COSMO System</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold ${
              dbConnected === true ? "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400" :
              dbConnected === false ? "bg-red-500/10 text-red-400" : "bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-500"
            }`}>
              <span className={`inline-block h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${
                dbConnected === true ? "bg-emerald-400" : dbConnected === false ? "bg-red-400" : "bg-zinc-600"
              }`} />
              {dbConnected === true ? "DB Connected" : dbConnected === false ? "DB Offline" : "Checking..."}
            </div>
            <button onClick={() => setShowCreate(true)} className="rounded-lg bg-amber-500 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-black hover:bg-amber-400">+ New Project</button>
            <button onClick={handleSignOut} disabled={signingOut} className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-700 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-400 hover:text-zinc-200 hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors">
              {signingOut ? "Signing out..." : "Sign Out"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Create form */}
        {showCreate && (
          <div className="mb-6 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/20 bg-amber-500/5 p-5">
            <div className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-200 mb-3">Create New Project</div>
            <div className="flex items-end gap-3">
              <div className="flex-1">
                <label className="text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-500 mb-1 block">Project Name</label>
                <input value={newName} onChange={e => setNewName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Dr. Cuddles — ReadyRESCUE"
                  className="w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-300 focus:border-amber-500 focus:outline-none"
                  onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === "Enter") createProject(); }} />
              </div>
              <div className="flex-1">
                <label className="text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-500 mb-1 block">Brand Name</label>
                <input value={newBrand} onChange={e => setNewBrand(e.target.value)} placeholder="Dr. Cuddles"
                  className="w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-300 focus:border-amber-500 focus:outline-none"
                  onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === "Enter") createProject(); }} />
              </div>
              <button onClick={createProject} disabled={creating || !newName.trim()}
                className="rounded-lg bg-amber-500 px-5 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-black hover:bg-amber-400 disabled:opacity-50">
                {creating ? "Creating..." : "Create"}
              </button>
              <button onClick={() => { setShowCreate(false); setNewName(""); setNewBrand(""); }}
                className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-700 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-800">Cancel</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Section legend */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-4 text-[10px] text-zinc-600">
          <span>Section status:</span>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><div className="w-3 h-3 rounded bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-500/30" /><span>Approved</span></div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><div className="w-3 h-3 rounded bg-amber-500/20 border border-amber-500/30" /><span>Active</span></div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><div className="w-3 h-3 rounded bg-zinc-800/50 border border-zinc-800" /><span>Pending</span></div>
        </div>

        {/* Projects list */}
        {loading ? (
          <div className="text-center py-10 text-zinc-500 text-sm">Loading projects...</div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {projects.map(p => (
              <div key={p.id} className="rounded-xl border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900/50 hover:border-zinc-700 transition-colors group">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-4 p-5">
                  {/* Clickable area — navigates to project */}
                  <a href={`/projects/${p.id}/${sectionRoute[p.current_phase] || "intake"}`} className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <div className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-200 group-hover:text-zinc-100 truncate">{p.name}</div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 mt-0.5">{p.brand_name || "No brand"} • Created {new Date(p.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 ml-3">
                        <span className="rounded bg-amber-500/20 px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold text-amber-400">
                          {p.current_phase} {phaseLabel[p.current_phase] || ""}
                        </span>
                        <span className={`rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[8px] font-bold ${
                          p.status === "in_progress" ? "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400/70" :
                          p.status === "completed" ? "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400" : "bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-500"
                        }`}>{p.status}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <SectionDots project={p} />
                  </a>

                  {/* Menu button */}
                  <div className="relative shrink-0">
                    <button
                      onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); setMenuOpen(menuOpen === p.id ? null : p.id); }}
                      className="p-1.5 rounded-md text-zinc-600 hover:text-zinc-400 hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                        <path d="M10 6a2 2 0 110-4 2 2 0 010 4zM10 12a2 2 0 110-4 2 2 0 010 4zM10 18a2 2 0 110-4 2 2 0 010 4z" />
                      </svg>
                    </button>
                    {menuOpen === p.id && (
                      <ProjectMenu
                        project={p}
                        onRename={() => { setMenuOpen(null); setRenaming(p); }}
                        onDelete={() => { setMenuOpen(null); setDeleting(p); }}
                        onDuplicate={() => duplicateProject(p)}
                        onClose={() => setMenuOpen(null)}
                      />
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}

            {projects.length === 0 && dbConnected && (
              <div className="text-center py-12 text-xs text-zinc-600">
                <p className="mb-2">No projects yet.</p>
                <button onClick={() => setShowCreate(true)} className="text-amber-400 hover:text-amber-300 underline">Create your first project</button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="mt-12 text-center">
          <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-700">1o8 Marketplace SEO — RUFUS + COSMO System v2.0</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Modals */}
      {renaming && (
        <RenameModal
          project={renaming}
          onSave={(name, brand) => renameProject(renaming.id, name, brand)}
          onClose={() => setRenaming(null)}
        />
      )}
      {deleting && (
        <DeleteModal
          project={deleting}
          onConfirm={() => deleteProject(deleting.id)}
          onClose={() => setDeleting(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * GET /api/bq/asins — Fetch ASINs list with filters + pagination
 * POST /api/bq/asins — Fetch full data for selected ASINs (S1 pipeline)
 *
 * GET query params: clientIDCode (required), parentageLevel, variationThemeName,
 *   productCategory, productSubcategory, flavor, style, color, size, status,
 *   searchTerm, limit, offset
 *
 * POST body: { asins: string[], clientIDCode: string }
 */

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { fetchASINs, fetchFullASINData, type ASINFilters } from "@/lib/bigquery";

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);

    const clientIDCode = searchParams.get("clientIDCode");
    if (!clientIDCode) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "clientIDCode is required" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const filters: ASINFilters = { clientIDCode };

    if (searchParams.get("parentageLevel")) filters.parentageLevel = searchParams.get("parentageLevel")!;
    if (searchParams.get("variationThemeName")) filters.variationThemeName = searchParams.get("variationThemeName")!;
    if (searchParams.get("variationID")) filters.variationID = searchParams.get("variationID")!;
    if (searchParams.get("productCategory")) filters.productCategory = searchParams.get("productCategory")!;
    if (searchParams.get("productSubcategory")) filters.productSubcategory = searchParams.get("productSubcategory")!;
    if (searchParams.get("flavor")) filters.flavor = searchParams.get("flavor")!;
    if (searchParams.get("style")) filters.style = searchParams.get("style")!;
    if (searchParams.get("color")) filters.color = searchParams.get("color")!;
    if (searchParams.get("size")) filters.size = searchParams.get("size")!;
    if (searchParams.get("status")) filters.status = searchParams.get("status")!;
    if (searchParams.get("searchTerm")) filters.searchTerm = searchParams.get("searchTerm")!;
    if (searchParams.get("limit")) filters.limit = parseInt(searchParams.get("limit")!, 10);
    if (searchParams.get("offset")) filters.offset = parseInt(searchParams.get("offset")!, 10);

    const result = await fetchASINs(filters);

    return NextResponse.json(result);
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("BigQuery ASINs GET error:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: error.message || "Failed to fetch ASINs" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const body = await request.json();
    const { asins, clientIDCode } = body;

    if (!clientIDCode) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "clientIDCode is required" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }
    if (!asins || !Array.isArray(asins) || asins.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "asins array is required and must not be empty" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const fullData = await fetchFullASINData(asins, clientIDCode);

    return NextResponse.json({ asins: fullData });
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("BigQuery ASINs POST error:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: error.message || "Failed to fetch full ASIN data" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// S5 COSMO API — Claude AI
// POST /api/claude/cosmo
// Action: generate
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY,
  fetch: fetch,
});

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const { action } = body;

    if (action === "generate") {
      return handleGenerate(body);
    } else {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unknown action" }, { status: 400 });
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error("COSMO API error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message || "Failed" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

/** Attempt to salvage a truncated JSON array by closing it */
function repairTruncatedJson(raw: string): any[] | null {
  let text = raw.trim();
  if (!text.startsWith("[")) return null;

  // Already valid?
  try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch {}

  // Strip trailing partial object — find last complete }, or }
  const lastComplete = Math.max(text.lastIndexOf("},"), text.lastIndexOf("}\n"));
  if (lastComplete > 0) {
    const candidate = text.slice(0, lastComplete + 1) + "]";
    try { return JSON.parse(candidate); } catch {}
  }

  // Last resort: close the array
  const closed = text.replace(/,?\s*$/, "") + "]";
  try { return JSON.parse(closed); } catch {}

  return null;
}

async function handleGenerate(body: any) {
  // Body now contains pre-trimmed data from the client
  const { brandName, parentAsin, asinList, topKeywords, reviewThemes, rufusInsights, guidelines } = body;

  const systemPrompt = `You are the COSMO Semantic Modeling Engine for 1o8 Marketplace SEO.

Your task: Generate a complete COSMO semantic entity-relationship map for an Amazon product listing.

COSMO RELATIONSHIP TYPES (use only these):
- IS_A: Product classification/category
- HAS_A: Product attributes/features
- USED_FOR: Primary use cases
- USED_FOR_AUD: Target audience segments
- MADE_OF: Ingredients/materials
- SOLD_AS: Packaging/format/variants
- COMPARED_TO: Competitive positioning (internal only, no competitor names)
- INTERESTED_IN: User interests/lifestyle
- AVAILABLE_IN: Sizes/flavors/colors/variants
- USED_WITH: Complementary products
- USED_BY: User demographics
- xINTERESTED_IN: Extended interest categories
- xWANT: User goals/desires

PDP SECTION MAPPING (for COSMOAppliedPDPSection1 and COSMOAppliedPDPSection2):
- Title, Bullet 1, Bullet 2, Bullet 3, Bullet 4, Bullet 5, Description, Backend, A+ Module, Image, Not Applicable

RULES:
1. Generate exactly 20 relationship rows — no more, no less.
2. Prioritize variety across ALL relationship types — aim for at least one of each applicable type.
3. Every row must trace to a keyword, review insight, or Rufus answer.
4. COSMOEntity = the product or product attribute being mapped.
5. COSMOTailType = the target concept (audience, use case, ingredient, etc.)
6. COSMOMappedValue = the specific value — keep concise.
7. COSMOUsageExplanation = how this relationship informs listing content — max 20 words.
8. COSMOAppliedPDPSection1 = primary PDP location.
9. COSMOAppliedPDPSection2 = secondary PDP location (use "Not Applicable" if none).
10. COSMONotes = source reference — max 10 words.
11. No cell may be blank — use "Not Applicable" where needed.
12. NEVER include competitor names in any field.
13. No medical/disease claims.

OUTPUT: Return ONLY a valid JSON array — no markdown, no code fences, no preamble, no explanation.
Start with [ and end with ].

JSON schema for each object:
{"ASIN":"","COSMOEntity":"","COSMORelationType":"","COSMOTailType":"","COSMOMappedValue":"","COSMOUsageExplanation":"","COSMOAppliedPDPSection1":"","COSMOAppliedPDPSection2":"","COSMONotes":""}`;

  const guidelinesBlock = guidelines
    ? `\n=== BRAND GUIDELINES ===\n${String(guidelines).substring(0, 600)}\n=== END GUIDELINES ===\n`
    : "";

  const userPrompt = `Product: ${brandName}
Parent ASIN: ${parentAsin}
ASINs in scope: ${asinList || ""}
${guidelinesBlock}
=== TOP KEYWORDS (S2) ===
${topKeywords || "None provided"}

=== REVIEW THEMES (S3) ===
${reviewThemes || "None provided"}

=== RUFUS INSIGHTS (S4) ===
${rufusInsights || "None provided"}

Generate exactly 20 COSMO rows as a valid JSON array. Output ONLY the JSON array.`;

  console.log("COSMO: Calling Claude Haiku, prompt length:", userPrompt.length);
  const startTime = Date.now();

  const response = await client.messages.create({
    model: "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001",
    max_tokens: 4096,
    system: systemPrompt,
    messages: [{ role: "user", content: userPrompt }],
  });

  console.log("COSMO: Claude responded in", Date.now() - startTime, "ms, stop_reason:", response.stop_reason);

  const text = response.content
    .filter((b) => b.type === "text")
    .map((b) => (b.type === "text" ? b.text : ""))
    .join("");

  const clean = text.replace(/```json\s*/g, "").replace(/```\s*/g, "").trim();

  // Try clean parse first
  try {
    const rows = JSON.parse(clean);
    return NextResponse.json({ rows, usage: response.usage });
  } catch {
    // Try to repair truncated JSON
    const repaired = repairTruncatedJson(clean);
    if (repaired && repaired.length > 0) {
      console.warn(`COSMO: repaired truncated JSON, recovered ${repaired.length} rows`);
      return NextResponse.json({ rows: repaired, usage: response.usage, repaired: true });
    }

    console.error("COSMO parse failed. stop_reason:", response.stop_reason, "| Raw start:", clean.substring(0, 200));
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `COSMO generation failed: ${response.stop_reason === "max_tokens" ? "Response too long — try again with fewer keywords loaded" : "Invalid JSON from AI"}` },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// S2 Keyword Tiering API — Claude AI
// POST /api/claude/keywords
// Batches run in PARALLEL to fit within Vercel 60s timeout
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY,
  fetch: fetch,
});

const BATCH_SIZE = 100;

const SYSTEM_PROMPT = `You are the Keyword Intelligence and Tiering Engine for Amazon SEO (RUFUS + COSMO).

TASK: For each keyword, assign Priority Tier, Search Intent, Use Location, Match Type, COSMO Relationship, Buyer Stage, and a short Note.

TIERING RULES:
- T1: High purchase intent → Title. Match: Exact. 5-8 keywords total across all batches.
- T2: Mid-funnel → Bullet Points. Match: Phrase. 10-15 keywords total.
- T3: Semantic expansion → Description. Match: Phrase. 15-20 keywords total.
- T4: Long-tail/awareness → Backend. Match: Exact or Broad. Everything else.
- No keyword in more than one tier.

BUYER STAGE: Awareness | Consideration | Decision
COSMO: IS_A | HAS_A | USED_FOR | USED_FOR_AUD | MADE_OF | SOLD_AS | COMPARED_TO | INTERESTED_IN | AVAILABLE_IN
INTENT: Informational | Commercial | Navigational | Transactional

SCORING: (Relevancy×0.45) + (NormVolume×0.35) + (BuyerStageWeight×0.20). Decision=1.0, Consideration=0.7, Awareness=0.4.

OUTPUT: Return ONLY a JSON array. Each element:
{"t":"keyword","v":number,"tier":"T1","int":"Transactional","loc":"Title","mt":"Exact","cos":"USED_FOR","bs":"Decision","n":"note"}

Field key mapping: t=KeywordText, v=SearchVolume, tier=PriorityTier, int=SearchIntent, loc=PrimaryUseLocation, mt=MatchType, cos=COSMORelationship, bs=BuyerStage, n=Notes.

Use these SHORT keys to save space. Return ONLY the JSON array — no markdown, no explanation, no code fences.`;

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const { keywords, brandName, variationProduct, variationTheme, competitors, guidelines } = body;

    if (!keywords || !Array.isArray(keywords) || keywords.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "No keywords provided" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    if (!brandName) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Brand name is required" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // Limit to top 400 (200 product + 200 competitor, enforced by frontend)
    const topKeywords = keywords.slice(0, 400);

    // Split into batches
    const batches: any[][] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < topKeywords.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
      batches.push(topKeywords.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE));
    }

    const guidelinesBlock = guidelines
      ? `BRAND GUIDELINES (apply to tone, intent signals, audience keywords):\n${String(guidelines).substring(0, 600)}\n`
      : "";

    // Tier budget per batch (distributed evenly)
    const t1PerBatch = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(8 / batches.length));
    const t2PerBatch = Math.max(2, Math.ceil(15 / batches.length));

    console.log(`Keywords: ${topKeywords.length} in ${batches.length} parallel batches`);

    // Run ALL batches in parallel to fit within 60s Vercel timeout
    const results = await Promise.all(
      batches.map(async (batch, batchIdx) => {
        const kwLines = batch
          .map((kw: any) => `${kw.keyword_phrase}\t${kw.search_volume}\t${kw.cerebro_iq_score || ""}\t${kw.competing_products || ""}\t${kw.title_density || ""}\t${kw.cpr || ""}`)
          .join("\n");

        const tierGuidance = `This is batch ${batchIdx + 1} of ${batches.length}. Assign max ${t1PerBatch} T1, ${t2PerBatch} T2, rest split T3/T4.`;

        const userPrompt = `Product: ${brandName} — ${variationProduct || "Product"}
Theme: ${variationTheme || "N/A"}
${guidelinesBlock}${tierGuidance}

Batch ${batchIdx + 1}/${batches.length} (${batch.length} keywords):
Keyword\tVolume\tIQ\tCompetition\tTitleDensity\tCPR
${kwLines}

Return JSON array for ALL ${batch.length} keywords using short keys.`;

        const response = await client.messages.create({
          model: "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001",
          max_tokens: 8192,
          system: SYSTEM_PROMPT,
          messages: [{ role: "user", content: userPrompt }],
        });

        const usage = response.usage || { input_tokens: 0, output_tokens: 0 };

        const text = response.content
          .filter((block) => block.type === "text")
          .map((block) => (block.type === "text" ? block.text : ""))
          .join("");

        const clean = text.replace(/```json\s*/g, "").replace(/```\s*/g, "").trim();

        let parsed: any[];
        try {
          parsed = JSON.parse(clean);
        } catch {
          const lastBracket = clean.lastIndexOf("}");
          if (lastBracket > 0) {
            try {
              parsed = JSON.parse(clean.substring(0, lastBracket + 1) + "]");
            } catch {
              console.error(`Batch ${batchIdx + 1} JSON parse failed. Raw length: ${clean.length}`);
              return { keywords: [], usage };
            }
          } else {
            return { keywords: [], usage };
          }
        }

        const expanded = parsed.map((kw: any) => ({
          KeywordText: kw.t || kw.KeywordText || "",
          KeywordSearchVolume: kw.v || kw.KeywordSearchVolume || 0,
          KeywordPriorityTier: kw.tier || kw.KeywordPriorityTier || "T4",
          KeywordSearchIntent: kw.int || kw.KeywordSearchIntent || "",
          KeywordPrimaryUseLocation: expandLocation(kw.loc || kw.KeywordPrimaryUseLocation || "Backend Search Terms"),
          KeywordMatchType: kw.mt || kw.KeywordMatchType || "Broad",
          KeywordCOSMORelationship: kw.cos || kw.KeywordCOSMORelationship || "",
          KeywordBuyerStage: kw.bs || kw.KeywordBuyerStage || "Awareness",
          KeywordNotes: kw.n || kw.KeywordNotes || "",
        }));

        return { keywords: expanded, usage };
      })
    );

    // Merge results
    const allTiered: any[] = [];
    const totalUsage = { input_tokens: 0, output_tokens: 0 };
    for (const r of results) {
      allTiered.push(...r.keywords);
      totalUsage.input_tokens += r.usage.input_tokens;
      totalUsage.output_tokens += r.usage.output_tokens;
    }

    console.log(`Keywords done: ${allTiered.length} tiered, ${totalUsage.input_tokens + totalUsage.output_tokens} tokens`);

    return NextResponse.json({
      keywords: allTiered,
      model: "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001",
      usage: totalUsage,
      batches: batches.length,
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error("Claude API error:", err);

    if (err.message?.includes("authentication") || err.message?.includes("api_key") || err.status === 401) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Invalid Anthropic API key. Check your .env.local ANTHROPIC_API_KEY." },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: err.message || "Failed to process keywords" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

function expandLocation(loc: string): string {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {
    "Title": "Title",
    "Bullets": "Bullet Points",
    "Bullet Points": "Bullet Points",
    "Description": "Description",
    "Backend": "Backend Search Terms",
    "Backend Search Terms": "Backend Search Terms",
  };
  return map[loc] || loc;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// S3 Review Analysis API — Claude AI (raw fetch, no SDK)
// POST /api/claude/reviews
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const SYSTEM_PROMPT = `You are the Review Intelligence Engine for Amazon SEO.

Analyze each review. Return structured intelligence.

FOR EACH REVIEW determine:
- s: Sentiment (Positive+ | Positive | Neutral | Negative | Negative-)
- th: Key themes comma-separated
- u: Usage mentioned (Ritual, Habitual, Occasional, Emergency, or context)
- pkg: Packaging feedback or "None mentioned"
- pr: Price feedback or "None mentioned"
- hl: Heat/intensity feedback or "Not applicable"
- ri: Rufus buyer-psychology insight from review language
- bm: Bullet mapping (e.g. "Bullet 1: Effectiveness")

RULES:
- Anonymize names as Reviewer_001, Reviewer_002, etc.
- No blank fields — use "None mentioned" or "Not applicable"

OUTPUT: ONLY a JSON array with short keys:
{"id":"...","d":"YYYY-MM-DD","rn":"Reviewer_XXX","v":"...","r":5,"t":"title","s":"Positive","th":"...","u":"...","pkg":"...","pr":"...","hl":"...","ri":"...","bm":"..."}

No markdown, no code fences, no explanation. Start with [ end with ].`;

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const apiKey = process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY;
    if (!apiKey) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" }, { status: 500 });

    const body = await req.json();
    const { reviewBlock, reviewCount, brandName, productName } = body;

    // Support both new (pre-trimmed) and legacy (full reviews) format
    let prompt: string;
    let count: number;

    if (reviewBlock) {
      prompt = reviewBlock;
      count = reviewCount || 0;
    } else if (body.reviews && Array.isArray(body.reviews)) {
      const reviews = body.reviews.slice(0, 60);
      count = reviews.length;
      prompt = reviews
        .map((r: any, i: number) =>
          `[${i + 1}] ${r.star_rating}★ | ${r.product_variation || "—"} | ${r.date_iso || ""} | HV:${r.helpful_votes || 0}\n${r.title}\n${(r.text || "").substring(0, 250)}`)
        .join("\n---\n");
    } else {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "No reviews provided" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const userPrompt = `Product: ${brandName || "Product"} — ${productName || ""}
${count} reviews:

${prompt}

Analyze ALL ${count} reviews. Return JSON array with short keys.`;

    console.log(`Reviews: ${count} reviews, prompt ~${userPrompt.length} chars`);
    const startTime = Date.now();

    // Use raw fetch — no SDK overhead, faster cold start
    const response = await fetch("https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "x-api-key": apiKey,
        "anthropic-version": "2023-06-01",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        model: "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001",
        max_tokens: 8192,
        system: SYSTEM_PROMPT,
        messages: [{ role: "user", content: userPrompt }],
      }),
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      const errText = await response.text();
      console.error(`Anthropic API ${response.status}:`, errText);
      return NextResponse.json({ error: `Anthropic API error ${response.status}` }, { status: 502 });
    }

    const data = await response.json();
    console.log(`Reviews: responded in ${Date.now() - startTime}ms, stop: ${data.stop_reason}`);

    const usage = data.usage || { input_tokens: 0, output_tokens: 0 };

    const text = (data.content || [])
      .filter((b: any) => b.type === "text")
      .map((b: any) => b.text)
      .join("");

    const clean = text.replace(/```json\s*/g, "").replace(/```\s*/g, "").trim();

    let parsed: any[];
    try {
      parsed = JSON.parse(clean);
    } catch {
      const lastBracket = clean.lastIndexOf("}");
      if (lastBracket > 0) {
        try {
          parsed = JSON.parse(clean.substring(0, lastBracket + 1) + "]");
        } catch {
          console.error(`Reviews JSON parse failed. Raw: ${clean.substring(0, 300)}`);
          return NextResponse.json({ error: "AI response was malformed. Try again." }, { status: 500 });
        }
      } else {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "AI returned empty response. Try again." }, { status: 500 });
      }
    }

    // Expand short keys
    const expanded = parsed.map((kw: any) => ({
      ReviewID: kw.id || kw.ReviewID || "",
      ReviewDate: kw.d || kw.ReviewDate || "",
      ReviewReviewerName: kw.rn || kw.ReviewReviewerName || "",
      ReviewASIN: "ParentASIN",
      ReviewProductVariation: kw.v || kw.ReviewProductVariation || "",
      ReviewStarRating: kw.r || kw.ReviewStarRating || 0,
      ReviewTitle: kw.t || kw.ReviewTitle || "",
      ReviewSentiment: kw.s || kw.ReviewSentiment || "Neutral",
      ReviewKeyThemes: kw.th || kw.ReviewKeyThemes || "",
      ReviewUsageMentioned: kw.u || kw.ReviewUsageMentioned || "Not analyzed",
      ReviewPackagingFeedback: kw.pkg || kw.ReviewPackagingFeedback || "None mentioned",
      ReviewPriceFeedback: kw.pr || kw.ReviewPriceFeedback || "None mentioned",
      ReviewHeatLevelFeedback: kw.hl || kw.ReviewHeatLevelFeedback || "Not applicable",
      ReviewRufusUsableInsight: kw.ri || kw.ReviewRufusUsableInsight || "Not analyzed",
      ReviewBulletMapping: kw.bm || kw.ReviewBulletMapping || "Not analyzed",
    }));

    return NextResponse.json({
      reviews: expanded,
      totalProcessed: expanded.length,
      usage,
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error("Reviews API error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: err.message || "Failed to analyze reviews" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// S4 Rufus API — Claude AI
// POST /api/claude/rufus
// Actions: generate_phase2, analyze
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY,
  fetch: fetch,
});

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const { action } = body;
    if (action === "generate_phase2") return handleGeneratePhase2(body);
    if (action === "analyze") return handleAnalyze(body);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unknown action" }, { status: 400 });
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error("Rufus API error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message || "Failed" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// ── Generate Phase 2 Strategic Questions ─────────────────────

async function handleGeneratePhase2(body: any) {
  const { phase1, brandName, productName, guidelines } = body;

  const systemPrompt = `You are the RUFUS Optimization Engine for Amazon listing SEO.

Given the Phase 1 foundational Q&A from Rufus, generate 8-10 additional strategic questions to ask Rufus for deeper discovery.

RULES:
- Every question MUST end with a question mark
- Questions must be short and direct for Rufus chat input
- Focus on: usage patterns, objection resolution, competitive positioning, audience segments, purchase triggers, seasonal usage, gifting context, complementary products
- No quotation marks in questions
- Each question should explore a different angle not covered in Phase 1
- Questions should help inform listing optimization, A+ content, and image strategy

OUTPUT: Return ONLY a JSON array of question strings. No markdown, no code fences.
Example: ["What ingredients does this product contain?", "How quickly does this product work?"]`;

  const guidelinesSection = guidelines
    ? `\nBRAND GUIDELINES (use to shape question relevance and brand voice):\n${guidelines.substring(0, 600)}\n`
    : "";

  const userPrompt = `Product: ${brandName} — ${productName}
${guidelinesSection}
Phase 1 Responses:
${phase1.map((p: any, i: number) => `Q${i + 1}: ${p.question}\nA${i + 1}: ${p.answer}`).join("\n\n")}

Generate 8-10 strategic Phase 2 questions.`;

  const response = await client.messages.create({
    model: "claude-sonnet-4-20250514",
    max_tokens: 2048,
    system: systemPrompt,
    messages: [{ role: "user", content: userPrompt }],
  });

  const text = response.content
    .filter((b) => b.type === "text")
    .map((b) => (b.type === "text" ? b.text : ""))
    .join("");

  const clean = text.replace(/```json\s*/g, "").replace(/```\s*/g, "").trim();

  let questions;
  try {
    questions = JSON.parse(clean);
  } catch {
    const lines = clean
      .split("\n")
      .filter((l) => l.trim().endsWith("?"))
      .map((l) => l.replace(/^[\s\-\d.*"]+/, "").replace(/[",\]]+$/, "").trim());
    if (lines.length > 0) {
      questions = lines;
    } else {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Failed to parse AI response" }, { status: 500 });
    }
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ questions, usage: response.usage });
}

// ── Analyze All Q&A into OUT_RUF ──────────────────────────────

async function handleAnalyze(body: any) {
  const { allQA, brandName, productName, guidelines } = body;

  const systemPrompt = `You are the RUFUS Analysis Engine for 1o8 Marketplace SEO (RUFUS + COSMO system).

Analyze each Rufus Q&A pair and produce structured intelligence for the OUT_RUF table.

FOR EACH Q&A PAIR, determine:

1. RufusQuestionCategory: One of — Product Identity, Usage & Application, Customer Satisfaction, Customer Dissatisfaction, Competitive Landscape, Purchase Decision, Ingredient & Composition, Efficacy & Performance, Audience & Demographics, Seasonal & Contextual

2. RufusInsightType: One of — Core Benefit, Objection, Desire, Usage Pattern, Competitive Advantage, Purchase Trigger, Trust Signal, Value Proposition

3. RufusPrimaryObjectionAddressed: The main customer objection this Q&A helps resolve, or "None identified"

4. RufusPrimaryDesireAddressed: The main customer desire this Q&A satisfies, or "None identified"

5. RufusCOSMORelationship: Primary COSMO relationship type — IS_A, HAS_A, USED_FOR, USED_FOR_AUD, MADE_OF, SOLD_AS, COMPARED_TO, INTERESTED_IN, AVAILABLE_IN

6. RufusUsageContext: How/when the product is used based on this Q&A — e.g., "Daily wellness routine", "Emergency relief", "Athletic recovery"

7. RufusNotes: Any additional flags — competitor mentions, compliance concerns, gaps, cross-reference notes. Use "None" if nothing notable.

RULES:
- ASIN must be "ParentASIN" for all rows (variation family scope)
- No field may be blank
- RufusQuestion and RufusAnswer must be preserved exactly as provided
- One row per Q&A pair

OUTPUT: Return ONLY a valid JSON array. Each object:
{
  "ASIN": "ParentASIN",
  "RufusQuestion": "...",
  "RufusAnswer": "...",
  "RufusQuestionCategory": "...",
  "RufusInsightType": "...",
  "RufusPrimaryObjectionAddressed": "...",
  "RufusPrimaryDesireAddressed": "...",
  "RufusCOSMORelationship": "...",
  "RufusUsageContext": "...",
  "RufusNotes": "..."
}

No markdown, no code fences, no explanation.`;

  const guidelinesSection = guidelines
    ? `\nBRAND GUIDELINES (apply brand voice and audience context to all analysis):\n${guidelines.substring(0, 600)}\n`
    : "";

  const qaBlock = (allQA || [])
    .map((qa: any, i: number) => `Q${i + 1}: ${qa.question}\nA${i + 1}: ${qa.answer}`)
    .join("\n\n");

  const userPrompt = `Product: ${brandName} — ${productName}
Total Q&A pairs: ${(allQA || []).length}
${guidelinesSection}
${qaBlock}

Analyze ALL ${(allQA || []).length} Q&A pairs. Return the complete JSON array.`;

  const response = await client.messages.create({
    model: "claude-sonnet-4-20250514",
    max_tokens: 8192,
    system: systemPrompt,
    messages: [{ role: "user", content: userPrompt }],
  });

  const text = response.content
    .filter((b) => b.type === "text")
    .map((b) => (b.type === "text" ? b.text : ""))
    .join("");

  const clean = text.replace(/```json\s*/g, "").replace(/```\s*/g, "").trim();

  try {
    const rows = JSON.parse(clean);
    return NextResponse.json({ rows, usage: response.usage });
  } catch {
    console.error("Rufus analyze parse failed:", clean.substring(0, 200));
    const rows = (allQA || []).map((qa: any) => ({
      ASIN: "ParentASIN",
      RufusQuestion: qa.question,
      RufusAnswer: qa.answer,
      RufusQuestionCategory: "Parse Error",
      RufusInsightType: "Parse Error",
      RufusPrimaryObjectionAddressed: "Not analyzed",
      RufusPrimaryDesireAddressed: "Not analyzed",
      RufusCOSMORelationship: "Not analyzed",
      RufusUsageContext: "Not analyzed",
      RufusNotes: "AI analysis failed — re-run",
    }));
    return NextResponse.json({ rows, usage: response.usage });
  }
}

Rufus:\n${rufus.slice(0, 5).map((r: any) => `Q: ${r.RufusQuestion}\nA: ${(r.RufusAnswer || "").substring(0, 120)}`).join("\n\n")}

    const rows = JSON.parse(jsonMatch[0]);
    return NextResponse.json({ rows, usage: claudeData.usage });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";

export const maxDuration = 60;

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const body = await req.json();
  const { brandName, rows, keywords, cosmo, rufus, reviews, guidelines } = body;

  const apiKey = process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY;
  if (!apiKey) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" }, { status: 500 });

  // Build summary of generated content
  const contentSummary = rows.map((r: any) => {
    return `ASIN: ${r.ASIN} (${r.ParentageLevel})
Title: ${r.Title || "[empty]"}
DetailedB1: ${(r.DetailedBulletPoint_1 || "").substring(0, 120)}...
DetailedB2: ${(r.DetailedBulletPoint_2 || "").substring(0, 120)}...
DetailedB3: ${(r.DetailedBulletPoint_3 || "").substring(0, 120)}...
DetailedB4: ${(r.DetailedBulletPoint_4 || "").substring(0, 120)}...
DetailedB5: ${(r.DetailedBulletPoint_5 || "").substring(0, 120)}...
Description: ${(r.ProductDescription || "").substring(0, 200)}...
Backend Core: ${(r.SearchTermsCore || "").substring(0, 100)}...`;
  }).join("\n\n");

  // Keyword tier breakdown
  const tier1 = keywords.filter((k: any) => k.KeywordPriorityTier === "T1").slice(0, 15);
  const tier2 = keywords.filter((k: any) => k.KeywordPriorityTier === "T2").slice(0, 15);

  const systemPrompt = `You are the 1o8 SEO Audit Engine. You analyze generated Amazon listing content against the research data from Sections 1-5 to identify gaps, missed opportunities, and areas for improvement BEFORE the content is locked.

Your audit must cover:
1. COMPLIANCE CHECK: Scan for prohibited terms, medical claims, competitor names, emoji, colon misuse
2. KEYWORD COVERAGE: Check how many Tier 1 and Tier 2 keywords appear in titles, bullets, description
3. COSMO DENSITY: Do the listings express COSMO relationships (IS_A, HAS_FEATURE, USED_FOR, etc.)?
4. RUFUS COVERAGE: Are the 5 Rufus questions answered somewhere in the content?
5. HUMAN VOICE: Does content read naturally or feel keyword-stuffed/templated?
6. BUYER JOURNEY: Title=Decision, B1-B2=Consideration, B3-B5=Decision, Desc=Awareness→Consideration?
7. VARIATION CONSISTENCY: Are Child ASINs differentiated appropriately?

Score each category 0-100. Also compute an overall score (weighted average).

Find specific, actionable improvement opportunities. For each finding include:
- severity: "critical" | "warning" | "info"
- category: which audit area
- detail: what was found
- suggestion: specific fix

OUTPUT: Return ONLY valid JSON:
{
  "complianceScore": <0-100>,
  "keywordCoverage": <0-100>,
  "cosmoDensity": <0-100>,
  "rufusCoverage": <0-100>,
  "humanVoice": <0-100>,
  "buyerJourney": <0-100>,
  "variationConsistency": <0-100>,
  "overallScore": <0-100>,
  "findings": [
    { "severity": "...", "category": "...", "detail": "...", "suggestion": "..." }
  ]
}`;

  const userPrompt = `Audit this generated content against the research data.

BRAND: ${brandName}
${guidelines ? `BRAND GUIDELINES: ${guidelines.substring(0, 500)}` : ""}

═══ GENERATED CONTENT ═══
${contentSummary}

═══ RESEARCH DATA ═══

TIER 1 KEYWORDS (must appear in surface content):
${tier1.map((k: any) => `- "${k.KeywordText}" SV:${k.SearchVolume}`).join("\n")}

TIER 2 KEYWORDS (should appear where natural):
${tier2.map((k: any) => `- "${k.KeywordText}" SV:${k.SearchVolume}`).join("\n")}

COSMO RELATIONSHIPS (should be expressed in content):
${cosmo.slice(0, 15).map((c: any) => `${c.COSMORelationType}: ${c.COSMOMappedValue} → PDP: ${c.COSMOAppliedPDPSection1}`).join("\n")}

RUFUS QUESTIONS (should be answered in listing):
${rufus.slice(0, 5).map((r: any) => `Q: ${r.RufusQuestion}\nA: ${(r.RufusAnswer || "").substring(0, 150)}`).join("\n\n")}

REVIEW THEMES (should be addressed):
${reviews.slice(0, 10).map((r: any) => `${r.ReviewTheme || "Theme"}: ${(r.ReviewRufusUsableInsight || "").substring(0, 100)}`).join("\n")}

Return ONLY valid JSON.`;

  try {
    const claudeRes = await fetch("https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "x-api-key": apiKey,
        "anthropic-version": "2023-06-01",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        model: "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001",
        max_tokens: 4000,
        system: systemPrompt,
        messages: [{ role: "user", content: userPrompt }],
      }),
    });

    if (!claudeRes.ok) {
      const errText = await claudeRes.text();
      throw new Error(`Claude API ${claudeRes.status}: ${errText}`);
    }

    const claudeData = await claudeRes.json();
    const text = claudeData.content?.[0]?.text || "";

    const jsonMatch = text.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
    if (!jsonMatch) throw new Error("No JSON in audit response");

    const result = JSON.parse(jsonMatch[0]);
    return NextResponse.json(result);
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Document Text Extraction API
// POST /api/extract-doc
// Supports: .pdf (via Claude vision), .docx/.doc (mammoth), .txt/.md (native)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

const anthropic = new Anthropic({ apiKey: process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY });

// Max file size: 20MB (Anthropic PDF limit is 32MB base64 ≈ 24MB raw)
const MAX_FILE_SIZE = 20 * 1024 * 1024;

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const formData = await req.formData();
    const file = formData.get("file") as File | null;
    if (!file) return NextResponse.json({ error: "No file provided" }, { status: 400 });

    if (file.size > MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: `File too large (${(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)}MB). Max 20MB. Try compressing or splitting the PDF.` },
        { status: 413 }
      );
    }

    const filename = file.name;
    const ext = filename.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? "";
    const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const buffer = Buffer.from(bytes);

    // ── TXT / MD — read directly ──────────────────────────
    if (ext === "txt" || ext === "md") {
      const text = buffer.toString("utf-8");
      return NextResponse.json({ text, filename, method: "plaintext" });
    }

    // ── DOCX / DOC — mammoth ──────────────────────────────
    if (ext === "docx" || ext === "doc") {
      try {
        // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-var-requires
        const mammoth = require("mammoth");
        const result = await mammoth.extractRawText({ buffer });
        const text = result.value?.trim() ?? "";
        if (!text) throw new Error("empty");
        return NextResponse.json({ text, filename, method: "mammoth" });
      } catch {
        const text = await extractDocxFallback(buffer);
        if (text) return NextResponse.json({ text, filename, method: "docx-fallback" });
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "Could not extract DOCX content." }, { status: 422 });
      }
    }

    // ── PDF — send to Claude as base64 document ───────────
    if (ext === "pdf") {
      try {
        const base64 = buffer.toString("base64");
        const response = await anthropic.messages.create({
          model: "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001",
          max_tokens: 16384,
          messages: [
            {
              role: "user",
              content: [
                {
                  type: "document",
                  source: {
                    type: "base64",
                    media_type: "application/pdf",
                    data: base64,
                  },
                } as any,
                {
                  type: "text",
                  text: "Extract ALL text from this document exactly as written. Return only the raw text content, preserving paragraphs and structure. No commentary, no summaries, no formatting changes.",
                },
              ],
            },
          ],
        });

        const text = response.content
          .filter((b) => b.type === "text")
          .map((b) => (b.type === "text" ? b.text : ""))
          .join("")
          .trim();

        if (!text) {
          return NextResponse.json(
            { error: "PDF appears to be empty or image-only with no readable text." },
            { status: 422 }
          );
        }
        return NextResponse.json({ text, filename, method: "claude-pdf" });
      } catch (err: any) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: `PDF extraction failed: ${err.message}` },
          { status: 422 }
        );
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ error: `Unsupported file type: .${ext}` }, { status: 415 });
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error("extract-doc error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message || "Extraction failed" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// ── Zero-dependency DOCX fallback ─────────────────────────────
async function extractDocxFallback(buffer: Buffer): Promise<string> {
  try {
    const { inflateRawSync } = await import("zlib");
    const data = buffer;
    let offset = 0;
    while (offset < data.length - 4) {
      if (
        data[offset] === 0x50 && data[offset + 1] === 0x4b &&
        data[offset + 2] === 0x03 && data[offset + 3] === 0x04
      ) {
        const compression = data.readUInt16LE(offset + 8);
        const compressedSize = data.readUInt32LE(offset + 18);
        const filenameLen = data.readUInt16LE(offset + 26);
        const extraLen = data.readUInt16LE(offset + 28);
        const filenameStart = offset + 30;
        const entryName = data.slice(filenameStart, filenameStart + filenameLen).toString("utf-8");
        const dataStart = filenameStart + filenameLen + extraLen;
        if (entryName === "word/document.xml" && compressedSize > 0) {
          const compressed = data.slice(dataStart, dataStart + compressedSize);
          const xmlBuf = compression === 0 ? compressed : inflateRawSync(compressed);
          return xmlBuf.toString("utf-8")
            .replace(/<w:br[^>]*\/>/g, "\n")
            .replace(/<w:p[ >][^>]*>/g, "\n")
            .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "")
            .replace(/&amp;/g, "&").replace(/&lt;/g, "<").replace(/&gt;/g, ">")
            .replace(/&quot;/g, '"').replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n").trim();
        }
        offset = dataStart + (compressedSize || 1);
      } else {
        offset++;
      }
    }
    return "";
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}

    const auth = createAuthServerClient();

      .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

    return NextResponse.json(data || []);
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

  try {
    const auth = createAuthServerClient();
    const { data: { user } } = await auth.auth.getUser();
    if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

    const supabase = createServerClient();

      .insert({
        user_id: user.id,
        name: body.name || "New Project",
        brand_name: body.brand_name || "",
        status: "draft",
        current_phase: "S1",
      })
      .select()
      .single();

    if (error) throw error;
    return NextResponse.json(data);
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// Project API — CRUD with Supabase

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createServerClient } from "@/lib/db";

export async function GET(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  try {
    const supabase = createServerClient();
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("projects")
      .select("*, s1_intake(*)")
      .eq("id", params.id)
      .single();

    if (error) throw error;
    return NextResponse.json(data);
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 404 });
  }
}

export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  try {
    const supabase = createServerClient();
    const body = await req.json();

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("projects")
      .update(body)
      .eq("id", params.id)
      .select()
      .single();

    if (error) throw error;
    return NextResponse.json(data);
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function DELETE(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  try {
    const supabase = createServerClient();

    // Cascade deletes handle child tables (s1_intake, s2_keywords, etc.)
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from("projects")
      .delete()
      .eq("id", params.id);

    if (error) throw error;
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
