// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// POST /api/projects/[id]/export-gdoc
// Uses direct Google Drive REST API with manual JWT auth
// — no googleapis dependency, no webpack crypto issues
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createServerClient } from "@/lib/db";
import { buildDocxBuffer } from "@/lib/docx-builder";
import crypto from "crypto";

export const maxDuration = 60;

// ── Private key parsing (tries every format) ─────────────────

function parsePrivateKey(raw: string): crypto.KeyObject {
  // Step 1: replace escaped newlines
  const cleaned = raw.replace(/\\n/g, "\n");

  // Try as-is first (already valid PEM)
  try { return crypto.createPrivateKey(cleaned); } catch (_) {}

  // Extract raw base64 content
  const b64 = cleaned
    .replace(/-----BEGIN [A-Z ]+-----/g, "")
    .replace(/-----END [A-Z ]+-----/g, "")
    .replace(/\s+/g, "");

  const wrap = (h: string) => {
    const lines = b64.match(/.{1,64}/g) || [];
    return `-----BEGIN ${h}-----\n${lines.join("\n")}\n-----END ${h}-----\n`;
  };

  // Try PKCS#8 PEM
  try { return crypto.createPrivateKey(wrap("PRIVATE KEY")); } catch (_) {}
  // Try PKCS#1 PEM
  try { return crypto.createPrivateKey(wrap("RSA PRIVATE KEY")); } catch (_) {}
  // Try DER PKCS#8
  try { return crypto.createPrivateKey({ key: Buffer.from(b64, "base64"), format: "der", type: "pkcs8" }); } catch (_) {}
  // Try DER PKCS#1
  try { return crypto.createPrivateKey({ key: Buffer.from(b64, "base64"), format: "der", type: "pkcs1" }); } catch (_) {}

  // All failed — include diagnostics
  throw new Error(
    `Cannot parse private key. len=${raw.length}, ` +
    `starts="${raw.substring(0, 40)}", ` +
    `hasLiteralBackslashN=${raw.includes("\\n")}, ` +
    `hasRealNewline=${raw.includes("\n")}, ` +
    `b64len=${b64.length}`
  );
}

// ── Google OAuth2 via manual JWT ─────────────────────────────

function createJWT(email: string, privateKey: crypto.KeyObject, scopes: string[], subject?: string) {
  const header = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ alg: "RS256", typ: "JWT" })).toString("base64url");
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  const claims: Record<string, unknown> = {
    iss: email,
    scope: scopes.join(" "),
    aud: "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token",
    iat: now,
    exp: now + 3600,
  };
  if (subject) claims.sub = subject;
  const payload = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(claims)).toString("base64url");
  const input = `${header}.${payload}`;
  const signer = crypto.createSign("RSA-SHA256");
  signer.update(input);
  const signature = signer.sign(privateKey, "base64url");
  return `${input}.${signature}`;
}

async function getAccessToken(email: string, privateKey: crypto.KeyObject, scopes: string[], subject?: string) {
  const jwt = createJWT(email, privateKey, scopes, subject);
  const res = await fetch("https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
    body: `grant_type=urn%3Aietf%3Aparams%3Aoauth%3Agrant-type%3Ajwt-bearer&assertion=${jwt}`,
  });
  const data = await res.json();
  if (!data.access_token) throw new Error(`Google auth failed: ${JSON.stringify(data)}`);
  return data.access_token as string;
}

// ── Google Drive REST helpers ────────────────────────────────

const DRIVE = "https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3";
const UPLOAD = "https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3";

async function driveList(token: string, q: string, driveId?: string) {
  const p = new URLSearchParams({ q, fields: "files(id)", supportsAllDrives: "true", includeItemsFromAllDrives: "true" });
  if (driveId) { p.set("corpora", "drive"); p.set("driveId", driveId); }
  const res = await fetch(`${DRIVE}/files?${p}`, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
  const data = await res.json();
  return (data.files || []) as { id: string }[];
}

async function driveCreateFolder(token: string, name: string, parentId: string) {
  const res = await fetch(`${DRIVE}/files?supportsAllDrives=true`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ name, mimeType: "application/vnd.google-apps.folder", parents: [parentId] }),
  });
  const data = await res.json();
  return data.id as string;
}

async function driveDelete(token: string, fileId: string) {
  await fetch(`${DRIVE}/files/${fileId}?supportsAllDrives=true`, {
    method: "DELETE",
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
  });
}

async function driveUpload(token: string, name: string, parentId: string, buffer: Buffer, mimeType: string) {
  const metadata = JSON.stringify({ name, parents: [parentId] });
  const boundary = "----docxupload" + Date.now();
  const body = Buffer.concat([
    Buffer.from(
      `--${boundary}\r\nContent-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8\r\n\r\n${metadata}\r\n` +
      `--${boundary}\r\nContent-Type: ${mimeType}\r\n\r\n`
    ),
    buffer,
    Buffer.from(`\r\n--${boundary}--`),
  ]);
  const res = await fetch(`${UPLOAD}/files?uploadType=multipart&supportsAllDrives=true&fields=id`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, "Content-Type": `multipart/related; boundary=${boundary}` },
    body,
  });
  const data = await res.json();
  if (!data.id) throw new Error(`Upload failed: ${JSON.stringify(data)}`);
  return data.id as string;
}

async function driveGetMeta(token: string, fileId: string, fields: string) {
  const res = await fetch(`${DRIVE}/files/${fileId}?supportsAllDrives=true&fields=${fields}`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
  });
  return res.json();
}

// ── Route handler ────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  try {
    // ── Env check ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    const rootFolderId     = process.env.GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID?.trim();
    const serviceEmail     = process.env.GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL?.trim();
    const serviceKey       = process.env.GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PRIVATE_KEY?.trim();
    const impersonateEmail = process.env.GOOGLE_IMPERSONATE_EMAIL?.trim();
    if (!rootFolderId || !serviceEmail || !serviceKey) {
      const missing = [
        !serviceEmail && "GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL",
        !serviceKey   && "GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PRIVATE_KEY",
        !rootFolderId && "GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID",
      ].filter(Boolean).join(", ");
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: `Google Drive not configured. Add to .env.local: ${missing}`, setup: true },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // ── Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    const supabase = createServerClient();
    const [{ data: proj }, { data: dbRows }] = await Promise.all([
      supabase.from("projects").select("brand_name").eq("id", params.id).single(),
      supabase.from("s7_seo").select("*").eq("project_id", params.id).order("created_at", { ascending: true }),
    ]);
    if (!dbRows?.length) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "No SEO data found. Save content first." }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const brand    = (proj as any)?.brand_name || "Unknown Brand";
    const today    = new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-US", { year: "numeric", month: "long", day: "numeric" });
    const dateSlug = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

    // ── Map rows ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    const rows = (dbRows as any[]).map(r => ({
      asin: r.asin||"", parentage: r.parentage_level||"", product: r.variation_product||"",
      flavor: r.flavor||"", style: r.style||"", color: r.color||"", size: r.size||"",
      title: r.title||"", titleC: r.title_char_length||0,
      d1:r.detailed_bullet_point_1||"",  d1c:r.detailed_bullet_point_1_char_length||0,
      d2:r.detailed_bullet_point_2||"",  d2c:r.detailed_bullet_point_2_char_length||0,
      d3:r.detailed_bullet_point_3||"",  d3c:r.detailed_bullet_point_3_char_length||0,
      d4:r.detailed_bullet_point_4||"",  d4c:r.detailed_bullet_point_4_char_length||0,
      d5:r.detailed_bullet_point_5||"",  d5c:r.detailed_bullet_point_5_char_length||0,
      c1:r.concise_bullet_point_1||"",   c1c:r.concise_bullet_point_1_char_length||0,
      c2:r.concise_bullet_point_2||"",   c2c:r.concise_bullet_point_2_char_length||0,
      c3:r.concise_bullet_point_3||"",   c3c:r.concise_bullet_point_3_char_length||0,
      c4:r.concise_bullet_point_4||"",   c4c:r.concise_bullet_point_4_char_length||0,
      c5:r.concise_bullet_point_5||"",   c5c:r.concise_bullet_point_5_char_length||0,
      ct1:r.content_bullet_point_1||"",  ct1c:r.content_bullet_point_1_char_length||0,
      ct2:r.content_bullet_point_2||"",  ct2c:r.content_bullet_point_2_char_length||0,
      ct3:r.content_bullet_point_3||"",  ct3c:r.content_bullet_point_3_char_length||0,
      ct4:r.content_bullet_point_4||"",  ct4c:r.content_bullet_point_4_char_length||0,
      ct5:r.content_bullet_point_5||"",  ct5c:r.content_bullet_point_5_char_length||0,
      kf1:r.key_features_bullet_point_1||"", kf1c:r.key_features_bullet_point_1_char_length||0,
      kf2:r.key_features_bullet_point_2||"", kf2c:r.key_features_bullet_point_2_char_length||0,
      kf3:r.key_features_bullet_point_3||"", kf3c:r.key_features_bullet_point_3_char_length||0,
      kf4:r.key_features_bullet_point_4||"", kf4c:r.key_features_bullet_point_4_char_length||0,
      kf5:r.key_features_bullet_point_5||"", kf5c:r.key_features_bullet_point_5_char_length||0,
      desc:r.product_description||"",        descC:r.product_description_char_length||0,
      bkCore:r.search_terms_core||"",        bkCoreB:r.search_terms_core_byte_length||0,
      bkSupp:r.search_terms_supplement||"",  bkSuppB:r.search_terms_supplement_byte_length||0,
      bkSymp:r.search_terms_symptom||"",     bkSympB:r.search_terms_symptom_byte_length||0,
      bkAud:r.search_terms_audience||"",     bkAudB:r.search_terms_audience_byte_length||0,
      bkLong:r.search_terms_longtail||"",    bkLongB:r.search_terms_longtail_byte_length||0,
    }));
    rows.sort((a, b) => {
      const aP = a.parentage.toLowerCase()==="parent", bP = b.parentage.toLowerCase()==="parent";
      if (aP && !bP) return -1; if (!aP && bP) return 1; return a.asin.localeCompare(b.asin);
    });

    // ── Build docx ───────────────────────────────────────────
    const buffer = await buildDocxBuffer(rows, brand, today);
    const docName = `OUT_SEO_${brand.replace(/\s+/g, "_")}_${dateSlug}`;

    // ── Authenticate ─────────────────────────────────────────
    const privateKey = parsePrivateKey(serviceKey);
    const scopes = ["https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive"];
    let token: string;
    try {
      token = await getAccessToken(serviceEmail, privateKey, scopes, impersonateEmail || undefined);
    } catch (authErr: any) {
      // Provide diagnostics for auth failures
      const diag = `ServiceAccount: ${serviceEmail}, Impersonate: ${impersonateEmail || "none"}, Folder: ${rootFolderId}`;
      console.error("Auth diagnostic:", diag, authErr);
      return NextResponse.json({
        error: `Google auth failed. Verify your Vercel env vars match your GCP service account JSON. (${diag})`,
        detail: authErr.message,
      }, { status: 500 });
    }

    // ── Detect Shared Drive ──────────────────────────────────
    let driveId: string | undefined;
    try {
      const meta = await driveGetMeta(token, rootFolderId, "driveId");
      driveId = meta.driveId || undefined;
    } catch (_) { /* rootFolderId might be a Drive ID itself */ }

    // ── Find or create brand subfolder ───────────────────────
    const safeBrand = brand.replace(/[/\\?%*:|"<>]/g, "-").trim();
    const existing = await driveList(
      token,
      `name='${safeBrand.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}' and mimeType='application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and '${rootFolderId}' in parents and trashed=false`,
      driveId,
    );

    const brandFolderId = existing.length
      ? existing[0].id
      : await driveCreateFolder(token, safeBrand, rootFolderId);

    // ── Delete old file with same name ───────────────────────
    try {
      const old = await driveList(
        token,
        `(name='${docName}' or name='${docName}.docx') and '${brandFolderId}' in parents and trashed=false`,
        driveId,
      );
      for (const f of old) await driveDelete(token, f.id);
    } catch (_) { /* ignore cleanup errors */ }

    // ── Upload .docx ─────────────────────────────────────────
    const fileId = await driveUpload(
      token,
      `${docName}.docx`,
      brandFolderId,
      buffer,
      "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
    );

    const url = `https://drive.google.com/file/d/${fileId}/view`;
    return NextResponse.json({ url, brand, filename: docName });

  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error("export-gdoc error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message || "Export failed" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createServerClient } from "@/lib/db";

export async function GET(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  try {
    const supabase = createServerClient();
    const phase = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("phase");

    switch (phase) {
      case "s1_intake": {
        const { data: project } = await supabase
          .from("projects")
          .select("brand_name, client_name, client_bible_url, brand_url, competitors, variation_theme, date, client_id_code, brand_guidelines, brand_guidelines_lock, variety_pack_details")
          .eq("id", params.id)
          .single();

        const { data: rows } = await supabase
          .from("s1_intake")
          .select("*")
          .eq("project_id", params.id)
          .order("parentage_level", { ascending: true });

        // Normalize s1_intake rows into the shape the frontend expects
        const asins = (rows || []).map((r: any) => ({
          asin: r.asin,
          sku: r.sku,
          amazon_url: r.amazon_pdp_url,
          website_url: r.website_pdp_url,
          variation_id: r.variation_id,
          variation_product: r.variation_product,
          parentage_level: r.parentage_level,
          variation_theme_name: r.variation_theme_name,
          flavor: r.flavor,
          style: r.style,
          color: r.color,
          size: r.size,
          existing_content: {
            item_name: r.item_name || "",
            detailed_bullets: [
              r.detailed_bullet_point_1 || "",
              r.detailed_bullet_point_2 || "",
              r.detailed_bullet_point_3 || "",
              r.detailed_bullet_point_4 || "",
              r.detailed_bullet_point_5 || "",
            ],
            product_description: r.product_description || "",
            generic_keywords: [
              r.generic_keyword_1 || "",
              r.generic_keyword_2 || "",
              r.generic_keyword_3 || "",
              r.generic_keyword_4 || "",
              r.generic_keyword_5 || "",
            ],
            concise_bullets: [
              r.concise_bullet_point_1 || "",
              r.concise_bullet_point_2 || "",
              r.concise_bullet_point_3 || "",
              r.concise_bullet_point_4 || "",
              r.concise_bullet_point_5 || "",
            ],
            content_bullets: [
              r.pa_li_bullet_point_1 || "",
              r.pa_li_bullet_point_2 || "",
              r.pa_li_bullet_point_3 || "",
              r.pa_li_bullet_point_4 || "",
              r.pa_li_bullet_point_5 || "",
            ],
            key_features: [
              r.key_feature_1 || "",
              r.key_feature_2 || "",
              r.key_feature_3 || "",
              r.key_feature_4 || "",
              r.key_feature_5 || "",
            ],
          },
        }));

        // Build competitors from first row
        const first = rows?.[0];
        const competitors: { name: string; url: string }[] = [];
        if (first) {
          for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
            const name = first[`competitor_${i}_name`];
            if (name) competitors.push({ name, url: first[`competitor_${i}_url`] || "" });
          }
        }

        return NextResponse.json({
          project: {
            ...(project || {}),
            brand_name: first?.brand_name || project?.brand_name || "",
            client_name: first?.client_name || project?.client_name || "",
            client_id_code: first?.client_id_code || project?.client_id_code || "",
            date: first?.date || project?.date || "",
            client_bible_url: first?.client_bible_url || project?.client_bible_url || "",
            brand_url: first?.brand_url || project?.brand_url || "",
            competitors: competitors.length > 0 ? competitors : (project?.competitors || []),
            brand_guidelines: project?.brand_guidelines || "",
            brand_guidelines_lock: project?.brand_guidelines_lock || "not_applicable",
            variety_pack_details: project?.variety_pack_details ? JSON.parse(project.variety_pack_details) : [],
          },
          asins,
        });
      }

      case "s2_keywords": {
        const { data: keywords } = await supabase
          .from("s2_keywords")
          .select("*")
          .eq("project_id", params.id)
          .order("keyword_search_volume", { ascending: false });
        return NextResponse.json({
          keywords: (keywords || []).map((k: any) => ({
            KeywordText: k.keyword_text,
            KeywordSearchVolume: k.keyword_search_volume,
            KeywordPriorityTier: k.keyword_priority_tier,
            KeywordSearchIntent: k.keyword_search_intent,
            KeywordPrimaryUseLocation: k.keyword_primary_use_location,
            KeywordMatchType: k.keyword_match_type,
            KeywordCOSMORelationship: k.keyword_cosmo_relationship,
            KeywordBuyerStage: k.keyword_buyer_stage,
            KeywordNotes: k.keyword_notes,
            KeywordSource: k.keyword_source,
          })),
        });
      }

      case "s3_reviews": {
        const { data: reviews } = await supabase
          .from("s3_reviews")
          .select("*")
          .eq("project_id", params.id)
          .order("review_star_rating", { ascending: false });
        return NextResponse.json({
          reviews: (reviews || []).map((r: any) => ({
            ReviewID: r.review_id,
            ReviewDate: r.review_date,
            ReviewReviewerName: r.review_reviewer_name,
            ReviewASIN: r.review_asin,
            ReviewProductVariation: r.review_product_variation,
            ReviewStarRating: r.review_star_rating,
            ReviewTitle: r.review_title,
            ReviewText: r.review_text,
            ReviewSentiment: r.review_sentiment,
            ReviewKeyThemes: r.review_key_themes,
            ReviewUsageMentioned: r.review_usage_mentioned,
            ReviewPackagingFeedback: r.review_packaging_feedback,
            ReviewPriceFeedback: r.review_price_feedback,
            ReviewHeatLevelFeedback: r.review_heat_level_feedback,
            ReviewRufusUsableInsight: r.review_rufus_usable_insight,
            ReviewBulletMapping: r.review_bullet_mapping,
          })),
        });
      }

      case "s4_rufus": {
        // Load all rufus Q&A rows for this project
        const { data: rows } = await supabase
          .from("s4_rufus")
          .select("*")
          .eq("project_id", params.id)
          .order("created_at", { ascending: true });

        if (!rows || rows.length === 0) {
          return NextResponse.json({ rows: [] });
        }

        // Return rows in the frontend's expected format
        return NextResponse.json({
          rows: rows.map((r: any) => ({
            ASIN: r.asin,
            RufusQuestion: r.rufus_question,
            RufusAnswer: r.rufus_answer,
            RufusQuestionCategory: r.rufus_question_category,
            RufusInsightType: r.rufus_insight_type,
            RufusPrimaryObjectionAddressed: r.rufus_primary_objection_addressed,
            RufusPrimaryDesireAddressed: r.rufus_primary_desire_addressed,
            RufusCOSMORelationship: r.rufus_cosmo_relationship,
            RufusUsageContext: r.rufus_usage_context,
            RufusNotes: r.rufus_notes,
          })),
        });
      }

      case "s5_cosmo": {
        const { data: rows } = await supabase
          .from("s5_cosmo")
          .select("*")
          .eq("project_id", params.id)
          .order("created_at", { ascending: true });

        return NextResponse.json({
          rows: (rows || []).map((r: any) => ({
            ASIN: r.asin,
            COSMOEntity: r.cosmo_entity,
            COSMORelationType: r.cosmo_relation_type,
            COSMOTailType: r.cosmo_tail_type,
            COSMOMappedValue: r.cosmo_mapped_value,
            COSMOUsageExplanation: r.cosmo_usage_explanation,
            COSMOAppliedPDPSection1: r.cosmo_applied_pdp_section_1,
            COSMOAppliedPDPSection2: r.cosmo_applied_pdp_section_2,
            COSMONotes: r.cosmo_notes,
          })),
        });
      }

      case "s6_compliance": {
        const { data: rows } = await supabase
          .from("s6_compliance")
          .select("*")
          .eq("project_id", params.id)
          .order("created_at", { ascending: true });

        return NextResponse.json({
          rows: (rows || []).map((r: any) => ({
            Severity: r.severity,
            Category: r.category,
            SourceSection: r.source_section,
            SourceField: r.source_field,
            FlaggedTerm: r.flagged_term,
            Detail: r.detail,
            ScannedAt: r.scanned_at,
          })),
        });
      }

      case "s7_seo": {
        const { data: rows } = await supabase
          .from("s7_seo")
          .select("*")
          .eq("project_id", params.id)
          .order("created_at", { ascending: true });

        const { data: proj } = await supabase
          .from("projects")
          .select("seo_config")
          .eq("id", params.id)
          .single();

        return NextResponse.json({
          rows: (rows || []).map((r: any) => ({
            ASIN: r.asin,
            URL: r.url,
            VariationID: r.variation_id,
            VariationProduct: r.variation_product,
            ParentageLevel: r.parentage_level,
            VariationThemeName: r.variation_theme_name,
            Flavor: r.flavor,
            Style: r.style,
            Color: r.color,
            Size: r.size,
            Title: r.title,
            Title_CharLength: r.title_char_length,
            DetailedBulletPoint_1: r.detailed_bullet_point_1,
            DetailedBulletPoint_1_CharLength: r.detailed_bullet_point_1_char_length,
            DetailedBulletPoint_2: r.detailed_bullet_point_2,
            DetailedBulletPoint_2_CharLength: r.detailed_bullet_point_2_char_length,
            DetailedBulletPoint_3: r.detailed_bullet_point_3,
            DetailedBulletPoint_3_CharLength: r.detailed_bullet_point_3_char_length,
            DetailedBulletPoint_4: r.detailed_bullet_point_4,
            DetailedBulletPoint_4_CharLength: r.detailed_bullet_point_4_char_length,
            DetailedBulletPoint_5: r.detailed_bullet_point_5,
            DetailedBulletPoint_5_CharLength: r.detailed_bullet_point_5_char_length,
            ConciseBulletPoint_1: r.concise_bullet_point_1,
            ConciseBulletPoint_1_CharLength: r.concise_bullet_point_1_char_length,
            ConciseBulletPoint_2: r.concise_bullet_point_2,
            ConciseBulletPoint_2_CharLength: r.concise_bullet_point_2_char_length,
            ConciseBulletPoint_3: r.concise_bullet_point_3,
            ConciseBulletPoint_3_CharLength: r.concise_bullet_point_3_char_length,
            ConciseBulletPoint_4: r.concise_bullet_point_4,
            ConciseBulletPoint_4_CharLength: r.concise_bullet_point_4_char_length,
            ConciseBulletPoint_5: r.concise_bullet_point_5,
            ConciseBulletPoint_5_CharLength: r.concise_bullet_point_5_char_length,
            ContentBulletPoint_1: r.content_bullet_point_1,
            ContentBulletPoint_1_CharLength: r.content_bullet_point_1_char_length,
            ContentBulletPoint_2: r.content_bullet_point_2,
            ContentBulletPoint_2_CharLength: r.content_bullet_point_2_char_length,
            ContentBulletPoint_3: r.content_bullet_point_3,
            ContentBulletPoint_3_CharLength: r.content_bullet_point_3_char_length,
            ContentBulletPoint_4: r.content_bullet_point_4,
            ContentBulletPoint_4_CharLength: r.content_bullet_point_4_char_length,
            ContentBulletPoint_5: r.content_bullet_point_5,
            ContentBulletPoint_5_CharLength: r.content_bullet_point_5_char_length,
            KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_1: r.key_features_bullet_point_1,
            KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_1_CharLength: r.key_features_bullet_point_1_char_length,
            KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_2: r.key_features_bullet_point_2,
            KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_2_CharLength: r.key_features_bullet_point_2_char_length,
            KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_3: r.key_features_bullet_point_3,
            KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_3_CharLength: r.key_features_bullet_point_3_char_length,
            KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_4: r.key_features_bullet_point_4,
            KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_4_CharLength: r.key_features_bullet_point_4_char_length,
            KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_5: r.key_features_bullet_point_5,
            KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_5_CharLength: r.key_features_bullet_point_5_char_length,
            ProductDescription: r.product_description,
            ProductDescription_CharLength: r.product_description_char_length,
            SearchTermsCore: r.search_terms_core,
            SearchTermsCore_ByteLength: r.search_terms_core_byte_length,
            SearchTermsSupplement: r.search_terms_supplement,
            SearchTermsSupplement_ByteLength: r.search_terms_supplement_byte_length,
            SearchTermsSymptom: r.search_terms_symptom,
            SearchTermsSymptom_ByteLength: r.search_terms_symptom_byte_length,
            SearchTermsAudience: r.search_terms_audience,
            SearchTermsAudience_ByteLength: r.search_terms_audience_byte_length,
            SearchTermsLongTail: r.search_terms_longtail,
            SearchTermsLongTail_ByteLength: r.search_terms_longtail_byte_length,
          })),
          config: proj?.seo_config || null,
        });
      }

      case "parent_asin": {
        const { data: parent } = await supabase
          .from("s1_intake")
          .select("asin, amazon_pdp_url")
          .eq("project_id", params.id)
          .eq("parentage_level", "Parent")
          .single();
        return NextResponse.json({
          parent: parent ? { asin: parent.asin, amazon_url: parent.amazon_pdp_url } : null,
        });
      }

      default:
        return NextResponse.json({ error: `Unknown phase: ${phase}` }, { status: 400 });
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Save Phase Data API
// POST /api/projects/[id]/save
// Saves keywords, reviews, rufus, cosmo data to Supabase
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { createServerClient } from "@/lib/db";

export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: { id: string } }) {
  try {
    const supabase = createServerClient();
    const body = await req.json();
    const { phase, data } = body;

    switch (phase) {
      case "s1_intake": {
        const { metadata, asins, variety_pack_details } = data;

        // Update project metadata
        const { error: metaError } = await supabase
          .from("projects")
          .update({
            brand_name: metadata.brand_name || metadata.brandName,
            date: metadata.date,
            client_id_code: metadata.client_id_code || metadata.clientIdCode,
            client_name: metadata.client_name || metadata.clientName,
            client_bible_url: metadata.client_bible_url || metadata.clientBibleUrl,
            brand_url: metadata.brand_url || metadata.brandUrl,
            competitors: metadata.competitors || [],
            variation_theme: asins?.[0]?.variation_theme_name || "",
            brand_guidelines: metadata.brand_guidelines || "",
            brand_guidelines_lock: metadata.brand_guidelines_lock || "not_applicable",
            variety_pack_details: variety_pack_details ? JSON.stringify(variety_pack_details) : null,
          })
          .eq("id", params.id);
        if (metaError) {
          console.error("Project metadata update error:", metaError);
          throw metaError;
        }

        // Save to s1_intake (flat columns)
        if (asins && asins.length > 0) {
          await supabase.from("s1_intake").delete().eq("project_id", params.id);

          const ec = (a: any) => a.existing_content || {};
          const rows = asins.map((a: any) => ({
            project_id: params.id,
            // A-L: Structure
            asin: a.asin || "",
            sku: a.sku || "",
            amazon_pdp_url: a.amazon_url || "",
            website_pdp_url: a.website_url || "",
            variation_id: a.variation_id || "",
            variation_product: a.variation_product || "",
            parentage_level: a.parentage_level || "Child",
            variation_theme_name: a.variation_theme_name || "",
            flavor: a.flavor || "",
            style: a.style || "",
            color: a.color || "",
            size: a.size || "",
            // M-R: Item Name + Detailed Bullets
            item_name: ec(a).item_name || "",
            detailed_bullet_point_1: (ec(a).detailed_bullets || [])[0] || "",
            detailed_bullet_point_2: (ec(a).detailed_bullets || [])[1] || "",
            detailed_bullet_point_3: (ec(a).detailed_bullets || [])[2] || "",
            detailed_bullet_point_4: (ec(a).detailed_bullets || [])[3] || "",
            detailed_bullet_point_5: (ec(a).detailed_bullets || [])[4] || "",
            // S: Description
            product_description: ec(a).product_description || "",
            // T-X: Generic Keywords
            generic_keyword_1: (ec(a).generic_keywords || [])[0] || "",
            generic_keyword_2: (ec(a).generic_keywords || [])[1] || "",
            generic_keyword_3: (ec(a).generic_keywords || [])[2] || "",
            generic_keyword_4: (ec(a).generic_keywords || [])[3] || "",
            generic_keyword_5: (ec(a).generic_keywords || [])[4] || "",
            // Y-AC: Concise Bullets
            concise_bullet_point_1: (ec(a).concise_bullets || [])[0] || "",
            concise_bullet_point_2: (ec(a).concise_bullets || [])[1] || "",
            concise_bullet_point_3: (ec(a).concise_bullets || [])[2] || "",
            concise_bullet_point_4: (ec(a).concise_bullets || [])[3] || "",
            concise_bullet_point_5: (ec(a).concise_bullets || [])[4] || "",
            // AD-AH: PA+/LI Bullets
            pa_li_bullet_point_1: (ec(a).content_bullets || [])[0] || "",
            pa_li_bullet_point_2: (ec(a).content_bullets || [])[1] || "",
            pa_li_bullet_point_3: (ec(a).content_bullets || [])[2] || "",
            pa_li_bullet_point_4: (ec(a).content_bullets || [])[3] || "",
            pa_li_bullet_point_5: (ec(a).content_bullets || [])[4] || "",
            // AI-AM: Key Features
            key_feature_1: (ec(a).key_features || [])[0] || "",
            key_feature_2: (ec(a).key_features || [])[1] || "",
            key_feature_3: (ec(a).key_features || [])[2] || "",
            key_feature_4: (ec(a).key_features || [])[3] || "",
            key_feature_5: (ec(a).key_features || [])[4] || "",
            // Metadata (same on every row)
            date: metadata.date || "",
            client_id_code: metadata.client_id_code || metadata.clientIdCode || "",
            brand_name: metadata.brand_name || metadata.brandName || "",
            client_name: metadata.client_name || metadata.clientName || "",
            client_bible_url: metadata.client_bible_url || metadata.clientBibleUrl || "",
            brand_url: metadata.brand_url || metadata.brandUrl || "",
            // Competitors
            competitor_1_name: (metadata.competitors || [])[0]?.name || "",
            competitor_1_url: (metadata.competitors || [])[0]?.url || "",
            competitor_2_name: (metadata.competitors || [])[1]?.name || "",
            competitor_2_url: (metadata.competitors || [])[1]?.url || "",
            competitor_3_name: (metadata.competitors || [])[2]?.name || "",
            competitor_3_url: (metadata.competitors || [])[2]?.url || "",
            competitor_4_name: (metadata.competitors || [])[3]?.name || "",
            competitor_4_url: (metadata.competitors || [])[3]?.url || "",
            competitor_5_name: (metadata.competitors || [])[4]?.name || "",
            competitor_5_url: (metadata.competitors || [])[4]?.url || "",
          }));

          const { error } = await supabase.from("s1_intake").insert(rows);
          if (error) throw error;
        }

        // Mark S1 approved
        await supabase
          .from("projects")
          .update({ s1_approved_at: new Date().toISOString(), current_phase: "S2" })
          .eq("id", params.id);

        return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
      }

      case "s2_keywords": {
        await supabase.from("s2_keywords").delete().eq("project_id", params.id);

        const keywordRows = data.keywords.map((k: any) => ({
          project_id: params.id,
          asin: k.ASIN || "",
          keyword_text: k.KeywordText,
          keyword_search_volume: k.KeywordSearchVolume || 0,
          keyword_priority_tier: k.KeywordPriorityTier,
          keyword_search_intent: k.KeywordSearchIntent,
          keyword_primary_use_location: k.KeywordPrimaryUseLocation,
          keyword_match_type: k.KeywordMatchType,
          keyword_cosmo_relationship: k.KeywordCOSMORelationship,
          keyword_buyer_stage: k.KeywordBuyerStage,
          keyword_notes: k.KeywordNotes || "",
          keyword_source: k.KeywordSource || "Client",
        }));

        const { error } = await supabase.from("s2_keywords").insert(keywordRows);
        if (error) throw error;

        await supabase
          .from("projects")
          .update({ s2_approved_at: new Date().toISOString(), current_phase: "S3" })
          .eq("id", params.id);

        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, count: keywordRows.length });
      }

      case "s3_reviews": {
        // Delete existing reviews
        await supabase.from("s3_reviews").delete().eq("project_id", params.id);

        const reviewRows = data.reviews.map((r: any) => ({
          project_id: params.id,
          review_id: r.ReviewID || "",
          review_date: r.ReviewDate || "",
          review_reviewer_name: r.ReviewReviewerName || "",
          review_asin: r.ReviewASIN || "",
          review_product_variation: r.ReviewProductVariation || "",
          review_star_rating: r.ReviewStarRating || 0,
          review_title: r.ReviewTitle || "",
          review_text: r.ReviewText || r.originalText || "",
          review_sentiment: r.ReviewSentiment || "",
          review_key_themes: r.ReviewKeyThemes || "",
          review_usage_mentioned: r.ReviewUsageMentioned || "",
          review_packaging_feedback: r.ReviewPackagingFeedback || "",
          review_price_feedback: r.ReviewPriceFeedback || "",
          review_heat_level_feedback: r.ReviewHeatLevelFeedback || "",
          review_rufus_usable_insight: r.ReviewRufusUsableInsight || "",
          review_bullet_mapping: r.ReviewBulletMapping || "",
        }));

        const { error } = await supabase.from("s3_reviews").insert(reviewRows);
        if (error) throw error;

        await supabase
          .from("projects")
          .update({ s3_approved_at: new Date().toISOString(), current_phase: "S4" })
          .eq("id", params.id);

        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, count: reviewRows.length });
      }

      case "s4_rufus": {
        // Delete existing rufus rows and insert one row per Q&A pair
        await supabase.from("s4_rufus").delete().eq("project_id", params.id);

        const rows = (data.analyzedRows || []).map((r: any) => ({
          project_id: params.id,
          asin: r.ASIN || "",
          rufus_question: r.RufusQuestion || "",
          rufus_answer: r.RufusAnswer || "",
          rufus_question_category: r.RufusQuestionCategory || "",
          rufus_insight_type: r.RufusInsightType || "",
          rufus_primary_objection_addressed: r.RufusPrimaryObjectionAddressed || "",
          rufus_primary_desire_addressed: r.RufusPrimaryDesireAddressed || "",
          rufus_cosmo_relationship: r.RufusCOSMORelationship || "",
          rufus_usage_context: r.RufusUsageContext || "",
          rufus_notes: r.RufusNotes || "",
        }));

        if (rows.length > 0) {
          const { error } = await supabase.from("s4_rufus").insert(rows);
          if (error) throw error;
        }

        await supabase
          .from("projects")
          .update({ s4_approved_at: new Date().toISOString(), current_phase: "S5" })
          .eq("id", params.id);

        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, count: rows.length });
      }

      case "s5_cosmo": {
        // Delete existing and insert one row per COSMO relationship
        await supabase.from("s5_cosmo").delete().eq("project_id", params.id);

        const cosmoRows = (data.rows || []).map((r: any) => ({
          project_id: params.id,
          asin: r.ASIN || "",
          cosmo_entity: r.COSMOEntity || "",
          cosmo_relation_type: r.COSMORelationType || "",
          cosmo_tail_type: r.COSMOTailType || "",
          cosmo_mapped_value: r.COSMOMappedValue || "",
          cosmo_usage_explanation: r.COSMOUsageExplanation || "",
          cosmo_applied_pdp_section_1: r.COSMOAppliedPDPSection1 || "",
          cosmo_applied_pdp_section_2: r.COSMOAppliedPDPSection2 || "",
          cosmo_notes: r.COSMONotes || "",
        }));

        if (cosmoRows.length > 0) {
          const { error } = await supabase.from("s5_cosmo").insert(cosmoRows);
          if (error) throw error;
        }

        await supabase
          .from("projects")
          .update({ s5_approved_at: new Date().toISOString(), current_phase: "S6" })
          .eq("id", params.id);

        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, count: cosmoRows.length });
      }

      case "s6_compliance": {
        await supabase.from("s6_compliance").delete().eq("project_id", params.id);

        const complianceRows = (data.rows || []).map((r: any) => ({
          project_id: params.id,
          severity: r.Severity || "",
          category: r.Category || "",
          source_section: r.SourceSection || "",
          source_field: r.SourceField || "",
          flagged_term: r.FlaggedTerm || "",
          detail: r.Detail || "",
          scanned_at: r.ScannedAt || new Date().toISOString(),
        }));

        if (complianceRows.length > 0) {
          const { error } = await supabase.from("s6_compliance").insert(complianceRows);
          if (error) throw error;
        }

        // Store compliance summary on the project (compliance is integrated into S6 SEO)
        await supabase
          .from("projects")
          .update({
            compliance_summary: data.summary || null,
          })
          .eq("id", params.id);

        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, count: complianceRows.length });
      }

      case "s7_seo": {
        await supabase.from("s7_seo").delete().eq("project_id", params.id);

        const seoRows = (data.rows || []).map((r: any) => ({
          project_id: params.id,
          asin: r.ASIN || "",
          url: r.URL || "",
          variation_id: r.VariationID || "",
          variation_product: r.VariationProduct || "",
          parentage_level: r.ParentageLevel || "",
          variation_theme_name: r.VariationThemeName || "",
          flavor: r.Flavor || "",
          style: r.Style || "",
          color: r.Color || "",
          size: r.Size || "",
          title: r.Title || "",
          title_char_length: r.Title_CharLength || 0,
          detailed_bullet_point_1: r.DetailedBulletPoint_1 || "",
          detailed_bullet_point_1_char_length: r.DetailedBulletPoint_1_CharLength || 0,
          detailed_bullet_point_2: r.DetailedBulletPoint_2 || "",
          detailed_bullet_point_2_char_length: r.DetailedBulletPoint_2_CharLength || 0,
          detailed_bullet_point_3: r.DetailedBulletPoint_3 || "",
          detailed_bullet_point_3_char_length: r.DetailedBulletPoint_3_CharLength || 0,
          detailed_bullet_point_4: r.DetailedBulletPoint_4 || "",
          detailed_bullet_point_4_char_length: r.DetailedBulletPoint_4_CharLength || 0,
          detailed_bullet_point_5: r.DetailedBulletPoint_5 || "",
          detailed_bullet_point_5_char_length: r.DetailedBulletPoint_5_CharLength || 0,
          concise_bullet_point_1: r.ConciseBulletPoint_1 || "",
          concise_bullet_point_1_char_length: r.ConciseBulletPoint_1_CharLength || 0,
          concise_bullet_point_2: r.ConciseBulletPoint_2 || "",
          concise_bullet_point_2_char_length: r.ConciseBulletPoint_2_CharLength || 0,
          concise_bullet_point_3: r.ConciseBulletPoint_3 || "",
          concise_bullet_point_3_char_length: r.ConciseBulletPoint_3_CharLength || 0,
          concise_bullet_point_4: r.ConciseBulletPoint_4 || "",
          concise_bullet_point_4_char_length: r.ConciseBulletPoint_4_CharLength || 0,
          concise_bullet_point_5: r.ConciseBulletPoint_5 || "",
          concise_bullet_point_5_char_length: r.ConciseBulletPoint_5_CharLength || 0,
          content_bullet_point_1: r.ContentBulletPoint_1 || "",
          content_bullet_point_1_char_length: r.ContentBulletPoint_1_CharLength || 0,
          content_bullet_point_2: r.ContentBulletPoint_2 || "",
          content_bullet_point_2_char_length: r.ContentBulletPoint_2_CharLength || 0,
          content_bullet_point_3: r.ContentBulletPoint_3 || "",
          content_bullet_point_3_char_length: r.ContentBulletPoint_3_CharLength || 0,
          content_bullet_point_4: r.ContentBulletPoint_4 || "",
          content_bullet_point_4_char_length: r.ContentBulletPoint_4_CharLength || 0,
          content_bullet_point_5: r.ContentBulletPoint_5 || "",
          content_bullet_point_5_char_length: r.ContentBulletPoint_5_CharLength || 0,
          key_features_bullet_point_1: r.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_1 || "",
          key_features_bullet_point_1_char_length: r.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_1_CharLength || 0,
          key_features_bullet_point_2: r.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_2 || "",
          key_features_bullet_point_2_char_length: r.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_2_CharLength || 0,
          key_features_bullet_point_3: r.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_3 || "",
          key_features_bullet_point_3_char_length: r.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_3_CharLength || 0,
          key_features_bullet_point_4: r.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_4 || "",
          key_features_bullet_point_4_char_length: r.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_4_CharLength || 0,
          key_features_bullet_point_5: r.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_5 || "",
          key_features_bullet_point_5_char_length: r.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_5_CharLength || 0,
          product_description: r.ProductDescription || "",
          product_description_char_length: r.ProductDescription_CharLength || 0,
          search_terms_core: r.SearchTermsCore || "",
          search_terms_core_byte_length: r.SearchTermsCore_ByteLength || 0,
          search_terms_supplement: r.SearchTermsSupplement || "",
          search_terms_supplement_byte_length: r.SearchTermsSupplement_ByteLength || 0,
          search_terms_symptom: r.SearchTermsSymptom || "",
          search_terms_symptom_byte_length: r.SearchTermsSymptom_ByteLength || 0,
          search_terms_audience: r.SearchTermsAudience || "",
          search_terms_audience_byte_length: r.SearchTermsAudience_ByteLength || 0,
          search_terms_longtail: r.SearchTermsLongTail || "",
          search_terms_longtail_byte_length: r.SearchTermsLongTail_ByteLength || 0,
        }));

        if (seoRows.length > 0) {
          const { error } = await supabase.from("s7_seo").insert(seoRows);
          if (error) throw error;
        }

        await supabase
          .from("projects")
          .update({
            // Only mark fully approved when in_progress is explicitly false
            ...(data.config?.in_progress === false ? {
              s6_approved_at: new Date().toISOString(),
              current_phase: "S7",
            } : {}),
            seo_config: data.config || null,
          })
          .eq("id", params.id);

        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, count: seoRows.length });
      }

      default:
        return NextResponse.json({ error: `Unknown phase: ${phase}` }, { status: 400 });
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error("Save error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { createAuthBrowserClient } from "@/lib/auth-browser";

export default function LoginPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const supabase = createAuthBrowserClient();

  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [isSignUp, setIsSignUp] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setLoading(true);

    const { error: authError } = isSignUp
      ? await supabase.auth.signUp({ email, password })
      : await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });

    if (authError) {
      setError(authError.message);
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    router.push("/");
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-zinc-950 px-4">
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm">
        {/* Logo + title */}
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center mb-8">
          <img src="/logo.png" alt="1o8 Agency" width={56} height={56} className="rounded-lg mb-4" />
          <h1 className="text-xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-zinc-100">1o8 SEO Manager</h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 mt-1">Amazon Listing Optimization</p>
        </div>

        {/* Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="rounded-xl border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900/60 p-6 space-y-4">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-200">
            {isSignUp ? "Create Account" : "Sign In"}
          </h2>

          {error && (
            <div className="rounded-md bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-red-400">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}

          <div>
            <label className="text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-500 mb-1 block">Email</label>
            <input
              type="email"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              required
              autoFocus
              className="w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-800 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-200 focus:border-amber-500 focus:outline-none"
              placeholder="you@company.com"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-500 mb-1 block">Password</label>
            <input
              type="password"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              required
              minLength={6}
              className="w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-800 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-200 focus:border-amber-500 focus:outline-none"
              placeholder="Min 6 characters"
            />
          </div>

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading}
            className="w-full rounded-lg bg-amber-500 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-black hover:bg-amber-400 disabled:opacity-50 transition-colors"
          >
            {loading ? "Please wait..." : isSignUp ? "Create Account" : "Sign In"}
          </button>

          <p className="text-center text-xs text-zinc-500">
            {isSignUp ? "Already have an account?" : "Don't have an account?"}{" "}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => { setIsSignUp(!isSignUp); setError(null); }}
              className="text-amber-400 hover:text-amber-300 underline"
            >
              {isSignUp ? "Sign in" : "Sign up"}
            </button>
          </p>
        </form>

        <p className="text-center text-[10px] text-zinc-700 mt-6">
          1o8 Marketplace SEO — RUFUS + COSMO System
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: seo-manager-reference/app/projects/[id]/cosmo/page.tsx
