"use client";

import { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from "react";
import StepNav from "@/components/step-nav";
import AIGeneratingButton from "@/components/ai-generating-button";
import { useRouter, useParams } from "next/navigation";

// ── Steps ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
const COSMO_STEPS = [
  { key: "inputs", label: "S5.1 Verify Inputs" },
  { key: "summary", label: "S5.2 Research Summary" },
  { key: "mapping", label: "S5.3 Generate COSMO Map" },
  { key: "review", label: "S5.4 Review OUT_COS" },
  { key: "approved", label: "S5.5 Approved" },
];

const RELATION_TYPES = [
  "IS_A", "HAS_A", "USED_FOR", "USED_FOR_AUD", "MADE_OF",
  "SOLD_AS", "COMPARED_TO", "INTERESTED_IN", "AVAILABLE_IN",
  "USED_WITH", "USED_BY", "xINTERESTED_IN", "xWANT",
];

interface COSMORow {
  ASIN: string;
  COSMOEntity: string;
  COSMORelationType: string;
  COSMOTailType: string;
  COSMOMappedValue: string;
  COSMOUsageExplanation: string;
  COSMOAppliedPDPSection1: string;
  COSMOAppliedPDPSection2: string;
  COSMONotes: string;
}

interface InputStatus {
  s1: boolean; s2: boolean; s3: boolean; s4: boolean;
  s1Count: number; s2Count: number; s3Count: number; s4Count: number;
}

interface ResearchData {
  brandName: string;
  parentAsin: string;
  asins: any[];
  variationTheme: string;
  varietyPackDetails?: any[];
  competitors: { name: string; url: string }[];
  keywords: any[];
  tierCounts: Record<string, number>;
  topKeywords: any[];
  intentBreakdown: Record<string, number>;
  reviews: any[];
  avgRating: number;
  sentimentBreakdown: Record<string, number>;
  topThemes: string[];
  topInsights: string[];
  rufusRows: any[];
  rufusCategories: Record<string, number>;
  cosmoHints: Record<string, number>;
}

type Step = "inputs" | "summary" | "mapping" | "review" | "approved";

export default function COSMOPage() {
  const params = useParams();
  const router = useRouter();
  const projectId = params.id as string;

  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>("inputs");
  const [completedSteps, setCompletedSteps] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [isApproved, setIsApproved] = useState(false);
  const [loadingState, setLoadingState] = useState(true);
  const [guidelinesText, setGuidelinesText] = useState("");

  const [inputStatus, setInputStatus] = useState<InputStatus>({
    s1: false, s2: false, s3: false, s4: false,
    s1Count: 0, s2Count: 0, s3Count: 0, s4Count: 0,
  });
  const [inputsVerified, setInputsVerified] = useState(false);

  const [research, setResearch] = useState<ResearchData | null>(null);
  const [researchLoading, setResearchLoading] = useState(false);

  const [cosmoRows, setCosmoRows] = useState<COSMORow[]>([]);
  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState(false);
  const [aiError, setAiError] = useState("");
  const [parentAsin, setParentAsin] = useState("");
  const [brandName, setBrandName] = useState("");

  // ── Load saved data on mount ─────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => {
    async function load() {
      try {
        const projRes = await fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}`);
        if (projRes.ok) {
          const proj = await projRes.json();
          if (proj.brand_name) setBrandName(proj.brand_name);
        if (proj.brand_guidelines) setGuidelinesText(proj.brand_guidelines);
        }

        const asinRes = await fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/load?phase=parent_asin`);
        if (asinRes.ok) {
          const { parent } = await asinRes.json();
          if (parent) setParentAsin(parent.asin);
        }

        const cosmoRes = await fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/load?phase=s5_cosmo`);
        if (cosmoRes.ok) {
          const data = await cosmoRes.json();
          if (data.rows && data.rows.length > 0) {
            setCosmoRows(data.rows);
            setIsApproved(true);
            setInputsVerified(true);
            setCompletedSteps(new Set(COSMO_STEPS.map((s: any) => s.key)));
            setStep("approved");
          }
        }
      } catch {}
      setLoadingState(false);
    }
    load();
  }, [projectId]);

  // ── Verify all prerequisite inputs ───────────────────────
  const verifyInputs = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const status: InputStatus = {
        s1: false, s2: false, s3: false, s4: false,
        s1Count: 0, s2Count: 0, s3Count: 0, s4Count: 0,
      };

      const [s1Res, s2Res, s3Res, s4Res] = await Promise.all([
        fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/load?phase=s1_intake`),
        fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/load?phase=s2_keywords`),
        fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/load?phase=s3_reviews`),
        fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/load?phase=s4_rufus`),
      ]);

      if (s1Res.ok) { const s1 = await s1Res.json(); status.s1 = (s1.asins?.length || 0) > 0; status.s1Count = s1.asins?.length || 0; }
      if (s2Res.ok) {
        const s2 = await s2Res.json();
        const s2Count = s2.keywords?.length || 0;
        // Also check localStorage in case keywords haven't been saved to Supabase yet
        let s2FromLocal = false;
        try {
          const localRaw = localStorage.getItem(`project_state_${projectId}`);
          if (localRaw) {
            const localState = JSON.parse(localRaw);
            if (localState.s2_approved_at) s2FromLocal = true;
            if (!s2Count && localState.section_locks?.s2_keywords_data) {
              const kdata = JSON.parse(localState.section_locks.s2_keywords_data);
              if (kdata.keywords?.length > 0) { status.s2Count = kdata.keywords.length; }
            }
          }
        } catch {}
        status.s2 = s2Count > 0 || s2FromLocal;
        if (s2Count > 0) status.s2Count = s2Count;
      }
      if (s3Res.ok) {
        const s3 = await s3Res.json();
        const s3Count = s3.reviews?.length || 0;
        // S3 can be skipped (0 reviews) — check approval timestamp too
        let s3Approved = false;
        try {
          const localRaw = localStorage.getItem(`project_state_${projectId}`);
          if (localRaw) {
            const localState = JSON.parse(localRaw);
            if (localState.s3_approved_at) s3Approved = true;
          }
        } catch {}
        status.s3 = s3Count > 0 || s3Approved;
        status.s3Count = s3Count;
      }
      if (s4Res.ok) { const s4 = await s4Res.json(); status.s4 = (s4.rows?.length || 0) > 0; status.s4Count = s4.rows?.length || 0; }

      setInputStatus(status);
      if (status.s1 && status.s2 && status.s3 && status.s4) {
        setInputsVerified(true);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setAiError("Failed to verify inputs: " + err.message);
    }
  }, [projectId]);

  // ── Load full research data for summary ──────────────────
  const loadResearch = useCallback(async () => {
    setResearchLoading(true);
    try {
      const [s1Res, s2Res, s3Res, s4Res] = await Promise.all([
        fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/load?phase=s1_intake`),
        fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/load?phase=s2_keywords`),
        fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/load?phase=s3_reviews`),
        fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/load?phase=s4_rufus`),
      ]);

      const s1 = s1Res.ok ? await s1Res.json() : {};
      const s2 = s2Res.ok ? await s2Res.json() : {};
      const s3 = s3Res.ok ? await s3Res.json() : {};
      const s4 = s4Res.ok ? await s4Res.json() : {};

      const kws = s2.keywords || [];
      const revs = s3.reviews || [];
      const ruf = s4.rows || [];

      // S2 analysis
      const tierCounts: Record<string, number> = {};
      const intentBreakdown: Record<string, number> = {};
      kws.forEach((k: any) => {
        tierCounts[k.KeywordPriorityTier] = (tierCounts[k.KeywordPriorityTier] || 0) + 1;
        intentBreakdown[k.KeywordSearchIntent] = (intentBreakdown[k.KeywordSearchIntent] || 0) + 1;
      });

      // S3 analysis
      const sentimentBreakdown: Record<string, number> = {};
      let ratingSum = 0;
      const themeMap: Record<string, number> = {};
      revs.forEach((r: any) => {
        sentimentBreakdown[r.ReviewSentiment] = (sentimentBreakdown[r.ReviewSentiment] || 0) + 1;
        ratingSum += (r.ReviewStarRating || 0);
        if (r.ReviewKeyThemes) {
          r.ReviewKeyThemes.split(/[,;|]/).forEach((t: string) => {
            const clean = t.trim();
            if (clean) themeMap[clean] = (themeMap[clean] || 0) + 1;
          });
        }
      });
      const topThemes = Object.entries(themeMap).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 8).map(([t]) => t);
      const topInsights = revs.filter((r: any) => r.ReviewRufusUsableInsight && r.ReviewRufusUsableInsight !== "None").slice(0, 6).map((r: any) => r.ReviewRufusUsableInsight);

      // S4 analysis
      const rufusCategories: Record<string, number> = {};
      const cosmoHints: Record<string, number> = {};
      ruf.forEach((r: any) => {
        if (r.RufusQuestionCategory) rufusCategories[r.RufusQuestionCategory] = (rufusCategories[r.RufusQuestionCategory] || 0) + 1;
        if (r.RufusCOSMORelationship) cosmoHints[r.RufusCOSMORelationship] = (cosmoHints[r.RufusCOSMORelationship] || 0) + 1;
      });

      const vpDetails = s1.project?.variety_pack_details || [];
      setResearch({
        brandName: s1.project?.brand_name || brandName,
        parentAsin,
        asins: s1.asins || [],
        varietyPackDetails: vpDetails,
        variationTheme: s1.asins?.[0]?.variation_theme_name || "—",
        competitors: s1.project?.competitors || [],
        keywords: kws,
        tierCounts,
        topKeywords: kws.filter((k: any) => k.KeywordPriorityTier === "Tier 1").slice(0, 12),
        intentBreakdown,
        reviews: revs,
        avgRating: revs.length > 0 ? ratingSum / revs.length : 0,
        sentimentBreakdown,
        topThemes,
        topInsights,
        rufusRows: ruf,
        rufusCategories,
        cosmoHints,
      });

      setCompletedSteps(prev => new Set([...prev, "inputs"]));
      setStep("summary");
    } catch (err: any) {
      setAiError("Failed to load research: " + err.message);
    } finally {
      setResearchLoading(false);
    }
  }, [projectId, brandName, parentAsin]);

  // ── Generate COSMO Map via Claude ────────────────────────
  const generateCOSMO = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!research) return;
    setIsGenerating(true);
    setAiError("");

    try {
      // Pre-trim data on client side to minimize payload size
      const asinList = (research.asins || []).map((a: any) => a.asin).join(", ");
      const topKeywords = (research.keywords || [])
        .slice(0, 25)
        .map((k: any) => `${k.KeywordText} (SV:${k.KeywordSearchVolume}, ${k.KeywordPriorityTier})`)
        .join("\n");
      const reviewThemes = (research.reviews || [])
        .slice(0, 15)
        .map((r: any) => `[${r.ReviewStarRating}★] ${r.ReviewKeyThemes || ""} | ${r.ReviewRufusUsableInsight || ""}`)
        .join("\n");
      const rufusInsights = (research.rufusRows || [])
        .slice(0, 15)
        .map((r: any) => `Q: ${r.RufusQuestion}\nA: ${(r.RufusAnswer || "").substring(0, 150)}\nCOSMO hint: ${r.RufusCOSMORelationship || ""}`)
        .join("\n\n");

      const res = await fetch("/api/claude/cosmo", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          action: "generate",
          brandName: research.brandName,
          parentAsin: research.parentAsin,
          asinList,
          topKeywords,
          reviewThemes,
          rufusInsights,
          guidelines: guidelinesText,
        }),
      });

      let data;
      try {
        data = await res.json();
      } catch {
        throw new Error("Response was cut off — the API may have timed out. Please try again.");
      }
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `API ${res.status}`);

      setCosmoRows(data.rows || []);
      setCompletedSteps(prev => new Set([...prev, "inputs", "summary"]));
      setStep("review");
    } catch (err: any) {
      setAiError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(false);
    }
  }, [research]);

  // ── Download CSV ─────────────────────────────────────────
  const downloadCSV = useCallback(() => {
    const headers = ["ASIN","COSMOEntity","COSMORelationType","COSMOTailType","COSMOMappedValue","COSMOUsageExplanation","COSMOAppliedPDPSection1","COSMOAppliedPDPSection2","COSMONotes"];
    const csvRows = [headers.join(",")];
    for (const r of cosmoRows) {
      csvRows.push(headers.map(h => `"${(r[h as keyof COSMORow] || "").replace(/"/g, '""')}"`).join(","));
    }
    const blob = new Blob([csvRows.join("\n")], { type: "text/csv" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url; a.download = "OUT_COS.csv"; a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, [cosmoRows]);

  // ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  const StatBadge = ({ label, value, color = "zinc" }: { label: string; value: string | number; color?: string }) => (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-2 px-3 py-2">
      <div className={`text-sm font-extrabold ${color === "green" ? "text-accent-green" : color === "amber" ? "text-brand-400" : color === "red" ? "text-red-400" : "text-zinc-100"}`}>{value}</div>
      <div className="text-[9px] text-zinc-500 uppercase tracking-wide">{label}</div>
    </div>
  );

  if (loadingState) {
    return <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20"><span className="text-zinc-500">Loading S5 COSMO...</span></div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-6xl">
      <h1 className="text-xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-zinc-100 mb-1">COSMO Semantic Modeling</h1>
      <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 mb-4">
        {step === "inputs" ? "Verify Prerequisite Inputs" : step === "summary" ? "Research Summary — All Inputs" : step === "mapping" ? "Generating COSMO Map" : step === "review" ? "Review COSMO Map (OUT_COS)" : "COSMO — Approved"}
      </p>
      <StepNav
        steps={COSMO_STEPS}
        currentStep={step}
        onStepClick={(key) => setStep(key as Step)}
        completedSteps={completedSteps}
        isApproved={isApproved}
      />

      {/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
      {/* STEP 1: VERIFY INPUTS                                  */}
      {/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
      {step === "inputs" && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 p-5">
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-200 mb-3">Prerequisite Gate — All sections must be approved</h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 mb-4">COSMO modeling requires locked data from S1 Intake, S2 Keywords, S3 Reviews, and S4 Rufus.</p>

            {!inputStatus.s1 && !inputsVerified ? (
              <button onClick={verifyInputs} className="rounded-lg bg-brand-500 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-surface-0 hover:bg-brand-400">
                Verify All Inputs
              </button>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {[
                  { label: "S1 Intake", ok: inputStatus.s1, count: inputStatus.s1Count, unit: "ASINs" },
                  { label: "S2 Keywords", ok: inputStatus.s2, count: inputStatus.s2Count, unit: "keywords" },
                  { label: "S3 Reviews", ok: inputStatus.s3, count: inputStatus.s3Count, unit: "reviews" },
                  { label: "S4 Rufus", ok: inputStatus.s4, count: inputStatus.s4Count, unit: "Q&A pairs" },
                ].map(({ label, ok, count, unit }) => (
                  <div key={label} className={`flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 text-sm ${ok ? "bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20" : "bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20"}`}>
                    <span className={ok ? "text-emerald-400" : "text-red-400"}>{ok ? "✓" : "✗"}</span>
                    <span className={ok ? "text-emerald-300" : "text-red-300"}>{label}</span>
                    <span className="text-zinc-500 text-xs ml-auto">{ok ? (count > 0 ? `${count} ${unit}` : "Skipped") : "Not found"}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}

                {inputsVerified && (
                  <div className="pt-3">
                    <button onClick={loadResearch} disabled={researchLoading} className="rounded-lg bg-brand-500 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-surface-0 hover:bg-brand-400 disabled:opacity-50">
                      {researchLoading ? "Loading research data..." : "All Verified → View Research Summary"}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
                {!inputsVerified && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-red-400 pt-2">Missing prerequisites. Complete and approve all prior sections before COSMO.</p>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
      {/* STEP 2: RESEARCH SUMMARY                               */}
      {/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
      {step === "summary" && research && (
        <div className="space-y-5">
          <div className="rounded-lg border border-brand-500/20 bg-brand-500/5 px-4 py-3">
            <p className="text-xs text-brand-400">This is the complete research intelligence from S1–S4 that will feed COSMO semantic modeling. Review before proceeding.</p>
          </div>

          {/* ── S1: Product Identity ── */}
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 p-5">
            <a href={`/projects/${projectId}/intake`} className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4 group cursor-pointer">
              <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-bold bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400">S1</span>
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-200 group-hover:text-blue-400 transition-colors">Product Identity & Structure</h2>
              <span className="ml-auto text-[10px] text-zinc-600 group-hover:text-blue-400">Intake →</span>
            </a>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 mb-4">
              <StatBadge label="Brand" value={research.brandName} />
              <StatBadge label="Parent ASIN" value={research.parentAsin || "—"} />
              <StatBadge label="Total ASINs" value={research.asins.length} color="amber" />
              <StatBadge label="Variation Theme" value={research.variationTheme} />
            </div>

            {/* ASIN family tree — parent always first */}
            <div className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-2/50 p-3 mb-3">
              <h3 className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-2">Variation Family</h3>
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-[11px] border-collapse">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b border-surface-4">
                      <th className="py-1.5 px-2 text-left text-[9px] font-bold text-zinc-600 uppercase tracking-wide whitespace-nowrap">Level</th>
                      <th className="py-1.5 px-2 text-left text-[9px] font-bold text-zinc-600 uppercase tracking-wide whitespace-nowrap">ASIN</th>
                      <th className="py-1.5 px-2 text-left text-[9px] font-bold text-zinc-600 uppercase tracking-wide w-full">Title</th>
                      <th className="py-1.5 px-2 text-left text-[9px] font-bold text-zinc-600 uppercase tracking-wide whitespace-nowrap">Attributes</th>
                      <th className="py-1.5 px-2 text-left text-[9px] font-bold text-zinc-600 uppercase tracking-wide whitespace-nowrap">Pack</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {[...research.asins]
                      .sort((a: any, b: any) => {
                        const aP = (a.parentage_level||"").toLowerCase() === "parent";
                        const bP = (b.parentage_level||"").toLowerCase() === "parent";
                        if (aP && !bP) return -1; if (!aP && bP) return 1; return 0;
                      })
                      .flatMap((a: any) => {
                        const isParent = (a.parentage_level||"").toLowerCase() === "parent";
                        const vp = (research.varietyPackDetails||[]).find((v: any) => v.asin === a.asin);
                        const rows = [];
                        rows.push(
                          <tr key={a.asin} className={`border-b border-surface-4/40 align-top ${isParent ? "bg-blue-500/5" : "hover:bg-surface-3/20"}`}>
                            <td className="py-2 px-2 whitespace-nowrap">
                              <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[8px] font-bold ${isParent ? "bg-blue-500/15 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/20" : "bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-400 border border-purple-500/15"}`}>
                                {isParent ? "PARENT" : "CHILD"}
                              </span>
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-2 px-2 font-mono text-zinc-400 whitespace-nowrap">{a.asin}</td>
                            <td className="py-2 px-2 text-zinc-300 min-w-[220px]" style={{wordBreak:"break-word",whiteSpace:"normal"}}>{a.existing_content?.item_name || "—"}</td>
                            <td className="py-2 px-2 whitespace-nowrap text-zinc-500">{[a.flavor,a.size,a.color,a.style].filter(Boolean).join(" · ") || "—"}</td>
                            <td className="py-2 px-2 whitespace-nowrap">
                              {vp && <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[8px] font-bold bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20">VARIETY</span>}
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        );
                        if (vp && vp.includedRows?.length > 0) {
                          rows.push(
                            <tr key={`${a.asin}-vp`} className="border-b border-surface-4/40 bg-amber-500/[0.02]">
                              <td colSpan={5} className="px-2 pb-2 pt-0">
                                <div className="ml-6 rounded border border-amber-500/15 bg-amber-500/5 px-2.5 py-2 space-y-1">
                                  <p className="text-[9px] font-bold text-amber-400/70 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1.5">Included items</p>
                                  {vp.includedRows.map((row: any, ri: number) => (
                                    <div key={ri} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5 text-[10px] text-amber-300/80">
                                      <span className="text-amber-400/50 font-mono">#{ri+1}</span>
                                      {row.flavor && <span className="bg-amber-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">{row.flavor}</span>}
                                      {row.size   && <span className="bg-amber-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">{row.size}</span>}
                                      {row.color  && <span className="bg-amber-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">{row.color}</span>}
                                      {row.style  && <span className="bg-amber-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">{row.style}</span>}
                                      {row.units && row.units !== "1" && <span className="text-amber-400/50">x{row.units}</span>}
                                      {row.customLabel && <span className="italic text-amber-400/50">{row.customLabel}</span>}
                                    </div>
                                  ))}
                                  {(vp.extraFlavors||vp.extraSizes||vp.extraColors||vp.extraStyles) && (
                                    <p className="text-[9px] text-amber-400/50 italic pt-0.5">Extra: {[vp.extraFlavors,vp.extraSizes,vp.extraColors,vp.extraStyles].filter(Boolean).join(", ")}</p>
                                  )}
                                  {vp.notes && <p className="text-[9px] text-amber-400/40 italic">{vp.notes}</p>}
                                </div>
                              </td>
                            </tr>
                          );
                        }
                        return rows;
                      })
                    }
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Competitors */}
            {research.competitors.length > 0 && (
              <div className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-2/50 p-3">
                <h3 className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-2">Competitor Context</h3>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  {research.competitors.map((c, i) => (
                    <div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px]">
                      <span className="text-zinc-600">{i+1}.</span>
                      <span className="text-zinc-300">{c.name}</span>
                      {c.url && <span className="text-zinc-600 text-[10px] truncate">{c.url}</span>}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Brand Guidelines */}
            {guidelinesText && (
              <div className="rounded-lg border border-amber-500/20 bg-amber-500/5 p-3 mt-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                  <h3 className="text-[10px] text-amber-400 uppercase tracking-wide font-semibold">Brand Guidelines — Locked</h3>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500">{guidelinesText.length.toLocaleString()} chars</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-300 whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed line-clamp-6">{guidelinesText}</p>
                {guidelinesText.length > 400 && (
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 mt-1">Showing preview — full guidelines applied to all AI generation</p>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
            {!guidelinesText && (
              <div className="rounded-lg border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900/30 p-3 mt-3">
                <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500">No brand guidelines provided — S1.6 was skipped</p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* ── S2: Keyword Intelligence ── */}
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 p-5">
            <a href={`/projects/${projectId}/keywords`} className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4 group cursor-pointer">
              <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-bold bg-green-500/20 text-green-400">S2</span>
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-200 group-hover:text-green-400 transition-colors">Keyword Intelligence</h2>
              <span className="ml-auto text-[10px] text-zinc-600 group-hover:text-green-400">OUT_KEY →</span>
            </a>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-5 gap-3 mb-4">
              <StatBadge label="Total Keywords" value={research.keywords.length} color="amber" />
              {Object.entries(research.tierCounts).sort().map(([tier, count]) => (
                <StatBadge key={tier} label={tier} value={count} color={tier === "Tier 1" ? "green" : tier === "Tier 2" ? "amber" : "zinc"} />
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Top Tier 1 */}
            <div className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-2/50 p-3 mb-3">
              <h3 className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-2">Top Tier 1 Keywords (Surface Text Targets)</h3>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                {research.topKeywords.map((k: any, i: number) => (
                  <span key={i} className="px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20">
                    {k.KeywordText} <span className="text-zinc-500 ml-1">SV:{k.KeywordSearchVolume}</span>
                  </span>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Intent + Buyer Stage */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-2/50 p-3">
                <h3 className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-2">Search Intent</h3>
                {Object.entries(research.intentBreakdown).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).map(([intent, count]) => (
                  <div key={intent} className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] py-0.5">
                    <span className="text-zinc-300">{intent}</span>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <div className="w-16 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-surface-4 overflow-hidden">
                        <div className="h-full bg-brand-500/60 rounded-full" style={{width: `${(count / research.keywords.length) * 100}%`}} />
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-zinc-500 w-6 text-right">{count}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-2/50 p-3">
                <h3 className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-2">COSMO Relationships (from Keywords)</h3>
                {(() => {
                  const cosmoKw: Record<string, number> = {};
                  research.keywords.forEach((k: any) => {
                    if (k.KeywordCOSMORelationship) cosmoKw[k.KeywordCOSMORelationship] = (cosmoKw[k.KeywordCOSMORelationship] || 0) + 1;
                  });
                  return Object.entries(cosmoKw).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 8).map(([rel, count]) => (
                    <div key={rel} className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] py-0.5">
                      <span className="text-zinc-300">{rel}</span>
                      <span className="text-zinc-500">{count}</span>
                    </div>
                  ));
                })()}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* ── S3: Review Intelligence ── */}
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 p-5">
            <a href={`/projects/${projectId}/reviews`} className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4 group cursor-pointer">
              <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-bold bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400">S3</span>
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-200 group-hover:text-yellow-400 transition-colors">Review Intelligence</h2>
              <span className="ml-auto text-[10px] text-zinc-600 group-hover:text-yellow-400">OUT_REV →</span>
            </a>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 mb-4">
              <StatBadge label="Total Reviews" value={research.reviews.length} color="amber" />
              <StatBadge label="Avg Rating" value={research.avgRating.toFixed(1) + "★"} color={research.avgRating >= 4 ? "green" : research.avgRating >= 3 ? "amber" : "red"} />
              {Object.entries(research.sentimentBreakdown).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 2).map(([s, c]) => (
                <StatBadge key={s} label={s} value={c} color={s.toLowerCase().includes("positive") ? "green" : s.toLowerCase().includes("negative") ? "red" : "zinc"} />
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              {/* Themes */}
              <div className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-2/50 p-3">
                <h3 className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-2">Top Themes (Frequency)</h3>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  {research.topThemes.map((t, i) => (
                    <div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px]">
                      <span className="text-zinc-600 w-4">{i + 1}.</span>
                      <span className="text-zinc-300">{t}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                  {research.topThemes.length === 0 && <span className="text-zinc-600 text-[11px]">No themes extracted</span>}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Rufus-Usable Insights */}
              <div className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-2/50 p-3">
                <h3 className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-2">Rufus-Usable Insights</h3>
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  {research.topInsights.map((ins, i) => (
                    <div key={i} className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 pl-2 border-l-2 border-brand-500/30">{ins}</div>
                  ))}
                  {research.topInsights.length === 0 && <span className="text-zinc-600 text-[11px]">No actionable insights</span>}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* ── S4: Rufus Intelligence ── */}
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 p-5">
            <a href={`/projects/${projectId}/rufus`} className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4 group cursor-pointer">
              <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-bold bg-red-500/20 text-red-400">S4</span>
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-200 group-hover:text-red-400 transition-colors">Rufus Intelligence</h2>
              <span className="ml-auto text-[10px] text-zinc-600 group-hover:text-red-400">OUT_RUF →</span>
            </a>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 mb-4">
              <StatBadge label="Q&A Pairs" value={research.rufusRows.length} color="amber" />
              <StatBadge label="Categories" value={Object.keys(research.rufusCategories).length} />
              <StatBadge label="COSMO Hints" value={Object.keys(research.cosmoHints).length} color="green" />
              <StatBadge label="Actionable" value={research.rufusRows.filter((r: any) => r.RufusInsightType && r.RufusInsightType !== "None" && r.RufusInsightType !== "Not Applicable").length} />
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-4">
              {/* Categories */}
              <div className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-2/50 p-3">
                <h3 className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-2">Question Categories</h3>
                {Object.entries(research.rufusCategories).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).map(([cat, count]) => (
                  <div key={cat} className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] py-0.5">
                    <span className="text-zinc-300">{cat}</span>
                    <span className="text-zinc-500">{count}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
                {Object.keys(research.rufusCategories).length === 0 && <span className="text-zinc-600 text-[11px]">No categories</span>}
              </div>

              {/* COSMO Hints */}
              <div className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-2/50 p-3">
                <h3 className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-2">COSMO Relationship Hints</h3>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                  {Object.entries(research.cosmoHints).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).map(([rel, count]) => (
                    <span key={rel} className="px-2 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] bg-brand-500/10 text-brand-400 border border-brand-500/20">
                      {rel} <span className="text-zinc-500">×{count}</span>
                    </span>
                  ))}
                  {Object.keys(research.cosmoHints).length === 0 && <span className="text-zinc-600 text-[10px]">No hints</span>}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Key Q&A pairs */}
            <div className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-2/50 p-3">
              <h3 className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 uppercase tracking-wide mb-2">Key Q&A Pairs</h3>
              <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[240px] overflow-y-auto pr-2" style={{scrollbarWidth:"thin"}}>
                {research.rufusRows.slice(0, 10).map((r: any, i: number) => (
                  <div key={i} className="text-[11px] border-l-2 border-surface-4 pl-3 py-1 hover:border-brand-500/40 transition-colors">
                    <div className="text-zinc-300 font-medium">{r.RufusQuestion}</div>
                    <div className="text-zinc-500 mt-0.5 line-clamp-2">{r.RufusAnswer}</div>
                    <div className="flex gap-2 mt-1">
                      {r.RufusCOSMORelationship && r.RufusCOSMORelationship !== "Not Applicable" && (
                        <span className="px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-[8px] bg-brand-500/10 text-brand-400">{r.RufusCOSMORelationship}</span>
                      )}
                      {r.RufusInsightType && r.RufusInsightType !== "None" && r.RufusInsightType !== "Not Applicable" && (
                        <span className="px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-[8px] bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-500">{r.RufusInsightType}</span>
                      )}
                      {r.RufusQuestionCategory && (
                        <span className="px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-[8px] bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-600">{r.RufusQuestionCategory}</span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* ── Action Bar ── */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 pt-2">
            <button onClick={() => setStep("inputs")} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-400 hover:bg-surface-2">
              Back to Verification
            </button>
            <button onClick={() => { setStep("mapping"); setTimeout(generateCOSMO, 100); }} className="ml-auto rounded-lg bg-brand-500 px-6 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-surface-0 hover:bg-brand-400">
              Research Reviewed → Generate COSMO Map
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
      {/* STEP 3: GENERATING                                     */}
      {/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
      {step === "mapping" && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 p-6 text-center">
          {isGenerating ? (
            <div>
  <AIGeneratingButton isGenerating={true} onClick={()=>{}} label="Ask Claude to Generate COSMO Map" />
            </div>
          ) : aiError ? (
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm text-red-400 mb-3">{aiError}</p>
              <button onClick={generateCOSMO} className="rounded-lg bg-brand-500 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-surface-0 hover:bg-brand-400">
                Retry Generation
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm text-zinc-300 mb-4">Ready to generate COSMO semantic map.</p>
<AIGeneratingButton isGenerating={false} onClick={generateCOSMO} label="Ask Claude to Generate COSMO Map" />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
      {/* STEP 4: REVIEW OUT_COS                                 */}
      {/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
      {step === "review" && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-zinc-200">OUT_COS — {cosmoRows.length} relationships</h2>
              <div className="flex gap-1 flex-wrap">
                {RELATION_TYPES.filter(rt => cosmoRows.some(r => r.COSMORelationType === rt)).map(rt => (
                  <span key={rt} className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] bg-brand-500/10 text-brand-400">
                    {rt} ({cosmoRows.filter(r => r.COSMORelationType === rt).length})
                  </span>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-[11px]">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-surface-4 text-zinc-500">
                    <th className="py-2 px-2 text-left font-medium">ASIN</th>
                    <th className="py-2 px-2 text-left font-medium">Entity</th>
                    <th className="py-2 px-2 text-left font-medium">Relation</th>
                    <th className="py-2 px-2 text-left font-medium">Tail</th>
                    <th className="py-2 px-2 text-left font-medium">Mapped Value</th>
                    <th className="py-2 px-2 text-left font-medium">Usage</th>
                    <th className="py-2 px-2 text-left font-medium">PDP 1</th>
                    <th className="py-2 px-2 text-left font-medium">PDP 2</th>
                    <th className="py-2 px-2 text-left font-medium">Notes</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {cosmoRows.map((r, i) => (
                    <tr key={i} className="border-b border-surface-4/50 hover:bg-surface-2/30 align-top">
                      <td className="py-2 px-2 font-mono text-zinc-400 whitespace-nowrap">{r.ASIN?.substring(0, 10)}</td>
                      <td className="py-2 px-2 text-zinc-200 min-w-[100px]" style={{wordBreak:"break-word"}}>{r.COSMOEntity}</td>
                      <td className="py-2 px-2 whitespace-nowrap"><span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-bold bg-brand-500/15 text-brand-400">{r.COSMORelationType}</span></td>
                      <td className="py-2 px-2 text-zinc-300 min-w-[80px]" style={{wordBreak:"break-word"}}>{r.COSMOTailType}</td>
                      <td className="py-2 px-2 text-zinc-300 min-w-[140px] text-justify" style={{wordBreak:"break-word"}}>{r.COSMOMappedValue}</td>
                      <td className="py-2 px-2 text-zinc-400 min-w-[160px] text-justify" style={{wordBreak:"break-word"}}>{r.COSMOUsageExplanation}</td>
                      <td className="py-2 px-2 text-zinc-400 whitespace-nowrap">{r.COSMOAppliedPDPSection1}</td>
                      <td className="py-2 px-2 text-zinc-400 whitespace-nowrap">{r.COSMOAppliedPDPSection2}</td>
                      <td className="py-2 px-2 text-zinc-500 min-w-[120px] text-justify" style={{wordBreak:"break-word"}}>{r.COSMONotes}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 pt-2">
            <button onClick={() => setStep("summary")} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-400 hover:bg-surface-2">Back to Summary</button>
            <button onClick={downloadCSV} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-400 hover:bg-surface-2">Download OUT_COS.csv</button>
            <button
              onClick={async () => {
                try {
                  await fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/save`, {
                    method: "POST",
                    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ phase: "s5_cosmo", data: { rows: cosmoRows } }),
                  });
                } catch {}
                setIsApproved(true);
                setStep("approved");
              }}
              className="ml-auto rounded-lg bg-accent-green px-6 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-surface-0 hover:bg-accent-green/80"
            >
              ✓ Approve S5 — Unlock S6 SEO Content
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
      {/* STEP 5: APPROVED                                       */}
      {/* ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */}
      {step === "approved" && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-accent-green/30 bg-accent-green/5 p-6 text-center">
          <div className="mb-2 text-lg font-extrabold text-accent-green">S5 COSMO — Approved ✓</div>
          <p className="text-sm text-zinc-400 mb-4">{cosmoRows.length} semantic relationships mapped across {RELATION_TYPES.filter(rt => cosmoRows.some(r => r.COSMORelationType === rt)).length} types.</p>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={downloadCSV} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400 hover:bg-surface-2">Download OUT_COS.csv</button>
            <a href={`/projects/${projectId}/seo`} className="rounded-lg bg-brand-500 px-5 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-surface-0 hover:bg-brand-400">Continue → S6 SEO Content</a>
            <button onClick={() => { setIsApproved(false); setStep("review"); }} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-500 hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-zinc-300">Unlock for Editing</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {aiError && step !== "mapping" && (
        <div className="mt-4 rounded-lg bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/30 p-3">
          <p className="text-sm text-red-400">{aiError}</p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useCallback, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import AIGeneratingButton from "@/components/ai-generating-button";
import { useParams } from "next/navigation";
import { parseCerebroCSV, type CerebroParseResult } from "@/lib/parsers/cerebro";
import AICostTracker from "@/components/ai-cost-tracker";
import {
  approvePhase,
  saveProjectState,
  getProjectState,
} from "@/components/project-shell";
import StepNav from "@/components/step-nav";

interface TieredKeyword {
  KeywordText: string;
  KeywordSearchVolume: number;
  KeywordPriorityTier: "T1" | "T2" | "T3" | "T4";
  KeywordSearchIntent: string;
  KeywordPrimaryUseLocation: string;
  KeywordMatchType: string;
  KeywordCOSMORelationship: string;
  KeywordBuyerStage: string;
  KeywordNotes: string;
}

interface KeywordAuditEntry {
  KeywordText: string;
  KeywordSearchVolume: number;
  KeywordPriorityTier: "T1" | "T2" | "T3" | "T4";
  isUsed: boolean;
  locations: string[];
}

type KeywordsStep = "upload" | "parsed" | "review" | "approved";

function buildAuditEntries(
  keywords: TieredKeyword[],
  seoContent: Record<string, string>
): KeywordAuditEntry[] {
  return keywords.map((kw) => {
    const phrase = kw.KeywordText.toLowerCase().trim();
    const locations: string[] = [];
    Object.entries(seoContent).forEach(([field, text]) => {
      if (text && text.toLowerCase().includes(phrase)) locations.push(field);
    });
    return {
      KeywordText: kw.KeywordText,
      KeywordSearchVolume: kw.KeywordSearchVolume,
      KeywordPriorityTier: kw.KeywordPriorityTier,
      isUsed: locations.length > 0,
      locations,
    };
  });
}

const SEO_FIELDS: [string, string][] = [
  ["Title", "Title (190–200 chars)"],
  ["Description", "Description"],
  ["Det1", "Detailed Bullet 1"], ["Det2", "Detailed Bullet 2"],
  ["Det3", "Detailed Bullet 3"], ["Det4", "Detailed Bullet 4"],
  ["Det5", "Detailed Bullet 5"],
  ["Con1", "Concise Bullet 1"], ["Con2", "Concise Bullet 2"],
  ["Con3", "Concise Bullet 3"], ["Con4", "Concise Bullet 4"],
  ["Con5", "Concise Bullet 5"],
  ["Ct1", "Content Bullet 1"], ["Ct2", "Content Bullet 2"],
  ["Ct3", "Content Bullet 3"],
  ["Kf1", "Key Feature 1"], ["Kf2", "Key Feature 2"],
  ["Kf3", "Key Feature 3"],
  ["Backend1", "Backend Set 1"], ["Backend2", "Backend Set 2"],
  ["Backend3", "Backend Set 3"], ["Backend4", "Backend Set 4"],
  ["Backend5", "Backend Set 5"],
];

const EMPTY_SEO = Object.fromEntries(SEO_FIELDS.map(([k]) => [k, ""]));

export default function KeywordsPage() {
  const params = useParams();
  const projectId = params?.id as string;

  const [step, setStep] = useState<KeywordsStep>("upload");
  const [clientResult, setClientResult] = useState<CerebroParseResult | null>(null);
  const [competitorResults, setCompetitorResults] = useState<CerebroParseResult[]>([]);
  const [competitorName, setCompetitorName] = useState("");
  const [tieredKeywords, setTieredKeywords] = useState<TieredKeyword[]>([]);
  const [isRunningAI, setIsRunningAI] = useState(false);
  const [aiError, setAiError] = useState("");
  const [aiUsage, setAiUsage] = useState<any>(null);
  const [aiStartTime, setAiStartTime] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const [tierFilter, setTierFilter] = useState("all");
  const [stageFilter, setStageFilter] = useState("all");
  const [searchFilter, setSearchFilter] = useState("");
  const [sortCol, setSortCol] = useState("KeywordSearchVolume");
  const [sortAsc, setSortAsc] = useState(false);

  const [auditLocked, setAuditLocked] = useState(false);
  const [auditEntries, setAuditEntries] = useState<KeywordAuditEntry[]>([]);
  const [seoContent, setSeoContent] = useState<Record<string, string>>(EMPTY_SEO);

  const [completedSteps, setCompletedSteps] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [asins, setAsins] = useState<{asin:string;parentage:string;label:string}[]>([]);
  const [asinCopied, setAsinCopied] = useState(false);
  const [isApproved, setIsApproved] = useState(false);
  const [guidelinesText, setGuidelinesText] = useState("");

  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const compFileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  // Restore persisted state on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!projectId) return;
    // Load brand guidelines + ASINs from S1
    fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/load?phase=s1_intake`)
      .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : null)
      .then(d => {
        if (d?.project?.brand_guidelines) setGuidelinesText(d.project.brand_guidelines);
        if (d?.asins?.length) {
          setAsins(d.asins.map((a: any) => ({
            asin: a.asin || "",
            parentage: (a.parentage_level || "").toLowerCase(),
            label: a.variation_product || a.asin || "",
          })).filter((a: any) => a.asin));
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {});
    const state = getProjectState(projectId);
    if (state.s2_approved_at) {
      // If we have saved keyword data, restore it
      const raw = state.section_locks?.["s2_keywords_data"];
      if (raw) {
        try {
          const saved = JSON.parse(raw);
          if (saved.keywords?.length) setTieredKeywords(saved.keywords);
          if (saved.auditLocked) {
            setAuditLocked(true);
            setAuditEntries(saved.auditEntries || []);
            setSeoContent(saved.seoContent || EMPTY_SEO);
          }
        } catch {}
      }
      setCompletedSteps(new Set(["upload", "parsed", "review", "approved"]));
      setIsApproved(true);
      setStep("approved");
    }
  }, [projectId]);

  const handleClientUpload = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (ev) => {
      const result = parseCerebroCSV(ev.target?.result as string, "Client");
      setClientResult(result);
      setCompletedSteps(prev => new Set([...prev, "upload"]));
      setStep("parsed");
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  }, []);

  const handleCompetitorUpload = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (ev) => {
      const name = competitorName || file.name.replace(/\.csv$/i, "");
      const result = parseCerebroCSV(ev.target?.result as string, `Competitor: ${name}`);
      setCompetitorResults((prev) => [...prev, result]);
      setCompetitorName("");
      if (compFileRef.current) compFileRef.current.value = "";
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  }, [competitorName]);

  const handleRunAI = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!clientResult) return;
    setIsRunningAI(true);
    setAiError("");
    setAiStartTime(Date.now());
    try {
      // Limit: 200 product keywords + 200 competitor keywords (if uploaded)
      const productKeywords = clientResult.keywords.slice(0, 200);
      const competitorKeywords = competitorResults.flatMap((r) => r.keywords).slice(0, 200);
      const allKeywords = [...productKeywords, ...competitorKeywords];
      const res = await fetch("/api/claude/keywords", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          keywords: allKeywords,
          brandName: getProjectState(projectId)?.brand_name || "Brand",
          variationProduct: "",
          variationTheme: "",
          competitors: [],
          guidelines: guidelinesText,
        }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        let msg = `API returned ${res.status}`;
        try { const err = await res.json(); msg = err.error || msg; } catch {}
        throw new Error(msg);
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      setTieredKeywords(data.keywords);
      setAiUsage(data.usage);
      setCompletedSteps(prev => new Set([...prev, "upload", "parsed"]));
      setStep("review");
      if (projectId) {
        const state = getProjectState(projectId);
        const locks = { ...(state.section_locks || {}) };
        locks["s2_keywords_data"] = JSON.stringify({ keywords: data.keywords });
        saveProjectState(projectId, { section_locks: locks });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setAiError(err.message || "Failed to run AI tiering");
    } finally {
      setIsRunningAI(false);
    }
  }, [clientResult, competitorResults, projectId]);

  const handleRunAudit = useCallback(() => {
    setAuditEntries(buildAuditEntries(tieredKeywords, seoContent));
  }, [tieredKeywords, seoContent]);

  const handleLockAudit = useCallback(() => {
    if (!projectId) return;
    const state = getProjectState(projectId);
    const locks = { ...(state.section_locks || {}) };
    const existing = locks["s2_keywords_data"] ? JSON.parse(locks["s2_keywords_data"]) : {};
    locks["s2_keywords_data"] = JSON.stringify({
      ...existing,
      auditLocked: true,
      auditEntries,
      seoContent,
    });
    saveProjectState(projectId, { section_locks: locks });
    setAuditLocked(true);
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("project_state_updated"));
  }, [projectId, auditEntries, seoContent]);

  const filteredKeywords = tieredKeywords
    .filter((kw) => {
      if (tierFilter !== "all" && kw.KeywordPriorityTier !== tierFilter) return false;
      if (stageFilter !== "all" && kw.KeywordBuyerStage !== stageFilter) return false;
      if (searchFilter && !kw.KeywordText.toLowerCase().includes(searchFilter.toLowerCase()))
        return false;
      return true;
    })
    .sort((a, b) => {
      const av = (a as any)[sortCol], bv = (b as any)[sortCol];
      if (typeof av === "number" && typeof bv === "number")
        return sortAsc ? av - bv : bv - av;
      return sortAsc
        ? String(av).localeCompare(String(bv))
        : String(bv).localeCompare(String(av));
    });

  const tierCounts = { T1: 0, T2: 0, T3: 0, T4: 0 };
  tieredKeywords.forEach((kw) => {
    if (kw.KeywordPriorityTier in tierCounts)
      tierCounts[kw.KeywordPriorityTier as keyof typeof tierCounts]++;
  });

  const downloadCSV = useCallback(() => {
    const hdrs = [
      "KeywordText","KeywordSearchVolume","KeywordPriorityTier","KeywordSearchIntent",
      "KeywordPrimaryUseLocation","KeywordMatchType","KeywordCOSMORelationship",
      "KeywordBuyerStage","KeywordNotes",
    ];
    const rows = tieredKeywords.map((kw) =>
      hdrs.map((h) => {
        const v = String((kw as any)[h] || "");
        return v.includes(",") || v.includes('"') ? `"${v.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : v;
      }).join(",")
    );
    const blob = new Blob([[hdrs.join(","), ...rows].join("\n")], { type: "text/csv" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url; a.download = "OUT_KEY.csv"; a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, [tieredKeywords]);

  // Audit split
  const unusedByTier: Record<string, KeywordAuditEntry[]> = { T1: [], T2: [], T3: [], T4: [] };
  const usedEntries: KeywordAuditEntry[] = [];
  auditEntries.forEach((e) => {
    if (e.isUsed) usedEntries.push(e);
    else unusedByTier[e.KeywordPriorityTier]?.push(e);
  });
  (["T1","T2","T3","T4"] as const).forEach((t) => {
    unusedByTier[t].sort((a, b) => b.KeywordSearchVolume - a.KeywordSearchVolume);
  });
  usedEntries.sort((a, b) => b.KeywordSearchVolume - a.KeywordSearchVolume);

  const stepTitle: Record<KeywordsStep, string> = {
    upload: "Upload Cerebro CSV",
    parsed: "Parsed Keywords",
    review: "Review OUT_KEY",
    approved: "Keywords Approved ✓",
  };

  const KEYWORDS_STEPS = [
    { key: "upload", label: "S2.1 Upload CSV" },
    { key: "parsed", label: "S2.2 Parsed Data" },
    { key: "review", label: "S2.3 OUT_KEY Review" },
    { key: "approved", label: "S2.4 Approved" },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="max-w-6xl">
      <h1 className="text-xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-zinc-100 mb-1">Keyword Extraction & Tiering</h1>
      <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 mb-4">{stepTitle[step]}</p>
      <StepNav
        steps={KEYWORDS_STEPS}
        currentStep={step}
        onStepClick={(key) => setStep(key as KeywordsStep)}
        completedSteps={completedSteps}
        isApproved={isApproved}
      />

      {/* ── Upload ── */}
      {step === "upload" && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {/* ASIN list to copy into Helium 10 */}
          {asins.length > 0 && (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-brand-500/20 bg-brand-500/5 p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-brand-400">Step 1 — Copy ASINs into Helium 10 Cerebro</h3>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500 mt-0.5">Paste these into Cerebro, run the research, then export as CSV</p>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    const childAsins = asins.filter(a => a.parentage !== "parent").map(a => a.asin);
                    const toCopy = childAsins.length > 0 ? childAsins : asins.map(a => a.asin);
                    navigator.clipboard.writeText(toCopy.join("\n")).then(() => {
                      setAsinCopied(true);
                      setTimeout(() => setAsinCopied(false), 2000);
                    });
                  }}
                  className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition-all ${asinCopied ? "bg-accent-green/10 text-accent-green border border-accent-green/20" : "bg-brand-500/20 text-brand-400 border border-brand-500/30 hover:bg-brand-500/30"}`}
                >
                  {asinCopied ? (
                    <><svg className="h-3.5 w-3.5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" strokeWidth={2.5} stroke="currentColor"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="m4.5 12.75 6 6 9-13.5" /></svg>Copied!</>
                  ) : (
                    <><svg className="h-3.5 w-3.5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" strokeWidth={2} stroke="currentColor"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M15.666 3.888A2.25 2.25 0 0 0 13.5 2.25h-3c-1.03 0-1.9.693-2.166 1.638m7.332 0c.055.194.084.4.084.612v0a.75.75 0 0 1-.75.75H9a.75.75 0 0 1-.75-.75v0c0-.212.03-.418.084-.612m7.332 0c.646.049 1.288.11 1.927.184 1.1.128 1.907 1.077 1.907 2.185V19.5a2.25 2.25 0 0 1-2.25 2.25H6.75A2.25 2.25 0 0 1 4.5 19.5V6.257c0-1.108.806-2.057 1.907-2.185a48.208 48.208 0 0 1 1.927-.184" /></svg>Copy variation ASINs</>
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
              <div className="grid gap-1.5" style={{gridTemplateColumns:"repeat(auto-fill,minmax(180px,1fr))"}}>
                {asins.map((a, i) => (
                  <div key={i} className={`flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 ${a.parentage === "parent" ? "border-blue-500/15 bg-blue-500/5" : "border-surface-4 bg-surface-2/50"}`}>
                    <span className={`shrink-0 px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-[8px] font-bold ${a.parentage === "parent" ? "bg-blue-500/15 text-blue-400" : "bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-400"}`}>
                      {a.parentage === "parent" ? "PAR" : "CHD"}
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-zinc-200 tracking-wide">{a.asin}</span>
                    {a.label && a.label !== a.asin && (
                      <span className="text-[9px] text-zinc-500 truncate">{a.label}</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              <p className="text-[9px] text-zinc-600 mt-2">
                {asins.filter(a=>a.parentage!=="parent").length > 0
                  ? `${asins.filter(a=>a.parentage!=="parent").length} child ASINs copied (parent excluded from Cerebro research)`
                  : `${asins.length} ASINs — copy all into Cerebro`}
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Upload */}
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 p-5">
            <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-zinc-400">
              Step 2 — Upload the Helium 10 Cerebro CSV export for your{" "}
              <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-200">variation ASINs</span>.
            </p>
            <input
              ref={fileInputRef} type="file" accept=".csv" onChange={handleClientUpload}
              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-dashed border-surface-5 bg-surface-0 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-zinc-400 file:mr-3 file:rounded-md file:border-0 file:bg-brand-500/20 file:px-3 file:py-1.5 file:text-xs file:font-bold file:text-brand-400 hover:border-brand-700 cursor-pointer"
            />
            <p className="mt-2 text-[10px] text-zinc-600">
              Supported: Keyword Phrase, Search Volume, Cerebro IQ Score, Competing Products, Title Density, CPR, Position
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Parsed ── */}
      {step === "parsed" && clientResult && (
        <div>
          <div className="mb-4 grid grid-cols-5 gap-3">
            <StatCard label="Product Keywords" value={clientResult.keywords.length} />
            <StatCard label="To AI (max 200)" value={Math.min(clientResult.keywords.length, 200)} color={clientResult.keywords.length > 200 ? "amber" : "green"} />
            <StatCard label="Total Raw Rows" value={clientResult.totalRaw} />
            <StatCard label="Duplicates Removed" value={clientResult.duplicatesRemoved} color="amber" />
            <StatCard label="Invalid Removed" value={clientResult.invalidRemoved} color="red" />
          </div>
          {competitorResults.length > 0 && (() => {
            const compTotal = competitorResults.reduce((s, r) => s + r.keywords.length, 0);
            return (
              <div className="mb-4 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <StatCard label="Competitor Keywords" value={compTotal} />
                <StatCard label="Competitor To AI (max 200)" value={Math.min(compTotal, 200)} color={compTotal > 200 ? "amber" : "green"} />
              </div>
            );
          })()}
          {clientResult.errors.length > 0 && (
            <div className="mb-4 rounded-lg border border-red-900/50 bg-red-950/30 p-4">
              {clientResult.errors.map((e, i) => <div key={i} className="text-xs text-accent-red py-0.5">{e}</div>)}
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 overflow-hidden">
            <div className="px-4 py-2.5 border-b border-surface-4 flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-400">Top Keywords by Search Volume (preview)</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-600">Source: {clientResult.source}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="overflow-x-auto max-h-[400px] overflow-y-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-xs">
                <thead className="sticky top-0 bg-surface-2">
                  <tr>
                    {["#","Keyword Phrase","Volume","IQ Score","Competition","Title Density","CPR","Position"].map((h) => (
                      <th key={h} className="px-3 py-2 text-left font-bold text-zinc-500">{h}</th>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {clientResult.keywords.slice(0, 50).map((kw, i) => (
                    <tr key={i} className="border-t border-surface-4 hover:bg-surface-2/50">
                      <td className="px-3 py-1.5 text-zinc-600">{i + 1}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-1.5 font-medium text-zinc-200">{kw.keyword_phrase}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-1.5 text-right font-mono text-zinc-300">{kw.search_volume.toLocaleString()}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-1.5 text-right font-mono text-zinc-400">{kw.cerebro_iq_score}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-1.5 text-right font-mono text-zinc-400">{kw.competing_products.toLocaleString()}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-1.5 text-right font-mono text-zinc-400">{kw.title_density}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-1.5 text-right font-mono text-zinc-400">{kw.cpr}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-1.5 text-right font-mono text-zinc-400">{kw.position || "—"}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-amber-900/30 bg-amber-950/10 p-5">
            <div className="mb-2 text-sm font-bold text-accent-amber">Add Competitor Cerebro Data? (Optional)</div>
            <p className="mb-3 text-xs text-zinc-400">Competitor data reveals keyword gaps and competitive positioning opportunities.</p>
            {competitorResults.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mb-3 space-y-1">
                {competitorResults.map((cr, i) => (
                  <div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-accent-green">
                    <svg className="h-3.5 w-3.5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" strokeWidth={2} stroke="currentColor"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="m4.5 12.75 6 6 9-13.5" /></svg>
                    {cr.source}: {cr.keywords.length} keywords
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="flex items-end gap-3">
              <div className="flex-1">
                <label className="mb-1 block text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-500">Competitor Name</label>
                <input value={competitorName} onChange={(e) => setCompetitorName(e.target.value)} placeholder="e.g. BrandX"
                  className="w-full rounded-md border border-surface-4 bg-surface-0 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-300 placeholder:text-zinc-700 focus:border-brand-700 focus:outline-none" />
              </div>
              <input ref={compFileRef} type="file" accept=".csv" onChange={handleCompetitorUpload}
                className="rounded-md border border-surface-4 bg-surface-0 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-400 file:mr-2 file:rounded file:border-0 file:bg-amber-500/20 file:px-2 file:py-0.5 file:text-[10px] file:font-bold file:text-accent-amber cursor-pointer" />
            </div>
          </div>
          {/* Keyword limits info */}
          {(clientResult.keywords.length > 200 || competitorResults.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.keywords.length, 0) > 200) && (
            <div className="mb-4 rounded-lg border border-blue-900/30 bg-blue-950/10 p-3 text-xs text-blue-400">
              <span className="font-bold">Keyword limits:</span>{" "}
              {clientResult.keywords.length > 200 && (
                <span>Product keywords trimmed from {clientResult.keywords.length} to 200 (top by volume). </span>
              )}
              {competitorResults.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.keywords.length, 0) > 200 && (
                <span>Competitor keywords trimmed from {competitorResults.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.keywords.length, 0)} to 200 (top by volume). </span>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={() => { setStep("upload"); setClientResult(null); setCompetitorResults([]); }}
              className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400 hover:bg-surface-2">Back</button>
<AIGeneratingButton
              isGenerating={isRunningAI}
              onClick={handleRunAI}
              label="Ask Claude to Run AI Tiering"
              disabled={isRunningAI}
            />
            <AICostTracker isRunning={isRunningAI} usage={aiUsage} startTime={aiStartTime} error={aiError} />
          </div>
          {aiError && !isRunningAI && (
            <div className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-red-900/50 bg-red-950/30 p-3 text-xs text-accent-red">{aiError}</div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Review OUT_KEY ── */}
      {step === "review" && tieredKeywords.length > 0 && (
        <div>
          <div className="mb-4 grid grid-cols-5 gap-3">
            <TierCard tier="T1" count={tierCounts.T1} label="Title" color="text-brand-400" min={5} />
            <TierCard tier="T2" count={tierCounts.T2} label="Bullets" color="text-accent-blue" min={10} />
            <TierCard tier="T3" count={tierCounts.T3} label="Description" color="text-accent-green" min={15} />
            <TierCard tier="T4" count={tierCounts.T4} label="Backend" color="text-zinc-400" min={20} />
            <StatCard label="Total" value={tieredKeywords.length} color={tieredKeywords.length >= 50 ? "green" : "red"} />
          </div>
          <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap">
            <input value={searchFilter} onChange={(e) => setSearchFilter(e.target.value)} placeholder="Search keywords..."
              className="rounded-md border border-surface-4 bg-surface-0 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-300 placeholder:text-zinc-700 focus:border-brand-700 focus:outline-none w-52" />
            <select value={tierFilter} onChange={(e) => setTierFilter(e.target.value)} className="rounded-md border border-surface-4 bg-surface-0 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-300 focus:outline-none">
              <option value="all">All Tiers</option>
              <option value="T1">T1 — Title</option>
              <option value="T2">T2 — Bullets</option>
              <option value="T3">T3 — Description</option>
              <option value="T4">T4 — Backend</option>
            </select>
            <select value={stageFilter} onChange={(e) => setStageFilter(e.target.value)} className="rounded-md border border-surface-4 bg-surface-0 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-300 focus:outline-none">
              <option value="all">All Stages</option>
              <option value="Awareness">Awareness</option>
              <option value="Consideration">Consideration</option>
              <option value="Decision">Decision</option>
            </select>
            <span className="ml-auto text-[10px] text-zinc-600">{filteredKeywords.length} of {tieredKeywords.length}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 overflow-hidden">
            <div className="overflow-x-auto max-h-[500px] overflow-y-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-xs">
                <thead className="sticky top-0 bg-surface-2 z-10">
                  <tr>
                    {["KeywordText","KeywordSearchVolume","KeywordPriorityTier","KeywordSearchIntent","KeywordPrimaryUseLocation","KeywordMatchType","KeywordCOSMORelationship","KeywordBuyerStage","KeywordNotes"].map((col) => (
                      <th key={col} onClick={() => { setSortCol(col); setSortAsc(sortCol === col ? !sortAsc : false); }}
                        className="px-2.5 py-2 text-left font-bold text-zinc-500 cursor-pointer hover:text-zinc-300 whitespace-nowrap select-none">
                        {col.replace("Keyword","").replace(/([A-Z])/g," $1").trim()}
                        {sortCol === col && <span className="ml-1">{sortAsc ? "↑" : "↓"}</span>}
                      </th>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {filteredKeywords.map((kw, i) => (
                    <tr key={i} className="border-t border-surface-4 hover:bg-surface-2/50">
                      <td className="px-2.5 py-1.5 font-medium text-zinc-200 max-w-[200px]">
                        <span className="block text-justify leading-relaxed">{kw.KeywordText}</span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-2.5 py-1.5 text-right font-mono text-zinc-300">{kw.KeywordSearchVolume?.toLocaleString()}</td>
                      <td className="px-2.5 py-1.5"><TierBadge tier={kw.KeywordPriorityTier} /></td>
                      <td className="px-2.5 py-1.5 text-zinc-400">{kw.KeywordSearchIntent}</td>
                      <td className="px-2.5 py-1.5 text-zinc-400">{kw.KeywordPrimaryUseLocation}</td>
                      <td className="px-2.5 py-1.5 text-zinc-400">{kw.KeywordMatchType}</td>
                      <td className="px-2.5 py-1.5 text-zinc-400 max-w-[120px] truncate" title={kw.KeywordCOSMORelationship}>{kw.KeywordCOSMORelationship}</td>
                      <td className="px-2.5 py-1.5"><StageBadge stage={kw.KeywordBuyerStage} /></td>
                      <td className="px-2.5 py-1.5 text-zinc-500 max-w-[150px]">
                        <span className="block text-justify leading-relaxed">{kw.KeywordNotes}</span>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={() => setStep("parsed")} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400 hover:bg-surface-2">Back to Parsed</button>
            <button onClick={handleRunAI} disabled={isRunningAI} className="rounded-lg border border-brand-700 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-brand-400 hover:bg-brand-950">Re-run AI Tiering</button>
            <button onClick={downloadCSV} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400 hover:bg-surface-2">Download OUT_KEY.csv</button>
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                if (projectId) {
                  approvePhase(projectId, "s2");
                  const state = getProjectState(projectId);
                  const locks = { ...(state.section_locks || {}) };
                  const existing = locks["s2_keywords_data"] ? JSON.parse(locks["s2_keywords_data"]) : {};
                  locks["s2_keywords_data"] = JSON.stringify({ ...existing, approved: true });
                  saveProjectState(projectId, { section_locks: locks });
                  window.dispatchEvent(new Event("project_state_updated"));
                  // Save to Supabase so S5 COSMO can read it
                  fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/save`, {
                    method: "POST",
                    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ phase: "s2_keywords", data: { keywords: tieredKeywords } }),
                  }).catch(() => {});
                }
                setCompletedSteps(new Set(["upload", "parsed", "review", "approved"]));
                setIsApproved(true);
                setStep("approved");
              }}
              className="ml-auto rounded-lg bg-accent-green px-6 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-surface-0 hover:bg-accent-green/80"
            >
              ✓ Approve S2 — Unlock Reviews (S3)
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}



      {/* ── Approved ── */}
      {step === "approved" && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-accent-green/30 bg-accent-green/5 p-6 text-center">
          <div className="mb-2 text-lg font-extrabold text-accent-green">S2 Keywords — Approved ✓</div>
          <p className="text-sm text-zinc-400 mb-4">{tieredKeywords.length} keywords locked across 4 tiers.</p>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={downloadCSV} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400 hover:bg-surface-2">
              Download OUT_KEY.csv
            </button>
            <button onClick={() => setStep("review")}
              className="rounded-lg border border-brand-700 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-brand-400 hover:bg-brand-950">
              View OUT_KEY →
            </button>
            <a href={`/projects/${projectId}/reviews`} className="rounded-lg bg-brand-500 px-5 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-surface-0 hover:bg-brand-400">
              Continue → S3 Reviews
            </a>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function StatCard({ label, value, color = "default", suffix = "" }: { label: string; value: number; color?: string; suffix?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 px-4 py-3">
      <div className={`text-lg font-extrabold ${color === "red" ? "text-accent-red" : color === "green" ? "text-accent-green" : color === "amber" ? "text-accent-amber" : "text-zinc-100"}`}>
        {value}{suffix}
      </div>
      <div className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500">{label}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

function TierCard({ tier, count, label, color, min }: { tier: string; count: number; label: string; color: string; min: number }) {
  const ok = count >= min;
  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 px-4 py-3">
      <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
        <span className={`text-lg font-extrabold ${color}`}>{count}</span>
        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-500">{tier}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500">{label}</div>
      <div className={`mt-1 text-[9px] font-bold ${ok ? "text-accent-green" : "text-accent-red"}`}>
        {ok ? "✓" : "✗"} min {min}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function TierBadge({ tier }: { tier: string }) {
  const colors: Record<string, string> = {
    T1: "bg-brand-500/20 text-brand-400",
    T2: "bg-accent-blue/20 text-accent-blue",
    T3: "bg-accent-green/20 text-accent-green",
    T4: "bg-zinc-700/30 text-zinc-400",
  };
  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex items-center rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-extrabold ${colors[tier] || "bg-surface-4 text-zinc-500"}`}>
      {tier}
    </span>
  );
}

function StageBadge({ stage }: { stage: string }) {
  const colors: Record<string, string> = {
    Decision: "text-brand-400",
    Consideration: "text-accent-blue",
    Awareness: "text-zinc-400",
  };
  return <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold ${colors[stage] || "text-zinc-500"}`}>{stage}</span>;
}
