"use client";

import { useState, useCallback, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import { useRouter, useParams } from "next/navigation";
import { parseReviewCSV, type ReviewParseResult, type ParsedReview } from "@/lib/parsers/reviews";
import AICostTracker from "@/components/ai-cost-tracker";
import AIGeneratingButton from "@/components/ai-generating-button";
import StepNav from "@/components/step-nav";

const REVIEWS_STEPS = [
  { key: "upload", label: "S3.1 Upload CSV" },
  { key: "parsed", label: "S3.2 Parsed" },
  { key: "review", label: "S3.3 Review OUT_REV" },
  { key: "approved", label: "S3.4 Approved" },
];

interface AnalyzedReview {
  ReviewID: string;
  ReviewDate: string;
  ReviewReviewerName: string;
  ReviewASIN: string;
  ReviewProductVariation: string;
  ReviewStarRating: number;
  ReviewTitle: string;
  ReviewSentiment: string;
  ReviewKeyThemes: string;
  ReviewUsageMentioned: string;
  ReviewPackagingFeedback: string;
  ReviewPriceFeedback: string;
  ReviewHeatLevelFeedback: string;
  ReviewRufusUsableInsight: string;
  ReviewBulletMapping: string;
}

type ReviewsStep = "upload" | "parsed" | "review" | "approved";

export default function ReviewsPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useParams();
  const projectId = params.id as string;
  const [step, setStep] = useState<ReviewsStep>("upload");
  const [isApproved, setIsApproved] = useState(false);
  const [completedSteps, setCompletedSteps] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [loadingState, setLoadingState] = useState(true);
  const [parentAsin, setParentAsin] = useState<{ asin: string; amazon_url: string } | null>(null);
  const [parseResult, setParseResult] = useState<ReviewParseResult | null>(null);
  const [reviewFileName, setReviewFileName] = useState("");
  const [analyzedReviews, setAnalyzedReviews] = useState<AnalyzedReview[]>([]);

  // Load saved data on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    async function load() {
      try {
        // Load parent ASIN from S1
        const asinRes = await fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/load?phase=parent_asin`);
        if (asinRes.ok) {
          const { parent } = await asinRes.json();
          if (parent) setParentAsin(parent);
        }

        const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/load?phase=s3_reviews`);
        if (res.ok) {
          const { reviews } = await res.json();
          if (reviews && reviews.length > 0) {
            // Load route already maps to ReviewID etc.
            setAnalyzedReviews(reviews);
            setReviewFileName(`Saved data — ${reviews.length} reviews`);
            setIsApproved(true);
            setCompletedSteps(new Set(REVIEWS_STEPS.map((s) => s.key)));
            setStep("approved");
          }
        }
      } catch {}
      setLoadingState(false);
    }
    load();
  }, [projectId]);
  const [isRunningAI, setIsRunningAI] = useState(false);
  const [aiError, setAiError] = useState("");
  const [aiProgress, setAiProgress] = useState("");
  const [aiStartTime, setAiStartTime] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [aiUsage, setAiUsage] = useState<any>(null);

  // Filters
  const [starFilter, setStarFilter] = useState<string>("all");
  const [sentimentFilter, setSentimentFilter] = useState<string>("all");
  const [searchFilter, setSearchFilter] = useState("");
  const [expandedRow, setExpandedRow] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  // Load saved data on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadSaved() {
      try {
        // Load parent ASIN from S1
        const asinRes = await fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/load?phase=parent_asin`);
        if (asinRes.ok) {
          const { parent } = await asinRes.json();
          if (parent) setParentAsin(parent);
        }

        const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/load?phase=s3_reviews`);
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = await res.json();
          if (data.reviews && data.reviews.length > 0) {
            setAnalyzedReviews(data.reviews);
            setStep("approved");
          }
        }
      } catch {}
    }
    if (projectId !== "demo-1") loadSaved();
  }, [projectId]);

  const handleUpload = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    setReviewFileName(file.name);
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (ev) => {
      const text = ev.target?.result as string;
      const result = parseReviewCSV(text);
      setParseResult(result);
      setStep("parsed");
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  }, []);

  const handleRunAI = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!parseResult) return;
    setIsRunningAI(true);
    setAiError("");
    setAiProgress(`Analyzing ${parseResult.reviews.length} reviews...`);
    setAiStartTime(Date.now());
    setAiUsage(null);

    try {
      // Pre-trim reviews client-side — keep compact for Vercel 60s limit
      const trimmed = parseResult.reviews.slice(0, 30);
      const reviewBlock = trimmed
        .map((r: any, i: number) =>
          `[${i + 1}] ${r.star_rating}★|${r.product_variation || "—"}|${r.date_iso || ""}|HV:${r.helpful_votes || 0}\n${(r.title || "").substring(0, 80)}\n${(r.text || "").substring(0, 150)}`)
        .join("\n---\n");

      setAiProgress(`Analyzing ${trimmed.length} of ${parseResult.reviews.length} reviews...`);

      const res = await fetch("/api/claude/reviews", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          reviewBlock,
          reviewCount: trimmed.length,
          brandName: "Dr. Cuddles", // TODO: from project
          productName: "ReadyRESCUE",
        }),
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        let msg = `API returned ${res.status}`;
        try { const err = await res.json(); msg = err.error || msg; } catch {}
        throw new Error(msg);
      }

      const data = await res.json();
      setAnalyzedReviews(data.reviews);
      if (data.usage) setAiUsage(data.usage);
      setAiProgress("");
      setStep("review");
    } catch (err: any) {
      setAiError(err.message || "Failed to analyze reviews");
      setAiProgress("");
    } finally {
      setIsRunningAI(false);
    }
  }, [parseResult]);

  // Filtered reviews
  const filteredReviews = analyzedReviews.filter((r) => {
    if (starFilter !== "all" && r.ReviewStarRating !== parseInt(starFilter)) return false;
    if (sentimentFilter !== "all" && r.ReviewSentiment !== sentimentFilter) return false;
    if (searchFilter) {
      const s = searchFilter.toLowerCase();
      const origText = (originalTextMap.get(r.ReviewID) || "").toLowerCase();
      if (!r.ReviewTitle.toLowerCase().includes(s) && !r.ReviewKeyThemes.toLowerCase().includes(s) && !r.ReviewRufusUsableInsight.toLowerCase().includes(s) && !origText.includes(s)) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });

  // Download OUT_REV CSV
  const downloadCSV = useCallback(() => {
    const headers = [
      "ReviewID", "ReviewDate", "ReviewReviewerName", "ReviewASIN", "ReviewProductVariation",
      "ReviewStarRating", "ReviewTitle", "ReviewText", "ReviewSentiment", "ReviewKeyThemes",
      "ReviewUsageMentioned", "ReviewPackagingFeedback", "ReviewPriceFeedback",
      "ReviewHeatLevelFeedback", "ReviewRufusUsableInsight", "ReviewBulletMapping",
    ];
    // Merge original text back in
    const originalMap = new Map(parseResult?.reviews.map((r) => [r.review_id, r.text]) || []);

    const rows = analyzedReviews.map((r) => {
      const values = [
        r.ReviewID, r.ReviewDate, r.ReviewReviewerName, r.ReviewASIN, r.ReviewProductVariation,
        String(r.ReviewStarRating), r.ReviewTitle, originalMap.get(r.ReviewID) || "",
        r.ReviewSentiment, r.ReviewKeyThemes, r.ReviewUsageMentioned,
        r.ReviewPackagingFeedback, r.ReviewPriceFeedback, r.ReviewHeatLevelFeedback,
        r.ReviewRufusUsableInsight, r.ReviewBulletMapping,
      ];
      return values.map((v) => {
        const s = String(v || "");
        return s.includes(",") || s.includes('"') || s.includes("\n") ? `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : s;
      }).join(",");
    });
    const csv = [headers.join(","), ...rows].join("\n");
    const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = "OUT_REV.csv";
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, [analyzedReviews, parseResult]);

  // Map review IDs to original text for display
  const originalTextMap = new Map(parseResult?.reviews.map((r) => [r.review_id, r.text]) || []);

  // Sentiment counts
  const sentimentCounts: Record<string, number> = {};
  analyzedReviews.forEach((r) => {
    sentimentCounts[r.ReviewSentiment] = (sentimentCounts[r.ReviewSentiment] || 0) + 1;
  });

  return (
    <div className="max-w-6xl">
      <h1 className="text-xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-zinc-100 mb-1">Review Synthesis</h1>
      <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 mb-4">
        {step === "upload" ? "Upload Review CSV" : step === "parsed" ? "Parsed Reviews" : step === "review" ? "Review Analysis (OUT_REV)" : "Reviews Approved"}
      </p>
      <StepNav
        steps={REVIEWS_STEPS}
        currentStep={step}
        onStepClick={(key) => setStep(key as ReviewsStep)}
        completedSteps={completedSteps}
        isApproved={isApproved}
      />

      {/* ── Upload ── */}
      {step === "upload" && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 p-5">
          <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-zinc-400">
            Upload the Amazon review CSV export for your{" "}
            <strong className="text-zinc-200">parent ASIN</strong>.{" "}
            {parentAsin ? (
              <a
                href={parentAsin.amazon_url || `https://www.amazon.com/dp/${parentAsin.asin}`}
                target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-mono text-brand-400 hover:text-brand-300 underline underline-offset-2"
              >
                {parentAsin.asin}
                <svg className="h-3 w-3" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" strokeWidth={2} stroke="currentColor"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M13.5 6H5.25A2.25 2.25 0 0 0 3 8.25v10.5A2.25 2.25 0 0 0 5.25 21h10.5A2.25 2.25 0 0 0 18 18.75V10.5m-10.5 6L21 3m0 0h-5.25M21 3v5.25" /></svg>
              </a>
            ) : (
              <span className="text-zinc-500 italic">complete S1 first</span>
            )}{" "}
            — one file covers all variations.
          </p>

          {/* Show uploaded/saved file indicator */}
          {reviewFileName && (
            <div className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-accent-green/30 bg-accent-green/5 px-4 py-2.5">
              <svg className="h-4 w-4 text-accent-green shrink-0" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" strokeWidth={2} stroke="currentColor"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="m4.5 12.75 6 6 9-13.5" /></svg>
              <span className="text-xs font-medium text-zinc-300 flex-1">{reviewFileName}</span>
              {parseResult && <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500">{parseResult.reviews.length} reviews parsed</span>}
              {!parseResult && analyzedReviews.length > 0 && <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500">{analyzedReviews.length} reviews in DB</span>}
              <button
                onClick={() => { setParseResult(null); setReviewFileName(""); setAnalyzedReviews([]); if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = ""; }}
                className="rounded p-1 text-zinc-600 hover:bg-red-950/30 hover:text-accent-red transition-colors"
                title="Remove and re-upload"
              >
                <svg className="h-3.5 w-3.5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" strokeWidth={2} stroke="currentColor"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M6 18 18 6M6 6l12 12" /></svg>
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          <input
            ref={fileInputRef}
            type="file"
            accept=".csv"
            onChange={handleUpload}
            className="w-full rounded-lg border border-dashed border-surface-5 bg-surface-0 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-zinc-400 file:mr-3 file:rounded-md file:border-0 file:bg-brand-500/20 file:px-3 file:py-1.5 file:text-xs file:font-bold file:text-brand-400 hover:border-brand-700 cursor-pointer"
          />
          <p className="mt-2 text-[10px] text-zinc-600">
            {reviewFileName ? "Upload a new CSV to replace existing data." : "Required columns: id, text, date, title, rating. Optional: profileName, images, helpful, variant:* name"}
          </p>

          {/* Skip if no reviews */}
          {!reviewFileName && (
            <button
              onClick={async () => {
                try {
                  await fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/save`, {
                    method: "POST",
                    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ phase: "s3_reviews", data: { reviews: [] } }),
                  });
                } catch {}
                setAnalyzedReviews([]);
                setIsApproved(true);
                setCompletedSteps(new Set(REVIEWS_STEPS.map((s) => s.key)));
                setStep("approved");
              }}
              className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-500 hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-zinc-300"
            >
              Skip — No Reviews Available
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Parsed ── */}
      {step === "parsed" && parseResult && (
        <div>
          {/* Stats */}
          <div className="mb-4 grid grid-cols-4 gap-3">
            <StatCard label="Reviews Parsed" value={parseResult.reviews.length} />
            <StatCard label="With Helpful Votes" value={parseResult.reviews.filter((r) => r.helpful_votes > 0).length} color="amber" />
            <StatCard label="Variant Columns" value={parseResult.variantColumns.length} />
            <StatCard label="Unique Variations" value={new Set(parseResult.reviews.map((r) => r.product_variation)).size} />
          </div>

          {parseResult.errors.length > 0 && (
            <div className="mb-4 rounded-lg border border-red-900/50 bg-red-950/30 p-4">
              {parseResult.errors.map((e, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="text-xs text-accent-red py-0.5">{e}</div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Star distribution */}
          <div className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 p-5">
            <div className="mb-3 text-xs font-bold text-zinc-400">Star Distribution</div>
            <div className="flex items-end gap-4">
              {[5, 4, 3, 2, 1].map((star) => {
                const count = parseResult.starDistribution[star] || 0;
                const pct = parseResult.reviews.length > 0 ? (count / parseResult.reviews.length) * 100 : 0;
                const isPriority = star === 3 || star === 4;
                return (
                  <div key={star} className="flex-1 text-center">
                    <div className="mb-1 flex justify-center">
                      <div
                        className={`w-full rounded-t transition-all ${isPriority ? "bg-brand-500" : star === 5 ? "bg-accent-green" : "bg-accent-red/60"}`}
                        style={{ height: `${Math.max(4, pct * 1.5)}px` }}
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300">{count}</div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-0.5">
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-400">{star}★</span>
                      {isPriority && <span className="text-[8px] font-bold text-brand-400">PRIORITY</span>}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Preview table */}
          <div className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 overflow-hidden">
            <div className="px-4 py-2.5 border-b border-surface-4 flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-400">
                Review Preview (first 30)
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-600">{parseResult.reviews.length} total</span>
            </div>
            <div className="overflow-x-auto max-h-[450px] overflow-y-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-xs">
                <thead className="sticky top-0 bg-surface-2 z-10">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left font-bold text-zinc-500 whitespace-nowrap">Date</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 text-center font-bold text-zinc-500 whitespace-nowrap">Rating</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left font-bold text-zinc-500 whitespace-nowrap">Title</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left font-bold text-zinc-500 whitespace-nowrap min-w-[300px]">Text</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left font-bold text-zinc-500 whitespace-nowrap">Variation</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 text-right font-bold text-zinc-500 whitespace-nowrap">Helpful</th>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 text-center font-bold text-zinc-500 whitespace-nowrap">Images</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {parseResult.reviews.slice(0, 30).map((r, i) => (
                    <tr key={i} className="border-t border-surface-4 hover:bg-surface-2/50 align-top">
                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-zinc-500 whitespace-nowrap">{r.date_iso}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-center">
                        <StarBadge rating={r.star_rating} />
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-zinc-200 font-medium max-w-[200px]">
                        <div className="break-words" style={{whiteSpace:"normal"}}>{r.title}</div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-zinc-400 min-w-[300px] max-w-[400px]">
                        <div className="line-clamp-3 leading-relaxed">{r.text}</div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-zinc-400 whitespace-nowrap">{r.product_variation}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right font-mono text-zinc-400">{r.helpful_votes || "—"}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-center">
                        {r.images ? (
                          <span className="inline-flex h-4 w-4 items-center justify-center rounded bg-accent-blue/20 text-[8px] font-bold text-accent-blue" title={r.images}>✓</span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-zinc-700">—</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
            {parseResult.reviews.length > 30 && (
              <div className="px-4 py-2 border-t border-surface-4 text-[10px] text-zinc-600">
                Showing 30 of {parseResult.reviews.length} reviews
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Actions */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={() => { setStep("upload"); setParseResult(null); }} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400 hover:bg-surface-2">
              Back
            </button>
            <AIGeneratingButton
              isGenerating={isRunningAI}
              onClick={handleRunAI}
              label="Run AI Analysis (Claude)"
            />
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                // Skip AI — pass reviews through with placeholder analysis
                const skipped = parseResult!.reviews.slice(0, 50).map((r, i) => ({
                  ReviewID: r.review_id,
                  ReviewDate: r.date_iso,
                  ReviewReviewerName: `Reviewer_${String(i + 1).padStart(3, "0")}`,
                  ReviewASIN: "",
                  ReviewProductVariation: r.product_variation || "",
                  ReviewStarRating: r.star_rating,
                  ReviewTitle: r.title,
                  ReviewText: r.text.substring(0, 200),
                  ReviewSentiment: r.star_rating >= 4 ? "Positive" : r.star_rating === 3 ? "Neutral" : "Negative",
                  ReviewKeyThemes: "AI analysis skipped",
                  ReviewUsageMentioned: "Not analyzed",
                  ReviewPackagingFeedback: "Not analyzed",
                  ReviewPriceFeedback: "Not analyzed",
                  ReviewHeatLevelFeedback: "Not analyzed",
                  ReviewRufusUsableInsight: "Not analyzed",
                  ReviewBulletMapping: "Not analyzed",
                }));
                setAnalyzedReviews(skipped);
                setStep("review");
              }}
              disabled={isRunningAI}
              className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400 hover:bg-surface-2 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              Skip AI → Approve Raw
            </button>
            <AICostTracker
              isRunning={isRunningAI}
              usage={aiUsage}
              startTime={aiStartTime}
              error={aiError}
            />
          </div>

          {aiError && !isRunningAI && (
            <div className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-red-900/50 bg-red-950/30 p-3 text-xs text-accent-red">{aiError}</div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Review OUT_REV ── */}
      {step === "review" && analyzedReviews.length > 0 && (
        <div>
          {/* Sentiment overview */}
          <div className="mb-4 grid grid-cols-6 gap-3">
            {["Positive+", "Positive", "Neutral", "Negative", "Negative-"].map((s) => (
              <div key={s} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 px-3 py-2.5 text-center">
                <div className={`text-lg font-extrabold ${sentimentColor(s)}`}>{sentimentCounts[s] || 0}</div>
                <div className="text-[9px] text-zinc-500">{s}</div>
              </div>
            ))}
            <StatCard label="Total Analyzed" value={analyzedReviews.length} />
          </div>

          {/* Filters */}
          <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap">
            <input
              value={searchFilter}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchFilter(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search titles, themes, insights..."
              className="rounded-md border border-surface-4 bg-surface-0 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-300 placeholder:text-zinc-700 focus:border-brand-700 focus:outline-none w-56"
            />
            <select value={starFilter} onChange={(e) => setStarFilter(e.target.value)} className="rounded-md border border-surface-4 bg-surface-0 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-300 focus:outline-none">
              <option value="all">All Stars</option>
              {[5, 4, 3, 2, 1].map((s) => <option key={s} value={s}>{s}★</option>)}
            </select>
            <select value={sentimentFilter} onChange={(e) => setSentimentFilter(e.target.value)} className="rounded-md border border-surface-4 bg-surface-0 px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-zinc-300 focus:outline-none">
              <option value="all">All Sentiments</option>
              {["Positive+", "Positive", "Neutral", "Negative", "Negative-"].map((s) => <option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>)}
            </select>
            <span className="ml-auto text-[10px] text-zinc-600">{filteredReviews.length} of {analyzedReviews.length}</span>
          </div>

          {/* OUT_REV cards */}
          <div className="mb-4 space-y-2 max-h-[500px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
            {filteredReviews.map((r) => (
              <div
                key={r.ReviewID}
                className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 p-4 cursor-pointer hover:border-surface-5 transition-colors"
                onClick={() => setExpandedRow(expandedRow === r.ReviewID ? null : r.ReviewID)}
              >
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <StarBadge rating={r.ReviewStarRating} />
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-200 break-words" style={{whiteSpace:"normal"}}>{r.ReviewTitle}</span>
                      <span className={`text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded ${sentimentBg(r.ReviewSentiment)}`}>
                        {r.ReviewSentiment}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[10px] text-zinc-500">
                      <span>{r.ReviewReviewerName}</span>
                      <span>{r.ReviewDate}</span>
                      <span>{r.ReviewProductVariation}</span>
                    </div>

                    {/* Review text preview */}
                    {(() => {
                      const originalText = originalTextMap.get(r.ReviewID) || "";
                      if (!originalText) return null;
                      const isExpanded = expandedRow === r.ReviewID;
                      return (
                        <div className="mt-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-zinc-400">
                          {isExpanded ? originalText : originalText.length > 180 ? originalText.substring(0, 180) + "..." : originalText}
                        </div>
                      );
                    })()}

                    {/* Themes */}
                    <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                      {r.ReviewKeyThemes.split(",").map((t, i) => (
                        <span key={i} className="rounded bg-surface-3 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-medium text-zinc-400">
                          {t.trim()}
                        </span>
                      ))}
                    </div>

                    {/* Expanded detail */}
                    {expandedRow === r.ReviewID && (
                      <div className="mt-3 space-y-2 border-t border-surface-4 pt-3">
                        <DetailRow label="Rufus Insight" value={r.ReviewRufusUsableInsight} />
                        <DetailRow label="Bullet Mapping" value={r.ReviewBulletMapping} />
                        <DetailRow label="Usage" value={r.ReviewUsageMentioned} />
                        <DetailRow label="Packaging" value={r.ReviewPackagingFeedback} />
                        <DetailRow label="Price" value={r.ReviewPriceFeedback} />
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Actions */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={() => setStep("parsed")} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400 hover:bg-surface-2">
              Back
            </button>
            <button onClick={downloadCSV} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400 hover:bg-surface-2">
              Download OUT_REV.csv
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={async () => {
                try {
                  const reviewsWithText = analyzedReviews.map((r) => ({
                    ...r,
                    originalText: originalTextMap.get(r.ReviewID) || "",
                    helpfulVotes: parseResult?.reviews.find((pr) => pr.review_id === r.ReviewID)?.helpful_votes || 0,
                  }));
                  await fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/save`, {
                    method: "POST",
                    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ phase: "s3_reviews", data: { reviews: reviewsWithText } }),
                  });
                } catch {}
                router.push(`/projects/${projectId}/rufus`);
              }}
              className="ml-auto rounded-lg bg-accent-green px-6 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-surface-0 hover:bg-accent-green/80"
            >
              ✓ Approve S3 — Unlock Rufus (S4)
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Approved ── */}
      {step === "approved" && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-accent-green/30 bg-accent-green/5 p-6 text-center">
          <div className="mb-2 text-lg font-extrabold text-accent-green">S3 Reviews — Approved ✓</div>
          <p className="text-sm text-zinc-400 mb-4">{analyzedReviews.length} reviews analyzed with sentiment, themes, and Rufus insights.</p>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={downloadCSV} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400 hover:bg-surface-2">
              Download OUT_REV.csv
            </button>
            <a href={`/projects/${projectId}/rufus`} className="rounded-lg bg-brand-500 px-5 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-surface-0 hover:bg-brand-400">
              Continue → S4 Rufus
            </a>
            <button onClick={() => { setIsApproved(false); setStep("review"); }} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-500 hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-zinc-300">
              Unlock for Editing
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Sub-components ──────────────────────────────────────────

function StatCard({ label, value, color = "default" }: { label: string; value: number; color?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 px-4 py-3">
      <div className={`text-lg font-extrabold ${color === "red" ? "text-accent-red" : color === "green" ? "text-accent-green" : color === "amber" ? "text-accent-amber" : "text-zinc-100"}`}>{value}</div>
      <div className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500">{label}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

function StarBadge({ rating }: { rating: number }) {
  const colors: Record<number, string> = {
    5: "bg-accent-green/20 text-accent-green",
    4: "bg-accent-green/10 text-accent-green/80",
    3: "bg-brand-500/20 text-brand-400",
    2: "bg-accent-red/15 text-accent-red/80",
    1: "bg-accent-red/20 text-accent-red",
  };
  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex items-center rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-extrabold ${colors[rating] || "bg-surface-4 text-zinc-500"}`}>
      {rating}★
    </span>
  );
}

function DetailRow({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
      <span className="w-24 shrink-0 text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-500">{label}</span>
      <span className="text-[11px] text-zinc-300 leading-relaxed text-justify">{value}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

function sentimentColor(s: string): string {
  if (s.startsWith("Positive")) return "text-accent-green";
  if (s === "Neutral") return "text-zinc-400";
  return "text-accent-red";
}

function sentimentBg(s: string): string {
  if (s === "Positive+") return "bg-accent-green/20 text-accent-green";
  if (s === "Positive") return "bg-accent-green/10 text-accent-green/80";
  if (s === "Neutral") return "bg-zinc-700/30 text-zinc-400";
  if (s === "Negative") return "bg-accent-red/15 text-accent-red/80";
  return "bg-accent-red/20 text-accent-red";
}

FILE: seo-manager-reference/app/projects/[id]/rufus/page.tsx

"use client";

import { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from "react";
import AIGeneratingButton from "@/components/ai-generating-button";
import { useRouter, useParams } from "next/navigation";
import AICostTracker from "@/components/ai-cost-tracker";
import StepNav from "@/components/step-nav";

const RUFUS_STEPS = [
  { key: "phase1_display", label: "S4.1 Phase 1 Questions" },
  { key: "phase1_input", label: "S4.2 Phase 1 Answers" },
  { key: "phase1_confirm", label: "S4.3 Phase 1 Confirm" },
  { key: "phase2_display", label: "S4.4 Phase 2 Questions" },
  { key: "phase2_input", label: "S4.5 Phase 2 Answers" },
  { key: "phase2_confirm", label: "S4.6 Phase 2 Confirm" },
  { key: "review", label: "S4.7 Review OUT_RUF" },
  { key: "approved", label: "S4.8 Approved" },
];

// Phase 1 canonical questions (immutable per S4.3.1.3)
const PHASE1_QUESTIONS = [
  "What is this product for?",
  "What do people like about this product?",
  "What do people NOT like about this product?",
  "What are people buying instead of this product?",
  "Why do customers choose this product over alternatives?",
];

const PHASE1_PASTE_BLOCK = `Please provide answer followed by the following questions:
What is this product for?
What do people like about this product?
What do people NOT like about this product?
What are people buying instead of this product?
Why do customers choose this product over alternatives?`;

interface QAPair {
  question: string;
  answer: string;
}

interface AnalyzedRufus {
  ASIN: string;
  RufusQuestion: string;
  RufusAnswer: string;
  RufusQuestionCategory: string;
  RufusInsightType: string;
  RufusPrimaryObjectionAddressed: string;
  RufusPrimaryDesireAddressed: string;
  RufusCOSMORelationship: string;
  RufusUsageContext: string;
  RufusNotes: string;
}

type RufusStep = "phase1_display" | "phase1_input" | "phase1_confirm" | "phase2_display" | "phase2_input" | "phase2_confirm" | "analysis" | "review" | "approved";

export default function RufusPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useParams();
  const projectId = params.id as string;
  const [step, setStep] = useState<RufusStep>("phase1_display");
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [isApproved, setIsApproved] = useState(false);
  const [completedSteps, setCompletedSteps] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [parentAsin, setParentAsin] = useState<{ asin: string; amazon_url: string } | null>(null);
  const [loadingState, setLoadingState] = useState(true);
  const [guidelinesText, setGuidelinesText] = useState("");

  // Phase 1
  const [phase1Answers, setPhase1Answers] = useState<string[]>(["", "", "", "", ""]);
  const [phase1Bulk, setPhase1Bulk] = useState("");

  // Phase 2
  const [phase2Questions, setPhase2Questions] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [phase2Answers, setPhase2Answers] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [phase2Bulk, setPhase2Bulk] = useState("");
  const [isGeneratingQ, setIsGeneratingQ] = useState(false);
  const [genUsage, setGenUsage] = useState<any>(null);

  // Analysis
  const [analyzedRows, setAnalyzedRows] = useState<AnalyzedRufus[]>([]);
  const [isRunningAI, setIsRunningAI] = useState(false);
  const [aiError, setAiError] = useState("");
  const [aiStartTime, setAiStartTime] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [aiUsage, setAiUsage] = useState<any>(null);

  // ── Load saved data on mount ────────────────────────────────

  useEffect(() => {
    async function load() {
      try {
        // Load brand guidelines from S1
        const s1Res = await fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/load?phase=s1_intake`);
        if (s1Res.ok) {
          const s1 = await s1Res.json();
          if (s1.project?.brand_guidelines) setGuidelinesText(s1.project.brand_guidelines);
        }

        // Load parent ASIN
        const asinRes = await fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/load?phase=parent_asin`);
        if (asinRes.ok) {
          const { parent } = await asinRes.json();
          if (parent) setParentAsin(parent);
        }

        // Load saved rufus data
        const rufusRes = await fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/load?phase=s4_rufus`);
        if (rufusRes.ok) {
          const data = await rufusRes.json();
          if (data.rows && data.rows.length > 0) {
            setAnalyzedRows(data.rows);
            // Reconstruct phase1/phase2 answers from saved rows
            const p1: string[] = ["", "", "", "", ""];
            const p2q: string[] = [];
            const p2a: string[] = [];
            for (const r of data.rows) {
              // Check if this is a Phase 1 question
              const p1idx = PHASE1_QUESTIONS.findIndex(q => 
                q.toLowerCase() === (r.RufusQuestion || "").toLowerCase()
              );
              if (p1idx >= 0) {
                p1[p1idx] = r.RufusAnswer || "";
              } else {
                p2q.push(r.RufusQuestion || "");
                p2a.push(r.RufusAnswer || "");
              }
            }
            setPhase1Answers(p1);
            if (p2q.length > 0) {
              setPhase2Questions(p2q);
              setPhase2Answers(p2a);
            }
            setCompletedSteps(new Set(RUFUS_STEPS.map(s => s.key)));
            setIsApproved(true);
            setStep("approved");
          }
        }
      } catch {}
      setLoadingState(false);
    }
    load();
  }, [projectId]);

  // ── Copy paste block ──────────────────────────────────────

  const copyPasteBlock = useCallback(() => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(PHASE1_PASTE_BLOCK);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  }, []);

  // ── Shared Rufus answer cleaner ──────────────────────────
  const cleanRufusAnswer = (text: string): string => {
    return text.split("\n")
      .filter(l => {
        const t = l.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!t) return false;
        if (t === "see more" || t === "more details" || t === "customer question") return false;
        if (t.startsWith("i can't help") || t.startsWith("i cannot help")) return false;
        if (t.startsWith("i'd recommend:") || t.startsWith("i would recommend:")) return false;
        return true;
      })
      .join("\n")
      .trim();
  };

  // ── Generic question-answer parser for Rufus output ──────
  const parseRufusBulk = (text: string, questions: string[]): string[] => {
    const answers = new Array(questions.length).fill("");
    if (!text.trim()) return answers;

    const lines = text.split("\n");
    const questionPositions: {lineIdx: number; qIdx: number}[] = [];

    for (let li = 0; li < lines.length; li++) {
      const lineLow = lines[li].toLowerCase().trim();
      if (!lineLow || lineLow.length < 15) continue;

      for (let qi = 0; qi < questions.length; qi++) {
        if (questionPositions.some(p => p.qIdx === qi)) continue;
        const qLow = questions[qi].toLowerCase();

        // Method 1: Direct substring (first 35 chars)
        const subLen = Math.min(35, qLow.length);
        if (lineLow.includes(qLow.substring(0, subLen))) {
          questionPositions.push({ lineIdx: li, qIdx: qi });
          break;
        }

        // Method 2: Significant word matching (4+ char words)
        const qWords = qLow.match(/\b[a-z]{4,}\b/g) || [];
        if (qWords.length >= 3) {
          const matchCount = qWords.filter(w => lineLow.includes(w)).length;
          if (matchCount / qWords.length >= 0.65) {
            questionPositions.push({ lineIdx: li, qIdx: qi });
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    questionPositions.sort((a, b) => a.lineIdx - b.lineIdx);

    if (questionPositions.length > 0) {
      for (let i = 0; i < questionPositions.length; i++) {
        const startLine = questionPositions[i].lineIdx + 1;
        const endLine = i < questionPositions.length - 1
          ? questionPositions[i + 1].lineIdx
          : lines.length;
        const raw = lines.slice(startLine, endLine).join("\n");
        answers[questionPositions[i].qIdx] = cleanRufusAnswer(raw);
      }
    } else {
      const paragraphs = text.split(/\n\s*\n/).filter(p => p.trim());
      paragraphs.forEach((p, i) => {
        if (i < answers.length) answers[i] = cleanRufusAnswer(p);
      });
    }

    return answers;
  };

  // ── Parse Phase 1 bulk input ──────────────────────────────

  const parsePhase1Bulk = useCallback(() => {
    const text = phase1Bulk.trim();
    if (!text) return;

    // First try Q1/A1 label patterns
    const lines = text.split(/\n/).filter((l) => l.trim());
    const labelAnswers: string[] = ["", "", "", "", ""];
    let currentQ = -1;
    let buffer = "";
    let foundLabels = false;

    for (const line of lines) {
      const qMatch = line.match(/^(?:Q|Question)\s*(\d)/i);
      const aMatch = line.match(/^(?:A|Answer)\s*(\d)/i);

      if (qMatch) {
        if (currentQ >= 0 && buffer.trim()) labelAnswers[currentQ] = buffer.trim();
        currentQ = parseInt(qMatch[1]) - 1;
        buffer = "";
        foundLabels = true;
        continue;
      }
      if (aMatch) {
        if (currentQ >= 0 && buffer.trim()) labelAnswers[currentQ] = buffer.trim();
        currentQ = parseInt(aMatch[1]) - 1;
        buffer = line.replace(/^(?:A|Answer)\s*\d[.:]\s*/i, "");
        foundLabels = true;
        continue;
      }
      buffer += (buffer ? "\n" : "") + line;
    }
    if (currentQ >= 0 && buffer.trim()) labelAnswers[currentQ] = buffer.trim();

    if (foundLabels && labelAnswers.some(a => a)) {
      setPhase1Answers(labelAnswers.map(a => cleanRufusAnswer(a)));
    } else {
      setPhase1Answers(parseRufusBulk(text, PHASE1_QUESTIONS));
    }
    setCompletedSteps(prev => new Set([...prev, "phase1_display", "phase1_input"]));
    setStep("phase1_confirm");
  }, [phase1Bulk]);

  // ── Generate Phase 2 questions via Claude ─────────────────

  const generatePhase2Questions = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsGeneratingQ(true);
    setAiError("");
    setAiStartTime(Date.now());

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/claude/rufus", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          action: "generate_phase2",
          phase1: PHASE1_QUESTIONS.map((q, i) => ({ question: q, answer: phase1Answers[i] })),
          brandName: parentAsin || "Product",
          productName: parentAsin || "Product",
          guidelines: guidelinesText,
        }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `API ${res.status}`);
      setPhase2Questions(data.questions);
      setPhase2Answers(new Array(data.questions.length).fill(""));
      setGenUsage(data.usage);
      setCompletedSteps(prev => new Set([...prev, "phase1_display", "phase1_input", "phase1_confirm"]));
      setStep("phase2_display");
    } catch (err: any) {
      setAiError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setIsGeneratingQ(false);
    }
  }, [phase1Answers]);

  // ── Parse Phase 2 bulk input ──────────────────────────────

  const parsePhase2Bulk = useCallback(() => {
    const text = phase2Bulk.trim();
    if (!text) return;
    setPhase2Answers(parseRufusBulk(text, phase2Questions));
    setCompletedSteps(prev => new Set([...prev, "phase2_display", "phase2_input"]));
    setStep("phase2_confirm");
  }, [phase2Bulk, phase2Questions]);

  // ── Run Final Analysis ────────────────────────────────────

  const runAnalysis = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsRunningAI(true);
    setAiError("");
    setAiStartTime(Date.now());
    setAiUsage(null);

    const allQA: QAPair[] = [
      ...PHASE1_QUESTIONS.map((q, i) => ({ question: q, answer: phase1Answers[i] })),
      ...phase2Questions.map((q, i) => ({ question: q, answer: phase2Answers[i] })),
    ];

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/claude/rufus", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          action: "analyze",
          guidelines: guidelinesText,
          allQA,
          brandName: parentAsin || "Product",
          productName: parentAsin || "Product",
        }),
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(errData.error || `API ${res.status}`);
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      setAnalyzedRows(data.rows);
      setAiUsage(data.usage);
      setCompletedSteps(prev => new Set([...prev, "phase1_display", "phase1_input", "phase1_confirm", "phase2_display", "phase2_input", "phase2_confirm"]));
      setStep("review");
    } catch (err: any) {
      setAiError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setIsRunningAI(false);
    }
  }, [phase1Answers, phase2Questions, phase2Answers]);

  // ── Download CSV ──────────────────────────────────────────

  const downloadCSV = useCallback(() => {
    const headers = ["ASIN", "RufusQuestion", "RufusAnswer", "RufusQuestionCategory", "RufusInsightType", "RufusPrimaryObjectionAddressed", "RufusPrimaryDesireAddressed", "RufusCOSMORelationship", "RufusUsageContext", "RufusNotes"];
    const rows = analyzedRows.map((r) =>
      headers.map((h) => {
        const val = String((r as any)[h] || "");
        return val.includes(",") || val.includes('"') || val.includes("\n") ? `"${val.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : val;
      }).join(",")
    );
    const csv = [headers.join(","), ...rows].join("\n");
    const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = "OUT_RUF.csv";
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, [analyzedRows]);

  // ── Build Phase 2 paste blocks (≤496 chars) ──────────────

  const phase2Batches: string[][] = [];
  if (phase2Questions.length > 0) {
    let currentBatch: string[] = [];
    let currentLen = 0;
    for (const q of phase2Questions) {
      const newLen = currentLen + (currentBatch.length > 0 ? 1 : 0) + q.length;
      if (newLen > 496 && currentBatch.length > 0) {
        phase2Batches.push(currentBatch);
        currentBatch = [q];
        currentLen = q.length;
      } else {
        currentBatch.push(q);
        currentLen = newLen;
      }
    }
    if (currentBatch.length > 0) phase2Batches.push(currentBatch);
  }

  // ── RENDER ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  if (loadingState) {
    return (
      <div className="max-w-6xl flex items-center gap-3 py-10 text-zinc-500 text-sm">
        <span className="inline-block h-4 w-4 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-zinc-500 border-t-transparent" />
        Loading Rufus data...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-6xl">
      <h1 className="text-xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-zinc-100 mb-1">Rufus Optimization</h1>
      <p className="text-xs text-zinc-500 mb-4">
        {step.startsWith("phase1") ? "Phase 1 — Foundational Questions" : step.startsWith("phase2") ? "Phase 2 — Strategic Questions" : step === "analysis" ? "Running Analysis" : step === "review" ? "Review OUT_RUF" : step === "approved" ? "Rufus Approved" : "Rufus"}
      </p>
      <StepNav
        steps={RUFUS_STEPS}
        currentStep={step}
        onStepClick={(key) => setStep(key as RufusStep)}
        completedSteps={completedSteps}
        isApproved={isApproved}
      />

      {/* ── PHASE 1: Display paste block ── */}
      {step === "phase1_display" && (
        <div>
          <div className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 p-5">
            <p className="mb-3 text-sm text-zinc-400">
              Copy the block below and paste it into the <span className="font-semibold text-zinc-200">Rufus AI chat</span> for your Parent ASIN. Then paste the responses back here.
            </p>

            {/* Parent ASIN link */}
            <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-brand-700/20 bg-brand-950/10 px-4 py-2.5">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-500">Parent ASIN:</span>
              {parentAsin ? (
                <>
                  <a
                    href={parentAsin.amazon_url || `https://www.amazon.com/dp/${parentAsin.asin}`}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="text-xs font-bold text-brand-400 hover:text-brand-300 underline underline-offset-2"
                  >
                    {parentAsin.asin}
                  </a>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-600">← Open in Amazon, then ask Rufus</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-600 italic">Not set — complete S1 Intake first</span>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Paste block */}
            <div className="relative rounded-lg border border-brand-700/30 bg-surface-0 p-4">
              <pre className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-300 whitespace-pre-wrap font-mono">{PHASE1_PASTE_BLOCK}</pre>
              <button
                onClick={copyPasteBlock}
                className="absolute top-2 right-2 rounded-md bg-brand-500/20 px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-brand-400 hover:bg-brand-500/30"
              >
                {copied ? "✓ Copied" : "Copy"}
              </button>
              <div className="mt-2 text-[10px] text-zinc-600">
                {PHASE1_PASTE_BLOCK.length} characters (max 496)
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button onClick={() => setStep("phase1_input")} className="rounded-lg bg-brand-500 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-surface-0 hover:bg-brand-400">
            I Have the Rufus Responses →
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── PHASE 1: Input answers ── */}
      {step === "phase1_input" && (
        <div>
          <div className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 p-5">
            <p className="mb-3 text-sm text-zinc-400">
              Paste all 5 Rufus responses below. You can paste them as a block — the system will auto-map them to each question.
            </p>
            <textarea
              value={phase1Bulk}
              onChange={(e) => setPhase1Bulk(e.target.value)}
              rows={12}
              placeholder={"Q1: What is this product for?\nA1: ...\n\nQ2: What do people like about this product?\nA2: ..."}
              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-0 px-4 py-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-300 placeholder:text-zinc-700 focus:border-brand-700 focus:outline-none resize-none font-mono"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={() => setStep("phase1_display")} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400 hover:bg-surface-2">Back</button>
            <button onClick={parsePhase1Bulk} disabled={!phase1Bulk.trim()} className="rounded-lg bg-brand-500 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-surface-0 hover:bg-brand-400 disabled:opacity-50">
              Parse & Map Answers
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── PHASE 1: Confirm mapping ── */}
      {step === "phase1_confirm" && (
        <div>
          <div className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-brand-700/20 bg-brand-950/10 p-5">
            <div className="mb-3 text-sm font-bold text-brand-400">Phase 1 Auto-Mapping Confirmation</div>
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {PHASE1_QUESTIONS.map((q, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 p-3">
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-500 mb-1">Q{i + 1}: {q}</div>
                  <textarea
                    value={phase1Answers[i]}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const updated = [...phase1Answers];
                      updated[i] = e.target.value;
                      setPhase1Answers(updated);
                    }}
                    rows={3}
                    className="w-full rounded-md border border-surface-4 bg-surface-0 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-300 focus:border-brand-700 focus:outline-none resize-none"
                  />
                  {!phase1Answers[i].trim() && (
                    <div className="mt-1 text-[9px] font-bold text-accent-red">Missing answer</div>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={() => setStep("phase1_input")} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400 hover:bg-surface-2">Back</button>
<AIGeneratingButton
              isGenerating={isGeneratingQ}
              onClick={generatePhase2Questions}
              label="Ask Claude to Generate Phase 2 Questions"
              disabled={phase1Answers.some((a) => !a.trim()) || isGeneratingQ}
            />
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                // Skip Phase 2 AI — go straight to manual Phase 2 with placeholder questions
                setPhase2Questions([
                  "What ingredients does this product contain?",
                  "How quickly does this product work?",
                  "Is this product suitable for sensitive skin?",
                  "What age groups use this product most?",
                  "How does the packaging protect the product?",
                  "Is this product used daily or as needed?",
                  "What situations trigger a purchase of this product?",
                  "Does this product replace any home remedies?",
                ]);
                setPhase2Answers(new Array(8).fill(""));
                setCompletedSteps(prev => new Set([...prev, "phase1_display", "phase1_input", "phase1_confirm"]));
      setStep("phase2_display");
              }}
              disabled={phase1Answers.some((a) => !a.trim()) || isGeneratingQ}
              className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400 hover:bg-surface-2 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              Skip AI → Use Default Questions
            </button>
            <AICostTracker isRunning={isGeneratingQ} usage={genUsage} startTime={aiStartTime} error={aiError} />
          </div>
          {aiError && !isGeneratingQ && (
            <div className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-red-900/50 bg-red-950/30 p-3 text-xs text-accent-red">{aiError}</div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── PHASE 2: Display questions + paste blocks ── */}
      {step === "phase2_display" && (
        <div>
          <div className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 p-5">
            <div className="mb-3 text-sm font-bold text-zinc-200">
              {phase2Questions.length} Strategic Questions Generated
            </div>
            <p className="mb-4 text-xs text-zinc-400">
              Copy each batch below and paste into Rufus. Then paste all responses back.
            </p>

            {phase2Batches.map((batch, bi) => {
              const blockText = batch.join("\n");
              return (
                <div key={bi} className="mb-3 rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-0 p-4 relative">
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-500 mb-2">
                    Batch {bi + 1} — {blockText.length} chars
                    {blockText.length > 496 && <span className="ml-2 text-accent-red">EXCEEDS 496 LIMIT</span>}
                  </div>
                  <pre className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-300 whitespace-pre-wrap font-mono">{blockText}</pre>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => { navigator.clipboard.writeText(blockText); }}
                    className="absolute top-2 right-2 rounded-md bg-brand-500/20 px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-brand-400 hover:bg-brand-500/30"
                  >
                    Copy
                  </button>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          <button onClick={() => setStep("phase2_input")} className="rounded-lg bg-brand-500 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-surface-0 hover:bg-brand-400">
            I Have the Rufus Responses →
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── PHASE 2: Input answers ── */}
      {step === "phase2_input" && (
        <div>
          <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-zinc-400">
            {phase2Batches.length} batch{phase2Batches.length !== 1 ? "es" : ""} — paste Rufus responses for each batch below.
          </p>

          <div className="space-y-4 mb-4">
            {phase2Batches.map((batch, bi) => {
              const isFilled = !!(phase2Bulk.split("---BATCH---")[bi]?.trim());
              return (
                <div key={bi} className={`rounded-xl border p-4 space-y-3 ${isFilled ? "border-accent-green/20 bg-accent-green/5" : "border-surface-4 bg-surface-1"}`}>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className={`flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[9px] font-extrabold ${isFilled ? "bg-accent-green/20 text-accent-green" : "bg-brand-500/15 text-brand-400"}`}>
                      {isFilled ? "✓" : bi + 1}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-300">Batch {bi + 1}</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-zinc-600">{batch.length} question{batch.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}</span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Questions reference */}
                  <div className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-0 px-3 py-2 space-y-1">
                    {batch.map((q, qi) => {
                      const globalIdx = phase2Batches.slice(0, bi).reduce((n, b) => n + b.length, 0) + qi;
                      return (
                        <div key={qi} className="flex items-start gap-2">
                          <span className="shrink-0 text-[9px] font-bold text-zinc-600 mt-0.5">Q{globalIdx + 6}</span>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-zinc-500 leading-relaxed">{q}</p>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>

                  {/* One textarea for the whole batch */}
                  <textarea
                    value={phase2Bulk.split("---BATCH---")[bi] || ""}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const parts = phase2Batches.map((_, i) => phase2Bulk.split("---BATCH---")[i] || "");
                      parts[bi] = e.target.value;
                      setPhase2Bulk(parts.join("---BATCH---"));
                    }}
                    rows={5}
                    placeholder={`Paste Rufus responses for Batch ${bi + 1}...`}
                    className="w-full rounded-md border border-surface-4 bg-surface-0 px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-zinc-300 placeholder:text-zinc-600 focus:border-brand-700 focus:outline-none resize-none"
                  />
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={() => setStep("phase2_display")} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400 hover:bg-surface-2">Back</button>
            <button
              onClick={parsePhase2Bulk}
              disabled={!phase2Bulk.trim()}
              className="rounded-lg bg-brand-500 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-surface-0 hover:bg-brand-400 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              Parse & Continue →
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── PHASE 2: Confirm ── */}
      {step === "phase2_confirm" && (
        <div>
          <div className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 p-5">
            <div className="mb-3 text-sm font-bold text-zinc-200">Phase 2 Answer Confirmation</div>
            <div className="space-y-3 max-h-[400px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
              {phase2Questions.map((q, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-0 p-3">
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-zinc-500 mb-1">Q{i + 6}: {q}</div>
                  <textarea
                    value={phase2Answers[i]}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const updated = [...phase2Answers];
                      updated[i] = e.target.value;
                      setPhase2Answers(updated);
                    }}
                    rows={2}
                    className="w-full rounded-md border border-surface-4 bg-surface-0 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-300 focus:border-brand-700 focus:outline-none resize-none"
                  />
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={() => setStep("phase2_input")} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400 hover:bg-surface-2">Back</button>
<AIGeneratingButton
              isGenerating={isRunningAI}
              onClick={runAnalysis}
              label="Ask Claude to Run Final Analysis"
              disabled={isRunningAI}
            />
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                // Skip AI — create placeholder OUT_RUF rows
                const allQA = [
                  ...PHASE1_QUESTIONS.map((q, i) => ({ question: q, answer: phase1Answers[i] })),
                  ...phase2Questions.map((q, i) => ({ question: q, answer: phase2Answers[i] })),
                ];
                const skipped = allQA.map((qa) => ({
                  ASIN: "ParentASIN",
                  RufusQuestion: qa.question,
                  RufusAnswer: qa.answer,
                  RufusQuestionCategory: "Not analyzed",
                  RufusInsightType: "Not analyzed",
                  RufusPrimaryObjectionAddressed: "AI analysis skipped",
                  RufusPrimaryDesireAddressed: "AI analysis skipped",
                  RufusCOSMORelationship: "Not analyzed",
                  RufusUsageContext: "Not analyzed",
                  RufusNotes: "AI analysis skipped",
                }));
                setAnalyzedRows(skipped);
                setCompletedSteps(prev => new Set([...prev, "phase1_display", "phase1_input", "phase1_confirm", "phase2_display", "phase2_input", "phase2_confirm"]));
      setStep("review");
              }}
              disabled={isRunningAI}
              className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400 hover:bg-surface-2 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              Skip AI → Approve Raw
            </button>
            <AICostTracker isRunning={isRunningAI} usage={aiUsage} startTime={aiStartTime} error={aiError} />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Review OUT_RUF ── */}
      {step === "review" && analyzedRows.length > 0 && (
        <div>
          <div className="mb-4 grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
            <StatCard label="Total Q&A Pairs" value={analyzedRows.length} />
            <StatCard label="Phase 1" value={5} />
            <StatCard label="Phase 2" value={analyzedRows.length - 5} />
          </div>

          <div className="mb-4 space-y-2 max-h-[500px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
            {analyzedRows.map((r, i) => (
              <div key={i} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 p-4">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3 mb-2">
                  <span className={`shrink-0 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-extrabold ${i < 5 ? "bg-brand-500/20 text-brand-400" : "bg-accent-blue/20 text-accent-blue"}`}>
                    {i < 5 ? "P1" : "P2"}
                  </span>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-200 mb-1">{r.RufusQuestion}</div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-zinc-400 leading-relaxed mb-2">{r.RufusAnswer}</div>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                      <Tag label={r.RufusQuestionCategory} />
                      <Tag label={r.RufusInsightType} />
                      <Tag label={r.RufusCOSMORelationship} color="blue" />
                      <Tag label={r.RufusUsageContext} color="green" />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {r.RufusNotes && r.RufusNotes !== "None" && (
                  <div className="mt-2 text-[10px] text-zinc-500 border-t border-surface-4 pt-2">
                    <span className="font-bold">Notes:</span> {r.RufusNotes}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={downloadCSV} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400 hover:bg-surface-2">
              Download OUT_RUF.csv
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={async () => {
                try {
                  await fetch(`/api/projects/${projectId}/save`, {
                    method: "POST",
                    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                      phase: "s4_rufus",
                      data: {
                        analyzedRows: analyzedRows,
                      },
                    }),
                  });
                } catch {}
                setCompletedSteps(new Set(RUFUS_STEPS.map(s => s.key)));
                setIsApproved(true);
                setStep("approved");
              }}
              className="ml-auto rounded-lg bg-accent-green px-6 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-surface-0 hover:bg-accent-green/80"
            >
              ✓ Approve S4 — Unlock COSMO (S5)
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Approved ── */}
      {step === "approved" && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-accent-green/30 bg-accent-green/5 p-6 text-center">
          <div className="mb-2 text-lg font-extrabold text-accent-green">S4 Rufus — Approved ✓</div>
          <p className="text-sm text-zinc-400 mb-4">{analyzedRows.length} Q&A pairs analyzed with COSMO relationships and buyer insights.</p>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={downloadCSV} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-400 hover:bg-surface-2">
              Download OUT_RUF.csv
            </button>
            <a href={`/projects/${projectId}/cosmo`} className="rounded-lg bg-brand-500 px-5 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-surface-0 hover:bg-brand-400">
              Continue → S5 COSMO
            </a>
            <button onClick={() => { setStep("review"); }} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-500 hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-zinc-300">
              Unlock for Editing
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function StatCard({ label, value }: { label: string; value: number }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 px-4 py-3">
      <div className="text-lg font-extrabold text-zinc-100">{value}</div>
      <div className="text-[10px] text-zinc-500">{label}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Tag({ label, color = "default" }: { label: string; color?: string }) {
  if (!label || label === "None") return null;
  const c = color === "blue" ? "bg-accent-blue/15 text-accent-blue" : color === "green" ? "bg-accent-green/15 text-accent-green" : "bg-surface-3 text-zinc-400";
  return <span className={`rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-medium ${c}`}>{label}</span>;
}

"use client";

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// AI Cost Tracker — Shows token usage + estimated cost
// Place inline next to "Run AI" buttons
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";

// Sonnet pricing (per million tokens) as of Feb 2026
const PRICING = {
  "claude-sonnet-4-20250514": { input: 3.0, output: 15.0 },
  "claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929": { input: 3.0, output: 15.0 },
  "claude-opus-4-6": { input: 15.0, output: 75.0 },
  default: { input: 3.0, output: 15.0 },
};

interface AIUsage {
  input_tokens: number;
  output_tokens: number;
  model?: string;
}

interface AICostTrackerProps {
  isRunning: boolean;
  usage: AIUsage | null;
  startTime: number | null; // Date.now() when started
  error?: string;
}

export default function AICostTracker({ isRunning, usage, startTime, error }: AICostTrackerProps) {
  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(0);

  // Live timer while running
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isRunning || !startTime) {
      setElapsed(0);
      return;
    }
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setElapsed(Math.floor((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000));
    }, 100);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isRunning, startTime]);

  // Calculate cost
  const estimateCost = (u: AIUsage): number => {
    const model = u.model || "default";
    const rates = PRICING[model as keyof typeof PRICING] || PRICING.default;
    return (u.input_tokens / 1_000_000) * rates.input + (u.output_tokens / 1_000_000) * rates.output;
  };

  // Running state
  if (isRunning) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-brand-700/30 bg-brand-950/30 px-3 py-2">
        <span className="inline-block h-2 w-2 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-brand-500" />
        <div className="text-xs">
          <span className="font-bold text-brand-400">Processing</span>
          <span className="ml-2 font-mono text-zinc-500">{formatTime(elapsed)}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Error state
  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-red-900/30 bg-red-950/20 px-3 py-2">
        <span className="inline-block h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-accent-red" />
        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-accent-red">Failed</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Completed with usage data
  if (usage) {
    const cost = estimateCost(usage);
    const totalTokens = usage.input_tokens + usage.output_tokens;

    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4 rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-2/50 px-3 py-2">
        {/* Tokens */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <svg className="h-3 w-3 text-zinc-500" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" strokeWidth={1.5} stroke="currentColor">
            <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M9.813 15.904 9 18.75l-.813-2.846a4.5 4.5 0 0 0-3.09-3.09L2.25 12l2.846-.813a4.5 4.5 0 0 0 3.09-3.09L9 5.25l.813 2.846a4.5 4.5 0 0 0 3.09 3.09L15.75 12l-2.846.813a4.5 4.5 0 0 0-3.09 3.09Z" />
          </svg>
          <div className="text-[10px]">
            <span className="font-mono text-zinc-400">{totalTokens.toLocaleString()}</span>
            <span className="text-zinc-600"> tok</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Breakdown */}
        <div className="text-[9px] text-zinc-600">
          {usage.input_tokens.toLocaleString()}↑ {usage.output_tokens.toLocaleString()}↓
        </div>

        {/* Cost */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-accent-green">${cost.toFixed(4)}</span>
        </div>

        {/* Check mark */}
        <svg className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-accent-green" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" strokeWidth={2} stroke="currentColor">
          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="m4.5 12.75 6 6 9-13.5" />
        </svg>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // No usage yet
  return null;
}

function formatTime(seconds: number): string {
  if (seconds < 60) return `${seconds}s`;
  const mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  const secs = seconds % 60;
  return `${mins}m ${secs}s`;
}

"use client";

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";

interface AIGeneratingButtonProps {
  isGenerating: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
  label: string;
  generatingLabel?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg";
}

const GENERATING_MESSAGES = [
  "Analyzing research data",
  "Building semantic context",
  "Applying COSMO relationships",
  "Optimizing for human voice",
  "Integrating keyword strategy",
  "Crafting content",
  "Applying brand guidelines",
  "Finalizing output",
];

// Claude asterisk logomark — exact match to the app icon
function ClaudeIcon({ className, style }: { className?: string; style?: React.CSSProperties }) {
  return (
    <svg className={className} style={style} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
      <path d="M11.987 1C5.924 1 1 5.923 1 11.987 1 18.05 5.924 23 11.987 23 18.05 23 23 18.05 23 11.987 23 5.923 18.05 1 11.987 1zm.013 3.5c.46 0 .833.373.833.833v3.334a.833.833 0 0 1-1.666 0V5.333c0-.46.373-.833.833-.833zm5.196 2.304a.833.833 0 0 1 0 1.179l-2.357 2.357a.833.833 0 0 1-1.179-1.179l2.357-2.357a.833.833 0 0 1 1.179 0zM5.804 6.804a.833.833 0 0 1 1.179 0l2.357 2.357a.833.833 0 1 1-1.179 1.179L5.804 7.983a.833.833 0 0 1 0-1.179zM4.5 11.154h3.334a.833.833 0 0 1 0 1.666H4.5a.833.833 0 0 1 0-1.666zm11.666 0H19.5a.833.833 0 0 1 0 1.666h-3.334a.833.833 0 0 1 0-1.666zm-3.023 3.189a.833.833 0 0 1 0 1.179l-2.357 2.357a.833.833 0 0 1-1.179-1.179l2.357-2.357a.833.833 0 0 1 1.179 0zM9.34 14.34a.833.833 0 0 1 1.179 1.179l-2.357 2.357a.833.833 0 0 1-1.179-1.179zm2.647 2.327a.833.833 0 0 1 .833.833V20.833a.833.833 0 0 1-1.666 0V17.5c0-.46.373-.833.833-.833z"/>
    </svg>
  );
}

export default function AIGeneratingButton({
  isGenerating,
  onClick,
  label,
  disabled = false,
  className = "",
  size = "md",
}: AIGeneratingButtonProps) {
  const [msgIdx, setMsgIdx] = useState(0);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [dots, setDots] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isGenerating) { setMsgIdx(0); setProgress(0); setDots(0); return; }
    const msgTimer = setInterval(() => setMsgIdx(i => (i + 1) % GENERATING_MESSAGES.length), 2600);
    const progressTimer = setInterval(() => setProgress(p => Math.min(p + Math.random() * 2.5, 92)), 350);
    const dotsTimer = setInterval(() => setDots(d => (d + 1) % 4), 450);
    return () => { clearInterval(msgTimer); clearInterval(progressTimer); clearInterval(dotsTimer); };
  }, [isGenerating]);

  const sizeClasses = size === "sm"
    ? "px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs"
    : size === "lg"
    ? "px-8 py-3 text-sm"
    : "px-5 py-2.5 text-sm";

  // ── GENERATING STATE ──────────────────────────────────────
  if (isGenerating) {
    return (
      <div className={`relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden ${sizeClasses} ${className}`}
        style={{ background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #c84b31 0%, #e8602a 50%, #d4522e 100%)", minWidth: "220px" }}
      >
        {/* Animated progress fill */}
        <div
          className="absolute inset-0 transition-all duration-500 ease-out origin-left"
          style={{ background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.25)", transform: `scaleX(${1 - progress / 100})`, transformOrigin: "right" }}
        />
        {/* Sweep shimmer */}
        <div
          className="absolute inset-0 opacity-30"
          style={{
            background: "linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.4) 50%, transparent 100%)",
            animation: "shimmer 1.6s ease-in-out infinite",
            backgroundSize: "200% 100%",
          }}
        />
        <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center gap-2.5">
          {/* Spinning Claude icon */}
          <ClaudeIcon className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-white animate-spin" style={{ animationDuration: "2s" } as React.CSSProperties} />
          <div className="flex flex-col items-start leading-none">
            <span className="font-bold text-white text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wide">Claude is working</span>
            <span className="text-white/70 text-[10px] truncate max-w-[180px]">
              {GENERATING_MESSAGES[msgIdx]}{"·".repeat(dots + 1)}
            </span>
          </div>
          <span className="ml-auto font-mono text-white/60 text-[10px] shrink-0">{Math.round(progress)}%</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ── IDLE STATE ────────────────────────────────────────────
  return (
    <button
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      className={`group relative flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-white active:scale-[0.98] transition-all duration-150 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed overflow-hidden ${sizeClasses} ${className}`}
      style={{ background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #c84b31 0%, #e8602a 50%, #d4522e 100%)" }}
    >
      {/* Hover overlay */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-white/0 group-hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors duration-150" />
      <ClaudeIcon className="relative h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-white group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform duration-150" />
      <span className="relative">{label}</span>
    </button>
  );
}
