"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useSession } from "next-auth/react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { getScoreColor, getScoreLabel } from "@/lib/completeness";
import { getMatchColor } from "@/lib/sp-api/comparator";
import { ALL_STATUSES, STATUS_CHIP_STYLES, STATUS_CHIP_EMPTY } from "@/lib/constants";
import { RefreshCw, Loader2, Plus, Package, Users } from "lucide-react";
import { NewClientDialog } from "@/components/clients/new-client-dialog";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/ui/empty-state";
import { LoadingPlaceholder } from "@/components/ui/loading-placeholder";

// ── Types ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type ClientEntry = {
  clientIdCode: string;
  clientName: string;
  count: number;
  activeCount: number;
  statusBreakdown: Record<string, number>;
  team?: { label: string; name: string }[];
  amazonMatch?: { avgMatch: number; comparedCount: number } | null;
};

type InactiveClientEntry = {
  clientIdCode: string;
  clientName: string;
};

type CompletnessSummary = {
  averageScore: number;
  distribution: {
    ready: number;
    good: number;
    incomplete: number;
    poor: number;
  };
};

// ── Fetchers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

async function fetchClients(): Promise<ClientEntry[]> {
  const res = await fetch("/api/clients");
  if (!res.ok) return [];
  return res.json();
}

async function fetchInactiveClients(): Promise<InactiveClientEntry[]> {
  const res = await fetch("/api/clients?status=inactive");
  if (!res.ok) return [];
  return res.json();
}

async function fetchCompleteness(): Promise<
  Record<string, CompletnessSummary>
> {
  const res = await fetch("/api/products/completeness/batch");
  if (!res.ok) return {};
  return res.json();
}

// ── Animated readiness ring ───────────────────────────────────────────

function ReadinessRing({
  score,
  size = 56,
}: {
  score: number;
  size?: number;
}) {
  const color = getScoreColor(score);
  const label = getScoreLabel(score);
  const r = 14;
  const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * r;
  const dashArray = `${(score / 100) * circumference} ${circumference}`;

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
      <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
        <svg
          className="-rotate-90"
          width={size}
          height={size}
          viewBox="0 0 36 36"
        >
          <circle
            cx="18"
            cy="18"
            r={r}
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            className="text-muted"
            strokeWidth="3"
          />
          <circle
            cx="18"
            cy="18"
            r={r}
            fill="none"
            stroke={color}
            strokeWidth="3"
            strokeDasharray={dashArray}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            className="animate-ring-fill"
            style={{ animationDelay: "0.3s" }}
          />
        </svg>
        <span
          className="absolute text-xs font-bold tabular-nums animate-fade-up"
          style={{ color, animationDelay: "0.5s" }}
        >
          {score}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="min-w-0">
        <span className="text-sm font-semibold" style={{ color }}>
          {label}
        </span>
        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{score}% avg</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Readiness distribution bar ────────────────────────────────────────

function ReadinessDistribution({
  distribution,
}: {
  distribution: CompletnessSummary["distribution"];
}) {
  const total =
    distribution.ready +
    distribution.good +
    distribution.incomplete +
    distribution.poor;
  if (total === 0) return null;

  const segments = [
    { key: "ready", count: distribution.ready, color: "bg-emerald-500", label: "Ready" },
    { key: "good", count: distribution.good, color: "bg-brand", label: "Good" },
    { key: "incomplete", count: distribution.incomplete, color: "bg-orange-500", label: "Inc." },
    { key: "poor", count: distribution.poor, color: "bg-red-500", label: "Poor" },
  ];

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex h-1.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden bg-muted/60">
        {segments.map(
          (seg) =>
            seg.count > 0 && (
              <div
                key={seg.key}
                className={`${seg.color} animate-bar-fill`}
                style={{ width: `${(seg.count / total) * 100}%` }}
              />
            )
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="flex gap-2 mt-1.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground flex-wrap">
        {segments.map(
          (seg) =>
            seg.count > 0 && (
              <span key={seg.key} className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <span
                  className={`inline-block h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${seg.color}`}
                />
                {seg.count} {seg.label}
              </span>
            )
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── ASIN status grid ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

function StatusGrid({
  statusBreakdown,
}: {
  statusBreakdown: Record<string, number>;
}) {
  const nonZeroStatuses = ALL_STATUSES.filter((s) => (statusBreakdown[s] ?? 0) > 0);
  if (nonZeroStatuses.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-px">
      {nonZeroStatuses.map((status) => {
        const count = statusBreakdown[status] ?? 0;
        return (
          <span
            key={status}
            className={`flex items-center justify-center rounded-sm px-1 text-[11px] font-bold h-[18px] whitespace-nowrap ${STATUS_CHIP_STYLES[status]}`}
          >
            {count} {status === "Replacement ASIN" ? "Replace" : status}
          </span>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Main page ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function ClientsPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const isAdmin = session?.user?.role === "admin";
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [batchingClient, setBatchingClient] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showNewClient, setShowNewClient] = useState(false);

  const { data: clients = [], isLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["clients"],
    queryFn: fetchClients,
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  const { data: inactiveClients = [] } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["clients", "inactive"],
    queryFn: fetchInactiveClients,
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  const { data: completeness = {} } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["completeness-batch"],
    queryFn: fetchCompleteness,
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  const batchMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (clientIdCode: string) => {
      setBatchingClient(clientIdCode);
      const res = await fetch("/api/compare/batch", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ clientIdCode, maxProducts: 500 }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Batch comparison failed");
      }
      return res.json();
    },
    onSettled: () => {
      setBatchingClient(null);
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["clients"] });
    },
  });

  // Aggregate totals across all clients
  const totalProducts = clients.reduce((sum, c) => sum + c.count, 0);
  const globalStatus: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const c of clients) {
    for (const [status, count] of Object.entries(c.statusBreakdown)) {
      globalStatus[status] = (globalStatus[status] ?? 0) + count;
    }
  }

  return (
    <div>
      {/* Page header */}
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10 py-4 mb-2 bg-background">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter">
            <span className="text-foreground font-bold">Clients</span><span className="text-brand font-medium">Insight</span>
          </h1>
          {isAdmin && (
            <Button
              size="sm"
              className="mt-1 bg-brand text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover shadow-[0_0_16px_-4px_var(--brand-glow)]"
              onClick={() => setShowNewClient(true)}
            >
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" />
              New Client
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Summary cards - Asymmetric Hero */}
      {!isLoading && clients.length > 0 && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 mb-12">

          {/* Main ASINs display (Spans 8 cols) */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-7 xl:col-span-8 rounded-2xl border border-neutral-300 dark:border-white/10 glass-card p-8 lg:p-10 flex flex-col justify-between animate-card-enter">
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-brand uppercase tracking-[0.2em] mb-2 font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)]">Global Catalog</p>
              <div className="flex items-baseline gap-3">
                <span className="text-5xl lg:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tighter text-foreground font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)]">
                  {totalProducts.toLocaleString()}
                </span>
                <span className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">Total ASINs</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-10 pt-6 border-t border-border/40">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                {ALL_STATUSES.map((status) => {
                  const count = globalStatus[status] ?? 0;
                  const hasCount = count > 0;
                  if (!hasCount) return null;
                  return (
                    <span
                      key={status}
                      className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold whitespace-nowrap ${STATUS_CHIP_STYLES[status]}`}
                    >
                      {count.toLocaleString()} {status === "Replacement ASIN" ? "Replace" : status}
                    </span>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Active Clients (Spans 4 cols) */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-5 xl:col-span-4 rounded-2xl border border-neutral-300 dark:border-white/10 glass-card p-8 lg:p-10 flex flex-col justify-center animate-card-enter" style={{ animationDelay: "80ms" }}>
            <div className="space-y-6">
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-[0.2em] mb-1 font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)]">Active</p>
                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
                  <span className="text-5xl font-bold tracking-tighter text-brand font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)]">{clients.length}</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">Clients</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {inactiveClients.length > 0 && (
                <div className="pt-6 border-t border-border/40">
                  <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-[0.2em] mb-1 font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)]">Inactive</p>
                  <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
                    <span className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tighter text-red-500 font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)]">{inactiveClients.length}</span>
                    <span className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">Archived</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

        </div>
      )}

      {/* Client grid */}
      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
          <LoadingPlaceholder count={6} className="border-border/40" />
        </div>
      ) : clients.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={Users}
          title="No clients found"
          description="Add a client to get started with your product catalog."
          action={
            isAdmin ? (
              <Button
                size="sm"
                className="bg-brand text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover"
                onClick={() => setShowNewClient(true)}
              >
                <Plus className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" />
                New Client
              </Button>
            ) : undefined
          }
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
          {clients.map((client, index) => {
            const comp = completeness[client.clientIdCode];
            return (
              <div
                key={client.clientIdCode}
                className="rounded-xl glass-card text-card-foreground cursor-pointer card-glow animate-card-enter overflow-hidden group/card border border-neutral-300 dark:border-white/10"
                style={{ animationDelay: `${index * 60}ms` }}
                onClick={() =>
                  router.push(`/clients/${client.clientIdCode}`)
                }
              >
                <div className="px-5 pt-5 pb-4 border-b border-neutral-200 dark:border-white/10 relative z-10">
                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
                    {/* Top: name + code */}
                    <div className="min-w-0 w-full">
                      <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground truncate font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tight group-hover/card:text-brand transition-colors title-overflow-fix">
                        {client.clientName}
                      </h2>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground font-mono mt-0.5 opacity-60">
                        {client.clientIdCode}
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    {/* Middle: Status Chips */}
                    <div className="w-full">
                      <StatusGrid
                        statusBreakdown={client.statusBreakdown}
                      />
                    </div>

                    {/* Bottom: Catalog count & View Button */}
                    <div className="flex items-end justify-between mt-1 gap-2 border-t border-border/10 pt-3">
                      <div className="min-w-0 shrink">
                        <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-[0.15em] mb-1 font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)]">Catalog</p>
                        <div className="flex items-baseline gap-1.5">
                          <span className="text-3xl font-bold tabular-nums text-foreground group-hover/card:text-brand transition-colors font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter">
                            {client.activeCount}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            active
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/40 hidden sm:inline">
                            / {client.count} total
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <button
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          router.push(`/products?client=${client.clientIdCode}`);
                        }}
                        className="shrink-0 inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-brand hover:text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand transition-all group/link px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border border-brand/30 hover:shadow-[0_0_12px_-2px_var(--brand-glow)]"
                      >
                        <Package className="h-3.5 w-3.5 transition-transform group-hover/link:scale-110" />
                        Products
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="px-5 py-4 space-y-3">
                  {/* Readiness + Amazon Match side by side */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    {/* Readiness */}
                    {comp ? (
                      <div className="space-y-2">
                        <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-[0.12em]">
                          Readiness
                        </p>
                        <ReadinessRing score={comp.averageScore} size={48} />
                        <ReadinessDistribution
                          distribution={comp.distribution}
                        />
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="space-y-2">
                        <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-[0.12em]">
                          Readiness
                        </p>
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/50">
                          No data
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {/* Amazon Match */}
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      <p className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-[0.12em]">
                        Amazon Match
                      </p>
                      {client.amazonMatch ? (
                        <>
                          <ReadinessRing
                            score={client.amazonMatch.avgMatch}
                            size={48}
                          />
                          <div>
                            <div className="flex h-1.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden bg-muted/60">
                              <div
                                className="h-full rounded-full animate-bar-fill"
                                style={{
                                  width: `${client.amazonMatch.avgMatch}%`,
                                  backgroundColor: getMatchColor(
                                    client.amazonMatch.avgMatch
                                  ),
                                }}
                              />
                            </div>
                            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                              {client.amazonMatch.comparedCount} of{" "}
                              {client.activeCount} compared
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/50">
                          Not compared
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Batch compare button (admin only) */}
                  {isAdmin && (
                    <Button
                      variant="outline"
                      size="sm"
                      className="w-full text-xs border-border/60 hover:border-brand/30 hover:shadow-[0_0_12px_-4px_var(--brand-glow)]"
                      disabled={batchingClient !== null}
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        batchMutation.mutate(client.clientIdCode);
                      }}
                    >
                      {batchingClient === client.clientIdCode ? (
                        <>
                          <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 mr-1 animate-spin" />
                          Comparing...
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <RefreshCw className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
                          Batch Compare
                        </>
                      )}
                    </Button>
                  )}

                  {/* Team members */}
                  {client.team && client.team.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="border-t border-border/40 pt-2.5 space-y-0.5">
                      {client.team.map((member) => (
                        <div
                          key={member.label}
                          className="grid grid-cols-2 text-xs gap-2"
                        >
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground text-right truncate">
                            {member.label}
                          </span>
                          <span className="font-medium truncate">
                            {member.name}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Inactive Clients */}
      {inactiveClients.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mt-12">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-muted-foreground font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)]">
              Inactive Clients
            </h2>
            <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-red-500/10 text-red-400 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold tabular-nums">
              {inactiveClients.length}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
            {inactiveClients.map((client, index) => (
              <div
                key={client.clientIdCode}
                className="rounded-xl border border-border/40 glass-panel text-card-foreground cursor-pointer transition-all hover:border-red-500/30 hover:shadow-[0_0_24px_-4px_rgba(239,68,68,0.15)] px-5 py-4 animate-card-enter"
                style={{ animationDelay: `${index * 40}ms` }}
                onClick={() =>
                  router.push(`/clients/${client.clientIdCode}`)
                }
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium truncate">
                      {client.clientName}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-mono truncate">
                      {client.clientIdCode}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <span className="shrink-0 inline-flex items-center rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold bg-red-600/10 text-red-400 border border-red-500/20">
                    Inactive
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <NewClientDialog open={showNewClient} onOpenChange={setShowNewClient} />
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/app/admin/ai/page.tsx
================================================
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Loader2, RotateCcw, Save } from "lucide-react";
import { AI_DEFAULTS, AVAILABLE_MODELS, AI_FEATURE_KEYS } from "@/lib/ai-config";
import type { AiFeatureKey, AiFeatureConfig } from "@/lib/ai-config";

interface AiConfigResponse {
  features: Record<AiFeatureKey, AiFeatureConfig>;
  updatedAt: string | null;
  updatedBy: string | null;
}

export default function AdminAiPage() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const { data, isLoading, error } = useQuery<AiConfigResponse>({
    queryKey: ["admin-ai-config"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/ai-config");
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load AI config");
      return res.json();
    },
  });

  const [localConfig, setLocalConfig] = useState<Record<string, AiFeatureConfig> | null>(null);

  // Initialize local state from server data
  const config = localConfig ?? data?.features ?? null;

  // Track if user has made changes
  const hasChanges = localConfig !== null;

  function updateFeature(key: AiFeatureKey, field: keyof AiFeatureConfig, value: string | number | boolean) {
    const current = config ?? data?.features;
    if (!current) return;

    setLocalConfig({
      ...current,
      [key]: { ...current[key], [field]: value },
    });
  }

  function resetToDefaults() {
    const reset: Record<string, AiFeatureConfig> = {};
    for (const key of AI_FEATURE_KEYS) {
      reset[key] = { ...AI_DEFAULTS[key] };
    }
    setLocalConfig(reset);
  }

  const saveMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (features: Record<string, AiFeatureConfig>) => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/ai-config", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ features }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to save");
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success("AI configuration saved");
      setLocalConfig(null);
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["admin-ai-config"] });
    },
    onError: () => toast.error("Failed to save AI configuration"),
  });

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
        <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-zinc-400" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error || !data) {
    return (
      <div className="p-8 text-red-400">
        Failed to load AI configuration. Make sure you have admin access.
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-4xl px-6 py-8">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="mb-6 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-zinc-100 font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)]">
            AI Configuration
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-400">
            Manage model, token limits, and enabled state for every AI feature in the app.
          </p>
          {data.updatedAt && (
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-zinc-500">
              Last updated {new Date(data.updatedAt).toLocaleDateString()} by {data.updatedBy}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={resetToDefaults}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-zinc-600 bg-zinc-800 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-700"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Reset Defaults
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => config && saveMutation.mutate(config)}
            disabled={!hasChanges || saveMutation.isPending}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md bg-[#F8BF1D] px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-[#0F1111] hover:bg-[#F8BF1D]/90 disabled:opacity-40"
          >
            {saveMutation.isPending ? (
              <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
            ) : (
              <Save className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            )}
            Save Changes
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Feature cards */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        {AI_FEATURE_KEYS.map((key) => {
          const feat = config?.[key] ?? AI_DEFAULTS[key];
          const defaults = AI_DEFAULTS[key];
          const isDefault = feat.model === defaults.model && feat.maxTokens === defaults.maxTokens && feat.enabled === defaults.enabled;

          return (
            <div
              key={key}
              className={`rounded-lg border p-4 ${
                feat.enabled
                  ? "border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-800/50"
                  : "border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900/50 opacity-60"
              }`}
            >
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
                {/* Left: label + route */}
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-100">{feat.label}</h3>
                    {!isDefault && (
                      <span className="rounded bg-amber-500/15 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-amber-400">
                        MODIFIED
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <code className="mt-0.5 block text-xs text-zinc-500">{feat.route}</code>
                </div>

                {/* Right: enabled toggle */}
                <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="text-xs text-zinc-400">
                    {feat.enabled ? "Enabled" : "Disabled"}
                  </span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    role="switch"
                    aria-checked={feat.enabled}
                    onClick={() => updateFeature(key, "enabled", !feat.enabled)}
                    className={`relative inline-flex h-5 w-9 items-center rounded-full transition-colors ${
                      feat.enabled ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-zinc-600"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span
                      className={`inline-block h-3.5 w-3.5 transform rounded-full bg-white transition-transform ${
                        feat.enabled ? "translate-x-[18px]" : "translate-x-[3px]"
                      }`}
                    />
                  </button>
                </label>
              </div>

              {/* Config row */}
              <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-4">
                {/* Model selector */}
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <label className="mb-1 block text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-500">
                    Model
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={feat.model}
                    onChange={(e) => updateFeature(key, "model", e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-600 bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm text-zinc-200 outline-none focus:border-[#F8BF1D]/50"
                  >
                    {AVAILABLE_MODELS.map((m) => (
                      <option key={m.id} value={m.id}>
                        {m.label}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                {/* Max tokens */}
                <div className="w-32">
                  <label className="mb-1 block text-[11px] font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-500">
                    Max Tokens
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min={50}
                    max={16384}
                    step={50}
                    value={feat.maxTokens}
                    onChange={(e) => updateFeature(key, "maxTokens", Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full rounded-md border border-zinc-600 bg-zinc-900 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm text-zinc-200 outline-none focus:border-[#F8BF1D]/50"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/app/admin/issues/page.tsx

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useSession } from "next-auth/react";
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from "@/components/ui/avatar";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { MessageSquareText, X, ImageIcon, MessageSquare, Mail, Check, Pencil, Trash2, BellRing } from "lucide-react";

type IssueReport = {
  id: number;
  reportedBy: string;
  reportedByName: string | null;
  section: string;
  description: string;
  screenshotUrl: string | null;
  status: "pending" | "in_review" | "in_progress" | "resolved" | "closed";
  adminNotes: string | null;
  notesSeen: boolean;
  resolvedBy: string | null;
  resolvedAt: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
};

const STATUS_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  pending: "bg-orange-500/15 text-orange-500 border-orange-500/25",
  in_review: "bg-blue-500/15 text-blue-500 border-blue-500/25",
  in_progress: "bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-500 border-amber-500/25",
  resolved: "bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-500 border-emerald-500/25",
  closed: "bg-zinc-500/15 text-zinc-400 border-zinc-500/25",
};

const ROW_BG: Record<string, string> = {
  pending: "bg-orange-500/10",
  in_review: "bg-blue-500/10",
  in_progress: "bg-amber-500/10",
  resolved: "bg-emerald-500/15",
  closed: "bg-zinc-500/10 opacity-60",
};

const STATUS_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  pending: "Pending",
  in_review: "In Review",
  in_progress: "In Progress",
  resolved: "Resolved",
  closed: "Closed",
};

function formatDate(dateStr: string) {
  const d = new Date(dateStr);
  return d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    year: "numeric",
    hour: "numeric",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

export default function IssueReportsPage() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [selectedReport, setSelectedReport] = useState<IssueReport | null>(null);
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState<string>("all");
  const [notesText, setNotesText] = useState("");
  const [supportEmail, setSupportEmail] = useState("");
  const [editingSupportEmail, setEditingSupportEmail] = useState(false);
  const [supportEmailDraft, setSupportEmailDraft] = useState("");

  const isAdmin = session?.user?.role === "admin";

  // Load support email setting
  useQuery({
    queryKey: ["support-email"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/issue-reports/settings");
      if (!res.ok) return { support_email: "" };
      return res.json();
    },
    select: (data: { support_email: string }) => {
      if (data.support_email !== supportEmail && !editingSupportEmail) {
        setSupportEmail(data.support_email);
      }
      return data;
    },
  });

  const supportEmailMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (email: string) => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/issue-reports/settings", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ support_email: email }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to save");
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      setSupportEmail(data.support_email);
      setEditingSupportEmail(false);
      toast.success("Support email updated");
    },
    onError: () => toast.error("Failed to update support email"),
  });

  const { data: reports, isLoading } = useQuery<IssueReport[]>({
    queryKey: ["issue-reports"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/issue-reports");
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch");
      return res.json();
    },
  });

  const statusMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      id,
      status,
      adminNotes,
    }: {
      id: number;
      status?: string;
      adminNotes?: string;
    }) => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/issue-reports", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ id, status, adminNotes }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to update");
      return res.json() as Promise<IssueReport>;
    },
    onSuccess: (updated) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["issue-reports"] });
      if (selectedReport && selectedReport.id === updated.id) {
        setSelectedReport(updated);
      }
      toast.success("Report updated");
    },
    onError: () => toast.error("Failed to update"),
  });

  const deleteMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (id: number) => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/issue-reports", {
        method: "DELETE",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ id }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to delete");
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["issue-reports"] });
      setSelectedReport(null);
      toast.success("Report removed");
    },
    onError: () => toast.error("Failed to remove report"),
  });

  const markSeenMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (id: number) => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/issue-reports", {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ id }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to mark as seen");
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["issue-reports"] });
    },
  });

  // Reports with unread admin responses (non-admin only)
  const unseenReplies = !isAdmin
    ? reports?.filter((r) => r.adminNotes && !r.notesSeen) ?? []
    : [];

  const filtered =
    filterStatus === "all"
      ? reports
      : reports?.filter((r) => r.status === filterStatus);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10 py-4 mb-2 bg-background">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter mb-2">
              <span className="text-foreground font-bold">Feed</span><span className="text-brand">back</span>
            </h1>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              User-submitted feedback, bug reports, and suggestions
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            {/* Support email config (admin only) */}
            {isAdmin && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Mail className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
                {editingSupportEmail ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <input
                      type="email"
                      value={supportEmailDraft}
                      onChange={(e) => setSupportEmailDraft(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="support@example.com"
                      className="h-8 w-[220px] rounded-md border border-border bg-background px-2.5 text-xs focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand/50"
                      onKeyDown={(e) => {
                        if (e.key === "Enter") supportEmailMutation.mutate(supportEmailDraft);
                        if (e.key === "Escape") setEditingSupportEmail(false);
                      }}
                      autoFocus
                    />
                    <Button
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="icon-sm"
                      onClick={() => supportEmailMutation.mutate(supportEmailDraft)}
                      disabled={supportEmailMutation.isPending}
                    >
                      <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="icon-sm"
                      onClick={() => setEditingSupportEmail(false)}
                    >
                      <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      setSupportEmailDraft(supportEmail);
                      setEditingSupportEmail(true);
                    }}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors"
                  >
                    <span className={supportEmail ? "" : "italic opacity-60"}>
                      {supportEmail || "Set support email"}
                    </span>
                    <Pencil className="h-3 w-3" />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Filter:</span>
            <Select value={filterStatus} onValueChange={setFilterStatus}>
              <SelectTrigger className="w-[140px] h-8 text-xs">
                <SelectValue />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="all">All</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="pending">Pending</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="in_review">In Review</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="in_progress">In Progress</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="resolved">Resolved</SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="closed">Closed</SelectItem>
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Unread admin responses callout */}
      {unseenReplies.length > 0 && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-brand/30 bg-brand/5 p-4 space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-brand">
            <BellRing className="h-4 w-4" />
            <span className="text-sm font-semibold">
              {unseenReplies.length === 1
                ? "You have a new response from the team"
                : `You have ${unseenReplies.length} new responses from the team`}
            </span>
          </div>
          {unseenReplies.map((report) => (
            <button
              key={report.id}
              className="w-full text-left rounded-lg border border-border bg-background/60 p-3 hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors"
              onClick={() => {
                setSelectedReport(report);
                setNotesText(report.adminNotes ?? "");
                markSeenMutation.mutate(report.id);
              }}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                <span className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground">
                  Feedback #{report.id} — <code className="text-[10px] bg-muted/50 px-1 py-0.5 rounded">{report.section}</code>
                </span>
                <Badge
                  variant="outline"
                  className={`text-[10px] ${STATUS_COLORS[report.status]}`}
                >
                  {STATUS_LABELS[report.status]}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2">
                {report.adminNotes}
              </p>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Table */}
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border overflow-hidden bg-background/50">
        <Table>
          <TableHeader>
            <TableRow className="bg-muted/30">
              <TableHead className="w-[160px]">Date</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="w-[180px]">Reported By</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="w-[120px]">Section</TableHead>
              <TableHead>Description</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="w-[50px] text-center">IMG</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="w-[140px]">Status</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="w-[80px]" />
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {isLoading &&
              Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, i) => (
                <TableRow key={i}>
                  {Array.from({ length: 7 }).map((_, j) => (
                    <TableCell key={j}>
                      <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full" />
                    </TableCell>
                  ))}
                </TableRow>
              ))}

            {!isLoading && (!filtered || filtered.length === 0) && (
              <TableRow>
                <TableCell colSpan={7} className="text-center py-12 text-muted-foreground">
                  <MessageSquareText className="h-8 w-8 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-30" />
                  No feedback found
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            )}

            {filtered?.map((report) => (
              <TableRow
                key={report.id}
                className={`cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/20 ${ROW_BG[report.status] ?? ""}`}
                onClick={() => {
                  setSelectedReport(report);
                  setNotesText(report.adminNotes ?? "");
                  if (!isAdmin && report.adminNotes && !report.notesSeen) {
                    markSeenMutation.mutate(report.id);
                  }
                }}
              >
                <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  {formatDate(report.createdAt)}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Avatar className="h-6 w-6">
                      <AvatarFallback className="text-[10px]">
                        {(report.reportedByName ?? report.reportedBy)
                          .split(" ")
                          .map((n) => n[0])
                          .join("")
                          .slice(0, 2)
                          .toUpperCase()}
                      </AvatarFallback>
                    </Avatar>
                    <span className="text-sm truncate max-w-[130px]">
                      {report.reportedByName ?? report.reportedBy}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <code className="text-xs bg-muted/50 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                    {report.section}
                  </code>
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell className="text-sm max-w-xs truncate">
                  {report.description}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell className="text-center">
                  {report.screenshotUrl && (
                    <ImageIcon className="h-3.5 w-3.5 mx-auto text-muted-foreground" />
                  )}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
                  {isAdmin ? (
                    <Select
                      value={report.status}
                      onValueChange={(val) => {
                        statusMutation.mutate({ id: report.id, status: val });
                      }}
                    >
                      <SelectTrigger className="h-7 text-xs border-0 bg-transparent shadow-none w-[130px] p-0 focus:ring-0">
                        <SelectValue>
                          <Badge
                            variant="outline"
                            className={`text-[10px] ${STATUS_COLORS[report.status]}`}
                          >
                            {STATUS_LABELS[report.status]}
                          </Badge>
                        </SelectValue>
                      </SelectTrigger>
                      <SelectContent>
                        {Object.entries(STATUS_LABELS).map(([val, label]) => (
                          <SelectItem key={val} value={val}>
                            <Badge
                              variant="outline"
                              className={`text-[10px] ${STATUS_COLORS[val]}`}
                            >
                              {label}
                            </Badge>
                          </SelectItem>
                        ))}
                      </SelectContent>
                    </Select>
                  ) : (
                    <Badge
                      variant="outline"
                      className={`text-[10px] ${STATUS_COLORS[report.status]}`}
                    >
                      {STATUS_LABELS[report.status]}
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                </TableCell>
                <TableCell>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Button
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="icon-sm"
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        setSelectedReport(report);
                        setNotesText(report.adminNotes ?? "");
                      }}
                    >
                      <MessageSquare className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </Button>
                    {isAdmin && (
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="icon-sm"
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          if (confirm("Remove this feedback item?")) {
                            deleteMutation.mutate(report.id);
                          }
                        }}
                        disabled={deleteMutation.isPending}
                        className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      </Button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </TableCell>
              </TableRow>
            ))}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </div>

      {/* Detail Modal */}
      {selectedReport && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50"
          onClick={() => setSelectedReport(null)}
        >
          <div
            className="bg-background border border-border rounded-xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-2xl mx-4 max-h-[85vh] overflow-auto"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            {/* Header */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-4 border-b border-border sticky top-0 bg-background z-10">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <MessageSquareText className="h-4 w-4 text-brand" />
                <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold">
                  Feedback #{selectedReport.id}
                </h2>
                <Badge
                  variant="outline"
                  className={`text-[10px] ml-2 ${STATUS_COLORS[selectedReport.status]}`}
                >
                  {STATUS_LABELS[selectedReport.status]}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setSelectedReport(null)}
                className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Body */}
            <div className="px-5 py-4 space-y-4">
              {/* Meta */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block mb-1">
                    Reported By
                  </span>
                  <span>{selectedReport.reportedByName ?? selectedReport.reportedBy}</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block mb-1">
                    Date
                  </span>
                  <span>{formatDate(selectedReport.createdAt)}</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block mb-1">
                    Section
                  </span>
                  <code className="text-xs bg-muted/50 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                    {selectedReport.section}
                  </code>
                </div>
                {selectedReport.resolvedBy && (
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block mb-1">
                      Resolved By
                    </span>
                    <span>{selectedReport.resolvedBy}</span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Description */}
              <div>
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block mb-1">
                  Description
                </span>
                <p className="text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap bg-muted/30 rounded-md p-3">
                  {selectedReport.description}
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Screenshot */}
              {selectedReport.screenshotUrl && (
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block mb-1">
                    Screenshot
                  </span>
                  {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                  <img
                    src={selectedReport.screenshotUrl}
                    alt="Feedback screenshot"
                    className="w-full rounded-md border border-border"
                  />
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Developer Comments (admin editable) */}
              {isAdmin && (
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground block mb-1">
                    Developer Comments
                  </span>
                  <textarea
                    value={notesText}
                    onChange={(e) => setNotesText(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Add developer comments or notes about this issue..."
                    rows={3}
                    className="w-full rounded-md border border-border bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand/50 resize-none"
                  />
                  <div className="flex justify-end mt-2">
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={() => {
                        statusMutation.mutate({
                          id: selectedReport.id,
                          adminNotes: notesText,
                        });
                      }}
                      disabled={statusMutation.isPending}
                      className="bg-brand text-black hover:bg-brand/90"
                    >
                      Save Comments
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Read-only developer comments for non-admins */}
              {!isAdmin && selectedReport.adminNotes && (
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground block mb-1">
                    Developer Comments
                  </span>
                  <p className="text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap bg-muted/30 rounded-md p-3">
                    {selectedReport.adminNotes}
                  </p>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/app/admin/repo/page.tsx

"use client";

import { useMemo } from "react";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import {
  GitBranch,
  Loader2,
  RefreshCw,
  XCircle,
  Cloud,
  ArrowUp,
  ArrowDown,
  CheckCircle2,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

// ── Types ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface GitBranchData {
  name: string;
  shortHash: string;
  date: string;
  author: string;
  subject: string;
  isMain: boolean;
  isCurrent: boolean;
  hasRemote: boolean;
  aheadBehind: { ahead: number; behind: number } | null;
}

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function relativeTime(dateStr: string | null): string {
  if (!dateStr) return "never";
  const d = new Date(dateStr);
  const now = new Date();
  const diffMs = now.getTime() - d.getTime();
  const diffMin = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000);
  const diffHr = Math.floor(diffMin / 60);
  const diffDay = Math.floor(diffHr / 24);

  if (diffMin < 1) return "just now";
  if (diffMin < 60) return `${diffMin}m ago`;
  if (diffHr < 24) return `${diffHr}h ago`;
  if (diffDay < 7) return `${diffDay}d ago`;
  return d.toLocaleDateString();
}

// ── Branch colors ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const BRANCH_COLORS = [
  "#4A90D9", // blue (main)
  "#E8A700", // brand gold
  "#8B5CF6", // violet
  "#10B981", // emerald
  "#F59E0B", // amber
  "#EF4444", // red
  "#06B6D4", // cyan
  "#EC4899", // pink
];

// ── Branch Diagram (SVG) ──────────────────────────────────────────────

function BranchDiagram({ branches }: { branches: GitBranchData[] }) {
  const layout = useMemo(() => {
    if (!branches.length) return null;

    const mainBranch = branches.find((b) => b.isMain);
    const featureBranches = branches.filter((b) => !b.isMain);

    // Layout constants — smaller dots, more spacing for info
    const nodeR = 7;
    const rowH = 68;
    const colW = 180;
    const padTop = 44;
    const padLeft = 240; // room for left-side labels
    const mainX = padLeft + colW;

    type Row = {
      branch: GitBranchData;
      x: number;
      y: number;
      color: string;
      forkFromY: number;
      side: "left" | "right" | "center";
    };

    const rows: Row[] = [];

    // Main at top
    if (mainBranch) {
      rows.push({
        branch: mainBranch,
        x: mainX,
        y: padTop,
        color: BRANCH_COLORS[0],
        forkFromY: padTop,
        side: "center",
      });
    }

    // Alternate left/right
    const left: GitBranchData[] = [];
    const right: GitBranchData[] = [];
    featureBranches.forEach((b, i) => (i % 2 === 0 ? left : right).push(b));

    const maxSide = Math.max(left.length, right.length);
    let y = padTop + rowH;

    for (let i = 0; i < maxSide; i++) {
      if (left[i]) {
        rows.push({
          branch: left[i],
          x: mainX - colW,
          y,
          color: BRANCH_COLORS[((i * 2) % (BRANCH_COLORS.length - 1)) + 1],
          forkFromY: y,
          side: "left",
        });
      }
      if (right[i]) {
        rows.push({
          branch: right[i],
          x: mainX + colW,
          y,
          color: BRANCH_COLORS[((i * 2 + 1) % (BRANCH_COLORS.length - 1)) + 1],
          forkFromY: y,
          side: "right",
        });
      }
      y += rowH;
    }

    const bottomY = y;
    const svgW = mainX + colW + padLeft + 200;
    const svgH = bottomY + 30;

    return { rows, mainX, padTop, bottomY, svgW, svgH, nodeR };
  }, [branches]);

  if (!layout) return null;

  return (
    <div className="overflow-x-auto">
      <svg
        width={layout.svgW}
        height={layout.svgH}
        viewBox={`0 0 ${layout.svgW} ${layout.svgH}`}
        className="mx-auto"
      >
        {/* Main trunk */}
        <line
          x1={layout.mainX}
          y1={layout.padTop - 16}
          x2={layout.mainX}
          y2={layout.bottomY}
          stroke="var(--muted-foreground)"
          strokeWidth={2}
          opacity={0.15}
        />

        {layout.rows.map((row) => {
          const isMain = row.branch.isMain;
          const isCurrent = row.branch.isCurrent;
          const ab = row.branch.aheadBehind;
          const R = layout.nodeR;

          // Text anchor positions
          const labelX =
            row.side === "center"
              ? row.x
              : row.side === "left"
                ? row.x - R - 10
                : row.x + R + 10;
          const anchor =
            row.side === "center"
              ? "middle"
              : row.side === "left"
                ? "end"
                : "start";

          return (
            <g key={row.branch.name}>
              {/* Fork curve */}
              {!isMain && (
                <path
                  d={`M ${layout.mainX} ${row.forkFromY} C ${layout.mainX} ${row.forkFromY + 22}, ${row.x} ${row.y - 22}, ${row.x} ${row.y}`}
                  fill="none"
                  stroke={row.color}
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  opacity={0.6}
                />
              )}

              {/* Stub lines */}
              {!isMain && (
                <line
                  x1={row.x}
                  y1={row.y - 12}
                  x2={row.x}
                  y2={row.y + 12}
                  stroke="var(--muted-foreground)"
                  strokeWidth={1.5}
                  opacity={0.1}
                />
              )}

              {/* Node */}
              <circle
                cx={row.x}
                cy={row.y}
                r={R}
                fill={row.color}
                stroke={isCurrent ? "var(--foreground)" : row.color}
                strokeWidth={isCurrent ? 2.5 : 1.5}
                opacity={0.9}
              />

              {/* Current indicator ring */}
              {isCurrent && (
                <circle
                  cx={row.x}
                  cy={row.y}
                  r={R + 4}
                  fill="none"
                  stroke={row.color}
                  strokeWidth={1}
                  opacity={0.35}
                  strokeDasharray="3 2"
                />
              )}

              {/* Branch name */}
              <text
                x={labelX}
                y={row.y - 14}
                textAnchor={anchor}
                className="text-[11px] font-bold fill-foreground"
                style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-geist-sans)" }}
              >
                {row.branch.name.replace("1o8-Marketplace/", "")}
              </text>

              {/* Commit subject (truncated) */}
              <text
                x={labelX}
                y={row.y + 2}
                textAnchor={anchor}
                className="text-[9px] fill-foreground"
                opacity={0.7}
                style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-geist-sans)" }}
              >
                {row.branch.subject.length > 40
                  ? row.branch.subject.slice(0, 40) + "..."
                  : row.branch.subject}
              </text>

              {/* Hash · author · time */}
              <text
                x={labelX}
                y={row.y + 14}
                textAnchor={anchor}
                className="text-[9px] fill-foreground"
                opacity={0.5}
                style={{ fontFamily: "var(--font-geist-mono, monospace)" }}
              >
                {row.branch.shortHash} · {row.branch.author} · {relativeTime(row.branch.date)}
              </text>

              {/* Ahead/behind badges */}
              {ab && (ab.ahead > 0 || ab.behind > 0) && (
                <g
                  transform={`translate(${
                    row.side === "left"
                      ? row.x - R - 10
                      : row.side === "right"
                        ? row.x + R + 10
                        : row.x + R + 8
                  }, ${row.y + 24})`}
                >
                  {ab.ahead > 0 && (
                    <>
                      <rect
                        x={row.side === "left" ? -38 : 0}
                        y={-7}
                        width={34}
                        height={14}
                        rx={4}
                        fill="#10B981"
                        opacity={0.15}
                      />
                      <text
                        x={row.side === "left" ? -21 : 17}
                        y={4}
                        textAnchor="middle"
                        className="text-[8px] font-bold"
                        fill="#10B981"
                      >
                        +{ab.ahead}
                      </text>
                    </>
                  )}
                  {ab.behind > 0 && (
                    <>
                      <rect
                        x={row.side === "left" ? -76 : ab.ahead > 0 ? 38 : 0}
                        y={-7}
                        width={34}
                        height={14}
                        rx={4}
                        fill="#EF4444"
                        opacity={0.15}
                      />
                      <text
                        x={
                          row.side === "left"
                            ? -59
                            : ab.ahead > 0
                              ? 55
                              : 17
                        }
                        y={4}
                        textAnchor="middle"
                        className="text-[8px] font-bold"
                        fill="#EF4444"
                      >
                        -{ab.behind}
                      </text>
                    </>
                  )}
                </g>
              )}

              {/* Remote dot */}
              {row.branch.hasRemote && (
                <circle
                  cx={row.x + R - 1}
                  cy={row.y - R + 1}
                  r={2.5}
                  fill="#10B981"
                  stroke="var(--card)"
                  strokeWidth={1}
                />
              )}
            </g>
          );
        })}

        {/* Legend */}
        <g transform={`translate(12, ${layout.bottomY - 6})`}>
          <circle cx={5} cy={0} r={3} fill={BRANCH_COLORS[0]} opacity={0.7} />
          <text x={13} y={3} className="text-[9px] fill-foreground" opacity={0.5}>
            main
          </text>
          <circle
            cx={46}
            cy={0}
            r={3}
            fill="none"
            stroke="var(--foreground)"
            strokeWidth={1}
            strokeDasharray="2 1.5"
            opacity={0.35}
          />
          <text x={54} y={3} className="text-[9px] fill-foreground" opacity={0.5}>
            current
          </text>
          <circle cx={96} cy={0} r={2} fill="#10B981" opacity={0.7} />
          <text x={103} y={3} className="text-[9px] fill-foreground" opacity={0.5}>
            remote
          </text>
        </g>
      </svg>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Branch Table (summary view) ───────────────────────────────────────

function BranchTable({ branches }: { branches: GitBranchData[] }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/40 bg-card overflow-hidden">
      <table className="w-full text-sm">
        <thead>
          <tr className="border-b border-border/20 bg-muted/20">
            <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left font-medium text-muted-foreground">Branch</th>
            <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left font-medium text-muted-foreground">Last Commit</th>
            <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left font-medium text-muted-foreground">Author</th>
            <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left font-medium text-muted-foreground">Age</th>
            <th className="px-3 py-2 text-center font-medium text-muted-foreground">Remote</th>
            <th className="px-3 py-2 text-center font-medium text-muted-foreground">Status</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {branches.map((b) => (
            <tr
              key={b.name}
              className={`border-b border-border/10 hover:bg-muted/10 ${
                b.isCurrent ? "bg-brand/5" : ""
              }`}
            >
              <td className="px-4 py-2">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span
                    className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full shrink-0"
                    style={{
                      backgroundColor: b.isMain
                        ? BRANCH_COLORS[0]
                        : BRANCH_COLORS[
                            (Math.abs(
                              b.name.split("").reduce((a, c) => a + c.charCodeAt(0), 0)
                            ) %
                              (BRANCH_COLORS.length - 1)) +
                              1
                          ],
                    }}
                  />
                  <span className="font-mono text-xs text-foreground">
                    {b.name.replace("1o8-Marketplace/", "")}
                  </span>
                  {b.isCurrent && (
                    <span className="text-[8px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-brand px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-brand/10">
                      HEAD
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {b.isMain && (
                    <span className="text-[8px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-500 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/10">
                      default
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </td>
              <td className="px-3 py-2">
                <div className="text-xs text-foreground/80 max-w-[300px] truncate">
                  {b.subject}
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-mono">{b.shortHash}</div>
              </td>
              <td className="px-3 py-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{b.author}</td>
              <td className="px-3 py-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                {relativeTime(b.date)}
              </td>
              <td className="px-3 py-2 text-center">
                {b.hasRemote ? (
                  <Cloud className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-500 mx-auto" />
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/40">local</span>
                )}
              </td>
              <td className="px-3 py-2">
                {b.aheadBehind ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-[10px] tabular-nums">
                    {b.aheadBehind.ahead > 0 && (
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-emerald-500">
                        <ArrowUp className="h-3 w-3" />
                        {b.aheadBehind.ahead}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {b.aheadBehind.behind > 0 && (
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-red-400">
                        <ArrowDown className="h-3 w-3" />
                        {b.aheadBehind.behind}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {b.aheadBehind.ahead === 0 && b.aheadBehind.behind === 0 && (
                      <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-400 mx-auto" />
                    )}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/40 block text-center">—</span>
                )}
              </td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Main page ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function RepoPage() {
  const { data, isLoading, error, refetch, isFetching } = useQuery<{
    branches: GitBranchData[];
    currentBranch: string;
  }>({
    queryKey: ["git-branches"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/git-branches");
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load");
      return res.json();
    },
    refetchInterval: 60_000,
  });

  const branches = data?.branches ?? [];
  const mainBranch = branches.find((b) => b.isMain);
  const featureBranches = branches.filter((b) => !b.isMain);
  const withRemote = branches.filter((b) => b.hasRemote).length;
  const localOnly = branches.filter((b) => !b.hasRemote).length;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10 py-4 mb-2 bg-background flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter mb-2">
            <span className="text-foreground font-bold">App</span>
            <span className="text-brand">Repo</span>
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Git branch visualization and repository status.
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => refetch()}
          disabled={isFetching}
          className="border-border/60 hover:border-brand/30 hover:shadow-[0_0_12px_-4px_var(--brand-glow)] mt-2 sm:mt-0"
        >
          {isFetching ? (
            <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
          ) : (
            <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />
          )}
          <span className="ml-1.5">Refresh</span>
        </Button>
      </div>

      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 gap-3">
          <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-brand" />
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Loading repository data...</p>
        </div>
      ) : error ? (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-red-500/25 bg-red-500/5 px-5 py-4 text-sm text-red-500 dark:text-red-400 flex items-center gap-3">
          <XCircle className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />
          Failed to load repository data
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {/* Summary stats */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card px-4 py-3.5 space-y-1.5 card-glow">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <GitBranch className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-[0.08em]">
                  Total Branches
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums text-foreground">{branches.length}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card px-4 py-3.5 space-y-1.5 card-glow">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <GitBranch className="h-4 w-4 text-brand" />
                <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-[0.08em]">
                  Current
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-lg font-bold text-brand font-mono truncate">
                {data?.currentBranch?.replace("1o8-Marketplace/", "") ?? "—"}
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card px-4 py-3.5 space-y-1.5 card-glow">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Cloud className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-500" />
                <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-[0.08em]">
                  Remote
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums text-foreground">
                {withRemote}
                <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground font-normal ml-1">
                  / {localOnly} local
                </span>
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card px-4 py-3.5 space-y-1.5 card-glow">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <GitBranch className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-[0.08em]">
                  Feature
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums text-foreground">
                {featureBranches.length}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Branch Diagram */}
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card/50 p-5 card-glow">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 mb-4">
              <GitBranch className="h-4 w-4 text-brand" />
              <h2 className="text-sm font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] text-foreground">
                Branch Graph
              </h2>
            </div>
            <BranchDiagram branches={branches} />

          {/* Branch Table */}

              All Branches
