FILE: src/app/admin/sync/page.tsx
================================================
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useSession } from "next-auth/react";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import {
  RefreshCw,
  Loader2,
  CheckCircle,
  XCircle,
  Database,
  Cloud,
  Clock,
  ArrowRightLeft,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

interface SyncTableResult {
  table: string;
  inserted: number;
  updated: number;
  skipped: number;
  errors: string[];
  durationMs: number;
}

interface SyncResult {
  success: boolean;
  tables: SyncTableResult[];
  totalDurationMs: number;
  triggeredBy: string;
}

interface SyncLogEntry {
  action: string;
  status: string;
  message: string;
  detail: { results: SyncTableResult[] } | null;
  durationMs: number | null;
  createdAt: string;
  userName: string | null;
}

const TABLE_CONFIG = [
  {
    id: "aac_clients",
    label: "AAC Clients",
    description: "Client metadata, Power BI URLs, team assignments",
    bqSource: "1o8BibleApp.AAC",
    direction: "BQ → Supabase",
  },
  {
    id: "column_attributes",
    label: "Attributes",
    description: "Column registry with 972 product attributes",
    bqSource: "1o8BibleApp.Attributes",
    direction: "BQ → Supabase",
  },
];

export default function SyncPage() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [selectedTables, setSelectedTables] = useState<string[]>([]);

  // Fetch recent sync logs
  const { data: logs, isLoading: logsLoading } = useQuery<SyncLogEntry[]>({
    queryKey: ["sync-logs"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/logs?section=sync&pageSize=10");
      if (!res.ok) return [];
      const data = await res.json();
      return data.data || [];
    },
    refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
  });

  // Sync mutation
  const syncMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (tables?: string[]) => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/sync", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ tables: tables?.length ? tables : undefined }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Sync failed");
      }
      return res.json() as Promise<SyncResult>;
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["sync-logs"] });
    },
  });

  if (session?.user?.role !== "admin") {
    return (
      <div className="p-8 text-center text-muted-foreground">
        Admin access required.
      </div>
    );
  }

  const toggleTable = (id: string) => {
    setSelectedTables((prev) =>
      prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((t) => t !== id) : [...prev, id]
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10 py-4 mb-2 bg-background flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between gap-4 animate-card-enter">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter mb-2">
            <span className="text-foreground font-bold">Data</span>
            <span className="text-brand">Sync</span>
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            BigQuery ↔ Supabase table synchronization
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => syncMutation.mutate(selectedTables.length ? selectedTables : undefined)}
          disabled={syncMutation.isPending}
          className="border-border/60 hover:border-brand/30 hover:shadow-[0_0_12px_-4px_var(--brand-glow)] mt-2 sm:mt-0"
        >
          {syncMutation.isPending ? (
            <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
          ) : (
            <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />
          )}
          <span className="ml-1.5">
            {syncMutation.isPending
              ? "Syncing..."
              : selectedTables.length
                ? `Sync ${selectedTables.length} table${selectedTables.length > 1 ? "s" : ""}`
                : "Sync All"}
          </span>
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Sync result banner */}
      {syncMutation.data && (
        <div
          className={`rounded-xl border px-5 py-4 flex items-start gap-4 animate-card-enter ${
            syncMutation.data.tables.every((t) => t.errors.length === 0)
              ? "border-emerald-500/25 bg-emerald-500/5"
              : "border-amber-500/25 bg-amber-500/5"
          }`}
        >
          <CheckCircle className="h-5 w-5 text-emerald-500 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <div className="flex-1 space-y-2">
            <p className="font-semibold text-foreground text-sm">
              Sync complete in {(syncMutation.data.totalDurationMs / 1000).toFixed(1)}s
            </p>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              {syncMutation.data.tables.map((t) => (
                <div
                  key={t.table}
                  className="rounded-lg border border-border/40 px-3 py-2 bg-card/50"
                >
                  <p className="font-mono text-xs text-foreground font-semibold">
                    {t.table}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                    {t.inserted} inserted, {t.updated} updated, {t.skipped} skipped
                    {t.errors.length > 0 && (
                      <span className="text-red-500 ml-1">
                        ({t.errors.length} errors)
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/60 mt-0.5">
                    {(t.durationMs / 1000).toFixed(1)}s
                  </p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {syncMutation.isError && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-red-500/25 bg-red-500/5 px-5 py-4 text-sm text-red-500 flex items-center gap-3">
          <XCircle className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0" />
          {syncMutation.error?.message || "Sync failed"}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Table cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        {TABLE_CONFIG.map((table, i) => {
          const isSelected = selectedTables.includes(table.id);
          return (
            <button
              key={table.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => toggleTable(table.id)}
              className={`rounded-xl border px-5 py-4 text-left transition-all cursor-pointer animate-card-enter ${
                isSelected
                  ? "border-brand/40 bg-brand/5 shadow-[0_0_12px_-4px_var(--brand-glow)]"
                  : "border-border/60 bg-card hover:border-border"
              }`}
              style={{ animationDelay: `${i * 60}ms` }}
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Cloud className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-500" />
                  <ArrowRightLeft className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground" />
                  <Database className="h-4 w-4 text-violet-500" />
                </div>
                <span className="font-semibold text-sm text-foreground">
                  {table.label}
                </span>
                {isSelected && (
                  <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-brand ml-auto" />
                )}
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                {table.description}
              </p>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-2 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/60">
                <span className="font-mono">{table.bqSource}</span>
                <span>{table.direction}</span>
              </div>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Cron info */}
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card/50 px-5 py-4 flex items-center gap-4 animate-card-enter" style={{ animationDelay: "120ms" }}>
        <Clock className="h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
        <div>
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">
            Automatic sync every 6 hours
          </p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
            Cron runs at 0:00, 6:00, 12:00, 18:00 UTC via Vercel. Products sync separately via dirty-flag publish (hourly).
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Recent sync history */}
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 overflow-hidden animate-card-enter" style={{ animationDelay: "180ms" }}>
        <div className="px-5 py-3.5 bg-card flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-border/40">
          <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          <span className="font-semibold text-sm text-foreground">
            Recent Sync History
          </span>
        </div>
        {logsLoading ? (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-8">
            <Loader2 className="h-5 w-5 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
          </div>
        ) : !logs || logs.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="px-5 py-6 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            No sync history yet. Run a sync to get started.
          </div>
        ) : (
          <table className="w-full text-sm">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-muted/30">
                <th className="text-left font-medium text-muted-foreground px-5 py-2 text-xs">
                  When
                </th>
                <th className="text-left font-medium text-muted-foreground px-5 py-2 text-xs">
                  Triggered By
                </th>
                <th className="text-left font-medium text-muted-foreground px-5 py-2 text-xs">
                  Status
                </th>
                <th className="text-left font-medium text-muted-foreground px-5 py-2 text-xs">
                  Result
                </th>
                <th className="text-right font-medium text-muted-foreground px-5 py-2 text-xs">
                  Duration
                </th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-border/40">
              {logs.map((log, i) => (
                <tr key={i} className="hover:bg-accent/20 transition-colors">
                  <td className="px-5 py-2.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground whitespace-nowrap">
                    {new Date(log.createdAt).toLocaleString()}
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-5 py-2.5 text-xs font-mono text-foreground">
                    {log.userName || "system"}
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-5 py-2.5">
                    <span
                      className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold ${
                        log.status === "success"
                          ? "bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-500"
                          : "bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-500"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {log.status === "success" ? (
                        <CheckCircle className="h-3 w-3" />
                      ) : (
                        <XCircle className="h-3 w-3" />
                      )}
                      {log.status}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-5 py-2.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {log.message}
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-5 py-2.5 text-right text-xs font-mono text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                    {log.durationMs ? `${(log.durationMs / 1000).toFixed(1)}s` : "—"}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

} from "lucide-react";

  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,

} from "@/components/ui/dialog";

  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/tooltip";
import { CONFIGURABLE_SECTIONS } from "@/lib/permissions";


const ROLE_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  admin: "bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-500 border-amber-500/25",
  editor: "bg-blue-500/15 text-blue-500 border-blue-500/25",
  viewer: "bg-zinc-500/15 text-zinc-400 border-zinc-500/25",
  client: "bg-purple-500/15 text-purple-500 border-purple-500/25",
  pending: "bg-orange-500/15 text-orange-500 border-orange-500/25",
  prospect: "bg-teal-500/15 text-teal-500 border-teal-500/25",
};

const ALL_ROLES = ["pending", "viewer", "editor", "admin", "client", "prospect"] as const;

const INTERNAL_TEAMS = [
  { value: "1o8-agency", label: "1o8 Agency", activeClass: "border-brand/40 bg-brand/10 text-brand" },
  { value: "1o8-marketplace", label: "1o8 Marketplace", activeClass: "border-blue-500/40 bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400" },
  { value: "external", label: "External", activeClass: "border-zinc-500/40 bg-zinc-500/10 text-zinc-300" },
] as const;

const SECTION_ICONS: Record<string, LucideIcon> = {
  seo: Search,
  design: Palette,
  ppc: TrendingUp,
  catalog: Package,
  finances: DollarSign,
  clients: UsersIcon,
  calendar: CalendarDays,
  activity: Activity,
  import: Download,
  publish: Upload,
  export: FileSpreadsheet,
  sales: DollarSign,
  reports: BarChart3,
  aplus: LayoutTemplate,
  files: Cloud,
  sync: GitCompareArrows,
  products: ShoppingBag,
};

type User = {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  name: string | null;
  image: string | null;
  role: "viewer" | "editor" | "admin" | "client" | "pending" | "prospect";
  allowedSections: string[];
  clientIdCode: string | null;
  lastLoginAt: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
};

function EditableName({ user, isSelf, onSave }: { user: User; isSelf: boolean; onSave: (name: string | null) => void }) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [value, setValue] = useState(user.name ?? "");
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (editing && inputRef.current) {
      inputRef.current.focus();
      inputRef.current.select();
    }
  }, [editing]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setValue(user.name ?? "");
  }, [user.name]);

  function commit() {
    const trimmed = value.trim();
    const newName = trimmed || null;
    if (newName !== (user.name ?? null)) {
      onSave(newName);
    }
    setEditing(false);
  }

  if (editing) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          value={value}
          onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}
          onBlur={commit}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === "Enter") commit();
            if (e.key === "Escape") { setValue(user.name ?? ""); setEditing(false); }
          }}
          className="w-32 rounded border border-border bg-background px-2 py-0.5 text-sm font-medium focus:border-brand focus:outline-none"
          placeholder="Name..."
        />
        <button type="button" onClick={commit} className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">
          <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <span className="group flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium">
      {user.name ?? "—"}
      {isSelf && (
        <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">You</Badge>
      )}
      {!isSelf && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setEditing(true)}
          className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
        >
          <Pencil className="h-3 w-3" />
        </button>
      )}
    </span>
  );
}

export default function UsersPage() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const { data: allUsers, isLoading } = useQuery<User[]>({
    queryKey: ["admin-users"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/users");
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch users");
      return res.json();
    },
  });

  const users = allUsers;

  const [clientDropdownUserId, setClientDropdownUserId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dropdownPos, setDropdownPos] = useState<{ top: number; left: number }>({ top: 0, left: 0 });
  const openDropdown = useCallback((userId: string, buttonEl: HTMLButtonElement) => {
    const rect = buttonEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    setDropdownPos({ top: rect.bottom + 4, left: rect.left });
    setClientDropdownUserId(userId);
  }, []);

  const { data: clients } = useQuery<{ clientIdCode: string; clientName: string }[]>({
    queryKey: ["clients-list"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/clients/list");
      if (!res.ok) return [];
      return res.json();
    },
  });

  const clientMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({ userId, clientIdCode }: { userId: string; clientIdCode: string | null }) => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/users", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ userId, clientIdCode }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Failed to update client");
      }
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["admin-users"] });
      toast.success("Client assignment updated");
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => toast.error(error.message),
  });

  function parseClientCodes(val: string | null): string[] {
    if (!val) return [];
    return val.split(",").map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  }

  function toggleClientCode(userId: string, currentVal: string | null, code: string) {
    const codes = parseClientCodes(currentVal);
    const next = codes.includes(code)
      ? codes.filter((c) => c !== code)
      : [...codes, code];
    clientMutation.mutate({
      userId,
      clientIdCode: next.length > 0 ? next.join(",") : null,
    });
  }

  // Keep a stable order: sort by initial role on first load, then freeze positions
  const orderRef = useRef<string[]>([]);
  if (users && orderRef.current.length === 0) {
    const roleOrder: Record<string, number> = { pending: 0, admin: 1, editor: 2, viewer: 3, client: 4, prospect: 5 };
    orderRef.current = [...users]
      .sort((a, b) => (roleOrder[a.role] ?? 99) - (roleOrder[b.role] ?? 99))
      .map((u) => u.id);
  }

  const roleMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({ userId, role }: { userId: string; role: string }) => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/users", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ userId, role }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Failed to update role");
      }
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["admin-users"] });
      toast.success("Role updated");
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => {
      toast.error(error.message);
    },
  });

  const sectionMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      userId,
      allowedSections,
    }: {
      userId: string;
      allowedSections: string[];
    }) => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/users", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ userId, allowedSections }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Failed to update sections");
      }
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["admin-users"] });
      toast.success("Section access updated");
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => {
      toast.error(error.message);
    },
  });

  const deleteMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (userId: string) => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/users", {
        method: "DELETE",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ userId }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Failed to remove user");
      }
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["admin-users"] });
      toast.success("User removed");
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => {
      toast.error(error.message);
    },
  });

  const nameMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({ userId, name }: { userId: string; name: string | null }) => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/users", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ userId, name }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Failed to update name");
      }
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["admin-users"] });
      toast.success("Name updated");
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => toast.error(error.message),
  });

  // ── Add User ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [addOpen, setAddOpen] = useState(false);
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState("");
  const [newEmail, setNewEmail] = useState("");
  const [newRole, setNewRole] = useState<typeof ALL_ROLES[number]>("viewer");
  const [newSections, setNewSections] = useState<string[]>([]);

  const addMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/users", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          email: newEmail.trim(),
          name: newName.trim() || undefined,
          role: newRole,
          allowedSections: newSections,
        }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Failed to add user");
      }
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["admin-users"] });
      toast.success("User added");
      setAddOpen(false);
      setNewName("");
      setNewEmail("");
      setNewRole("viewer");
      setNewSections([]);
      orderRef.current = []; // reset sort order
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => toast.error(error.message),
  });

  function toggleSection(user: User, sectionId: string) {
    const current = user.allowedSections ?? [];
    const next = current.includes(sectionId)
      ? current.filter((s) => s !== sectionId)
      : [...current, sectionId];
    sectionMutation.mutate({ userId: user.id, allowedSections: next });
  }

  // ── Bulk Selection ──────────────────────────────────────────
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const toggleSelect = (id: string) =>
    setSelectedIds((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      next.has(id) ? next.delete(id) : next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  const selectableUsers = (users ?? []).filter((u) => u.id !== session?.user?.id);
  const allSelected = selectableUsers.length > 0 && selectableUsers.every((u) => selectedIds.has(u.id));
  const toggleAll = () =>
    setSelectedIds(allSelected ? new Set() : new Set(selectableUsers.map((u) => u.id)));

  const bulkMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (updates: { userId: string; role?: string; allowedSections?: string[]; clientIdCode?: string | null }[]) => {
      const results = await Promise.allSettled(
        updates.map((u) =>
          fetch("/api/admin/users", {
            method: "PUT",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify(u),
          }).then((res) => {
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed");
          })
        )
      );
      const failed = results.filter((r) => r.status === "rejected").length;
      if (failed > 0) throw new Error(`${failed} update(s) failed`);
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["admin-users"] });
      toast.success(`Updated ${selectedIds.size} user(s)`);
      setSelectedIds(new Set());
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => toast.error(error.message),
  });

  function bulkSetRole(role: string) {
    bulkMutation.mutate([...selectedIds].map((userId) => ({ userId, role })));
  }
  function bulkSetTeam(clientIdCode: string | null) {
    bulkMutation.mutate([...selectedIds].map((userId) => ({ userId, clientIdCode })));
  }
  function bulkSetSections(sectionIds: string[]) {
    bulkMutation.mutate([...selectedIds].map((userId) => ({ userId, allowedSections: sectionIds })));
  }

  // ── Bulk action bar state ──────────────────────────────────
  const [bulkRoleOpen, setBulkRoleOpen] = useState(false);
  const [bulkTeamOpen, setBulkTeamOpen] = useState(false);
  const [bulkSectionsOpen, setBulkSectionsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [bulkSectionsPick, setBulkSectionsPick] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [headerHeight, setHeaderHeight] = useState(110);

  return (
    <div>
      <div ref={(el) => { if (el) { const h = el.offsetHeight; if (h !== headerHeight) setHeaderHeight(h); } }} className="sticky top-0 z-30 -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10 py-4 bg-background">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter mb-2"><span className="text-foreground font-bold">User</span><span className="text-brand">Management</span></h1>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Manage internal and client user access, roles, and section permissions.
            </p>
          </div>
          <Dialog open={addOpen} onOpenChange={setAddOpen}>
            <DialogTrigger asChild>
              <Button size="sm" className="text-xs gap-1.5">
                <UserPlus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Add User
              </Button>
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent className="max-w-md">
              <DialogHeader>
                <DialogTitle>Add User</DialogTitle>
              </DialogHeader>
              <div className="space-y-4 pt-2">
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <label className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Name</label>
                  <input
                    value={newName}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewName(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="John Doe"
                    className="w-full rounded-md border border-border bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:border-brand focus:outline-none"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <label className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Email *</label>
                  <input
                    value={newEmail}
                    onChange={(e) => setNewEmail(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="user@1o8.agency"
                    type="email"
                    className="w-full rounded-md border border-border bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:border-brand focus:outline-none"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <label className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Role</label>
                  <div className="flex gap-2">
                    {ALL_ROLES.map((r) => (
                      <button
                        key={r}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setNewRole(r)}
                        className={`rounded-md border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
                          newRole === r
                            ? ROLE_COLORS[r] + " border-current"
                            : "border-border text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted/50"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {r}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <label className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">Sections</label>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() =>
                        setNewSections((prev) =>
                          prev.length === CONFIGURABLE_SECTIONS.length
                            ? []
                            : CONFIGURABLE_SECTIONS.map((s) => s.id)
                        )
                      }
                      className="text-[10px] text-brand hover:underline"
                    >
                      {newSections.length === CONFIGURABLE_SECTIONS.length ? "Deselect all" : "Select all"}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                    {CONFIGURABLE_SECTIONS.map((s) => {
                      const Icon = SECTION_ICONS[s.id];
                      const checked = newSections.includes(s.id);
                      return (
                        <button
                          key={s.id}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() =>
                            setNewSections((prev) =>
                              checked ? prev.filter((x) => x !== s.id) : [...prev, s.id]
                            )
                          }
                          className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded border px-2 py-1.5 text-xs transition-colors ${
                            checked
                              ? "border-brand/40 bg-brand/10 text-brand"
                              : "border-border text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted/50"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {Icon && <Icon className="h-3 w-3" />}
                          {s.label}
                        </button>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
                  <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setAddOpen(false)}>
                    Cancel
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    disabled={!newEmail.trim() || addMutation.isPending}
                    onClick={() => addMutation.mutate()}
                  >
                    {addMutation.isPending ? "Adding..." : "Add User"}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </DialogContent>
          </Dialog>
        </div>

      </div>

      {selectedIds.size > 0 && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-md border border-brand/30 bg-brand/5 px-4 py-2">
          <span className="text-sm font-medium">{selectedIds.size} selected</span>
          <div className="h-4 w-px bg-border" />

          {/* Bulk Role */}
          <div className="relative">
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="text-xs h-7 gap-1" onClick={() => { setBulkRoleOpen(!bulkRoleOpen); setBulkTeamOpen(false); setBulkSectionsOpen(false); }}>
              Set Role <ChevronDown className="h-3 w-3" />
            </Button>
            {bulkRoleOpen && (
              <>
                <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[48]" onClick={() => setBulkRoleOpen(false)} />
                <div className="absolute top-full left-0 mt-1 z-[49] w-40 rounded-md border border-border bg-background shadow-lg">
                  {ALL_ROLES.map((r) => (
                    <button key={r} type="button" onClick={() => { bulkSetRole(r); setBulkRoleOpen(false); }} className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs hover:bg-muted/50">
                      <Badge variant="outline" className={`${ROLE_COLORS[r]} text-[10px]`}>{r}</Badge>
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Bulk Team */}
          <div className="relative">
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="text-xs h-7 gap-1" onClick={() => { setBulkTeamOpen(!bulkTeamOpen); setBulkRoleOpen(false); setBulkSectionsOpen(false); }}>
              Set Team <ChevronDown className="h-3 w-3" />
            </Button>
            {bulkTeamOpen && (
              <>
                <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[48]" onClick={() => setBulkTeamOpen(false)} />
                <div className="absolute top-full left-0 mt-1 z-[49] w-44 rounded-md border border-border bg-background shadow-lg">
                  <button type="button" onClick={() => { bulkSetTeam(null); setBulkTeamOpen(false); }} className="flex w-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted/50">None</button>
                  {INTERNAL_TEAMS.map((t) => (
                    <button key={t.value} type="button" onClick={() => { bulkSetTeam(t.value); setBulkTeamOpen(false); }} className="flex w-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs hover:bg-muted/50">{t.label}</button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Bulk Sections */}
          <div className="relative">
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="text-xs h-7 gap-1" onClick={() => {
              setBulkSectionsOpen(!bulkSectionsOpen);
              setBulkRoleOpen(false);
              setBulkTeamOpen(false);
              if (!bulkSectionsOpen) setBulkSectionsPick([]);
            }}>
              Set Sections <ChevronDown className="h-3 w-3" />
            </Button>
            {bulkSectionsOpen && (
              <>
                <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[48]" onClick={() => setBulkSectionsOpen(false)} />
                <div className="absolute top-full left-0 mt-1 z-[49] w-52 rounded-md border border-border bg-background shadow-lg p-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-medium">Pick sections</span>
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => setBulkSectionsPick((p) => p.length === CONFIGURABLE_SECTIONS.length ? [] : CONFIGURABLE_SECTIONS.map((s) => s.id))} className="text-[10px] text-brand hover:underline">
                      {bulkSectionsPick.length === CONFIGURABLE_SECTIONS.length ? "None" : "All"}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                  {CONFIGURABLE_SECTIONS.map((s) => {
                    const Icon = SECTION_ICONS[s.id];
                    const checked = bulkSectionsPick.includes(s.id);
                    return (
                      <button key={s.id} type="button" onClick={() => setBulkSectionsPick((p) => checked ? p.filter((x) => x !== s.id) : [...p, s.id])} className={`flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded px-2 py-1 text-xs hover:bg-muted/50 ${checked ? "text-brand" : "text-muted-foreground"}`}>
                        <Checkbox checked={checked} className="h-3 w-3" tabIndex={-1} />
                        {Icon && <Icon className="h-3 w-3" />}
                        {s.label}
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                  <Button size="sm" className="w-full mt-2 h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => { bulkSetSections(bulkSectionsPick); setBulkSectionsOpen(false); }}>
                    Apply to {selectedIds.size} user(s)
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="ml-auto">
            <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="text-xs h-7 text-muted-foreground" onClick={() => setSelectedIds(new Set())}>
              Clear
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {isLoading ? (
        <Skeleton className="h-[300px] w-full" />
      ) : (
        <TooltipProvider delayDuration={200}>
        <div className="rounded-md border relative">
          <table className="w-full caption-bottom text-sm">
            <thead className="sticky z-20 bg-background [&_tr]:border-b" style={{ top: headerHeight }}>
              <tr className="border-b transition-colors">
                <th className="text-foreground/80 h-10 px-2 text-left align-middle font-medium whitespace-nowrap w-10"><Checkbox checked={allSelected} onCheckedChange={toggleAll} /></th>
                <th className="text-foreground/80 h-10 px-2 text-left align-middle font-medium whitespace-nowrap">User</th>
                <th className="text-foreground/80 h-10 px-2 text-left align-middle font-medium whitespace-nowrap">Email</th>
                {ALL_ROLES.map((r) => (
                  <th key={r} className="text-foreground/80 h-10 px-2 text-center align-middle font-medium whitespace-nowrap w-20">
                    <Badge variant="outline" className={ROLE_COLORS[r]}>{r}</Badge>
                  </th>
                ))}
                <th className="text-foreground/80 h-10 px-2 text-left align-middle font-medium whitespace-nowrap w-44">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><Building2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground" /><span>Client</span></div>
                </th>
                <th className="text-foreground/80 h-10 px-2 text-center align-middle font-medium whitespace-nowrap w-16">All</th>
                {CONFIGURABLE_SECTIONS.map((s) => {
                  const Icon = SECTION_ICONS[s.id];
                  const isSub = s.type === "subsection";
                  return (
                    <th key={s.id} className={`text-foreground/80 h-10 px-1 text-center align-middle font-medium whitespace-nowrap ${isSub ? "w-10" : "w-12"}`}>
                      <Tooltip>
                        <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-center">
                            {Icon && <Icon className={`${isSub ? "h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground/60" : "h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground"}`} />}
                          </div>
                        </TooltipTrigger>
                        <TooltipContent side="top"><p>{isSub ? `↳ ${s.label}` : s.label}</p></TooltipContent>
                      </Tooltip>
                    </th>
                  );
                })}
                <th className="text-foreground/80 h-10 px-2 text-left align-middle font-medium whitespace-nowrap">Last Login</th>
                <th className="text-foreground/80 h-10 px-2 text-left align-middle font-medium whitespace-nowrap">Joined</th>
                <th className="text-foreground/80 h-10 px-2 text-left align-middle font-medium whitespace-nowrap w-20"></th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <TableBody>
              {[...(users ?? [])].sort((a, b) => {
                const ai = orderRef.current.indexOf(a.id);
                const bi = orderRef.current.indexOf(b.id);
                return (ai === -1 ? 999 : ai) - (bi === -1 ? 999 : bi);
              }).map((user) => {
                const initials = (user.name ?? user.email)
                  .split(" ")
                  .map((n) => n[0])
                  .join("")
                  .toUpperCase()
                  .slice(0, 2);
                const isSelf = user.id === session?.user?.id;
                const isUserAdmin = user.role === "admin";

                return (
                  <TableRow key={user.id} className={selectedIds.has(user.id) ? "bg-brand/5" : ""}>
                    <TableCell>
                      {isSelf ? <div className="h-4 w-4" /> : (
                        <Checkbox checked={selectedIds.has(user.id)} onCheckedChange={() => toggleSelect(user.id)} />
                      )}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <Avatar className="h-8 w-8">
                          <AvatarImage src={user.image ?? undefined} />
                          <AvatarFallback className="text-xs">
                            {initials}
                          </AvatarFallback>
                        </Avatar>
                        <EditableName
                          user={user}
                          isSelf={isSelf}
                          onSave={(name) => nameMutation.mutate({ userId: user.id, name })}
                        />
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground">
                      {user.email}
                    </TableCell>
                    {ALL_ROLES.map((r) => (
                      <TableCell key={r} className="text-center">
                        <input
                          type="radio"
                          name={`role-${user.id}`}
                          checked={user.role === r}
                          disabled={isSelf || roleMutation.isPending}
                          onChange={() =>
                            roleMutation.mutate({ userId: user.id, role: r })
                          }
                          className="h-4 w-4 accent-brand cursor-pointer disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
                        />
                      </TableCell>
                    ))}
                    <TableCell>
                      {(user.role === "client" || user.role === "prospect") ? (() => {
                        const codes = parseClientCodes(user.clientIdCode);
                        const isOpen = clientDropdownUserId === user.id;
                        return (
                          <div className="relative">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={(e) => isOpen ? setClientDropdownUserId(null) : openDropdown(user.id, e.currentTarget)}
                              className="flex w-full max-w-[180px] items-center justify-between gap-1 rounded border border-border bg-background px-2 py-1 text-xs hover:bg-muted/50 transition-colors"
                            >
                              <span className={codes.length === 0 ? "text-muted-foreground" : "truncate"}>
                                {codes.length === 0
                                  ? "Assign client(s)..."
                                  : codes.length === 1
                                    ? (clients?.find((c) => c.clientIdCode === codes[0])?.clientName || codes[0])
                                    : `${codes.length} clients`}
                              </span>
                              <ChevronDown className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" />
                            </button>
                            {isOpen && createPortal(
                              <>
                                <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[998]" onClick={() => setClientDropdownUserId(null)} />
                                <div className="fixed z-[999] w-56 rounded-md border border-border bg-background shadow-lg max-h-48 overflow-y-auto" style={{ top: dropdownPos.top, left: dropdownPos.left }}>
                                  {(clients ?? []).map((c) => {
                                    const selected = codes.includes(c.clientIdCode);
                                    return (
                                      <button
                                        key={c.clientIdCode}
                                        type="button"
                                        onClick={() => toggleClientCode(user.id, user.clientIdCode, c.clientIdCode)}
                                        className={`flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs hover:bg-muted/50 transition-colors ${selected ? "bg-muted/30" : ""}`}
                                      >
                                        <Checkbox checked={selected} className="h-3.5 w-3.5" tabIndex={-1} />
                                        <span className="truncate">{c.clientName || c.clientIdCode}</span>
                                        <span className="ml-auto text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{c.clientIdCode}</span>
                                      </button>
                                    );
                                  })}
                                </div>
                              </>,
                              document.body
                            )}
                            {codes.length > 0 && (
                              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-1 max-w-[180px]">
                                {codes.map((code) => (
                                  <Badge key={code} variant="outline" className="text-[10px] gap-0.5 py-0 px-1.5 bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-400 border-purple-500/25">
                                    {clients?.find((c) => c.clientIdCode === code)?.clientName || code}
                                    <button
                                      type="button"
                                      onClick={() => toggleClientCode(user.id, user.clientIdCode, code)}
                                      className="hover:text-destructive"
                                    >
                                      <X className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
                                    </button>
                                  </Badge>
                                ))}
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        );
                      })() : (
                        <select
                          value={user.clientIdCode ?? ""}
                          disabled={isSelf || clientMutation.isPending}
                          onChange={(e) => clientMutation.mutate({ userId: user.id, clientIdCode: e.target.value || null })}
                          className="rounded border border-border bg-background px-2 py-1 text-xs text-foreground focus:border-brand focus:outline-none disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          <option value="">—</option>
                          {INTERNAL_TEAMS.map((team) => (
                            <option key={team.value} value={team.value}>{team.label}</option>
                          ))}
                        </select>
                      )}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-center">
                      {(() => {
                        const allIds = CONFIGURABLE_SECTIONS.map((s) => s.id);
                        const allChecked =
                          isUserAdmin ||
                          allIds.every((id) =>
                            (user.allowedSections ?? []).includes(id)
                          );
                        return (
                          <Checkbox
                            checked={allChecked}
                            disabled={isUserAdmin || sectionMutation.isPending}
                            onCheckedChange={() => {
                              const next = allChecked ? [] : [...allIds];
                              sectionMutation.mutate({
                                userId: user.id,
                                allowedSections: next,
                              });
                            }}
                          />
                        );
                      })()}
                    </TableCell>
                    {CONFIGURABLE_SECTIONS.map((section) => (
                      <TableCell key={section.id} className="text-center">
                        <Checkbox
                          checked={
                            isUserAdmin ||
                            (user.allowedSections ?? []).includes(section.id)
                          }
                          disabled={isUserAdmin || sectionMutation.isPending}
                          onCheckedChange={() =>
                            toggleSection(user, section.id)
                          }
                        />
                      </TableCell>
                    ))}
                    <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">
                      {user.lastLoginAt
                        ? new Date(user.lastLoginAt).toLocaleString()
                        : "Never"}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">
                      {new Date(user.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell>
                      {!isSelf && (
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="sm"
                          className="text-red-500 hover:text-red-600 hover:bg-red-500/10"
                          disabled={deleteMutation.isPending}
                          onClick={() => {
                            if (confirm(`Remove ${user.name ?? user.email}?`)) {
                              deleteMutation.mutate(user.id);
                            }
                          }}
                        >
                          Remove
                        </Button>
                      )}
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                );
              })}
            </TableBody>
          </table>
        </div>
        </TooltipProvider>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/app/api/activity/route.ts

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { activityLog } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { desc, eq, and, gte, lte, or, ilike, sql, not } from "drizzle-orm";

/**
 * Map department IDs to field label patterns for filtering activity.
 * Activity entries are product field edits — we categorize by field name.
 */
const DEPARTMENT_FIELD_PATTERNS: Record<string, string[]> = {
  seo: ["seo", "keyword", "search_term", "backend_keyword"],
  design: ["aplus", "a+", "image", "alt_text", "video", "photo"],
  ppc: ["ad_", "ppc", "campaign", "acos", "roas", "spend"],
  catalog: ["title", "bullet", "description", "brand", "manufacturer", "category", "item_type"],
  finances: ["price", "revenue", "cost", "fee", "margin"],
};

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const params = req.nextUrl.searchParams;
  const page = Math.max(1, parseInt(params.get("page") || "1", 10));
  const pageSize = Math.min(100, Math.max(1, parseInt(params.get("pageSize") || "50", 10)));
  const client = params.get("client") || "";
  const user = params.get("user") || "";
  const editType = params.get("editType") || "";
  const search = params.get("search") || "";
  const from = params.get("from") || "";
  const to = params.get("to") || "";
  const department = params.get("department") || "";

  const conditions = [];

  if (client) {
    conditions.push(eq(activityLog.clientIdCode, client));
  }
  if (user) {
    conditions.push(eq(activityLog.changedBy, user));
  }
  if (editType) {
    conditions.push(eq(activityLog.editType, editType));
  }
  if (from) {
    conditions.push(gte(activityLog.changedAt, new Date(from)));
  }
  if (to) {
    const toDate = new Date(to);
    toDate.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
    conditions.push(lte(activityLog.changedAt, toDate));
  }
  if (search) {
    conditions.push(
      or(
        ilike(activityLog.asin, `%${search}%`),
        ilike(activityLog.sku, `%${search}%`),
        ilike(activityLog.fieldLabel, `%${search}%`),
        ilike(activityLog.itemName, `%${search}%`)
      )
    );
  }
  if (department && DEPARTMENT_FIELD_PATTERNS[department]) {
    const patterns = DEPARTMENT_FIELD_PATTERNS[department];
    const deptCondition = or(
      ...patterns.map((p) => ilike(activityLog.bqName, `%${p}%`)),
      ...patterns.map((p) => ilike(activityLog.fieldLabel, `%${p}%`)),
    );
    if (deptCondition) conditions.push(deptCondition);
  }

  const where = conditions.length > 0 ? and(...conditions) : undefined;

  const [rows, countResult] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select()
      .from(activityLog)
      .where(where)
      .orderBy(desc(activityLog.changedAt))
      .limit(pageSize)
      .offset((page - 1) * pageSize),
    db
      .select({ count: sql<number>`count(*)` })
      .from(activityLog)
      .where(where),
  ]);

  const total = Number(countResult[0].count);

  return NextResponse.json({
    data: rows,
    pagination: {
      page,
      pageSize,
      total,
      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize),
    },
  });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { seoSettings } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import {
  AI_DEFAULTS,
  AI_FEATURE_KEYS,
  type AiFeatureKey,
  type AiFeatureConfig,
} from "@/lib/ai-config";
import { invalidateAiConfigCache } from "@/lib/ai-config.server";

export const maxDuration = 60;

/** GET — return merged config (defaults + overrides) for all features */
export async function GET() {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session || session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Admin only" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  try {
    const [row] = await db
      .select({ value: seoSettings.value, updatedAt: seoSettings.updatedAt, updatedBy: seoSettings.updatedBy })
      .from(seoSettings)
      .where(eq(seoSettings.key, "ai_config"))
      .limit(1);

    const overrides: Partial<Record<AiFeatureKey, Partial<AiFeatureConfig>>> = row?.value
      ? JSON.parse(row.value)
      : {};

    // Merge defaults with overrides
    const features: Record<string, AiFeatureConfig> = {};
    for (const key of AI_FEATURE_KEYS) {
      features[key] = {
        ...AI_DEFAULTS[key],
        ...overrides[key],
        label: AI_DEFAULTS[key].label,
        route: AI_DEFAULTS[key].route,
      };
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      features,
      updatedAt: row?.updatedAt ?? null,
      updatedBy: row?.updatedBy ?? null,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

/** PUT — save overrides (only changed fields) */
export async function PUT(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session || session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Admin only" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const { features } = body as { features: Record<string, Partial<AiFeatureConfig>> };

    if (!features || typeof features !== "object") {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "features object required" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // Only store overrides (fields that differ from defaults)
    const overrides: Partial<Record<AiFeatureKey, Partial<AiFeatureConfig>>> = {};
    for (const key of AI_FEATURE_KEYS) {
      const submitted = features[key];
      if (!submitted) continue;

      const defaults = AI_DEFAULTS[key];
      const diff: Partial<AiFeatureConfig> = {};

      if (submitted.model && submitted.model !== defaults.model) diff.model = submitted.model;
      if (submitted.maxTokens && submitted.maxTokens !== defaults.maxTokens) diff.maxTokens = submitted.maxTokens;
      if (typeof submitted.enabled === "boolean" && submitted.enabled !== defaults.enabled) diff.enabled = submitted.enabled;

      if (Object.keys(diff).length > 0) {
        overrides[key] = diff;
      }
    }

    const value = JSON.stringify(overrides);

    await db
      .insert(seoSettings)
      .values({ key: "ai_config", value, updatedBy: session.user.email! })
      .onConflictDoUpdate({
        target: seoSettings.key,
        set: { value, updatedAt: new Date(), updatedBy: session.user.email! },
      });

    invalidateAiConfigCache();

    return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
  } catch (err) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: src/app/api/admin/git-branches/route.ts
================================================
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { execSync } from "child_process";

export interface GitBranch {
  name: string;
  shortHash: string;
  date: string;
  author: string;
  subject: string;
  isMain: boolean;
  isCurrent: boolean;
  hasRemote: boolean;
  aheadBehind: { ahead: number; behind: number } | null;
}

export async function GET() {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session || session.user?.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  try {
    const currentBranch = execSync("git branch --show-current", {
      encoding: "utf-8",
      timeout: 5000,
    }).trim();

    const raw = execSync(
      "git for-each-ref --sort=-committerdate --format='%(refname:short)|%(objectname:short)|%(committerdate:iso8601)|%(authorname)|%(subject)|%(upstream:short)' refs/heads/",
      { encoding: "utf-8", timeout: 5000 }
    ).trim();

    const defaultBranch = "main";

    const branches: GitBranch[] = raw
      .split("\n")
      .filter(Boolean)
      .filter((line) => !line.startsWith("origin"))
      .map((line) => {
        const [name, shortHash, date, author, subject, upstream] =
          line.split("|");

        let aheadBehind: { ahead: number; behind: number } | null = null;
        if (upstream) {
          try {
            const ab = execSync(
              `git rev-list --left-right --count ${name}...${upstream}`,
              { encoding: "utf-8", timeout: 3000 }
            ).trim();
            const [ahead, behind] = ab.split("\t").map(Number);
            aheadBehind = { ahead, behind };
          } catch {
            // branch may not have upstream tracking
          }
        }

        return {
          name,
          shortHash,
          date,
          author,
          subject,
          isMain: name === defaultBranch,
          isCurrent: name === currentBranch,
          hasRemote: !!upstream,
          aheadBehind,
        };
      });

    return NextResponse.json({ branches, currentBranch });
  } catch (e) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to read git branches" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

    data: rows,
    pagination: {
      page,
      pageSize,
      total,
      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize),

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  adminEventLog,
  master,
  columnAttributes,
  aac,
  users,
  publishHistory,
  activityLog,
  fieldComments,
  amazonSnapshots,
  spApiCredentials,
  categoryDefinitions,
  categoryAttributes,
} from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { desc, eq, and, gte, sql, or, ilike, count } from "drizzle-orm";
import { BigQuery } from "@google-cloud/bigquery";

export const maxDuration = 60;

/** Race a promise against a timeout — returns fallback on timeout */
function withTimeout<T>(promise: Promise<T>, ms: number, fallback: T): Promise<T> {
  return Promise.race([
    promise,
    new Promise<T>((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve(fallback), ms)),
  ]);
}

// Anthropic pricing per million tokens (as of 2025)
const MODEL_PRICING: Record<string, { input: number; output: number }> = {
  "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001": { input: 0.8, output: 4 },
  "claude-sonnet-4-20250514": { input: 3, output: 15 },
  "claude-sonnet-4-5-20250514": { input: 3, output: 15 },
  "claude-opus-4-20250514": { input: 15, output: 75 },
};

const PROJECT_ID = process.env.GCP_PROJECT_ID || "amazon-data-461918";
const BQ_DATASET = process.env.BQ_DATASET || "1o8Hub";
const BQ_TABLE = process.env.BQ_TABLE || "Master";

function estimateCost(
  model: string,
  inputTokens: number,
  outputTokens: number
): number {
  const pricing = MODEL_PRICING[model] || MODEL_PRICING["claude-haiku-4-5-20251001"];
  return (inputTokens * pricing.input + outputTokens * pricing.output) / 1_000_000;
}

function getBigQueryClient(): BigQuery {
  if (process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL && process.env.GCP_PRIVATE_KEY) {
    let privateKey = process.env.GCP_PRIVATE_KEY;
    privateKey = privateKey.replace(/\\n/g, "\n");
    if (privateKey.startsWith('"') && privateKey.endsWith('"')) {
      privateKey = JSON.parse(privateKey);
    }
    return new BigQuery({
      projectId: PROJECT_ID,
      credentials: {
        client_email: process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL,
        private_key: privateKey,
      },
    });
  }
  return new BigQuery({ projectId: PROJECT_ID });
}

// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
async function countTable(table: any): Promise<number> {
  const [row] = await db.select({ count: sql<number>`count(*)` }).from(table);
  return Number(row.count);
}

interface TableInfo {
  name: string;
  rows: number;
}

interface CheckResult {
  name: string;
  status: "ok" | "error";
  latencyMs: number;
  details?: string;
  tables?: TableInfo[];
}

async function checkPostgres(): Promise<CheckResult> {
  const start = Date.now();
  try {
    const counts = await Promise.all([
      countTable(users),
      countTable(master),
      countTable(columnAttributes),
      countTable(aac),
      countTable(publishHistory),
      countTable(activityLog),
      countTable(fieldComments),
      countTable(amazonSnapshots),
      countTable(spApiCredentials),
      countTable(categoryDefinitions),
      countTable(categoryAttributes),
    ]);

    const tableNames = [
      "users",
      "products",
      "column_attributes",
      "aac_clients",
      "publish_history",
      "activity_log",
      "field_comments",
      "amazon_snapshots",
      "sp_api_credentials",
      "category_definitions",
      "category_attributes",
    ];

    const tables: TableInfo[] = tableNames.map((name, i) => ({
      name,
      rows: counts[i],
    }));

    const totalRows = counts.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);

    return {
      name: "PostgreSQL (Supabase)",
      status: "ok",
      latencyMs: Date.now() - start,
      details: `${tables.length} tables, ${totalRows.toLocaleString()} total rows`,
      tables,
    };
  } catch (e) {
    return {
      name: "PostgreSQL (Supabase)",
      status: "error",
      latencyMs: Date.now() - start,
      details: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Connection failed",
    };
  }
}

async function checkBigQueryTable(
  bq: BigQuery,
  dataset: string,
  table: string
): Promise<CheckResult> {
  const fullName = `${PROJECT_ID}.${dataset}.${table}`;
  const start = Date.now();
  try {
    const [rows] = await bq.query({
      query: `SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM \`${fullName}\``,
      location: "us-west1",
    });
    const cnt = Number(rows[0].cnt);
    return {
      name: `BQ: ${dataset}.${table}`,
      status: "ok",
      latencyMs: Date.now() - start,
      details: `${cnt.toLocaleString()} rows`,
    };
  } catch (e) {
    return {
      name: `BQ: ${dataset}.${table}`,
      status: "error",
      latencyMs: Date.now() - start,
      details: e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Query failed",
    };
  }
}

async function getDataIntegrity() {
  const [totals] = await db
    .select({
      total: sql<number>`count(*)`,
      dirty: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${master.isDirty} = true)`,
      missingAsin: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${master.asin} is null or ${master.asin} = '')`,
      missingUuid: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where (${master.rawColumnValues}->>'UUID') is null or (${master.rawColumnValues}->>'UUID') = '')`,
      missingItemName: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${master.itemName} is null or ${master.itemName} = '')`,
    })
    .from(master);

  const clientRows = await db
    .select({
      client: master.clientIdCode,
      count: sql<number>`count(*)`,
      dirty: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${master.isDirty} = true)`,
    })
    .from(master)
    .groupBy(master.clientIdCode)
    .orderBy(sql`count(*) desc`);

  return {
    totalProducts: Number(totals.total),
    dirtyProducts: Number(totals.dirty),
    missingAsin: Number(totals.missingAsin),
    missingUuid: Number(totals.missingUuid),
    missingItemName: Number(totals.missingItemName),
    clientBreakdown: clientRows.map((r) => ({
      client: r.client ?? "Unknown",
      count: Number(r.count),
      dirty: Number(r.dirty),
    })),
  };
}

async function getLastPublish() {
  const [row] = await db
    .select({
      publishedBy: publishHistory.publishedBy,
      publishedAt: publishHistory.publishedAt,
      rowsPublished: publishHistory.rowsPublished,
      dirtyCount: publishHistory.dirtyCount,
    })
    .from(publishHistory)
    .orderBy(desc(publishHistory.publishedAt))
    .limit(1);

  if (!row) return null;
  return {
    publishedBy: row.publishedBy,
    publishedAt: row.publishedAt.toISOString(),
    rowsPublished: row.rowsPublished,
    dirtyCount: row.dirtyCount,
  };
}

async function getSpApiStatus() {
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      clientIdCode: spApiCredentials.clientIdCode,
      marketplaceId: spApiCredentials.marketplaceId,
      isActive: spApiCredentials.isActive,
      lastSyncAt: spApiCredentials.lastSyncAt,
    })
    .from(spApiCredentials)
    .orderBy(spApiCredentials.clientIdCode);

  return rows.map((r) => ({
    clientIdCode: r.clientIdCode,
    marketplaceId: r.marketplaceId,
    isActive: r.isActive,
    lastSyncAt: r.lastSyncAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
  }));
}

async function getCategoryDefSummary() {
  const [defCount] = await db
    .select({ count: count() })
    .from(categoryDefinitions);
  const [attrCount] = await db
    .select({ count: count() })
    .from(categoryAttributes);
  const [clientCount] = await db
    .select({ count: sql<number>`count(distinct ${categoryDefinitions.clientIdCode})` })
    .from(categoryDefinitions);

  return {
    totalDefinitions: Number(defCount.count),
    totalAttributes: Number(attrCount.count),
    clients: Number(clientCount.count),
  };
}

async function getRecentActivity() {
  const [stats] = await db
    .select({
      today: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${activityLog.changedAt} >= now() - interval '24 hours')`,
      week: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${activityLog.changedAt} >= now() - interval '7 days')`,
      editors: sql<number>`count(distinct ${activityLog.changedBy}) filter (where ${activityLog.changedAt} >= now() - interval '7 days')`,
    })
    .from(activityLog);

  return {
    editsToday: Number(stats.today),
    editsThisWeek: Number(stats.week),
    activeEditors: Number(stats.editors),
  };
}

export async function GET() {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session || session.user?.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const thirtyDaysAgo = new Date();
  thirtyDaysAgo.setDate(thirtyDaysAgo.getDate() - 30);

  const sevenDaysAgo = new Date();
  sevenDaysAgo.setDate(sevenDaysAgo.getDate() - 7);

  const bq = getBigQueryClient();

  // Run observability + health queries in parallel (15s global timeout)
  const [
    claudeEvents,
    recentErrors,
    serviceHealth,
    activityCount,
    errorCount,
    healthChecks,
    dataIntegrity,
    lastPublish,
    spApiStatus,
    categoryDefs,
    recentActivity,
  ] = await withTimeout(Promise.all([
    // Claude AI usage
    db
      .select()
      .from(adminEventLog)
      .where(
        and(
          ilike(adminEventLog.action, "claude:%"),
          gte(adminEventLog.createdAt, thirtyDaysAgo)
        )
      )
      .orderBy(desc(adminEventLog.createdAt)),
    // Recent errors
    db
      .select({
        id: adminEventLog.id,
        section: adminEventLog.section,
        action: adminEventLog.action,
        message: adminEventLog.message,
        userEmail: adminEventLog.userEmail,
        detail: adminEventLog.detail,
        resourceType: adminEventLog.resourceType,
        resourceId: adminEventLog.resourceId,
        resourceLabel: adminEventLog.resourceLabel,
        createdAt: adminEventLog.createdAt,
      })
      .from(adminEventLog)
      .where(eq(adminEventLog.status, "error"))
      .orderBy(desc(adminEventLog.createdAt))
      .limit(50),
    // Service health
    Promise.all(
      [
        { name: "Redshift (Intentwise)", pattern: "%redshift%" },
        { name: "BigQuery", pattern: "%bigquery%" },
        { name: "Google Drive", pattern: "%drive%" },
        { name: "Claude AI", pattern: "claude:%" },
        { name: "Amazon SP-API", pattern: "%sp-api%" },
        { name: "Rainforest API", pattern: "%rainforest%" },
      ].map(async (svc) => {
        const [lastSuccess] = await db
          .select({
            action: adminEventLog.action,
            createdAt: adminEventLog.createdAt,
            message: adminEventLog.message,
          })
          .from(adminEventLog)
          .where(
            and(
              or(
                ilike(adminEventLog.action, svc.pattern),
                ilike(adminEventLog.section, svc.pattern)
              ),
              eq(adminEventLog.status, "success")
            )
          )
          .orderBy(desc(adminEventLog.createdAt))
          .limit(1);

        const [lastError] = await db
          .select({
            action: adminEventLog.action,
            createdAt: adminEventLog.createdAt,
            message: adminEventLog.message,
          })
          .from(adminEventLog)
          .where(
            and(
              or(
                ilike(adminEventLog.action, svc.pattern),
                ilike(adminEventLog.section, svc.pattern)
              ),
              eq(adminEventLog.status, "error")
            )
          )
          .orderBy(desc(adminEventLog.createdAt))
          .limit(1);

        return {
          name: svc.name,
          lastSuccess: lastSuccess?.createdAt || null,
          lastSuccessAction: lastSuccess?.action || null,
          lastError: lastError?.createdAt || null,
          lastErrorMessage: lastError?.message || null,
          status: !lastSuccess
            ? "unknown"
            : !lastError
              ? "healthy"
              : new Date(lastSuccess.createdAt!) > new Date(lastError.createdAt!)
                ? "healthy"
                : "degraded",
        };
      })
    ),
    // Activity count (7d)
    db
      .select({ count: sql<number>`count(*)` })
      .from(adminEventLog)
      .where(gte(adminEventLog.createdAt, sevenDaysAgo))
      .then(([r]) => r),
    // Error count (7d)
    db
      .select({ count: sql<number>`count(*)` })
      .from(adminEventLog)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(adminEventLog.status, "error"),
          gte(adminEventLog.createdAt, sevenDaysAgo)
        )
      )
      .then(([r]) => r),
    // Health checks (Postgres + BQ with 10s timeout per BQ query)
    Promise.all([
      checkPostgres(),
      withTimeout(checkBigQueryTable(bq, BQ_DATASET, BQ_TABLE), 10_000, { name: `BQ: ${BQ_DATASET}.${BQ_TABLE}`, status: "error" as const, latencyMs: 10000, details: "Timeout (10s)" }),
      withTimeout(checkBigQueryTable(bq, BQ_DATASET, "AAC"), 10_000, { name: `BQ: ${BQ_DATASET}.AAC`, status: "error" as const, latencyMs: 10000, details: "Timeout (10s)" }),
      withTimeout(checkBigQueryTable(bq, BQ_DATASET, "Attributes"), 10_000, { name: `BQ: ${BQ_DATASET}.Attributes`, status: "error" as const, latencyMs: 10000, details: "Timeout (10s)" }),
      withTimeout(checkBigQueryTable(bq, BQ_DATASET, "SEO"), 10_000, { name: `BQ: ${BQ_DATASET}.SEO`, status: "error" as const, latencyMs: 10000, details: "Timeout (10s)" }),
    ]),
    withTimeout(getDataIntegrity(), 8_000, { totalProducts: 0, dirtyProducts: 0, missingAsin: 0, missingUuid: 0, missingItemName: 0, clientBreakdown: [] }),
    withTimeout(getLastPublish(), 5_000, null),
    withTimeout(getSpApiStatus(), 5_000, []),
    withTimeout(getCategoryDefSummary(), 5_000, { totalDefinitions: 0, totalAttributes: 0, clients: 0 }),
    withTimeout(getRecentActivity(), 5_000, { editsToday: 0, editsThisWeek: 0, activeEditors: 0 }),
  ]), 20_000, [
    [], // claudeEvents
    [], // recentErrors
    [], // serviceHealth
    { count: 0 }, // activityCount
    { count: 0 }, // errorCount
    [] as unknown as [CheckResult, CheckResult, CheckResult, CheckResult, CheckResult], // healthChecks
    { totalProducts: 0, dirtyProducts: 0, missingAsin: 0, missingUuid: 0, missingItemName: 0, clientBreakdown: [] }, // dataIntegrity
    null, // lastPublish
    [], // spApiStatus
    { totalDefinitions: 0, totalAttributes: 0, clients: 0 }, // categoryDefs
    { editsToday: 0, editsThisWeek: 0, activeEditors: 0 }, // recentActivity
  ] as const);

  // Aggregate Claude feature usage
  const featureUsage: Record<
    string,
    {
      calls: number;
      errors: number;
      inputTokens: number;
      outputTokens: number;
      cost: number;
      avgDurationMs: number;
      totalDurationMs: number;
    }
  > = {};

  let totalCost = 0;
  let totalInputTokens = 0;
  let totalOutputTokens = 0;

  for (const event of claudeEvents) {
    const feature = event.action;
    if (!featureUsage[feature]) {
      featureUsage[feature] = {
        calls: 0,
        errors: 0,
        inputTokens: 0,
        outputTokens: 0,
        cost: 0,
        avgDurationMs: 0,
        totalDurationMs: 0,
      };
    }

    const f = featureUsage[feature];
    f.calls++;
    if (event.status === "error") f.errors++;
    if (event.durationMs) f.totalDurationMs += event.durationMs;

    const detail = event.detail as Record<string, unknown> | null;
    const usage = detail?.usage as
      | { input_tokens?: number; output_tokens?: number }
      | undefined;
    const model = (detail?.model as string) || "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001";

    if (usage) {
      const inp = usage.input_tokens || 0;
      const out = usage.output_tokens || 0;
      f.inputTokens += inp;
      f.outputTokens += out;
      const cost = estimateCost(model, inp, out);
      f.cost += cost;
      totalCost += cost;
      totalInputTokens += inp;
      totalOutputTokens += out;
    }
  }

  for (const f of Object.values(featureUsage)) {
    f.avgDurationMs = f.calls > 0 ? Math.round(f.totalDurationMs / f.calls) : 0;
  }

  // Daily cost breakdown (last 7 days)
  const dailyCostEvents = claudeEvents.filter(
    (e) => e.createdAt && new Date(e.createdAt) >= sevenDaysAgo
  );
  const dailyCosts: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const event of dailyCostEvents) {
    const day = new Date(event.createdAt!).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const detail = event.detail as Record<string, unknown> | null;
    const usage = detail?.usage as
      | { input_tokens?: number; output_tokens?: number }
      | undefined;
    const model = (detail?.model as string) || "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001";
    if (usage) {
      const cost = estimateCost(
        model,
        usage.input_tokens || 0,
        usage.output_tokens || 0
      );
      dailyCosts[day] = (dailyCosts[day] || 0) + cost;
    }
  }

  const allHealthOk = healthChecks.every((c) => c.status === "ok");

  return NextResponse.json({
    summary: {
      totalCost30d: totalCost,
      totalInputTokens30d: totalInputTokens,
      totalOutputTokens30d: totalOutputTokens,
      totalCalls30d: claudeEvents.length,
      totalErrors30d: claudeEvents.filter((e) => e.status === "error").length,
      eventsLast7d: Number(activityCount.count),
      errorsLast7d: Number(errorCount.count),
    },
    featureUsage,
    dailyCosts,
    serviceHealth,
    recentErrors,
    // System health data
    systemHealth: {
      status: allHealthOk ? "healthy" : "degraded",
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      checks: healthChecks,
      dataIntegrity,
      lastPublish,
      spApiStatus,
      categoryDefs,
      recentActivity,
      env: {
        GCP_PROJECT_ID: PROJECT_ID,
        BQ_DATASET,
        BQ_TABLE,
        GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL: process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL
          ? `${process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL.slice(0, 12)}...`
          : "not set",
        DATABASE_URL: process.env.DATABASE_URL ? "set" : "not set",
      },
    },
  });
}

FILE: src/app/api/admin/seo-recount/route.ts

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { seoAsins } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, isNotNull } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";

export async function POST() {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session || session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const allAsins = await db
    .select({ id: seoAsins.id, generatedContent: seoAsins.generatedContent })
    .from(seoAsins)
    .where(isNotNull(seoAsins.generatedContent));

  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  let updated = 0;

  for (const row of allAsins) {
    const gc = row.generatedContent as Record<string, unknown> | null;
    if (!gc) continue;

    let changed = false;
    for (const key of Object.keys(gc)) {
      if (key.endsWith("_CharLength")) {
        const contentKey = key.replace("_CharLength", "");
        if (typeof gc[contentKey] === "string") {
          const correct = (gc[contentKey] as string).length;
          if (gc[key] !== correct) {
            gc[key] = correct;
            changed = true;
          }
        }
      } else if (key.endsWith("_ByteLength")) {
        const contentKey = key.replace("_ByteLength", "");
        if (typeof gc[contentKey] === "string") {
          const correct = encoder.encode(gc[contentKey] as string).length;
          if (gc[key] !== correct) {
            gc[key] = correct;
            changed = true;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if (changed) {
      await db.update(seoAsins).set({ generatedContent: gc as any }).where(eq(seoAsins.id, row.id));
      updated++;
    }
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true, total: allAsins.length, updated });
}
