import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { spApiCredentials, aac } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { SPAPIClient, MARKETPLACE_REGIONS } from "@/lib/sp-api/client";

function maskToken(token: string): string {
  if (token.length <= 8) return "****" + token;
  return "****" + token.slice(-8);
}

function formatCredential(cred: typeof spApiCredentials.$inferSelect) {
  return {
    id: cred.id,
    clientIdCode: cred.clientIdCode,
    marketplaceId: cred.marketplaceId,
    sellerId: cred.sellerId,
    refreshTokenMasked: maskToken(cred.refreshToken),
    region: cred.region,
    isActive: cred.isActive,
    lastSyncAt: cred.lastSyncAt,
    createdAt: cred.createdAt,
    updatedAt: cred.updatedAt,
  };
}

const KNOWN_MARKETPLACES = new Set(Object.keys(MARKETPLACE_REGIONS));

export async function GET() {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden: admin only" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const all = await db.select().from(spApiCredentials).orderBy(spApiCredentials.clientIdCode);
  return NextResponse.json({
    credentials: all.map(formatCredential),
  });
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden: admin only" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const { clientIdCode, marketplaceId, sellerId, refreshToken, region } =
    body as {
      clientIdCode: string;
      marketplaceId: string;
      sellerId: string;
      refreshToken: string;
      region?: string;
    };

  if (!clientIdCode || !marketplaceId || !sellerId || !refreshToken) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "clientIdCode, marketplaceId, sellerId, and refreshToken are required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Validate marketplace
  if (!KNOWN_MARKETPLACES.has(marketplaceId)) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `Unknown marketplace ID: ${marketplaceId}` },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Validate client exists
  const [client] = await db
    .select()
    .from(aac)
    .where(eq(aac.clientIdCode, clientIdCode))
    .limit(1);

  if (!client) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `Client ${clientIdCode} not found in aac_clients` },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Check for duplicate
  const detectedRegion = region ?? MARKETPLACE_REGIONS[marketplaceId] ?? "na";

  try {
    const [created] = await db
      .insert(spApiCredentials)
      .values({
        clientIdCode,
        marketplaceId,
        sellerId,
        refreshToken,
        region: detectedRegion,
      })
      .returning();

    return NextResponse.json(formatCredential(created), { status: 201 });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    if (msg.includes("unique") || msg.includes("duplicate")) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: `Credentials already exist for ${clientIdCode} + ${marketplaceId}` },
        { status: 409 }
      );
    }
    throw err;
  }
}

export async function PUT(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden: admin only" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const { id, ...fields } = body as {
    id: number;
    sellerId?: string;
    refreshToken?: string;
    isActive?: boolean;
    region?: string;
  };

  if (!id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "id is required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const updates: Record<string, unknown> = { updatedAt: new Date() };
  if (fields.sellerId !== undefined) updates.sellerId = fields.sellerId;
  if (fields.refreshToken !== undefined) updates.refreshToken = fields.refreshToken;
  if (fields.isActive !== undefined) updates.isActive = fields.isActive;
  if (fields.region !== undefined) updates.region = fields.region;

  const [updated] = await db
    .update(spApiCredentials)
    .set(updates)
    .where(eq(spApiCredentials.id, id))
    .returning();

  if (!updated) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Credential not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  return NextResponse.json(formatCredential(updated));
}

export async function DELETE(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden: admin only" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const { id } = body as { id: number };

  if (!id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "id is required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const [deleted] = await db
    .delete(spApiCredentials)
    .where(eq(spApiCredentials.id, id))
    .returning();

  if (!deleted) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Credential not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
}

FILE: src/app/api/admin/sp-api/test/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { spApiCredentials } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { SPAPIClient } from "@/lib/sp-api/client";

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden: admin only" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const { id } = body as { id: number };

  if (!id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "id is required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const [cred] = await db
    .select()
    .from(spApiCredentials)
    .where(eq(spApiCredentials.id, id))
    .limit(1);

  if (!cred) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Credential not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  const client = new SPAPIClient({
    clientId: process.env.SP_API_CLIENT_ID!,
    clientSecret: process.env.SP_API_CLIENT_SECRET!,
    refreshToken: cred.refreshToken,
    marketplaceId: cred.marketplaceId,
    sellerId: cred.sellerId,
    region: cred.region as "na" | "eu" | "fe",
  });

  try {
    await client.getAccessToken();
    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message: "Connection successful",
    });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    return NextResponse.json({
      success: false,
      message: `Token exchange failed: ${msg}`,
    });
  }
}

  }

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { users } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { VALID_SECTION_IDS } from "@/lib/permissions";

export async function GET() {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session || session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const allUsers = await db.select().from(users);
  return NextResponse.json(allUsers);
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session || session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const { email, name, role, allowedSections } = body as {
    email: string;
    name?: string;
    role?: "viewer" | "editor" | "admin" | "client" | "pending" | "prospect";
    allowedSections?: string[];
  };

  if (!email || !email.includes("@")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Valid email is required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const userRole = role ?? "viewer";
  if (!["viewer", "editor", "admin", "client", "pending", "prospect"].includes(userRole)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid role" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  if (allowedSections) {
    const invalid = allowedSections.filter((s) => !VALID_SECTION_IDS.includes(s));
    if (invalid.length > 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: `Invalid sections: ${invalid.join(", ")}` }, { status: 400 });
    }
  }

  // Check for duplicate email
  const existing = await db.select({ id: users.id }).from(users).where(eq(users.email, email.toLowerCase())).limit(1);
  if (existing.length > 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "User with this email already exists" }, { status: 409 });
  }

  const [newUser] = await db
    .insert(users)
    .values({
      email: email.toLowerCase(),
      name: name || null,
      role: userRole,
      allowedSections: allowedSections ?? [],
    })
    .returning();

  return NextResponse.json(newUser, { status: 201 });
}

export async function PUT(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session || session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const { userId, role, allowedSections, clientIdCode, name } = body as {
    userId: string;
    role?: "viewer" | "editor" | "admin" | "client" | "pending" | "prospect";
    allowedSections?: string[];
    clientIdCode?: string | null;
    name?: string | null;
  };

  if (!userId) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid request" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Prevent admin from demoting themselves
  if (userId === session.user.id && role && role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Cannot change your own role" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  const updates: Partial<{
    role: "viewer" | "editor" | "admin" | "client" | "pending" | "prospect";
    allowedSections: string[];
    clientIdCode: string | null;
    name: string | null;
  }> = {};

  if (role) {
    if (!["viewer", "editor", "admin", "client", "pending", "prospect"].includes(role)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid role" }, { status: 400 });
    }
    updates.role = role;
  }

  if (allowedSections !== undefined) {
    // Validate all section IDs
    const invalid = allowedSections.filter((s) => !VALID_SECTION_IDS.includes(s));
    if (invalid.length > 0) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: `Invalid sections: ${invalid.join(", ")}` },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }
    updates.allowedSections = allowedSections;
  }

  if (clientIdCode !== undefined) {
    updates.clientIdCode = clientIdCode;
  }

  if (name !== undefined) {
    updates.name = name ? name.trim() : null;
  }

  if (Object.keys(updates).length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Nothing to update" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  await db.update(users).set(updates).where(eq(users.id, userId));

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
}

export async function DELETE(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session || session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { userId } = (await req.json()) as { userId: string };

  if (!userId) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid request" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  if (userId === session.user.id) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Cannot remove yourself" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  await db.delete(users).where(eq(users.id, userId));

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";

export const maxDuration = 60;

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const apiKey = process.env.RAINFOREST_API_KEY;
  if (!apiKey) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Rainforest API key not configured" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }

  const { searchParams } = req.nextUrl;
  const asin = searchParams.get("asin");
  const amazonDomain = searchParams.get("amazon_domain") || "amazon.com";

  if (!asin) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Missing required parameter: asin" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  try {
    const url = new URL("https://api.rainforestapi.com/request");
    url.searchParams.set("api_key", apiKey);
    url.searchParams.set("type", "product");
    url.searchParams.set("asin", asin);
    url.searchParams.set("amazon_domain", amazonDomain);

    const response = await fetch(url.toString(), { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(50000) });

    if (!response.ok) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: `Rainforest API returned ${response.status}` },
        { status: response.status >= 500 ? 503 : response.status }
      );
    }

    const data = await response.json();

    if (data.request_info?.success === false) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: data.request_info?.message || "Rainforest request failed" },
        { status: 502 }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ product: data.product });
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof DOMException && error.name === "TimeoutError") {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Rainforest API request timed out" },
        { status: 503 }
      );
    }
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to fetch from Rainforest API" },
      { status: 503 }
    );
  }
}

FILE: src/app/api/amazon-sync/compare/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { amazonSyncSnapshots, master } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and, desc } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { SYNC_FIELDS } from "@/lib/amazon-sync-field-map";
import { getProductFieldValue } from "@/lib/product-mapper";
import type { RainforestProduct } from "@/types/rainforest";
import type { Product } from "@/lib/db/schema";

export const maxDuration = 60;

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const productId = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("product_id");
  if (!productId) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "product_id required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Get the product for catalog values
  const [product] = await db
    .select()
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.id, productId))
    .limit(1);

  if (!product) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Product not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  // Get latest snapshot per provider
  const [rainforestSnap] = await db
    .select()
    .from(amazonSyncSnapshots)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(amazonSyncSnapshots.productId, productId),
        eq(amazonSyncSnapshots.provider, "rainforest")
      )
    )
    .orderBy(desc(amazonSyncSnapshots.fetchedAt))
    .limit(1);

  const [firecrawlSnap] = await db
    .select()
    .from(amazonSyncSnapshots)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(amazonSyncSnapshots.productId, productId),
        eq(amazonSyncSnapshots.provider, "firecrawl")
      )
    )
    .orderBy(desc(amazonSyncSnapshots.fetchedAt))
    .limit(1);

  // Build three-way comparison for each field
  const rainforestData = rainforestSnap?.snapshotData as RainforestProduct | null;
  const firecrawlData = firecrawlSnap?.snapshotData as RainforestProduct | null;

  const fields = SYNC_FIELDS.map((field) => {
    const hubValue = field.getCatalogValue(product as Product);
    const rainforestValue = rainforestData
      ? field.getRainforestValue(rainforestData)
      : null;
    const firecrawlValue = firecrawlData
      ? field.getRainforestValue(firecrawlData)
      : null;

    // Determine if values match
    const allSame =
      hubValue === rainforestValue && rainforestValue === firecrawlValue;
    const rfMatch = rainforestValue === firecrawlValue;

    return {
      fieldName: field.field_name,
      label: field.label,
      fieldGroup: field.field_group,
      hubValue,
      rainforestValue,
      firecrawlValue,
      allMatch: allSame,
      providersMatch: rfMatch,
    };
  });

  return NextResponse.json({
    fields,
    rainforestSnapshot: rainforestSnap
      ? { id: rainforestSnap.id, fetchedAt: rainforestSnap.fetchedAt }
      : null,
    firecrawlSnapshot: firecrawlSnap
      ? { id: firecrawlSnap.id, fetchedAt: firecrawlSnap.fetchedAt }
      : null,
  });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { amazonSyncDiscrepancies, master, activityLog } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { SYNC_FIELDS } from "@/lib/amazon-sync-field-map";
import {
  COMPUTED_FIELDS,
  getTriggeredComputedFields,
  computeUUID,
  computeSummarizedTitle,
  computeAmazonPdpUrl,
} from "@/lib/computed-fields";

export const maxDuration = 60;

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { searchParams } = req.nextUrl;
  const clientIdCode = searchParams.get("client_id");
  const productId = searchParams.get("product_id");
  const status = searchParams.get("status");
  const resolved = searchParams.get("resolved");
  const page = parseInt(searchParams.get("page") || "1");
  const pageSize = parseInt(searchParams.get("pageSize") || "100");

  // Build where conditions
  const conditions = [];
  if (clientIdCode)
    conditions.push(eq(amazonSyncDiscrepancies.clientIdCode, clientIdCode));
  if (productId)
    conditions.push(eq(amazonSyncDiscrepancies.productId, productId));
  if (status) conditions.push(eq(amazonSyncDiscrepancies.status, status));
  if (resolved !== null && resolved !== undefined) {
    conditions.push(
      eq(amazonSyncDiscrepancies.resolved, resolved === "true")
    );
  }

  const where = conditions.length > 0 ? and(...conditions) : undefined;

  const [countResult] = await db
    .select({ count: sql<number>`count(*)` })
    .from(amazonSyncDiscrepancies)
    .where(where);
  const total = Number(countResult.count);

  const rows = await db
    .select({
      id: amazonSyncDiscrepancies.id,
      snapshotId: amazonSyncDiscrepancies.snapshotId,
      productId: amazonSyncDiscrepancies.productId,
      clientIdCode: amazonSyncDiscrepancies.clientIdCode,
      asin: amazonSyncDiscrepancies.asin,
      fieldName: amazonSyncDiscrepancies.fieldName,
      fieldGroup: amazonSyncDiscrepancies.fieldGroup,
      catalogValue: amazonSyncDiscrepancies.catalogValue,
      amazonValue: amazonSyncDiscrepancies.amazonValue,
      status: amazonSyncDiscrepancies.status,
      resolved: amazonSyncDiscrepancies.resolved,
      resolvedAction: amazonSyncDiscrepancies.resolvedAction,
      resolvedAt: amazonSyncDiscrepancies.resolvedAt,
      resolvedBy: amazonSyncDiscrepancies.resolvedBy,
      createdAt: amazonSyncDiscrepancies.createdAt,
      productTitle: master.itemName,
      productAsin: master.asin,
    })
    .from(amazonSyncDiscrepancies)
    .leftJoin(master, eq(amazonSyncDiscrepancies.productId, master.id))
    .where(where)
    .orderBy(amazonSyncDiscrepancies.createdAt)
    .limit(pageSize)
    .offset((page - 1) * pageSize);

  return NextResponse.json({
    data: rows,
    pagination: {
      page,
      pageSize,
      total,
      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize),
    },
  });
}

// PATCH — resolve/unresolve a discrepancy
export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (session.user.role === "viewer") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const { id, resolved, resolvedAction } = body as {
    id: string;
    resolved: boolean;
    resolvedAction?: "update_amazon" | "update_hub" | null;
  };

  if (!id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "id is required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // If "update_hub", write the Amazon value into the product (Supabase + marks dirty for BQ publish)
  if (resolved && resolvedAction === "update_hub") {
    // Fetch the discrepancy
    const [disc] = await db
      .select()
      .from(amazonSyncDiscrepancies)
      .where(eq(amazonSyncDiscrepancies.id, id))
      .limit(1);

    if (!disc) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Discrepancy not found" }, { status: 404 });
    }

    // Find the sync field definition to get the bqName
    const syncField = SYNC_FIELDS.find((f) => f.field_name === disc.fieldName);
    const bqName = syncField?.bqName;

    if (!bqName) {
      // Field has no catalog mapping — can't write back, just mark resolved
      await db
        .update(amazonSyncDiscrepancies)
        .set({
          resolved: true,
          resolvedAction: "update_hub",
          resolvedAt: new Date(),
          resolvedBy: session.user.email ?? null,
        })
        .where(eq(amazonSyncDiscrepancies.id, id));

      return NextResponse.json({ success: true, warning: "Field has no catalog mapping — marked resolved but no data updated" });
    }

    // Fetch current product
    const [product] = await db
      .select()
      .from(master)
      .where(eq(master.id, disc.productId))
      .limit(1);

    if (!product) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Product not found" }, { status: 404 });
    }

    const newValue = disc.amazonValue;

    // Reject computed fields
    if (COMPUTED_FIELDS.has(bqName)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: `${bqName} is a computed field` }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const jsonbFields = [
      "contentSeo", "variations", "packaging", "targetAudience",
      "fulfillment", "productAttributes", "nutritionSupplements",
      "complianceSafety", "images", "dimensionsWeight", "otherAttributes",
    ] as const;

    let oldValue: string | null = null;
    const updates: Record<string, unknown> = {};

    // Check core fields first
    const coreField = Object.keys(product).find((k) => k === bqName.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + bqName.slice(1));
    if (coreField && coreField in product) {
      oldValue = (product as Record<string, unknown>)[coreField] as string | null;
      updates[coreField] = newValue;
    } else {
      // JSONB field — find and update in the right blob
      let primaryBlob: string | null = null;

      for (const blobField of jsonbFields) {
        const blob = (product as Record<string, unknown>)[blobField] as Record<string, string> | null;
        if (blob && bqName in blob) {
          if (!primaryBlob) {
            primaryBlob = blobField;
            oldValue = blob[bqName] ?? null;
            if (newValue == null) {
              const newBlob = { ...blob };
              delete newBlob[bqName];
              updates[blobField] = newBlob;
            } else {
              updates[blobField] = { ...blob, [bqName]: newValue };
            }
          } else {
            // Remove stale copy from other blobs
            const newBlob = { ...blob };
            delete newBlob[bqName];
            updates[blobField] = newBlob;
          }
        }
      }

      if (!primaryBlob) {
        // Not found — add to otherAttributes
        const current = (product.otherAttributes as Record<string, string>) ?? {};
        oldValue = current[bqName] ?? null;
        updates.otherAttributes = { ...current, ...(newValue != null ? { [bqName]: newValue } : {}) };
      }
    }

    // Update rawColumnValues
    const rawValues = { ...(product.rawColumnValues ?? {}) };
    if (newValue != null) {
      rawValues[bqName] = newValue;
    } else {
      delete rawValues[bqName];
    }

    // Recompute dependent computed fields
    const triggered = getTriggeredComputedFields(bqName, undefined);
    for (const computedField of triggered) {
      if (computedField === "UUID") {
        const asin = (updates.asin !== undefined ? updates.asin : product.asin) as string | null;
        const sku = (updates.sku !== undefined ? updates.sku : product.sku) as string | null;
        const cid = (updates.clientIdCode !== undefined ? updates.clientIdCode : product.clientIdCode) as string | null;
        const newUUID = computeUUID(asin, sku, cid);
        rawValues["UUID"] = newUUID;
        for (const bf of jsonbFields) {
          const blob = (updates[bf] ?? (product as Record<string, unknown>)[bf]) as Record<string, string> | null;
          if (blob && "UUID" in blob) {
            updates[bf] = { ...blob, UUID: newUUID };
          }
        }
      } else if (computedField === "AmazonPDPURL") {
        const asin = (updates.asin !== undefined ? updates.asin : product.asin) as string | null;
        const newUrl = computeAmazonPdpUrl(asin);
        rawValues["AmazonPDPURL"] = newUrl;
        for (const bf of jsonbFields) {
          const blob = (updates[bf] ?? (product as Record<string, unknown>)[bf]) as Record<string, string> | null;
          if (blob && "AmazonPDPURL" in blob) {
            updates[bf] = { ...blob, AmazonPDPURL: newUrl };
          }
        }
      } else if (computedField === "SummarizedTitle") {
        const r = (k: string) => rawValues[k] ?? null;
        const newTitle = computeSummarizedTitle(r("VariationProduct"), r("Style"), r("Flavor"), r("Color"), r("Size"));
        updates.summarizedTitle = newTitle;
        rawValues["SummarizedTitle"] = newTitle;
      }
    }

    updates.rawColumnValues = rawValues;

    // Change log + dirty flag
    const changeLog = [...(product.changeLog ?? [])];
    changeLog.push({
      field: bqName,
      oldValue,
      newValue,
      changedBy: session.user.email,
      changedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    });
    updates.changeLog = changeLog;
    updates.isDirty = true;
    updates.updatedAt = new Date();

    // Write product update
    await db.update(master).set(updates).where(eq(master.id, disc.productId));

    // Activity log
    await db.insert(activityLog).values({
      productId: disc.productId,
      asin: product.asin,
      sku: product.sku,
      clientIdCode: product.clientIdCode,
      itemName: product.itemName,
      fieldLabel: syncField?.label ?? bqName,
      bqName,
      oldValue,
      newValue,
      changedBy: session.user.email!,
      editType: "single",
    });
  }

  // Mark discrepancy as resolved/unresolved
  await db
    .update(amazonSyncDiscrepancies)
    .set({
      resolved,
      resolvedAction: resolved ? (resolvedAction ?? null) : null,
      resolvedAt: resolved ? new Date() : null,
      resolvedBy: resolved ? session.user.email ?? null : null,
    })
    .where(eq(amazonSyncDiscrepancies.id, id));

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  master,
  amazonSyncSnapshots,
  amazonSyncDiscrepancies,
  amazonSyncRuns,
  seoSettings,
} from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, inArray } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { computeDiscrepancies } from "@/lib/amazon-sync-field-map";
import { scrapeAmazonProduct } from "@/lib/firecrawl";
import type { RainforestProduct } from "@/types/rainforest";

export const maxDuration = 60;

function delay(ms: number) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

type SingleProvider = "rainforest" | "firecrawl";

async function fetchFromProvider(
  providerName: SingleProvider,
  asin: string,
  amazonDomain: string
): Promise<RainforestProduct> {
  if (providerName === "firecrawl") {
    const result = await scrapeAmazonProduct(asin, amazonDomain);
    return result.product;
  }

  // Rainforest
  const apiKey = process.env.RAINFOREST_API_KEY!;
  const url = new URL("https://api.rainforestapi.com/request");
  url.searchParams.set("api_key", apiKey);
  url.searchParams.set("type", "product");
  url.searchParams.set("asin", asin);
  url.searchParams.set("amazon_domain", amazonDomain);

  const response = await fetch(url.toString(), {
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(45000),
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Rainforest API returned ${response.status}`);
  }

  const data = await response.json();
  if (data.request_info?.success === false) {
    throw new Error(data.request_info?.message || "Rainforest request failed");
  }

  return data.product as RainforestProduct;
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const {
    product_ids,
    client_id: clientIdCode,
    amazon_domain = "amazon.com",
    run_id,
    provider: providerOverride,
  } = body as {
    product_ids: string[];
    client_id: string;
    amazon_domain?: string;
    run_id?: string;
    provider?: "rainforest" | "firecrawl" | "both";
  };

  if (!product_ids?.length || !clientIdCode) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "product_ids and client_id are required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Determine provider: explicit override > DB setting > default rainforest
  let providerChoice = providerOverride;
  if (!providerChoice) {
    const [setting] = await db
      .select()
      .from(seoSettings)
      .where(eq(seoSettings.key, "amazon_sync_provider"))
      .limit(1);
    providerChoice = (setting?.value as "rainforest" | "firecrawl") || "rainforest";
  }

  // Build list of providers to run
  const providers: SingleProvider[] =
    providerChoice === "both"
      ? ["rainforest", "firecrawl"]
      : [providerChoice as SingleProvider];

  // Validate API keys
  if (providers.includes("rainforest") && !process.env.RAINFOREST_API_KEY) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Rainforest API key not configured" }, { status: 500 });
  }
  if (providers.includes("firecrawl") && !process.env.FIRECRAWL_API_KEY) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Firecrawl API key not configured" }, { status: 500 });
  }

  // Fetch products
  const productRows = await db
    .select({ id: master.id, asin: master.asin })
    .from(master)
    .where(inArray(master.id, product_ids));

  const results: Array<{
    product_id: string;
    asin: string;
    provider: string;
    status: "success" | "failed" | "skipped";
    discrepancies_count: number;
    error?: string;
  }> = [];
  let totalCredits = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < productRows.length; i++) {
    const row = productRows[i];

    if (!row.asin) {
      results.push({
        product_id: row.id,
        asin: "",
        provider: providers.join("+"),
        status: "skipped",
        discrepancies_count: 0,
        error: "No ASIN",
      });
      continue;
    }

    // Fetch full product once for comparison
    const [fullProduct] = await db
      .select()
      .from(master)
      .where(eq(master.id, row.id))
      .limit(1);

    for (const prov of providers) {
      try {
        // Rate limit
        if (results.filter((r) => r.status === "success").length > 0) await delay(1000);

        const rainforestProduct = await fetchFromProvider(prov, row.asin, amazon_domain);

        // Store snapshot with provider tag
        const [snapshot] = await db
          .insert(amazonSyncSnapshots)
          .values({
            clientIdCode,
            productId: row.id,
            asin: row.asin,
            amazonDomain: amazon_domain,
            provider: prov,
            snapshotData: rainforestProduct,
            creditsUsed: 1,
          })
          .returning({ id: amazonSyncSnapshots.id });

        totalCredits += 1;

        // Only compute/store discrepancies for the primary provider (first in list)
        // For "both" mode, rainforest is the primary discrepancy source
        if (prov === providers[0]) {
          // Delete old discrepancies for this product
          await db
            .delete(amazonSyncDiscrepancies)
            .where(eq(amazonSyncDiscrepancies.productId, row.id));

          const discs = computeDiscrepancies(fullProduct, rainforestProduct);
          if (discs.length > 0) {
            await db.insert(amazonSyncDiscrepancies).values(
              discs.map((d) => ({
                snapshotId: snapshot.id,
                productId: row.id,
                clientIdCode,
                asin: row.asin!,
                fieldName: d.field_name,
                fieldGroup: d.field_group,
                catalogValue: d.catalog_value,
                amazonValue: d.amazon_value,
                status: d.status,
              }))
            );
          }

          results.push({
            product_id: row.id,
            asin: row.asin,
            provider: prov,
            status: "success",
            discrepancies_count: discs.filter((d) => d.status !== "match").length,
          });
        } else {
          results.push({
            product_id: row.id,
            asin: row.asin,
            provider: prov,
            status: "success",
            discrepancies_count: 0,
          });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        results.push({
          product_id: row.id,
          asin: row.asin ?? "",
          provider: prov,
          status: "failed",
          discrepancies_count: 0,
          error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error",
        });
      }
    }

    // Update run progress if tracking
    if (run_id) {
      await db
        .update(amazonSyncRuns)
        .set({
          completedProducts: results.filter((r) => r.status === "success").length,
          failedProducts: results.filter((r) => r.status === "failed").length,
          creditsUsed: totalCredits,
        })
        .where(eq(amazonSyncRuns.id, run_id));
    }
  }

  return NextResponse.json({
    success: true,
    results,
    credits_used: totalCredits,
    provider: providerChoice,
  });
}

FILE: src/app/api/amazon-sync/run/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, amazonSyncRuns } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and, isNotNull, ne, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";

export const maxDuration = 60;

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const { client_id: clientIdCode, amazon_domain = "amazon.com" } = body as {
    client_id: string;
    amazon_domain?: string;
  };

  if (!clientIdCode) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "client_id is required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Get all non-parent products with ASINs for this client
  const clientProducts = await db
    .select({ id: master.id, asin: master.asin })
    .from(master)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(master.clientIdCode, clientIdCode),
        eq(master.status, "Active"),
        isNotNull(master.asin),
        ne(master.asin, ""),
        sql`lower(${master.parentageLevel}) != 'parent'`
      )
    );

  if (clientProducts.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "No products with ASINs found for this client" },
      { status: 404 }
    );
  }

  // Create run record
  const [run] = await db
    .insert(amazonSyncRuns)
    .values({
      clientIdCode,
      runType: "manual",
      status: "running",
      totalProducts: clientProducts.length,
      startedAt: new Date(),
    })
    .returning();

  // Process in batches of 5
  const batchSize = 5;
  const productIds = clientProducts.map((p) => p.id);
  let totalCredits = 0;
  let totalCompleted = 0;
  let totalFailed = 0;

  try {
    for (let i = 0; i < productIds.length; i += batchSize) {
      const batch = productIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);

      const baseUrl = req.nextUrl.origin;
      const fetchRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/amazon-sync/fetch`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          cookie: req.headers.get("cookie") || "",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          product_ids: batch,
          client_id: clientIdCode,
          amazon_domain,
          run_id: run.id,
        }),
      });

      if (fetchRes.ok) {
        const data = await fetchRes.json();
        totalCredits += data.credits_used || 0;
        totalCompleted += data.results?.filter(
          (r: { status: string }) => r.status === "success"
        ).length ?? 0;
        totalFailed += data.results?.filter(
          (r: { status: string }) => r.status === "failed"
        ).length ?? 0;
      } else {
        totalFailed += batch.length;
      }
    }

    // Mark run complete
    await db
      .update(amazonSyncRuns)
      .set({
        status: "completed",
        completedProducts: totalCompleted,
        failedProducts: totalFailed,
        creditsUsed: totalCredits,
        completedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(amazonSyncRuns.id, run.id));

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      run_id: run.id,
      total_products: clientProducts.length,
      completed: totalCompleted,
      failed: totalFailed,
      credits_used: totalCredits,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    await db
      .update(amazonSyncRuns)
      .set({
        status: "failed",
        errorMessage:
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error",
        completedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(amazonSyncRuns.id, run.id));

    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Sync run failed" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { seoSettings } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const PROVIDER_KEY = "amazon_sync_provider";
const VALID_PROVIDERS = ["rainforest", "firecrawl"] as const;
export type SyncProvider = (typeof VALID_PROVIDERS)[number];

// GET — return current provider setting
export async function GET() {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const [row] = await db
    .select()
    .from(seoSettings)
    .where(eq(seoSettings.key, PROVIDER_KEY))
    .limit(1);

  return NextResponse.json({
    provider: (row?.value as SyncProvider) || "rainforest",
  });
}

// PUT — update provider (admin only)
export async function PUT(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Admin only" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const { provider } = body as { provider: string };

  if (!VALID_PROVIDERS.includes(provider as SyncProvider)) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `Invalid provider. Must be one of: ${VALID_PROVIDERS.join(", ")}` },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  await db
    .insert(seoSettings)
    .values({
      key: PROVIDER_KEY,
      value: provider,
      updatedAt: new Date(),
      updatedBy: session.user.email ?? "",
    })
    .onConflictDoUpdate({
      target: seoSettings.key,
      set: {
        value: provider,
        updatedAt: new Date(),
        updatedBy: session.user.email ?? "",
      },
    });

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true, provider });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { amazonSyncSnapshots } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, desc } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";

export const maxDuration = 60;

export async function GET(
  _req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ productId: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { productId } = await params;

  // Get latest snapshot
  const [latest] = await db
    .select()
    .from(amazonSyncSnapshots)
    .where(eq(amazonSyncSnapshots.productId, productId))
    .orderBy(desc(amazonSyncSnapshots.fetchedAt))
    .limit(1);

  if (!latest) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "No snapshot found" },
      { status: 404 }
    );
  }

  // Get all snapshots for history
  const history = await db
    .select({
      id: amazonSyncSnapshots.id,
      fetchedAt: amazonSyncSnapshots.fetchedAt,
      creditsUsed: amazonSyncSnapshots.creditsUsed,
    })
    .from(amazonSyncSnapshots)
    .where(eq(amazonSyncSnapshots.productId, productId))
    .orderBy(desc(amazonSyncSnapshots.fetchedAt))
    .limit(30);

  return NextResponse.json({
    snapshot: latest,
    history,
  });
}

FILE: src/app/api/amazon-sync/summary/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  amazonSyncDiscrepancies,
  amazonSyncSnapshots,
  amazonSyncRuns,
  master,
  aac,
} from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, sql, and, ne, desc } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";

export const maxDuration = 60;

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const clientIdCode = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("client_id");

  // Discrepancy summary per client
  const discBySummary = await db
    .select({
      clientIdCode: amazonSyncDiscrepancies.clientIdCode,
      total: sql<number>`count(*)`,
      mismatches: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${amazonSyncDiscrepancies.status} != 'match')`,
      unresolved: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${amazonSyncDiscrepancies.status} != 'match' and ${amazonSyncDiscrepancies.resolved} = false)`,
    })
    .from(amazonSyncDiscrepancies)
    .groupBy(amazonSyncDiscrepancies.clientIdCode);

  // Last sync per client
  const lastSyncs = await db
    .select({
      clientIdCode: amazonSyncRuns.clientIdCode,
      lastSync: sql<string>`max(${amazonSyncRuns.completedAt})`,
    })
    .from(amazonSyncRuns)
    .where(eq(amazonSyncRuns.status, "completed"))
    .groupBy(amazonSyncRuns.clientIdCode);

  // Get active client codes from AAC table
  const activeClients = await db
    .select({ clientIdCode: aac.clientIdCode })
    .from(aac)
    .where(eq(aac.clientStatus, "Active"));
  const activeClientCodes = new Set(activeClients.map((c) => c.clientIdCode));

  // Product counts with ASINs per client (active only)
  const productCounts = await db
    .select({
      clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode,
      count: sql<number>`count(*)`,
    })
    .from(master)
    .where(sql`${master.asin} IS NOT NULL AND ${master.asin} != '' AND ${master.status} = 'Active' AND lower(${master.parentageLevel}) != 'parent'`)
    .groupBy(master.clientIdCode)
    .then((rows) => rows.filter((r) => r.clientIdCode && activeClientCodes.has(r.clientIdCode)));

  // If client_id specified, get per-product summary
  let productSummary: Array<{
    productId: string;
    asin: string;
    sku: string | null;
    title: string | null;
    parentageLevel: string | null;
    parentAsin: string | null;
    lastSynced: string | null;
    mismatches: number;
    thumbnailUrl: string | null;
  }> = [];

  if (clientIdCode) {
    const perProduct = await db
      .select({
        productId: master.id,
        asin: master.asin,
        sku: master.sku,
        title: master.itemName,
        thumbnailUrl: master.mainImageUrl,
        parentageLevel: master.parentageLevel,
        parentAsin: master.parentAsin,
      })
      .from(master)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(master.clientIdCode, clientIdCode),
          eq(master.status, "Active"),
          sql`${master.asin} IS NOT NULL AND ${master.asin} != ''`,
          sql`lower(${master.parentageLevel}) != 'parent'`
        )
      );

    // Get last snapshot + discrepancy counts per product
    for (const p of perProduct) {
      const [lastSnapshot] = await db
        .select({ fetchedAt: amazonSyncSnapshots.fetchedAt })
        .from(amazonSyncSnapshots)
        .where(eq(amazonSyncSnapshots.productId, p.productId))
        .orderBy(desc(amazonSyncSnapshots.fetchedAt))
        .limit(1);

      const [discCount] = await db
        .select({
          count: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${amazonSyncDiscrepancies.status} != 'match' and ${amazonSyncDiscrepancies.resolved} = false)`,
        })
        .from(amazonSyncDiscrepancies)
        .where(eq(amazonSyncDiscrepancies.productId, p.productId));

      productSummary.push({
        productId: p.productId,
        asin: p.asin ?? "",
        sku: p.sku ?? null,
        title: p.title,
        parentageLevel: p.parentageLevel ?? null,
        parentAsin: p.parentAsin ?? null,
        lastSynced: lastSnapshot?.fetchedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
        mismatches: Number(discCount?.count ?? 0),
        thumbnailUrl: p.thumbnailUrl,
      });
    }
  }

  return NextResponse.json({
    clients: discBySummary.map((d) => ({
      clientIdCode: d.clientIdCode,
      totalFields: Number(d.total),
      mismatches: Number(d.mismatches),
      unresolved: Number(d.unresolved),
      lastSync:
        lastSyncs.find((s) => s.clientIdCode === d.clientIdCode)?.lastSync ??
        null,
      productCount:
        Number(
          productCounts.find((c) => c.clientIdCode === d.clientIdCode)
            ?.count ?? 0
        ),
    })),
    allClients: productCounts.map((c) => ({
      clientIdCode: c.clientIdCode,
      productCount: Number(c.count),
      lastSync:
        lastSyncs.find((s) => s.clientIdCode === c.clientIdCode)?.lastSync ??
        null,
      unresolved: Number(
        discBySummary.find((d) => d.clientIdCode === c.clientIdCode)
          ?.unresolved ?? 0
      ),
    })),
    products: productSummary,
  });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, aplusModules, aplusModuleImages, aplusSets } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, asc, inArray } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";

export const maxDuration = 60;

/** Retry a fn up to `n` times on CONNECTION_CLOSED / CONNECTION_ENDED errors */
async function withRetry<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>, retries = 2): Promise<T> {
  for (let i = 0; i <= retries; i++) {
    try {
      return await fn();
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const code = (err as { cause?: { code?: string } })?.cause?.code;
      if (i < retries && (code === "CONNECTION_CLOSED" || code === "CONNECTION_ENDED")) {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200 * (i + 1)));
        continue;
      }
      throw err;
    }
  }
  throw new Error("Unreachable");
}

export async function GET(
  _req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ productId: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  if (!canAccessSection(session, "aplus")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { productId } = await params;

  try {

  // Fetch the product row for the page header
  const [product] = await withRetry(() =>
    db
      .select({
        id: master.id,
        name: master.itemName,
        asin: master.asin,
        clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode,
        marketplace: master.marketplace,
      })
      .from(master)
      .where(eq(master.id, productId))
      .limit(1)
  );

  if (!product) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Product not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  // Fetch or auto-create the A+ set config
  let [setConfig] = await withRetry(() =>
    db
      .select()
      .from(aplusSets)
      .where(eq(aplusSets.productId, productId))
      .limit(1)
  );

  if (!setConfig) {
    [setConfig] = await withRetry(() =>
      db
        .insert(aplusSets)
        .values({
          productId,
          scopeType: "ASIN",
          scopeIdentifier: product.asin || productId,
          platform: "SC",
          contentType: "PA+",
          version: 1,
        })
        .returning()
    );
  }

  // Fetch all modules for this product ordered by moduleNumber
  const modules = await withRetry(() =>
    db
      .select()
      .from(aplusModules)
      .where(eq(aplusModules.productId, productId))
      .orderBy(asc(aplusModules.moduleNumber))
  );

  // Fetch all images for these modules in one query
  let images: (typeof aplusModuleImages.$inferSelect)[] = [];
  if (modules.length > 0) {
    const moduleIds = modules.map((m) => m.id);
    images = await withRetry(() =>
      db
        .select()
        .from(aplusModuleImages)
        .where(inArray(aplusModuleImages.moduleId, moduleIds))
        .orderBy(asc(aplusModuleImages.imageSlot))
    );
  }

  // Attach images to their parent modules
  const imagesByModuleId = images.reduce<
    Record<string, (typeof aplusModuleImages.$inferSelect)[]>
  >((acc, img) => {
    if (!acc[img.moduleId]) acc[img.moduleId] = [];
    acc[img.moduleId].push(img);
    return acc;
  }, {});

  const modulesWithImages = modules.map((m) => ({
    ...m,
    images: imagesByModuleId[m.id] ?? [],
  }));

  return NextResponse.json({
    product,
    modules: modulesWithImages,
    setConfig: {
      id: setConfig.id,
      scopeType: setConfig.scopeType,
      scopeIdentifier: setConfig.scopeIdentifier,
      platform: setConfig.platform,
      contentType: setConfig.contentType,
      version: setConfig.version,
      groupNumber: setConfig.groupNumber,
      parentAsin: setConfig.parentAsin,
      coveredAsins: setConfig.coveredAsins,
    },
  });

  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[aplus GET] Error:", err);
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to load A+ content", detail: message },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { aplusModules, activityLog, master } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and, isNotNull } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const ALLOWED_STATUSES = ["draft", "in_review", "approved", "uploaded"] as const;
const ADMIN_ONLY_STATUSES = ["approved", "uploaded"] as const;

type AllowedStatus = (typeof ALLOWED_STATUSES)[number];

export async function PATCH(
  req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ productId: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  if (!canAccessSection(session, "aplus")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const role = session.user.role;
  if (role !== "editor" && role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { productId } = await params;

  try {

  const body = await req.json();
  const { status } = body as { status: string };

  if (!ALLOWED_STATUSES.includes(status as AllowedStatus)) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `Invalid status. Must be one of: ${ALLOWED_STATUSES.join(", ")}` },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  if (
    ADMIN_ONLY_STATUSES.includes(status as "approved" | "uploaded") &&
    role !== "admin"
  ) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Only admins can set status to approved or uploaded" },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }

  const updated = await db
    .update(aplusModules)
    .set({ status: status as AllowedStatus, updatedAt: new Date() })
    .where(
      and(
        eq(aplusModules.productId, productId),
        isNotNull(aplusModules.moduleType)
      )
    )
    .returning({ id: aplusModules.id });

  // Log bulk status change
  if (updated.length > 0) {
    const [product] = await db
      .select({ asin: master.asin, sku: master.sku, clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode })
      .from(master)
      .where(eq(master.id, productId))
      .limit(1);

    await db.insert(activityLog).values({
      productId,
      asin: product?.asin ?? null,
      sku: product?.sku ?? null,
      clientIdCode: product?.clientIdCode ?? null,
      itemName: null,
      fieldLabel: "A+ Bulk Status",
      bqName: "aplus_bulk_status",
      oldValue: null,
      newValue: `${status} (${updated.length} modules)`,
      changedBy: session.user.email ?? "",
      editType: "aplus",
    });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ updated: updated.length });

  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[aplus bulk-status PATCH] Error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Failed to update statuses" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { aplusComments, master, users } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, desc, and, sql, isNull, ne, inArray } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { sendEmail, buildAplusCommentEmail } from "@/lib/email";

export const maxDuration = 60;

// GET — fetch all comments for a product
export async function GET(
  _req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ productId: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (!canAccessSection(session, "aplus")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { productId } = await params;

  try {

  const role = session.user.role;
  const userClientIdCode = (session.user as { clientIdCode?: string | null }).clientIdCode ?? null;

  // Client users only see client-audience comments matching their clientIdCode
  const conditions = [eq(aplusComments.productId, productId)];
  if (role === "client") {
    conditions.push(eq(aplusComments.audience, "client"));
    if (userClientIdCode) {
      conditions.push(eq(aplusComments.clientIdCode, userClientIdCode));
    } else {
      // Client with no clientIdCode sees nothing
      return NextResponse.json({ comments: [] });
    }
  }

  const comments = await db
    .select()
    .from(aplusComments)
    .where(and(...conditions))
    .orderBy(desc(aplusComments.createdAt));

  return NextResponse.json({ comments });

  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[aplus comments GET] Error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Failed to load comments" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// POST — create a new comment
export async function POST(
  req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ productId: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (!canAccessSection(session, "aplus")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { productId } = await params;
  const body = await req.json();

  const { moduleId, parentCommentId, body: commentBody, pinX, pinY, audience: requestAudience } = body;

  if (!commentBody?.trim()) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Comment body is required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Auto-increment comment number for top-level comments
  let commentNumber: number | null = null;
  if (!parentCommentId) {
    const [maxResult] = await db
      .select({ max: sql<number>`COALESCE(MAX(comment_number), 0)` })
      .from(aplusComments)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(aplusComments.productId, productId),
          sql`parent_comment_id IS NULL`
        )
      );
    commentNumber = (maxResult?.max ?? 0) + 1;
  }

  // Determine audience + clientIdCode
  const postRole = session.user.role;
  const postUserClientIdCode = (session.user as { clientIdCode?: string | null }).clientIdCode ?? null;

  let commentAudience: string;
  let commentClientIdCode: string | null;

  if (postRole === "client") {
    // Client users always post as "client"
    commentAudience = "client";
    commentClientIdCode = postUserClientIdCode;
  } else {
    // Internal users: default "internal", but allow "client" when replying to client threads
    commentAudience = requestAudience === "client" ? "client" : "internal";
    commentClientIdCode = requestAudience === "client" ? (body.clientIdCode ?? null) : null;
  }

  try {
    const [comment] = await db
      .insert(aplusComments)
      .values({
        productId,
        moduleId: moduleId || null,
        parentCommentId: parentCommentId || null,
        authorEmail: session.user.email ?? "",
        authorName: session.user.name ?? null,
        body: commentBody.trim(),
        pinX: pinX != null ? Math.round(pinX) : null,
        pinY: pinY != null ? Math.round(pinY) : null,
        commentNumber,
        audience: commentAudience,
        clientIdCode: commentClientIdCode,
      })
      .returning();

    // Fire-and-forget email notification to admins/editors (don't block response)
    (async () => {
      try {
        const [product] = await db
          .select({ name: master.itemName })
          .from(master)
          .where(eq(master.id, productId))
          .limit(1);

        // Notify admins and editors (except the comment author)
        const recipients = await db
          .select({ email: users.email })
          .from(users)
          .where(
            and(
              inArray(users.role, ["admin", "editor"]),
              ne(users.email, session.user.email ?? "")
            )
          );

        const emailContent = buildAplusCommentEmail({
          authorName: session.user.name ?? null,
          authorEmail: session.user.email ?? "",
          productName: product?.name ?? "Unknown product",
          productId,
          body: commentBody.trim(),
          audience: commentAudience,
          commentNumber,
        });

        for (const r of recipients) {
          await sendEmail({ to: r.email, ...emailContent });
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("[comments POST] Notification error:", err);
      }
    })();

    return NextResponse.json({ comment }, { status: 201 });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    console.error("[comments POST] Insert error:", msg, err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to create comment" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { aplusComments } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";

export const maxDuration = 60;

// PATCH — update comment (resolve/reopen/edit body)
export async function PATCH(
  req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ productId: string; commentId: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (!canAccessSection(session, "aplus")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { commentId } = await params;

  try {

  const body = await req.json();
  const role = session.user.role;
  const userEmail = session.user.email ?? "";

  // Fetch comment to check ownership
  const [existing] = await db
    .select({ authorEmail: aplusComments.authorEmail })
    .from(aplusComments)
    .where(eq(aplusComments.id, commentId))
    .limit(1);

  if (!existing) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Comment not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  // Only the author, editors, or admins can modify a comment
  const isOwner = existing.authorEmail === userEmail;
  if (!isOwner && role !== "editor" && role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "You can only edit your own comments" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const updates: Record<string, unknown> = {};

  if (body.status === "resolved") {
    updates.status = "resolved";
    updates.resolvedBy = userEmail;
    updates.resolvedAt = new Date();
  } else if (body.status === "active") {
    updates.status = "active";
    updates.resolvedBy = null;
    updates.resolvedAt = null;
  }

  if (body.body !== undefined) {
    updates.body = body.body.trim();
  }

  updates.updatedAt = new Date();

  const [updated] = await db
    .update(aplusComments)
    .set(updates)
    .where(eq(aplusComments.id, commentId))
    .returning();

  return NextResponse.json({ comment: updated });

  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[aplus comment PATCH] Error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Failed to update comment" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// DELETE — remove a comment
export async function DELETE(
  _req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ productId: string; commentId: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (!canAccessSection(session, "aplus")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { commentId } = await params;

  try {

  const role = session.user.role;
  const userEmail = session.user.email ?? "";

  // Fetch comment to check ownership
  const [existing] = await db
    .select({ authorEmail: aplusComments.authorEmail })
    .from(aplusComments)
    .where(eq(aplusComments.id, commentId))
    .limit(1);

  if (!existing) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Comment not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  // Only the author or admins can delete a comment
  const isOwner = existing.authorEmail === userEmail;
  if (!isOwner && role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "You can only delete your own comments" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  await db
    .delete(aplusComments)
    .where(eq(aplusComments.id, commentId));

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true });

  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[aplus comment DELETE] Error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Failed to delete comment" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: src/app/api/aplus/[productId]/compare/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  master,
  aplusModules,
  aplusModuleImages,
  amazonSyncSnapshots,
} from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, asc, inArray, and, desc } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import type { RainforestProduct } from "@/types/rainforest";

export const maxDuration = 60;

// Normalize text for comparison: lowercase + trim whitespace
function normalizeText(text: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!text) return "";
  return text.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
}

export async function GET(
  _req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ productId: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  if (!canAccessSection(session, "aplus")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { productId } = await params;

  // 1. Fetch the product
  const [product] = await db
    .select({
      id: master.id,
      asin: master.asin,
      itemName: master.itemName,
      clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode,
    })
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.id, productId))
    .limit(1);

  if (!product) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Product not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  // 2. Fetch all modules for this product
  const moduleRows = await db
    .select()
    .from(aplusModules)
    .where(eq(aplusModules.productId, productId))
    .orderBy(asc(aplusModules.moduleNumber));

  // 3. Fetch all module images
  const moduleIds = moduleRows.map((m) => m.id);
  const imageRows =
    moduleIds.length > 0
      ? await db
          .select()
          .from(aplusModuleImages)
          .where(inArray(aplusModuleImages.moduleId, moduleIds))
          .orderBy(asc(aplusModuleImages.imageSlot))
      : [];

  // 4. Fetch the latest Rainforest snapshot for this product
  const [snapshot] = await db
    .select()
    .from(amazonSyncSnapshots)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(amazonSyncSnapshots.productId, productId),
        eq(amazonSyncSnapshots.provider, "rainforest")
      )
    )
    .orderBy(desc(amazonSyncSnapshots.fetchedAt))
    .limit(1);

  const hasSnapshot = !!snapshot;

  // 5. Extract Amazon A+ images from snapshot
  const snapshotData = snapshot?.snapshotData as RainforestProduct | undefined;
  const hasAmazonAplus =
    hasSnapshot && (snapshotData?.a_plus_content?.has_a_plus_content ?? false);
  const amazonImages: { link: string; name: string }[] =
    snapshotData?.a_plus_content?.all_images ?? [];
  const amazonImageCount = hasSnapshot ? amazonImages.length : null;

  // 6. Build a map from moduleId -> moduleNumber
  const moduleNumberMap = new Map<string, number>(
    moduleRows.map((m) => [m.id, m.moduleNumber])
  );

  // 7. Build imageDiff array
  type DiffStatus = "match" | "mismatch" | "hub_only" | "amazon_only";
  type DiffEntry = {
    slot: string;
    hubAltText: string | null;
    amazonAltText: string | null;
    status: DiffStatus;
  };

  const diffEntries: DiffEntry[] = [];
  const matchedAmazonIndices = new Set<number>();

  for (const image of imageRows) {
    const moduleNumber = moduleNumberMap.get(image.moduleId) ?? 0;
    const slot = `module_${moduleNumber}/image_${image.imageSlot}`;
    const hubAltText = image.altText ?? null;
    const normalizedHub = normalizeText(hubAltText);

    if (!hasSnapshot) {
      diffEntries.push({
        slot,
        hubAltText,
        amazonAltText: null,
        status: "hub_only",
      });
      continue;
    }

    // Find best Amazon match by normalized text
    let bestMatchIdx = -1;
    if (normalizedHub) {
      for (let i = 0; i < amazonImages.length; i++) {
        if (matchedAmazonIndices.has(i)) continue;
        if (normalizeText(amazonImages[i].name) === normalizedHub) {
          bestMatchIdx = i;
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    if (bestMatchIdx >= 0) {
      matchedAmazonIndices.add(bestMatchIdx);
      diffEntries.push({
        slot,
        hubAltText,
        amazonAltText: amazonImages[bestMatchIdx].name,
        status: "match",
      });
    } else {
      // No match found
      const amazonAltText =
        hasAmazonAplus && amazonImages.length > 0
          ? null // Amazon has A+ but no matching alt text
          : null;
      diffEntries.push({
        slot,
        hubAltText,
        amazonAltText,
        status: hasAmazonAplus ? "mismatch" : "hub_only",
      });
    }
  }

  // Add Amazon-only entries (images in Amazon snapshot not matched to any Hub image)
  for (let i = 0; i < amazonImages.length; i++) {
    if (!matchedAmazonIndices.has(i)) {
      diffEntries.push({
        slot: `amazon_only/${i + 1}`,
        hubAltText: null,
        amazonAltText: amazonImages[i].name || null,
        status: "amazon_only",
      });
    }
  }

  // 8. Compute match rate
  const hubImageCount = imageRows.length;
  const matchCount = diffEntries.filter((e) => e.status === "match").length;
  const matchRate =
    hubImageCount > 0 ? Math.round((matchCount / hubImageCount) * 100) : 0;

  return NextResponse.json({
    product: {
      id: product.id,
      asin: product.asin,
      name: product.itemName,
    },
    snapshotFetchedAt: snapshot?.fetchedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
    hubImageCount,
    amazonImageCount,
    hasSnapshot,
    hasAmazonAplus,
    imageDiff: diffEntries,
    matchRate,
  });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { aplusModules, aplusModuleImages, master, activityLog } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import {
  APLUS_MODULE_TYPES,
  APLUS_MODULE_SPECS,
  type AplusModuleType,
} from "@/lib/aplus-module-specs";

export const maxDuration = 60;

export async function POST(
  req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ productId: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  if (!canAccessSection(session, "aplus")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const role = session.user.role;
  if (role !== "editor" && role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { productId } = await params;

  try {

  const body = await req.json();
  const { moduleType, moduleNumber } = body as {
    moduleType: string;
    moduleNumber: number;
  };

  // Validate moduleType
  if (!APLUS_MODULE_TYPES.includes(moduleType as AplusModuleType)) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Invalid moduleType" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Validate moduleNumber is 1-7
  if (
    typeof moduleNumber !== "number" ||
    moduleNumber < 1 ||
    moduleNumber > 7 ||
    !Number.isInteger(moduleNumber)
  ) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "moduleNumber must be an integer between 1 and 7" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Check that moduleNumber is not already taken for this product
  const existing = await db
    .select({ id: aplusModules.id })
    .from(aplusModules)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(aplusModules.productId, productId),
        eq(aplusModules.moduleNumber, moduleNumber)
      )
    )
    .limit(1);

  if (existing.length > 0) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `Module number ${moduleNumber} is already taken for this product` },
      { status: 409 }
    );
  }

  // Insert the module
  const [module] = await db
    .insert(aplusModules)
    .values({
      productId,
      moduleNumber,
      moduleType: moduleType as AplusModuleType,
      status: "draft",
    })
    .returning();

  // Auto-create image stub rows for each slot in the module spec
  const spec = APLUS_MODULE_SPECS[moduleType as AplusModuleType];
  let images: (typeof aplusModuleImages.$inferSelect)[] = [];

  // Look up product for clientIdCode/asin/sku to populate image rows
  const [product] = await db
    .select({
      clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode,
      asin: master.asin,
      sku: master.sku,
    })
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.id, productId))
    .limit(1);

  const imageRows: Array<{
    moduleId: string;
    imageSlot: number;
    customLabel: string;
    clientIdCode: string | null;
    asin: string | null;
    sku: string | null;
  }> = [];

  // Standard image slots
  for (let idx = 0; idx < spec.imageSlots.length; idx++) {
    imageRows.push({
      moduleId: module.id,
      imageSlot: idx + 1,
      customLabel: spec.imageSlots[idx].key,
      clientIdCode: product?.clientIdCode ?? null,
      asin: product?.asin ?? null,
      sku: product?.sku ?? null,
    });
  }

  // Repeatable group panel images (create min items)
  if (spec.repeatableGroup?.image) {
    const rg = spec.repeatableGroup;
    const baseSlot = spec.imageSlots.length + 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < rg.minItems; i++) {
      imageRows.push({
        moduleId: module.id,
        imageSlot: baseSlot + i,
        customLabel: `panel_${i + 1}_${rg.image!.key}`,
        clientIdCode: product?.clientIdCode ?? null,
        asin: product?.asin ?? null,
        sku: product?.sku ?? null,
      });
    }
  }

  if (imageRows.length > 0) {
    images = await db.insert(aplusModuleImages).values(imageRows).returning();
  }

  // Log activity
  await db.insert(activityLog).values({
    productId,
    asin: product?.asin ?? null,
    sku: product?.sku ?? null,
    clientIdCode: product?.clientIdCode ?? null,
    itemName: null,
    fieldLabel: `A+ Module ${moduleNumber}`,
    bqName: `aplus_module_${moduleNumber}`,
    oldValue: null,
    newValue: moduleType,
    changedBy: session.user.email ?? "",
    editType: "aplus",
  });

  return NextResponse.json({ ...module, images }, { status: 201 });

  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[aplus modules POST] Error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to create module" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { aplusModules, activityLog, master } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const EDITOR_ALLOWED_STATUSES = ["draft", "in_review"] as const;
const ADMIN_ONLY_STATUSES = ["approved", "uploaded"] as const;
const ALL_ALLOWED_STATUSES = [
  ...EDITOR_ALLOWED_STATUSES,
  ...ADMIN_ONLY_STATUSES,
] as const;

type AllowedStatus = (typeof ALL_ALLOWED_STATUSES)[number];

const TEXT_FIELDS = [
  "headlineText",
  "subheadlineText",
  "bodyText",
  "altText",
  "overlayText",
  "imageDescription",
  "aiImagePrompt",
  "cosmoRelationType",
  "figmaUrl",
  "markupUrl",
  "videoDriveFileId",
  "videoTitle",
  "videoDescription",
  "textPosition",
  "fontColor",
] as const;

export async function PATCH(
  req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ productId: string; moduleId: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  if (!canAccessSection(session, "aplus")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const role = session.user.role;
  if (role !== "editor" && role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { productId, moduleId } = await params;

  try {

  const body = await req.json();

  // Build whitelisted update object
  const updates: Record<string, unknown> = {};

  for (const field of TEXT_FIELDS) {
    if (field in body) {
      updates[field] = body[field];
    }
  }

  // Handle status field with role check
  if ("status" in body) {
    const newStatus = body.status as string;
    if (!ALL_ALLOWED_STATUSES.includes(newStatus as AllowedStatus)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: `Invalid status value: ${newStatus}` },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }
    if (
      ADMIN_ONLY_STATUSES.includes(newStatus as "approved" | "uploaded") &&
      role !== "admin"
    ) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Only admins can set status to approved or uploaded" },
        { status: 403 }
      );
    }
    updates.status = newStatus;
  }

  if (Object.keys(updates).length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "No valid fields to update" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Fetch current module for logging
  const [current] = await db
    .select({
      moduleNumber: aplusModules.moduleNumber,
      status: aplusModules.status,
      moduleType: aplusModules.moduleType,
    })
    .from(aplusModules)
    .where(and(eq(aplusModules.id, moduleId), eq(aplusModules.productId, productId)))
    .limit(1);

  if (!current) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Module not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  updates.updatedAt = new Date();

  const [updated] = await db
    .update(aplusModules)
    .set(updates)
    .where(
      and(eq(aplusModules.id, moduleId), eq(aplusModules.productId, productId))
    )
    .returning();

  // Log status changes to activity log
  if ("status" in updates && updates.status !== current.status) {
    const [product] = await db
      .select({ asin: master.asin, sku: master.sku, clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode })
      .from(master)
      .where(eq(master.id, productId))
      .limit(1);

    await db.insert(activityLog).values({
      productId,
      asin: product?.asin ?? null,
      sku: product?.sku ?? null,
      clientIdCode: product?.clientIdCode ?? null,
      itemName: null,
      fieldLabel: `A+ Module ${current.moduleNumber} Status`,
      bqName: `aplus_module_${current.moduleNumber}_status`,
      oldValue: current.status,
      newValue: String(updates.status),
      changedBy: session.user.email ?? "",
      editType: "aplus",
    });
  }

  return NextResponse.json(updated);

  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[aplus module PATCH] Error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to update module" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

export async function DELETE(
  _req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ productId: string; moduleId: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  if (!canAccessSection(session, "aplus")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const role = session.user.role;
  if (role !== "editor" && role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { productId, moduleId } = await params;

  try {

  // Fetch module info before deletion for logging
  const [toDelete] = await db
    .select({ moduleNumber: aplusModules.moduleNumber, moduleType: aplusModules.moduleType })
    .from(aplusModules)
    .where(and(eq(aplusModules.id, moduleId), eq(aplusModules.productId, productId)))
    .limit(1);

  if (!toDelete) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Module not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  await db
    .delete(aplusModules)
    .where(
      and(eq(aplusModules.id, moduleId), eq(aplusModules.productId, productId))
    );

  // Log deletion
  const [product] = await db
    .select({ asin: master.asin, sku: master.sku, clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode })
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.id, productId))
    .limit(1);

  await db.insert(activityLog).values({
    productId,
    asin: product?.asin ?? null,
    sku: product?.sku ?? null,
    clientIdCode: product?.clientIdCode ?? null,
    itemName: null,
    fieldLabel: `A+ Module ${toDelete.moduleNumber}`,
    bqName: `aplus_module_${toDelete.moduleNumber}_deleted`,
    oldValue: toDelete.moduleType,
    newValue: null,
    changedBy: session.user.email ?? "",
    editType: "aplus",
  });

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });

  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[aplus module DELETE] Error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to delete module" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
