async function requireEditor() {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) return null;
  if (!canAccessSection(session, "aplus")) return null;
  const role = session.user.role;
  if (role !== "editor" && role !== "admin") return null;
  return session;
}

export async function POST(
  req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ productId: string; moduleId: string }> }
) {
  const session = await requireEditor();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { moduleId } = await params;
  const body = await req.json();

  const { imageSlot, customLabel, driveFileId, panelData } = body as {
    imageSlot: number;
    customLabel?: string;
    driveFileId?: string;
    panelData?: Record<string, string>;
  };

  if (typeof imageSlot !== "number") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "imageSlot is required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const [created] = await db
    .insert(aplusModuleImages)
    .values({
      moduleId,
      imageSlot,
      customLabel: customLabel ?? null,
      driveFileId: driveFileId ?? null,
      panelData: panelData ?? null,
    })
    .onConflictDoUpdate({
      target: [aplusModuleImages.moduleId, aplusModuleImages.imageSlot],
      set: {
        ...(driveFileId !== undefined ? { driveFileId: driveFileId ?? null } : {}),
        ...(panelData !== undefined ? { panelData: panelData ?? null } : {}),
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      },
    })
    .returning();

  return NextResponse.json(created, { status: 201 });
}

export async function PATCH(
  req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ productId: string; moduleId: string }> }
) {
  const session = await requireEditor();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { moduleId } = await params;
  const body = await req.json();

  const { imageSlot, panelData } = body as {
    imageSlot: number;
    panelData: Record<string, string>;
  };

  if (typeof imageSlot !== "number") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "imageSlot is required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const [updated] = await db
    .update(aplusModuleImages)
    .set({ panelData, updatedAt: new Date() })
    .where(
      and(
        eq(aplusModuleImages.moduleId, moduleId),
        eq(aplusModuleImages.imageSlot, imageSlot)
      )
    )
    .returning();

  if (!updated) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Image slot not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  return NextResponse.json(updated);
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { aplusModules, aplusModuleImages, master } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import {
  APLUS_MODULE_SPECS,
  type AplusModuleType,
} from "@/lib/aplus-module-specs";

export const maxDuration = 60;

// POST — add a new panel image row
export async function POST(
  _req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ productId: string; moduleId: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (!canAccessSection(session, "aplus")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }
  const role = session.user.role;
  if (role !== "editor" && role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { productId, moduleId } = await params;

  try {

  // Get module to determine type and spec
  const [mod] = await db
    .select()
    .from(aplusModules)
    .where(and(eq(aplusModules.id, moduleId), eq(aplusModules.productId, productId)))
    .limit(1);

  if (!mod) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Module not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  const spec = APLUS_MODULE_SPECS[mod.moduleType as AplusModuleType];
  if (!spec.repeatableGroup?.image) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Module type has no panel images" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const rg = spec.repeatableGroup;

  // Count existing panel images
  const existingImages = await db
    .select()
    .from(aplusModuleImages)
    .where(eq(aplusModuleImages.moduleId, moduleId));

  const panelImages = existingImages.filter((img) =>
    img.customLabel?.startsWith("panel_")
  );

  if (panelImages.length >= rg.maxItems) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `Maximum ${rg.maxItems} panels allowed` },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Find next slot number
  const maxSlot = existingImages.reduce((max, img) => Math.max(max, img.imageSlot), 0);
  const panelNumber = panelImages.length + 1;

  // Get product info for image row
  const [product] = await db
    .select({
      clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode,
      asin: master.asin,
      sku: master.sku,
    })
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.id, productId))
    .limit(1);

  const [newImage] = await db
    .insert(aplusModuleImages)
    .values({
      moduleId,
      imageSlot: maxSlot + 1,
      customLabel: `panel_${panelNumber}_${rg.image!.key}`,
      clientIdCode: product?.clientIdCode ?? null,
      asin: product?.asin ?? null,
      sku: product?.sku ?? null,
    })
    .returning();

  return NextResponse.json({ image: newImage }, { status: 201 });

  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[aplus panels POST] Error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Failed to add panel" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// DELETE — remove the last panel image row
export async function DELETE(
  _req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ productId: string; moduleId: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (!canAccessSection(session, "aplus")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }
  const role = session.user.role;
  if (role !== "editor" && role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { productId, moduleId } = await params;

  try {

  const [mod] = await db
    .select()
    .from(aplusModules)
    .where(and(eq(aplusModules.id, moduleId), eq(aplusModules.productId, productId)))
    .limit(1);

  if (!mod) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Module not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  const spec = APLUS_MODULE_SPECS[mod.moduleType as AplusModuleType];
  if (!spec.repeatableGroup?.image) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Module type has no panel images" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const rg = spec.repeatableGroup;

  const existingImages = await db
    .select()
    .from(aplusModuleImages)
    .where(eq(aplusModuleImages.moduleId, moduleId));

  const panelImages = existingImages
    .filter((img) => img.customLabel?.startsWith("panel_"))
    .sort((a, b) => b.imageSlot - a.imageSlot);

  if (panelImages.length <= rg.minItems) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `Minimum ${rg.minItems} panels required` },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Remove the last panel image
  const lastPanel = panelImages[0];
  await db
    .delete(aplusModuleImages)
    .where(eq(aplusModuleImages.id, lastPanel.id));

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true, removedId: lastPanel.id });

  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[aplus panels DELETE] Error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Failed to remove panel" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: src/app/api/aplus/[productId]/reorder/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { aplusModules, aplusModuleImages, driveFiles } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and, inArray } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { driveClient } from "@/lib/drive-client";

export const maxDuration = 60;

/** Replace _M{#}_ segment in a filename with a new module number */
function renameModSegment(filename: string, newModNum: number): string {
  return filename.replace(/_M\d+_/, `_M${newModNum}_`);
}

/** Check if a filename follows SOP naming (contains _M{#}_ segment) */
function isSopNamed(filename: string): boolean {
  return /_M\d+_/.test(filename);
}

export async function PATCH(
  req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ productId: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  if (!canAccessSection(session, "aplus")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const role = session.user.role;
  if (role !== "editor" && role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { productId } = await params;
  const body = await req.json();
  const { order } = body as { order: Array<{ id: string; moduleNumber: number }> };

  if (!Array.isArray(order) || order.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "order must be a non-empty array" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // ── Step 1: Read current module positions (before reorder) ──
  const moduleIds = order.map((o) => o.id);
  const currentModules = await db
    .select({
      id: aplusModules.id,
      moduleNumber: aplusModules.moduleNumber,
    })
    .from(aplusModules)
    .where(inArray(aplusModules.id, moduleIds));

  const oldPositionById = new Map(
    currentModules.map((m) => [m.id, m.moduleNumber])
  );

  // ── Step 2: Update DB positions (two-pass to avoid unique constraint) ──
  await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    // Pass 1: set temporary negative values
    for (let i = 0; i < order.length; i++) {
      const { id } = order[i];
      await tx
        .update(aplusModules)
        .set({ moduleNumber: -(i + 1) })
        .where(
          and(eq(aplusModules.id, id), eq(aplusModules.productId, productId))
        );
    }

    // Pass 2: set final moduleNumber values
    for (const { id, moduleNumber } of order) {
      await tx
        .update(aplusModules)
        .set({ moduleNumber, updatedAt: new Date() })
        .where(
          and(eq(aplusModules.id, id), eq(aplusModules.productId, productId))
        );
    }
  });

  // ── Step 3: Rename Drive files for modules whose position changed ──
  const renameErrors: string[] = [];
  let renameCount = 0;

  for (const { id, moduleNumber: newPosition } of order) {
    const oldPosition = oldPositionById.get(id);
    if (oldPosition === newPosition) continue; // Position unchanged

    // Get all images for this module that have Drive files
    const images = await db
      .select({
        driveFileId: aplusModuleImages.driveFileId,
        mobileDriveFileId: aplusModuleImages.mobileDriveFileId,
      })
      .from(aplusModuleImages)
      .where(eq(aplusModuleImages.moduleId, id));

    // Collect all Drive file IDs to rename
    const driveFileIds: string[] = [];
    for (const img of images) {
      if (img.driveFileId) driveFileIds.push(img.driveFileId);
      if (img.mobileDriveFileId) driveFileIds.push(img.mobileDriveFileId);
    }

    // Rename each file in Drive
    for (const fileId of driveFileIds) {
      try {
        const file = await driveClient.getFile(fileId, "id,name");
        if (!isSopNamed(file.name)) continue; // Skip non-SOP files

        const newName = renameModSegment(file.name, newPosition);
        if (newName !== file.name) {
          await driveClient.renameFile(fileId, newName);

          // Update display name in driveFiles DB table
          await db
            .update(driveFiles)
            .set({ displayName: newName })
            .where(eq(driveFiles.driveFileId, fileId));

          renameCount++;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
        console.error(`[reorder] Failed to rename Drive file ${fileId}:`, msg);
        renameErrors.push(fileId);
      }
    }
  }

  return NextResponse.json({
    ok: true,
    driveRenames: renameCount,
    driveRenameErrors: renameErrors.length > 0 ? renameErrors : undefined,
  });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { aplusSets } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";

export const maxDuration = 60;

export async function PATCH(
  req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ productId: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (!canAccessSection(session, "aplus")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }
  if (session.user.role === "viewer") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Viewers cannot edit" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { productId } = await params;

  try {

  const body = await req.json();

  // Validate allowed fields
  const allowedFields = [
    "scopeType",
    "scopeIdentifier",
    "platform",
    "contentType",
    "version",
    "groupNumber",
    "parentAsin",
    "coveredAsins",
  ] as const;

  const updates: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const field of allowedFields) {
    if (body[field] !== undefined) {
      updates[field] = body[field];
    }
  }

  if (Object.keys(updates).length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "No valid fields to update" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Validate scopeType
  if (updates.scopeType && !["ASIN", "VAR", "GRP"].includes(updates.scopeType as string)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid scope type" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Validate platform
  if (updates.platform && !["SC", "VC"].includes(updates.platform as string)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid platform" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Validate version
  if (updates.version !== undefined) {
    const v = updates.version as number;
    if (!Number.isInteger(v) || v < 1 || v > 99) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Version must be 1-99" }, { status: 400 });
    }
  }

  // Validate groupNumber
  if (updates.groupNumber !== undefined && updates.groupNumber !== null) {
    const g = updates.groupNumber as number;
    if (!Number.isInteger(g) || g < 1 || g > 99) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Group number must be 1-99" }, { status: 400 });
    }
  }

  // Validate coveredAsins is an array of strings
  if (updates.coveredAsins !== undefined && updates.coveredAsins !== null) {
    if (!Array.isArray(updates.coveredAsins) || !updates.coveredAsins.every((a: unknown) => typeof a === "string")) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "coveredAsins must be an array of strings" }, { status: 400 });
    }
  }

  updates.updatedAt = new Date();

  const [updated] = await db
    .update(aplusSets)
    .set(updates)
    .where(eq(aplusSets.productId, productId))
    .returning();

  if (!updated) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Set config not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({
    id: updated.id,
    scopeType: updated.scopeType,
    scopeIdentifier: updated.scopeIdentifier,
    platform: updated.platform,
    contentType: updated.contentType,
    version: updated.version,
    groupNumber: updated.groupNumber,
    parentAsin: updated.parentAsin,
    coveredAsins: updated.coveredAsins,
  });

  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[aplus set-config PATCH] Error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Failed to update set config" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and, ne, isNotNull } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";

export const maxDuration = 60;

/**
 * GET /api/aplus/{productId}/siblings
 *
 * Returns all sibling ASINs in the same variation family
 * (products sharing the same parentAsin).
 */
export async function GET(
  _req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ productId: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (!canAccessSection(session, "aplus")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { productId } = await params;

  // Get this product's parentAsin
  const [product] = await db
    .select({
      id: master.id,
      asin: master.asin,
      parentAsin: master.parentAsin,
      clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode,
    })
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.id, productId))
    .limit(1);

  if (!product) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Product not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  // If no parentAsin, this product is not part of a variation — return just itself
  if (!product.parentAsin) {
    return NextResponse.json({
      siblings: [{
        id: product.id,
        asin: product.asin ?? "",
        itemName: null,
      }],
      parentAsin: null,
    });
  }

  // Find all products with the same parentAsin (including this one)
  const siblings = await db
    .select({
      id: master.id,
      asin: master.asin,
      itemName: master.itemName,
      variationGroup: master.variationGroup,
    })
    .from(master)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(master.parentAsin, product.parentAsin),
        isNotNull(master.asin),
      )
    );

  return NextResponse.json({
    siblings: siblings.map((s) => ({
      id: s.id,
      asin: s.asin ?? "",
      itemName: s.itemName,
      variationGroup: s.variationGroup,
    })),
    parentAsin: product.parentAsin,
  });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";

import { getAccessToken } from "@/lib/gcp-auth";
import { getAiFeatureConfig } from "@/lib/ai-config.server";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const anthropic = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY,
  fetch: fetch,
});

const DRIVE_BASE = "https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3";
const DRIVE_SCOPE = "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.readonly";

/** Download image from Drive and return as base64 + media type */
async function fetchDriveImage(
  fileId: string
): Promise<{ base64: string; mediaType: string } | null> {
  try {
    const token = await getAccessToken([DRIVE_SCOPE]);

    // Get mime type
    const metaRes = await fetch(
      `${DRIVE_BASE}/files/${encodeURIComponent(fileId)}?supportsAllDrives=true&fields=mimeType,size`,
      { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } }
    );
    if (!metaRes.ok) return null;
    const meta = await metaRes.json();

    // Skip files > 5MB to stay within Claude limits
    if (meta.size && Number(meta.size) > 5 * 1024 * 1024) return null;

    // Download bytes
    const dlRes = await fetch(
      `${DRIVE_BASE}/files/${encodeURIComponent(fileId)}?alt=media&supportsAllDrives=true`,
      { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } }
    );
    if (!dlRes.ok) return null;

    const buffer = await dlRes.arrayBuffer();
    const base64 = Buffer.from(buffer).toString("base64");
    const mediaType = meta.mimeType || "image/png";

    return { base64, mediaType };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("Failed to fetch Drive image for alt text:", err);
    return null;
  }
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session?.user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (!canAccessSection(session, "aplus")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  // Rate limit: 10 requests per minute per user
  const rl = checkRateLimit(session.user.email, 10, 60_000);
  if (!rl.success) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Rate limit exceeded. Try again later." },
      { status: 429, headers: { "Retry-After": String(Math.ceil((rl.resetAt - Date.now()) / 1000)) } }
    );
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const {
    productId,
    productName,
    moduleType,
    slotLabel,
    imageDescription,
    aiImagePrompt,
    driveFileId,
  } = body;

  if (!productName) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "productName is required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // ── Fetch the actual image if uploaded ────────────────────────
  let imageData: { base64: string; mediaType: string } | null = null;
  if (driveFileId) {
    imageData = await fetchDriveImage(driveFileId);
  }

  // ── Pull SEO + Rufus + COSMO data (optional enrichment) ──────
  let seoContext = "";
  if (productId) {
    try {
      const [seoProject] = await db
        .select({
          id: seoProjects.id,
          brandName: seoProjects.brandName,
          brandGuidelinesLock: seoProjects.brandGuidelinesLock,
        })
        .from(seoProjects)
        .where(eq(seoProjects.linkedProductId, productId))
        .orderBy(desc(seoProjects.updatedAt))
        .limit(1);

      if (seoProject) {
        const parts: string[] = [];

        if (seoProject.brandName) {
          parts.push(`Brand: ${seoProject.brandName}`);
        }

        // T1/T2 keywords
        const keywords = await db
          .select({ text: seoKeywords.text, tier: seoKeywords.priorityTier })
          .from(seoKeywords)
          .where(
            and(
              eq(seoKeywords.projectId, seoProject.id),
              inArray(seoKeywords.priorityTier, ["T1", "T2"])
            )
          );

        if (keywords.length > 0) {
          const t1 = keywords.filter((k) => k.tier === "T1").map((k) => k.text);
          const t2 = keywords.filter((k) => k.tier === "T2").map((k) => k.text);
          if (t1.length > 0) parts.push(`Primary keywords: ${t1.join(", ")}`);
          if (t2.length > 0) parts.push(`Secondary keywords: ${t2.slice(0, 10).join(", ")}`);
        }

        const lock = seoProject.brandGuidelinesLock as {
          brand_voice?: string | null;
          words_to_avoid?: string[];
        } | null;
        if (lock?.brand_voice) parts.push(`Brand voice: ${lock.brand_voice}`);
        if (lock?.words_to_avoid?.length) parts.push(`Words to avoid: ${lock.words_to_avoid.join(", ")}`);

        // Rufus S4
        try {
          const [rufus] = await db
            .select({ optimizationSummary: seoRufus.optimizationSummary })
            .from(seoRufus)
            .where(eq(seoRufus.projectId, seoProject.id))
            .limit(1);

          if (rufus) {
            const summary = rufus.optimizationSummary as {
              image_strategy?: string;
              audience_segmentation?: string;
            } | null;
            if (summary?.image_strategy) parts.push(`Image strategy (Rufus): ${summary.image_strategy}`);
            if (summary?.audience_segmentation) parts.push(`Target audience: ${summary.audience_segmentation}`);
          }
        } catch { /* non-fatal */ }

        // COSMO S5
        try {
          const [cosmo] = await db
            .select({ triples: seoCosmopMaps.triples })
            .from(seoCosmopMaps)
            .where(eq(seoCosmopMaps.projectId, seoProject.id))
            .limit(1);

          if (cosmo) {
            const triples = cosmo.triples as Array<{
              entity1: string; relationship: string; entity2: string; confidence: number;
            }> | null;
            if (triples && triples.length > 0) {
              const top = triples
                .sort((a, b) => (b.confidence ?? 0) - (a.confidence ?? 0))
                .slice(0, 5)
                .map((t) => `${t.entity1} → ${t.relationship} → ${t.entity2}`)
                .join("; ");
              parts.push(`Product relationships (COSMO): ${top}`);
            }
          }
        } catch { /* non-fatal */ }

        if (parts.length > 0) {
          seoContext = "\n\nSEO RESEARCH (use to enhance the description if relevant — do NOT force keywords that don't match what's in the image):\n" + parts.join("\n");
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Failed to fetch SEO context for alt text:", err);
    }
  }

  // ── Build prompt ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const contextParts: string[] = [];
  if (moduleType) contextParts.push(`Module type: ${moduleType.replace(/_/g, " ")}`);
  if (slotLabel) contextParts.push(`Image slot: ${slotLabel}`);
  if (imageDescription) contextParts.push(`Image description provided by user: ${imageDescription}`);
  if (aiImagePrompt) contextParts.push(`AI image prompt: ${aiImagePrompt}`);

  const hasImage = !!imageData;

  const prompt = hasImage
    ? `Look at this image from an Amazon A+ Content module and describe what it shows. This description will be used as alt text that Amazon's search algorithms (A9/Rufus/COSMO) read to understand the image content.

Product: ${productName}
${contextParts.length > 0 ? contextParts.join("\n") : ""}${seoContext}

Requirements:
- Max 100 characters (Amazon limit)
- Describe what you actually SEE in the image — be accurate and specific
- If SEO research is available and relevant to what's shown, you may naturally incorporate 1-2 keywords — but only if they truthfully describe the image
- No generic filler ("image of", "picture of", "photo showing")
- Focus on the product, its features, or the scene depicted

Return ONLY the alt text string, nothing else.`
    : `Generate alt text for an Amazon A+ Content image (no image uploaded yet — use the context below).

Product: ${productName}
${contextParts.length > 0 ? contextParts.join("\n") : ""}${seoContext}

Requirements:
- Max 100 characters (Amazon limit)
- Describe the likely image content based on the module type, slot, and product
- If SEO research is available, naturally weave in 1-2 relevant keywords
- No generic filler ("image of", "picture of")

Return ONLY the alt text string, nothing else.`;

  try {
    const messages: Anthropic.MessageCreateParamsNonStreaming["messages"] = [];

    if (hasImage) {
      messages.push({
        role: "user",
        content: [
          {
            type: "image",
            source: {
              type: "base64",
              media_type: imageData!.mediaType as "image/jpeg" | "image/png" | "image/gif" | "image/webp",
              data: imageData!.base64,
            },
          },
          { type: "text", text: prompt },
        ],
      });
    } else {
      messages.push({ role: "user", content: prompt });
    }

    const aiConfig = await getAiFeatureConfig("aplus_alt_text");
    if (!aiConfig.enabled) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Alt text generation is disabled" }, { status: 403 });
    }

    const response = await anthropic.messages.create({
      model: aiConfig.model,
      max_tokens: aiConfig.maxTokens,
      messages,
    });

    const text = response.content[0].type === "text" ? response.content[0].text.trim() : "";

    return NextResponse.json({ altText: text });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Alt text generation error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to generate alt text" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { getAiFeatureConfig } from "@/lib/ai-config.server";
import { checkRateLimit } from "@/lib/rate-limit";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { seoProjects, seoKeywords, seoRufus } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and, inArray, desc } from "drizzle-orm";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const anthropic = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY,
  fetch: fetch,
});

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session?.user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (!canAccessSection(session, "aplus")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  // Rate limit: 10 requests per minute per user
  const rl = checkRateLimit(session.user.email, 10, 60_000);
  if (!rl.success) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Rate limit exceeded. Try again later." },
      { status: 429, headers: { "Retry-After": String(Math.ceil((rl.resetAt - Date.now()) / 1000)) } }
    );
  }

  const aiConfig = await getAiFeatureConfig("aplus_video_title");
  if (!aiConfig.enabled) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Video title suggestion is disabled" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const { productId, productName, videoDescription } = body;

  if (!productName) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "productName is required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // ── Optional SEO context ──────────────────────────────────────
  let seoContext = "";
  if (productId) {
    try {
      const [seoProject] = await db
        .select({ id: seoProjects.id, brandName: seoProjects.brandName })
        .from(seoProjects)
        .where(eq(seoProjects.linkedProductId, productId))
        .orderBy(desc(seoProjects.updatedAt))
        .limit(1);

      if (seoProject) {
        const parts: string[] = [];
        if (seoProject.brandName) parts.push(`Brand: ${seoProject.brandName}`);

        const keywords = await db
          .select({ text: seoKeywords.text, tier: seoKeywords.priorityTier })
          .from(seoKeywords)
          .where(and(eq(seoKeywords.projectId, seoProject.id), inArray(seoKeywords.priorityTier, ["T1"])))
          .limit(5);

        if (keywords.length > 0) {
          parts.push(`Top keywords: ${keywords.map((k) => k.text).join(", ")}`);
        }

        try {
          const [rufus] = await db
            .select({ optimizationSummary: seoRufus.optimizationSummary })
            .from(seoRufus)
            .where(eq(seoRufus.projectId, seoProject.id))
            .limit(1);
          if (rufus) {
            const summary = rufus.optimizationSummary as { audience_segmentation?: string } | null;
            if (summary?.audience_segmentation) parts.push(`Audience: ${summary.audience_segmentation}`);
          }
        } catch { /* non-fatal */ }

        if (parts.length > 0) {
          seoContext = "\n\nSEO context (use if relevant):\n" + parts.join("\n");
        }
      }
    } catch { /* non-fatal */ }
  }

  const prompt = `Suggest a compelling video title for an Amazon A+ Premium Content video module.

Product: ${productName}
${videoDescription ? `Video description: ${videoDescription}` : ""}${seoContext}

Requirements:
- Max 60 characters (Amazon limit for video titles)
- Engaging and specific to the product
- Should make shoppers want to watch the video
- If SEO keywords are available, incorporate one naturally — only if it fits
- No clickbait, no ALL CAPS

Return ONLY the title string, nothing else.`;

  try {
    const response = await anthropic.messages.create({
      model: aiConfig.model,
      max_tokens: aiConfig.maxTokens,
      messages: [{ role: "user", content: prompt }],
    });

    const text = response.content[0].type === "text" ? response.content[0].text.trim() : "";
    return NextResponse.json({ title: text });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Video title generation error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Failed to generate video title" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { queryBigQuery } from "@/lib/bigquery";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";

export const maxDuration = 60;

// NOTE: Dataset name `1o8MSEO` is inferred from naming convention (1o8MAAC, 1o8Hub, 1o8MSEO).
// Confirm against actual BigQuery before using in production.
// The table name OUT_PA+ contains a `+` character — it MUST be backtick-escaped in BQ SQL.
const SEO_BQ_DATASET = "1o8MSEO";
const OUT_PA_PLUS_TABLE = `amazon-data-461918.${SEO_BQ_DATASET}.\`OUT_PA+\``;

interface OutPaPlusAsinRow {
  ASIN: string;
}

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session || session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const clientIdCode = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("clientIdCode");
  if (!clientIdCode) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "clientIdCode is required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  try {
    const rows = await queryBigQuery<OutPaPlusAsinRow>(
      `SELECT DISTINCT ASIN FROM \`${OUT_PA_PLUS_TABLE}\` WHERE ClientIDCode = @clientIdCode ORDER BY ASIN`,
      { clientIdCode }
    );

    const asins = rows.map((r) => r.ASIN).filter(Boolean);

    return NextResponse.json({ asins });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to fetch ASINs from BigQuery",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

FILE: src/app/api/aplus/bulk-compare/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, aplusModules, aplusModuleImages } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, sql, asc, inArray, and, isNotNull } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import type { RainforestProduct } from "@/types/rainforest";

export const maxDuration = 60;

// Normalize text for comparison: lowercase + trim whitespace
function normalizeText(text: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!text) return "";
  return text.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
}

type SnapshotRow = {
  id: string;
  product_id: string;
  asin: string;
  provider: string;
  snapshot_data: unknown;
  fetched_at: Date;
};

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  if (session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden — admin only" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
  const { clientIdCode } = body as { clientIdCode?: string };

  if (!clientIdCode) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "clientIdCode is required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // 1. Fetch all active, non-parent products for this client that have an ASIN
  const productRows = await db
    .select({
      id: master.id,
      asin: master.asin,
      itemName: master.itemName,
    })
    .from(master)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(master.clientIdCode, clientIdCode),
        eq(master.status, "Active"),
        isNotNull(master.asin),
        sql`lower(coalesce(${master.parentageLevel}, '')) <> 'parent'`
      )
    )
    .orderBy(asc(master.itemName));

  if (productRows.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({
      clientIdCode,
      totalProducts: 0,
      productsWithSnapshot: 0,
      productsWithAplus: 0,
      overallMatchRate: 0,
      perProduct: [],
    });
  }

  const productIds = productRows.map((p) => p.id);

  // 2. Bulk fetch modules and images to avoid N+1
  const moduleRows = await db
    .select()
    .from(aplusModules)
    .where(inArray(aplusModules.productId, productIds));

  const moduleIds = moduleRows.map((m) => m.id);
  const imageRows =
    moduleIds.length > 0
      ? await db
          .select()
          .from(aplusModuleImages)
          .where(inArray(aplusModuleImages.moduleId, moduleIds))
      : [];

  // 3. Bulk fetch latest snapshot per product using DISTINCT ON
  const rawSnapshotResult = productIds.length > 0
    ? await db.execute(
        sql`SELECT DISTINCT ON (product_id) id, product_id, asin, provider, snapshot_data, fetched_at
            FROM amazon_sync_snapshots
            WHERE product_id = ANY(${sql.raw(`ARRAY[${productIds.map((id) => `'${id}'`).join(",")}]::uuid[]`)})
              AND provider = 'rainforest'
            ORDER BY product_id, fetched_at DESC`
      )
    : [];
  const snapshotRows: SnapshotRow[] = Array.from(rawSnapshotResult as Iterable<SnapshotRow>);

  // Build lookup maps
  const snapshotByProductId = new Map<string, SnapshotRow>(
    snapshotRows.map((s) => [s.product_id, s])
  );

  // moduleNumberMap: moduleId -> moduleNumber
  const moduleNumberMap = new Map<string, number>(
    moduleRows.map((m) => [m.id, m.moduleNumber])
  );

  // modulesByProductId: productId -> module ids
  const modulesByProductId = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const m of moduleRows) {
    const existing = modulesByProductId.get(m.productId) ?? [];
    existing.push(m.id);
    modulesByProductId.set(m.productId, existing);
  }

  // imagesByModuleId: moduleId -> image rows
  const imagesByModuleId = new Map<string, typeof imageRows>();
  for (const img of imageRows) {
    const existing = imagesByModuleId.get(img.moduleId) ?? [];
    existing.push(img);
    imagesByModuleId.set(img.moduleId, existing);
  }

  // 4. Compute per-product compare results
  let totalMatchCount = 0;
  let totalHubImages = 0;
  let productsWithSnapshot = 0;
  let productsWithAplus = 0;

  const perProduct = productRows.map((product) => {
    const snapshot = snapshotByProductId.get(product.id);
    const hasSnapshot = !!snapshot;
    if (hasSnapshot) productsWithSnapshot++;

    const snapshotData = snapshot?.snapshot_data as RainforestProduct | undefined;
    const hasAmazonAplus =
      hasSnapshot && (snapshotData?.a_plus_content?.has_a_plus_content ?? false);
    if (hasAmazonAplus) productsWithAplus++;

    const amazonImages: { link: string; name: string }[] =
      snapshotData?.a_plus_content?.all_images ?? [];

    // Get all images for this product
    const productModuleIds = modulesByProductId.get(product.id) ?? [];
    const allProductImages = productModuleIds.flatMap(
      (moduleId) => imagesByModuleId.get(moduleId) ?? []
    );

    const hubImageCount = allProductImages.length;
    const amazonImageCount = hasSnapshot ? amazonImages.length : null;

    // Compute match rate
    const matchedAmazonIndices = new Set<number>();
    let matchCount = 0;

    for (const image of allProductImages) {
      const normalizedHub = normalizeText(image.altText);
      if (!hasSnapshot || !normalizedHub) continue;

      for (let i = 0; i < amazonImages.length; i++) {
        if (matchedAmazonIndices.has(i)) continue;
        if (normalizeText(amazonImages[i].name) === normalizedHub) {
          matchedAmazonIndices.add(i);
          matchCount++;
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    const matchRate =
      hubImageCount > 0 ? Math.round((matchCount / hubImageCount) * 100) : 0;

    totalHubImages += hubImageCount;
    totalMatchCount += matchCount;

    return {
      productId: product.id,
      asin: product.asin ?? "",
      productName: product.itemName ?? "",
      hubImageCount,
      amazonImageCount,
      matchRate,
      hasSnapshot,
    };
  });

  const overallMatchRate =
    totalHubImages > 0
      ? Math.round((totalMatchCount / totalHubImages) * 100)
      : 0;

  return NextResponse.json({
    clientIdCode,
    totalProducts: productRows.length,
    productsWithSnapshot,
    productsWithAplus,
    overallMatchRate,
    perProduct,
  });
}

FILE: src/app/api/aplus/import/route.ts

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { aplusModules, aplusModuleImages, master } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { queryBigQuery } from "@/lib/bigquery";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { eq, inArray } from "drizzle-orm";
import {
  APLUS_MODULE_SPECS,
  APLUS_MODULE_TYPES,
  type AplusModuleType,
} from "@/lib/aplus-module-specs";

export const maxDuration = 60;

// NOTE: Dataset name `1o8MSEO` is inferred from naming convention (1o8MAAC, 1o8Hub, 1o8MSEO).
// Confirm against actual BigQuery before using in production.
// The table name OUT_PA+ contains a `+` character — it MUST be backtick-escaped in BQ SQL.
const SEO_BQ_DATASET = "1o8MSEO";
const OUT_PA_PLUS_TABLE = `amazon-data-461918.${SEO_BQ_DATASET}.\`OUT_PA+\``;

// NOTE: BQ column names are best-effort — verify against actual OUT_PA+ schema
interface OutPaPlusRow {
  ASIN: string;
  ClientIDCode: string;
  APlusModule_Number: number;
  APlusModule_Type: string;
  APlusHeadline: string | null;
  APlusSubheadline: string | null;
  APlusBodyText: string | null;
  APlusAltText: string | null;
  APlusOverlayText: string | null;
  APlusImageDescription: string | null;
  APlusAIImagePrompt: string | null;
  APlusCosmoRelationType: string | null;
}

/**
 * Normalize a BQ module type string to the snake_case enum value.
 * Lowercases, replaces spaces and special characters with underscores,
 * collapses multiple underscores, then validates against APLUS_MODULE_TYPES.
 */
function normalizeModuleType(rawType: string | null | undefined): AplusModuleType | null {
  if (!rawType) return null;

  const normalized = rawType
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "_")
    .replace(/_+/g, "_")
    .replace(/^_|_$/g, "");

  if (APLUS_MODULE_TYPES.includes(normalized as AplusModuleType)) {
    return normalized as AplusModuleType;
  }

  // Fuzzy fallback: try removing common filler words and compare
  const fillerWords = ["standard", "a", "the", "and", "&", "with", "of"];
  const stripped = normalized
    .split("_")
    .filter((w) => !fillerWords.includes(w))
    .join("_");

  const fuzzyMatch = APLUS_MODULE_TYPES.find((type) => {
    const typeStripped = type
      .split("_")
      .filter((w) => !fillerWords.includes(w))
      .join("_");
    return typeStripped === stripped;
  });

  return fuzzyMatch ?? null;
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session || session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  let clientIdCode: string;
  let asins: string[];

  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    clientIdCode = body.clientIdCode;
    asins = body.asins;
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid request body" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  if (!clientIdCode || typeof clientIdCode !== "string") {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "clientIdCode is required and must be a string" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(asins) || asins.length === 0 || !asins.every((a) => typeof a === "string")) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "asins must be a non-empty array of strings" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  try {
    // 1. Pre-load product lookup map: ASIN -> { id, clientIdCode, sku }
    const productRows = await db
      .select({
        id: master.id,
        asin: master.asin,
        sku: master.sku,
        clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode,
      })
      .from(master)
      .where(inArray(master.asin, asins));

    const productMap = new Map(
      productRows
        .filter((p): p is typeof p & { asin: string } => p.asin !== null)
        .map((p) => [p.asin, p])
    );

    // 2. Fetch all BQ rows for the requested ASINs + clientIdCode in a single query
    const placeholders = asins.map((_, i) => `@asin_${i}`).join(", ");
    const bqParams: Record<string, string> = { clientIdCode };
    asins.forEach((asin, i) => {
      bqParams[`asin_${i}`] = asin;
    });

    const bqRows = await queryBigQuery<OutPaPlusRow>(
      `SELECT ASIN, ClientIDCode, APlusModule_Number, APlusModule_Type,
              APlusHeadline, APlusSubheadline, APlusBodyText, APlusAltText,
              APlusOverlayText, APlusImageDescription, APlusAIImagePrompt,
              APlusCosmoRelationType
       FROM \`${OUT_PA_PLUS_TABLE}\`
       WHERE ClientIDCode = @clientIdCode
         AND ASIN IN (${placeholders})
       ORDER BY ASIN, APlusModule_Number`,
      bqParams
    );

    // 3. Process each ASIN atomically
    let imported = 0;
    let skipped = 0;
    const errors: string[] = [];

    for (const asin of asins) {
      const product = productMap.get(asin);
      if (!product) {
        errors.push(`ASIN ${asin} not found in products table — skipped`);
        skipped++;
        continue;
      }

      const asinRows = bqRows.filter((r) => r.ASIN === asin);

      // Filter module_number > 7 with warning
      const validRows = asinRows.filter((r) => {
        const num = Number(r.APlusModule_Number);
        if (num > 7) {
          console.warn(
            `[aplus/import] ASIN ${asin}: module_number ${num} exceeds 7-module limit — skipped`
          );
          return false;
        }
        return true;
      });

      try {
        await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
          // DELETE existing modules for this product (cascade removes images)
          await tx
            .delete(aplusModules)
            .where(eq(aplusModules.productId, product.id));

          // INSERT fresh modules from BQ data
          for (const row of validRows) {
            const moduleType = normalizeModuleType(row.APlusModule_Type);

            if (!moduleType) {
              console.warn(
                `[aplus/import] ASIN ${asin}: unrecognized module type "${row.APlusModule_Type}" — skipped`
              );
              errors.push(
                `ASIN ${asin} module ${row.APlusModule_Number}: unrecognized type "${row.APlusModule_Type}"`
              );
              continue;
            }

            const [insertedModule] = await tx
              .insert(aplusModules)
              .values({
                productId: product.id,
                moduleNumber: Number(row.APlusModule_Number),
                moduleType,
                headlineText: row.APlusHeadline ?? null,
                subheadlineText: row.APlusSubheadline ?? null,
                bodyText: row.APlusBodyText ?? null,
                altText: row.APlusAltText ?? null,
                overlayText: row.APlusOverlayText ?? null,
                imageDescription: row.APlusImageDescription ?? null,
                aiImagePrompt: row.APlusAIImagePrompt ?? null,
                cosmoRelationType: row.APlusCosmoRelationType ?? null,
                importedAt: new Date(),
              })
              .returning();

            // INSERT image stub rows — one per image slot defined by the module spec
            const spec = APLUS_MODULE_SPECS[moduleType];
            if (spec.imageSlots.length > 0) {
              await tx.insert(aplusModuleImages).values(
                spec.imageSlots.map((slot, idx) => ({
                  moduleId: insertedModule.id,
                  imageSlot: idx + 1,
                  customLabel: slot.key,
                  clientIdCode: product.clientIdCode,
                  asin: product.asin,
                  sku: product.sku,
                  // Populate text fields from BQ row where available
                  altText: row.APlusAltText
                    ? row.APlusAltText.slice(0, 100)
                    : null,
                  aiImagePrompt: row.APlusAIImagePrompt ?? null,
                }))
              );
            }
          }
        });

        imported++;
      } catch (txError) {
        errors.push(
          `ASIN ${asin} transaction failed: ${txError instanceof Error ? txError.message : "unknown error"}`
        );
        skipped++;
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ imported, skipped, errors });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Import failed",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

FILE: src/app/api/aplus/products/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, aplusModules } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, sql, asc } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";

export const maxDuration = 60;

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  if (!canAccessSection(session, "aplus")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  try {

  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const clientFilter = searchParams.get("client") ?? null;

  // Build query for active products
  const productRows = await db
    .select({
      id: master.id,
      asin: master.asin,
      sku: master.sku,
      productName: master.itemName,
      clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode,
      parentageLevel: master.parentageLevel,
      parentAsin: master.parentAsin,
      variationGroup: master.variationGroup,
      variations: master.variations,
      mainImageUrl: master.mainImageUrl,
    })
    .from(master)
    .where(
      clientFilter
        ? sql`${master.status} = 'Active' AND ${master.clientIdCode} = ${clientFilter}`
        : sql`${master.status} = 'Active'`
    )
    .orderBy(asc(master.clientIdCode), asc(master.itemName));

  if (productRows.length === 0) {
    // Still return distinct client list even if no products match filter
    const allActiveProducts = clientFilter
      ? []
      : await db
          .select({ clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode })
          .from(master)
          .where(eq(master.status, "Active"))
          .orderBy(asc(master.clientIdCode));

    const clients = [
      ...new Set(
        allActiveProducts
          .map((p) => p.clientIdCode)
          .filter((c): c is string => c !== null)
      ),
    ];

    return NextResponse.json({ products: [], clients, role: session.user.role ?? "viewer" });
  }

  // Fetch module counts grouped by productId
  const moduleCounts = await db
    .select({
      productId: aplusModules.productId,
      moduleCount: sql<number>`cast(count(*) as int)`,
      approvedCount: sql<number>`cast(count(*) filter (where ${aplusModules.status} = 'approved') as int)`,
    })
    .from(aplusModules)
    .groupBy(aplusModules.productId);

  // Build a map from productId -> counts
  const countMap = new Map<string, { moduleCount: number; approvedCount: number }>();
  for (const row of moduleCounts) {
    countMap.set(row.productId, {
      moduleCount: row.moduleCount,
      approvedCount: row.approvedCount,
    });
  }

  // Fetch first A+ module image (driveFileId) per product for thumbnails
  const thumbRows = await db
    .select({
      productId: aplusModules.productId,
      driveFileId: sql<string | null>`(
        select img."drive_file_id" from "aplus_module_images" img
        where img."module_id" = ${aplusModules.id}
          and img."drive_file_id" is not null
        order by img."image_slot" asc
        limit 1
      )`,
    })
    .from(aplusModules)
    .where(eq(aplusModules.moduleNumber, 1));

  // Map productId -> first driveFileId
  const thumbMap = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const row of thumbRows) {
    if (row.driveFileId) {
      thumbMap.set(row.productId, row.driveFileId);
    }
  }

  // Merge counts + thumbnails into product rows
  const productsWithCounts = productRows.map((p) => {
    const counts = countMap.get(p.id) ?? { moduleCount: 0, approvedCount: 0 };
    const v = p.variations as Record<string, string | undefined> | null;
    const driveFileId = thumbMap.get(p.id);
    const thumbnailUrl = driveFileId
      ? `/api/drive/file/${driveFileId}`
      : p.mainImageUrl || null;
    return {
      id: p.id,
      asin: p.asin,
      sku: p.sku,
      productName: p.productName,
      clientIdCode: p.clientIdCode,
      parentageLevel: p.parentageLevel,
      parentAsin: p.parentAsin,
      variationGroup: p.variationGroup,
      variationId: v?.VariationID || null,
      variationTheme: v?.VariationThemeName || null,
      flavor: v?.Flavor || null,
      color: v?.Color || null,
      style: v?.Style || null,
      size: v?.Size || null,
      moduleCount: counts.moduleCount,
      approvedCount: counts.approvedCount,
      thumbnailUrl,
    };
  });

  // Extract distinct client list from all active products (for filter dropdown)
  const allClientsRows = await db
    .select({ clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode })
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.status, "Active"))
    .orderBy(asc(master.clientIdCode));

  const clients = [
    ...new Set(
      allClientsRows
        .map((p) => p.clientIdCode)
        .filter((c): c is string => c !== null)
    ),
  ];

  return NextResponse.json({
    products: productsWithCounts,
    clients,
    role: session.user.role ?? "viewer",
  });

  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[aplus products GET] Error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Failed to load A+ products" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: src/app/api/attributes/route.ts

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { columnAttributes } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, asc } from "drizzle-orm";

// In-memory cache (module-level, 5min TTL)
let cachedRows: (typeof columnAttributes.$inferSelect)[] | null = null;
let cacheTimestamp = 0;
const CACHE_TTL = 5 * 60 * 1000; // 5 minutes

async function getCachedAttributes() {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (cachedRows && now - cacheTimestamp < CACHE_TTL) {
    return cachedRows;
  }
  cachedRows = await db
    .select()
    .from(columnAttributes)
    .orderBy(asc(columnAttributes.masterRow));
  cacheTimestamp = now;
  return cachedRows;
}

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const url = req.nextUrl.searchParams;
  const client = url.get("client") || "";
  const group = url.get("group") || "";
  const essentialOnly = url.get("essential") === "true";

  let rows = await getCachedAttributes();

  // Apply filters in-memory (fast since dataset is small ~972 rows)
  if (group) {
    rows = rows.filter((r) => r.referenceGroup === group);
  }

  if (essentialOnly) {
    rows = rows.filter((r) => r.isEssential);
  }

  // If client filter, enrich with requirement level
  if (client) {
    const enriched = rows.map((row) => ({
      ...row,
      clientRequirement: row.clientRequirements?.[client] || "",
    }));
    return NextResponse.json(enriched);
  }

  return NextResponse.json(rows);
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { users } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session?.user?.email) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  // Only pending users can register
  if (session.user.role !== "pending") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Already registered" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const { fullName, clientName } = body as {
    fullName: string;
    clientName: string;
  };

  if (!fullName?.trim() || !clientName?.trim()) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Full name and client are required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Store client name in clientIdCode field for admin to review and map
  await db
    .update(users)
    .set({
      name: fullName.trim(),
      clientIdCode: clientName.trim(),
    })
    .where(eq(users.id, session.user.id));

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  categoryDefinitions,
  categoryAttributes,
  columnAttributes,
} from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and } from "drizzle-orm";
import { parseCategoryReport } from "@/lib/category-report-parser";
import { matchHubFields } from "@/lib/category-attribute-matcher";

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const clientIdCode = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("clientIdCode");

  const query = clientIdCode
    ? db
        .select()
        .from(categoryDefinitions)
        .where(eq(categoryDefinitions.clientIdCode, clientIdCode))
        .orderBy(categoryDefinitions.productType)
    : db
        .select()
        .from(categoryDefinitions)
        .orderBy(categoryDefinitions.clientIdCode, categoryDefinitions.productType);

  const definitions = await query;
  return NextResponse.json({ definitions });
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (session.user.role !== "editor" && session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Forbidden: editors or admins only" },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }

  const formData = await req.formData();
  const file = formData.get("file") as File | null;
  const clientIdCode = formData.get("clientIdCode") as string | null;

  if (!file) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "No file provided" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  if (!clientIdCode) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "clientIdCode is required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Parse the XLSM
  let parsed;
  try {
    const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
    parsed = parseCategoryReport(buffer);
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `Failed to parse report: ${msg}` },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Fetch Hub column attributes for matching
  const allColumns = await db.select().from(columnAttributes);
  const matches = matchHubFields(parsed.attributes, allColumns);
  const matchCount = matches.size;

  // Upsert: delete existing definition for same client + productType + marketplace
  const existing = await db
    .select({ id: categoryDefinitions.id })
    .from(categoryDefinitions)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(categoryDefinitions.clientIdCode, clientIdCode),
        eq(categoryDefinitions.productType, parsed.productType),
        eq(categoryDefinitions.marketplaceId, parsed.marketplace)
      )
    )
    .limit(1);

  if (existing.length > 0) {
    // Cascade will delete related attributes
    await db
      .delete(categoryDefinitions)
      .where(eq(categoryDefinitions.id, existing[0].id));
  }

  // Insert new definition
  const [newDef] = await db
    .insert(categoryDefinitions)
    .values({
      clientIdCode,
      productType: parsed.productType,
      marketplaceId: parsed.marketplace,
      totalAttributes: parsed.summary.total,
      requiredCount: parsed.summary.required,
      conditionalCount: parsed.summary.conditional,
      optionalCount: parsed.summary.optional,
      uploadedBy: session.user.email ?? "unknown",
    })
    .returning();

  // Insert all attributes
  if (parsed.attributes.length > 0) {
    const attrValues = parsed.attributes.map((attr) => ({
      definitionId: newDef.id,
      amazonFieldName: attr.amazonFieldName,
      localLabel: attr.localLabel,
      groupName: attr.groupName,
      description: attr.description || null,
      example: attr.example || null,
      requirement: attr.requirement,
      validValues: attr.validValues.length > 0 ? attr.validValues : null,
      bibleFieldMatch: matches.get(attr.amazonFieldName) ?? null,
      sortOrder: attr.sortOrder,
    }));

    // Insert in batches of 100 to avoid query size limits
    for (let i = 0; i < attrValues.length; i += 100) {
      await db
        .insert(categoryAttributes)
        .values(attrValues.slice(i, i + 100));
    }
  }

  return NextResponse.json({
    definition: newDef,
    summary: parsed.summary,
    productType: parsed.productType,
    marketplace: parsed.marketplace,
    matchCount,
  });
}

FILE: src/app/api/category-definitions/[productType]/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  categoryDefinitions,
  categoryAttributes,
  master,
} from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getProductFieldValue } from "@/lib/product-mapper";

export async function GET(
  req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ productType: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { productType } = await params;
  const clientIdCode = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("clientIdCode");
  const marketplaceId =
    req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("marketplaceId") || "ATVPDKIKX0DER";
  const productId = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("productId");

  if (!clientIdCode) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "clientIdCode is required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Find the definition
  const [definition] = await db
    .select()
    .from(categoryDefinitions)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(categoryDefinitions.clientIdCode, clientIdCode),
        eq(
          categoryDefinitions.productType,
          decodeURIComponent(productType)
        ),
        eq(categoryDefinitions.marketplaceId, marketplaceId)
      )
    )
    .limit(1);

  if (!definition) {
    return NextResponse.json({ definition: null, groups: [] });
  }

  // Fetch all attributes for this definition
  const attrs = await db
    .select()
    .from(categoryAttributes)
    .where(eq(categoryAttributes.definitionId, definition.id))
    .orderBy(categoryAttributes.sortOrder);

  // Optionally resolve current product values
  let product = null;
  if (productId) {
    const [p] = await db
      .select()
      .from(master)
      .where(eq(master.id, productId))
      .limit(1);
    product = p ?? null;
  }

  // Group attributes by groupName
  const groupMap = new Map<
    string,
    Array<{
      localLabel: string;
      amazonFieldName: string;
      description: string | null;
      example: string | null;
      requirement: string;
      validValues: string[] | null;
      bibleFieldMatch: string | null;
      currentValue: string | null;
      sortOrder: number;
    }>
  >();

  for (const attr of attrs) {
    const group = attr.groupName;
    if (!groupMap.has(group)) groupMap.set(group, []);

    let currentValue: string | null = null;
    if (product && attr.bibleFieldMatch) {
      currentValue = getProductFieldValue(product, attr.bibleFieldMatch);
    }

    groupMap.get(group)!.push({
      localLabel: attr.localLabel,
      amazonFieldName: attr.amazonFieldName,
      description: attr.description,
      example: attr.example,
      requirement: attr.requirement,
      validValues: attr.validValues,
      bibleFieldMatch: attr.bibleFieldMatch,
      currentValue,
      sortOrder: attr.sortOrder,
    });
  }

  // Convert to ordered array
  const groups = Array.from(groupMap.entries()).map(([name, attributes]) => ({
    name,
    attributes,
  }));

  return NextResponse.json({ definition, groups });
}

export async function DELETE(
  req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ productType: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Admin only" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { productType } = await params;
  // The param is used as the definition ID for delete
  const defId = parseInt(productType, 10);
  if (isNaN(defId)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid ID" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  await db
    .delete(categoryDefinitions)
    .where(eq(categoryDefinitions.id, defId));

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
}

FILE: src/app/api/clients/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, aac } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { sql, asc, ilike, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { CLIENT_NAMES, TEAM_ROLES } from "@/lib/constants";
import { insertClientToBigQuery } from "@/lib/bigquery";

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const statusFilter = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("status");

  // Return lightweight list for inactive clients
  if (statusFilter?.toLowerCase() === "inactive") {
    const inactiveClients = await db
      .select({
        clientIdCode: aac.clientIdCode,
        clientName: aac.clientName,
      })
      .from(aac)
      .where(ilike(aac.clientStatus, "inactive"))
      .orderBy(asc(aac.clientIdCode));

    return NextResponse.json(
      inactiveClients.map((c) => ({
        clientIdCode: c.clientIdCode,
        clientName: c.clientName || CLIENT_NAMES[c.clientIdCode] || c.clientIdCode,
      }))
    );
  }

  // Get active client codes + names + rawData from AAC table
  const activeClients = await db
    .select({
      clientIdCode: aac.clientIdCode,
      clientName: aac.clientName,
      rawData: aac.rawData,
    })
    .from(aac)
    .where(ilike(aac.clientStatus, "active"));

  const activeClientMap = new Map(
    activeClients.map((c) => [c.clientIdCode, { name: c.clientName, rawData: c.rawData }])
  );

  // Get product counts per client with status breakdown
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode,
      count: sql<number>`count(*)::int`,
      activeCount: sql<number>`count(*) FILTER (WHERE ${master.status} ILIKE 'active')::int`,
      discontinuedCount: sql<number>`count(*) FILTER (WHERE ${master.status} ILIKE 'discontinued')::int`,
      outOfStockCount: sql<number>`count(*) FILTER (WHERE ${master.status} ILIKE 'out of stock')::int`,
      closedCount: sql<number>`count(*) FILTER (WHERE ${master.status} ILIKE 'closed')::int`,
      inactiveCount: sql<number>`count(*) FILTER (WHERE ${master.status} ILIKE 'inactive')::int`,
      incompleteCount: sql<number>`count(*) FILTER (WHERE ${master.status} ILIKE 'incomplete')::int`,
      replacementCount: sql<number>`count(*) FILTER (WHERE ${master.status} ILIKE 'replacement%')::int`,
      unknownCount: sql<number>`count(*) FILTER (WHERE ${master.status} IS NULL OR ${master.status} = '')::int`,
    })
    .from(master)
    .where(sql`${master.clientIdCode} IS NOT NULL AND ${master.clientIdCode} != ''`)
    .groupBy(master.clientIdCode)
    .orderBy(asc(master.clientIdCode));

  // Get latest Amazon match scores per product (most recent snapshot per product)
  const amazonMatchRows = await db.execute(sql`
    SELECT
      p.client_id_code,
      ROUND(AVG(latest.overall_match))::int AS avg_match,
      COUNT(*)::int AS compared_count
    FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (product_id)
        product_id,
        overall_match
      FROM amazon_snapshots
      ORDER BY product_id, fetched_at DESC
    ) latest
    JOIN master p ON p.id = latest.product_id
    WHERE p.client_id_code IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.client_id_code
  `);

  const amazonMatchMap = new Map<string, { avgMatch: number; comparedCount: number }>();
  for (const row of amazonMatchRows) {
    const r = row as { client_id_code: string; avg_match: number; compared_count: number };
    amazonMatchMap.set(r.client_id_code, {
      avgMatch: r.avg_match,
      comparedCount: r.compared_count,
    });
  }

  // Build product stats map from rows
  const productStatsMap = new Map(
    rows.map((r) => [r.clientIdCode, r])
  );

  // Include ALL active AAC clients, even those with 0 products
  const filtered = [...activeClientMap.entries()].map(([clientIdCode, aac]) => {
    const r = productStatsMap.get(clientIdCode);
    // rawData may be double-stringified (JSON string inside JSONB)
    let raw: Record<string, string> = {};
    if (typeof aac.rawData === "string") {
      try { raw = JSON.parse(aac.rawData); } catch { /* ignore */ }
    } else if (aac.rawData) {
      raw = aac.rawData as Record<string, string>;
    }
    const team: { label: string; name: string }[] = [];
    for (const [key, label] of Object.entries(TEAM_ROLES)) {
      const name = raw[key]?.trim();
      if (name) team.push({ label, name });
    }
    const amazonMatch = amazonMatchMap.get(clientIdCode) ?? null;
    const statusBreakdown: Record<string, number> = {
      Active: r?.activeCount ?? 0,
      Inactive: r?.inactiveCount ?? 0,
      "Out of Stock": r?.outOfStockCount ?? 0,
      Closed: r?.closedCount ?? 0,
      Incomplete: r?.incompleteCount ?? 0,
      Discontinued: r?.discontinuedCount ?? 0,
      "Replacement ASIN": r?.replacementCount ?? 0,
    };
    return {
      clientIdCode,
      count: r?.count ?? 0,
      activeCount: r?.activeCount ?? 0,
      clientName: aac.name || CLIENT_NAMES[clientIdCode] || clientIdCode,
      statusBreakdown,
      team,
      amazonMatch,
    };
  });

  // Sort alphabetically by clientIdCode
  filtered.sort((a, b) => (a.clientIdCode ?? "").localeCompare(b.clientIdCode ?? ""));

  return NextResponse.json(filtered);
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const clientIdCode = (body.clientIdCode ?? "").trim();
  if (!clientIdCode) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Client ID Code is required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Check uniqueness
  const existing = await db
    .select({ id: aac.id })
    .from(aac)
    .where(eq(aac.clientIdCode, clientIdCode))
    .limit(1);

  if (existing.length > 0) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Client ID already exists" },
      { status: 409 }
    );
  }

  const clientName = (body.clientName ?? "").trim();
  const clientStatus = (body.clientStatus ?? "Active").trim() || "Active";

  await db.insert(aac).values({
    clientIdCode,
    clientName: clientName || null,
    clientStatus,
    rawData: {
      ClientIdCode: clientIdCode,
      ClientName: clientName,
      ClientStatus: clientStatus,
    },
  });

  // Also insert into BigQuery AAC table so SEO manager can see it
  try {
    await insertClientToBigQuery(clientIdCode, clientName, clientStatus);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Failed to insert client into BigQuery:", err);
    // Don't fail the request — PG insert succeeded
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ clientIdCode }, { status: 201 });
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, aac, adminEventLog } from "@/lib/db/schema";

export async function GET(
  _req: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ clientIdCode: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { clientIdCode } = await params;

  // Fetch client row
  const [client] = await db
    .select()
    .from(aac)
    .where(eq(aac.clientIdCode, clientIdCode))
    .limit(1);

  if (!client) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Client not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  // Parse rawData (handle double-stringified JSON)
  let rawData: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (typeof client.rawData === "string") {
    try {
      rawData = JSON.parse(client.rawData);
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  } else if (client.rawData) {
    rawData = client.rawData as Record<string, string>;
  }

  // Fetch product stats
  const [stats] = await db
    .select({
      count: sql<number>`count(*)::int`,
      activeCount: sql<number>`count(*) FILTER (WHERE ${master.status} ILIKE 'active')::int`,
      inactiveCount: sql<number>`count(*) FILTER (WHERE ${master.status} ILIKE 'inactive')::int`,
      outOfStockCount: sql<number>`count(*) FILTER (WHERE ${master.status} ILIKE 'out of stock')::int`,
      closedCount: sql<number>`count(*) FILTER (WHERE ${master.status} ILIKE 'closed')::int`,
      incompleteCount: sql<number>`count(*) FILTER (WHERE ${master.status} ILIKE 'incomplete')::int`,
      discontinuedCount: sql<number>`count(*) FILTER (WHERE ${master.status} ILIKE 'discontinued')::int`,
      replacementCount: sql<number>`count(*) FILTER (WHERE ${master.status} ILIKE 'replacement%')::int`,
    })
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.clientIdCode, clientIdCode));

  const statusBreakdown: Record<string, number> = {
    Active: stats?.activeCount ?? 0,
    Inactive: stats?.inactiveCount ?? 0,
    "Out of Stock": stats?.outOfStockCount ?? 0,
    Closed: stats?.closedCount ?? 0,
    Incomplete: stats?.incompleteCount ?? 0,
    Discontinued: stats?.discontinuedCount ?? 0,
    "Replacement ASIN": stats?.replacementCount ?? 0,
  };

  return NextResponse.json({
    client: {
      id: client.id,
      clientIdCode: client.clientIdCode,
      clientStatus: client.clientStatus,
      clientName: client.clientName,
      updatedAt: client.updatedAt,
    },
    rawData,
    productStats: {
      count: stats?.count ?? 0,
      activeCount: stats?.activeCount ?? 0,
      statusBreakdown,
    },
  });
}

export async function PUT(
  req: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ clientIdCode: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const role = (session.user as { role?: string })?.role;
  if (role === "viewer") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { clientIdCode } = await params;
  const body = await req.json();
  const { field, value } = body as { field: string; value: string };

  if (typeof field !== "string" || typeof value !== "string") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid body" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Fetch current row
  const [client] = await db
    .select()
    .from(aac)
    .where(eq(aac.clientIdCode, clientIdCode))
    .limit(1);

  if (!client) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Client not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  // Parse existing rawData
  let rawData: Record<string, string> = {};
  if (typeof client.rawData === "string") {
    try {
      rawData = JSON.parse(client.rawData);
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  } else if (client.rawData) {
    rawData = client.rawData as Record<string, string>;
  }

  const oldValue = rawData[field] ?? "";

  // Merge the updated field
  rawData[field] = value;

  // Build update payload
  const updatePayload: {
    rawData: Record<string, string>;
    updatedAt: Date;
    clientName?: string;
    clientStatus?: string;
    powerbiEmbedUrl?: string;
  } = {
    rawData,
    updatedAt: new Date(),
  };

  if (field === "ClientName") {
    updatePayload.clientName = value;
  }
  if (field === "ClientStatus") {
    updatePayload.clientStatus = value;
  }
  if (field === "PowerBIEmbedURL") {
    updatePayload.powerbiEmbedUrl = value;
  }

  const startMs = Date.now();

  await db
    .update(aac)
    .set(updatePayload)
    .where(eq(aac.clientIdCode, clientIdCode));

  // Sync to BigQuery
  console.log(`[AAC] Saving to DB done. Now syncing to BQ: ${clientIdCode}.${field} = "${value}"`);
  let bqStatus: "success" | "error" = "success";
  let bqError: string | undefined;
  try {
    await updateAacFieldInBigQuery(clientIdCode, field, value);
    console.log(`[AAC] BQ sync SUCCESS: ${clientIdCode}.${field}`);
  } catch (err) {
    bqStatus = "error";
    bqError = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    console.error(`[AAC] BQ sync FAILED: ${clientIdCode}.${field}:`, err);
  }

  const durationMs = Date.now() - startMs;

  // Log to admin_event_log
  await db.insert(adminEventLog).values({
    userEmail: session.user?.email ?? null,
    userName: session.user?.name ?? null,
    section: "clients",
    action: "client:edit",
    status: bqStatus,
    resourceType: "client",
    resourceId: clientIdCode,
    resourceLabel: `${clientIdCode} → ${field}`,
    message: bqStatus === "success"
      ? `Updated ${field}: "${oldValue}" → "${value}" (DB + BQ)`
      : `Updated ${field}: "${oldValue}" → "${value}" (DB ok, BQ failed: ${bqError})`,
    detail: { field, oldValue, newValue: value, bqStatus, bqError },
    durationMs,
  }).catch(() => {}); // best-effort logging

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true, bqSyncFailed: bqStatus === "error" });
}

export async function PATCH(
  req: Request,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ clientIdCode: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const role = (session.user as { role?: string })?.role;
  if (role === "viewer") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { clientIdCode } = await params;
  const body = await req.json();
  const { clientName, clientStatus } = body as {
    clientName?: string;
    clientStatus?: string;
  };

  // Validate at least one field to update
  if (clientName === undefined && clientStatus === undefined) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Nothing to update" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Fetch current row
  const [client] = await db
    .select()
    .from(aac)
    .where(eq(aac.clientIdCode, clientIdCode))
    .limit(1);

  if (!client) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Client not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  const updatePayload: {
    updatedAt: Date;
    clientName?: string;
    clientStatus?: string;
  } = { updatedAt: new Date() };

  if (clientName !== undefined) updatePayload.clientName = clientName;
  if (clientStatus !== undefined) updatePayload.clientStatus = clientStatus;

  await db
    .update(aac)
    .set(updatePayload)
    .where(eq(aac.clientIdCode, clientIdCode));

  // Log the edit
  await db.insert(adminEventLog).values({
    userEmail: session.user?.email ?? null,
    userName: session.user?.name ?? null,
    section: "clients",
    action: "client:edit",
    status: "success",
    resourceType: "client",
    resourceId: clientIdCode,
    resourceLabel: clientIdCode,
    message: `Updated client: name="${clientName ?? client.clientName}", status="${clientStatus ?? client.clientStatus}"`,
    detail: { clientName, clientStatus, previousName: client.clientName, previousStatus: client.clientStatus },
  }).catch(() => {});

  return NextResponse.json({
    success: true,
    clientIdCode,
    clientName: clientName ?? client.clientName,
    clientStatus: clientStatus ?? client.clientStatus,
  });
}
