import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { clientGanttTasks, ganttTemplates, aac } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { AIA_TASKS, NTA_TASKS } from "@/lib/gantt-templates";

type RouteCtx = { params: Promise<{ clientIdCode: string }> };

/** GET — fetch all gantt tasks for a client */
export async function GET(_req: NextRequest, { params }: RouteCtx) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const { clientIdCode } = await params;

  const tasks = await db
    .select()
    .from(clientGanttTasks)
    .where(eq(clientGanttTasks.clientIdCode, clientIdCode));

  // Also fetch client type from aac
  const [client] = await db
    .select({ clientType: aac.clientType })
    .from(aac)
    .where(eq(aac.clientIdCode, clientIdCode))
    .limit(1);

  return NextResponse.json({
    tasks,
    clientType: client?.clientType ?? null,
    initialized: tasks.length > 0,
  });
}

/** POST — initialize timeline from template (snapshot) */
export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: RouteCtx) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const { clientIdCode } = await params;
  const body = await req.json();
  const templateType = body.templateType as "AIA" | "NTA";

  if (!templateType || !["AIA", "NTA"].includes(templateType)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "templateType must be AIA or NTA" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Check if already initialized
  const existing = await db
    .select({ id: clientGanttTasks.id })
    .from(clientGanttTasks)
    .where(eq(clientGanttTasks.clientIdCode, clientIdCode))
    .limit(1);

  if (existing.length > 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Timeline already initialized" }, { status: 409 });
  }

  // Ensure gantt_templates are seeded
  const templateRows = await db.select().from(ganttTemplates).where(eq(ganttTemplates.templateType, templateType));

  let templateMap = new Map(templateRows.map((t) => [t.wbs, t.id]));

  if (templateRows.length === 0) {
    // Seed templates on first use
    const seeds = templateType === "AIA" ? AIA_TASKS : NTA_TASKS;
    const inserted = await db.insert(ganttTemplates).values(seeds).returning();
    templateMap = new Map(inserted.map((t) => [t.wbs, t.id]));
  }

  // Create client tasks (snapshot from template)
  const seeds = templateType === "AIA" ? AIA_TASKS : NTA_TASKS;
  const taskValues = seeds.map((t) => ({
    clientIdCode,
    templateTaskId: templateMap.get(t.wbs) ?? null,
    wbs: t.wbs,
    section: t.section,
    taskName: t.taskName,
    weekStart: t.weekStart,
    weekEnd: t.weekEnd,
    status: "pending" as const,
    completionPct: 0,
  }));

  const tasks = await db.insert(clientGanttTasks).values(taskValues).returning();

  // Update client type in aac
  await db
    .update(aac)
    .set({ clientType: templateType })
    .where(eq(aac.clientIdCode, clientIdCode));

  return NextResponse.json({ tasks, initialized: true }, { status: 201 });
}

/** PUT — add a single custom task */
export async function PUT(req: NextRequest, { params }: RouteCtx) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const { clientIdCode } = await params;
  const body = await req.json();

  const { section, taskName, weekStart, weekEnd, wbs } = body;
  if (!section || !taskName || !weekStart || !weekEnd) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "section, taskName, weekStart, weekEnd required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const [task] = await db
    .insert(clientGanttTasks)
    .values({
      clientIdCode,
      wbs: wbs || "X.XX",
      section,
      taskName,
      weekStart: Number(weekStart),
      weekEnd: Number(weekEnd),
      status: "pending",
      completionPct: 0,
    })
    .returning();

  return NextResponse.json(task, { status: 201 });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { clientGanttTasks } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";

type RouteCtx = { params: Promise<{ clientIdCode: string; taskId: string }> };

/** PATCH — update a single gantt task */
export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest, { params }: RouteCtx) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const { taskId } = await params;
  const body = await req.json();

  const allowed: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (body.status !== undefined) allowed.status = body.status;
  if (body.completionPct !== undefined) allowed.completionPct = body.completionPct;
  if (body.notes !== undefined) allowed.notes = body.notes;
  if (body.assignedTo !== undefined) allowed.assignedTo = body.assignedTo;
  if (body.weekStart !== undefined) allowed.weekStart = body.weekStart;
  if (body.weekEnd !== undefined) allowed.weekEnd = body.weekEnd;
  if (body.taskName !== undefined) allowed.taskName = body.taskName;
  if (body.section !== undefined) allowed.section = body.section;

  if (body.status === "in_progress" && !body.startedAt) {
    allowed.startedAt = new Date();
  }
  if (body.status === "completed") {
    allowed.completedAt = new Date();
    allowed.completionPct = 100;
  }

  allowed.updatedAt = new Date();

  const [updated] = await db
    .update(clientGanttTasks)
    .set(allowed)
    .where(eq(clientGanttTasks.id, Number(taskId)))
    .returning();

  if (!updated) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Task not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  return NextResponse.json(updated);
}

/** DELETE — remove a gantt task */
export async function DELETE(_req: NextRequest, { params }: RouteCtx) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const { taskId } = await params;

  const [deleted] = await db
    .delete(clientGanttTasks)
    .where(eq(clientGanttTasks.id, Number(taskId)))
    .returning();

  if (!deleted) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Task not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { clientOnboardingSteps } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { ONBOARDING_STEPS } from "@/lib/onboarding/steps";

export async function GET(
  _req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ clientIdCode: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { clientIdCode } = await params;

  // Get all recorded steps for this client
  const rows = await db
    .select()
    .from(clientOnboardingSteps)
    .where(eq(clientOnboardingSteps.clientIdCode, clientIdCode));

  const stepMap = new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.stepKey, r]));

  // Auto-mark "create_client" as completed — if we're fetching onboarding, the client exists
  if (!stepMap.has("create_client")) {
    await db
      .insert(clientOnboardingSteps)
      .values({
        clientIdCode,
        stepKey: "create_client",
        status: "completed",
        completedAt: new Date(),
        completedBy: "auto",
      })
      .onConflictDoNothing();
    stepMap.set("create_client", {
      id: "",
      clientIdCode,
      stepKey: "create_client",
      status: "completed",
      completedAt: new Date(),
      completedBy: "auto",
      metadata: null,
      createdAt: new Date(),
      updatedAt: new Date(),
    });
  }

  // Merge definitions with DB state
  const steps = ONBOARDING_STEPS.map((def) => {
    const row = stepMap.get(def.key);
    return {
      key: def.key,
      label: def.label,
      description: def.description,
      order: def.order,
      status: row?.status ?? "pending",
      completedAt: row?.completedAt ?? null,
      completedBy: row?.completedBy ?? null,
      metadata: row?.metadata ?? null,
    };
  });

  return NextResponse.json({ clientIdCode, steps });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { aac, clientOnboardingSteps } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and } from "drizzle-orm";
import { createClientDriveFolders } from "@/lib/onboarding/create-drive-folders";

export async function POST(
  _req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ clientIdCode: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (session.user.role !== "admin" && session.user.role !== "editor") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { clientIdCode } = await params;
  const sharedDriveId = process.env.GOOGLE_SHARED_DRIVE_ID?.trim();
  if (!sharedDriveId) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "GOOGLE_SHARED_DRIVE_ID not configured" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }

  // Look up client name for folder naming
  const [client] = await db
    .select({ clientName: aac.clientName })
    .from(aac)
    .where(eq(aac.clientIdCode, clientIdCode))
    .limit(1);
  const clientName = client?.clientName ?? undefined;

  // Mark step as in_progress
  await db
    .insert(clientOnboardingSteps)
    .values({
      clientIdCode,
      stepKey: "drive_folders",
      status: "in_progress",
    })
    .onConflictDoUpdate({
      target: [clientOnboardingSteps.clientIdCode, clientOnboardingSteps.stepKey],
      set: { status: "in_progress", updatedAt: new Date() },
    });

  try {
    const result = await createClientDriveFolders(clientIdCode, sharedDriveId, clientName);

    // Mark completed
    await db
      .update(clientOnboardingSteps)
      .set({
        status: "completed",
        completedAt: new Date(),
        completedBy: session.user.email ?? session.user.name ?? "unknown",
        metadata: {
          foldersCreated: result.created.length,
          foldersSkipped: result.skipped,
          folders: result.created.map((f) => ({
            name: f.name,
            type: f.type,
            path: f.path,
          })),
        },
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(
        and(
          eq(clientOnboardingSteps.clientIdCode, clientIdCode),
          eq(clientOnboardingSteps.stepKey, "drive_folders")
        )
      );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      created: result.created.length,
      skipped: result.skipped,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unknown error";
    console.error(`Drive folder creation failed for ${clientIdCode}:`, message);

    // Mark failed
    await db
      .update(clientOnboardingSteps)
      .set({
        status: "failed",
        metadata: { error: message },
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(
        and(
          eq(clientOnboardingSteps.clientIdCode, clientIdCode),
          eq(clientOnboardingSteps.stepKey, "drive_folders")
        )
      );

    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { aac } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { asc, eq } from "drizzle-orm";

// Lightweight client list — optional ?status=Active filter
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const status = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("status");

  const query = db
    .select({
      clientIdCode: aac.clientIdCode,
      clientName: aac.clientName,
    })
    .from(aac);

  const rows = status
    ? await query.where(eq(aac.clientStatus, status)).orderBy(asc(aac.clientName))
    : await query.orderBy(asc(aac.clientName));

  return NextResponse.json(
    rows.map((r) => ({
      clientIdCode: r.clientIdCode,
      clientName: r.clientName || r.clientIdCode,
    }))
  );
}

FILE: src/app/api/compare/batch/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  master,
  amazonSnapshots,
  spApiCredentials,
} from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and, isNotNull, ne } from "drizzle-orm";
import { SPAPIClient } from "@/lib/sp-api/client";
import { normalizeCatalogItem } from "@/lib/sp-api/normalizer";
import { compareProductWithAmazon } from "@/lib/sp-api/comparator";

export const maxDuration = 60;

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Forbidden: admin only" },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const { clientIdCode, maxProducts: maxParam } = body as {
    clientIdCode: string;
    maxProducts?: number;
  };

  if (!clientIdCode) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "clientIdCode is required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  const maxProducts = Math.min(Math.max(maxParam ?? 100, 1), 500);

  // Fetch credentials
  const [creds] = await db
    .select()
    .from(spApiCredentials)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(spApiCredentials.clientIdCode, clientIdCode),
        eq(spApiCredentials.isActive, true)
      )
    )
    .limit(1);

  if (!creds) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `No SP-API credentials configured for client ${clientIdCode}` },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Fetch products with non-empty ASINs
  const productList = await db
    .select()
    .from(master)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(master.clientIdCode, clientIdCode),
        isNotNull(master.asin),
        ne(master.asin, "")
      )
    )
    .limit(maxProducts);

  if (productList.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `No products with ASINs found for client ${clientIdCode}` },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Create SP-API client
  const client = new SPAPIClient({
    clientId: process.env.SP_API_CLIENT_ID!,
    clientSecret: process.env.SP_API_CLIENT_SECRET!,
    refreshToken: creds.refreshToken,
    marketplaceId: creds.marketplaceId,
    sellerId: creds.sellerId,
    region: creds.region as "na" | "eu" | "fe",
  });

  // Batch fetch
  const asins = productList.map((p) => p.asin!);
  const catalogItems = await client.getCatalogItemsBatch(asins);

  // Process results
  const errors: string[] = [];
  let compared = 0;
  let failed = 0;
  const matchScores: number[] = [];

  // Build ASIN → product map
  const asinToProduct = new Map(productList.map((p) => [p.asin!, p]));

  for (const [asin, catalogItem] of catalogItems.entries()) {
    const product = asinToProduct.get(asin);
    if (!product) continue;

    try {
      const normalizedData = normalizeCatalogItem(catalogItem);
      const comparison = compareProductWithAmazon(product, normalizedData);

      await db.insert(amazonSnapshots).values({
        productId: product.id,
        asin,
        marketplace: product.marketplace,
        normalizedData,
        comparisonResult: comparison,
        overallMatch: comparison.overallMatch,
        fetchedAt: new Date(),
      });

      matchScores.push(comparison.overallMatch);
      compared++;
    } catch (err) {
      const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
      errors.push(`${asin}: ${msg}`);
      failed++;
    }
  }

  // Count ASINs that weren't fetched at all
  for (const asin of asins) {
    if (!catalogItems.has(asin)) {
      errors.push(`${asin}: SP-API fetch failed`);
      failed++;
    }
  }

  // Update last_sync_at
  await db
    .update(spApiCredentials)
    .set({ lastSyncAt: new Date(), updatedAt: new Date() })
    .where(eq(spApiCredentials.id, creds.id));

  // Compute distribution
  const distribution = { perfect: 0, good: 0, drifted: 0, major: 0 };
  for (const score of matchScores) {
    if (score >= 95) distribution.perfect++;
    else if (score >= 70) distribution.good++;
    else if (score >= 50) distribution.drifted++;
    else distribution.major++;
  }

  const averageMatch =
    matchScores.length > 0
      ? Math.round(
          matchScores.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / matchScores.length
        )
      : 0;

  return NextResponse.json({
    total: productList.length,
    compared,
    failed,
    averageMatch,
    distribution,
    errors: errors.slice(0, 50), // Cap error list
  });
}

FILE: src/app/api/cron/amazon-sync/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  master,
  amazonSnapshots,
  spApiCredentials,
} from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and, isNotNull, ne } from "drizzle-orm";
import { SPAPIClient } from "@/lib/sp-api/client";
import { normalizeCatalogItem } from "@/lib/sp-api/normalizer";
import { compareProductWithAmazon } from "@/lib/sp-api/comparator";

export const maxDuration = 300; // 5 minutes for nightly batch

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  // Verify cron secret
  const authHeader = req.headers.get("authorization");
  const cronSecret = process.env.CRON_SECRET;

  if (!cronSecret || authHeader !== `Bearer ${cronSecret}`) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  // Fetch all active SP-API credentials
  const allCreds = await db
    .select()
    .from(spApiCredentials)
    .where(eq(spApiCredentials.isActive, true));

  if (allCreds.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({ message: "No active SP-API credentials" });
  }

  const results: {
    client: string;
    total: number;
    compared: number;
    failed: number;
    averageMatch: number;
  }[] = [];

  for (const creds of allCreds) {
    // Fetch products with ASINs for this client
    const productList = await db
      .select()
      .from(master)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(master.clientIdCode, creds.clientIdCode),
          isNotNull(master.asin),
          ne(master.asin, "")
        )
      );

    if (productList.length === 0) {
      results.push({
        client: creds.clientIdCode,
        total: 0,
        compared: 0,
        failed: 0,
        averageMatch: 0,
      });
      continue;
    }

    const client = new SPAPIClient({
      clientId: process.env.SP_API_CLIENT_ID!,
      clientSecret: process.env.SP_API_CLIENT_SECRET!,
      refreshToken: creds.refreshToken,
      marketplaceId: creds.marketplaceId,
      sellerId: creds.sellerId,
      region: creds.region as "na" | "eu" | "fe",
    });

    // Batch fetch catalog items
    const asins = productList.map((p) => p.asin!);
    let catalogItems: Map<string, unknown>;
    try {
      catalogItems = await client.getCatalogItemsBatch(asins);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`Cron: Failed batch fetch for ${creds.clientIdCode}:`, err);
      results.push({
        client: creds.clientIdCode,
        total: productList.length,
        compared: 0,
        failed: productList.length,
        averageMatch: 0,
      });
      continue;
    }

    const asinToProduct = new Map(productList.map((p) => [p.asin!, p]));
    let compared = 0;
    let failed = 0;
    const matchScores: number[] = [];

    for (const [asin, catalogItem] of catalogItems.entries()) {
      const product = asinToProduct.get(asin);
      if (!product) continue;

      try {
        const normalizedData = normalizeCatalogItem(catalogItem);
        const comparison = compareProductWithAmazon(product, normalizedData);

        await db.insert(amazonSnapshots).values({
          productId: product.id,
          asin,
          marketplace: product.marketplace,
          normalizedData,
          comparisonResult: comparison,
          overallMatch: comparison.overallMatch,
          fetchedAt: new Date(),
        });

        matchScores.push(comparison.overallMatch);
        compared++;
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(`Cron: Failed to compare ${asin}:`, err);
        failed++;
      }
    }

    // Count ASINs not fetched
    for (const asin of asins) {
      if (!catalogItems.has(asin)) {
        failed++;
      }
    }

    // Update last_sync_at
    await db
      .update(spApiCredentials)
      .set({ lastSyncAt: new Date(), updatedAt: new Date() })
      .where(eq(spApiCredentials.id, creds.id));

    const averageMatch =
      matchScores.length > 0
        ? Math.round(matchScores.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / matchScores.length)
        : 0;

    results.push({
      client: creds.clientIdCode,
      total: productList.length,
      compared,
      failed,
      averageMatch,
    });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({
    syncedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    clients: results,
  });
}

FILE: src/app/api/cron/amazon-sync-rainforest/route.ts

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, amazonSyncRuns } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";

export const maxDuration = 60;

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  // Verify cron secret
  const authHeader = req.headers.get("authorization");
  const cronSecret = process.env.CRON_SECRET;
  if (!cronSecret || authHeader !== `Bearer ${cronSecret}`) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const apiKey = process.env.RAINFOREST_API_KEY;
  if (!apiKey) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Rainforest API key not configured" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }

  // Get all clients with products that have ASINs
  const clientRows = await db
    .select({
      clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode,
      count: sql<number>`count(*)`,
    })
    .from(master)
    .where(sql`${master.asin} IS NOT NULL AND ${master.asin} != '' AND lower(${master.parentageLevel}) != 'parent'`)
    .groupBy(master.clientIdCode);

  const clients = clientRows.filter((c) => c.clientIdCode);

  const summary: Array<{
    client: string;
    total: number;
    completed: number;
    failed: number;
    credits: number;
  }> = [];

  for (const client of clients) {
    const clientIdCode = client.clientIdCode!;

    const clientProducts = await db
      .select({ id: master.id })
      .from(master)
      .where(
        sql`${master.clientIdCode} = ${clientIdCode} AND ${master.asin} IS NOT NULL AND ${master.asin} != '' AND lower(${master.parentageLevel}) != 'parent'`
      );

    const [run] = await db
      .insert(amazonSyncRuns)
      .values({
        clientIdCode,
        runType: "scheduled",
        status: "running",
        totalProducts: clientProducts.length,
        startedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .returning();

    try {
      const baseUrl = req.nextUrl.origin;
      const runRes = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/amazon-sync/fetch`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          product_ids: clientProducts.map((p) => p.id),
          client_id: clientIdCode,
          run_id: run.id,
        }),
      });

      const data = runRes.ok ? await runRes.json() : null;
      const completed =
        data?.results?.filter(
          (r: { status: string }) => r.status === "success"
        ).length ?? 0;
      const failed =
        data?.results?.filter(
          (r: { status: string }) => r.status === "failed"
        ).length ?? 0;

      await db
        .update(amazonSyncRuns)
        .set({
          status: "completed",
          completedProducts: completed,
          failedProducts: failed,
          creditsUsed: data?.credits_used ?? 0,
          completedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(sql`${amazonSyncRuns.id} = ${run.id}`);

      summary.push({
        client: clientIdCode,
        total: clientProducts.length,
        completed,
        failed,
        credits: data?.credits_used ?? 0,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      await db
        .update(amazonSyncRuns)
        .set({
          status: "failed",
          errorMessage:
            error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error",
          completedAt: new Date(),
        })
        .where(sql`${amazonSyncRuns.id} = ${run.id}`);

      summary.push({
        client: clientIdCode,
        total: clientProducts.length,
        completed: 0,
        failed: clientProducts.length,
        credits: 0,
      });
    }
  }

  console.log("[Rainforest Sync Cron] Summary:", JSON.stringify(summary));
  return NextResponse.json({ success: true, summary });
}

FILE: src/app/api/cron/impact/route.ts

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { contentImpactSnapshots, salesSummaryCache } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, or } from "drizzle-orm";
import { fillPendingSnapshots, type SalesMetricsSnapshot } from "@/lib/impact-snapshots";

export const maxDuration = 120;

/**
 * Daily cron safety net for impact snapshot processing.
 * Finds all clients with pending snapshots and fills them using
 * the most recent sales summary cache data.
 * Primary fill happens during sales dashboard loads (sales-summary API);
 * this cron ensures snapshots are processed even if nobody views the dashboard.
 */
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const authHeader = req.headers.get("authorization");
  const cronSecret = process.env.CRON_SECRET;
  if (!cronSecret || authHeader !== `Bearer ${cronSecret}`) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    // Find distinct clients with pending snapshots
    const pendingRows = await db
      .selectDistinct({ clientIdCode: contentImpactSnapshots.clientIdCode })
      .from(contentImpactSnapshots)
      .where(
        or(
          eq(contentImpactSnapshots.status, "pending_before"),
          eq(contentImpactSnapshots.status, "pending_after")
        )
      );

    if (pendingRows.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ processed: 0, message: "No pending snapshots" });
    }

    // Get the most recent sales summary cache
    const cacheRows = await db
      .select({ data: salesSummaryCache.data, updatedAt: salesSummaryCache.updatedAt })
      .from(salesSummaryCache)
      .where(eq(salesSummaryCache.cacheType, "summary"))
      .orderBy(salesSummaryCache.updatedAt)
      .limit(5);

    // Find the freshest cache entry (within 24h for cron — looser than the 12h lib threshold)
    type CacheShape = { clients?: Array<{ clientIdCode: string; current?: Record<string, number> }> };
    let cacheData: CacheShape | null = null;
    for (const row of cacheRows.reverse()) {
      const age = Date.now() - new Date(row.updatedAt).getTime();
      if (age > 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) continue;
      const data = row.data as CacheShape;
      if (data?.clients) {
        cacheData = data;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!cacheData?.clients) {
      return NextResponse.json({
        processed: 0,
        pendingClients: pendingRows.length,
        message: "No recent sales cache available",
      });
    }

    let filled = 0;
    const errors: string[] = [];

    for (const { clientIdCode } of pendingRows) {
      const client = cacheData.clients.find((c) => c.clientIdCode === clientIdCode);
      if (!client?.current) continue;

      const metrics: SalesMetricsSnapshot = {
        product_sales: client.current.product_sales ?? 0,
        ad_spend: client.current.ad_spend ?? 0,
        ad_revenue: client.current.ad_revenue ?? 0,
        ordered_units: client.current.ordered_units ?? 0,
        ordered_revenue: client.current.ordered_revenue ?? 0,
        glance_view_byasin: client.current.glance_view_byasin ?? 0,
        ad_impressions: client.current.ad_impressions ?? 0,
        ad_clicks: client.current.ad_clicks ?? 0,
      };

      try {
        await fillPendingSnapshots(clientIdCode, metrics);
        filled++;
      } catch (err) {
        errors.push(`${clientIdCode}: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : "unknown"}`);
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      processed: filled,
      pendingClients: pendingRows.length,
      errors: errors.length > 0 ? errors : undefined,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Impact cron error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Internal error" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

FILE: src/app/api/cron/snapshot-cleanup/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { amazonSnapshots } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { sql, inArray } from "drizzle-orm";

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  // Verify cron secret
  const authHeader = req.headers.get("authorization");
  const cronSecret = process.env.CRON_SECRET;

  if (!cronSecret || authHeader !== `Bearer ${cronSecret}`) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  // Find IDs of snapshots older than the 10 most recent per product
  const staleRows = await db.execute(sql`
    SELECT id FROM (
      SELECT
        id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY ${amazonSnapshots.productId}
          ORDER BY ${amazonSnapshots.fetchedAt} DESC
        ) AS rn
      FROM ${amazonSnapshots}
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn > 10
  `);

  const staleIds = (staleRows as unknown as { id: number }[]).map((r) => r.id);

  if (staleIds.length > 0) {
    // Delete in batches of 500
    for (let i = 0; i < staleIds.length; i += 500) {
      const batch = staleIds.slice(i, i + 500);
      await db
        .delete(amazonSnapshots)
        .where(inArray(amazonSnapshots.id, batch));
    }
  }

  return NextResponse.json({
    cleanedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    deletedSnapshots: staleIds.length,
  });
}

FILE: src/app/api/cron/sync-bq/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { publishDirtyToBigQuery } from "@/lib/bigquery";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, publishHistory } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";

export const maxDuration = 60;

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  // Verify cron secret
  const authHeader = req.headers.get("authorization");
  const cronSecret = process.env.CRON_SECRET;
  if (!cronSecret || authHeader !== `Bearer ${cronSecret}`) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  // Check if there are dirty products
  const dirtyRows = await db
    .select({
      id: master.id,
      asin: master.asin,
      sku: master.sku,
      changeLog: master.changeLog,
    })
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.isDirty, true));

  if (dirtyRows.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message: "No pending changes to sync",
      synced: 0,
    });
  }

  // Snapshot changes for history
  const changesSnapshot = dirtyRows.map((p) => ({
    asin: p.asin,
    sku: p.sku,
    edits: (p.changeLog ?? []).map((e) => ({
      field: e.field,
      oldValue: e.oldValue,
      newValue: e.newValue,
    })),
  }));

  try {
    const result = await publishDirtyToBigQuery();

    // Clear changeLogs on synced products
    for (const row of dirtyRows) {
      await db
        .update(master)
        .set({ changeLog: [] })
        .where(eq(master.id, row.id));
    }

    // Log to publish history
    await db.insert(publishHistory).values({
      publishedBy: "system/cron",
      rowsPublished: result.rowsPublished,
      jobId: result.jobId,
      dirtyCount: dirtyRows.length,
      changes: changesSnapshot,
    });

    console.log(
      `[BQ Sync Cron] Synced ${result.rowsPublished} products (Job: ${result.jobId})`
    );

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      synced: result.rowsPublished,
      jobId: result.jobId,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error";
    console.error("[BQ Sync Cron] Failed:", message);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `Sync failed: ${message}` },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

FILE: src/app/api/debug/finance/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { aac } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { queryRedshift } from "@/lib/redshift";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const ITEM_TABLE = `"amazon_source_data"."sellercentral_financialtransactions_itemlevelbreakdowns"`;
const TXN_TABLE = `"amazon_source_data"."sellercentral_financialtransactions_transactionlevelbreakdowns"`;

function parseRawData(rawData: unknown): Record<string, string> {
  if (typeof rawData === "string") {
    try { return JSON.parse(rawData); } catch { return {}; }
  }
  if (rawData && typeof rawData === "object") return rawData as Record<string, string>;
  return {};
}

/**
 * Debug endpoint to compare Redshift financial data against Amazon Seller Central.
 *
 * Usage: GET /api/debug/finance?client=GAF_SC_US&periodStart=2026-02-05&periodEnd=2026-02-19
 *
 * Returns raw breakdown types from both TXN and ITEM tables so we can diagnose
 * discrepancies with Amazon's settlement report.
 */
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session || !["admin", "editor"].includes(session.user.role)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const clientParam = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("client") || "GAF_SC_US";
  const periodStart = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("periodStart") || "2026-02-05";
  const periodEnd = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("periodEnd") || "2026-02-19";

  // Validate date format to prevent SQL injection
  const dateRegex = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;
  if (!dateRegex.test(periodStart) || !dateRegex.test(periodEnd)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid date format. Use YYYY-MM-DD." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Resolve client -> Intentwise account IDs
  const allClients = await db.select().from(aac);
  const record = allClients.find(
    (c) => (c.clientIdCode ?? "").toLowerCase() === clientParam.toLowerCase()
  );
  if (!record) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Client not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }
  const rawData = parseRawData(record.rawData);
  const intentwiseId = rawData["IntentwiseID"] || rawData["Intentwise ID"] || "";
  const accountIds = intentwiseId.split(",").map((s: string) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  if (accountIds.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "No Intentwise account linked" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  // Sanitize account IDs to prevent SQL injection
  const sanitizedAccountIds = accountIds.filter((id: string) => /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/.test(id));
  if (sanitizedAccountIds.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "No valid Intentwise accounts" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  const accountList = sanitizedAccountIds.map((id: string) => `'${id}'`).join(",");

  // ── Query 1: ALL breakdown types from TXN table for EXACT settlement period rows ──
  const txnSettlementExact = await queryRedshift<{
    breakdown_type: string;
    total: string;
    cnt: string;
  }>(`
    SELECT
      breakdown_type,
      SUM(CAST(breakdown_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total,
      COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM ${TXN_TABLE}
    WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
      AND report_start_date = '${periodStart}'::DATE
      AND report_end_date = '${periodEnd}'::DATE
    GROUP BY breakdown_type
    ORDER BY breakdown_type
  `);

  // ── Query 2: ALL breakdown types from TXN table for DAILY rows in the date range ──
  const txnDailyRange = await queryRedshift<{
    breakdown_type: string;
    total: string;
    cnt: string;
  }>(`
    SELECT
      breakdown_type,
      SUM(CAST(breakdown_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total,
      COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM ${TXN_TABLE}
    WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
      AND report_start_date = report_end_date
      AND report_start_date >= '${periodStart}'::DATE
      AND report_start_date <= '${periodEnd}'::DATE
    GROUP BY breakdown_type
    ORDER BY breakdown_type
  `);

  // ── Query 3: ALL breakdown types from ITEM table for EXACT settlement period ──
  const itemSettlementExact = await queryRedshift<{
    breakdown_type: string;
    total: string;
    cnt: string;
  }>(`
    SELECT
      breakdown_type,
      SUM(CAST(breakdown_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total,
      COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM ${ITEM_TABLE}
    WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
      AND report_start_date = '${periodStart}'::DATE
      AND report_end_date = '${periodEnd}'::DATE
    GROUP BY breakdown_type
    ORDER BY breakdown_type
  `);

  // ── Query 4: ALL breakdown types from ITEM table for DAILY rows ──
  const itemDailyRange = await queryRedshift<{
    breakdown_type: string;
    total: string;
    cnt: string;
  }>(`
    SELECT
      breakdown_type,
      SUM(CAST(breakdown_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total,
      COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM ${ITEM_TABLE}
    WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
      AND report_start_date = report_end_date
      AND report_start_date >= '${periodStart}'::DATE
      AND report_start_date <= '${periodEnd}'::DATE
    GROUP BY breakdown_type
    ORDER BY breakdown_type
  `);

  // ── Query 5: Check what distinct (report_start_date, report_end_date) pairs exist ──
  const datePairs = await queryRedshift<{
    report_start_date: string;
    report_end_date: string;
    row_count: string;
  }>(`
    SELECT
      report_start_date,
      report_end_date,
      COUNT(*) AS row_count
    FROM ${TXN_TABLE}
    WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
      AND (
        (report_start_date = '${periodStart}'::DATE AND report_end_date = '${periodEnd}'::DATE)
        OR (report_start_date = report_end_date
            AND report_start_date >= '${periodStart}'::DATE
            AND report_start_date <= '${periodEnd}'::DATE)
      )
    GROUP BY report_start_date, report_end_date
    ORDER BY report_start_date, report_end_date
  `);

  // ── Query 6: Grand total from TXN table — settlement exact vs daily sum ──
  const txnGrandTotalSettlement = await queryRedshift<{ grand_total: string }>(`
    SELECT SUM(CAST(breakdown_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS grand_total
    FROM ${TXN_TABLE}
    WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
      AND report_start_date = '${periodStart}'::DATE
      AND report_end_date = '${periodEnd}'::DATE
  `);

  const txnGrandTotalDaily = await queryRedshift<{ grand_total: string }>(`
    SELECT SUM(CAST(breakdown_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS grand_total
    FROM ${TXN_TABLE}
    WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
      AND report_start_date = report_end_date
      AND report_start_date >= '${periodStart}'::DATE
      AND report_start_date <= '${periodEnd}'::DATE
  `);

  // ── Query 7: Look for "Previous Reserve" / "Current Reserve" / "Unavailable balance" patterns ──
  const reserveRows = await queryRedshift<{
    breakdown_type: string;
    breakdown_amount: string;
    report_start_date: string;
    report_end_date: string;
  }>(`
    SELECT
      breakdown_type,
      CAST(breakdown_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS breakdown_amount,
      report_start_date,
      report_end_date
    FROM ${TXN_TABLE}
    WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
      AND breakdown_type IN ('ReserveDebit', 'ReserveCredit', 'FundTransfer',
                             'PreviousReserveAmountBalance', 'CurrentReserveAmount',
                             'UnavailableBalance', 'PreviousReserve', 'CurrentReserve',
                             'BeginningBalance', 'AvailableBalance')
      AND (
        (report_start_date = '${periodStart}'::DATE AND report_end_date = '${periodEnd}'::DATE)
        OR (report_start_date = report_end_date
            AND report_start_date >= '${periodStart}'::DATE
            AND report_start_date <= '${periodEnd}'::DATE)
      )
    ORDER BY report_start_date, breakdown_type
  `);

  // ── Query 8: Sample raw rows from TXN table to see ALL columns available ──
  const sampleRow = await queryRedshift<Record<string, unknown>>(`
    SELECT *
    FROM ${TXN_TABLE}
    WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
      AND report_start_date = '${periodStart}'::DATE
      AND report_end_date = '${periodEnd}'::DATE
    LIMIT 3
  `);

  // ── Query 9: Check ALL distinct breakdown_types ever for this account ──
  const allBreakdownTypes = await queryRedshift<{ breakdown_type: string; cnt: string }>(`
    SELECT breakdown_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM ${TXN_TABLE}
    WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
    GROUP BY breakdown_type
    ORDER BY breakdown_type
  `);

  // ── Query 10: Replicate what the finance API currently computes for this period ──
  // Using periodExact mode (same as selecting a settlement period preset)
  const TXN_ONLY_TYPES = [
    "'AdvertisingFee'", "'FundTransfer'", "'ReserveDebit'", "'ReserveCredit'",
    "'FBAInventoryReimbursement'", "'FBAReversedReimbursement'", "'COMPENSATED_CLAWBACK'",
    "'Refunded Expenses'", "'Refunded Sales'",
  ].join(",");

  const EXCLUDE_ITEM_TYPES = [
    "'ProductCharges'", "'AmazonFees'", "'Shipping'", "'Base'", "'Tax'",
  ].join(",");

  const dateFilterExact = `report_start_date = '${periodStart}'::DATE AND report_end_date = '${periodEnd}'::DATE`;

  const currentApiTxn = await queryRedshift<{ breakdown_type: string; total: string }>(`
    SELECT
      breakdown_type,
      SUM(CAST(breakdown_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total
    FROM ${TXN_TABLE}
    WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
      AND ${dateFilterExact}
      AND breakdown_type IN (${TXN_ONLY_TYPES})
    GROUP BY breakdown_type
  `);

  const currentApiItem = await queryRedshift<{ breakdown_type: string; total: string }>(`
    SELECT
      breakdown_type,
      SUM(CAST(breakdown_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total
    FROM ${ITEM_TABLE}
    WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
      AND ${dateFilterExact}
      AND breakdown_type NOT IN (${EXCLUDE_ITEM_TYPES})
    GROUP BY breakdown_type
  `);

  // Reproduce the finance API's computation
  const txnMap: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const r of currentApiTxn) txnMap[r.breakdown_type] = parseFloat(r.total) || 0;
  const itemMap: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const r of currentApiItem) itemMap[r.breakdown_type] = parseFloat(r.total) || 0;

  const salesTypes = ["OurPricePrincipal", "OurPriceTax", "ShippingPrincipal", "Promo"];
  const sales = salesTypes.reduce((s, t) => s + (itemMap[t] || 0), 0);
  const refundedSales = txnMap["Refunded Sales"] || 0;
  const expenseTypes = [
    "Commission", "FBAPerUnitFulfillmentFee", "FBAStorageFee", "FBALongTermStorageFee",
    "FBARemovalFee", "FBAInboundTransportationFee", "FBAFees",
    "StorageBillingFee", "AWDStorageFees", "LongTermStorageFee",
    "InboundTransportationFee", "AmazonUpstreamStorageTransportationFee",
    "AmazonUpstreamProcessingFee", "SubscriptionFee",
    "MarketplaceFacilitatorTax-Principal",
    "RefundCommission", "ShippingChargeback", "ShippingDiscount",
    "PromoRebates",
  ];
  const expenses = expenseTypes.reduce((s, t) => s + (itemMap[t] || 0), 0);
  const refundedExpenses = txnMap["Refunded Expenses"] || 0;
  const advertisingFee = txnMap["AdvertisingFee"] || 0;
  const fundTransfer = txnMap["FundTransfer"] || 0;
  const reserveDebit = txnMap["ReserveDebit"] || 0;
  const reserveCredit = txnMap["ReserveCredit"] || 0;
  const fbaReimbursement = txnMap["FBAInventoryReimbursement"] || 0;
  const reversedReimbursement = txnMap["FBAReversedReimbursement"] || 0;
  const netProceeds = sales + refundedSales + expenses + refundedExpenses
    + advertisingFee + fundTransfer + reserveDebit + reserveCredit;

  const apiReproduction = {
    sales,
    refundedSales,
    expenses,
    refundedExpenses,
    advertisingFee,
    fundTransfer,
    reserveDebit,
    reserveCredit,
    fbaReimbursement,
    reversedReimbursement,
    netProceeds,
    note_missing_from_net: "fbaReimbursement and reversedReimbursement are queried but NOT added to netProceeds",
    note_no_beginning_balance: "Amazon's 'Beginning Balance' (previous reserve carry-forward) is not tracked",
  };

  // Amazon's expected numbers for comparison
  const amazonExpected = {
    netProceeds: 838.98,
    beginningBalance: 1118.17,
    sales: 2564.04,
    refunds: -417.96,
    expenses: -1378.24,
    accountLevelReserve: -1047.03,
    disbursement: 838.98,
    formula: "Net = BeginningBalance + Sales + Refunds + Expenses + Reserve",
    detail: {
      productCharges: 2424.77,
      shipping: 23.37,
      inventoryReimbursements: 115.90,
      refundedExpenses: 57.00,
      refundedSales: -474.96,
      promoRebates: -13.98,
      fbaFees: -258.54,
      costOfAdvertising: -501.21,
      amazonFees: -580.00,
      reversedReimbursements: -24.51,
    },
  };

  return NextResponse.json({
    params: { client: clientParam, periodStart, periodEnd, accountIds },
    amazonExpected,
    apiReproduction,
    raw: {
      txnSettlementExact: txnSettlementExact.map(r => ({
        ...r, total: parseFloat(r.total),
      })),
      txnDailyRange: txnDailyRange.map(r => ({
        ...r, total: parseFloat(r.total),
      })),
      itemSettlementExact: itemSettlementExact.map(r => ({
        ...r, total: parseFloat(r.total),
      })),
      itemDailyRange: itemDailyRange.map(r => ({
        ...r, total: parseFloat(r.total),
      })),
    },
    datePairs: datePairs.map(r => ({
      start: new Date(r.report_start_date).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      end: new Date(r.report_end_date).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      rowCount: parseInt(r.row_count),
    })),
    grandTotals: {
      settlementExact: parseFloat(txnGrandTotalSettlement[0]?.grand_total || "0"),
      dailySum: parseFloat(txnGrandTotalDaily[0]?.grand_total || "0"),
    },
    reserveRows: reserveRows.map(r => ({
      ...r,
      breakdown_amount: parseFloat(r.breakdown_amount as string),
      report_start_date: new Date(r.report_start_date).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      report_end_date: new Date(r.report_end_date).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
    })),
    sampleColumns: sampleRow.length > 0 ? Object.keys(sampleRow[0]) : [],
    sampleRows: sampleRow.slice(0, 2),
    allBreakdownTypes: allBreakdownTypes.map(r => ({
      type: r.breakdown_type,
      count: parseInt(r.cnt),
    })),
  });
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// GET /api/drive/file/[fileId]
// Proxies a Google Drive file through the server so the browser
// can display images that require service-account authentication.
// Returns the raw file bytes with the correct Content-Type.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { getAccessToken } from "@/lib/gcp-auth";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const DRIVE_BASE = "https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3";
const DRIVE_SCOPE = "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.readonly";

export async function GET(
  _req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ fileId: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { fileId } = await params;

  try {
    const token = await getAccessToken([DRIVE_SCOPE]);

    // Get file metadata first (for Content-Type)
    const metaRes = await fetch(
      `${DRIVE_BASE}/files/${encodeURIComponent(fileId)}?supportsAllDrives=true&fields=mimeType,name,size`,
      { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } }
    );

    if (!metaRes.ok) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "File not found in Drive" },
        { status: metaRes.status }
      );
    }

    const meta = await metaRes.json();

    const fileSize = meta.size ? parseInt(meta.size, 10) : 0;
    const rangeHeader = _req.headers.get("range");

    // Build headers for the Drive download request
    const dlHeaders: Record<string, string> = { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` };
    if (rangeHeader) {
      dlHeaders["Range"] = rangeHeader;
    }

    // Download file content (passes Range header through to Drive)
    const dlRes = await fetch(
      `${DRIVE_BASE}/files/${encodeURIComponent(fileId)}?alt=media&supportsAllDrives=true`,
      { headers: dlHeaders }
    );

    if (!dlRes.ok && dlRes.status !== 206) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Failed to download file" },
        { status: dlRes.status }
      );
    }

    const contentType = meta.mimeType || "application/octet-stream";

    // Stream the response body directly from Drive to the client
    // (avoids buffering entire file in memory — critical for video)
    const responseHeaders: Record<string, string> = {
      "Content-Type": contentType,
      "Accept-Ranges": "bytes",
      "Cache-Control": "private, max-age=3600",
    };

    // Forward Content-Length and Content-Range from Drive's response
    const dlContentLength = dlRes.headers.get("content-length");
    if (dlContentLength) {
      responseHeaders["Content-Length"] = dlContentLength;
    }
    const dlContentRange = dlRes.headers.get("content-range");
    if (dlContentRange) {
      responseHeaders["Content-Range"] = dlContentRange;
    }

    // For non-range requests, add filename and total size if known
    if (!rangeHeader) {
      if (fileSize) responseHeaders["Content-Length"] = String(fileSize);
      responseHeaders["Content-Disposition"] = `inline; filename="${meta.name || fileId}"`;
    }

    return new NextResponse(dlRes.body, {
      status: dlRes.status,
      headers: responseHeaders,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    console.error("[drive/file] error:", message);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// GET /api/drive/ping
// Admin-only smoke test — verifies Drive credentials, shared drive
// access, and env vars are all correctly configured end-to-end.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { driveClient } from "@/lib/drive-client";

export const maxDuration = 60;

export async function GET() {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session || session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  try {
    const result = await driveClient.ping();
    return NextResponse.json({
      ok: true,
      driveId: result.driveId,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    });
  } catch (err) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// POST /api/drive/upload
// Multipart upload for files <= 4MB.
// Accepts FormData, auto-renames via buildFileName, resolves the
// target Drive folder, uploads the file, and inserts a DB record.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { driveFiles } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { driveClient } from "@/lib/drive-client";
import {
  buildFileName,
  resolveUploadFolder,
  buildAplusFileName,
  resolveAplusFolder,
} from "@/lib/drive-upload";
import type { AplusModuleType } from "@/lib/aplus-module-specs";
import type { AplusDevice, AplusPlatform, AplusScopeType } from "@/lib/aplus-file-naming";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024; // 4 MB for images
const MAX_VIDEO_BYTES = 500 * 1024 * 1024; // 500 MB for videos

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    // ── Auth ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const session = await getAuthSession();
    if (!session) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const role = session.user.role;
    if (role !== "editor" && role !== "admin") {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
    }



    // ── Parse FormData ────────────────────────────────────────
    const form = await req.formData();
    const file = form.get("file") as File | null;
    const clientIdCode = (form.get("clientIdCode") as string | null)?.trim();
    const asin = (form.get("asin") as string | null)?.trim() || null;
    const folderType = (form.get("folderType") as string | null)?.trim() || "aplus";
    const entityType = (form.get("entityType") as string | null)?.trim() || null;
    const entityId = (form.get("entityId") as string | null)?.trim() || null;
    const imageSlot = (form.get("imageSlot") as string | null)?.trim() || null;
    // SOP naming metadata (optional — when present, uses A+ naming)
    const moduleType = (form.get("moduleType") as string | null)?.trim() || null;
    const modulePosition = form.get("modulePosition") ? parseInt(form.get("modulePosition") as string) : null;
    const slotKey = (form.get("slotKey") as string | null)?.trim() || null;
    const device = ((form.get("device") as string | null)?.trim() || "DV") as AplusDevice;
    const marketplace = (form.get("marketplace") as string | null)?.trim() || "US";
    // Set config values for folder resolution (from client SetConfigCtx)
    const platform = ((form.get("platform") as string | null)?.trim() || "SC") as AplusPlatform;
    const scopeType = ((form.get("scopeType") as string | null)?.trim() || "ASIN") as AplusScopeType;
    const scopeIdentifier = (form.get("scopeIdentifier") as string | null)?.trim() || asin || "unknown";
    const version = form.get("version") ? parseInt(form.get("version") as string) : 1;
    const groupNumber = form.get("groupNumber") ? parseInt(form.get("groupNumber") as string) : undefined;
    const isVideo = form.get("isVideo") === "true";

    // ── Validate ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (!file) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing required field: file" }, { status: 400 });
    }
    if (!clientIdCode) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing required field: clientIdCode" }, { status: 400 });
    }
    const maxBytes = isVideo ? MAX_VIDEO_BYTES : MAX_IMAGE_BYTES;
    if (file.size > maxBytes) {
      const maxMB = maxBytes / (1024 * 1024);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: `File too large: ${file.size} bytes. Maximum is ${maxMB} MB. ${!isVideo ? "Use the resumable upload endpoint for larger files." : ""}` },
        { status: 413 }
      );
    }

    // ── Build display name ────────────────────────────────────
    const useAplusNaming = !!(moduleType && modulePosition && slotKey);
    const displayName = useAplusNaming
      ? buildAplusFileName({
          clientIdCode,
          version,
          scopeType,
          modulePosition: modulePosition!,
          moduleType: moduleType as AplusModuleType,
          slotKey: slotKey!,
          device,
          isVideo,
          asin: scopeType === "ASIN" ? (asin || undefined) : undefined,
          groupNumber: scopeType === "GRP" ? groupNumber : undefined,
        })
      : buildFileName({
          clientIdCode,
          asin,
          folderType,
          imageSlot,
          mimeType: file.type,
        });

    // ── Resolve target folder ─────────────────────────────────
    const folder = useAplusNaming
      ? await resolveAplusFolder({
          clientIdCode,
          marketplace,
          platform,
          scopeType,
          version,
          asin: scopeType === "ASIN" ? (asin || undefined) : undefined,
          groupNumber: scopeType === "GRP" ? groupNumber : undefined,
        })
      : await resolveUploadFolder({ clientIdCode, folderType, asin });
    if (!folder) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: `No Drive folder found for client "${clientIdCode}" with folderType "${folderType}". Client may not be onboarded yet.` },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    // ── Upload to Drive ───────────────────────────────────────
    const buffer = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer());
    const driveFile = await driveClient.uploadFile(
      displayName,
      folder.driveFolderId,
      buffer,
      file.type
    );

    // ── Insert DB record ──────────────────────────────────────
    const [dbRecord] = await db
      .insert(driveFiles)
      .values({
        driveFileId: driveFile.id,
        folderId: folder.id,
        originalName: file.name,
        displayName,
        mimeType: file.type,
        sizeBytes: file.size,
        entityType: entityType ?? undefined,
        entityId: entityId ?? undefined,
        uploadedBy: session.user.email!,
      })
      .returning({ id: driveFiles.id });

    return NextResponse.json({
      driveFileId: driveFile.id,
      displayName,
      dbId: dbRecord.id,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    console.error("[drive/upload] error:", message);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// POST /api/drive/upload-resumable
// Server-side proxy for resumable uploads (avoids CORS).
// Accepts raw binary body with metadata in headers.
// Streams the body to Google Drive instead of buffering for
// large file support (videos, high-res images).
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { driveFiles } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";

export const maxDuration = 120;

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const session = await getAuthSession();
    if (!session) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
    }
    const role = session.user.role;
    if (role !== "editor" && role !== "admin") {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
    }

    // Metadata from headers
    const sessionUri = req.headers.get("x-session-uri");
    const mimeType = req.headers.get("x-mime-type") || "application/octet-stream";
    const folderId = req.headers.get("x-folder-id");
    const displayName = req.headers.get("x-display-name");
    const originalName = req.headers.get("x-original-name");
    const entityType = req.headers.get("x-entity-type");
    const entityId = req.headers.get("x-entity-id");

    if (!sessionUri) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing x-session-uri header" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    if (!req.body) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "No request body" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // Read body into buffer — needed for size tracking and Drive PUT
    const buffer = Buffer.from(await req.arrayBuffer());
    const sizeBytes = buffer.length;

    console.log(`[upload-resumable] Uploading ${(sizeBytes / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)}MB ${mimeType} to Drive`);

    // PUT to Google Drive session URI (server-side, no CORS)
    const putRes = await fetch(sessionUri, {
      method: "PUT",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": mimeType,
        "Content-Length": String(sizeBytes),
      },
      body: buffer,
    });

    if (!putRes.ok) {
      const text = await putRes.text().catch(() => "");
      console.error("[upload-resumable] Drive PUT failed:", putRes.status, text);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: `Drive upload failed (${putRes.status}): ${text.slice(0, 200)}` },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }

    const putData = await putRes.json();
    const driveFileId: string = putData.id;

    // Record in DB
    if (folderId && displayName) {
      await db
        .insert(driveFiles)
        .values({
          driveFileId,
          folderId,
          originalName: originalName ?? "upload",
          displayName,
          mimeType,
          sizeBytes,
          entityType: entityType ?? undefined,
          entityId: entityId ?? undefined,
          uploadedBy: session.user.email!,
        })
        .returning({ id: driveFiles.id })
        .catch((err) => {
          console.warn("[upload-resumable] DB record failed:", err);
        });
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ driveFileId, displayName, sizeBytes });
  } catch (err) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    console.error("[upload-resumable] error:", message);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: src/app/api/drive/upload-session/route.ts

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// POST /api/drive/upload-session
// Initiates a resumable Drive upload session for files > 4 MB.
// Returns the session URI from the Drive API Location header.
// The client then PUTs the file directly to that URI.
// After the PUT completes, the client calls /api/drive/upload/record
// to persist the DB record.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { getAccessToken } from "@/lib/gcp-auth";
import {
  buildFileName,
  resolveUploadFolder,
  buildAplusFileName,
  resolveAplusFolder,
} from "@/lib/drive-upload";
import type { AplusModuleType } from "@/lib/aplus-module-specs";
import type { AplusDevice, AplusPlatform, AplusScopeType } from "@/lib/aplus-file-naming";

export const maxDuration = 60;

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    // ── Auth ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const session = await getAuthSession();
    if (!session) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const role = session.user.role;
    if (role !== "editor" && role !== "admin") {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
    }

    // ── Parse JSON body ───────────────────────────────────────
    const body = await req.json() as {
      clientIdCode?: string;
      asin?: string;
      folderType?: string;
      imageSlot?: string;
      mimeType?: string;
      entityType?: string;
      entityId?: string;
      fileName?: string;
      // SOP naming metadata
      moduleType?: string;
      modulePosition?: number;
      slotKey?: string;
      device?: string;
      marketplace?: string;
      isVideo?: boolean;
      // Set config values
      platform?: string;
      scopeType?: string;
      scopeIdentifier?: string;
      version?: number;
      clientIdCodeOverride?: string;
      groupNumber?: number;
    };

    const clientIdCode = body.clientIdCode?.trim();
    const asin = body.asin?.trim() || null;
    const folderType = body.folderType?.trim() || "aplus";
    const imageSlot = body.imageSlot?.trim() || null;
    const mimeType = body.mimeType?.trim();
    const entityType = body.entityType?.trim() || null;
    const entityId = body.entityId?.trim() || null;
    const fileName = body.fileName?.trim() || null;
    const moduleType = body.moduleType?.trim() || null;
    const modulePosition = body.modulePosition ?? null;
    const slotKey = body.slotKey?.trim() || null;
    const device = (body.device?.trim() || "DV") as AplusDevice;
    const marketplace = body.marketplace?.trim() || "US";
    // Set config values for folder resolution
    const platform = (body.platform?.trim() || "SC") as AplusPlatform;
    const scopeType = (body.scopeType?.trim() || "ASIN") as AplusScopeType;
    const version = body.version ?? 1;
    const groupNumber = body.groupNumber ?? undefined;
    const isVideo = body.isVideo ?? false;
    // Use clientIdCodeOverride from set config context if provided
    const resolvedClientIdCode = body.clientIdCodeOverride?.trim() || clientIdCode;

    // ── Validate ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    if (!clientIdCode) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing required field: clientIdCode" }, { status: 400 });
    }
    if (!mimeType) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing required field: mimeType" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // ── Build display name ────────────────────────────────────
    const useAplusNaming = !!(moduleType && modulePosition && slotKey && resolvedClientIdCode);
    const displayName = useAplusNaming
      ? buildAplusFileName({
          clientIdCode: resolvedClientIdCode!,
          version,
          scopeType,
          modulePosition: modulePosition!,
          moduleType: moduleType as AplusModuleType,
          slotKey: slotKey!,
          device,
          isVideo,
          asin: scopeType === "ASIN" ? (asin || undefined) : undefined,
          groupNumber: scopeType === "GRP" ? groupNumber : undefined,
        })
      : buildFileName({
          clientIdCode: clientIdCode!,
          asin,
          folderType,
          imageSlot,
          mimeType,
        });

    // ── Resolve target folder ─────────────────────────────────
    const folder = useAplusNaming
      ? await resolveAplusFolder({
          clientIdCode: resolvedClientIdCode!,
          marketplace,
          platform,
          scopeType,
          version,
          asin: scopeType === "ASIN" ? (asin || undefined) : undefined,
          groupNumber: scopeType === "GRP" ? groupNumber : undefined,
        })
      : await resolveUploadFolder({ clientIdCode: clientIdCode!, folderType, asin });
    if (!folder) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: `No Drive folder found for client "${clientIdCode}" with folderType "${folderType}". Client may not be onboarded yet.` },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    // ── Get Drive access token ────────────────────────────────
    const token = await getAccessToken(["https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive"]);

    // ── Initiate resumable session ────────────────────────────
    const res = await fetch(
      "https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3/files?uploadType=resumable&supportsAllDrives=true",
      {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
          "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=UTF-8",
          "X-Upload-Content-Type": mimeType,
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          name: displayName,
          parents: [folder.driveFolderId],
        }),
      }
    );

    if (!res.ok) {
      const text = await res.text().catch(() => "(could not read Drive error body)");
      console.error("[drive/upload-session] Drive error:", res.status, text);
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: `Drive API error (${res.status}): ${text}` },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }

    // ── Extract session URI from Location header ──────────────
    const sessionUri = res.headers.get("Location");
    if (!sessionUri) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Drive API did not return a Location header for the resumable session" },
        { status: 500 }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      sessionUri,
      displayName,
      folderId: folder.id,
      entityType,
      entityId,
      originalName: fileName,
      mimeType,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    console.error("[drive/upload-session] error:", message);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { columnAttributes, master } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, asc } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getProductFieldValue } from "@/lib/product-mapper";
import type { Product } from "@/lib/db/schema";

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session || !canAccessSection(session, "export")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const client = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("client");
  if (!client) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "client parameter required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Get column attributes
  const attrs = await db
    .select()
    .from(columnAttributes)
    .orderBy(asc(columnAttributes.masterRow));

  // Filter to columns relevant for this client
  const relevantAttrs = attrs.filter((attr) => {
    const req = attr.clientRequirements?.[client] || "";
    return req !== "" && req !== "Not Required";
  });

  if (relevantAttrs.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `No relevant columns found for client ${client}` },
      { status: 404 }
    );
  }

  // Get products for this client
  const clientProducts = await db
    .select()
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.clientIdCode, client));

  if (clientProducts.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `No products found for client ${client}` },
      { status: 404 }
    );
  }

  // Build CSV
  const columnNames = relevantAttrs.map((a) => a.generalLabel);
  const header = columnNames.map(escapeCsvField).join(",");

  const rows = clientProducts.map((product) => {
    return columnNames
      .map((colName) => {
        const val = getProductFieldValue(product as Product, colName);
        return escapeCsvField(val || "");
      })
      .join(",");
  });

  const csv = [header, ...rows].join("\n");

  return new NextResponse(csv, {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "text/csv; charset=utf-8",
      "Content-Disposition": `attachment; filename="${client}_export.csv"`,
    },
  });
}

function escapeCsvField(field: string): string {
  if (field.includes(",") || field.includes('"') || field.includes("\n")) {
    return `"${field.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
  }
  return field;
}

FILE: src/app/api/export/bq/query/route.ts

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { BigQuery } from "@google-cloud/bigquery";
import * as XLSX from "xlsx";
import jsPDF from "jspdf";
import autoTable from "jspdf-autotable";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const ALLOWED_DATASET = process.env.BQ_DATASET || "1o8Hub";

function getBigQueryClient(): BigQuery {
  const projectId = process.env.GCP_PROJECT_ID || "amazon-data-461918";
  if (process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL && process.env.GCP_PRIVATE_KEY) {
    let privateKey = process.env.GCP_PRIVATE_KEY;
    privateKey = privateKey.replace(/\\n/g, "\n");
    if (privateKey.startsWith('"') && privateKey.endsWith('"')) {
      privateKey = JSON.parse(privateKey);
    }
    return new BigQuery({
      projectId,
      credentials: {
        client_email: process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL,
        private_key: privateKey,
      },
    });
  }
  return new BigQuery({ projectId });
}

// POST /api/export/bq/query
// Body: { dataset, table, clients?, format: "preview"|"xlsx"|"pdf", limit? }
export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session || !canAccessSection(session, "export")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const { dataset, table, clients, statuses, selectedColumns, format = "preview", limit } = body as {
      dataset: string;
      table: string;
      clients?: string[];
      statuses?: string[];
      selectedColumns?: string[];
      format?: "preview" | "xlsx" | "pdf";
      limit?: number;
    };

    if (!dataset || !table) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "dataset and table are required" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // Only allow the configured dataset
    if (dataset !== ALLOWED_DATASET) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: `Access restricted to dataset ${ALLOWED_DATASET}` },
        { status: 403 }
      );
    }

    // Validate table name (alphanumeric + underscore only)
    const namePattern = /^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$/;
    if (!namePattern.test(table)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Invalid table name" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const bq = getBigQueryClient();
    const projectId = process.env.GCP_PROJECT_ID || "amazon-data-461918";
    const fullTable = `\`${projectId}.${dataset}.${table}\``;

    // First get schema to find client-like columns
    const [metadata] = await bq
      .dataset(dataset)
      .table(table)
      .getMetadata();
    const schema = metadata.schema?.fields || [];
    const columnNames: string[] = schema.map(
      (f: { name: string }) => f.name
    );

    // Detect filterable columns
    const clientColumnCandidates = [
      "clientIDCode", "ClientIDCode", "client_id_code", "clientIdCode", "account_id",
    ];
    const statusColumnCandidates = [
      "ClientStatus", "clientStatus", "client_status", "Status", "status",
    ];
    const clientCol = columnNames.find((c) => clientColumnCandidates.includes(c));
    const statusCol = columnNames.find((c) => statusColumnCandidates.includes(c));

    // Determine which columns to query
    // Validate selectedColumns against actual schema to prevent injection
    const queryCols =
      selectedColumns && selectedColumns.length > 0
        ? selectedColumns.filter((c) => columnNames.includes(c))
        : columnNames;

    // Build query
    const selectExpr =
      queryCols.length === columnNames.length
        ? "*"
        : queryCols.map((c) => `\`${c}\``).join(", ");
    let query = `SELECT ${selectExpr} FROM ${fullTable}`;
    const params: Record<string, string | string[]> = {};
    const conditions: string[] = [];

    if (clients && clients.length > 0 && clientCol) {
      conditions.push(`${clientCol} IN UNNEST(@clients)`);
      params.clients = clients;
    }
    if (statuses && statuses.length > 0 && statusCol) {
      conditions.push(`${statusCol} IN UNNEST(@statuses)`);
      params.statuses = statuses;
    }
    if (conditions.length > 0) {
      query += ` WHERE ${conditions.join(" AND ")}`;
    }

    if (format === "preview") {
      query += ` LIMIT ${Math.min(limit || 50, 200)}`;
    } else if (limit) {
      query += ` LIMIT ${Math.min(limit, 50000)}`;
    }

    const [rows] = await bq.query({
      query,
      params,
      location: "us-west1",
    });

    if (format === "preview") {
      // Also get total row count
      let totalQuery = `SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM ${fullTable}`;
      if (conditions.length > 0) {
        totalQuery += ` WHERE ${conditions.join(" AND ")}`;
      }
      const [countResult] = await bq.query({
        query: totalQuery,
        params,
        location: "us-west1",
      });
      const totalRows = Number(countResult[0]?.total ?? rows.length);

      return NextResponse.json({
        columns: queryCols,
        allColumns: columnNames,
        rows: rows.map((r: Record<string, unknown>) =>
          queryCols.map((c) => stringify(r[c]))
        ),
        totalRows,
        clientColumn: clientCol || null,
        statusColumn: statusCol || null,
      });
    }

    // Full data for download
    const dataRows = rows.map((r: Record<string, unknown>) =>
      queryCols.map((c) => stringify(r[c]))
    );

    if (format === "xlsx") {
      const ws = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet([queryCols, ...dataRows]);

      // Auto-width columns
      ws["!cols"] = queryCols.map((col, i) => {
        let maxWidth = col.length;
        for (const row of dataRows.slice(0, 100)) {
          maxWidth = Math.max(maxWidth, (row[i] || "").length);
        }
        return { wch: Math.min(maxWidth + 2, 50) };
      });

      const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, ws, table.substring(0, 31));
      const buffer = XLSX.write(wb, { type: "buffer", bookType: "xlsx" });

      return new NextResponse(buffer, {
        headers: {
          "Content-Type":
            "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
          "Content-Disposition": `attachment; filename="${dataset}_${table}.xlsx"`,
        },
      });
    }

    if (format === "pdf") {
      const doc = new jsPDF({ orientation: "landscape", unit: "pt" });

      doc.setFontSize(14);
      doc.text(`${dataset}.${table}`, 40, 30);
      doc.setFontSize(8);
      doc.text(
        `${rows.length} rows | Generated ${new Date().toLocaleDateString()}`,
        40,
        45
      );

      // Limit columns for PDF readability — show first 15 max
      const maxPdfCols = 15;
      const pdfColumns = queryCols.slice(0, maxPdfCols);
      const pdfRows = dataRows.map((r) => r.slice(0, maxPdfCols));

      autoTable(doc, {
        head: [pdfColumns],
        body: pdfRows,
        startY: 55,
        styles: { fontSize: 6, cellPadding: 3 },
        headStyles: { fillColor: [86, 84, 84], fontSize: 6 },
        columnStyles: Object.fromEntries(
          pdfColumns.map((_, i) => [i, { cellWidth: "auto" }])
        ),
        margin: { left: 20, right: 20 },
      });

      const pdfBuffer = Buffer.from(doc.output("arraybuffer"));

      return new NextResponse(pdfBuffer, {
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/pdf",
          "Content-Disposition": `attachment; filename="${dataset}_${table}.pdf"`,
        },
      });
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid format" }, { status: 400 });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("BQ query error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error:
          err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to query BigQuery",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

function stringify(val: unknown): string {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return "";
  if (typeof val === "object") return JSON.stringify(val);
  return String(val);
}

FILE: src/app/api/export/preview/route.ts
