import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { columnAttributes, master } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, asc, count } from "drizzle-orm";

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session || !canAccessSection(session, "export")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const client = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("client");
  if (!client) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "client parameter required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Get column attributes
  const attrs = await db
    .select()
    .from(columnAttributes)
    .orderBy(asc(columnAttributes.masterRow));

  // Filter to columns relevant for this client
  const relevantAttrs = attrs.filter((attr) => {
    const req = attr.clientRequirements?.[client] || "";
    return req !== "" && req !== "Not Required";
  });

  // Build requirement breakdown
  const requirementBreakdown: Record<string, number> = {};
  const columns: string[] = [];
  for (const attr of relevantAttrs) {
    const req = attr.clientRequirements?.[client] || "";
    requirementBreakdown[req] = (requirementBreakdown[req] || 0) + 1;
    columns.push(attr.generalLabel);
  }

  // Count products for this client
  const [productCountResult] = await db
    .select({ count: count() })
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.clientIdCode, client));

  return NextResponse.json({
    client,
    columnCount: relevantAttrs.length,
    productCount: productCountResult?.count || 0,
    columns,
    requirementBreakdown,
  });
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { aac } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { queryRedshift } from "@/lib/redshift";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const RS_SCHEMA = "intentwise_ecommerce_graph";
const RS_TABLE = "account_summary";
const FULL_TABLE = `"${RS_SCHEMA}"."${RS_TABLE}"`;

export async function GET() {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  if (!canAccessSection(session, "finances")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  // Get all client accounts
  const clients = await db.select().from(aac);
  if (clients.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json([]);
  }

  // Query last 30 days and previous 30 days for comparison
  const end = new Date();
  const start = new Date();
  start.setDate(end.getDate() - 30);
  const prevStart = new Date();
  prevStart.setDate(start.getDate() - 30);

  const endStr = end.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const startStr = start.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const prevStartStr = prevStart.toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  try {
    const rows = await queryRedshift(`
      SELECT
        account_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN report_date >= '${startStr}' THEN COALESCE(product_sales, 0) + COALESCE(ad_revenue, 0) ELSE 0 END) as total_revenue,
        SUM(CASE WHEN report_date >= '${startStr}' THEN COALESCE(ad_spend, 0) ELSE 0 END) as ad_spend,
        SUM(CASE WHEN report_date >= '${startStr}' THEN COALESCE(ad_revenue, 0) ELSE 0 END) as ad_revenue,
        SUM(CASE WHEN report_date >= '${startStr}' THEN COALESCE(product_sales, 0) ELSE 0 END) as product_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN report_date < '${startStr}' THEN COALESCE(product_sales, 0) + COALESCE(ad_revenue, 0) ELSE 0 END) as prev_total_revenue
      FROM ${FULL_TABLE}
      WHERE report_date >= '${prevStartStr}' AND report_date <= '${endStr}'
      GROUP BY account_name
      ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
    `);

    const result = rows.map((row: Record<string, unknown>) => ({
      clientIdCode: String(row.account_name ?? ""),
      totalRevenue: Number(row.total_revenue ?? 0),
      adSpend: Number(row.ad_spend ?? 0),
      adRevenue: Number(row.ad_revenue ?? 0),
      productSales: Number(row.product_sales ?? 0),
      prevTotalRevenue: Number(row.prev_total_revenue ?? 0),
    }));

    return NextResponse.json(result);
  } catch {
    // Redshift unavailable — return empty with no error to show empty state
    return NextResponse.json([]);
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { clientForecasts } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";

export const maxDuration = 30;

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const clientIdCode = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("clientIdCode");
  if (!clientIdCode) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing clientIdCode" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Portal clients can only see their own clientIdCode
  if (
    session.user.role === "client" &&
    session.user.clientIdCode !== clientIdCode
  ) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const rows = await db
    .select({
      month: clientForecasts.month,
      metric: clientForecasts.metric,
      forecastValue: clientForecasts.forecastValue,
      updatedAt: clientForecasts.updatedAt,
    })
    .from(clientForecasts)
    .where(eq(clientForecasts.clientIdCode, clientIdCode))
    .orderBy(clientForecasts.month, clientForecasts.metric);

  return NextResponse.json({ forecasts: rows });
}

export async function PUT(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  // Only admin or editor can write forecasts
  if (!["admin", "editor"].includes(session.user.role)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const { clientIdCode, month, metric, forecastValue } = body;

  if (!clientIdCode || !month || !metric || forecastValue == null) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Missing clientIdCode, month, metric, or forecastValue" },
      { status: 400 },
    );
  }

  const [forecast] = await db
    .insert(clientForecasts)
    .values({
      clientIdCode,
      month,
      metric,
      forecastValue: String(forecastValue),
      updatedBy: session.user.id,
      updatedAt: new Date(),
    })
    .onConflictDoUpdate({
      target: [
        clientForecasts.clientIdCode,
        clientForecasts.month,
        clientForecasts.metric,
      ],
      set: {
        forecastValue: String(forecastValue),
        updatedBy: session.user.id,
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      },
    })
    .returning();

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true, forecast });
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { clientGanttTasks, aac } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { sql, eq } from "drizzle-orm";

/** GET — summary of gantt progress per client (for the landing page) */
export async function GET() {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const rows = await db
    .select({
      clientIdCode: clientGanttTasks.clientIdCode,
      total: sql<number>`count(*)::int`,
      completed: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${clientGanttTasks.status} = 'completed')::int`,
      inProgress: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${clientGanttTasks.status} = 'in_progress')::int`,
      avgPct: sql<number>`coalesce(avg(${clientGanttTasks.completionPct})::int, 0)`,
    })
    .from(clientGanttTasks)
    .groupBy(clientGanttTasks.clientIdCode);

  // Fetch client names
  const clients = await db
    .select({ clientIdCode: aac.clientIdCode, clientName: aac.clientName, clientType: aac.clientType })
    .from(aac);

  const nameMap = new Map(clients.map((c) => [c.clientIdCode, { name: c.clientName, type: c.clientType }]));

  const result = rows.map((r) => ({
    ...r,
    clientName: nameMap.get(r.clientIdCode)?.name ?? null,
    clientType: nameMap.get(r.clientIdCode)?.type ?? null,
  }));

  return NextResponse.json(result);
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { contentImpactSnapshots } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, desc, and } from "drizzle-orm";

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const clientIdCode = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("client");
  const productId = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("productId");
  const limit = Math.min(parseInt(req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("limit") || "20"), 100);

  // Client-role users can only see their own data
  let effectiveClientFilter = clientIdCode;
  if (session.user.role === "client" && session.user.clientIdCode) {
    const allowedCodes = (session.user.clientIdCode as string).split(",").map((s: string) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (clientIdCode && !allowedCodes.includes(clientIdCode)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
    }
    // Force-filter to first allowed code when no client param provided
    if (!clientIdCode && allowedCodes.length > 0) {
      effectiveClientFilter = allowedCodes[0];
    }
  }

  const conditions = [];
  if (effectiveClientFilter) {
    conditions.push(eq(contentImpactSnapshots.clientIdCode, effectiveClientFilter));
  }
  if (productId) {
    conditions.push(eq(contentImpactSnapshots.productId, productId));
  }

  const snapshots = await db
    .select()
    .from(contentImpactSnapshots)
    .where(conditions.length > 0 ? and(...conditions) : undefined)
    .orderBy(desc(contentImpactSnapshots.changedAt))
    .limit(limit);

  // Compute deltas for complete snapshots
  const results = snapshots.map((s) => {
    let deltas: Record<string, { before: number; after: number; change: number; changePct: number | null }> | null = null;

    if (s.status === "complete" && s.beforeMetrics && s.afterMetrics) {
      deltas = {};
      const before = s.beforeMetrics as Record<string, number>;
      const after = s.afterMetrics as Record<string, number>;
      for (const key of Object.keys(before)) {
        const b = before[key] ?? 0;
        const a = after[key] ?? 0;
        deltas[key] = {
          before: b,
          after: a,
          change: a - b,
          changePct: b > 0 ? ((a - b) / b) * 100 : null,
        };
      }
    }

    return { ...s, deltas };
  });

  return NextResponse.json({ snapshots: results });
}

FILE: src/app/api/import/bigquery-preview/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { BigQuery } from "@google-cloud/bigquery";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { columnAttributes } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { autoMapColumns } from "@/lib/import-mapper";

const PROJECT_ID = process.env.GCP_PROJECT_ID || "amazon-data-461918";
const DEFAULT_DATASET = process.env.BQ_DATASET || "1o8Hub";
const DEFAULT_TABLE = process.env.BQ_TABLE || "Master";

function getBigQueryClient(): BigQuery {
  if (process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL && process.env.GCP_PRIVATE_KEY) {
    let privateKey = process.env.GCP_PRIVATE_KEY;
    privateKey = privateKey.replace(/\\n/g, "\n");
    if (privateKey.startsWith('"') && privateKey.endsWith('"')) {
      privateKey = JSON.parse(privateKey);
    }
    return new BigQuery({
      projectId: PROJECT_ID,
      credentials: {
        client_email: process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL,
        private_key: privateKey,
      },
    });
  }
  return new BigQuery({ projectId: PROJECT_ID });
}

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session || !canAccessSection(session, "import")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const params = req.nextUrl.searchParams;
  const dataset = params.get("dataset") || DEFAULT_DATASET;
  const table = params.get("table") || DEFAULT_TABLE;
  const limit = Math.min(20, Math.max(1, parseInt(params.get("limit") || "5", 10)));

  const bigquery = getBigQueryClient();
  const fullTable = `${PROJECT_ID}.${dataset}.${table}`;

  try {
    const [[previewRows], [countResult]] = await Promise.all([
      bigquery.query({
        query: `SELECT * FROM \`${fullTable}\` LIMIT ${limit}`,
      }),
      bigquery.query({
        query: `SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM \`${fullTable}\``,
      }),
    ]);

    const totalRows = Number(countResult[0].total);

    if (previewRows.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({
        totalRows: 0,
        headers: [],
        preview: [],
        mappings: [],
        dataset,
        table,
      });
    }

    const headers = Object.keys(previewRows[0]);
    const preview = previewRows.slice(0, limit).map((row: Record<string, unknown>) => {
      const flat: Record<string, string> = {};
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(row)) {
        flat[k] = v != null ? String(v) : "";
      }
      return flat;
    });

    // Auto-map columns
    const attrs = await db.select().from(columnAttributes);
    const mappings = autoMapColumns(headers, attrs);

    return NextResponse.json({
      totalRows,
      headers,
      preview,
      mappings,
      dataset,
      table,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : "BigQuery query failed";
    return NextResponse.json({ error: msg }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: src/app/api/import/execute/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { BigQuery } from "@google-cloud/bigquery";
import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { parse } from "csv-parse/sync";
import { mapBqRowToProduct, type BqRow } from "@/lib/product-mapper";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const PROJECT_ID = process.env.GCP_PROJECT_ID || "amazon-data-461918";

interface MappingEntry {
  sourceHeader: string;
  bqName: string;
}

interface ImportConfig {
  source: "csv" | "bigquery";
  mappings: MappingEntry[];
  conflictMode: "skip" | "overwrite" | "merge";
  clientFilter?: string;
  bqDataset?: string;
  bqTable?: string;
}

function getBigQueryClient(): BigQuery {
  if (process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL && process.env.GCP_PRIVATE_KEY) {
    let privateKey = process.env.GCP_PRIVATE_KEY;
    privateKey = privateKey.replace(/\\n/g, "\n");
    if (privateKey.startsWith('"') && privateKey.endsWith('"')) {
      privateKey = JSON.parse(privateKey);
    }
    return new BigQuery({
      projectId: PROJECT_ID,
      credentials: {
        client_email: process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL,
        private_key: privateKey,
      },
    });
  }
  return new BigQuery({ projectId: PROJECT_ID });
}

function applyMappings(
  sourceRows: Record<string, string>[],
  mappings: MappingEntry[]
): BqRow[] {
  return sourceRows.map((row) => {
    const bqRow: BqRow = {};
    for (const m of mappings) {
      if (m.bqName && row[m.sourceHeader] !== undefined) {
        bqRow[m.bqName] = row[m.sourceHeader];
      }
    }
    return bqRow;
  });
}

const BATCH_SIZE = 50;

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session || !canAccessSection(session, "import")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const startTime = Date.now();

  let config: ImportConfig;
  let sourceRows: Record<string, string>[];

  const contentType = req.headers.get("content-type") || "";

  if (contentType.includes("multipart/form-data")) {
    // CSV source
    const formData = await req.formData();
    const file = formData.get("file") as File | null;
    const configStr = formData.get("config") as string | null;

    if (!file || !configStr) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Missing file or config" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    try {
      config = JSON.parse(configStr);
    } catch {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Invalid config JSON" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const text = await file.text();
    try {
      sourceRows = parse(text, {
        columns: true,
        skip_empty_lines: true,
        trim: true,
        relax_column_count: true,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : "CSV parse error";
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: `Failed to parse CSV: ${msg}` },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }
  } else {
    // BigQuery source
    const body = await req.json();
    config = body as ImportConfig;

    if (!config.bqDataset || !config.bqTable) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "bqDataset and bqTable are required for BigQuery import" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const bigquery = getBigQueryClient();
    const fullTable = `${PROJECT_ID}.${config.bqDataset}.${config.bqTable}`;

    try {
      const [rows] = await bigquery.query({
        query: `SELECT * FROM \`${fullTable}\``,
      });
      sourceRows = rows.map((row: Record<string, unknown>) => {
        const flat: Record<string, string> = {};
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(row)) {
          flat[k] = v != null ? String(v) : "";
        }
        return flat;
      });
    } catch (e) {
      const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : "BigQuery query failed";
      return NextResponse.json({ error: msg }, { status: 500 });
    }
  }

  if (!config.mappings || config.mappings.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "No column mappings provided" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  if (!config.conflictMode) {
    config.conflictMode = "skip";
  }

  // Apply column mappings to get BQ-shaped rows
  const bqRows = applyMappings(sourceRows, config.mappings);

  // Apply client filter if set
  let filteredRows = bqRows;
  if (config.clientFilter) {
    filteredRows = bqRows.filter(
      (row) => row.ClientIDCode === config.clientFilter
    );
  }

  let inserted = 0;
  let updated = 0;
  let skipped = 0;
  let failed = 0;
  const errors: string[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < filteredRows.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
    const batch = filteredRows.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE);

    for (const bqRow of batch) {
      try {
        const asin = bqRow.ASIN || null;
        const sku = bqRow.SKU || null;
        const marketplace = bqRow.Marketplace || null;

        // Check for existing product
        let existingProduct = null;
        if (asin && sku && marketplace) {
          const found = await db
            .select()
            .from(master)
            .where(
              and(
                eq(master.asin, asin),
                eq(master.sku, sku),
                eq(master.marketplace, marketplace)
              )
            )
            .limit(1);
          if (found.length > 0) {
            existingProduct = found[0];
          }
        } else if (asin && sku) {
          const found = await db
            .select()
            .from(master)
            .where(and(eq(master.asin, asin), eq(master.sku, sku)))
            .limit(1);
          if (found.length > 0) {
            existingProduct = found[0];
          }
        }

        if (existingProduct) {
          if (config.conflictMode === "skip") {
            skipped++;
            continue;
          }

          if (config.conflictMode === "overwrite") {
            const newProduct = mapBqRowToProduct(bqRow);
            await db
              .update(master)
              .set({
                ...newProduct,
                updatedAt: new Date(),
                isDirty: true,
              })
              .where(eq(master.id, existingProduct.id));
            updated++;
          } else if (config.conflictMode === "merge") {
            // Only fill in fields that are empty in the DB
            const existingRaw = existingProduct.rawColumnValues ?? {};
            const mergedBqRow: BqRow = { ...existingRaw };

            for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(bqRow)) {
              if (value && (!existingRaw[key] || existingRaw[key].trim() === "")) {
                mergedBqRow[key] = value;
              }
            }

            const mergedProduct = mapBqRowToProduct(mergedBqRow);
            await db
              .update(master)
              .set({
                ...mergedProduct,
                updatedAt: new Date(),
                isDirty: true,
              })
              .where(eq(master.id, existingProduct.id));
            updated++;
          }
        } else {
          const newProduct = mapBqRowToProduct(bqRow);
          await db.insert(master).values(newProduct);
          inserted++;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        failed++;
        const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unknown error";
        if (errors.length < 10) {
          errors.push(msg);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  const duration = ((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1) + "s";

  return NextResponse.json({
    success: true,
    inserted,
    updated,
    skipped,
    failed,
    errors,
    duration,
  });
}

FILE: src/app/api/import/parse/route.ts

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { columnAttributes } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { parse } from "csv-parse/sync";
import { autoMapColumns } from "@/lib/import-mapper";
import { randomUUID } from "crypto";

export const maxDuration = 30;

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session || !canAccessSection(session, "import")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const formData = await req.formData();
  const file = formData.get("file") as File | null;

  if (!file) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "No file uploaded" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  if (!file.name.endsWith(".csv")) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Only .csv files are accepted" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // 10MB limit
  if (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "File too large. Maximum size is 10MB." },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  const text = await file.text();

  let records: Record<string, string>[];
  try {
    records = parse(text, {
      columns: true,
      skip_empty_lines: true,
      trim: true,
      relax_column_count: true,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : "CSV parse error";
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `Failed to parse CSV: ${msg}` },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  if (records.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "CSV file is empty or has no data rows" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  const headers = Object.keys(records[0]);
  const preview = records.slice(0, 5);

  // Fetch column attributes for auto-mapping
  const attrs = await db.select().from(columnAttributes);
  const mappings = autoMapColumns(headers, attrs);

  const importId = randomUUID();

  return NextResponse.json({
    importId,
    fileName: file.name,
    totalRows: records.length,
    headers,
    preview,
    mappings,
  });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { issueReports, seoSettings } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { desc, eq, and, notInArray, sql, count as dbCount } from "drizzle-orm";
import { sendEmail, buildNewReportEmail, buildStatusUpdateEmail } from "@/lib/email";

export const maxDuration = 60;

async function getSupportEmail(): Promise<string | null> {
  const [row] = await db
    .select()
    .from(seoSettings)
    .where(eq(seoSettings.key, "support_email"))
    .limit(1);
  return row?.value || null;

// GET — list all reports (admin sees all, others see own)
// ?count=open — returns { count: number } of unresolved issues (admin only)
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const isAdmin = session.user.role === "admin";

  // Quick count of open issues for admin header badge
  if (req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("count") === "open" && isAdmin) {
    const [result] = await db
      .select({ count: dbCount() })
      .from(issueReports)
      .where(notInArray(issueReports.status, ["resolved", "closed"]));
    return NextResponse.json({ count: result?.count ?? 0 });
  }

  const reports = isAdmin
    ? await db.select().from(issueReports).orderBy(desc(issueReports.createdAt))
    : await db
        .select()
        .from(issueReports)
        .where(eq(issueReports.reportedBy, session.user.email!))
        .orderBy(desc(issueReports.createdAt));

  return NextResponse.json(reports);
}

// POST — create a new issue report
export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const { section, description, screenshotUrl } = body as {
    section: string;
    description: string;
    screenshotUrl?: string;
  };

  if (!section || !description) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Section and description are required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Limit screenshot to ~5MB base64
  if (screenshotUrl && screenshotUrl.length > 7_000_000) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Screenshot too large (max 5MB)" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  const [report] = await db
    .insert(issueReports)
    .values({
      reportedBy: session.user.email!,
      reportedByName: session.user.name ?? null,
      section,
      description,
      screenshotUrl: screenshotUrl ?? null,
    })
    .returning();

  // Send email to support (non-blocking)
  getSupportEmail().then((supportEmail) => {
    if (supportEmail) {
      const { subject, html } = buildNewReportEmail(report);
      sendEmail({ to: supportEmail, subject, html });
    }
  });

  return NextResponse.json(report, { status: 201 });
}

// DELETE — remove an issue report (admin only)
export async function DELETE(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session || session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { id } = (await req.json()) as { id: number };
  if (!id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "ID required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  await db.delete(issueReports).where(eq(issueReports.id, id));

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
}

// PATCH — mark admin notes as seen (reporter only)
export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { id } = (await req.json()) as { id: number };
  if (!id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "ID required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Only the reporter can mark their own report as seen
  const [report] = await db
    .select()
    .from(issueReports)
    .where(and(eq(issueReports.id, id), eq(issueReports.reportedBy, session.user.email!)))
    .limit(1);

  if (!report) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  await db
    .update(issueReports)
    .set({ notesSeen: true })
    .where(eq(issueReports.id, id));

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
}

// PUT — update status / admin notes (admin only)
export async function PUT(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session || session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const { id, status, adminNotes } = body as {
    id: number;
    status?: "pending" | "in_review" | "in_progress" | "resolved" | "closed";
    adminNotes?: string;
  };

  if (!id) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "ID required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const updates: Partial<{
    status: "pending" | "in_review" | "in_progress" | "resolved" | "closed";
    adminNotes: string | null;
    notesSeen: boolean;
    resolvedBy: string | null;
    resolvedAt: Date | null;
    updatedAt: Date;
  }> = { updatedAt: new Date() };

  if (status) updates.status = status;
  if (adminNotes !== undefined) {
    updates.adminNotes = adminNotes;
    updates.notesSeen = false;
  }

  if (status === "resolved" || status === "closed") {
    updates.resolvedBy = session.user.email!;
    updates.resolvedAt = new Date();
  }

  await db
    .update(issueReports)
    .set(updates)
    .where(eq(issueReports.id, id));

  const [updated] = await db
    .select()
    .from(issueReports)
    .where(eq(issueReports.id, id))
    .limit(1);

  // Send status update email to reporter (non-blocking, only on status change)
  if (status && updated.reportedBy) {
    const { subject, html } = buildStatusUpdateEmail(updated);
    sendEmail({ to: updated.reportedBy, subject, html });
  }

  return NextResponse.json(updated);
}

export async function PUT(req: NextRequest) {

  if (!session || session.user.role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { support_email } = (await req.json()) as { support_email: string };

  const trimmed = (support_email || "").trim();

  // Upsert into seo_settings
  const [existing] = await db
    .select()
    .from(seoSettings)
    .where(eq(seoSettings.key, "support_email"))
    .limit(1);

    await db
      .update(seoSettings)
      .set({ value: trimmed, updatedAt: new Date(), updatedBy: session.user.email! })
      .where(eq(seoSettings.key, "support_email"));

    await db.insert(seoSettings).values({
      key: "support_email",
      value: trimmed,
      updatedBy: session.user.email!,
    });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ support_email: trimmed });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, adminEventLog } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and, inArray, desc, gte, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";

const CURATED_SECTIONS = ["aplus", "publish", "portal", "products"];
const MAX_EVENTS = 200;

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const role = session.user.role;

  // Determine client code — admin can preview via ?client= param
  let clientIdCode: string | null = null;

  if (role === "client" || role === "prospect") {
    clientIdCode = session.user.clientIdCode ?? null;
    if (!clientIdCode) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
    }
  } else if (role === "admin") {
    clientIdCode = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("client");
    if (!clientIdCode) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing client param" }, { status: 400 });
    }
  } else {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  // Step 1: Get all product IDs belonging to this client
  const clientProducts = await db
    .select({ id: master.id })
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.clientIdCode, clientIdCode));

  const productIds = clientProducts.map((p) => p.id);

  if (productIds.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({ events: [] });
  }

  // Step 2: Query events for these products (curated sections, last 90 days)
  const ninetyDaysAgo = new Date();
  ninetyDaysAgo.setDate(ninetyDaysAgo.getDate() - 90);

  const events = await db
    .select({
      id: adminEventLog.id,
      section: adminEventLog.section,
      action: adminEventLog.action,
      status: adminEventLog.status,
      message: adminEventLog.message,
      resourceLabel: adminEventLog.resourceLabel,
      createdAt: adminEventLog.createdAt,
      userName: adminEventLog.userName,
    })
    .from(adminEventLog)
    .where(
      and(
        inArray(adminEventLog.resourceId, productIds),
        inArray(adminEventLog.section, CURATED_SECTIONS),
        gte(adminEventLog.createdAt, ninetyDaysAgo)
      )
    )
    .orderBy(desc(adminEventLog.createdAt))
    .limit(MAX_EVENTS);

  return NextResponse.json({ events });
}

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { aac } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { ilike } from "drizzle-orm";

export const maxDuration = 60;

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  if (!canAccessSection(session, "reports")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const requestedClient = searchParams.get("client");
  let clientCode: string | null = null;

  if (session.user.role === "admin") {
    clientCode = requestedClient || null;
  } else if (requestedClient && session.user.clientIdCode) {
    // Validate the requested client is in the user's assigned clients
    const allowed = session.user.clientIdCode.split(",").map((s: string) => s.trim());
    clientCode = allowed.includes(requestedClient) ? requestedClient : null;
  } else {
    // Single-client fallback: use first assigned client
    clientCode = session.user.clientIdCode?.split(",")[0]?.trim() || null;
  }

  if (!clientCode) {
    return NextResponse.json({ embedUrl: null });
  }

  const [client] = await db
    .select({ powerbiEmbedUrl: aac.powerbiEmbedUrl })
    .from(aac)
    .where(ilike(aac.clientIdCode, clientCode))
    .limit(1);

  return NextResponse.json({
    embedUrl: client?.powerbiEmbedUrl || null,
  });
}

FILE: src/app/api/portal/finance/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { aac } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { queryRedshift } from "@/lib/redshift";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const ITEM_TABLE = `"amazon_source_data"."sellercentral_financialtransactions_itemlevelbreakdowns"`;
const TXN_TABLE = `"amazon_source_data"."sellercentral_financialtransactions_transactionlevelbreakdowns"`;

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

function parseRawData(rawData: unknown): Record<string, string> {
  if (typeof rawData === "string") {
    try { return JSON.parse(rawData); } catch { return {}; }
  }
  if (rawData && typeof rawData === "object") return rawData as Record<string, string>;
  return {};
}

async function resolveClient(session: { user: { role: string; clientIdCode?: string | null } }, clientParam: string | null) {
  const canSelectClient = ["admin", "editor"].includes(session.user.role);
  let clientFilter: string | null = null;

  if (clientParam && canSelectClient) {
    clientFilter = clientParam;
  } else if ((session.user.role === "client" || session.user.role === "prospect") && session.user.clientIdCode) {
    clientFilter = (session.user.clientIdCode as string).split(",")[0]?.trim() || null;
  }

  if (!clientFilter) return null;

  const allClients = await db.select().from(aac);
  const record = allClients.find(
    (c) => (c.clientIdCode ?? "").toLowerCase() === clientFilter!.toLowerCase()
  );
  if (!record) return null;

  const rawData = parseRawData(record.rawData);
  const adSpendBudget = parseFloat(rawData["AdSpendBudget1M"] || "0") || null;
  const intentwiseId = rawData["IntentwiseID"] || rawData["Intentwise ID"] || "";
  const accountIds = intentwiseId.split(",").map((s: string) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);

  return {
    clientFilter,
    clientName: record.clientName,
    accountIds,
    adSpendBudget,
  };
}

// ── Types ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type View = "statement" | "statements" | "transactions";

interface TxnBreakdownRow {
  breakdown_type: string;
  total: string;
  cnt: string;
}

interface StatementPeriodRow {
  report_start_date: string;
  report_end_date: string;
  download_date: string;
  breakdown_type: string;
  total: string;
}

interface TransactionRow {
  transaction_id: string;
  breakdown_type: string;
  amount: string;
  posted_date: string;
}

interface ItemBreakdownRow {
  breakdown_type: string;
  total: string;
}

// ── Main handler ──────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const clientParam = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("client");
  const view = (req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("view") || "statement") as View;
  const periodStart = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("periodStart");
  const periodEnd = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("periodEnd");
  const periodExact = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("periodExact") === "1";

  const client = await resolveClient(session, clientParam);
  if (!client) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Client not found or no client specified" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  if (client.accountIds.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({
      client: client.clientFilter,
      clientName: client.clientName,
      error: "No Intentwise account linked",
    });
  }

  const accountList = client.accountIds.map((id: string) => `'${id}'`).join(",");

  // ── Statement View (current/selected period) ───────────────
  if (view === "statement") {
    // Get settlement periods — first try actual ranges (start != end)
    let allPeriods = await queryRedshift<{ report_start_date: string; report_end_date: string }>(`
      SELECT DISTINCT report_start_date, report_end_date
      FROM ${TXN_TABLE}
      WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
        AND report_start_date <> report_end_date
      ORDER BY report_start_date DESC
      LIMIT 30
    `);

    let closedPeriods: { start: string; end: string; open: boolean }[];

    if (allPeriods.length > 0) {
      // Real settlement ranges exist — use them directly
      closedPeriods = allPeriods.map((p) => ({
        start: new Date(p.report_start_date).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
        end: new Date(p.report_end_date).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
        open: false,
      }));
    } else {
      // Only same-date entries exist — derive biweekly settlement periods
      // from the FundTransfer (disbursement) dates, which mark settlement boundaries
      const disbursementDates = await queryRedshift<{ settle_date: string }>(`
        SELECT DISTINCT report_start_date AS settle_date
        FROM ${TXN_TABLE}
        WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
          AND breakdown_type = 'FundTransfer'
        ORDER BY settle_date DESC
        LIMIT 20
      `);

      if (disbursementDates.length >= 2) {
        // Each disbursement date marks the end of a settlement period
        // The start is the previous disbursement date
        closedPeriods = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < disbursementDates.length - 1; i++) {
          const end = new Date(disbursementDates[i].settle_date).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
          const start = new Date(disbursementDates[i + 1].settle_date).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
          closedPeriods.push({ start, end, open: false });
        }
      } else {
        // Fallback: get the full date range and create a single period
        const dateRange = await queryRedshift<{ min_date: string; max_date: string }>(`
          SELECT MIN(report_start_date) AS min_date, MAX(report_start_date) AS max_date
          FROM ${TXN_TABLE}
          WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
        `);
        if (dateRange.length > 0) {
          closedPeriods = [{
            start: new Date(dateRange[0].min_date).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
            end: new Date(dateRange[0].max_date).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
            open: false,
          }];
        } else {
          closedPeriods = [];
        }
      }
    }

    // Add "Present (Open)" option
    const nowDate = new Date();
    const todayStr = nowDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const latestEnd = closedPeriods.length > 0
      ? closedPeriods[0].end
      : `${nowDate.getFullYear()}-${String(nowDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-01`;

    const availablePeriods = [
      { start: latestEnd, end: todayStr, open: true },
      ...closedPeriods,
    ];

    // Use selected or default to "Present (Open)"
    let startDate = periodStart;
    let endDate = periodEnd;

    if (!startDate || !endDate) {
      if (closedPeriods.length === 0) {
        return NextResponse.json({ client: client.clientFilter, clientName: client.clientName, statement: null, availablePeriods: [] });
      }
      // Default to open period
      startDate = latestEnd;
      endDate = todayStr;
    }

    // Always use daily rows (start=end) to avoid non-existent settlement period rows
    const dateFilter = `report_start_date = report_end_date AND report_start_date >= '${startDate}'::DATE AND report_start_date <= '${endDate}'::DATE`;

    // ── Query TXN table leaf types (exclude hierarchical parents: Sales, Expenses, AmazonFees, Base) ──
    const TXN_PARENT_TYPES = ["'Sales'", "'Expenses'", "'AmazonFees'", "'Base'"].join(",");

    const txnBreakdown = await queryRedshift<TxnBreakdownRow>(`
      SELECT
        breakdown_type,
        SUM(CAST(breakdown_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
      FROM ${TXN_TABLE}
      WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
        AND ${dateFilter}
        AND breakdown_type NOT IN (${TXN_PARENT_TYPES})
      GROUP BY breakdown_type
      ORDER BY total
    `);

    // ── Query ITEM table leaf types for the right-panel detail breakdown ──
    const EXCLUDE_ITEM_TYPES = ["'ProductCharges'", "'AmazonFees'", "'Shipping'", "'Base'", "'Tax'"].join(",");

    const itemBreakdown = await queryRedshift<ItemBreakdownRow>(`
      SELECT
        breakdown_type,
        SUM(CAST(breakdown_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total
      FROM ${ITEM_TABLE}
      WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
        AND ${dateFilter}
        AND breakdown_type NOT IN (${EXCLUDE_ITEM_TYPES})
      GROUP BY breakdown_type
      ORDER BY total
    `);

    // ── Query individual ReserveDebit entries to identify the latest settlement's reserve ──
    const reserveEntries = await queryRedshift<{ amount: string; report_date: string }>(`
      SELECT
        CAST(breakdown_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS amount,
        report_start_date AS report_date
      FROM ${TXN_TABLE}
      WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
        AND ${dateFilter}
        AND breakdown_type = 'ReserveDebit'
      ORDER BY report_start_date DESC, breakdown_amount
    `);

    // ── Query individual FundTransfer entries to find the latest disbursement ──
    const fundEntries = await queryRedshift<{ amount: string; report_date: string }>(`
      SELECT
        CAST(breakdown_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS amount,
        report_start_date AS report_date
      FROM ${TXN_TABLE}
      WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
        AND ${dateFilter}
        AND breakdown_type = 'FundTransfer'
      ORDER BY report_start_date DESC
    `);

    // Build lookups
    const txnMap: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const row of txnBreakdown) {
      txnMap[row.breakdown_type] = parseFloat(row.total) || 0;
    }

    const itemDetail: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const row of itemBreakdown) {
      itemDetail[row.breakdown_type] = parseFloat(row.total) || 0;
    }

    // ── Compute Amazon-style categories ──

    // Sales = Product charges + Shipping + Inventory Reimbursements
    // (matches Amazon's "Sales" which is "Product Price, Shipping, Gift Wrap and Taxes less Promotions")
    const sales = (txnMap["ProductCharges"] || 0) + (txnMap["Shipping"] || 0)
      + (txnMap["FBAInventoryReimbursement"] || 0);

    // Refunds = Refunded Sales + Refunded Expenses (combined like Amazon)
    const refundedSales = txnMap["Refunded Sales"] || 0;
    const refundedExpenses = txnMap["Refunded Expenses"] || 0;
    const refunds = refundedSales + refundedExpenses;

    // Expenses = ALL fees including advertising (Amazon combines them)
    const expenseLeafTypes = [
      "Commission", "FBAPerUnitFulfillmentFee", "FBAFees",
      "StorageBillingFee", "AWDStorageFees", "LongTermStorageFee",
      "InboundTransportationFee", "AmazonUpstreamStorageTransportationFee",
      "AmazonUpstreamProcessingFee", "SubscriptionFee",
      "PromoRebates", "ShippingChargeback",
      "AdvertisingFee", "FBAReversedReimbursement", "COMPENSATED_CLAWBACK",
    ];
    const expenses = expenseLeafTypes.reduce((s, t) => s + (txnMap[t] || 0), 0);

    // Account Level Reserve — de-duplicate ReserveDebit entries
    // Redshift stores duplicate ReserveDebit rows per settlement event.
    // Find the latest settlement's reserve by looking at the most recent ReserveDebit date,
    // then take just ONE entry from that date (they're duplicated).
    let accountLevelReserve = 0;
    if (reserveEntries.length > 0) {
      // Get unique (amount, date) pairs — the latest date's debit is the current reserve
      const latestDate = new Date(reserveEntries[0].report_date).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const latestReserveAmount = parseFloat(reserveEntries[0].amount) || 0;
      accountLevelReserve = latestReserveAmount; // single entry, not the duplicate
    }

    // Beginning Balance — the previous period's reserve carried forward
    // This is the ReserveCredit amount (release of previous reserve).
    // Since ReserveCredit isn't duplicated, use total minus the current period's release.
    const totalReserveCredit = txnMap["ReserveCredit"] || 0;
    // The current period's reserve release equals the absolute value of the previous period's reserve
    // Beginning balance = total ReserveCredit - current period's release
    // But simpler: Beginning Balance = Net Proceeds - Sales - Refunds - Expenses - Reserve
    // where Net Proceeds = latest FundTransfer (the actual disbursement)
    const latestFundTransfer = fundEntries.length > 0 ? parseFloat(fundEntries[0].amount) || 0 : 0;
    const beginningBalance = latestFundTransfer - sales - refunds - expenses - accountLevelReserve;

    // Net Proceeds = Beginning Balance + Sales + Refunds + Expenses + Account Level Reserve
    const netProceeds = beginningBalance + sales + refunds + expenses + accountLevelReserve;
    // (This equals latestFundTransfer by construction, which matches Amazon's disbursement)

    const fundTransfer = latestFundTransfer;

    // Combine into breakdown for backward compatibility
    const breakdown: Record<string, number> = {
      Sales: sales,
      Refunds: refunds,
      Expenses: expenses,
      AccountLevelReserve: accountLevelReserve,
      BeginningBalance: beginningBalance,
      FundTransfer: fundTransfer,
    };

    // Budget pacing (current month)
    const now = new Date();
    const currentMonthStart = `${now.getFullYear()}-${String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-01`;
    const today = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const adSpendRows = await queryRedshift<{ mtd_ad_spend: string }>(`
      SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ad_spend), 0) AS mtd_ad_spend
      FROM "intentwise_ecommerce_graph"."account_summary"
      WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
        AND report_date >= '${currentMonthStart}'::DATE
        AND report_date <= '${today}'::DATE
    `);
    const mtdAdSpend = parseFloat(adSpendRows[0]?.mtd_ad_spend || "0");
    const dayOfMonth = now.getDate();
    const daysInMonth = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, 0).getDate();
    const projectedSpend = daysInMonth > 0 ? (mtdAdSpend / dayOfMonth) * daysInMonth : 0;
    const budgetPacing = client.adSpendBudget ? {
      budget: client.adSpendBudget,
      mtdSpend: mtdAdSpend,
      projectedSpend: Math.round(projectedSpend * 100) / 100,
      pacePercent: Math.round((projectedSpend / client.adSpendBudget) * 100),
      dayOfMonth,
      daysInMonth,
      status: projectedSpend <= client.adSpendBudget * 0.9
        ? "under" as const
        : projectedSpend <= client.adSpendBudget * 1.1
          ? "on-track" as const
          : "over" as const,
    } : null;

    return NextResponse.json({
      client: client.clientFilter,
      clientName: client.clientName,
      statement: {
        periodStart: startDate,
        periodEnd: endDate,
        netProceeds,
        beginningBalance,
        sales,
        refunds,
        expenses,
        accountLevelReserve,
        fundTransfer,
        // Legacy fields for backward compat
        refundedSales,
        refundedExpenses,
        advertisingFee: 0,
        reserveDebit: accountLevelReserve,
        reserveCredit: 0,
        breakdown,
        itemDetail,
      },
      budgetPacing,
      availablePeriods,
    });
  }

  // ── All Statements View ────────────────────────────────────
  if (view === "statements") {
    const monthsBack = parseInt(req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("months") || "6", 10);
    const lookback = new Date();
    lookback.setMonth(lookback.getMonth() - Math.min(Math.max(monthsBack, 1), 12));
    const lookbackDate = lookback.toISOString().slice(0, 10);

    // First try settlement ranges (start != end)
    let rows = await queryRedshift<StatementPeriodRow>(`
      SELECT
        report_start_date,
        report_end_date,
        MAX(download_date) AS download_date,
        breakdown_type,
        SUM(CAST(breakdown_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total
      FROM ${TXN_TABLE}
      WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
        AND report_start_date >= '${lookbackDate}'::DATE
        AND report_start_date <> report_end_date
      GROUP BY report_start_date, report_end_date, breakdown_type
      ORDER BY report_start_date DESC, breakdown_type
    `);

    // Fallback: same-date entries — derive periods from FundTransfer dates
    if (rows.length === 0) {
      rows = await queryRedshift<StatementPeriodRow>(`
        WITH disbursements AS (
          SELECT DISTINCT report_start_date AS settle_date
          FROM ${TXN_TABLE}
          WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
            AND breakdown_type = 'FundTransfer'
            AND report_start_date >= '${lookbackDate}'::DATE
          ORDER BY settle_date DESC
        ),
        periods AS (
          SELECT
            LAG(settle_date) OVER (ORDER BY settle_date) AS period_start,
            settle_date AS period_end
          FROM disbursements
        )
        SELECT
          COALESCE(p.period_start, t.report_start_date) AS report_start_date,
          p.period_end AS report_end_date,
          MAX(t.download_date) AS download_date,
          t.breakdown_type,
          SUM(CAST(t.breakdown_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total
        FROM ${TXN_TABLE} t
        JOIN periods p
          ON t.report_start_date > COALESCE(p.period_start, '1900-01-01'::DATE)
          AND t.report_start_date <= p.period_end
        WHERE t.account_id IN (${accountList})
          AND t.report_start_date >= '${lookbackDate}'::DATE
          AND p.period_start IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY COALESCE(p.period_start, t.report_start_date), p.period_end, t.breakdown_type
        ORDER BY report_start_date DESC, breakdown_type
      `);
    }

    // Group by period
    const periodMap = new Map<string, {
      periodStart: string;
      periodEnd: string;
      downloadDate: string;
      sales: number;
      refunds: number;
      expenses: number;
      advertising: number;
      other: number;
      netProceeds: number;
      breakdown: Record<string, number>;
    }>();

    for (const row of rows) {
      const startStr = new Date(row.report_start_date).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const endStr = new Date(row.report_end_date).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const key = `${startStr}_${endStr}`;

      if (!periodMap.has(key)) {
        periodMap.set(key, {
          periodStart: startStr,
          periodEnd: endStr,
          downloadDate: new Date(row.download_date).toISOString().slice(0, 10),
          sales: 0,
          refunds: 0,
          expenses: 0,
          advertising: 0,
          other: 0,
          netProceeds: 0,
          breakdown: {},
        });
      }

      const period = periodMap.get(key)!;
      const amount = parseFloat(row.total) || 0;
      period.breakdown[row.breakdown_type] = amount;

      // Categorize
      if (["Sales", "ProductCharges", "Shipping"].includes(row.breakdown_type)) {
        period.sales += amount;
      } else if (["Refunded Sales", "Refunded Expenses", "ShippingChargeback"].includes(row.breakdown_type)) {
        period.refunds += amount;
      } else if (["AdvertisingFee"].includes(row.breakdown_type)) {
        period.advertising += amount;
      } else if (["Expenses", "AmazonFees", "Commission", "FBAPerUnitFulfillmentFee", "FBAFees",
                   "StorageBillingFee", "AWDStorageFees", "SubscriptionFee", "InboundTransportationFee",
                   "AmazonUpstreamStorageTransportationFee", "AmazonUpstreamProcessingFee",
                   "LongTermStorageFee"].includes(row.breakdown_type)) {
        period.expenses += amount;
      } else {
        period.other += amount;
      }
    }

    // Calculate net
    for (const period of periodMap.values()) {
      period.netProceeds = Object.values(period.breakdown).reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0);
    }

    const statements = Array.from(periodMap.values()).sort(
      (a, b) => b.periodStart.localeCompare(a.periodStart)
    );

    return NextResponse.json({
      client: client.clientFilter,
      clientName: client.clientName,
      statements,
    });
  }

  // ── Transaction View ───────────────────────────────────────
  if (view === "transactions") {
    if (!periodStart || !periodEnd) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "periodStart and periodEnd required for transaction view" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // Check if this account has real settlement ranges or only same-date entries
    const hasRanges = await queryRedshift<{ cnt: string }>(`
      SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ${TXN_TABLE}
      WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
        AND report_start_date = '${periodStart}'::DATE
        AND report_end_date = '${periodEnd}'::DATE
      LIMIT 1
    `);
    const useRange = !hasRanges.length || parseInt(hasRanges[0].cnt) === 0;

    // For real settlement ranges, match exact dates; for derived periods, match date range
    const txnDateFilter = useRange
      ? `report_start_date > '${periodStart}'::DATE AND report_start_date <= '${periodEnd}'::DATE`
      : periodStart !== periodEnd
        ? `report_start_date = '${periodStart}'::DATE AND report_end_date = '${periodEnd}'::DATE`
        : `report_start_date = report_end_date AND report_start_date = '${periodStart}'::DATE`;
    const txnRows = await queryRedshift<TransactionRow>(`
      SELECT
        transaction_id,
        breakdown_type,
        CAST(breakdown_amount AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS amount,
        report_start_date AS posted_date
      FROM ${TXN_TABLE}
      WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
        AND ${txnDateFilter}
      ORDER BY report_start_date DESC, transaction_id, breakdown_type
    `);

    // Get SKU/ASIN info from item-level table
    const itemRows = await queryRedshift<{ transaction_id: string; sku: string; quantity: string }>(`
      SELECT
        transaction_id,
        MAX(sku) AS sku,
        SUM(CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(quantity, ''), '0') AS INT)) AS quantity
      FROM ${ITEM_TABLE}
      WHERE account_id IN (${accountList})
        AND ${txnDateFilter}
      GROUP BY transaction_id
    `);
    const itemMap = new Map(itemRows.map((r) => [r.transaction_id, { sku: r.sku, quantity: parseInt(r.quantity) || 0 }]));

    // Group by transaction
    const txnMap = new Map<string, {
      transactionId: string;
      postedDate: string;
      sku: string;
      quantity: number;
      productCharges: number;
      promoRebates: number;
      amazonFees: number;
      other: number;
      total: number;
    }>();

    for (const row of txnRows) {
      if (!txnMap.has(row.transaction_id)) {
        const item = itemMap.get(row.transaction_id);
        txnMap.set(row.transaction_id, {
          transactionId: row.transaction_id,
          postedDate: row.posted_date ? new Date(row.posted_date).toISOString().slice(0, 10) : "",
          sku: item?.sku || "",
          quantity: item?.quantity || 0,
          productCharges: 0,
          promoRebates: 0,
          amazonFees: 0,
          other: 0,
          total: 0,
        });
      }
      const txn = txnMap.get(row.transaction_id)!;
      const amount = parseFloat(row.amount) || 0;

      if (["ProductCharges", "Sales", "Shipping"].includes(row.breakdown_type)) {
        txn.productCharges += amount;
      } else if (["PromoRebates"].includes(row.breakdown_type)) {
        txn.promoRebates += amount;
      } else if (["AmazonFees", "Commission", "FBAPerUnitFulfillmentFee", "FBAFees",
                   "Expenses"].includes(row.breakdown_type)) {
        txn.amazonFees += amount;
      } else {
        txn.other += amount;
      }
      txn.total += amount;
    }

    const transactions = Array.from(txnMap.values());

    return NextResponse.json({
      client: client.clientFilter,
      clientName: client.clientName,
      periodStart,
      periodEnd,
      transactions,
      transactionCount: transactions.length,
    });
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid view parameter" }, { status: 400 });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, varietyPackItems, activityLog } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { and, eq, ilike, or, sql, asc, desc, count } from "drizzle-orm";

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const session = await getAuthSession();
    if (!session) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const isAdmin = session.user.role === "admin";
    const url = req.nextUrl.searchParams;
    const clientParam = url.get("client");
    const search = url.get("search") || "";
    const statusFilter = url.get("status") || "";
    const sortBy = url.get("sortBy") || "asin";
    const sortOrder = url.get("sortOrder") === "desc" ? "desc" : "asc";
    const page = Math.max(1, parseInt(url.get("page") || "1"));
    const pageSize = Math.min(100, Math.max(1, parseInt(url.get("pageSize") || "50")));

    // Determine client code — admins can preview any client, client users use their own
    const clientCode = isAdmin
      ? clientParam
      : session.user.clientIdCode;

    if (!clientCode) {
      return NextResponse.json({ products: [], total: 0 });
    }

    // Build conditions
    const conditions = [eq(master.clientIdCode, clientCode)];

    if (search) {
      conditions.push(
        or(
          ilike(master.asin, `%${search}%`),
          ilike(master.sku, `%${search}%`),
          ilike(master.itemName, `%${search}%`),
          ilike(master.brandName, `%${search}%`),
        )!,
      );
    }

    if (statusFilter) {
      const statuses = statusFilter.split(",").map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      if (statuses.length === 1) {
        conditions.push(ilike(master.status, statuses[0]));
      } else if (statuses.length > 1) {
        conditions.push(or(...statuses.map((s) => ilike(master.status, s)))!);
      }
    }

    const where = and(...conditions);

    // Count total
    const [{ total }] = await db
      .select({ total: count() })
      .from(master)
      .where(where);

    // Variation ID expression (same as hub)
    const variationIdExpr = sql`COALESCE(${master.variations}->>'VariationID', ${master.otherAttributes}->>'VariationID', ${master.rawColumnValues}->>'VariationID')`;

    // Sort columns
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    const sortColumns: Record<string, any> = {
      asin: master.asin,
      sku: master.sku,
      status: master.status,
      variationId: variationIdExpr,
    };

    const sortKey = sortBy in sortColumns ? sortBy : "asin";
    const orderFn = sortOrder === "desc" ? desc : asc;

    // Fetch page
    const products = await db
      .select({
        id: master.id,
        asin: master.asin,
        sku: master.sku,
        status: master.status,
        itemName: master.itemName,
        summarizedTitle: master.summarizedTitle,
        variationId: sql<string | null>`${variationIdExpr}`,
        variationGroup: master.variationGroup,
        variations: master.variations,
        parentageLevel: master.parentageLevel,
        parentAsin: master.parentAsin,
        mainImageUrl: master.mainImageUrl,
        listPrice: master.listPrice,
        varietyPackItemCount: sql<number>`(SELECT count(*)::int FROM ${varietyPackItems} WHERE ${varietyPackItems.packProductId} = "master"."id")`,
        vpFlavors: sql<string[] | null>`(SELECT json_agg(CASE WHEN vpi.units > 1 THEN vpi.units || '× ' || vpi.flavor ELSE vpi.flavor END ORDER BY vpi.sort_order) FROM ${varietyPackItems} vpi WHERE vpi.pack_product_id = "master"."id" AND vpi.flavor IS NOT NULL)`,
        isPortalSubmission: sql<boolean>`(${master.rawColumnValues}->>'PortalNotes' IS NOT NULL OR (${master.asin} IS NULL AND ${master.status} = 'Incomplete'))`,
      })
      .from(master)
      .where(where)
      .orderBy(
        asc(master.clientIdCode),
        sql`COALESCE(${master.parentAsin}, ${master.asin})`,
        sql`CASE WHEN ${master.parentageLevel} = 'Parent' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END`,
        orderFn(sortColumns[sortKey]),
      )
      .limit(pageSize)
      .offset((page - 1) * pageSize);

    return NextResponse.json({ products, total });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[portal/products] Error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to load products" },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const session = await getAuthSession();
    if (!session) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
    }

    // Prospects are read-only — block product submissions
    if (session.user.role === "prospect") {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
    }

    const isAdmin = session.user.role === "admin";
    const clientParam = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("client");
    const clientCode = isAdmin ? clientParam : session.user.clientIdCode;

    if (!clientCode) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "No client assigned to your account" },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const body = await req.json();
    const { title, sku, upc, flavor, size, ingredients, notes } = body;

    if (!title?.trim() || !sku?.trim()) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Product title and SKU are required" },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    // Build variations JSONB with flavor/size if provided
    const variations: Record<string, string> = {};
    if (flavor) variations.Flavor = flavor;
    if (size) variations.Size = size;

    // Build rawColumnValues for extra fields
    const rawColumnValues: Record<string, string> = {};
    if (upc) rawColumnValues.UPC = upc;
    if (ingredients) rawColumnValues.Ingredients = ingredients;
    if (notes) rawColumnValues["PortalNotes"] = notes;

    const [created] = await db
      .insert(master)
      .values({
        clientIdCode: clientCode,
        itemName: title.trim(),
        sku: sku.trim(),
        status: "Incomplete",
        variations: Object.keys(variations).length > 0 ? variations : undefined,
        rawColumnValues:
          Object.keys(rawColumnValues).length > 0 ? rawColumnValues : undefined,
      })
      .returning({ id: master.id, asin: master.asin, sku: master.sku });

    // Activity log
    await db.insert(activityLog).values({
      productId: created.id,
      asin: created.asin,
      sku: created.sku,
      clientIdCode: clientCode,
      itemName: title.trim(),
      fieldLabel: "Product submitted via portal",
      bqName: "PortalSubmission",
      oldValue: null,
      newValue: `SKU: ${sku.trim()}`,
      changedBy: session.user.email!,
      editType: "single",
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ id: created.id }, { status: 201 });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[portal/products] POST Error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to submit product" },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { seoProjects, seoAsins, users } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { eq, desc, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const role = session.user.role;

  // Determine client code — admin can preview via ?client= param
  let clientIdCode: string | null = null;

  if (role === "client" || role === "prospect") {
    clientIdCode = session.user.clientIdCode ?? null;
    if (!clientIdCode) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
    }
  } else if (role === "admin") {
    clientIdCode = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("client");
    if (!clientIdCode) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing client param" }, { status: 400 });
    }
  } else {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const [projectRows, asinCounts] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select({
        id: seoProjects.id,
        name: seoProjects.name,
        brandName: seoProjects.brandName,
        status: seoProjects.status,
        currentPhase: seoProjects.currentPhase,
        createdAt: seoProjects.createdAt,
        updatedAt: seoProjects.updatedAt,
        assigneeName: users.name,
        assigneeImage: users.image,
        s1ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s1ApprovedAt,
        s2ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s2ApprovedAt,
        s3ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s3ApprovedAt,
        s4ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s4ApprovedAt,
        s5ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s5ApprovedAt,
        s6ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s6ApprovedAt,
      })
      .from(seoProjects)
      .leftJoin(users, eq(seoProjects.assignedTo, users.id))
      .where(eq(seoProjects.clientIdCode, clientIdCode))
      .orderBy(desc(seoProjects.createdAt)),

    db.execute<{ project_id: string; asin_count: number }>(sql`
      SELECT sp.id as project_id, count(sa.id)::int as asin_count
      FROM seo_projects sp
      LEFT JOIN seo_asins sa ON sa.project_id = sp.id
      WHERE sp.client_id_code = ${clientIdCode}
      GROUP BY sp.id
    `),
  ]);

  const asinMap = new Map(asinCounts.map((r) => [r.project_id, r.asin_count]));

  const projects = projectRows.map((p) => ({
    id: p.id,
    name: p.name,
    brand_name: p.brandName,
    status: p.status,
    current_phase: p.currentPhase,
    created_at: p.createdAt,
    updated_at: p.updatedAt,
    assignee_name: p.assigneeName,
    assignee_image: p.assigneeImage,
    asin_count: asinMap.get(p.id) ?? 0,
    s1_approved_at: p.s1ApprovedAt,
    s2_approved_at: p.s2ApprovedAt,
    s3_approved_at: p.s3ApprovedAt,
    s4_approved_at: p.s4ApprovedAt,
    s5_approved_at: p.s5ApprovedAt,
    s6_approved_at: p.s6ApprovedAt,
  }));

  return NextResponse.json(projects);
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { clientGanttTasks } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const role = session.user.role;

  let clientIdCode: string | null = null;

  if (role === "client" || role === "prospect") {
    clientIdCode = session.user.clientIdCode ?? null;
    if (!clientIdCode) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
    }
    // For multi-client users, take first
    clientIdCode = clientIdCode.split(",")[0].trim();
  } else if (role === "admin") {
    clientIdCode = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("client");
    if (!clientIdCode) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing client param" }, { status: 400 });
    }
  } else {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  // Aggregate by section
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      section: clientGanttTasks.section,
      total: sql<number>`count(*)::int`,
      completed: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${clientGanttTasks.status} = 'completed')::int`,
      inProgress: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${clientGanttTasks.status} = 'in_progress')::int`,
      avgPct: sql<number>`coalesce(avg(${clientGanttTasks.completionPct})::int, 0)`,
    })
    .from(clientGanttTasks)
    .where(eq(clientGanttTasks.clientIdCode, clientIdCode))
    .groupBy(clientGanttTasks.section);

  // Overall progress
  const allTasks = await db
    .select({
      total: sql<number>`count(*)::int`,
      completed: sql<number>`count(*) filter (where ${clientGanttTasks.status} = 'completed')::int`,
      avgPct: sql<number>`coalesce(avg(${clientGanttTasks.completionPct})::int, 0)`,
    })
    .from(clientGanttTasks)
    .where(eq(clientGanttTasks.clientIdCode, clientIdCode));

  return NextResponse.json({
    sections: rows,
    overall: allTasks[0] ?? { total: 0, completed: 0, avgPct: 0 },
    initialized: (allTasks[0]?.total ?? 0) > 0,
  });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { resolveUploadFolder, buildFileName } from "@/lib/drive-upload";
import { driveClient } from "@/lib/drive-client";
import { logEvent } from "@/lib/event-logger";

export const maxDuration = 120;

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  if (!canAccessSection(session, "aplus")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const role = session.user.role;
  if (role !== "client" && role !== "admin") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const clientIdCode = session.user.clientIdCode;
  if (role === "client" && !clientIdCode) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  try {
    const formData = await req.formData();
    const file = formData.get("file") as File | null;
    const asin = formData.get("asin") as string | null;

    if (!file) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "No file provided" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // Use client's own code, or admin can specify via form data
    const uploadClientCode = role === "admin"
      ? (formData.get("clientIdCode") as string) ?? clientIdCode
      : clientIdCode;

    if (!uploadClientCode) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing client code" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // Resolve the upload folder in Google Drive
    const folder = await resolveUploadFolder({
      clientIdCode: uploadClientCode,
      folderType: "aplus",
      asin,
    });

    if (!folder) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Client folder not configured in Google Drive" },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    // Build deterministic file name
    const fileName = buildFileName({
      clientIdCode: uploadClientCode,
      asin,
      folderType: "portal-upload",
      mimeType: file.type,
    });

    // Upload to Drive
    const buffer = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer());
    const driveFile = await driveClient.uploadFile(
      fileName,
      folder.driveFolderId,
      buffer,
      file.type
    );

    logEvent({
      userEmail: session.user.email,
      userName: session.user.name ?? undefined,
      section: "portal",
      action: "file:upload",
      resourceType: "file",
      resourceId: driveFile.id,
      resourceLabel: file.name,
      message: `Uploaded ${file.name} (${(file.size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB)`,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      fileId: driveFile.id,
      fileName: driveFile.name,
      driveUrl: `https://drive.google.com/file/d/${driveFile.id}/view`,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("[portal-upload] Failed:", error instanceof Error ? error.message : error);

    logEvent({
      userEmail: session.user.email,
      section: "portal",
      action: "file:upload",
      status: "error",
      message: `Upload failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : "unknown error"}`,
    });

    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Upload failed. Please try again." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}
