import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, amazonSnapshots, aac, varietyPackItems } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { and, ilike, or, sql, desc, asc, count, inArray, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { mapBqRowToProduct, type BqRow } from "@/lib/product-mapper";

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const url = req.nextUrl.searchParams;
  const page = Math.max(1, parseInt(url.get("page") || "1"));
  const pageSize = Math.min(100, Math.max(1, parseInt(url.get("pageSize") || "50")));
  const search = url.get("search") || "";
  const sortBy = url.get("sortBy") || "updatedAt";
  const sortOrder = url.get("sortOrder") === "asc" ? "asc" : "desc";
  const client = url.get("client") || "";
  const marketplace = url.get("marketplace") || "";
  const status = url.get("status") || "";
  const isDirty = url.get("isDirty");
  const includeInactive = url.get("includeInactive") === "true";
  const fieldsAll = url.get("fields") === "all";
  const parentsOnly = url.get("parentsOnly") === "true";

  // Build where conditions
  const conditions = [];

  // Card view: return parents, standalone products, and orphaned children (variation ID removed)
  if (parentsOnly) {
    conditions.push(
      or(
        ilike(master.parentageLevel, "parent"),
        sql`${master.parentSku} IS NULL`,
        sql`(${master.parentageLevel} = 'Child' AND (${master.variations}->>'VariationID' IS NULL OR ${master.variations}->>'VariationID' = ''))`
      )
    );
  }

  // By default, only show products from active clients (AAC table)
  if (!includeInactive && !client) {
    const activeClientRows = await db
      .select({ code: aac.clientIdCode })
      .from(aac)
      .where(ilike(aac.clientStatus, "active"));
    const activeCodes = activeClientRows.map((r) => r.code);
    if (activeCodes.length > 0) {
      conditions.push(inArray(master.clientIdCode, activeCodes));
    }
  }

  if (search) {
    conditions.push(
      or(
        ilike(master.asin, `%${search}%`),
        ilike(master.sku, `%${search}%`),
        ilike(master.brandName, `%${search}%`),
        ilike(master.itemName, `%${search}%`),
        ilike(master.summarizedTitle, `%${search}%`),
        ilike(master.clientIdCode, `%${search}%`)
      )
    );
  }

  if (client) {
    const clients = client.split(",").map((c) => c.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (clients.length === 1) {
      conditions.push(ilike(master.clientIdCode, clients[0]));
    } else if (clients.length > 1) {
      conditions.push(
        or(...clients.map((c) => ilike(master.clientIdCode, c)))
      );
    }
  }

  if (marketplace) {
    conditions.push(ilike(master.marketplace, marketplace));
  }

  if (status) {
    const statuses = status.split(",").map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (statuses.length === 1) {
      conditions.push(ilike(master.status, statuses[0]));
    } else if (statuses.length > 1) {
      conditions.push(
        or(...statuses.map((s) => ilike(master.status, s)))
      );
    }
  }

  if (isDirty === "true") {
    conditions.push(sql`${master.isDirty} = true`);
  } else if (isDirty === "false") {
    conditions.push(sql`${master.isDirty} = false`);
  }

  const where = conditions.length > 0 ? and(...conditions) : undefined;

  // Get total count
  const [{ total }] = await db
    .select({ total: count() })
    .from(master)
    .where(where);

  // Build order by clause
  const variationIdExpr = sql`COALESCE(${master.variations}->>'VariationID', ${master.otherAttributes}->>'VariationID', ${master.rawColumnValues}->>'VariationID')`;

  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
  const sortColumns: Record<string, any> = {
    asin: master.asin,
    sku: master.sku,
    brandName: master.brandName,
    marketplace: master.marketplace,
    status: master.status,
    updatedAt: master.updatedAt,
    clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode,
    variationId: variationIdExpr,
  };

  const sortKey = sortBy in sortColumns ? sortBy : "updatedAt";
  const orderFn = sortOrder === "asc" ? asc : desc;

  // Fetch page of products (core columns only for list view)
  // Group by client → variation family (parent first) → user sort
  const selectFields = {
      id: master.id,
      asin: master.asin,
      sku: master.sku,
      clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode,
      marketplace: master.marketplace,
      country: master.country,
      status: master.status,
      brandName: master.brandName,
      itemName: master.itemName,
      summarizedTitle: master.summarizedTitle,
      listPrice: master.listPrice,
      mainImageUrl: master.mainImageUrl,
      parentageLevel: master.parentageLevel,
      parentSku: master.parentSku,
      parentAsin: master.parentAsin,
      variationId: sql<string | null>`${variationIdExpr}`,
      variationGroup: master.variationGroup,
      variations: master.variations,
      isDirty: master.isDirty,
      changeLog: master.changeLog,
      updatedAt: master.updatedAt,
      varietyPackItemCount: sql<number>`(SELECT count(*)::int FROM ${varietyPackItems} WHERE ${varietyPackItems.packProductId} = "master"."id")`,
      vpFlavors: sql<string[] | null>`(SELECT json_agg(CASE WHEN vpi.units > 1 THEN vpi.units || '× ' || vpi.flavor ELSE vpi.flavor END ORDER BY vpi.sort_order) FROM ${varietyPackItems} vpi WHERE vpi.pack_product_id = "master"."id" AND vpi.flavor IS NOT NULL)`,
      ...(fieldsAll ? { rawColumnValues: master.rawColumnValues } : {}),
  };

  const rows = await db
    .select(selectFields)
    .from(master)
    .where(where)
    .orderBy(
      asc(master.clientIdCode),
      // Group by Variation ID (nulls last)
      asc(sql`${variationIdExpr} IS NULL`),
      asc(variationIdExpr),
      // Parent first within each variation family
      asc(sql`CASE WHEN ${master.parentageLevel} ILIKE 'parent' THEN 0 WHEN ${master.parentageLevel} ILIKE 'child' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END`),
      // Then by variation group (nulls last)
      asc(sql`${master.variationGroup} IS NULL`),
      asc(master.variationGroup),
      orderFn(sortColumns[sortKey]),
    )
    .limit(pageSize)
    .offset((page - 1) * pageSize);

  // Join latest Amazon match scores
  const productIds = rows.map((r) => r.id);
  let enrichedRows = rows as (typeof rows[number] & {
    _amazonMatch?: number | null;
    _amazonFetchedAt?: Date | null;
  })[];

  if (productIds.length > 0) {
    const snapshots = await db
      .selectDistinctOn([amazonSnapshots.productId], {
        productId: amazonSnapshots.productId,
        overallMatch: amazonSnapshots.overallMatch,
        fetchedAt: amazonSnapshots.fetchedAt,
      })
      .from(amazonSnapshots)
      .where(inArray(amazonSnapshots.productId, productIds))
      .orderBy(amazonSnapshots.productId, desc(amazonSnapshots.fetchedAt));

    const snapshotMap = new Map(
      snapshots.map((s) => [s.productId, s])
    );

    enrichedRows = rows.map((r) => ({
      ...r,
      _amazonMatch: snapshotMap.get(r.id)?.overallMatch ?? null,
      _amazonFetchedAt: snapshotMap.get(r.id)?.fetchedAt ?? null,
    }));
  }

  return NextResponse.json({
    data: enrichedRows,
    pagination: {
      page,
      pageSize,
      total,
      totalPages: Math.ceil(total / pageSize),
    },
  });
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  if (session.user.role === "viewer") {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Forbidden: viewers cannot create products" },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const { asin, sku, clientIdCode, marketplace } = body as {
    asin: string;
    sku: string;
    clientIdCode: string;
    marketplace: string;
  };

  // Validate required fields
  if (!asin?.trim() || !sku?.trim() || !clientIdCode?.trim() || !marketplace?.trim()) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "ASIN, SKU, Client, and Marketplace are required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  if (asin.trim().length !== 10) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "ASIN must be exactly 10 characters" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Check for duplicate (asin, sku, marketplace)
  const existing = await db
    .select({ id: master.id })
    .from(master)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(master.asin, asin.trim()),
        eq(master.sku, sku.trim()),
        ilike(master.marketplace, marketplace.trim())
      )
    )
    .limit(1);

  if (existing.length > 0) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "A product with this ASIN, SKU, and Marketplace already exists" },
      { status: 409 }
    );
  }

  // Build product from BQ row mapping
  const bqRow: BqRow = {
    ASIN: asin.trim(),
    SKU: sku.trim(),
    ClientIDCode: clientIdCode.trim(),
    Marketplace: marketplace.trim(),
  };

  const newProduct = mapBqRowToProduct(bqRow);
  newProduct.status = "Active";
  newProduct.isDirty = true;

  const [inserted] = await db
    .insert(master)
    .values(newProduct)
    .returning({ id: master.id });

  return NextResponse.json({ id: inserted.id }, { status: 201 });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, activityLog, fieldComments } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { createImpactSnapshot } from "@/lib/impact-snapshots";
import { eq, sql, count } from "drizzle-orm";
import {
  COMPUTED_FIELDS,
  getTriggeredComputedFields,
  computeUUID,
  computeSummarizedTitle,
  computeAmazonPdpUrl,
} from "@/lib/computed-fields";

export async function GET(
  _req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { id } = await params;

  const product = await db
    .select()
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.id, id))
    .limit(1);

  if (product.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Product not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  // Fetch comment counts grouped by bqName
  const commentRows = await db
    .select({
      bqName: fieldComments.bqName,
      total: count(),
      open: count(
        sql`CASE WHEN ${fieldComments.resolved} = false THEN 1 END`
      ),
    })
    .from(fieldComments)
    .where(eq(fieldComments.productId, id))
    .groupBy(fieldComments.bqName);

  const _commentCounts: Record<string, { total: number; open: number }> = {};
  for (const row of commentRows) {
    _commentCounts[row.bqName] = { total: row.total, open: row.open };
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ ...product[0], _commentCounts });
}

export async function PUT(
  req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  if (session.user.role === "viewer") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden: viewers cannot edit" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { id } = await params;

  const body = await req.json();
  const { field, value, bqName } = body as {
    field: string;
    value: string | null;
    bqName: string;
  };

  // Reject direct edits to computed fields
  if (COMPUTED_FIELDS.has(bqName)) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `${bqName} is a computed field and cannot be edited directly` },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Enforce ASIN must be exactly 10 characters
  if ((bqName === "ASIN" || bqName === "ParentASIN") && value != null && value.length !== 10) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "ASIN must be exactly 10 characters" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Fetch current product
  const [product] = await db
    .select()
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.id, id))
    .limit(1);

  if (!product) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Product not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  const jsonbFields = [
    "contentSeo", "variations", "packaging", "targetAudience",
    "fulfillment", "productAttributes", "nutritionSupplements",
    "complianceSafety", "images", "dimensionsWeight", "otherAttributes",
  ] as const;

  // Determine old value for change log
  let oldValue: string | null = null;
  const updates: Record<string, unknown> = {};

  // Check if it's a core field
  if (field && field in product) {
    oldValue = (product as Record<string, unknown>)[field] as string | null;
    updates[field] = value;
  } else {
    // It's a JSONB field — find which blob has it, and update there.
    // Also remove stale copies from ALL other blobs to prevent overwrites during publish.
    const VARIATION_KEYS = new Set([
      "VariationID", "VariationProduct", "VariationThemeName",
      "ChildRelationshipType", "Color", "Size", "Flavor", "Style",
      "Scent", "Material", "Pattern", "Count", "NumberOfItems",
    ]);
    // For variation keys, always write to the variations blob
    const canonicalBlob = VARIATION_KEYS.has(bqName) ? "variations" : null;
    let primaryBlob: string | null = null;

    for (const blobField of jsonbFields) {
      const blob = (product as Record<string, unknown>)[blobField] as Record<string, string> | null;
      if (blob && bqName in blob) {
        // If this key belongs in a canonical blob and this isn't it, treat as stale
        if (canonicalBlob && blobField !== canonicalBlob) {
          const newBlob = { ...blob };
          delete newBlob[bqName];
          updates[blobField] = newBlob;
          if (!primaryBlob) oldValue = blob[bqName] ?? null;
          continue;
        }
        if (!primaryBlob) {
          // First blob with this key — update it here
          primaryBlob = blobField;
          oldValue = blob[bqName] ?? null;
          if (value == null) {
            const newBlob = { ...blob };
            delete newBlob[bqName];
            updates[blobField] = newBlob;
          } else {
            updates[blobField] = { ...blob, [bqName]: value };
          }
        } else {
          // Duplicate key in another blob — remove the stale copy
          const newBlob = { ...blob };
          delete newBlob[bqName];
          updates[blobField] = newBlob;
        }
      }
    }

    // If not found in canonical blob (or any blob), write to the correct one
    if (!primaryBlob && bqName) {
      const targetBlob = canonicalBlob ?? "otherAttributes";
      const current = ((product as Record<string, unknown>)[targetBlob] as Record<string, string>) ?? {};
      if (!oldValue) oldValue = current[bqName] ?? null;
      updates[targetBlob] = { ...current, ...(value != null ? { [bqName]: value } : {}) };
    }
  }

  // Update raw_column_values too
  const rawValues = { ...(product.rawColumnValues ?? {}) };
  if (bqName) {
    if (value != null) {
      rawValues[bqName] = value;
    } else {
      delete rawValues[bqName];
    }
  }

  // Recompute dependent computed fields
  const triggered = getTriggeredComputedFields(bqName, field);
  for (const computedField of triggered) {
    if (computedField === "UUID") {
      const asin = (updates.asin !== undefined ? updates.asin : product.asin) as string | null;
      const sku = (updates.sku !== undefined ? updates.sku : product.sku) as string | null;
      const cid = (updates.clientIdCode !== undefined ? updates.clientIdCode : product.clientIdCode) as string | null;
      const newUUID = computeUUID(asin, sku, cid);
      rawValues["UUID"] = newUUID;
      // Update in any JSONB blob that has UUID
      for (const bf of jsonbFields) {
        const blob = (updates[bf] ?? (product as Record<string, unknown>)[bf]) as Record<string, string> | null;
        if (blob && "UUID" in blob) {
          updates[bf] = { ...blob, UUID: newUUID };
        }
      }
    } else if (computedField === "AmazonPDPURL") {
      const asin = (updates.asin !== undefined ? updates.asin : product.asin) as string | null;
      const newUrl = computeAmazonPdpUrl(asin);
      rawValues["AmazonPDPURL"] = newUrl;
      for (const bf of jsonbFields) {
        const blob = (updates[bf] ?? (product as Record<string, unknown>)[bf]) as Record<string, string> | null;
        if (blob && "AmazonPDPURL" in blob) {
          updates[bf] = { ...blob, AmazonPDPURL: newUrl };
        }
      }
    } else if (computedField === "SummarizedTitle") {
      const r = (k: string) => rawValues[k] ?? null;
      const newTitle = computeSummarizedTitle(r("VariationProduct"), r("Style"), r("Flavor"), r("Color"), r("Size"));
      updates.summarizedTitle = newTitle;
      rawValues["SummarizedTitle"] = newTitle;
    }
  }

  updates.rawColumnValues = rawValues;

  // Append to change log
  const changeLog = [...(product.changeLog ?? [])];
  changeLog.push({
    field: bqName || field,
    oldValue,
    newValue: value,
    changedBy: session.user.email,
    changedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  });

  updates.changeLog = changeLog;
  updates.isDirty = true;
  updates.updatedAt = new Date();

  await db.update(master).set(updates).where(eq(master.id, id));

  // Write to activity log
  await db.insert(activityLog).values({
    productId: id,
    asin: product.asin,
    sku: product.sku,
    clientIdCode: product.clientIdCode,
    itemName: product.itemName,
    fieldLabel: field || bqName,
    bqName,
    oldValue,
    newValue: value,
    changedBy: session.user.email!,
    editType: "single",
  });

  // Revenue attribution: create impact snapshot (fire-and-forget)
  if (product.clientIdCode) {
    createImpactSnapshot({
      clientIdCode: product.clientIdCode,
      productId: id,
      asin: product.asin ?? undefined,
      changeType: "product_edit",
      changeSummary: `${field || bqName}: "${oldValue}" → "${value}"`,
      changeCount: 1,
      changedBy: session.user.email!,
    }).catch(() => {});
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { fieldComments } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and, sql, count } from "drizzle-orm";

export async function GET(
  req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { id } = await params;
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const field = searchParams.get("field");
  const resolvedParam = searchParams.get("resolved");

  const conditions = [eq(fieldComments.productId, id)];
  if (field) {
    conditions.push(eq(fieldComments.bqName, field));
  }
  if (resolvedParam !== null) {
    conditions.push(eq(fieldComments.resolved, resolvedParam === "true"));
  }

  const comments = await db
    .select()
    .from(fieldComments)
    .where(and(...conditions))
    .orderBy(fieldComments.createdAt);

  // Compute counts
  const countRows = await db
    .select({
      total: count(),
      open: count(
        sql`CASE WHEN ${fieldComments.resolved} = false THEN 1 END`
      ),
      resolved: count(
        sql`CASE WHEN ${fieldComments.resolved} = true THEN 1 END`
      ),
    })
    .from(fieldComments)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(fieldComments.productId, id),
        ...(field ? [eq(fieldComments.bqName, field)] : [])
      )
    );

  return NextResponse.json({
    comments,
    counts: countRows[0] ?? { total: 0, open: 0, resolved: 0 },
  });
}

export async function POST(
  req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (session.user.role === "viewer") {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Forbidden: viewers cannot add comments" },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }

  const { id } = await params;
  const { bqName, comment } = (await req.json()) as {
    bqName: string;
    comment: string;
  };

  if (!bqName || !comment?.trim()) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "bqName and comment are required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  const [newComment] = await db
    .insert(fieldComments)
    .values({
      productId: id,
      bqName,
      comment: comment.trim(),
      author: session.user.email!,
      authorName: session.user.name || null,
    })
    .returning();

  return NextResponse.json(newComment, { status: 201 });
}

export async function PUT(
  req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (session.user.role === "viewer") {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Forbidden: viewers cannot modify comments" },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }

  const { id } = await params;
  const { commentId, action, comment } = (await req.json()) as {
    commentId: number;
    action: "resolve" | "reopen" | "edit" | "delete";
    comment?: string;
  };

  if (!commentId || !action) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "commentId and action are required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Fetch existing comment
  const [existing] = await db
    .select()
    .from(fieldComments)
    .where(
      and(eq(fieldComments.id, commentId), eq(fieldComments.productId, id))
    )
    .limit(1);

  if (!existing) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Comment not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  // Edit and delete restricted to author or admin
  if (
    (action === "edit" || action === "delete") &&
    existing.author !== session.user.email &&
    session.user.role !== "admin"
  ) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Only the author or an admin can perform this action" },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }

  if (action === "delete") {
    await db
      .delete(fieldComments)
      .where(eq(fieldComments.id, commentId));
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  }

  const updates: Record<string, unknown> = {
    updatedAt: new Date(),
  };

  if (action === "resolve") {
    updates.resolved = true;
    updates.resolvedBy = session.user.email;
    updates.resolvedAt = new Date();
  } else if (action === "reopen") {
    updates.resolved = false;
    updates.resolvedBy = null;
    updates.resolvedAt = null;
  } else if (action === "edit") {
    if (!comment?.trim()) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "comment is required for edit" },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }
    updates.comment = comment.trim();
  }

  const [updated] = await db
    .update(fieldComments)
    .set(updates)
    .where(eq(fieldComments.id, commentId))
    .returning();

  return NextResponse.json(updated);
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, amazonSnapshots, spApiCredentials } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and, desc, gte } from "drizzle-orm";
import { SPAPIClient } from "@/lib/sp-api/client";
import { normalizeCatalogItem } from "@/lib/sp-api/normalizer";
import { compareProductWithAmazon } from "@/lib/sp-api/comparator";

export async function POST(
  req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }
  if (session.user.role === "viewer") {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Forbidden: viewers cannot run comparisons" },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }

  const { id } = await params;
  const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
  const forceRefresh = body?.forceRefresh === true;

  // Fetch product
  const [product] = await db
    .select()
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.id, id))
    .limit(1);

  if (!product) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Product not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  if (!product.asin) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Product has no ASIN" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  if (!product.clientIdCode) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Product has no client ID code" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Fetch SP-API credentials for this client
  const [creds] = await db
    .select()
    .from(spApiCredentials)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(spApiCredentials.clientIdCode, product.clientIdCode),
        eq(spApiCredentials.isActive, true)
      )
    )
    .limit(1);

  if (!creds) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        error: `No SP-API credentials configured for client ${product.clientIdCode}`,
      },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Check for recent snapshot (within 24 hours)
  if (!forceRefresh) {
    const twentyFourHoursAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const [recentSnapshot] = await db
      .select()
      .from(amazonSnapshots)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(amazonSnapshots.productId, id),
          gte(amazonSnapshots.fetchedAt, twentyFourHoursAgo)
        )
      )
      .orderBy(desc(amazonSnapshots.fetchedAt))
      .limit(1);

    if (recentSnapshot) {
      // Re-run comparison against current Hub data (product may have changed)
      const normalizedData = recentSnapshot.normalizedData as ReturnType<
        typeof normalizeCatalogItem
      >;
      const comparison = compareProductWithAmazon(product, normalizedData);
      return NextResponse.json({ comparison, cached: true });
    }
  }

  // Fetch fresh data from SP-API
  const client = new SPAPIClient({
    clientId: process.env.SP_API_CLIENT_ID!,
    clientSecret: process.env.SP_API_CLIENT_SECRET!,
    refreshToken: creds.refreshToken,
    marketplaceId: creds.marketplaceId,
    sellerId: creds.sellerId,
    region: creds.region as "na" | "eu" | "fe",
  });

  let catalogItem;
  try {
    catalogItem = await client.getCatalogItem(product.asin);
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    if (msg.includes("(404)")) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: `Product not found on Amazon (ASIN: ${product.asin})` },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }
    if (msg.includes("(403)")) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "SP-API access denied — check credentials" },
        { status: 403 }
      );
    }
    throw err;
  }

  // Optionally fetch listing item for keywords (SKU may not exist)
  let listingItem = null;
  if (product.sku) {
    try {
      listingItem = await client.getListingItem(product.sku);
    } catch {
      // SKU may not exist in SP-API — that's fine
    }
  }

  // Normalize and compare
  const normalizedData = normalizeCatalogItem(catalogItem, listingItem);
  const comparison = compareProductWithAmazon(product, normalizedData);

  // Store snapshot
  await db.insert(amazonSnapshots).values({
    productId: id,
    asin: product.asin,
    marketplace: product.marketplace,
    normalizedData,
    comparisonResult: comparison,
    overallMatch: comparison.overallMatch,
    fetchedAt: new Date(),
  });

  return NextResponse.json({ comparison, cached: false });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { amazonSnapshots } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, desc } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { ComparisonResult } from "@/lib/sp-api/comparator";

export async function GET(
  req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { id } = await params;
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const limitParam = parseInt(searchParams.get("limit") ?? "10", 10);
  const limit = Math.min(Math.max(limitParam, 1), 50);

  const snapshots = await db
    .select()
    .from(amazonSnapshots)
    .where(eq(amazonSnapshots.productId, id))
    .orderBy(desc(amazonSnapshots.fetchedAt))
    .limit(limit);

  const history = snapshots.map((s) => {
    const cr = s.comparisonResult as ComparisonResult | null;
    return {
      id: s.id,
      overallMatch: s.overallMatch,
      fetchedAt: s.fetchedAt,
      mismatchedFields: cr?.mismatchedFields ?? 0,
      totalFields: cr?.totalFields ?? 0,
    };
  });

  return NextResponse.json({ history });
}

FILE: src/app/api/products/[id]/family/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, varietyPackItems } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and, or, ne, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

const FAMILY_SELECT = {
  id: master.id,
  asin: master.asin,
  sku: master.sku,
  parentSku: master.parentSku,
  parentAsin: master.parentAsin,
  parentageLevel: master.parentageLevel,
  clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode,
  marketplace: master.marketplace,
  status: master.status,
  brandName: master.brandName,
  itemName: master.itemName,
  summarizedTitle: master.summarizedTitle,
  listPrice: master.listPrice,
  mainImageUrl: master.mainImageUrl,
  isDirty: master.isDirty,
  variations: master.variations,
  variationGroup: master.variationGroup,
  variationRef: master.variationRef,
  varietyPackItemCount: sql<number>`(SELECT count(*)::int FROM ${varietyPackItems} WHERE ${varietyPackItems.packProductId} = "master"."id")`,
} as const;

export async function GET(
  _req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const { id } = await params;

  // Fetch the current product
  const [current] = await db
    .select(FAMILY_SELECT)
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.id, id))
    .limit(1);

  if (!current) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Product not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  const level = current.parentageLevel?.toLowerCase();

  // If no parentage info, return just the product
  if (!level || (level !== "parent" && level !== "child")) {
    return NextResponse.json({
      parent: null,
      children: [],
      currentId: id,
      variationTheme: current.variations?.["VariationThemeName"] ?? null,
    });
  }

  let parent = null;
  let children: (typeof current)[] = [];

  if (level === "parent") {
    parent = current;

    // Find children by parent_sku (Amazon hierarchy)
    const skuChildren = current.sku
      ? await db
          .select(FAMILY_SELECT)
          .from(master)
          .where(
            and(
              eq(master.parentSku, current.sku),
              or(
                eq(master.parentageLevel, "Child"),
                eq(master.parentageLevel, "child")
              ),
              sql`(${master.variations}->>'VariationID' IS NOT NULL AND ${master.variations}->>'VariationID' != '')`
            )
          )
      : [];

    // Also find products linked via variation builder (same variationRef, different product)
    const variationSiblings = current.variationRef
      ? await db
          .select(FAMILY_SELECT)
          .from(master)
          .where(
            and(
              eq(master.variationRef, current.variationRef),
              ne(master.id, current.id)
            )
          )
      : [];

    // Merge and deduplicate by ASIN (prefer copy with VP items, then by id)
    const byAsin = new Map<string, typeof current>();
    for (const c of [...skuChildren, ...variationSiblings]) {
      const key = c.asin || c.id; // fallback to id if no ASIN
      const existing = byAsin.get(key);
      if (!existing || (c.varietyPackItemCount ?? 0) > (existing.varietyPackItemCount ?? 0)) {
        byAsin.set(key, c);
      }
    }
    children = [...byAsin.values()];
  } else if (level === "child" && current.parentSku) {
    // Current product is a child — find parent by SKU, then find siblings
    const [parentProduct] = await db
      .select(FAMILY_SELECT)
      .from(master)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(master.sku, current.parentSku),
          eq(master.parentageLevel, "Parent")
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    parent = parentProduct ?? null;

    // Find all children (siblings) with same parent_sku
    // Exclude orphaned children (variation ID removed)
    // Deduplicate by ASIN (prefer copy with VP items)
    const rawChildren = await db
      .select(FAMILY_SELECT)
      .from(master)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(master.parentSku, current.parentSku),
          or(
            eq(master.parentageLevel, "Child"),
            eq(master.parentageLevel, "child")
          ),
          sql`(${master.variations}->>'VariationID' IS NOT NULL AND ${master.variations}->>'VariationID' != '')`
        )
      );
    const byAsinChild = new Map<string, typeof current>();
    for (const c of rawChildren) {
      const key = c.asin || c.id;
      const existing = byAsinChild.get(key);
      if (!existing || (c.varietyPackItemCount ?? 0) > (existing.varietyPackItemCount ?? 0)) {
        byAsinChild.set(key, c);
      }
    }
    children = [...byAsinChild.values()];
  }

  // Fetch VP included flavors for children that are variety packs
  const vpChildren = children.filter((c) => (c.varietyPackItemCount ?? 0) > 0);
  const vpFlavorsMap: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  if (vpChildren.length > 0) {
    for (const vp of vpChildren) {
      const items = await db
        .select({ flavor: varietyPackItems.flavor, units: varietyPackItems.units })
        .from(varietyPackItems)
        .where(eq(varietyPackItems.packProductId, vp.id));
      vpFlavorsMap[vp.id] = items
        .filter((it) => it.flavor)
        .map((it) => (it.units > 1 ? `${it.units}× ${it.flavor}` : it.flavor!));
    }
  }

  // Attach vpFlavors to children
  const enrichedChildren = children.map((c) => ({
    ...c,
    vpFlavors: vpFlavorsMap[c.id] ?? null,
  }));

  return NextResponse.json({
    parent,
    children: enrichedChildren,
    currentId: id,
    variationTheme: parent?.variations?.["VariationThemeName"] ??
      current.variations?.["VariationThemeName"] ?? null,
  });
}

FILE: src/app/api/products/[id]/impact/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { contentImpactSnapshots } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, desc } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";

export async function GET(
  _req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const role = session.user.role;
  const canProducts = canAccessSection(session, "products");
  const isClient = role === "client";

  if (!canProducts && !isClient) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { id: productId } = await params;

  // Fetch recent impact snapshots for this product
  const snapshots = await db
    .select()
    .from(contentImpactSnapshots)
    .where(eq(contentImpactSnapshots.productId, productId))
    .orderBy(desc(contentImpactSnapshots.changedAt));

  // If client, verify ownership
  if (isClient) {
    const clientCode = session.user.clientIdCode;
    if (!clientCode) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
    }
    const hasOwnership = snapshots.length === 0 || snapshots[0].clientIdCode === clientCode;
    if (!hasOwnership) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
    }
  }

  if (snapshots.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({
      status: "no_baseline",
      snapshots: [],
    });
  }

  const latest = snapshots[0];

  // Compute deltas if both before and after metrics are available
  const computeDelta = (key: string) => {
    const before = latest.beforeMetrics?.[key] ?? null;
    const after = latest.afterMetrics?.[key] ?? null;
    if (before === null || after === null) return null;
    if (before === 0) return { absolute: after, percentage: null };
    const pct = Math.round(((after - before) / before) * 100);
    return { absolute: after - before, percentage: pct };
  };

  return NextResponse.json({
    status: latest.status,
    before: latest.beforeMetrics,
    after: latest.afterMetrics,
    delta: latest.afterMetrics
      ? {
          units: computeDelta("avgDailyUnits"),
          revenue: computeDelta("avgDailyRevenue"),
          sessions: computeDelta("avgDailySessions"),
        }
      : null,
    changedAt: latest.changedAt,
    changeSummary: latest.changeSummary,
    impactWindowDays: latest.impactWindowDays,
    snapshots: snapshots.map((s) => ({
      id: s.id,
      changeType: s.changeType,
      changeSummary: s.changeSummary,
      status: s.status,
      changedAt: s.changedAt,
    })),
  });
}

FILE: src/app/api/products/[id]/revert/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, activityLog } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { CORE_COLUMNS } from "@/lib/column-registry";

const JSONB_FIELDS = [
  "contentSeo", "variations", "packaging", "targetAudience",
  "fulfillment", "productAttributes", "nutritionSupplements",
  "complianceSafety", "images", "dimensionsWeight", "otherAttributes",
] as const;

const coreByBqName = new Map(
  CORE_COLUMNS.filter((c) => c.coreField).map((c) => [c.bqName, c.coreField!])
);

/**
 * POST /api/products/[id]/revert
 * Reverts all unpublished changes by walking the changeLog in reverse
 * and restoring the original (oldest) value for each changed field.
 */
export async function POST(
  _req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  if (session.user.role === "viewer") {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Forbidden: viewers cannot revert" },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }

  const { id } = await params;

  const [product] = await db
    .select()
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.id, id))
    .limit(1);

  if (!product) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Product not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  if (!product.isDirty) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "No changes to revert" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const changeLog = product.changeLog ?? [];
  if (changeLog.length === 0) {
    // No changelog but dirty — just clear the flag
    await db
      .update(master)
      .set({ isDirty: false, updatedAt: new Date() })
      .where(eq(master.id, id));
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, reverted: 0 });
  }

  // Build map: field → original value (the oldValue from the FIRST change to that field)
  const originalValues = new Map<string, string | null>();
  for (const entry of changeLog) {
    if (!originalValues.has(entry.field)) {
      originalValues.set(entry.field, entry.oldValue);
    }
  }

  // Apply reversions
  const updates: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  const rawValues = { ...(product.rawColumnValues ?? {}) };

  for (const [bqName, originalValue] of originalValues) {
    const coreField = coreByBqName.get(bqName);

    if (coreField) {
      updates[coreField] = originalValue;
    } else {
      // JSONB field — find and update with dedup
      let found = false;
      for (const blobField of JSONB_FIELDS) {
        const blob = (updates[blobField] ??
          (product as Record<string, unknown>)[blobField]) as Record<string, string> | null;

        if (blob && bqName in blob) {
          if (!found) {
            found = true;
            if (originalValue != null) {
              updates[blobField] = { ...blob, [bqName]: originalValue };
            } else {
              const cleaned = { ...blob };
              delete cleaned[bqName];
              updates[blobField] = cleaned;
            }
          } else {
            const cleaned = { ...blob };
            delete cleaned[bqName];
            updates[blobField] = cleaned;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Update raw values
    if (originalValue != null) {
      rawValues[bqName] = originalValue;
    } else {
      delete rawValues[bqName];
    }
  }

  updates.rawColumnValues = rawValues;
  updates.changeLog = [];
  updates.isDirty = false;
  updates.updatedAt = new Date();

  await db.update(master).set(updates).where(eq(master.id, id));

  // Log the revert action
  await db.insert(activityLog).values({
    productId: id,
    asin: product.asin,
    sku: product.sku,
    clientIdCode: product.clientIdCode,
    itemName: product.itemName,
    fieldLabel: "Revert all changes",
    bqName: "_revert",
    oldValue: `${originalValues.size} fields`,
    newValue: null,
    changedBy: session.user.email!,
    editType: "single",
  });

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true, reverted: originalValues.size });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, activityLog } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { CORE_COLUMNS } from "@/lib/column-registry";

const JSONB_FIELDS = [
  "contentSeo", "variations", "packaging", "targetAudience",
  "fulfillment", "productAttributes", "nutritionSupplements",
  "complianceSafety", "images", "dimensionsWeight", "otherAttributes",
] as const;

const coreByBqName = new Map(
  CORE_COLUMNS.filter((c) => c.coreField).map((c) => [c.bqName, c.coreField!])
);

/**
 * POST /api/products/[id]/revert-field
 * Reverts a single field to its original value (before any edits).
 * Body: { bqName: string }
 */
export async function POST(
  req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  if (session.user.role === "viewer") {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const { id } = await params;
  const { bqName } = (await req.json()) as { bqName: string };

  if (!bqName) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "bqName is required" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const [product] = await db
    .select()
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.id, id))
    .limit(1);

  if (!product) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Product not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  const changeLog = product.changeLog ?? [];

  // Find the original value — the oldValue from the FIRST change to this field
  const firstEntry = changeLog.find((e) => e.field === bqName);
  if (!firstEntry) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "No changes found for this field" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const originalValue = firstEntry.oldValue;

  // Apply the original value back
  const updates: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  const rawValues = { ...(product.rawColumnValues ?? {}) };
  const coreField = coreByBqName.get(bqName);

  if (coreField) {
    updates[coreField] = originalValue;
  } else {
    let found = false;
    for (const blobField of JSONB_FIELDS) {
      const blob = (updates[blobField] ??
        (product as Record<string, unknown>)[blobField]) as Record<string, string> | null;

      if (blob && bqName in blob) {
        if (!found) {
          found = true;
          if (originalValue != null) {
            updates[blobField] = { ...blob, [bqName]: originalValue };
          } else {
            const cleaned = { ...blob };
            delete cleaned[bqName];
            updates[blobField] = cleaned;
          }
        } else {
          const cleaned = { ...blob };
          delete cleaned[bqName];
          updates[blobField] = cleaned;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  if (originalValue != null) {
    rawValues[bqName] = originalValue;
  } else {
    delete rawValues[bqName];
  }

  // Remove all changeLog entries for this field
  const newChangeLog = changeLog.filter((e) => e.field !== bqName);

  updates.rawColumnValues = rawValues;
  updates.changeLog = newChangeLog;
  updates.isDirty = newChangeLog.length > 0;
  updates.updatedAt = new Date();

  await db.update(master).set(updates).where(eq(master.id, id));

  // Activity log
  await db.insert(activityLog).values({
    productId: id,
    asin: product.asin,
    sku: product.sku,
    clientIdCode: product.clientIdCode,
    itemName: product.itemName,
    fieldLabel: `Reverted ${bqName}`,
    bqName,
    oldValue: null,
    newValue: originalValue,
    changedBy: session.user.email!,
    editType: "single",
  });

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and, ne } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { VariationData } from "@/lib/db/schema";

type Params = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// GET /api/products/[id]/siblings — products sharing the same parentAsin
export async function GET(_req: NextRequest, { params }: Params) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id } = await params;

  // Find the product's parentAsin
  const [product] = await db
    .select({ parentAsin: master.parentAsin })
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.id, id))
    .limit(1);

  if (!product?.parentAsin) return NextResponse.json([]);

  // Fetch all children of the same parent (excluding self)
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      id: master.id,
      asin: master.asin,
      sku: master.sku,
      itemName: master.itemName,
      summarizedTitle: master.summarizedTitle,
      mainImageUrl: master.mainImageUrl,
      variations: master.variations,
    })
    .from(master)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(master.parentAsin, product.parentAsin),
        ne(master.id, id),
        ne(master.parentageLevel, "Parent")
      )
    )
    .orderBy(master.asin)
    .limit(100);

  // Extract flavor/size/color/style from variations JSONB
  const siblings = rows.map((r) => {
    const v = (r.variations as VariationData) || {};
    return {
      id: r.id,
      asin: r.asin,
      sku: r.sku,
      itemName: r.itemName,
      summarizedTitle: r.summarizedTitle,
      mainImageUrl: r.mainImageUrl,
      flavor: v.Flavor || null,
      size: v.Size || null,
      color: v.Color || null,
      style: v.Style || null,
    };
  });

  return NextResponse.json(siblings);
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { varietyPackItems, master } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";

type Params = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// GET /api/products/[id]/variety-pack — get pack composition
export async function GET(_req: NextRequest, { params }: Params) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id } = await params;

  const items = await db
    .select({
      id: varietyPackItems.id,
      packProductId: varietyPackItems.packProductId,
      includedProductId: varietyPackItems.includedProductId,
      flavor: varietyPackItems.flavor,
      size: varietyPackItems.size,
      color: varietyPackItems.color,
      style: varietyPackItems.style,
      customLabel: varietyPackItems.customLabel,
      units: varietyPackItems.units,
      sortOrder: varietyPackItems.sortOrder,
      // Joined included product info
      includedAsin: master.asin,
      includedSku: master.sku,
      includedTitle: master.itemName,
      includedImage: master.mainImageUrl,
    })
    .from(varietyPackItems)
    .leftJoin(master, eq(varietyPackItems.includedProductId, master.id))
    .where(eq(varietyPackItems.packProductId, id))
    .orderBy(varietyPackItems.sortOrder);

  return NextResponse.json(items);
}

// PUT /api/products/[id]/variety-pack — replace entire pack composition
export async function PUT(req: NextRequest, { params }: Params) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id } = await params;
  const body = await req.json();
  const { items } = body as {
    items: Array<{
      includedProductId?: string | null;
      flavor?: string;
      size?: string;
      color?: string;
      style?: string;
      customLabel?: string;
      units?: number;
    }>;
  };

  if (!Array.isArray(items))
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "items array required" }, { status: 400 });

  await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    // Clear existing
    await tx.delete(varietyPackItems).where(eq(varietyPackItems.packProductId, id));

    // Insert new
    if (items.length > 0) {
      await tx.insert(varietyPackItems).values(
        items.map((item, i) => ({
          packProductId: id,
          includedProductId: item.includedProductId || null,
          flavor: item.flavor || null,
          size: item.size || null,
          color: item.color || null,
          style: item.style || null,
          customLabel: item.customLabel || null,
          units: item.units ?? 1,
          sortOrder: i,
        }))
      );
    }
  });

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, count: items.length });
}

// DELETE /api/products/[id]/variety-pack — remove all pack items
export async function DELETE(_req: NextRequest, { params }: Params) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id } = await params;
  await db.delete(varietyPackItems).where(eq(varietyPackItems.packProductId, id));
  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
}

FILE: src/app/api/products/bulk/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, activityLog } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { createImpactSnapshot } from "@/lib/impact-snapshots";
import { inArray, eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { z } from "zod";

const bulkEditSchema = z.object({
  productIds: z.array(z.string().uuid()).min(1).max(200),
  field: z.string().min(1),
  bqName: z.string().min(1),
  value: z.string(),
});

const JSONB_FIELDS = [
  "contentSeo",
  "variations",
  "packaging",
  "targetAudience",
  "fulfillment",
  "productAttributes",
  "nutritionSupplements",
  "complianceSafety",
  "images",
  "dimensionsWeight",
  "otherAttributes",
] as const;

export async function PUT(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  if (session.user.role === "viewer") {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Forbidden: viewers cannot edit" },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }

  let body: z.infer<typeof bulkEditSchema>;
  try {
    const raw = await req.json();
    body = bulkEditSchema.parse(raw);
  } catch (e) {
    const message =
      e instanceof z.ZodError
        ? e.issues.map((i) => i.message).join(", ")
        : "Invalid request body";
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const { productIds, field, bqName, value } = body;

  // Fetch all target products
  const targetProducts = await db
    .select()
    .from(master)
    .where(inArray(master.id, productIds));

  if (targetProducts.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "No products found for the given IDs" },
      { status: 404 }
    );
  }

  let updated = 0;
  let failed = 0;
  const errors: string[] = [];
  const now = new Date();
  const changedAt = now.toISOString();
  const activityRows: Array<{
    productId: string;
    asin: string | null;
    sku: string | null;
    clientIdCode: string | null;
    itemName: string | null;
    fieldLabel: string;
    bqName: string;
    oldValue: string | null;
    newValue: string;
    changedBy: string;
    editType: string;
  }> = [];

  try {
    await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      for (const product of targetProducts) {
        try {
          let oldValue: string | null = null;
          const updates: Record<string, unknown> = {};

          // Check if it's a core field
          if (field && field in product) {
            oldValue = (product as Record<string, unknown>)[
              field
            ] as string | null;
            updates[field] = value;
          } else {
            // JSONB field — find which blob has it, dedup across all blobs
            let primaryBlob: string | null = null;

            for (const blobField of JSONB_FIELDS) {
              const blob = (product as Record<string, unknown>)[
                blobField
              ] as Record<string, string> | null;
              if (blob && bqName in blob) {
                if (!primaryBlob) {
                  primaryBlob = blobField;
                  oldValue = blob[bqName] ?? null;
                  updates[blobField] = { ...blob, [bqName]: value };
                } else {
                  // Duplicate key in another blob — remove the stale copy
                  const newBlob = { ...blob };
                  delete newBlob[bqName];
                  updates[blobField] = newBlob;
                }
              }
            }

            // If not found in any blob, add to otherAttributes
            if (!primaryBlob) {
              const current =
                (product.otherAttributes as Record<string, string>) ?? {};
              oldValue = current[bqName] ?? null;
              updates.otherAttributes = { ...current, [bqName]: value };
            }
          }

          // Update rawColumnValues
          const rawValues = { ...(product.rawColumnValues ?? {}) };
          rawValues[bqName] = value;
          updates.rawColumnValues = rawValues;

          // Append to changeLog
          const changeLog = [...(product.changeLog ?? [])];
          changeLog.push({
            field: bqName || field,
            oldValue,
            newValue: value,
            changedBy: session.user.email!,
            changedAt,
          });

          updates.changeLog = changeLog;
          updates.isDirty = true;
          updates.updatedAt = now;

          await tx
            .update(master)
            .set(updates)
            .where(eq(master.id, product.id));

          activityRows.push({
            productId: product.id,
            asin: product.asin,
            sku: product.sku,
            clientIdCode: product.clientIdCode,
            itemName: product.itemName,
            fieldLabel: field,
            bqName,
            oldValue,
            newValue: value,
            changedBy: session.user.email!,
            editType: "bulk",
          });
          updated++;
        } catch (err) {
          failed++;
          const msg =
            err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unknown error";
          errors.push(
            `Product ${product.asin || product.id}: ${msg}`
          );
        }
      }
      // Batch insert activity log entries inside the transaction
      if (activityRows.length > 0) {
        await tx.insert(activityLog).values(activityRows);
      }
    });
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Transaction failed";
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `Bulk edit failed: ${msg}` },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }

  // Revenue attribution: create one snapshot per client affected (fire-and-forget)
  const clientCodes = [...new Set(
    targetProducts.map((p) => p.clientIdCode).filter(Boolean) as string[]
  )];
  for (const code of clientCodes) {
    const count = targetProducts.filter((p) => p.clientIdCode === code).length;
    createImpactSnapshot({
      clientIdCode: code,
      changeType: "bulk_edit",
      changeSummary: `Bulk edit: ${field} on ${count} product(s)`,
      changeCount: count,
      changedBy: session.user.email!,
    }).catch(() => {});
  }

  return NextResponse.json({ updated, failed, errors });
}

FILE: src/app/api/products/completeness/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, columnAttributes } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, inArray } from "drizzle-orm";
import {
  calculateCompleteness,
  getScoreBucket,
} from "@/lib/completeness";

import type { ColumnAttribute } from "@/lib/db/schema";

// In-memory cache for column attributes (5 minute TTL)
let cachedAttrs: ColumnAttribute[] | null = null;
let cacheTime = 0;
const CACHE_TTL = 5 * 60 * 1000;

async function getCachedAttributes(): Promise<ColumnAttribute[]> {
  if (cachedAttrs && Date.now() - cacheTime < CACHE_TTL) {
    return cachedAttrs;
  }
  const attrs = await db.select().from(columnAttributes);
  cachedAttrs = attrs;
  cacheTime = Date.now();
  return attrs;
}

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const params = req.nextUrl.searchParams;
  const client = params.get("client");
  const productIdsParam = params.get("productIds");
  const summaryOnly = params.get("summary") === "true";

  if (!client) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "client parameter is required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Fetch attributes (cached)
  const attrs = await getCachedAttributes();

  // Pre-filter to only attributes relevant for this client
  const relevantAttrs = attrs.filter((a) => {
    const reqs = a.clientRequirements as Record<string, string> | null;
    const level = reqs?.[client];
    return (
      level &&
      level !== "Not Required" &&
      level !== "Optional"
    );
  });

  // Fetch products
  let productList;
  if (productIdsParam) {
    const ids = productIdsParam.split(",").filter(Boolean);
    if (ids.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ scores: [], summary: null });
    }
    productList = await db
      .select()
      .from(master)
      .where(inArray(master.id, ids));
  } else {
    productList = await db
      .select()
      .from(master)
      .where(eq(master.clientIdCode, client));
  }

  // Calculate scores
  const scores = productList.map((product) => {
    const result = calculateCompleteness(product, relevantAttrs, client);
    return {
      productId: product.id,
      asin: product.asin,
      sku: product.sku,
      itemName: product.itemName,
      score: result.score,
      totalRequired: result.totalRequired,
      filledRequired: result.filledRequired,
      missingRequired: result.missingRequired,
      missingConditionallyRequired: result.missingConditionallyRequired,
    };
  });

  // Build summary
  const totalProducts = scores.length;
  const averageScore =
    totalProducts > 0
      ? Math.round(
          scores.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.score, 0) / totalProducts
        )
      : 0;

  const distribution = { ready: 0, good: 0, incomplete: 0, poor: 0 };
  for (const s of scores) {
    distribution[getScoreBucket(s.score)]++;
  }

  const summary = { totalProducts, averageScore, distribution };

  if (summaryOnly) {
    return NextResponse.json({ summary });
  }

  return NextResponse.json(
    { scores, summary },
    {
      headers: {
        "Cache-Control": "private, max-age=60",
      },
    }
  );
}

FILE: src/app/api/products/completeness/batch/route.ts
================================================
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, columnAttributes } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { and, isNotNull, ne, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { calculateCompleteness, getScoreBucket } from "@/lib/completeness";
import type { ColumnAttribute, Product } from "@/lib/db/schema";

export const maxDuration = 60;

// In-memory cache for batch results (5 minute TTL)
let batchCache: {
  data: Record<
    string,
    {
      averageScore: number;
      distribution: { ready: number; good: number; incomplete: number; poor: number };
    }
  >;
  time: number;
} | null = null;
const CACHE_TTL = 5 * 60 * 1000;

export async function GET() {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  // Return cached data if fresh
  if (batchCache && Date.now() - batchCache.time < CACHE_TTL) {
    return NextResponse.json(batchCache.data, {
      headers: { "Cache-Control": "private, max-age=60" },
    });
  }

  try {

  // Fetch all attributes
  const attrs = await db.select().from(columnAttributes);

  // Get distinct client codes first (lightweight query)
  const clientRows = await db
    .selectDistinct({ clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode })
    .from(master)
    .where(
      and(
        isNotNull(master.clientIdCode),
        ne(master.clientIdCode, "")
      )
    );

  const result: Record<
    string,
    {
      averageScore: number;
      distribution: { ready: number; good: number; incomplete: number; poor: number };
    }
  > = {};

  // Process each client separately to avoid one massive query holding a connection for 60s
  for (const row of clientRows) {
    const clientCode = row.clientIdCode!;

    const relevantAttrs = attrs.filter((a: ColumnAttribute) => {
      const reqs = a.clientRequirements as Record<string, string> | null;
      const level = reqs?.[clientCode];
      return level && level !== "Not Required" && level !== "Optional";
    });

    // Fetch products for this client only
    const clientProducts = await db
      .select()
      .from(master)
      .where(sql`${master.clientIdCode} = ${clientCode}`);

    if (relevantAttrs.length === 0) {
      result[clientCode] = {
        averageScore: 100,
        distribution: { ready: clientProducts.length, good: 0, incomplete: 0, poor: 0 },
      };
      continue;
    }

    const distribution = { ready: 0, good: 0, incomplete: 0, poor: 0 };
    let totalScore = 0;

    for (const product of clientProducts) {
      const score = calculateCompleteness(product, relevantAttrs, clientCode);
      totalScore += score.score;
      distribution[getScoreBucket(score.score)]++;
    }

    result[clientCode] = {
      averageScore:
        clientProducts.length > 0
          ? Math.round(totalScore / clientProducts.length)
          : 0,
      distribution,
    };
  }

  // Cache the result
  batchCache = { data: result, time: Date.now() };

  return NextResponse.json(result, {
    headers: { "Cache-Control": "private, max-age=60" },
  });

  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[completeness/batch] Error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({}, { status: 200 });
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { inArray } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";

/**
 * PATCH /api/products/variation-groups
 * Bulk assign variation_group to master rows.
 * Body: { product_ids: string[], variation_group: string | null }
 */
export async function PATCH(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const session = await getAuthSession();
    if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

    const body = await request.json();
    const { product_ids, variation_group } = body as {
      product_ids: string[];
      variation_group: string | null;
    };

    if (!product_ids || !Array.isArray(product_ids) || product_ids.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "product_ids is required" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const updated = await db
      .update(master)
      .set({ variationGroup: variation_group || null })
      .where(inArray(master.id, product_ids))
      .returning({ id: master.id });

    return NextResponse.json({ updated: updated.length });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unknown error";
    console.error("Variation groups PATCH error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: src/app/api/products/variety-pack-batch/route.ts

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, varietyPackItems } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, inArray } from "drizzle-orm";

// POST /api/products/variety-pack-batch — get variety pack items for multiple ASINs
export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const { asins } = (await req.json()) as { asins: string[] };
  if (!Array.isArray(asins) || asins.length === 0)
    return NextResponse.json({});

  // Find product IDs for these ASINs
  const products = await db
    .select({ id: master.id, asin: master.asin })
    .from(master)
    .where(inArray(master.asin, asins));

  if (products.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({});

  const productIds = products.map((p) => p.id);
  const asinById = new Map(products.map((p) => [p.id, p.asin]));

  // Fetch all variety pack items for these products
  const items = await db
    .select({
      id: varietyPackItems.id,
      packProductId: varietyPackItems.packProductId,
      includedProductId: varietyPackItems.includedProductId,
      flavor: varietyPackItems.flavor,
      size: varietyPackItems.size,
      color: varietyPackItems.color,
      style: varietyPackItems.style,
      customLabel: varietyPackItems.customLabel,
      units: varietyPackItems.units,
      sortOrder: varietyPackItems.sortOrder,
      // Joined included product info
      includedAsin: master.asin,
      includedTitle: master.itemName,
    })
    .from(varietyPackItems)
    .leftJoin(master, eq(varietyPackItems.includedProductId, master.id))
    .where(inArray(varietyPackItems.packProductId, productIds))
    .orderBy(varietyPackItems.sortOrder);

  // Group by ASIN
  const result: Record<string, typeof items> = {};
  for (const item of items) {
    const asin = asinById.get(item.packProductId);
    if (asin) {
      if (!result[asin]) result[asin] = [];
      result[asin].push(item);
    }
  }

  return NextResponse.json(result);
}

FILE: src/app/api/publish/route.ts

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { publishToBigQuery, publishDirtyToBigQuery, getPublishInfo } from "@/lib/bigquery";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { publishHistory, master } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";

export const maxDuration = 60;

export async function GET() {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  if (!canAccessSection(session, "publish")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden: admin only" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const info = await getPublishInfo();
  return NextResponse.json(info);
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  if (!canAccessSection(session, "publish")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden: admin only" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  try {
    // Parse optional mode from request body (default: incremental)
    let mode: "incremental" | "full" = "incremental";
    try {
      const body = await req.json();
      if (body?.mode === "full") mode = "full";
    } catch {
      // No body or invalid JSON — use default
    }

    // Read dirty products with changeLogs before publish (they'll be reset after)
    const dirtyRows = await db
      .select({
        id: master.id,
        asin: master.asin,
        sku: master.sku,
        changeLog: master.changeLog,
      })
      .from(master)
      .where(eq(master.isDirty, true));
    const dirtyCount = dirtyRows.length;

    // Snapshot changes for history
    const changesSnapshot = dirtyRows.map((p) => ({
      asin: p.asin,
      sku: p.sku,
      edits: (p.changeLog ?? []).map((e) => ({
        field: e.field,
        oldValue: e.oldValue,
        newValue: e.newValue,
      })),
    }));

    // Publish
    const result =
      mode === "full"
        ? await publishToBigQuery()
        : await publishDirtyToBigQuery();

    // Clear changeLogs on published products
    if (dirtyRows.length > 0) {
      const dirtyIds = dirtyRows.map((p) => p.id);
      for (const id of dirtyIds) {
        await db
          .update(master)
          .set({ changeLog: [] })
          .where(eq(master.id, id));
      }
    }

    // Log to publish history with snapshotted changes
    try {
      await db.insert(publishHistory).values({
        publishedBy: session.user.email,
        rowsPublished: result.rowsPublished,
        jobId: result.jobId,
        dirtyCount,
        changes: changesSnapshot,
      });
    } catch (historyErr) {
      console.error("Failed to log publish history:", historyErr);
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      ...result,
      mode,
      dirtyCount,
      publishedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      publishedBy: session.user.email,
    });
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error";
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `Publish failed: ${message}` },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { publishHistory } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { desc } from "drizzle-orm";

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  if (!canAccessSection(session, "publish")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden: admin only" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const limitParam = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("limit");
  const limit = Math.min(Math.max(parseInt(limitParam || "50", 10) || 50, 1), 100);

  const entries = await db
    .select()
    .from(publishHistory)
    .orderBy(desc(publishHistory.publishedAt))
    .limit(limit);

  return NextResponse.json(entries);
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { aggregateClientReport } from "@/lib/client-report";
import { generateXlsx } from "@/lib/report-xlsx";
import { generatePdf } from "@/lib/report-pdf";

export const maxDuration = 60;

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session || !canAccessSection(session, "reports")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const params = req.nextUrl.searchParams;
  const client = params.get("client");
  const format = params.get("format") || "xlsx";
  const fromParam = params.get("from");
  const toParam = params.get("to");

  if (!client) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "client parameter is required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  if (format !== "xlsx" && format !== "pdf") {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "format must be xlsx or pdf" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // Default date range: last 30 days
  const to = toParam ? new Date(toParam) : new Date();
  const from = fromParam
    ? new Date(fromParam)
    : new Date(to.getTime() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

  // Aggregate report data
  const reportData = await aggregateClientReport(client, from, to);

  // Generate file
  const dateStamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  if (format === "xlsx") {
    const buffer = generateXlsx(reportData);
    return new NextResponse(new Uint8Array(buffer), {
      headers: {
        "Content-Type":
          "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
        "Content-Disposition": `attachment; filename="${client}_report_${dateStamp}.xlsx"`,
      },
    });
  }

  // PDF
  const buffer = generatePdf(reportData);
  return new NextResponse(new Uint8Array(buffer), {
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/pdf",
      "Content-Disposition": `attachment; filename="${client}_report_${dateStamp}.pdf"`,
    },
  });
}
