import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { aac } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { ilike } from "drizzle-orm";
import { queryRedshift } from "@/lib/redshift";
import { getCachedData, setCachedData, buildSummaryCacheKey } from "@/lib/sales-cache";
import { fillPendingSnapshots } from "@/lib/impact-snapshots";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const RS_SCHEMA = "intentwise_ecommerce_graph";
const RS_TABLE = "account_summary";
const FULL_TABLE = `"${RS_SCHEMA}"."${RS_TABLE}"`;
const SNS_TABLE = `"amazon_source_data"."replenishment_offer_metrics"`;

type TimePeriod = "1D" | "7D" | "1M" | "3M" | "6M" | "1Y";

function formatLocalDate(d: Date): string {
  const y = d.getFullYear();
  const m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${y}-${m}-${day}`;
}

function getISOWeekNumber(d: Date): number {
  const date = new Date(Date.UTC(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate()));
  date.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate() + 4 - (date.getUTCDay() || 7));
  const yearStart = new Date(Date.UTC(date.getUTCFullYear(), 0, 1));
  return Math.ceil(((date.getTime() - yearStart.getTime()) / 86400000 + 1) / 7);
}

function getMondayOfISOWeek(year: number, week: number): Date {
  const jan4 = new Date(year, 0, 4);
  const jan4Day = jan4.getDay() || 7;
  const mondayW1 = new Date(year, 0, 4 - jan4Day + 1);
  const monday = new Date(mondayW1);
  monday.setDate(mondayW1.getDate() + (week - 1) * 7);
  return monday;
}

function getDateRange(period: TimePeriod): { start: string; end: string } {
  const end = new Date();
  const start = new Date();
  switch (period) {
    case "1D": start.setDate(end.getDate() - 1); break;
    case "7D": start.setDate(end.getDate() - 7); break;
    case "1M": start.setMonth(end.getMonth() - 1); break;
    case "3M": start.setMonth(end.getMonth() - 3); break;
    case "6M": start.setMonth(end.getMonth() - 6); break;
    case "1Y": start.setFullYear(end.getFullYear() - 1); break;
  }
  return { start: start.toISOString().slice(0, 10), end: end.toISOString().slice(0, 10) };
}

function getPreviousRange(start: string, end: string): { prevStart: string; prevEnd: string } {
  const s = new Date(start);
  const e = new Date(end);
  const diffMs = e.getTime() - s.getTime();
  const prevEnd = new Date(s.getTime() - 1);
  const prevStart = new Date(prevEnd.getTime() - diffMs);
  return { prevStart: prevStart.toISOString().slice(0, 10), prevEnd: prevEnd.toISOString().slice(0, 10) };
}

function goalSuffix(period: TimePeriod): string {
  switch (period) {
    case "1D": return "1D";
    case "7D": return "1W";
    case "1M": return "1M";
    case "3M": return "3M";
    case "6M": return "6M";
    case "1Y": return "1Y";
  }
}

interface RedshiftRow {
  account_id: number;
  account_name: string;
  ad_impressions: number;
  ad_clicks: number;
  ad_spend: number;
  ad_revenue: number;
  ad_orders: number;
  product_sales: number;
  product_quantity: number;
  shipped_units: number;
  shipped_revenue: number;
  ordered_units: number;
  ordered_revenue: number;
  total_order_items: number;
  mobile_app_sessions: number;
  browser_session: number;
  glance_view_byasin: number;
  // Not available in Redshift yet — default to 0
  ntb_orders: number;
  ntb_revenue: number;
  ntb_ordered_units: number;
  inv_age_0_to_90_days: number;
  inv_age_91_to_180_days: number;
  inv_age_181_to_270_days: number;
  inv_age_271_to_365_days: number;
  inv_age_365_plus_days: number;
  former_active_sns_subscriptions: number;
  new_active_sns_subscriptions: number;
  new_sns_subscriptions_revenue: number;
}

function buildAggQuery(startDate: string, endDate: string, periodLabel: string): string {
  return `
    SELECT
      account_id,
      account_name,
      COALESCE(SUM(ad_impressions), 0) AS ad_impressions,
      COALESCE(SUM(ad_clicks), 0) AS ad_clicks,
      COALESCE(SUM(ad_spend), 0) AS ad_spend,
      COALESCE(SUM(ad_revenue), 0) AS ad_revenue,
      COALESCE(SUM(ad_orders), 0) AS ad_orders,
      COALESCE(SUM(product_sales), 0) AS product_sales,
      COALESCE(SUM(product_quantity), 0) AS product_quantity,
      COALESCE(SUM(shipped_units), 0) AS shipped_units,
      COALESCE(SUM(shipped_revenue), 0) AS shipped_revenue,
      COALESCE(SUM(ordered_units), 0) AS ordered_units,
      COALESCE(SUM(ordered_revenue), 0) AS ordered_revenue,
      COALESCE(SUM(total_order_items), 0) AS total_order_items,
      COALESCE(SUM(mobile_app_sessions), 0) AS mobile_app_sessions,
      COALESCE(SUM(browser_session), 0) AS browser_session,
      COALESCE(SUM(glance_view_byasin), 0) AS glance_view_byasin,
      0 AS ntb_orders,
      0 AS ntb_revenue,
      0 AS ntb_ordered_units,
      0 AS inv_age_0_to_90_days,
      0 AS inv_age_91_to_180_days,
      0 AS inv_age_181_to_270_days,
      0 AS inv_age_271_to_365_days,
      0 AS inv_age_365_plus_days,
      0 AS former_active_sns_subscriptions,
      0 AS new_active_sns_subscriptions,
      0 AS new_sns_subscriptions_revenue,
      '${periodLabel}' AS period_label
    FROM ${FULL_TABLE}
    WHERE report_date >= '${startDate}'::DATE AND report_date <= '${endDate}'::DATE
    GROUP BY account_id, account_name
  `;
}

interface ClientInfo {
  clientIdCode: string;
  clientName: string;
  brandName: string | null;
  tier: string | null;
  marketplace: string | null;
  country: string | null;
  ppcManager: string | null;
  accountManager: string | null;
  accountIds: string[];
  goals: {
    acosGoal: number | null;
    roasGoal: number | null;
    tacosGoal: number | null;
    adSpendBudget: number | null;
    salesForecast: number | null;
    orgRevGoal: number | null;
  };
}

function parseRawData(rawData: unknown): Record<string, string> {
  if (typeof rawData === "string") {
    try { return JSON.parse(rawData); } catch { return {}; }
  }
  if (rawData && typeof rawData === "object") return rawData as Record<string, string>;
  return {};
}

function computeMetrics(m: RedshiftRow) {
  const acos = m.ad_revenue > 0 ? (m.ad_spend / m.ad_revenue) * 100 : null;
  const roas = m.ad_spend > 0 ? m.ad_revenue / m.ad_spend : null;
  const tacos = m.product_sales > 0 ? (m.ad_spend / m.product_sales) * 100 : null;
  const ctr = m.ad_impressions > 0 ? (m.ad_clicks / m.ad_impressions) * 100 : null;
  const totalSessions = m.mobile_app_sessions + m.browser_session;
  const pctOrgRevenue = m.product_sales > 0
    ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, ((m.product_sales - m.ad_revenue) / m.product_sales) * 100)) : null;
  const pctPpcRevenue = m.product_sales > 0
    ? Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (m.ad_revenue / m.product_sales) * 100)) : null;
  const unitSessionPct = totalSessions > 0
    ? (m.product_quantity / totalSessions) * 100 : null;

  return {
    acos, roas, tacos, ctr, totalSessions,
    pctOrgRevenue, pctPpcRevenue, unitSessionPct,
  };
}

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
  // Allow cron refresh via CRON_SECRET bearer token
  const isCronRequest = req.headers.get("x-cron-refresh") === "true";
  const cronSecret = process.env.CRON_SECRET;
  let session: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getAuthSession>> = null;

  if (isCronRequest && cronSecret && req.headers.get("authorization") === `Bearer ${cronSecret}`) {
    // Cron-authenticated — proceed without session
  } else {
    session = await getAuthSession();
    if (!session) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
    }
  }

  const period = (req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("period") || "1M") as TimePeriod;
  const customStart = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("start");
  const customEnd = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("end");

  const refresh = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("refresh") === "true";

  const isCustomRange = customStart && customEnd;
  const { start, end } = isCustomRange
    ? { start: customStart, end: customEnd }
    : getDateRange(period);
  const suffix = goalSuffix(period);

  // Check cache first (unless refresh requested)
  const cacheKey = buildSummaryCacheKey(start, end);
  if (!refresh) {
    try {
      const cached = await getCachedData<Record<string, unknown>>("summary", cacheKey);
      if (cached) {
        // Apply client filtering to cached response
        const clientParam = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("client");
        let clients = cached.clients as Array<{ clientIdCode: string }>;
        if (clientParam) {
          clients = clients.filter((r) => r.clientIdCode === clientParam);
        } else if (session?.user.role === "client" && session?.user.clientIdCode) {
          const allowedCodes = (session.user.clientIdCode as string).split(",").map((s: string) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
          clients = clients.filter((r) => allowedCodes.includes(r.clientIdCode));
        }
        return NextResponse.json({ ...cached, clients, fromCache: true });
      }
    } catch (cacheErr) {
      console.warn("[sales-summary] Cache read failed, falling through to Redshift:", cacheErr instanceof Error ? cacheErr.message : cacheErr);
    }
  }

  const { prevStart, prevEnd } = getPreviousRange(start, end);

  // YoY: same ISO week number in the previous year, Sunday-start
  const startDate = new Date(start + "T00:00:00");
  const mondayOfStart = new Date(startDate);
  mondayOfStart.setDate(startDate.getDate() + 1);
  const isoWeek = getISOWeekNumber(mondayOfStart);
  const prevYear = mondayOfStart.getFullYear() - 1;
  const yoyMonday = getMondayOfISOWeek(prevYear, isoWeek);
  const yoySunday = new Date(yoyMonday);
  yoySunday.setDate(yoyMonday.getDate() - 1);
  const diffDays = Math.round((new Date(end + "T00:00:00").getTime() - startDate.getTime()) / 86400000);
  const yoyEndDate = new Date(yoySunday);
  yoyEndDate.setDate(yoySunday.getDate() + diffDays);
  const yoyStartStr = formatLocalDate(yoySunday);
  const yoyEndStr = formatLocalDate(yoyEndDate);

  // MTD
  const endDate = new Date(end + "T00:00:00");
  const mtdStartStr = `${endDate.getFullYear()}-${String(endDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-01`;
  const mtdEndStr = end;

  // YTD
  const ytdStartStr = `${endDate.getFullYear()}-01-01`;
  const ytdEndStr = end;

  // 1. Get active clients with Intentwise mapping from AAC
  const activeClients = await db
    .select({
      clientIdCode: aac.clientIdCode,
      clientName: aac.clientName,
      rawData: aac.rawData,
    })
    .from(aac)
    .where(ilike(aac.clientStatus, "active"));

  const iwToClient = new Map<string, ClientInfo>();

  for (const c of activeClients) {
    const raw = parseRawData(c.rawData);
    const iwId = raw.IntentwiseID;
    if (!iwId) continue;

    const parseGoal = (key: string): number | null => {
      const val = raw[key];
      if (!val || val === "N/A" || val.includes("#")) return null;
      const num = parseFloat(val.replace("%", "").replace(",", ""));
      return isNaN(num) ? null : num;
    };

    iwToClient.set(iwId, {
      clientIdCode: c.clientIdCode!,
      clientName: c.clientName || c.clientIdCode!,
      brandName: raw.BrandName || null,
      tier: raw.Tier || null,
      marketplace: raw.Marketplace || null,
      country: raw.Country || null,
      ppcManager: raw.PPCManager_1o8M || null,
      accountManager: raw.AccountManager1_1o8M || null,
      accountIds: [iwId],
      goals: {
        acosGoal: parseGoal(`ACOSGoal${suffix}`),
        roasGoal: parseGoal(`ROASGoal${suffix}`),
        tacosGoal: parseGoal(`TACOSGoal${suffix}`),
        adSpendBudget: parseGoal(`ADSpendBudget${suffix}`),
        salesForecast: parseGoal(`SalesForecast${suffix}`),
        orgRevGoal: parseGoal(`PercentageOrgRevGoal${suffix}`),
      },
    });
  }

  // 2. Query all periods in a single Redshift call using UNION ALL
  const combinedSql = `
    ${buildAggQuery(start, end, "current")}
    UNION ALL
    ${buildAggQuery(prevStart, prevEnd, "previous")}
    UNION ALL
    ${buildAggQuery(yoyStartStr, yoyEndStr, "yoy")}
    UNION ALL
    ${buildAggQuery(mtdStartStr, mtdEndStr, "mtd")}
    UNION ALL
    ${buildAggQuery(ytdStartStr, ytdEndStr, "ytd")}
  `;

  // Query latest data date
  const latestDateSql = `
    SELECT MAX(report_date)::TEXT AS latest_date
    FROM ${FULL_TABLE}
    WHERE product_sales IS NOT NULL
  `;

  // Query last table refresh time from Redshift system catalog
  const lastRefreshSql = `
    SELECT COALESCE(
      (SELECT MAX(endtime)::TEXT AS last_refresh
       FROM stl_insert si
       JOIN stv_tbl_perm tp ON si.tbl = tp.id
       WHERE tp.name = '${RS_TABLE}'
       AND tp.slice = 0),
      NULL
    ) AS last_refresh
  `;

  // Query active SNS subscriptions from replenishment_offer_metrics
  // This is a cumulative metric — take the latest snapshot (max end_date) per account per period
  // SNS data is weekly and often lags — get the most recent snapshot up to the period's end date
  function buildSnsSql(endDate: string, periodLabel: string): string {
    return `
      SELECT
        r.account_id::BIGINT AS account_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(r.active_subscriptions::FLOAT), 0)::BIGINT AS active_subscriptions,
        '${periodLabel}' AS period_label
      FROM ${SNS_TABLE} r
      INNER JOIN (
        SELECT account_id, MAX(end_date) AS max_date
        FROM ${SNS_TABLE}
        WHERE end_date::DATE <= '${endDate}'::DATE
        GROUP BY account_id
      ) latest ON r.account_id = latest.account_id AND r.end_date = latest.max_date
      GROUP BY r.account_id
    `;
  }

  const snsSql = `
    ${buildSnsSql(end, "current")}
    UNION ALL
    ${buildSnsSql(prevEnd, "previous")}
    UNION ALL
    ${buildSnsSql(yoyEndStr, "yoy")}
    UNION ALL
    ${buildSnsSql(mtdEndStr, "mtd")}
    UNION ALL
    ${buildSnsSql(ytdEndStr, "ytd")}
  `;

  const [allRows, latestDateResult, refreshResult, snsRows] = await Promise.all([
    queryRedshift<RedshiftRow & { period_label: string }>(combinedSql),
    queryRedshift<{ latest_date: string }>(latestDateSql),
    queryRedshift<{ last_refresh: string | null }>(`${lastRefreshSql}`).catch(() => [{ last_refresh: null }]),
    queryRedshift<{ account_id: number; active_subscriptions: number; period_label: string }>(snsSql).catch(() => []),
  ]);

  const latestDataDate = latestDateResult[0]?.latest_date || null;
  const lastRefreshedAt = refreshResult[0]?.last_refresh || null;

  // Build SNS lookup: Map<"period_label|account_id", active_subscriptions>
  const snsMap = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const row of snsRows) {
    const key = `${row.period_label}|${row.account_id}`;
    snsMap.set(key, Number(row.active_subscriptions) || 0);
  }

  // Inject SNS data into main rows
  for (const row of allRows) {
    const key = `${row.period_label}|${row.account_id}`;
    const sns = snsMap.get(key);
    if (sns != null) {
      (row as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).new_active_sns_subscriptions = sns;
    }
  }

  // 3. Split into periods
  const currentRows = allRows.filter((r) => r.period_label === "current");
  const prevRows = allRows.filter((r) => r.period_label === "previous");
  const yoyRows = allRows.filter((r) => r.period_label === "yoy");
  const mtdRows = allRows.filter((r) => r.period_label === "mtd");
  const ytdRows = allRows.filter((r) => r.period_label === "ytd");

  function toNumber(val: unknown): number {
    if (typeof val === "number") return val;
    if (typeof val === "string") return parseFloat(val) || 0;
    return 0;
  }

  function normalizeRow(row: Record<string, unknown>): RedshiftRow {
    return {
      account_id: toNumber(row.account_id),
      account_name: String(row.account_name || ""),
      ad_impressions: toNumber(row.ad_impressions),
      ad_clicks: toNumber(row.ad_clicks),
      ad_spend: toNumber(row.ad_spend),
      ad_revenue: toNumber(row.ad_revenue),
      ad_orders: toNumber(row.ad_orders),
      product_sales: toNumber(row.product_sales),
      product_quantity: toNumber(row.product_quantity),
      shipped_units: toNumber(row.shipped_units),
      shipped_revenue: toNumber(row.shipped_revenue),
      ordered_units: toNumber(row.ordered_units),
      ordered_revenue: toNumber(row.ordered_revenue),
      total_order_items: toNumber(row.total_order_items),
      mobile_app_sessions: toNumber(row.mobile_app_sessions),
      browser_session: toNumber(row.browser_session),
      glance_view_byasin: toNumber(row.glance_view_byasin),
      ntb_orders: toNumber(row.ntb_orders),
      ntb_revenue: toNumber(row.ntb_revenue),
      ntb_ordered_units: toNumber(row.ntb_ordered_units),
      inv_age_0_to_90_days: toNumber(row.inv_age_0_to_90_days),
      inv_age_91_to_180_days: toNumber(row.inv_age_91_to_180_days),
      inv_age_181_to_270_days: toNumber(row.inv_age_181_to_270_days),
      inv_age_271_to_365_days: toNumber(row.inv_age_271_to_365_days),
      inv_age_365_plus_days: toNumber(row.inv_age_365_plus_days),
      former_active_sns_subscriptions: toNumber(row.former_active_sns_subscriptions),
      new_active_sns_subscriptions: toNumber(row.new_active_sns_subscriptions),
      new_sns_subscriptions_revenue: toNumber(row.new_sns_subscriptions_revenue),
    };
  }

  function mergeRows(rows: (RedshiftRow & { period_label: string })[]): Map<string, RedshiftRow> {
    const map = new Map<string, RedshiftRow>();
    for (const rawRow of rows) {
      const row = normalizeRow(rawRow as unknown as Record<string, unknown>);
      const client = iwToClient.get(String(row.account_id));
      if (!client) continue;
      const existing = map.get(client.clientIdCode);
      if (existing) {
        const keys: (keyof RedshiftRow)[] = [
          "ad_impressions","ad_clicks","ad_spend","ad_revenue","ad_orders",
          "product_sales","product_quantity","shipped_units","shipped_revenue",
          "ordered_units","ordered_revenue","total_order_items",
          "mobile_app_sessions","browser_session","glance_view_byasin",
          "ntb_orders","ntb_revenue","ntb_ordered_units",
          "new_active_sns_subscriptions","new_sns_subscriptions_revenue",
        ];
        for (const k of keys) {
          (existing[k] as number) += row[k] as number;
        }
      } else {
        map.set(client.clientIdCode, row);
      }
    }
    return map;
  }

  const currentMap = mergeRows(currentRows);
  const prevMap = mergeRows(prevRows);
  const yoyMap = mergeRows(yoyRows);
  const mtdMap = mergeRows(mtdRows);
  const ytdMap = mergeRows(ytdRows);

  // 4. Build results
  const results: Array<{
    clientIdCode: string;
    clientName: string;
    brandName: string | null;
    tier: string | null;
    marketplace: string | null;
    ppcManager: string | null;
    accountManager: string | null;
    accountIds: string[];
    goals: ClientInfo["goals"];
    current: RedshiftRow;
    previous: RedshiftRow | null;
    yoy: RedshiftRow | null;
    mtd: RedshiftRow | null;
    ytd: RedshiftRow | null;
    computed: ReturnType<typeof computeMetrics>;
    prevComputed: ReturnType<typeof computeMetrics> | null;
    yoyComputed: ReturnType<typeof computeMetrics> | null;
    mtdComputed: ReturnType<typeof computeMetrics> | null;
    ytdComputed: ReturnType<typeof computeMetrics> | null;
  }> = [];

  for (const [clientId, metrics] of currentMap) {
    const info = [...iwToClient.entries()].find(([, c]) => c.clientIdCode === clientId)![1];
    const prev = prevMap.get(clientId) || null;
    const yoy = yoyMap.get(clientId) || null;
    const mtd = mtdMap.get(clientId) || null;
    const ytd = ytdMap.get(clientId) || null;
    results.push({
      clientIdCode: info.clientIdCode,
      clientName: info.clientName,
      brandName: info.brandName,
      tier: info.tier,
      marketplace: info.marketplace,
      ppcManager: info.ppcManager,
      accountManager: info.accountManager,
      accountIds: info.accountIds,
      goals: info.goals,
      current: metrics,
      previous: prev,
      yoy,
      mtd,
      ytd,
      computed: computeMetrics(metrics),
      prevComputed: prev ? computeMetrics(prev) : null,
      yoyComputed: yoy ? computeMetrics(yoy) : null,
      mtdComputed: mtd ? computeMetrics(mtd) : null,
      ytdComputed: ytd ? computeMetrics(ytd) : null,
    });
  }

  // Sort by tier ascending (nulls last), then by ad_spend descending
  results.sort((a, b) => {
    const tierA = a.tier ? parseInt(a.tier, 10) : 999;
    const tierB = b.tier ? parseInt(b.tier, 10) : 999;
    if (tierA !== tierB) return tierA - tierB;
    return b.current.ad_spend - a.current.ad_spend;
  });

  // Build full response (unfiltered — for caching)
  const fullResponse = {
    period, start, end, prevStart, prevEnd,
    yoyStart: yoyStartStr, yoyEnd: yoyEndStr,
    mtdStart: mtdStartStr, mtdEnd: mtdEndStr,
    ytdStart: ytdStartStr, ytdEnd: ytdEndStr,
    latestDataDate,
    lastRefreshedAt,
    clients: results,
  };

  // Write to cache (fire-and-forget)
  setCachedData("summary", cacheKey, fullResponse).catch((err) =>
    console.error("Failed to write summary cache:", err)
  );

  // Revenue attribution: fill pending impact snapshots per client (fire-and-forget)
  for (const client of results) {
    const m = client.current;
    fillPendingSnapshots(client.clientIdCode, {
      product_sales: m.product_sales,
      ad_spend: m.ad_spend,
      ad_revenue: m.ad_revenue,
      ordered_units: m.ordered_units,
      ordered_revenue: m.ordered_revenue,
      glance_view_byasin: m.glance_view_byasin,
      ad_impressions: m.ad_impressions,
      ad_clicks: m.ad_clicks,
    }).catch(() => {});
  }

  // Filter to specific client if requested or client-role user
  const clientParam = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("client");
  let filteredResults = results;
  if (clientParam) {
    filteredResults = results.filter((r) => r.clientIdCode === clientParam);
  } else if (session?.user.role === "client" && session?.user.clientIdCode) {
    const allowedCodes = session.user.clientIdCode.split(",").map((s: string) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    filteredResults = results.filter((r) => allowedCodes.includes(r.clientIdCode));
  }

  return NextResponse.json({
    ...fullResponse,
    clients: filteredResults,
    fromCache: false,
  });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[sales-summary] Unhandled error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Internal server error" },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { queryRedshift } from "@/lib/redshift";
import { getCachedData, setCachedData, buildDailyCacheKey } from "@/lib/sales-cache";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const RS_SCHEMA = "intentwise_ecommerce_graph";
const RS_TABLE = "account_summary";
const FULL_TABLE = `"${RS_SCHEMA}"."${RS_TABLE}"`;
const SNS_TABLE = `"amazon_source_data"."replenishment_offer_metrics"`;

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  // Allow cron refresh via CRON_SECRET bearer token
  const isCronRequest = req.headers.get("x-cron-refresh") === "true";
  const cronSecret = process.env.CRON_SECRET;

  if (isCronRequest && cronSecret && req.headers.get("authorization") === `Bearer ${cronSecret}`) {
    // Cron-authenticated — proceed without session
  } else {
    const session = await getAuthSession();
    if (!session) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
    }
  }

  const start = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("start");
  const end = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("end");
  const accountIds = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("accountIds");
  const refresh = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("refresh") === "true";

  if (!start || !end || !accountIds) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing start, end, or accountIds" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Check Supabase cache first (unless refresh requested)
  const cacheKey = buildDailyCacheKey(start, end, accountIds);
  if (!refresh) {
    const cached = await getCachedData<{ days: unknown[] }>("daily", cacheKey);
    if (cached) {
      return NextResponse.json(cached);
    }
  }

  const ids = accountIds.split(",").map((id) => id.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  if (ids.some((id) => isNaN(parseInt(id, 10)))) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid accountIds" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  const inClause = ids.map((id) => `${parseInt(id, 10)}::BIGINT`).join(",");

  const sql = `
    SELECT
      TO_CHAR(report_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS report_date,
      COALESCE(SUM(ad_impressions), 0) AS ad_impressions,
      COALESCE(SUM(ad_clicks), 0) AS ad_clicks,
      COALESCE(SUM(ad_spend), 0) AS ad_spend,
      COALESCE(SUM(ad_revenue), 0) AS ad_revenue,
      COALESCE(SUM(ad_orders), 0) AS ad_orders,
      COALESCE(SUM(product_sales), 0) AS product_sales,
      COALESCE(SUM(product_quantity), 0) AS product_quantity,
      COALESCE(SUM(shipped_units), 0) AS shipped_units,
      COALESCE(SUM(shipped_revenue), 0) AS shipped_revenue,
      COALESCE(SUM(ordered_units), 0) AS ordered_units,
      COALESCE(SUM(ordered_revenue), 0) AS ordered_revenue,
      COALESCE(SUM(total_order_items), 0) AS total_order_items,
      COALESCE(SUM(mobile_app_sessions), 0) AS mobile_app_sessions,
      COALESCE(SUM(browser_session), 0) AS browser_session,
      COALESCE(SUM(glance_view_byasin), 0) AS glance_view_byasin,
      0 AS ntb_orders,
      0 AS ntb_revenue,
      0 AS ntb_ordered_units,
      0 AS new_active_sns_subscriptions,
      0 AS new_sns_subscriptions_revenue
    FROM ${FULL_TABLE}
    WHERE report_date >= '${start}'::DATE AND report_date <= '${end}'::DATE
      AND account_id IN (${inClause})
    GROUP BY report_date
    ORDER BY report_date
  `;

  // SNS: cumulative active_subscriptions — weekly data, get latest snapshot up to end of range
  const snsSql = `
    SELECT
      COALESCE(SUM(r.active_subscriptions::FLOAT), 0)::BIGINT AS active_subscriptions
    FROM ${SNS_TABLE} r
    INNER JOIN (
      SELECT account_id, MAX(end_date) AS max_date
      FROM ${SNS_TABLE}
      WHERE end_date::DATE <= '${end}'::DATE
        AND account_id IN (${inClause})
      GROUP BY account_id
    ) latest ON r.account_id = latest.account_id AND r.end_date = latest.max_date
    WHERE r.account_id IN (${inClause})
  `;

  const [rows, snsResult] = await Promise.all([
    queryRedshift<Record<string, unknown>>(sql),
    queryRedshift<{ active_subscriptions: number }>(snsSql).catch(() => [{ active_subscriptions: 0 }]),
  ]);

  // Apply latest SNS value to all daily rows (cumulative metric, not per-day)
  const snsValue = Number(snsResult[0]?.active_subscriptions) || 0;
  for (const row of rows) {
    row.new_active_sns_subscriptions = snsValue;
  }

  const result = { days: rows };

  // Write to Supabase cache (fire-and-forget)
  setCachedData("daily", cacheKey, result).catch(() => {});

  return NextResponse.json(result);
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { queryRedshift } from "@/lib/redshift";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { inArray } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getCachedData, setCachedData, buildInventoryCacheKey } from "@/lib/sales-cache";

export const maxDuration = 120;

const RS_SCHEMA = "amazon_source_data";
const INV_TABLE = `"${RS_SCHEMA}"."sellercentral_fbamanageinventory_report"`;
const RES_TABLE = `"${RS_SCHEMA}"."sellercentral_fbareservedinventory_report"`;
const PROD_TABLE = `"intentwise_ecommerce_graph"."product_summary"`;

const HEALTH_TABLE = `"${RS_SCHEMA}"."sellercentral_fbainventoryhealth_report"`;
const LISTINGS_TABLE = `"${RS_SCHEMA}"."sellercentral_alllistings_report"`;
const IMAGES_TABLE = `"${RS_SCHEMA}"."catalog_item_images"`;

interface AggRow {
  period: string;
  asin: string;
  sku: string;
  product_name: string;
  // Sales metrics (SUMs)
  product_sales: number;
  product_quantity: number;
  ad_impressions: number;
  ad_clicks: number;
  ad_spend: number;
  ad_revenue: number;
  ad_orders: number;
  total_order_items: number;
  browser_session: number;
  mobile_app_session: number;
  // Inventory metrics (latest day snapshot)
  afn_fulfillable_quantity: number;
  afn_inbound_working_quantity: number;
  afn_inbound_shipped_quantity: number;
  afn_inbound_receiving_quantity: number;
  afn_reserved_quantity: number;
  afn_unsellable_quantity: number;
  reserved_customerorders: number;
  reserved_fc_transfers: number;
  reserved_fc_processing: number;
  // Meta
  listing_status: string;
  main_image_link: string;
}

interface HealthRow {
  asin: string;
  sku: string;
  inv_age_0_to_90_days: string | number;
  inv_age_91_to_180_days: string | number;
  inv_age_181_to_270_days: string | number;
  inv_age_271_to_365_days: string | number;
  inv_age_365_plus_days: string | number;
  units_shipped_last_7_days: string | number;
  units_shipped_last_30_days: string | number;
  units_shipped_last_90_days: string | number;
  weeks_of_cover_t30: string | number;
  sales_rank: string | number;
}

const DATE_RE = /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/;

function buildPeriodCTE(
  periodName: string,
  start: string,
  end: string,
  idList: string,
) {
  // For each period, aggregate sales metrics (SUM) and inventory (latest day snapshot)
  return `
  ${periodName}_sales AS (
    SELECT
      '${periodName}' AS period,
      COALESCE(i.asin, '') AS asin,
      COALESCE(i.sku, '') AS sku,
      MAX(COALESCE(i.product_name, '')) AS product_name,
      SUM(COALESCE(p.product_sales, 0)) AS product_sales,
      SUM(COALESCE(p.product_quantity, 0)) AS product_quantity,
      SUM(COALESCE(p.ad_impressions, 0)) AS ad_impressions,
      SUM(COALESCE(p.ad_clicks, 0)) AS ad_clicks,
      SUM(COALESCE(p.ad_spend, 0)) AS ad_spend,
      SUM(COALESCE(p.ad_revenue, 0)) AS ad_revenue,
      SUM(COALESCE(p.ad_orders, 0)) AS ad_orders,
      SUM(COALESCE(p.total_order_items, 0)) AS total_order_items,
      SUM(COALESCE(p.browser_session, 0)) AS browser_session,
      SUM(COALESCE(p.mobile_app_session, 0)) AS mobile_app_session
    FROM ${INV_TABLE} i
    LEFT JOIN ${PROD_TABLE} p
      ON i.account_id = p.account_id AND i.sku = p.sku AND i.report_date = p.report_date
    WHERE i.account_id IN (${idList})
      AND i.report_date >= '${start}'::DATE
      AND i.report_date <= '${end}'::DATE
    GROUP BY i.asin, i.sku
  ),
  ${periodName}_latest_date AS (
    SELECT i.asin, i.sku, MAX(i.report_date) AS max_date
    FROM ${INV_TABLE} i
    WHERE i.account_id IN (${idList})
      AND i.report_date >= '${start}'::DATE
      AND i.report_date <= '${end}'::DATE
    GROUP BY i.asin, i.sku
  ),
  ${periodName}_inv AS (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(i.asin, '') AS asin,
      COALESCE(i.sku, '') AS sku,
      COALESCE(i.afn_fulfillable_quantity, 0) AS afn_fulfillable_quantity,
      COALESCE(i.afn_inbound_working_quantity, 0) AS afn_inbound_working_quantity,
      COALESCE(i.afn_inbound_shipped_quantity, 0) AS afn_inbound_shipped_quantity,
      COALESCE(i.afn_inbound_receiving_quantity, 0) AS afn_inbound_receiving_quantity,
      COALESCE(i.afn_reserved_quantity, 0) AS afn_reserved_quantity,
      COALESCE(i.afn_unsellable_quantity, 0) AS afn_unsellable_quantity,
      COALESCE(r.reserved_customerorders, 0) AS reserved_customerorders,
      COALESCE(r.reserved_fc_transfers, 0) AS reserved_fc_transfers,
      COALESCE(r.reserved_fc_processing, 0) AS reserved_fc_processing,
      COALESCE(l.status, '') AS listing_status,
      COALESCE(img.link, '') AS main_image_link
    FROM ${INV_TABLE} i
    INNER JOIN ${periodName}_latest_date ld
      ON i.asin = ld.asin AND i.sku = ld.sku AND i.report_date = ld.max_date
    LEFT JOIN ${RES_TABLE} r
      ON i.account_id = r.account_id AND i.sku = r.sku AND i.report_date = r.report_date
    LEFT JOIN ${LISTINGS_TABLE} l
      ON i.account_id = l.account_id AND i.sku = l.seller_sku AND i.report_date = l.report_date
    LEFT JOIN ${IMAGES_TABLE} img
      ON i.account_id = img.account_id AND i.asin = img.asin AND img.variant = 'MAIN'
    WHERE i.account_id IN (${idList})
  ),
  ${periodName}_combined AS (
    SELECT
      s.period,
      s.asin,
      s.sku,
      s.product_name,
      s.product_sales,
      s.product_quantity,
      s.ad_impressions,
      s.ad_clicks,
      s.ad_spend,
      s.ad_revenue,
      s.ad_orders,
      s.total_order_items,
      s.browser_session,
      s.mobile_app_session,
      COALESCE(inv.afn_fulfillable_quantity, 0) AS afn_fulfillable_quantity,
      COALESCE(inv.afn_inbound_working_quantity, 0) AS afn_inbound_working_quantity,
      COALESCE(inv.afn_inbound_shipped_quantity, 0) AS afn_inbound_shipped_quantity,
      COALESCE(inv.afn_inbound_receiving_quantity, 0) AS afn_inbound_receiving_quantity,
      COALESCE(inv.afn_reserved_quantity, 0) AS afn_reserved_quantity,
      COALESCE(inv.afn_unsellable_quantity, 0) AS afn_unsellable_quantity,
      COALESCE(inv.reserved_customerorders, 0) AS reserved_customerorders,
      COALESCE(inv.reserved_fc_transfers, 0) AS reserved_fc_transfers,
      COALESCE(inv.reserved_fc_processing, 0) AS reserved_fc_processing,
      COALESCE(inv.listing_status, '') AS listing_status,
      COALESCE(inv.main_image_link, '') AS main_image_link
    FROM ${periodName}_sales s
    LEFT JOIN ${periodName}_inv inv ON s.asin = inv.asin AND s.sku = inv.sku
  )`;
}

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  // Allow cron refresh via CRON_SECRET bearer token
  const isCronRequest = req.headers.get("x-cron-refresh") === "true";
  const cronSecret = process.env.CRON_SECRET;

  if (isCronRequest && cronSecret && req.headers.get("authorization") === `Bearer ${cronSecret}`) {
    // Cron-authenticated — proceed without session
  } else {
    const session = await getAuthSession();
    if (!session) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
    }
  }

  const sp = req.nextUrl.searchParams;
  const start = sp.get("start");
  const end = sp.get("end");
  const accountIds = sp.get("accountIds");
  const prevStart = sp.get("prevStart");
  const prevEnd = sp.get("prevEnd");
  const yoyStart = sp.get("yoyStart");
  const yoyEnd = sp.get("yoyEnd");
  const mtdStart = sp.get("mtdStart");
  const mtdEnd = sp.get("mtdEnd");
  const ytdStart = sp.get("ytdStart");
  const ytdEnd = sp.get("ytdEnd");

  const refresh = sp.get("refresh") === "true";

  if (!start || !end || !accountIds) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing start, end, or accountIds" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const ids = accountIds.split(",").map((id) => id.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  const safeIds = ids.filter((id) => /^\d+$/.test(id));
  if (safeIds.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({ products: [] });
  }

  // Check cache first (unless refresh requested)
  const cacheKey = buildInventoryCacheKey(start, end, accountIds);
  if (!refresh) {
    const cached = await getCachedData<{ products: unknown[] }>("inventory", cacheKey);
    if (cached) {
      return NextResponse.json({ ...cached, fromCache: true });
    }
  }

  // Validate all date params
  const allDates = [start, end, prevStart, prevEnd, yoyStart, yoyEnd, mtdStart, mtdEnd, ytdStart, ytdEnd].filter(Boolean);
  if (allDates.some((d) => !DATE_RE.test(d!))) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid date format" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const idList = safeIds.join(",");

  // Build periods - always include current, conditionally include others
  const periods: { name: string; start: string; end: string }[] = [
    { name: "current", start: start, end: end },
  ];
  if (prevStart && prevEnd) periods.push({ name: "previous", start: prevStart, end: prevEnd });
  if (yoyStart && yoyEnd) periods.push({ name: "yoy", start: yoyStart, end: yoyEnd });
  if (mtdStart && mtdEnd) periods.push({ name: "mtd", start: mtdStart, end: mtdEnd });
  if (ytdStart && ytdEnd) periods.push({ name: "ytd", start: ytdStart, end: ytdEnd });

  // Run each period as a separate sequential query to avoid massive CTE timeouts
  try {
    const rows: AggRow[] = [];
    for (const p of periods) {
      const cte = buildPeriodCTE(p.name, p.start, p.end, idList);
      const sql = `WITH ${cte}\nSELECT * FROM ${p.name}_combined`;
      const periodRows = await queryRedshift<AggRow>(sql);
      rows.push(...periodRows);
    }

    // Fetch inventory health (age buckets) — latest snapshot per ASIN/SKU
    const healthRows = await queryRedshift<HealthRow>(`
      SELECT h.asin, h.sku,
        h.inv_age_0_to_90_days, h.inv_age_91_to_180_days,
        h.inv_age_181_to_270_days, h.inv_age_271_to_365_days,
        h.inv_age_365_plus_days,
        h.units_shipped_last_7_days, h.units_shipped_last_30_days,
        h.units_shipped_last_90_days, h.weeks_of_cover_t30, h.sales_rank
      FROM ${HEALTH_TABLE} h
      INNER JOIN (
        SELECT account_id, asin, sku, MAX(snapshot_date) AS max_date
        FROM ${HEALTH_TABLE}
        WHERE account_id IN (${idList})
        GROUP BY account_id, asin, sku
      ) latest ON h.account_id = latest.account_id
        AND h.asin = latest.asin AND h.sku = latest.sku
        AND h.snapshot_date = latest.max_date
      WHERE h.account_id IN (${idList})
    `);

    const healthMap = new Map<string, HealthRow>();
    for (const h of healthRows) {
      healthMap.set(`${h.asin}|${h.sku}`, h);
    }

    // Collect unique ASINs for PG lookup
    const uniqueAsins = [...new Set(rows.map((r) => r.asin).filter(Boolean))];

    const productMap = new Map<string, { itemName: string; mainImageUrl: string; variationId: string; parentAsin: string; color: string; size: string; flavor: string; style: string }>();
    if (uniqueAsins.length > 0) {
      const productRows = await db
        .select({
          asin: master.asin,
          itemName: master.itemName,
          mainImageUrl: master.mainImageUrl,
          parentAsin: master.parentAsin,
          variations: master.variations,
        })
        .from(master)
        .where(inArray(master.asin, uniqueAsins));

      for (const p of productRows) {
        if (!p.asin) continue;
        const v = p.variations ?? {};
        if (!productMap.has(p.asin)) {
          productMap.set(p.asin, {
            itemName: p.itemName || "",
            mainImageUrl: p.mainImageUrl || "",
            variationId: v.VariationID ?? "",
            parentAsin: p.parentAsin || "",
            color: v.Color ?? "",
            size: v.Size ?? "",
            flavor: v.Flavor ?? "",
            style: v.Style ?? "",
          });
        }
      }
    }

    // Group rows by product, then by period
    type PeriodData = {
      product_sales: number;
      units_sold: number;
      ad_impressions: number;
      ad_clicks: number;
      ad_spend: number;
      ad_revenue: number;
      ad_orders: number;
      total_order_items: number;
      browser_session: number;
      mobile_app_session: number;
      available: number;
      inbound_quantity: number;
      reserved_quantity: number;
      reserved_customerorders: number;
      reserved_fc_transfers: number;
      reserved_fc_processing: number;
      unfulfillable_quantity: number;
    };

    type AgeBuckets = {
      age_0_90: number;
      age_91_180: number;
      age_181_270: number;
      age_271_365: number;
      age_365_plus: number;
      shipped_7d: number;
      shipped_30d: number;
      shipped_90d: number;
      weeks_of_cover: number | null;
      sales_rank: number | null;
    };

    type ProductAgg = {
      asin: string;
      sku: string;
      product_name: string;
      main_image_url: string;
      listing_status: string;
      variation_id: string;
      parent_asin: string;
      color: string;
      size: string;
      flavor: string;
      style: string;
      age: AgeBuckets | null;
      current: PeriodData | null;
      previous: PeriodData | null;
      yoy: PeriodData | null;
      mtd: PeriodData | null;
      ytd: PeriodData | null;
    };

    const productAggs = new Map<string, ProductAgg>();

    for (const r of rows) {
      const key = `${r.asin}|${r.sku}`;
      const prod = productMap.get(r.asin);
      const inbound =
        (Number(r.afn_inbound_working_quantity) || 0) +
        (Number(r.afn_inbound_shipped_quantity) || 0) +
        (Number(r.afn_inbound_receiving_quantity) || 0);

      if (!productAggs.has(key)) {
        const h = healthMap.get(key);
        const ageBuckets: AgeBuckets | null = h
          ? {
              age_0_90: Number(h.inv_age_0_to_90_days) || 0,
              age_91_180: Number(h.inv_age_91_to_180_days) || 0,
              age_181_270: Number(h.inv_age_181_to_270_days) || 0,
              age_271_365: Number(h.inv_age_271_to_365_days) || 0,
              age_365_plus: Number(h.inv_age_365_plus_days) || 0,
              shipped_7d: Number(h.units_shipped_last_7_days) || 0,
              shipped_30d: Number(h.units_shipped_last_30_days) || 0,
              shipped_90d: Number(h.units_shipped_last_90_days) || 0,
              weeks_of_cover: h.weeks_of_cover_t30 ? Number(h.weeks_of_cover_t30) : null,
              sales_rank: h.sales_rank ? Number(h.sales_rank) : null,
            }
          : null;

        productAggs.set(key, {
          asin: r.asin,
          sku: r.sku,
          product_name: prod?.itemName || r.product_name,
          main_image_url: r.main_image_link || prod?.mainImageUrl || "",
          listing_status: r.listing_status || "",
          variation_id: prod?.variationId || "",
          parent_asin: prod?.parentAsin || "",
          color: prod?.color || "",
          size: prod?.size || "",
          flavor: prod?.flavor || "",
          style: prod?.style || "",
          age: ageBuckets,
          current: null,
          previous: null,
          yoy: null,
          mtd: null,
          ytd: null,
        });
      }

      const agg = productAggs.get(key)!;
      // Keep latest listing status from current period
      if (r.period === "current" && r.listing_status) {
        agg.listing_status = r.listing_status;
      }

      const periodData: PeriodData = {
        product_sales: Number(r.product_sales) || 0,
        units_sold: Number(r.product_quantity) || 0,
        ad_impressions: Number(r.ad_impressions) || 0,
        ad_clicks: Number(r.ad_clicks) || 0,
        ad_spend: Number(r.ad_spend) || 0,
        ad_revenue: Number(r.ad_revenue) || 0,
        ad_orders: Number(r.ad_orders) || 0,
        total_order_items: Number(r.total_order_items) || 0,
        browser_session: Number(r.browser_session) || 0,
        mobile_app_session: Number(r.mobile_app_session) || 0,
        available: Number(r.afn_fulfillable_quantity) || 0,
        inbound_quantity: inbound,
        reserved_quantity: Number(r.afn_reserved_quantity) || 0,
        reserved_customerorders: Number(r.reserved_customerorders) || 0,
        reserved_fc_transfers: Number(r.reserved_fc_transfers) || 0,
        reserved_fc_processing: Number(r.reserved_fc_processing) || 0,
        unfulfillable_quantity: Number(r.afn_unsellable_quantity) || 0,
      };

      const period = r.period as keyof Pick<ProductAgg, "current" | "previous" | "yoy" | "mtd" | "ytd">;
      if (period in agg) {
        agg[period] = periodData;
      }
    }

    const response = { products: Array.from(productAggs.values()) };

    // Write to cache (fire-and-forget)
    setCachedData("inventory", cacheKey, response).catch((err) =>
      console.error("Failed to write inventory cache:", err)
    );

    return NextResponse.json({ ...response, fromCache: false });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Inventory query error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to fetch inventory data" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { queryRedshift } from "@/lib/redshift";
import { getCachedData, setCachedData } from "@/lib/sales-cache";

export const maxDuration = 120;

const RS_SCHEMA = "intentwise_ecommerce_graph";
const RS_TABLE = "account_summary";
const FULL_TABLE = `"${RS_SCHEMA}"."${RS_TABLE}"`;

function buildMonthlyCacheKey(accountIds: string): string {
  const sorted = accountIds.split(",").map((s) => s.trim()).sort().join(",");
  return `monthly_${sorted}`;
}

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const accountIds = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("accountIds");
  const refresh = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("refresh") === "true";

  if (!accountIds) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing accountIds" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Check Supabase cache first (unless refresh requested)
  const cacheKey = buildMonthlyCacheKey(accountIds);
  if (!refresh) {
    const cached = await getCachedData<{ months: unknown[] }>("monthly", cacheKey);
    if (cached) {
      return NextResponse.json(cached);
    }
  }

  const ids = accountIds.split(",").map((id) => id.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  if (ids.some((id) => isNaN(parseInt(id, 10)))) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid accountIds" }, { status: 400 });
  }
  const inClause = ids.map((id) => `${parseInt(id, 10)}::BIGINT`).join(",");

  // Start from Jan 1 of the previous year
  const startDate = `${new Date().getFullYear() - 1}-01-01`;

  const sql = `
    SELECT
      TO_CHAR(report_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
      SUM(COALESCE(product_sales, 0)) AS product_sales,
      SUM(COALESCE(ad_spend, 0)) AS ad_spend,
      SUM(COALESCE(ad_revenue, 0)) AS ad_revenue,
      SUM(COALESCE(ad_orders, 0)) AS ad_orders,
      SUM(COALESCE(product_quantity, 0)) AS product_quantity,
      SUM(COALESCE(ordered_revenue, 0)) AS ordered_revenue
    FROM ${FULL_TABLE}
    WHERE account_id IN (${inClause})
      AND report_date >= '${startDate}'::DATE
    GROUP BY 1
    ORDER BY 1
  `;

  const rows = await queryRedshift<Record<string, unknown>>(sql);
  const result = { months: rows };

  // Write to Supabase cache (fire-and-forget)
  setCachedData("monthly", cacheKey, result).catch(() => {});

  return NextResponse.json(result);
}

FILE: src/app/api/sales-summary/sns/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { queryRedshift } from "@/lib/redshift";
import { getCachedData, setCachedData, buildSnsCacheKey } from "@/lib/sales-cache";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const SNS_TABLE = `"amazon_source_data"."replenishment_offer_metrics"`;

/**
 * Returns weekly SNS active_subscriptions as a continuous timeline.
 * Each point has the current value and the value from exactly 1 year prior.
 * Timeline spans from ~Jan of previous year to now.
 */
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  // Allow cron refresh via CRON_SECRET bearer token
  const isCronRequest = req.headers.get("x-cron-refresh") === "true";
  const cronSecret = process.env.CRON_SECRET;

  if (isCronRequest && cronSecret && req.headers.get("authorization") === `Bearer ${cronSecret}`) {
    // Cron-authenticated — proceed without session
  } else {
    const session = await getAuthSession();
    if (!session) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
    }
  }

  const accountIds = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("accountIds");
  const refresh = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("refresh") === "true";

  if (!accountIds) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing accountIds" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  const ids = accountIds.split(",").map((id) => id.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  if (ids.some((id) => isNaN(parseInt(id, 10)))) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid accountIds — must be numeric" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Check Supabase cache first
  const cacheKey = buildSnsCacheKey(accountIds);
  if (!refresh) {
    const cached = await getCachedData<{ timeline: unknown[] }>("sns", cacheKey);
    if (cached) {
      return NextResponse.json(cached);
    }
  }

  const inClause = ids.map((id) => `${parseInt(id, 10)}::BIGINT`).join(",");

  const now = new Date();
  const prevYear = now.getFullYear() - 1;

  // Get all weekly snapshots from 2 years ago to now
  const sql = `
    SELECT
      TO_CHAR(end_date::DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS end_date,
      COALESCE(SUM(active_subscriptions::FLOAT), 0)::BIGINT AS active_subscriptions
    FROM ${SNS_TABLE}
    WHERE account_id IN (${inClause})
      AND end_date::DATE >= '${prevYear - 1}-01-01'::DATE
    GROUP BY end_date::DATE
    ORDER BY end_date::DATE
  `;

  const rows = await queryRedshift<{
    end_date: string;
    active_subscriptions: number;
  }>(sql).catch(() => []);

  // Build a date -> value lookup
  const dateMap = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const row of rows) {
    dateMap.set(row.end_date, Number(row.active_subscriptions));
  }

  // Build timeline: all dates from Jan of prev year to now
  const timelineStart = `${prevYear}-01-01`;
  const allDates = rows
    .map((r) => r.end_date)
    .filter((d) => d >= timelineStart);

  // For a given date, find the closest value in dateMap within ±10 days of target
  const findClosest = (targetDate: string): number | null => {
    const target = new Date(targetDate + "T00:00:00").getTime();
    let best: number | null = null;
    let bestDist = Infinity;
    for (const [d, v] of dateMap) {
      const dist = Math.abs(new Date(d + "T00:00:00").getTime() - target);
      if (dist < bestDist && dist <= 10 * 86400000) {
        bestDist = dist;
        best = v;
      }
    }
    return best;
  };

  const timeline: { date: string; value: number; yearAgo: number | null }[] = [];
  for (const date of allDates) {
    const value = dateMap.get(date)!;
    const dt = new Date(date + "T00:00:00");
    dt.setFullYear(dt.getFullYear() - 1);
    const m = String(dt.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
    const day = String(dt.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
    const yearAgoDate = `${dt.getFullYear()}-${m}-${day}`;
    const yearAgo = findClosest(yearAgoDate);
    timeline.push({ date, value, yearAgo });
  }

  const result = { timeline };

  // Write to Supabase cache (fire-and-forget)
  setCachedData("sns", cacheKey, result).catch(() => {});

  return NextResponse.json(result);
}

FILE: src/app/api/search/route.ts

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, aac, seoProjects } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { ilike, or, eq } from "drizzle-orm";

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session?.user) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const q = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("q")?.trim();
  if (!q || q.length < 2) {
    return NextResponse.json({ products: [], clients: [], seoProjects: [] });
  }

  const pattern = `%${q}%`;

  const [productRows, clientRows, seoRows] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select({
        id: master.id,
        asin: master.asin,
        sku: master.sku,
        itemName: master.itemName,
        summarizedTitle: master.summarizedTitle,
        clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode,
        mainImageUrl: master.mainImageUrl,
      })
      .from(master)
      .where(
        or(
          ilike(master.asin, pattern),
          ilike(master.sku, pattern),
          ilike(master.itemName, pattern),
          ilike(master.summarizedTitle, pattern),
          ilike(master.brandName, pattern)
        )
      )
      .limit(8),

    db
      .select({
        id: aac.id,
        clientIdCode: aac.clientIdCode,
        clientName: aac.clientName,
        clientStatus: aac.clientStatus,
      })
      .from(aac)
      .where(
        or(
          ilike(aac.clientIdCode, pattern),
          ilike(aac.clientName, pattern)
        )
      )
      .limit(5),

    db
      .select({
        id: seoProjects.id,
        name: seoProjects.name,
        status: seoProjects.status,
        currentPhase: seoProjects.currentPhase,
        clientIdCode: seoProjects.clientIdCode,
      })
      .from(seoProjects)
      .where(
        or(
          ilike(seoProjects.name, pattern),
          ilike(seoProjects.clientIdCode, pattern)
        )
      )
      .limit(5),
  ]);

  return NextResponse.json({
    products: productRows,
    clients: clientRows,
    seoProjects: seoRows,
  });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { getSeoVersion } from "@/lib/bigquery";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, activityLog } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { CORE_COLUMNS } from "@/lib/column-registry";

/** SEO content fields to copy from BQ version into the product */
const SEO_CONTENT_FIELDS = [
  "ItemName",
  "DetailedBulletPoint1",
  "DetailedBulletPoint2",
  "DetailedBulletPoint3",
  "DetailedBulletPoint4",
  "DetailedBulletPoint5",
  "ProductDescription",
  "GenericKeyword1",
  "GenericKeyword2",
  "GenericKeyword3",
  "GenericKeyword4",
  "GenericKeyword5",
  "ConciseBulletPoint1",
  "ConciseBulletPoint2",
  "ConciseBulletPoint3",
  "ConciseBulletPoint4",
  "ConciseBulletPoint5",
  "PA_LIBulletPoint1",
  "PA_LIBulletPoint2",
  "PA_LIBulletPoint3",
  "PA_LIBulletPoint4",
  "PA_LIBulletPoint5",
  "KeyFeature1",
  "KeyFeature2",
  "KeyFeature3",
  "KeyFeature4",
  "KeyFeature5",
];

/** SEO metadata fields to copy */
const SEO_META_FIELDS = [
  "SEOVersionNumber",
  "SEOCategory",
  "SEOStatus",
  "SEODocURL",
];

const JSONB_FIELDS = [
  "contentSeo",
  "variations",
  "packaging",
  "targetAudience",
  "fulfillment",
  "productAttributes",
  "nutritionSupplements",
  "complianceSafety",
  "images",
  "dimensionsWeight",
  "otherAttributes",
] as const;

const coreByBqName = new Map(
  CORE_COLUMNS.filter((c) => c.coreField).map((c) => [c.bqName, c.coreField!])
);

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  if (session.user.role === "viewer") {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Forbidden: viewers cannot activate SEO versions" },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }

  const body = await req.json();
  const { productId, seoVersionNumber, seoCategory, asin, sku } = body as {
    productId: string;
    seoVersionNumber: string;
    seoCategory: string;
    asin: string;
    sku: string;
  };

  if (!productId || !seoVersionNumber || !seoCategory || !asin || !sku) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "productId, seoVersionNumber, seoCategory, asin, and sku are required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  // 1. Fetch the specific SEO version from BQ
  const seoRow = await getSeoVersion(asin, sku, seoVersionNumber, seoCategory);
  if (!seoRow) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "SEO version not found in BigQuery" },
      { status: 404 }
    );
  }

  // 2. Fetch current product
  const [product] = await db
    .select()
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.id, productId))
    .limit(1);

  if (!product) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Product not found" }, { status: 404 });
  }

  // 3. Build updates — apply all SEO fields using JSONB dedup pattern
  const updates: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  const rawValues = { ...(product.rawColumnValues ?? {}) };
  const changeLog = [...(product.changeLog ?? [])];
  const allFieldsToApply = [...SEO_CONTENT_FIELDS, ...SEO_META_FIELDS];

  for (const bqName of allFieldsToApply) {
    const newValue = seoRow[bqName] ?? "";
    const coreField = coreByBqName.get(bqName);

    if (coreField) {
      // Core column — update directly
      updates[coreField] = newValue || null;
    } else {
      // JSONB field — find which blob has it, update with dedup
      let primaryBlob: string | null = null;

      for (const blobField of JSONB_FIELDS) {
        const blob = (updates[blobField] ??
          (product as Record<string, unknown>)[blobField]) as Record<
          string,
          string
        > | null;

        if (blob && bqName in blob) {
          if (!primaryBlob) {
            primaryBlob = blobField;
            updates[blobField] = { ...blob, [bqName]: newValue };
          } else {
            // Remove stale duplicate
            const cleaned = { ...blob };
            delete cleaned[bqName];
            updates[blobField] = cleaned;
          }
        }
      }

      // If not in any blob, add to contentSeo (SEO fields' natural home)
      if (!primaryBlob) {
        const current =
          (updates.contentSeo as Record<string, string>) ??
          ((product.contentSeo as Record<string, string>) ?? {});
        updates.contentSeo = { ...current, [bqName]: newValue };
      }
    }

    // Update raw values
    if (newValue) {
      rawValues[bqName] = newValue;
    } else {
      delete rawValues[bqName];
    }

    // Add to change log
    const oldValue =
      product.rawColumnValues?.[bqName] ?? null;
    if (oldValue !== newValue) {
      changeLog.push({
        field: bqName,
        oldValue,
        newValue: newValue || null,
        changedBy: session.user.email!,
        changedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      });
    }
  }

  updates.rawColumnValues = rawValues;
  updates.changeLog = changeLog;
  updates.isDirty = true;
  updates.updatedAt = new Date();

  await db.update(master).set(updates).where(eq(master.id, productId));

  // 4. Activity log entry
  await db.insert(activityLog).values({
    productId,
    asin: product.asin,
    sku: product.sku,
    clientIdCode: product.clientIdCode,
    itemName: product.itemName,
    fieldLabel: `SEO Version ${seoVersionNumber} (${seoCategory})`,
    bqName: "SEOVersionNumber",
    oldValue: product.rawColumnValues?.["SEOVersionNumber"] ?? null,
    newValue: seoVersionNumber,
    changedBy: session.user.email!,
    editType: "single",
  });

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
}

/**
 * Map a Hub product row to the HubASIN shape expected by the SEO intake page.
 * Pulls from core columns first, then JSONB blobs, then rawColumnValues.
 */
function mapProductToASIN(row: {
  asin: string | null;
  sku: string | null;
  clientIdCode: string | null;
  marketplace: string | null;
  country: string | null;
  brandName: string | null;
  status: string | null;
  summarizedTitle: string | null;
  parentageLevel: string | null;
  parentSku: string | null;
  parentAsin: string | null;
  itemName: string | null;
  listPrice: string | null;
  productType: string | null;
  itemTypeKeyword: string | null;
  variations: VariationData | null;
  contentSeo: Record<string, string> | null;
  targetAudience: Record<string, string> | null;
  productAttributes: Record<string, string> | null;
  nutritionSupplements: Record<string, string> | null;
  rawColumnValues: Record<string, string> | null;
  variationGroup: string | null;

const selectColumns = {

  productAttributes: master.productAttributes,
  nutritionSupplements: master.nutritionSupplements,

  variationGroup: master.variationGroup,

/**
 * GET /api/seo/bq/asins
 * Fetch paginated ASIN list from Hub's PostgreSQL products table.
 */
export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
    const clientIDCode = searchParams.get("clientIDCode");
    if (!clientIDCode) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "clientIDCode is required" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const conditions = [eq(master.clientIdCode, clientIDCode)];

    const parentageLevel = searchParams.get("parentageLevel");
    if (parentageLevel) conditions.push(ilike(master.parentageLevel, parentageLevel));

    const variationThemeName = searchParams.get("variationThemeName");
    if (variationThemeName) {
      conditions.push(sql`${master.variations}->>'VariationThemeName' = ${variationThemeName}`);
    }

    const variationID = searchParams.get("variationID");
    if (variationID) {
      conditions.push(sql`${master.variations}->>'VariationID' = ${variationID}`);
    }

    const productCategory = searchParams.get("productCategory");
    if (productCategory) {
      conditions.push(sql`${master.productAttributes}->>'ProductCategory' = ${productCategory}`);
    }

    const productSubcategory = searchParams.get("productSubcategory");
    if (productSubcategory) {
      conditions.push(sql`${master.productAttributes}->>'ProductSubcategory' = ${productSubcategory}`);
    }

    const flavor = searchParams.get("flavor");
    if (flavor) conditions.push(sql`${master.variations}->>'Flavor' = ${flavor}`);

    const style = searchParams.get("style");
    if (style) conditions.push(sql`${master.variations}->>'Style' = ${style}`);

    const color = searchParams.get("color");
    if (color) conditions.push(sql`${master.variations}->>'Color' = ${color}`);

    const size = searchParams.get("size");
    if (size) conditions.push(sql`${master.variations}->>'Size' = ${size}`);

    const statusFilter = searchParams.get("status");
    if (statusFilter) conditions.push(ilike(master.status, statusFilter));

    const searchTerm = searchParams.get("searchTerm");
    if (searchTerm) {
      const pattern = `%${searchTerm}%`;
      conditions.push(
        or(
          ilike(master.asin, pattern),
          ilike(master.sku, pattern),
          ilike(master.summarizedTitle, pattern)
        )!
      );
    }

    const limit = parseInt(searchParams.get("limit") || "50", 10);
    const offset = parseInt(searchParams.get("offset") || "0", 10);

    // Get total count
    const [{ count }] = await db
      .select({ count: sql<number>`count(*)::int` })
      .from(master)
      .where(and(...conditions));

    // Get paginated results — group by VariationID, parent first then children
    const rows = await db
      .select(selectColumns)
      .from(master)
      .where(and(...conditions))
      .orderBy(sql`${master.variations}->>'VariationID' ASC NULLS LAST`, desc(master.parentageLevel), asc(master.asin))
      .limit(limit)
      .offset(offset);

    return NextResponse.json({
      asins: rows.map(mapProductToASIN),
      totalCount: count,
    });
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    const msg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to fetch ASINs";
    console.error("ASINs GET error:", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: msg }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

/**
 * POST /api/seo/bq/asins
 * Fetch full ASIN data for selected ASINs.
 */
export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const { asins: asinList, clientIDCode } = await request.json();
    if (!clientIDCode) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "clientIDCode is required" }, { status: 400 });
    }
    if (!asinList?.length) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "asins array is required" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const rows = await db
      .select(selectColumns)
      .from(master)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(master.clientIdCode, clientIDCode),
          inArray(master.asin, asinList)
        )
      )
      .orderBy(sql`${master.variations}->>'VariationID' ASC NULLS LAST`, desc(master.parentageLevel), asc(master.asin));

    return NextResponse.json({ asins: rows.map(mapProductToASIN) });
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    const msg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to fetch full ASIN data";
    console.error("ASINs POST error:", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: msg }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { aac } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { ilike, eq, and, asc, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { AACClient } from "@/lib/bigquery";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";

export const maxDuration = 60;

/**
 * GET /api/seo/bq/clients
 * Fetch client list from PostgreSQL aac_clients table.
 * Returns data shaped like the BQ AAC table (PascalCase keys) for
 * backward compatibility with intake page.
 */
export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);

    const conditions = [];

    const clientName = searchParams.get("clientName");
    if (clientName) {
      conditions.push(ilike(aac.clientName, `%${clientName}%`));
    }

    const brandName = searchParams.get("brandName");
    if (brandName) {
      conditions.push(
        sql`${aac.rawData}->>'BrandName' ILIKE ${`%${brandName}%`}`
      );
    }

    const marketplace = searchParams.get("marketplace");
    if (marketplace) {
      conditions.push(
        sql`${aac.rawData}->>'Marketplace' = ${marketplace}`
      );
    }

    const country = searchParams.get("country");
    if (country) {
      conditions.push(
        sql`${aac.rawData}->>'Country' = ${country}`
      );
    }

    const clientStatus = searchParams.get("clientStatus");
    if (clientStatus) {
      conditions.push(ilike(aac.clientStatus, clientStatus));
    } else {
      // Default: only Active clients
      conditions.push(ilike(aac.clientStatus, "active"));
    }

    const clientIDCode = searchParams.get("clientIDCode");
    if (clientIDCode) {
      conditions.push(eq(aac.clientIdCode, clientIDCode));
    }

    const rows = await db
      .select({
        clientIdCode: aac.clientIdCode,
        clientStatus: aac.clientStatus,
        clientName: aac.clientName,
        rawData: aac.rawData,
      })
      .from(aac)
      .where(conditions.length > 0 ? and(...conditions) : undefined)
      .orderBy(
        sql`CAST(${aac.rawData}->>'Tier' AS INTEGER) ASC NULLS LAST`,
        asc(aac.clientName)
      )
      .limit(200);

    // Map to BQ-compatible PascalCase shape
    const clients: AACClient[] = rows.map((row) => {
      const raw = typeof row.rawData === "string"
        ? JSON.parse(row.rawData)
        : (row.rawData || {}) as Record<string, string>;

      return {
        ClientStatus: row.clientStatus || raw.ClientStatus || null,
        ClientName: row.clientName || raw.ClientName || null,
        ClientIDCode: row.clientIdCode || raw.ClientIDCode || null,
        BrandName: raw.BrandName || row.clientName || null,
        Marketplace: raw.Marketplace || null,
        Country: raw.Country || null,
        Tier: raw.Tier ? Number(raw.Tier) : null,
        BrandURL: raw.BrandURL || null,
        ClientHubURL: raw.ClientHubURL || raw.ClientBibleURL || null,
        ClientHubID: raw.ClientHubID || raw.ClientBibleID || null,
        Competitor1Name: raw.Competitor1Name || null,
        Competitor1URL: raw.Competitor1URL || null,
        Competitor2Name: raw.Competitor2Name || null,
        Competitor2URL: raw.Competitor2URL || null,
        Competitor3Name: raw.Competitor3Name || null,
        Competitor3URL: raw.Competitor3URL || null,
        Competitor4Name: raw.Competitor4Name || null,
        Competitor4URL: raw.Competitor4URL || null,
        Competitor5Name: raw.Competitor5Name || null,
        Competitor5URL: raw.Competitor5URL || null,
      };
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ clients });
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    const msg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to fetch clients";
    console.error("Clients error:", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: msg }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";

/**
 * GET /api/seo/bq/filters
 * Fetch distinct filter options for ASINs belonging to a client.
 * Reads from Hub's PostgreSQL products table.
 */
export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const clientIDCode = new URL(request.url).searchParams.get("clientIDCode");
    if (!clientIDCode) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "clientIDCode is required" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const [row] = await db
      .select({
        parentageLevels: sql<string[]>`ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ${master.parentageLevel}) FILTER (WHERE ${master.parentageLevel} IS NOT NULL)`,
        variationThemeNames: sql<string[]>`ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ${master.variations}->>'VariationThemeName') FILTER (WHERE ${master.variations}->>'VariationThemeName' IS NOT NULL)`,
        variationIDs: sql<string[]>`ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ${master.variations}->>'VariationID') FILTER (WHERE ${master.variations}->>'VariationID' IS NOT NULL)`,
        productCategories: sql<string[]>`ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ${master.productAttributes}->>'ProductCategory') FILTER (WHERE ${master.productAttributes}->>'ProductCategory' IS NOT NULL)`,
        productSubcategories: sql<string[]>`ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ${master.productAttributes}->>'ProductSubcategory') FILTER (WHERE ${master.productAttributes}->>'ProductSubcategory' IS NOT NULL)`,
        flavors: sql<string[]>`ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ${master.variations}->>'Flavor') FILTER (WHERE ${master.variations}->>'Flavor' IS NOT NULL)`,
        styles: sql<string[]>`ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ${master.variations}->>'Style') FILTER (WHERE ${master.variations}->>'Style' IS NOT NULL)`,
        colors: sql<string[]>`ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ${master.variations}->>'Color') FILTER (WHERE ${master.variations}->>'Color' IS NOT NULL)`,
        sizes: sql<string[]>`ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ${master.variations}->>'Size') FILTER (WHERE ${master.variations}->>'Size' IS NOT NULL)`,
        statuses: sql<string[]>`ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ${master.status}) FILTER (WHERE ${master.status} IS NOT NULL)`,
        totalCount: sql<number>`count(*)::int`,
      })
      .from(master)
      .where(eq(master.clientIdCode, clientIDCode));

    return NextResponse.json({
      parentageLevels: (row?.parentageLevels || []).filter(Boolean).sort(),
      variationThemeNames: (row?.variationThemeNames || []).filter(Boolean).sort(),
      variationIDs: (row?.variationIDs || []).filter(Boolean).sort(),
      productCategories: (row?.productCategories || []).filter(Boolean).sort(),
      productSubcategories: (row?.productSubcategories || []).filter(Boolean).sort(),
      flavors: (row?.flavors || []).filter(Boolean).sort(),
      styles: (row?.styles || []).filter(Boolean).sort(),
      colors: (row?.colors || []).filter(Boolean).sort(),
      sizes: (row?.sizes || []).filter(Boolean).sort(),
      statuses: (row?.statuses || []).filter(Boolean).sort(),
      totalCount: row?.totalCount || 0,
    });
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    const msg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to fetch filter options";
    console.error("Filters error:", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: msg }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// S5 COSMO API — Claude AI
// POST /api/claude/cosmo
// Action: generate
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";
import { getConfigDocBlock } from "@/lib/seo-config-doc";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { logEvent } from "@/lib/event-logger";
import { getAiFeatureConfig } from "@/lib/ai-config.server";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY,
  fetch: fetch,
});

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  const startTime = Date.now();

  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const { action } = body;

    const aiConfig = await getAiFeatureConfig("seo_cosmo");
    if (!aiConfig.enabled) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Feature disabled" }, { status: 403 });

    if (action === "generate") {
      return handleGenerate(body, session, startTime, aiConfig);
    } else {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unknown action" }, { status: 400 });
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error("COSMO API error:", err);

    logEvent({
      userEmail: session?.user?.email,
      userName: session?.user?.name,
      section: "seo",
      action: "claude:cosmo",
      status: "error",
      message: err.message || "Failed",
      detail: { error: err.message },
      durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message || "Failed" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

/** Attempt to salvage a truncated JSON array by closing it */
function repairTruncatedJson(raw: string): any[] | null {
  let text = raw.trim();
  if (!text.startsWith("[")) return null;

  // Already valid?
  try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch {}

  // Strip trailing partial object — find last complete }, or }
  const lastComplete = Math.max(text.lastIndexOf("},"), text.lastIndexOf("}\n"));
  if (lastComplete > 0) {
    const candidate = text.slice(0, lastComplete + 1) + "]";
    try { return JSON.parse(candidate); } catch {}
  }

  // Last resort: close the array
  const closed = text.replace(/,?\s*$/, "") + "]";
  try { return JSON.parse(closed); } catch {}

  return null;
}

async function handleGenerate(body: any, session: any, startTime: number, aiConfig: { model: string; maxTokens: number }) {
  // Body now contains pre-trimmed data from the client
  const { brandName, parentAsin, asinList, topKeywords, reviewThemes, rufusInsights, guidelines } = body;

  const systemPrompt = `You are the COSMO Semantic Modeling Engine for 1o8 Marketplace SEO.

Your task: Generate a complete COSMO semantic entity-relationship map for an Amazon product listing.

COSMO RELATIONSHIP TYPES (use only these, grouped by category):
Functional/Usage: USED_FOR_FUNC, USED_TO, CAPABLE_OF
Event/Context: USED_FOR_EVE, USED_ON, USED_IN_LOC
Product/Concept: USED_AS, IS_A, xIS_A
Body/Interaction: USED_IN_BODY
Complementary: USED_WITH
Audience/User: USED_FOR_AUD, USED_BY
Interest/Motivation: xINTERESTED_IN, xWANT

Category guidance:
- USED_FOR_FUNC: Core function or practical use of the product
- USED_TO: Intended purpose or outcome the product supports
- CAPABLE_OF: What the product can enable based on its features
- USED_FOR_EVE: Events or activities where the product is used
- USED_ON: Time-based, seasonal, or situational relevance
- USED_IN_LOC: Physical locations or environments
- USED_AS: Functional or conceptual role of the product
- IS_A: Primary taxonomic classification
- xIS_A: Audience- or context-specific classifications for category clarity
- USED_IN_BODY: Body interaction (fully compliant, non-medical language only)
- USED_WITH: Products or items commonly used alongside
- USED_FOR_AUD: Intended audience
- USED_BY: Common user type or demographic
- xINTERESTED_IN: Interests, preferences, or thematic categories tied to the user
- xWANT: Goals, desires, or activities the user seeks to accomplish

PDP SECTION MAPPING (for COSMOAppliedPDPSection1 and COSMOAppliedPDPSection2):
- Title, Bullet 1, Bullet 2, Bullet 3, Bullet 4, Bullet 5, Description, Backend, A+ Module, Image, Not Applicable

RULES:
1. Generate exactly 20 relationship rows — no more, no less.
2. Prioritize variety across ALL relationship types — aim for at least one of each applicable type.
3. Every row must trace to a keyword, review insight, or Rufus answer.
4. COSMOEntity = the product or product attribute being mapped.
5. COSMOTailType = the target concept (audience, use case, ingredient, etc.)
6. COSMOMappedValue = the specific value — keep concise.
7. COSMOUsageExplanation = how this relationship informs listing content — max 20 words.
8. COSMOAppliedPDPSection1 = primary PDP location.
9. COSMOAppliedPDPSection2 = secondary PDP location (use "Not Applicable" if none).
10. COSMONotes = source reference — max 10 words.
11. No cell may be blank — use "Not Applicable" where needed.
12. NEVER include competitor names in any field.
13. No medical/disease claims.

OUTPUT: Return ONLY a valid JSON array — no markdown, no code fences, no preamble, no explanation.
Start with [ and end with ].

JSON schema for each object:
{"ASIN":"","COSMOEntity":"","COSMORelationType":"","COSMOTailType":"","COSMOMappedValue":"","COSMOUsageExplanation":"","COSMOAppliedPDPSection1":"","COSMOAppliedPDPSection2":"","COSMONotes":""}`;

  const guidelinesBlock = guidelines
    ? `\n=== BRAND GUIDELINES ===\n${String(guidelines).substring(0, 600)}\n=== END GUIDELINES ===\n`
    : "";

  const userPrompt = `Product: ${brandName}
Parent ASIN: ${parentAsin}
ASINs in scope: ${asinList || ""}
${guidelinesBlock}
=== TOP KEYWORDS (S2) ===
${topKeywords || "None provided"}

=== REVIEW THEMES (S3) ===
${reviewThemes || "None provided"}

=== RUFUS INSIGHTS (S4) ===
${rufusInsights || "None provided"}

Generate exactly 20 COSMO rows as a valid JSON array. Output ONLY the JSON array.`;

  const configBlock = await getConfigDocBlock(4000);
  const finalSystemPrompt = configBlock ? `${configBlock}\n\n${systemPrompt}` : systemPrompt;

  console.log("COSMO: Calling Claude Haiku, prompt length:", userPrompt.length);

  const response = await client.messages.create({
    model: aiConfig.model,
    max_tokens: aiConfig.maxTokens,
    system: finalSystemPrompt,
    messages: [{ role: "user", content: userPrompt }],
  });

  console.log("COSMO: Claude responded in", Date.now() - startTime, "ms, stop_reason:", response.stop_reason);

  const text = response.content
    .filter((b) => b.type === "text")
    .map((b) => (b.type === "text" ? b.text : ""))
    .join("");

  const clean = text.replace(/```json\s*/g, "").replace(/```\s*/g, "").trim();

  // Try clean parse first
  try {
    const rows = JSON.parse(clean);

    logEvent({
      userEmail: session?.user?.email,
      userName: session?.user?.name,
      section: "seo",
      action: "claude:cosmo",
      status: "success",
      resourceLabel: brandName,
      message: `Generated ${rows.length} COSMO rows`,
      detail: { rowsOut: rows.length, usage: response.usage },
      durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ rows, usage: response.usage });
  } catch {
    // Try to repair truncated JSON
    const repaired = repairTruncatedJson(clean);
    if (repaired && repaired.length > 0) {
      console.warn(`COSMO: repaired truncated JSON, recovered ${repaired.length} rows`);

      logEvent({
        userEmail: session?.user?.email,
        userName: session?.user?.name,
        section: "seo",
        action: "claude:cosmo",
        status: "warning",
        resourceLabel: brandName,
        message: `Repaired truncated JSON, recovered ${repaired.length} rows`,
        detail: { rowsOut: repaired.length, stopReason: response.stop_reason, usage: response.usage },
        durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,
      });

      return NextResponse.json({ rows: repaired, usage: response.usage, repaired: true });
    }

    const errMsg = `COSMO generation failed: ${response.stop_reason === "max_tokens" ? "Response too long — try again with fewer keywords loaded" : "Invalid JSON from AI"}`;

    logEvent({
      userEmail: session?.user?.email,
      userName: session?.user?.name,
      section: "seo",
      action: "claude:cosmo",
      status: "error",
      resourceLabel: brandName,
      message: errMsg,
      detail: { stopReason: response.stop_reason, rawStart: clean.substring(0, 200), usage: response.usage },
      durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,
    });

    console.error("COSMO parse failed. stop_reason:", response.stop_reason, "| Raw start:", clean.substring(0, 200));
    return NextResponse.json({ error: errMsg }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
