// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// S2 Keyword Tiering API — Claude AI
// POST /api/claude/keywords
// Batches run in PARALLEL to fit within Vercel 60s timeout
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";
import { getConfigDocBlock } from "@/lib/seo-config-doc";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { logEvent } from "@/lib/event-logger";
import { getAiFeatureConfig } from "@/lib/ai-config.server";
import { checkRateLimit } from "@/lib/rate-limit";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY,
  fetch: fetch,
});

const BATCH_SIZE = 100;

const SYSTEM_PROMPT = `You are the Keyword Intelligence and Tiering Engine for Amazon SEO (RUFUS + COSMO).

TASK: For each keyword, assign Priority Tier, Search Intent, Use Location, Match Type, COSMO Relationship, Buyer Stage, and a short Note.

TIERING RULES:
- T1: High purchase intent → Title. Match: Exact. 5-8 keywords total across all batches.
- T2: Mid-funnel → Bullet Points. Match: Phrase. 10-15 keywords total.
- T3: Semantic expansion → Description. Match: Phrase. 15-20 keywords total.
- T4: Long-tail/awareness → Backend. Match: Exact or Broad. Everything else.
- No keyword in more than one tier.

BUYER STAGE: Awareness | Consideration | Decision
COSMO: USED_FOR_FUNC | USED_TO | CAPABLE_OF | USED_FOR_EVE | USED_ON | USED_IN_LOC | USED_AS | IS_A | xIS_A | USED_IN_BODY | USED_WITH | USED_FOR_AUD | USED_BY | xINTERESTED_IN | xWANT
INTENT: Informational | Commercial | Navigational | Transactional

SCORING: (Relevancy×0.45) + (NormVolume×0.35) + (BuyerStageWeight×0.20). Decision=1.0, Consideration=0.7, Awareness=0.4.

OUTPUT: Return ONLY a JSON array. Each element:
{"t":"keyword","v":number,"tier":"T1","int":"Transactional","loc":"Title","mt":"Exact","cos":"USED_FOR_FUNC","bs":"Decision","n":"note"}

Field key mapping: t=KeywordText, v=SearchVolume, tier=PriorityTier, int=SearchIntent, loc=PrimaryUseLocation, mt=MatchType, cos=COSMORelationship, bs=BuyerStage, n=Notes.

Use these SHORT keys to save space. Return ONLY the JSON array — no markdown, no explanation, no code fences.`;

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  const startTime = Date.now();

  // Rate limit: 10 requests per minute per user
  const rlKey = session?.user?.email || req.headers.get("x-forwarded-for") || "anonymous";
  const rl = checkRateLimit(rlKey, 10, 60_000);
  if (!rl.success) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Rate limit exceeded. Try again later." },
      { status: 429, headers: { "Retry-After": String(Math.ceil((rl.resetAt - Date.now()) / 1000)) } }
    );
  }

  let body: any;

  try {
    body = await req.json();
    const { keywords, brandName, variationProduct, variationTheme, competitors, guidelines } = body;

    if (!keywords || !Array.isArray(keywords) || keywords.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "No keywords provided" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    if (!brandName) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Brand name is required" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const aiConfig = await getAiFeatureConfig("seo_keywords");
    if (!aiConfig.enabled) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Feature disabled" }, { status: 403 });

    // Limit to top 400 (200 product + 200 competitor, enforced by frontend)
    const topKeywords = keywords.slice(0, 400);

    // Split into batches
    const batches: any[][] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < topKeywords.length; i += BATCH_SIZE) {
      batches.push(topKeywords.slice(i, i + BATCH_SIZE));
    }

    const guidelinesBlock = guidelines
      ? `BRAND GUIDELINES (apply to tone, intent signals, audience keywords):\n${String(guidelines).substring(0, 600)}\n`
      : "";

    const configBlock = await getConfigDocBlock(3000);
    const effectiveSystemPrompt = configBlock
      ? `${configBlock}\n\n${SYSTEM_PROMPT}`
      : SYSTEM_PROMPT;

    // Tier budget per batch (distributed evenly)
    const t1PerBatch = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(8 / batches.length));
    const t2PerBatch = Math.max(2, Math.ceil(15 / batches.length));

    console.log(`Keywords: ${topKeywords.length} in ${batches.length} parallel batches`);

    // Run ALL batches in parallel to fit within 60s Vercel timeout
    const results = await Promise.all(
      batches.map(async (batch, batchIdx) => {
        const kwLines = batch
          .map((kw: any) => `${kw.keyword_phrase}\t${kw.search_volume}\t${kw.cerebro_iq_score || ""}\t${kw.competing_products || ""}\t${kw.title_density || ""}\t${kw.cpr || ""}`)
          .join("\n");

        const tierGuidance = `This is batch ${batchIdx + 1} of ${batches.length}. Assign max ${t1PerBatch} T1, ${t2PerBatch} T2, rest split T3/T4.`;

        const userPrompt = `Product: ${brandName} — ${variationProduct || "Product"}
Theme: ${variationTheme || "N/A"}
${guidelinesBlock}${tierGuidance}

Batch ${batchIdx + 1}/${batches.length} (${batch.length} keywords):
Keyword\tVolume\tIQ\tCompetition\tTitleDensity\tCPR
${kwLines}

Return JSON array for ALL ${batch.length} keywords using short keys.`;

        const response = await client.messages.create({
          model: aiConfig.model,
          max_tokens: aiConfig.maxTokens,
          system: effectiveSystemPrompt,
          messages: [{ role: "user", content: userPrompt }],
        });

        const usage = response.usage || { input_tokens: 0, output_tokens: 0 };

        const text = response.content
          .filter((block) => block.type === "text")
          .map((block) => (block.type === "text" ? block.text : ""))
          .join("");

        const clean = text.replace(/```json\s*/g, "").replace(/```\s*/g, "").trim();

        let parsed: any[];
        try {
          parsed = JSON.parse(clean);
        } catch {
          const lastBracket = clean.lastIndexOf("}");
          if (lastBracket > 0) {
            try {
              parsed = JSON.parse(clean.substring(0, lastBracket + 1) + "]");
            } catch {
              console.error(`Batch ${batchIdx + 1} JSON parse failed. Raw length: ${clean.length}`);
              return { keywords: [], usage };
            }
          } else {
            return { keywords: [], usage };
          }
        }

        const expanded = parsed.map((kw: any) => ({
          KeywordText: kw.t || kw.KeywordText || "",
          KeywordSearchVolume: kw.v || kw.KeywordSearchVolume || 0,
          KeywordPriorityTier: kw.tier || kw.KeywordPriorityTier || "T4",
          KeywordSearchIntent: kw.int || kw.KeywordSearchIntent || "",
          KeywordPrimaryUseLocation: expandLocation(kw.loc || kw.KeywordPrimaryUseLocation || "Backend Search Terms"),
          KeywordMatchType: kw.mt || kw.KeywordMatchType || "Broad",
          KeywordCOSMORelationship: kw.cos || kw.KeywordCOSMORelationship || "",
          KeywordBuyerStage: kw.bs || kw.KeywordBuyerStage || "Awareness",
          KeywordNotes: kw.n || kw.KeywordNotes || "",
        }));

        return { keywords: expanded, usage };
      })
    );

    // Merge results
    const allTiered: any[] = [];
    const totalUsage = { input_tokens: 0, output_tokens: 0 };
    for (const r of results) {
      allTiered.push(...r.keywords);
      totalUsage.input_tokens += r.usage.input_tokens;
      totalUsage.output_tokens += r.usage.output_tokens;
    }

    console.log(`Keywords done: ${allTiered.length} tiered, ${totalUsage.input_tokens + totalUsage.output_tokens} tokens`);

    logEvent({
      userEmail: session?.user?.email,
      userName: session?.user?.name,
      section: "seo",
      action: "claude:keywords",
      status: "success",
      resourceType: "brand",
      resourceLabel: brandName,
      message: `Tiered ${allTiered.length} keywords in ${batches.length} batches`,
      detail: { keywordsIn: topKeywords.length, keywordsOut: allTiered.length, batches: batches.length, usage: totalUsage },
      durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      keywords: allTiered,
      model: aiConfig.model,
      usage: totalUsage,
      batches: batches.length,
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error("Claude API error:", err);

    logEvent({
      userEmail: session?.user?.email,
      userName: session?.user?.name,
      section: "seo",
      action: "claude:keywords",
      status: "error",
      resourceLabel: body?.brandName,
      message: err.message || "Failed to process keywords",
      detail: { error: err.message },
      durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,
    });

    if (err.message?.includes("authentication") || err.message?.includes("api_key") || err.status === 401) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Invalid Anthropic API key. Check your .env.local ANTHROPIC_API_KEY." },
        { status: 401 }
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: err.message || "Failed to process keywords" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

function expandLocation(loc: string): string {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {
    "Title": "Title",
    "Bullets": "Bullet Points",
    "Bullet Points": "Bullet Points",
    "Description": "Description",
    "Backend": "Backend Search Terms",
    "Backend Search Terms": "Backend Search Terms",
  };
  return map[loc] || loc;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// S3 Review Analysis API — Claude AI (raw fetch, no SDK)
// POST /api/claude/reviews
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getConfigDocBlock } from "@/lib/seo-config-doc";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { logEvent } from "@/lib/event-logger";
import { getAiFeatureConfig } from "@/lib/ai-config.server";
import { checkRateLimit } from "@/lib/rate-limit";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const SYSTEM_PROMPT = `You are the Review Intelligence Engine for Amazon SEO.

Analyze each review. Return structured intelligence.

FOR EACH REVIEW determine:
- s: Sentiment (Positive+ | Positive | Neutral | Negative | Negative-)
- th: Key themes comma-separated
- u: Usage mentioned (Ritual, Habitual, Occasional, Emergency, or context)
- pkg: Packaging feedback or "None mentioned"
- pr: Price feedback or "None mentioned"
- hl: Heat/intensity feedback or "Not applicable"
- ri: Rufus buyer-psychology insight from review language
- bm: Bullet mapping (e.g. "Bullet 1: Effectiveness")

RULES:
- Anonymize names as Reviewer_001, Reviewer_002, etc.
- No blank fields — use "None mentioned" or "Not applicable"

OUTPUT: ONLY a JSON array with short keys:
{"id":"...","d":"YYYY-MM-DD","rn":"Reviewer_XXX","v":"...","r":5,"t":"title","s":"Positive","th":"...","u":"...","pkg":"...","pr":"...","hl":"...","ri":"...","bm":"..."}

No markdown, no code fences, no explanation. Start with [ end with ].`;

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  const startTime = Date.now();

  // Rate limit: 10 requests per minute per user
  const rlKey = session?.user?.email || req.headers.get("x-forwarded-for") || "anonymous";
  const rl = checkRateLimit(rlKey, 10, 60_000);
  if (!rl.success) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Rate limit exceeded. Try again later." },
      { status: 429, headers: { "Retry-After": String(Math.ceil((rl.resetAt - Date.now()) / 1000)) } }
    );
  }

  try {
    const apiKey = process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY;
    if (!apiKey) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" }, { status: 500 });

    const aiConfig = await getAiFeatureConfig("seo_reviews");
    if (!aiConfig.enabled) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Feature disabled" }, { status: 403 });

    const body = await req.json();
    const { reviewBlock, reviewCount, brandName, productName } = body;

    // Support both new (pre-trimmed) and legacy (full reviews) format
    let prompt: string;
    let count: number;

    if (reviewBlock) {
      prompt = reviewBlock;
      count = reviewCount || 0;
    } else if (body.reviews && Array.isArray(body.reviews)) {
      const reviews = body.reviews.slice(0, 60);
      count = reviews.length;
      prompt = reviews
        .map((r: any, i: number) =>
          `[${i + 1}] ${r.star_rating}★ | ${r.product_variation || "—"} | ${r.date_iso || ""} | HV:${r.helpful_votes || 0}\n${r.title}\n${(r.text || "").substring(0, 250)}`)
        .join("\n---\n");
    } else {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "No reviews provided" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const userPrompt = `Product: ${brandName || "Product"} — ${productName || ""}
${count} reviews:

${prompt}

Analyze ALL ${count} reviews. Return JSON array with short keys.`;

    console.log(`Reviews: ${count} reviews, prompt ~${userPrompt.length} chars`);
    const startTime = Date.now();

    const configBlock = await getConfigDocBlock(2000);
    const finalSystemPrompt = configBlock ? `${configBlock}\n\n${SYSTEM_PROMPT}` : SYSTEM_PROMPT;

    // Use raw fetch — no SDK overhead, faster cold start
    const response = await fetch("https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "x-api-key": apiKey,
        "anthropic-version": "2023-06-01",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        model: aiConfig.model,
        max_tokens: aiConfig.maxTokens,
        system: finalSystemPrompt,
        messages: [{ role: "user", content: userPrompt }],
      }),
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      const errText = await response.text();
      console.error(`Anthropic API ${response.status}:`, errText);
      return NextResponse.json({ error: `Anthropic API error ${response.status}` }, { status: 502 });
    }

    const data = await response.json();
    console.log(`Reviews: responded in ${Date.now() - startTime}ms, stop: ${data.stop_reason}`);

    const usage = data.usage || { input_tokens: 0, output_tokens: 0 };

    const text = (data.content || [])
      .filter((b: any) => b.type === "text")
      .map((b: any) => b.text)
      .join("");

    const clean = text.replace(/```json\s*/g, "").replace(/```\s*/g, "").trim();

    let parsed: any[];
    try {
      parsed = JSON.parse(clean);
    } catch {
      const lastBracket = clean.lastIndexOf("}");
      if (lastBracket > 0) {
        try {
          parsed = JSON.parse(clean.substring(0, lastBracket + 1) + "]");
        } catch {
          console.error(`Reviews JSON parse failed. Raw: ${clean.substring(0, 300)}`);
          return NextResponse.json({ error: "AI response was malformed. Try again." }, { status: 500 });
        }
      } else {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "AI returned empty response. Try again." }, { status: 500 });
      }
    }

    // Expand short keys
    const expanded = parsed.map((kw: any) => ({
      ReviewID: kw.id || kw.ReviewID || "",
      ReviewDate: kw.d || kw.ReviewDate || "",
      ReviewReviewerName: kw.rn || kw.ReviewReviewerName || "",
      ReviewASIN: "ParentASIN",
      ReviewProductVariation: kw.v || kw.ReviewProductVariation || "",
      ReviewStarRating: kw.r || kw.ReviewStarRating || 0,
      ReviewTitle: kw.t || kw.ReviewTitle || "",
      ReviewSentiment: kw.s || kw.ReviewSentiment || "Neutral",
      ReviewKeyThemes: kw.th || kw.ReviewKeyThemes || "",
      ReviewUsageMentioned: kw.u || kw.ReviewUsageMentioned || "Not analyzed",
      ReviewPackagingFeedback: kw.pkg || kw.ReviewPackagingFeedback || "None mentioned",
      ReviewPriceFeedback: kw.pr || kw.ReviewPriceFeedback || "None mentioned",
      ReviewHeatLevelFeedback: kw.hl || kw.ReviewHeatLevelFeedback || "Not applicable",
      ReviewRufusUsableInsight: kw.ri || kw.ReviewRufusUsableInsight || "Not analyzed",
      ReviewBulletMapping: kw.bm || kw.ReviewBulletMapping || "Not analyzed",
    }));

    logEvent({
      userEmail: session?.user?.email,
      userName: session?.user?.name,
      section: "seo",
      action: "claude:reviews",
      status: "success",
      resourceLabel: brandName || productName,
      message: `Analyzed ${expanded.length} reviews`,
      detail: { reviewsIn: count, reviewsOut: expanded.length, usage },
      durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      reviews: expanded,
      totalProcessed: expanded.length,
      usage,
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error("Reviews API error:", err);

    logEvent({
      userEmail: session?.user?.email,
      userName: session?.user?.name,
      section: "seo",
      action: "claude:reviews",
      status: "error",
      message: err.message || "Failed to analyze reviews",
      detail: { error: err.message },
      durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,
    });

    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: err.message || "Failed to analyze reviews" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// S4 Rufus API — Claude AI
// POST /api/claude/rufus
// Actions: generate_phase2, analyze
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";
import { getConfigDocBlock } from "@/lib/seo-config-doc";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { logEvent } from "@/lib/event-logger";
import { getAiFeatureConfig } from "@/lib/ai-config.server";
import { checkRateLimit } from "@/lib/rate-limit";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const client = new Anthropic({
  apiKey: process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY,
  fetch: fetch,
});

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  const startTime = Date.now();

  // Rate limit: 10 requests per minute per user
  const rlKey = session?.user?.email || req.headers.get("x-forwarded-for") || "anonymous";
  const rl = checkRateLimit(rlKey, 10, 60_000);
  if (!rl.success) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Rate limit exceeded. Try again later." },
      { status: 429, headers: { "Retry-After": String(Math.ceil((rl.resetAt - Date.now()) / 1000)) } }
    );
  }

  try {
    const aiConfig = await getAiFeatureConfig("seo_rufus");
    if (!aiConfig.enabled) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Feature disabled" }, { status: 403 });

    const body = await req.json();
    const { action } = body;
    if (action === "generate_phase2") return handleGeneratePhase2(body, session, startTime, aiConfig);
    if (action === "analyze") return handleAnalyze(body, session, startTime, aiConfig);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unknown action" }, { status: 400 });
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error("Rufus API error:", err);

    logEvent({
      userEmail: session?.user?.email,
      userName: session?.user?.name,
      section: "seo",
      action: "claude:rufus",
      status: "error",
      message: err.message || "Failed",
      detail: { error: err.message },
      durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message || "Failed" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// ── Generate Phase 2 Strategic Questions ─────────────────────

async function handleGeneratePhase2(body: any, session: any, startTime: number, aiConfig: { model: string; maxTokens: number }) {
  const { phase1, brandName, productName, guidelines } = body;

  const systemPrompt = `You are the RUFUS Optimization Engine for Amazon listing SEO.

Given the Phase 1 foundational Q&A from Rufus, generate 8-10 additional strategic questions to ask Rufus for deeper discovery.

RULES:
- Every question MUST end with a question mark
- Questions must be short and direct for Rufus chat input
- Focus on: usage patterns, objection resolution, competitive positioning, audience segments, purchase triggers, seasonal usage, gifting context, complementary products
- No quotation marks in questions
- Each question should explore a different angle not covered in Phase 1
- Questions should help inform listing optimization, A+ content, and image strategy

OUTPUT: Return ONLY a JSON array of question strings. No markdown, no code fences.
Example: ["What ingredients does this product contain?", "How quickly does this product work?"]`;

  const guidelinesSection = guidelines
    ? `\nBRAND GUIDELINES (use to shape question relevance and brand voice):\n${guidelines.substring(0, 600)}\n`
    : "";

  const userPrompt = `Product: ${brandName} — ${productName}
${guidelinesSection}
Phase 1 Responses:
${phase1.map((p: any, i: number) => `Q${i + 1}: ${p.question}\nA${i + 1}: ${p.answer}`).join("\n\n")}

Generate 8-10 strategic Phase 2 questions.`;

  const response = await client.messages.create({
    model: aiConfig.model,
    max_tokens: aiConfig.maxTokens,
    system: systemPrompt,
    messages: [{ role: "user", content: userPrompt }],
  });

  const text = response.content
    .filter((b) => b.type === "text")
    .map((b) => (b.type === "text" ? b.text : ""))
    .join("");

  const clean = text.replace(/```json\s*/g, "").replace(/```\s*/g, "").trim();

  let questions;
  try {
    questions = JSON.parse(clean);
  } catch {
    const lines = clean
      .split("\n")
      .filter((l) => l.trim().endsWith("?"))
      .map((l) => l.replace(/^[\s\-\d.*"]+/, "").replace(/[",\]]+$/, "").trim());
    if (lines.length > 0) {
      questions = lines;
    } else {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Failed to parse AI response" }, { status: 500 });
    }
  }

  logEvent({
    userEmail: session?.user?.email,
    userName: session?.user?.name,
    section: "seo",
    action: "claude:rufus:generate_phase2",
    status: "success",
    resourceLabel: `${brandName} — ${productName}`,
    message: `Generated ${Array.isArray(questions) ? questions.length : 0} Phase 2 questions`,
    detail: { questionsCount: Array.isArray(questions) ? questions.length : 0, usage: response.usage },
    durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,
  });

  return NextResponse.json({ questions, usage: response.usage });
}

// ── Analyze All Q&A into OUT_RUF ──────────────────────────────

async function handleAnalyze(body: any, session: any, startTime: number, aiConfig: { model: string; maxTokens: number }) {
  const { allQA, brandName, productName, guidelines } = body;

  const systemPrompt = `You are the RUFUS Analysis Engine for 1o8 Marketplace SEO (RUFUS + COSMO system).

Analyze each Rufus Q&A pair and produce structured intelligence for the OUT_RUF table.

FOR EACH Q&A PAIR, determine:

1. RufusQuestionCategory: One of — Product Identity, Usage & Application, Customer Satisfaction, Customer Dissatisfaction, Competitive Landscape, Purchase Decision, Ingredient & Composition, Efficacy & Performance, Audience & Demographics, Seasonal & Contextual

2. RufusInsightType: One of — Core Benefit, Objection, Desire, Usage Pattern, Competitive Advantage, Purchase Trigger, Trust Signal, Value Proposition

3. RufusPrimaryObjectionAddressed: The main customer objection this Q&A helps resolve, or "None identified"

4. RufusPrimaryDesireAddressed: The main customer desire this Q&A satisfies, or "None identified"

5. RufusCOSMORelationship: Primary COSMO relationship type — USED_FOR_FUNC, USED_TO, CAPABLE_OF, USED_FOR_EVE, USED_ON, USED_IN_LOC, USED_AS, IS_A, xIS_A, USED_IN_BODY, USED_WITH, USED_FOR_AUD, USED_BY, xINTERESTED_IN, xWANT

6. RufusUsageContext: How/when the product is used based on this Q&A — e.g., "Daily wellness routine", "Emergency relief", "Athletic recovery"

7. RufusNotes: Any additional flags — competitor mentions, compliance concerns, gaps, cross-reference notes. Use "None" if nothing notable.

RULES:
- ASIN must be "ParentASIN" for all rows (variation family scope)
- No field may be blank
- RufusQuestion and RufusAnswer must be preserved exactly as provided
- One row per Q&A pair

OUTPUT: Return ONLY a valid JSON array. Each object:
{
  "ASIN": "ParentASIN",
  "RufusQuestion": "...",
  "RufusAnswer": "...",
  "RufusQuestionCategory": "...",
  "RufusInsightType": "...",
  "RufusPrimaryObjectionAddressed": "...",
  "RufusPrimaryDesireAddressed": "...",
  "RufusCOSMORelationship": "...",
  "RufusUsageContext": "...",
  "RufusNotes": "..."
}

No markdown, no code fences, no explanation.`;

  const guidelinesSection = guidelines
    ? `\nBRAND GUIDELINES (apply brand voice and audience context to all analysis):\n${guidelines.substring(0, 600)}\n`
    : "";

  const qaBlock = (allQA || [])
    .map((qa: any, i: number) => `Q${i + 1}: ${qa.question}\nA${i + 1}: ${qa.answer}`)
    .join("\n\n");

  const userPrompt = `Product: ${brandName} — ${productName}
Total Q&A pairs: ${(allQA || []).length}
${guidelinesSection}
${qaBlock}

Analyze ALL ${(allQA || []).length} Q&A pairs. Return the complete JSON array.`;

  const configBlock = await getConfigDocBlock(3000);
  const finalSystemPrompt = configBlock ? `${configBlock}\n\n${systemPrompt}` : systemPrompt;

  const response = await client.messages.create({
    model: aiConfig.model,
    max_tokens: aiConfig.maxTokens,
    system: finalSystemPrompt,
    messages: [{ role: "user", content: userPrompt }],
  });

  const text = response.content
    .filter((b) => b.type === "text")
    .map((b) => (b.type === "text" ? b.text : ""))
    .join("");

  const clean = text.replace(/```json\s*/g, "").replace(/```\s*/g, "").trim();

  try {
    const rows = JSON.parse(clean);

    logEvent({
      userEmail: session?.user?.email,
      userName: session?.user?.name,
      section: "seo",
      action: "claude:rufus:analyze",
      status: "success",
      resourceLabel: `${brandName} — ${productName}`,
      message: `Analyzed ${rows.length} Q&A pairs`,
      detail: { qaIn: (allQA || []).length, rowsOut: rows.length, usage: response.usage },
      durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ rows, usage: response.usage });
  } catch {
    console.error("Rufus analyze parse failed:", clean.substring(0, 200));

    logEvent({
      userEmail: session?.user?.email,
      userName: session?.user?.name,
      section: "seo",
      action: "claude:rufus:analyze",
      status: "warning",
      resourceLabel: `${brandName} — ${productName}`,
      message: "AI response parse failed — returned fallback rows",
      detail: { qaIn: (allQA || []).length, usage: response.usage },
      durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,
    });

    const rows = (allQA || []).map((qa: any) => ({
      ASIN: "ParentASIN",
      RufusQuestion: qa.question,
      RufusAnswer: qa.answer,
      RufusQuestionCategory: "Parse Error",
      RufusInsightType: "Parse Error",
      RufusPrimaryObjectionAddressed: "Not analyzed",
      RufusPrimaryDesireAddressed: "Not analyzed",
      RufusCOSMORelationship: "Not analyzed",
      RufusUsageContext: "Not analyzed",
      RufusNotes: "AI analysis failed — re-run",
    }));
    return NextResponse.json({ rows, usage: response.usage });
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getConfigDocBlock } from "@/lib/seo-config-doc";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { logEvent } from "@/lib/event-logger";
import { getAiFeatureConfig } from "@/lib/ai-config.server";
import { CONTENT_VOICES, CHAR_LIMITS } from "@/lib/seo-pipeline-config";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, varietyPackItems } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, inArray } from "drizzle-orm";
import { loadCompetitiveData } from "@/lib/seo-skill-runner";
import { checkRateLimit } from "@/lib/rate-limit";

export const maxDuration = 60;

/** Filter COSMO rows by PDP section for targeted prompt injection */
function filterCosmoForSection(cosmo: any[], section: string): any[] {
  return cosmo.filter((c: any) =>
    c.COSMOAppliedPDPSection1 === section || c.COSMOAppliedPDPSection2 === section
  );
}

/** Format COSMO rows with PDP context for prompts */
function formatCosmoBlock(cosmo: any[], label: string): string {
  if (!cosmo.length) return "";
  return `\n${label}:\n${cosmo.map((c: any) =>
    `- ${c.COSMORelationType}: ${c.COSMOMappedValue} → ${c.COSMOUsageExplanation || ""}`
  ).join("\n")}`;
}

/** Build content voice instruction */
function getVoiceInstruction(voice?: string): string {
  const v = (voice && voice in CONTENT_VOICES)
    ? CONTENT_VOICES[voice as keyof typeof CONTENT_VOICES]
    : CONTENT_VOICES.natural;
  return `\nCONTENT VOICE: ${v}`;
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  const startTime = Date.now();

  // Rate limit: 10 requests per minute per user
  const rlKey = session?.user?.email || req.headers.get("x-forwarded-for") || "anonymous";
  const rl = checkRateLimit(rlKey, 10, 60_000);
  if (!rl.success) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Rate limit exceeded. Try again later." },
      { status: 429, headers: { "Retry-After": String(Math.ceil((rl.resetAt - Date.now()) / 1000)) } }
    );
  }

OUTPUT FORMAT: Return a JSON array. Each object = one ASIN with these exact keys:

    case "backend": {

  // ── Helper: call Claude and parse JSON array from response ──
  async function callClaudeAndParse(sysPrompt: string, usrPrompt: string, model: string, maxTokens: number) {
    const claudeRes = await fetch("https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "x-api-key": apiKey!,
        "anthropic-version": "2023-06-01",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        model,
        max_tokens: maxTokens,
        system: sysPrompt,
        messages: [{ role: "user", content: usrPrompt }],
      }),
    });

    if (!claudeRes.ok) {
      const errText = await claudeRes.text();
      throw new Error(`Claude API ${claudeRes.status}: ${errText}`);
    }

    const claudeData = await claudeRes.json();
    const text = claudeData.content?.[0]?.text || "";

    // Strip markdown code fences, then find balanced JSON array
    const cleaned = text.replace(/```(?:json)?\s*/gi, "").replace(/```/g, "").trim();
    const arrStart = cleaned.indexOf("[");
    if (arrStart === -1) throw new Error("No JSON array in Claude response");
    let depth = 0;
    let arrEnd = -1;
    let inString = false;
    let escape = false;
    for (let i = arrStart; i < cleaned.length; i++) {
      const ch = cleaned[i];
      if (escape) { escape = false; continue; }
      if (ch === "\\") { escape = true; continue; }
      if (ch === '"') { inString = !inString; continue; }
      if (inString) continue;
      if (ch === "[") depth++;
      else if (ch === "]") { depth--; if (depth === 0) { arrEnd = i; break; } }
    }
    let jsonStr: string;
    if (arrEnd === -1) {
      const partial = cleaned.slice(arrStart);
      let candidate = "";
      let pos = partial.lastIndexOf("}");
      while (pos > 0) {
        candidate = partial.slice(0, pos + 1) + "]";
        try { JSON.parse(candidate); break; } catch { candidate = ""; pos = partial.lastIndexOf("}", pos - 1); }
      }
      if (!candidate) throw new Error("No complete JSON array in Claude response");
      jsonStr = candidate;
    } else {
      jsonStr = cleaned.slice(arrStart, arrEnd + 1);
    }
    return { rows: JSON.parse(jsonStr) as any[], usage: claudeData.usage };
  }

  // ── Helper: compute char/byte lengths server-side ──
  function computeLengths(rows: any[]) {
    const SKIP_FIELDS = new Set(["ASIN"]);
    const BYTE_FIELDS = new Set(["BackendSearchTerms"]);
    for (const row of rows) {
      for (const key of Object.keys(row)) {
        if (SKIP_FIELDS.has(key) || key.endsWith("_CharLength") || key.endsWith("_ByteLength")) continue;
        if (typeof row[key] === "string") {
          if (BYTE_FIELDS.has(key)) {
            row[`${key}_ByteLength`] = new TextEncoder().encode(row[key]).length;
          } else {
            row[`${key}_CharLength`] = row[key].length;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  try {
    const configBlock = await getConfigDocBlock(6000);
    const finalSystemPrompt = configBlock ? `${configBlock}\n\n${systemPrompt}` : systemPrompt;

    let { rows, usage: totalUsage } = await callClaudeAndParse(finalSystemPrompt, userPrompt, aiConfig.model, aiConfig.maxTokens);

    // Normalize ASIN key — Claude sometimes returns lowercase "asin"
    for (const row of rows) {
      if (!row.ASIN && row.asin) {
        row.ASIN = row.asin;
        delete row.asin;
      }
      delete row.asin_CharLength;
    }

    // ── Auto-fix titles that miss character limits ──
    // One retry with exact per-title feedback, then programmatic padding/trimming as fallback
    if (batch === "titles") {
      const { min, max } = CHAR_LIMITS.title;

      const getFailingTitles = (r: any[]) => r.filter((row: any) => {
        const len = (row.Title || "").length;
        return len < min || len > max;
      });

      // One retry attempt — wrapped in try-catch so programmatic fallback always runs
      let failing = getFailingTitles(rows);
      if (failing.length > 0) {
        console.log(`[SEO Titles] ${failing.length} titles out of range, retrying...`);
        try {
          const failLines = failing.map((r: any) =>
            `{"ASIN":"${r.ASIN}","Title":"${r.Title}","chars":${(r.Title||"").length},"need":${min - (r.Title||"").length}}`
          ).join("\n");

          const retryPrompt = `Expand these titles to ${min}-${max} chars each. Add keywords with " - " separators.\n\n${failLines}\n\nKeywords: ${tier1.concat(tier2).slice(0, 10).map((k: any) => k.KeywordText).join(", ")}\n\nReturn ONLY JSON array: [{"ASIN":"...","Title":"..."}]`;

          const retry = await callClaudeAndParse(finalSystemPrompt, retryPrompt, aiConfig.model, aiConfig.maxTokens);
          const retryMap = new Map(retry.rows.map((r: any) => [r.ASIN, r.Title]));
          for (const row of rows) {
            const newTitle = retryMap.get(row.ASIN);
            if (newTitle && newTitle.length >= min && newTitle.length <= max) row.Title = newTitle;
          }
          totalUsage = {
            input_tokens: (totalUsage?.input_tokens || 0) + (retry.usage?.input_tokens || 0),
            output_tokens: (totalUsage?.output_tokens || 0) + (retry.usage?.output_tokens || 0),
          };
        } catch (e) {
          console.log(`[SEO Titles] Retry failed: ${(e as Error).message}, falling back to programmatic padding`);
        }
      }

      // Trim titles that exceed max (keep the readable part)
      for (const row of rows) {
        const len = (row.Title || "").length;
        if (len > max) {
          let trimmed = row.Title.slice(0, max);
          const lastSep = trimmed.lastIndexOf(" - ");
          if (lastSep > min - 20) trimmed = trimmed.slice(0, lastSep);
          row.Title = trimmed;
        }
      }
      console.log(`[SEO Titles] Final lengths: ${rows.map((r: any) => (r.Title||"").length).join(", ")}`);
    }

    computeLengths(rows);

    // Debug: verify padded titles are in response
    if (batch === "titles") {
      console.log(`[SEO Titles] Response row[0] Title length: ${(rows[0]?.Title || "").length}, Title_CharLength: ${rows[0]?.Title_CharLength}`);
    }

    logEvent({
      userEmail: session?.user?.email,
      userName: session?.user?.name,
      section: "seo",
      action: `claude:seo:${batch}`,
      status: "success",
      resourceLabel: brandName,
      message: `Generated ${batch} for ${rows.length} ASINs`,
      detail: { batch, asinsCount: rows.length, usage: totalUsage, hasFeedback: !!feedback },
      durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ rows, usage: totalUsage });
  } catch (err: any) {
    logEvent({
      userEmail: session?.user?.email,
      userName: session?.user?.name,
      section: "seo",
      action: `claude:seo:${batch}`,
      status: "error",
      resourceLabel: brandName,
      message: err.message || `Failed to generate ${batch}`,
      detail: { batch, error: err.message },
      durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

    },

    backend: null,
  },

function makeRequest(body: Record<string, unknown>) {
  return new NextRequest("http://localhost/api/seo/claude/seo-audit", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),

  keywords: [{ KeywordText: "test keyword", KeywordPriorityTier: "T1", SearchVolume: 1000 }],

  rufus: [{ RufusQuestion: "What is this?", RufusAnswer: "A test product" }],

describe("POST /api/seo/claude/seo-audit", () => {
  it("returns 500 when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is missing", async () => {
    delete process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY;
    const res = await POST(makeRequest(defaultBody));
    expect(res.status).toBe(500);
    const data = await res.json();
    expect(data.error).toContain("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY");
  });

  it("returns 403 when feature is disabled", async () => {
    process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "test-key";
    mockedGetAiFeatureConfig.mockResolvedValue({ ...aiConfig, enabled: false });
    const res = await POST(makeRequest(defaultBody));
    expect(res.status).toBe(403);
  });

  it("parses audit response with all 12 scores including geoScore", async () => {
    process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "test-key";

    // Mock Call 1: Score response
    mockFetch.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      ok: true,
      json: () => Promise.resolve({
        content: [{ text: JSON.stringify(validAuditResponse) }],
        usage: { input_tokens: 100, output_tokens: 200 },
      }),
    });

    const res = await POST(makeRequest(defaultBody));
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);

    const data = await res.json();
    expect(data.geoScore).toBe(60);
    expect(data.overallScore).toBe(75);
    expect(data.eeatScore).toBe(65);
    expect(data.readabilityScore).toBe(82);
    expect(data.citabilityScore).toBe(70);
    expect(data.findings).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(data.findings[0].asin).toBe("B0XXXXX");
    expect(data.findings[0].field).toBe("DetailedBulletPoint_3");
  });

  it("handles markdown-fenced JSON in response", async () => {
    process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "test-key";

    mockFetch.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      ok: true,
      json: () => Promise.resolve({
        content: [{ text: "```json\n" + JSON.stringify(validAuditResponse) + "\n```" }],
        usage: {},
      }),
    });

    const res = await POST(makeRequest(defaultBody));
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    const data = await res.json();
    expect(data.overallScore).toBe(75);
  });

  it("returns empty findings array gracefully", async () => {
    process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "test-key";

    const noFindings = { ...validAuditResponse, findings: [] };
    mockFetch.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      ok: true,
      json: () => Promise.resolve({
        content: [{ text: JSON.stringify(noFindings) }],
        usage: {},
      }),
    });

    const res = await POST(makeRequest(defaultBody));
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    const data = await res.json();
    expect(data.findings).toEqual([]);
    // No rewrite call should be made since no warning+ findings
    expect(mockFetch).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("triggers rewrite call for warning+ findings", async () => {
    process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "test-key";

    // Call 1: Score
    mockFetch.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      ok: true,
      json: () => Promise.resolve({
        content: [{ text: JSON.stringify(validAuditResponse) }],
        usage: {},
      }),
    });

    // Call 2: Rewrite
    mockFetch.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      ok: true,
      json: () => Promise.resolve({
        content: [{ text: JSON.stringify([{ index: 0, rewrite: "IMPROVED BULLET: Better content here" }]) }],
        usage: {},
      }),
    });

    const res = await POST(makeRequest(defaultBody));
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    const data = await res.json();
    expect(data.findings[0].rewrite).toBe("IMPROVED BULLET: Better content here");
    expect(mockFetch).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2); // Score + Rewrite
  });

  it("still returns scores when rewrite call fails", async () => {
    process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "test-key";

    // Call 1: Score succeeds
    mockFetch.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      ok: true,
      json: () => Promise.resolve({
        content: [{ text: JSON.stringify(validAuditResponse) }],
        usage: {},
      }),
    });

    // Call 2: Rewrite fails
    mockFetch.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      ok: false,
      text: () => Promise.resolve("Rate limit exceeded"),
    });

    const res = await POST(makeRequest(defaultBody));
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    const data = await res.json();
    expect(data.overallScore).toBe(75);
    expect(data.findings[0].rewrite).toBeUndefined(); // No rewrite since call failed
  });

  it("handles missing geoScore in response gracefully", async () => {
    process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "test-key";

    const noGeo = { ...validAuditResponse };
    delete (noGeo as any).geoScore;

    mockFetch.mockResolvedValueOnce({
      ok: true,
      json: () => Promise.resolve({
        content: [{ text: JSON.stringify(noGeo) }],
        usage: {},
      }),
    });

    const res = await POST(makeRequest(defaultBody));
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    const data = await res.json();
    expect(data.geoScore).toBeUndefined();
    expect(data.overallScore).toBe(75); // Other scores still work
  });
});

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getConfigDocBlock } from "@/lib/seo-config-doc";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { logEvent } from "@/lib/event-logger";
import { getAiFeatureConfig } from "@/lib/ai-config.server";

export const maxDuration = 120;

/** Extract a balanced JSON object from a string that may contain markdown fences */
function extractJsonObject(raw: string): Record<string, unknown> {
  const cleaned = raw.replace(/```(?:json)?\s*/gi, "").replace(/```/g, "").trim();
  const objStart = cleaned.indexOf("{");
  if (objStart === -1) throw new Error("No JSON in response");
  let depth = 0;
  let objEnd = -1;
  let inString = false;
  let escape = false;
  for (let i = objStart; i < cleaned.length; i++) {
    const ch = cleaned[i];
    if (escape) { escape = false; continue; }
    if (ch === "\\") { escape = true; continue; }
    if (ch === '"') { inString = !inString; continue; }
    if (inString) continue;
    if (ch === "{") depth++;
    else if (ch === "}") { depth--; if (depth === 0) { objEnd = i; break; } }
  }
  if (objEnd === -1) throw new Error("No complete JSON object in response");
  return JSON.parse(cleaned.slice(objStart, objEnd + 1));
}

/** Extract a balanced JSON array from a string */
function extractJsonArray(raw: string): unknown[] {
  const cleaned = raw.replace(/```(?:json)?\s*/gi, "").replace(/```/g, "").trim();
  const arrStart = cleaned.indexOf("[");
  if (arrStart === -1) throw new Error("No JSON array in response");
  let depth = 0;
  let arrEnd = -1;
  let inString = false;
  let escape = false;
  for (let i = arrStart; i < cleaned.length; i++) {
    const ch = cleaned[i];
    if (escape) { escape = false; continue; }
    if (ch === "\\") { escape = true; continue; }
    if (ch === '"') { inString = !inString; continue; }
    if (inString) continue;
    if (ch === "[") depth++;
    else if (ch === "]") { depth--; if (depth === 0) { arrEnd = i; break; } }
  }
  if (arrEnd === -1) throw new Error("No complete JSON array in response");
  return JSON.parse(cleaned.slice(arrStart, arrEnd + 1));
}

/** Call Claude API */
async function callClaude(
  apiKey: string,
  model: string,
  maxTokens: number,
  system: string,
  user: string,
): Promise<{ text: string; usage: unknown }> {
  const res = await fetch("https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "x-api-key": apiKey,
      "anthropic-version": "2023-06-01",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      model,
      max_tokens: maxTokens,
      system,
      messages: [{ role: "user", content: user }],
    }),
  });

  if (!res.ok) {
    const errText = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`Claude API ${res.status}: ${errText}`);
  }

  const data = await res.json();
  return { text: data.content?.[0]?.text || "", usage: data.usage };
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  const startTime = Date.now();

  const body = await req.json();
  const { brandName, rows, keywords, cosmo, rufus, reviews, guidelines } = body;

  const apiKey = process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY;
  if (!apiKey) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" }, { status: 500 });

  const aiConfig = await getAiFeatureConfig("seo_audit");
  if (!aiConfig.enabled) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Feature disabled" }, { status: 403 });

  // Build summary of generated content
  const contentSummary = rows.map((r: any) => {
    return `ASIN: ${r.ASIN} (${r.ParentageLevel})
Title: ${r.Title || "[empty]"}
DetailedB1: ${(r.DetailedBulletPoint_1 || "").substring(0, 120)}...
DetailedB2: ${(r.DetailedBulletPoint_2 || "").substring(0, 120)}...
DetailedB3: ${(r.DetailedBulletPoint_3 || "").substring(0, 120)}...
DetailedB4: ${(r.DetailedBulletPoint_4 || "").substring(0, 120)}...
DetailedB5: ${(r.DetailedBulletPoint_5 || "").substring(0, 120)}...
Description: ${(r.ProductDescription || "").substring(0, 200)}...
Backend: ${(r.BackendSearchTerms || "").substring(0, 200)}...`;
  }).join("\n\n");

  // Keyword tier breakdown
  const tier1 = keywords.filter((k: any) => k.KeywordPriorityTier === "T1").slice(0, 15);
  const tier2 = keywords.filter((k: any) => k.KeywordPriorityTier === "T2").slice(0, 15);

  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  // CALL 1: Score 12 categories + findings
  // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  const scoreSystemPrompt = `You are the 1o8 SEO Premium Audit Engine. You analyze generated Amazon listing content against research data to score quality and identify specific improvement opportunities.

Your audit covers 12 dimensions:
1. COMPLIANCE: Prohibited terms, medical claims, competitor names, emoji, colon misuse
2. KEYWORD COVERAGE: Tier 1 and Tier 2 keyword presence in titles, bullets, description
3. COSMO DENSITY: COSMO relationship expression (USED_FOR_FUNC, USED_TO, CAPABLE_OF, IS_A, USED_FOR_AUD)
4. RUFUS COVERAGE: Are Rufus questions answered in the content?
5. HUMAN VOICE: Natural readability vs keyword-stuffed/templated feel
6. BUYER JOURNEY: Title=Decision, B1-B2=Consideration, B3-B5=Decision, Desc=Awareness→Consideration
7. VARIATION CONSISTENCY: Child ASIN differentiation
8. E-E-A-T SIGNALS: Experience, Expertise, Authority, Trust — claims backed by evidence, knowledgeable voice
9. READABILITY: Flesch-Kincaid grade 8-10, scannable bullets, well-structured description
10. AI CITABILITY: Can AI assistants (Rufus, AI Overviews, ChatGPT) excerpt clean quotable passages? Clear Q&A structures?
11. GEO READINESS: Brand mention signals, passage citability for AI search, entity clarity, implicit Q&A structure for AI-powered discovery (Amazon Rufus, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, ChatGPT web search)
12. OVERALL: Weighted average of all dimensions

For each finding, be SPECIFIC — include which ASIN and which field (Title, DetailedBulletPoint_1-5, ProductDescription, BackendSearchTerms) is affected.

OUTPUT: Return ONLY valid JSON:
{
  "complianceScore": <0-100>,
  "keywordCoverage": <0-100>,
  "cosmoDensity": <0-100>,
  "rufusCoverage": <0-100>,
  "humanVoice": <0-100>,
  "buyerJourney": <0-100>,
  "variationConsistency": <0-100>,
  "eeatScore": <0-100>,
  "readabilityScore": <0-100>,
  "citabilityScore": <0-100>,
  "geoScore": <0-100>,
  "overallScore": <0-100>,
  "findings": [
    {
      "severity": "critical" | "warning" | "info",
      "category": "<audit dimension name>",
      "asin": "<specific ASIN or 'all'>",
      "field": "<Title|DetailedBulletPoint_1-5|ProductDescription|BackendSearchTerms|all>",
      "detail": "<what was found>",
      "suggestion": "<specific improvement instruction>",
      "batch": "titles" | "bullets" | "description" | "backend" | "all"
    }
  ],
  "remediation": {
    "titles": "<specific feedback for title regeneration or null>",
    "bullets": "<specific feedback for bullet regeneration or null>",
    "description": "<specific feedback for description regeneration or null>",
    "backend": "<specific feedback for backend regeneration or null>"
  }
}`;

  const scoreUserPrompt = `Audit this generated content against the research data.

BRAND: ${brandName}
${guidelines ? `BRAND GUIDELINES: ${guidelines.substring(0, 500)}` : ""}

═══ GENERATED CONTENT ═══
${contentSummary}

═══ RESEARCH DATA ═══

TIER 1 KEYWORDS (must appear in surface content):
${tier1.map((k: any) => `- "${k.KeywordText}" SV:${k.SearchVolume}`).join("\n")}

TIER 2 KEYWORDS (should appear where natural):
${tier2.map((k: any) => `- "${k.KeywordText}" SV:${k.SearchVolume}`).join("\n")}

COSMO RELATIONSHIPS (should be expressed in content):
${cosmo.slice(0, 15).map((c: any) => `${c.COSMORelationType}: ${c.COSMOMappedValue} → PDP: ${c.COSMOAppliedPDPSection1}`).join("\n")}

RUFUS QUESTIONS (should be answered in listing):
${rufus.slice(0, 5).map((r: any) => `Q: ${r.RufusQuestion}\nA: ${(r.RufusAnswer || "").substring(0, 150)}`).join("\n\n")}

REVIEW THEMES (should be addressed):
${reviews.slice(0, 10).map((r: any) => `${r.ReviewTheme || "Theme"}: ${(r.ReviewRufusUsableInsight || "").substring(0, 100)}`).join("\n")}

Return ONLY valid JSON.`;

  try {
    const configBlock = await getConfigDocBlock(4000);
    const finalScoreSystemPrompt = configBlock
      ? `${configBlock}\n\n${scoreSystemPrompt}`
      : scoreSystemPrompt;

    // Call 1: Score + findings
    const scoreResponse = await callClaude(
      apiKey,
      aiConfig.model,
      aiConfig.maxTokens,
      finalScoreSystemPrompt,
      scoreUserPrompt,
    );

    const result = extractJsonObject(scoreResponse.text) as any;

    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // CALL 2: Generate rewrite suggestions for warning+ findings
    // ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    const rewritableFindings = (result.findings || []).filter(
      (f: any) => f.severity === "critical" || f.severity === "warning"
    );

    if (rewritableFindings.length > 0) {
      try {
        const rewriteSystemPrompt = `You are a premium Amazon listing copywriter. For each content finding below, write a specific replacement text that fixes the identified issue while maintaining compliance, keyword coverage, and natural voice.

Rules:
- Match the original field's character limits (Title: 190-200, Detailed bullets: 390-400, Description: 1000-1200, Backend: ≤500 bytes)
- Maintain ALL CAPS header + colon format for bullets
- No medical claims, competitor names, emoji, or colon in titles/descriptions
- Preserve existing keyword coverage while fixing the issue
- Write as if you're a product expert, not a copywriter

OUTPUT: Return ONLY a valid JSON array. Each object:
{ "index": <finding index 0-based>, "rewrite": "<the complete replacement text for the field>" }`;

        const findingsSummary = rewritableFindings.map((f: any, i: number) => {
          // Find the current text for this finding
          const row = rows.find((r: any) => r.ASIN === f.asin);
          const currentText = row ? (row[f.field] || "") : "";
          return `[${i}] ASIN: ${f.asin} | Field: ${f.field} | Issue: ${f.detail} | Suggestion: ${f.suggestion}
Current text: ${(currentText as string).substring(0, 300)}`;
        }).join("\n\n");

        const rewriteResponse = await callClaude(
          apiKey,
          aiConfig.model,
          Math.min(aiConfig.maxTokens, 8192),
          rewriteSystemPrompt,
          `Generate rewrites for these ${rewritableFindings.length} findings:\n\n${findingsSummary}\n\nReturn ONLY valid JSON array.`,
        );

        const rewrites = extractJsonArray(rewriteResponse.text) as any[];

        // Merge rewrites back into findings
        for (const rw of rewrites) {
          if (typeof rw.index === "number" && rw.index < rewritableFindings.length && rw.rewrite) {
            // Find this finding in the original result.findings array
            const originalFinding = result.findings.find(
              (f: any) =>
                f.asin === rewritableFindings[rw.index].asin &&
                f.field === rewritableFindings[rw.index].field &&
                f.detail === rewritableFindings[rw.index].detail
            );
            if (originalFinding) {
              originalFinding.rewrite = rw.rewrite;
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (rewriteErr: any) {
        // Rewrite call failed — scores still valid, just no rewrites
        logEvent({
          userEmail: session?.user?.email,
          section: "seo",
          action: "claude:seo-audit:rewrite",
          status: "error",
          message: `Rewrite generation failed: ${rewriteErr.message}`,
          durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,
        });
      }
    }

    logEvent({
      userEmail: session?.user?.email,
      userName: session?.user?.name,
      section: "seo",
      action: "claude:seo-audit",
      status: "success",
      resourceLabel: brandName,
      message: `Premium audit complete — score ${result.overallScore}/100, ${result.findings?.length || 0} findings, ${rewritableFindings.length} rewrites`,
      detail: {
        overallScore: result.overallScore,
        geoScore: result.geoScore,
        findingsCount: result.findings?.length || 0,
        rewriteCount: rewritableFindings.length,
        usage: scoreResponse.usage,
      },
      durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,
    });

    return NextResponse.json(result);
  } catch (err: any) {
    logEvent({
      userEmail: session?.user?.email,
      userName: session?.user?.name,
      section: "seo",
      action: "claude:seo-audit",
      status: "error",
      resourceLabel: brandName,
      message: err.message || "SEO audit failed",
      detail: { error: err.message },
      durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { seoProjects, seoAsins, seoExports, seoQualityScores, users, aac, variations } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { eq, desc, count, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

export async function GET(
  _req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ clientId: string }> }
) {
  try {
    const session = await getAuthSession();
    if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

    const { clientId } = await params;

    // Parallel queries
    const [projectRows, clientRow] = await Promise.all([
      // Projects for this client, joined with users
      db
        .select({
          id: seoProjects.id,
          name: seoProjects.name,
          brandName: seoProjects.brandName,
          status: seoProjects.status,
          currentPhase: seoProjects.currentPhase,
          clientIdCode: seoProjects.clientIdCode,
          createdBy: seoProjects.createdBy,
          assignedTo: seoProjects.assignedTo,
          createdAt: seoProjects.createdAt,
          updatedAt: seoProjects.updatedAt,
          s1ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s1ApprovedAt,
          s2ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s2ApprovedAt,
          s3ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s3ApprovedAt,
          s4ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s4ApprovedAt,
          s5ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s5ApprovedAt,
          s6ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s6ApprovedAt,
          variationId: seoProjects.variationId,
          version: seoProjects.version,
          assigneeName: users.name,
          assigneeImage: users.image,
          variationName: variations.name,
          variationCode: variations.code,
        })
        .from(seoProjects)
        .leftJoin(users, eq(seoProjects.assignedTo, users.id))
        .leftJoin(variations, eq(seoProjects.variationId, variations.id))
        .where(eq(seoProjects.clientIdCode, clientId))
        .orderBy(desc(seoProjects.createdAt)),

      // Client name lookup
      db
        .select({
          clientIdCode: aac.clientIdCode,
          clientName: aac.clientName,
        })
        .from(aac)
        .where(eq(aac.clientIdCode, clientId))
        .limit(1),
    ]);

    const projectIds = projectRows.map((p) => p.id);
    const clientName = clientRow[0]?.clientName ?? clientId;

    // Get ASIN counts and exports for these projects (only if projects exist)
    let asinCount = 0;
    let allExports: Array<{
      id: string;
      projectId: string;
      type: string;
      url: string | null;
      createdAt: Date;
    }> = [];

    if (projectIds.length > 0) {
      const [asinRows, exportRows] = await Promise.all([
        db
          .select({
            projectId: seoAsins.projectId,
            count: count(),
          })
          .from(seoAsins)
          .where(eq(seoAsins.projectId, projectIds[0]!))
          .groupBy(seoAsins.projectId),

        db
          .select({
            id: seoExports.id,
            projectId: seoExports.projectId,
            type: seoExports.type,
            url: seoExports.url,
            createdAt: seoExports.createdAt,
          })
          .from(seoExports)
          .orderBy(desc(seoExports.createdAt))
          .limit(50),
      ]);

      // For multiple projects, we need to sum up ASINs across all projects
      // The simple eq above only works for one project; let's use a broader approach
      // Re-query for all project ASIN counts
      if (projectIds.length > 1) {
        const allAsinRows = await db
          .select({
            projectId: seoAsins.projectId,
            count: count(),
          })
          .from(seoAsins)
          .groupBy(seoAsins.projectId);

        const asinMap: Record<string, number> = {};
        for (const r of allAsinRows) {
          asinMap[r.projectId] = Number(r.count);
        }
        asinCount = projectIds.reduce((sum, id) => sum + (asinMap[id] || 0), 0);
      } else {
        asinCount = asinRows.reduce((sum, r) => sum + Number(r.count), 0);
      }

      // Filter exports to only this client's projects
      const projectIdSet = new Set(projectIds);
      allExports = exportRows.filter((e) => projectIdSet.has(e.projectId));
    }

    // Quality score history per project (last 10 scores per project)
    const qualityScoreRows = projectIds.length > 0
      ? await db
          .select({
            projectId: seoQualityScores.projectId,
            overallScore: seoQualityScores.overallScore,
            createdAt: seoQualityScores.createdAt,
          })
          .from(seoQualityScores)
          .orderBy(desc(seoQualityScores.createdAt))
      : [];

    // Group by project, keep last 10 per project
    const qualityByProject = new Map<string, number[]>();
    for (const row of qualityScoreRows) {
      if (!projectIds.includes(row.projectId)) continue;
      const existing = qualityByProject.get(row.projectId) || [];
      if (existing.length < 10) {
        existing.push(row.overallScore);
        qualityByProject.set(row.projectId, existing);
      }
    }

    // Content previews from seoAsins (first ASIN per project with generated content)
    const contentRows = projectIds.length > 0
      ? await db
          .select({
            projectId: seoAsins.projectId,
            generatedContent: seoAsins.generatedContent,
          })
          .from(seoAsins)
      : [];

    const contentMap = new Map<string, { title: string; bullet1: string; description: string }>();
    for (const row of contentRows) {
      if (!projectIds.includes(row.projectId) || contentMap.has(row.projectId)) continue;
      const gc = row.generatedContent as Record<string, string> | null;
      if (gc?.item_name) {
        contentMap.set(row.projectId, {
          title: gc.item_name || "",
          bullet1: gc.detailed_bullet_1 || gc.bullet_1 || "",
          description: gc.product_description || "",
        });
      }
    }

    // Export info per project
    const exportMap = new Map<string, { export_count: number; last_exported_at: string; last_url: string | null }>();
    for (const e of allExports) {
      const existing = exportMap.get(e.projectId);
      if (!existing) {
        exportMap.set(e.projectId, {
          export_count: 1,
          last_exported_at: e.createdAt.toISOString(),
          last_url: e.url,
        });
      } else {
        existing.export_count++;
      }
    }

    // Build projects response
    const projects = projectRows.map((p) => ({
      id: p.id,
      name: p.name,
      brand_name: p.brandName,
      status: p.status,
      current_phase: p.currentPhase,
      client_id_code: p.clientIdCode,
      created_by: p.createdBy,
      assigned_to: p.assignedTo,
      assignee_name: p.assigneeName,
      assignee_image: p.assigneeImage,
      created_at: p.createdAt,
      updated_at: p.updatedAt,
      s1_approved_at: p.s1ApprovedAt,
      s2_approved_at: p.s2ApprovedAt,
      s3_approved_at: p.s3ApprovedAt,
      s4_approved_at: p.s4ApprovedAt,
      s5_approved_at: p.s5ApprovedAt,
      s6_approved_at: p.s6ApprovedAt,
      variation_id: p.variationId,
      variation_name: p.variationName,
      variation_code: p.variationCode,
      version: p.version,
      quality_scores: qualityByProject.get(p.id) || [],
      content_preview: contentMap.get(p.id) || null,
      quality_score: (qualityByProject.get(p.id) || []).length > 0
        ? { overall_score: (qualityByProject.get(p.id) || [])[0], scored_at: "" }
        : null,
      export_info: exportMap.get(p.id) || null,
    }));

    // Phase breakdown
    const phaseBreakdown = { S1: 0, S2: 0, S3: 0, S4: 0, S5: 0, S6: 0, completed: 0 };
    for (const p of projectRows) {
      if (p.status === "completed") {
        phaseBreakdown.completed++;
      } else {
        const phase = p.currentPhase as keyof typeof phaseBreakdown;
        if (phase in phaseBreakdown && phase !== "completed") {
          (phaseBreakdown as Record<string, number>)[phase]++;
        }
      }
    }

    const recentExports = allExports.slice(0, 10).map((e) => ({
      id: e.id,
      projectId: e.projectId,
      type: e.type,
      url: e.url,
      createdAt: e.createdAt,
    }));

    return NextResponse.json({
      clientIdCode: clientId,
      clientName,
      projects,
      asinCount,
      exportCount: allExports.length,
      recentExports,
      phaseBreakdown,
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { seoSettings } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const settingsKey = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("key") || "config_doc";
    const rows = await db.select().from(seoSettings).where(eq(seoSettings.key, settingsKey)).limit(1);
    const value = rows[0]?.value ?? "";
    const updatedAt = rows[0]?.updatedAt ?? null;
    const updatedBy = rows[0]?.updatedBy ?? "";
    return NextResponse.json({ value, updated_at: updatedAt, updated_by: updatedBy });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const session = await getAuthSession();
    if (!session || session.user.role !== "admin") {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Admin only" }, { status: 403 });
    }
    const body = await req.json();
    const settingsKey = body.key || "config_doc";
    const value = body.value;
    if (typeof value !== "string") {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "value must be a string" }, { status: 400 });
    }
    const [row] = await db
      .insert(seoSettings)
      .values({ key: settingsKey, value, updatedBy: session.user.email! })
      .onConflictDoUpdate({
        target: seoSettings.key,
        set: { value, updatedAt: new Date(), updatedBy: session.user.email! },
      })
      .returning();
    return NextResponse.json({ value: row.value, updated_at: row.updatedAt, updated_by: row.updatedBy });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: src/app/api/seo/dashboard/route.ts
================================================
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { seoProjects, seoAsins, seoExports, users, aac } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { eq, desc, sql, count } from "drizzle-orm";

export const maxDuration = 60;

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const session = await getAuthSession();
    if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

    // Parallel queries
    const [projectRows, asinCounts, recentExports, clientRows] = await Promise.all([
      // 1. Projects + users join
      db
        .select({
          id: seoProjects.id,
          name: seoProjects.name,
          brandName: seoProjects.brandName,
          status: seoProjects.status,
          currentPhase: seoProjects.currentPhase,
          clientIdCode: seoProjects.clientIdCode,
          assignedTo: seoProjects.assignedTo,
          createdAt: seoProjects.createdAt,
          updatedAt: seoProjects.updatedAt,
          s1ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s1ApprovedAt,
          s2ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s2ApprovedAt,
          s3ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s3ApprovedAt,
          s4ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s4ApprovedAt,
          s5ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s5ApprovedAt,
          s6ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s6ApprovedAt,
          assigneeName: users.name,
          assigneeImage: users.image,
        })
        .from(seoProjects)
        .leftJoin(users, eq(seoProjects.assignedTo, users.id))
        .orderBy(desc(seoProjects.createdAt)),

      // 2. ASIN counts by project
      db
        .select({
          projectId: seoAsins.projectId,
          count: count(),
        })
        .from(seoAsins)
        .groupBy(seoAsins.projectId),

      // 3. Recent exports (last 30 days)
      db
        .select({
          id: seoExports.id,
          projectId: seoExports.projectId,
          type: seoExports.type,
          url: seoExports.url,
          createdAt: seoExports.createdAt,
        })
        .from(seoExports)
        .where(sql`${seoExports.createdAt} > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'`)
        .orderBy(desc(seoExports.createdAt))
        .limit(30),

      // 4. Client name lookup
      db
        .select({
          clientIdCode: aac.clientIdCode,
          clientName: aac.clientName,
        })
        .from(aac),
    ]);

    // Build lookup maps
    const clientNameMap: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const c of clientRows) {
      clientNameMap[c.clientIdCode] = c.clientName ?? c.clientIdCode;
    }

    const asinCountMap: Record<string, number> = {};
    let totalAsins = 0;
    for (const row of asinCounts) {
      asinCountMap[row.projectId] = Number(row.count);
      totalAsins += Number(row.count);
    }

    // Filter non-archived projects for metrics
    const active = projectRows.filter((p) => p.status !== "archived");
    const now = new Date();
    const startOfMonth = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1);

    // --- Metrics ---
    const totalProjects = active.length;
    const activeProjects = active.filter((p) => p.status === "in_progress").length;
    const completedThisMonth = active.filter(
      (p) => p.status === "completed" && p.updatedAt && new Date(p.updatedAt) >= startOfMonth
    ).length;
    const exportsThisMonth = recentExports.filter(
      (e) => new Date(e.createdAt) >= startOfMonth
    ).length;

    // Average progress: each approval = 16.67%
    function countApprovals(p: (typeof projectRows)[0]): number {
      let n = 0;
      if (p.s1ApprovedAt) n++;
      if (p.s2ApprovedAt) n++;
      if (p.s3ApprovedAt) n++;
      if (p.s4ApprovedAt) n++;
      if (p.s5ApprovedAt) n++;
      if (p.s6ApprovedAt) n++;
      return n;
    }

    const avgProgress =
      active.length > 0
        ? Math.round(
            (active.reduce((sum, p) => sum + countApprovals(p) * 16.67, 0) / active.length) * 100
          ) / 100
        : 0;

    // --- Clients ---
    const clientGroups: Record<string, (typeof projectRows)[0][]> = {};
    for (const p of active) {
      if (!p.clientIdCode) continue;
      if (!clientGroups[p.clientIdCode]) clientGroups[p.clientIdCode] = [];
      clientGroups[p.clientIdCode].push(p);
    }

    const clients = Object.entries(clientGroups).map(([clientIdCode, projects]) => {
      const completedCount = projects.filter((p) => p.status === "completed").length;
      const avgProg =
        projects.length > 0
          ? Math.round(
              (projects.reduce((sum, p) => sum + countApprovals(p) * 16.67, 0) / projects.length) *
                100
            ) / 100
          : 0;

      const phaseBreakdown = { S1: 0, S2: 0, S3: 0, S4: 0, S5: 0, S6: 0 };
      for (const p of projects) {
        const phase = p.currentPhase as keyof typeof phaseBreakdown;
        if (phase in phaseBreakdown) phaseBreakdown[phase]++;
      }

      const asinCount = projects.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (asinCountMap[p.id] || 0), 0);

      return {
        clientIdCode,
        clientName: clientNameMap[clientIdCode] || clientIdCode,
        projectCount: projects.length,
        completedCount,
        avgProgress: avgProg,
        phaseBreakdown,
        asinCount,
      };
    });

    // --- Team ---
    const teamMap: Record<string, { id: string; name: string | null; image: string | null; projectCount: number }> = {};
    for (const p of active) {
      if (!p.assignedTo) continue;
      if (!teamMap[p.assignedTo]) {
        teamMap[p.assignedTo] = {
          id: p.assignedTo,
          name: p.assigneeName,
          image: p.assigneeImage,
          projectCount: 0,
        };
      }
      teamMap[p.assignedTo].projectCount++;
    }
    const team = Object.values(teamMap);

    // --- Funnel ---
    const funnel = { S1: 0, S2: 0, S3: 0, S4: 0, S5: 0, S6: 0, completed: 0 };
    for (const p of active) {
      if (p.status === "completed") {
        funnel.completed++;
      } else {
        const phase = p.currentPhase as keyof typeof funnel;
        if (phase in funnel && phase !== "completed") {
          (funnel as Record<string, number>)[phase]++;
        }
      }
    }

    // --- Stale projects (idle 7+ days, not completed/archived) ---
    const sevenDaysAgo = new Date(now.getTime() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const stale: Array<{
      id: string;
      name: string;
      clientIdCode: string | null;
      currentPhase: string;
      assigneeName: string | null;
      daysSinceActivity: number;
    }> = [];

    for (const p of projectRows) {
      if (p.status === "completed" || p.status === "archived") continue;

      // Find most recent activity timestamp
      const timestamps = [
        p.s1ApprovedAt,
        p.s2ApprovedAt,
        p.s3ApprovedAt,
        p.s4ApprovedAt,
        p.s5ApprovedAt,
        p.s6ApprovedAt,
      ].filter(Boolean) as Date[];

      const lastActivity =
        timestamps.length > 0
          ? new Date(Math.max(...timestamps.map((t) => new Date(t).getTime())))
          : new Date(p.createdAt);

      if (lastActivity < sevenDaysAgo) {
        const daysSinceActivity = Math.floor(
          (now.getTime() - lastActivity.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)
        );
        stale.push({
          id: p.id,
          name: p.name,
          clientIdCode: p.clientIdCode,
          currentPhase: p.currentPhase,
          assigneeName: p.assigneeName,
          daysSinceActivity,
        });
      }
    }

    // Sort stale by days descending
    stale.sort((a, b) => b.daysSinceActivity - a.daysSinceActivity);

    // --- Activity feed ---
    const activityItems: Array<{
      type: "approval" | "export";
      projectId: string;
      projectName: string;
      detail: string;
      actorName: string | null;
      timestamp: string;
    }> = [];

    const phaseLabels: Record<string, string> = {
      s1: "S1 Intake",
      s2: "S2 Keywords",
      s3: "S3 Reviews",
      s4: "S4 Rufus",
      s5: "S5 COSMO",
      s6: "S6 SEO Content",
    };

    for (const p of projectRows) {
      const approvals = [
        { key: "s1", at: p.s1ApprovedAt },
        { key: "s2", at: p.s2ApprovedAt },
        { key: "s3", at: p.s3ApprovedAt },
        { key: "s4", at: p.s4ApprovedAt },
        { key: "s5", at: p.s5ApprovedAt },
        { key: "s6", at: p.s6ApprovedAt },
      ];

      for (const a of approvals) {
        if (a.at) {
          activityItems.push({
            type: "approval",
            projectId: p.id,
            projectName: p.name,
            detail: `${phaseLabels[a.key]} approved`,
            actorName: p.assigneeName,
            timestamp: new Date(a.at).toISOString(),
          });
        }
      }
    }

    // Merge exports into activity
    // Build project name lookup for exports
    const projectNameMap: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const p of projectRows) {
      projectNameMap[p.id] = p.name;
    }

    for (const e of recentExports) {
      activityItems.push({
        type: "export",
        projectId: e.projectId,
        projectName: projectNameMap[e.projectId] || "Unknown",
        detail: `Exported to ${e.type === "google_doc" ? "Google Drive" : e.type?.toUpperCase() || "file"}`,
        actorName: null,
        timestamp: new Date(e.createdAt).toISOString(),
      });
    }

    // Sort by timestamp desc, take top 15
    activityItems.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp).getTime());
    const activity = activityItems.slice(0, 15);

    // --- Completed in last 30 days ---
    const thirtyDaysAgo = new Date(now.getTime() - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const completed: Array<{
      id: string;
      name: string;
      clientIdCode: string | null;
      completedAt: string;
      daysToComplete: number;
    }> = [];

    for (const p of projectRows) {
      if (p.status !== "completed" || !p.updatedAt) continue;
      const completedAt = new Date(p.updatedAt);
      if (completedAt < thirtyDaysAgo) continue;

      const daysToComplete = Math.max(
        1,
        Math.floor(
          (completedAt.getTime() - new Date(p.createdAt).getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)
        )
      );

      completed.push({
        id: p.id,
        name: p.name,
        clientIdCode: p.clientIdCode,
        completedAt: completedAt.toISOString(),
        daysToComplete,
      });
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      metrics: {
        totalProjects,
        activeProjects,
        completedThisMonth,
        totalAsins,
        exportsThisMonth,
        avgProgress,
      },
      clients,
      team,
      funnel,
      stale,
      activity,
      completed,
    });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
