// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Document Text Extraction API
// POST /api/extract-doc
// Supports: .pdf (via Claude vision), .docx/.doc (mammoth), .txt/.md (native)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";
import { getAiFeatureConfig } from "@/lib/ai-config.server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";

const anthropic = new Anthropic({ apiKey: process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, fetch: fetch });

// Max file size: 20MB (Anthropic PDF limit is 32MB base64 ≈ 24MB raw)
const MAX_FILE_SIZE = 20 * 1024 * 1024;

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const formData = await req.formData();
    const file = formData.get("file") as File | null;
    if (!file) return NextResponse.json({ error: "No file provided" }, { status: 400 });

    if (file.size > MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: `File too large (${(file.size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(1)}MB). Max 20MB. Try compressing or splitting the PDF.` },
        { status: 413 }
      );
    }

    const aiConfig = await getAiFeatureConfig("seo_extract_doc");
    if (!aiConfig.enabled) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Feature disabled" }, { status: 403 });

    const filename = file.name;
    const ext = filename.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() ?? "";
    const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const buffer = Buffer.from(bytes);

    // ── TXT / MD — read directly ──────────────────────────
    if (ext === "txt" || ext === "md") {
      const text = buffer.toString("utf-8");
      return NextResponse.json({ text, filename, method: "plaintext" });
    }

    // ── DOCX / DOC — mammoth ──────────────────────────────
    if (ext === "docx" || ext === "doc") {
      try {
        // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-var-requires
        const mammoth = require("mammoth");
        const result = await mammoth.extractRawText({ buffer });
        const text = result.value?.trim() ?? "";
        if (!text) throw new Error("empty");
        return NextResponse.json({ text, filename, method: "mammoth" });
      } catch {
        const text = await extractDocxFallback(buffer);
        if (text) return NextResponse.json({ text, filename, method: "docx-fallback" });
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "Could not extract DOCX content." }, { status: 422 });
      }
    }

    // ── PDF — send to Claude as base64 document ───────────
    if (ext === "pdf") {
      try {
        const base64 = buffer.toString("base64");
        const response = await anthropic.messages.create({
          model: aiConfig.model,
          max_tokens: aiConfig.maxTokens,
          messages: [
            {
              role: "user",
              content: [
                {
                  type: "document",
                  source: {
                    type: "base64",
                    media_type: "application/pdf",
                    data: base64,
                  },
                } as any,
                {
                  type: "text",
                  text: "Extract ALL text from this document exactly as written. Return only the raw text content, preserving paragraphs and structure. No commentary, no summaries, no formatting changes.",
                },
              ],
            },
          ],
        });

        const text = response.content
          .filter((b) => b.type === "text")
          .map((b) => (b.type === "text" ? b.text : ""))
          .join("")
          .trim();

        if (!text) {
          return NextResponse.json(
            { error: "PDF appears to be empty or image-only with no readable text." },
            { status: 422 }
          );
        }
        return NextResponse.json({ text, filename, method: "claude-pdf" });
      } catch (err: any) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: `PDF extraction failed: ${err.message}` },
          { status: 422 }
        );
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ error: `Unsupported file type: .${ext}` }, { status: 415 });
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error("extract-doc error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message || "Extraction failed" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// ── Zero-dependency DOCX fallback ─────────────────────────────
async function extractDocxFallback(buffer: Buffer): Promise<string> {
  try {
    const { inflateRawSync } = await import("zlib");
    const data = buffer;
    let offset = 0;
    while (offset < data.length - 4) {
      if (
        data[offset] === 0x50 && data[offset + 1] === 0x4b &&
        data[offset + 2] === 0x03 && data[offset + 3] === 0x04
      ) {
        const compression = data.readUInt16LE(offset + 8);
        const compressedSize = data.readUInt32LE(offset + 18);
        const filenameLen = data.readUInt16LE(offset + 26);
        const extraLen = data.readUInt16LE(offset + 28);
        const filenameStart = offset + 30;
        const entryName = data.slice(filenameStart, filenameStart + filenameLen).toString("utf-8");
        const dataStart = filenameStart + filenameLen + extraLen;
        if (entryName === "word/document.xml" && compressedSize > 0) {
          const compressed = data.slice(dataStart, dataStart + compressedSize);
          const xmlBuf = compression === 0 ? compressed : inflateRawSync(compressed);
          return xmlBuf.toString("utf-8")
            .replace(/<w:br[^>]*\/>/g, "\n")
            .replace(/<w:p[ >][^>]*>/g, "\n")
            .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "")
            .replace(/&amp;/g, "&").replace(/&lt;/g, "<").replace(/&gt;/g, ">")
            .replace(/&quot;/g, '"').replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n").trim();
        }
        offset = dataStart + (compressedSize || 1);
      } else {
        offset++;
      }
    }
    return "";
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from "vitest";
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";

const { mockDb, mockedGetAuthSession } = vi.hoisted(() => {
  const chain: Record<string, ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>> = {};
  const methods = ["select", "from", "where", "orderBy", "limit", "insert", "update", "set", "values", "returning", "execute", "leftJoin"];
  for (const m of methods) {
    chain[m] = vi.fn().mockReturnValue(chain);
  }
  chain.orderBy = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([]);
  chain.returning = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([]);
  chain.execute = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([]);

  return {
    mockDb: chain,
    mockedGetAuthSession: vi.fn(),
  };

  });

    expect(body.status).toBe("draft");

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { seoProjects, seoAsins, seoExports, seoQualityScores, users, master, aac, variations } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { eq, desc, sql, inArray, and } from "drizzle-orm";

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const session = await getAuthSession();
    if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

    // 4-query bulk + JS join (avoids N+1)
    const [projectRows, contentRows, qualityRows, exportRows] = await Promise.all([
      // 1. Projects with assignee
      db
        .select({
          id: seoProjects.id,
          name: seoProjects.name,
          brandName: seoProjects.brandName,
          status: seoProjects.status,
          currentPhase: seoProjects.currentPhase,
          clientIdCode: seoProjects.clientIdCode,
          createdBy: seoProjects.createdBy,
          assignedTo: seoProjects.assignedTo,
          createdAt: seoProjects.createdAt,
          updatedAt: seoProjects.updatedAt,
          s1ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s1ApprovedAt,
          s2ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s2ApprovedAt,
          s3ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s3ApprovedAt,
          s4ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s4ApprovedAt,
          s5ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s5ApprovedAt,
          s6ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s6ApprovedAt,
          linkedProductId: seoProjects.linkedProductId,
          variationId: seoProjects.variationId,
          version: seoProjects.version,
          assigneeName: users.name,
          assigneeImage: users.image,
          variationName: variations.name,
          variationCode: variations.code,
        })
        .from(seoProjects)
        .leftJoin(users, eq(seoProjects.assignedTo, users.id))
        .leftJoin(variations, eq(seoProjects.variationId, variations.id))
        .orderBy(desc(seoProjects.createdAt)),

      // 2. Content previews from seo_asins (first ASIN per project with generatedContent)
      db
        .select({
          projectId: seoAsins.projectId,
          generatedContent: seoAsins.generatedContent,
          asin: seoAsins.asin,
        })
        .from(seoAsins),

      // 3. Latest quality score per project (most recent)
      db.execute<{
        project_id: string; overall_score: number; compliance_score: number | null;
        keyword_coverage: number | null; cosmo_density: number | null;
        rufus_coverage: number | null; human_voice: number | null;
        buyer_journey: number | null; variation_consistency: number | null;
        created_at: Date;
      }>(sql`
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (project_id)
          project_id, overall_score, compliance_score, keyword_coverage,
          cosmo_density, rufus_coverage, human_voice, buyer_journey,
          variation_consistency, findings_count, created_at
        FROM seo_quality_scores
        ORDER BY project_id, created_at DESC
      `),

      // 4. Export counts + latest export per project
      db.execute<{
        project_id: string; export_count: number;
        last_exported_at: Date; last_url: string | null;
      }>(sql`
        SELECT project_id, count(*)::int as export_count,
          max(created_at) as last_exported_at,
          (array_agg(url ORDER BY created_at DESC))[1] as last_url
        FROM seo_exports
        GROUP BY project_id
      `),
    ]);

    // Build lookup maps
    const contentMap = new Map<string, { title: string; bullet1: string; description: string }>();
    for (const row of contentRows) {
      if (contentMap.has(row.projectId)) continue;
      const gc = (row.generatedContent as unknown as Record<string, string>) || {};
      if (gc.Title) {
        contentMap.set(row.projectId, {
          title: gc.Title || "",
          bullet1: gc.DetailedBulletPoint_1 || gc.ConciseBulletPoint_1 || "",
          description: gc.ProductDescription || "",
        });
      }
    }

    const qualityMap = new Map<string, {
      overall_score: number;
      compliance_score: number | null;
      keyword_coverage: number | null;
      cosmo_density: number | null;
      rufus_coverage: number | null;
      human_voice: number | null;
      buyer_journey: number | null;
      variation_consistency: number | null;
      scored_at: string;
    }>();
    for (const row of qualityRows) {
      qualityMap.set(row.project_id, {
        overall_score: row.overall_score,
        compliance_score: row.compliance_score,
        keyword_coverage: row.keyword_coverage,
        cosmo_density: row.cosmo_density,
        rufus_coverage: row.rufus_coverage,
        human_voice: row.human_voice,
        buyer_journey: row.buyer_journey,
        variation_consistency: row.variation_consistency,
        scored_at: row.created_at?.toISOString?.() || "",
      });
    }

    const exportMap = new Map<string, {
      export_count: number;
      last_exported_at: string;
      last_url: string | null;
    }>();
    for (const row of exportRows) {
      exportMap.set(row.project_id, {
        export_count: row.export_count,
        last_exported_at: row.last_exported_at?.toISOString?.() || "",
        last_url: row.last_url,
      });
    }

    const projects = projectRows.map((p) => ({
      id: p.id,
      name: p.name,
      brand_name: p.brandName,
      status: p.status,
      current_phase: p.currentPhase,
      client_id_code: p.clientIdCode,
      created_by: p.createdBy,
      assigned_to: p.assignedTo,
      assignee_name: p.assigneeName,
      assignee_image: p.assigneeImage,
      created_at: p.createdAt,
      updated_at: p.updatedAt,
      s1_approved_at: p.s1ApprovedAt,
      s2_approved_at: p.s2ApprovedAt,
      s3_approved_at: p.s3ApprovedAt,
      s4_approved_at: p.s4ApprovedAt,
      s5_approved_at: p.s5ApprovedAt,
      s6_approved_at: p.s6ApprovedAt,
      linked_product_id: p.linkedProductId,
      variation_id: p.variationId,
      variation_name: p.variationName,
      variation_code: p.variationCode,
      version: p.version,
      // Enriched fields
      content_preview: contentMap.get(p.id) || null,
      quality_score: qualityMap.get(p.id) || null,
      export_info: exportMap.get(p.id) || null,
    }));

    return NextResponse.json(projects);
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unknown error";
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const session = await getAuthSession();
    if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

    const body = await req.json();
    const targeting = body.targeting as {
      mode: "family" | "group" | "single";
      product_ids: string[];
    } | undefined;

    // Validate client if targeting is provided
    if (targeting && body.client_id_code) {
      const [client] = await db
        .select({ clientIdCode: aac.clientIdCode, clientName: aac.clientName, rawData: aac.rawData })
        .from(aac)
        .where(eq(aac.clientIdCode, body.client_id_code))
        .limit(1);

      if (!client) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "Client not found" }, { status: 400 });
      }

      if (!targeting.product_ids?.length) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: "At least 1 product must be selected" }, { status: 400 });
      }

      // Validate product IDs belong to this client
      const selectedProducts = await db
        .select({
          id: master.id,
          asin: master.asin,
          sku: master.sku,
          parentageLevel: master.parentageLevel,
          parentAsin: master.parentAsin,
          parentSku: master.parentSku,
          itemName: master.itemName,
          summarizedTitle: master.summarizedTitle,
          mainImageUrl: master.mainImageUrl,
          variations: master.variations,
          variationGroup: master.variationGroup,
          contentSeo: master.contentSeo,
          genericKeywords: master.genericKeywords,
          brandName: master.brandName,
          clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode,
        })
        .from(master)
        .where(
          and(
            inArray(master.id, targeting.product_ids),
            eq(master.clientIdCode, body.client_id_code)
          )
        );

      if (selectedProducts.length !== targeting.product_ids.length) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { error: "Some product IDs do not belong to this client" },
          { status: 400 }
        );
      }

      // Extract competitor info from AAC rawData
      let raw: Record<string, string> = {};
      if (typeof client.rawData === "string") {
        try { raw = JSON.parse(client.rawData); } catch { /* ignore */ }
      } else if (client.rawData) {
        raw = client.rawData as Record<string, string>;
      }

      const competitors: Array<{ name: string; url: string }> = [];
      for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
        const name = raw[`Competitor${i}Name`]?.trim();
        const url = raw[`Competitor${i}URL`]?.trim() || "";
        if (name) competitors.push({ name, url });
      }

      // Create project + asins in a transaction to avoid orphaned projects
      const result = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
        const [project] = await tx
          .insert(seoProjects)
          .values({
            createdBy: session.user.email!,
            name: body.name || "New Project",
            brandName: body.brand_name || selectedProducts[0]?.brandName || "",
            status: "draft",
            currentPhase: "S1",
            assignedTo: body.assigned_to || null,
            clientIdCode: body.client_id_code,
            clientName: client.clientName || "",
            brandUrl: raw.BrandURL || raw.WebsiteURL || "",
            clientBibleUrl: raw.ClientBibleURL || "",
            competitors,
            contentRules: body.content_rules || null,
            date: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
          })
          .returning();

        // Insert seoAsins rows for each targeted product
        const asinRows = selectedProducts.map((p) => {
          const v = p.variations || {};
          const cs = p.contentSeo || {};
          return {
            projectId: project.id,
            asin: p.asin || "",
            sku: p.sku || "",
            parentageLevel: p.parentageLevel || "",
            variationId: v.VariationID || "",
            variationProduct: v.VariationProduct || "",
            variationThemeName: v.VariationThemeName || "",
            flavor: v.Flavor || "",
            style: v.Style || "",
            color: v.Color || "",
            size: v.Size || "",
            variationGroup: p.variationGroup || "",
            existingContent: {
              item_name: p.itemName || p.summarizedTitle || "",
              detailed_bullets: [
                cs.DetailedBulletPoint1 || "",
                cs.DetailedBulletPoint2 || "",
                cs.DetailedBulletPoint3 || "",
                cs.DetailedBulletPoint4 || "",
                cs.DetailedBulletPoint5 || "",
              ],
              product_description: cs.ProductDescription || "",
              generic_keywords: [
                p.genericKeywords || "",
              ].filter(Boolean),
              concise_bullets: [
                cs.ConciseBulletPoint1 || "",
                cs.ConciseBulletPoint2 || "",
                cs.ConciseBulletPoint3 || "",
                cs.ConciseBulletPoint4 || "",
                cs.ConciseBulletPoint5 || "",
              ],
              content_bullets: [
                cs.PA_LIBulletPoint1 || "",
                cs.PA_LIBulletPoint2 || "",
                cs.PA_LIBulletPoint3 || "",
                cs.PA_LIBulletPoint4 || "",
                cs.PA_LIBulletPoint5 || "",
              ],
              key_features: [
                cs.KeyFeature1 || "",
                cs.KeyFeature2 || "",
                cs.KeyFeature3 || "",
                cs.KeyFeature4 || "",
                cs.KeyFeature5 || "",
              ],
            },
          };
        });

        if (asinRows.length > 0) {
          await tx.insert(seoAsins).values(asinRows);
        }

        return { project, asinCount: asinRows.length };
      });

      return NextResponse.json({
        id: result.project.id,
        name: result.project.name,
        brand_name: result.project.brandName,
        status: result.project.status,
        current_phase: result.project.currentPhase,
        assigned_to: result.project.assignedTo,
        asin_count: result.asinCount,
      });
    }

    // Legacy create flow (no targeting — backwards compatible)
    let legacyVersion = 1;
    if (body.variation_id) {
      const [{ count }] = await db
        .select({ count: sql<number>`count(*)::int` })
        .from(seoProjects)
        .where(eq(seoProjects.variationId, body.variation_id));
      legacyVersion = (count || 0) + 1;
    }
    const [project] = await db
      .insert(seoProjects)
      .values({
        createdBy: session.user.email!,
        name: body.name || "New Project",
        brandName: body.brand_name || "",
        status: "draft",
        currentPhase: "S1",
        assignedTo: body.assigned_to || null,
        linkedProductId: body.linked_product_id || null,
        variationId: body.variation_id || null,
        version: legacyVersion,
        clientIdCode: body.client_id_code || null,
      })
      .returning();

    return NextResponse.json({
      id: project.id,
      name: project.name,
      brand_name: project.brandName,
      status: project.status,
      current_phase: project.currentPhase,
      assigned_to: project.assignedTo,
    });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error("[SEO Projects POST] Error:", err);
    const raw = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unknown error";
    const message = raw.startsWith("Failed query:") ? "Failed to create project" : raw;
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { seoProjects, variations } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";

export const maxDuration = 60;

function toSnakeCase(p: typeof seoProjects.$inferSelect, variation?: { name: string; code: string; primaryDimension: string | null; themeAttributes: string[] | null } | null) {
  return {
    id: p.id,
    name: p.name,
    brand_name: p.brandName,
    status: p.status,
    current_phase: p.currentPhase,
    client_id_code: p.clientIdCode,
    created_at: p.createdAt,
    updated_at: p.updatedAt,
    s1_approved_at: p.s1ApprovedAt,
    s2_approved_at: p.s2ApprovedAt,
    s3_approved_at: p.s3ApprovedAt,
    s4_approved_at: p.s4ApprovedAt,
    s5_approved_at: p.s5ApprovedAt,
    s6_approved_at: p.s6ApprovedAt,
    linked_product_id: p.linkedProductId,
    variation_id: p.variationId,
    brand_url: p.brandUrl,
    client_bible_url: p.clientBibleUrl,
    competitors: p.competitors,
    brand_guidelines: p.brandGuidelines,
    brand_guidelines_lock: p.brandGuidelinesLock,
    variety_pack_details: p.varietyPackDetails,
    version: p.version,
    variation: variation ? {
      name: variation.name,
      code: variation.code,
      primary_dimension: variation.primaryDimension,
      theme_attributes: variation.themeAttributes,
    } : null,
  };
}

export async function GET(_req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  try {
    const { id } = await params;
    const [project] = await db.select().from(seoProjects).where(eq(seoProjects.id, id)).limit(1);
    if (!project) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Not found" }, { status: 404 });
    let variation = null;
    if (project.variationId) {
      const [v] = await db.select({ name: variations.name, code: variations.code, primaryDimension: variations.primaryDimension, themeAttributes: variations.themeAttributes }).from(variations).where(eq(variations.id, project.variationId)).limit(1);
      variation = v || null;
    }
    return NextResponse.json(toSnakeCase(project, variation));
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  try {
    const { id } = await params;
    const body = await req.json();
    // Map snake_case body keys to Drizzle camelCase
    const update: Record<string, unknown> = { updatedAt: new Date() };
    if (body.name !== undefined) update.name = body.name;
    if (body.brand_name !== undefined) update.brandName = body.brand_name;
    if (body.status !== undefined) update.status = body.status;
    if (body.current_phase !== undefined) update.currentPhase = body.current_phase;
    if (body.assigned_to !== undefined) update.assignedTo = body.assigned_to || null;
    if (body.client_id_code !== undefined) update.clientIdCode = body.client_id_code || null;
    const [project] = await db.update(seoProjects).set(update).where(eq(seoProjects.id, id)).returning();
    return NextResponse.json(toSnakeCase(project));
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function DELETE(_req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  try {
    const session = await getAuthSession();
    if (!session || session.user.role === "viewer") {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
    }
    const { id } = await params;
    await db.delete(seoProjects).where(eq(seoProjects.id, id));
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { seoSettings } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";

function settingsKey(projectId: string) {
  return `audit_result:${projectId}`;
}

export async function GET(_req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id } = await params;
  try {
    const [row] = await db
      .select({ value: seoSettings.value })
      .from(seoSettings)
      .where(eq(seoSettings.key, settingsKey(id)))
      .limit(1);

    return NextResponse.json({ result: row?.value ? JSON.parse(row.value) : null });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id } = await params;
  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    await db
      .insert(seoSettings)
      .values({
        key: settingsKey(id),
        value: JSON.stringify(body),
        updatedBy: session.user?.email || "system",
      })
      .onConflictDoUpdate({
        target: seoSettings.key,
        set: {
          value: JSON.stringify(body),
          updatedAt: new Date(),
          updatedBy: session.user?.email || "system",
        },
      });

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// S0 Competitive Analysis API
// GET  — fetch saved competitive analysis for a project
// POST — save competitive analysis results
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { seoSettings } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { logEvent } from "@/lib/event-logger";

function settingsKey(projectId: string) {
  return `competitive:${projectId}`;
}

export async function GET(_req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id } = await params;
  try {
    const [row] = await db
      .select({ value: seoSettings.value })
      .from(seoSettings)
      .where(eq(seoSettings.key, settingsKey(id)))
      .limit(1);

    const competitive = row?.value ? JSON.parse(row.value) : null;
    return NextResponse.json({ competitive });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id } = await params;
  const startTime = Date.now();

  try {
    const body = await req.json();

    await db
      .insert(seoSettings)
      .values({
        key: settingsKey(id),
        value: JSON.stringify(body),
        updatedBy: session.user?.email || "system",
      })
      .onConflictDoUpdate({
        target: seoSettings.key,
        set: {
          value: JSON.stringify(body),
          updatedAt: new Date(),
          updatedBy: session.user?.email || "system",
        },
      });

    logEvent({
      userEmail: session.user?.email,
      userName: session.user?.name,
      section: "seo",
      action: "competitive:save",
      status: "success",
      message: `Saved competitive analysis for project ${id}`,
      detail: { projectId: id, competitorCount: body.competitors?.length || 0 },
      durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { seoProjects, seoAsins } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

export async function POST(
  _req: NextRequest,
  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }
) {
  try {
    const session = await getAuthSession();
    if (!session) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const { id } = await params;

    // Load the source project
    const [source] = await db
      .select()
      .from(seoProjects)
      .where(eq(seoProjects.id, id))
      .limit(1);

    if (!source) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Project not found" }, { status: 404 });
    }

    // Calculate next version number
    let nextVersion = 1;
    if (source.variationId) {
      const [{ count }] = await db
        .select({ count: sql<number>`count(*)::int` })
        .from(seoProjects)
        .where(eq(seoProjects.variationId, source.variationId));
      nextVersion = (count || 0) + 1;
    } else {
      // No variation — count projects with the same name prefix
      nextVersion = source.version + 1;
    }

    // Load source ASINs
    const sourceAsins = await db
      .select()
      .from(seoAsins)
      .where(eq(seoAsins.projectId, id));

    // Create duplicate project in a transaction
    const result = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      const [newProject] = await tx
        .insert(seoProjects)
        .values({
          createdBy: session.user.email!,
          name: source.name,
          brandName: source.brandName,
          status: "draft",
          currentPhase: "S1",
          assignedTo: source.assignedTo,
          clientIdCode: source.clientIdCode,
          clientName: source.clientName,
          brandUrl: source.brandUrl,
          clientBibleUrl: source.clientBibleUrl,
          competitors: source.competitors,
          variationId: source.variationId,
          variationTheme: source.variationTheme,
          sizePresent: source.sizePresent,
          brandGuidelines: source.brandGuidelines,
          brandGuidelinesLock: source.brandGuidelinesLock,
          varietyPackDetails: source.varietyPackDetails,
          linkedProductId: source.linkedProductId,
          version: nextVersion,
          date: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
        })
        .returning();

      // Duplicate ASINs (without generated content — fresh start)
      if (sourceAsins.length > 0) {
        await tx.insert(seoAsins).values(
          sourceAsins.map((a) => ({
            projectId: newProject.id,
            asin: a.asin,
            sku: a.sku,
            amazonUrl: a.amazonUrl,
            websiteUrl: a.websiteUrl,
            variationId: a.variationId,
            variationProduct: a.variationProduct,
            parentageLevel: a.parentageLevel,
            variationThemeName: a.variationThemeName,
            flavor: a.flavor,
            style: a.style,
            color: a.color,
            size: a.size,
            variationGroup: a.variationGroup,
            existingContent: a.existingContent,
          }))
        );
      }

      return { project: newProject, asinCount: sourceAsins.length };
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      id: result.project.id,
      name: result.project.name,
      version: result.project.version,
      asin_count: result.asinCount,
    });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unknown error";
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// POST /api/seo/projects/[id]/export-gdoc
// Builds OUT_SEO .docx and uploads to Google Drive
// Uses shared gcp-auth + drive-client (same creds as rest of app)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { seoProjects, seoAsins, seoExports } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { buildDocxBuffer, type DocxRow } from "@/lib/seo-docx-builder";
import { driveClient } from "@/lib/drive-client";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";

export const maxDuration = 60;

// ── Route handler ────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function POST(_req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const rootFolderId = process.env.GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID?.trim();

    if (!rootFolderId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Google Drive not configured. Add GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID to env.", setup: true },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const { id } = await params;

    // ── Load data from Hub DB ──────────────────────────────
    const [project] = await db.select({ brandName: seoProjects.brandName })
      .from(seoProjects).where(eq(seoProjects.id, id)).limit(1);

    const asins = await db.select({
      asin: seoAsins.asin, parentageLevel: seoAsins.parentageLevel,
      variationProduct: seoAsins.variationProduct, flavor: seoAsins.flavor,
      style: seoAsins.style, color: seoAsins.color, size: seoAsins.size,
      generatedContent: seoAsins.generatedContent,
    }).from(seoAsins).where(eq(seoAsins.projectId, id));

    if (!asins.length) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "No ASIN data found for this project." }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const hasContent = asins.some(a => {
      const gc = (a.generatedContent as any) || {};
      return !!gc.Title;
    });
    if (!hasContent) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "No SEO content generated yet. Complete S6 first." }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const brand    = project?.brandName || "Unknown Brand";
    const today    = new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-US", { year: "numeric", month: "long", day: "numeric" });
    const dateSlug = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

    // ── Map to DocxRow format ─────────────────────────────────
    const rows: DocxRow[] = asins
      .sort((a, b) => {
        const aP = (a.parentageLevel || "").toLowerCase() === "parent";
        const bP = (b.parentageLevel || "").toLowerCase() === "parent";
        if (aP && !bP) return -1; if (!aP && bP) return 1;
        return a.asin.localeCompare(b.asin);
      })
      .map(a => {
        const gc = (a.generatedContent as any) || {};
        return {
          asin:     a.asin || "",
          parentage: a.parentageLevel || "",
          product:  a.variationProduct || "",
          flavor:   a.flavor || "", style: a.style || "",
          color:    a.color || "", size: a.size || "",
          title:    gc.Title || "",                titleC: gc.Title_CharLength || 0,
          d1: gc.DetailedBulletPoint_1 || "",      d1c: gc.DetailedBulletPoint_1_CharLength || 0,
          d2: gc.DetailedBulletPoint_2 || "",      d2c: gc.DetailedBulletPoint_2_CharLength || 0,
          d3: gc.DetailedBulletPoint_3 || "",      d3c: gc.DetailedBulletPoint_3_CharLength || 0,
          d4: gc.DetailedBulletPoint_4 || "",      d4c: gc.DetailedBulletPoint_4_CharLength || 0,
          d5: gc.DetailedBulletPoint_5 || "",      d5c: gc.DetailedBulletPoint_5_CharLength || 0,
          c1: gc.ConciseBulletPoint_1 || "",       c1c: gc.ConciseBulletPoint_1_CharLength || 0,
          c2: gc.ConciseBulletPoint_2 || "",       c2c: gc.ConciseBulletPoint_2_CharLength || 0,
          c3: gc.ConciseBulletPoint_3 || "",       c3c: gc.ConciseBulletPoint_3_CharLength || 0,
          c4: gc.ConciseBulletPoint_4 || "",       c4c: gc.ConciseBulletPoint_4_CharLength || 0,
          c5: gc.ConciseBulletPoint_5 || "",       c5c: gc.ConciseBulletPoint_5_CharLength || 0,
          ct1: gc.ContentBulletPoint_1 || "",      ct1c: gc.ContentBulletPoint_1_CharLength || 0,
          ct2: gc.ContentBulletPoint_2 || "",      ct2c: gc.ContentBulletPoint_2_CharLength || 0,
          ct3: gc.ContentBulletPoint_3 || "",      ct3c: gc.ContentBulletPoint_3_CharLength || 0,
          ct4: gc.ContentBulletPoint_4 || "",      ct4c: gc.ContentBulletPoint_4_CharLength || 0,
          ct5: gc.ContentBulletPoint_5 || "",      ct5c: gc.ContentBulletPoint_5_CharLength || 0,
          kf1: gc.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_1 || "",  kf1c: gc.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_1_CharLength || 0,
          kf2: gc.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_2 || "",  kf2c: gc.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_2_CharLength || 0,
          kf3: gc.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_3 || "",  kf3c: gc.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_3_CharLength || 0,
          kf4: gc.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_4 || "",  kf4c: gc.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_4_CharLength || 0,
          kf5: gc.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_5 || "",  kf5c: gc.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_5_CharLength || 0,
          desc:    gc.ProductDescription || "",    descC: gc.ProductDescription_CharLength || 0,
          backend: gc.BackendSearchTerms || "",    backendB: gc.BackendSearchTerms_ByteLength || 0,
        };
      });

    // ── Build .docx ───────────────────────────────────────────
    const buffer = await buildDocxBuffer(rows, brand, today);
    const docName = `OUT_SEO_${brand.replace(/\s+/g, "_")}_${dateSlug}`;

    // ── Find or create brand subfolder ────────────────────────
    const safeBrand = brand.replace(/[/\\?%*:|"<>]/g, "-").trim();
    const existingFolders = await driveClient.listFiles(
      `name='${safeBrand.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}' and mimeType='application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and '${rootFolderId}' in parents and trashed=false`,
    );
    const brandFolderId = existingFolders.files.length
      ? existingFolders.files[0].id
      : (await driveClient.createFolder(safeBrand, rootFolderId)).id;

    // ── Delete old file with same name ────────────────────────
    try {
      const old = await driveClient.listFiles(
        `(name='${docName}' or name='${docName}.docx') and '${brandFolderId}' in parents and trashed=false`,
      );
      for (const f of old.files) await driveClient.deleteFile(f.id);
    } catch (_) {}

    // ── Upload ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    const uploaded = await driveClient.uploadFile(
      `${docName}.docx`, brandFolderId, buffer,
      "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
    );

    const exportUrl = `https://drive.google.com/file/d/${uploaded.id}/view`;

    // Track export in seo_exports (insert-after-upload)
    await db.insert(seoExports).values({
      projectId: id,
      type: "google_doc",
      url: exportUrl,
      contentSnapshot: { brand, asinsCount: asins.length, date: dateSlug },
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      url: exportUrl,
      brand,
      filename: docName,
    });

  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error("export-gdoc error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message || "Export failed" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: src/app/api/seo/projects/[id]/export-variation/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  seoProjects,
  seoAsins,
  master,
  variations,
  variationGroups,
  variationGroupAssignments,
} from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, inArray, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

type Params = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

/**
 * POST /api/seo/projects/[id]/export-variation
 *
 * Reads SEO project ASIN/family data and auto-creates a variation
 * with groups and product assignments in the variation builder.
 */
export async function POST(_req: NextRequest, { params }: Params) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Not authenticated" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id } = await params;

  // 1. Load the SEO project
  const [project] = await db
    .select()
    .from(seoProjects)
    .where(eq(seoProjects.id, id))
    .limit(1);

  if (!project)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Project not found" }, { status: 404 });

  if (project.variationId)
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Project already linked to a variation", variationId: project.variationId },
      { status: 409 }
    );

  if (!project.clientIdCode)
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Project has no client ID code" },
      { status: 400 }
    );

  // 2. Load seoAsins for this project
  const asins = await db
    .select()
    .from(seoAsins)
    .where(eq(seoAsins.projectId, id));

  if (asins.length === 0)
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "No ASINs found in this project" },
      { status: 400 }
    );

  // 3. Match seoAsins to master products by ASIN + clientIdCode
  const asinValues = [...new Set(asins.map((a) => a.asin).filter(Boolean))];
  const products = await db
    .select({ id: master.id, asin: master.asin, parentageLevel: master.parentageLevel })
    .from(master)
    .where(
      sql`${master.asin} = ANY(${asinValues}) AND ${master.clientIdCode} = ${project.clientIdCode}`
    );

  const productByAsin = new Map(products.map((p) => [p.asin, p]));

  // 4. Build variation families from seoAsins (same logic as intake buildVariationFamilies)
  const parents = asins.filter((a) => a.parentageLevel === "Parent");
  const children = asins.filter((a) => a.parentageLevel === "Child");

  // Detect variation theme from parents
  const themes = [
    ...new Set(parents.map((p) => p.variationThemeName).filter(Boolean)),
  ];
  const primaryTheme = themes[0] || null;

  // Detect theme attributes from the data
  const themeAttrs: string[] = [];
  const hasAttr = (field: string) =>
    asins.some((a) => a[field as keyof typeof a]);
  if (hasAttr("flavor")) themeAttrs.push("Flavor");
  if (hasAttr("color")) themeAttrs.push("Color");
  if (hasAttr("size")) themeAttrs.push("Size");
  if (hasAttr("style")) themeAttrs.push("Style");

  // Build group names from variationGroup field on seoAsins
  const groupNames = [
    ...new Set(
      asins
        .map((a) => a.variationGroup)
        .filter((g): g is string => !!g && g.trim().length > 0)
    ),
  ];

  // If no explicit groups, create one group per parent
  const useParentGroups = groupNames.length === 0 && parents.length > 0;

  // Generate a unique variation code
  const codeBase = `${project.clientIdCode}-SEO-${project.name
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, "")
    .substring(0, 10)
    .toUpperCase()}`;

  // 5. Create everything in a transaction
  const result = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    // Create the variation
    const [variation] = await tx
      .insert(variations)
      .values({
        clientId: project.clientIdCode!,
        name: project.name,
        code: codeBase,
        amazonVariationId: parents[0]?.variationId || null,
        themeAttributes: themeAttrs,
        primaryDimension: primaryTheme,
        description: `Auto-created from SEO project "${project.name}"`,
      })
      .returning();

    // Create groups
    const groupMap = new Map<string, string>(); // groupName -> groupId

    if (useParentGroups) {
      // One group per parent ASIN
      for (let i = 0; i < parents.length; i++) {
        const parent = parents[i];
        const groupName =
          parent.variationProduct || parent.asin || `Group ${i + 1}`;
        const [group] = await tx
          .insert(variationGroups)
          .values({
            variationId: variation.id,
            name: groupName,
            dimension: primaryTheme || "Variation",
            sortOrder: i,
          })
          .returning();
        groupMap.set(parent.asin, group.id);
      }
    } else if (groupNames.length > 0) {
      // Named groups from variationGroup field
      for (let i = 0; i < groupNames.length; i++) {
        const [group] = await tx
          .insert(variationGroups)
          .values({
            variationId: variation.id,
            name: groupNames[i],
            dimension: primaryTheme || "Variation",
            sortOrder: i,
          })
          .returning();
        groupMap.set(groupNames[i], group.id);
      }
    }

    // Assign products to variation + groups
    const assignedProductIds: string[] = [];

    for (const seoAsin of asins) {
      const product = productByAsin.get(seoAsin.asin);
      if (!product) continue;

      assignedProductIds.push(product.id);

      // Determine which group this product belongs to
      let groupId: string | null = null;
      if (useParentGroups) {
        // Children go into their parent's group, parents into their own
        if (seoAsin.parentageLevel === "Parent") {
          groupId = groupMap.get(seoAsin.asin) || null;
        } else {
          // Find parent for this child by matching variationId or variationGroup
          const parentAsin = parents.find(
            (p) =>
              (seoAsin.variationId && p.variationId === seoAsin.variationId) ||
              (seoAsin.variationGroup && p.asin === seoAsin.variationGroup)
          );
          if (parentAsin) groupId = groupMap.get(parentAsin.asin) || null;
          // Fallback: first parent group
          if (!groupId && parents.length === 1)
            groupId = groupMap.get(parents[0].asin) || null;
        }
      } else if (seoAsin.variationGroup && groupMap.has(seoAsin.variationGroup)) {
        groupId = groupMap.get(seoAsin.variationGroup) || null;
      }

      // Insert group assignment if we have a group
      if (groupId) {
        await tx
          .insert(variationGroupAssignments)
          .values({ groupId, productId: product.id })
          .onConflictDoNothing();
      }
    }

    // Bulk update master: set variationRef + VariationID in JSONB
    if (assignedProductIds.length > 0) {
      await tx
        .update(master)
        .set({
          variationRef: variation.id,
          variations: sql`jsonb_set(
            COALESCE(${master.variations}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb),
            '{VariationID}',
            ${JSON.stringify(variation.code)}::jsonb
          )`,
        })
        .where(inArray(master.id, assignedProductIds));

      // Sync variationGroup display field for products with group assignments
      for (const productId of assignedProductIds) {
        const assignments = await tx
          .select({ name: variationGroups.name })
          .from(variationGroupAssignments)
          .innerJoin(
            variationGroups,
            eq(variationGroupAssignments.groupId, variationGroups.id)
          )
          .where(eq(variationGroupAssignments.productId, productId));
        if (assignments.length > 0) {
          const names = assignments.map((a) => a.name).join(", ");
          await tx
            .update(master)
            .set({ variationGroup: names })
            .where(eq(master.id, productId));
        }
      }
    }

    // Link the SEO project back to the variation
    await tx
      .update(seoProjects)
      .set({ variationId: variation.id, updatedAt: new Date() })
      .where(eq(seoProjects.id, id));

    return {
      variationId: variation.id,
      variationName: variation.name,
      variationCode: variation.code,
      groupsCreated: groupMap.size,
      productsAssigned: assignedProductIds.length,
      totalAsins: asins.length,
      unmatchedAsins: asins.length - assignedProductIds.length,
    };
  });

  return NextResponse.json(result, { status: 201 });
}

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from "vitest";
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";

// ── Mocks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const { mockDb, mockTx, mockedGetAuthSession } = vi.hoisted(() => {
  // Call tracker — each select/from/where/limit sequence returns a queued value
  let queryQueue: unknown[] = [];
  let txQueryQueue: unknown[] = [];

  function makeChain(queue: unknown[]) {
    const chain: Record<string, ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>> = {};
    const passthrough = ["select", "from", "innerJoin", "insert", "values", "set"];
    for (const m of passthrough) {
      chain[m] = vi.fn().mockReturnValue(chain);
    }
    // Terminal methods pull from queue
    chain.where = vi.fn().mockImplementation(() => {
      // Return chainable that has limit, but also is thenable (for no-limit queries)
      const result = queue.shift() ?? [];
      const sub = {
        limit: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(result),
        then: (resolve: (v: unknown) => void, reject?: (e: unknown) => void) => {
          return Promise.resolve(result).then(resolve, reject);
        },
      };
      return sub;
    });
    chain.limit = vi.fn().mockImplementation(() => {
      return Promise.resolve(queue.shift() ?? []);
    });
    chain.returning = vi.fn().mockImplementation(() => {
      return Promise.resolve(queue.shift() ?? []);
    });
    chain.update = vi.fn().mockReturnValue(chain);
    return chain;
  }

  const dbChain = makeChain(queryQueue);
  const txChain = makeChain(txQueryQueue);

  // Transaction runs callback with txChain
  dbChain.transaction = vi.fn().mockImplementation(
    async (cb: (tx: typeof txChain) => Promise<unknown>) => cb(txChain)
  );

  // Expose queue push helpers
  (dbChain as Record<string, unknown>)._pushResult = (v: unknown) => queryQueue.push(v);
  (txChain as Record<string, unknown>)._pushResult = (v: unknown) => txQueryQueue.push(v);
  (dbChain as Record<string, unknown>)._resetQueue = () => { queryQueue = []; (dbChain as Record<string, unknown>).where = makeChain(queryQueue).where; };
  (txChain as Record<string, unknown>)._resetQueue = () => { txQueryQueue = []; (txChain as Record<string, unknown>).where = makeChain(txQueryQueue).where; };

  // Keep stable references but allow queue reset
  return {
    mockDb: { ...dbChain, _q: queryQueue, _pushResult: (v: unknown) => queryQueue.push(v) } as unknown as Record<string, ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>> & { _q: unknown[]; _pushResult: (v: unknown) => void },
    mockTx: { ...txChain, _q: txQueryQueue, _pushResult: (v: unknown) => txQueryQueue.push(v) } as unknown as Record<string, ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>> & { _q: unknown[]; _pushResult: (v: unknown) => void },
    mockedGetAuthSession: vi.fn(),
  };
});

vi.mock("@/lib/db", () => ({ db: mockDb }));
vi.mock("@/lib/db/schema", () => ({

  variationGroups: { id: "id", name: "name" },

}));
vi.mock("@/lib/auth-db", () => ({ getAuthSession: mockedGetAuthSession }));
vi.mock("drizzle-orm", () => ({

  inArray: vi.fn((...args: unknown[]) => args),
  sql: Object.assign(vi.fn().mockReturnValue("sql"), {
    // Tagged template support
    [Symbol.for("tag")]: true,
  }),
}));

import { POST } from "./route";

const mockSession = { user: { email: "test@1o8.agency", role: "admin" } };
const mockParams = { params: Promise.resolve({ id: "proj-1" }) };

function makeRequest() {
  return new NextRequest("http://localhost/api/seo/projects/proj-1/link-variation", {
    method: "POST",
  });
}

beforeEach(() => {
  vi.clearAllMocks();
  // Reset query queues by clearing arrays
  while (mockDb._q?.length) mockDb._q.pop();
  while (mockTx._q?.length) mockTx._q.pop();
});

// ── Tests ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe("POST /api/seo/projects/[id]/link-variation", () => {
  it("returns 401 when not authenticated", async () => {
    mockedGetAuthSession.mockResolvedValue(null);
    const res = await POST(makeRequest(), mockParams);
    expect(res.status).toBe(401);
  });

  it("returns 404 when project not found", async () => {
    mockedGetAuthSession.mockResolvedValue(mockSession);
    // project query → empty
    mockDb._pushResult([]);
    const res = await POST(makeRequest(), mockParams);
    expect(res.status).toBe(404);
    expect((await res.json()).error).toBe("Project not found");
  });

  it("returns 409 when project already linked", async () => {
    mockedGetAuthSession.mockResolvedValue(mockSession);
    mockDb._pushResult([{ id: "proj-1", variationId: "var-1", clientIdCode: "CLI" }]);
    const res = await POST(makeRequest(), mockParams);
    expect(res.status).toBe(409);
    expect((await res.json()).error).toBe("Project already linked to a variation");
  });

  it("returns 400 when no seoAsins exist", async () => {
    mockedGetAuthSession.mockResolvedValue(mockSession);
    // project
    mockDb._pushResult([{ id: "proj-1", variationId: null, clientIdCode: "CLI" }]);
    // seoAsins
    mockDb._pushResult([]);
    const res = await POST(makeRequest(), mockParams);
    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect((await res.json()).error).toBe("No ASINs found in this project");
  });

  it("returns 400 when no products match in catalog", async () => {
    mockedGetAuthSession.mockResolvedValue(mockSession);
    mockDb._pushResult([{ id: "proj-1", variationId: null, clientIdCode: "CLI" }]);
    mockDb._pushResult([{ asin: "B001", projectId: "proj-1" }]);
    // master products
    mockDb._pushResult([]);
    const res = await POST(makeRequest(), mockParams);
    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect((await res.json()).error).toBe("No matching products found in catalog");
  });

  it("returns 400 when no products have a variationRef", async () => {
    mockedGetAuthSession.mockResolvedValue(mockSession);
    mockDb._pushResult([{ id: "proj-1", variationId: null, clientIdCode: "CLI" }]);
    mockDb._pushResult([{ asin: "B001", projectId: "proj-1" }]);
    mockDb._pushResult([{ id: "prod-1", asin: "B001", variationRef: null }]);
    const res = await POST(makeRequest(), mockParams);
    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect((await res.json()).error).toBe("No products are assigned to a variation in the builder");
  });

  it("returns 400 when variation not found in DB", async () => {
    mockedGetAuthSession.mockResolvedValue(mockSession);
    mockDb._pushResult([{ id: "proj-1", variationId: null, clientIdCode: "CLI" }]);
    mockDb._pushResult([{ asin: "B001", projectId: "proj-1" }]);
    mockDb._pushResult([{ id: "prod-1", asin: "B001", variationRef: "var-1" }]);
    // variation lookup
    mockDb._pushResult([]);
    const res = await POST(makeRequest(), mockParams);
    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect((await res.json()).error).toBe("Matched variation not found");
  });

  it("links project to variation successfully (happy path)", async () => {
    mockedGetAuthSession.mockResolvedValue(mockSession);
    // project
    mockDb._pushResult([{ id: "proj-1", variationId: null, clientIdCode: "CLI" }]);
    // seoAsins
    mockDb._pushResult([
      { asin: "B001", projectId: "proj-1" },
      { asin: "B002", projectId: "proj-1" },
    ]);
    // master products
    mockDb._pushResult([
      { id: "prod-1", asin: "B001", variationRef: "var-1" },
      { id: "prod-2", asin: "B002", variationRef: "var-1" },
    ]);
    // variation lookup
    mockDb._pushResult([{ id: "var-1", name: "My Var", code: "MV-001" }]);

    // Transaction queries:
    // 1. count existing projects on variation
    mockTx._pushResult([{ count: 0 }]);
    // 2. update seoProjects (via update().set().where())
    mockTx._pushResult(undefined);
    // 3. group assignments (for sync)
    mockTx._pushResult([]);

    const res = await POST(makeRequest(), mockParams);
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    const body = await res.json();
    expect(body.variationId).toBe("var-1");
    expect(body.variationCode).toBe("MV-001");
    expect(body.version).toBe(1);
    expect(body.matchedProducts).toBe(2);
    expect(body.unmatchedAsins).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("reports unmatched ASINs and increments version", async () => {
    mockedGetAuthSession.mockResolvedValue(mockSession);
    mockDb._pushResult([{ id: "proj-1", variationId: null, clientIdCode: "CLI" }]);
    mockDb._pushResult([
      { asin: "B001", projectId: "proj-1" },
      { asin: "B002", projectId: "proj-1" },
      { asin: "B003", projectId: "proj-1" },
    ]);
    // Only 2 match in catalog
    mockDb._pushResult([
      { id: "prod-1", asin: "B001", variationRef: "var-1" },
      { id: "prod-2", asin: "B002", variationRef: "var-1" },
    ]);
    mockDb._pushResult([{ id: "var-1", name: "My Var", code: "MV-001" }]);

    // Transaction: 1 existing project on this variation
    mockTx._pushResult([{ count: 1 }]);
    mockTx._pushResult(undefined);
    mockTx._pushResult([]);

    const res = await POST(makeRequest(), mockParams);
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    const body = await res.json();
    expect(body.version).toBe(2);
    expect(body.unmatchedAsins).toEqual(["B003"]);
    expect(body.matchedProducts).toBe(2);
  });
});

FILE: src/app/api/seo/projects/[id]/link-variation/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  seoProjects,
  seoAsins,
  master,
  variations,
  variationGroups,
  variationGroupAssignments,
} from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and, inArray, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

type Params = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

/**
 * POST /api/seo/projects/[id]/link-variation
 *
 * Retroactively links an existing SEO project to its matching variation
 * by matching seoAsins → master products → variationRef.
 * Preserves all existing content (generatedContent, keywords, etc.).
 * Also syncs seo_asins.variationGroup from the variation builder's groups.
 */
export async function POST(_req: NextRequest, { params }: Params) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Not authenticated" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id } = await params;

  // 1. Load the SEO project
  const [project] = await db
    .select()
    .from(seoProjects)
    .where(eq(seoProjects.id, id))
    .limit(1);

  if (!project)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Project not found" }, { status: 404 });

  if (project.variationId)
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Project already linked to a variation", variationId: project.variationId },
      { status: 409 }
    );

  // 2. Load seoAsins for this project
  const asins = await db
    .select()
    .from(seoAsins)
    .where(eq(seoAsins.projectId, id));

  if (asins.length === 0)
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "No ASINs found in this project" },
      { status: 400 }
    );

  // 3. Match seoAsins → master products (by asin + clientIdCode)
  const asinValues = [...new Set(asins.map((a) => a.asin).filter(Boolean))];

  if (asinValues.length === 0)
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "No valid ASINs in this project" },
      { status: 400 }
    );

  const matchedProducts = await db
    .select({
      id: master.id,
      asin: master.asin,
      variationRef: master.variationRef,
    })
    .from(master)
    .where(
      project.clientIdCode
        ? sql`${master.asin} = ANY(${asinValues}) AND ${master.clientIdCode} = ${project.clientIdCode}`
        : sql`${master.asin} = ANY(${asinValues})`
    );

  if (matchedProducts.length === 0)
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "No matching products found in catalog" },
      { status: 400 }
    );

  // 4. Find the variation these products belong to
  const variationRefs = [
    ...new Set(
      matchedProducts
        .map((p) => p.variationRef)
        .filter((ref): ref is string => !!ref)
    ),
  ];

  if (variationRefs.length === 0)
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "No products are assigned to a variation in the builder" },
      { status: 400 }
    );

  // Use the first (and expected only) variation
  const variationId = variationRefs[0];

  // Load variation details
  const [variation] = await db
    .select({ id: variations.id, name: variations.name, code: variations.code })
    .from(variations)
    .where(eq(variations.id, variationId))
    .limit(1);

  if (!variation)
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Matched variation not found" },
      { status: 400 }
    );

  // 5. Collect unmatched ASINs (products not in catalog or not in a variation)
  const matchedAsinSet = new Set(matchedProducts.map((p) => p.asin));
  const unmatchedAsins = asinValues.filter((a) => !matchedAsinSet.has(a));
  const unassignedAsins = matchedProducts
    .filter((p) => !p.variationRef)
    .map((p) => p.asin);

  // 6. Transaction: link project + sync groups
  const result = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    // Count existing projects on this variation for version numbering
    const [{ count }] = await tx
      .select({ count: sql<number>`count(*)::int` })
      .from(seoProjects)
      .where(eq(seoProjects.variationId, variationId));

    const version = count + 1;

    // Set variationId and version on the SEO project
    await tx
      .update(seoProjects)
      .set({
        variationId: variationId,
        version: version,
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      })
      .where(eq(seoProjects.id, id));

    // Sync seo_asins.variationGroup from variation_group_assignments
    // Build a map: productId -> group names
    const productIds = matchedProducts
      .filter((p) => p.variationRef === variationId)
      .map((p) => p.id);

    let groupsSynced = 0;

    if (productIds.length > 0) {
      // Get all group assignments for these products
      const assignments = await tx
        .select({
          productId: variationGroupAssignments.productId,
          groupName: variationGroups.name,
        })
        .from(variationGroupAssignments)
        .innerJoin(
          variationGroups,
          eq(variationGroupAssignments.groupId, variationGroups.id)
        )
        .where(inArray(variationGroupAssignments.productId, productIds));

      // Group by productId
      const groupsByProduct = new Map<string, string[]>();
      for (const a of assignments) {
        const existing = groupsByProduct.get(a.productId) || [];
        existing.push(a.groupName);
        groupsByProduct.set(a.productId, existing);
      }

      // Build asin → productId map
      const asinToProductId = new Map(
        matchedProducts.map((p) => [p.asin, p.id])
      );

      // Update seo_asins.variationGroup for matched ASINs
      for (const seoAsin of asins) {
        const productId = asinToProductId.get(seoAsin.asin);
        if (!productId) continue;

        const groups = groupsByProduct.get(productId);
        if (groups && groups.length > 0) {
          await tx
            .update(seoAsins)
            .set({ variationGroup: groups.join(", ") })
            .where(
              and(
                eq(seoAsins.projectId, id),
                eq(seoAsins.asin, seoAsin.asin)
              )
            );
          groupsSynced++;
        }
      }
    }

    return {
      variationId: variation.id,
      variationCode: variation.code,
      variationName: variation.name,
      version,
      matchedProducts: matchedProducts.length,
      totalAsins: asinValues.length,
      unmatchedAsins,
      unassignedAsins,
      groupsSynced,
    };
  });

  return NextResponse.json(result);
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { seoProjects, seoAsins, seoKeywords, seoReviews, seoRufus, seoCosmopMaps, seoComplianceReports } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, desc } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";

export async function GET(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const { id } = await params;
    const phase = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("phase");

    switch (phase) {
      case "s1_intake": {
        const [project] = await db.select().from(seoProjects).where(eq(seoProjects.id, id)).limit(1);
        const asins = await db.select().from(seoAsins).where(eq(seoAsins.projectId, id));
        const ec = (a: typeof asins[0]) => (a.existingContent as any) || {};
        return NextResponse.json({
          project: {
            brand_name: project?.brandName || "",
            client_name: project?.clientName || "",
            client_id_code: project?.clientIdCode || "",
            date: project?.date || "",
            client_bible_url: project?.clientBibleUrl || "",
            brand_url: project?.brandUrl || "",
            competitors: project?.competitors || [],
            brand_guidelines: project?.brandGuidelines || "",
            brand_guidelines_lock: project?.brandGuidelinesLock || "not_applicable",
            variety_pack_details: project?.varietyPackDetails ? JSON.parse(project.varietyPackDetails) : [],
          },
          asins: asins.map((a) => ({
            asin: a.asin, sku: a.sku, amazon_url: a.amazonUrl, website_url: a.websiteUrl,
            variation_id: a.variationId, variation_product: a.variationProduct,
            parentage_level: a.parentageLevel, variation_theme_name: a.variationThemeName,
            flavor: a.flavor, style: a.style, color: a.color, size: a.size,
            variation_group: a.variationGroup || null,
            existing_content: ec(a),
          })),
        });
      }

      case "s2_keywords": {
        const keywords = await db.select().from(seoKeywords).where(eq(seoKeywords.projectId, id)).orderBy(desc(seoKeywords.searchVolume));
        return NextResponse.json({
          keywords: keywords.map((k) => ({
            KeywordText: k.text, KeywordSearchVolume: k.searchVolume,
            KeywordPriorityTier: k.priorityTier, KeywordSearchIntent: k.searchIntent,
            KeywordPrimaryUseLocation: k.primaryUseLocation, KeywordMatchType: k.matchType,
            KeywordCOSMORelationship: k.cosmoRelationship, KeywordBuyerStage: k.buyerStage,
            KeywordNotes: k.notes, KeywordSource: k.keywordSource,
          })),
        });
      }

      case "s3_reviews": {
        const reviews = await db.select().from(seoReviews).where(eq(seoReviews.projectId, id)).orderBy(desc(seoReviews.starRating));
        return NextResponse.json({
          reviews: reviews.map((r) => ({
            ReviewID: r.reviewId, ReviewDate: r.date, ReviewReviewerName: r.reviewerName,
            ReviewASIN: r.asin, ReviewProductVariation: r.productVariation,
            ReviewStarRating: r.starRating, ReviewTitle: r.title, ReviewText: r.text,
            ReviewSentiment: r.sentiment, ReviewKeyThemes: r.keyThemes,
            ReviewUsageMentioned: r.usageMentioned, ReviewPackagingFeedback: r.packagingFeedback,
            ReviewPriceFeedback: r.priceFeedback, ReviewHeatLevelFeedback: r.heatLevelFeedback,
            ReviewRufusUsableInsight: r.rufusUsableInsight, ReviewBulletMapping: r.bulletMapping,
          })),
        });
      }

      case "s4_rufus": {
        const [rufus] = await db.select().from(seoRufus).where(eq(seoRufus.projectId, id)).limit(1);
        return NextResponse.json({ rows: (rufus?.rows as any[]) || [] });
      }

      case "s5_cosmo": {
        const [cosmo] = await db.select().from(seoCosmopMaps).where(eq(seoCosmopMaps.projectId, id)).limit(1);
        return NextResponse.json({ rows: (cosmo?.rows as any[]) || [] });
      }

      case "s6_compliance": {
        const [report] = await db.select().from(seoComplianceReports).where(eq(seoComplianceReports.projectId, id)).limit(1);
        return NextResponse.json({ rows: (report?.issues as any[]) || [] });
      }

      case "s7_seo": {
        const asins = await db.select({ asin: seoAsins.asin, generatedContent: seoAsins.generatedContent, variationId: seoAsins.variationId, variationProduct: seoAsins.variationProduct, parentageLevel: seoAsins.parentageLevel, variationThemeName: seoAsins.variationThemeName, flavor: seoAsins.flavor, style: seoAsins.style, color: seoAsins.color, size: seoAsins.size, amazonUrl: seoAsins.amazonUrl }).from(seoAsins).where(eq(seoAsins.projectId, id));
        const [project] = await db.select({ seoConfig: seoProjects.brandGuidelinesLock }).from(seoProjects).where(eq(seoProjects.id, id)).limit(1);
        return NextResponse.json({
          rows: asins.map((a) => {
            const gc = (a.generatedContent as any) || {};
            // Recompute CharLength/ByteLength from actual content
            for (const key of Object.keys(gc)) {
              if (key.endsWith("_CharLength")) {
                const ck = key.replace("_CharLength", "");
                if (typeof gc[ck] === "string") gc[key] = gc[ck].length;
              } else if (key.endsWith("_ByteLength")) {
                const ck = key.replace("_ByteLength", "");
                if (typeof gc[ck] === "string") gc[key] = new TextEncoder().encode(gc[ck]).length;
              }
            }
            return {
              ASIN: a.asin, URL: a.amazonUrl, VariationID: a.variationId,
              VariationProduct: a.variationProduct, ParentageLevel: a.parentageLevel,
              VariationThemeName: a.variationThemeName, Flavor: a.flavor,
              Style: a.style, Color: a.color, Size: a.size, ...gc,
            };
          }),
          config: null,
        });
      }

      case "parent_asin": {
        const [parent] = await db.select({ asin: seoAsins.asin, amazonUrl: seoAsins.amazonUrl })
          .from(seoAsins).where(eq(seoAsins.projectId, id)).limit(1);
        return NextResponse.json({ parent: parent ? { asin: parent.asin, amazon_url: parent.amazonUrl } : null });
      }

      default:
        return NextResponse.json({ error: `Unknown phase: ${phase}` }, { status: 400 });
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
