// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SEO → Product Migration API
//
// POST — Push approved S6 content from seoAsins.generatedContent
//        back to master products. Maps SEO pipeline field names
//        to the product schema (core fields + contentSeo JSONB).
//
// GET  — Preview migration: shows what will change per ASIN
//        without writing anything.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, seoProjects, seoAsins, activityLog } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { eq, and, inArray } from "drizzle-orm";
import { logEvent } from "@/lib/event-logger";

// ── Field mapping: S6 output → master product ────────────────

/** Maps S6 column names to master product field paths */
const FIELD_MAP: Record<string, { target: "core" | "contentSeo"; field: string }> = {
  Title:                      { target: "core",       field: "itemName" },
  ProductDescription:         { target: "contentSeo", field: "ProductDescription" },
  DetailedBulletPoint_1:      { target: "contentSeo", field: "DetailedBulletPoint1" },
  DetailedBulletPoint_2:      { target: "contentSeo", field: "DetailedBulletPoint2" },
  DetailedBulletPoint_3:      { target: "contentSeo", field: "DetailedBulletPoint3" },
  DetailedBulletPoint_4:      { target: "contentSeo", field: "DetailedBulletPoint4" },
  DetailedBulletPoint_5:      { target: "contentSeo", field: "DetailedBulletPoint5" },
  ConciseBulletPoint_1:       { target: "contentSeo", field: "ConciseBulletPoint1" },
  ConciseBulletPoint_2:       { target: "contentSeo", field: "ConciseBulletPoint2" },
  ConciseBulletPoint_3:       { target: "contentSeo", field: "ConciseBulletPoint3" },
  ConciseBulletPoint_4:       { target: "contentSeo", field: "ConciseBulletPoint4" },
  ConciseBulletPoint_5:       { target: "contentSeo", field: "ConciseBulletPoint5" },
  ContentBulletPoint_1:       { target: "contentSeo", field: "PA_LIBulletPoint1" },
  ContentBulletPoint_2:       { target: "contentSeo", field: "PA_LIBulletPoint2" },
  ContentBulletPoint_3:       { target: "contentSeo", field: "PA_LIBulletPoint3" },
  ContentBulletPoint_4:       { target: "contentSeo", field: "PA_LIBulletPoint4" },
  ContentBulletPoint_5:       { target: "contentSeo", field: "PA_LIBulletPoint5" },
  KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_1:   { target: "contentSeo", field: "KeyFeature1" },
  KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_2:   { target: "contentSeo", field: "KeyFeature2" },
  KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_3:   { target: "contentSeo", field: "KeyFeature3" },
  KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_4:   { target: "contentSeo", field: "KeyFeature4" },
  KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_5:   { target: "contentSeo", field: "KeyFeature5" },
  BackendSearchTerms:         { target: "core",       field: "genericKeywords" },
};

/** Extract mapped fields from generatedContent */
function extractMappedFields(gc: Record<string, unknown>): Map<string, { target: "core" | "contentSeo"; field: string; value: string }> {
  const mapped = new Map<string, { target: "core" | "contentSeo"; field: string; value: string }>();
  for (const [s6Col, mapping] of Object.entries(FIELD_MAP)) {
    const value = gc[s6Col];
    if (value && typeof value === "string" && value.trim()) {
      mapped.set(s6Col, { ...mapping, value: value.trim() });
    }
  }
  return mapped;
}

// ── GET: Preview ──────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function GET(_req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id: projectId } = await params;

  // Load project
  const [project] = await db.select({
    id: seoProjects.id,
    name: seoProjects.name,
    brandName: seoProjects.brandName,
    clientIdCode: seoProjects.clientIdCode,
    s6ApprovedAt: seoProjects.s6ApprovedAt,
  }).from(seoProjects).where(eq(seoProjects.id, projectId)).limit(1);

  if (!project) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Project not found" }, { status: 404 });

  // Load SEO ASINs with generated content
  const asins = await db.select({
    asin: seoAsins.asin,
    generatedContent: seoAsins.generatedContent,
    parentageLevel: seoAsins.parentageLevel,
    variationProduct: seoAsins.variationProduct,
  }).from(seoAsins).where(eq(seoAsins.projectId, projectId));

  const asinsWithContent = asins.filter(a => a.generatedContent && Object.keys(a.generatedContent as object).length > 0);

  if (asinsWithContent.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "No generated content found. Complete S6 first." }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Match to master products
  const asinCodes = asinsWithContent.map(a => a.asin).filter(Boolean) as string[];
  const products = await db.select({
    id: master.id,
    asin: master.asin,
    itemName: master.itemName,
    genericKeywords: master.genericKeywords,
    contentSeo: master.contentSeo,
  }).from(master).where(
    project.clientIdCode
      ? and(inArray(master.asin, asinCodes), eq(master.clientIdCode, project.clientIdCode))
      : inArray(master.asin, asinCodes)
  );

  const productByAsin = new Map(products.map(p => [p.asin, p]));

  // Build preview
  const preview = asinsWithContent.map(a => {
    const gc = (a.generatedContent as Record<string, unknown>) || {};
    const mapped = extractMappedFields(gc);
    const product = productByAsin.get(a.asin!);

    const changes: { field: string; s6Column: string; oldValue: string | null; newValue: string }[] = [];

    for (const [s6Col, { target, field, value }] of mapped) {
      let oldValue: string | null = null;
      if (product) {
        if (target === "core") {
          oldValue = (product as any)[field] || null;
        } else {
          const blob = (product.contentSeo as Record<string, string>) || {};
          oldValue = blob[field] || null;
        }
      }
      changes.push({ field, s6Column: s6Col, oldValue, newValue: value });
    }

    return {
      asin: a.asin,
      parentage: a.parentageLevel,
      variation: a.variationProduct,
      matched: !!product,
      productId: product?.id || null,
      currentTitle: product?.itemName || null,
      fieldsToUpdate: changes.length,
      changes,
    };
  });

  const matched = preview.filter(p => p.matched).length;
  const unmatched = preview.filter(p => !p.matched).length;
  const totalFields = preview.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.fieldsToUpdate, 0);

  return NextResponse.json({
    projectName: project.name,
    brandName: project.brandName,
    s6Approved: !!project.s6ApprovedAt,
    totalAsins: asinsWithContent.length,
    matched,
    unmatched,
    totalFields,
    preview,
  });
}

// ── POST: Execute migration ───────────────────────────────────

export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  if (session.user.role === "viewer") return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });

  const { id: projectId } = await params;
  const startTime = Date.now();

  // Load project
  const [project] = await db.select({
    id: seoProjects.id,
    name: seoProjects.name,
    brandName: seoProjects.brandName,
    clientIdCode: seoProjects.clientIdCode,
  }).from(seoProjects).where(eq(seoProjects.id, projectId)).limit(1);

  if (!project) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Project not found" }, { status: 404 });

  // Load SEO ASINs with generated content
  const asins = await db.select({
    asin: seoAsins.asin,
    generatedContent: seoAsins.generatedContent,
  }).from(seoAsins).where(eq(seoAsins.projectId, projectId));

  const asinsWithContent = asins.filter(a => a.generatedContent && Object.keys(a.generatedContent as object).length > 0);
  if (asinsWithContent.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "No generated content to migrate" }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Match to master products
  const asinCodes = asinsWithContent.map(a => a.asin).filter(Boolean) as string[];
  const products = await db.select({
    id: master.id,
    asin: master.asin,
    sku: master.sku,
    clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode,
    itemName: master.itemName,
    genericKeywords: master.genericKeywords,
    contentSeo: master.contentSeo,
    rawColumnValues: master.rawColumnValues,
    changeLog: master.changeLog,
  }).from(master).where(
    project.clientIdCode
      ? and(inArray(master.asin, asinCodes), eq(master.clientIdCode, project.clientIdCode))
      : inArray(master.asin, asinCodes)
  );

  const productByAsin = new Map(products.map(p => [p.asin, p]));
  const userEmail = session.user.email || "system";
  let migratedCount = 0;
  let fieldsUpdated = 0;
  const unmatchedAsins: string[] = [];

  for (const seoAsin of asinsWithContent) {
    const product = productByAsin.get(seoAsin.asin!);
    if (!product) {
      unmatchedAsins.push(seoAsin.asin!);
      continue;
    }

    const gc = (seoAsin.generatedContent as Record<string, unknown>) || {};
    const mapped = extractMappedFields(gc);
    if (mapped.size === 0) continue;

    const updates: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    const rawValues = { ...(product.rawColumnValues ?? {}) };
    const changeLog = [...(product.changeLog ?? [])];
    let currentContentSeo = { ...((product.contentSeo as Record<string, string>) ?? {}) };

    for (const [s6Col, { target, field, value }] of mapped) {
      if (target === "core") {
        const oldValue = (product as any)[field] || null;
        updates[field] = value;

        // Map to BQ name for raw values
        const bqName = s6Col === "Title" ? "ItemName" : s6Col === "BackendSearchTerms" ? "GenericKeyword1" : s6Col;
        rawValues[bqName] = value;

        if (oldValue !== value) {
          changeLog.push({
            field: bqName,
            oldValue,
            newValue: value,
            changedBy: userEmail,
            changedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            // seo-migration
          });
        }
      } else {
        const oldValue = currentContentSeo[field] || null;
        currentContentSeo[field] = value;
        rawValues[field] = value;

        if (oldValue !== value) {
          changeLog.push({
            field,
            oldValue,
            newValue: value,
            changedBy: userEmail,
            changedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            // seo-migration
          });
        }
      }
      fieldsUpdated++;
    }

    updates.contentSeo = currentContentSeo;
    updates.rawColumnValues = rawValues;
    updates.changeLog = changeLog;
    updates.isDirty = true;
    updates.updatedAt = new Date();

    await db.update(master).set(updates).where(eq(master.id, product.id));

    // Activity log
    await db.insert(activityLog).values({
      productId: product.id,
      asin: product.asin,
      sku: product.sku,
      clientIdCode: product.clientIdCode,
      itemName: (updates.itemName as string) || product.itemName,
      fieldLabel: `SEO Migration from ${project.name}`,
      bqName: "SEO_MIGRATION",
      oldValue: null,
      newValue: `${mapped.size} fields migrated`,
      changedBy: userEmail,
      editType: "single",
    });

    migratedCount++;
  }

  logEvent({
    userEmail,
    userName: session.user?.name,
    section: "seo",
    action: "migrate-to-products",
    status: "success",
    resourceLabel: project.brandName,
    message: `Migrated ${fieldsUpdated} fields across ${migratedCount} products from ${project.name}`,
    detail: {
      projectId,
      projectName: project.name,
      migratedCount,
      fieldsUpdated,
      unmatchedAsins,
    },
    durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,
  });

  return NextResponse.json({
    success: true,
    migratedCount,
    fieldsUpdated,
    unmatchedAsins,
    totalAsins: asinsWithContent.length,
  });
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SEO Skill Runner API
// POST — trigger a skill (competitive)
// GET  — fetch saved results for skills
//
// Note: validation and geo_check skills were absorbed into the
// premium audit in S6.6 (/api/seo/claude/seo-audit).
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import {
  getSkillConfig,
  runCompetitiveAnalysis,
  loadCompetitiveData,
} from "@/lib/seo-skill-runner";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const VALID_SKILLS = ["competitive"] as const;
type SkillName = (typeof VALID_SKILLS)[number];

export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id: projectId } = await params;
  const body = await req.json();
  const skill = body.skill as SkillName;

  if (!VALID_SKILLS.includes(skill)) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: `Invalid skill: ${skill}. Valid: ${VALID_SKILLS.join(", ")}` }, { status: 400 });
  }

  // Check if skill is enabled
  const config = await getSkillConfig();
  const configMap: Record<SkillName, boolean> = {
    competitive: config.s0_competitive,
  };

  if (!configMap[skill] && !body.force) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: `Skill "${skill}" is disabled. Enable it in /seo/config or pass force: true.` }, { status: 403 });
  }

  const userEmail = session.user?.email || "system";

  try {
    let result;
    switch (skill) {
      case "competitive":
        result = await runCompetitiveAnalysis(projectId, userEmail);
        break;
    }
    return NextResponse.json({ skill, result });
  } catch (err: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function GET(_req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id: projectId } = await params;

  const [competitive, config] = await Promise.all([
    loadCompetitiveData(projectId),
    getSkillConfig(),
  ]);

  return NextResponse.json({ competitive, config });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { seoProjects, seoAsins, seoKeywords, seoReviews, seoRufus, seoCosmopMaps, seoComplianceReports } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";

export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const { id } = await params;
    const { phase, data } = await req.json();

    switch (phase) {
      case "s1_intake": {
        const { metadata: m, asins, variety_pack_details } = data;

        await db.update(seoProjects).set({
          brandName: m.brand_name || m.brandName || "",
          date: m.date || null,
          clientIdCode: m.client_id_code || m.clientIdCode || null,
          clientName: m.client_name || m.clientName || null,
          clientBibleUrl: m.client_bible_url || m.clientBibleUrl || null,
          brandUrl: m.brand_url || m.brandUrl || null,
          competitors: m.competitors || [],
          variationTheme: asins?.[0]?.variation_theme_name || null,
          brandGuidelines: m.brand_guidelines || "",
          brandGuidelinesLock: m.brand_guidelines_lock || null,
          varietyPackDetails: variety_pack_details ? JSON.stringify(variety_pack_details) : null,
          updatedAt: new Date(),
        }).where(eq(seoProjects.id, id));

        if (asins?.length > 0) {
          await db.delete(seoAsins).where(eq(seoAsins.projectId, id));
          const ec = (a: any) => a.existing_content || {};
          await db.insert(seoAsins).values(asins.map((a: any) => ({
            projectId: id,
            asin: a.asin || "",
            sku: a.sku || "",
            amazonUrl: a.amazon_url || null,
            websiteUrl: a.website_url || null,
            variationId: a.variation_id || null,
            variationProduct: a.variation_product || null,
            parentageLevel: a.parentage_level || null,
            variationThemeName: a.variation_theme_name || null,
            flavor: a.flavor || null,
            style: a.style || null,
            color: a.color || null,
            size: a.size || null,
            variationGroup: a.variation_group || null,
            existingContent: ec(a),
          })));
        }

        await db.update(seoProjects).set({ s1ApprovedAt: new Date(), currentPhase: "S2", updatedAt: new Date() }).where(eq(seoProjects.id, id));
        return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
      }

      case "s2_keywords": {
        await db.delete(seoKeywords).where(eq(seoKeywords.projectId, id));
        if (data.keywords?.length > 0) {
          await db.insert(seoKeywords).values(data.keywords.map((k: any) => ({
            projectId: id,
            text: k.KeywordText,
            searchVolume: k.KeywordSearchVolume || 0,
            priorityTier: k.KeywordPriorityTier || null,
            searchIntent: k.KeywordSearchIntent || null,
            primaryUseLocation: k.KeywordPrimaryUseLocation || null,
            matchType: k.KeywordMatchType || null,
            cosmoRelationship: k.KeywordCOSMORelationship || null,
            buyerStage: k.KeywordBuyerStage || null,
            notes: k.KeywordNotes || "",
            keywordSource: k.KeywordSource || "Client",
          })));
        }
        await db.update(seoProjects).set({ s2ApprovedAt: new Date(), currentPhase: "S3", updatedAt: new Date() }).where(eq(seoProjects.id, id));
        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, count: data.keywords?.length || 0 });
      }

      case "s3_reviews": {
        await db.delete(seoReviews).where(eq(seoReviews.projectId, id));
        if (data.reviews?.length > 0) {
          await db.insert(seoReviews).values(data.reviews.map((r: any) => ({
            projectId: id,
            reviewId: r.ReviewID || null,
            date: r.ReviewDate || null,
            reviewerName: r.ReviewReviewerName || null,
            asin: r.ReviewASIN || null,
            productVariation: r.ReviewProductVariation || null,
            starRating: r.ReviewStarRating || null,
            title: r.ReviewTitle || null,
            text: r.ReviewText || r.originalText || null,
            sentiment: r.ReviewSentiment || null,
            keyThemes: r.ReviewKeyThemes || null,
            usageMentioned: r.ReviewUsageMentioned || null,
            packagingFeedback: r.ReviewPackagingFeedback || null,
            priceFeedback: r.ReviewPriceFeedback || null,
            heatLevelFeedback: r.ReviewHeatLevelFeedback || null,
            rufusUsableInsight: r.ReviewRufusUsableInsight || null,
            bulletMapping: r.ReviewBulletMapping || null,
            helpfulVotes: 0,
          })));
        }
        await db.update(seoProjects).set({ s3ApprovedAt: new Date(), currentPhase: "S4", updatedAt: new Date() }).where(eq(seoProjects.id, id));
        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, count: data.reviews?.length || 0 });
      }

      case "s4_rufus_draft":
      case "s4_rufus": {
        const rows = data.analyzedRows || [];
        const existing = await db.select({ id: seoRufus.id }).from(seoRufus).where(eq(seoRufus.projectId, id)).limit(1);
        if (existing.length > 0) {
          await db.update(seoRufus).set({ rows, updatedAt: new Date() }).where(eq(seoRufus.projectId, id));
        } else {
          await db.insert(seoRufus).values({ projectId: id, rows });
        }
        // Only advance phase on full approval, not draft save
        if (phase === "s4_rufus") {
          await db.update(seoProjects).set({ s4ApprovedAt: new Date(), currentPhase: "S5", updatedAt: new Date() }).where(eq(seoProjects.id, id));
        }
        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, count: rows.length });
      }

      case "s5_cosmo": {
        const rows = data.rows || [];
        const existing = await db.select({ id: seoCosmopMaps.id }).from(seoCosmopMaps).where(eq(seoCosmopMaps.projectId, id)).limit(1);
        if (existing.length > 0) {
          await db.update(seoCosmopMaps).set({ rows, updatedAt: new Date() }).where(eq(seoCosmopMaps.projectId, id));
        } else {
          await db.insert(seoCosmopMaps).values({ projectId: id, rows });
        }
        await db.update(seoProjects).set({ s5ApprovedAt: new Date(), currentPhase: "S6", updatedAt: new Date() }).where(eq(seoProjects.id, id));
        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, count: rows.length });
      }

      case "s6_compliance": {
        const issues = data.rows || [];
        const existing = await db.select({ id: seoComplianceReports.id }).from(seoComplianceReports).where(eq(seoComplianceReports.projectId, id)).limit(1);
        if (existing.length > 0) {
          await db.update(seoComplianceReports).set({ issues, status: data.summary?.status || "clean" }).where(eq(seoComplianceReports.projectId, id));
        } else {
          await db.insert(seoComplianceReports).values({ projectId: id, issues, status: data.summary?.status || "clean" });
        }
        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, count: issues.length });
      }

      case "s7_seo": {
        // Store generated content on each seo_asin row
        const rows: any[] = data.rows || [];
        if (rows.length > 0 && rows[0].Title) {
          console.log(`[SEO Save] s7_seo: ${rows.length} rows, first title length: ${rows[0].Title.length}`);
        }
        const encoder = new TextEncoder();
        for (const r of rows) {
          const { ASIN, URL, VariationID, VariationProduct, ParentageLevel, VariationThemeName, Flavor, Style, Color, Size, ...content } = r;
          // Always recompute char/byte counts before persisting
          for (const key of Object.keys(content)) {
            if (key.endsWith("_CharLength")) {
              const ck = key.replace("_CharLength", "");
              if (typeof content[ck] === "string") content[key] = content[ck].length;
            } else if (key.endsWith("_ByteLength")) {
              const ck = key.replace("_ByteLength", "");
              if (typeof content[ck] === "string") content[key] = encoder.encode(content[ck]).length;
            }
          }
          await db.update(seoAsins).set({ generatedContent: content }).where(eq(seoAsins.asin, ASIN));
        }
        if (data.config?.in_progress === false) {
          await db.update(seoProjects).set({ s6ApprovedAt: new Date(), updatedAt: new Date() }).where(eq(seoProjects.id, id));
        }
        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, count: rows.length });
      }

      default:
        return NextResponse.json({ error: `Unknown phase: ${phase}` }, { status: 400 });
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error("SEO save error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: err.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

    expect(res.status).toBe(400);

    mockedGetAuthSession.mockResolvedValue(mockSession);

    expect(body.action).toBe("approve");
    expect(body.count).toBe(2);
  });

    mockedGetAuthSession.mockResolvedValue(mockSession);
    const res = await PATCH(patchReq({ action: "reassign", projectIds: ["p1"] }));
    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect((await res.json()).error).toBe("assignTo required for reassign");
  });

  it("reassigns projects successfully", async () => {
    mockedGetAuthSession.mockResolvedValue(mockSession);
    const res = await PATCH(patchReq({ action: "reassign", projectIds: ["p1"], assignTo: "user-123" }));
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect((await res.json()).action).toBe("reassign");
  });

  it("returns 400 for unknown action", async () => {
    mockedGetAuthSession.mockResolvedValue(mockSession);
    const res = await PATCH(patchReq({ action: "invalid", projectIds: ["p1"] }));
    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect((await res.json()).error).toMatch(/Unknown action/);
  });
});

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { seoProjects, seoAsins, seoExports } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { eq, inArray } from "drizzle-orm";
import { buildDocxBuffer, type DocxRow } from "@/lib/seo-docx-builder";
import { driveClient } from "@/lib/drive-client";

export const maxDuration = 120;

// PATCH /api/seo/projects/bulk — bulk operations
export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  try {
    const { action, projectIds, assignTo } = await req.json();

    if (!Array.isArray(projectIds) || projectIds.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "projectIds array required" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    switch (action) {
      case "approve": {
        // Mark S6 as approved for all selected projects
        await db
          .update(seoProjects)
          .set({
            s6ApprovedAt: new Date(),
            status: "completed",
            updatedAt: new Date(),
          })
          .where(inArray(seoProjects.id, projectIds));

        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, action: "approve", count: projectIds.length });
      }

      case "reassign": {
        if (!assignTo) {
          return NextResponse.json({ error: "assignTo required for reassign" }, { status: 400 });
        }
        await db
          .update(seoProjects)
          .set({ assignedTo: assignTo, updatedAt: new Date() })
          .where(inArray(seoProjects.id, projectIds));

        return NextResponse.json({ success: true, action: "reassign", count: projectIds.length });
      }

      case "export": {
        const rootFolderId = process.env.GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID?.trim();
        if (!rootFolderId) {
          return NextResponse.json(
            { error: "Google Drive not configured" },
            { status: 400 }
          );
        }

        // Use dynamic import for p-limit (ESM)
        const pLimit = (await import("p-limit")).default;
        const limit = pLimit(5);

        const results = await Promise.allSettled(
          projectIds.map((id: string) =>
            limit(async () => {
              const [project] = await db
                .select({ brandName: seoProjects.brandName })
                .from(seoProjects)
                .where(eq(seoProjects.id, id))
                .limit(1);

              const asins = await db
                .select({
                  asin: seoAsins.asin,
                  parentageLevel: seoAsins.parentageLevel,
                  variationProduct: seoAsins.variationProduct,
                  flavor: seoAsins.flavor,
                  style: seoAsins.style,
                  color: seoAsins.color,
                  size: seoAsins.size,
                  generatedContent: seoAsins.generatedContent,
                })
                .from(seoAsins)
                .where(eq(seoAsins.projectId, id));

              if (!asins.length) throw new Error("No ASIN data");

              const hasContent = asins.some((a) => {
                const gc = (a.generatedContent as unknown as Record<string, string>) || {};
                return !!gc.Title;
              });
              if (!hasContent) throw new Error("No content generated");

              const brand = project?.brandName || "Unknown Brand";
              const dateSlug = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
              const today = new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
                year: "numeric",
                month: "long",
                day: "numeric",
              });

              const rows: DocxRow[] = asins
                .sort((a, b) => {
                  const aP = (a.parentageLevel || "").toLowerCase() === "parent";
                  const bP = (b.parentageLevel || "").toLowerCase() === "parent";
                  if (aP && !bP) return -1;
                  if (!aP && bP) return 1;
                  return a.asin.localeCompare(b.asin);
                })
                .map((a) => {
                  const gc = (a.generatedContent as unknown as Record<string, string | number>) || {};
                  return {
                    asin: a.asin || "", parentage: a.parentageLevel || "",
                    product: a.variationProduct || "",
                    flavor: a.flavor || "", style: a.style || "",
                    color: a.color || "", size: a.size || "",
                    title: (gc.Title as string) || "", titleC: (gc.Title_CharLength as number) || 0,
                    d1: (gc.DetailedBulletPoint_1 as string) || "", d1c: (gc.DetailedBulletPoint_1_CharLength as number) || 0,
                    d2: (gc.DetailedBulletPoint_2 as string) || "", d2c: (gc.DetailedBulletPoint_2_CharLength as number) || 0,
                    d3: (gc.DetailedBulletPoint_3 as string) || "", d3c: (gc.DetailedBulletPoint_3_CharLength as number) || 0,
                    d4: (gc.DetailedBulletPoint_4 as string) || "", d4c: (gc.DetailedBulletPoint_4_CharLength as number) || 0,
                    d5: (gc.DetailedBulletPoint_5 as string) || "", d5c: (gc.DetailedBulletPoint_5_CharLength as number) || 0,
                    c1: (gc.ConciseBulletPoint_1 as string) || "", c1c: (gc.ConciseBulletPoint_1_CharLength as number) || 0,
                    c2: (gc.ConciseBulletPoint_2 as string) || "", c2c: (gc.ConciseBulletPoint_2_CharLength as number) || 0,
                    c3: (gc.ConciseBulletPoint_3 as string) || "", c3c: (gc.ConciseBulletPoint_3_CharLength as number) || 0,
                    c4: (gc.ConciseBulletPoint_4 as string) || "", c4c: (gc.ConciseBulletPoint_4_CharLength as number) || 0,
                    c5: (gc.ConciseBulletPoint_5 as string) || "", c5c: (gc.ConciseBulletPoint_5_CharLength as number) || 0,
                    ct1: (gc.ContentBulletPoint_1 as string) || "", ct1c: (gc.ContentBulletPoint_1_CharLength as number) || 0,
                    ct2: (gc.ContentBulletPoint_2 as string) || "", ct2c: (gc.ContentBulletPoint_2_CharLength as number) || 0,
                    ct3: (gc.ContentBulletPoint_3 as string) || "", ct3c: (gc.ContentBulletPoint_3_CharLength as number) || 0,
                    ct4: (gc.ContentBulletPoint_4 as string) || "", ct4c: (gc.ContentBulletPoint_4_CharLength as number) || 0,
                    ct5: (gc.ContentBulletPoint_5 as string) || "", ct5c: (gc.ContentBulletPoint_5_CharLength as number) || 0,
                    kf1: (gc.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_1 as string) || "", kf1c: (gc.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_1_CharLength as number) || 0,
                    kf2: (gc.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_2 as string) || "", kf2c: (gc.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_2_CharLength as number) || 0,
                    kf3: (gc.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_3 as string) || "", kf3c: (gc.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_3_CharLength as number) || 0,
                    kf4: (gc.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_4 as string) || "", kf4c: (gc.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_4_CharLength as number) || 0,
                    kf5: (gc.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_5 as string) || "", kf5c: (gc.KeyFeaturesBulletPoint_5_CharLength as number) || 0,
                    desc: (gc.ProductDescription as string) || "", descC: (gc.ProductDescription_CharLength as number) || 0,
                    backend: (gc.BackendSearchTerms as string) || "", backendB: (gc.BackendSearchTerms_ByteLength as number) || 0,
                  };
                });

              const buffer = await buildDocxBuffer(rows, brand, today);
              const docName = `OUT_SEO_${brand.replace(/\s+/g, "_")}_${dateSlug}`;

              const safeBrand = brand.replace(/[/\\?%*:|"<>]/g, "-").trim();
              const existingFolders = await driveClient.listFiles(
                `name='${safeBrand.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}' and mimeType='application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and '${rootFolderId}' in parents and trashed=false`,
              );
              const brandFolderId = existingFolders.files.length
                ? existingFolders.files[0].id
                : (await driveClient.createFolder(safeBrand, rootFolderId)).id;

              try {
                const old = await driveClient.listFiles(
                  `(name='${docName}' or name='${docName}.docx') and '${brandFolderId}' in parents and trashed=false`,
                );
                for (const f of old.files) await driveClient.deleteFile(f.id);
              } catch (_) {}

              const uploaded = await driveClient.uploadFile(
                `${docName}.docx`,
                brandFolderId,
                buffer,
                "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
              );

              const url = `https://drive.google.com/file/d/${uploaded.id}/view`;

              // Insert export record after successful upload
              await db.insert(seoExports).values({
                projectId: id,
                type: "google_doc",
                url,
                contentSnapshot: { brand, asinsCount: asins.length, date: dateSlug },
              });

              return { projectId: id, url, brand };
            })
          )
        );

        const exported = results.map((r, i) => {
          const base = { id: projectIds[i], status: r.status };
          if (r.status === "fulfilled") {
            return { ...base, url: r.value.url, brand: r.value.brand };
          }
          return { ...base, error: (r as PromiseRejectedResult).reason?.message };
        });

        const successCount = results.filter((r) => r.status === "fulfilled").length;
        return NextResponse.json({
          success: true,
          action: "export",
          total: projectIds.length,
          successCount,
          failedCount: projectIds.length - successCount,
          results: exported,
        });
      }

      default:
        return NextResponse.json({ error: `Unknown action: ${action}` }, { status: 400 });
    }
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unknown error";
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: src/app/api/seo/projects/catalog/route.ts

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, variations } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { and, eq, ilike, inArray, or, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";

interface CatalogChild {
  id: string;
  asin: string;
  sku: string;
  title: string;
  parentageLevel: string;
  flavor: string | null;
  style: string | null;
  color: string | null;
  size: string | null;
  status: string | null;
  mainImageUrl: string | null;
  variationId: string | null;
  variationGroup: string | null;
}

interface CatalogFamily {
  parentAsin: string;
  parentSku: string;
  parentTitle: string;
  variationTheme: string;
  mainImageUrl: string | null;
  children: CatalogChild[];
  groups: string[];
}

const selectCols = {
  id: master.id,
  asin: master.asin,
  sku: master.sku,
  itemName: master.itemName,
  summarizedTitle: master.summarizedTitle,
  parentageLevel: master.parentageLevel,
  parentSku: master.parentSku,
  parentAsin: master.parentAsin,
  status: master.status,
  mainImageUrl: master.mainImageUrl,
  variations: master.variations,
  variationGroup: master.variationGroup,
  variationRef: master.variationRef,
} as const;

/**
 * GET /api/seo/projects/catalog?clientIdCode=X&search=optional
 * Returns products grouped by variation family for the wizard ASIN picker.
 */
export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const session = await getAuthSession();
    if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

    const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
    const clientIdCode = searchParams.get("clientIdCode");
    if (!clientIdCode) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "clientIdCode is required" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const conditions = [eq(master.clientIdCode, clientIdCode)];

    const search = searchParams.get("search");
    if (search) {
      const pattern = `%${search}%`;
      conditions.push(
        or(
          ilike(master.asin, pattern),
          ilike(master.itemName, pattern),
          ilike(master.summarizedTitle, pattern),
          ilike(master.sku, pattern)
        )!
      );
    }

    const rows = await db
      .select(selectCols)
      .from(master)
      .where(and(...conditions))
      .orderBy(sql`${master.parentageLevel} ASC NULLS LAST`, sql`${master.asin} ASC`);

    // ── Deduplicate by ASIN: prefer rows with variationRef ──
    const deduped = new Map<string, typeof rows[number]>();
    for (const row of rows) {
      const key = row.asin || row.id;
      const existing = deduped.get(key);
      if (!existing || (!existing.variationRef && row.variationRef)) {
        deduped.set(key, row);
      }
    }
    const uniqueRows = [...deduped.values()];

    // ── Load variation names for products that have variationRef ──
    const variationRefIds = [...new Set(uniqueRows.map(r => r.variationRef).filter(Boolean))] as string[];
    const variationNameMap = new Map<string, { name: string; theme: string; image: string | null }>();
    if (variationRefIds.length > 0) {
      const varRows = await db.select({
        id: variations.id,
        name: variations.name,
        themeAttributes: variations.themeAttributes,
      }).from(variations).where(inArray(variations.id, variationRefIds));
      for (const v of varRows) {
        variationNameMap.set(v.id, {
          name: v.name,
          theme: (v.themeAttributes || []).join("-"),
          image: null,
        });
      }
    }

    // ── Build family groupings ──
    const familyMap = new Map<string, CatalogFamily>();
    const standalone: CatalogChild[] = [];

    // Index parents first
    const parentByAsin = new Map<string, typeof uniqueRows[number]>();
    const parentBySku = new Map<string, typeof uniqueRows[number]>();

    for (const row of uniqueRows) {
      if (row.parentageLevel?.toLowerCase() === "parent") {
        if (row.asin) parentByAsin.set(row.asin, row);
        if (row.sku) parentBySku.set(row.sku, row);
      }
    }

    // Prefer variation builder grouping: group by variationRef when available
    // Otherwise fall back to parentage-based grouping
    for (const row of uniqueRows) {
      if (row.parentageLevel?.toLowerCase() === "parent") {
        // Parents: create family keyed by variationRef (preferred) or ASIN
        const varInfo = row.variationRef ? variationNameMap.get(row.variationRef) : null;
        const familyKey = row.variationRef || row.asin || row.sku || row.id;
        if (!familyMap.has(familyKey)) {
          const v = row.variations || {};
          familyMap.set(familyKey, {
            parentAsin: row.asin || "",
            parentSku: row.sku || "",
            parentTitle: row.itemName || row.summarizedTitle || row.asin || "",
            variationTheme: varInfo?.theme || v.VariationThemeName || "",
            mainImageUrl: row.mainImageUrl,
            children: [],
            groups: [],
          });
        }
        continue;
      }

      const child: CatalogChild = {
        id: row.id,
        asin: row.asin || "",
        sku: row.sku || "",
        title: row.itemName || row.summarizedTitle || "",
        parentageLevel: row.parentageLevel || "",
        flavor: row.variations?.Flavor || null,
        style: row.variations?.Style || null,
        color: row.variations?.Color || null,
        size: row.variations?.Size || null,
        status: row.status,
        mainImageUrl: row.mainImageUrl,
        variationId: row.variations?.VariationID || null,
        variationGroup: row.variationGroup || null,
      };

      // Priority 1: Match by variationRef (variation builder grouping)
      if (row.variationRef && familyMap.has(row.variationRef)) {
        familyMap.get(row.variationRef)!.children.push(child);
        continue;
      }

      // Priority 2: Match by variationRef even if parent wasn't loaded
      if (row.variationRef) {
        const varInfo = variationNameMap.get(row.variationRef);
        if (!familyMap.has(row.variationRef)) {
          familyMap.set(row.variationRef, {
            parentAsin: "",
            parentSku: "",
            parentTitle: varInfo?.name || "Variation Group",
            variationTheme: varInfo?.theme || row.variations?.VariationThemeName || "",
            mainImageUrl: null,
            children: [],
            groups: [],
          });
        }
        familyMap.get(row.variationRef)!.children.push(child);
        continue;
      }

      // Priority 3: Match by parentAsin/parentSku (legacy parentage grouping)
      let familyKey: string | null = null;
      if (row.parentAsin && parentByAsin.has(row.parentAsin)) {
        const parent = parentByAsin.get(row.parentAsin)!;
        familyKey = parent.variationRef || row.parentAsin;
      } else if (row.parentSku && parentBySku.has(row.parentSku)) {
        const parent = parentBySku.get(row.parentSku)!;
        familyKey = parent.variationRef || parent.asin || parent.sku || parent.id;
      }

      if (familyKey && familyMap.has(familyKey)) {
        familyMap.get(familyKey)!.children.push(child);
      } else if (row.parentageLevel?.toLowerCase() === "child") {
        // Orphan child — create a placeholder family
        const key = row.parentAsin || row.parentSku || `orphan-${row.id}`;
        if (!familyMap.has(key)) {
          familyMap.set(key, {
            parentAsin: row.parentAsin || "",
            parentSku: row.parentSku || "",
            parentTitle: `Family: ${row.parentAsin || row.parentSku || "Unknown"}`,
            variationTheme: row.variations?.VariationThemeName || "",
            mainImageUrl: null,
            children: [],
            groups: [],
          });
        }
        familyMap.get(key)!.children.push(child);
      } else {
        standalone.push(child);
      }
    }

    // ── Merge duplicate families ──
    // A parent with no variationRef creates an ASIN-keyed family.
    // Its children with variationRef create a separate variationRef-keyed family.
    // Merge the ASIN-keyed family into the variationRef-keyed one.
    const parentAsinToVarKey = new Map<string, string>();
    for (const [key, family] of familyMap) {
      // variationRef keys are UUIDs; ASIN keys are not
      if (key.includes("-") && key.length > 20 && family.parentAsin) {
        // This is a variationRef-keyed family — record which parentAsin it covers
        parentAsinToVarKey.set(family.parentAsin, key);
      }
      // Also check children's parent ASINs for families without a parentAsin set
      if (key.includes("-") && key.length > 20 && !family.parentAsin) {
        for (const child of family.children) {
          const childRow = uniqueRows.find(r => r.id === child.id);
          if (childRow?.parentAsin) {
            parentAsinToVarKey.set(childRow.parentAsin, key);
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
    for (const [asinKey, family] of familyMap) {
      // Skip variationRef-keyed families
      if (asinKey.includes("-") && asinKey.length > 20) continue;
      const varKey = parentAsinToVarKey.get(asinKey);
      if (varKey && familyMap.has(varKey)) {
        const target = familyMap.get(varKey)!;
        // Merge children into the variationRef family
        target.children.push(...family.children);
        // Fill in parent info if the target was missing it
        if (!target.parentAsin && family.parentAsin) target.parentAsin = family.parentAsin;
        if (!target.parentSku && family.parentSku) target.parentSku = family.parentSku;
        if (!target.mainImageUrl && family.mainImageUrl) target.mainImageUrl = family.mainImageUrl;
        // Use the parent's title if target has a generic one
        if (target.parentTitle === "Variation Group" && family.parentTitle) {
          target.parentTitle = family.parentTitle;
        }
        familyMap.delete(asinKey);
      }
    }

    // ── Resolve remaining orphan titles ──
    // Any family still showing "Family: {ASIN}" has no variation match — try DB lookup
    const orphanAsins = [...familyMap.values()]
      .filter(f => f.parentTitle.startsWith("Family: ") && f.parentAsin)
      .map(f => f.parentAsin);
    if (orphanAsins.length > 0) {
      const parentRows = await db
        .select({ asin: master.asin, itemName: master.itemName, summarizedTitle: master.summarizedTitle })
        .from(master)
        .where(inArray(master.asin, orphanAsins));
      const titleMap = new Map(parentRows.map(p => [p.asin, p.itemName || p.summarizedTitle || ""]));
      for (const family of familyMap.values()) {
        if (!family.parentTitle.startsWith("Family: ")) continue;
        const resolved = titleMap.get(family.parentAsin);
        if (resolved) {
          family.parentTitle = resolved;
        } else if (family.children.length > 0) {
          // Derive from first child
          const theme = family.variationTheme || "Variations";
          family.parentTitle = `${family.parentAsin} (${theme})`;
        }
      }
    }

    // Compute distinct individual group tags per family
    // variationGroup is comma-separated (e.g. "5.5Flo2Pk, Fla01") — split into individual tags
    for (const family of familyMap.values()) {
      const groupSet = new Set<string>();
      for (const child of family.children) {
        if (child.variationGroup) {
          for (const tag of child.variationGroup.split(",")) {
            const trimmed = tag.trim();
            if (trimmed) groupSet.add(trimmed);
          }
        }
      }
      family.groups = Array.from(groupSet).sort();
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      families: Array.from(familyMap.values()),
      standalone,
      totalCount: uniqueRows.length,
    });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unknown error";
    console.error("Catalog GET error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from "vitest";
import { NextRequest } from "next/server";

const { mockDb, mockedGetAuthSession } = vi.hoisted(() => {
  const chain: Record<string, ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>> = {};
  const methods = ["select", "from", "where", "orderBy", "limit", "insert", "update", "set", "values", "returning", "execute", "leftJoin"];
  for (const m of methods) {
    chain[m] = vi.fn().mockReturnValue(chain);
  }
  // Terminal methods resolve promises
  chain.orderBy = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([]);
  chain.returning = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([]);
  chain.execute = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([]);

  return {
    mockDb: chain,
    mockedGetAuthSession: vi.fn(),
  };
});

  seoQualityScores: { projectId: "project_id", createdAt: "created_at" },
}));
vi.mock("@/lib/auth-db", () => ({ getAuthSession: mockedGetAuthSession }));

import { GET, POST } from "./route";

const mockSession = { user: { email: "test@1o8.agency", role: "admin" } };

beforeEach(() => vi.clearAllMocks());

describe("GET /api/seo/quality", () => {
  it("returns 401 when not authenticated", async () => {
    mockedGetAuthSession.mockResolvedValue(null);
    const res = await GET(new NextRequest("http://localhost/api/seo/quality?projectId=abc"));
    expect(res.status).toBe(401);
  });

  it("returns 400 when projectId is missing", async () => {
    mockedGetAuthSession.mockResolvedValue(mockSession);
    const res = await GET(new NextRequest("http://localhost/api/seo/quality"));
    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect((await res.json()).error).toBe("projectId required");
  });

  it("returns scores for valid projectId", async () => {
    mockedGetAuthSession.mockResolvedValue(mockSession);
    const fakeScores = [{ id: "1", projectId: "abc", overallScore: 85 }];
    mockDb.orderBy.mockResolvedValueOnce(fakeScores);
    const res = await GET(new NextRequest("http://localhost/api/seo/quality?projectId=abc"));
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(await res.json()).toEqual(fakeScores);
  });
});

describe("POST /api/seo/quality", () => {
  it("returns 401 when not authenticated", async () => {
    mockedGetAuthSession.mockResolvedValue(null);
    const res = await POST(new NextRequest("http://localhost/api/seo/quality", {
      method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ projectId: "abc", overallScore: 85 }),
    }));
    expect(res.status).toBe(401);
  });

  it("returns 400 when projectId is missing", async () => {
    mockedGetAuthSession.mockResolvedValue(mockSession);
    const res = await POST(new NextRequest("http://localhost/api/seo/quality", {
      method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ overallScore: 85 }),
    }));
    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
    expect((await res.json()).error).toBe("projectId and overallScore required");
  });

  it("returns 400 when overallScore is missing", async () => {
    mockedGetAuthSession.mockResolvedValue(mockSession);
    const res = await POST(new NextRequest("http://localhost/api/seo/quality", {
      method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ projectId: "abc" }),
    }));
    expect(res.status).toBe(400);
  });

  it("persists score and returns it on success", async () => {
    mockedGetAuthSession.mockResolvedValue(mockSession);
    const saved = { id: "1", projectId: "abc", overallScore: 85 };
    mockDb.returning.mockResolvedValueOnce([saved]);
    const res = await POST(new NextRequest("http://localhost/api/seo/quality", {
      method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ projectId: "abc", overallScore: 85.7, complianceScore: 90.2 }),
    }));
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect((await res.json()).id).toBe("1");
  });
});

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { seoQualityScores } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { eq, desc } from "drizzle-orm";

// GET /api/seo/quality?projectId=xxx — fetch quality score history
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const projectId = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("projectId");
  if (!projectId) return NextResponse.json({ error: "projectId required" }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const scores = await db
      .select()
      .from(seoQualityScores)
      .where(eq(seoQualityScores.projectId, projectId))
      .orderBy(desc(seoQualityScores.createdAt));

    return NextResponse.json(scores);
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unknown error";
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// POST /api/seo/quality — persist audit score
export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    const { projectId, overallScore, complianceScore, keywordCoverage,
      cosmoDensity, rufusCoverage, humanVoice, buyerJourney,
      variationConsistency, eeatScore, readabilityScore, citabilityScore,
      geoScore, findingsCount } = body;

    if (!projectId || overallScore === undefined) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "projectId and overallScore required" }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const [score] = await db
      .insert(seoQualityScores)
      .values({
        projectId,
        overallScore: Math.round(overallScore),
        complianceScore: complianceScore != null ? Math.round(complianceScore) : null,
        keywordCoverage: keywordCoverage != null ? Math.round(keywordCoverage) : null,
        cosmoDensity: cosmoDensity != null ? Math.round(cosmoDensity) : null,
        rufusCoverage: rufusCoverage != null ? Math.round(rufusCoverage) : null,
        humanVoice: humanVoice != null ? Math.round(humanVoice) : null,
        buyerJourney: buyerJourney != null ? Math.round(buyerJourney) : null,
        variationConsistency: variationConsistency != null ? Math.round(variationConsistency) : null,
        eeatScore: eeatScore != null ? Math.round(eeatScore) : null,
        readabilityScore: readabilityScore != null ? Math.round(readabilityScore) : null,
        citabilityScore: citabilityScore != null ? Math.round(citabilityScore) : null,
        geoScore: geoScore != null ? Math.round(geoScore) : null,
        findingsCount: findingsCount || 0,
      })
      .returning();

    return NextResponse.json(score);
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unknown error";
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { getSeoVersions } from "@/lib/bigquery";
import type { SeoVersion } from "@/lib/seo-types";

/** The 27 SEO content fields we extract from each BQ row */
const SEO_FIELD_NAMES = [
  "ItemName",
  "DetailedBulletPoint1",
  "DetailedBulletPoint2",
  "DetailedBulletPoint3",
  "DetailedBulletPoint4",
  "DetailedBulletPoint5",
  "ProductDescription",
  "GenericKeyword1",
  "GenericKeyword2",
  "GenericKeyword3",
  "GenericKeyword4",
  "GenericKeyword5",
  "ConciseBulletPoint1",
  "ConciseBulletPoint2",
  "ConciseBulletPoint3",
  "ConciseBulletPoint4",
  "ConciseBulletPoint5",
  "PA_LIBulletPoint1",
  "PA_LIBulletPoint2",
  "PA_LIBulletPoint3",
  "PA_LIBulletPoint4",
  "PA_LIBulletPoint5",
  "KeyFeature1",
  "KeyFeature2",
  "KeyFeature3",
  "KeyFeature4",
  "KeyFeature5",
];

export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  const asin = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("asin");
  const sku = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("sku");

  if (!asin || !sku) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "asin and sku are required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );
  }

  try {
    const rows = await getSeoVersions(asin, sku);

    const versions: SeoVersion[] = rows.map((row) => {
      const fields: Record<string, string> = {};
      let populatedCount = 0;

      for (const name of SEO_FIELD_NAMES) {
        const val = row[name] ?? "";
        fields[name] = val;
        if (val.trim()) populatedCount++;
      }

      return {
        seoVersionNumber: row["SEOVersionNumber"] ?? "",
        seoCategory: row["SEOCategory"] ?? "",
        seoStatus: row["SEOStatus"] ?? "",
        seoDocUrl: row["SEODocURL"] || null,
        fields,
        populatedCount,
      };
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ versions });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Failed to fetch SEO versions:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to fetch SEO versions" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

FILE: src/app/api/sync/status/route.ts

import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, publishHistory } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, desc, count, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

export async function GET() {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  // Pending changes count
  const [dirtyResult] = await db
    .select({ count: count() })
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.isDirty, true));

  // Total products
  const [totalResult] = await db
    .select({ count: count() })
    .from(master);

  // Last sync
  const [lastSync] = await db
    .select({
      id: publishHistory.id,
      publishedBy: publishHistory.publishedBy,
      publishedAt: publishHistory.publishedAt,
      rowsPublished: publishHistory.rowsPublished,
      jobId: publishHistory.jobId,
      dirtyCount: publishHistory.dirtyCount,
    })
    .from(publishHistory)
    .orderBy(desc(publishHistory.publishedAt))
    .limit(1);

  // Recent editors — unique emails from dirty products' changeLogs
  const dirtyProducts = await db
    .select({ changeLog: master.changeLog })
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.isDirty, true));

  const editors = new Set<string>();
  for (const p of dirtyProducts) {
    for (const entry of p.changeLog ?? []) {
      if (entry.changedBy) editors.add(entry.changedBy);
    }
  }

  return NextResponse.json({
    pendingChanges: dirtyResult.count,
    totalProducts: totalResult.count,
    lastSync: lastSync ?? null,
    pendingEditors: Array.from(editors),
  });
}

FILE: src/app/api/sync/tables/route.ts
================================================
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { BigQuery } from "@google-cloud/bigquery";

export const maxDuration = 60;

const PROJECT_ID = process.env.GCP_PROJECT_ID || "amazon-data-461918";
const DATASET = process.env.BQ_DATASET || "1o8Hub";

function getBigQueryClient(): BigQuery {
  if (process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL && process.env.GCP_PRIVATE_KEY) {
    let privateKey = process.env.GCP_PRIVATE_KEY;
    privateKey = privateKey.replace(/\\n/g, "\n");
    if (privateKey.startsWith('"') && privateKey.endsWith('"')) {
      privateKey = JSON.parse(privateKey);
    }
    return new BigQuery({
      projectId: PROJECT_ID,
      credentials: {
        client_email: process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL,
        private_key: privateKey,
      },
    });
  }
  return new BigQuery({ projectId: PROJECT_ID });
}

// Tables that are affected by a pending incremental sync
const SYNC_AFFECTED_TABLES = ["Master", "Master_Staging"];

export async function GET() {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const bq = getBigQueryClient();
    const ds = bq.dataset(DATASET);
    const [tables] = await ds.getTables();

    const tableInfos = await Promise.all(
      tables.map(async (table) => {
        const tableId = table.id!;
        try {
          const [metadata] = await table.getMetadata();
          const numRows = parseInt(metadata.numRows ?? "0", 10);
          const numBytes = parseInt(metadata.numBytes ?? "0", 10);
          const lastModified = metadata.lastModifiedTime
            ? new Date(parseInt(metadata.lastModifiedTime, 10)).toISOString()
            : null;
          const createdAt = metadata.creationTime
            ? new Date(parseInt(metadata.creationTime, 10)).toISOString()
            : null;
          const columnCount = metadata.schema?.fields?.length ?? 0;
          const type = metadata.type ?? "TABLE";

          return {
            id: tableId,
            type,
            numRows,
            numBytes,
            columnCount,
            lastModified,
            createdAt,
            affectedBySync: SYNC_AFFECTED_TABLES.includes(tableId),
          };
        } catch {
          return {
            id: tableId,
            type: "TABLE",
            numRows: 0,
            numBytes: 0,
            columnCount: 0,
            lastModified: null,
            createdAt: null,
            affectedBySync: SYNC_AFFECTED_TABLES.includes(tableId),
          };
        }
      })
    );

    // Sort: affected tables first, then alphabetical
    tableInfos.sort((a, b) => {
      if (a.affectedBySync !== b.affectedBySync)
        return a.affectedBySync ? -1 : 1;
      return a.id.localeCompare(b.id);
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      dataset: `${PROJECT_ID}.${DATASET}`,
      tables: tableInfos,
    });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Failed to fetch BQ table metadata:", err);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "Failed to fetch BigQuery tables" },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

FILE: src/app/api/sync/trigger/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession, canAccessSection } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { publishDirtyToBigQuery, publishToBigQuery } from "@/lib/bigquery";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, publishHistory } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";

export const maxDuration = 60;

export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });
  }

  if (!canAccessSection(session, "publish")) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Forbidden" }, { status: 403 });
  }

  let mode: "incremental" | "full" = "incremental";
  try {
    const body = await req.json();
    if (body?.mode === "full") mode = "full";
  } catch {
    // Default incremental
  }

  // Snapshot dirty products before sync
  const dirtyRows = await db
    .select({
      id: master.id,
      asin: master.asin,
      sku: master.sku,
      changeLog: master.changeLog,
    })
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.isDirty, true));

  if (mode === "incremental" && dirtyRows.length === 0) {
    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      message: "No pending changes to sync",
      synced: 0,
    });
  }

  const changesSnapshot = dirtyRows.map((p) => ({
    asin: p.asin,
    sku: p.sku,
    edits: (p.changeLog ?? []).map((e) => ({
      field: e.field,
      oldValue: e.oldValue,
      newValue: e.newValue,
    })),
  }));

  try {
    const result =
      mode === "full"
        ? await publishToBigQuery()
        : await publishDirtyToBigQuery();

    // Clear changeLogs
    if (dirtyRows.length > 0) {
      for (const row of dirtyRows) {
        await db
          .update(master)
          .set({ changeLog: [] })
          .where(eq(master.id, row.id));
      }
    }

    // Log to history
    await db.insert(publishHistory).values({
      publishedBy: session.user.email,
      rowsPublished: result.rowsPublished,
      jobId: result.jobId,
      dirtyCount: dirtyRows.length,
      changes: changesSnapshot,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      synced: result.rowsPublished,
      jobId: result.jobId,
      mode,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Unknown error";
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `Sync failed: ${message}` },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { variations } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

// GET /api/variations?clientId=XXX — list all variations for a client
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Not authenticated" }, { status: 401 });

  const clientId = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("clientId");

  const query = db
    .select({
      id: variations.id,
      clientId: variations.clientId,
      name: variations.name,
      code: variations.code,
      amazonVariationId: variations.amazonVariationId,
      themeAttributes: variations.themeAttributes,
      primaryDimension: variations.primaryDimension,
      description: variations.description,
      status: variations.status,
      lockedAt: variations.lockedAt,
      createdAt: variations.createdAt,
      updatedAt: variations.updatedAt,
      groupCount: sql<number>`(
        SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM variation_groups
        WHERE variation_id = "variations"."id"
      )`.as("groupCount"),
      productCount: sql<number>`(
        SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM master
        WHERE variation_ref = "variations"."id"
      )`.as("productCount"),
      seoProjectCount: sql<number>`(
        SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM seo_projects
        WHERE variation_id = "variations"."id"
      )`.as("seoProjectCount"),
      vpCount: sql<number>`(
        SELECT count(DISTINCT vpi.pack_product_id)::int
        FROM variety_pack_items vpi
        JOIN master m ON m.id = vpi.pack_product_id
        WHERE m.variation_ref = "variations"."id"
      )`.as("vpCount"),
    })
    .from(variations);

  const rows = clientId
    ? await query.where(eq(variations.clientId, clientId)).orderBy(variations.name)
    : await query.orderBy(variations.name);

  return NextResponse.json(rows);
}

// POST /api/variations — create a new variation
export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Not authenticated" }, { status: 401 });

  const body = await req.json();
  const { clientId, name, code, amazonVariationId, themeAttributes, primaryDimension, description } = body;

  if (!clientId || !name || !code)
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "clientId, name, and code are required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );

  try {
    const [row] = await db
      .insert(variations)
      .values({
        clientId,
        name,
        code,
        amazonVariationId: amazonVariationId || null,
        themeAttributes: themeAttributes || [],
        primaryDimension: primaryDimension || null,
        description: description || null,
      })
      .returning();

    return NextResponse.json(row, { status: 201 });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
    console.error("[POST /api/variations]", message);
    const isDupe = message.includes("unique") || message.includes("duplicate");
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: isDupe ? `Code "${code}" already exists` : message },
      { status: isDupe ? 409 : 500 }
    );
  }
}



================================================
FILE: src/app/api/variations/[id]/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  variations,
  variationGroups,
  variationTags,
  variationTagAssignments,
  variationGroupAssignments,
  varietyPackItems,
  master,
} from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and, sql, isNull, inArray } from "drizzle-orm";

type Params = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// GET /api/variations/[id] — full tree: variation + groups + tags + products
export async function GET(_req: NextRequest, { params }: Params) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Not authenticated" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id } = await params;

  // Run four queries in parallel
  const [variationRows, groupRows, tags, allProducts] = await Promise.all([
    // 1. Variation metadata
    db.select().from(variations).where(eq(variations.id, id)).limit(1),

    // 2. Groups
    db
      .select()
      .from(variationGroups)
      .where(eq(variationGroups.variationId, id))
      .orderBy(variationGroups.sortOrder),

    // 3. Tags with assignment count
    db
      .select({
        id: variationTags.id,
        variationId: variationTags.variationId,
        dimension: variationTags.dimension,
        value: variationTags.value,
        sortOrder: variationTags.sortOrder,
        createdAt: variationTags.createdAt,
        assignmentCount: sql<number>`(
          SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM variation_tag_assignments
          WHERE tag_id = ${variationTags.id}
        )`,
      })
      .from(variationTags)
      .where(eq(variationTags.variationId, id))
      .orderBy(variationTags.dimension, variationTags.sortOrder),

    // 4. All products in this variation (with their tag assignments)
    db
      .select({
        id: master.id,
        asin: master.asin,
        sku: master.sku,
        itemName: master.itemName,
        imageUrl: master.mainImageUrl,
        groupRef: master.groupRef,
        parentageLevel: master.parentageLevel,
        variations: master.variations,
      })
      .from(master)
      .where(eq(master.variationRef, id)),
  ]);

  if (variationRows.length === 0)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Variation not found" }, { status: 404 });

  // Get tag assignments and group assignments for all products in this variation
  const productIds = allProducts.map((p) => p.id);
  let tagAssignments: { tagId: string; productId: string }[] = [];
  let groupAssignments: { groupId: string; productId: string }[] = [];
  let packItems: { packProductId: string; includedProductId: string | null; flavor: string | null; size: string | null; color: string | null; style: string | null; customLabel: string | null; units: number; sortOrder: number | null; includedAsin: string | null; includedTitle: string | null }[] = [];
  if (productIds.length > 0) {
    [tagAssignments, groupAssignments, packItems] = await Promise.all([
      db
        .select({
          tagId: variationTagAssignments.tagId,
          productId: variationTagAssignments.productId,
        })
        .from(variationTagAssignments)
        .where(inArray(variationTagAssignments.productId, productIds)),
      db
        .select({
          groupId: variationGroupAssignments.groupId,
          productId: variationGroupAssignments.productId,
        })
        .from(variationGroupAssignments)
        .where(inArray(variationGroupAssignments.productId, productIds)),
      db
        .select({
          packProductId: varietyPackItems.packProductId,
          includedProductId: varietyPackItems.includedProductId,
          flavor: varietyPackItems.flavor,
          size: varietyPackItems.size,
          color: varietyPackItems.color,
          style: varietyPackItems.style,
          customLabel: varietyPackItems.customLabel,
          units: varietyPackItems.units,
          sortOrder: varietyPackItems.sortOrder,
          includedAsin: master.asin,
          includedTitle: master.itemName,
        })
        .from(varietyPackItems)
        .leftJoin(master, eq(varietyPackItems.includedProductId, master.id))
        .where(inArray(varietyPackItems.packProductId, productIds))
        .orderBy(varietyPackItems.sortOrder),
    ]);
  }

  // Build variety pack lookup (product → items)
  const packLookup = new Map<string, typeof packItems>();
  for (const item of packItems) {
    const arr = packLookup.get(item.packProductId) ?? [];
    arr.push(item);
    packLookup.set(item.packProductId, arr);
  }

  // Build group membership lookup (product → set of group IDs)
  const groupMembership = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  for (const ga of groupAssignments) {
    const set = groupMembership.get(ga.productId) ?? new Set();
    set.add(ga.groupId);
    groupMembership.set(ga.productId, set);
  }

  // Build tag lookup per product
  const tagLookup = new Map<string, { id: string; dimension: string; value: string }[]>();
  for (const assignment of tagAssignments) {
    const tag = tags.find((t) => t.id === assignment.tagId);
    if (tag) {
      const arr = tagLookup.get(assignment.productId) ?? [];
      arr.push({ id: tag.id, dimension: tag.dimension, value: tag.value });
      tagLookup.set(assignment.productId, arr);
    }
  }

  // Map products with tags + variety pack items
  const mapProduct = (p: typeof allProducts[0]) => ({
    id: p.id,
    asin: p.asin,
    sku: p.sku,
    title: p.itemName,
    imageUrl: p.imageUrl,
    parentageLevel: p.parentageLevel,
    variations: p.variations,
    tags: tagLookup.get(p.id) ?? [],
    varietyPackItems: (packLookup.get(p.id) ?? []).map((it) => ({
      includedProductId: it.includedProductId,
      includedAsin: it.includedAsin,
      includedTitle: it.includedTitle,
      flavor: it.flavor,
      size: it.size,
      color: it.color,
      style: it.style,
      customLabel: it.customLabel,
      units: it.units,
    })),
  });

  // Build groups with products (via junction — a product can appear in multiple groups)
  // Also include VP products whose included flavors match the group name
  const groups = groupRows.map((g) => {
    const assigned = allProducts.filter((p) => groupMembership.get(p.id)?.has(g.id));
    const assignedIds = new Set(assigned.map((p) => p.id));
    const vpMatches = allProducts.filter((p) => {
      if (assignedIds.has(p.id)) return false;
      const items = packLookup.get(p.id);
      if (!items?.length) return false;
      const gLower = g.name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g, "");
      return items.some((it) => {
        if (!it.flavor) return false;
        const fLower = it.flavor.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g, "");
        // Exact match, or group name is an abbreviation (first letters of each word)
        if (fLower === gLower) return true;
        const initials = it.flavor.split(/\s+/).map((w) => w.slice(0, 3).toLowerCase()).join("");
        return initials === gLower;
      });
    });
    return {
      ...g,
      products: [...assigned, ...vpMatches].map(mapProduct),
    };
  });

  // Ungrouped products — those with no group assignments at all
  const ungroupedProducts = allProducts
    .filter((p) => !groupMembership.has(p.id))
    .map(mapProduct);

  return NextResponse.json({
    ...variationRows[0],
    groups,
    tags,
    ungroupedProducts,
  });
}

// PATCH /api/variations/[id] — update variation metadata
export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest, { params }: Params) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Not authenticated" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id } = await params;
  const body = await req.json();

  const updates: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (body.name !== undefined) updates.name = body.name;
  if (body.code !== undefined) updates.code = body.code;
  if (body.amazonVariationId !== undefined)
    updates.amazonVariationId = body.amazonVariationId;
  if (body.themeAttributes !== undefined)
    updates.themeAttributes = body.themeAttributes;
  if (body.primaryDimension !== undefined)
    updates.primaryDimension = body.primaryDimension;
  if (body.description !== undefined) updates.description = body.description;
  if (body.status !== undefined) {
    updates.status = body.status;
    updates.lockedAt = body.status === "locked" ? new Date() : null;
  }

  if (Object.keys(updates).length === 0)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "No fields to update" }, { status: 400 });

  updates.updatedAt = new Date();

  const [row] = await db
    .update(variations)
    .set(updates)
    .where(eq(variations.id, id))
    .returning();

  if (!row)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Variation not found" }, { status: 404 });

  return NextResponse.json(row);
}

// DELETE /api/variations/[id] — delete variation (cascades groups/tags; unsets master FKs)
export async function DELETE(_req: NextRequest, { params }: Params) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Not authenticated" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id } = await params;

  await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    // Unset variation_ref, group_ref, variationGroup, and VariationID on master rows
    await tx
      .update(master)
      .set({
        variationRef: null,
        groupRef: null,
        variationGroup: null,
        variations: sql`COALESCE(${master.variations}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) - 'VariationID'`,
      })
      .where(eq(master.variationRef, id));

    // Delete the variation (cascades groups, tags, tag/group assignments via FK cascade)
    await tx.delete(variations).where(eq(variations.id, id));
  });

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
}
