FILE: src/app/api/variations/[id]/assign/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, variations, variationGroups, variationTagAssignments, variationGroupAssignments } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and, inArray, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

type Params = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// PATCH /api/variations/[id]/assign — bulk assign products to variation/group + tags
// Body: { productIds: string[], groupId?: string | null, tagIds?: string[], unassign?: boolean }
export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest, { params }: Params) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Not authenticated" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id } = await params;
  const body = await req.json();
  const { productIds, groupId, tagIds, unassign } = body;

  if (!Array.isArray(productIds) || productIds.length === 0)
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "productIds array is required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );

  await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    // Look up variation code for VariationID in JSONB
    const [variation] = await tx
      .select({ code: variations.code })
      .from(variations)
      .where(eq(variations.id, id))
      .limit(1);
    const variationCode = variation?.code ?? null;

    if (unassign) {
      // Clear variation_ref and VariationID from JSONB
      await tx
        .update(master)
        .set({
          variationRef: null,
          groupRef: null,
          variationGroup: null,
          variations: sql`COALESCE(${master.variations}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) - 'VariationID'`,
        })
        .where(inArray(master.id, productIds));

      // Remove all group assignments for these products
      for (const productId of productIds) {
        await tx
          .delete(variationGroupAssignments)
          .where(eq(variationGroupAssignments.productId, productId));
      }

      // Remove tag assignments
      for (const productId of productIds) {
        await tx
          .delete(variationTagAssignments)
          .where(eq(variationTagAssignments.productId, productId));
      }
      return;
    }

    // 1. Set variation_ref and VariationID in JSONB (no groupRef — groups are via junction now)
    await tx
      .update(master)
      .set({
        variationRef: id,
        variations: sql`jsonb_set(
          COALESCE(${master.variations}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb),
          '{VariationID}',
          ${JSON.stringify(variationCode)}::jsonb
        )`,
      })
      .where(inArray(master.id, productIds));

    // 2. Handle group assignment via junction table (additive — doesn't remove from other groups)
    if (groupId) {
      // Look up group name to sync variationGroup varchar
      const [group] = await tx
        .select({ name: variationGroups.name })
        .from(variationGroups)
        .where(eq(variationGroups.id, groupId))
        .limit(1);

      // Insert into junction table (additive)
      const groupInserts = productIds.map((productId: string) => ({
        groupId,
        productId,
      }));
      await tx
        .insert(variationGroupAssignments)
        .values(groupInserts)
        .onConflictDoNothing();

      // Sync variationGroup display field — comma-separated list of all group names
      if (group) {
        for (const productId of productIds) {
          const assignments = await tx
            .select({ name: variationGroups.name })
            .from(variationGroupAssignments)
            .innerJoin(variationGroups, eq(variationGroupAssignments.groupId, variationGroups.id))
            .where(eq(variationGroupAssignments.productId, productId));
          const names = assignments.map((a) => a.name).join(", ");
          await tx
            .update(master)
            .set({ variationGroup: names || null })
            .where(eq(master.id, productId));
        }
      }
    } else if (groupId === null) {
      // Explicit ungrouping: remove all group assignments for these products
      for (const productId of productIds) {
        await tx
          .delete(variationGroupAssignments)
          .where(eq(variationGroupAssignments.productId, productId));
      }
      await tx
        .update(master)
        .set({ groupRef: null, variationGroup: null })
        .where(inArray(master.id, productIds));
    }

    // 3. Handle tag assignments if provided
    if (Array.isArray(tagIds)) {
      for (const productId of productIds) {
        await tx
          .delete(variationTagAssignments)
          .where(eq(variationTagAssignments.productId, productId));
      }

      if (tagIds.length > 0) {
        const inserts = productIds.flatMap((productId: string) =>
          tagIds.map((tagId: string) => ({ tagId, productId }))
        );
        await tx
          .insert(variationTagAssignments)
          .values(inserts)
          .onConflictDoNothing();
      }
    }
  });

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, updated: productIds.length });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { variationGroups } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

type Params = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// POST /api/variations/[id]/groups — create a group within this variation
export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: Params) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Not authenticated" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id } = await params;
  const body = await req.json();
  const { name, dimension, sortOrder } = body;

  if (!name || !dimension)
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "name and dimension are required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );

  // Auto-assign next sortOrder if not provided
  let order = sortOrder;
  if (order === undefined || order === null) {
    const [maxRow] = await db
      .select({ max: sql<number>`COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), -1) + 1` })
      .from(variationGroups)
      .where(eq(variationGroups.variationId, id));
    order = maxRow?.max ?? 0;
  }

  const [row] = await db
    .insert(variationGroups)
    .values({
      variationId: id,
      name,
      dimension,
      sortOrder: order,
    })
    .returning();

  return NextResponse.json(row, { status: 201 });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { variationGroups, variationGroupAssignments, master } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

type Params = { params: Promise<{ id: string; groupId: string }> };

// PATCH /api/variations/[id]/groups/[groupId] — rename or reorder a group
export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest, { params }: Params) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Not authenticated" }, { status: 401 });

  const { groupId } = await params;
  const body = await req.json();

  const updates: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (body.name !== undefined) updates.name = body.name;
  if (body.dimension !== undefined) updates.dimension = body.dimension;
  if (body.sortOrder !== undefined) updates.sortOrder = body.sortOrder;
  if (body.isVarietyPack !== undefined) updates.isVarietyPack = body.isVarietyPack;
  if (body.varietyPackDetails !== undefined) updates.varietyPackDetails = body.varietyPackDetails;

  if (Object.keys(updates).length === 0)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "No fields to update" }, { status: 400 });

  const [row] = await db
    .update(variationGroups)
    .set(updates)
    .where(eq(variationGroups.id, groupId))
    .returning();

  if (!row)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Group not found" }, { status: 404 });

  // Sync variationGroup varchar on master rows when group is renamed
  if (body.name !== undefined) {
    // Find all products in this group via junction and rebuild their group name list
    const members = await db
      .select({ productId: variationGroupAssignments.productId })
      .from(variationGroupAssignments)
      .where(eq(variationGroupAssignments.groupId, groupId));

    for (const m of members) {
      const allGroups = await db
        .select({ name: variationGroups.name })
        .from(variationGroupAssignments)
        .innerJoin(variationGroups, eq(variationGroupAssignments.groupId, variationGroups.id))
        .where(eq(variationGroupAssignments.productId, m.productId));
      const names = allGroups.map((g) => g.name).join(", ");
      await db
        .update(master)
        .set({ variationGroup: names || null })
        .where(eq(master.id, m.productId));
    }
  }

  return NextResponse.json(row);
}

// DELETE /api/variations/[id]/groups/[groupId] — delete group, update variationGroup on members
export async function DELETE(_req: NextRequest, { params }: Params) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Not authenticated" }, { status: 401 });

  const { groupId } = await params;

  await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
    // Find all products in this group before deletion
    const members = await tx
      .select({ productId: variationGroupAssignments.productId })
      .from(variationGroupAssignments)
      .where(eq(variationGroupAssignments.groupId, groupId));

    // Delete the group (cascades junction rows via FK)
    await tx.delete(variationGroups).where(eq(variationGroups.id, groupId));

    // Rebuild variationGroup display field for affected products
    for (const m of members) {
      const remaining = await tx
        .select({ name: variationGroups.name })
        .from(variationGroupAssignments)
        .innerJoin(variationGroups, eq(variationGroupAssignments.groupId, variationGroups.id))
        .where(eq(variationGroupAssignments.productId, m.productId));
      const names = remaining.map((g) => g.name).join(", ");
      await tx
        .update(master)
        .set({ variationGroup: names || null, groupRef: null })
        .where(eq(master.id, m.productId));
    }
  });

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
}

// DELETE /api/variations/[id]/groups/[groupId]/members — remove products from a group
// Body: { productIds: string[] }
export async function DELETE(req: NextRequest, { params }: Params) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Not authenticated" }, { status: 401 });

  const { groupId } = await params;

  if (!Array.isArray(productIds) || productIds.length === 0)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "productIds array is required" }, { status: 400 });

        .where(eq(variationGroupAssignments.productId, productId));

        .update(master)
        .set({ variationGroup: names || null })
        .where(eq(master.id, productId));
    }
  });

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, removed: productIds.length });

FILE: src/app/api/variations/[id]/seo-projects/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import {
  variations,
  variationGroups,
  variationGroupAssignments,
  seoProjects,
  seoAsins,
  master,
  aac,
} from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and, inArray, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

type Params = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// POST /api/variations/[id]/seo-projects — bulk-create one SEO project per group
export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: Params) {
  try {
    const session = await getAuthSession();
    if (!session)
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

    const { id } = await params;
    const body = await req.json();
    const { assignedTo, mode = "per-group" } = body as {
      assignedTo?: string;
      mode?: "per-group" | "all";
    };

    // 1. Load variation
    const [variation] = await db
      .select()
      .from(variations)
      .where(eq(variations.id, id))
      .limit(1);

    if (!variation)
      return NextResponse.json({ error: "Variation not found" }, { status: 404 });

    if (variation.status !== "locked")
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Variation must be locked before creating SEO projects" },
        { status: 400 }
      );

    // 2. Check for existing SEO projects linked to this variation
    const existing = await db
      .select({ id: seoProjects.id })
      .from(seoProjects)
      .where(eq(seoProjects.variationId, id))
      .limit(1);

    if (existing.length > 0)
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "SEO projects already exist for this variation" },
        { status: 409 }
      );

    // 3. Load groups with their products via junction
    const groups = await db
      .select()
      .from(variationGroups)
      .where(eq(variationGroups.variationId, id))
      .orderBy(variationGroups.sortOrder);

    if (groups.length === 0)
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "Variation has no groups" },
        { status: 400 }
      );

    // Get all group assignments
    const groupIds = groups.map((g) => g.id);
    const assignments = await db
      .select({
        groupId: variationGroupAssignments.groupId,
        productId: variationGroupAssignments.productId,
      })
      .from(variationGroupAssignments)
      .where(inArray(variationGroupAssignments.groupId, groupIds));

    // Build group → productIds map
    const groupProductMap = new Map<string, string[]>();
    for (const a of assignments) {
      const arr = groupProductMap.get(a.groupId) ?? [];
      arr.push(a.productId);
      groupProductMap.set(a.groupId, arr);
    }

    // Filter to non-empty groups
    const nonEmptyGroups = groups.filter(
      (g) => (groupProductMap.get(g.id)?.length ?? 0) > 0
    );

    if (nonEmptyGroups.length === 0)
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: "All groups are empty" },
        { status: 400 }
      );

    // 4. Load all needed products in one query
    const allProductIds = [...new Set(assignments.map((a) => a.productId))];
    const products = await db
      .select({
        id: master.id,
        asin: master.asin,
        sku: master.sku,
        parentageLevel: master.parentageLevel,
        itemName: master.itemName,
        summarizedTitle: master.summarizedTitle,
        mainImageUrl: master.mainImageUrl,
        variations: master.variations,
        variationGroup: master.variationGroup,
        contentSeo: master.contentSeo,
        genericKeywords: master.genericKeywords,
        brandName: master.brandName,
        clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode,
      })
      .from(master)
      .where(inArray(master.id, allProductIds));

    const productMap = new Map(products.map((p) => [p.id, p]));

    // 5. Load client info (for competitors, brand URL, etc.)
    const clientId = variation.clientId;
    let clientRow: { clientName: string | null; rawData: unknown } | undefined;
    if (clientId) {
      const [c] = await db
        .select({
          clientName: aac.clientName,
          rawData: aac.rawData,
        })
        .from(aac)
        .where(eq(aac.clientIdCode, clientId))
        .limit(1);
      clientRow = c;
    }

    let raw: Record<string, string> = {};
    if (clientRow) {
      if (typeof clientRow.rawData === "string") {
        try { raw = JSON.parse(clientRow.rawData); } catch { /* ignore */ }
      } else if (clientRow.rawData) {
        raw = clientRow.rawData as Record<string, string>;
      }
    }

    const competitors: Array<{ name: string; url: string }> = [];
    for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
      const name = raw[`Competitor${i}Name`]?.trim();
      const url = raw[`Competitor${i}URL`]?.trim() || "";
      if (name) competitors.push({ name, url });
    }

    // Helper: build seoAsin row from a product
    const buildAsinRow = (
      projectId: string,
      p: (typeof products)[0],
      groupName: string
    ) => {
      const v = (p.variations as Record<string, string>) || {};
      const cs = (p.contentSeo as Record<string, string>) || {};
      return {
        projectId,
        asin: p.asin || "",
        sku: p.sku || "",
        parentageLevel: p.parentageLevel || "",
        variationId: v.VariationID || "",
        variationProduct: v.VariationProduct || "",
        variationThemeName: v.VariationThemeName || "",
        flavor: v.Flavor || "",
        style: v.Style || "",
        color: v.Color || "",
        size: v.Size || "",
        variationGroup: groupName,
        existingContent: {
          item_name: p.itemName || p.summarizedTitle || "",
          detailed_bullets: [
            cs.DetailedBulletPoint1 || "",
            cs.DetailedBulletPoint2 || "",
            cs.DetailedBulletPoint3 || "",
            cs.DetailedBulletPoint4 || "",
            cs.DetailedBulletPoint5 || "",
          ],
          product_description: cs.ProductDescription || "",
          generic_keywords: [p.genericKeywords || ""].filter(Boolean),
          concise_bullets: [
            cs.ConciseBulletPoint1 || "",
            cs.ConciseBulletPoint2 || "",
            cs.ConciseBulletPoint3 || "",
            cs.ConciseBulletPoint4 || "",
            cs.ConciseBulletPoint5 || "",
          ],
          content_bullets: [
            cs.PA_LIBulletPoint1 || "",
            cs.PA_LIBulletPoint2 || "",
            cs.PA_LIBulletPoint3 || "",
            cs.PA_LIBulletPoint4 || "",
            cs.PA_LIBulletPoint5 || "",
          ],
          key_features: [
            cs.KeyFeature1 || "",
            cs.KeyFeature2 || "",
            cs.KeyFeature3 || "",
            cs.KeyFeature4 || "",
            cs.KeyFeature5 || "",
          ],
        },
      };
    };

    // 6. Create projects + ASINs in a transaction
    const result = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
      // Get next version number for this variation
      const [{ count: existingCount }] = await tx
        .select({ count: sql<number>`count(*)::int` })
        .from(seoProjects)
        .where(eq(seoProjects.variationId, id));
      let nextVersion = (existingCount || 0) + 1;

      const created: Array<{
        id: string;
        name: string;
        groupName: string;
        asinCount: number;
      }> = [];

      if (mode === "all") {
        // Single project with ALL products from the variation
        const allProducts = [...productMap.values()];
        const brandName =
          allProducts[0]?.brandName || clientRow?.clientName || "";

        const [project] = await tx
          .insert(seoProjects)
          .values({
            createdBy: session.user.email!,
            name: variation.code,
            brandName,
            status: "draft",
            currentPhase: "S1",
            assignedTo: assignedTo || null,
            clientIdCode: clientId || null,
            clientName: clientRow?.clientName || "",
            brandUrl: raw.BrandURL || raw.WebsiteURL || "",
            clientBibleUrl: raw.ClientBibleURL || "",
            competitors,
            variationId: id,
            version: nextVersion++,
            date: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
          })
          .returning();

        // Build group name lookup for each product
        const productGroupNames = new Map<string, string>();
        for (const group of nonEmptyGroups) {
          for (const pid of groupProductMap.get(group.id) ?? []) {
            const existing = productGroupNames.get(pid);
            productGroupNames.set(
              pid,
              existing ? `${existing}, ${group.name}` : group.name
            );
          }
        }

        const asinRows = allProducts.map((p) =>
          buildAsinRow(project.id, p, productGroupNames.get(p.id) || "")
        );

        if (asinRows.length > 0) {
          await tx.insert(seoAsins).values(asinRows);
        }

        created.push({
          id: project.id,
          name: variation.code,
          groupName: "(all)",
          asinCount: asinRows.length,
        });
      } else {
        // One project per group
        for (const group of nonEmptyGroups) {
          const productIds = groupProductMap.get(group.id) ?? [];
          const groupProducts = productIds
            .map((pid) => productMap.get(pid))
            .filter(Boolean) as typeof products;

          const projectName = `${variation.code}_${group.name}`;
          const brandName =
            groupProducts[0]?.brandName || clientRow?.clientName || "";

          const [project] = await tx
            .insert(seoProjects)
            .values({
              createdBy: session.user.email!,
              name: projectName,
              brandName,
              status: "draft",
              currentPhase: "S1",
              assignedTo: assignedTo || null,
              clientIdCode: clientId || null,
              clientName: clientRow?.clientName || "",
              brandUrl: raw.BrandURL || raw.WebsiteURL || "",
              clientBibleUrl: raw.ClientBibleURL || "",
              competitors,
              variationId: id,
              version: nextVersion++,
              date: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
            })
            .returning();

          const asinRows = groupProducts.map((p) =>
            buildAsinRow(project.id, p, group.name)
          );

          if (asinRows.length > 0) {
            await tx.insert(seoAsins).values(asinRows);
          }

          created.push({
            id: project.id,
            name: projectName,
            groupName: group.name,
            asinCount: asinRows.length,
          });
        }
      }

      return created;
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ projects: result }, { status: 201 });
  } catch (err: unknown) {
    console.error("[Variation SEO Projects POST] Error:", err);
    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Unknown error";
    return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: src/app/api/variations/[id]/suggest/route.ts

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { variations, master } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, or } from "drizzle-orm";

type Params = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// Dimensions we extract from the variations JSONB blob
const VARIATION_DIMENSIONS = [
  "VariationThemeName",
  "Color",
  "Size",
  "Flavor",
  "Style",
] as const;

// GET /api/variations/[id]/suggest — auto-suggest groups and tags from Amazon variation data
export async function GET(_req: NextRequest, { params }: Params) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Not authenticated" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id } = await params;

  // Get the variation to find its clientId and primaryDimension
  const [variation] = await db
    .select({
      clientId: variations.clientId,
      primaryDimension: variations.primaryDimension,
      themeAttributes: variations.themeAttributes,
    })
    .from(variations)
    .where(eq(variations.id, id))
    .limit(1);

  if (!variation)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Variation not found" }, { status: 404 });

  // Get products that belong to this variation OR share the same clientId
  // and have variations JSONB data
  const products = await db
    .select({
      id: master.id,
      asin: master.asin,
      sku: master.sku,
      itemName: master.itemName,
      variationsData: master.variations,
    })
    .from(master)
    .where(
      or(
        eq(master.variationRef, id),
        eq(master.clientIdCode, variation.clientId)
      )
    );

  // Extract unique values per dimension
  const dimensionValues: Record<string, Set<string>> = {};
  const themeNames = new Set<string>();

  for (const product of products) {
    const data = product.variationsData;
    if (!data) continue;

    for (const dim of VARIATION_DIMENSIONS) {
      const val = data[dim];
      if (val && val.trim()) {
        if (dim === "VariationThemeName") {
          themeNames.add(val.trim());
        } else {
          if (!dimensionValues[dim]) dimensionValues[dim] = new Set();
          dimensionValues[dim].add(val.trim());
        }
      }
    }

    // Also check for any other non-standard keys that have values
    for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(data)) {
      if (
        val &&
        val.trim() &&
        !["VariationID", "VariationProduct", "ChildRelationshipType"].includes(key) &&
        !VARIATION_DIMENSIONS.includes(key as (typeof VARIATION_DIMENSIONS)[number])
      ) {
        if (!dimensionValues[key]) dimensionValues[key] = new Set();
        dimensionValues[key].add(val.trim());
      }
    }
  }

  // Determine primary dimension for groups (e.g., "Color")
  const primaryDim = variation.primaryDimension || "Color";

  // Suggest groups from primary dimension values
  const groupValues = dimensionValues[primaryDim];
  const suggestedGroups = groupValues
    ? Array.from(groupValues).sort().map((name) => ({
        name,
        dimension: primaryDim,
      }))
    : [];

  // Suggest tags from all non-primary dimensions
  const suggestedTags: { dimension: string; values: string[] }[] = [];
  for (const [dimension, values] of Object.entries(dimensionValues)) {
    if (dimension === primaryDim) continue; // groups, not tags
    if (values.size > 0) {
      suggestedTags.push({
        dimension,
        values: Array.from(values).sort(),
      });
    }
  }

  // Also include theme info for setting the variation's theme_attributes
  const parsedThemes = Array.from(themeNames).flatMap((t) =>
    t.split("/").map((s) => s.replace(/Name$/, "").trim())
  );

  return NextResponse.json({
    suggestedGroups,
    suggestedTags,
    suggestedThemeAttributes: [...new Set(parsedThemes)],
    suggestedPrimaryDimension: parsedThemes[0] || null,
    productCount: products.length,
  });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { variationTags } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

type Params = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

// POST /api/variations/[id]/tags — create a tag within this variation
export async function POST(req: NextRequest, { params }: Params) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Not authenticated" }, { status: 401 });

  const { id } = await params;
  const body = await req.json();
  const { dimension, value, sortOrder } = body;

  if (!dimension || !value)
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "dimension and value are required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );

  // Auto-assign next sortOrder if not provided
  let order = sortOrder;
  if (order === undefined || order === null) {
    const [maxRow] = await db
      .select({ max: sql<number>`COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), -1) + 1` })
      .from(variationTags)
      .where(eq(variationTags.variationId, id));
    order = maxRow?.max ?? 0;
  }

  const [row] = await db
    .insert(variationTags)
    .values({
      variationId: id,
      dimension,
      value,
      sortOrder: order,
    })
    .returning();

  return NextResponse.json(row, { status: 201 });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { variationTags, variationTagAssignments } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";

type Params = { params: Promise<{ id: string; tagId: string }> };

// PATCH /api/variations/[id]/tags/[tagId] — update a tag
export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest, { params }: Params) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Not authenticated" }, { status: 401 });

  const { tagId } = await params;
  const body = await req.json();

  const updates: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (body.dimension !== undefined) updates.dimension = body.dimension;
  if (body.value !== undefined) updates.value = body.value;
  if (body.sortOrder !== undefined) updates.sortOrder = body.sortOrder;

  if (Object.keys(updates).length === 0)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "No fields to update" }, { status: 400 });

  const [row] = await db
    .update(variationTags)
    .set(updates)
    .where(eq(variationTags.id, tagId))
    .returning();

  if (!row)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Tag not found" }, { status: 404 });

  return NextResponse.json(row);
}

// DELETE /api/variations/[id]/tags/[tagId] — delete tag (cascades assignments)
export async function DELETE(_req: NextRequest, { params }: Params) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Not authenticated" }, { status: 401 });

  const { tagId } = await params;

  // Tag assignments cascade-delete via FK, so just delete the tag
  await db.delete(variationTags).where(eq(variationTags.id, tagId));

  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true });
}

import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { variations } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";

// GET /api/variations/next-code?clientId=C23_SC_US
// Returns the next sequential code for this client, e.g. C23_SC_US_02
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Not authenticated" }, { status: 401 });

  const clientId = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("clientId");
  if (!clientId)
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: "clientId is required" },
      { status: 400 }
    );

  // Find all existing codes for this client prefix, extract max number
  const prefix = `${clientId}_`;
  const rows = await db
    .select({ code: variations.code })
    .from(variations)
    .where(sql`${variations.code} LIKE ${prefix + '%'}`);

  let maxNum = 0;
  for (const row of rows) {
    const suffix = row.code.slice(prefix.length);
    const num = parseInt(suffix, 10);
    if (!isNaN(num) && num > maxNum) maxNum = num;
  }

  const next = maxNum + 1;
  const code = `${clientId}_${String(next).padStart(2, "0")}`;

  console.log(`[next-code] clientId=${clientId}, prefix=${prefix}, existingCodes=${rows.map(r => r.code).join(",")}, maxNum=${maxNum}, code=${code}`);

  return NextResponse.json({ code, next });
}

FILE: src/app/api/variety-packs/route.ts
================================================
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getAuthSession } from "@/lib/auth-db";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, varietyPackItems } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, sql, desc, ilike, inArray } from "drizzle-orm";

// GET /api/variety-packs — list all products that have variety pack items
// Optional: ?client=CLIENTCODE to filter by client
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const session = await getAuthSession();
  if (!session)
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Unauthorized" }, { status: 401 });

  const clientFilter = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get("client");

  // Find all distinct pack product IDs with their item count
  const packProducts = await db
    .select({
      packProductId: varietyPackItems.packProductId,
      itemCount: sql<number>`coalesce(sum(${varietyPackItems.units}), 0)::int`,
    })
    .from(varietyPackItems)
    .groupBy(varietyPackItems.packProductId)
    .orderBy(desc(sql<number>`count(*)`));

  if (packProducts.length === 0) return NextResponse.json([]);

  // Load product details and items in parallel
  const productIds = packProducts.map((p) => p.packProductId);
  const countMap = new Map(packProducts.map((p) => [p.packProductId, p.itemCount]));

  const [products, items] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select({
        id: master.id,
        asin: master.asin,
        sku: master.sku,
        clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode,
        itemName: master.itemName,
        summarizedTitle: master.summarizedTitle,
        mainImageUrl: master.mainImageUrl,
      })
      .from(master)
      .where(inArray(master.id, productIds)),
    db
      .select({
        packProductId: varietyPackItems.packProductId,
        flavor: varietyPackItems.flavor,
        size: varietyPackItems.size,
        color: varietyPackItems.color,
        style: varietyPackItems.style,
        customLabel: varietyPackItems.customLabel,
        units: varietyPackItems.units,
        includedAsin: master.asin,
        includedSku: master.sku,
        includedTitle: master.itemName,
      })
      .from(varietyPackItems)
      .leftJoin(master, eq(varietyPackItems.includedProductId, master.id))
      .where(inArray(varietyPackItems.packProductId, productIds))
      .orderBy(varietyPackItems.sortOrder),
  ]);

  const productMap = new Map(products.map((p) => [p.id, p]));
  const itemsByProduct = new Map<string, typeof items>();
  for (const item of items) {
    if (!itemsByProduct.has(item.packProductId)) itemsByProduct.set(item.packProductId, []);
    itemsByProduct.get(item.packProductId)!.push(item);
  }

  const result = packProducts
    .map((pp) => {
      const product = productMap.get(pp.packProductId);
      if (!product) return null;
      // Client filter (case-insensitive)
      if (clientFilter && product.clientIdCode?.toLowerCase() !== clientFilter.toLowerCase()) return null;
      return {
        ...product,
        itemCount: countMap.get(pp.packProductId) || 0,
        items: (itemsByProduct.get(pp.packProductId) || []).map((it) => ({
          flavor: it.flavor,
          size: it.size,
          color: it.color,
          style: it.style,
          customLabel: it.customLabel,
          units: it.units,
          includedAsin: it.includedAsin,
          includedSku: it.includedSku,
          includedTitle: it.includedTitle,
        })),
      };
    })
    .filter(Boolean);

  return NextResponse.json(result);
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useSession, signOut } from "next-auth/react";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Loader2, Clock, LogOut } from "lucide-react";

export default function RegisterPage() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const [fullName, setFullName] = useState(session?.user?.name ?? "");
  const [clientName, setClientName] = useState("");
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  // Check if user already submitted (has clientIdCode set)
  const { data: syncData } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["register-check"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/auth/session-sync");
      return res.json();
    },
  });

  const alreadySubmitted =
    submitted ||
    (syncData?.user?.role === "pending" && syncData?.user?.clientIdCode);

  async function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    setSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/auth/register", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ fullName, clientName }),
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        throw new Error(data.error || "Registration failed");
      }

      setSubmitted(true);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Something went wrong");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  if (alreadySubmitted) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-muted/40">
        <Card className="w-full max-w-sm">
          <CardHeader className="text-center">
            <div className="mx-auto mb-3 flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-amber-500/15">
              <Clock className="h-6 w-6 text-amber-500" />
            </div>
            <CardTitle className="text-xl">Pending Approval</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              Your registration has been submitted. An admin will review and
              approve your access shortly.
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              className="w-full text-muted-foreground"
              onClick={() => signOut({ callbackUrl: "/auth/signin" })}
            >
              <LogOut className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
              Sign out
            </Button>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-muted/40">
      <Card className="w-full max-w-sm">
        <CardHeader className="text-center">
          <CardTitle className="text-2xl">1o8 Hub</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Complete your registration to request access.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="text-sm font-medium">Email</label>
              <Input
                value={session?.user?.email ?? ""}
                disabled
                className="bg-white text-black"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="text-sm font-medium">Full Name</label>
              <Input
                value={fullName}
                onChange={(e) => setFullName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Your full name"
                required
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="text-sm font-medium">Client / Company</label>
              <Input
                value={clientName}
                onChange={(e) => setClientName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Your client or company name"
                required
              />
            </div>

            {error && (
              <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p>
            )}

            <Button
              type="submit"
              className="w-full"
              disabled={submitting || !fullName.trim() || !clientName.trim()}
            >
              {submitting && <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />}
              Request Access
            </Button>

            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="ghost"
              className="w-full text-muted-foreground"
              onClick={() => signOut({ callbackUrl: "/auth/signin" })}
            >
              <LogOut className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
              Sign out
            </Button>
          </form>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function getDaysInMonth(year: number, month: number): number {
  return new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
}

function getFirstDayOfWeek(year: number, month: number): number {
  return new Date(year, month, 1).getDay();
}

function formatDateKey(year: number, month: number, day: number): string {
  return `${year}-${String(month + 1).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(day).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

function toLocalDateParts(dateStr: string): { year: number; month: number; day: number } {
  const [y, m, d] = dateStr.split("-").map(Number);
  return { year: y, month: m - 1, day: d };
}

const MONTH_NAMES = [
  "January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June",
  "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December",
];

const DAY_HEADERS = ["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"];

// ── localStorage persistence ──────────────────────────────────────────────

const STORAGE_KEY = "1o8-calendar-events";

function loadCustomEvents(): CalendarEvent[] {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return [];
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

function saveCustomEvents(events: CalendarEvent[]) {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(events));
}

    />
  );
}

// ── Add Event Dialog ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function AddEventDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  defaultDate,
  onAdd,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  defaultDate: string;
  onAdd: (event: CalendarEvent) => void;
}) {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [date, setDate] = useState(defaultDate);
  const [type, setType] = useState<EventType>("deadline");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    if (!title.trim() || !date) return;
    onAdd({
      id: `custom-${Date.now()}`,
      title: title.trim(),
      date,
      type,
      description: description.trim() || undefined,
    });
    setTitle("");
    setDescription("");
    onOpenChange(false);
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[440px]">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tight">
            Add Event
          </DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">
            Add a deadline, content milestone, or custom event.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-4 pt-2">
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1.5 block">Title</label>
            <Input
              value={title}
              onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. Spring Campaign Launch"
              onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && handleSubmit()}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1.5 block">Date</label>
              <Input
                type="date"
                value={date}
                onChange={(e) => setDate(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1.5 block">Type</label>
              <Select value={type} onValueChange={(v) => setType(v as EventType)}>
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="deadline">Deadline</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="content">Content</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="milestone">Milestone</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="holiday">Holiday</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1.5 block">Description (optional)</label>
            <Textarea
              value={description}
              onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Notes, links, or context..."
              rows={3}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-1">
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              disabled={!title.trim() || !date}
              onClick={handleSubmit}
              className="bg-brand text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover shadow-[0_0_16px_-4px_var(--brand-glow)]"
            >
              <Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1" />
              Add Event
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

// ── Event Detail Panel ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function EventDetailPanel({
  event,
  onClose,
  onDelete,
}: {
  event: CalendarEvent;
  onClose: () => void;
  onDelete?: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  const style = EVENT_STYLES[event.type];
  const Icon = style.icon;
  const isCustom = event.id.startsWith("custom-");
  const { year, month, day } = toLocalDateParts(event.date);
  const dateObj = new Date(year, month, day);

  return (
    <div className="animate-card-enter rounded-xl glass-card border border-neutral-300 dark:border-white/10 p-5 space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
          <div className={`shrink-0 rounded-lg p-2.5 ${style.bg} ${style.border} border`}>
            <Icon className={`h-5 w-5 ${style.text}`} />
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <h3 className="font-bold text-foreground font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tight truncate">
              {event.title}
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
              {dateObj.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { weekday: "long", month: "long", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" })}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          className="shrink-0 rounded-md p-1 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted transition-colors"
        >
          <X className="h-4 w-4" />
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider ${style.bg} ${style.text} ${style.border} border`}>
          <Icon className="h-3 w-3" />
          {style.label}
        </span>
      </div>

      {event.description && (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
          {event.description}
        </p>
      )}

      {/* Days until */}
      {(() => {
        const now = new Date();
        now.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        const evDate = new Date(year, month, day);
        const diff = Math.ceil((evDate.getTime() - now.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
        if (diff === 0)
          return <p className="text-xs font-bold text-brand">Today</p>;
        if (diff > 0)
          return (
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              <span className="font-bold text-foreground">{diff}</span> day{diff !== 1 ? "s" : ""} away
            </p>
          );
        return (
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <span className="font-bold text-foreground">{Math.abs(diff)}</span> day{Math.abs(diff) !== 1 ? "s" : ""} ago
          </p>
        );
      })()}

      {isCustom && onDelete && (
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          className="w-full text-xs text-red-400 border-red-500/20 hover:bg-red-500/10 hover:border-red-500/30"
          onClick={() => onDelete(event.id)}
        >
          <X className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
          Remove Event
        </Button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Upcoming Events Sidebar ───────────────────────────────────────────────

function UpcomingEvents({
  events,
  onSelect,
}: {
  events: CalendarEvent[];
  onSelect: (event: CalendarEvent) => void;
}) {
  const now = new Date();
  now.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

  const upcoming = useMemo(() => {
    return events
      .filter((e) => {
        const { year, month, day } = toLocalDateParts(e.date);
        return new Date(year, month, day) >= now;
      })
      .sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date))
      .slice(0, 8);
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [events]);

  if (upcoming.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <h3 className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-[0.15em] font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)]">
        Upcoming
      </h3>
      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        {upcoming.map((event) => {
          const { year, month, day } = toLocalDateParts(event.date);
          const evDate = new Date(year, month, day);
          const diff = Math.ceil((evDate.getTime() - now.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
          const style = EVENT_STYLES[event.type];
          const Icon = style.icon;
          return (
            <button
              key={event.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onSelect(event)}
              className="flex items-center gap-3 w-full rounded-lg px-3 py-2.5 text-left transition-all hover:bg-muted/60 group cursor-pointer"
            >
              <div className={`shrink-0 rounded-md p-1.5 ${style.bg}`}>
                <Icon className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${style.text}`} />
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground truncate group-hover:text-brand transition-colors">
                  {event.title}
                </p>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                  {evDate.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric" })}
                  {diff === 0 && <span className="ml-1 font-bold text-brand">Today</span>}
                  {diff === 1 && <span className="ml-1 text-amber-400">Tomorrow</span>}
                  {diff > 1 && diff <= 7 && <span className="ml-1 text-muted-foreground/70">{diff}d</span>}
                </p>
              </div>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Filter Toggle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function FilterToggle({
  activeFilters,
  onToggle,
}: {
  activeFilters: Set<EventType>;
  onToggle: (type: EventType) => void;
}) {
  const types: EventType[] = ["holiday", "deadline", "content", "milestone"];
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
      {types.map((type) => {
        const style = EVENT_STYLES[type];
        const Icon = style.icon;
        const active = activeFilters.has(type);
        return (
          <button
            key={type}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onToggle(type)}
            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-medium border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              active
                ? `${style.bg} ${style.text} ${style.border}`
                : "bg-transparent text-muted-foreground/50 border-border/30 hover:border-border/50"
            }`}
          >
            <Icon className="h-3 w-3" />
            {style.label}
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Main Calendar Page ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function CalendarPage() {
  const today = new Date();
  const [currentMonth, setCurrentMonth] = useState(today.getMonth());
  const [currentYear, setCurrentYear] = useState(today.getFullYear());
  const [customEvents, setCustomEvents] = useState<CalendarEvent[]>(() => loadCustomEvents());
  const [selectedEvent, setSelectedEvent] = useState<CalendarEvent | null>(null);
  const [addDialogOpen, setAddDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [addDialogDate, setAddDialogDate] = useState("");
  const [activeFilters, setActiveFilters] = useState<Set<EventType>>(
    () => new Set(["holiday", "deadline", "content", "milestone"])
  );

  const allEvents = useMemo(() => [...HOLIDAYS, ...customEvents], [customEvents]);

  const filteredEvents = useMemo(
    () => allEvents.filter((e) => activeFilters.has(e.type)),
    [allEvents, activeFilters]
  );

  // Build date -> events map for current month
  const eventsByDate = useMemo(() => {
    const map: Record<string, CalendarEvent[]> = {};
    for (const ev of filteredEvents) {
      const { year, month } = toLocalDateParts(ev.date);
      if (year === currentYear && month === currentMonth) {
        if (!map[ev.date]) map[ev.date] = [];
        map[ev.date].push(ev);
      }
    }
    return map;
  }, [filteredEvents, currentYear, currentMonth]);

  const handlePrevMonth = useCallback(() => {
    if (currentMonth === 0) {
      setCurrentMonth(11);
      setCurrentYear((y) => y - 1);
    } else {
      setCurrentMonth((m) => m - 1);
    }
    setSelectedEvent(null);
  }, [currentMonth]);

  const handleNextMonth = useCallback(() => {
    if (currentMonth === 11) {
      setCurrentMonth(0);
      setCurrentYear((y) => y + 1);
    } else {
      setCurrentMonth((m) => m + 1);
    }
    setSelectedEvent(null);
  }, [currentMonth]);

  const handleToday = useCallback(() => {
    setCurrentMonth(today.getMonth());
    setCurrentYear(today.getFullYear());
    setSelectedEvent(null);
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const handleToggleFilter = useCallback((type: EventType) => {
    setActiveFilters((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(type)) next.delete(type);
      else next.add(type);
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  const handleAddEvent = useCallback((event: CalendarEvent) => {
    setCustomEvents((prev) => {
      const next = [...prev, event];
      saveCustomEvents(next);
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  const handleDeleteEvent = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setCustomEvents((prev) => {
      const next = prev.filter((e) => e.id !== id);
      saveCustomEvents(next);
      return next;
    });
    setSelectedEvent(null);
  }, []);

  const handleDayClick = useCallback(
    (day: number) => {
      const key = formatDateKey(currentYear, currentMonth, day);
      const dayEvents = eventsByDate[key];
      if (dayEvents && dayEvents.length > 0) {
        setSelectedEvent(dayEvents[0]);
      } else {
        setAddDialogDate(key);
        setAddDialogOpen(true);
      }
    },
    [currentYear, currentMonth, eventsByDate]
  );

  const handleSelectEvent = useCallback(
    (event: CalendarEvent) => {
      const { year, month } = toLocalDateParts(event.date);
      if (year !== currentYear || month !== currentMonth) {
        setCurrentYear(year);
        setCurrentMonth(month);
      }
      setSelectedEvent(event);
    },
    [currentYear, currentMonth]
  );

  // ── Calendar grid build ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const daysInMonth = getDaysInMonth(currentYear, currentMonth);
  const firstDayOfWeek = getFirstDayOfWeek(currentYear, currentMonth);

  // Prev month trailing days
  const prevMonth = currentMonth === 0 ? 11 : currentMonth - 1;
  const prevYear = currentMonth === 0 ? currentYear - 1 : currentYear;
  const daysInPrevMonth = getDaysInMonth(prevYear, prevMonth);

  const todayKey = formatDateKey(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate());

  const calendarCells: {
    day: number;
    key: string;
    isCurrentMonth: boolean;
    isToday: boolean;
    events: CalendarEvent[];
  }[] = [];

  // Trailing days of prev month
  for (let i = firstDayOfWeek - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const d = daysInPrevMonth - i;
    const key = formatDateKey(prevYear, prevMonth, d);
    calendarCells.push({
      day: d,
      key,
      isCurrentMonth: false,
      isToday: key === todayKey,
      events: [],
    });
  }

  // Current month days
  for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) {
    const key = formatDateKey(currentYear, currentMonth, d);
    calendarCells.push({
      day: d,
      key,
      isCurrentMonth: true,
      isToday: key === todayKey,
      events: eventsByDate[key] || [],
    });
  }

  // Fill remaining to complete grid (6 rows)
  const nextMonth = currentMonth === 11 ? 0 : currentMonth + 1;
  const nextYear = currentMonth === 11 ? currentYear + 1 : currentYear;
  const remaining = 42 - calendarCells.length;
  for (let d = 1; d <= remaining; d++) {
    const key = formatDateKey(nextYear, nextMonth, d);
    calendarCells.push({
      day: d,
      key,
      isCurrentMonth: false,
      isToday: key === todayKey,
      events: [],
    });
  }

  // Count events this month
  const monthEventCount = Object.values(eventsByDate).reduce((sum, evs) => sum + evs.length, 0);

  return (
    <div>
      {/* Page header */}
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10 py-4 mb-2 bg-background">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter">
              <span className="text-foreground font-bold">Content</span><span className="text-brand font-medium">Calendar</span>
            </h1>
            {monthEventCount > 0 && (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-brand/10 text-brand px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold tabular-nums mt-2">
                {monthEventCount} this month
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            className="bg-brand text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover shadow-[0_0_16px_-4px_var(--brand-glow)]"
            onClick={() => {
              setAddDialogDate(todayKey);
              setAddDialogOpen(true);
            }}
          >
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" />
            Add Event
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-[1fr_280px] gap-6">
        {/* Main calendar area */}
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {/* Month nav + filters */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <button
                onClick={handlePrevMonth}
                className="rounded-lg p-2 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted transition-colors"
              >
                <ChevronLeft className="h-5 w-5" />
              </button>
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tight min-w-[220px] text-center">
                {MONTH_NAMES[currentMonth]}{" "}
                <span className="text-muted-foreground font-normal">{currentYear}</span>
              </h2>
              <button
                onClick={handleNextMonth}
                className="rounded-lg p-2 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted transition-colors"
              >
                <ChevronRight className="h-5 w-5" />
              </button>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={handleToday}
                className="text-xs ml-1"
              >
                <CalendarDays className="h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1" />
                Today
              </Button>
            </div>
            <FilterToggle activeFilters={activeFilters} onToggle={handleToggleFilter} />
          </div>

          {/* Calendar grid */}
          <div className="rounded-xl glass-card border border-neutral-300 dark:border-white/10 overflow-hidden animate-card-enter">
            {/* Day headers */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-7 border-b border-border/40">
              {DAY_HEADERS.map((d) => (
                <div
                  key={d}
                  className="py-3 text-center text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-[0.15em]"
                >
                  {d}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Day cells */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-7">
              {calendarCells.map((cell, idx) => {
                const isSelected = selectedEvent && selectedEvent.date === cell.key;
                const isWeekend = idx % 7 === 0 || idx % 7 === 6;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={cell.key + "-" + idx}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => cell.isCurrentMonth && handleDayClick(cell.day)}
                    className={`
                      relative min-h-[90px] lg:min-h-[110px] p-1.5 lg:p-2 border-b border-r border-border/20
                      text-left transition-all group/cell cursor-pointer
                      ${cell.isCurrentMonth ? "hover:bg-muted/40" : "opacity-30 pointer-events-none"}
                      ${isSelected ? "bg-brand/5 ring-1 ring-brand/30 ring-inset" : ""}
                      ${cell.isToday ? "bg-brand/[0.04]" : ""}
                      ${isWeekend && cell.isCurrentMonth ? "bg-muted/20" : ""}
                    `}
                  >
                    {/* Day number */}
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                      <span
                        className={`
                          inline-flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-semibold tabular-nums
                          ${cell.isToday
                            ? "h-6 w-6 rounded-full bg-brand text-brand-foreground font-bold"
                            : cell.isCurrentMonth
                              ? "text-foreground"
                              : "text-muted-foreground/40"
                          }
                        `}
                      >
                        {cell.day}
                      </span>
                      {cell.events.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="flex gap-[3px]">
                          {cell.events.slice(0, 3).map((ev) => (
                            <EventDot key={ev.id} type={ev.type} />
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Event chips */}
                    <div className="space-y-0.5">
                      {cell.events.slice(0, 2).map((ev) => (
                        <EventChip
                          key={ev.id}
                          event={ev}
                          onClick={() => {
                            setSelectedEvent(ev);
                          }}
                        />
                      ))}
                      {cell.events.length > 2 && (
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-medium pl-1">
                          +{cell.events.length - 2} more
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Hover add indicator */}
                    {cell.isCurrentMonth && cell.events.length === 0 && (
                      <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center opacity-0 group-hover/cell:opacity-100 transition-opacity pointer-events-none">
                        <Plus className="h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground/30" />
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Legend */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4 px-1">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider font-bold">Legend</span>
            <div className="flex gap-3 flex-wrap">
              {(["holiday", "deadline", "content", "milestone"] as EventType[]).map((type) => {
                const style = EVENT_STYLES[type];
                const Icon = style.icon;
                return (
                  <span key={type} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                    <Icon className={`h-3 w-3 ${style.text}`} />
                    {style.label}
                  </span>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Right sidebar */}
        <div className="space-y-5">
          {/* Selected event detail */}
          {selectedEvent && (
            <EventDetailPanel
              event={selectedEvent}
              onClose={() => setSelectedEvent(null)}
              onDelete={selectedEvent.id.startsWith("custom-") ? handleDeleteEvent : undefined}
            />
          )}

          {/* Upcoming events */}
          <div className="rounded-xl glass-card border border-neutral-300 dark:border-white/10 p-4 animate-card-enter" style={{ animationDelay: "80ms" }}>
            <UpcomingEvents events={allEvents} onSelect={handleSelectEvent} />
          </div>

          {/* Monthly summary */}
          <div className="rounded-xl glass-card border border-neutral-300 dark:border-white/10 p-4 animate-card-enter" style={{ animationDelay: "160ms" }}>
            <h3 className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-[0.15em] font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] mb-3">
              {MONTH_NAMES[currentMonth]} Summary
            </h3>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              {(["holiday", "deadline", "content", "milestone"] as EventType[]).map((type) => {
                const style = EVENT_STYLES[type];
                const Icon = style.icon;
                const count = Object.values(eventsByDate)
                  .flat()
                  .filter((e) => e.type === type).length;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={type}
                    className={`rounded-lg px-3 py-2 ${style.bg} ${style.border} border`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-1">
                      <Icon className={`h-3 w-3 ${style.text}`} />
                      <span className={`text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider ${style.text}`}>
                        {style.label}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <span className={`text-xl font-bold tabular-nums ${style.text} font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)]`}>
                      {count}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Quick add hint */}
          <div className="px-2">
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/60 leading-relaxed">
              <Flag className="h-3 w-3 inline-block mr-1 relative -top-px" />
              Click any empty day to add a new event. Click an event to see details.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Add Event Dialog */}
      <AddEventDialog
        open={addDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setAddDialogOpen}
        defaultDate={addDialogDate}
        onAdd={handleAddEvent}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { useParams, usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { CLIENT_NAMES } from "@/lib/constants";

const TABS = [
  { label: "Overview", href: "" },
  { label: "Inventory", href: "/inventory" },
  { label: "Forecast", href: "/forecast" },
] as const;

export default function ClientLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const { clientIdCode } = useParams<{ clientIdCode: string }>();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const base = `/clients/${clientIdCode}`;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-0">
      <nav className="border-b flex gap-1 px-4">
        {TABS.map((tab) => {
          const href = `${base}${tab.href}`;
          const isActive =
            tab.href === ""
              ? pathname === base || pathname === `${base}/`
              : pathname.startsWith(href);

          return (
            <Link
              key={tab.href}
              href={href}
              className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm rounded-t transition-colors ${
                isActive
                  ? "bg-card text-foreground border-b-2 border-brand font-medium"
                  : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
              }`}
            >
              {tab.label}
            </Link>
          );
        })}
      </nav>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/app/clients/[clientIdCode]/forecast/page.tsx

"use client";

import React from "react";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { ForecastEditor } from "@/components/analytics/forecast-editor";

function formatDate(d: Date): string {
  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

function daysAgo(n: number): string {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() - n);
  return formatDate(d);
}

export default function ForecastPage({
  params,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ clientIdCode: string }>;
}) {
  const { clientIdCode } = React.use(params);

  const end = formatDate(new Date());
  const start = daysAgo(7);

  const { data: clientData, isLoading: clientLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["sales-summary-fc", clientIdCode],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/sales-summary?period=7D&start=${start}&end=${end}&client=${clientIdCode}`
      );
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch client data");
      return res.json();
    },
  });

  const accountIds = clientData?.clients?.[0]?.accountIds;

  const { data: monthlyData, isLoading: monthlyLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["monthly", clientIdCode, accountIds],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/sales-summary/monthly?accountIds=${accountIds}`
      );
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch monthly data");
      return res.json();
    },
    enabled: !!accountIds,
  });

  const { data: forecastData, isLoading: forecastLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["forecasts", clientIdCode],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/forecasts?clientIdCode=${clientIdCode}`
      );
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch forecasts");
      return res.json();
    },
  });

  const isLoading = clientLoading || monthlyLoading || forecastLoading;

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-24">
        <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6 space-y-6">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">
        Sales & PPC Forecast
      </h1>
      <ForecastEditor
        monthlyActuals={monthlyData?.months ?? []}
        forecasts={forecastData?.forecasts ?? []}
        clientIdCode={clientIdCode}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

export default function InventoryPage({
  params,

  params: Promise<{ clientIdCode: string }>;

      </h1>

        products={inventoryData?.products ?? []}
        periodLabel="Last 7 Days"
      />
    </div>
  );
