FILE: src/app/clients/[clientIdCode]/onboarding/page.tsx
================================================
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useParams } from "next/navigation";
import Link from "next/link";
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  CheckCircle2,
  Circle,
  Loader2,
  AlertCircle,
  Play,
  Pencil,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { NewClientDialog, type ClientEditData } from "@/components/clients/new-client-dialog";

// ── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface OnboardingStep {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  description: string;
  order: number;
  status: "pending" | "in_progress" | "completed" | "failed";
  completedAt: string | null;
  completedBy: string | null;
  metadata: Record<string, unknown> | null;
}

interface OnboardingResponse {
  clientIdCode: string;
  steps: OnboardingStep[];
}

// ── Status styling ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

const STATUS_CONFIG = {
  pending: {
    icon: Circle,
    label: "Pending",
    className: "text-muted-foreground",
    badgeClassName: "bg-muted text-muted-foreground",
  },
  in_progress: {
    icon: Loader2,
    label: "In Progress",
    className: "text-[var(--brand-yellow)]",
    badgeClassName: "bg-yellow-500/10 text-yellow-600 dark:text-yellow-400",
  },
  completed: {
    icon: CheckCircle2,
    label: "Completed",
    className: "text-[var(--brand-green)]",
    badgeClassName: "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400",
  },
  failed: {
    icon: AlertCircle,
    label: "Failed",
    className: "text-[var(--brand-red)]",
    badgeClassName: "bg-red-500/10 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400",
  },
} as const;

// ── Step action map ────────────────────────────────────────────────

function useStepAction(clientIdCode: string, stepKey: string) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      const url = `/api/clients/${encodeURIComponent(clientIdCode)}/onboarding/${stepKey}`;
      const res = await fetch(url, { method: "POST" });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: "Request failed" }));
        throw new Error(data.error || `Step failed (${res.status})`);
      }
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ["onboarding", clientIdCode],
      });
    },
  });
}

// ── Step Card ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function StepCard({
  step,
  clientIdCode,
  onEdit,
}: {
  step: OnboardingStep;
  clientIdCode: string;
  onEdit?: () => void;
}) {
  const mutation = useStepAction(clientIdCode, step.key);
  const config = STATUS_CONFIG[step.status];
  const StatusIcon = config.icon;
  const isManualStep = step.key === "create_client";
  const canRun = !isManualStep && (step.status === "pending" || step.status === "failed");

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border bg-card text-card-foreground">
      <div className="flex items-start gap-4 p-5">
        {/* Status icon */}
        <div className={`mt-0.5 ${config.className}`}>
          <StatusIcon
            className={`h-5 w-5 ${step.status === "in_progress" ? "animate-spin" : ""}`}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Content */}
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">{step.label}</h3>
            <span
              className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full ${config.badgeClassName}`}
            >
              {config.label}
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{step.description}</p>

          {/* Completed info — skip for auto-completed steps */}
          {step.status === "completed" && step.completedAt && !isManualStep && (
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-2">
              Completed{" "}
              {new Date(step.completedAt).toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
                month: "short",
                day: "numeric",
                year: "numeric",
                hour: "2-digit",
                minute: "2-digit",
              })}
              {step.completedBy && step.completedBy !== "auto" ? ` by ${step.completedBy}` : ""}
              {step.metadata &&
              typeof step.metadata === "object" &&
              "foldersCreated" in step.metadata
                ? ` — ${step.metadata.foldersCreated} folders created`
                : ""}
            </p>
          )}

          {/* Error info */}
          {step.status === "failed" && step.metadata && "error" in step.metadata && (
            <p className="text-[10px] text-[var(--brand-red)] mt-2">
              Error: {String(step.metadata.error)}
            </p>
          )}

          {/* Mutation error */}
          {mutation.error && (
            <p className="text-[10px] text-[var(--brand-red)] mt-2">
              {mutation.error.message}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Action button */}
        <div className="flex-shrink-0">
          {canRun && (
            <Button
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => mutation.mutate()}
              disabled={mutation.isPending}
              className="gap-1.5"
            >
              {mutation.isPending ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                  Running...
                </>
              ) : step.status === "failed" ? (
                <>
                  <Play className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  Retry
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Play className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  Run
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
          )}
          {step.status === "completed" && isManualStep && onEdit && (
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={onEdit}
              className="gap-1.5 text-muted-foreground"
            >
              <Pencil className="h-3 w-3" />
              Edit
            </Button>
          )}
          {step.status === "completed" && !isManualStep && (
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => mutation.mutate()}
              disabled={mutation.isPending}
              className="gap-1.5 text-muted-foreground"
            >
              {mutation.isPending ? (
                <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
              ) : (
                "Re-run"
              )}
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Page ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function OnboardingPage() {
  const { clientIdCode } = useParams<{ clientIdCode: string }>();
  const [editDialogOpen, setEditDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editData, setEditData] = useState<ClientEditData | undefined>();

  // Fetch client details for edit dialog pre-fill
  const { data: clientData } = useQuery<{
    client: { clientIdCode: string; clientName: string; clientStatus: string };
  }>({
    queryKey: ["client-detail", clientIdCode],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/clients/${encodeURIComponent(clientIdCode)}`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load client");
      return res.json();
    },
  });

  function handleEditClient() {
    if (clientData?.client) {
      setEditData({
        clientIdCode: clientData.client.clientIdCode,
        clientName: clientData.client.clientName || "",
        clientStatus: clientData.client.clientStatus,
      });
    } else {
      setEditData({
        clientIdCode,
        clientName: "",
        clientStatus: "Active",
      });
    }
    setEditDialogOpen(true);
  }

  const { data, isLoading, error } = useQuery<OnboardingResponse>({
    queryKey: ["onboarding", clientIdCode],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/clients/${encodeURIComponent(clientIdCode)}/onboarding`
      );
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load onboarding status");
      return res.json();
    },
    refetchInterval: 5000, // poll while steps may be running
  });

  const completedCount =
    data?.steps.filter((s) => s.status === "completed").length ?? 0;
  const totalCount = data?.steps.length ?? 0;

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10 py-4 mb-2 bg-background">
        <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter mb-2">
          <span className="text-foreground font-bold">Client</span><span className="text-brand font-medium">Onboarding</span>
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {clientIdCode} — {completedCount}{"/"}{totalCount} steps completed
        </p>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mt-2">
          <Link
            href="/onboarding"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Client Onboarding
          </Link>
          <Link
            href={`/clients/${clientIdCode}`}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
          >
            {clientIdCode}
          </Link>
        </div>

          {/* Progress bar */}
          {totalCount > 0 && (
            <div className="mt-4 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-muted overflow-hidden">
              <div
                className="h-full rounded-full bg-[var(--brand)] transition-all duration-500"
                style={{
                  width: `${Math.round((completedCount / totalCount) * 100)}%`,
                }}
              />
            </div>
          )}
      </div>

      <div className="max-w-3xl">
        {/* Loading state */}
        {isLoading && (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-16">
            <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Error state */}
        {error && (
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--brand-red)]/20 bg-red-500/5 p-5 text-center">
            <AlertCircle className="h-5 w-5 text-[var(--brand-red)] mx-auto mb-2" />
            <p className="text-sm text-[var(--brand-red)]">{error.message}</p>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Steps */}
        {data && (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {data.steps
              .sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order)
              .map((step) => (
                <StepCard
                  key={step.key}
                  step={step}
                  clientIdCode={clientIdCode}
                  onEdit={step.key === "create_client" ? handleEditClient : undefined}
                />
              ))}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Empty state for when all done */}
        {data && completedCount === totalCount && totalCount > 0 && (
          <div className="mt-6 rounded-xl border bg-emerald-500/5 border-emerald-500/20 p-5 text-center">
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-6 w-6 text-[var(--brand-green)] mx-auto mb-2" />
            <p className="text-sm font-medium">All onboarding steps completed</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
              {clientIdCode} is fully set up and ready to go.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <NewClientDialog
        open={editDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setEditDialogOpen}
        editData={editData}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function fmt(n: number, short = false): string {
  const abs = Math.abs(n);
  const prefix = n < 0 ? "-$" : "$";
  if (short && abs >= 1000) {
    return prefix + abs.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
  }
  return prefix + abs.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
}

function dateLabel(d: string): string {
  return new Date(d + "T00:00:00").toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

function DateInput({ value, onChange, label }: { value: string; onChange: (iso: string) => void; label: string }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const date = parse(value, "yyyy-MM-dd", new Date());

  return (
    <div>
      <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">{label}</label>
      <Popover open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <PopoverTrigger asChild>
          <button className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-border bg-background px-3 py-1.5 text-sm min-w-[160px] hover:bg-muted/50 transition-colors">
            <CalendarIcon className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
            <span className="font-mono">{format(date, "MM/dd/yyyy")}</span>
          </button>
        </PopoverTrigger>
        <PopoverContent className="w-auto p-0" align="start">
          <Calendar
            mode="single"
            selected={date}
            onSelect={(d) => {
              if (d) {
                onChange(format(d, "yyyy-MM-dd"));
                setOpen(false);
              }
            }}
            defaultMonth={date}
          />
        </PopoverContent>
      </Popover>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Waterfall Component ────────────────────────────────────────────

function WaterfallChart({ statement }: { statement: StatementData["statement"] }) {
  if (!statement) return null;

  const {
    beginningBalance,
    sales,
    refunds,
    expenses,
    accountLevelReserve,
    fundTransfer,
    netProceeds,
    itemDetail,
  } = statement;

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card overflow-hidden">
      {/* Header — Net Proceeds banner (matches Amazon) */}
      <div className="px-6 py-5 border-b border-border/40 bg-muted/20">
        <p className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground mb-1">Net Proceeds</p>
        <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {dateLabel(statement.periodStart)}
            {statement.periodStart !== statement.periodEnd && (
              ` – ${statement.periodEnd === new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) ? "Present (Open)" : dateLabel(statement.periodEnd)}`
            )}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className={`text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight mt-1 font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] ${netProceeds >= 0 ? "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" : "text-red-500"}`}>
          {fmt(netProceeds)}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Sankey flow chart — source labels rendered inside the chart */}
      <div className="p-4">
        <SankeyFlowChart statement={statement} />
      </div>

      {/* Footer — summary items not in the Sankey */}
      <div className="px-6 py-4 border-t border-border/40 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-6">
        {beginningBalance !== 0 && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-sm bg-blue-500" />
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Beginning Balance</span>
            <span className="text-xs font-mono font-semibold tabular-nums text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
              {fmt(beginningBalance)}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
        {accountLevelReserve !== 0 && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-sm bg-slate-400" />
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Account Reserve</span>
            <span className="text-xs font-mono font-semibold tabular-nums text-red-500">
              {fmt(accountLevelReserve)}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
        {fundTransfer !== 0 && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-sm bg-slate-400" />
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Disbursement</span>
            <span className="text-xs font-mono font-semibold tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
              {fmt(fundTransfer)}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Budget Pacing Card ──────────────────────────────────────────

function BudgetPacingCard({ pacing }: { pacing: BudgetPacing }) {
  const progressPct = Math.min((pacing.mtdSpend / pacing.budget) * 100, 100);
  const expectedPct = (pacing.dayOfMonth / pacing.daysInMonth) * 100;

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card p-5">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <span className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
          Ad Spend Pacing
        </span>
        <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg p-2 bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
          <Gauge className="h-4 w-4" />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)]">
        {fmt(pacing.mtdSpend, true)}{" "}
        <span className="text-sm font-normal text-muted-foreground">/ {fmt(pacing.budget, true)}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-3 relative">
        <div className="h-2.5 bg-muted rounded-full overflow-hidden">
          <div
            className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all ${
              pacing.status === "over" ? "bg-red-500" : pacing.status === "on-track" ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-amber-500"
            }`}
            style={{ width: `${progressPct}%` }}
          />
        </div>
        <div
          className="absolute top-0 h-2.5 w-0.5 bg-foreground/30 rounded-full"
          style={{ left: `${expectedPct}%` }}
        />
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-2">
        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Day {pacing.dayOfMonth}/{pacing.daysInMonth}
        </span>
        <span className={`text-xs font-semibold ${
          pacing.status === "over" ? "text-red-500" : pacing.status === "on-track" ? "text-emerald-500" : "text-amber-500"
        }`}>
          {pacing.status === "over" ? "Over budget" : pacing.status === "on-track" ? "On track" : "Under-pacing"}
          {" "}({pacing.pacePercent}%)
        </span>
      </div>
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
        Projected: {fmt(pacing.projectedSpend, true)} by month-end
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Statement View Tab ──────────────────────────────────────────

function StatementView({ clientCode }: { clientCode: string }) {
  const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const thirtyDaysAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState(thirtyDaysAgo);
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState(today);

  const { data, isLoading } = useQuery<StatementData>({
    queryKey: ["hub-finance-statement", clientCode, startDate, endDate],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const params = new URLSearchParams({
        client: clientCode,
        view: "statement",
        periodStart: startDate,
        periodEnd: endDate,
      });
      const res = await fetch(`/api/portal/finance?${params}`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load");
      return res.json();
    },
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  const dateControls = (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-4">
      <DateInput label="From" value={startDate} onChange={setStartDate} />
      <DateInput label="To" value={endDate} onChange={setEndDate} />
    </div>
  );

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        {dateControls}
        <div className="h-[300px] rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card animate-pulse" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!data?.statement) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        {dateControls}
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card p-12 text-center">
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">{data?.error || "No financial data available for this date range."}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-end gap-4">
        {dateControls}

        {data.budgetPacing && (
          <div className="flex-1 max-w-sm ml-auto">
            <BudgetPacingCard pacing={data.budgetPacing} />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <WaterfallChart statement={data.statement} />
    </div>
  );
}

// Classify item detail keys into Sales (positive), Refunds, or Expenses
const SALES_KEYS = new Set([
  "OurPricePrincipal", "OurPriceTax", "MarketplaceFacilitatorTax-Principal",
  "ShippingPrincipal", "FBAInventoryReimbursement",
]);
const REFUND_KEYS = new Set([
  "Refunded Sales", "Refunded Expenses", "RefundCommission",
  "RestockingDeductionPrincipal", "RestockingDeductionTax",
]);
// Everything else negative → Expenses

function SankeyFlowChart({ statement }: { statement: NonNullable<StatementData["statement"]> }) {
  const { sales, refunds, expenses, itemDetail } = statement;

  // Classify items into 3 buckets
  const MAX_PER_GROUP = 5;
  const salesItems: [string, number][] = [];
  const refundItems: [string, number][] = [];
  const expenseItems: [string, number][] = [];

  for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(itemDetail)) {
    if (Math.abs(val) < 1 || ["Base", "Tax"].includes(key)) continue;
    if (SALES_KEYS.has(key) || (val > 0 && !REFUND_KEYS.has(key))) {
      salesItems.push([key, val]);
    } else if (REFUND_KEYS.has(key)) {
      refundItems.push([key, Math.abs(val)]);
    } else {
      expenseItems.push([key, Math.abs(val)]);
    }
  }

  // Sort each by value desc
  salesItems.sort(([, a], [, b]) => b - a);
  refundItems.sort(([, a], [, b]) => b - a);
  expenseItems.sort(([, a], [, b]) => b - a);

  // Need at least Sales and one other group
  if (salesItems.length < 1 || (refundItems.length < 1 && expenseItems.length < 1)) return null;

  // Cap items per group with "Other" rollup
  const capGroup = (items: [string, number][], otherLabel: string) => {
    const top = items.slice(0, MAX_PER_GROUP);
    const rest = items.slice(MAX_PER_GROUP).reduce((s, [, v]) => s + v, 0);
    if (rest > 1) top.push([otherLabel, rest]);
    return top;
  };

  const cappedSales = capGroup(salesItems, "Other income");
  const cappedRefunds = capGroup(refundItems, "Other refunds");
  const cappedExpenses = capGroup(expenseItems, "Other fees");

  // Build Sankey: 3 sources (Sales, Refunds, Expenses) → sub-categories
  const TEAL = "#10b981";   // emerald-500 — matches Sales dot
  const SALMON = "#f59e0b"; // amber-500 — matches Refunds dot
  const RED = "#ef4444";    // red-500 — matches Expenses dot

  const sourceNames = new Set(["Sales", "Refunds", "Expenses"]);
  const nodes: { name: string }[] = [];
  const links: { source: number; target: number; value: number }[] = [];
  const nodeColorMap: string[] = [];

  // Source nodes
  nodes.push({ name: "Sales" }); nodeColorMap.push(TEAL);
  const hasRefunds = cappedRefunds.length > 0;
  const hasExpenses = cappedExpenses.length > 0;
  if (hasRefunds) { nodes.push({ name: "Refunds" }); nodeColorMap.push(SALMON); }
  if (hasExpenses) { nodes.push({ name: "Expenses" }); nodeColorMap.push(RED); }

  const salesIdx = 0;
  const refundsIdx = hasRefunds ? 1 : -1;
  const expensesIdx = hasRefunds && hasExpenses ? 2 : hasExpenses ? 1 : -1;

  // Add target nodes for each group
  for (const [key, value] of cappedSales) {
    const idx = nodes.length;
    nodes.push({ name: sankeyLabel(key) });
    nodeColorMap.push(TEAL);
    links.push({ source: salesIdx, target: idx, value });
  }
  for (const [key, value] of cappedRefunds) {
    const idx = nodes.length;
    nodes.push({ name: sankeyLabel(key) });
    nodeColorMap.push(SALMON);
    links.push({ source: refundsIdx, target: idx, value });
  }
  for (const [key, value] of cappedExpenses) {
    const idx = nodes.length;
    nodes.push({ name: sankeyLabel(key) });
    nodeColorMap.push(RED);
    links.push({ source: expensesIdx, target: idx, value });
  }

  // Remove near-zero links and their orphaned target nodes
  const validLinks = links.filter((l) => l.value >= 1);
  if (validLinks.length < 2) return null;

  // Rebuild nodes to remove orphaned targets
  const usedIndices = new Set<number>();
  for (const l of validLinks) { usedIndices.add(l.source); usedIndices.add(l.target); }
  const indexMap = new Map<number, number>();
  const filteredNodes: { name: string }[] = [];
  const filteredColors: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
    if (usedIndices.has(i)) {
      indexMap.set(i, filteredNodes.length);
      filteredNodes.push(nodes[i]);
      filteredColors.push(nodeColorMap[i]);
    }
  }
  const remappedLinks = validLinks.map((l) => ({
    source: indexMap.get(l.source)!,
    target: indexMap.get(l.target)!,
    value: l.value,
  }));

  // Replace mutable arrays for renderNode closure
  nodeColorMap.length = 0;
  nodeColorMap.push(...filteredColors);

  const data = { nodes: filteredNodes, links: remappedLinks };

  const renderNode = useCallback(
    (props: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number; index: number; payload: { name: string; value: number } }) => {
      const { x, y, width, height, index, payload } = props;
      const isSource = sourceNames.has(payload.name);
      const color = nodeColorMap[index] || "#94a3b8";
      const h = Math.max(height, 2);
      // Show signed values: positive for sales items, negative for refund/expense items
      const isNegative = color === RED || color === SALMON;
      const displayVal = isSource
        ? (payload.name === "Sales" ? fmt(sales) : payload.name === "Refunds" ? fmt(refunds) : fmt(expenses))
        : fmt(isNegative ? -payload.value : payload.value);
      const valColor = isNegative ? RED : TEAL;
      return (
        <g>
          <rect x={x} y={y} width={width} height={h} fill={color} rx={2} opacity={0.85} />
          {isSource ? (
            /* Left side: source label + value, anchored to the left of the bar */
            <>
              <text
                x={x - 8} y={y + h / 2 - 7}
                textAnchor="end" dominantBaseline="central"
                className="fill-foreground"
                style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600 }}
              >
                {payload.name}
              </text>
              <text
                x={x - 8} y={y + h / 2 + 8}
                textAnchor="end" dominantBaseline="central"
                style={{ fontSize: 10, fontFamily: "var(--font-geist-mono, monospace)", fontWeight: 600, fill: valColor }}
              >
                {displayVal}
              </text>
            </>
          ) : (
            /* Right side: label left-aligned, value right-aligned at fixed column */
            <>
              <text
                x={x + width + 6} y={y + h / 2}
                textAnchor="start" dominantBaseline="central"
                className="fill-foreground"
                style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 500 }}
              >
                {payload.name.length > 24 ? payload.name.slice(0, 22) + "…" : payload.name}
              </text>
              <text
                x={x + width + 250} y={y + h / 2}
                textAnchor="end" dominantBaseline="central"
                style={{ fontSize: 10, fontFamily: "var(--font-geist-mono, monospace)", fontWeight: 600, fill: valColor }}
              >
                {displayVal}
              </text>
            </>
          )}
        </g>
      );
    },
    [sales, refunds, expenses, nodeColorMap],
  );

  const renderLink = useCallback(
    (props: {
      sourceX: number; targetX: number; sourceY: number; targetY: number;
      sourceControlX: number; targetControlX: number; linkWidth: number;
      payload: { source: { name: string }; target: { name: string } };
    }) => {
      const { sourceX, targetX, sourceY, targetY, sourceControlX, targetControlX, linkWidth, payload } = props;
      const color = payload.source.name === "Sales" ? TEAL : payload.source.name === "Refunds" ? SALMON : RED;
      return (
        <path
          d={`M${sourceX},${sourceY + linkWidth / 2} C${sourceControlX},${sourceY + linkWidth / 2} ${targetControlX},${targetY + linkWidth / 2} ${targetX},${targetY + linkWidth / 2} L${targetX},${targetY - linkWidth / 2} C${targetControlX},${targetY - linkWidth / 2} ${sourceControlX},${sourceY - linkWidth / 2} ${sourceX},${sourceY - linkWidth / 2} Z`}
          fill={color}
          opacity={0.2}
          strokeWidth={0}
        />
      );
    },
    [],
  );

  const sourceCount = [salesIdx, refundsIdx, expensesIdx].filter((i) => usedIndices.has(i)).length;
  const rightCount = filteredNodes.length - sourceCount;

  const chartHeight = Math.max(300, rightCount * 36 + 80);

  return (
    <div className="w-full" style={{ height: chartHeight }}>
      <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
          <Sankey
            data={data}
            nodeWidth={8}
            nodePadding={14}
            margin={{ left: 120, right: 280, top: 10, bottom: 10 }}
            link={renderLink as any}
            node={renderNode as any}
          >
            <Tooltip
              content={({ payload }: any) => {
                if (!payload?.length) return null;
                const item = payload[0]?.payload;
                if (!item) return null;
                const name = item.source?.name && item.target?.name
                  ? `${item.source.name} → ${item.target.name}`
                  : item.name || "";
                return (
                  <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-popover px-3 py-2 text-xs shadow-md">
                    <p className="font-medium">{name}</p>
                    <p className="font-mono text-muted-foreground">{fmt(item.value)}</p>
                  </div>
                );
              }}
            />
          </Sankey>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── All Statements Tab ──────────────────────────────────────────

function AllStatementsView({ clientCode, onViewPeriod }: { clientCode: string; onViewPeriod: (start: string, end: string) => void }) {
  const [months, setMonths] = useState(6);
  const [expandedPeriod, setExpandedPeriod] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const { data, isLoading } = useQuery<StatementsData>({
    queryKey: ["hub-finance-statements", clientCode, months],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const params = new URLSearchParams({ client: clientCode, view: "statements", months: String(months) });
      const res = await fetch(`/api/portal/finance?${params}`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load");
      return res.json();
    },
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  if (isLoading) {
    return <div className="h-[400px] rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card animate-pulse" />;
  }

  const statements = data?.statements || [];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Settlement periods from Seller Central financial transactions.
        </p>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          {[3, 6, 12].map((m) => (
            <button
              key={m}
              onClick={() => setMonths(m)}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
                months === m
                  ? "bg-[#2563eb] text-white"
                  : "bg-muted/60 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
              }`}
            >
              {m}M
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card overflow-hidden">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-border/40 bg-muted/30">
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-left text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Settlement Period
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Sales
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Refunds
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Expenses
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Advertising
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Other
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Net Proceeds
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider w-28">
                </th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {statements.map((s) => {
                const key = `${s.periodStart}_${s.periodEnd}`;
                const isExpanded = expandedPeriod === key;
                const significantBreakdown = Object.entries(s.breakdown)
                  .filter(([k, v]) => Math.abs(v) > 0.5 && !["Base"].includes(k))
                  .sort(([, a], [, b]) => a - b);

                return (
                  <React.Fragment key={key}>
                    <tr
                      className="group cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors border-b border-border/30"
                      onClick={() => setExpandedPeriod(isExpanded ? null : key)}
                    >
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-sm font-medium">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          {isExpanded ? (
                            <ChevronDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
                          ) : (
                            <ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
                          )}
                          <span>
                            {dateLabel(s.periodStart)}
                            {s.periodStart !== s.periodEnd && (
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground"> – {dateLabel(s.periodEnd)}</span>
                            )}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-sm text-right text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-medium">
                        {fmt(s.sales, true)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-sm text-right text-amber-500 font-medium">
                        {fmt(s.refunds, true)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-sm text-right text-red-500 font-medium">
                        {fmt(s.expenses, true)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-sm text-right text-orange-500 font-medium">
                        {fmt(s.advertising, true)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-sm text-right text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                        {fmt(s.other, true)}
                      </td>
                      <td className={`py-3 px-4 text-sm text-right font-bold ${
                        s.netProceeds >= 0 ? "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" : "text-red-500"
                      }`}>
                        {fmt(s.netProceeds, true)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right">
                        <button
                          onClick={(e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            onViewPeriod(s.periodStart, s.periodEnd);
                          }}
                          className="text-xs text-[#2563eb] hover:underline font-medium"
                        >
                          View transactions
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                    {isExpanded && significantBreakdown.length > 0 && (
                      <tr className="border-b border-border/20">
                        <td colSpan={8} className="bg-muted/15 px-10 py-3">
                          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-x-6 gap-y-1.5">
                            {significantBreakdown.map(([bKey, value]) => (
                              <div key={bKey} className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs gap-2">
                                <span className="text-muted-foreground truncate">{friendlyName(bKey)}</span>
                                <span className={`font-mono font-medium tabular-nums shrink-0 ${value < 0 ? "text-red-500" : "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"}`}>
                                  {fmt(value)}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    )}
                  </React.Fragment>
                );
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        {statements.length === 0 && (
          <div className="p-12 text-center">
            <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">No statements found for this period.</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Transaction View Tab ────────────────────────────────────────

function TransactionView({
  clientCode,
  periodStart,
  periodEnd,
}: {
  clientCode: string;
  periodStart: string;
  periodEnd: string;
}) {
  const { data, isLoading } = useQuery<TransactionsData>({
    queryKey: ["hub-finance-transactions", clientCode, periodStart, periodEnd],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const params = new URLSearchParams({
        client: clientCode,
        view: "transactions",
        periodStart,
        periodEnd,
      });
      const res = await fetch(`/api/portal/finance?${params}`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load");
      return res.json();
    },
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  if (isLoading) {
    return <div className="h-[300px] rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card animate-pulse" />;
  }

  const transactions = data?.transactions || [];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {dateLabel(periodStart)}
          {periodStart !== periodEnd && ` – ${dateLabel(periodEnd)}`}
          {" "}&mdash; {transactions.length} transactions
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card overflow-hidden">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-border/40 bg-muted/30">
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-left text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Date
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-left text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  SKU
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Qty
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Product Charges
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Promo Rebates
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Amazon Fees
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Other
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Total
                </th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {transactions.map((txn) => (
                <tr key={txn.transactionId} className="border-b border-border/20 hover:bg-muted/20 transition-colors" title={txn.transactionId}>
                  <td className="py-2.5 px-4 text-xs text-muted-foreground whitespace-nowrap">
                    {txn.postedDate ? dateLabel(txn.postedDate) : "—"}
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 px-4 text-xs font-mono text-foreground max-w-[200px] truncate" title={txn.sku}>
                    {txn.sku || "—"}
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 px-4 text-xs text-right font-mono tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
                    {txn.quantity || "—"}
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 px-4 text-xs text-right font-mono tabular-nums">
                    <span className={txn.productCharges >= 0 ? "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" : "text-red-500"}>
                      {fmt(txn.productCharges)}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 px-4 text-xs text-right font-mono tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
                    {txn.promoRebates !== 0 ? fmt(txn.promoRebates) : "$0.00"}
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 px-4 text-xs text-right font-mono tabular-nums text-red-500">
                    {fmt(txn.amazonFees)}
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 px-4 text-xs text-right font-mono tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
                    {txn.other !== 0 ? fmt(txn.other) : "$0.00"}
                  </td>
                  <td className={`py-2.5 px-4 text-xs text-right font-mono font-semibold tabular-nums ${txn.total >= 0 ? "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" : "text-red-500"}`}>
                    {fmt(txn.total)}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
            {transactions.length > 0 && (
              <tfoot>
                <tr className="border-t-2 border-border bg-muted/20">
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 text-xs font-bold" colSpan={3}>
                    Total ({transactions.length})
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 text-xs text-right font-mono font-bold tabular-nums text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                    {fmt(transactions.reduce((s, t) => s + t.productCharges, 0))}
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 text-xs text-right font-mono font-bold tabular-nums">
                    {fmt(transactions.reduce((s, t) => s + t.promoRebates, 0))}
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 text-xs text-right font-mono font-bold tabular-nums text-red-500">
                    {fmt(transactions.reduce((s, t) => s + t.amazonFees, 0))}
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 text-xs text-right font-mono font-bold tabular-nums">
                    {fmt(transactions.reduce((s, t) => s + t.other, 0))}
                  </td>
                  <td className={`py-3 px-4 text-xs text-right font-mono font-bold tabular-nums ${
                    transactions.reduce((s, t) => s + t.total, 0) >= 0 ? "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" : "text-red-500"
                  }`}>
                    {fmt(transactions.reduce((s, t) => s + t.total, 0))}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              </tfoot>
            )}
          </table>
        </div>

        {transactions.length === 0 && (
          <div className="p-12 text-center">
            <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">No transactions found for this period.</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Main Finance Page ───────────────────────────────────────────

function FinanceContent() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<Tab>("statement");
  const [txnPeriod, setTxnPeriod] = useState<{ start: string; end: string } | null>(null);

  const { data: activeClients = [] } = useQuery<{ clientIdCode: string; clientName: string }[]>({
    queryKey: ["active-clients"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/clients");
      if (!res.ok) return [];
      return res.json();
    },
    staleTime: 10 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  const clientCode = searchParams.get("client") || "";
  const clientName = clientCode
    ? activeClients.find((c) => c.clientIdCode === clientCode)?.clientName || CLIENT_NAMES[clientCode] || clientCode
    : "";

  function handleClientChange(code: string) {
    setActiveTab("statement");
    setTxnPeriod(null);
    router.push(code ? `/finances?client=${code}` : "/finances");
  }

  function handleViewPeriod(start: string, end: string) {
    setTxnPeriod({ start, end });
    setActiveTab("transactions");
  }

  const tabs: { id: Tab; label: string; icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }> }[] = [
    { id: "statement", label: "Statement View", icon: FileText },
    { id: "statements", label: "All Statements", icon: List },
    { id: "transactions", label: "Transaction View", icon: Receipt },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10 py-4 bg-background">
        <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter mb-2">
          <span className="text-foreground font-bold">Finance</span>
          <span className="text-brand">Reports</span>
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {clientName
            ? `${clientName} — Amazon Seller Central financial transactions`
            : "Select a client to view settlement statements and transactions."
          }
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Client Selector */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg p-2 bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
          <Users className="h-4 w-4" />
        </div>
        <select
          value={clientCode}
          onChange={(e) => handleClientChange(e.target.value)}
          className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm min-w-[250px]"
        >
          <option value="">Select a client...</option>
          {activeClients.map((c) => (
            <option key={c.clientIdCode} value={c.clientIdCode}>
              {c.clientName} ({c.clientIdCode})
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </div>

      {!clientCode ? (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card p-12 text-center">
          <Users className="h-12 w-12 mx-auto mb-4 text-muted-foreground/30" />
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">Select a client above to view their financial data.</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {/* Tabs */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 border-b border-border/40 -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10">
            {tabs.map((tab) => (
              <button
                key={tab.id}
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
                className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium border-b-2 transition-colors ${
                  activeTab === tab.id
                    ? "border-[#2563eb] text-[#2563eb]"
                    : "border-transparent text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:border-border"
                }`}
              >
                <tab.icon className="h-4 w-4" />
                {tab.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Tab Content */}
          {activeTab === "statement" && <StatementView clientCode={clientCode} />}
          {activeTab === "statements" && (
            <AllStatementsView clientCode={clientCode} onViewPeriod={handleViewPeriod} />
          )}
          {activeTab === "transactions" && txnPeriod && (
            <TransactionView
              clientCode={clientCode}
              periodStart={txnPeriod.start}
              periodEnd={txnPeriod.end}
            />
          )}
          {activeTab === "transactions" && !txnPeriod && (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card p-12 text-center">
              <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">
                Select a period from{" "}
                <button
                  onClick={() => setActiveTab("statements")}
                  className="text-[#2563eb] hover:underline font-medium"
                >
                  All Statements
                </button>
                {" "}to view individual transactions.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function FinancesPage() {
  return (
    <Suspense>
      <FinanceContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import Link from "next/link";
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  Circle,
  Loader2,
  AlertCircle,
  ClipboardList,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

// ── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface ClientListItem {
  clientIdCode: string;
  clientName: string;
  count: number;
  activeCount: number;
}

interface OnboardingStep {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  status: "pending" | "in_progress" | "completed" | "failed";
}

interface ClientOnboarding {
  clientIdCode: string;
  steps: OnboardingStep[];
}

// ── Page ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function OnboardingListPage() {
  // Fetch active clients
  const { data: clients, isLoading: loadingClients } = useQuery<ClientListItem[]>({
    queryKey: ["clients"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/clients");
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load clients");
      return res.json();
    },
  });

  // Fetch onboarding status for all clients
  const { data: onboardingMap, isLoading: loadingOnboarding } = useQuery<
    Record<string, OnboardingStep[]>
  >({
    queryKey: ["onboarding-all"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!clients?.length) return {};
      const results: Record<string, OnboardingStep[]> = {};
      // Fetch in parallel but limit concurrency
      const fetches = clients.map(async (c) => {
        try {
          const res = await fetch(
            `/api/clients/${encodeURIComponent(c.clientIdCode)}/onboarding`
          );
          if (res.ok) {
            const data: ClientOnboarding = await res.json();
            results[c.clientIdCode] = data.steps;
          }
        } catch {
          // skip failed fetches
        }
      });
      await Promise.all(fetches);
      return results;
    },
    enabled: !!clients?.length,
  });

  const isLoading = loadingClients || loadingOnboarding;

  function getProgress(clientIdCode: string) {
    const steps = onboardingMap?.[clientIdCode];
    if (!steps?.length) return { completed: 0, total: 0, percentage: 0 };
    const completed = steps.filter((s) => s.status === "completed").length;
    return {
      completed,
      total: steps.length,
      percentage: Math.round((completed / steps.length) * 100),
    };
  }

  function getStatusIcon(clientIdCode: string) {
    const { completed, total } = getProgress(clientIdCode);
    if (total === 0) return <Circle className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />;
    if (completed === total)
      return <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-[var(--brand-green)]" />;
    const steps = onboardingMap?.[clientIdCode];
    if (steps?.some((s) => s.status === "failed"))
      return <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-[var(--brand-red)]" />;
    if (steps?.some((s) => s.status === "in_progress"))
      return <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin text-[var(--brand-yellow)]" />;
    return <Circle className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10 py-4 mb-2 bg-background">
        <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter mb-2">
          <span className="text-foreground font-bold">Client</span><span className="text-brand font-medium">Onboarding</span>
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Track onboarding progress for all active clients.
        </p>
      </div>
      <div className="max-w-4xl">

        {/* Loading */}
        {isLoading && (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-16">
            <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Client list */}
        {!isLoading && clients && (
          <div className="rounded-xl border bg-card text-card-foreground overflow-hidden">
            <table className="w-full">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-border/50 text-left">
                  <th className="px-5 py-3 text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Client
                  </th>
                  <th className="px-5 py-3 text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Status
                  </th>
                  <th className="px-5 py-3 text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Progress
                  </th>
                  <th className="px-5 py-3 text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider text-right">
                    Action
                  </th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {clients.map((client) => {
                  const { completed, total, percentage } = getProgress(
                    client.clientIdCode
                  );
                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={client.clientIdCode}
                      className="border-b border-border/30 last:border-0 hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <td className="px-5 py-3">
                        <div>
                          <p className="text-sm font-medium">
                            {client.clientName || client.clientIdCode}
                          </p>
                          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-mono">
                            {client.clientIdCode}
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-3">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          {getStatusIcon(client.clientIdCode)}
                          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            {total === 0
                              ? "Not started"
                              : completed === total
                                ? "Complete"
                                : `${completed}/${total} steps`}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-3">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <div className="h-1.5 w-24 rounded-full bg-muted overflow-hidden">
                            <div
                              className="h-full rounded-full bg-[var(--brand)] transition-all duration-500"
                              style={{ width: `${percentage}%` }}
                            />
                          </div>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                            {percentage}%
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-3 text-right">
                        <Link
                          href={`/clients/${client.clientIdCode}/onboarding`}
                        >
                          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="text-xs">
                            Manage
                          </Button>
                        </Link>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ClientDashboard() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const user = session?.user;
  const isAdmin = user?.role === "admin";
  const isProspect = user?.role === "prospect";
  const previewClient = isAdmin ? searchParams.get("client") : null;
  const clientCode = previewClient || user?.clientIdCode;
  const clientName = isAdmin
    ? previewClient
      ? CLIENT_NAMES[previewClient] || previewClient
      : "Admin Preview"
    : clientCode
      ? CLIENT_NAMES[clientCode] || clientCode
      : "Your Account";
  const allowedSections = user?.allowedSections ?? [];
  const clientParam = previewClient ? `?client=${previewClient}` : "";

  const visibleCards = SECTION_CARDS.filter((card) =>
    card.permission === null || canAccess(card.permission, allowedSections, isAdmin)
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-10">
      {/* Preview Banner for prospects */}
      {isProspect && (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-teal-500/30 bg-teal-500/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400 flex items-center gap-2">

          <span>

          </span>

// ── Admin Portal Landing ────────────────────────────────────────

function AdminPortalLanding() {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [expandedUsers, setExpandedUsers] = useState(false);

  // Fetch active clients
  const { data: clients = [], isLoading: clientsLoading } = useQuery<ClientSummary[]>({
    queryKey: ["portal-clients"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/clients");
      if (!res.ok) return [];
      return res.json();
    },
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  // Fetch all users, filter to client role
  const { data: allUsers = [], isLoading: usersLoading } = useQuery<ClientUser[]>({
    queryKey: ["admin-users"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/users");
      if (!res.ok) return [];
      return res.json();
    },
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  const clientUsers = allUsers.filter((u) => u.role === "client" || u.role === "prospect");

  // Fetch all clients for the dropdown
  const { data: allClients = [] } = useQuery<{ clientIdCode: string; clientName: string }[]>({
    queryKey: ["admin-clients"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/clients");
      if (!res.ok) return [];
      return res.json();
    },
    staleTime: 10 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  const sectionMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({ userId, allowedSections }: { userId: string; allowedSections: string[] }) => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/users", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ userId, allowedSections }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Failed to update sections");
      }
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["admin-users"] });
      toast.success("Section access updated");
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => toast.error(error.message),
  });

  const clientCodeMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({ userId, clientIdCode }: { userId: string; clientIdCode: string | null }) => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/users", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ userId, clientIdCode }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Failed to update client");
      }
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["admin-users"] });
      toast.success("Client assignment updated");
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => toast.error(error.message),
  });

  const deleteMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (userId: string) => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/users", {
        method: "DELETE",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ userId }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Failed to remove user");
      }
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["admin-users"] });
      toast.success("Client user removed");
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => toast.error(error.message),
  });

  function toggleSection(user: ClientUser, sectionId: string) {
    const current = user.allowedSections ?? [];
    const next = current.includes(sectionId)
      ? current.filter((s) => s !== sectionId)
      : [...current, sectionId];
    sectionMutation.mutate({ userId: user.id, allowedSections: next });
  }

  // Group client users by client
  const usersByClient = new Map<string, ClientUser[]>();
  for (const u of clientUsers) {
    const key = u.clientIdCode || "unassigned";
    if (!usersByClient.has(key)) usersByClient.set(key, []);
    usersByClient.get(key)!.push(u);
  }

  // Active clients only
  const activeClients = clients.filter((c) => {
    // clients API returns all, we show them all — they can click to preview
    return true;
  });

      {/* Header */}

          <span className="text-foreground font-bold">Client</span><span className="text-brand font-medium">Portal</span>

            ({activeClients.length})

        {clientsLoading ? (

            {Array.from({ length: 8 }).map((_, i) => (
              <Skeleton key={i} className="h-[140px] rounded-xl" />
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
            {activeClients.map((client) => {
              const assignedUsers = usersByClient.get(client.clientIdCode) ?? [];
              return (
                <Link
                  key={client.clientIdCode}
                  href={`/portal?client=${client.clientIdCode}`}
                  className="group rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card p-5 transition-all hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-slate-200/50 dark:hover:shadow-black/20 hover:border-brand/30"
                >

                              </Avatar>

                                checked={(user.allowedSections ?? []).includes(section.id)}
                                disabled={sectionMutation.isPending}
                                onCheckedChange={() => toggleSection(user, section.id)}
                              />
                            </TableCell>
                          ))}
                          <TableCell className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">
                            {user.lastLoginAt
                              ? new Date(user.lastLoginAt).toLocaleDateString()
                              : "Never"}
                          </TableCell>

                            <Button
                              variant="ghost"
                              size="sm"
                              className="text-red-500 hover:text-red-600 hover:bg-red-500/10 text-xs"
                              disabled={deleteMutation.isPending}
                              onClick={() => {
                                if (confirm(`Remove ${user.name ?? user.email}?`)) {
                                  deleteMutation.mutate(user.id);
                                }
                              }}
                            >
                              Remove
                            </Button>
                          </TableCell>
                        </TableRow>
                      );
                    })}
                  </TableBody>
                </Table>
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  return <ClientDashboard />;

"use client";

import { useState, useMemo, Suspense } from "react";

  ImageIcon,

// ── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type AplusProduct = {
  id: string;
  asin: string | null;
  sku: string | null;
  productName: string | null;
  clientIdCode: string | null;
  variationGroup: string | null;
  variationId: string | null;
  variationTheme: string | null;
  flavor: string | null;
  color: string | null;
  style: string | null;
  size: string | null;
  moduleCount: number;
  approvedCount: number;
  thumbnailUrl: string | null;
};

type ApiResponse = {
  products: AplusProduct[];
  clients: string[];
  role: string;
};

// ── Status badge ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function StatusBadge({ moduleCount, approvedCount }: { moduleCount: number; approvedCount: number }) {
  if (moduleCount === 0) {
    return <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">No modules</span>;
  }
  const allApproved = approvedCount === moduleCount;
  return (
    <Badge
      variant="outline"
      className={cn(
        "text-xs",
        allApproved
          ? "border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500"
          : "border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600"
      )}
    >
      {approvedCount}/{moduleCount} approved
    </Badge>
  );
}

// ── Content ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function parseClientCodes(val: string | null | undefined): string[] {
  if (!val) return [];
  return val.split(",").map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
}

function PortalAplusContent() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  const isAdmin = session?.user?.role === "admin";
  const previewClient = isAdmin ? searchParams.get("client") : null;
  const clientCodes = previewClient

    : parseClientCodes(session?.user?.clientIdCode);

  if (clientCodes.length === 0 && !isAdmin) {
    return (

        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No client assigned to your account yet.</p>

  const clientParam = previewClient ? `?client=${previewClient}` : "";

  return (

function PortalAplusForClient({ clientCode, previewClient, showClientHeader }: { clientCode: string; previewClient: string | null; showClientHeader: boolean }) {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");

  // Fetch products filtered by client
  const { data, isLoading, isError } = useQuery<ApiResponse>({
    queryKey: ["portal-aplus-products", clientCode],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const url = clientCode
        ? `/api/aplus/products?client=${encodeURIComponent(clientCode)}`
        : "/api/aplus/products";
      const res = await fetch(url);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch products");
      return res.json();
    },
    enabled: !!clientCode,
    staleTime: 2 * 60_000,
  });

  // Only show products that actually have A+ modules
  const productsWithModules = useMemo(() => {
    const all = data?.products ?? [];
    return all.filter((p) => p.moduleCount > 0);
  }, [data]);

  // Apply search filter
  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return productsWithModules;
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
    return productsWithModules.filter(
      (p) =>
        p.asin?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.productName?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.sku?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.variationId?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.flavor?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.color?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.size?.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
  }, [productsWithModules, searchQuery]);

  const clientParam = previewClient ? `?client=${previewClient}` : "";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      {/* Client header (shown when user has multiple clients) */}
      {showClientHeader && (
        <div className="border-b border-border/60 pb-3">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">{clientCode}</h2>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Search */}
      <div>
        <div className="max-w-sm relative">
          <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground/60 pointer-events-none" />
          <Input
            placeholder="Search by ASIN or product name..."
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            className="pl-8 h-9 text-sm"
            disabled={isLoading}
          />
          {searchQuery && (
            <button
              onClick={() => setSearchQuery("")}
              className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground/60 hover:text-muted-foreground"
            >
              <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Content */}
      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
          {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
            <Skeleton key={i} className="h-[160px] rounded-xl" />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : isError ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-24 text-center">
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Failed to load A+ products. Please try again.</p>
        </div>
      ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-24 text-center gap-4">
          <div className="rounded-full bg-muted/40 p-6">
            <ImageIcon className="h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground/50" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
              {searchQuery ? `No products matching "${searchQuery}"` : "No A+ content available yet"}
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/70 mt-1">
              {searchQuery
                ? "Try a different search term."
                : "A+ modules will appear here once our team starts creating content."}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5">
          {filtered.map((product) => (
            <Link
              key={product.id}
              href={`/portal/aplus/${product.id}${clientParam}`}
              className="group rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card p-5 transition-all hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-slate-200/50 dark:hover:shadow-black/20 hover:border-[#008296]/30"
            >
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tight leading-snug">
                    {product.productName || product.sku || "Untitled Product"}
                  </h3>
                  <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 text-[11px] font-mono text-muted-foreground">
                    <span>ASIN: <span className="text-foreground/70">{product.asin ?? "—"}</span></span>
                    <span>SKU: <span className="text-foreground/70">{product.sku ?? "—"}</span></span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-0.5 flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 text-[11px] font-mono text-muted-foreground">
                    {product.variationId && (
                      <span>VAR: <span className="text-foreground/70">{product.variationId}</span></span>
                    )}
                    {(() => {
                      const theme = product.variationTheme?.toLowerCase();
                      const val = theme?.includes("flavor") ? product.flavor
                        : theme?.includes("color") ? product.color
                        : theme?.includes("style") ? product.style
                        : product.flavor || product.color || product.style || null;
                      const label = theme?.includes("flavor") ? "Flavor"
                        : theme?.includes("color") ? "Color"
                        : theme?.includes("style") ? "Style"
                        : val === product.flavor ? "Flavor"
                        : val === product.color ? "Color"
                        : val === product.style ? "Style" : null;
                      return val ? <span>{label}: <span className="text-foreground/70">{val}</span></span> : null;
                    })()}
                    {product.size && (
                      <span>Size: <span className="text-foreground/70">{product.size}</span></span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="rounded-lg bg-[#008296]/10 shrink-0 overflow-hidden w-14 h-14 flex items-center justify-center">
                  {product.thumbnailUrl ? (
                    <img
                      src={product.thumbnailUrl}
                      alt=""
                      className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                      loading="lazy"
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <ImageIcon className="h-4 w-4 text-[#008296]" />
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                    {product.moduleCount} module{product.moduleCount !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <StatusBadge moduleCount={product.moduleCount} approvedCount={product.approvedCount} />
              </div>

              <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium text-[#008296] opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                Review
                <ChevronRight className="h-3 w-3" />
              </div>
            </Link>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Footer count */}
      {!isLoading && !isError && filtered.length > 0 && (
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground text-right">
          {filtered.length} product{filtered.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""} with A+ content
          {searchQuery ? ` matching "${searchQuery}"` : ""}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
