"use client";

import { useState, useCallback, useMemo, Suspense } from "react";
import { useParams, useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useSession } from "next-auth/react";
import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ArrowLeft, Loader2, CheckCircle2, MessageSquareWarning } from "lucide-react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { AplusPreviewPanel } from "@/components/aplus/aplus-preview-panel";
import { AplusCommentThread } from "@/components/aplus/aplus-comment-thread";
import type { PendingPin } from "@/components/aplus/aplus-workspace";
import type { aplusModules, aplusModuleImages } from "@/lib/db/schema";

// ── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type AplusModuleWithImages = (typeof aplusModules.$inferSelect) & {
  images: (typeof aplusModuleImages.$inferSelect)[];
};

interface AplusApiResponse {
  product: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    asin: string;
    clientIdCode: string;
    marketplace?: string | null;
  };
  modules: AplusModuleWithImages[];
}

type CommentPin = {
  id: string;
  moduleId: string | null;
  pinX: number;
  pinY: number;
  commentNumber: number | null;
  status: "active" | "resolved";
  isClient: boolean;
};

// ── Content ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function PortalAplusReviewContent() {
  const { productId } = useParams<{ productId: string }>();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const [pendingPin, setPendingPin] = useState<PendingPin | null>(null);

  const isAdmin = session?.user?.role === "admin";
  const isClient = session?.user?.role === "client";
  const previewClient = isAdmin ? searchParams.get("client") : null;
  const clientParam = previewClient ? `?client=${previewClient}` : "";
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const [actionInFlight, setActionInFlight] = useState<"approve" | "reject" | null>(null);
  const [rejectReason, setRejectReason] = useState("");
  const [showRejectInput, setShowRejectInput] = useState(false);
  const [actionMessage, setActionMessage] = useState<{ type: "success" | "error"; text: string } | null>(null);

  const handleApprove = useCallback(async () => {
    setActionInFlight("approve");
    setActionMessage(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/aplus/${productId}/bulk-status`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ status: "approved" }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error((await res.json()).error ?? "Failed");
      setActionMessage({ type: "success", text: "All modules approved" });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["aplus-modules", productId] });
    } catch (err) {
      setActionMessage({ type: "error", text: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to approve" });
    } finally {
      setActionInFlight(null);
    }
  }, [productId, queryClient]);

  const handleReject = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!rejectReason.trim()) return;
    setActionInFlight("reject");
    setActionMessage(null);
    try {
      // Set status back to draft
      const statusRes = await fetch(`/api/aplus/${productId}/bulk-status`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ status: "draft" }),
      });
      if (!statusRes.ok) throw new Error((await statusRes.json()).error ?? "Failed");

      // Post rejection reason as comment
      await fetch(`/api/aplus/${productId}/comments`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          text: `Changes requested: ${rejectReason}`,
          audience: "client",
        }),
      });

      setActionMessage({ type: "success", text: "Changes requested — team has been notified" });
      setShowRejectInput(false);
      setRejectReason("");
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["aplus-modules", productId] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["aplus-comments", productId] });
    } catch (err) {
      setActionMessage({ type: "error", text: err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed" });
    } finally {
      setActionInFlight(null);
    }
  }, [productId, rejectReason, queryClient]);

  // Fetch product + modules (same query key as workspace for dedup)
  const { data, isLoading, isError } = useQuery<AplusApiResponse>({
    queryKey: ["aplus-modules", productId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/aplus/${productId}`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load A+ modules");
      return res.json();
    },
    refetchOnWindowFocus: true,
  });

  // Fetch comments for pin overlay on preview
  const { data: commentsData } = useQuery<{ comments: Array<{
    id: string;
    moduleId: string | null;
    pinX: number | null;
    pinY: number | null;
    commentNumber: number | null;
    status: "active" | "resolved";
    audience: string;
  }> }>({
    queryKey: ["aplus-comments", productId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/aplus/${productId}/comments`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch comments");
      return res.json();
    },
    refetchInterval: 15000,
  });

  // Extract pins from comments that have coordinates
  const commentPins: CommentPin[] = useMemo(() => {
    return (commentsData?.comments ?? [])
      .filter((c) => c.pinX != null && c.pinY != null)
      .map((c) => ({
        id: c.id,
        moduleId: c.moduleId,
        pinX: c.pinX!,
        pinY: c.pinY!,
        commentNumber: c.commentNumber,
        status: c.status,
        isClient: c.audience === "client",
      }));
  }, [commentsData]);

  const handlePreviewPin = useCallback((moduleId: string, moduleNumber: number, pinX: number, pinY: number) => {
    setPendingPin({ moduleId, moduleNumber, pinX, pinY });
  }, []);

  const handlePinClear = useCallback(() => {
    setPendingPin(null);
  }, []);

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", minHeight: "400px" }}>
        <Loader2 style={{ width: 24, height: 24, color: "#888c8c", animation: "spin 1s linear infinite" }} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (isError || !data) {
    return (
      <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", minHeight: "400px", color: "#d13212", fontSize: 14 }}>
        Failed to load A+ content. Please refresh.
      </div>
    );
  }

  const { product, modules } = data;
  const approvedCount = modules.filter((m) => m.status === "approved").length;
  const totalCount = modules.length;

  return (
    <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", height: "calc(100vh - 100px)", overflow: "hidden" }}>
      {/* Header bar */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 border-b border-border bg-background shrink-0">
        <Link
          href={`/portal/aplus${clientParam}`}
          className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors shrink-0"
        >
          <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
        </Link>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <h1 className="text-base font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tight leading-snug truncate">
            {product.name}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-mono">{product.asin}</p>
        </div>
        <Badge
          variant="outline"
          className={cn(
            "text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 shrink-0",
            approvedCount === totalCount && totalCount > 0
              ? "border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500/10"
              : "border-amber-500/30 text-amber-600 bg-amber-500/10"
          )}
        >
          {approvedCount}/{totalCount} approved
        </Badge>

        {/* Client approve/reject actions */}
        {isClient && totalCount > 0 && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              className="text-xs border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500/10"
              disabled={actionInFlight !== null}
              onClick={handleApprove}
            >
              {actionInFlight === "approve" ? (
                <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin mr-1" />
              ) : (
                <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
              )}
              Approve All
            </Button>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              className="text-xs border-amber-500/30 text-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500/10"
              disabled={actionInFlight !== null}
              onClick={() => setShowRejectInput(!showRejectInput)}
            >
              <MessageSquareWarning className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
              Request Changes
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Reject reason input bar */}
      {showRejectInput && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 border-b border-border bg-amber-500/5 shrink-0">
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="What changes are needed?"
            value={rejectReason}
            onChange={(e) => setRejectReason(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && handleReject()}
            className="flex-1 text-sm bg-transparent border border-border rounded px-2 py-1 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-amber-500/50"
            autoFocus
          />
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="default"
            className="text-xs"
            disabled={!rejectReason.trim() || actionInFlight !== null}
            onClick={handleReject}
          >
            {actionInFlight === "reject" ? <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" /> : "Submit"}
          </Button>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="ghost"
            className="text-xs"
            onClick={() => { setShowRejectInput(false); setRejectReason(""); }}
          >
            Cancel
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Action feedback */}
      {actionMessage && (
        <div className={cn(
          "px-4 py-1.5 text-xs shrink-0 border-b border-border",
          actionMessage.type === "success" ? "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600" : "bg-red-500/10 text-red-500"
        )}>
          {actionMessage.text}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 2-panel layout: Preview (left ~65%) | Comments (right ~35%) */}
      <div style={{ display: "flex", flex: 1, overflow: "hidden" }}>
        {/* Preview panel */}
        <div style={{
          flex: "0 0 65%",
          overflowY: "auto",
          backgroundColor: "#f7f8fa",
          borderRight: "1px solid var(--border, #333)",
        }}>
          <AplusPreviewPanel
            modules={modules}
            product={product}
            commentPins={commentPins}
            pendingPin={pendingPin}
            onPin={handlePreviewPin}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Comment thread */}
        <div style={{
          flex: 1,
          minWidth: 0,
          display: "flex",
          flexDirection: "column",
          overflow: "hidden",
        }}>
          <AplusCommentThread
            productId={productId}
            pendingPin={pendingPin}
            onPinClear={handlePinClear}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Default export with Suspense for useSearchParams ─────────────────

export default function PortalAplusReviewPage() {
  return (
    <Suspense>
      <PortalAplusReviewContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

// ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function fmt(n: number, short = false): string {
  const abs = Math.abs(n);
  const prefix = n < 0 ? "-$" : "$";
  if (short && abs >= 1000) {
    return prefix + abs.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 0 });
  }
  return prefix + abs.toLocaleString("en-US", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
}

function dateLabel(d: string): string {
  return new Date(d + "T00:00:00").toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    year: "numeric",
  });
}

  "Refunded Expenses": "Refunded expenses",
  Base: "Base",
  Tax: "Tax",
  Other: "Other",
  Promo: "Promotions",
};

function friendlyName(key: string): string {
  return FEE_LABELS[key] || key.replace(/([A-Z])/g, " $1").trim();
}

type Tab = "statement" | "statements" | "transactions";

function DateInput({ value, onChange, label }: { value: string; onChange: (iso: string) => void; label: string }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const date = parse(value, "yyyy-MM-dd", new Date());

  return (
    <div>
      <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">{label}</label>
      <Popover open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <PopoverTrigger asChild>
          <button className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-border bg-background px-3 py-1.5 text-sm min-w-[160px] hover:bg-muted/50 transition-colors">
            <CalendarIcon className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
            <span className="font-mono">{format(date, "MM/dd/yyyy")}</span>
          </button>
        </PopoverTrigger>
        <PopoverContent className="w-auto p-0" align="start">
          <Calendar
            mode="single"
            selected={date}
            onSelect={(d) => {
              if (d) {
                onChange(format(d, "yyyy-MM-dd"));
                setOpen(false);
              }
            }}
            defaultMonth={date}
          />
        </PopoverContent>
      </Popover>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Waterfall Component ────────────────────────────────────────────

function WaterfallChart({ statement }: { statement: StatementData["statement"] }) {
  if (!statement) return null;

  const {
    beginningBalance,
    sales,
    refunds,
    expenses,
    accountLevelReserve,
    fundTransfer,
    netProceeds,
    itemDetail,
  } = statement;

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card overflow-hidden">
      {/* Header — Net Proceeds banner (matches Amazon) */}
      <div className="px-6 py-5 border-b border-border/40 bg-muted/20">
        <p className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground mb-1">Net Proceeds</p>
        <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {dateLabel(statement.periodStart)}
            {statement.periodStart !== statement.periodEnd && (
              ` – ${statement.periodEnd === new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) ? "Present (Open)" : dateLabel(statement.periodEnd)}`
            )}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className={`text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight mt-1 font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] ${netProceeds >= 0 ? "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" : "text-red-500"}`}>
          {fmt(netProceeds)}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Sankey flow chart — source labels rendered inside the chart */}
      <div className="p-4">
        <SankeyFlowChart statement={statement} />
      </div>

      {/* Footer — summary items not in the Sankey */}
      <div className="px-6 py-4 border-t border-border/40 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-6">
        {beginningBalance !== 0 && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-sm bg-blue-500" />
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Beginning Balance</span>
            <span className="text-xs font-mono font-semibold tabular-nums text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
              {fmt(beginningBalance)}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
        {accountLevelReserve !== 0 && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-sm bg-slate-400" />
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Account Reserve</span>
            <span className="text-xs font-mono font-semibold tabular-nums text-red-500">
              {fmt(accountLevelReserve)}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
        {fundTransfer !== 0 && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-sm bg-slate-400" />
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Disbursement</span>
            <span className="text-xs font-mono font-semibold tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
              {fmt(fundTransfer)}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Budget Pacing Card ──────────────────────────────────────────

function BudgetPacingCard({ pacing }: { pacing: BudgetPacing }) {
  const progressPct = Math.min((pacing.mtdSpend / pacing.budget) * 100, 100);
  const expectedPct = (pacing.dayOfMonth / pacing.daysInMonth) * 100;

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card p-5">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <span className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
          Ad Spend Pacing
        </span>
        <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg p-2 bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
          <Gauge className="h-4 w-4" />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)]">
        {fmt(pacing.mtdSpend, true)}{" "}
        <span className="text-sm font-normal text-muted-foreground">/ {fmt(pacing.budget, true)}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-3 relative">
        <div className="h-2.5 bg-muted rounded-full overflow-hidden">
          <div
            className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all ${
              pacing.status === "over" ? "bg-red-500" : pacing.status === "on-track" ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-amber-500"
            }`}
            style={{ width: `${progressPct}%` }}
          />
        </div>
        <div
          className="absolute top-0 h-2.5 w-0.5 bg-foreground/30 rounded-full"
          style={{ left: `${expectedPct}%` }}
        />
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-2">
        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Day {pacing.dayOfMonth}/{pacing.daysInMonth}
        </span>
        <span className={`text-xs font-semibold ${
          pacing.status === "over" ? "text-red-500" : pacing.status === "on-track" ? "text-emerald-500" : "text-amber-500"
        }`}>
          {pacing.status === "over" ? "Over budget" : pacing.status === "on-track" ? "On track" : "Under-pacing"}
          {" "}({pacing.pacePercent}%)
        </span>
      </div>
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
        Projected: {fmt(pacing.projectedSpend, true)} by month-end
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Statement View Tab ──────────────────────────────────────────

function StatementView({ clientCode }: { clientCode: string }) {
  const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const thirtyDaysAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState(thirtyDaysAgo);
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState(today);

  const { data, isLoading } = useQuery<StatementData>({
    queryKey: ["portal-finance-statement", clientCode, startDate, endDate],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const params = new URLSearchParams({
        client: clientCode,
        view: "statement",
        periodStart: startDate,
        periodEnd: endDate,
      });
      const res = await fetch(`/api/portal/finance?${params}`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load");
      return res.json();
    },
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  const dateControls = (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-4">
      <DateInput label="From" value={startDate} onChange={setStartDate} />
      <DateInput label="To" value={endDate} onChange={setEndDate} />
    </div>
  );

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        {dateControls}
        <div className="h-[300px] rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card animate-pulse" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!data?.statement) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        {dateControls}
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card p-12 text-center">
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">{data?.error || "No financial data available for this date range."}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-end gap-4">
        {dateControls}

        {data.budgetPacing && (
          <div className="flex-1 max-w-sm ml-auto">
            <BudgetPacingCard pacing={data.budgetPacing} />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <WaterfallChart statement={data.statement} />
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Sankey Flow Chart (Amazon-style: 3 sources → sub-category breakdowns) ──

// Map for right-side labels
const SANKEY_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  OurPricePrincipal: "Product charges", OurPriceTax: "Tax collected",
  "MarketplaceFacilitatorTax-Principal": "Marketplace tax",
  ShippingPrincipal: "Shipping", Commission: "Referral fees",
  FBAPerUnitFulfillmentFee: "FBA fulfillment fees",
  PoAPerUnitFulfillmentFee: "FBA fulfillment fees",
  "Po A Per Unit Fulfillment Fee": "FBA fulfillment fees",
  FBAStorageFee: "FBA storage fees",
  StorageBillingFee: "Storage fees", AWDStorageFees: "AWD storage",
  LongTermStorageFee: "Long-term storage",
  InboundTransportationFee: "Inbound shipping",
  FBAInboundTransportationFee: "Inbound shipping",
  AmazonUpstreamStorageTransportationFee: "Upstream transport",
  SubscriptionFee: "Subscription", Subscription: "Subscription",
  AdvertisingFee: "Cost of Advertising", PromoRebates: "Promo rebates",
  ShippingChargeback: "Shipping chargeback", ShippingDiscount: "Shipping discount",
  FBAInventoryReimbursement: "Inventory reimbursements",
  FBAReversedReimbursement: "Reversed reimbursements",
  "Refunded Sales": "Refunded sales", "Refunded Expenses": "Refunded expenses",
  "Our Price Discount": "Our Price Discount", "P O A Service Fee": "POA Service Fee",
  FBARemovalFee: "Removal fees", RefundCommission: "Refund commission",
  RestockingDeductionPrincipal: "Restocking deduction",
  RestockingDeductionTax: "Restocking tax",
  COMPENSATED_CLAWBACK: "Compensated clawback",
  FBAPerOrderFulfillmentFee: "FBA order fees",
  VariableClosingFee: "Variable closing fee",
  GiftWrap: "Gift wrap",
  PromotionalRebates: "Promo rebates",
  ProductCharges: "Product charges",
  ProductChargesTax: "Tax collected",
  ShippingCharges: "Shipping",
  RefundProductCharges: "Refund product charges",
  RefundShippingCharges: "Refund shipping",
};

function sankeyLabel(key: string): string {
  return SANKEY_LABELS[key] || key
    .replace(/([A-Z]+)([A-Z][a-z])/g, "$1 $2")
    .replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g, "$1 $2")
    .trim();
}

// Classify item detail keys into Sales (positive), Refunds, or Expenses
const SALES_KEYS = new Set([
  "OurPricePrincipal", "OurPriceTax", "MarketplaceFacilitatorTax-Principal",
  "ShippingPrincipal", "FBAInventoryReimbursement",
]);
const REFUND_KEYS = new Set([
  "Refunded Sales", "Refunded Expenses", "RefundCommission",
  "RestockingDeductionPrincipal", "RestockingDeductionTax",
]);
// Everything else negative → Expenses

function SankeyFlowChart({ statement }: { statement: NonNullable<StatementData["statement"]> }) {
  const { sales, refunds, expenses, itemDetail } = statement;

  // Classify items into 3 buckets
  const MAX_PER_GROUP = 5;
  const salesItems: [string, number][] = [];
  const refundItems: [string, number][] = [];
  const expenseItems: [string, number][] = [];

  for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(itemDetail)) {
    if (Math.abs(val) < 1 || ["Base", "Tax"].includes(key)) continue;
    if (SALES_KEYS.has(key) || (val > 0 && !REFUND_KEYS.has(key))) {
      salesItems.push([key, val]);
    } else if (REFUND_KEYS.has(key)) {
      refundItems.push([key, Math.abs(val)]);
    } else {
      expenseItems.push([key, Math.abs(val)]);
    }
  }

  // Sort each by value desc
  salesItems.sort(([, a], [, b]) => b - a);
  refundItems.sort(([, a], [, b]) => b - a);
  expenseItems.sort(([, a], [, b]) => b - a);

  // Need at least Sales and one other group
  if (salesItems.length < 1 || (refundItems.length < 1 && expenseItems.length < 1)) return null;

  // Cap items per group with "Other" rollup
  const capGroup = (items: [string, number][], otherLabel: string) => {
    const top = items.slice(0, MAX_PER_GROUP);
    const rest = items.slice(MAX_PER_GROUP).reduce((s, [, v]) => s + v, 0);
    if (rest > 1) top.push([otherLabel, rest]);
    return top;
  };

  const cappedSales = capGroup(salesItems, "Other income");
  const cappedRefunds = capGroup(refundItems, "Other refunds");
  const cappedExpenses = capGroup(expenseItems, "Other fees");

  // Build Sankey: 3 sources (Sales, Refunds, Expenses) → sub-categories
  const TEAL = "#10b981";   // emerald-500 — matches Sales dot
  const SALMON = "#f59e0b"; // amber-500 — matches Refunds dot
  const RED = "#ef4444";    // red-500 — matches Expenses dot

  const sourceNames = new Set(["Sales", "Refunds", "Expenses"]);
  const nodes: { name: string }[] = [];
  const links: { source: number; target: number; value: number }[] = [];
  const nodeColorMap: string[] = [];

  // Source nodes
  nodes.push({ name: "Sales" }); nodeColorMap.push(TEAL);
  const hasRefunds = cappedRefunds.length > 0;
  const hasExpenses = cappedExpenses.length > 0;
  if (hasRefunds) { nodes.push({ name: "Refunds" }); nodeColorMap.push(SALMON); }
  if (hasExpenses) { nodes.push({ name: "Expenses" }); nodeColorMap.push(RED); }

  const salesIdx = 0;
  const refundsIdx = hasRefunds ? 1 : -1;
  const expensesIdx = hasRefunds && hasExpenses ? 2 : hasExpenses ? 1 : -1;

  // Add target nodes for each group
  for (const [key, value] of cappedSales) {
    const idx = nodes.length;
    nodes.push({ name: sankeyLabel(key) });
    nodeColorMap.push(TEAL);
    links.push({ source: salesIdx, target: idx, value });
  }
  for (const [key, value] of cappedRefunds) {
    const idx = nodes.length;
    nodes.push({ name: sankeyLabel(key) });
    nodeColorMap.push(SALMON);
    links.push({ source: refundsIdx, target: idx, value });
  }
  for (const [key, value] of cappedExpenses) {
    const idx = nodes.length;
    nodes.push({ name: sankeyLabel(key) });
    nodeColorMap.push(RED);
    links.push({ source: expensesIdx, target: idx, value });
  }

  // Remove near-zero links and their orphaned target nodes
  const validLinks = links.filter((l) => l.value >= 1);
  if (validLinks.length < 2) return null;

  // Rebuild nodes to remove orphaned targets
  const usedIndices = new Set<number>();
  for (const l of validLinks) { usedIndices.add(l.source); usedIndices.add(l.target); }
  const indexMap = new Map<number, number>();
  const filteredNodes: { name: string }[] = [];
  const filteredColors: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) {
    if (usedIndices.has(i)) {
      indexMap.set(i, filteredNodes.length);
      filteredNodes.push(nodes[i]);
      filteredColors.push(nodeColorMap[i]);
    }
  }
  const remappedLinks = validLinks.map((l) => ({
    source: indexMap.get(l.source)!,
    target: indexMap.get(l.target)!,
    value: l.value,
  }));

  // Replace mutable arrays for renderNode closure
  nodeColorMap.length = 0;
  nodeColorMap.push(...filteredColors);

  const data = { nodes: filteredNodes, links: remappedLinks };

  const renderNode = useCallback(
    (props: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number; index: number; payload: { name: string; value: number } }) => {
      const { x, y, width, height, index, payload } = props;
      const isSource = sourceNames.has(payload.name);
      const color = nodeColorMap[index] || "#94a3b8";
      const h = Math.max(height, 2);
      // Show signed values: positive for sales items, negative for refund/expense items
      const isNegative = color === RED || color === SALMON;
      const displayVal = isSource
        ? (payload.name === "Sales" ? fmt(sales) : payload.name === "Refunds" ? fmt(refunds) : fmt(expenses))
        : fmt(isNegative ? -payload.value : payload.value);
      const valColor = isNegative ? RED : TEAL;
      return (
        <g>
          <rect x={x} y={y} width={width} height={h} fill={color} rx={2} opacity={0.85} />
          {isSource ? (
            /* Left side: source label + value, anchored to the left of the bar */
            <>
              <text
                x={x - 8} y={y + h / 2 - 7}
                textAnchor="end" dominantBaseline="central"
                className="fill-foreground"
                style={{ fontSize: 11, fontWeight: 600 }}
              >
                {payload.name}
              </text>
              <text
                x={x - 8} y={y + h / 2 + 8}
                textAnchor="end" dominantBaseline="central"
                style={{ fontSize: 10, fontFamily: "var(--font-geist-mono, monospace)", fontWeight: 600, fill: valColor }}
              >
                {displayVal}
              </text>
            </>
          ) : (
            /* Right side: label left-aligned, value right-aligned at fixed column */
            <>
              <text
                x={x + width + 6} y={y + h / 2}
                textAnchor="start" dominantBaseline="central"
                className="fill-foreground"
                style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 500 }}
              >
                {payload.name.length > 24 ? payload.name.slice(0, 22) + "…" : payload.name}
              </text>
              <text
                x={x + width + 250} y={y + h / 2}
                textAnchor="end" dominantBaseline="central"
                style={{ fontSize: 10, fontFamily: "var(--font-geist-mono, monospace)", fontWeight: 600, fill: valColor }}
              >
                {displayVal}
              </text>
            </>
          )}
        </g>
      );
    },
    [sales, refunds, expenses, nodeColorMap],
  );

  const renderLink = useCallback(
    (props: {
      sourceX: number; targetX: number; sourceY: number; targetY: number;
      sourceControlX: number; targetControlX: number; linkWidth: number;
      payload: { source: { name: string }; target: { name: string } };
    }) => {
      const { sourceX, targetX, sourceY, targetY, sourceControlX, targetControlX, linkWidth, payload } = props;
      const color = payload.source.name === "Sales" ? TEAL : payload.source.name === "Refunds" ? SALMON : RED;
      return (
        <path
          d={`M${sourceX},${sourceY + linkWidth / 2} C${sourceControlX},${sourceY + linkWidth / 2} ${targetControlX},${targetY + linkWidth / 2} ${targetX},${targetY + linkWidth / 2} L${targetX},${targetY - linkWidth / 2} C${targetControlX},${targetY - linkWidth / 2} ${sourceControlX},${sourceY - linkWidth / 2} ${sourceX},${sourceY - linkWidth / 2} Z`}
          fill={color}
          opacity={0.2}
          strokeWidth={0}
        />
      );
    },
    [],
  );

  const sourceCount = [salesIdx, refundsIdx, expensesIdx].filter((i) => usedIndices.has(i)).length;
  const rightCount = filteredNodes.length - sourceCount;

  const chartHeight = Math.max(300, rightCount * 36 + 80);

  return (
    <div className="w-full" style={{ height: chartHeight }}>
      <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
          <Sankey
            data={data}
            nodeWidth={8}
            nodePadding={14}
            margin={{ left: 120, right: 280, top: 10, bottom: 10 }}
            link={renderLink as any}
            node={renderNode as any}
          >
            <Tooltip
              content={({ payload }: any) => {
                if (!payload?.length) return null;
                const item = payload[0]?.payload;
                if (!item) return null;
                const name = item.source?.name && item.target?.name
                  ? `${item.source.name} → ${item.target.name}`
                  : item.name || "";
                return (
                  <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-popover px-3 py-2 text-xs shadow-md">
                    <p className="font-medium">{name}</p>
                    <p className="font-mono text-muted-foreground">{fmt(item.value)}</p>
                  </div>
                );
              }}
            />
          </Sankey>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── All Statements Tab ──────────────────────────────────────────

function AllStatementsView({ clientCode, onViewPeriod }: { clientCode: string; onViewPeriod: (start: string, end: string) => void }) {
  const [months, setMonths] = useState(6);
  const [expandedPeriod, setExpandedPeriod] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const { data, isLoading } = useQuery<StatementsData>({
    queryKey: ["portal-finance-statements", clientCode, months],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const params = new URLSearchParams({ client: clientCode, view: "statements", months: String(months) });
      const res = await fetch(`/api/portal/finance?${params}`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load");
      return res.json();
    },
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  if (isLoading) {
    return <div className="h-[400px] rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card animate-pulse" />;
  }

  const statements = data?.statements || [];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Settlement periods from Seller Central financial transactions.
        </p>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          {[3, 6, 12].map((m) => (
            <button
              key={m}
              onClick={() => setMonths(m)}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
                months === m
                  ? "bg-[#2563eb] text-white"
                  : "bg-muted/60 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
              }`}
            >
              {m}M
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card overflow-hidden">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-border/40 bg-muted/30">
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-left text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Settlement Period
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Sales
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Refunds
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Expenses
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Advertising
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Other
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Net Proceeds
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider w-28">
                </th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {statements.map((s) => {
                const key = `${s.periodStart}_${s.periodEnd}`;
                const isExpanded = expandedPeriod === key;
                const significantBreakdown = Object.entries(s.breakdown)
                  .filter(([k, v]) => Math.abs(v) > 0.5 && !["Base"].includes(k))
                  .sort(([, a], [, b]) => a - b);

                return (
                  <React.Fragment key={key}>
                    <tr
                      className="group cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors border-b border-border/30"
                      onClick={() => setExpandedPeriod(isExpanded ? null : key)}
                    >
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-sm font-medium">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          {isExpanded ? (
                            <ChevronDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
                          ) : (
                            <ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
                          )}
                          <span>
                            {dateLabel(s.periodStart)}
                            {s.periodStart !== s.periodEnd && (
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground"> – {dateLabel(s.periodEnd)}</span>
                            )}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-sm text-right text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-medium">
                        {fmt(s.sales, true)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-sm text-right text-amber-500 font-medium">
                        {fmt(s.refunds, true)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-sm text-right text-red-500 font-medium">
                        {fmt(s.expenses, true)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-sm text-right text-orange-500 font-medium">
                        {fmt(s.advertising, true)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-sm text-right text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                        {fmt(s.other, true)}
                      </td>
                      <td className={`py-3 px-4 text-sm text-right font-bold ${
                        s.netProceeds >= 0 ? "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" : "text-red-500"
                      }`}>
                        {fmt(s.netProceeds, true)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right">
                        <button
                          onClick={(e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            onViewPeriod(s.periodStart, s.periodEnd);
                          }}
                          className="text-xs text-[#2563eb] hover:underline font-medium"
                        >
                          View transactions
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                    {isExpanded && significantBreakdown.length > 0 && (
                      <tr className="border-b border-border/20">
                        <td colSpan={8} className="bg-muted/15 px-10 py-3">
                          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-x-6 gap-y-1.5">
                            {significantBreakdown.map(([bKey, value]) => (
                              <div key={bKey} className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs gap-2">
                                <span className="text-muted-foreground truncate">{friendlyName(bKey)}</span>
                                <span className={`font-mono font-medium tabular-nums shrink-0 ${value < 0 ? "text-red-500" : "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"}`}>
                                  {fmt(value)}
                                </span>
                              </div>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    )}
                  </React.Fragment>
                );
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        {statements.length === 0 && (
          <div className="p-12 text-center">
            <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">No statements found for this period.</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Transaction View Tab ────────────────────────────────────────

function TransactionView({
  clientCode,
  periodStart,
  periodEnd,
}: {
  clientCode: string;
  periodStart: string;
  periodEnd: string;
}) {
  const { data, isLoading } = useQuery<TransactionsData>({
    queryKey: ["portal-finance-transactions", clientCode, periodStart, periodEnd],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const params = new URLSearchParams({
        client: clientCode,
        view: "transactions",
        periodStart,
        periodEnd,
      });
      const res = await fetch(`/api/portal/finance?${params}`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load");
      return res.json();
    },
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  if (isLoading) {
    return <div className="h-[300px] rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card animate-pulse" />;
  }

  const transactions = data?.transactions || [];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {dateLabel(periodStart)}
          {periodStart !== periodEnd && ` – ${dateLabel(periodEnd)}`}
          {" "}&mdash; {transactions.length} transactions
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card overflow-hidden">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-border/40 bg-muted/30">
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-left text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Date
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-left text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  SKU
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Qty
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Product Charges
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Promo Rebates
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Amazon Fees
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Other
                </th>
                <th className="py-2.5 px-4 text-right text-[10px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Total
                </th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {transactions.map((txn) => (
                <tr key={txn.transactionId} className="border-b border-border/20 hover:bg-muted/20 transition-colors" title={txn.transactionId}>
                  <td className="py-2.5 px-4 text-xs text-muted-foreground whitespace-nowrap">
                    {txn.postedDate ? dateLabel(txn.postedDate) : "—"}
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 px-4 text-xs font-mono text-foreground max-w-[200px] truncate" title={txn.sku}>
                    {txn.sku || "—"}
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 px-4 text-xs text-right font-mono tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
                    {txn.quantity || "—"}
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 px-4 text-xs text-right font-mono tabular-nums">
                    <span className={txn.productCharges >= 0 ? "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" : "text-red-500"}>
                      {fmt(txn.productCharges)}
                    </span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 px-4 text-xs text-right font-mono tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
                    {txn.promoRebates !== 0 ? fmt(txn.promoRebates) : "$0.00"}
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 px-4 text-xs text-right font-mono tabular-nums text-red-500">
                    {fmt(txn.amazonFees)}
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-2.5 px-4 text-xs text-right font-mono tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
                    {txn.other !== 0 ? fmt(txn.other) : "$0.00"}
                  </td>
                  <td className={`py-2.5 px-4 text-xs text-right font-mono font-semibold tabular-nums ${txn.total >= 0 ? "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" : "text-red-500"}`}>
                    {fmt(txn.total)}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
            {transactions.length > 0 && (
              <tfoot>
                <tr className="border-t-2 border-border bg-muted/20">
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 text-xs font-bold" colSpan={3}>
                    Total ({transactions.length})
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 text-xs text-right font-mono font-bold tabular-nums text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                    {fmt(transactions.reduce((s, t) => s + t.productCharges, 0))}
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 text-xs text-right font-mono font-bold tabular-nums">
                    {fmt(transactions.reduce((s, t) => s + t.promoRebates, 0))}
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 text-xs text-right font-mono font-bold tabular-nums text-red-500">
                    {fmt(transactions.reduce((s, t) => s + t.amazonFees, 0))}
                  </td>
                  <td className="py-3 px-4 text-xs text-right font-mono font-bold tabular-nums">
                    {fmt(transactions.reduce((s, t) => s + t.other, 0))}
                  </td>
                  <td className={`py-3 px-4 text-xs text-right font-mono font-bold tabular-nums ${
                    transactions.reduce((s, t) => s + t.total, 0) >= 0 ? "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" : "text-red-500"
                  }`}>
                    {fmt(transactions.reduce((s, t) => s + t.total, 0))}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              </tfoot>
            )}
          </table>
        </div>

        {transactions.length === 0 && (
          <div className="p-12 text-center">
            <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">No transactions found for this period.</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Main Finance Page ───────────────────────────────────────────

function FinanceContent() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<Tab>("statement");
  const [txnPeriod, setTxnPeriod] = useState<{ start: string; end: string } | null>(null);

  const user = session?.user;
  const isAdmin = user?.role === "admin";
  const previewClient = isAdmin ? searchParams.get("client") : null;

  // Parse assigned client codes (comma-separated)
  const assignedCodes = (previewClient || user?.clientIdCode || "")
    .split(",")
    .map((s) => s.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);

  const [selectedClient, setSelectedClient] = useState<string>("");
  const clientCode = selectedClient || assignedCodes[0] || "";
  const clientName = clientCode ? CLIENT_NAMES[clientCode] || clientCode : "";

  function handleClientChange(code: string) {
    setSelectedClient(code);
    setActiveTab("statement");
    setTxnPeriod(null);
  }

  function handleViewPeriod(start: string, end: string) {
    setTxnPeriod({ start, end });
    setActiveTab("transactions");
  }

  const tabs: { id: Tab; label: string; icon: React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }> }[] = [
    { id: "statement", label: "Statement View", icon: FileText },
    { id: "statements", label: "All Statements", icon: List },
    { id: "transactions", label: "Transaction View", icon: Receipt },
  ];

  if (assignedCodes.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card p-12 text-center">
        <p className="text-muted-foreground">No client accounts assigned. Contact your account manager for access.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10 py-4 bg-background">
        <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter mb-2">
          <span className="text-foreground font-bold">Finance</span>
          <span className="text-[#2563eb]">Reports</span>
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {clientName} &mdash; Amazon Seller Central financial transactions
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Client selector (only if multiple clients assigned) */}
      {assignedCodes.length > 1 && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg p-2 bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
            <Users className="h-4 w-4" />
          </div>
          <select
            value={clientCode}
            onChange={(e) => handleClientChange(e.target.value)}
            className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm min-w-[250px]"
          >
            {assignedCodes.map((code) => (
              <option key={code} value={code}>
                {CLIENT_NAMES[code] || code} ({code})
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 border-b border-border/40 -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10">
        {tabs.map((tab) => (
          <button
            key={tab.id}
            onClick={() => setActiveTab(tab.id)}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium border-b-2 transition-colors ${
              activeTab === tab.id
                ? "border-[#2563eb] text-[#2563eb]"
                : "border-transparent text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:border-border"
            }`}
          >
            <tab.icon className="h-4 w-4" />
            {tab.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Tab Content */}
      {activeTab === "statement" && <StatementView clientCode={clientCode} />}
      {activeTab === "statements" && (
        <AllStatementsView clientCode={clientCode} onViewPeriod={handleViewPeriod} />
      )}
      {activeTab === "transactions" && txnPeriod && (
        <TransactionView
          clientCode={clientCode}
          periodStart={txnPeriod.start}
          periodEnd={txnPeriod.end}
        />
      )}
      {activeTab === "transactions" && !txnPeriod && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card p-12 text-center">
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">
            Select a period from{" "}
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab("statements")}
              className="text-[#2563eb] hover:underline font-medium"
            >
              All Statements
            </button>
            {" "}to view individual transactions.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function FinancePage() {
  return (
    <Suspense>
      <FinanceContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

FILE: src/app/portal/products/page.tsx

"use client";

import { useState, useRef, useCallback, Suspense } from "react";
import { useSession } from "next-auth/react";
import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import Link from "next/link";
import {
  Package,
  Search,
  ArrowLeft,
  X,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  ArrowUpDown,
  PackageOpen,
  Plus,
  ExternalLink,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { CLIENT_NAMES } from "@/lib/constants";
import { SubmitProductDialog } from "./submit-product-dialog";

// ── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type Product = {
  id: string;
  asin: string | null;
  sku: string | null;
  status: string | null;
  itemName: string | null;
  summarizedTitle: string | null;
  variationId: string | null;
  variationGroup: string | null;
  variations: Record<string, string | undefined> | null;
  parentageLevel: string | null;
  parentAsin: string | null;
  mainImageUrl: string | null;
  listPrice: string | null;
  varietyPackItemCount: number;
  vpFlavors: string[] | null;
  isPortalSubmission: boolean;
};

type ApiResponse = {
  products: Product[];
  total: number;
};

// ── Status styles (matching hub) ──────────────────────────────────

const STATUS_STYLES: Record<string, string> = {
  active: "bg-status-active/15 text-status-active border-status-active/30",
  inactive: "bg-status-inactive/15 text-status-inactive border-status-inactive/30",
  closed: "bg-status-closed/15 text-status-closed border-status-closed/30",
  discontinued: "bg-status-discontinued/15 text-status-discontinued border-status-discontinued/30",
  incomplete: "bg-status-incomplete/15 text-status-incomplete border-status-incomplete/30",
  "out of stock": "bg-status-oos/15 text-status-oos border-status-oos/30",
};

function StatusBadge({ status }: { status: string }) {
  const style = STATUS_STYLES[status.toLowerCase()] ?? "bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border";
  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-1.5 py-0 text-[10px] font-medium whitespace-nowrap ${style}`}>
      {status}
    </span>
  );
}

// ── Status filter chips (matching hub colors) ─────────────────────

const STATUS_CHIP_COLORS: Record<string, { on: string; off: string }> = {
  Active: { on: "bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30", off: "bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-transparent" },
  Closed: { on: "bg-red-500/15 text-red-400 border-red-500/30", off: "bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-transparent" },
  Discontinued: { on: "bg-orange-500/15 text-orange-400 border-orange-500/30", off: "bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-transparent" },
  Inactive: { on: "bg-muted text-foreground/80 border-border", off: "bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-transparent" },
  Incomplete: { on: "bg-yellow-500/15 text-yellow-400 border-brand/30", off: "bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-transparent" },
  "Out of Stock": { on: "bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 border-purple-300", off: "bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-transparent" },
};

const ALL_STATUSES = ["Active", "Closed", "Discontinued", "Inactive", "Incomplete", "Out of Stock"];

// ── Content ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function PortalProductsContent() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [statuses, setStatuses] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set(["Active"]));
  const [submitOpen, setSubmitOpen] = useState(false);
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState("asin");
  const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<"asc" | "desc">("asc");
  const pageSize = 50;

  const isAdmin = session?.user?.role === "admin";
  const previewClient = isAdmin ? searchParams.get("client") : null;
  const clientCode = previewClient || session?.user?.clientIdCode;
  const clientParam = previewClient ? `?client=${previewClient}` : "";

  // Debounced search
  const [debouncedSearch, setDebouncedSearch] = useState("");
  const timerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>(undefined);
  const handleSearch = useCallback((val: string) => {
    clearTimeout(timerRef.current);
    timerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setDebouncedSearch(val);
      setPage(1);
    }, 300);
  }, []);

  const statusParam = [...statuses].join(",");

  const { data, isLoading, isError } = useQuery<ApiResponse>({
    queryKey: ["portal-products", clientCode, debouncedSearch, statusParam, sortBy, sortOrder, page],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();
      if (clientCode) params.set("client", clientCode);
      if (debouncedSearch) params.set("search", debouncedSearch);
      if (statusParam) params.set("status", statusParam);
      params.set("sortBy", sortBy);
      params.set("sortOrder", sortOrder);
      params.set("page", String(page));
      params.set("pageSize", String(pageSize));
      const res = await fetch(`/api/portal/products?${params}`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch products");
      return res.json();
    },
    enabled: !!clientCode,
    staleTime: 2 * 60_000,
  });

  const products = data?.products ?? [];
  const total = data?.total ?? 0;
  const totalPages = Math.ceil(total / pageSize);

  const toggleSort = (col: string) => {
    if (sortBy === col) {
      setSortOrder((o) => (o === "asc" ? "desc" : "asc"));
    } else {
      setSortBy(col);
      setSortOrder("asc");
    }
    setPage(1);
  };

  const toggleStatus = (status: string) => {
    setStatuses((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(status)) next.delete(status);
      else next.add(status);
      return next;
    });
    setPage(1);
  };

  if (!clientCode && !isAdmin) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-24 text-center gap-4">
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No client assigned to your account yet.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <SubmitProductDialog
        open={submitOpen}
        onOpenChange={setSubmitOpen}
        clientParam={previewClient ? `client=${previewClient}` : undefined}
        onSubmitted={() => {
          setStatuses((prev) => new Set([...prev, "Incomplete"]));
          setPage(1);
        }}
      />

      {/* Header */}
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10 py-4 bg-background">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-1">
          <Link
            href={`/portal${clientParam}`}
            className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
          </Link>
          <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter">
            <span className="text-foreground font-bold">Product</span>
            <span className="text-[#2563eb]">Catalog</span>
          </h1>
          <div className="flex-1" />
          {session?.user?.role !== "prospect" && (
            <Button
              size="sm"
              className="bg-brand text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover"
              onClick={() => setSubmitOpen(true)}
            >
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" />
              Submit Product
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground ml-7">
          Your product catalog &mdash; {total.toLocaleString()} product{total !== 1 ? "s" : ""}.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Toolbar: Search + Status filters */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center gap-3">
        <div className="max-w-sm relative flex-1">
          <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground/60 pointer-events-none" />
          <Input
            placeholder="Search ASIN, SKU, brand, title..."
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => {
              setSearchQuery(e.target.value);
              handleSearch(e.target.value);
            }}
            className="pl-8 h-9 text-sm"
          />
          {searchQuery && (
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setSearchQuery("");
                setDebouncedSearch("");
                setPage(1);
              }}
              className="absolute right-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground/60 hover:text-muted-foreground"
            >
              <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mr-1">Status:</span>
          {ALL_STATUSES.map((s) => {
            const isOn = statuses.has(s);
            const colors = STATUS_CHIP_COLORS[s] || STATUS_CHIP_COLORS.Active;
            return (
              <button
                key={s}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => toggleStatus(s)}
                className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors cursor-pointer select-none ${isOn ? colors.on : colors.off}`}
              >
                {s}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Table */}
      {isLoading ? (
        <Skeleton className="h-[400px] w-full rounded-xl" />
      ) : isError ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-24 text-center">
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Failed to load products. Please try again.</p>
        </div>
      ) : products.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-24 text-center gap-4">
          <div className="rounded-full bg-muted/40 p-6">
            <Package className="h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground/50" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
              {debouncedSearch || statuses.size > 0
                ? "No products matching your filters"
                : "No products in your catalog yet"}
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/70 mt-1">
              {debouncedSearch
                ? "Try a different search term or adjust status filters."
                : "Products will appear here once they are added to the system."}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-xs">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-stone-100 dark:border-zinc-800 text-left">
                  <th className="px-3 py-2.5 font-bold text-brand whitespace-nowrap" style={{ width: "100px" }}>
                    <SortButton col="asin" label="ASIN" current={sortBy} order={sortOrder} onToggle={toggleSort} />
                  </th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2.5 font-bold text-brand whitespace-nowrap" style={{ width: "130px" }}>
                    <SortButton col="sku" label="SKU" current={sortBy} order={sortOrder} onToggle={toggleSort} />
                  </th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2.5 font-bold text-brand whitespace-nowrap" style={{ width: "80px" }}>Status</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2.5 font-bold text-brand whitespace-nowrap" style={{ width: "280px", maxWidth: "280px" }}>Title</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2.5 font-bold text-brand whitespace-nowrap" style={{ width: "90px" }}>
                    <SortButton col="variationId" label="Var ID" current={sortBy} order={sortOrder} onToggle={toggleSort} />
                  </th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2.5 font-bold text-brand whitespace-nowrap" style={{ width: "100px" }}>Group</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2.5 font-bold text-brand whitespace-nowrap" style={{ width: "80px" }}>Theme</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2.5 font-bold text-brand whitespace-nowrap" style={{ width: "40px" }}><span title="Variety Pack">VP</span></th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2.5 font-bold text-brand whitespace-nowrap" style={{ width: "120px" }}>Flavor</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2.5 font-bold text-brand whitespace-nowrap" style={{ width: "80px" }}>Size</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-2.5 font-bold text-brand whitespace-nowrap" style={{ width: "70px" }}>Parentage</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {/* Client group header */}
                {products.length > 0 && (
                  <tr className="border-b border-stone-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
                    <td colSpan={11} className="px-3 py-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-brand">
                          {CLIENT_NAMES[clientCode || ""] || clientCode || "Products"}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{clientCode}</span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">({total})</span>
                        <div className="flex-1 h-px bg-border" />
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                )}
                {products.map((p) => (
                  <tr
                    key={p.id}
                    className={cn(
                      "border-b transition-colors",
                      p.isPortalSubmission
                        ? "border-l-2 border-l-yellow-400 bg-yellow-500/[0.03] border-b-yellow-100 dark:border-b-yellow-900/20 hover:bg-yellow-500/[0.06]"
                        : "border-stone-50 dark:border-zinc-800/50 hover:bg-stone-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50",
                    )}
                  >
                        <td className="px-3 py-2" style={{ width: "100px" }}>
                          {p.isPortalSubmission && !p.asin ? (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-semibold bg-yellow-500/15 text-yellow-600 dark:text-yellow-400 border border-yellow-500/30 whitespace-nowrap">
                              Pending Review
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="font-mono font-bold text-xs text-brand whitespace-nowrap inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                              {p.asin || "—"}
                              {p.asin && (
                                <a
                                  href={`https://www.amazon.com/dp/${p.asin}`}
                                  target="_blank"
                                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                                  className="text-muted-foreground/50 hover:text-brand transition-colors"
                                  title="View on Amazon"
                                  onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                                >
                                  <ExternalLink className="h-3 w-3" />
                                </a>
                              )}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2" style={{ width: "130px" }}>
                          <span className="font-mono text-xs truncate block text-foreground">{p.sku || "—"}</span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2" style={{ width: "80px" }}>
                          {p.status ? <StatusBadge status={p.status} /> : "—"}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2" style={{ width: "280px", maxWidth: "280px" }}>
                          <span className="text-xs text-foreground line-clamp-3 break-words">
                            {p.itemName || p.summarizedTitle || "—"}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2" style={{ width: "90px" }}>
                          <span className="font-mono text-xs truncate block text-foreground">{p.variationId || "—"}</span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2" style={{ width: "100px" }}>
                          <span className={cn("text-xs font-mono", p.variationGroup ? "text-brand-group" : "text-foreground")}>
                            {p.variationGroup || "—"}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2" style={{ width: "80px" }}>
                          <span className="font-mono text-xs truncate block text-foreground">
                            {p.variations?.VariationThemeName || "—"}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2" style={{ width: "40px" }}>
                          {(p.varietyPackItemCount ?? 0) > 0 ? (
                            <span
                              className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-[8px] font-bold bg-brand-vp/15 text-brand-vp border border-brand-vp/30"
                              title={`${p.varietyPackItemCount} pack items`}
                            >
                              <PackageOpen className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
                            </span>
                          ) : null}
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2" style={{ width: "120px" }}>
                          <FlavorCell product={p} />
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2" style={{ width: "80px" }}>
                          <span className="text-xs text-foreground">{p.variations?.Size || "—"}</span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2" style={{ width: "70px" }}>
                          <span className="font-mono text-xs text-foreground">{p.parentageLevel || "—"}</span>
                        </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>

          {/* Pagination */}
          {totalPages > 1 && (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2">
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Page {page} of {totalPages} &mdash; {total.toLocaleString()} product{total !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
              </p>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  disabled={page <= 1}
                  onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1))}
                >
                  <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
                </Button>
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  disabled={page >= totalPages}
                  onClick={() => setPage((p) => Math.min(totalPages, p + 1))}
                >
                  <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Sort button ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

function SortButton({
  col,
  label,
  current,
  order,
  onToggle,
}: {
  col: string;
  label: string;
  current: string;
  order: "asc" | "desc";
  onToggle: (col: string) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="-ml-3 h-8" onClick={() => onToggle(col)}>
      {label}
      <ArrowUpDown className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
    </Button>
  );
}

// ── Flavor cell (VP multi-flavor or single) ───────────────────────

function FlavorCell({ product }: { product: Product }) {
  const isVP = (product.varietyPackItemCount ?? 0) > 0;
  const vpFlavors = product.vpFlavors;

  if (isVP && vpFlavors?.length) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
        {vpFlavors.map((f, i) => (
          <span key={i} className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] bg-brand-vp/10 text-brand-vp whitespace-nowrap">
            {f}
          </span>
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <span className="text-xs text-foreground">
      {product.variations?.Flavor || "—"}
    </span>
  );
}

export default function PortalProducts() {
  return (
    <Suspense>
      <PortalProductsContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

FILE: src/app/portal/products/submit-product-dialog.tsx
================================================
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";

interface SubmitProductDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  clientParam?: string;
  onSubmitted?: () => void;
}

export function SubmitProductDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  clientParam,
  onSubmitted,
}: SubmitProductDialogProps) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [sku, setSku] = useState("");
  const [upc, setUpc] = useState("");
  const [flavor, setFlavor] = useState("");
  const [size, setSize] = useState("");
  const [ingredients, setIngredients] = useState("");
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");

  const mutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      const params = clientParam ? `?${clientParam}` : "";
      const res = await fetch(`/api/portal/products${params}`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          title: title.trim(),
          sku: sku.trim(),
          upc: upc.trim() || undefined,
          flavor: flavor.trim() || undefined,
          size: size.trim() || undefined,
          ingredients: ingredients.trim() || undefined,
          notes: notes.trim() || undefined,
        }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Failed to submit product");
      }
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success("Product submitted! Our team will review it shortly.");
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["portal-products"] });
      resetState();
      onOpenChange(false);
      onSubmitted?.();
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => {
      toast.error(error.message);
    },
  });

  function resetState() {
    setTitle("");
    setSku("");
    setUpc("");
    setFlavor("");
    setSize("");
    setIngredients("");
    setNotes("");
  }

  function handleOpenChange(open: boolean) {
    if (!open) resetState();
    onOpenChange(open);
  }

  const canSubmit = title.trim() && sku.trim() && !mutation.isPending;

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-md max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Submit New Product</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Enter your product details. Our team will review and complete the
            listing.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="text-sm font-medium">
              Product Title <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
            </label>
            <Input
              placeholder="e.g. Organic Green Tea 16oz"
              value={title}
              onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="text-sm font-medium">
              SKU <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
            </label>
            <Input
              placeholder="e.g. OGT-16OZ-001"
              value={sku}
              onChange={(e) => setSku(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="text-sm font-medium">UPC / EAN</label>
            <Input
              placeholder="e.g. 012345678901"
              value={upc}
              onChange={(e) => setUpc(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="text-sm font-medium">Flavor / Color / Style</label>
              <Input
                placeholder="e.g. Mint"
                value={flavor}
                onChange={(e) => setFlavor(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="text-sm font-medium">Size</label>
              <Input
                placeholder="e.g. 16 oz"
                value={size}
                onChange={(e) => setSize(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="text-sm font-medium">Ingredients</label>
            <Textarea
              placeholder="List key ingredients..."
              value={ingredients}
              onChange={(e) => setIngredients(e.target.value)}
              rows={3}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="text-sm font-medium">Notes to Team</label>
            <Textarea
              placeholder="Anything else we should know..."
              value={notes}
              onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
              rows={2}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => handleOpenChange(false)}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button
            disabled={!canSubmit}
            onClick={() => mutation.mutate()}
            className="bg-brand text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover"
          >
            {mutation.isPending ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-1 animate-spin" />
                Submitting...
              </>
            ) : (
              "Submit Product"
            )}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

FILE: src/app/portal/reports/page.tsx
