"use client";

import { Suspense } from "react";
import { useSession } from "next-auth/react";
import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { BarChart3 } from "lucide-react";

function parseClientCodes(val: string | null | undefined): string[] {
  if (!val) return [];
  return val.split(",").map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
}

function ReportsContent() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const isAdmin = session?.user?.role === "admin";
  const previewClient = isAdmin ? searchParams.get("client") : null;
  const clientCodes = previewClient
    ? [previewClient]
    : parseClientCodes(session?.user?.clientIdCode);

  // Admin without client param
  if (isAdmin && clientCodes.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-8">
        <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter">
          <span className="text-foreground font-bold">Client</span><span className="text-[#2563eb] font-medium">Reports</span>
        </h1>
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 glass-card p-12 text-center">
          <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            Select a client from the sidebar to view their report.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (clientCodes.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-24 text-center gap-4">
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No client assigned to your account yet.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter">
        <span className="text-foreground font-bold">Client</span><span className="text-[#2563eb] font-medium">Reports</span>
      </h1>
      {clientCodes.map((code) => (
        <ReportsForClient key={code} clientCode={code} previewClient={previewClient} showClientHeader={clientCodes.length > 1} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function ReportsForClient({ clientCode, previewClient, showClientHeader }: { clientCode: string; previewClient: string | null; showClientHeader: boolean }) {
  const { data, isLoading } = useQuery<{ embedUrl: string | null }>({
    queryKey: ["portal-embed-url", clientCode],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();
      if (previewClient) params.set("client", previewClient);
      else params.set("client", clientCode);
      const res = await fetch(`/api/portal/embed-url?${params}`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch embed URL");
      return res.json();
    },
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
    enabled: !!clientCode,
  });

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="h-[600px] flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="h-6 w-6 border-2 border-[#2563eb] border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!data?.embedUrl) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        {showClientHeader && (
          <div className="border-b border-border/60 pb-3">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">{clientCode}</h2>
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 glass-card p-12 text-center">
          <BarChart3 className="h-12 w-12 text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 mx-auto mb-4" />
          <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            Your report is being prepared and will be available here soon. Please reach out to your account manager for details.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {showClientHeader && (
        <div className="border-b border-border/60 pb-3">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight">{clientCode}</h2>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="h-[calc(100vh-10rem)] rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-border/60">
        <iframe
          src={data.embedUrl}
          className="w-full h-full border-0"
          allowFullScreen
          title={`Power BI Report — ${clientCode}`}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function PortalReportsPage() {
  return (
    <Suspense>
      <ReportsContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

FILE: src/app/portal/sales/forecast/page.tsx
================================================
"use client";

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useSession } from "next-auth/react";
import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { Loader2, ArrowLeft } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ForecastEditor } from "@/components/analytics/forecast-editor";

function formatDate(d: Date): string {
  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

function daysAgo(n: number): string {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() - n);
  return formatDate(d);
}

export default function PortalForecastPage() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  const clientIdCode =
    searchParams.get("client") || session?.user?.clientIdCode;
  const role = session?.user?.role;
  const readOnly = role === "client" || role === "prospect";

  const end = formatDate(new Date());
  const start = daysAgo(7);

  const { data: clientData, isLoading: clientLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["portal-sales-summary-fc", clientIdCode],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/sales-summary?period=7D&start=${start}&end=${end}&client=${clientIdCode}`
      );
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch client data");
      return res.json();
    },
    enabled: !!clientIdCode,
  });

  const accountIds = clientData?.clients?.[0]?.accountIds;

  const { data: monthlyData, isLoading: monthlyLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["portal-monthly", clientIdCode, accountIds],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/sales-summary/monthly?accountIds=${accountIds}`
      );
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch monthly data");
      return res.json();
    },
    enabled: !!accountIds,
  });

  const { data: forecastData, isLoading: forecastLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["portal-forecasts", clientIdCode],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/forecasts?clientIdCode=${clientIdCode}`
      );
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch forecasts");
      return res.json();
    },
    enabled: !!clientIdCode,
  });

  const isLoading = clientLoading || monthlyLoading || forecastLoading;

  if (!clientIdCode) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-24 text-muted-foreground">
        No client assigned.
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-24">
        <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6 space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
        <Link
          href="/portal/sales"
          className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
        >
          <ArrowLeft className="h-5 w-5" />
        </Link>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tight">
          <span className="font-bold">Sales&PPC</span>
          <span className="text-[#2563eb]">Forecast</span>
        </h1>
      </div>
      <ForecastEditor
        monthlyActuals={monthlyData?.months ?? []}
        forecasts={forecastData?.forecasts ?? []}
        clientIdCode={clientIdCode}
        readOnly={readOnly}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";

import { Loader2, ArrowLeft } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { InventoryForecastTable } from "@/components/analytics/inventory-forecast-table";

function formatDate(d: Date): string {
  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

function daysAgo(n: number): string {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setDate(d.getDate() - n);
  return formatDate(d);
}

export default function PortalInventoryPage() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  const clientIdCode =
    searchParams.get("client") || session?.user?.clientIdCode;

  const end = formatDate(new Date());

  const { data: clientData, isLoading: clientLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["portal-sales-summary-inv", clientIdCode],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/sales-summary?period=7D&start=${start}&end=${end}&client=${clientIdCode}`
      );
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch client data");
      return res.json();
    },
    enabled: !!clientIdCode,
  });

  const accountIds = clientData?.clients?.[0]?.accountIds;

  const { data: inventoryData, isLoading: inventoryLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["portal-inventory", clientIdCode, start, end, accountIds],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/sales-summary/inventory?start=${start}&end=${end}&accountIds=${accountIds}`
      );
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch inventory data");
      return res.json();
    },
    enabled: !!accountIds,
  });

  const isLoading = clientLoading || inventoryLoading;

  if (!clientIdCode) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-24 text-muted-foreground">
        No client assigned.
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-24">
        <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6 space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
        <Link
          href="/portal/sales"
          className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
        >
          <ArrowLeft className="h-5 w-5" />
        </Link>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tight">
          <span className="font-bold">Inventory</span>
          <span className="text-[#2563eb]">Forecast</span>
        </h1>
      </div>
      <InventoryForecastTable
        products={inventoryData?.products ?? []}
        periodLabel="Last 7 Days"
      />
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/app/portal/seo/page.tsx
================================================
"use client";

import { useMemo, Suspense } from "react";
import { useSession } from "next-auth/react";
import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ArrowLeft, Search, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { CLIENT_NAMES } from "@/lib/constants";

// ── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type SeoProject = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  brand_name: string;
  status: string;
  current_phase: string;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
  assignee_name: string | null;
  assignee_image: string | null;
  asin_count: number;
  s1_approved_at: string | null;
  s2_approved_at: string | null;
  s3_approved_at: string | null;
  s4_approved_at: string | null;
  s5_approved_at: string | null;
  s6_approved_at: string | null;
};

const PHASES = [
  { code: "S1", label: "Intake" },
  { code: "S2", label: "Keywords" },
  { code: "S3", label: "Reviews" },
  { code: "S4", label: "Rufus" },
  { code: "S5", label: "COSMO" },
  { code: "S6", label: "Content" },
];

// ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function approvedCount(p: SeoProject): number {
  let c = 0;
  if (p.s1_approved_at) c++;
  if (p.s2_approved_at) c++;
  if (p.s3_approved_at) c++;
  if (p.s4_approved_at) c++;
  if (p.s5_approved_at) c++;
  if (p.s6_approved_at) c++;
  return c;
}

function progressPct(p: SeoProject): number {
  return Math.round((approvedCount(p) / 6) * 100);
}

function relativeTime(dateStr: string): string {
  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(dateStr).getTime();
  const mins = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
  if (mins < 1) return "just now";
  if (mins < 60) return `${mins}m ago`;
  const hrs = Math.floor(mins / 60);
  if (hrs < 24) return `${hrs}h ago`;
  const days = Math.floor(hrs / 24);
  return `${days}d ago`;
}

const STATUS_STYLES: Record<string, string> = {
  draft: "border-stone-300 bg-stone-100 text-stone-600 dark:border-zinc-600 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-400",
  in_progress: "border-blue-400/40 bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400",
  completed: "border-emerald-400/40 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400",
  archived: "border-stone-300 bg-stone-50 text-stone-400 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-500",
};

// ── Project Card ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function ProjectCard({ project, delay }: { project: SeoProject; delay: number }) {
  const progress = progressPct(project);
  const approved = approvedCount(project);
  const currentPhase = PHASES.find((ph) => ph.code === project.current_phase);

  return (
    <div
      className="rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 p-5 animate-card-enter"
      style={{ animationDelay: `${delay}ms` }}
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 mb-3">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground truncate">{project.name}</h3>
          {project.brand_name && (
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{project.brand_name}</p>
          )}
        </div>
        <Badge
          variant="outline"
          className={cn("text-[10px] shrink-0", STATUS_STYLES[project.status] || "")}
        >
          {project.status.replace("_", " ")}
        </Badge>
      </div>

      {/* Phase progress */}
      <div className="mb-3">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
            Phase {project.current_phase} — {currentPhase?.label || "Unknown"}
          </span>
          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-foreground tabular-nums">
            {approved}/6
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-1">
          {PHASES.map((ph, i) => {
            const isApproved = [
              project.s1_approved_at,
              project.s2_approved_at,
              project.s3_approved_at,
              project.s4_approved_at,
              project.s5_approved_at,
              project.s6_approved_at,
            ][i];
            const isCurrent = ph.code === project.current_phase;
            return (
              <div
                key={ph.code}
                className={cn(
                  "h-1.5 flex-1 rounded-full transition-all",
                  isApproved
                    ? "bg-emerald-500"
                    : isCurrent
                      ? "bg-brand/60 animate-pulse"
                      : "bg-stone-200 dark:bg-zinc-700"
                )}
                title={`${ph.code} ${ph.label}${isApproved ? " ✓" : isCurrent ? " (current)" : ""}`}
              />
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Footer details */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          {project.asin_count > 0 && (
            <span>{project.asin_count} ASIN{project.asin_count !== 1 ? "s" : ""}</span>
          )}
          {project.assignee_name && (
            <span>{project.assignee_name.split(" ")[0]}</span>
          )}
        </div>
        <span>Updated {relativeTime(project.updated_at)}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Main Page ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function PortalSeoContent() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const user = session?.user;
  const isAdmin = user?.role === "admin";
  const previewClient = isAdmin ? searchParams.get("client") : null;
  const clientCode = previewClient || user?.clientIdCode;
  const clientParam = previewClient ? `?client=${previewClient}` : "";
  const clientName = clientCode ? CLIENT_NAMES[clientCode] || clientCode : "";

  const { data: projects = [], isLoading } = useQuery<SeoProject[]>({
    queryKey: ["portal-seo", clientCode],
    queryFn: () =>
      fetch(`/api/portal/seo${clientParam}`).then((r) => {
        if (!r.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load");
        return r.json();
      }),
    enabled: !!clientCode,
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  const active = useMemo(() => projects.filter((p) => p.status !== "completed" && p.status !== "archived"), [projects]);
  const completed = useMemo(() => projects.filter((p) => p.status === "completed"), [projects]);
  const avgProgress = useMemo(() => {
    if (active.length === 0) return 0;
    return Math.round(active.reduce((sum, p) => sum + progressPct(p), 0) / active.length);
  }, [active]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10 py-4 bg-background">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-1">
          <Link
            href={`/portal${clientParam}`}
            className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="h-5 w-5" />
          </Link>
          <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter">
            <span className="text-foreground font-bold">SEO</span>
            <span className="text-[#2563eb]">Projects</span>
          </h1>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground ml-9">
          {clientName} &mdash; Amazon Listing Optimization Pipeline
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Loading */}
      {isLoading && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-20">
          <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-brand" />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Empty state */}
      {!isLoading && projects.length === 0 && (
        <div className="text-center py-20">
          <Search className="h-10 w-10 text-muted-foreground/30 mx-auto mb-4" />
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">
            No SEO projects found for {clientName}.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Metrics */}
      {!isLoading && projects.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
            <MetricCard label="Active" value={active.length} delay={0} />
            <MetricCard label="Completed" value={completed.length} delay={60} />
            <MetricCard label="Avg Progress" value={`${avgProgress}%`} progress={avgProgress} delay={120} />
            <MetricCard label="Total Projects" value={projects.length} delay={180} />
          </div>

          {/* Active Projects */}
          {active.length > 0 && (
            <div>
              <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">
                In Progress
              </p>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                {active.map((p, i) => (
                  <ProjectCard key={p.id} project={p} delay={i * 60} />
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Completed Projects */}
          {completed.length > 0 && (
            <div>
              <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">
                Completed
              </p>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                {completed.map((p, i) => (
                  <ProjectCard key={p.id} project={p} delay={i * 60} />
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function MetricCard({ label, value, progress, delay = 0 }: {
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  progress?: number;
  delay?: number;
}) {
  return (
    <div
      className="rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 animate-card-enter"
      style={{ animationDelay: `${delay}ms` }}
    >
      <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
        {label}
      </p>
      <p className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tighter text-foreground font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)]">
        {value}
      </p>
      {progress !== undefined && (
        <div className="mt-2 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-stone-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 overflow-hidden">
          <div
            className="h-full rounded-full bg-brand transition-all duration-700"
            style={{ width: `${Math.min(progress, 100)}%` }}
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function PortalSeoPage() {
  return (
    <Suspense>
      <PortalSeoContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { CheckCircle2, Clock, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

type SectionProgress = {
  section: string;
  total: number;
  completed: number;
  inProgress: number;
  avgPct: number;
};

type TimelineResponse = {
  sections: SectionProgress[];
  overall: { total: number; completed: number; avgPct: number };
  initialized: boolean;
};

const SECTION_ICONS: Record<string, string> = {
  Onboarding: "🚀",
  Content: "📝",
  PPC: "📊",
};

const SECTION_DESCRIPTIONS: Record<string, string> = {
  Onboarding: "Account setup, access configuration, and project initialization",
  Content: "Creative assets, listings, A+ content, and storefront",
  PPC: "Advertising campaigns, analytics, and performance dashboards",
};

export default function PortalTimeline() {
  const { data, isLoading } = useQuery<TimelineResponse>({
    queryKey: ["portal-timeline"],
    queryFn: () => fetch("/api/portal/timeline").then((r) => r.json()),
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10 py-4 bg-background">

          <span className="text-foreground font-bold">Project</span>
          <span className="text-[#2563eb]">Timeline</span>
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
          Track milestones and deliverables across your account.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Loading */}
      {isLoading && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
            <div
              key={i}
              className="h-32 rounded-xl bg-muted/50 animate-pulse"
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Empty state */}
      {!isLoading && !data?.initialized && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card p-16 text-center">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#2563eb]/10 p-4 mb-4">
            <Clock className="h-8 w-8 text-[#2563eb]" />
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold mb-2">Coming Soon</h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground max-w-md mx-auto">
            Your onboarding timeline will appear when your project begins.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Phase cards */}
      {!isLoading && data?.initialized && (
        <>
          {/* Overall progress */}
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card p-5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold">Overall Progress</h2>
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {data.overall.completed} / {data.overall.total} tasks
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="w-full h-3 rounded-full bg-muted/50 overflow-hidden">
              <div
                className="h-full rounded-full bg-brand transition-all"
                style={{ width: `${data.overall.avgPct}%` }}
              />
            </div>
            <p className="text-right text-xs font-bold tabular-nums text-brand mt-1">
              {data.overall.avgPct}%
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Section cards */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            {data.sections.map((section) => {
              const pct = section.total > 0
                ? Math.round((section.completed / section.total) * 100)
                : 0;
              const allDone = section.completed === section.total && section.total > 0;

              return (
                <div
                  key={section.section}
                  className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card p-5 space-y-3"
                  style={{ animationDelay: `${["Onboarding", "Content", "PPC"].indexOf(section.section) * 50}ms` }}
                >
                  {/* Section header */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-lg">
                      {SECTION_ICONS[section.section] ?? "📋"}
                    </span>
                    <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#2563eb]">
                      {section.section}
                    </h3>
                    {allDone && (
                      <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-[var(--brand-green)] ml-auto" />
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {SECTION_DESCRIPTIONS[section.section] ?? ""}
                  </p>

                  {/* Progress bar */}
                  <div>
                    <div className="w-full h-2 rounded-full bg-muted/50 overflow-hidden">
                      <div
                        className="h-full rounded-full bg-brand transition-all"
                        style={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
                        role="progressbar"
                        aria-valuenow={pct}
                        aria-valuemin={0}
                        aria-valuemax={100}
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-1.5">
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                        {section.completed} / {section.total} tasks
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold tabular-nums text-brand">
                        {pct}%
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Status breakdown */}
                  <div className="flex gap-2">
                    {section.inProgress > 0 && (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-300 dark:bg-amber-500/20 dark:text-amber-400 dark:border-amber-500/30">
                        {section.inProgress} in progress
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {section.completed > 0 && (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:border-emerald-500/30">
                        {section.completed} done
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { AvatarCircle } from "@/components/seo/avatar-circle";

// ── Types ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface ProjectSummary {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  brand_name: string;
  status: string;
  current_phase: string;
  client_id_code: string | null;
  created_by: string;
  assigned_to: string | null;
  assignee_name: string | null;
  assignee_image: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
  s1_approved_at: string | null;
  s2_approved_at: string | null;
  s3_approved_at: string | null;
  s4_approved_at: string | null;
  s5_approved_at: string | null;
  s6_approved_at: string | null;
  linked_product_id: string | null;
}

interface TeamMember {
  id: string;
  name: string | null;
  email: string;
  image: string | null;
}

interface ClientEntry {
  clientIdCode: string;
  clientName: string;
}

// ── Constants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const PHASES = [
  { code: "S1", label: "Intake", route: "intake" },
  { code: "S2", label: "Keywords", route: "keywords" },
  { code: "S3", label: "Reviews", route: "reviews" },
  { code: "S4", label: "Rufus", route: "rufus" },
  { code: "S5", label: "COSMO", route: "cosmo" },
  { code: "S6", label: "Content", route: "seo" },
];

const phaseRouteMap: Record<string, string> = {
  S1: "intake",
  S2: "keywords",
  S3: "reviews",
  S4: "rufus",
  S5: "cosmo",
  S6: "seo",
};

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function relativeTime(dateStr: string): string {
  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(dateStr).getTime();
  const mins = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
  if (mins < 1) return "just now";
  if (mins < 60) return `${mins}m ago`;
  const hrs = Math.floor(mins / 60);
  if (hrs < 24) return `${hrs}h ago`;
  const days = Math.floor(hrs / 24);
  return `${days}d ago`;
}

function daysBetween(a: string, b: string): number {
  return Math.round(
    (new Date(b).getTime() - new Date(a).getTime()) / 86400000
  );
}

function daysSince(dateStr: string): number {
  return Math.round((Date.now() - new Date(dateStr).getTime()) / 86400000);
}

function lastActivityDate(p: ProjectSummary): string {
  const approvals = [
    p.s1_approved_at, p.s2_approved_at, p.s3_approved_at,
    p.s4_approved_at, p.s5_approved_at, p.s6_approved_at,
  ].filter(Boolean) as string[];
  if (approvals.length === 0) return p.created_at;
  return approvals.reduce((latest, t) =>
    new Date(t) > new Date(latest) ? t : latest
  );
}

function approvedPhaseCount(p: ProjectSummary): number {
  let count = 0;
  if (p.s1_approved_at) count++;
  if (p.s2_approved_at) count++;
  if (p.s3_approved_at) count++;
  if (p.s4_approved_at) count++;
  if (p.s5_approved_at) count++;
  if (p.s6_approved_at) count++;
  return count;
}

function uniqueAsins(projects: ProjectSummary[]): number {
  const linked = new Set<string>();
  for (const p of projects) {
    if (p.linked_product_id) linked.add(p.linked_product_id);
  }
  return linked.size;
}

// ── Skeleton ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function Skeleton({ className = "" }: { className?: string }) {
  return (
    <div
      className={`animate-pulse bg-stone-200 dark:bg-zinc-800 rounded-xl ${className}`}
    />
  );
}

// ── Metric Card ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function MetricCard({
  label,
  value,
  sub,
  progress,
  delay = 0,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  sub?: string;
  progress?: number;
  delay?: number;
}) {
  return (
    <div
      className="rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 animate-card-enter"
      style={{ animationDelay: `${delay}ms` }}
    >
      <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
        {label}
      </p>
      <p className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tighter text-foreground font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)]">
        {value}
      </p>
      {progress !== undefined && (
        <div className="mt-2 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-stone-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 overflow-hidden">
          <div
            className="h-full rounded-full bg-brand transition-all duration-700"
            style={{ width: `${Math.min(progress, 100)}%` }}
          />
        </div>
      )}
      {sub && (
        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-1">{sub}</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Phase Funnel Bar ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

function PhaseFunnel({ projects }: { projects: ProjectSummary[] }) {
  const phaseCounts: Record<string, number> = {};
  let completedCount = 0;

  for (const phase of PHASES) {
    phaseCounts[phase.code] = 0;
  }

  for (const p of projects) {
    if (p.status === "completed") {
      completedCount++;
    } else if (phaseCounts[p.current_phase] !== undefined) {
      phaseCounts[p.current_phase]++;
    }
  }

  const maxCount = Math.max(
    ...Object.values(phaseCounts),
    completedCount,
    1
  );

  const rows = [
    ...PHASES.map((ph) => ({
      label: `${ph.code} ${ph.label}`,
      count: phaseCounts[ph.code],
      color: "bg-brand",
    })),
    {
      label: "Completed",
      count: completedCount,
      color: "bg-emerald-500",
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      {rows.map((row) => (
        <div key={row.label} className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <span className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground w-28 shrink-0 text-right">
            {row.label}
          </span>
          <div className="flex-1 h-6 rounded bg-stone-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/60 overflow-hidden relative">
            <div
              className={`h-full rounded ${row.color} transition-all duration-700`}
              style={{
                width: row.count > 0 ? `${(row.count / maxCount) * 100}%` : "0%",
              }}
            />
            {row.count > 0 && (
              <span className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[11px] font-bold text-foreground/70">
                {row.count}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          {row.count === 0 && (
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/40 w-6">0</span>
          )}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Client Health Card ────────────────────────────────────────────────

function ClientHealthCard({
  clientCode,
  clientName,
  projects,
  delay,
}: {
  clientCode: string;
  clientName: string;
  projects: ProjectSummary[];
  delay: number;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const totalPhases = projects.length * 6;
  const approvedTotal = projects.reduce(
    (sum, p) => sum + approvedPhaseCount(p),
    0
  );
  const pct = totalPhases > 0 ? Math.round((approvedTotal / totalPhases) * 100) : 0;

  const barColor =
    pct > 75
      ? "bg-emerald-500"
      : pct >= 25
        ? "bg-amber-500"
        : "bg-red-500";

  // Phase breakdown
  const phaseBreakdown = PHASES.map((ph) => {
    const approved = projects.filter((p) => {
      const key = `${ph.code.toLowerCase()}_approved_at` as keyof ProjectSummary;
      return !!p[key];
    }).length;
    return { code: ph.code, approved, total: projects.length };
  });

  return (
    <div
      className="rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-5 cursor-pointer hover:border-stone-300 hover:shadow-md transition-all dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 dark:hover:border-zinc-700 animate-card-enter"
      style={{ animationDelay: `${delay}ms` }}
      onClick={() => router.push(`/seo/clients/${clientCode}`)}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground truncate font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)]">
          {clientName}
        </h3>
        <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground shrink-0 ml-2">
          {projects.length} project{projects.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Progress bar */}
      <div className="h-2 rounded-full bg-stone-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 overflow-hidden mb-2">
        <div
          className={`h-full rounded-full ${barColor} transition-all duration-700`}
          style={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
        />
      </div>
      <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mb-3">{pct}% phases approved</p>

      {/* Phase breakdown */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
        {phaseBreakdown.map((pb) => (
          <span
            key={pb.code}
            className={`inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold ${
              pb.approved === pb.total && pb.total > 0
                ? "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-500/20 dark:text-emerald-400"
                : pb.approved > 0
                  ? "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-500/20 dark:text-amber-400"
                  : "bg-stone-100 text-stone-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500"
            }`}
          >
            {pb.code}:{pb.approved}/{pb.total}
          </span>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Activity Item ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function buildActivity(projects: ProjectSummary[]): {
  type: "approval" | "export";
  description: string;
  time: string;
}[] {
  const items: { type: "approval" | "export"; description: string; time: string }[] = [];

  for (const p of projects) {
    const phases = [
      { code: "S1", label: "Intake", at: p.s1_approved_at },
      { code: "S2", label: "Keywords", at: p.s2_approved_at },
      { code: "S3", label: "Reviews", at: p.s3_approved_at },
      { code: "S4", label: "Rufus", at: p.s4_approved_at },
      { code: "S5", label: "COSMO", at: p.s5_approved_at },
      { code: "S6", label: "Content", at: p.s6_approved_at },
    ];

    for (const ph of phases) {
      if (ph.at) {
        items.push({
          type: "approval",
          description: `${p.assignee_name || "Someone"} approved ${ph.code} ${ph.label} for ${p.brand_name || p.name}`,
          time: ph.at,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  items.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.time).getTime() - new Date(a.time).getTime());
  return items.slice(0, 12);
}

// ── Main Page ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function SEODashboardPage() {
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<ProjectSummary[]>([]);
  const [team, setTeam] = useState<TeamMember[]>([]);
  const [clients, setClients] = useState<ClientEntry[]>([]);
  const [projectsLoaded, setProjectsLoaded] = useState(false);
  const [selectedAssignee, setSelectedAssignee] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const loading = !projectsLoaded;

  useEffect(() => {
    // Fetch independently so partial data renders as it arrives
    fetch("/api/seo/projects")
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : []))
      .then(setProjects)
      .catch(() => {})
      .finally(() => setProjectsLoaded(true));

    fetch("/api/seo/team")
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : []))
      .then(setTeam)
      .catch(() => {});

    fetch("/api/clients/list")
      .then((r) => (r.ok ? r.json() : []))
      .then(setClients)
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  // Client name lookup
  const clientNameMap = useMemo(
    () => Object.fromEntries(clients.map((c) => [c.clientIdCode, c.clientName])),
    [clients]
  );

  // Filter by selected assignee
  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedAssignee) return projects;
    return projects.filter((p) => p.assigned_to === selectedAssignee);
  }, [projects, selectedAssignee]);

  // ── Computed metrics ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  const activeProjects = filtered.filter((p) => p.status !== "completed");
  const completedProjects = filtered.filter((p) => p.status === "completed");

  const now = new Date();
  const monthStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1);
  const completedThisMonth = completedProjects.filter(
    (p) => new Date(p.updated_at) >= monthStart
  ).length;

  const avgProgress = useMemo(() => {
    if (filtered.length === 0) return 0;
    const total = filtered.reduce(
      (sum, p) => sum + approvedPhaseCount(p),
      0
    );
    return Math.round((total / (filtered.length * 6)) * 100);
  }, [filtered]);

  const asinsOptimized = uniqueAsins(
    filtered.filter((p) => p.status === "completed")
  );

  // Real export count from enriched API response
  const exportsSent = filtered.reduce((sum, p) => {
    const info = (p as any).export_info;
    return sum + (info?.export_count || 0);
  }, 0);

  // Team workload
  const teamWorkload = useMemo(() => {
    const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const p of projects) {
      if (p.assigned_to) {
        counts[p.assigned_to] = (counts[p.assigned_to] || 0) + 1;
      }
    }
    return team
      .map((m) => ({ ...m, projectCount: counts[m.id] || 0 }))
      .filter((m) => m.projectCount > 0)
      .sort((a, b) => b.projectCount - a.projectCount);
  }, [team, projects]);

  // Stale projects: idle 7+ days based on most recent phase approval (or created_at if none)
  const staleProjects = useMemo(() => {
    return filtered
      .filter((p) => p.status !== "completed" && p.status !== "archived" && daysSince(lastActivityDate(p)) >= 7)
      .sort((a, b) => daysSince(lastActivityDate(b)) - daysSince(lastActivityDate(a)));
  }, [filtered]);

  // Client-grouped projects for health cards
  const clientGroups = useMemo(() => {
    const groups: Record<string, ProjectSummary[]> = {};
    for (const p of filtered) {
      if (p.client_id_code) {
        if (!groups[p.client_id_code]) groups[p.client_id_code] = [];
        groups[p.client_id_code].push(p);
      }
    }
    return Object.entries(groups).sort((a, b) =>
      (clientNameMap[a[0]] || a[0]).localeCompare(clientNameMap[b[0]] || b[0])
    );
  }, [filtered, clientNameMap]);

  // Activity feed
  const activity = useMemo(() => buildActivity(filtered), [filtered]);

  // Recently completed
  const recentlyCompleted = useMemo(() => {
    return completedProjects
      .sort(
        (a, b) =>
          new Date(b.updated_at).getTime() - new Date(a.updated_at).getTime()
      )
      .slice(0, 8);
  }, [completedProjects]);

  // Selected assignee info
  const selectedMember = team.find((m) => m.id === selectedAssignee);

  // ── Render ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  // Empty state
  if (!loading && projects.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div>
        <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10 py-4 mb-2 bg-background">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter">
              <span className="text-foreground font-bold">SEO</span>
              <span className="text-brand">Dashboard</span>
            </h1>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2">
            Amazon Listing Optimization &mdash; RUFUS &amp; COSMO System
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="text-center py-20">
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mb-3">
            No SEO projects yet.
          </p>
          <Link
            href="/seo/manager"
            className="text-brand hover:text-brand-hover underline text-sm font-medium"
          >
            Create your first project in SEO Manager
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div>
      {/* ── 1. Header (sticky) ─────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10 py-4 mb-2 bg-background">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter">
              <span className="text-foreground font-bold">SEO</span>
              <span className="text-brand">Dashboard</span>
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2">
              Amazon Listing Optimization &mdash; RUFUS &amp; COSMO System
            </p>
          </div>
          <Link
            href="/seo/manager"
            className="rounded-lg bg-brand px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover shadow-[0_0_16px_-4px_var(--brand-glow)] shrink-0"
          >
            Go to Manager &rarr;
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filter indicator */}
      {selectedAssignee && selectedMember && (
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-brand/30 bg-brand/5 px-4 py-2 animate-card-enter">
          <AvatarCircle
            name={selectedMember.name}
            image={selectedMember.image}
            size={20}
          />
          <span className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground">
            Filtering by{" "}
            <span className="font-bold">
              {selectedMember.name || selectedMember.email}
            </span>
          </span>
          <button
            onClick={() => setSelectedAssignee(null)}
            className="ml-auto text-[10px] font-bold text-brand hover:text-brand-hover underline"
          >
            Clear filter
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── 2. Hero Metrics Row ────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {loading ? (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-5 gap-4 mb-8">
          {Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, i) => (
            <Skeleton key={i} className="h-24" />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-5 gap-4 mb-8">
          <MetricCard
            label="Active Projects"
            value={activeProjects.length}
            delay={0}
          />
          <MetricCard
            label="Completed This Month"
            value={completedThisMonth}
            delay={60}
          />
          <MetricCard
            label="Avg Progress"
            value={`${avgProgress}%`}
            progress={avgProgress}
            delay={120}
          />
          <MetricCard
            label="ASINs Optimized"
            value={asinsOptimized}
            delay={180}
          />
          <MetricCard
            label="Exports Sent"
            value={exportsSent}
            delay={240}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── 3. Team Workload Strip ─────────────────────────────────── */}
      {!loading && teamWorkload.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mb-8">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">
            Team Workload
          </p>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap">
            {teamWorkload.map((member) => {
              const isActive = selectedAssignee === member.id;
              return (
                <button
                  key={member.id}
                  onClick={() =>
                    setSelectedAssignee(isActive ? null : member.id)
                  }
                  className={`flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border px-3 py-1.5 transition-all ${
                    isActive
                      ? "border-brand bg-brand/10 shadow-[0_0_12px_-4px_var(--brand-glow)]"
                      : "border-stone-200 bg-white hover:border-stone-300 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 dark:hover:border-zinc-700"
                  }`}
                >
                  <AvatarCircle
                    name={member.name}
                    image={member.image}
                    size={22}
                  />
                  <span className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground">
                    {(member.name || member.email).split(" ")[0]}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                    {member.projectCount}
                  </span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── 4. Stale Alerts ────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {!loading && staleProjects.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mb-8 rounded-xl border border-amber-300/60 bg-amber-50/50 p-5 dark:border-amber-500/20 dark:bg-amber-500/5 animate-card-enter">
          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-400 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
            <svg
              className="w-4 h-4"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            >
              <path
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
                strokeWidth={2}
                d="M12 9v2m0 4h.01m-6.938 4h13.856c1.54 0 2.502-1.667 1.732-2.5L13.732 4c-.77-.833-1.964-.833-2.732 0L4.082 16.5c-.77.833.192 2.5 1.732 2.5z"
              />
            </svg>
            Stale Projects
          </p>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {staleProjects.map((p) => (
              <Link
                key={p.id}
                href={`/seo/${p.id}/${phaseRouteMap[p.current_phase] || "intake"}`}
                className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg px-3 py-2 hover:bg-amber-100/60 dark:hover:bg-amber-500/10 transition-colors"
              >
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-foreground truncate block">
                    {p.name}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                    {p.client_id_code
                      ? clientNameMap[p.client_id_code] || p.client_id_code
                      : "No client"}{" "}
                    &middot; {p.current_phase}{" "}
                    {PHASES.find((ph) => ph.code === p.current_phase)?.label}
                    {p.assignee_name && ` · ${p.assignee_name}`}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 shrink-0 ml-3">
                  {daysSince(lastActivityDate(p))} days idle
                </span>
              </Link>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── 5. Phase Funnel ────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {loading ? (
        <Skeleton className="h-52 mb-8" />
      ) : (
        <div className="mb-8">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">
            Phase Funnel
          </p>
          <div className="rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900/50">
            <PhaseFunnel projects={filtered} />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── 6. Client Health Cards ─────────────────────────────────── */}
      {loading ? (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-8">
          {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
            <Skeleton key={i} className="h-36" />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : clientGroups.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="mb-8">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">
            Client Health
          </p>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            {clientGroups.map(([code, prjs], index) => (
              <ClientHealthCard
                key={code}
                clientCode={code}
                clientName={clientNameMap[code] || code}
                projects={prjs}
                delay={index * 60}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {/* ── 7. Bottom Row: Activity + Recently Completed ───────────── */}
      {!loading && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6 mb-8">
          {/* Activity Feed */}
          {activity.length > 0 && (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 animate-card-enter">
              <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">
                Recent Activity
              </p>
              <div className="space-y-2.5">
                {activity.map((item, i) => (
                  <div key={i} className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                    <div
                      className={`mt-0.5 w-5 h-5 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                        item.type === "approval"
                          ? "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600 dark:bg-emerald-500/20 dark:text-emerald-400"
                          : "bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-500/20 dark:text-blue-400"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {item.type === "approval" ? (
                        <svg
                          className="w-3 h-3"
                          fill="none"
                          stroke="currentColor"
                          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                        >
                          <path
                            strokeLinecap="round"
                            strokeLinejoin="round"
                            strokeWidth={3}
                            d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"
                          />
                        </svg>
                      ) : (
                        <svg
                          className="w-3 h-3"
                          fill="none"
                          stroke="currentColor"
                          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                        >
                          <path
                            strokeLinecap="round"
                            strokeLinejoin="round"
                            strokeWidth={2}
                            d="M14 5l7 7m0 0l-7 7m7-7H3"
                          />
                        </svg>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <p className="text-xs text-foreground leading-snug">
                        {item.description}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                        {relativeTime(item.time)}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Recently Completed */}
          {recentlyCompleted.length > 0 && (
            <div className="rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 animate-card-enter">
              <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">
                Recently Completed
              </p>
              <div className="space-y-2.5">
                {recentlyCompleted.map((p) => (
                  <div key={p.id} className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                    <div className="mt-0.5 w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 dark:bg-emerald-500/20 dark:text-emerald-400">
                      <svg
                        className="w-3 h-3"
                        fill="none"
                        stroke="currentColor"
                        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                      >
                        <path
                          strokeLinecap="round"
                          strokeLinejoin="round"
                          strokeWidth={3}
                          d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"
                        />
                      </svg>
                    </div>
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <p className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground truncate">
                        {p.name}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                        {p.client_id_code
                          ? clientNameMap[p.client_id_code] || p.client_id_code
                          : "No client"}{" "}
                        &middot; completed {daysSince(p.updated_at)}d ago
                        {p.created_at &&
                          p.updated_at &&
                          ` · took ${daysBetween(p.created_at, p.updated_at)}d`}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
