"use client";

import { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from "react";
import AIGeneratingButton from "@/components/seo/ai-generating-button";
import { useRouter, useParams } from "next/navigation";
import AICostTracker from "@/components/seo/ai-cost-tracker";
import { useSectionHeader } from "@/components/seo/project-shell";

const RUFUS_STEPS = [
  { key: "phase1_display", label: "S4.1 Phase 1 Questions" },
  { key: "phase1_input", label: "S4.2 Phase 1 Answers" },
  { key: "phase1_confirm", label: "S4.3 Phase 1 Confirm" },
  { key: "phase2_display", label: "S4.4 Phase 2 Questions" },
  { key: "phase2_input", label: "S4.5 Phase 2 Answers" },
  { key: "phase2_confirm", label: "S4.6 Phase 2 Confirm" },
  { key: "review", label: "S4.7 Review OUT_RUF" },
  { key: "approved", label: "S4.8 Approved" },
];

// Phase 1 canonical questions (immutable per S4.3.1.3)
const PHASE1_QUESTIONS = [
  "What is this product for?",
  "What do people like about this product?",
  "What do people NOT like about this product?",
  "What are people buying instead of this product?",
  "Why do customers choose this product over alternatives?",
];

const PHASE1_PASTE_BLOCK = `Please provide answer followed by the following questions:
What is this product for?
What do people like about this product?
What do people NOT like about this product?
What are people buying instead of this product?
Why do customers choose this product over alternatives?`;

interface QAPair {
  question: string;
  answer: string;
}

interface AnalyzedRufus {
  ASIN: string;
  RufusQuestion: string;
  RufusAnswer: string;
  RufusQuestionCategory: string;
  RufusInsightType: string;
  RufusPrimaryObjectionAddressed: string;
  RufusPrimaryDesireAddressed: string;
  RufusCOSMORelationship: string;
  RufusUsageContext: string;
  RufusNotes: string;
}

type RufusStep = "phase1_display" | "phase1_input" | "phase1_confirm" | "phase2_display" | "phase2_input" | "phase2_confirm" | "analysis" | "review" | "approved";

export default function RufusPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const params = useParams();
  const projectId = params.id as string;
  const [step, setStep] = useState<RufusStep>("phase1_display");
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [isApproved, setIsApproved] = useState(false);
  const [completedSteps, setCompletedSteps] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [parentAsin, setParentAsin] = useState<{ asin: string; amazon_url: string } | null>(null);
  const [loadingState, setLoadingState] = useState(true);
  const [guidelinesText, setGuidelinesText] = useState("");

  // Phase 1
  const [phase1Answers, setPhase1Answers] = useState<string[]>(["", "", "", "", ""]);
  const [phase1Bulk, setPhase1Bulk] = useState("");

  // Phase 2
  const [phase2Questions, setPhase2Questions] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [phase2Answers, setPhase2Answers] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [phase2Bulk, setPhase2Bulk] = useState("");
  const [isGeneratingQ, setIsGeneratingQ] = useState(false);
  const [genUsage, setGenUsage] = useState<any>(null);

  // Analysis
  const [analyzedRows, setAnalyzedRows] = useState<AnalyzedRufus[]>([]);
  const [isRunningAI, setIsRunningAI] = useState(false);
  const [aiError, setAiError] = useState("");
  const [aiStartTime, setAiStartTime] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [aiUsage, setAiUsage] = useState<any>(null);

  // ── Load saved data on mount ────────────────────────────────

  useEffect(() => {
    async function load() {
      try {
        // Load brand guidelines from S1
        const s1Res = await fetch(`/api/seo/projects/${projectId}/load?phase=s1_intake`);
        if (s1Res.ok) {
          const s1 = await s1Res.json();
          if (s1.project?.brand_guidelines) setGuidelinesText(s1.project.brand_guidelines);
        }

        // Load parent ASIN
        const asinRes = await fetch(`/api/seo/projects/${projectId}/load?phase=parent_asin`);
        if (asinRes.ok) {
          const { parent } = await asinRes.json();
          if (parent) setParentAsin(parent);
        }

        // Load saved rufus data
        const rufusRes = await fetch(`/api/seo/projects/${projectId}/load?phase=s4_rufus`);
        if (rufusRes.ok) {
          const data = await rufusRes.json();
          if (data.rows && data.rows.length > 0) {
            setAnalyzedRows(data.rows);
            // Reconstruct phase1/phase2 answers from saved rows
            const p1: string[] = ["", "", "", "", ""];
            const p2q: string[] = [];
            const p2a: string[] = [];
            for (const r of data.rows) {
              const p1idx = PHASE1_QUESTIONS.findIndex(q =>
                q.toLowerCase() === (r.RufusQuestion || "").toLowerCase()
              );
              if (p1idx >= 0) {
                p1[p1idx] = r.RufusAnswer || "";
              } else {
                p2q.push(r.RufusQuestion || "");
                p2a.push(r.RufusAnswer || "");
              }
            }
            setPhase1Answers(p1);
            if (p2q.length > 0) {
              setPhase2Questions(p2q);
              setPhase2Answers(p2a);
            }
            // Check if S4 was actually approved (project advanced to S5+)
            const projRes = await fetch(`/api/seo/projects/${projectId}`);
            const proj = projRes.ok ? await projRes.json() : null;
            const approved = proj?.s4ApprovedAt != null;
            if (approved) {
              setCompletedSteps(new Set(RUFUS_STEPS.map(s => s.key)));
              setIsApproved(true);
              setStep("approved");
            } else {
              // Draft — go to review step so user can approve
              setCompletedSteps(prev => new Set([...prev, "phase1_display", "phase1_input", "phase1_confirm", "phase2_display", "phase2_input", "phase2_confirm"]));
              setStep("review");
            }
          }
        }
      } catch {}
      setLoadingState(false);
    }
    load();
  }, [projectId]);

  // ── Copy paste block ──────────────────────────────────────

  const copyPasteBlock = useCallback(() => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(PHASE1_PASTE_BLOCK);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  }, []);

  // ── Shared Rufus answer cleaner ──────────────────────────
  const cleanRufusAnswer = (text: string): string => {
    return text.split("\n")
      .filter(l => {
        const t = l.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!t) return false;
        if (t === "see more" || t === "more details" || t === "customer question") return false;
        if (t.startsWith("i can't help") || t.startsWith("i cannot help")) return false;
        if (t.startsWith("i'd recommend:") || t.startsWith("i would recommend:")) return false;
        return true;
      })
      .join("\n")
      .trim();
  };

  // ── Generic question-answer parser for Rufus output ──────
  const parseRufusBulk = (text: string, questions: string[]): string[] => {
    const answers = new Array(questions.length).fill("");
    if (!text.trim()) return answers;

    const lines = text.split("\n");
    const questionPositions: {lineIdx: number; qIdx: number}[] = [];

    for (let li = 0; li < lines.length; li++) {
      const lineLow = lines[li].toLowerCase().trim();
      if (!lineLow || lineLow.length < 15) continue;

      for (let qi = 0; qi < questions.length; qi++) {
        if (questionPositions.some(p => p.qIdx === qi)) continue;
        const qLow = questions[qi].toLowerCase();

        // Method 1: Direct substring (first 35 chars)
        const subLen = Math.min(35, qLow.length);
        if (lineLow.includes(qLow.substring(0, subLen))) {
          questionPositions.push({ lineIdx: li, qIdx: qi });
          break;
        }

        // Method 2: Significant word matching (4+ char words)
        const qWords = qLow.match(/\b[a-z]{4,}\b/g) || [];
        if (qWords.length >= 3) {
          const matchCount = qWords.filter(w => lineLow.includes(w)).length;
          if (matchCount / qWords.length >= 0.65) {
            questionPositions.push({ lineIdx: li, qIdx: qi });
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    questionPositions.sort((a, b) => a.lineIdx - b.lineIdx);

    if (questionPositions.length > 0) {
      for (let i = 0; i < questionPositions.length; i++) {
        const startLine = questionPositions[i].lineIdx + 1;
        const endLine = i < questionPositions.length - 1
          ? questionPositions[i + 1].lineIdx
          : lines.length;
        const raw = lines.slice(startLine, endLine).join("\n");
        answers[questionPositions[i].qIdx] = cleanRufusAnswer(raw);
      }
    } else {
      const paragraphs = text.split(/\n\s*\n/).filter(p => p.trim());
      paragraphs.forEach((p, i) => {
        if (i < answers.length) answers[i] = cleanRufusAnswer(p);
      });
    }

    return answers;
  };

  // ── Parse Phase 1 bulk input ──────────────────────────────

  const parsePhase1Bulk = useCallback(() => {
    const text = phase1Bulk.trim();
    if (!text) return;

    // First try Q1/A1 label patterns
    const lines = text.split(/\n/).filter((l) => l.trim());
    const labelAnswers: string[] = ["", "", "", "", ""];
    let currentQ = -1;
    let buffer = "";
    let foundLabels = false;

    for (const line of lines) {
      const qMatch = line.match(/^(?:Q|Question)\s*(\d)/i);
      const aMatch = line.match(/^(?:A|Answer)\s*(\d)/i);

      if (qMatch) {
        if (currentQ >= 0 && buffer.trim()) labelAnswers[currentQ] = buffer.trim();
        currentQ = parseInt(qMatch[1]) - 1;
        buffer = "";
        foundLabels = true;
        continue;
      }
      if (aMatch) {
        if (currentQ >= 0 && buffer.trim()) labelAnswers[currentQ] = buffer.trim();
        currentQ = parseInt(aMatch[1]) - 1;
        buffer = line.replace(/^(?:A|Answer)\s*\d[.:]\s*/i, "");
        foundLabels = true;
        continue;
      }
      buffer += (buffer ? "\n" : "") + line;
    }
    if (currentQ >= 0 && buffer.trim()) labelAnswers[currentQ] = buffer.trim();

    if (foundLabels && labelAnswers.some(a => a)) {
      setPhase1Answers(labelAnswers.map(a => cleanRufusAnswer(a)));
    } else {
      setPhase1Answers(parseRufusBulk(text, PHASE1_QUESTIONS));
    }
    setCompletedSteps(prev => new Set([...prev, "phase1_display", "phase1_input"]));
    setStep("phase1_confirm");
  }, [phase1Bulk]);

  // ── Generate Phase 2 questions via Claude ─────────────────

  const generatePhase2Questions = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsGeneratingQ(true);
    setAiError("");
    setAiStartTime(Date.now());

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/seo/claude/rufus", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          action: "generate_phase2",
          phase1: PHASE1_QUESTIONS.map((q, i) => ({ question: q, answer: phase1Answers[i] })),
          brandName: parentAsin || "Product",
          productName: parentAsin || "Product",
          guidelines: guidelinesText,
        }),
      });

      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || `API ${res.status}`);
      setPhase2Questions(data.questions);
      setPhase2Answers(new Array(data.questions.length).fill(""));
      setGenUsage(data.usage);
      setCompletedSteps(prev => new Set([...prev, "phase1_display", "phase1_input", "phase1_confirm"]));
      setStep("phase2_display");
    } catch (err: any) {
      setAiError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setIsGeneratingQ(false);
    }
  }, [phase1Answers]);

  // ── Parse Phase 2 bulk input ──────────────────────────────

  const parsePhase2Bulk = useCallback(() => {
    const text = phase2Bulk.trim();
    if (!text) return;
    setPhase2Answers(parseRufusBulk(text, phase2Questions));
    setCompletedSteps(prev => new Set([...prev, "phase2_display", "phase2_input"]));
    setStep("phase2_confirm");
  }, [phase2Bulk, phase2Questions]);

  // ── Run Final Analysis ────────────────────────────────────

  const runAnalysis = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsRunningAI(true);
    setAiError("");
    setAiStartTime(Date.now());
    setAiUsage(null);

    const allQA: QAPair[] = [
      ...PHASE1_QUESTIONS.map((q, i) => ({ question: q, answer: phase1Answers[i] })),
      ...phase2Questions.map((q, i) => ({ question: q, answer: phase2Answers[i] })),
    ];

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/seo/claude/rufus", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          action: "analyze",
          guidelines: guidelinesText,
          allQA,
          brandName: parentAsin || "Product",
          productName: parentAsin || "Product",
        }),
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(errData.error || `API ${res.status}`);
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      setAnalyzedRows(data.rows);
      setAiUsage(data.usage);
      setCompletedSteps(prev => new Set([...prev, "phase1_display", "phase1_input", "phase1_confirm", "phase2_display", "phase2_input", "phase2_confirm"]));
      setStep("review");
      // Auto-save so data persists if user navigates away
      try {
        await fetch(`/api/seo/projects/${projectId}/save`, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ phase: "s4_rufus_draft", data: { analyzedRows: data.rows } }),
        });
      } catch {}
    } catch (err: any) {
      setAiError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setIsRunningAI(false);
    }
  }, [phase1Answers, phase2Questions, phase2Answers]);

  // ── Download CSV ──────────────────────────────────────────

  const downloadCSV = useCallback(() => {
    const headers = ["ASIN", "RufusQuestion", "RufusAnswer", "RufusQuestionCategory", "RufusInsightType", "RufusPrimaryObjectionAddressed", "RufusPrimaryDesireAddressed", "RufusCOSMORelationship", "RufusUsageContext", "RufusNotes"];
    const rows = analyzedRows.map((r) =>
      headers.map((h) => {
        const val = String((r as any)[h] || "");
        return val.includes(",") || val.includes('"') || val.includes("\n") ? `"${val.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : val;
      }).join(",")
    );
    const csv = [headers.join(","), ...rows].join("\n");
    const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = "OUT_RUF.csv";
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  }, [analyzedRows]);

  // ── Build Phase 2 paste blocks (≤496 chars) ──────────────

  const phase2Batches: string[][] = [];
  if (phase2Questions.length > 0) {
    let currentBatch: string[] = [];
    let currentLen = 0;
    for (const q of phase2Questions) {
      const newLen = currentLen + (currentBatch.length > 0 ? 1 : 0) + q.length;
      if (newLen > 496 && currentBatch.length > 0) {
        phase2Batches.push(currentBatch);
        currentBatch = [q];
        currentLen = q.length;
      } else {
        currentBatch.push(q);
        currentLen = newLen;
      }
    }
    if (currentBatch.length > 0) phase2Batches.push(currentBatch);
  }

  // ── Section header (must be before any early return) ─────

  useSectionHeader({
    title: "Rufus Optimization",
    subtitle: step.startsWith("phase1") ? "Phase 1 — Foundational Questions" : step.startsWith("phase2") ? "Phase 2 — Strategic Questions" : step === "analysis" ? "Running Analysis" : step === "review" ? "Review OUT_RUF" : step === "approved" ? "Rufus Approved" : "Rufus",
    steps: RUFUS_STEPS,
    currentStep: step,
    onStepClick: (key) => setStep(key as RufusStep),
    completedSteps,
    isApproved,
  });

  if (loadingState) {
    return (
      <div className="max-w-4xl flex items-center gap-3 py-10 text-muted-foreground text-sm">
        <span className="inline-block h-4 w-4 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-muted-foreground border-t-transparent" />
        Loading Rufus data...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-6xl">

      {/* ── PHASE 1: Display paste block ── */}
      {step === "phase1_display" && (
        <div>
          <div className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 p-5">
            <p className="mb-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Copy the block below and paste it into the <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">Rufus AI chat</span> for your Parent ASIN. Then paste the responses back here.
            </p>

            {/* Parent ASIN link */}
            <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-brand-700/20 bg-brand-950/10 px-4 py-2.5">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground">Parent ASIN:</span>
              {parentAsin ? (
                <>
                  <a
                    href={parentAsin.amazon_url || `https://www.amazon.com/dp/${parentAsin.asin}`}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="text-xs font-bold text-brand-400 hover:text-brand-300 underline underline-offset-2"
                  >
                    {parentAsin.asin}
                  </a>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/60">← Open in Amazon, then ask Rufus</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/60 italic">Not set — complete S1 Intake first</span>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Paste block */}
            <div className="relative rounded-lg border border-brand-700/30 bg-surface-0 p-4">
              <pre className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-foreground/80 whitespace-pre-wrap font-mono">{PHASE1_PASTE_BLOCK}</pre>
              <button
                onClick={copyPasteBlock}
                className="absolute top-2 right-2 rounded-md bg-brand-500/20 px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-brand-400 hover:bg-brand-500/30"
              >
                {copied ? "✓ Copied" : "Copy"}
              </button>
              <div className="mt-2 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/60">
                {PHASE1_PASTE_BLOCK.length} characters (max 496)
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button onClick={() => setStep("phase1_input")} className="rounded-lg bg-brand-500 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-surface-0 hover:bg-brand-400">
            I Have the Rufus Responses →
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── PHASE 1: Input answers ── */}
      {step === "phase1_input" && (
        <div>
          <div className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 p-5">
            <p className="mb-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Paste all 5 Rufus responses below. You can paste them as a block — the system will auto-map them to each question.
            </p>
            <textarea
              value={phase1Bulk}
              onChange={(e) => setPhase1Bulk(e.target.value)}
              rows={12}
              placeholder={"Q1: What is this product for?\nA1: ...\n\nQ2: What do people like about this product?\nA2: ..."}
              className="w-full rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-0 px-4 py-3 text-xs leading-relaxed text-foreground/80 placeholder:text-muted-foreground/40 focus:border-brand-700 focus:outline-none resize-none font-mono"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={() => setStep("phase1_display")} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:bg-surface-2">Back</button>
            <button onClick={parsePhase1Bulk} disabled={!phase1Bulk.trim()} className="rounded-lg bg-brand-500 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-surface-0 hover:bg-brand-400 disabled:opacity-50">
              Parse & Map Answers
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── PHASE 1: Confirm mapping ── */}
      {step === "phase1_confirm" && (
        <div>
          <div className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-brand-700/20 bg-brand-950/10 p-5">
            <div className="mb-3 text-sm font-bold text-brand-400">Phase 1 Auto-Mapping Confirmation</div>
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {PHASE1_QUESTIONS.map((q, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 p-3">
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground mb-1">Q{i + 1}: {q}</div>
                  <textarea
                    value={phase1Answers[i]}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const updated = [...phase1Answers];
                      updated[i] = e.target.value;
                      setPhase1Answers(updated);
                    }}
                    rows={3}
                    className="w-full rounded-md border border-surface-4 bg-surface-0 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-foreground/80 focus:border-brand-700 focus:outline-none resize-none"
                  />
                  {!phase1Answers[i].trim() && (
                    <div className="mt-1 text-[9px] font-bold text-accent-red">Missing answer</div>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={() => setStep("phase1_input")} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:bg-surface-2">Back</button>
<AIGeneratingButton
              isGenerating={isGeneratingQ}
              onClick={generatePhase2Questions}
              label="Ask Claude to Generate Phase 2 Questions"
              disabled={phase1Answers.some((a) => !a.trim()) || isGeneratingQ}
            />
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                // Skip Phase 2 AI — go straight to manual Phase 2 with placeholder questions
                setPhase2Questions([
                  "What ingredients does this product contain?",
                  "How quickly does this product work?",
                  "Is this product suitable for sensitive skin?",
                  "What age groups use this product most?",
                  "How does the packaging protect the product?",
                  "Is this product used daily or as needed?",
                  "What situations trigger a purchase of this product?",
                  "Does this product replace any home remedies?",
                ]);
                setPhase2Answers(new Array(8).fill(""));
                setCompletedSteps(prev => new Set([...prev, "phase1_display", "phase1_input", "phase1_confirm"]));
      setStep("phase2_display");
              }}
              disabled={phase1Answers.some((a) => !a.trim()) || isGeneratingQ}
              className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:bg-surface-2 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              Skip AI → Use Default Questions
            </button>
            <AICostTracker isRunning={isGeneratingQ} usage={genUsage} startTime={aiStartTime} error={aiError} />
          </div>
          {aiError && !isGeneratingQ && (
            <div className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-red-900/50 bg-red-950/30 p-3 text-xs text-accent-red">{aiError}</div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── PHASE 2: Display questions + paste blocks ── */}
      {step === "phase2_display" && (
        <div>
          <div className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 p-5">
            <div className="mb-3 text-sm font-bold text-foreground">
              {phase2Questions.length} Strategic Questions Generated
            </div>
            <p className="mb-4 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Copy each batch below and paste into Rufus. Then paste all responses back.
            </p>

            {phase2Batches.map((batch, bi) => {
              const blockText = batch.join("\n");
              return (
                <div key={bi} className="mb-3 rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-0 p-4 relative">
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                    Batch {bi + 1} — {blockText.length} chars
                    {blockText.length > 496 && <span className="ml-2 text-accent-red">EXCEEDS 496 LIMIT</span>}
                  </div>
                  <pre className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-foreground/80 whitespace-pre-wrap font-mono">{blockText}</pre>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => { navigator.clipboard.writeText(blockText); }}
                    className="absolute top-2 right-2 rounded-md bg-brand-500/20 px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-brand-400 hover:bg-brand-500/30"
                  >
                    Copy
                  </button>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          <button onClick={() => setStep("phase2_input")} className="rounded-lg bg-brand-500 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-surface-0 hover:bg-brand-400">
            I Have the Rufus Responses →
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── PHASE 2: Input answers ── */}
      {step === "phase2_input" && (
        <div>
          <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {phase2Batches.length} batch{phase2Batches.length !== 1 ? "es" : ""} — paste Rufus responses for each batch below.
          </p>

          <div className="space-y-4 mb-4">
            {phase2Batches.map((batch, bi) => {
              const isFilled = !!(phase2Bulk.split("---BATCH---")[bi]?.trim());
              return (
                <div key={bi} className={`rounded-xl border p-4 space-y-3 ${isFilled ? "border-accent-green/20 bg-accent-green/5" : "border-surface-4 bg-surface-1"}`}>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className={`flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[9px] font-extrabold ${isFilled ? "bg-accent-green/20 text-accent-green" : "bg-brand-500/15 text-brand-400"}`}>
                      {isFilled ? "✓" : bi + 1}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-foreground/80">Batch {bi + 1}</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/60">{batch.length} question{batch.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}</span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Questions reference */}
                  <div className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-0 px-3 py-2 space-y-1">
                    {batch.map((q, qi) => {
                      const globalIdx = phase2Batches.slice(0, bi).reduce((n, b) => n + b.length, 0) + qi;
                      return (
                        <div key={qi} className="flex items-start gap-2">
                          <span className="shrink-0 text-[9px] font-bold text-muted-foreground/60 mt-0.5">Q{globalIdx + 6}</span>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">{q}</p>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>

                  {/* One textarea for the whole batch */}
                  <textarea
                    value={phase2Bulk.split("---BATCH---")[bi] || ""}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const parts = phase2Batches.map((_, i) => phase2Bulk.split("---BATCH---")[i] || "");
                      parts[bi] = e.target.value;
                      setPhase2Bulk(parts.join("---BATCH---"));
                    }}
                    rows={5}
                    placeholder={`Paste Rufus responses for Batch ${bi + 1}...`}
                    className="w-full rounded-md border border-surface-4 bg-surface-0 px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-foreground/80 placeholder:text-muted-foreground/60 focus:border-brand-700 focus:outline-none resize-none"
                  />
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={() => setStep("phase2_display")} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:bg-surface-2">Back</button>
            <button
              onClick={parsePhase2Bulk}
              disabled={!phase2Bulk.trim()}
              className="rounded-lg bg-brand-500 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-surface-0 hover:bg-brand-400 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              Parse & Continue →
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── PHASE 2: Confirm ── */}
      {step === "phase2_confirm" && (
        <div>
          <div className="mb-4 rounded-xl border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 p-5">
            <div className="mb-3 text-sm font-bold text-foreground">Phase 2 Answer Confirmation</div>
            <div className="space-y-3 max-h-[400px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
              {phase2Questions.map((q, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-0 p-3">
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground mb-1">Q{i + 6}: {q}</div>
                  <textarea
                    value={phase2Answers[i]}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const updated = [...phase2Answers];
                      updated[i] = e.target.value;
                      setPhase2Answers(updated);
                    }}
                    rows={2}
                    className="w-full rounded-md border border-surface-4 bg-surface-0 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-foreground/80 focus:border-brand-700 focus:outline-none resize-none"
                  />
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={() => setStep("phase2_input")} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:bg-surface-2">Back</button>
<AIGeneratingButton
              isGenerating={isRunningAI}
              onClick={runAnalysis}
              label="Ask Claude to Run Final Analysis"
              disabled={isRunningAI}
            />
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                // Skip AI — create placeholder OUT_RUF rows
                const allQA = [
                  ...PHASE1_QUESTIONS.map((q, i) => ({ question: q, answer: phase1Answers[i] })),
                  ...phase2Questions.map((q, i) => ({ question: q, answer: phase2Answers[i] })),
                ];
                const skipped = allQA.map((qa) => ({
                  ASIN: "ParentASIN",
                  RufusQuestion: qa.question,
                  RufusAnswer: qa.answer,
                  RufusQuestionCategory: "Not analyzed",
                  RufusInsightType: "Not analyzed",
                  RufusPrimaryObjectionAddressed: "AI analysis skipped",
                  RufusPrimaryDesireAddressed: "AI analysis skipped",
                  RufusCOSMORelationship: "Not analyzed",
                  RufusUsageContext: "Not analyzed",
                  RufusNotes: "AI analysis skipped",
                }));
                setAnalyzedRows(skipped);
                setCompletedSteps(prev => new Set([...prev, "phase1_display", "phase1_input", "phase1_confirm", "phase2_display", "phase2_input", "phase2_confirm"]));
      setStep("review");
              }}
              disabled={isRunningAI}
              className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:bg-surface-2 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              Skip AI → Approve Raw
            </button>
            <AICostTracker isRunning={isRunningAI} usage={aiUsage} startTime={aiStartTime} error={aiError} />
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Review OUT_RUF ── */}
      {step === "review" && analyzedRows.length > 0 && (
        <div>
          <div className="mb-4 grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
            <StatCard label="Total Q&A Pairs" value={analyzedRows.length} />
            <StatCard label="Phase 1" value={5} />
            <StatCard label="Phase 2" value={analyzedRows.length - 5} />
          </div>

          <div className="mb-4 space-y-2 max-h-[500px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
            {analyzedRows.map((r, i) => (
              <div key={i} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 p-4">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3 mb-2">
                  <span className={`shrink-0 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-extrabold ${i < 5 ? "bg-brand-500/20 text-brand-400" : "bg-accent-blue/20 text-accent-blue"}`}>
                    {i < 5 ? "P1" : "P2"}
                  </span>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="text-xs font-bold text-foreground mb-1">{r.RufusQuestion}</div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-2">{r.RufusAnswer}</div>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                      <Tag label={r.RufusQuestionCategory} />
                      <Tag label={r.RufusInsightType} />
                      <Tag label={r.RufusCOSMORelationship} color="blue" />
                      <Tag label={r.RufusUsageContext} color="green" />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {r.RufusNotes && r.RufusNotes !== "None" && (
                  <div className="mt-2 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground border-t border-surface-4 pt-2">
                    <span className="font-bold">Notes:</span> {r.RufusNotes}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={downloadCSV} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:bg-surface-2">
              Download OUT_RUF.csv
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={async () => {
                try {
                  const res = await fetch(`/api/seo/projects/${projectId}/save`, {
                    method: "POST",
                    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                      phase: "s4_rufus",
                      data: {
                        analyzedRows: analyzedRows,
                      },
                    }),
                  });
                  if (!res.ok) {
                    const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
                    throw new Error(errData.error || `Save failed: ${res.status}`);
                  }
                  setCompletedSteps(new Set(RUFUS_STEPS.map(s => s.key)));
                  setIsApproved(true);
                  setStep("approved");
                } catch (e: any) {
                  alert(`S4 approve failed: ${e.message}`);
                }
              }}
              className="ml-auto rounded-lg bg-accent-green px-6 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-surface-0 hover:bg-accent-green/80"
            >
              ✓ Approve S4 — Unlock COSMO (S5)
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ── Approved ── */}
      {step === "approved" && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-accent-green/30 bg-accent-green/5 p-6 text-center">
          <div className="mb-2 text-lg font-extrabold text-accent-green">S4 Rufus — Approved ✓</div>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4">{analyzedRows.length} Q&A pairs analyzed with COSMO relationships and buyer insights.</p>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={downloadCSV} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:bg-surface-2">
              Download OUT_RUF.csv
            </button>
            <a href={`/seo/${projectId}/cosmo`} className="rounded-lg bg-brand-500 px-5 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-surface-0 hover:bg-brand-400">
              Continue → S5 COSMO
            </a>
            <button onClick={() => { setStep("review"); }} className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:bg-surface-2 hover:text-foreground/80">
              Unlock for Editing
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function StatCard({ label, value }: { label: string; value: number }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-surface-4 bg-surface-1 px-4 py-3">
      <div className="text-lg font-extrabold text-foreground">{value}</div>
      <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{label}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Tag({ label, color = "default" }: { label: string; color?: string }) {
  if (!label || label === "None") return null;
  const c = color === "blue" ? "bg-accent-blue/15 text-accent-blue" : color === "green" ? "bg-accent-green/15 text-accent-green" : "bg-surface-3 text-muted-foreground";
  return <span className={`rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-medium ${c}`}>{label}</span>;
}

function QualityBadge({ score }: { score: number | null | undefined }) {
  if (score == null) return null;
  const color = score >= 80
    ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400"
    : score >= 60
      ? "bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-500/20 dark:text-amber-400"
      : "bg-red-50 text-red-600 dark:bg-red-500/10 dark:text-red-400";
  return (
    <span className={`rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[8px] font-bold ${color}`}>
      {score}
    </span>
  );
}

const PHASES = ["S1", "S2", "S3", "S4", "S5", "S6"] as const;

// ── Phase Breakdown Bar ───────────────────────────────────────────────

function PhaseBreakdown({
  breakdown,
}: {
  breakdown: ClientDetail["phaseBreakdown"];
}) {
  const total =
    breakdown.S1 +
    breakdown.S2 +
    breakdown.S3 +
    breakdown.S4 +
    breakdown.S5 +
    breakdown.S6 +
    breakdown.completed;

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 animate-card-enter">
      <h2 className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-[0.15em] mb-3">
        Phase Overview
      </h2>

      {/* Bar */}
      {total > 0 && (
        <div className="flex h-2.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden bg-stone-100 dark:bg-zinc-800/50 mb-3">
          {PHASES.map((phase) => {
            const count = breakdown[phase];
            if (!count) return null;
            return (
              <div
                key={phase}
                className="bg-amber-400 dark:bg-amber-500/60 transition-all"
                style={{ width: `${(count / total) * 100}%` }}
              />
            );
          })}
          {breakdown.completed > 0 && (
            <div
              className="bg-emerald-500 dark:bg-emerald-500/60 transition-all"
              style={{
                width: `${(breakdown.completed / total) * 100}%`,
              }}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Labels */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4 flex-wrap">
        {PHASES.map((phase) => (
          <div key={phase} className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <div
              className={`w-6 h-6 rounded flex items-center justify-center text-[9px] font-bold ${
                breakdown[phase] > 0
                  ? "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 border border-amber-300 dark:bg-amber-500/20 dark:text-amber-400 dark:border-amber-500/30"
                  : "bg-stone-100 text-stone-400 border border-stone-200 dark:bg-zinc-800/50 dark:text-zinc-600 dark:border-zinc-800"
              }`}
            >
              {breakdown[phase]}
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{phase}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <div
            className={`w-6 h-6 rounded flex items-center justify-center text-[9px] font-bold ${
              breakdown.completed > 0
                ? "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-500/20 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:border-emerald-500/30"
                : "bg-stone-100 text-stone-400 border border-stone-200 dark:bg-zinc-800/50 dark:text-zinc-600 dark:border-zinc-800"
            }`}
          >
            {breakdown.completed}
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-0.5">
            <svg
              className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-500"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            >
              <path
                strokeLinecap="round"
                strokeLinejoin="round"
                strokeWidth={2}
                d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"
              />
            </svg>
            Done
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function SEOClientDetailPage() {
  const params = useParams();
  const clientId = params.clientId as string;

  const [data, setData] = useState<ClientDetail | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [deletingId, setDeletingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [confirmId, setConfirmId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const deleteProject = useCallback(async (projectId: string) => {
    setDeletingId(projectId);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/seo/projects/${projectId}`, { method: "DELETE" });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to delete");
      setData((prev) => prev ? {
        ...prev,
        projects: prev.projects.filter((p) => p.id !== projectId),
      } : prev);
      toast.success("Project deleted");
    } catch {
      toast.error("Failed to delete project");
    } finally {
      setDeletingId(null);
      setConfirmId(null);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    async function load() {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/seo/clients/${clientId}`);
        if (!res.ok) {
          const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: "Failed to load" }));
          setError(err.error || "Failed to load client data");
          return;
        }
        setData(await res.json());
      } catch {
        setError("Failed to load client data");
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
    load();
  }, [clientId]);

  return (
    <div>
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10 py-4 mb-2 bg-background">
        <Link
          href="/seo"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors mb-3"
        >
          <svg
            className="w-3.5 h-3.5"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          >
            <path
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
              strokeWidth={2}
              d="M15 19l-7-7 7-7"
            />
          </svg>
          Back to Dashboard
        </Link>

        {data && (
          <>
            <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter">
              <span className="text-foreground font-bold">
                {data.clientName}
              </span>
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2">
              {data.projects.length} project
              {data.projects.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""} &middot;{" "}
              {data.asinCount} ASIN{data.asinCount !== 1 ? "s" : ""} &middot;{" "}
              {data.exportCount} export{data.exportCount !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
            </p>
          </>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Content */}
      {loading ? (
        <Skeleton />
      ) : error ? (
        <div className="text-center py-12">
          <p className="text-sm text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">{error}</p>
          <Link
            href="/seo"
            className="text-xs text-brand hover:underline mt-2 inline-block"
          >
            Back to SEO Dashboard
          </Link>
        </div>
      ) : data && data.projects.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="text-center py-12 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <p className="mb-2">No SEO projects for this client yet.</p>
          <Link
            href="/seo"
            className="text-amber-700 hover:text-amber-600 underline dark:text-amber-400 dark:hover:text-amber-300"
          >
            Back to SEO Manager
          </Link>
        </div>
      ) : data ? (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Phase Overview */}
          <PhaseBreakdown breakdown={data.phaseBreakdown} />

                ({data.projects.length})

              {data.projects.map((p, index) => (
                <div
                  key={p.id}
                  className="rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white hover:border-stone-300 hover:shadow-md transition-all group card-glow animate-card-enter dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 dark:hover:border-zinc-700"
                  style={{ animationDelay: `${index * 50}ms` }}
                >
                  <Link href={`/seo/${p.id}/${sectionRoute[p.current_phase] || "intake"}`} className="block flex-1 min-w-0 p-5">
                    {/* TIER 1: Identity */}
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">

                      {p.export_info ? ` (${p.export_info.export_count})` : ""}

                              rel="noopener noreferrer"
                              className="text-brand hover:underline"
                              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                            >
                              Open
                            </a>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-muted-foreground/50">--</span>
                          )}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Action Button */}
          <div className="pt-2">
            <Link
              href={`/seo/manager?client=${clientId}`}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-brand px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover shadow-[0_0_16px_-4px_var(--brand-glow)] transition-all"
            >
              <svg
                className="w-4 h-4"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              >
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M13 7l5 5m0 0l-5 5m5-5H6"
                />
              </svg>
              Open in SEO Manager
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Minimal markdown renderer ────────────────────────────────────────

function MarkdownPreview({ content }: { content: string }) {
  const lines = content.split("\n");
  const elements: React.ReactNode[] = [];
  let i = 0;

  while (i < lines.length) {
    const line = lines[i];
    if (line.startsWith("```")) {
      const codeLines: string[] = [];
      i++;
      while (i < lines.length && !lines[i].startsWith("```")) { codeLines.push(lines[i]); i++; }
      elements.push(<pre key={i} className="my-2 rounded-md bg-card border border-border px-4 py-3 text-xs font-mono text-foreground/80 overflow-x-auto whitespace-pre">{codeLines.join("\n")}</pre>);
      i++; continue;
    }
    if (line.startsWith("# ")) { elements.push(<h1 key={i} className="text-lg font-extrabold text-foreground mt-6 mb-2 pb-1 border-b border-border">{line.slice(2)}</h1>); i++; continue; }
    if (line.startsWith("## ")) { elements.push(<h2 key={i} className="text-sm font-bold text-amber-400 mt-5 mb-1.5">{line.slice(3)}</h2>); i++; continue; }
    if (line.startsWith("### ")) { elements.push(<h3 key={i} className="text-xs font-bold text-foreground/80 mt-3 mb-1">{line.slice(4)}</h3>); i++; continue; }
    if (line.startsWith("- ")) {
      elements.push(
        <div key={i} className="flex gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
          <span className="mt-1 text-amber-500/60 shrink-0">•</span>
          <span dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: renderInline(line.slice(2)) }} />
        </div>
      );
      i++; continue;
    }
    if (line.trim() === "") { elements.push(<div key={i} className="h-1" />); i++; continue; }
    elements.push(<p key={i} className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed" dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: renderInline(line) }} />);
    i++;
  }
  return <div className="space-y-0.5">{elements}</div>;
}

function escapeHtml(text: string): string {
  return text
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;");
}

function renderInline(text: string): string {
  return escapeHtml(text)
    .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code class="rounded bg-muted px-1 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-amber-300">$1</code>')
    .replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, '<strong class="text-foreground font-semibold">$1</strong>')
    .replace(/\*([^*]+)\*/g, '<em class="text-foreground/80">$1</em>');
}

// ── Tab: Global Rules (preserved markdown editor) ────────────────────

function GlobalRulesTab({
  content,
  setContent,
  savedContent,
  onSave,
  saving,
  savedMsg,
  isAdmin,
  updatedAt,
  updatedBy,
}: {
  content: string;
  setContent: (v: string) => void;
  savedContent: string;
  onSave: () => void;
  saving: boolean;
  savedMsg: boolean;
  isAdmin: boolean;
  updatedAt: string | null;
  updatedBy: string;
}) {
  const isDirty = content !== savedContent;
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<"edit" | "preview" | "split">("split");

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            Global AI rules and guidelines injected into every Claude call.
            {updatedAt && (
              <span className="ml-2 text-muted-foreground/50">
                Last saved {new Date(updatedAt).toLocaleString()}
                {updatedBy && updatedBy !== "system" ? ` by ${updatedBy}` : ""}
              </span>
            )}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {isAdmin && (
            <label className="cursor-pointer rounded-lg border border-border px-3 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:border-foreground/30 transition-colors">
              Upload .md
              <input
                type="file"
                accept=".md,text/markdown,text/plain"
                className="hidden"
                onChange={(e) => {
                  const file = e.target.files?.[0];
                  if (!file) return;
                  const reader = new FileReader();
                  reader.onload = (ev) => {
                    const text = ev.target?.result as string;
                    if (typeof text === "string") setContent(text);
                  };
                  reader.readAsText(file);
                  e.target.value = "";
                }}
              />
            </label>
          )}
          <div className="flex rounded-lg border border-border overflow-hidden text-[10px] font-bold">
            {(["edit", "split", "preview"] as const).map((m) => (
              <button key={m} onClick={() => setMode(m)}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 capitalize transition-colors ${mode === m ? "bg-accent text-foreground" : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground/80"}`}>
                {m}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          {isAdmin && (
            <button
              onClick={onSave}
              disabled={saving || !isDirty}
              className={`rounded-lg px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition-all ${savedMsg ? "bg-emerald-600 text-white" : isDirty ? "bg-amber-500 text-black hover:bg-amber-400" : "bg-muted text-muted-foreground cursor-not-allowed"}`}
            >
              {saving ? "Saving..." : savedMsg ? "Saved" : "Save"}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className={`grid gap-4 ${mode === "split" ? "grid-cols-2" : "grid-cols-1"}`} style={{ height: "calc(100vh - 16rem)" }}>
        {(mode === "edit" || mode === "split") && (
          <div className="flex flex-col rounded-xl border border-border overflow-hidden">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-2 border-b border-border bg-muted/50">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">Markdown</span>
              {isDirty && <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-400">Unsaved changes</span>}
            </div>
            <textarea
              value={content}
              onChange={(e) => setContent(e.target.value)}
              readOnly={!isAdmin}
              spellCheck={false}
              className="flex-1 w-full resize-none bg-background px-5 py-4 font-mono text-xs text-foreground/80 leading-relaxed focus:outline-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground/40"
              placeholder="# SEO Manager — Global Configuration&#10;&#10;## Compliance Rules&#10;&#10;- Rule one&#10;- Rule two"
            />
          </div>
        )}
        {(mode === "preview" || mode === "split") && (
          <div className="flex flex-col rounded-xl border border-border overflow-hidden">
            <div className="px-4 py-2 border-b border-border bg-muted/50">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">Preview</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-6 py-5">
              {content.trim() ? <MarkdownPreview content={content} /> : <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/40 italic">Nothing to preview.</p>}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Main Page ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function SEOConfigPage() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const isAdmin = session?.user?.role === "admin";

  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>("pipeline");

  // Global rules state
  const [rulesContent, setRulesContent] = useState("");
  const [savedRulesContent, setSavedRulesContent] = useState("");
  const [rulesUpdatedAt, setRulesUpdatedAt] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [rulesUpdatedBy, setRulesUpdatedBy] = useState("");
  const [rulesSaving, setRulesSaving] = useState(false);
  const [rulesSavedMsg, setRulesSavedMsg] = useState(false);

  // AI config state
  const [aiConfig, setAiConfig] = useState<Record<string, AiFeatureConfig> | null>(null);
  const [localAiConfig, setLocalAiConfig] = useState<Record<string, AiFeatureConfig> | null>(null);
  const [aiSaving, setAiSaving] = useState(false);
  const aiHasChanges = localAiConfig !== null;
  const effectiveAiConfig = localAiConfig ?? aiConfig;

  // Skill config state
  const [skillConfig, setSkillConfig] = useState<SkillConfig>(DEFAULT_SKILL_CONFIG);
  const [savedSkillConfig, setSavedSkillConfig] = useState<SkillConfig>(DEFAULT_SKILL_CONFIG);
  const [skillSaving, setSkillSaving] = useState(false);
  const skillHasChanges = JSON.stringify(skillConfig) !== JSON.stringify(savedSkillConfig);

  // Loading
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Load all config on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    Promise.all([
      fetch("/api/seo/config").then((r) => r.json()),
      fetch("/api/admin/ai-config").then((r) => r.ok ? r.json() : null),
      fetch("/api/seo/config?key=skill_config").then((r) => r.ok ? r.json() : null),
    ])
      .then(([rulesData, aiData, skillData]) => {
        // Rules
        setRulesContent(rulesData.value ?? "");
        setSavedRulesContent(rulesData.value ?? "");
        setRulesUpdatedAt(rulesData.updated_at);
        setRulesUpdatedBy(rulesData.updated_by);

        // AI config
        if (aiData?.features) {
          setAiConfig(aiData.features);
        } else {
          // Build from defaults
          const defaults: Record<string, AiFeatureConfig> = {};
          for (const key of AI_FEATURE_KEYS) defaults[key] = { ...AI_DEFAULTS[key] };
          setAiConfig(defaults);
        }

        // Skill config
        if (skillData?.value) {
          try {
            const parsed = typeof skillData.value === "string" ? JSON.parse(skillData.value) : skillData.value;
            const merged = { ...DEFAULT_SKILL_CONFIG, ...parsed };
            setSkillConfig(merged);
            setSavedSkillConfig(merged);
          } catch { /* use defaults */ }
        }
      })
      .catch(() => setError("Failed to load configuration"))
      .finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  // AI config handlers
  function updateAiFeature(key: AiFeatureKey, field: keyof AiFeatureConfig, value: string | number | boolean) {
    const current = effectiveAiConfig;
    if (!current) return;
    setLocalAiConfig({ ...current, [key]: { ...current[key], [field]: value } });
  }

  function resetAiDefaults() {
    const reset: Record<string, AiFeatureConfig> = {};
    for (const key of AI_FEATURE_KEYS) reset[key] = { ...AI_DEFAULTS[key] };
    setLocalAiConfig(reset);
  }

  const saveAiConfig = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!effectiveAiConfig || aiSaving) return;
    setAiSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/ai-config", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ features: effectiveAiConfig }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to save");
      setAiConfig(effectiveAiConfig);
      setLocalAiConfig(null);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setAiSaving(false);
    }
  }, [effectiveAiConfig, aiSaving]);

  // Rules save handler
  const saveRules = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!isAdmin || rulesSaving) return;
    setRulesSaving(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/seo/config", {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ value: rulesContent }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error((await res.json()).error || "Save failed");
      const data = await res.json();
      setSavedRulesContent(rulesContent);
      setRulesUpdatedAt(data.updated_at);
      setRulesUpdatedBy(data.updated_by);
      setRulesSavedMsg(true);
      setTimeout(() => setRulesSavedMsg(false), 2500);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setRulesSaving(false);
    }
  }, [rulesContent, isAdmin, rulesSaving]);

  // Skill config save handler
  const saveSkillConfig = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!isAdmin || skillSaving) return;
    setSkillSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/seo/config", {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ key: "skill_config", value: JSON.stringify(skillConfig) }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to save skill config");
      setSavedSkillConfig({ ...skillConfig });
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setSkillSaving(false);
    }
  }, [skillConfig, isAdmin, skillSaving]);

  // Ctrl/Cmd+S to save active tab
  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && e.key === "s") {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (tab === "rules") saveRules();
        else if (tab === "ai-steps") saveAiConfig();
        else if (tab === "skills") saveSkillConfig();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener("keydown", handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handler);
  }, [tab, saveRules, saveAiConfig, saveSkillConfig]);

  const TABS: { id: Tab; label: string }[] = [
    { id: "pipeline", label: "Pipeline" },
    { id: "ai-steps", label: "AI Steps" },
    { id: "skills", label: "/seo Skills" },
    { id: "rules", label: "Global Rules" },
  ];

  return (
    <div>
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10 py-4 mb-2 bg-background">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
          <Link href="/seo" className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground/80 transition-colors">
            ← SEO Projects
          </Link>
          <span className="text-muted-foreground/40">/</span>
        </div>
        <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter mb-3">
          <span className="text-foreground font-bold">SEO</span><span className="text-brand">Configuration</span>
        </h1>

        {/* Tab bar */}
        <div className="flex gap-1 border-b border-border -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10">
          {TABS.map((t) => (
            <button
              key={t.id}
              onClick={() => setTab(t.id)}
              className={`px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold transition-colors border-b-2 -mb-px ${tab === t.id ? "border-brand text-foreground" : "border-transparent text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground/80"}`}
            >
              {t.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {!isAdmin && (
        <div className="mb-4 rounded-lg border border-amber-500/20 bg-amber-500/5 px-4 py-2 text-xs text-amber-400">
          View-only — admin access required to edit.
        </div>
      )}

      {error && (
        <div className="mb-4 rounded-lg border border-red-500/30 bg-red-500/5 px-4 py-2 text-xs text-red-400 flex items-center justify-between">
          {error}
          <button onClick={() => setError(null)} className="text-red-500 underline text-[10px]">Dismiss</button>
        </div>
      )}

      {loading ? (
        <div className="text-center py-20 text-muted-foreground text-sm">Loading configuration...</div>
      ) : (
        <div className="mt-4">
          {tab === "pipeline" && <PipelineOverview aiConfig={effectiveAiConfig} />}
          {tab === "ai-steps" && effectiveAiConfig && (
            <AIStepsTab
              aiConfig={effectiveAiConfig}
              onUpdate={updateAiFeature}
              onSave={saveAiConfig}
              onReset={resetAiDefaults}
              hasChanges={aiHasChanges}
              saving={aiSaving}
              isAdmin={isAdmin}
            />
          )}
          {tab === "skills" && (
            <SkillsTab
              config={skillConfig}
              onChange={(key, value) => setSkillConfig((prev) => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }))}
              onSave={saveSkillConfig}
              hasChanges={skillHasChanges}
              saving={skillSaving}
              isAdmin={isAdmin}
            />
          )}
          {tab === "rules" && (
            <GlobalRulesTab
              content={rulesContent}
              setContent={setRulesContent}
              savedContent={savedRulesContent}
              onSave={saveRules}
              saving={rulesSaving}
              savedMsg={rulesSavedMsg}
              isAdmin={isAdmin}
              updatedAt={rulesUpdatedAt}
              updatedBy={rulesUpdatedBy}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Quality Badge ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function QualityBadge({ score }: { score: number | null | undefined }) {
  if (score == null) return null;

  const color = score >= 80
    ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400"
    : score >= 60
      ? "bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-500/20 dark:text-amber-400"
      : "bg-red-50 text-red-600 dark:bg-red-500/10 dark:text-red-400";

  const label = score >= 80 ? "good" : score >= 60 ? "moderate" : "needs improvement";

  return (
    <span
      className={`rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[8px] font-bold ${color}`}
      aria-label={`Quality score: ${score} out of 100, ${label}`}
    >
      <span className="hidden sm:inline">Quality: </span>{score}
    </span>
  );
}

function ProjectMenu({
  onRename, onDelete, onDuplicate, onChangeClient, onLinkVariation, onClose, showLinkVariation,
}: {
  onRename: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
  onDuplicate: () => void;
  onChangeClient: () => void;
  onLinkVariation: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
  showLinkVariation: boolean;
}) {
  const ref = useOutsideClick<HTMLDivElement>(onClose);

  const itemClass = "w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-50 transition-colors dark:text-zinc-300 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 focus:bg-stone-50 dark:focus:bg-zinc-800 outline-none";

  function handleKeyDown(e: React.KeyboardEvent) {
    if (e.key === "Escape") { onClose(); return; }
    if (e.key === "ArrowDown" || e.key === "ArrowUp") {
      e.preventDefault();
      const items = (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>("[role=menuitem]");
      const current = document.activeElement as HTMLElement;
      const idx = Array.from(items).indexOf(current as HTMLButtonElement);
      const next = e.key === "ArrowDown"
        ? items[(idx + 1) % items.length]
        : items[(idx - 1 + items.length) % items.length];
      next?.focus();
    }
  }

  return (
    <div ref={ref} role="menu" onKeyDown={handleKeyDown} className="absolute right-0 bottom-full mb-1 z-50 w-44 rounded-lg border border-stone-200 bg-white shadow-xl py-1 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">
      <button role="menuitem" onMouseDown={onRename} className={itemClass}>
        <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-stone-400 dark:text-zinc-500" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M11 5H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v11a2 2 0 002 2h11a2 2 0 002-2v-5m-1.414-9.414a2 2 0 112.828 2.828L11.828 15H9v-2.828l8.586-8.586z" /></svg>
        Rename
      </button>
      <button role="menuitem" onMouseDown={onDuplicate} className={itemClass}>
        <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-stone-400 dark:text-zinc-500" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M8 16H6a2 2 0 01-2-2V6a2 2 0 012-2h8a2 2 0 012 2v2m-6 12h8a2 2 0 002-2v-8a2 2 0 00-2-2h-8a2 2 0 00-2 2v8a2 2 0 002 2z" /></svg>
        New Version
      </button>
      <button role="menuitem" onMouseDown={onChangeClient} className={itemClass}>
        <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-stone-400 dark:text-zinc-500" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 20H7m10 0v-2c0-.656-.126-1.283-.356-1.857M7 20H2v-2a3 3 0 015.356-1.857M7 20v-2c0-.656.126-1.283.356-1.857m0 0a5.002 5.002 0 019.288 0M15 7a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z" /></svg>
        Change Client
      </button>
      {showLinkVariation && (
        <>
          <div className="my-1 border-t border-stone-200 dark:border-zinc-800" />
          <button role="menuitem" onMouseDown={onLinkVariation} className={itemClass}>
            <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-stone-400 dark:text-zinc-500" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M13.828 10.172a4 4 0 00-5.656 0l-4 4a4 4 0 105.656 5.656l1.102-1.101m-.758-4.899a4 4 0 005.656 0l4-4a4 4 0 00-5.656-5.656l-1.1 1.1" /></svg>
            Link to Variation
          </button>
        </>
      )}
      <div className="my-1 border-t border-stone-200 dark:border-zinc-800" />
      <button role="menuitem" onMouseDown={onDelete} className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 transition-colors dark:text-red-400 dark:hover:bg-red-500/10 focus:bg-red-50 dark:focus:bg-red-500/10 outline-none">
        <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16" /></svg>
        Delete SEO
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
