function RenameModal({
  project, onSave, onClose,
}: {
  project: ProjectSummary;
  onSave: (name: string, brand: string) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const [name, setName] = useState(project.name);
  const [brand, setBrand] = useState(project.brand_name);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 dark:bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground mb-4">Rename Project</h3>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div>
            <label className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground mb-1 block">Project Name</label>
            <input autoFocus value={name} onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full rounded-md border border-stone-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-foreground focus:border-amber-500 focus:outline-none dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800"
              onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === "Enter") onSave(name, brand); }} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground mb-1 block">Brand Name</label>
            <input value={brand} onChange={e => setBrand(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full rounded-md border border-stone-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-foreground focus:border-amber-500 focus:outline-none dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800"
              onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === "Enter") onSave(name, brand); }} />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 mt-5">
          <button onClick={onClose} className="rounded-lg border border-stone-300 px-4 py-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:bg-stone-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">Cancel</button>
          <button onClick={() => onSave(name, brand)} disabled={!name.trim()} className="rounded-lg bg-brand px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover disabled:opacity-50">Save</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Delete Modal ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function DeleteModal({
  project, onConfirm, onClose,
}: {
  project: ProjectSummary;
  onConfirm: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const [typed, setTyped] = useState("");
  const needsConfirm = typed.toLowerCase() === "delete";

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 dark:bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-xl border border-red-300 bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl dark:border-red-500/30 dark:bg-zinc-900" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 mb-2">Delete Project</h3>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1">
          This will permanently delete <span className="font-bold text-foreground">{project.name}</span> and all its data.
        </p>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/70 mb-4">This action cannot be undone.</p>
        <div>
          <label className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground mb-1 block">Type <span className="text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">delete</span> to confirm</label>
          <input value={typed} onChange={e => setTyped(e.target.value)} placeholder="delete"
            className="w-full rounded-md border border-stone-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-foreground focus:border-red-500 focus:outline-none dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800"
            onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === "Enter" && needsConfirm) onConfirm(); }} />
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 mt-5">
          <button onClick={onClose} className="rounded-lg border border-stone-300 px-4 py-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:bg-stone-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">Cancel</button>
          <button onClick={onConfirm} disabled={!needsConfirm} className="rounded-lg bg-red-600 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-red-500 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed dark:bg-red-500 dark:hover:bg-red-400">Delete Permanently</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Assignee Select (Create form) ────────────────────────────────────

function AssigneeSelect({
  value, team, onChange,
}: {
  value: string;
  team: TeamMember[];
  onChange: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const ref = useOutsideClick<HTMLDivElement>(() => setOpen(false));
  const selected = team.find((m) => m.id === value);

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className="relative">
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
        className="w-full rounded-md border border-stone-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-xs text-left text-foreground focus:border-amber-500 focus:outline-none dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 flex items-center gap-2">
        {selected ? (
          <>
            <AvatarCircle name={selected.name} image={selected.image} size={18} />
            <span>{selected.name || selected.email}</span>
          </>
        ) : (
          <span className="text-muted-foreground">Select assignee...</span>
        )}
      </button>
      {open && (
        <div className="absolute left-0 top-full mt-1 z-30 w-full rounded-lg border border-stone-200 bg-white shadow-xl py-1 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">
          <button type="button" onClick={() => { onChange(""); setOpen(false); }}
            className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:bg-stone-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
            No assignee
          </button>
          {team.map((m) => (
            <button type="button" key={m.id} onClick={() => { onChange(m.id); setOpen(false); }}
              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs hover:bg-stone-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 ${m.id === value ? "bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-500/10" : ""}`}>
              <AvatarCircle name={m.name} image={m.image} size={18} />
              <span className="text-foreground">{m.name || m.email}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Inline Assignee Picker ───────────────────────────────────────────

function InlineAssigneePicker({
  project, team, isOpen, onToggle, onSelect, onClose, isAdmin, currentUserId,
}: {
  project: ProjectSummary;
  team: TeamMember[];
  isOpen: boolean;
  onToggle: (e: React.MouseEvent) => void;
  onSelect: (userId: string) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
  isAdmin: boolean;
  currentUserId?: string;
}) {
  const ref = useOutsideClick<HTMLDivElement>(onClose, isOpen);

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className="relative">
      {project.assigned_to ? (
        <button type="button"
          onClick={(isAdmin || project.assigned_to === currentUserId) ? onToggle : undefined}
          className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 ${(isAdmin || project.assigned_to === currentUserId) ? "cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80" : ""}`}
          title={project.assignee_name || "Assigned"}>
          <AvatarCircle name={project.assignee_name} image={project.assignee_image} size={22} />
          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground max-w-[80px] truncate hidden sm:inline">
            {project.assignee_name?.split(" ")[0] || "Assigned"}
          </span>
        </button>
      ) : (
        <button type="button"
          onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); if (isAdmin) { onToggle(e); } else if (currentUserId) { onSelect(currentUserId); } }}
          className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/50 hover:text-muted-foreground border border-dashed border-stone-300 dark:border-zinc-700 rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 transition-colors">
          {isAdmin ? "+ Assign" : "+ Claim"}
        </button>
      )}
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="absolute right-0 top-full mt-1 z-30 w-52 rounded-lg border border-stone-200 bg-white shadow-xl py-1 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">
          {project.assigned_to && (
            <button type="button" onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); onSelect(""); }}
              className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:bg-stone-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
              Unassign
            </button>
          )}
          {team.map((m) => (
            <button type="button" key={m.id}
              onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); onSelect(m.id); }}
              className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-xs hover:bg-stone-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800 ${m.id === project.assigned_to ? "bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-500/10" : ""}`}>
              <AvatarCircle name={m.name} image={m.image} size={18} />
              <span className="text-foreground">{m.name || m.email}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Client Picker Modal ──────────────────────────────────────────────

function ClientPickerModal({
  project, clients, onSave, onClose,
}: {
  project: ProjectSummary;
  clients: ClientEntry[];
  onSave: (clientIdCode: string) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(project.client_id_code || "");

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 dark:bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground mb-4">Change Client</h3>
        <select value={selected} onChange={e => setSelected(e.target.value)}
          className="w-full rounded-md border border-stone-300 bg-white px-3 py-2 text-sm text-foreground focus:border-amber-500 focus:outline-none dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">
          <option value="">No client</option>
          {clients.map((c) => (
            <option key={c.clientIdCode} value={c.clientIdCode}>{c.clientName}</option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 mt-5">
          <button onClick={onClose} className="rounded-lg border border-stone-300 px-4 py-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:bg-stone-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">Cancel</button>
          <button onClick={() => onSave(selected)} className="rounded-lg bg-brand px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover">Save</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Main Content ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function SEOManagerContent() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const clientFilter = searchParams.get("client");
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const isAdmin = session?.user?.role === "admin";

  // Data
  const [projects, setProjects] = useState<ProjectSummary[]>([]);
  const [team, setTeam] = useState<TeamMember[]>([]);
  const [activeClients, setActiveClients] = useState<ClientEntry[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  // Create form moved to /seo/new wizard

  // UI state
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [assigneePickerOpen, setAssigneePickerOpen] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [renaming, setRenaming] = useState<ProjectSummary | null>(null);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState<ProjectSummary | null>(null);
  const [changingClient, setChangingClient] = useState<ProjectSummary | null>(null);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState(false);

  // Bulk mode
  const [bulkMode, setBulkMode] = useState(false);
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

  // Diff modal
  const [diffVersions, setDiffVersions] = useState<{ v1: SeoVersion; v2: SeoVersion } | null>(null);

  // Lookups
  const clientNameMap = Object.fromEntries(activeClients.map((c) => [c.clientIdCode, c.clientName]));
  const filteredProjects = clientFilter
    ? projects.filter((p) => p.client_id_code === clientFilter)
    : projects;

  // ── Data loading ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const loadProjects = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/seo/projects");
      if (res.ok) setProjects(await res.json());
    } catch { }
    setLoading(false);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadProjects();
    fetch("/api/seo/team").then((r) => r.ok ? r.json() : []).then(setTeam).catch(() => {});
    fetch("/api/clients").then((r) => r.ok ? r.json() : []).then(setActiveClients).catch(() => {});
  }, [loadProjects]);

  // ── Project actions ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async function renameProject(id: string, name: string, brand: string) {
    setActionLoading(true);
    try {
      await fetch(`/api/seo/projects/${id}`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ name, brand_name: brand }),
      });
      setProjects(prev => prev.map(p => p.id === id ? { ...p, name, brand_name: brand } : p));
    } catch { }
    setRenaming(null);
    setActionLoading(false);
  }

  async function deleteProject(id: string) {
    setActionLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/seo/projects/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" });
      if (res.ok) {
        setProjects(prev => prev.filter(p => p.id !== id));
      } else {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: "Delete failed" }));
        alert(err.error || "Failed to delete project");
      }
    } catch (e: unknown) {
      alert(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to delete project");
    }
    setDeleting(null);
    setActionLoading(false);
  }

  async function duplicateProject(project: ProjectSummary) {
    setActionLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/seo/projects/${project.id}/duplicate`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        await loadProjects();
        router.push(`/seo/${data.id}/intake`);
      }
    } catch { }
    setMenuOpen(null);
    setActionLoading(false);
  }

  async function updateAssignee(projectId: string, assignedTo: string) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/seo/projects/${projectId}`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ assigned_to: assignedTo || null }),
      });
      if (res.ok) await loadProjects();
    } catch { }
  }

  async function linkToVariation(project: ProjectSummary) {
    setMenuOpen(null);
    toast.promise(
      fetch(`/api/seo/projects/${project.id}/link-variation`, { method: "POST" })
        .then(async (res) => {
          const data = await res.json();
          if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || "Failed to link");
          await loadProjects();
          if (data.unmatchedAsins?.length > 0 || data.unassignedAsins?.length > 0) {
            const warns: string[] = [];
            if (data.unmatchedAsins.length > 0) warns.push(`${data.unmatchedAsins.length} ASINs not in catalog`);
            if (data.unassignedAsins.length > 0) warns.push(`${data.unassignedAsins.length} ASINs not in a variation`);
            toast.warning(`Linked with warnings: ${warns.join(", ")}`, { duration: 6000 });
          }
          return data;
        }),
      {
        loading: "Linking to variation...",
        success: (data) => `Linked to ${data.variationCode} (V${data.version})`,
        error: (err) => err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to link to variation",
      }
    );
  }

  async function updateClient(projectId: string, clientIdCode: string) {
    setActionLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/seo/projects/${projectId}`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ client_id_code: clientIdCode || null }),
      });
      if (res.ok) await loadProjects();
    } catch { }
    setChangingClient(null);
    setActionLoading(false);
  }

  // ── Bulk operations ────────────────────────────────────────────────

  function toggleSelect(id: string) {
    setSelectedIds((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  }

  async function bulkApprove() {
    const res = await fetch("/api/seo/projects/bulk", {
      method: "PATCH",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ action: "approve", projectIds: [...selectedIds] }),
    });
    if (res.ok) {
      setBulkMode(false);
      setSelectedIds(new Set());
      await loadProjects();
    }
  }

  async function bulkExport() {
    const res = await fetch("/api/seo/projects/bulk", {
      method: "PATCH",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ action: "export", projectIds: [...selectedIds] }),
    });
    if (res.ok) {
      setBulkMode(false);
      setSelectedIds(new Set());
      await loadProjects();
    }
  }

  async function bulkReassign(userId: string) {
    const res = await fetch("/api/seo/projects/bulk", {
      method: "PATCH",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ action: "reassign", projectIds: [...selectedIds], assignTo: userId }),
    });
    if (res.ok) {
      setBulkMode(false);
      setSelectedIds(new Set());
      await loadProjects();
    }
  }

  // ── Keyboard handlers ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  useEffect(() => {
    function handleKeyDown(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (e.key === "Escape" && bulkMode) {
        setBulkMode(false);
        setSelectedIds(new Set());
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  }, [bulkMode]);

  // ── Render ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const currentUserId = team.find(m => m.email === session?.user?.email)?.id;

  return (
    <div className={bulkMode && selectedIds.size > 0 ? "pb-20" : ""}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10 py-4 mb-2 bg-background">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter">
            <span className="text-foreground font-bold">SEO</span><span className="text-brand">Manager</span>
          </h1>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">
            {isAdmin && (
              <Link href="/seo/config"
                className="rounded-lg border border-stone-300 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-stone-500 hover:text-stone-700 hover:bg-stone-50 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:text-zinc-200 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800">
                <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M10.325 4.317c.426-1.756 2.924-1.756 3.35 0a1.724 1.724 0 002.573 1.066c1.543-.94 3.31.826 2.37 2.37a1.724 1.724 0 001.065 2.572c1.756.426 1.756 2.924 0 3.35a1.724 1.724 0 00-1.066 2.573c.94 1.543-.826 3.31-2.37 2.37a1.724 1.724 0 00-2.572 1.065c-.426 1.756-2.924 1.756-3.35 0a1.724 1.724 0 00-2.573-1.066c-1.543.94-3.31-.826-2.37-2.37a1.724 1.724 0 00-1.065-2.572c-1.756-.426-1.756-2.924 0-3.35a1.724 1.724 0 001.066-2.573c-.94-1.543.826-3.31 2.37-2.37.996.608 2.296.07 2.572-1.065z" />
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15 12a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z" />
                </svg>
                Config
              </Link>
            )}
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setBulkMode(!bulkMode);
                if (bulkMode) setSelectedIds(new Set());
              }}
              className={`rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold transition-colors ${
                bulkMode
                  ? "border-brand bg-brand/10 text-brand"
                  : "border-stone-300 text-muted-foreground hover:bg-stone-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
              }`}
            >
              {bulkMode ? "Cancel Select" : "Select"}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => router.push("/seo/new")}
              className="rounded-lg bg-brand px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover shadow-[0_0_16px_-4px_var(--brand-glow)]"
            >
              + New Project
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2">Amazon Listing Optimization &mdash; RUFUS &amp; COSMO System</p>
      </div>

      {/* Client filter banner */}
      {clientFilter && (
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-amber-300/40 bg-amber-50 px-4 py-2.5 dark:border-amber-500/20 dark:bg-amber-500/5">
          <span className="text-xs text-foreground">
            Showing <span className="font-bold">{filteredProjects.length}</span> project{filteredProjects.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""} for{" "}
            <span className="font-bold">{clientNameMap[clientFilter] || clientFilter}</span>
          </span>
          <Link href="/seo/manager" className="text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-700 hover:text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 dark:hover:text-amber-300 underline">
            Clear filter
          </Link>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Section legend */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-4 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
        <span>Status:</span>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><div className="w-3 h-3 rounded bg-emerald-100 border border-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-500/20 dark:border-emerald-500/30" /><span>Approved</span></div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><div className="w-3 h-3 rounded bg-amber-100 border border-amber-300 dark:bg-amber-500/20 dark:border-amber-500/30" /><span>Active</span></div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><div className="w-3 h-3 rounded bg-stone-200 border border-stone-300 dark:bg-zinc-800/50 dark:border-zinc-800" /><span>Pending</span></div>
      </div>

      {/* Projects list -- grouped by client */}
      {loading ? (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {[1, 2].map((i) => (
            <div key={i} className="space-y-3">
              <div className="h-4 w-48 bg-muted-foreground/10 rounded animate-pulse" />
              <div className="rounded-xl border border-stone-200 dark:border-zinc-800 p-5 space-y-3">
                <div className="flex justify-between">
                  <div className="h-5 w-56 bg-muted-foreground/10 rounded animate-pulse" />
                  <div className="h-5 w-24 bg-muted-foreground/10 rounded animate-pulse" />
                </div>
                <div className="h-4 w-80 bg-muted-foreground/10 rounded animate-pulse" />
                <div className="h-4 w-64 bg-muted-foreground/10 rounded animate-pulse" />
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {(() => {
            const grouped: Record<string, ProjectSummary[]> = {};
            for (const p of filteredProjects) {
              const key = p.client_id_code || "__none__";
              if (!grouped[key]) grouped[key] = [];
              grouped[key].push(p);
            }
            const sortedKeys = Object.keys(grouped).sort((a, b) => {
              if (a === "__none__") return 1;
              if (b === "__none__") return -1;
              return (clientNameMap[a] || a).localeCompare(clientNameMap[b] || b);
            });
            let globalIndex = 0;
            return sortedKeys.map((clientKey) => (
              <div key={clientKey}>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                  <h2 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-brand">
                    {clientKey === "__none__" ? "No Client" : clientNameMap[clientKey] || clientKey}
                  </h2>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">({grouped[clientKey].length})</span>
                  <div className="flex-1 h-px bg-border" />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2.5">
                  {grouped[clientKey].map((p) => {
                    const index = globalIndex++;
                    const isSelected = selectedIds.has(p.id);
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={p.id}
                        className={`rounded-xl border transition-all group card-glow animate-card-enter ${
                          isSelected
                            ? "border-amber-300/40 bg-amber-50 dark:border-amber-500/20 dark:bg-amber-500/5"
                            : "border-stone-200 bg-white hover:border-stone-300 hover:shadow-md dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 dark:hover:border-zinc-700"
                        }`}
                        style={{ animationDelay: `${index * 50}ms` }}
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-start gap-4 p-5">
                          {/* Bulk checkbox */}
                          {bulkMode && (
                            <button
                              onClick={() => toggleSelect(p.id)}
                              className="mt-1 shrink-0 w-[44px] h-[44px] flex items-center justify-center"
                              aria-label={isSelected ? "Deselect project" : "Select project"}
                            >
                              <div className={`w-5 h-5 rounded border-2 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center ${
                                isSelected
                                  ? "border-brand bg-brand"
                                  : "border-stone-300 dark:border-zinc-600"
                              }`}>
                                {isSelected && (
                                  <svg className="w-3 h-3 text-brand-foreground" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={3} d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" />
                                  </svg>
                                )}
                              </div>
                            </button>
                          )}

                          <a href={`/seo/${p.id}/${sectionRoute[p.current_phase] || "intake"}`} className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                            {/* TIER 1: Identity */}
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                              <div className="min-w-0">
                                <div className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground group-hover:text-amber-800 dark:group-hover:text-zinc-100 truncate flex items-center gap-1.5">{p.name}{p.variation_id && <span className="px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-bold bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20 shrink-0">V{p.version}</span>}</div>
                                <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                                  {p.brand_name || "No brand"} &middot; Created {new Date(p.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 ml-3">
                                <InlineAssigneePicker
                                  project={p} team={team}
                                  isOpen={assigneePickerOpen === p.id}
                                  onToggle={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); setAssigneePickerOpen(assigneePickerOpen === p.id ? null : p.id); }}
                                  onSelect={(userId) => { setAssigneePickerOpen(null); updateAssignee(p.id, userId); }}
                                  onClose={() => setAssigneePickerOpen(null)}
                                  isAdmin={isAdmin}
                                  currentUserId={currentUserId}
                                />
                                <span className="rounded-md bg-amber-100 px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-500/20 dark:text-amber-400">
                                  {p.current_phase} {phaseLabel[p.current_phase] || ""}
                                </span>
                                <span className={`rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[8px] font-bold ${
                                  p.status === "in_progress" ? "bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-400/70" :
                                  p.status === "completed" ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400" :
                                  "bg-stone-100 text-stone-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500"
                                }`}>{p.status}</span>
                              </div>
                            </div>

                            {/* TIER 2: Status (dots + quality + export) */}
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-1">
                              <SectionDots project={p} />
                              {p.variation_code && (
                                <span className="rounded-md bg-violet-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[8px] font-bold text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-500/10 dark:text-violet-400">
                                  {p.variation_code}
                                </span>
                              )}
                              <QualityBadge score={p.quality_score?.overall_score} />
                              <ExportBadge exportInfo={p.export_info} />
                            </div>

                            {/* TIER 3: Content Preview */}
                            <ContentPreview preview={p.content_preview} phase={p.current_phase} />

                            {/* TIER 4: Drill-down accordions */}
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-6 mt-3" onClick={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>
                              <VersionTimeline
                                projectId={p.id}
                                asin="" sku=""
                                onCompare={(v1, v2) => setDiffVersions({ v1, v2 })}
                              />
                              <div>
                                <button
                                  className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors flex items-center gap-1"
                                  onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); }}
                                >
                                  <span>&#9656;</span> Export History
                                  {p.export_info ? ` (${p.export_info.export_count})` : ""}
                                </button>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </a>

                          <div className="relative shrink-0">
                            <button
                              onClick={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); setMenuOpen(menuOpen === p.id ? null : p.id); }}
                              className="p-1.5 rounded-md text-stone-400 hover:text-stone-600 hover:bg-stone-100 transition-colors dark:text-zinc-600 dark:hover:text-zinc-400 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
                            >
                              <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                                <path d="M10 6a2 2 0 110-4 2 2 0 010 4zM10 12a2 2 0 110-4 2 2 0 010 4zM10 18a2 2 0 110-4 2 2 0 010 4z" />
                              </svg>
                            </button>
                            {menuOpen === p.id && (
                              <ProjectMenu
                                onRename={() => { setMenuOpen(null); setRenaming(p); }}
                                onDelete={() => { setMenuOpen(null); setDeleting(p); }}
                                onDuplicate={() => duplicateProject(p)}
                                onChangeClient={() => { setMenuOpen(null); setChangingClient(p); }}
                                onLinkVariation={() => linkToVariation(p)}
                                showLinkVariation={!p.variation_id}
                                onClose={() => setMenuOpen(null)}
                              />
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            ));
          })()}

          {filteredProjects.length === 0 && (
            <div className="text-center py-12 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {clientFilter ? (
                <p>No SEO projects found for this client.</p>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <p className="mb-2">No SEO projects yet.</p>
                  <button onClick={() => router.push("/seo/new")} className="text-amber-700 hover:text-amber-600 underline dark:text-amber-400 dark:hover:text-amber-300">Create your first project</button>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Bulk Action Bar */}
      {bulkMode && (
        <BulkActionBar
          selectedCount={selectedIds.size}
          onApprove={bulkApprove}
          onExport={bulkExport}
          onReassign={bulkReassign}
          onClear={() => { setBulkMode(false); setSelectedIds(new Set()); }}
          team={team}
        />
      )}

      {/* Loading overlay */}
      {actionLoading && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-40 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/30 dark:bg-black/40">
          <div className="text-sm text-foreground bg-card rounded-lg px-4 py-3 shadow-lg border border-border/60">Processing...</div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Modals */}
      {renaming && (
        <RenameModal
          project={renaming}
          onSave={(name, brand) => renameProject(renaming.id, name, brand)}
          onClose={() => setRenaming(null)}
        />
      )}
      {deleting && (
        <DeleteModal
          project={deleting}
          onConfirm={() => deleteProject(deleting.id)}
          onClose={() => setDeleting(null)}
        />
      )}
      {changingClient && (
        <ClientPickerModal
          project={changingClient}
          clients={activeClients}
          onSave={(clientIdCode) => updateClient(changingClient.id, clientIdCode)}
          onClose={() => setChangingClient(null)}
        />
      )}
      {diffVersions && (
        <DiffModal
          v1={diffVersions.v1}
          v2={diffVersions.v2}
          onClose={() => setDiffVersions(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function SEOManagerPage() {
  return (
    <Suspense fallback={<div className="text-center py-10 text-muted-foreground text-sm">Loading...</div>}>
      <SEOManagerContent />
    </Suspense>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import Link from "next/link";
import { CalendarDays, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

type ClientGanttSummary = {
  clientIdCode: string;
  clientName: string | null;
  clientType: "AIA" | "NTA" | null;
  total: number;
  completed: number;
  inProgress: number;
  avgPct: number;
};

export default function TimelineLandingPage() {
  const { data, isLoading } = useQuery<ClientGanttSummary[]>({
    queryKey: ["gantt-summary"],
    queryFn: () => fetch("/api/gantt").then((r) => r.json()),
  });

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10 py-4 mb-4 bg-background">
        <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter">
          <span className="text-foreground font-bold">Client</span>
          <span className="text-brand font-medium">Timelines</span>
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
          13-week onboarding progress across all clients.
        </p>
      </div>

      {isLoading && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-16">
          <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
        </div>
      )}

      {!isLoading && (!data || data.length === 0) && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card p-16 text-center">
          <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 p-4 mb-4">
            <CalendarDays className="h-8 w-8 text-brand" />
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold mb-2">No timelines yet</h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground max-w-md mx-auto">
            Initialize a timeline from any client&apos;s detail page to start tracking onboarding progress.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {!isLoading && data && data.length > 0 && (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {data
            .sort((a, b) => (a.clientName ?? a.clientIdCode).localeCompare(b.clientName ?? b.clientIdCode))
            .map((client) => {
              const pct = client.total > 0 ? Math.round((client.completed / client.total) * 100) : 0;
              const allDone = client.completed === client.total;

              return (
                <Link
                  key={client.clientIdCode}
                  href={`/clients/${client.clientIdCode}/timeline`}
                  className="block rounded-xl border bg-card hover:border-stone-300 hover:shadow-md transition-all dark:hover:border-zinc-700"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-4 p-5">
                    {/* Left: client info */}
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                        <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold truncate">
                          {client.clientName ?? client.clientIdCode}
                        </h3>
                        {client.clientType && (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-300 dark:bg-amber-500/20 dark:text-amber-400 dark:border-amber-500/30">
                            {client.clientType}
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {allDone && (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-300 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:border-emerald-500/30">
                            Complete
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {client.clientIdCode} · {client.completed}/{client.total} tasks · {client.inProgress} in progress
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    {/* Right: progress */}
                    <div className="w-32 shrink-0">
                      <div className="w-full h-2 rounded-full bg-muted/50 overflow-hidden">
                        <div
                          className="h-full rounded-full bg-brand transition-all"
                          style={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
                        />
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-right text-xs font-bold tabular-nums text-brand mt-1">
                        {pct}%
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </Link>
              );
            })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogFooter,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import {
  Plus,
  Layers,
  FolderTree,
  Package,
  Loader2,
  Search,
  Lock,
  PackageOpen,
  Trash2,
} from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

// ── Types ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type ClientEntry = {
  clientIdCode: string;
  clientName: string;
};

type VariationSummary = {
  id: string;
  clientId: string;
  name: string;
  code: string;
  primaryDimension: string | null;
  themeAttributes: string[] | null;
  description: string | null;
  status: "draft" | "locked";
  lockedAt: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  productCount: number;
  groupCount: number;
  vpCount: number;
};

// ── Fetchers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

async function fetchClients(): Promise<ClientEntry[]> {
  const res = await fetch("/api/clients/list?status=Active");
  if (!res.ok) return [];
  return res.json();
}

async function fetchVariations(
  clientId: string
): Promise<VariationSummary[]> {
  const params = clientId ? `?clientId=${clientId}` : "";
  const res = await fetch(`/api/variations${params}`);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch variations");
  return res.json();
}

async function createVariation(body: {
  name: string;
  code: string;
  clientId: string;
}): Promise<VariationSummary> {
  const res = await fetch("/api/variations", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const text = await res.text();
    let msg = "Failed to create variation";
    try { msg = JSON.parse(text).error ?? msg; } catch { msg = text || msg; }
    throw new Error(`${msg} (${res.status})`);
  }
  return res.json();
}

// ── Component ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function VariationsPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const [selectedClient, setSelectedClient] = useState<string>("");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [newClient, setNewClient] = useState("");

  // ── Queries ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const { data: clients = [] } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["clients-list"],
    queryFn: fetchClients,
    staleTime: 5 * 60_000,
  });

  const {
    data: variations = [],
    isLoading,
    isError,
  } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["variations", selectedClient],
    queryFn: () => fetchVariations(selectedClient === "all" ? "" : selectedClient),
  });

  const createMut = useMutation({
    mutationFn: createVariation,
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["variations"] });
      setDialogOpen(false);
      setNewClient("");
      router.push(`/variations/${data.id}`);
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      toast.error(err.message);
    },
  });

  const deleteMut = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (id: string) => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/variations/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(err.error ?? "Failed to delete");
      }
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["variations"] });
      toast.success("Variation deleted");
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => toast.error(err.message),
  });

  // ── Derived ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const clientNameMap = useMemo(
    () =>
      Object.fromEntries(clients.map((c) => [c.clientIdCode, c.clientName])),
    [clients]
  );

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    if (!search) return variations;
    const q = search.toLowerCase();
    return variations.filter(
      (v) =>
        v.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        v.code.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
  }, [variations, search]);

  // Group by client
  const groupedByClient = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, VariationSummary[]>();
    for (const v of filtered) {
      const arr = map.get(v.clientId) ?? [];
      arr.push(v);
      map.set(v.clientId, arr);
    }
    // Sort client groups by name
    return Array.from(map.entries()).sort((a, b) => {
      const nameA = clientNameMap[a[0]] ?? a[0];
      const nameB = clientNameMap[b[0]] ?? b[0];
      return nameA.localeCompare(nameB);
    });
  }, [filtered, clientNameMap]);

  // ── Handlers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async function handleCreate() {
    if (!newClient) return;
    const name = "New Variation";
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/variations/next-code?clientId=${encodeURIComponent(newClient)}`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to get next code");
      const { code } = await res.json();
      createMut.mutate({ name, code, clientId: newClient });
    } catch {
      toast.error("Failed to generate variation code");
    }
  }

  function openDialog() {
    setNewClient(selectedClient && selectedClient !== "all" ? selectedClient : "");
    setDialogOpen(true);
  }

  // ── Render ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  return (
    <div>
      {/* Sticky header + toolbar */}
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10 pt-4 pb-4 bg-background">
        <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter mb-2">
          <span className="text-foreground font-bold">Variation</span>
          <span className="text-brand">Builder</span>
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4">
          Define variation families, groups, and cross-cutting tags for product
          catalogs.
        </p>

        {/* Toolbar */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <Select value={selectedClient} onValueChange={setSelectedClient}>
          <SelectTrigger className="w-[200px] rounded-md border border-stone-300 bg-white text-sm dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">
            <SelectValue placeholder="All clients" />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectItem value="all">All clients</SelectItem>
            {clients.map((c) => (
              <SelectItem key={c.clientIdCode} value={c.clientIdCode}>
                {c.clientName}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>

        <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[180px] max-w-[320px]">
          <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input
            placeholder="Search variations..."
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            className="pl-9 rounded-md border border-stone-300 bg-white text-sm dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900"
          />
        </div>

        <Button
          onClick={openDialog}
          className="rounded-lg bg-brand px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover shadow-[0_0_16px_-4px_var(--brand-glow)] ml-auto"
        >
          <Plus className="h-4 w-4 mr-1.5" />
          New Variation
        </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Content */}
      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {[1, 2].map((i) => (
            <div key={i}>
              <Skeleton className="h-5 w-40 mb-3" />
              <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
                {[1, 2].map((j) => (
                  <div
                    key={j}
                    className="rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-5 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900/50"
                  >
                    <Skeleton className="h-5 w-3/4 mb-3" />
                    <Skeleton className="h-4 w-1/2 mb-2" />
                    <div className="flex gap-2 mt-4">
                      <Skeleton className="h-6 w-16 rounded-md" />
                      <Skeleton className="h-6 w-16 rounded-md" />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : isError ? (
        <div className="text-center py-12 text-muted-foreground text-sm">
          Failed to load variations. Please try again.
        </div>
      ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="text-center py-16">
          <Layers className="h-10 w-10 text-muted-foreground/40 mx-auto mb-3" />
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {search
              ? "No variations match your search."
              : `No variations yet${selectedClient && selectedClient !== "all" ? ` for ${clientNameMap[selectedClient] ?? selectedClient}` : ""}. Create your first one.`}
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-8">
          {groupedByClient.map(([clientId, clientVariations]) => (
            <div key={clientId}>
              <h2 className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-brand mb-3">
                {clientNameMap[clientId] ?? clientId}
              </h2>
              <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
                {clientVariations.map((v) => (
                  <div
                    key={v.id}
                    onClick={() => router.push(`/variations/${v.id}`)}
                    className={cn(
                      "text-left rounded-xl border p-5 transition-all card-glow animate-card-enter cursor-pointer relative group",
                      v.status === "locked"
                        ? "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50/30 hover:border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-500/20 dark:bg-amber-500/5 dark:hover:border-amber-500/30"
                        : "border-stone-200 bg-white hover:border-stone-300 hover:shadow-md dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 dark:hover:border-zinc-700"
                    )}
                  >
                    <button
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        if (confirm(`Delete "${v.name}"? This cannot be undone.`)) deleteMut.mutate(v.id);
                      }}
                      className="absolute top-3 right-3 p-1.5 rounded-md opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500 hover:bg-red-50 dark:hover:bg-red-500/10"
                      title="Delete variation"
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </button>
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 mb-1 pr-6">
                      <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground truncate">
                        {v.name}
                      </h3>
                      {v.status === "locked" && (
                        <Badge className="rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 border-amber-300 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-400 dark:border-amber-500/30 shrink-0">
                          <Lock className="h-2.5 w-2.5 mr-1" />
                          Locked
                        </Badge>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground mb-3 font-mono">
                      {v.code}
                    </p>

                    {v.themeAttributes && v.themeAttributes.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mb-3">
                        {v.themeAttributes.map((attr) => (
                          <Badge
                            key={attr}
                            variant="secondary"
                            className="rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold"
                          >
                            {attr}
                          </Badge>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    )}

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mt-auto pt-2 border-t border-stone-100 dark:border-zinc-800">

                ))}

          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Create dialog */}
      <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>New Variation</DialogTitle>
          </DialogHeader>

          <div className="space-y-4 py-2">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label className="text-xs font-bold">Client</Label>
              <Select value={newClient} onValueChange={setNewClient}>
                <SelectTrigger className="rounded-md border border-stone-300 bg-white text-sm dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-white">
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Select client" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {clients.map((c) => (
                    <SelectItem key={c.clientIdCode} value={c.clientIdCode}>
                      {c.clientName}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter>
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)}
              className="rounded-lg border border-stone-300 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:bg-stone-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"

            </Button>

            >
              {createMut.isPending && (
                <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-1.5 animate-spin" />
              )}
              Create
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
