"use client";

import { useState, useMemo, useRef, useEffect, Fragment } from "react";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import {
  PackageOpen,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  ExternalLink,
  Loader2,
  Search,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronRight,
} from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { hiResAmazonImg } from "@/lib/utils";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";

// ── Types ─────────────────────────────────────────────

type ClientEntry = { clientIdCode: string; clientName: string };

type ProductEntry = {
  id: string;
  asin: string | null;
  sku: string | null;
  clientIdCode: string | null;
  itemName: string | null;
  summarizedTitle: string | null;
  mainImageUrl: string | null;
  varietyPackItemCount?: number;
  variations?: Record<string, string> | null;
};

type PackItem = {
  id?: string;
  includedProductId: string | null;
  includedAsin: string | null;
  includedSku: string | null;
  includedTitle: string | null;
  includedImage: string | null;
  flavor: string | null;
  size: string | null;
  color: string | null;
  style: string | null;
  customLabel: string | null;
  units: number;
};

type SiblingProduct = {
  id: string;
  asin: string | null;
  sku: string | null;
  itemName: string | null;
  summarizedTitle: string | null;
  mainImageUrl: string | null;
  flavor: string | null;
  size: string | null;
  color: string | null;
  style: string | null;
};

type VarietyPackProduct = {
  id: string;
  asin: string | null;
  sku: string | null;
  clientIdCode: string | null;
  itemName: string | null;
  summarizedTitle: string | null;
  mainImageUrl: string | null;
  itemCount: number;
  items: Array<{
    flavor: string | null;
    size: string | null;
    color: string | null;
    style: string | null;
    customLabel: string | null;
    units: number;
    includedAsin: string | null;
    includedSku: string | null;
    includedTitle: string | null;
  }>;
};

// ── Fetchers ──────────────────────────────────────────

async function fetchClients(): Promise<ClientEntry[]> {
  const res = await fetch("/api/clients/list?status=Active");
  if (!res.ok) return [];
  return res.json();
}

async function fetchProducts(client: string): Promise<ProductEntry[]> {
  const res = await fetch(
    `/api/products?client=${encodeURIComponent(client)}&pageSize=100&status=Active`
  );
  if (!res.ok) return [];
  const data = await res.json();
  if (Array.isArray(data)) return data;
  if (Array.isArray(data.data)) return data.data;
  if (Array.isArray(data.products)) return data.products;
  return [];
}

async function fetchVarietyPacks(client?: string): Promise<VarietyPackProduct[]> {
  const url = client ? `/api/variety-packs?client=${encodeURIComponent(client)}` : "/api/variety-packs";
  const res = await fetch(url);
  if (!res.ok) return [];
  return res.json();
}

async function fetchPackItems(productId: string): Promise<PackItem[]> {
  const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${productId}/variety-pack`);
  if (!res.ok) return [];
  return res.json();
}

async function fetchSiblings(productId: string): Promise<SiblingProduct[]> {
  const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${productId}/siblings`);
  if (!res.ok) return [];
  return res.json();
}

async function savePackItems(productId: string, items: PackItem[]): Promise<void> {
  const payload = {
    items: items.map((it) => ({
      includedProductId: it.includedProductId || null,
      flavor: it.flavor || "",
      size: it.size || "",
      color: it.color || "",
      style: it.style || "",
      customLabel: it.customLabel || "",
      units: it.units,
    })),
  };
  const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${productId}/variety-pack`, {
    method: "PUT",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(payload),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const text = await res.text().catch(() => "");
    throw new Error(`Failed to save (${res.status}): ${text}`);
  }
}

// ── Page ──────────────────────────────────────────────

export default function VarietyPacksPage() {
  const [selectedClient, setSelectedClient] = useState<string>("");
  const [selectedProduct, setSelectedProduct] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [productSearch, setProductSearch] = useState("");

  const { data: clients = [] } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["clients-list"],
    queryFn: fetchClients,
    staleTime: 5 * 60_000,
  });

  const { data: products = [], isLoading: productsLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["products-for-vp", selectedClient],
    queryFn: () => fetchProducts(selectedClient),
    enabled: !!selectedClient,
    staleTime: 60_000,
  });

  const { data: packs = [], isLoading: packsLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["variety-packs", selectedClient || "all"],
    queryFn: () => fetchVarietyPacks(selectedClient || undefined),
  });

  // Build client code → name lookup from fetched clients (same source as dropdown)
  const clientNameMap = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<string, string>();
    for (const c of clients) m.set(c.clientIdCode, c.clientName);
    return m;
  }, [clients]);

  // Group packs by client when showing all
  const groupedPacks = useMemo(() => {
    if (selectedClient || packs.length === 0) return null;
    const groups = new Map<string, VarietyPackProduct[]>();
    for (const pack of packs) {
      const key = pack.clientIdCode || "Unknown";
      if (!groups.has(key)) groups.set(key, []);
      groups.get(key)!.push(pack);
    }
    return [...groups.entries()].sort(([a], [b]) =>
      (clientNameMap.get(a) || a).localeCompare(clientNameMap.get(b) || b)
    );
  }, [packs, selectedClient, clientNameMap]);

  // Products filtered by search, excluding those that already have VPs
  const existingVpIds = useMemo(() => new Set(packs.map((p) => p.id)), [packs]);

  const filteredProducts = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedClient) return [];
    const q = productSearch.toLowerCase().trim();
    return products.filter((p) => {
      if (existingVpIds.has(p.id)) return false; // already a VP
      if (!q) return true;
      return (
        p.asin?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.sku?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.itemName?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.summarizedTitle?.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    });
  }, [products, productSearch, selectedClient, existingVpIds]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter mb-1">
          <span className="text-foreground font-bold">Variety</span><span className="text-brand">Packs</span>
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {packs.length} pack{packs.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""} across all clients.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Client picker + product selector row */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center gap-3">
        <Select value={selectedClient} onValueChange={(v) => { setSelectedClient(v === "all" ? "" : v); setSelectedProduct(null); setProductSearch(""); }}>
          <SelectTrigger className="w-[220px] rounded-md border border-border bg-card text-sm">
            <SelectValue placeholder="Select client" />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectItem value="all">All clients</SelectItem>
            {clients.map((c) => (
              <SelectItem key={c.clientIdCode} value={c.clientIdCode}>
                {c.clientName}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>

        {selectedClient && (
          <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-md">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search products to define as variety pack..."
              value={productSearch}
              onChange={(e) => setProductSearch(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full rounded-md border border-border bg-card pl-9 pr-3 py-2 text-sm text-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground/60 focus:border-brand-vp focus:outline-none"
            />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Product picker — shows all client products, search filters */}
      {selectedClient && !selectedProduct && (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card">
          {productsLoading ? (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-6">
              <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
            </div>
          ) : filteredProducts.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="px-4 py-4 text-xs text-muted-foreground">No matching products found.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="max-h-[480px] overflow-y-auto divide-y divide-border">
              {filteredProducts.slice(0, 30).map((p) => (
                <button
                  key={p.id}
                  onClick={() => { setSelectedProduct(p.id); setProductSearch(""); }}
                  className="flex items-center gap-3 w-full text-left px-4 py-2.5 hover:bg-muted/50 transition-colors"
                >
                  <div className="h-8 w-8 rounded border border-border bg-muted overflow-hidden shrink-0">
                    {p.mainImageUrl ? (
                      <img src={hiResAmazonImg(p.mainImageUrl, 100)} alt="" className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
                    ) : (
                      <div className="h-full w-full flex items-center justify-center">
                        <PackageOpen className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground/40" />
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-brand shrink-0">{p.asin || "—"}</span>
                      {p.sku && <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground shrink-0">{p.sku}</span>}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-foreground/80 truncate">{p.itemName || p.summarizedTitle || "—"}</p>
                    <VariationChips variations={p.variations} />
                  </div>
                  <Plus className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Inline composer for selected product */}
      {selectedProduct && (
        <PackComposer
          productId={selectedProduct}
          clientProducts={products}
          onClose={() => setSelectedProduct(null)}
        />
      )}

      {/* Existing variety packs */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        {packsLoading ? (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-12">
            <Loader2 className="h-5 w-5 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
          </div>
        ) : packs.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="text-center py-12 text-muted-foreground text-sm">
            {selectedClient
              ? "No variety packs for this client. Search a product above to define one."
              : "Select a client to view and manage variety packs."}
          </div>
        ) : groupedPacks ? (
          groupedPacks.map(([clientCode, clientPacks]) => (
            <Fragment key={clientCode}>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-2">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-wider text-muted-foreground">
                  {clientNameMap.get(clientCode) || clientCode}
                </span>
                <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0">
                  {clientPacks.length}
                </Badge>
                <div className="flex-1 border-t border-border/40" />
              </div>
              {clientPacks.map((pack) => (
                <ExistingPackCard key={pack.id} pack={pack} />
              ))}
            </Fragment>
          ))
        ) : (
          packs.map((pack) => (
            <ExistingPackCard key={pack.id} pack={pack} />
          ))
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Pack Composer (new VP definition) ─────────────────

function PackComposer({ productId, clientProducts, onClose }: { productId: string; clientProducts: ProductEntry[]; onClose: () => void }) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [items, setItems] = useState<PackItem[]>([]);
  const [customOptions, setCustomOptions] = useState<Record<string, Set<string>>>({
    flavor: new Set(), size: new Set(), color: new Set(), style: new Set(),
  });

  const { data: packItems = [], isLoading: packLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["variety-pack", productId],
    queryFn: () => fetchPackItems(productId),
  });

  const { data: product } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["product-basic", productId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${productId}`);
      if (!res.ok) return null;
      const data = await res.json();
      return data.data?.[0] || data;
    },
  });

  // Available products = all client products except the pack product itself
  const availableProducts = useMemo(
    () => clientProducts.filter((p) => p.id !== productId),
    [clientProducts, productId]
  );

  // Build available options from ALL client products (including pack itself)
  const familyOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const opts = { flavor: new Set<string>(), size: new Set<string>(), color: new Set<string>(), style: new Set<string>() };
    for (const p of clientProducts) {
      const v = p.variations;
      if (v?.Flavor) opts.flavor.add(v.Flavor);
      if (v?.Size) opts.size.add(v.Size);
      if (v?.Color) opts.color.add(v.Color);
      if (v?.Style) opts.style.add(v.Style);
    }
    // Merge custom options
    for (const key of Object.keys(opts) as Array<keyof typeof opts>) {
      for (const v of customOptions[key]) opts[key].add(v);
    }
    return opts;
  }, [clientProducts, customOptions]);

  // Which attribute columns to show (only if family has them)
  const showFlavor = familyOptions.flavor.size > 0;
  const showSize = familyOptions.size.size > 0;
  const showColor = familyOptions.color.size > 0;
  const showStyle = familyOptions.style.size > 0;
  const noAttributes = !showFlavor && !showSize && !showColor && !showStyle;

  // Init local items from server data
  const initialized = items.length > 0 || packItems.length === 0;
  if (!initialized && packItems.length > 0 && items.length === 0) {
    setItems([...packItems]);
  }

  const saveMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => savePackItems(productId, items),
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success("Variety pack saved");
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["variety-pack", productId] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["variety-packs"] });
      onClose();
    },
    onError: (err) => { console.error("VP save error:", err); toast.error("Failed to save variety pack"); },
  });

  function addItem() {
    setItems((prev) => [
      ...prev,
      {
        includedProductId: null, includedAsin: null, includedSku: null,
        includedTitle: null, includedImage: null, flavor: null,
        size: null, color: null, style: null, customLabel: null, units: 1,
      },
    ]);
  }

  function removeItem(idx: number) {
    setItems((prev) => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
  }

  function updateItem(idx: number, field: keyof PackItem, value: string | number) {
    setItems((prev) =>
      prev.map((it, i) => (i === idx ? { ...it, [field]: value } : it))
    );
  }

  function addCustomOption(field: string, value: string) {
    setCustomOptions((prev) => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      next[field] = new Set(prev[field]);
      next[field].add(value);
      return next;
    });
  }

  if (packLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-xl border-2 border-brand-vp/30 bg-card p-6 flex items-center justify-center">
        <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Build dynamic grid columns — attribute chips + units
  const attrCols = `${showFlavor ? "1fr " : ""}${showSize ? "1fr " : ""}${showColor ? "1fr " : ""}${showStyle ? "1fr " : ""}`;
  const gridCols = noAttributes ? "1fr 80px" : `${attrCols}80px`;

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border-2 border-brand-vp/30 bg-card p-4 space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted overflow-hidden shrink-0">
          {product?.mainImageUrl ? (
            <img src={hiResAmazonImg(product.mainImageUrl, 100)} alt="" className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
          ) : (
            <div className="h-full w-full flex items-center justify-center">
              <PackageOpen className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground/40" />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="font-mono text-xs text-brand">{product?.asin || "—"}</span>
            <Badge className="rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold bg-brand-vp/15 text-brand-vp border-brand-vp/30">
              New Pack
            </Badge>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-foreground/80 truncate mt-0.5">
            {product?.itemName || product?.summarizedTitle || "Loading..."}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Column headers */}
      {items.length > 0 && (
        <div className="grid gap-2 px-8" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: gridCols }}>
          {noAttributes && <div className="text-[9px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">Custom Label</div>}
          {showFlavor && <div className="text-[9px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">Flavor</div>}
          {showSize && <div className="text-[9px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">Size</div>}
          {showColor && <div className="text-[9px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">Color</div>}
          {showStyle && <div className="text-[9px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">Style</div>}
          <div className="text-[9px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">Units</div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Items list */}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        {items.map((item, idx) => (
          <div key={idx} className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/30 p-3">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-medium shrink-0 w-4 text-center pt-1">{idx + 1}</span>
            <div className="flex-1 grid gap-2" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: gridCols }}>
              {noAttributes && (
                <FieldInput label="" value={item.customLabel || ""} onChange={(v) => updateItem(idx, "customLabel", v)} />
              )}
              {showFlavor && (
                <ChipField
                  options={[...familyOptions.flavor]}
                  value={item.flavor || ""}
                  onChange={(v) => updateItem(idx, "flavor", v)}
                  onAddCustom={(v) => addCustomOption("flavor", v)}
                  placeholder="e.g. Vanilla"
                />
              )}
              {showSize && (
                <ChipField
                  options={[...familyOptions.size]}
                  value={item.size || ""}
                  onChange={(v) => updateItem(idx, "size", v)}
                  onAddCustom={(v) => addCustomOption("size", v)}
                  placeholder="e.g. 4oz"
                />
              )}
              {showColor && (
                <ChipField
                  options={[...familyOptions.color]}
                  value={item.color || ""}
                  onChange={(v) => updateItem(idx, "color", v)}
                  onAddCustom={(v) => addCustomOption("color", v)}
                  placeholder="e.g. Red"
                />
              )}
              {showStyle && (
                <ChipField
                  options={[...familyOptions.style]}
                  value={item.style || ""}
                  onChange={(v) => updateItem(idx, "style", v)}
                  onAddCustom={(v) => addCustomOption("style", v)}
                  placeholder="e.g. Classic"
                />
              )}
              <input
                value={String(item.units)}
                type="number"
                min="1"
                onChange={(e) => updateItem(idx, "units", parseInt(e.target.value) || 1)}
                className="rounded border border-border bg-background px-2 py-1 text-xs text-foreground placeholder-muted-foreground/60 focus:border-brand-vp focus:outline-none text-center"
              />
            </div>
            <button onClick={() => removeItem(idx)} className="shrink-0 p-1 pt-1 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500 transition-colors">
              <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Actions */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-1">
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={addItem} className="text-xs">
          <Plus className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" /> Add Item
        </Button>
        <div className="flex-1" />
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={onClose} className="text-xs">Cancel</Button>
        <Button
          size="sm"
          onClick={() => saveMutation.mutate()}
          disabled={saveMutation.isPending || items.length === 0}
          className="text-xs bg-brand-vp hover:bg-brand-vp/80 text-black"
        >
          {saveMutation.isPending ? "Saving..." : `Save (${items.length} item${items.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""})`}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Existing Pack Card (with inline editing) ──────────

function ExistingPackCard({ pack }: { pack: VarietyPackProduct }) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [items, setItems] = useState<PackItem[]>([]);
  const [showSiblingPicker, setShowSiblingPicker] = useState(false);

  const { data: fullItems = [] } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["variety-pack", pack.id],
    queryFn: () => fetchPackItems(pack.id),
    enabled: editing,
  });

  const { data: siblings = [] } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["product-siblings", pack.id],
    queryFn: () => fetchSiblings(pack.id),
    enabled: editing,
  });

  const saveMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => savePackItems(pack.id, items),
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success("Variety pack updated");
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["variety-pack", pack.id] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["variety-packs"] });
      setEditing(false);
    },
    onError: () => toast.error("Failed to save"),
  });

  const deleteMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${pack.id}/variety-pack`, { method: "DELETE" });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Delete failed");
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success("Variety pack removed");
      queryClient.removeQueries({ queryKey: ["variety-pack", pack.id] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["variety-packs"] });
    },
    onError: () => toast.error("Failed to delete"),
  });

  function startEditing() {
    setItems([...fullItems]);
    setEditing(true);
    setExpanded(true);
  }

  function cancelEditing() {
    setItems([]);
    setEditing(false);
    setShowSiblingPicker(false);
  }

  function addFromSibling(sib: SiblingProduct) {
    setItems((prev) => [
      ...prev,
      {
        includedProductId: sib.id,
        includedAsin: sib.asin,
        includedSku: sib.sku,
        includedTitle: sib.itemName || sib.summarizedTitle,
        includedImage: sib.mainImageUrl,
        flavor: sib.flavor || null,
        size: sib.size || null,
        color: sib.color || null,
        style: sib.style || null,
        customLabel: null,
        units: 1,
      },
    ]);
    setShowSiblingPicker(false);
  }

  function addCustom() {
    setItems((prev) => [
      ...prev,
      {
        includedProductId: null, includedAsin: null, includedSku: null,
        includedTitle: null, includedImage: null, flavor: null,
        size: null, color: null, style: null, customLabel: null, units: 1,
      },
    ]);
  }

  function removeItem(idx: number) {
    setItems((prev) => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
  }

  function updateItem(idx: number, field: keyof PackItem, value: string | number) {
    setItems((prev) => prev.map((it, i) => (i === idx ? { ...it, [field]: value } : it)));
  }

  const usedIds = new Set(items.filter((it) => it.includedProductId).map((it) => it.includedProductId));
  const availableSiblings = siblings.filter((s) => s.id !== pack.id && !usedIds.has(s.id));

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card">
      {/* Header row */}
      <button
        onClick={() => setExpanded(!expanded)}
        className="flex items-center gap-3 w-full text-left px-4 py-3 hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors"
      >
        {expanded ? (
          <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
        ) : (
          <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
        )}
        <div className="h-10 w-10 rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted overflow-hidden shrink-0">
          {pack.mainImageUrl ? (
            <img src={hiResAmazonImg(pack.mainImageUrl, 100)} alt="" className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
          ) : (
            <div className="h-full w-full flex items-center justify-center">
              <PackageOpen className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground/40" />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {pack.asin && <span className="font-mono text-xs text-brand shrink-0">{pack.asin}</span>}
            {pack.sku && <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground shrink-0">{pack.sku}</span>}
            {pack.clientIdCode && <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[9px] shrink-0">{pack.clientIdCode}</Badge>}
            <Badge className="rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold bg-brand-vp/15 text-brand-vp border-brand-vp/30 shrink-0">
              {pack.itemCount} unit{pack.itemCount !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
            </Badge>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-foreground/80 truncate mt-0.5">
            {pack.itemName || pack.summarizedTitle || "—"}
          </p>
        </div>
        <span
          role="button"
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            if (confirm(`Remove variety pack for ${pack.asin || pack.sku}? This deletes all pack items.`)) {
              deleteMutation.mutate();
            }
          }}
          className="shrink-0 p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-500/10 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500" />
        </span>
        <Link
          href={`/products/${pack.id}`}
          onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          className="shrink-0 p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-muted transition-colors"
        >
          <ExternalLink className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground hover:text-brand" />
        </Link>
      </button>

      {/* Expanded content */}
      {expanded && (
        <div className="px-4 pb-4 space-y-3">
          {editing ? (
            <>
              {/* Editable items */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {items.map((item, idx) => (
                  <div key={idx} className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/30 p-3">
                    <div className="shrink-0 w-10 h-10 rounded border border-border bg-background flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden">
                      {item.includedImage ? (
                        <img src={item.includedImage} alt="" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                      ) : (
                        <PackageOpen className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground/40" />
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        {item.includedAsin && <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-brand shrink-0">{item.includedAsin}</span>}
                        {item.includedSku && <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground shrink-0">{item.includedSku}</span>}
                        <span className="text-xs text-foreground/80 truncate">{item.includedTitle || item.customLabel || "Custom item"}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-2">
                        <FieldInput label="Flavor" value={item.flavor || ""} onChange={(v) => updateItem(idx, "flavor", v)} />
                        <FieldInput label="Size" value={item.size || ""} onChange={(v) => updateItem(idx, "size", v)} />
                        <FieldInput label="Color" value={item.color || ""} onChange={(v) => updateItem(idx, "color", v)} />
                        <FieldInput label="Style" value={item.style || ""} onChange={(v) => updateItem(idx, "style", v)} />
                        <FieldInput label="Units" value={String(item.units)} onChange={(v) => updateItem(idx, "units", parseInt(v) || 1)} type="number" />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <button onClick={() => removeItem(idx)} className="shrink-0 p-1 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500 transition-colors">
                      <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* Sibling picker */}
              {showSiblingPicker && (
                <div className="rounded-lg border border-brand-vp/30 bg-background p-2 max-h-72 overflow-y-auto space-y-1">
                  {availableSiblings.length === 0 ? (
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground px-2 py-1">No siblings available</p>
                  ) : (<>
                    <div className="grid gap-1 px-2 py-1 border-b border-border/50 mb-1" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: "80px 90px 1fr 70px 90px 60px 60px" }}>
                      <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">ASIN</span>
                      <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">SKU</span>
                      <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">Title</span>
                      <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">Flavor</span>
                      <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">Size</span>
                      <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">Color</span>
                      <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">Style</span>
                    </div>
                    {availableSiblings.map((sib) => (
                      <button
                        key={sib.id}
                        onClick={() => addFromSibling(sib)}
                        className="grid gap-1 w-full text-left px-2 py-1.5 rounded hover:bg-brand-vp/10 transition-colors"
                        style={{ gridTemplateColumns: "80px 90px 1fr 70px 90px 60px 60px" }}
                      >
                        <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-brand truncate">{sib.asin || "—"}</span>
                        <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-muted-foreground truncate">{sib.sku || "—"}</span>
                        <span className="text-xs text-foreground/80 truncate">{sib.itemName || sib.summarizedTitle || "—"}</span>
                        <span className="text-[9px] text-foreground/70 truncate">{sib.flavor || "—"}</span>
                        <span className="text-[9px] text-foreground/70 truncate">{sib.size || "—"}</span>
                        <span className="text-[9px] text-foreground/70 truncate">{sib.color || "—"}</span>
                        <span className="text-[9px] text-foreground/70 truncate">{sib.style || "—"}</span>
                      </button>
                    ))}</>
                  )}
                  <button onClick={() => setShowSiblingPicker(false)} className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground px-2 py-1">Cancel</button>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Edit action buttons */}
              {!showSiblingPicker && (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-1">
                  <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => setShowSiblingPicker(true)} className="text-xs">
                    <Plus className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" /> Add Sibling
                  </Button>
                  <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={addCustom} className="text-xs">
                    <Plus className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" /> Custom Item
                  </Button>
                  <div className="flex-1" />
                  <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={cancelEditing} className="text-xs">Cancel</Button>
                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={() => saveMutation.mutate()}
                    disabled={saveMutation.isPending}
                    className="text-xs bg-brand-vp hover:bg-brand-vp/80 text-black"
                  >
                    {saveMutation.isPending ? "Saving..." : "Save"}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              {/* Read-only items grid */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-2">
                {pack.items.map((item, i) => (
                  <div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/30 px-3 py-2">
                    <span className="text-xs font-medium text-brand-vp shrink-0">
                      {`${item.units}x`}
                    </span>
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      {(item.includedAsin || item.includedSku) && (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-0.5">
                          {item.includedAsin && <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-brand">{item.includedAsin}</span>}
                          {item.includedSku && <span className="font-mono text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">{item.includedSku}</span>}
                        </div>
                      )}
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 text-[10px]">
                        {item.flavor && <span className="text-foreground/80">{item.flavor}</span>}
                        {cleanSize(item.size) && <span className="text-muted-foreground">{cleanSize(item.size)}</span>}
                        {item.color && <span className="text-muted-foreground">{item.color}</span>}
                        {item.style && <span className="text-muted-foreground">{item.style}</span>}
                        {item.customLabel && <span className="text-muted-foreground italic">{item.customLabel}</span>}
                        {!item.flavor && !item.size && !item.color && !item.style && !item.customLabel && (
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground italic">Unnamed item</span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={startEditing} className="text-xs">
                Edit Pack
              </Button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────

/** Strip "(Pack of N)" from size strings to avoid confusion with VP units */
function cleanSize(s: string | null): string | null {
  if (!s) return null;
  return s.replace(/\s*\(pack\s+of\s+\d+\)/i, "").trim() || null;
}

// ── Chip Field (dropdown with available options) ──────

function ChipField({
  options,
  value,
  onChange,
  onAddCustom,
  placeholder,
}: {
  options: string[];
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  onAddCustom?: (v: string) => void;
  placeholder: string;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [customMode, setCustomMode] = useState(false);
  const [customVal, setCustomVal] = useState("");
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const handler = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handler);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handler);
  }, [open]);

  if (value) {
    return (
      <span className="px-2 py-1 rounded text-[10px] font-medium border bg-brand-vp/20 text-brand-vp border-brand-vp/40 flex items-center gap-1 w-fit">
        {value}
        <button type="button" onClick={() => onChange("")} className="hover:text-red-400 ml-0.5 text-[9px]">&times;</button>
      </span>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="relative" ref={ref}>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => { setOpen(!open); setCustomMode(false); setCustomVal(""); }}
        className="px-2 py-1 rounded text-[10px] font-medium border border-dashed border-border text-muted-foreground hover:border-brand-vp/40 hover:text-brand-vp transition-all"
      >
        + Add
      </button>
      {open && !customMode && (
        <div className="absolute z-20 top-full left-0 mt-1 min-w-[140px] max-h-48 overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border border-brand-vp/30 bg-card shadow-lg">
          {options.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="px-3 py-2 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">No options</div>
          ) : (
            options.map((opt) => (
              <button
                key={opt}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => { onChange(opt); setOpen(false); }}
                className="block w-full text-left px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] text-foreground hover:bg-brand-vp/10 hover:text-brand-vp transition-colors"
              >
                {opt}
              </button>
            ))
          )}
          {onAddCustom && (
            <>
              <div className="border-t border-border" />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setCustomMode(true)}
                className="block w-full text-left px-3 py-1.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground hover:bg-brand-vp/10 hover:text-brand-vp transition-colors italic"
              >
                Custom value...
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
      {open && customMode && (
        <div className="absolute z-20 top-full left-0 mt-1 min-w-[180px] rounded-lg border border-brand-vp/30 bg-card shadow-lg p-2">
          <div className="flex gap-1">
            <input
              value={customVal}
              onChange={(e) => setCustomVal(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === "Enter" && customVal.trim()) {
                  onAddCustom?.(customVal.trim());
                  onChange(customVal.trim());
                  setCustomVal("");
                  setOpen(false);
                }
                if (e.key === "Escape") { setCustomMode(false); setCustomVal(""); }
              }}
              placeholder={placeholder}
              autoFocus
              className="flex-1 rounded border border-brand-vp/30 bg-background px-2 py-1 text-[11px] text-foreground placeholder-muted-foreground/60 focus:border-brand-vp focus:outline-none"
            />
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                if (customVal.trim()) {
                  onAddCustom?.(customVal.trim());
                  onChange(customVal.trim());
                  setCustomVal("");
                  setOpen(false);
                }
              }}
              className="px-2 py-1 rounded text-[10px] bg-brand-vp text-white hover:bg-brand-vp/80"
            >
              Add
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Variation attribute chips ─────────────────────────

const VARIATION_KEYS = ["Flavor", "Size", "Color", "Style"] as const;

function VariationChips({ variations }: { variations?: Record<string, string> | null }) {
  if (!variations) return null;
  const chips = VARIATION_KEYS.map((k) => variations[k]).filter(Boolean);
  if (chips.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-0.5">
      {VARIATION_KEYS.map((k) => {
        const v = variations[k];
        if (!v) return null;
        return (
          <span key={k} className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-full border border-border px-1.5 py-0 text-[9px]">
            <span className="text-muted-foreground">{k}:</span>
            <span className="font-medium text-foreground/80">{v}</span>
          </span>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Shared field input ────────────────────────────────

function FieldInput({
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
  type = "text",
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  type?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div>
      <label className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">{label}</label>
      <input
        type={type}
        value={value}
        onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
        className="w-full rounded border border-border bg-background px-2 py-1 text-xs text-foreground placeholder-muted-foreground/60 focus:border-brand-vp focus:outline-none"
        min={type === "number" ? 1 : undefined}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import Link from "next/link";
import { GitCompare, AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";
import { CLIENT_NAMES } from "@/lib/constants";

type ClientSummary = {
  clientIdCode: string;
  totalFields: number;
  mismatches: number;
  unresolved: number;
  lastSync: string | null;
  productCount: number;
};

export function AmazonSyncSummaryWidget() {
  const { data } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["amazon-sync-summary"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/amazon-sync/summary");
      if (!res.ok) return null;
      return res.json();
    },
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  const clients: ClientSummary[] = data?.clients ?? [];
  const totalUnresolved = clients.reduce((s, c) => s + c.unresolved, 0);

  // Top 3 clients by unresolved count
  const top3 = [...clients]
    .sort((a, b) => b.unresolved - a.unresolved)
    .slice(0, 3);

  if (clients.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <Link
      href="/amazon-sync"
      className="glass-card rounded-lg p-4 hover:ring-1 hover:ring-brand/30 transition-all block"
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <GitCompare className="h-4 w-4 text-brand" />
          <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-white font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)]">
            Amazon Sync
          </span>
        </div>
        {totalUnresolved > 0 && (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-amber-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-500 tabular-nums">
            <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3" />
            {totalUnresolved} unresolved
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {top3.length > 0 && (
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          {top3.map((c) => (
            <div
              key={c.clientIdCode}
              className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs"
            >
              <span className="text-muted-foreground truncate">
                {CLIENT_NAMES[c.clientIdCode] || c.clientIdCode}
              </span>
              <span
                className={`font-bold tabular-nums ${
                  c.unresolved > 0 ? "text-amber-500" : "text-emerald-500"
                }`}
              >
                {c.unresolved}
              </span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="mt-3 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/70">
        View all &rarr;
      </div>
    </Link>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import {
  Search,
  ChevronLeft,
  ChevronRight,
  X,
  Pencil,
  Layers,
} from "lucide-react";
import { CLIENT_NAMES } from "@/lib/constants";
import { DEPARTMENTS, type DepartmentId } from "@/lib/permissions";

type ActivityEntry = {
  id: number;
  productId: string;
  asin: string | null;
  sku: string | null;
  clientIdCode: string | null;
  itemName: string | null;
  fieldLabel: string;
  bqName: string;
  oldValue: string | null;
  newValue: string | null;
  changedBy: string;
  changedAt: string;
  editType: string;
};

type ActivityResponse = {
  data: ActivityEntry[];
  pagination: {
    page: number;
    pageSize: number;
    total: number;
    totalPages: number;
  };
};

type ClientEntry = { clientIdCode: string; count: number; activeCount: number };

async function fetchActivity(params: URLSearchParams): Promise<ActivityResponse> {
  const res = await fetch(`/api/activity?${params.toString()}`);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch activity");
  return res.json();
}

async function fetchClients(): Promise<ClientEntry[]> {
  const res = await fetch("/api/clients");
  if (!res.ok) return [];
  return res.json();
}

function truncate(str: string | null, max: number): string {
  if (!str) return "—";
  return str.length > max ? str.slice(0, max) + "..." : str;
}

function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  const now = new Date();
  const diffMs = now.getTime() - d.getTime();
  const diffMin = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000);
  const diffHr = Math.floor(diffMs / 3600000);
  const diffDay = Math.floor(diffMs / 86400000);

  if (diffMin < 1) return "just now";
  if (diffMin < 60) return `${diffMin}m ago`;
  if (diffHr < 24) return `${diffHr}h ago`;
  if (diffDay < 7) return `${diffDay}d ago`;

  return d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    year: d.getFullYear() !== now.getFullYear() ? "numeric" : undefined,
  });
}

function formatDateTime(iso: string): string {
  return new Date(iso).toLocaleString("en-US", {
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    year: "numeric",
    hour: "numeric",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

export function ActivityFeed() {

  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [debouncedSearch, setDebouncedSearch] = useState("");
  const [client, setClient] = useState("");
  const [editType, setEditType] = useState("");
  const [department, setDepartment] = useState("");

  const { data: clientsData = [] } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["clients"],
    queryFn: fetchClients,
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  const clientCodes = useMemo(
    () => clientsData.map((c) => c.clientIdCode),
    [clientsData]
  );

  const handleSearchChange = useCallback((value: string) => {
    setSearch(value);
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      setDebouncedSearch(value);
      setPage(1);
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
  }, []);

  const params = useMemo(() => {
    const p = new URLSearchParams();
    p.set("page", String(page));
    p.set("pageSize", "50");
    if (debouncedSearch) p.set("search", debouncedSearch);
    if (client) p.set("client", client);
    if (editType) p.set("editType", editType);
    if (department) p.set("department", department);
    return p;
  }, [page, debouncedSearch, client, editType, department]);

  const { data, isLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["activity", params.toString()],
    queryFn: () => fetchActivity(params),
  });

  const entries = data?.data ?? [];
  const pagination = data?.pagination;
  const hasFilters = search || client || editType || department;

                  {c}
                </SelectItem>
              ))}

          <Select
            value={department || "all"}
            onValueChange={(v) => {
              setDepartment(v === "all" ? "" : v);
              setPage(1);
            }}
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="w-[140px]">

                </SelectItem>

          <Select

            Showing {(pagination.page - 1) * pagination.pageSize + 1}&ndash;
            {Math.min(pagination.page * pagination.pageSize, pagination.total)}{" "}
            of {pagination.total} entries
          </p>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              disabled={page <= 1}
              onClick={() => setPage(page - 1)}
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
              Prev
            </Button>
            <span className="text-sm">
              Page {pagination.page} of {pagination.totalPages}
            </span>
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              disabled={page >= pagination.totalPages}
              onClick={() => setPage(page + 1)}
            >
              Next
              <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

type EventLogEntry = {
  id: number;
  userEmail: string | null;
  userName: string | null;
  section: string;
  action: string;
  status: string;
  resourceType: string | null;
  resourceId: string | null;
  resourceLabel: string | null;
  message: string | null;
  detail: Record<string, unknown> | null;
  durationMs: number | null;
  createdAt: string;
};

type Pagination = {
  page: number;
  pageSize: number;
  total: number;
  totalPages: number;
};

const SECTIONS = [
  { value: "", label: "All Sections" },
  { value: "seo", label: "SEO Manager" },
  { value: "products", label: "Products" },
  { value: "publish", label: "Publish" },
  { value: "import", label: "Import" },
  { value: "export", label: "Export" },
  { value: "auth", label: "Auth" },
  { value: "admin", label: "Admin" },
];

const STATUSES = [
  { value: "", label: "All Statuses" },
  { value: "success", label: "Success" },
  { value: "error", label: "Error" },
  { value: "warning", label: "Warning" },
];

async function fetchLogs(params: Record<string, string>) {
  const qs = new URLSearchParams(params).toString();
  const res = await fetch(`/api/admin/logs?${qs}`);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch logs");
  return res.json() as Promise<{ data: EventLogEntry[]; pagination: Pagination }>;
}

function StatusBadge({ status }: { status: string }) {
  if (status === "error") {
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-red-500/15 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-red-400">
        <AlertCircle className="h-3 w-3" /> Error
      </span>
    );
  }
  if (status === "warning") {
    return (
      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-amber-500/15 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-amber-400">
        <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3" /> Warning
      </span>
    );
  }
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/15 px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-emerald-400">
      <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3" /> Success
    </span>
  );
}

function SectionBadge({ section }: { section: string }) {
  const colors: Record<string, string> = {
    seo: "bg-violet-500/15 text-violet-400",
    products: "bg-blue-500/15 text-blue-400",
    publish: "bg-brand/15 text-brand",
    import: "bg-cyan-500/15 text-cyan-400",
    export: "bg-teal-500/15 text-teal-400",
    auth: "bg-pink-500/15 text-pink-400",
    admin: "bg-orange-500/15 text-orange-400",
  };
  return (
    <span
      className={`inline-flex rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-semibold ${colors[section] || "bg-muted text-muted-foreground"}`}
    >
      {section}
    </span>
  );
}

function RelativeTime({ date }: { date: string }) {
  const d = new Date(date);
  const now = new Date();
  const diffMs = now.getTime() - d.getTime();
  const diffMin = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000);
  const diffHr = Math.floor(diffMin / 60);
  const diffDay = Math.floor(diffHr / 24);

  let relative: string;
  if (diffMin < 1) relative = "just now";
  else if (diffMin < 60) relative = `${diffMin}m ago`;
  else if (diffHr < 24) relative = `${diffHr}h ago`;
  else if (diffDay < 7) relative = `${diffDay}d ago`;
  else relative = d.toLocaleDateString();

  return (
    <span title={d.toLocaleString()} className="text-xs text-muted-foreground whitespace-nowrap">
      {relative}
    </span>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useSession } from "next-auth/react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,

  Select,
  SelectContent,

  SelectValue,

// ─── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface Credential {
  id: number;
  clientIdCode: string;
  marketplaceId: string;
  sellerId: string;
  refreshTokenMasked: string;
  region: string;
  isActive: boolean;
  lastSyncAt: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
}

interface ClientEntry {
  clientIdCode: string;
  clientName: string;
}

const MARKETPLACES = [
  { id: "ATVPDKIKX0DER", label: "US", region: "na" },
  { id: "A2EUQ1WTGCTBG2", label: "CA", region: "na" },
  { id: "A1F83G8C2ARO7P", label: "UK", region: "eu" },

const MARKETPLACE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {};
for (const m of MARKETPLACES) {
  MARKETPLACE_LABELS[m.id] = m.label;

function getRegionForMarketplace(marketplaceId: string): string {
  return MARKETPLACES.find((m) => m.id === marketplaceId)?.region ?? "na";
}

// ─── Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function SPAPICredentials() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<Credential | null>(null);
  const [testingId, setTestingId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [testResult, setTestResult] = useState<{
    id: number;
    success: boolean;
    message: string;
  } | null>(null);

  // Form state
  const [formClient, setFormClient] = useState("");
  const [formMarketplace, setFormMarketplace] = useState("");
  const [formSellerId, setFormSellerId] = useState("");
  const [formRefreshToken, setFormRefreshToken] = useState("");

  const isAdmin = session?.user?.role === "admin";

  // ─── Queries ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const { data: credentials = [], isLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["sp-api-credentials"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/sp-api");
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch credentials");
      const data = await res.json();
      return data.credentials as Credential[];
    },
    enabled: isAdmin,
  });

  const { data: clients = [] } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["clients"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/clients");
      if (!res.ok) return [];
      return res.json() as Promise<ClientEntry[]>;
    },
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  // ─── Mutations ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const createMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (body: Record<string, unknown>) => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/sp-api", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Failed to create");
      }
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["sp-api-credentials"] });
      toast.success("Credentials created");
      closeDialog();
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => toast.error(err.message),
  });

  const updateMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (body: Record<string, unknown>) => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/sp-api", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Failed to update");
      }
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["sp-api-credentials"] });
      toast.success("Credentials updated");
      closeDialog();
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => toast.error(err.message),
  });

  const deleteMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (id: number) => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/sp-api", {
        method: "DELETE",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ id }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to delete");
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["sp-api-credentials"] });
      toast.success("Credentials deleted");
    },
    onError: () => toast.error("Failed to delete credentials"),
  });

  const testMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (id: number) => {
      setTestingId(id);
      setTestResult(null);
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/sp-api/test", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ id }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Request failed");
      return res.json() as Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }>;
    },
    onSuccess: (data, id) => {
      setTestResult({ id, ...data });
      setTestingId(null);
      if (data.success) {
        toast.success("Connection successful");
      } else {
        toast.error(data.message);
      }
    },
    onError: (_, id) => {
      setTestResult({ id, success: false, message: "Request failed" });
      setTestingId(null);
    },
  });

  // ─── Dialog helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  function openCreate() {
    setEditing(null);
    setFormClient("");
    setFormMarketplace("");
    setFormSellerId("");
    setFormRefreshToken("");
    setDialogOpen(true);
  }

  function openEdit(cred: Credential) {
    setEditing(cred);
    setFormClient(cred.clientIdCode);
    setFormMarketplace(cred.marketplaceId);
    setFormSellerId(cred.sellerId);
    setFormRefreshToken("");
    setDialogOpen(true);
  }

  function closeDialog() {
    setDialogOpen(false);
    setEditing(null);
  }

  function handleSave() {
    if (editing) {
      const body: Record<string, unknown> = { id: editing.id };
      if (formSellerId && formSellerId !== editing.sellerId)
        body.sellerId = formSellerId;
      if (formRefreshToken) body.refreshToken = formRefreshToken;
      updateMutation.mutate(body);
    } else {
      if (!formClient || !formMarketplace || !formSellerId || !formRefreshToken) {
        toast.error("All fields are required");
        return;
      }
      createMutation.mutate({
        clientIdCode: formClient,
        marketplaceId: formMarketplace,
        sellerId: formSellerId,
        refreshToken: formRefreshToken,
        region: getRegionForMarketplace(formMarketplace),
      });
    }
  }

  const isSaving = createMutation.isPending || updateMutation.isPending;

  // ─── Render ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  if (!isAdmin) {
    return <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Admin access required.</p>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground/80">
          {credentials.length} credential{credentials.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
        </h3>
        <Button size="sm" onClick={openCreate}>
          <Plus className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" />
          Add Credentials
        </Button>
      </div>

      {isLoading ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground/70">Loading...</p>
      ) : credentials.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          No SP-API credentials configured yet.
        </p>
      ) : (
        <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card">
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>Client</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Marketplace</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Seller ID</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Last Sync</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">Actions</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {credentials.map((cred) => (
                <TableRow key={cred.id}>
                  <TableCell className="font-medium">
                    {cred.clientIdCode}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    {MARKETPLACE_LABELS[cred.marketplaceId] ?? cred.marketplaceId}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs">
                    {cred.sellerId}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <Badge
                      variant={cred.isActive ? "default" : "secondary"}
                      className={
                        cred.isActive
                          ? "bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-500/15"
                          : ""
                      }
                    >
                      {cred.isActive ? "Active" : "Inactive"}
                    </Badge>
                    {testResult?.id === cred.id && (
                      <span className="ml-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                        {testResult.success ? (
                          <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
                        ) : (
                          <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-red-500" />
                        )}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {cred.lastSyncAt
                      ? new Date(cred.lastSyncAt).toLocaleDateString()
                      : "Never"}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="text-right">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="sm"
                        onClick={() => testMutation.mutate(cred.id)}
                        disabled={testingId === cred.id}
                        title="Test Connection"
                      >
                        {testingId === cred.id ? (
                          <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                        ) : (
                          <Plug className="h-4 w-4" />
                        )}
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="sm"
                        onClick={() => openEdit(cred)}
                        title="Edit"
                      >
                        <Pencil className="h-4 w-4" />
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="sm"
                        onClick={() => {
                          if (confirm("Delete these credentials?")) {
                            deleteMutation.mutate(cred.id);
                          }
                        }}
                        title="Delete"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4 text-red-500" />
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add/Edit Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>
              {editing ? "Edit Credentials" : "Add SP-API Credentials"}
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              {editing
                ? "Update seller ID or refresh token."
                : "Connect a client's Amazon Seller account."}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          <div className="space-y-4 py-2">
            {/* Client */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label>Client</Label>
              {editing ? (
                <Input value={editing.clientIdCode} disabled />
              ) : (
                <Select value={formClient} onValueChange={setFormClient}>
                  <SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectValue placeholder="Select a client" />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {clients.map((c) => (
                      <SelectItem key={c.clientIdCode} value={c.clientIdCode}>
                        {c.clientName || c.clientIdCode}
                      </SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Marketplace */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label>Marketplace</Label>
              {editing ? (
                <Input
                  value={
                    MARKETPLACE_LABELS[editing.marketplaceId] ??
                    editing.marketplaceId
                  }
                  disabled
                />
              ) : (
                <Select
                  value={formMarketplace}
                  onValueChange={setFormMarketplace}
                >
                  <SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectValue placeholder="Select marketplace" />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {MARKETPLACES.map((m) => (
                      <SelectItem key={m.id} value={m.id}>
                        {m.label} ({m.id})
                      </SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Region (auto-detected) */}
            {(formMarketplace || editing) && (
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label>Region (auto-detected)</Label>
                <Input
                  value={
                    editing
                      ? editing.region
                      : getRegionForMarketplace(formMarketplace)
                  }
                  disabled
                />
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Seller ID */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label>Seller ID</Label>
              <Input
                value={formSellerId}
                onChange={(e) => setFormSellerId(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="A3XXXXXXXXX"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Refresh Token */}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label>
                Refresh Token
                {editing && (
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/70 ml-1">
                    (leave blank to keep existing)
                  </span>
                )}
              </Label>
              <Input
                type="password"
                value={formRefreshToken}
                onChange={(e) => setFormRefreshToken(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Atzr|xxxxx..."
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={closeDialog}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={isSaving}>
              {isSaving && <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-1 animate-spin" />}
              {editing ? "Update" : "Create"}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { fmtCurrency } from "@/lib/formatters";
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from "react";

interface ForecastEditorProps {
  monthlyActuals: Array<{
    month: string;
    product_sales: number;
    ad_spend: number;
    ad_revenue: number;
  }>;
  forecasts: Array<{
    month: string;
    metric: string;
    forecastValue: string | null;
  }>;
  clientIdCode: string;
  readOnly?: boolean;
}

type RowDef = {
  label: string;
  type: "actual" | "forecast" | "balance";
  metric: "product_sales" | "ad_spend";
};

const ROWS: RowDef[] = [
  { label: "Sales Actual", type: "actual", metric: "product_sales" },
  { label: "Sales Forecast", type: "forecast", metric: "product_sales" },
  { label: "Sales Balance", type: "balance", metric: "product_sales" },
  { label: "Ad Spend Actual", type: "actual", metric: "ad_spend" },
  { label: "Ad Spend Forecast", type: "forecast", metric: "ad_spend" },
  { label: "Ad Spend Balance", type: "balance", metric: "ad_spend" },
];

function generateMonths(): string[] {
  const now = new Date();
  const currentYear = now.getFullYear();
  const prevYear = currentYear - 1;
  const months: string[] = [];
  for (let y = prevYear; y <= currentYear; y++) {
    for (let m = 1; m <= 12; m++) {
      months.push(`${y}-${String(m).padStart(2, "0")}`);
    }
  }
  return months;
}

function formatMonthHeader(month: string): string {
  const [y, m] = month.split("-");
  const names = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"];
  return `${names[parseInt(m, 10) - 1]} '${y.slice(2)}`;
}

function parseCurrencyInput(raw: string): number {
  const cleaned = raw.replace(/[$,\s]/g, "");
  const num = parseFloat(cleaned);
  return isNaN(num) ? 0 : num;
}

export function ForecastEditor({
  monthlyActuals,
  forecasts,
  clientIdCode,
  readOnly = false,
}: ForecastEditorProps) {
  const months = useMemo(generateMonths, []);
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  // Build lookup maps
  const actualsMap = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<string, (typeof monthlyActuals)[number]>();
    for (const a of monthlyActuals) m.set(a.month, a);
    return m;
  }, [monthlyActuals]);

  const [localForecasts, setLocalForecasts] = useState(() => {
    const m = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const f of forecasts) {
      if (f.forecastValue != null) {
        m.set(`${f.metric}:${f.month}`, parseCurrencyInput(f.forecastValue));
      }
    }
    return m;
  });

  const [editingCell, setEditingCell] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [savingCells, setSavingCells] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

  const saveMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (params: { month: string; metric: string; value: number }) => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/forecasts", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          clientIdCode,
          month: params.month,
          metric: params.metric,
          forecastValue: params.value,
        }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Save failed");
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["forecasts", clientIdCode] });
    },
  });

  const handleBlur = useCallback(
    (month: string, metric: string, rawValue: string) => {
      const key = `${metric}:${month}`;
      const value = parseCurrencyInput(rawValue);
      setLocalForecasts((prev) => new Map(prev).set(key, value));
      setEditingCell(null);
      setSavingCells((prev) => new Set(prev).add(key));
      saveMutation.mutate(
        { month, metric, value },
        { onSettled: () => setSavingCells((prev) => { const n = new Set(prev); n.delete(key); return n; }) },
      );
    },
    [saveMutation],
  );

  function getActual(month: string, metric: "product_sales" | "ad_spend"): number | null {
    const a = actualsMap.get(month);
    if (!a) return null;
    return metric === "product_sales" ? a.product_sales : a.ad_spend;
  }

  function getForecast(month: string, metric: string): number | null {
    return localForecasts.get(`${metric}:${month}`) ?? null;
  }

  function getBalance(month: string, metric: "product_sales" | "ad_spend"): number | null {
    const actual = getActual(month, metric);
    const forecast = getForecast(month, metric);
    if (forecast == null) return null;
    if (actual == null) return forecast;
    return forecast - actual;
  }

  function getCellValue(row: RowDef, month: string): number | null {
    switch (row.type) {
      case "actual":
        return getActual(month, row.metric);
      case "forecast":
        return getForecast(month, row.metric);
      case "balance":
        return getBalance(month, row.metric);
    }
  }

  function rowBg(row: RowDef): string {
    if (row.type === "actual") return "bg-muted/5";
    if (row.type === "forecast") return "bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/20";
    return "";
  }

  return (
    <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-border">
      <table className="w-full text-xs tabular-nums">
        <thead>
          <tr className="border-b border-border bg-muted/50">
            <th className="sticky left-0 z-10 bg-card px-3 py-2 text-left font-medium text-card-foreground min-w-[140px]">
              Metric
            </th>
            {months.map((m) => (
              <th
                key={m}
                className="border-l border-border px-2 py-2 text-right font-medium text-card-foreground whitespace-nowrap min-w-[72px]"
              >
                {formatMonthHeader(m)}
              </th>
            ))}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {ROWS.map((row) => (
            <tr key={row.label} className={`border-b border-border ${rowBg(row)}`}>
              <td className="sticky left-0 z-10 bg-inherit px-3 py-1.5 font-medium text-card-foreground whitespace-nowrap">
                {row.label}
              </td>
              {months.map((month) => {
                const cellKey = `${row.metric}:${month}`;
                const value = getCellValue(row, month);
                const isSaving = savingCells.has(cellKey);
                const isEditing = editingCell === `${row.label}:${month}`;

                // Balance row: colored text
                if (row.type === "balance") {
                  const color =
                    value == null
                      ? "text-muted-foreground"
                      : value >= 0
                        ? "text-[#34C759]"
                        : "text-[#FF5C5F]";
                  return (
                    <td
                      key={month}
                      className={`border-l border-border px-2 py-1.5 text-right ${color}`}
                    >
                      {fmtCurrency(value)}
                    </td>
                  );
                }

                // Forecast row: editable
                if (row.type === "forecast" && !readOnly) {
                  if (isEditing) {
                    return (
                      <td key={month} className="border-l border-border p-0">
                        <input
                          autoFocus
                          type="text"
                          defaultValue={value != null ? value.toString() : ""}
                          className="w-full bg-transparent px-2 py-1.5 text-right text-xs outline-none ring-1 ring-[#2563eb] rounded-none"
                          onBlur={(e) => handleBlur(month, row.metric, e.target.value)}
                          onKeyDown={(e) => {
                            if (e.key === "Enter") (e.target as HTMLInputElement).blur();
                            if (e.key === "Escape") setEditingCell(null);
                          }}
                        />
                      </td>
                    );
                  }

                  return (
                    <td
                      key={month}
                      className={`border-l border-border px-2 py-1.5 text-right cursor-pointer hover:ring-1 hover:ring-[#2563eb]/50 ${
                        isSaving ? "opacity-50" : ""
                      }`}
                      onClick={() => setEditingCell(`${row.label}:${month}`)}
                    >
                      {fmtCurrency(value)}
                    </td>
                  );
                }

                // Actual row or read-only forecast
                return (
                  <td
                    key={month}
                    className="border-l border-border px-2 py-1.5 text-right text-card-foreground"
                  >
                    {fmtCurrency(value)}
                  </td>
                );
              })}
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/analytics/inventory-forecast-table.tsx
