"use client";

import { fmtCurrency, fmtInt, fmtPct } from "@/lib/formatters";
import Image from "next/image";
import { useMemo } from "react";

interface AgeBuckets {
  age_0_90: number;
  age_91_180: number;
  age_181_270: number;
  age_271_365: number;
  age_365_plus: number;
  shipped_7d: number;
  shipped_30d: number;
  shipped_90d: number;
  weeks_of_cover: number | null;
  sales_rank: number | null;
}

interface InventoryProduct {
  asin: string;
  sku: string;
  product_name: string;
  main_image_url: string;
  listing_status: string;
  age: AgeBuckets | null;
  current: {
    product_sales: number;
    units_sold: number;
    ad_spend: number;
    ad_revenue: number;
    available: number;
    inbound_quantity: number;
    reserved_quantity: number;
    reserved_customerorders: number;
    reserved_fc_transfers: number;
    reserved_fc_processing: number;
    unfulfillable_quantity: number;
  } | null;
}

interface InventoryForecastTableProps {
  products: InventoryProduct[];
  periodLabel: string;
}

type HealthStatus = "Healthy" | "Warning" | "Critical" | "No Sales";

function calcDaysOfSupply(available: number, unitsSold: number): number | null {
  if (unitsSold === 0) return null;
  const dailyRate = unitsSold / 7;
  return dailyRate > 0 ? Math.round(available / dailyRate) : null;
}

function getHealth(unitsSold: number, daysOfSupply: number | null): HealthStatus {
  if (unitsSold === 0) return "No Sales";
  if (daysOfSupply == null) return "No Sales";
  if (daysOfSupply <= 14) return "Critical";
  if (daysOfSupply <= 30) return "Warning";
  return "Healthy";
}

const HEALTH_STYLES: Record<HealthStatus, string> = {
  Healthy: "bg-[#34C759]/10 text-[#34C759]",
  Warning: "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400",
  Critical: "bg-[#FF5C5F]/10 text-[#FF5C5F]",
  "No Sales": "bg-muted text-muted-foreground",
};

function StatusBadge({ status }: { status: string }) {
  const isActive = status?.toLowerCase() === "active";
  return (
    <span
      className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium ${
        isActive
          ? "bg-[#34C759]/10 text-[#34C759]"
          : "bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
      }`}
    >
      {status || "\u2014"}
    </span>
  );
}

export function InventoryForecastTable({
  products,
  periodLabel,
}: InventoryForecastTableProps) {
  const sorted = useMemo(
    () =>
      [...products].sort(
        (a, b) =>
          (b.current?.product_sales ?? 0) - (a.current?.product_sales ?? 0),
      ),
    [products],
  );

  return (
    <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-border">
      <table className="w-full text-xs tabular-nums">
        <thead>
          <tr className="border-b border-border bg-muted/50">
            <th className="px-2 py-2 text-left font-medium text-card-foreground" />
            <th className="px-2 py-2 text-left font-medium text-card-foreground">ASIN</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2 text-left font-medium text-card-foreground">SKU</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2 text-left font-medium text-card-foreground min-w-[160px]">Title</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2 text-left font-medium text-card-foreground">Status</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2 text-right font-medium text-card-foreground">Units Sold</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2 text-right font-medium text-card-foreground">Sales</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2 text-right font-medium text-card-foreground">Ad Spend</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2 text-right font-medium text-card-foreground">ACOS</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2 text-right font-medium text-card-foreground">Available</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2 text-right font-medium text-card-foreground">Inbound</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2 text-right font-medium text-card-foreground">Reserved</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2 text-right font-medium text-card-foreground">Unfulfillable</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2 text-right font-medium text-card-foreground whitespace-nowrap">0–90d</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2 text-right font-medium text-card-foreground whitespace-nowrap">91–180d</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2 text-right font-medium text-card-foreground whitespace-nowrap">181–270d</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2 text-right font-medium text-card-foreground whitespace-nowrap">271–365d</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2 text-right font-medium text-card-foreground whitespace-nowrap">365d+</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2 text-right font-medium text-card-foreground">Days of Supply</th>
            <th className="px-2 py-2 text-center font-medium text-card-foreground">Health</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {sorted.map((p, idx) => {
            const c = p.current;
            const unitsSold = c?.units_sold ?? 0;
            const available = c?.available ?? 0;
            const dos = calcDaysOfSupply(available, unitsSold);
            const health = getHealth(unitsSold, dos);
            const acos =
              c && c.ad_revenue > 0
                ? (c.ad_spend / c.ad_revenue) * 100
                : null;

            return (
              <tr
                key={`${p.asin}-${p.sku}`}
                className={`border-b border-border ${idx % 2 === 0 ? "bg-card" : "bg-muted/30"}`}
              >
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5">
                  {p.main_image_url ? (
                    <Image
                      src={p.main_image_url}
                      alt={p.product_name}
                      width={32}
                      height={32}
                      className="rounded object-cover"
                      unoptimized
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <div className="h-8 w-8 rounded bg-muted" />
                  )}
                </td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5">
                  <a
                    href={`https://amazon.com/dp/${p.asin}`}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="text-[#2563eb] hover:underline"
                  >
                    {p.asin}
                  </a>
                </td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5 text-muted-foreground">{p.sku}</td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5 max-w-[200px] truncate" title={p.product_name}>
                  {p.product_name?.length > 40
                    ? p.product_name.slice(0, 40) + "\u2026"
                    : p.product_name || "\u2014"}
                </td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5">
                  <StatusBadge status={p.listing_status} />
                </td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5 text-right">{fmtInt(c?.units_sold)}</td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5 text-right">{fmtCurrency(c?.product_sales)}</td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5 text-right">{fmtCurrency(c?.ad_spend)}</td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5 text-right">{fmtPct(acos)}</td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5 text-right">{fmtInt(c?.available)}</td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5 text-right">{fmtInt(c?.inbound_quantity)}</td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5 text-right">{fmtInt(c?.reserved_quantity)}</td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5 text-right">{fmtInt(c?.unfulfillable_quantity)}</td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5 text-right">{fmtInt(p.age?.age_0_90)}</td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5 text-right">{fmtInt(p.age?.age_91_180)}</td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5 text-right">{fmtInt(p.age?.age_181_270)}</td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5 text-right">{fmtInt(p.age?.age_271_365)}</td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5 text-right">{fmtInt(p.age?.age_365_plus)}</td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5 text-right">{dos != null ? fmtInt(dos) : "\u2014"}</td>
                <td className="px-2 py-1.5 text-center">
                  <span
                    className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium ${HEALTH_STYLES[health]}`}
                  >
                    {health}
                  </span>
                </td>
              </tr>
            );
          })}
          {sorted.length === 0 && (
            <tr>
              <td colSpan={20} className="px-4 py-8 text-center text-muted-foreground">
                No inventory data for {periodLabel}
              </td>
            </tr>
          )}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import {
  MessageCircle,
  Send,
  Check,
  RotateCcw,
  Trash2,
  Loader2,
  Search,
  MapPin,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import type { PendingPin } from "./aplus-workspace";

type Comment = {
  id: string;
  productId: string;
  moduleId: string | null;
  parentCommentId: string | null;
  authorEmail: string;
  authorName: string | null;
  body: string;
  audience: "internal" | "client";
  clientIdCode: string | null;
  status: "active" | "resolved";
  pinX: number | null;
  pinY: number | null;
  commentNumber: number | null;
  resolvedBy: string | null;
  resolvedAt: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
};

interface AplusCommentThreadProps {
  productId: string;
  /** Currently selected module ID for filtering / new comment context */
  activeModuleId?: string | null;
  /** Callback when a comment pin is clicked (to scroll preview) */
  onPinClick?: (moduleId: string | null, pinX: number, pinY: number) => void;
  /** Pending pin from preview click */
  pendingPin?: PendingPin | null;
  /** Clear pending pin */
  onPinClear?: () => void;
}

function getInitials(name: string | null, email: string): string {
  if (name) {
    return name
      .split(" ")
      .map((w) => w[0])
      .join("")
      .toUpperCase()
      .slice(0, 2);
  }
  return email.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
}

function timeAgo(dateStr: string): string {
  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(dateStr).getTime();
  const mins = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
  if (mins < 1) return "just now";
  if (mins < 60) return `${mins}m ago`;
  const hrs = Math.floor(mins / 60);
  if (hrs < 24) return `${hrs}h ago`;
  const days = Math.floor(hrs / 24);
  if (days < 7) return `${days}d ago`;
  return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleDateString();
}

// Avatar colors by email hash
const AVATAR_COLORS = [
  "#3B82F6", "#EF4444", "#10B981", "#F59E0B", "#8B5CF6",
  "#EC4899", "#6366F1", "#14B8A6", "#F97316", "#06B6D4",
];

function avatarColor(email: string): string {
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < email.length; i++) {
    hash = email.charCodeAt(i) + ((hash << 5) - hash);
  }
  return AVATAR_COLORS[Math.abs(hash) % AVATAR_COLORS.length];
}

export function AplusCommentThread({
  productId,
  activeModuleId,
  onPinClick,
  pendingPin,
  onPinClear,
}: AplusCommentThreadProps) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<"active" | "resolved">("active");
  const [newComment, setNewComment] = useState("");
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  // @mention state
  const [mentionQuery, setMentionQuery] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [mentionStart, setMentionStart] = useState(0); // cursor position of the "@"
  const [mentionIdx, setMentionIdx] = useState(0); // keyboard-selected index

  type TeamMember = { id: string; name: string | null; email: string; image: string | null };
  const { data: teamData } = useQuery<TeamMember[]>({
    queryKey: ["team-members"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/team");
      if (!res.ok) return [];
      return res.json();
    },
    staleTime: 5 * 60_000,
  });
  const teamMembers = teamData ?? [];

  const mentionMatches = mentionQuery !== null
    ? teamMembers.filter((m) => {
        const q = mentionQuery.toLowerCase();
        return (m.name?.toLowerCase().includes(q) || m.email.toLowerCase().includes(q));
      }).slice(0, 6)
    : [];

  function handleCommentChange(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) {
    const val = e.target.value;
    setNewComment(val);

    // Detect @mention trigger
    const cursor = e.target.selectionStart ?? val.length;
    const beforeCursor = val.slice(0, cursor);
    const atIdx = beforeCursor.lastIndexOf("@");
    if (atIdx >= 0) {
      const afterAt = beforeCursor.slice(atIdx + 1);
      // Only trigger if no space after @ (still typing the mention)
      if (!afterAt.includes(" ") && afterAt.length <= 30) {
        setMentionQuery(afterAt);
        setMentionStart(atIdx);
        setMentionIdx(0);
        return;
      }
    }
    setMentionQuery(null);
  }

  function insertMention(member: TeamMember) {
    const displayName = member.name || member.email.split("@")[0];
    const before = newComment.slice(0, mentionStart);
    const after = newComment.slice(mentionStart + 1 + (mentionQuery?.length ?? 0));
    setNewComment(`${before}@${displayName} ${after}`);
    setMentionQuery(null);
    inputRef.current?.focus();
  }

  const { data, isLoading } = useQuery<{ comments: Comment[] }>({
    queryKey: ["aplus-comments", productId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/aplus/${productId}/comments`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch comments");
      return res.json();
    },
    refetchInterval: 15000, // Poll every 15s for real-time-ish updates
  });

  const allComments = data?.comments ?? [];

  // Separate top-level and replies
  const topLevel = allComments.filter((c) => !c.parentCommentId);
  const replies = allComments.filter((c) => c.parentCommentId);
  const repliesByParent = new Map<string, Comment[]>();
  for (const r of replies) {
    const key = r.parentCommentId!;
    const existing = repliesByParent.get(key) ?? [];
    existing.push(r);
    repliesByParent.set(key, existing);
  }

  // Filter by tab and search
  const filtered = topLevel.filter((c) => {
    if (c.status !== tab) return false;
    if (searchQuery.trim()) {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      return (
        c.body.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        c.authorName?.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        c.authorEmail.toLowerCase().includes(q)
      );
    }
    return true;
  });

  // Sort: newest first for active, oldest first for resolved
  const sorted = [...filtered].sort((a, b) => {
    const da = new Date(a.createdAt).getTime();
    const db = new Date(b.createdAt).getTime();
    return tab === "active" ? db - da : da - db;
  });

  const activeCount = topLevel.filter((c) => c.status === "active").length;
  const resolvedCount = topLevel.filter((c) => c.status === "resolved").length;

  // Auto-focus input when a pin is placed
  useEffect(() => {
    if (pendingPin && inputRef.current) {
      inputRef.current.focus();
    }
  }, [pendingPin]);

  // Create comment mutation
  const createMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (body: string) => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/aplus/${productId}/comments`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          body,
          moduleId: pendingPin?.moduleId ?? activeModuleId ?? null,
          pinX: pendingPin?.pinX ?? null,
          pinY: pendingPin?.pinY ?? null,
        }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        console.error("[comments] POST failed:", res.status, errData);
        throw new Error(errData.error || `Failed to create comment (${res.status})`);
      }
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["aplus-comments", productId] });
      setNewComment("");
      onPinClear?.();
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => toast.error(err.message || "Failed to post comment"),
  });

  // Resolve/reopen mutation
  const statusMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({ commentId, status }: { commentId: string; status: "active" | "resolved" }) => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/aplus/${productId}/comments/${commentId}`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ status }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to update comment");
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["aplus-comments", productId] });
    },
    onError: () => toast.error("Failed to update comment"),
  });

  // Delete mutation
  const deleteMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (commentId: string) => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/aplus/${productId}/comments/${commentId}`, {
        method: "DELETE",
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to delete comment");
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["aplus-comments", productId] });
    },
    onError: () => toast.error("Failed to delete comment"),
  });

  function handleSubmit() {
    if (!newComment.trim()) return;
    createMutation.mutate(newComment);
  }

  function handleKeyDown(e: React.KeyboardEvent) {
    // Mention dropdown keyboard navigation
    if (mentionQuery !== null && mentionMatches.length > 0) {
      if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
        e.preventDefault();
        setMentionIdx((i) => (i + 1) % mentionMatches.length);
        return;
      }
      if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
        e.preventDefault();
        setMentionIdx((i) => (i - 1 + mentionMatches.length) % mentionMatches.length);
        return;
      }
      if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === "Tab") {
        e.preventDefault();
        insertMention(mentionMatches[mentionIdx]);
        return;
      }
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        setMentionQuery(null);
        return;
      }
    }

    if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      handleSubmit();
    }
  }

  const tabStyle = (isActive: boolean): React.CSSProperties => ({
    fontSize: "13px",
    fontWeight: isActive ? 700 : 500,
    color: isActive ? "#0F1111" : "#888c8c",
    borderBottom: isActive ? "2px solid #008296" : "2px solid transparent",
    padding: "8px 12px",
    cursor: "pointer",
    background: "none",
    border: "none",
    borderBottomStyle: "solid",
    borderBottomWidth: "2px",
    borderBottomColor: isActive ? "#008296" : "transparent",
  });

  return (
    <div style={{
      display: "flex",
      flexDirection: "column",
      height: "100%",
      backgroundColor: "#ffffff",
      color: "#0F1111",
      borderLeft: "1px solid #e7e7e7",
    }}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div style={{
        padding: "12px 16px",
        borderBottom: "1px solid #e7e7e7",
        display: "flex",
        alignItems: "center",
        gap: "8px",
      }}>
        <MessageCircle style={{ width: "16px", height: "16px", color: "#008296" }} />
        <span style={{ fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: 700, color: "#0F1111" }}>Comments</span>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div style={{
        display: "flex",
        borderBottom: "1px solid #e7e7e7",
        padding: "0 8px",
      }}>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setTab("active")} style={tabStyle(tab === "active")}>
          {activeCount} Active
        </button>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setTab("resolved")} style={tabStyle(tab === "resolved")}>
          {resolvedCount} Resolved
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Search */}
      <div style={{ padding: "8px 12px", borderBottom: "1px solid #f0f2f4" }}>
        <div style={{ position: "relative" }}>
          <Search style={{
            position: "absolute",
            left: "8px",
            top: "50%",
            transform: "translateY(-50%)",
            width: "13px",
            height: "13px",
            color: "#888c8c",
          }} />
          <input
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search comments..."
            style={{
              width: "100%",
              padding: "5px 8px 5px 28px",
              fontSize: "12px",
              border: "1px solid #e7e7e7",
              borderRadius: "3px",
              outline: "none",
              color: "#0F1111",
              backgroundColor: "#fafafa",
            }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Comment list */}
      <div style={{
        flex: 1,
        overflowY: "auto",
        padding: "8px 0",
      }}>
        {isLoading ? (
          <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "center", padding: "24px" }}>
            <Loader2 style={{ width: "20px", height: "20px", color: "#888c8c", animation: "spin 1s linear infinite" }} />
          </div>
        ) : sorted.length === 0 ? (
          <div style={{ textAlign: "center", padding: "32px 16px", color: "#888c8c", fontSize: "13px" }}>
            {tab === "active" ? "No active comments" : "No resolved comments"}
          </div>
        ) : (
          sorted.map((comment) => {
            const threadReplies = repliesByParent.get(comment.id) ?? [];
            return (
              <CommentCard
                key={comment.id}
                comment={comment}
                replies={threadReplies}
                onResolve={() => statusMutation.mutate({ commentId: comment.id, status: "resolved" })}
                onReopen={() => statusMutation.mutate({ commentId: comment.id, status: "active" })}
                onDelete={() => deleteMutation.mutate(comment.id)}
                onPinClick={onPinClick}
                productId={productId}
              />
            );
          })
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Pending pin indicator */}
      {pendingPin && (
        <div style={{
          borderTop: "1px solid #e7e7e7",
          padding: "6px 12px",
          display: "flex",
          alignItems: "center",
          gap: "6px",
          backgroundColor: "#f0f9fa",
          fontSize: "12px",
          color: "#008296",
        }}>
          <MapPin style={{ width: "12px", height: "12px", flexShrink: 0 }} />
          <span style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            Pin on MOD{String(pendingPin.moduleNumber).padStart(2, "0")} ({Math.round(pendingPin.pinX)}%, {Math.round(pendingPin.pinY)}%)
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onPinClear}
            style={{
              background: "none",
              border: "none",
              cursor: "pointer",
              padding: "2px",
              color: "#888c8c",
              display: "flex",
            }}
          >
            <X style={{ width: "12px", height: "12px" }} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* New comment input */}
      <div style={{
        borderTop: pendingPin ? "none" : "1px solid #e7e7e7",
        padding: "12px",
        display: "flex",
        alignItems: "flex-end",
        gap: "8px",
      }}>
        <div style={{ flex: 1, position: "relative" }}>
          {/* @mention dropdown */}
          {mentionQuery !== null && mentionMatches.length > 0 && (
            <div style={{
              position: "absolute",
              bottom: "100%",
              left: 0,
              right: 0,
              marginBottom: "4px",
              backgroundColor: "#ffffff",
              border: "1px solid #e7e7e7",
              borderRadius: "4px",
              boxShadow: "0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)",
              maxHeight: "180px",
              overflowY: "auto",
              zIndex: 20,
            }}>
              {mentionMatches.map((m, i) => (
                <button
                  key={m.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => insertMention(m)}
                  style={{
                    display: "flex",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    gap: "8px",
                    width: "100%",
                    padding: "6px 10px",
                    fontSize: "13px",
                    color: "#0F1111",
                    backgroundColor: i === mentionIdx ? "#f0f2f4" : "transparent",
                    border: "none",
                    cursor: "pointer",
                    textAlign: "left",
                  }}
                >
                  <span style={{
                    width: "22px",
                    height: "22px",
                    borderRadius: "50%",
                    backgroundColor: avatarColor(m.email),
                    color: "#fff",
                    fontSize: "10px",
                    fontWeight: 700,
                    display: "flex",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    justifyContent: "center",
                    flexShrink: 0,
                  }}>
                    {getInitials(m.name, m.email)}
                  </span>
                  <span style={{ fontWeight: 600 }}>{m.name || m.email.split("@")[0]}</span>
                  <span style={{ color: "#888c8c", fontSize: "12px" }}>{m.email}</span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
          <textarea
            ref={inputRef}
            value={newComment}
            onChange={handleCommentChange}
            onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
            onBlur={() => setTimeout(() => setMentionQuery(null), 200)}
            placeholder="Type @ to mention a team member"
            rows={1}
            style={{
              width: "100%",
              fontSize: "13px",
              padding: "8px 10px",
              border: "1px solid #e7e7e7",
              borderRadius: "3px",
              outline: "none",
              resize: "none",
              color: "#0F1111",
              minHeight: "36px",
              maxHeight: "80px",
            }}
          />
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleSubmit}
          disabled={!newComment.trim() || createMutation.isPending}
          style={{
            width: "32px",
            height: "32px",
            borderRadius: "50%",
            backgroundColor: newComment.trim() ? "#008296" : "#e7e7e7",
            border: "none",
            cursor: newComment.trim() ? "pointer" : "default",
            display: "flex",
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "center",
            flexShrink: 0,
          }}
        >
          {createMutation.isPending ? (
            <Loader2 style={{ width: "14px", height: "14px", color: "#ffffff", animation: "spin 1s linear infinite" }} />
          ) : (
            <Send style={{ width: "14px", height: "14px", color: "#ffffff" }} />
          )}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ─── Single comment card ──────────────────────────────────────────────

function CommentCard({
  comment,
  replies,
  onResolve,
  onReopen,
  onDelete,
  onPinClick,
  productId,
}: {
  comment: Comment;
  replies: Comment[];
  onResolve: () => void;
  onReopen: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
  onPinClick?: (moduleId: string | null, pinX: number, pinY: number) => void;
  productId: string;
}) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(true);
  const [replyOpen, setReplyOpen] = useState(false);
  const [replyText, setReplyText] = useState("");
  const replyRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);
  const color = comment.audience === "client" ? "#7C3AED" : avatarColor(comment.authorEmail);

  const replyMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (body: string) => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/aplus/${productId}/comments`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          body,
          parentCommentId: comment.id,
          moduleId: comment.moduleId,
          audience: comment.audience,
          clientIdCode: comment.clientIdCode,
        }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const errData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(errData.error || "Failed to reply");
      }
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["aplus-comments", productId] });
      setReplyText("");
      setReplyOpen(false);
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => toast.error(err.message),
  });

  return (
    <div style={{
      padding: "12px 16px",
      borderBottom: "1px solid #f0f2f4",
    }}>
      {/* Header row */}
      <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "flex-start", gap: "10px" }}>
        {/* Number badge */}
        {comment.commentNumber && (
          <span style={{
            display: "inline-flex",
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "center",
            width: "22px",
            height: "22px",
            borderRadius: "50%",
            backgroundColor: color,
            color: "#ffffff",
            fontSize: "11px",
            fontWeight: 700,
            flexShrink: 0,
          }}>
            {comment.commentNumber}
          </span>
        )}

        <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
          {/* Author + time */}
          <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "6px", marginBottom: "4px" }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: "13px", fontWeight: 700, color: "#0F1111" }}>
              {comment.authorName || comment.authorEmail.split("@")[0]}
            </span>
            {comment.audience === "client" && (
              <span style={{
                fontSize: "10px",
                fontWeight: 600,
                color: "#ffffff",
                backgroundColor: "#6366F1",
                padding: "1px 6px",
                borderRadius: "9999px",
                lineHeight: "16px",
              }}>
                Client
              </span>
            )}
            <span style={{ fontSize: "11px", color: "#888c8c" }}>
              {timeAgo(comment.createdAt)}
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Pin indicator */}
          {comment.pinX != null && comment.pinY != null && (
            <div
              style={{
                display: "inline-flex",
                alignItems: "center",
                gap: "3px",
                fontSize: "10px",
                color: "#008296",
                marginBottom: "4px",
                cursor: onPinClick ? "pointer" : "default",
              }}
              onClick={() => {
                if (onPinClick && comment.pinX != null && comment.pinY != null) {
                  onPinClick(comment.moduleId, comment.pinX, comment.pinY);
                }
              }}
            >
              <MapPin style={{ width: "10px", height: "10px" }} />
              Pinned
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Body */}
          <p style={{
            fontSize: "13px",
            color: "#0F1111",
            lineHeight: 1.5,
            margin: 0,
            whiteSpace: "pre-wrap",
            wordBreak: "break-word",
          }}>
            {comment.body}
          </p>

          {/* Actions */}
          <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "8px", marginTop: "8px" }}>
            {comment.status === "active" ? (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onResolve}
                style={{
                  display: "flex",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  gap: "4px",
                  fontSize: "11px",
                  color: "#10B981",
                  background: "none",
                  border: "none",
                  cursor: "pointer",
                  padding: 0,
                }}
              >
                <Check style={{ width: "12px", height: "12px" }} />
                Resolve
              </button>
            ) : (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={onReopen}
                style={{
                  display: "flex",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  gap: "4px",
                  fontSize: "11px",
                  color: "#F59E0B",
                  background: "none",
                  border: "none",
                  cursor: "pointer",
                  padding: 0,
                }}
              >
                <RotateCcw style={{ width: "12px", height: "12px" }} />
                Reopen
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onDelete}
              style={{
                display: "flex",
                alignItems: "center",
                gap: "4px",
                fontSize: "11px",
                color: "#888c8c",
                background: "none",
                border: "none",
                cursor: "pointer",
                padding: 0,
              }}
            >
              <Trash2 style={{ width: "11px", height: "11px" }} />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                setReplyOpen(!replyOpen);
                setTimeout(() => replyRef.current?.focus(), 50);
              }}
              style={{
                display: "flex",
                alignItems: "center",
                gap: "4px",
                fontSize: "11px",
                color: "#008296",
                background: "none",
                border: "none",
                cursor: "pointer",
                padding: 0,
                marginLeft: "4px",
              }}
            >
              <MessageCircle style={{ width: "11px", height: "11px" }} />
              Reply
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Replies */}
          {replies.length > 0 && (
            <div style={{ marginTop: "10px", paddingLeft: "12px", borderLeft: "2px solid #e7e7e7" }}>
              {replies.map((reply) => (
                <div key={reply.id} style={{ marginBottom: "8px" }}>
                  <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "4px", marginBottom: "2px" }}>
                    <span style={{ fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: 600, color: "#0F1111" }}>
                      {reply.authorName || reply.authorEmail.split("@")[0]}
                    </span>
                    {reply.audience === "client" && (
                      <span style={{
                        fontSize: "9px",
                        fontWeight: 600,
                        color: "#ffffff",
                        backgroundColor: "#6366F1",
                        padding: "0px 5px",
                        borderRadius: "9999px",
                        lineHeight: "14px",
                      }}>
                        Client
                      </span>
                    )}
                    <span style={{ fontSize: "10px", color: "#888c8c" }}>
                      {timeAgo(reply.createdAt)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <p style={{ fontSize: "12px", color: "#565959", margin: 0, lineHeight: 1.4 }}>
                    {reply.body}
                  </p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Reply input */}
          {replyOpen && (
            <div style={{ marginTop: "8px", display: "flex", gap: "6px", alignItems: "flex-end" }}>
              <textarea
                ref={replyRef}
                value={replyText}
                onChange={(e) => setReplyText(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => {
                  if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    if (replyText.trim()) replyMutation.mutate(replyText);
                  }
                  if (e.key === "Escape") setReplyOpen(false);
                }}
                placeholder="Write a reply..."
                rows={1}
                style={{
                  flex: 1,
                  fontSize: "12px",
                  padding: "6px 8px",
                  border: "1px solid #e7e7e7",
                  borderRadius: "3px",
                  outline: "none",
                  resize: "none",
                  color: "#0F1111",
                  minHeight: "32px",
                  maxHeight: "60px",
                }}
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => { if (replyText.trim()) replyMutation.mutate(replyText); }}
                disabled={!replyText.trim() || replyMutation.isPending}
                style={{
                  width: "28px",
                  height: "28px",
                  borderRadius: "50%",
                  backgroundColor: replyText.trim() ? "#008296" : "#e7e7e7",
                  border: "none",
                  cursor: replyText.trim() ? "pointer" : "default",
                  display: "flex",
                  alignItems: "center",
                  justifyContent: "center",
                  flexShrink: 0,
                }}
              >
                {replyMutation.isPending ? (
                  <Loader2 style={{ width: "12px", height: "12px", color: "#ffffff", animation: "spin 1s linear infinite" }} />
                ) : (
                  <Send style={{ width: "12px", height: "12px", color: "#ffffff" }} />
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";

  Table,
  TableBody,

  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";

import {
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Info,
  CircleDot,
  AlertCircle,
} from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

// ── Types ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type DiffStatus = "match" | "mismatch" | "hub_only" | "amazon_only";

type DiffEntry = {
  slot: string;
  hubAltText: string | null;
  amazonAltText: string | null;
  status: DiffStatus;
};

type CompareApiResponse = {
  product: { id: string; asin: string | null; name: string | null };
  snapshotFetchedAt: string | null;
  hubImageCount: number;
  amazonImageCount: number | null;
  hasSnapshot: boolean;
  hasAmazonAplus: boolean;
  imageDiff: DiffEntry[];
  matchRate: number;
};

interface AplusComparePanelProps {
  productId: string;
}

// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function formatSlot(slot: string): string {
  // "module_1/image_2" -> "Module 1 / Image 2"
  // "amazon_only/3" -> "Amazon Only #3"
  if (slot.startsWith("amazon_only/")) {
    const n = slot.split("/")[1];
    return `Amazon Only #${n}`;
  }
  return slot
    .replace("module_", "Module ")
    .replace("/image_", " / Image ");
}

function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  const d = new Date(iso);
  return d.toLocaleString("en-US", {
    month: "short",
    day: "numeric",
    year: "numeric",
    hour: "numeric",
    minute: "2-digit",
  });
}

// ── Status badge ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function StatusBadge({ status }: { status: DiffStatus }) {
  switch (status) {
    case "match":
      return (
        <Badge
          variant="outline"
          className="border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500 gap-1"
        >
          <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3" />
          Match
        </Badge>
      );
    case "mismatch":
      return (
        <Badge
          variant="outline"
          className="border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-500 gap-1"
        >
          <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3" />
          Mismatch
        </Badge>
      );
    case "hub_only":
      return (
        <Badge
          variant="outline"
          className="border-blue-500/40 bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-500 gap-1"
        >
          <Info className="h-3 w-3" />
          Hub Only
        </Badge>
      );
    case "amazon_only":
      return (
        <Badge
          variant="outline"
          className="border-purple-500/40 bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-500 gap-1"
        >
          <CircleDot className="h-3 w-3" />
          Amazon Only
        </Badge>
      );
  }
}

// ── Match rate indicator ───────────────────────────────────────────────

function MatchRateIndicator({ rate }: { rate: number }) {
  const color =
    rate >= 90
      ? "text-emerald-500"
      : rate >= 50
      ? "text-amber-500"
      : "text-red-400";

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
      <span className={cn("text-4xl font-bold tabular-nums", color)}>
        {rate}%
      </span>
      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">Match Rate</span>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Loading skeleton ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

function CompareSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <Skeleton className="h-28 w-full rounded-xl" />
      <div className="space-y-2">
        {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
          <Skeleton
            key={i}
            className="h-12 w-full rounded-lg"
            style={{ animationDelay: `${i * 60}ms` }}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Main component ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function AplusComparePanel({ productId }: AplusComparePanelProps) {
  const { data, isLoading, isError } = useQuery<CompareApiResponse>({
    queryKey: ["aplus-compare", productId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/aplus/${productId}/compare`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load comparison data");
      return res.json();
    },
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  if (isLoading) return <CompareSkeleton />;

  if (isError || !data) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 text-center gap-3">
        <AlertCircle className="h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground/50" />
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          Failed to load comparison data. Please try again.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // No snapshot at all
  if (!data.hasSnapshot) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <Card className="border-amber-500/20 bg-amber-500/5">
          <CardContent className="pt-6 flex items-start gap-3">
            <AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5 text-amber-500 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-amber-500">
                No Rainforest snapshot available
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                Run Amazon Sync to fetch live data before comparing.
              </p>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {data.imageDiff.length > 0 && (
          <ImageDiffTable imageDiff={data.imageDiff} />
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Has snapshot but no A+ content on Amazon
  if (!data.hasAmazonAplus) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        {/* Summary header */}
        <SummaryHeader data={data} />

        <Card className="border-muted/30 bg-muted/5">
          <CardContent className="pt-6 flex items-start gap-3">
            <Info className="h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Amazon has no A+ content for this product.
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {data.imageDiff.length > 0 && (
          <ImageDiffTable imageDiff={data.imageDiff} />
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <SummaryHeader data={data} />
      <ImageDiffTable imageDiff={data.imageDiff} />
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Summary header sub-component ──────────────────────────────────────

function SummaryHeader({ data }: { data: CompareApiResponse }) {
  const countDelta =
    data.amazonImageCount !== null
      ? data.amazonImageCount - data.hubImageCount
      : null;

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader className="pb-2">
        <CardTitle className="text-base flex items-center justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
          <div>
            <span className="font-semibold">
              {data.product.name ?? data.product.asin ?? "Product"}
            </span>
            {data.product.asin && (
              <span className="ml-2 text-xs font-mono text-muted-foreground">
                {data.product.asin}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          {data.snapshotFetchedAt && (
            <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">
              Snapshot from: {formatDate(data.snapshotFetchedAt)}
            </span>
          )}
        </CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-8 flex-wrap">
          {/* Match rate */}
          <MatchRateIndicator rate={data.matchRate} />

          {/* Image count comparison */}
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground w-24">Hub images:</span>
              <span className="font-semibold tabular-nums">
                {data.hubImageCount}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground w-24">
                Amazon images:
              </span>
              <span className="font-semibold tabular-nums">
                {data.amazonImageCount ?? "—"}
              </span>
              {countDelta !== null && countDelta !== 0 && (
                <span
                  className={cn(
                    "text-xs font-semibold tabular-nums",
                    countDelta > 0 ? "text-emerald-500" : "text-red-400"
                  )}
                >
                  {countDelta > 0 ? `+${countDelta}` : countDelta}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Quick stats */}
          {data.imageDiff.length > 0 && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap">
              {(["match", "mismatch", "hub_only", "amazon_only"] as DiffStatus[]).map(
                (status) => {
                  const count = data.imageDiff.filter(
                    (e) => e.status === status
                  ).length;
                  if (count === 0) return null;
                  return (
                    <div key={status} className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      <StatusBadge status={status} />
                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
                        {count}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  );
                }
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

// ── Image diff table sub-component ────────────────────────────────────

                <StatusBadge status={entry.status} />
              </TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          ))}

      </Table>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import {
  DndContext,
  closestCenter,
  PointerSensor,
  KeyboardSensor,
  useSensor,
  useSensors,
  type DragEndEvent,
} from "@dnd-kit/core";
import {
  SortableContext,
  sortableKeyboardCoordinates,
  verticalListSortingStrategy,
  arrayMove,
  useSortable,
} from "@dnd-kit/sortable";
import { CSS } from "@dnd-kit/utilities";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Plus, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { AplusModuleCard, SetConfigCtx } from "./aplus-module-card";
import { ModuleTypePicker } from "./module-type-picker";
import { AplusSetConfig, type SetConfig } from "./aplus-set-config";
import type { aplusModules, aplusModuleImages } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import type { AplusModuleType } from "@/lib/aplus-module-specs";

type AplusModule = typeof aplusModules.$inferSelect;
type AplusModuleImage = typeof aplusModuleImages.$inferSelect;
type AplusModuleWithImages = AplusModule & { images: AplusModuleImage[] };
type AplusStatus = "draft" | "in_review" | "approved" | "uploaded";

interface AplusEditorProps {
  productId: string;
  userRole: string;
}

interface AplusApiResponse {
  product: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    asin: string;
    clientIdCode: string;
    marketplace?: string | null;
  };
  modules: AplusModuleWithImages[];
  setConfig?: SetConfig;
}

const STATUS_OPTIONS: { value: AplusStatus; label: string }[] = [
  { value: "draft", label: "Draft" },
  { value: "in_review", label: "In Review" },
  { value: "approved", label: "Approved" },
  { value: "uploaded", label: "Uploaded" },
];

const MAX_SLOTS = 7;

// ─── Sortable wrapper ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function SortableModuleCard({
  module,
  productId,
  readOnly,
  onDelete,
  productClientIdCode,
  productAsin,
  productName,
  productMarketplace,
}: {
  module: AplusModuleWithImages;
  productId: string;
  readOnly: boolean;
  onDelete: () => void;
  productClientIdCode?: string | null;
  productAsin?: string | null;
  productName?: string | null;
  productMarketplace?: string | null;
}) {

  const {
    attributes,
    listeners,
    setNodeRef,
    transform,
    transition,
    isDragging,
  } = useSortable({ id: module.id });

  const style: React.CSSProperties = {
    transform: CSS.Transform.toString(transform),
    transition,
    opacity: isDragging ? 0.5 : 1,
    zIndex: isDragging ? 10 : undefined,
  };

  return (
    <AplusModuleCard
      module={module}
      productId={productId}
      readOnly={readOnly}
      onDelete={onDelete}
      productClientIdCode={productClientIdCode}
      productAsin={productAsin}
      productName={productName}
      productMarketplace={productMarketplace}
      sortableProps={{
        attributes: attributes as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
        listeners: listeners as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
        setNodeRef,
        style,
      }}
    />
  );
}

// ─── Empty slot placeholder ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
function EmptySlot({
  slotNumber,
  readOnly,
  onAdd,
}: {
  slotNumber: number;
  readOnly: boolean;

}) {

      {readOnly && (
        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/40 italic">Empty slot</span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ─── Main editor ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function AplusEditor({ productId, userRole }: AplusEditorProps) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const readOnly = userRole === "viewer";

  const [pickerOpen, setPickerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [pickerSlot, setPickerSlot] = useState<number>(1);

  const { data, isLoading, isError } = useQuery<AplusApiResponse>({
    queryKey: ["aplus-modules", productId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/aplus/${productId}`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load A+ modules");
      return res.json();
    },
    refetchOnWindowFocus: true,
  });

  const modules = data?.modules ?? [];
  const product = data?.product;

  // ── Sensors ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const sensors = useSensors(
    useSensor(PointerSensor, { activationConstraint: { distance: 8 } }),
    useSensor(KeyboardSensor, { coordinateGetter: sortableKeyboardCoordinates })
  );

  // ── Reorder mutation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const reorderMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (order: Array<{ id: string; moduleNumber: number }>) => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/aplus/${productId}/reorder`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ order }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to reorder modules");
      return res.json();
    },
    onError: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["aplus-modules", productId] });
      toast.error("Reorder failed — reverted to previous order");
    },
  });

  const handleDragEnd = useCallback(
    (event: DragEndEvent) => {
      const { active, over } = event;
      if (!over || active.id === over.id) return;

      const oldIndex = modules.findIndex((m) => m.id === active.id);
      const newIndex = modules.findIndex((m) => m.id === over.id);
      if (oldIndex === -1 || newIndex === -1) return;

      const reordered = arrayMove(modules, oldIndex, newIndex).map((m, i) => ({
        ...m,
        moduleNumber: i + 1,
      }));

      // Optimistic update
      queryClient.setQueryData<AplusApiResponse>(
        ["aplus-modules", productId],
        (prev) => prev ? { ...prev, modules: reordered } : prev
      );

      // Persist
      reorderMutation.mutate(
        reordered.map((m) => ({ id: m.id, moduleNumber: m.moduleNumber }))
      );
    },
    [modules, productId, queryClient, reorderMutation]
  );

  // ── Create module mutation ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const createMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      moduleType,
      moduleNumber,
    }: {
      moduleType: AplusModuleType;
      moduleNumber: number;
    }) => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/aplus/${productId}/modules`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ moduleType, moduleNumber }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(err.error || "Failed to create module");
      }
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["aplus-modules", productId] });
      toast.success("Module created");
    },
    onError: (err) => {
      toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to create module");
    },
  });

  // ── Bulk status mutation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const bulkStatusMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (status: AplusStatus) => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/aplus/${productId}/bulk-status`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ status }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to bulk update status");
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: (_data, status) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["aplus-modules", productId] });
      toast.success(`All modules set to ${status.replace(/_/g, " ")}`);
    },
    onError: () => {
      toast.error("Failed to update module statuses");
    },
  });

  const handleOpenPicker = (slotNumber: number) => {
    setPickerSlot(slotNumber);
    setPickerOpen(true);
  };

  const handleTypeSelect = (type: AplusModuleType) => {
    createMutation.mutate({ moduleType: type, moduleNumber: pickerSlot });
  };

  // ── Rollup counts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const approvedCount = modules.filter((m) => m.status === "approved").length;
  const filledCount = modules.length;

  // ── 7-slot layout ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const slots = Array.from({ length: MAX_SLOTS }, (_, i) => i + 1);
  // Build a map: moduleNumber -> module
  const moduleByNumber = new Map<number, AplusModuleWithImages>();
  for (const m of modules) {
    moduleByNumber.set(m.moduleNumber, m);
  }

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-[300px]">
        <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (isError) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-[300px]">
        <p className="text-sm text-red-500">Failed to load A+ modules. Please refresh.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Note: product header, status badge, bulk status, and set config
          are now in the workspace top bar (aplus-workspace.tsx). */}

      {/* 7-slot list with DnD for filled modules */}
      <SetConfigCtx.Provider value={{
        scopeType: data?.setConfig?.scopeType,
        scopeIdentifier: data?.setConfig?.scopeIdentifier,
        platform: data?.setConfig?.platform,
        version: data?.setConfig?.version,
        groupNumber: data?.setConfig?.groupNumber ?? undefined,
        parentAsin: data?.setConfig?.parentAsin ?? undefined,
        coveredAsins: data?.setConfig?.coveredAsins ?? undefined,
        clientIdCode: data?.product?.clientIdCode ?? undefined,
        asin: data?.product?.asin ?? undefined,
      }}>
        <DndContext
          sensors={sensors}
          collisionDetection={closestCenter}
          onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}
        >
          <SortableContext
            items={modules.map((m) => m.id)}
            strategy={verticalListSortingStrategy}
          >
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {slots.map((slotNumber) => {
                const module = moduleByNumber.get(slotNumber);
                if (module) {
                  return (
                    <SortableModuleCard
                      key={module.id}
                      module={module}
                      productId={productId}
                      readOnly={readOnly}
                      productClientIdCode={product?.clientIdCode}
                      productAsin={product?.asin}
                      productName={product?.name}
                      productMarketplace={product?.marketplace}
                      onDelete={() => {
                        queryClient.invalidateQueries({
                          queryKey: ["aplus-modules", productId],
                        });
                      }}
                    />
                  );
                }
                return (
                  <EmptySlot
                    key={`empty-${slotNumber}`}
                    slotNumber={slotNumber}
                    readOnly={readOnly}
                    onAdd={handleOpenPicker}
                  />
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </SortableContext>
        </DndContext>
      </SetConfigCtx.Provider>

      {/* Module type picker dialog */}
      <ModuleTypePicker
        open={pickerOpen}
        onOpenChange={setPickerOpen}
        onSelect={handleTypeSelect}
        slotNumber={pickerSlot}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useContext } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { ImageIcon, Loader2, Check, X, AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import type { ImageSlotSpec, AplusModuleType } from "@/lib/aplus-module-specs";
import type { aplusModuleImages } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { ProductFallbackCtx, ModuleNamingCtx, SetConfigCtx } from "./aplus-module-card";
import { getFixedSlotKey, getRepeatableSlotKey, generateImageFilename, type AplusScopeType } from "@/lib/aplus-file-naming";

type AplusModuleImage = typeof aplusModuleImages.$inferSelect;
type FieldSaveState = "idle" | "saving" | "saved" | "error";
type UploadState = "idle" | "uploading" | "success" | "error";

interface AplusImageSlotProps {
  image: AplusModuleImage;
  productId: string;
  moduleId: string;
  readOnly: boolean;
  slotSpec: ImageSlotSpec;
  fallbackClientIdCode?: string | null;
  fallbackAsin?: string | null;
  /** Module type for SOP file naming */
  moduleType?: AplusModuleType;
  /** Module position (1-based) for SOP file naming */
  modulePosition?: number;
  /** Product marketplace for SOP folder resolution */
  marketplace?: string | null;
  /** Panel number (1-based) — for repeatable group images (carousel, hotspot, etc.) */
  panelNumber?: number;
}

async function patchImage(
  productId: string,
  moduleId: string,
  imageId: string,
  data: Partial<{ altText: string; imageDescription: string; aiImagePrompt: string; driveFileId: string; mobileDriveFileId: string }>
) {
  const res = await fetch(
    `/api/aplus/${productId}/modules/${moduleId}/images/${imageId}`,
    {
      method: "PATCH",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(data),
    }
  );
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    throw new Error(err.error || "Failed to save");
  }
  return res.json();
}

function SaveIndicator({ state }: { state: FieldSaveState }) {
  if (state === "saving")
    return <Loader2 style={{ width: "12px", height: "12px", color: "#888c8c", animation: "spin 1s linear infinite", flexShrink: 0 }} />;
  if (state === "saved")
    return <Check style={{ width: "12px", height: "12px", color: "#047857", flexShrink: 0 }} />;
  if (state === "error")
    return <X style={{ width: "12px", height: "12px", color: "#d13212", flexShrink: 0 }} />;
  return null;
}

export function AplusImageSlot({
  image,
  productId,
  moduleId,
  readOnly,
  slotSpec,
  fallbackClientIdCode,
  fallbackAsin,
  moduleType,
  modulePosition,
  marketplace,
  panelNumber,
}: AplusImageSlotProps) {
  const productFallback = useContext(ProductFallbackCtx);
  const moduleNamingCtx = useContext(ModuleNamingCtx);
  const clientIdCode = image.clientIdCode || fallbackClientIdCode || productFallback.clientIdCode;
  const asin = image.asin || fallbackAsin || productFallback.asin;

  const setConfigCtx = useContext(SetConfigCtx);

  // SOP naming: prefer props, fall back to context
  const resolvedModuleType = moduleType ?? moduleNamingCtx.moduleType;
  const resolvedModulePosition = modulePosition ?? moduleNamingCtx.modulePosition;
  const resolvedMarketplace = marketplace ?? moduleNamingCtx.marketplace;
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);

  const [altText, setAltText] = useState(image.altText ?? "");
  const [aiImagePrompt, setAiImagePrompt] = useState(image.aiImagePrompt ?? "");
  const [imageDescription, setImageDescription] = useState(image.imageDescription ?? "");

  const [altSaveState, setAltSaveState] = useState<FieldSaveState>("idle");
  const [promptSaveState, setPromptSaveState] = useState<FieldSaveState>("idle");
  const [descSaveState, setDescSaveState] = useState<FieldSaveState>("idle");

  // AI alt text generation
  const [isGeneratingAlt, setIsGeneratingAlt] = useState(false);

  // Upload state — desktop
  const [uploadState, setUploadState] = useState<UploadState>("idle");
  const [uploadedFileName, setUploadedFileName] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [driveFileId, setDriveFileId] = useState<string | null>(
    (image as Record<string, unknown>).driveFileId as string | null ?? null
  );

  // Upload state — mobile
  const [mobileUploadState, setMobileUploadState] = useState<UploadState>("idle");
  const [mobileDriveFileId, setMobileDriveFileId] = useState<string | null>(
    (image as Record<string, unknown>).mobileDriveFileId as string | null ?? null
  );

  // Sync local state when image prop changes (e.g. after query invalidation)
  useEffect(() => {
    setAltText(image.altText ?? "");
    setAiImagePrompt(image.aiImagePrompt ?? "");
    setImageDescription(image.imageDescription ?? "");
    setDriveFileId((image as Record<string, unknown>).driveFileId as string | null ?? null);
    setMobileDriveFileId((image as Record<string, unknown>).mobileDriveFileId as string | null ?? null);
  }, [image.id, image.altText, image.aiImagePrompt, image.imageDescription, (image as Record<string, unknown>).driveFileId, (image as Record<string, unknown>).mobileDriveFileId]);

  // Replace-in-place confirmation state
  const [confirmReplaceOpen, setConfirmReplaceOpen] = useState(false);
  const [pendingReplaceDevice, setPendingReplaceDevice] = useState<"DV" | "MV" | null>(null);
  const pendingFileRef = useRef<File | null>(null);

  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const mobileFileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const mutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (data: Partial<{ altText: string; imageDescription: string; aiImagePrompt: string; driveFileId: string; mobileDriveFileId: string }>) =>
      patchImage(productId, moduleId, image.id, data),
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["aplus-modules", productId] });
    },
  });

  const makeBlurHandler = (
    field: "altText" | "aiImagePrompt" | "imageDescription",
    currentValue: string,
    savedValue: string | null,
    setSaveState: (s: FieldSaveState) => void
  ) => async () => {
    const trimmed = currentValue.trim() || null;
    if (trimmed === (savedValue?.trim() || null)) return;
    setSaveState("saving");
    try {
      await mutation.mutateAsync({ [field]: trimmed ?? "" });
      setSaveState("saved");
      setTimeout(() => setSaveState("idle"), 1500);
    } catch {
      setSaveState("error");
      toast.error("Failed to save field");
    }
  };

  async function handleGenerateAltText() {
    setIsGeneratingAlt(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/aplus/ai/alt-text", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          productId,
          productName: productFallback.productName || "Unknown product",
          moduleType: resolvedModuleType,
          slotLabel: slotSpec.label,
          imageDescription: imageDescription.trim() || undefined,
          aiImagePrompt: aiImagePrompt.trim() || undefined,
          driveFileId: driveFileId || undefined,
        }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to generate");
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.altText) {
        setAltText(data.altText);
        // Auto-save
        setAltSaveState("saving");
        await mutation.mutateAsync({ altText: data.altText });
        setAltSaveState("saved");
        setTimeout(() => setAltSaveState("idle"), 1500);
        toast.success("Alt text generated");
      }
    } catch {
      toast.error("Failed to generate alt text");
    } finally {
      setIsGeneratingAlt(false);
    }
  }

  // Resolve the SOP file slot key from spec key + module type
  // Panel images (panelNumber set) → PAN{n}, fixed images → MAIN/BG/IMG/etc.
  const fileSlotKey = panelNumber
    ? getRepeatableSlotKey(slotSpec.key, panelNumber)
    : resolvedModuleType
      ? getFixedSlotKey(resolvedModuleType, slotSpec.key)
      : String(image.imageSlot);

  /** Build the SOP filename for display in the replace confirmation dialog */
  function getSopFilename(device: "DV" | "MV"): string {
    const cid = setConfigCtx.clientIdCode || clientIdCode || "UNKNOWN";
    const ver = setConfigCtx.version || 1;
    const st = (setConfigCtx.scopeType || "ASIN") as AplusScopeType;
    const scopeAsin = st === "ASIN" ? (asin || "UNKNOWN") : undefined;
    const grpNum = st === "GRP" ? setConfigCtx.groupNumber : undefined;
    if (resolvedModuleType && resolvedModulePosition) {
      return generateImageFilename(cid, ver, st, resolvedModulePosition, resolvedModuleType, fileSlotKey, device, scopeAsin, grpNum);
    }
    return `${cid}_V${String(ver).padStart(2, "0")}_${fileSlotKey}_${device}.png`;
  }

  async function doMultipartUpload(file: File, device: "DV" | "MV"): Promise<{ driveFileId: string; displayName: string }> {
    // Resolve clientIdCode: prefer set config context (has full cid), fall back to product-level
    const resolvedCid = setConfigCtx.clientIdCode || clientIdCode || "";
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append("file", file);
    formData.append("clientIdCode", resolvedCid);
    formData.append("asin", asin ?? "");
    formData.append("folderType", "aplus");
    formData.append("entityType", "aplus_image");
    formData.append("entityId", image.id);
    formData.append("imageSlot", String(image.imageSlot));
    // SOP naming metadata
    if (resolvedModuleType) formData.append("moduleType", resolvedModuleType);
    if (resolvedModulePosition) formData.append("modulePosition", String(resolvedModulePosition));
    formData.append("slotKey", fileSlotKey);
    formData.append("device", device);
    if (resolvedMarketplace) formData.append("marketplace", resolvedMarketplace);
    // Set config values for folder resolution + new naming convention
    if (setConfigCtx.platform) formData.append("platform", setConfigCtx.platform);
    if (setConfigCtx.scopeType) formData.append("scopeType", setConfigCtx.scopeType);
    if (setConfigCtx.scopeIdentifier) formData.append("scopeIdentifier", setConfigCtx.scopeIdentifier);
    if (setConfigCtx.version) formData.append("version", String(setConfigCtx.version));
    if (setConfigCtx.groupNumber) formData.append("groupNumber", String(setConfigCtx.groupNumber));

    const res = await fetch("/api/drive/upload", {
      method: "POST",
      body: formData,
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(err.error || "Upload failed");
    }

    const data = await res.json();
    return { driveFileId: data.driveFileId, displayName: data.displayName };
  }

  async function doResumableUpload(file: File, device: "DV" | "MV"): Promise<{ driveFileId: string; displayName: string }> {
    // Step 1: Initiate session server-side
    const sessionRes = await fetch("/api/drive/upload-session", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        clientIdCode: clientIdCode ?? "",
        asin: asin ?? "",
        folderType: "aplus",
        imageSlot: String(image.imageSlot),
        mimeType: file.type,
        entityType: "aplus_image",
        entityId: image.id,
        fileName: file.name,
        // SOP naming metadata
        moduleType: resolvedModuleType ?? undefined,
        modulePosition: resolvedModulePosition ?? undefined,
        slotKey: fileSlotKey,
        device,
        marketplace: resolvedMarketplace ?? undefined,
        // Set config values for folder resolution + new naming convention
        platform: setConfigCtx.platform ?? undefined,
        scopeType: setConfigCtx.scopeType ?? undefined,
        scopeIdentifier: setConfigCtx.scopeIdentifier ?? undefined,
        version: setConfigCtx.version ?? undefined,
        clientIdCodeOverride: setConfigCtx.clientIdCode ?? undefined,
        groupNumber: setConfigCtx.groupNumber ?? undefined,
      }),
    });

    if (!sessionRes.ok) {
      const err = await sessionRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(err.error || "Failed to initiate upload session");
    }

    const meta = await sessionRes.json();

    // Step 2: Send raw binary to server proxy with metadata in headers (avoids CORS)
    const proxyRes = await fetch("/api/drive/upload-resumable", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": file.type,
        "x-session-uri": meta.sessionUri,
        "x-mime-type": meta.mimeType ?? file.type,
        "x-folder-id": meta.folderId ?? "",
        "x-display-name": meta.displayName ?? "",
        "x-original-name": meta.originalName ?? file.name,
        "x-entity-type": meta.entityType ?? "",
        "x-entity-id": meta.entityId ?? "",
      },
      body: file,
    });

    if (!proxyRes.ok) {
      const err = await proxyRes.json().catch(() => ({}));
      throw new Error(err.error || "Upload to Drive failed");
    }

    const proxyData = await proxyRes.json();
    return { driveFileId: proxyData.driveFileId, displayName: proxyData.displayName ?? meta.displayName };
  }

  /** Execute the actual upload for a device slot */
  async function executeUpload(file: File, device: "DV" | "MV") {
    const isDesktop = device === "DV";
    if (isDesktop) setUploadState("uploading");
    else setMobileUploadState("uploading");

    try {
      const FOUR_MB = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
      const result = file.size <= FOUR_MB
        ? await doMultipartUpload(file, device)
        : await doResumableUpload(file, device);

      if (isDesktop) {
        setUploadState("success");
        setUploadedFileName(result.displayName);
        setDriveFileId(result.driveFileId);
        mutation.mutate({ driveFileId: result.driveFileId });
      } else {
        setMobileUploadState("success");
        setMobileDriveFileId(result.driveFileId);
        mutation.mutate({ mobileDriveFileId: result.driveFileId });
      }
      toast.success(`${isDesktop ? "Desktop" : "Mobile"} image uploaded to Drive`);
    } catch (err) {
      if (isDesktop) setUploadState("error");
      else setMobileUploadState("error");
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Upload failed";
      toast.error(message);
    }
  }

  /** Confirm replace and proceed with upload */
  function handleConfirmReplace() {
    const file = pendingFileRef.current;
    const device = pendingReplaceDevice;
    setConfirmReplaceOpen(false);
    setPendingReplaceDevice(null);
    pendingFileRef.current = null;
    if (file && device) {
      executeUpload(file, device);
    }
  }

  function handleCancelReplace() {
    setConfirmReplaceOpen(false);
    setPendingReplaceDevice(null);
    pendingFileRef.current = null;
  }

  async function handleFileChange(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    e.target.value = "";

    // If slot already has a file, show replace confirmation
    if (driveFileId) {
      pendingFileRef.current = file;
      setPendingReplaceDevice("DV");
      setConfirmReplaceOpen(true);
      return;
    }

    executeUpload(file, "DV");
  }

  async function handleMobileFileChange(e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    e.target.value = "";

    // If slot already has a file, show replace confirmation
    if (mobileDriveFileId) {
      pendingFileRef.current = file;
      setPendingReplaceDevice("MV");
      setConfirmReplaceOpen(true);
      return;
    }

    executeUpload(file, "MV");
  }

  function handleDropZoneClick() {
    if (readOnly) return;
    if (!clientIdCode) {
      toast.error("This image slot has no client code. Save the module first.");
      return;
    }
    fileInputRef.current?.click();
  }

  function handleMobileDropZoneClick() {
    if (readOnly) return;
    if (!clientIdCode) {
      toast.error("This image slot has no client code. Save the module first.");
      return;
    }
    mobileFileInputRef.current?.click();
  }

  const dimText = `${slotSpec.desktopSize.width}:${slotSpec.desktopSize.height}`;
  const hasAltText = !!image.altText?.trim();

  const inputStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    backgroundColor: "#ffffff",
    color: "#0F1111",
    border: "1px solid #888c8c",
    borderRadius: "4px",
    fontSize: "14px",
    padding: "6px 10px",
    width: "100%",
    outline: "none",
  };

  const hasDesktopImage = !!driveFileId;
  const hasMobileImage = !!mobileDriveFileId;

  const dropZoneStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    backgroundColor: "#f7f8fa",
    border: "2px dashed #7f9ba6",
    borderRadius: "2px",
    display: "flex",
    flexDirection: "column",
    alignItems: "center",
    justifyContent: "center",
    gap: "6px",
    cursor: "pointer",
    overflow: "hidden",
  };

  // Render drop zone content based on upload state
  function renderDesktopDropZoneContent() {
    if (uploadState === "uploading") {
      return (
        <>
          <Loader2 style={{ width: "36px", height: "36px", color: "#6b8f9e", animation: "spin 1s linear infinite" }} />
          <span style={{ fontSize: "14px", color: "#6b8f9e" }}>Uploading...</span>
        </>
      );
    }
    if (uploadState === "success" && imageProxyUrl) {
      return (
        <img
          src={imageProxyUrl}
          alt={altText || "Uploaded image"}
          style={{
            width: "100%",
            objectFit: "cover",
            borderRadius: "2px",
          }}
        />
      );
    }
    if (uploadState === "error") {
      return (
        <>
          <AlertTriangle style={{ width: "36px", height: "36px", color: "#d13212" }} />
          <div style={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: "14px", color: "#d13212", fontWeight: 500 }}>
              Upload failed
            </span>
            <br />
            <span style={{ fontSize: "13px", color: "#6b8f9e" }}>
              Click to retry

          </div>
        </>
      );
