    return (
      <>
        <ImageIcon style={{ width: "36px", height: "36px", color: "#6b8f9e" }} />
        <div style={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
          <span style={{ fontSize: "14px", color: "#6b8f9e", fontWeight: 500 }}>
            Click to upload
          </span>
        </div>
      </>
    );
  }

  const imageProxyUrl = driveFileId ? `/api/drive/file/${driveFileId}` : null;

  return (
    <>
      {/* Hidden file inputs */}
      <input
        type="file"
        ref={fileInputRef}
        accept="image/*"
        style={{ display: "none" }}
        onChange={handleFileChange}
      />
      <input
        type="file"
        ref={mobileFileInputRef}
        accept="image/*"
        style={{ display: "none" }}
        onChange={handleMobileFileChange}
      />

      {/* ── Clickable image placeholder (SC style) ────────────── */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setDialogOpen(true)}
        style={{
          width: "100%",
          backgroundColor: "#f7f8fa",
          border: imageProxyUrl ? "2px solid #e7e7e7" : "2px dashed #7f9ba6",
          borderRadius: "2px",
          display: "flex",
          flexDirection: "column",
          alignItems: "center",
          justifyContent: "center",
          gap: "6px",
          padding: imageProxyUrl ? "8px" : "48px 0",
          cursor: "pointer",
          overflow: "hidden",
        }}
      >
        {imageProxyUrl ? (
          <>
            <img
              src={imageProxyUrl}
              alt={altText || "Uploaded image"}
              style={{
                width: "100%",
                objectFit: "cover",
                borderRadius: "2px",
              }}
            />
            {hasAltText && (
              <span style={{ fontSize: "12px", color: "#888c8c", marginTop: "4px" }}>
                Alt: {image.altText}
              </span>
            )}
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <ImageIcon style={{ width: "28px", height: "28px", color: "#6b8f9e" }} />
            <span style={{ fontSize: "13px", fontWeight: 600, color: "#6b8f9e" }}>{dimText}</span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: "13px", color: "#6b8f9e", display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "6px" }}>
              {uploadState === "uploading" && (
                <Loader2 style={{ width: "13px", height: "13px", animation: "spin 1s linear infinite" }} />
              )}
              Click to add image
            </span>
            {hasAltText && (
              <span style={{ fontSize: "12px", color: "#888c8c", marginTop: "4px" }}>
                Alt: {image.altText}
              </span>
            )}
            {uploadedFileName && (
              <span style={{ fontSize: "12px", color: "#047857", marginTop: "4px" }}>
                Uploaded: {uploadedFileName}
              </span>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </button>

      {/* ── Replace-in-place confirmation dialog ────────────── */}
      {confirmReplaceOpen && pendingReplaceDevice && createPortal(
        <div
          style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, zIndex: 110, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }}
        >
          <div
            style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.4)" }}
            onClick={handleCancelReplace}
          />
          <div
            style={{
              position: "relative",
              backgroundColor: "#ffffff",
              color: "#0F1111",
              borderRadius: "4px",
              boxShadow: "0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)",
              width: "100%",
              maxWidth: "420px",
              padding: "24px",
              zIndex: 111,
            }}
          >
            <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "flex-start", gap: "12px", marginBottom: "16px" }}>
              <AlertTriangle style={{ width: "24px", height: "24px", color: "#e47911", flexShrink: 0, marginTop: "2px" }} />
              <div>
                <h3 style={{ fontSize: "16px", fontWeight: 700, color: "#0F1111", margin: "0 0 8px 0" }}>
                  Replace existing image?
                </h3>
                <p style={{ fontSize: "14px", color: "#565959", margin: "0 0 8px 0" }}>
                  This slot already has a file in Drive. Uploading will overwrite:
                </p>
                <code style={{
                  display: "block",
                  fontSize: "13px",
                  backgroundColor: "#f0f2f4",
                  color: "#0F1111",
                  padding: "8px 12px",
                  borderRadius: "3px",
                  fontFamily: "monospace",
                  wordBreak: "break-all",
                }}>
                  {getSopFilename(pendingReplaceDevice)}
                </code>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "flex-end", gap: "8px" }}>
              <button
                type="button"

              <button

                  backgroundColor: "#e47911",
                  border: "1px solid #c45500",

              >
                Replace

            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      , document.body)}

      {/* ── Add Image dialog (Amazon SC style) ─────────────── */}
      {dialogOpen && createPortal(
        <div
          style={{ position: "fixed", inset: 0, zIndex: 100, display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }}
        >
          <div
            style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, backgroundColor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.4)" }}
            onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)}
          />

          <div
            style={{
              position: "relative",
              backgroundColor: "#ffffff",
              color: "#0F1111",
              borderRadius: "4px",
              boxShadow: "0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)",
              width: "100%",
              maxWidth: slotSpec.mobileSize ? "680px" : "480px",
              maxHeight: "90vh",
              overflowY: "auto",
              padding: "24px",
              zIndex: 101,
            }}
          >
            {/* Header */}
            <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "space-between", marginBottom: "20px" }}>
              <h2 style={{ fontSize: "18px", fontWeight: 700, color: "#0F1111", margin: 0 }}>Add Image</h2>
              <button
                type="button"

                <label style={{ fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: 700, color: "#0F1111", display: "block", marginBottom: "8px" }}>

              {slotSpec.mobileSize && (
                <div>
                  <label style={{ fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: 700, color: "#0F1111", display: "block", marginBottom: "8px" }}>
                    <span style={{ color: "#d13212", marginRight: "2px" }}>*</span>
                    Add mobile image [{slotSpec.mobileSize.width}px x {slotSpec.mobileSize.height}px min]
                  </label>
                  <div style={{ ...dropZoneStyle, padding: hasMobileImage ? 0 : "48px 0" }} onClick={handleMobileDropZoneClick}>
                    {mobileUploadState === "uploading" ? (
                      <>
                        <Loader2 style={{ width: "36px", height: "36px", color: "#6b8f9e", animation: "spin 1s linear infinite" }} />
                        <span style={{ fontSize: "14px", color: "#6b8f9e" }}>Uploading...</span>
                      </>
                    ) : mobileDriveFileId ? (
                      <img
                        src={`/api/drive/file/${mobileDriveFileId}`}
                        alt={altText || "Uploaded mobile image"}
                        style={{ width: "100%", objectFit: "cover", borderRadius: "2px" }}
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <ImageIcon style={{ width: "36px", height: "36px", color: "#6b8f9e" }} />
                        <div style={{ textAlign: "center" }}>
                          <span style={{ fontSize: "14px", color: "#6b8f9e", fontWeight: 500 }}>
                            Drag image here
                          </span>
                          <br />
                          <span style={{ fontSize: "14px", color: "#6b8f9e" }}>
                            <strong>or</strong> click to select
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Alt text */}

                <SaveIndicator state={altSaveState} />

              <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "8px", alignItems: "center" }}>
                <input
                  value={altText}
                  onChange={(e) => setAltText(e.target.value)}
                  onBlur={makeBlurHandler("altText", altText, image.altText, setAltSaveState)}
                  disabled={readOnly}
                  placeholder="Enter alt text"
                  maxLength={110}
                  style={{ ...inputStyle, flex: 1 }}
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleGenerateAltText}
                  disabled={readOnly || isGeneratingAlt}
                  style={{
                    display: "flex",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    gap: "6px",
                    padding: "6px 14px",
                    fontSize: "13px",
                    fontWeight: 600,
                    color: "#ffffff",
                    background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #c84b31 0%, #e8602a 50%, #d4522e 100%)",
                    border: "none",
                    borderRadius: "8px",
                    cursor: isGeneratingAlt ? "wait" : "pointer",
                    whiteSpace: "nowrap",
                    opacity: readOnly ? 0.4 : 1,
                    minWidth: "fit-content",
                    flexShrink: 0,
                  }}
                >
                  {isGeneratingAlt ? (
                    <Loader2 style={{ width: "14px", height: "14px", animation: "spin 1s linear infinite" }} />
                  ) : (
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" style={{ width: "14px", height: "14px" }}>
                      <path d="M11.987 1C5.924 1 1 5.923 1 11.987 1 18.05 5.924 23 11.987 23 18.05 23 23 18.05 23 11.987 23 5.923 18.05 1 11.987 1zm.013 3.5c.46 0 .833.373.833.833v3.334a.833.833 0 0 1-1.666 0V5.333c0-.46.373-.833.833-.833zm5.196 2.304a.833.833 0 0 1 0 1.179l-2.357 2.357a.833.833 0 0 1-1.179-1.179l2.357-2.357a.833.833 0 0 1 1.179 0zM5.804 6.804a.833.833 0 0 1 1.179 0l2.357 2.357a.833.833 0 1 1-1.179 1.179L5.804 7.983a.833.833 0 0 1 0-1.179zM4.5 11.154h3.334a.833.833 0 0 1 0 1.666H4.5a.833.833 0 0 1 0-1.666zm11.666 0H19.5a.833.833 0 0 1 0 1.666h-3.334a.833.833 0 0 1 0-1.666zm-3.023 3.189a.833.833 0 0 1 0 1.179l-2.357 2.357a.833.833 0 0 1-1.179-1.179l2.357-2.357a.833.833 0 0 1 1.179 0zM9.34 14.34a.833.833 0 0 1 1.179 1.179l-2.357 2.357a.833.833 0 0 1-1.179-1.179zm2.647 2.327a.833.833 0 0 1 .833.833V20.833a.833.833 0 0 1-1.666 0V17.5c0-.46.373-.833.833-.833z"/>

FILE: src/components/aplus/aplus-import-wizard.tsx
================================================
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";
import { Loader2, RefreshCw, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";

// ── Types ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type ProductsApiResponse = {
  products: unknown[];
  clients: string[];
  role: string;
};

type ImportResult = {
  imported: number;
  skipped: number;
  errors: string[];
};

// ── Step indicator ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function StepIndicator({ step }: { step: 1 | 2 | 3 }) {
  return (
    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-6">
      Step {step} of 3
    </p>
  );
}

// ── Main wizard ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function AplusImportWizard() {
  const [step, setStep] = useState<1 | 2 | 3>(1);
  const [selectedClient, setSelectedClient] = useState<string>("");
  const [availableAsins, setAvailableAsins] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [selectedAsins, setSelectedAsins] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [asinsLoading, setAsinsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [asinsError, setAsinsError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [importing, setImporting] = useState(false);
  const [importResult, setImportResult] = useState<ImportResult | null>(null);

  // Fetch client list
  const { data, isLoading: clientsLoading } = useQuery<ProductsApiResponse>({
    queryKey: ["aplus-products-wizard"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/aplus/products");
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch clients");
      return res.json();
    },
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  const clients = data?.clients ?? [];
  const userRole = data?.role ?? "viewer";

  // Admin guard
  if (!clientsLoading && userRole !== "admin") {
    return (
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="py-12 text-center">
            <AlertCircle className="h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground mx-auto mb-3" />
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">Admin access required</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
              Only administrators can access the A+ import tool.
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ── Step 2: fetch ASINs ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  async function loadAsins(clientIdCode: string) {
    setAsinsLoading(true);
    setAsinsError(null);
    setAvailableAsins([]);
    setSelectedAsins(new Set());

    try {
      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/aplus/asins?clientIdCode=${encodeURIComponent(clientIdCode)}`
      );
      if (!res.ok) {
        const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(body.error ?? "Failed to fetch ASINs");
      }
      const json = await res.json();
      setAvailableAsins(json.asins ?? []);
    } catch (err) {
      setAsinsError(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to load ASINs"
      );
    } finally {
      setAsinsLoading(false);
    }
  }

  function goToStep2() {
    setStep(2);
    loadAsins(selectedClient);
  }

  function handleSelectAll() {
    setSelectedAsins(new Set(availableAsins));
  }

  function handleDeselectAll() {
    setSelectedAsins(new Set());
  }

  function toggleAsin(asin: string) {
    setSelectedAsins((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(asin)) {
        next.delete(asin);
      } else {
        next.add(asin);
      }
      return next;
    });
  }

  // ── Step 3: run import ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  async function runImport() {
    setImporting(true);
    setStep(3);
    setImportResult(null);

    try {
      const res = await fetch("/api/aplus/import", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          clientIdCode: selectedClient,
          asins: Array.from(selectedAsins),
        }),
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(body.error ?? "Import failed");
      }

      const result: ImportResult = await res.json();
      setImportResult(result);
      toast.success(`Imported ${result.imported} ASIN${result.imported !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`);
    } catch (err) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Import failed";
      setImportResult({ imported: 0, skipped: 0, errors: [message] });
      toast.error(message);
    } finally {
      setImporting(false);
    }
  }

  function resetWizard() {
    setStep(1);
    setSelectedClient("");
    setAvailableAsins([]);
    setSelectedAsins(new Set());
    setAsinsError(null);
    setImportResult(null);
  }

  // ── Render ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  return (
    <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto">

      {/* Step 1: Select Client */}
      {step === 1 && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="text-base">Select Client</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              Choose a client to browse available ASINs in BigQuery.
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-6">
            <StepIndicator step={1} />
            {clientsLoading ? (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                Loading clients...
              </div>
            ) : (
              <Select
                value={selectedClient}
                onValueChange={setSelectedClient}
              >
                <SelectTrigger className="w-full">
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Select a client..." />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {clients.map((client) => (
                    <SelectItem key={client} value={client}>
                      {client}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            )}
            <div className="flex justify-end">
              <Button
                onClick={goToStep2}
                disabled={!selectedClient || clientsLoading}
              >
                Next
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Step 2: Select ASINs */}
      {step === 2 && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="text-base">Select ASINs</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              Choose ASINs to import from client{" "}
              <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{selectedClient}</span>.
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4">
            <StepIndicator step={2} />

            {asinsLoading && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 py-8 justify-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                Fetching ASINs from BigQuery...
              </div>
            )}

            {asinsError && !asinsLoading && (
              <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-400/20 bg-red-400/10 px-4 py-3 space-y-2">
                <p className="text-sm text-red-400">{asinsError}</p>
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => loadAsins(selectedClient)}
                >
                  <RefreshCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1.5" />
                  Retry
                </Button>
              </div>
            )}

            {!asinsLoading && !asinsError && availableAsins.length === 0 && (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground py-8 text-center">
                No ASINs found for {selectedClient} in BigQuery.
              </p>
            )}

            {!asinsLoading && !asinsError && availableAsins.length > 0 && (
              <>
                {/* Select all / deselect all + count */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {selectedAsins.size} of {availableAsins.length} selected
                  </span>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Button
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={handleSelectAll}
                      disabled={selectedAsins.size === availableAsins.length}
                    >
                      Select All
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={handleDeselectAll}
                      disabled={selectedAsins.size === 0}
                    >
                      Deselect All
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* ASIN checkbox list */}
                <div className="rounded-lg border border-border/50 divide-y divide-border/30 max-h-80 overflow-y-auto">
                  {availableAsins.map((asin) => (
                    <label
                      key={asin}
                      className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <Checkbox
                        checked={selectedAsins.has(asin)}
                        onCheckedChange={() => toggleAsin(asin)}
                        id={`asin-${asin}`}
                      />
                      <span className="font-mono text-xs text-foreground">
                        {asin}
                      </span>
                    </label>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </>
            )}

            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2">
              <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setStep(1)}>
                Back
              </Button>
              <Button
                onClick={runImport}
                disabled={
                  selectedAsins.size === 0 || asinsLoading || !!asinsError
                }
              >
                Import Selected ({selectedAsins.size})
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Step 3: Results */}
      {step === 3 && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="text-base">Import Results</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              {importing
                ? "Importing A+ data from BigQuery..."
                : "Import complete."}
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4">
            <StepIndicator step={3} />

            {importing && (
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 py-10 text-center">
                <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-brand" />
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Importing...</p>
              </div>
            )}

            {!importing && importResult && (
              <div className="space-y-4">
                {/* Summary row */}
                <div className="rounded-lg border border-border/50 bg-muted/10 px-4 py-4 flex items-center gap-6 flex-wrap">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-500 shrink-0" />
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                      Imported
                    </span>
                    <Badge
                      variant="outline"
                      className="border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500 tabular-nums"
                    >
                      {importResult.imported}
                    </Badge>
                  </div>

                  {importResult.skipped > 0 && (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
                        Skipped
                      </span>
                      <Badge
                        variant="outline"
                        className="border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-500 tabular-nums"
                      >
                        {importResult.skipped}
                      </Badge>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Error list */}
                {importResult.errors.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-400/20 bg-red-400/5 px-4 py-3 space-y-1.5">
                    <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-red-400 uppercase tracking-wide">
                      Errors
                    </p>
                    <ul className="space-y-1">
                      {importResult.errors.map((err, i) => (
                        <li
                          key={i}
                          className="text-xs text-red-400 font-mono leading-relaxed"
                        >
                          {err}
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="flex justify-end pt-2">
                  <Button variant="outline" onClick={resetWizard}>
                    Import More
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/aplus/aplus-set-config.tsx

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Settings, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

export interface SetConfig {
  id: string;
  scopeType: string;
  scopeIdentifier: string;
  platform: string;
  contentType: string;
  version: number;
  groupNumber: number | null;
  parentAsin: string | null;
  coveredAsins: string[] | null;
}

interface AplusSetConfigProps {
  productId: string;
  productAsin: string;
  productClientIdCode: string;
  config: SetConfig;
  readOnly: boolean;
}

const SCOPE_OPTIONS = [
  { value: "VAR", label: "Full Variation", desc: "All ASINs share this content" },
  { value: "GRP", label: "ASIN Group", desc: "Selected ASINs share this content" },
  { value: "ASIN", label: "Single ASIN", desc: "Unique content for this ASIN only" },
];

const PLATFORM_OPTIONS = [
  { value: "SC", label: "Seller Central" },
  { value: "VC", label: "Vendor Central" },
];

function pad2(n: number): string {
  return n.toString().padStart(2, "0");
}

/** Build the scope segment label for display: V01, V01G01, V01_B0DCLWMB4Y */
function buildScopeLabel(
  version: number,
  scopeType: string,
  asin?: string,
  groupNumber?: number,
): string {
  const v = `V${pad2(version)}`;
  switch (scopeType) {
    case "VAR":
      return v;
    case "GRP":
      return `${v}G${pad2(groupNumber ?? 1)}`;
    case "ASIN":
      return `${v}_${asin ?? "???"}`;
    default:
      return v;
  }
}

/** Build the folder name that will be created in Drive */
function buildFolderPreview(
  clientIdCode: string,
  version: number,
  scopeType: string,
  asin?: string,
  groupNumber?: number,
): string {
  const scopeSeg = buildScopeLabel(version, scopeType, asin, groupNumber);
  return `${clientIdCode}-Graphics/${clientIdCode}-A+/PA+/${scopeSeg}/`;
}

const chipBase: React.CSSProperties = {
  display: "inline-flex",
  alignItems: "center",
  gap: "4px",
  fontSize: "12px",
  fontWeight: 600,
  padding: "3px 10px",
  borderRadius: "3px",
  cursor: "default",
};

interface SiblingAsin {
  id: string;
  asin: string;
  itemName: string | null;
}

export function AplusSetConfig({ productId, productAsin, productClientIdCode, config, readOnly }: AplusSetConfigProps) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);

  const [scopeType, setScopeType] = useState(config.scopeType);
  const [scopeIdentifier, setScopeIdentifier] = useState(config.scopeIdentifier);
  const [platform, setPlatform] = useState(config.platform);
  const [version, setVersion] = useState(config.version);
  const [groupNumber, setGroupNumber] = useState(config.groupNumber ?? 1);
  const [coveredAsins, setCoveredAsins] = useState<string[]>(config.coveredAsins ?? []);
  const [parentAsin, setParentAsin] = useState(config.parentAsin ?? "");

  // Sync from props when config changes externally
  useEffect(() => {
    setScopeType(config.scopeType);
    setScopeIdentifier(config.scopeIdentifier);
    setPlatform(config.platform);
    setVersion(config.version);
    setGroupNumber(config.groupNumber ?? 1);
    setCoveredAsins(config.coveredAsins ?? []);
    setParentAsin(config.parentAsin ?? "");
  }, [config]);

  // Fetch sibling ASINs (same parentAsin) for GRP/VAR scope selection
  const { data: siblingsData } = useQuery<{ siblings: SiblingAsin[] }>({
    queryKey: ["aplus-siblings", productId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/aplus/${productId}/siblings`);
      if (!res.ok) return { siblings: [] };
      return res.json();
    },
    enabled: expanded && (scopeType === "GRP" || scopeType === "VAR"),
  });
  const siblings = siblingsData?.siblings ?? [];

  const mutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (data: Partial<SetConfig>) => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/aplus/${productId}/set-config`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(data),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(err.error || "Failed to save");
      }
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["aplus-modules", productId] });
      toast.success("Set config saved");
    },
    onError: (err) => {
      toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Failed to save");
    },
  });

  function computeScopeIdentifier(
    type: string,
    ver: number,
    asin?: string,
    grpNum?: number,
  ): string {
    return buildScopeLabel(ver, type, asin, grpNum);
  }

  function handleScopeTypeChange(newScope: string) {
    setScopeType(newScope);
    let newIdentifier: string;

    if (newScope === "ASIN") {
      newIdentifier = computeScopeIdentifier(newScope, version, productAsin);
      mutation.mutate({
        scopeType: newScope,
        scopeIdentifier: newIdentifier,
        coveredAsins: [productAsin],
      });
    } else if (newScope === "GRP") {
      newIdentifier = computeScopeIdentifier(newScope, version, undefined, groupNumber);
      setScopeIdentifier(newIdentifier);
      // Don't save yet — user needs to select covered ASINs
    } else {
      // VAR — covers all siblings
      const allAsins = siblings.map((s) => s.asin).filter(Boolean);
      if (!allAsins.includes(productAsin)) allAsins.push(productAsin);
      newIdentifier = computeScopeIdentifier(newScope, version);
      setCoveredAsins(allAsins);
      mutation.mutate({
        scopeType: newScope,
        scopeIdentifier: newIdentifier,
        coveredAsins: allAsins,
        parentAsin: parentAsin || null,
      });
    }

    setScopeIdentifier(newIdentifier!);
  }

  function handlePlatformChange(newPlatform: string) {
    setPlatform(newPlatform);
    mutation.mutate({ platform: newPlatform });
  }

  function handleVersionChange(newVersion: number) {
    if (newVersion < 1 || newVersion > 99) return;
    setVersion(newVersion);
    // Recompute scope identifier with new version
    const newIdentifier = computeScopeIdentifier(
      scopeType,
      newVersion,
      scopeType === "ASIN" ? productAsin : undefined,
      scopeType === "GRP" ? groupNumber : undefined,
    );
    setScopeIdentifier(newIdentifier);
    mutation.mutate({ version: newVersion, scopeIdentifier: newIdentifier });
  }

  function handleGroupNumberChange(newGrpNum: number) {
    if (newGrpNum < 1 || newGrpNum > 99) return;
    setGroupNumber(newGrpNum);
    const newIdentifier = computeScopeIdentifier("GRP", version, undefined, newGrpNum);
    setScopeIdentifier(newIdentifier);
    mutation.mutate({
      scopeType: "GRP",
      groupNumber: newGrpNum,
      scopeIdentifier: newIdentifier,
    });
  }

  function toggleCoveredAsin(asin: string) {
    const next = coveredAsins.includes(asin)
      ? coveredAsins.filter((a) => a !== asin)
      : [...coveredAsins, asin];
    setCoveredAsins(next);
    mutation.mutate({ coveredAsins: next });
  }

  // Computed display
  const scopeLabel = buildScopeLabel(
    version,
    scopeType,
    scopeType === "ASIN" ? productAsin : undefined,
    scopeType === "GRP" ? groupNumber : undefined,
  );
  const folderPreview = buildFolderPreview(
    productClientIdCode,
    version,
    scopeType,
    scopeType === "ASIN" ? productAsin : undefined,
    scopeType === "GRP" ? groupNumber : undefined,
  );

  const inputStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    backgroundColor: "#ffffff",
    color: "#0F1111",
    border: "1px solid #888c8c",
    borderRadius: "4px",
    fontSize: "13px",
    padding: "4px 8px",
    outline: "none",
  };

  const selectStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
    ...inputStyle,
    cursor: "pointer",
  };

  return (
    <div style={{
      backgroundColor: "#f0f2f4",
      border: "1px solid #e7e7e7",
      borderRadius: "4px",
      overflow: "hidden",
    }}>
      {/* Collapsed summary bar */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setExpanded(!expanded)}
        style={{
          display: "flex",
          alignItems: "center",
          gap: "10px",
          width: "100%",
          padding: "8px 12px",
          backgroundColor: "transparent",
          border: "none",
          cursor: "pointer",
          color: "#0F1111",
          fontSize: "13px",
        }}
      >
        <Settings style={{ width: "14px", height: "14px", color: "#565959" }} />
        <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, color: "#565959" }}>Set Config</span>

        {/* Summary chips */}
        <span style={{ ...chipBase, backgroundColor: "#e3f1e6", color: "#067d20" }}>
          {platform}
        </span>
        <span style={{ ...chipBase, backgroundColor: "#e8eef6", color: "#1a5276" }}>
          {scopeType === "VAR" ? "Variation" : scopeType === "GRP" ? "Group" : "ASIN"}
        </span>
        <span style={{ ...chipBase, backgroundColor: "#fef3e2", color: "#8a6d3b", fontFamily: "monospace" }}>
          {scopeLabel}
        </span>
        <span style={{ ...chipBase, backgroundColor: "#f0e6f6", color: "#6c3483" }}>
          {config.contentType}
        </span>
        {coveredAsins.length > 1 && (
          <span style={{ ...chipBase, backgroundColor: "#fce4ec", color: "#b71c1c", fontSize: "11px" }}>
            {coveredAsins.length} ASINs
          </span>
        )}

        {mutation.isPending && (
          <Loader2 style={{ width: "12px", height: "12px", color: "#888c8c", animation: "spin 1s linear infinite" }} />
        )}

        <span style={{ marginLeft: "auto" }}>
          {expanded ? (
            <ChevronUp style={{ width: "16px", height: "16px", color: "#888c8c" }} />
          ) : (
            <ChevronDown style={{ width: "16px", height: "16px", color: "#888c8c" }} />
          )}
        </span>
      </button>

      {/* Expanded config panel */}
      {expanded && (
        <div style={{
          padding: "12px 16px",
          borderTop: "1px solid #e7e7e7",
          display: "flex",
          flexDirection: "column",
          gap: "16px",
          backgroundColor: "#ffffff",
        }}>
          {/* Row 1: Scope type selector (prominent) */}
          <div>
            <label style={{ fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: 700, color: "#565959", display: "block", marginBottom: "6px" }}>
              Content Scope
            </label>
            <div style={{ display: "flex", gap: "8px", flexWrap: "wrap" }}>
              {SCOPE_OPTIONS.map((opt) => (
                <button
                  key={opt.value}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => !readOnly && handleScopeTypeChange(opt.value)}
                  disabled={readOnly}
                  style={{
                    flex: "1 1 0",
                    minWidth: "140px",
                    padding: "8px 12px",
                    borderRadius: "6px",
                    border: scopeType === opt.value
                      ? "2px solid #008296"
                      : "1px solid #d5d9d9",
                    backgroundColor: scopeType === opt.value
                      ? "#e0f4f7"
                      : "#ffffff",
                    cursor: readOnly ? "default" : "pointer",
                    textAlign: "left",
                    opacity: readOnly ? 0.6 : 1,
                  }}
                >
                  <div style={{ fontSize: "13px", fontWeight: 600, color: "#0F1111" }}>
                    {opt.label}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: "11px", color: "#565959", marginTop: "2px" }}>
                    {opt.desc}
                  </div>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Row 2: Platform + Version + Group Number (for GRP) */}
          <div style={{
            display: "grid",
            gridTemplateColumns: scopeType === "GRP" ? "1fr 1fr 1fr" : "1fr 1fr",
            gap: "16px",
          }}>
            {/* Platform */}
            <div>
              <label style={{ fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: 700, color: "#565959", display: "block", marginBottom: "4px" }}>
                Platform
              </label>
              <select
                value={platform}
                onChange={(e) => handlePlatformChange(e.target.value)}
                disabled={readOnly}
                style={selectStyle}
              >
                {PLATFORM_OPTIONS.map((opt) => (
                  <option key={opt.value} value={opt.value}>{opt.label}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* Version */}
            <div>
              <label style={{ fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: 700, color: "#565959", display: "block", marginBottom: "4px" }}>
                Version
              </label>
              <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "6px" }}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleVersionChange(version - 1)}
                  disabled={readOnly || version <= 1}
                  style={{
                    ...inputStyle,
                    width: "28px",
                    height: "28px",
                    padding: 0,
                    display: "flex",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    justifyContent: "center",
                    cursor: readOnly || version <= 1 ? "default" : "pointer",
                    opacity: readOnly || version <= 1 ? 0.4 : 1,
                  }}
                >
                  −
                </button>
                <span style={{ fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: 600, fontFamily: "monospace", color: "#0F1111", minWidth: "28px", textAlign: "center" }}>
                  V{pad2(version)}
                </span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleVersionChange(version + 1)}
                  disabled={readOnly || version >= 99}
                  style={{
                    ...inputStyle,
                    width: "28px",
                    height: "28px",
                    padding: 0,
                    display: "flex",
                    alignItems: "center",
                    justifyContent: "center",
                    cursor: readOnly || version >= 99 ? "default" : "pointer",
                    opacity: readOnly || version >= 99 ? 0.4 : 1,
                  }}
                >
                  +
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Group Number (only for GRP scope) */}
            {scopeType === "GRP" && (
              <div>
                <label style={{ fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: 700, color: "#565959", display: "block", marginBottom: "4px" }}>
                  Group #
                </label>
                <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: "6px" }}>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleGroupNumberChange(groupNumber - 1)}
                    disabled={readOnly || groupNumber <= 1}
                    style={{
                      ...inputStyle,
                      width: "28px",
                      height: "28px",
                      padding: 0,
                      display: "flex",
                      alignItems: "center",
                      justifyContent: "center",
                      cursor: readOnly || groupNumber <= 1 ? "default" : "pointer",
                      opacity: readOnly || groupNumber <= 1 ? 0.4 : 1,
                    }}
                  >
                    −
                  </button>
                  <span style={{ fontSize: "14px", fontWeight: 600, fontFamily: "monospace", color: "#0F1111", minWidth: "28px", textAlign: "center" }}>
                    G{pad2(groupNumber)}
                  </span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleGroupNumberChange(groupNumber + 1)}
                    disabled={readOnly || groupNumber >= 99}
                    style={{
                      ...inputStyle,
                      width: "28px",
                      height: "28px",
                      padding: 0,
                      display: "flex",
                      alignItems: "center",
                      justifyContent: "center",
                      cursor: readOnly || groupNumber >= 99 ? "default" : "pointer",
                      opacity: readOnly || groupNumber >= 99 ? 0.4 : 1,
                    }}
                  >
                    +
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Row 3: ASIN selection (for GRP/VAR scope) */}
          {(scopeType === "GRP" || scopeType === "VAR") && (
            <div>
              <label style={{ fontSize: "12px", fontWeight: 700, color: "#565959", display: "block", marginBottom: "6px" }}>
                {scopeType === "VAR" ? "Covered ASINs (all in variation)" : "Select ASINs in this group"}
              </label>
              {siblings.length === 0 ? (
                <p style={{ fontSize: "12px", color: "#888c8c", fontStyle: "italic" }}>
                  No sibling ASINs found. This product may not be part of a variation family.
                </p>
              ) : (
                <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "4px", maxHeight: "200px", overflowY: "auto" }}>
                  {siblings.map((sib) => {
                    const isChecked = scopeType === "VAR" || coveredAsins.includes(sib.asin);
                    return (
                      <label
                        key={sib.id}
                        style={{
                          display: "flex",
                          alignItems: "center",
                          gap: "8px",
                          padding: "4px 8px",
                          borderRadius: "4px",
                          backgroundColor: isChecked ? "#e0f4f7" : "#f7f8fa",
                          border: isChecked ? "1px solid #008296" : "1px solid #e7e7e7",
                          cursor: scopeType === "VAR" || readOnly ? "default" : "pointer",
                          opacity: readOnly ? 0.6 : 1,
                          fontSize: "12px",
                        }}
                      >
                        <input
                          type="checkbox"
                          checked={isChecked}
                          disabled={scopeType === "VAR" || readOnly}
                          onChange={() => toggleCoveredAsin(sib.asin)}
                          style={{ accentColor: "#008296" }}
                        />
                        <span style={{ fontFamily: "monospace", fontWeight: 600, color: "#0F1111", minWidth: "100px" }}>
                          {sib.asin}
                        </span>
                        <span style={{ color: "#565959", overflow: "hidden", textOverflow: "ellipsis", whiteSpace: "nowrap" }}>
                          {sib.itemName ?? "—"}
                        </span>
                      </label>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Row 4: Folder + file preview */}
          <div style={{
            backgroundColor: "#f7f8fa",
            borderRadius: "4px",
            padding: "8px 12px",
            fontSize: "12px",
            fontFamily: "monospace",
            color: "#565959",
          }}>
            <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, marginBottom: "4px", fontFamily: "inherit", color: "#0F1111" }}>
              Drive folder path:
            </div>
            <div>{folderPreview}</div>
            <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, marginTop: "8px", marginBottom: "4px", fontFamily: "inherit", color: "#0F1111" }}>
              File naming example:
            </div>
            <div>
              {productClientIdCode}_{scopeLabel}_M1_PFI_MAIN_DV_IMG.png
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

type AplusStatus = "draft" | "in_review" | "approved" | "uploaded";

interface AplusStatusBadgeProps {
  status: AplusStatus;
  className?: string;
}

const STATUS_STYLES: Record<AplusStatus, string> = {
  draft: "border-border text-muted-foreground bg-muted/50",
  in_review: "border-amber-500/30 text-amber-600 bg-amber-500/10",
  approved: "border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500/10",
  uploaded: "border-blue-500/30 text-blue-500 bg-blue-500/10",
};

function formatStatus(status: AplusStatus): string {
  return status.replace(/_/g, " ").replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
}

export function AplusStatusBadge({ status, className }: AplusStatusBadgeProps) {
  return (
    <Badge
      variant="outline"
      className={cn(STATUS_STYLES[status], "text-xs font-medium", className)}
    >
      {formatStatus(status)}
    </Badge>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { AplusModuleCard } from "./aplus-module-card";
import type { aplusModules, aplusModuleImages } from "@/lib/db/schema";

type AplusModule = typeof aplusModules.$inferSelect;
type AplusModuleImage = typeof aplusModuleImages.$inferSelect;
type AplusModuleWithImages = AplusModule & { images: AplusModuleImage[] };

interface AplusViewerProps {
  productId: string;
}

interface AplusApiResponse {
  product: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    asin: string;
    clientIdCode: string;
  };
  modules: AplusModuleWithImages[];
}

const MAX_SLOTS = 7;

// ─── Read-only empty slot ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function EmptySlotReadOnly({ slotNumber }: { slotNumber: number }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border-2 border-dashed border-border/50 bg-muted/10 p-6 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 min-h-[100px]">
      <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground/60 font-medium">
        Module {slotNumber}
      </span>
      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/40 italic">Empty slot</span>
    </div>
  );
}

// ─── Main viewer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export function AplusViewer({ productId }: AplusViewerProps) {
  const { data, isLoading, isError } = useQuery<AplusApiResponse>({
    queryKey: ["aplus-modules", productId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/aplus/${productId}`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load A+ modules");
      return res.json();
    },
    refetchOnWindowFocus: true,
  });

  const modules = data?.modules ?? [];
  const product = data?.product;

  // ── Rollup counts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const approvedCount = modules.filter((m) => m.status === "approved").length;
  const filledCount = modules.length;

  // ── 7-slot layout ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const slots = Array.from({ length: MAX_SLOTS }, (_, i) => i + 1);
  const moduleByNumber = new Map<number, AplusModuleWithImages>();
  for (const m of modules) {
    moduleByNumber.set(m.moduleNumber, m);
  }

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-[300px]">
        <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (isError) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-[300px]">
        <p className="text-sm text-red-500">Failed to load A+ modules. Please refresh.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Page header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <h1 className="text-xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tight">
            {product?.name ?? "A+ Content"}
          </h1>
          {product?.asin && (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground font-mono">{product.asin}</p>
          )}
          {product?.clientIdCode && (
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/70">{product.clientIdCode}</p>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap">
          {/* Rollup badge */}
          <Badge
            variant="outline"
            className={cn(
              "text-sm px-3 py-1",
              approvedCount === filledCount && filledCount > 0
                ? "border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500/10"
                : "border-amber-500/30 text-amber-600 bg-amber-500/10"
            )}
          >
            {filledCount}/7 modules, {approvedCount} approved
          </Badge>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* No modules at all */}
      {filledCount === 0 ? (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-16 text-center">
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">No A+ modules yet.</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {slots.map((slotNumber) => {
            const module = moduleByNumber.get(slotNumber);
            if (module) {
              return (
                <AplusModuleCard
                  key={module.id}
                  module={module}
                  productId={productId}
                  readOnly={true}
                  onDelete={() => {}}
                  sortableProps={undefined}
                />
              );
            }
            return (
              <EmptySlotReadOnly
                key={`empty-${slotNumber}`}
                slotNumber={slotNumber}
              />
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import Link from "next/link";
import {
  Loader2,
  PanelLeftClose,
  PanelLeftOpen,
  PanelRightClose,
  PanelRightOpen,
  MessageCircle,
  Download,
  ExternalLink,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { AplusEditor } from "./aplus-editor";
import { AplusPreviewPanel } from "./aplus-preview-panel";
import { AplusCommentThread } from "./aplus-comment-thread";
import { AplusSetConfig, type SetConfig } from "./aplus-set-config";
import type { aplusModules, aplusModuleImages } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { generateTrackerRows, type TrackerRow, type AplusScopeType } from "@/lib/aplus-file-naming";
import type { AplusModuleType } from "@/lib/aplus-module-specs";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";

type AplusModuleWithImages = (typeof aplusModules.$inferSelect) & {
  images: (typeof aplusModuleImages.$inferSelect)[];
};

interface AplusApiResponse {
  product: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    asin: string;
    clientIdCode: string;
    marketplace?: string | null;
  };
  modules: AplusModuleWithImages[];
  setConfig?: SetConfig;
}

interface AplusWorkspaceProps {
  productId: string;
  userRole: string;
}

export type PendingPin = {
  moduleId: string;
  moduleNumber: number;
  pinX: number;
  pinY: number;
};

type CommentPin = {
  id: string;
  moduleId: string | null;
  pinX: number;
  pinY: number;
  commentNumber: number | null;
  status: "active" | "resolved";
  isClient: boolean;
};

type AplusStatus = "draft" | "in_review" | "approved" | "uploaded";
const STATUS_OPTIONS: { value: AplusStatus; label: string }[] = [
  { value: "draft", label: "Draft" },
  { value: "in_review", label: "In Review" },
  { value: "approved", label: "Approved" },
  { value: "uploaded", label: "Uploaded" },
];

/** Export all tracker rows for the current A+ set as TSV (pasteable into Google Sheets) */
function exportTrackerTsv(
  modules: AplusModuleWithImages[],
  clientIdCode: string,
  version: number,
  scopeType: AplusScopeType,
  productAsin: string,
  groupNumber?: number,
) {
  const allRows: TrackerRow[] = [];
  for (const mod of modules) {
    const panelCount = mod.images.filter((img) => img.customLabel?.startsWith("panel_")).length || undefined;
    const rows = generateTrackerRows(
      clientIdCode,
      version,
      scopeType,
      mod.moduleNumber,
      mod.moduleType as AplusModuleType,
      scopeType === "ASIN" ? productAsin : undefined,
      scopeType === "GRP" ? groupNumber : undefined,
      panelCount,
    );
    allRows.push(...rows);
  }

  // TSV header
  const header = "file name\tTYPE\tTYPE ABBR\tMODTYPE\tMODNUMBER\tMODTYPE ABBR\tTEXTFIELD\tTEXFIELD ABBR\tPANEL NUMBER\tGROUP\tGROUP ABBR\tIMAGE\tIMAGE NUMBER";
  const lines = allRows.map((r) =>
    [
      r.fileName,
      r.type,
      r.typeAbbr,
      r.modType,
      r.modNumber,
      r.modTypeAbbr,
      r.textField,
      r.textFieldAbbr,
      r.panelNumber ?? "",
      r.group,
      r.groupAbbr,
      r.image,
      r.imageNumber,
    ].join("\t")
  );

  const tsv = [header, ...lines].join("\n");
  const blob = new Blob([tsv], { type: "text/tab-separated-values" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = url;
  a.download = `${clientIdCode}_tracker.tsv`;
  a.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

export function AplusWorkspace({ productId, userRole }: AplusWorkspaceProps) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [previewOpen, setPreviewOpen] = useState(true);
  const [commentsOpen, setCommentsOpen] = useState(true);
  const [editorOpen, setEditorOpen] = useState(true);
  const [pendingPin, setPendingPin] = useState<PendingPin | null>(null);
  const readOnly = userRole === "viewer";

  // ── Bulk status mutation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const bulkStatusMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (status: AplusStatus) => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/aplus/${productId}/bulk-status`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ status }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to bulk update status");
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: (_data, status) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["aplus-modules", productId] });
      toast.success(`All modules set to ${status.replace(/_/g, " ")}`);
    },
    onError: () => {
      toast.error("Failed to update module statuses");
    },
  });

  // Fetch comments for pin overlay on preview
  const { data: commentsData } = useQuery<{ comments: Array<{
    id: string;
    moduleId: string | null;
    pinX: number | null;
    pinY: number | null;
    commentNumber: number | null;
    status: "active" | "resolved";
    audience: string;
  }> }>({
    queryKey: ["aplus-comments", productId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/aplus/${productId}/comments`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch comments");
      return res.json();
    },
    refetchInterval: 15000,
  });

  // Extract pins from comments that have coordinates
  const commentPins: CommentPin[] = (commentsData?.comments ?? [])
    .filter((c) => c.pinX != null && c.pinY != null)
    .map((c) => ({
      id: c.id,
      moduleId: c.moduleId,
      pinX: c.pinX!,
      pinY: c.pinY!,
      commentNumber: c.commentNumber,
      status: c.status,
      isClient: c.audience === "client",
    }));

  const handlePreviewPin = useCallback((moduleId: string, moduleNumber: number, pinX: number, pinY: number) => {
    setPendingPin({ moduleId, moduleNumber, pinX, pinY });
    // Auto-open comments panel if closed
    setCommentsOpen(true);
  }, []);

  const handlePinClear = useCallback(() => {
    setPendingPin(null);
  }, []);

  const { data, isLoading, isError, error } = useQuery<AplusApiResponse>({
    queryKey: ["aplus-modules", productId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/aplus/${productId}`);
      if (!res.ok) {
        const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(body.detail || body.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`);
      }
      return res.json();
    },
    refetchOnWindowFocus: true,
  });

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", minHeight: "400px" }}>
        <Loader2 style={{ width: "24px", height: "24px", color: "#888c8c", animation: "spin 1s linear infinite" }} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (isError || !data) {
    return (
      <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center", minHeight: "400px", gap: "8px" }}>
        <p style={{ color: "#d13212", fontSize: "14px" }}>Failed to load A+ modules. Please refresh.</p>
        {error && <p style={{ color: "#888", fontSize: "12px", fontFamily: "monospace" }}>{error.message}</p>}
      </div>
    );
  }

  const modules = data.modules;
  const product = data.product;
  const approvedCount = modules.filter((m) => m.status === "approved").length;
  const filledCount = modules.length;

  return (
    <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", height: "calc(100vh - 100px)", overflow: "hidden", borderRadius: "6px", border: "1px solid var(--border, #333)" }}>

      {/* ══ Top bar: product header + set config (spans all panels) ══ */}
      <div className="bg-background border-b border-border px-4 py-3 flex-shrink-0">
        {/* Row 1: product name + status */}
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
          <div className="space-y-0.5 min-w-0 flex-1">
            <h1 className="text-base font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tight leading-snug truncate">
              {product.name}
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-mono">
              {product.asin}
              <Link href={`/products/${product.id}`} className="ml-2 inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 text-brand hover:underline">
                View product <ExternalLink className="h-3 w-3" />
              </Link>
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-shrink-0 flex-wrap">
            <Badge
              variant="outline"
              className={cn(
                "text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5",
                approvedCount === filledCount && filledCount > 0
                  ? "border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500/10"
                  : "border-amber-500/30 text-amber-600 bg-amber-500/10"
              )}
            >
              {approvedCount}/{filledCount} approved
            </Badge>
            {!readOnly && modules.length > 0 && (
              <Select
                disabled={readOnly || bulkStatusMutation.isPending}
                onValueChange={(v) => bulkStatusMutation.mutate(v as AplusStatus)}
              >
                <SelectTrigger className="w-36 h-7 text-xs">
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Set all status..." />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {STATUS_OPTIONS.map((opt) => (
                    <SelectItem key={opt.value} value={opt.value} className="text-xs">
                      {opt.label}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Row 2: set config + export */}
        {data.setConfig && (
          <div className="mt-2 flex items-start gap-2">
            <div className="flex-1">
              <AplusSetConfig
                productId={productId}
                productAsin={product.asin}
                productClientIdCode={product.clientIdCode ?? ""}
                config={data.setConfig}
                readOnly={readOnly}
              />
            </div>
            {modules.length > 0 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                title="Export tracker TSV"
                onClick={() => {
                  const cid = product.clientIdCode || "UNKNOWN";
                  const ver = data.setConfig?.version || 1;
                  const st = (data.setConfig?.scopeType || "ASIN") as AplusScopeType;
                  const grpNum = data.setConfig?.groupNumber ?? undefined;
                  exportTrackerTsv(modules, cid, ver, st, product.asin, grpNum);
                }}
                className="shrink-0 mt-1 p-1.5 rounded border border-border/50 hover:bg-muted/50 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors"
              >
                <Download className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ══ Panel area ══ */}
      <div style={{ display: "flex", flex: 1, overflow: "hidden" }}>

        {/* ── Left: Comments ───────────────────────────── */}
        {commentsOpen && (
          <div style={{
            width: "280px",
            minWidth: "260px",
            display: "flex",
            flexDirection: "column",
            borderRight: "1px solid var(--border, #333)",
          }}>
            <AplusCommentThread
              productId={productId}
              pendingPin={pendingPin}
              onPinClear={handlePinClear}
            />
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Comments toggle */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setCommentsOpen(!commentsOpen)}
          title={commentsOpen ? "Hide comments" : "Show comments"}
          style={{
            width: "20px",
            display: "flex",
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "center",
            backgroundColor: "var(--muted, #262626)",
            border: "none",
            cursor: "pointer",
            flexShrink: 0,
          }}
        >
          <MessageCircle style={{ width: "12px", height: "12px", color: "#F4BD1F" }} />
        </button>

        {/* ── Center: Preview ──────────────────────────────── */}
        {previewOpen && (
          <div style={{ flex: 3, minWidth: "300px", overflowY: "auto", backgroundColor: "#f7f8fa", borderRight: "1px solid var(--border, #333)" }}>
            <AplusPreviewPanel
              modules={modules}
              product={product}
              commentPins={commentPins}
              pendingPin={pendingPin}
              onPin={handlePreviewPin}
            />
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Preview toggle */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setPreviewOpen(!previewOpen)}
          title={previewOpen ? "Hide preview" : "Show preview"}
          style={{
            width: "20px",
            display: "flex",
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "center",
            backgroundColor: "var(--muted, #262626)",
            border: "none",
            cursor: "pointer",
            flexShrink: 0,
          }}
        >
          {previewOpen ? (
            <PanelLeftClose style={{ width: "12px", height: "12px", color: "#F4BD1F" }} />
          ) : (
            <PanelLeftOpen style={{ width: "12px", height: "12px", color: "#F4BD1F" }} />
          )}
        </button>

        {/* ── Right: Editor ──────────────────────────────── */}
        {editorOpen && (
          <div style={{
            flex: 2,
            minWidth: "360px",
            overflowY: "auto",
            padding: "16px 20px",
            backgroundColor: "var(--background, #1a1a1a)",
            color: "var(--foreground, #fff)",
          }}>
            <AplusEditor productId={productId} userRole={userRole} />
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Editor toggle */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setEditorOpen(!editorOpen)}
          title={editorOpen ? "Hide editor" : "Show editor"}
          style={{
            width: "20px",
            display: "flex",
            alignItems: "center",
            justifyContent: "center",
            backgroundColor: "var(--muted, #262626)",
            border: "none",
            cursor: "pointer",
            flexShrink: 0,
          }}
        >
          {editorOpen ? (
            <PanelRightClose style={{ width: "12px", height: "12px", color: "#F4BD1F" }} />
          ) : (
            <PanelRightOpen style={{ width: "12px", height: "12px", color: "#F4BD1F" }} />
          )}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useSession } from "next-auth/react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ArrowLeft, ExternalLink, Loader2, Check, Package, Search, ChevronDown, ChevronRight, CalendarDays } from "lucide-react";

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";

  ALL_STATUSES,
  STATUS_CHIP_STYLES,
  STATUS_CHIP_EMPTY,
  TEAM_ROLES,
} from "@/lib/constants";

// ── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type ClientDetailResponse = {
  client: {
    id: number;
    clientIdCode: string;
    clientStatus: string | null;
    clientName: string | null;
    updatedAt: string | null;
  };
  rawData: Record<string, string>;

type SectionProps = {

  onSave: (field: string, value: string) => Promise<void>;
};

// ── Section helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function SectionCard({
  title,
  children,
}: {
  title: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border bg-card text-card-foreground">

// ── Client Status Select ───────────────────────────────────────────────

function ClientStatusSelect({
  value,
  onSave,
}: {
  value: string;
  onSave: (value: string) => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [saveState, setSaveState] = useState<"idle" | "saving" | "saved">("idle");

  async function handleChange(next: string) {
    if (next === value) return;
    setSaveState("saving");
    try {
      await onSave(next);
      setSaveState("saved");
      setTimeout(() => setSaveState("idle"), 1500);
    } catch {
      setSaveState("idle");
    }
  }

  const statusLower = value.toLowerCase();
  const isActive = statusLower === "active";
  const isProspect = statusLower === "prospect";

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
      <Select value={value} onValueChange={handleChange}>
        <SelectTrigger
          className={`h-7 w-[110px] text-xs font-semibold border ${
            isActive
              ? "text-emerald-500 border-emerald-500/30"
              : isProspect
                ? "text-brand border-brand/30"
                : "text-red-500 border-red-500/30"
          }`}
        >
          <SelectValue />
        </SelectTrigger>
        <SelectContent>
          <SelectItem value="Active">
            <span className="text-emerald-500 font-medium">Active</span>
          </SelectItem>
          <SelectItem value="Prospect">
            <span className="text-brand font-medium">Prospect</span>
          </SelectItem>
          <SelectItem value="Inactive">
            <span className="text-red-500 font-medium">Inactive</span>
          </SelectItem>
        </SelectContent>
      </Select>
      {saveState === "saving" && (
        <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
      )}
      {saveState === "saved" && (
        <Check className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-500" />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Team section ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function TeamSection({
  title,
  keys,
  rawData,
  readOnly,
  onSave,
}: {
  title: string;
  keys: string[];
} & SectionProps) {
  const rows = keys.map((key) => ({
    key,
    label: TEAM_ROLES[key] ?? key.replace(/_/g, " "),
    name: rawData[key]?.trim() ?? "",
  }));

  const visible = readOnly ? rows.filter((r) => r.name) : rows;
  if (visible.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <SectionCard title={title}>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-x-6">
        {visible.map((r) => (
          <KeyValueRow
            key={r.key}
            label={r.label}
            rawKey={r.key}
            value={r.name}
            readOnly={readOnly}
            onSave={onSave}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

// ── Client Contacts ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function ContactsSection({ rawData, readOnly, onSave }: SectionProps) {
  const slots: { nameKey: string; emailKey: string; label: string }[] = [];
  for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
    slots.push({
      nameKey: `ClientContactName${i}`,
      emailKey: `ClientContactEmail${i}`,
      label: `Contact ${i}`,
    });
  }
  slots.push({
    nameKey: "AmazonContactName",
    emailKey: "AmazonContactEmail",
    label: "Amazon Contact",
  });

  const visible = readOnly
    ? slots.filter(
        (s) => rawData[s.nameKey]?.trim() || rawData[s.emailKey]?.trim()
      )
    : slots;

  if (visible.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <SectionCard title="Client Contacts">
      <div className="space-y-0">
        {visible.map((s) => (
          <div
            key={s.label}
            className="grid grid-cols-[140px_1fr_1fr] gap-2 py-1.5 text-sm border-b border-border/30 last:border-0"
          >
            <span className="text-muted-foreground">{s.label}</span>
            <EditableCell
              field={s.nameKey}
              value={rawData[s.nameKey]?.trim() ?? ""}
              readOnly={readOnly}
              onSave={onSave}
              type="text"
            />
            <EditableCell
              field={s.emailKey}
              value={rawData[s.emailKey]?.trim() ?? ""}
              readOnly={readOnly}
              onSave={onSave}
              type="email"
            />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

// ── PPC ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function PPCSection({ rawData, readOnly, onSave }: SectionProps) {
  const periods = ["1D", "1W", "1M", "3M", "6M", "1Y", "Comment"] as const;
  const metrics = [
    { label: "AD Spend Budget", prefix: "ADSpendBudget", unit: "$" },
    { label: "Sales Forecast", prefix: "SalesForecast", unit: "$" },
    { label: "% Org Rev Goal", prefix: "PercentageOrgRevGoal", unit: "%" },
    { label: "ACOS Goal", prefix: "ACOSGoal", unit: "%" },
    { label: "ROAS Goal", prefix: "ROASGoal", unit: "" },
    { label: "TACOS Goal", prefix: "TACOSGoal", unit: "%" },
  ] as const;

  // Check if any data exists (read-only: hide empty section)
  const hasData =
    !readOnly ||
    metrics.some((m) =>
      periods.some((p) => rawData[`${m.prefix}${p}`]?.trim())
    );
  if (!hasData) return null;

  return (
    <SectionCard title="PPC">
      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-sm">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-border/50">
              <th className="text-left py-1.5 pr-3 text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
                Metric
              </th>
              {periods.map((p) => (
                <th
                  key={p}
                  className="text-center py-1.5 px-2 text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground"
                >
                  {p}
                </th>
              ))}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {metrics.map((m) => {
              const hasRow =
                !readOnly ||
                periods.some((p) => rawData[`${m.prefix}${p}`]?.trim());
              if (!hasRow) return null;
              return (
                <tr
                  key={m.prefix}
                  className="border-b border-border/30 last:border-0"
                >
                  <td className="py-1.5 pr-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">
                    {m.label}
                  </td>
                  {periods.map((p) => {
                    const fieldKey = `${m.prefix}${p}`;
                    const isComment = p === "Comment";
                    return (
                      <td key={p} className="text-center py-1.5 px-2">
                        <EditableCell
                          field={fieldKey}
                          value={rawData[fieldKey]?.trim() ?? ""}
                          readOnly={readOnly}
                          onSave={onSave}
                          className="text-muted-foreground"
                          prefix={!isComment && m.unit === "$" ? "$" : undefined}
                          suffix={!isComment && m.unit === "%" ? "%" : undefined}
                          align={isComment ? "left" : "right"}
                        />
                      </td>
                    );
                  })}
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </SectionCard>
  );
}
