// ── AAC Raw Data Table ────────────────────────────────────────────────

function AACSection({ rawData, readOnly, onSave }: SectionProps) {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);

  const entries = useMemo(() => {
    const all = Object.entries(rawData)
      .filter(([key]) => key.trim())
      .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b));

    if (!search.trim()) return all;
    const q = search.toLowerCase();
    return all.filter(
      ([key, val]) =>
        key.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        (val ?? "").toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
  }, [rawData, search]);

  const displayEntries = expanded ? entries : entries.slice(0, 50);
  const totalFields = Object.keys(rawData).length;
  const filledFields = Object.values(rawData).filter((v) => v?.trim()).length;

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border bg-card text-card-foreground">
      <div className="px-5 py-3 border-b border-border/50 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">AAC</h3>
          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {filledFields} / {totalFields} fields populated
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="relative w-64">
          <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Filter fields…"
            value={search}
            onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full h-7 pl-8 pr-3 text-xs bg-background border border-border/50 rounded-md outline-none focus:border-brand transition-colors"
          />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-sm">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-border/50">
              <th className="text-left py-2 px-5 text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground w-[280px]">
                Field
              </th>
              <th className="text-left py-2 px-5 text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
                Value
              </th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {displayEntries.map(([key, val]) => (
              <tr
                key={key}
                className="border-b border-border/20 last:border-0 hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors"
              >
                <td className="py-1.5 px-5 font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground whitespace-nowrap">
                  {key}
                </td>
                <td className="py-1.5 px-5">
                  <EditableCell
                    field={key}
                    value={val?.trim() ?? ""}
                    readOnly={readOnly}
                    onSave={onSave}
                    type={
                      key.toLowerCase().includes("url") || key.toLowerCase().includes("dashboard")
                        ? "url"
                        : key.toLowerCase().includes("email")
                          ? "email"
                          : "text"
                    }
                  />
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
            {displayEntries.length === 0 && (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan={2} className="py-6 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  No fields match &ldquo;{search}&rdquo;
                </td>
              </tr>
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
      {!expanded && entries.length > 50 && (
        <button
          onClick={() => setExpanded(true)}
          className="w-full py-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-brand hover:text-brand-hover border-t border-border/50 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-colors"
        >
          <ChevronDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          Show all {entries.length} fields
        </button>
      )}
      {expanded && entries.length > 50 && (
        <button
          onClick={() => setExpanded(false)}
          className="w-full py-2.5 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground border-t border-border/50 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 transition-colors"
        >
          <ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          Collapse
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Main component ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function ClientDetail({ clientIdCode }: { clientIdCode: string }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const role = (session?.user as { role?: string } | undefined)?.role;
  const readOnly = role === "viewer" || !role;

  const { data, isLoading, error } = useQuery<ClientDetailResponse>({
    queryKey: ["client-detail", clientIdCode],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/clients/${clientIdCode}`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch client");
      return res.json();
    },
  });

  const mutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({ field, value }: { field: string; value: string }) => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/clients/${clientIdCode}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ field, value }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Save failed");
    },
    onSuccess: (_data, variables) => {
      // Optimistic update in the query cache
      queryClient.setQueryData<ClientDetailResponse>(
        ["client-detail", clientIdCode],
        (old) => {
          if (!old) return old;
          const newRawData = { ...old.rawData, [variables.field]: variables.value };
          const newClient = { ...old.client };
          if (variables.field === "ClientName") newClient.clientName = variables.value;
          if (variables.field === "ClientStatus") newClient.clientStatus = variables.value;
          return { ...old, rawData: newRawData, client: newClient };
        }
      );
      // Refresh clients list & sidebar when status or name changes
      if (variables.field === "ClientStatus" || variables.field === "ClientName") {
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["clients"] });
      }
    },
  });

  const handleSave = useCallback(
    async (field: string, value: string) => {
      await mutation.mutateAsync({ field, value });
    },
    [mutation]
  );

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6 space-y-4">
        <div className="h-8 w-48 bg-muted rounded animate-pulse" />
        <div className="h-40 bg-muted/50 rounded-xl animate-pulse" />
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          {Array.from({ length: 4 }).map((_, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="h-32 bg-muted/50 rounded-xl animate-pulse" />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error || !data) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6">
        <p className="text-destructive">Failed to load client data.</p>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="mt-2" onClick={() => router.back()}>
          <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" /> Go Back
        </Button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const { client, rawData, productStats } = data;
  const statusLower = client.clientStatus?.toLowerCase();
  const isActive = statusLower === "active";
  const isProspect = statusLower === "prospect";

  const headerFields = [
    { key: "Marketplace", label: "Marketplace" },
    { key: "Country", label: "Country" },
  ];

  const team1o8MKeys = [
    "ExecutiveStrategist_1o8M",
    "AccountManager1_1o8M",
    "ProjectManager_1o8M",
    "ProjectManagerAsana_1o8M",
    "DesignManager_1o8M",
    "SEOManager_1o8M",
    "PPCManager_1o8M",
    "CatalogManager_1o8M",
    "DesignUploadManager_1o8M",
  ];

  const team1o8AKeys = [
    "ExecutiveStrategist_1o8A",
    "AccountManager_1o8A",
    "ProjectManager_1o8A",
  ];

  return (
    <div className="p-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-6">
      {/* Back button */}
      <Button
        variant="ghost"
        size="sm"
        className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground -ml-2"
        onClick={() => router.push("/")}
      >
        <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" /> Clients
      </Button>

      {/* Header */}
      <div className="rounded-xl border bg-card text-card-foreground p-5">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-start sm:justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap">
              {readOnly ? (
                <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-brand">
                  {client.clientName || clientIdCode}
                </h1>
              ) : (
                <EditableCell
                  field="ClientName"
                  value={client.clientName ?? ""}
                  readOnly={false}
                  onSave={handleSave}
                  className="text-2xl font-bold text-brand"
                />
              )}
              {readOnly ? (
                <Badge
                  className={
                    isActive
                      ? "bg-emerald-600/15 text-emerald-500 border border-emerald-500/30"
                      : isProspect
                        ? "bg-brand/15 text-brand border border-brand/30"
                        : "bg-red-600/15 text-red-500 border border-red-500/30"
                  }
                >
                  {client.clientStatus || "Unknown"}
                </Badge>
              ) : (
                <ClientStatusSelect
                  value={client.clientStatus ?? "Active"}
                  onSave={(v) => handleSave("ClientStatus", v)}
                />
              )}
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground font-mono">
              {client.clientIdCode}
            </p>
            <div className="text-sm flex items-center gap-1">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Merchant ID:</span>
              <EditableCell
                field="merchantID"
                value={rawData["merchantID"]?.trim() ?? ""}
                readOnly={readOnly}
                onSave={handleSave}
              />
            </div>
            {headerFields.map((hf) => {
              const val = rawData[hf.key]?.trim() ?? "";
              if (readOnly && !val) return null;
              return (
                <div key={hf.key} className="text-sm flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">{hf.label}:</span>
                  <EditableCell
                    field={hf.key}
                    value={val}
                    readOnly={readOnly}
                    onSave={handleSave}
                  />
                </div>
              );
            })}
            {/* Brand URL */}
            {(rawData["BrandURL"]?.trim() || !readOnly) && (
              <div className="text-sm flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Brand URL:</span>
                <EditableCell
                  field="BrandURL"
                  value={rawData["BrandURL"]?.trim() ?? ""}
                  readOnly={readOnly}
                  onSave={handleSave}
                  type="url"
                />
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
              {(rawData["BrandRegistry"]?.trim() || !readOnly) && (
                <div className="text-sm flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">Brand Registry:</span>
                  <EditableCell
                    field="BrandRegistry"
                    value={rawData["BrandRegistry"]?.trim() ?? ""}
                    readOnly={readOnly}
                    onSave={handleSave}
                  />
                </div>
              )}
              {(rawData["Walmart"]?.trim() || !readOnly) && (
                <div className="text-sm flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">Walmart:</span>
                  <EditableCell
                    field="Walmart"
                    value={rawData["Walmart"]?.trim() ?? ""}
                    readOnly={readOnly}
                    onSave={handleSave}
                  />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Product stats */}
          <div className="shrink-0 space-y-2">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">Products</p>
            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
              <span className="text-3xl font-bold tabular-nums text-brand">
                {productStats.activeCount}
              </span>
              <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                active / {productStats.count} total
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
              {ALL_STATUSES.map((status) => {
                const count = productStats.statusBreakdown[status] ?? 0;
                const hasCount = count > 0;
                return (
                  <span
                    key={status}
                    className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-sm px-1.5 text-[10px] font-bold h-5 whitespace-nowrap ${
                      hasCount
                        ? STATUS_CHIP_STYLES[status]
                        : STATUS_CHIP_EMPTY[status]
                    }`}
                  >
                    {count}{" "}
                    {status === "Replacement ASIN" ? "Replace" : status}
                  </span>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-1">
              <Link
                href={`/products?client=${client.clientIdCode}`}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-brand hover:text-brand-hover transition-colors"
              >
                <Package className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                View Products
              </Link>
              {!readOnly && (
                <>
                  <Link
                    href={`/clients/${client.clientIdCode}/onboarding`}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors"
                  >
                    Onboarding
                  </Link>
                  <Link
                    href={`/clients/${client.clientIdCode}/timeline`}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors"
                  >
                    <CalendarDays className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    Timeline
                  </Link>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Sections */}
      <TeamSection title="Team (1o8 Marketplace)" keys={team1o8MKeys} rawData={rawData} readOnly={readOnly} onSave={handleSave} />
      <TeamSection title="Team (1o8 Agency)" keys={team1o8AKeys} rawData={rawData} readOnly={readOnly} onSave={handleSave} />
      <ContactsSection rawData={rawData} readOnly={readOnly} onSave={handleSave} />
      <FinancialSection rawData={rawData} readOnly={readOnly} onSave={handleSave} />
      <DashboardsSection rawData={rawData} readOnly={readOnly} onSave={handleSave} />
      <IntentwiseSection rawData={rawData} readOnly={readOnly} onSave={handleSave} />
      <CompetitorsSection rawData={rawData} readOnly={readOnly} onSave={handleSave} />
      <PromotionsSection rawData={rawData} readOnly={readOnly} onSave={handleSave} />
      <PPCSection rawData={rawData} readOnly={readOnly} onSave={handleSave} />
      <OtherDetailsSection rawData={rawData} readOnly={readOnly} onSave={handleSave} />

      {/* AAC — full raw data table */}
      <AACSection rawData={rawData} readOnly={readOnly} onSave={handleSave} />
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/clients/client-gantt.tsx

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Loader2, CalendarDays, Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import {
  Popover,
  PopoverContent,
  PopoverTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/popover";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { SECTION_ORDER, TOTAL_WEEKS } from "@/lib/gantt-templates";

// ── Types ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type GanttTask = {
  id: number;
  clientIdCode: string;
  wbs: string;
  section: string;
  taskName: string;
  weekStart: number;
  weekEnd: number;
  status: "pending" | "in_progress" | "completed";
  completionPct: number;
  assignedTo: string | null;
  notes: string | null;
};

type GanttResponse = {
  tasks: GanttTask[];
  clientType: "AIA" | "NTA" | null;
  initialized: boolean;
};

// ── Status colors (from DESIGN.md) ─────────────────────────────────

const STATUS_BAR: Record<string, string> = {
  completed: "bg-[var(--brand-green)]",
  in_progress: "bg-[var(--brand-yellow)]",
  pending: "bg-muted-foreground/30",
};

// ── Week columns ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const WEEKS = Array.from({ length: TOTAL_WEEKS }, (_, i) => i + 1);

// ── Main component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function ClientGantt({ clientIdCode }: { clientIdCode: string }) {
  const qc = useQueryClient();
  const [addingSection, setAddingSection] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const { data, isLoading } = useQuery<GanttResponse>({
    queryKey: ["gantt", clientIdCode],
    queryFn: () =>
      fetch(`/api/clients/${clientIdCode}/gantt`).then((r) => r.json()),
  });

  const initMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (templateType: "AIA" | "NTA") =>
      fetch(`/api/clients/${clientIdCode}/gantt`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ templateType }),
      }).then((r) => r.json()),
    onSuccess: () => qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["gantt", clientIdCode] }),
  });

  const updateMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ taskId, ...patch }: { taskId: number } & Record<string, unknown>) =>
      fetch(`/api/clients/${clientIdCode}/gantt/${taskId}`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(patch),
      }).then((r) => r.json()),
    onSuccess: () => qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["gantt", clientIdCode] }),
  });

  const deleteMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (taskId: number) =>
      fetch(`/api/clients/${clientIdCode}/gantt/${taskId}`, {
        method: "DELETE",
      }).then((r) => r.json()),
    onSuccess: () => qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["gantt", clientIdCode] }),
  });

  const addMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (task: { section: string; taskName: string; weekStart: number; weekEnd: number; wbs: string }) =>
      fetch(`/api/clients/${clientIdCode}/gantt`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(task),
      }).then((r) => r.json()),
    onSuccess: () => {
      qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["gantt", clientIdCode] });
      setAddingSection(null);
    },
  });

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-3">
        {[1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
          <div key={i} className="h-12 rounded-lg bg-muted/50 animate-pulse" />
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!data?.initialized) {
    return <EmptyState onInit={(t) => initMutation.mutate(t)} loading={initMutation.isPending} />;
  }

  const grouped = new Map<string, GanttTask[]>();
  for (const t of data.tasks) {
    const list = grouped.get(t.section) ?? [];
    list.push(t);
    grouped.set(t.section, list);
  }

  const currentWeek = Math.min(
    TOTAL_WEEKS,
    Math.max(1, Math.ceil((new Date().getTime() - new Date(new Date().getFullYear(), 0, 1).getTime()) / (7 * 86400000)) % TOTAL_WEEKS || 1)
  );

  return (
    <div className="overflow-x-auto -mx-1">
      <div
        className="min-w-[900px]"
        style={{
          display: "grid",
          gridTemplateColumns: `220px repeat(${TOTAL_WEEKS}, 1fr)`,
        }}
      >
        {/* Header row */}
        <div className="sticky left-0 z-10 bg-background border-b border-border/50 px-2 py-2">
          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
            Task
          </span>
        </div>
        {WEEKS.map((w) => (
          <div
            key={w}
            className={`text-center text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground border-b border-border/50 py-2 ${
              w === currentWeek ? "bg-amber-500/10" : ""
            }`}
          >
            W{w}
          </div>
        ))}

        {/* Sections */}
        {SECTION_ORDER.map((section) => {
          const tasks = grouped.get(section) ?? [];

          return (
            <GanttSection
              key={section}
              section={section}
              tasks={tasks}
              currentWeek={currentWeek}
              onUpdate={(taskId, patch) => updateMutation.mutate({ taskId, ...patch })}
              onDelete={(taskId) => deleteMutation.mutate(taskId)}
              onAddClick={() => setAddingSection(section)}
              isAdding={addingSection === section}
              onAddSubmit={(task) => addMutation.mutate({ ...task, section })}
              onAddCancel={() => setAddingSection(null)}
              addPending={addMutation.isPending}
            />
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Section ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function GanttSection({
  section,
  tasks,
  currentWeek,
  onUpdate,
  onDelete,
  onAddClick,
  isAdding,
  onAddSubmit,
  onAddCancel,
  addPending,
}: {
  section: string;
  tasks: GanttTask[];
  currentWeek: number;
  onUpdate: (taskId: number, patch: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
  onDelete: (taskId: number) => void;
  onAddClick: () => void;
  isAdding: boolean;
  onAddSubmit: (task: { taskName: string; weekStart: number; weekEnd: number; wbs: string }) => void;
  onAddCancel: () => void;
  addPending: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <>
      {/* Section header */}
      <div className="col-span-full border-b border-border/30 bg-muted/30 px-2 py-1.5 flex items-center justify-between">
        <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
          {section}
        </span>
        <button
          onClick={onAddClick}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors"
        >
          <Plus className="h-3 w-3" />
          Add
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Task rows */}
      {tasks
        .sort((a, b) => a.wbs.localeCompare(b.wbs))
        .map((task) => (
          <GanttRow
            key={task.id}
            task={task}
            currentWeek={currentWeek}
            onUpdate={onUpdate}
            onDelete={onDelete}
          />
        ))}

      {/* Inline add form */}
      {isAdding && (
        <AddTaskRow
          onSubmit={onAddSubmit}
          onCancel={onAddCancel}
          pending={addPending}
          nextWbs={getNextWbs(tasks, section)}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
}

function getNextWbs(tasks: GanttTask[], section: string): string {
  const sectionNum = section === "Onboarding" ? "1" : section === "Content" ? "2" : "3";
  const nums = tasks
    .filter((t) => t.wbs.startsWith(sectionNum + "."))
    .map((t) => parseInt(t.wbs.split(".")[1], 10))
    .filter((n) => !isNaN(n));
  const next = nums.length > 0 ? Math.max(...nums) + 1 : 1;
  return `${sectionNum}.${String(next).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

// ── Add task row ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function AddTaskRow({
  onSubmit,
  onCancel,
  pending,
  nextWbs,
}: {
  onSubmit: (task: { taskName: string; weekStart: number; weekEnd: number; wbs: string }) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
  pending: boolean;
  nextWbs: string;
}) {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [ws, setWs] = useState("1");
  const [we, setWe] = useState("1");

  return (
    <div className="col-span-full border-b border-border/30 bg-amber-500/5 px-2 py-2 flex items-center gap-2">
      <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground tabular-nums w-8 shrink-0">{nextWbs}</span>
      <input
        autoFocus
        type="text"
        value={name}
        onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
        placeholder="Task name..."
        className="flex-1 rounded-md border border-stone-300 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-xs focus:border-amber-500 focus:outline-none dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900"
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === "Enter" && name.trim()) {
            onSubmit({ taskName: name.trim(), weekStart: Number(ws), weekEnd: Number(we), wbs: nextWbs });
          }
          if (e.key === "Escape") onCancel();
        }}
      />
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
        <span>W</span>
        <input
          type="number"
          min={1}
          max={13}
          value={ws}
          onChange={(e) => setWs(e.target.value)}
          className="w-10 rounded border border-stone-300 px-1 py-1 text-xs text-center dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900"
        />
        <span>–</span>
        <input
          type="number"
          min={1}
          max={13}
          value={we}
          onChange={(e) => setWe(e.target.value)}
          className="w-10 rounded border border-stone-300 px-1 py-1 text-xs text-center dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900"
        />
      </div>
      <Button
        size="sm"
        onClick={() => name.trim() && onSubmit({ taskName: name.trim(), weekStart: Number(ws), weekEnd: Number(we), wbs: nextWbs })}
        disabled={!name.trim() || pending}
        className="h-7 px-2 text-xs bg-brand text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover"
      >
        {pending ? <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" /> : "Add"}
      </Button>
      <button onClick={onCancel} className="text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">
        Cancel
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Task row ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function GanttRow({
  task,
  currentWeek,
  onUpdate,
  onDelete,
}: {
  task: GanttTask;
  currentWeek: number;
  onUpdate: (taskId: number, patch: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
  onDelete: (taskId: number) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <>
      {/* Frozen task name column */}
      <div className="sticky left-0 z-10 bg-background border-b border-border/20 px-2 py-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5 min-h-[36px]">
        <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground tabular-nums w-8 shrink-0">
          {task.wbs}
        </span>
        <span className="text-xs truncate">{task.taskName}</span>
      </div>

      {/* Week cells */}
      {WEEKS.map((w) => {
        const isInRange = w >= task.weekStart && w <= task.weekEnd;
        const isStart = w === task.weekStart;
        const isEnd = w === task.weekEnd;
        const isTodayCol = w === currentWeek;

        return (
          <div
            key={w}
            className={`border-b border-border/20 relative ${
              isTodayCol ? "bg-amber-500/5" : ""
            }`}
          >
            {isInRange && (
              <Popover>
                <PopoverTrigger asChild>
                  <button
                    className={`absolute inset-x-0.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-5 cursor-pointer transition-colors hover:opacity-80
                      ${STATUS_BAR[task.status]}
                      ${isStart ? "rounded-l-md" : ""}
                      ${isEnd ? "rounded-r-md" : ""}
                    `}
                    role="progressbar"
                    aria-valuenow={task.completionPct}
                    aria-valuemin={0}
                    aria-valuemax={100}
                    aria-label={`${task.taskName}: ${task.completionPct}%`}
                  >
                    {isStart && task.weekEnd - task.weekStart >= 2 && (
                      <span className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center text-[9px] font-bold text-white/90 mix-blend-luminosity">
                        {task.completionPct}%
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </PopoverTrigger>
                <PopoverContent className="w-80 p-3 space-y-3" align="start">
                  <TaskPopover task={task} onUpdate={onUpdate} onDelete={onDelete} />
                </PopoverContent>
              </Popover>
            )}

            {isTodayCol && (
              <div className="absolute right-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-px border-r border-dashed border-brand" />
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
}

// ── Task popover ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function TaskPopover({
  task,
  onUpdate,
  onDelete,
}: {
  task: GanttTask;
  onUpdate: (taskId: number, patch: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
  onDelete: (taskId: number) => void;
}) {
  const [taskName, setTaskName] = useState(task.taskName);
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState(task.notes ?? "");
  const [assignedTo, setAssignedTo] = useState(task.assignedTo ?? "");
  const [weekStart, setWeekStart] = useState(task.weekStart);
  const [weekEnd, setWeekEnd] = useState(task.weekEnd);
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState(false);

  function saveField(field: string, value: unknown, original: unknown) {
    if (value !== original) {
      onUpdate(task.id, { [field]: value });
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2.5">
      {/* Task name (editable) */}
      <div className="space-y-1">
        <label className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase">Task Name</label>
        <input
          type="text"
          value={taskName}
          onChange={(e) => setTaskName(e.target.value)}
          onBlur={() => saveField("taskName", taskName, task.taskName)}
          className="w-full rounded-md border border-stone-300 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-sm font-semibold text-foreground focus:border-amber-500 focus:outline-none dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300"
        />
        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{task.wbs} · {task.section}</p>
      </div>

      {/* Duration */}
      <div className="space-y-1">
        <label className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase">Duration</label>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">W</span>
            <input
              type="number"
              min={1}
              max={13}
              value={weekStart}
              onChange={(e) => setWeekStart(Number(e.target.value))}
              onBlur={() => saveField("weekStart", weekStart, task.weekStart)}
              className="w-12 rounded border border-stone-300 px-1.5 py-1 text-xs text-center tabular-nums dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900"
            />
          </div>
          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">to</span>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">W</span>
            <input
              type="number"
              min={1}
              max={13}
              value={weekEnd}
              onChange={(e) => setWeekEnd(Number(e.target.value))}
              onBlur={() => saveField("weekEnd", weekEnd, task.weekEnd)}
              className="w-12 rounded border border-stone-300 px-1.5 py-1 text-xs text-center tabular-nums dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900"
            />
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground ml-auto">
            {weekEnd - weekStart + 1}w
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Status */}
      <div className="space-y-1">
        <label className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase">Status</label>
        <Select
          value={task.status}
          onValueChange={(v) => onUpdate(task.id, { status: v })}
        >
          <SelectTrigger className="h-8 text-xs">
            <SelectValue />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectItem value="pending">Pending</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="in_progress">In Progress</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="completed">Completed</SelectItem>
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      </div>

      {/* Completion % */}
      <div className="space-y-1">
        <label className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase">Completion</label>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <input
            type="range"
            min={0}
            max={100}
            step={5}
            value={task.completionPct}
            onChange={(e) => onUpdate(task.id, { completionPct: Number(e.target.value) })}
            className="flex-1 h-1.5 accent-brand"
          />
          <span className="text-xs font-bold tabular-nums w-8 text-right">
            {task.completionPct}%
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Assigned to */}
      <div className="space-y-1">
        <label className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase">Assigned To</label>
        <input
          type="text"
          value={assignedTo}
          onChange={(e) => setAssignedTo(e.target.value)}
          onBlur={() => saveField("assignedTo", assignedTo || null, task.assignedTo)}
          placeholder="Name..."
          className="w-full rounded-md border border-stone-300 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-foreground focus:border-amber-500 focus:outline-none dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300"
        />
      </div>

      {/* Notes */}
      <div className="space-y-1">
        <label className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase">Notes</label>
        <textarea
          value={notes}
          onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
          onBlur={() => saveField("notes", notes || null, task.notes)}
          rows={2}
          placeholder="Add notes..."
          className="w-full rounded-md border border-stone-300 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-foreground focus:border-amber-500 focus:outline-none dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:text-zinc-300 resize-none"
        />
      </div>

      {/* Delete */}
      <div className="pt-1 border-t border-border/50">
        {!confirmDelete ? (
          <button
            onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(true)}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground hover:text-[var(--brand-red)] transition-colors"
          >
            <Trash2 className="h-3 w-3" />
            Delete task
          </button>
        ) : (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-[10px] text-[var(--brand-red)]">Delete this task?</span>
            <button
              onClick={() => onDelete(task.id)}
              className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[var(--brand-red)] hover:underline"
            >
              Yes
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(false)}
              className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground hover:underline"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Empty state ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function EmptyState({
  onInit,
  loading,
}: {
  onInit: (t: "AIA" | "NTA") => void;
  loading: boolean;
}) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<"AIA" | "NTA">("NTA");

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card p-12 text-center">
      <div className="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 p-4 mb-4">
        <CalendarDays className="h-8 w-8 text-brand" />
      </div>
      <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold mb-1">No timeline yet</h3>
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-6 max-w-sm mx-auto">
        Initialize the 13-week onboarding timeline from a template. This creates
        a snapshot — future template changes won&apos;t affect this client.
      </p>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3">
        <Select
          value={selected}
          onValueChange={(v) => setSelected(v as "AIA" | "NTA")}
        >
          <SelectTrigger className="w-[120px] h-9 text-sm">
            <SelectValue />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectItem value="AIA">AIA (13 tasks)</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="NTA">NTA (20 tasks)</SelectItem>
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
        <Button
          onClick={() => onInit(selected)}
          disabled={loading}
          className="rounded-lg bg-brand px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover shadow-[0_0_16px_-4px_var(--brand-glow)]"
        >
          {loading ? (
            <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
          ) : (
            "Initialize Timeline"
          )}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/clients/editable-cell.tsx

"use client";

import { useState, useRef, useCallback, useEffect } from "react";
import { ExternalLink, Building2, Mail, Loader2, Check } from "lucide-react";

type SaveState = "idle" | "saving" | "saved";

/** Format a raw numeric string for display based on prefix/suffix unit */
function formatDisplay(raw: string, prefix?: string, suffix?: string): string {
  const num = parseFloat(raw);
  if (isNaN(num)) return raw; // non-numeric → show as-is

  if (suffix === "%") {
    // Values stored as decimals (0.2 → 20%), or already whole (20 → 20%)
    const pct = num < 1 && num > 0 ? num * 100 : num;
    // Remove unnecessary trailing decimals (20.0 → 20)
    const formatted = pct % 1 === 0 ? pct.toFixed(0) : pct.toFixed(1);
    return `${formatted}%`;
  }

  if (prefix === "$") {
    const formatted = num.toLocaleString("en-US", {
      minimumFractionDigits: 0,
      maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    });
    return `$${formatted}`;
  }

  return raw;
}

interface EditableCellProps {
  field: string;
  value: string;
  readOnly: boolean;
  onSave: (field: string, value: string) => Promise<void>;
  type?: "text" | "url" | "email";
  className?: string;
  /** Prefix shown before value in read-only mode (e.g. "$") */
  prefix?: string;
  /** Suffix shown after value in read-only mode (e.g. "%") */
  suffix?: string;
  /** Text alignment for the input (default: "left") */
  align?: "left" | "right" | "center";
}

export function EditableCell({
  field,
  value,
  readOnly,
  onSave,
  type = "text",
  className = "",
  prefix,
  suffix,
  align = "left",
}: EditableCellProps) {
  const [localValue, setLocalValue] = useState(value);
  const [saveState, setSaveState] = useState<SaveState>("idle");
  const savedTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  // Sync external value changes (only when not actively editing)
  useEffect(() => {
    setLocalValue(value);
  }, [value]);

  const doSave = useCallback(
    async (v: string) => {
      if (v === value) return;
      setSaveState("saving");
      try {
        await onSave(field, v);
        setSaveState("saved");
        savedTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => setSaveState("idle"), 1500);
      } catch {
        setSaveState("idle");
      }
    },
    [field, value, onSave]
  );

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      (e.target as HTMLInputElement).blur();
    }
    if (e.key === "Escape") {
      setLocalValue(value);
      (e.target as HTMLInputElement).blur();
    }
  };

  const handleBlur = () => {
    doSave(localValue);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (savedTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(savedTimerRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  // Read-only rendering
  if (readOnly) {
    if (!value) return null;

    if (type === "url") {
      return (
        <div className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 ${className}`}>
          <span className="font-medium break-all">{value}</span>
          <a
            href={value.startsWith("http") ? value : `https://${value}`}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="text-brand hover:text-brand-hover shrink-0"
            title="Open website"
          >
            <Building2 className="h-4 w-4" />
          </a>
        </div>
      );
    }

    if (type === "email") {
      return (
        <a
          href={`mailto:${value}`}
          className={`text-brand hover:underline flex items-center gap-1 ${className}`}
        >
          <Mail className="h-3 w-3" />
          {value}
        </a>
      );
    }

    const display = (prefix || suffix) ? formatDisplay(value, prefix, suffix) : value;
    const alignClass = align === "right" ? "text-right" : align === "center" ? "text-center" : "";
    return <span className={`font-medium block ${alignClass} ${className}`}>{display}</span>;
  }

  // Editable rendering
  return (
    <div className={`relative flex items-center gap-1 ${className}`}>
      {prefix && <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs shrink-0">{prefix}</span>}
      <input
        type={type === "email" ? "email" : "text"}
        value={localValue}
        onChange={(e) => setLocalValue(e.target.value)}
        onBlur={handleBlur}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        className={`w-full bg-transparent border-b border-border/50 focus:border-brand outline-none text-sm py-0.5 px-0 font-medium transition-colors ${align === "right" ? "text-right" : align === "center" ? "text-center" : ""}`}
      />
      {suffix && <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs shrink-0">{suffix}</span>}
      {type === "url" && localValue && (
        <a
          href={localValue.startsWith("http") ? localValue : `https://${localValue}`}
          target="_blank"
          rel="noopener noreferrer"
          className="text-brand hover:text-brand-hover shrink-0"
          title="Open website"
          onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        >
          <Building2 className="h-4 w-4" />
        </a>
      )}
      {saveState === "saving" && (
        <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
      )}
      {saveState === "saved" && (
        <Check className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0 text-emerald-500" />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

export interface ClientEditData {
  clientIdCode: string;
  clientName: string;
  clientStatus: string;
}

interface NewClientDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  /** When provided, dialog opens in edit mode */
  editData?: ClientEditData;
}

export function NewClientDialog({ open, onOpenChange, editData }: NewClientDialogProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const isEditMode = !!editData;

  const [clientIdCode, setClientIdCode] = useState("");
  const [clientName, setClientName] = useState("");
  const [clientStatus, setClientStatus] = useState("Active");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  // Populate form when editData changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (editData && open) {
      setClientIdCode(editData.clientIdCode);
      setClientName(editData.clientName || "");
      setClientStatus(editData.clientStatus || "Active");
      setError("");
    }
  }, [editData, open]);

  const mutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      if (isEditMode) {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/clients/${encodeURIComponent(editData.clientIdCode)}`, {
          method: "PATCH",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({ clientName, clientStatus }),
        });
        if (!res.ok) {
          const data = await res.json();
          throw new Error(data.error || "Failed to update client");
        }
        return res.json();
      }
      const res = await fetch("/api/clients", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ clientIdCode, clientName, clientStatus }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        throw new Error(data.error || "Failed to create client");
      }
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["clients"] });
      if (isEditMode) {
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["onboarding", editData.clientIdCode] });
      }
      onOpenChange(false);
      resetForm();
      if (!isEditMode) {
        router.push(`/clients/${data.clientIdCode}/onboarding`);
      }
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      setError(err.message);
    },
  });

  function resetForm() {
    setClientIdCode("");
    setClientName("");
    setClientStatus("Active");
    setError("");
  }

  function handleOpenChange(next: boolean) {
    if (!next) resetForm();
    onOpenChange(next);
  }

  function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    if (!clientIdCode.trim()) {
      setError("Client ID Code is required");
      return;
    }
    mutation.mutate();
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{isEditMode ? "Edit Client" : "New Client"}</DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="clientIdCode">
              Client ID Code <span className="text-destructive">*</span>
            </Label>
            <Input
              id="clientIdCode"
              placeholder="e.g. BRA_SC_US"
              value={clientIdCode}
              onChange={(e) => setClientIdCode(e.target.value)}
              disabled={mutation.isPending || isEditMode}
              className={isEditMode ? "opacity-60" : ""}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="clientName">Client Name</Label>
            <Input
              id="clientName"
              placeholder="e.g. Brand Name"
              value={clientName}
              onChange={(e) => setClientName(e.target.value)}
              disabled={mutation.isPending}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>Status</Label>
            <Select
              value={clientStatus}
              onValueChange={setClientStatus}
              disabled={mutation.isPending}
            >
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="Active">
                  <span className="text-emerald-500 font-medium">Active</span>
                </SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="Prospect">
                  <span className="text-brand font-medium">Prospect</span>
                </SelectItem>
                <SelectItem value="Inactive">
                  <span className="text-red-500 font-medium">Inactive</span>
                </SelectItem>
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
          {error && (
            <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{error}</p>
          )}
          <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => handleOpenChange(false)}
              disabled={mutation.isPending}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={mutation.isPending}>
              {mutation.isPending ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-1 animate-spin" />
                  {isEditMode ? "Saving..." : "Creating..."}
                </>
              ) : isEditMode ? (
                "Save Changes"
              ) : (
                "Create Client"
              )}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from "react";
import { useQuery, useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  Columns3,
  Database,
  FileSpreadsheet,
  FileText,
  Filter,
  Search,
  X,
  Loader2,
} from "lucide-react";

type PreviewResult = {
  columns: string[];
  allColumns: string[];
  rows: string[][];
  totalRows: number;
  clientColumn: string | null;
  statusColumn: string | null;
};

type QueryBody = {
  dataset: string;
  table: string;
  clients?: string[];
  statuses?: string[];
  selectedColumns?: string[];
  format: "preview" | "xlsx" | "pdf";
  limit?: number;
};

async function fetchTables(): Promise<string[]> {
  const res = await fetch("/api/export/bq/tables");
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch tables");
  const data = await res.json();
  return data.datasets?.[0]?.tables ?? [];
}

async function queryBQ(body: QueryBody): Promise<PreviewResult | Blob> {
  const res = await fetch("/api/export/bq/query", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: "Request failed" }));
    throw new Error(err.error || "Query failed");
  }
  if (body.format === "preview") return res.json();
  return res.blob();
}

function extractUniqueValues(
  preview: PreviewResult,
  columnName: string | null
): string[] {
  if (!columnName) return [];
  const colIdx = preview.columns.indexOf(columnName);
  if (colIdx < 0) return [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const result: string[] = [];
  for (const row of preview.rows) {
    const val = row[colIdx];
    if (val && !seen.has(val)) {
      seen.add(val);
      result.push(val);
    }
  }
  return result.sort();
}

const DATASET = "1o8Hub";

export function BqExplorer() {
  const [selectedTables, setSelectedTables] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [selectedClients, setSelectedClients] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [selectedStatuses, setSelectedStatuses] = useState<string[]>(["Active"]);
  const [selectedColumns, setSelectedColumns] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [showFilters, setShowFilters] = useState(false);
  const [showColumnPicker, setShowColumnPicker] = useState(false);
  const [columnSearch, setColumnSearch] = useState("");
  const [previewData, setPreviewData] = useState<PreviewResult | null>(null);
  const [activeTable, setActiveTable] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const { data: tables, isLoading: tablesLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["bq-tables"],
    queryFn: fetchTables,
    staleTime: 10 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  // When tables change, reset preview
  useEffect(() => {
    setPreviewData(null);
    setSelectedColumns([]);
    setColumnSearch("");
    setError(null);
  }, [selectedTables]);

  const buildQueryBody = useCallback(
    (table: string, format: "preview" | "xlsx" | "pdf"): QueryBody => ({
      dataset: DATASET,
      table,
      clients: selectedClients.length > 0 ? selectedClients : undefined,
      statuses: selectedStatuses.length > 0 ? selectedStatuses : undefined,
      selectedColumns: selectedColumns.length > 0 ? selectedColumns : undefined,
      format,
      limit: format === "preview" ? 50 : undefined,
    }),
    [selectedClients, selectedStatuses, selectedColumns]
  );

  const previewMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (table: string) =>
      queryBQ(buildQueryBody(table, "preview")) as Promise<PreviewResult>,
    onSuccess: (data, table) => {
      setPreviewData(data);
      setActiveTable(table);
      setError(null);
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      setError(err.message);
      setPreviewData(null);
    },
  });

  const downloadMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ table, format }: { table: string; format: "xlsx" | "pdf" }) =>
      queryBQ(buildQueryBody(table, format)) as Promise<Blob>,
    onSuccess: (blob, { table, format }) => {
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `${DATASET}_${table}.${format}`;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      setError(err.message);
    },
  });

  const toggleItem = useCallback(
    (item: string, setter: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string[]>>) => {
      setter((prev) =>
        prev.includes(item) ? prev.filter((c) => c !== item) : [...prev, item]
      );
    },
    []
  );

  const handlePreview = useCallback(() => {
    if (selectedTables.length === 1) {
      previewMutation.mutate(selectedTables[0]);
    }
  }, [selectedTables, previewMutation]);

  const handleDownload = useCallback(
    (format: "xlsx" | "pdf") => {
      // Download each selected table
      for (const table of selectedTables) {
        downloadMutation.mutate({ table, format });
      }
    },
    [selectedTables, downloadMutation]
  );

  const availableClients = previewData
    ? extractUniqueValues(previewData, previewData.clientColumn)
    : [];
  const availableStatuses = previewData
    ? extractUniqueValues(previewData, previewData.statusColumn)
    : [];

  const allColumns = previewData?.allColumns ?? [];
  const filteredColumns = columnSearch
    ? allColumns.filter((c) =>
        c.toLowerCase().includes(columnSearch.toLowerCase())
      )
    : allColumns;

  const hasFilters = previewData?.clientColumn || previewData?.statusColumn;
  const activeFilterCount = selectedClients.length + selectedStatuses.length;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Database className="h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground" />
        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">BigQuery Explorer</h2>
        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{DATASET}</span>
      </div>

      {/* Table selection */}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-medium">
          Select tables
        </label>
        {tablesLoading && <Skeleton className="h-10 w-full max-w-lg" />}
        {tables && (
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {tables.map((t) => (
              <label
                key={t}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50 rounded-md border px-3 py-1.5 transition-colors data-[checked=true]:border-primary/50 data-[checked=true]:bg-primary/5"
                data-checked={selectedTables.includes(t)}
              >
                <Checkbox
                  checked={selectedTables.includes(t)}
                  onCheckedChange={() => toggleItem(t, setSelectedTables)}
                />
                <span>{t}</span>
              </label>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Actions */}
      {selectedTables.length > 0 && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          {selectedTables.length === 1 && (
            <Button
              onClick={handlePreview}
              disabled={previewMutation.isPending}
              variant="outline"
            >
              {previewMutation.isPending ? (
                <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
              ) : (
                <Search className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
              )}
              Preview
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button
            onClick={() => handleDownload("xlsx")}
            disabled={downloadMutation.isPending}
          >
            {downloadMutation.isPending ? (
              <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
            ) : (
              <FileSpreadsheet className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
            )}
            Download XLSX
            {selectedTables.length > 1 && (
              <span className="ml-1 text-xs opacity-70">
                ({selectedTables.length} tables)
              </span>
            )}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => handleDownload("pdf")}
            disabled={downloadMutation.isPending}
          >
            {downloadMutation.isPending ? (
              <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
            ) : (
              <FileText className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
            )}
            Download PDF
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Error */}
      {error && (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-500/30 bg-red-500/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-400">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Loading */}
      {previewMutation.isPending && (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <Skeleton className="h-8 w-full" />
          <Skeleton className="h-64 w-full" />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Preview results */}
      {previewData && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {/* Stats bar */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <Badge variant="outline">{activeTable}</Badge>
            <Badge variant="outline">
              {previewData.totalRows.toLocaleString()} total rows
            </Badge>
            <Badge variant="outline">
              {previewData.columns.length} columns
            </Badge>
          </div>

          {/* Column picker */}
          {allColumns.length > 0 && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowColumnPicker((v) => !v)}
                className="text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              >
                <Columns3 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                {showColumnPicker ? "Hide" : "Select"} columns
                {selectedColumns.length > 0 && (
                  <Badge variant="secondary" className="ml-1">
                    {selectedColumns.length} of {allColumns.length}
                  </Badge>
                )}
                {selectedColumns.length === 0 && (
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/60 ml-1">
                    (all {allColumns.length})
                  </span>
                )}
              </button>

              {showColumnPicker && (
                <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card p-4 max-w-3xl space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <Input
                      placeholder="Search columns..."
                      value={columnSearch}
                      onChange={(e) => setColumnSearch(e.target.value)}
                      className="max-w-xs h-8 text-sm"
                    />
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      {selectedColumns.length > 0 && (
                        <button
                          onClick={() => setSelectedColumns([])}
                          className="text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground flex items-center gap-1"
                        >
                          <X className="h-3 w-3" />
                          Clear
                        </button>
                      )}
                      <button
                        onClick={() => setSelectedColumns([...allColumns])}
                        className="text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                      >
                        Select all
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 gap-1 max-h-[240px] overflow-y-auto">
                    {filteredColumns.map((col) => (
                      <label
                        key={col}
                        className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50 rounded px-2 py-1"
                      >
                        <Checkbox
                          checked={selectedColumns.includes(col)}
                          onCheckedChange={() =>
                            toggleItem(col, setSelectedColumns)
                          }
                        />
                        <span className="truncate" title={col}>
                          {col}
                        </span>
                      </label>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  {selectedColumns.length > 0 && (
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="outline"
                      onClick={handlePreview}
                      disabled={previewMutation.isPending}
                    >
                      {previewMutation.isPending ? (
                        <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                      ) : (
                        <Search className="mr-2 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      )}
                      Apply columns
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Filters */}
          {hasFilters && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowFilters((v) => !v)}
                className="text-sm text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              >
                <Filter className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                {showFilters ? "Hide filters" : "Filters"}
                {activeFilterCount > 0 && (
                  <Badge variant="secondary" className="ml-1">
                    {activeFilterCount} active
                  </Badge>
                )}
              </button>

              {showFilters && (
                <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card p-4 max-w-3xl space-y-4">
                  {/* Status filter */}
                  {previewData.statusColumn && (
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className="text-sm font-medium">Status</span>
                        {selectedStatuses.length > 0 && (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => setSelectedStatuses([])}
                            className="text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground flex items-center gap-1"
                          >
                            <X className="h-3 w-3" />
                            Clear
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                        {availableStatuses.map((status) => (
                          <label
                            key={status}
                            className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50 rounded px-2 py-1"
                          >
                            <Checkbox
                              checked={selectedStatuses.includes(status)}
                              onCheckedChange={() =>
                                toggleItem(status, setSelectedStatuses)
                              }
                            />
                            <span>{status}</span>
                          </label>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                      {availableStatuses.length === 0 && (
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          No status values found in preview data.
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Client filter */}
                  {previewData.clientColumn && (
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className="text-sm font-medium">Client</span>
                        {selectedClients.length > 0 && (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => setSelectedClients([])}
                            className="text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground flex items-center gap-1"
                          >
                            <X className="h-3 w-3" />
                            Clear
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 gap-2">
                        {availableClients.map((client) => (
                          <label
                            key={client}
                            className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50 rounded px-2 py-1"
                          >
                            <Checkbox
                              checked={selectedClients.includes(client)}
                              onCheckedChange={() =>
                                toggleItem(client, setSelectedClients)
                              }
                            />
                            <span className="truncate">{client}</span>
                          </label>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                      {availableClients.length === 0 && (
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          No client values found in preview data.
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    Filter values shown from preview rows. Query without
                    filters first to see all available values.
                  </p>

                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    variant="outline"
                    onClick={handlePreview}
                    disabled={previewMutation.isPending}
                  >
                    {previewMutation.isPending ? (
                      <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                    ) : (
                      <Search className="mr-2 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    )}
                    Apply filters
                  </Button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Data table */}
          <div className="rounded-lg border overflow-hidden">
            <div className="overflow-x-auto max-h-[500px] overflow-y-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-xs">
                <thead className="bg-muted/50 sticky top-0">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left font-medium text-muted-foreground w-10">
                      #
                    </th>
                    {previewData.columns.map((col) => (
                      <th
                        key={col}
                        className="px-3 py-2 text-left font-medium text-muted-foreground whitespace-nowrap"
                      >
                        {col}
                      </th>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-border">
                  {previewData.rows.map((row, i) => (
                    <tr
                      key={i}
                      className="hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <td className="px-3 py-1.5 text-muted-foreground">
                        {i + 1}
                      </td>
                      {row.map((cell, j) => (
                        <td
                          key={j}
                          className="px-3 py-1.5 max-w-[200px] truncate"
                          title={cell}
                        >
                          {cell}
                        </td>
                      ))}
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
            {previewData.rows.length < previewData.totalRows && (
              <div className="px-3 py-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground bg-muted/30 border-t">
                Showing {previewData.rows.length} of{" "}
                {previewData.totalRows.toLocaleString()} rows
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { Download, FileSpreadsheet } from "lucide-react";
import { CLIENT_CODES } from "@/lib/constants";
import { REQUIREMENT_COLORS } from "@/lib/constants";
import type { RequirementLevel } from "@/lib/constants";

type ExportPreview = {
  client: string;
  columnCount: number;
  productCount: number;
  columns: string[];
  requirementBreakdown: Record<string, number>;
};

async function fetchPreview(client: string): Promise<ExportPreview> {
  const res = await fetch(`/api/export/preview?client=${client}`);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch preview");
  return res.json();
}

const BREAKDOWN_ORDER: RequirementLevel[] = [
  "Required",
  "Conditionally Required",
  "Recommended",
  "Optional",
];

export function ExportTool() {
  const [selectedClient, setSelectedClient] = useState("");

  const { data: preview, isLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["export-preview", selectedClient],
    queryFn: () => fetchPreview(selectedClient),
    enabled: !!selectedClient,
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  const handleDownload = () => {
    if (!selectedClient) return;
    window.open(`/api/export?client=${selectedClient}`, "_blank");
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <FileSpreadsheet className="h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground" />
        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">Client Export</h2>
      </div>

      <div className="max-w-sm">
        <Select
          value={selectedClient || "placeholder"}
          onValueChange={(v) => setSelectedClient(v === "placeholder" ? "" : v)}
        >
          <SelectTrigger>
            <SelectValue placeholder="Select a client..." />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectItem value="placeholder" disabled>
              Select a client...
            </SelectItem>
            {CLIENT_CODES.map((c) => (
              <SelectItem key={c} value={c}>
                {c}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      </div>

      {selectedClient && isLoading && (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <Skeleton className="h-32 w-full max-w-lg" />
        </div>
      )}

      {preview && (
        <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card p-6 max-w-lg space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <h3 className="font-semibold">{preview.client}</h3>
            <Badge variant="outline">{preview.productCount} products</Badge>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm">
            <div>
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Columns</span>
              <p className="text-2xl font-bold">{preview.columnCount}</p>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-muted-foreground">Products</span>
              <p className="text-2xl font-bold">{preview.productCount}</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Requirement breakdown
            </span>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
              {BREAKDOWN_ORDER.map((level) => {
                const count = preview.requirementBreakdown[level] || 0;
                if (count === 0) return null;
                return (
                  <span
                    key={level}
                    className={`inline-flex items-center rounded px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium border ${REQUIREMENT_COLORS[level]}`}
                  >
                    {count}{" "}
                    {level === "Conditionally Required" ? "Cond.Req" : level}
                  </span>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          <Button
            onClick={handleDownload}
            disabled={preview.productCount === 0}
            className="w-full"
          >
            <Download className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
            Download CSV
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/impact/impact-card.tsx
