"use client";

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { TrendingUp, TrendingDown, Minus, Activity, Clock } from "lucide-react";

interface ImpactSnapshot {
  id: number;
  clientIdCode: string;
  productId: string | null;
  asin: string | null;
  changeType: string;
  changeSummary: string;
  changeCount: number;
  changedBy: string;
  changedAt: string;
  status: "pending_before" | "pending_after" | "complete";
  impactWindowDays: number;
  deltas: Record<string, { before: number; after: number; change: number; changePct: number | null }> | null;
}

function formatCurrency(n: number): string {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", { style: "currency", currency: "USD", maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(n);
}

function formatPct(n: number | null): string {
  if (n == null) return "N/A";
  return `${n >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${n.toFixed(1)}%`;
}

function TrendIcon({ value }: { value: number | null }) {
  if (value == null || Math.abs(value) < 0.5) return <Minus className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />;
  if (value > 0) return <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4 text-green-600" />;
  return <TrendingDown className="h-4 w-4 text-red-600" />;
}

function DeltaRow({ label, delta }: { label: string; delta: { before: number; after: number; change: number; changePct: number | null } }) {
  const isCurrency = ["product_sales", "ad_spend", "ad_revenue", "ordered_revenue"].includes(label);
  const fmt = isCurrency ? formatCurrency : (n: number) => n.toLocaleString();

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between py-1.5">
      <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground capitalize">{label.replace(/_/g, " ")}</span>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <span className="text-sm tabular-nums">{fmt(delta.before)}</span>
        <span className="text-muted-foreground">→</span>
        <span className="text-sm font-medium tabular-nums">{fmt(delta.after)}</span>
        <span className={`text-sm font-medium tabular-nums ${
          delta.changePct != null && delta.changePct > 0 ? "text-green-600" :
          delta.changePct != null && delta.changePct < 0 ? "text-red-600" : ""
        }`}>
          {formatPct(delta.changePct)}
        </span>
        <TrendIcon value={delta.changePct} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function SnapshotCard({ snapshot }: { snapshot: ImpactSnapshot }) {
  const isPending = snapshot.status !== "complete";
  const daysAgo = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(snapshot.changedAt).getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
  const daysRemaining = isPending ? Math.max(0, snapshot.impactWindowDays - daysAgo) : 0;

  // Key metrics to display
  const keyMetrics = ["product_sales", "ordered_revenue", "ad_spend", "ad_revenue", "glance_view_byasin", "ordered_units"];

  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card p-4 space-y-3">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Activity className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">{snapshot.changeSummary}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <span>{snapshot.changedBy}</span>
            <span>·</span>
            <span>{new Date(snapshot.changedAt).toLocaleDateString()}</span>
            {snapshot.changeCount > 1 && (
              <>
                <span>·</span>
                <span>{snapshot.changeCount} changes</span>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        {isPending ? (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-amber-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400">
            <Clock className="h-3 w-3" />
            {daysRemaining > 0 ? `${daysRemaining}d remaining` : "Measuring..."}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="rounded-full bg-green-100 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900/30 dark:text-green-400">
            Complete
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {snapshot.deltas ? (
        <div className="divide-y">
          {keyMetrics.map((key) =>
            snapshot.deltas![key] ? (
              <DeltaRow key={key} label={key} delta={snapshot.deltas![key]} />
            ) : null
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground italic">
          Impact data will be available after the {snapshot.impactWindowDays}-day measurement window.
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function ImpactCard({ clientIdCode, productId, limit = 5 }: {
  clientIdCode?: string;
  productId?: string;
  limit?: number;
}) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (clientIdCode) params.set("client", clientIdCode);
  if (productId) params.set("productId", productId);
  params.set("limit", String(limit));

  const { data, isLoading } = useQuery<{ snapshots: ImpactSnapshot[] }>({
    queryKey: ["impact", clientIdCode, productId, limit],
    queryFn: () => fetch(`/api/impact?${params}`).then((r) => r.json()),
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold flex items-center gap-2">
          <Activity className="h-4 w-4" /> Content Impact
        </h3>
        <div className="h-24 animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-muted" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!data?.snapshots?.length) return null;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold flex items-center gap-2">
        <Activity className="h-4 w-4" /> Content Impact Attribution
      </h3>
      {data.snapshots.map((s) => (
        <SnapshotCard key={s.id} snapshot={s} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/import/import-wizard.tsx

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useSession } from "next-auth/react";
import { Check } from "lucide-react";
import { StepSource, type ImportSourceState } from "./step-source";
import { StepMapping } from "./step-mapping";
import { StepOptions } from "./step-options";
import { StepExecute } from "./step-execute";
import type { ColumnMapping } from "@/lib/import-mapper";

type ImportStep = "source" | "mapping" | "options" | "execute";

const STEPS: { key: ImportStep; label: string; number: number }[] = [
  { key: "source", label: "Source", number: 1 },
  { key: "mapping", label: "Mapping", number: 2 },
  { key: "options", label: "Options", number: 3 },
  { key: "execute", label: "Import", number: 4 },
];

export function ImportWizard() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const [step, setStep] = useState<ImportStep>("source");

  // Shared state across steps
  const [sourceState, setSourceState] = useState<ImportSourceState | null>(null);
  const [confirmedMappings, setConfirmedMappings] = useState<ColumnMapping[]>([]);
  const [conflictMode, setConflictMode] = useState<"skip" | "overwrite" | "merge">("skip");
  const [clientFilter, setClientFilter] = useState("");

  if (session?.user?.role !== "admin") {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
        <div className="text-center">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground">Unauthorized</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
            Only admin users can access the import wizard.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const currentIdx = STEPS.findIndex((s) => s.key === step);

  return (
    <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto">
      {/* Step Indicator */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-0 mb-8">
        {STEPS.map((s, i) => {
          const isActive = s.key === step;
          const isCompleted = i < currentIdx;
          return (
            <div key={s.key} className="flex items-center">
              {i > 0 && (
                <div
                  className="w-12 h-0.5 mx-1"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: isCompleted ? "var(--brand)" : "oklch(1 0 0 / 12%)",
                  }}
                />
              )}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div
                  className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-semibold transition-colors"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: isActive || isCompleted ? "var(--brand)" : "oklch(1 0 0 / 12%)",
                    color: isActive || isCompleted ? "var(--brand-foreground)" : "#9ca3af",
                  }}
                >
                  {isCompleted ? <Check className="h-4 w-4" /> : s.number}
                </div>
                <span
                  className={`text-sm font-medium ${
                    isActive
                      ? "text-foreground"
                      : isCompleted
                        ? "text-foreground/80"
                        : "text-muted-foreground/70"
                  }`}
                >
                  {s.label}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Step Content */}
      {step === "source" && (
        <StepSource
          sourceState={sourceState}
          onComplete={(state) => {
            setSourceState(state);
            setConfirmedMappings(state.mappings);
            setStep("mapping");
          }}
        />
      )}

      {step === "mapping" && sourceState && (
        <StepMapping
          sourceState={sourceState}
          mappings={confirmedMappings}
          onBack={() => setStep("source")}
          onComplete={(mappings) => {
            setConfirmedMappings(mappings);
            setStep("options");
          }}
        />
      )}

      {step === "options" && sourceState && (
        <StepOptions
          sourceState={sourceState}
          mappings={confirmedMappings}
          conflictMode={conflictMode}
          onConflictModeChange={setConflictMode}
          clientFilter={clientFilter}
          onClientFilterChange={setClientFilter}
          onBack={() => setStep("mapping")}
          onComplete={() => setStep("execute")}
        />
      )}

      {step === "execute" && sourceState && (
        <StepExecute
          sourceState={sourceState}
          mappings={confirmedMappings}
          conflictMode={conflictMode}
          clientFilter={clientFilter}
          onBack={() => setStep("options")}
          onReset={() => {
            setStep("source");
            setSourceState(null);
            setConfirmedMappings([]);
            setConflictMode("skip");
            setClientFilter("");
          }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/import/step-execute.tsx

"use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import {
  Loader2,
  CheckCircle,
  XCircle,
  ArrowRight,
  RotateCcw,
} from "lucide-react";
import type { ColumnMapping } from "@/lib/import-mapper";
import type { ImportSourceState } from "./step-source";

interface ImportResult {
  success: boolean;
  inserted: number;
  updated: number;
  skipped: number;
  failed: number;
  errors: string[];
  duration: string;
}

interface StepExecuteProps {
  sourceState: ImportSourceState;
  mappings: ColumnMapping[];
  conflictMode: "skip" | "overwrite" | "merge";
  clientFilter: string;
  onBack: () => void;
  onReset: () => void;
}

export function StepExecute({
  sourceState,
  mappings,
  conflictMode,
  clientFilter,
  onBack,
  onReset,
}: StepExecuteProps) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const router = useRouter();

  // Build confirmed mappings (only mapped columns)
  const confirmedMappings = mappings
    .filter((m) => m.bqName)
    .map((m) => ({
      sourceHeader: m.sourceHeader,
      bqName: m.bqName!,
    }));

  const importMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (): Promise<ImportResult> => {
      if (sourceState.type === "csv") {
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append("file", sourceState.file!);
        formData.append(
          "config",
          JSON.stringify({
            source: "csv",
            mappings: confirmedMappings,
            conflictMode,
            clientFilter: clientFilter || undefined,
          })
        );
        const res = await fetch("/api/import/execute", {
          method: "POST",
          body: formData,
        });
        if (!res.ok) {
          const err = await res.json();
          throw new Error(err.error || "Import failed");
        }
        return res.json();
      } else {
        const res = await fetch("/api/import/execute", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            source: "bigquery",
            mappings: confirmedMappings,
            conflictMode,
            clientFilter: clientFilter || undefined,
            bqDataset: sourceState.bqDataset,
            bqTable: sourceState.bqTable,
          }),
        });
        if (!res.ok) {
          const err = await res.json();
          throw new Error(err.error || "Import failed");
        }
        return res.json();
      }
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      toast.success(
        `Import complete: ${data.inserted} inserted, ${data.updated} updated`
      );
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["products"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["clients"] });
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => {
      toast.error(`Import failed: ${error.message}`);
    },
  });

  // Auto-start import on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    importMutation.mutate();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);

  const result = importMutation.data;
  const isLoading = importMutation.isPending;
  const isError = importMutation.isError;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {isLoading && (
        <div className="rounded-lg border p-8 text-center space-y-4">
          <Loader2 className="h-12 w-12 animate-spin mx-auto text-brand" />
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">Importing Products...</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Processing {sourceState.totalRows.toLocaleString()} rows. This may
            take a minute.
          </p>
          {/* Indeterminate progress bar */}
          <div className="w-full max-w-md mx-auto h-2 bg-muted rounded-full overflow-hidden">
            <div
              className="h-full rounded-full animate-pulse"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: "var(--brand)",
                width: "60%",
                animation: "indeterminate 1.5s ease-in-out infinite",
              }}
            />
          </div>
          <style>{`
            @keyframes indeterminate {
              0% { transform: translateX(-100%); width: 40%; }
              50% { transform: translateX(50%); width: 60%; }
              100% { transform: translateX(200%); width: 40%; }
            }
          `}</style>
        </div>
      )}

      {result && (
        <div className="rounded-lg border p-8 space-y-6">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <CheckCircle className="h-8 w-8 text-emerald-500" />
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">Import Complete</h2>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
            <StatCard label="Inserted" value={result.inserted} color="text-emerald-600" />
            <StatCard label="Updated" value={result.updated} color="text-blue-600" />
            <StatCard label="Skipped" value={result.skipped} color="text-muted-foreground" />
            <StatCard label="Failed" value={result.failed} color={result.failed > 0 ? "text-red-600" : "text-muted-foreground"} />
          </div>

          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Duration: {result.duration}
          </p>

          {result.errors.length > 0 && (
            <div className="rounded-md border border-red-500/30 bg-red-500/10 p-3">
              <h4 className="text-sm font-medium text-red-400 mb-1">Errors</h4>
              <ul className="text-xs text-red-400 space-y-0.5">
                {result.errors.map((err, i) => (
                  <li key={i}>{err}</li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="flex gap-3">
            <Button
              onClick={() => router.push("/products")}
              className="bg-brand text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover"
            >
              View Products
              <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />
            </Button>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={onReset}>
              <RotateCcw className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" />
              Import More
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {isError && !result && (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-500/30 bg-red-500/10 p-8 text-center space-y-4">
          <XCircle className="h-12 w-12 mx-auto text-red-500" />
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-red-400">Import Failed</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-red-400">
            {importMutation.error?.message || "An unknown error occurred"}
          </p>
          <div className="flex justify-center gap-3">
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={onBack}>
              Back to Options
            </Button>
            <Button
              onClick={() => importMutation.mutate()}
              className="bg-brand text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover"
            >
              Retry
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Back button only shown during loading */}
      {isLoading && (
        <div className="flex justify-start">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={onBack} disabled>
            Back
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function StatCard({
  label,
  value,
  color,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: number;
  color: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card p-4 text-center">
      <p className={`text-2xl font-bold ${color}`}>
        {value.toLocaleString()}
      </p>
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">{label}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import {
  Popover,
  PopoverContent,
  PopoverTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/popover";
import {
  Command,
  CommandInput,
  CommandList,
  CommandEmpty,
  CommandGroup,
  CommandItem,
} from "@/components/ui/command";
import { ChevronsUpDown, Check, AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";
import { useColumnAttributes } from "@/hooks/use-column-attributes";
import type { ColumnMapping } from "@/lib/import-mapper";
import type { ImportSourceState } from "./step-source";

interface StepMappingProps {
  sourceState: ImportSourceState;
  mappings: ColumnMapping[];
  onBack: () => void;
  onComplete: (mappings: ColumnMapping[]) => void;
}

export function StepMapping({
  sourceState,
  mappings: initialMappings,
  onBack,
  onComplete,
}: StepMappingProps) {
  const [mappings, setMappings] = useState<ColumnMapping[]>(initialMappings);
  const { groups, isLoading: attrsLoading } = useColumnAttributes();

  // Flatten groups for the picker
  const allAttributes = useMemo(() => {
    const result: { group: string; bqName: string; generalLabel: string }[] = [];
    for (const group of groups) {
      for (const subgroup of group.subgroups) {
        for (const attr of subgroup.attributes) {
          if (attr.bigqueryLabel) {
            result.push({
              group: group.name,
              bqName: attr.bigqueryLabel,
              generalLabel: attr.generalLabel,
            });
          }
        }
      }
    }
    return result;
  }, [groups]);

  // Grouped for the command picker
  const groupedAttributes = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, { bqName: string; generalLabel: string }[]>();
    for (const a of allAttributes) {
      if (!map.has(a.group)) map.set(a.group, []);
      map.get(a.group)!.push(a);
    }
    return map;
  }, [allAttributes]);

  const mappedCount = mappings.filter((m) => m.bqName).length;
  const unmappedCount = mappings.filter((m) => !m.bqName).length;

  // Check for duplicate target mappings
  const duplicates = useMemo(() => {
    const bqNames = mappings.filter((m) => m.bqName).map((m) => m.bqName!);
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    const dups = new Set<string>();
    for (const name of bqNames) {
      if (seen.has(name)) dups.add(name);
      seen.add(name);
    }
    return dups;
  }, [mappings]);

  // Must have ASIN or SKU mapped
  const hasIdentifier = mappings.some(
    (m) => m.bqName === "ASIN" || m.bqName === "SKU"
  );

  const canProceed = hasIdentifier && duplicates.size === 0;

  function updateMapping(index: number, bqName: string | null, generalLabel: string | null) {
    setMappings((prev) => {
      const next = [...prev];
      next[index] = {
        ...next[index],
        bqName,
        generalLabel,
        confidence: bqName ? "exact" : "unmapped",
      };
      return next;
    });
  }

  // Get a preview value for a given source header
  function getPreviewValue(header: string): string {
    for (const row of sourceState.preview) {
      if (row[header] && row[header].trim()) {
        const val = row[header];
        return val.length > 40 ? val.slice(0, 40) + "..." : val;
      }
    }
    return "";
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">Column Mapping</h2>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
          Review and adjust how source columns map to Hub fields.
        </p>
      </div>

      {!hasIdentifier && (
        <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-md border border-red-500/30 bg-red-500/10 p-3 text-sm text-red-400">
          <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>At least <strong>ASIN</strong> or <strong>SKU</strong> must be mapped to proceed.</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {duplicates.size > 0 && (
        <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-md border border-red-500/30 bg-red-500/10 p-3 text-sm text-red-400">
          <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>
            Duplicate target mappings: {[...duplicates].join(", ")}. Each target column can only be mapped once.
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Mapping Table */}
      <div className="border rounded-lg overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-sm">
          <thead>
            <tr className="bg-muted/50 border-b">
              <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left font-medium w-[200px]">Source Column</th>
              <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left font-medium w-[300px]">Maps To (Hub)</th>
              <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left font-medium w-[100px]">Confidence</th>
              <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left font-medium">Preview</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {mappings.map((m, i) => {
              const isDuplicate = m.bqName ? duplicates.has(m.bqName) : false;
              return (
                <tr key={m.sourceHeader} className={`border-b ${i % 2 === 0 ? "bg-card" : "bg-muted/30"}`}>
                  <td className="px-3 py-1.5 font-mono text-xs">{m.sourceHeader}</td>
                  <td className="px-3 py-1.5">
                    <MappingPicker
                      value={m.bqName}
                      groupedAttributes={groupedAttributes}
                      attrsLoading={attrsLoading}
                      isDuplicate={isDuplicate}
                      onChange={(bqName, generalLabel) =>
                        updateMapping(i, bqName, generalLabel)
                      }
                    />
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-3 py-1.5">
                    <ConfidenceBadge confidence={m.confidence} />
                  </td>
                  <td className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground font-mono truncate max-w-[200px]">
                    {getPreviewValue(m.sourceHeader)}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      {/* Summary */}
      <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        Mapped: <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{mappedCount}</span> /{" "}
        {mappings.length} columns &middot; Unmapped:{" "}
        <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{unmappedCount}</span> columns
        (will be skipped)
      </div>

      {/* Navigation */}
      <div className="flex justify-between">
        <Button variant="outline" onClick={onBack}>
          Back
        </Button>
        <Button
          onClick={() => onComplete(mappings)}
          disabled={!canProceed}
          className="bg-brand text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover"
        >
          Next: Import Options
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ConfidenceBadge({ confidence }: { confidence: string }) {
  switch (confidence) {
    case "exact":
      return (
        <Badge className="bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30 hover:bg-emerald-500/15">
          Exact
        </Badge>
      );
    case "partial":
      return (
        <Badge className="bg-yellow-500/15 text-brand border-brand/30 hover:bg-yellow-500/15">
          Partial
        </Badge>
      );
    default:
      return (
        <Badge className="bg-red-500/15 text-red-400 border-red-500/30 hover:bg-red-500/15">
          Unmapped
        </Badge>
      );
  }
}

function MappingPicker({
  value,
  groupedAttributes,
  attrsLoading,
  isDuplicate,
  onChange,
}: {
  value: string | null;
  groupedAttributes: Map<string, { bqName: string; generalLabel: string }[]>;
  attrsLoading: boolean;
  isDuplicate: boolean;
  onChange: (bqName: string | null, generalLabel: string | null) => void;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <Popover open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <PopoverTrigger asChild>
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          role="combobox"
          className={`w-full justify-between font-normal text-xs h-8 ${
            isDuplicate ? "border-red-500/40 bg-red-500/10" : ""
          }`}
        >
          <span className="truncate">
            {value || "Skip this column"}
          </span>
          <ChevronsUpDown className="ml-1 h-3 w-3 shrink-0 opacity-50" />
        </Button>
      </PopoverTrigger>
      <PopoverContent className="w-[360px] p-0" align="start">
        <Command>
          <CommandInput placeholder="Search fields..." />
          <CommandList>
            <CommandEmpty>
              {attrsLoading ? "Loading..." : "No fields found."}
            </CommandEmpty>
            <CommandGroup heading="Actions">
              <CommandItem
                value="__skip__"
                onSelect={() => {
                  onChange(null, null);
                  setOpen(false);
                }}
              >
                <Check className={`mr-2 h-4 w-4 ${!value ? "opacity-100" : "opacity-0"}`} />
                <span className="text-muted-foreground italic">Skip this column</span>
              </CommandItem>
            </CommandGroup>
            {[...groupedAttributes.entries()].map(([group, attrs]) => (
              <CommandGroup key={group} heading={group}>
                {attrs.map((attr) => (
                  <CommandItem
                    key={attr.bqName}
                    value={`${attr.generalLabel} ${attr.bqName}`}
                    onSelect={() => {
                      onChange(attr.bqName, attr.generalLabel);
                      setOpen(false);
                    }}
                  >
                    <Check
                      className={`mr-2 h-4 w-4 ${
                        value === attr.bqName ? "opacity-100" : "opacity-0"
                      }`}
                    />
                    <span className="truncate text-xs">{attr.generalLabel}</span>
                    {attr.bqName !== attr.generalLabel && (
                      <span className="ml-auto text-[10px] text-muted-foreground truncate">
                        {attr.bqName}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </CommandItem>
                ))}
              </CommandGroup>
            ))}
          </CommandList>
        </Command>
      </PopoverContent>
    </Popover>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useMemo } from "react";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import type { ColumnMapping } from "@/lib/import-mapper";
import type { ImportSourceState } from "./step-source";

type ClientEntry = { clientIdCode: string; count: number; activeCount: number };

async function fetchClients(): Promise<ClientEntry[]> {
  const res = await fetch("/api/clients");
  if (!res.ok) return [];
  return res.json();
}

interface StepOptionsProps {
  sourceState: ImportSourceState;
  mappings: ColumnMapping[];
  conflictMode: "skip" | "overwrite" | "merge";
  onConflictModeChange: (mode: "skip" | "overwrite" | "merge") => void;
  clientFilter: string;
  onClientFilterChange: (client: string) => void;
  onBack: () => void;
  onComplete: () => void;
}

const CONFLICT_OPTIONS = [
  {
    value: "skip" as const,
    label: "Skip",
    description: "Keep existing data, ignore the import row",
  },
  {
    value: "overwrite" as const,
    label: "Overwrite",
    description: "Replace all fields with imported values",
  },
  {
    value: "merge" as const,
    label: "Merge",
    description: "Only fill in fields that are currently empty in the DB",
  },
];

export function StepOptions({
  sourceState,
  mappings,
  conflictMode,
  onConflictModeChange,
  clientFilter,
  onClientFilterChange,
  onBack,
  onComplete,
}: StepOptionsProps) {
  const { data: clients = [] } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["clients"],
    queryFn: fetchClients,
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  const mappedCount = mappings.filter((m) => m.bqName).length;
  const unmappedCount = mappings.filter((m) => !m.bqName).length;

  // Estimate filtered row count from preview data
  const filteredEstimate = useMemo(() => {
    if (!clientFilter) return null;
    // Find which source header maps to ClientIDCode
    const clientMapping = mappings.find((m) => m.bqName === "ClientIDCode");
    if (!clientMapping) return null;
    const matchingPreview = sourceState.preview.filter(
      (row) => row[clientMapping.sourceHeader] === clientFilter
    );
    // This is just an estimate from preview rows
    if (sourceState.preview.length === 0) return null;
    const ratio = matchingPreview.length / sourceState.preview.length;
    return Math.round(sourceState.totalRows * ratio);
  }, [clientFilter, mappings, sourceState]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">Import Options</h2>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
          Configure how to handle conflicts and filter data.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Conflict Resolution */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <label className="text-sm font-medium">
          Conflict Resolution
        </label>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          When an imported product already exists (matched by ASIN + SKU + Marketplace):
        </p>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {CONFLICT_OPTIONS.map((opt) => (
            <label
              key={opt.value}
              className={`flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border p-3 cursor-pointer transition-colors ${
                conflictMode === opt.value
                  ? "border-brand bg-brand/10"
                  : "border-border hover:border-border"
              }`}
            >
              <input
                type="radio"
                name="conflictMode"
                value={opt.value}
                checked={conflictMode === opt.value}
                onChange={() => onConflictModeChange(opt.value)}
                className="mt-0.5 accent-brand"
              />
              <div>
                <span className="text-sm font-medium">{opt.label}</span>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                  {opt.description}
                </p>
              </div>
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Client Filter */}
      <div className="space-y-2 max-w-sm">
        <label className="text-sm font-medium">
          Client Filter (optional)
        </label>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          Only import rows matching this ClientIDCode
        </p>
        <Select
          value={clientFilter || "all"}
          onValueChange={(v) => onClientFilterChange(v === "all" ? "" : v)}
        >
          <SelectTrigger>
            <SelectValue placeholder="All clients" />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectItem value="all">All Clients</SelectItem>
            {clients.map((c) => (
              <SelectItem key={c.clientIdCode} value={c.clientIdCode}>
                {c.clientIdCode}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
        {clientFilter && filteredEstimate !== null && (
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            ~{sourceState.totalRows.toLocaleString()} rows &rarr;{" "}
            ~{filteredEstimate.toLocaleString()} rows matching{" "}
            <span className="font-medium">{clientFilter}</span>
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Summary */}
      <div className="rounded-lg border bg-muted/50 p-4 space-y-1.5">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-medium">Summary</h3>
        <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground space-y-0.5">
          <p>
            Source:{" "}
            <span className="text-foreground font-medium">
              {sourceState.type === "csv"
                ? `${sourceState.fileName} (${sourceState.totalRows.toLocaleString()} rows)`
                : `BigQuery ${sourceState.bqDataset}.${sourceState.bqTable} (${sourceState.totalRows.toLocaleString()} rows)`}
            </span>
          </p>
          <p>
            Mapped columns:{" "}
            <span className="text-foreground font-medium">
              {mappedCount} of {mappings.length}
            </span>
          </p>
          <p>
            Unmapped (will be skipped):{" "}
            <span className="text-foreground font-medium">{unmappedCount}</span>
          </p>
          <p>
            Conflict mode:{" "}
            <span className="text-foreground font-medium capitalize">
              {conflictMode}
            </span>
          </p>
          {clientFilter && (
            <p>
              Client filter:{" "}
              <span className="text-foreground font-medium">{clientFilter}</span>
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Navigation */}
      <div className="flex justify-between">
        <Button variant="outline" onClick={onBack}>
          Back
        </Button>
        <Button
          onClick={onComplete}
          className="bg-brand text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover"
        >
          Start Import
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/import/step-source.tsx

"use client";

import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from "react";
import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  FileSpreadsheet,
  Database,
  Upload,
  Loader2,
  CheckCircle,
  XCircle,
} from "lucide-react";
import type { ColumnMapping } from "@/lib/import-mapper";

export interface ImportSourceState {
  type: "csv" | "bigquery";
  file?: File;
  fileName?: string;
  totalRows: number;
  headers: string[];
  preview: Record<string, string>[];
  mappings: ColumnMapping[];
  bqDataset?: string;
  bqTable?: string;
}

interface StepSourceProps {
  sourceState: ImportSourceState | null;
  onComplete: (state: ImportSourceState) => void;
}

export function StepSource({ sourceState, onComplete }: StepSourceProps) {
  const [sourceType, setSourceType] = useState<"csv" | "bigquery" | null>(
    sourceState?.type ?? null
  );
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(sourceState?.file ?? null);
  const [bqDataset, setBqDataset] = useState(sourceState?.bqDataset ?? "1o8Hub");
  const [bqTable, setBqTable] = useState(sourceState?.bqTable ?? "Master");
  const [parseResult, setParseResult] = useState<ImportSourceState | null>(sourceState);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const csvParseMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (csvFile: File) => {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("file", csvFile);
      const res = await fetch("/api/import/parse", {
        method: "POST",
        body: formData,
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Parse failed");
      }
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      const state: ImportSourceState = {
        type: "csv",
        file: file!,
        fileName: data.fileName,
        totalRows: data.totalRows,
        headers: data.headers,
        preview: data.preview,
        mappings: data.mappings,
      };
      setParseResult(state);
      setError("");
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      setError(err.message);
      setParseResult(null);
    },
  });

  const bqPreviewMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();
      params.set("dataset", bqDataset);
      params.set("table", bqTable);
      params.set("limit", "5");
      const res = await fetch(`/api/import/bigquery-preview?${params}`);
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "BigQuery preview failed");
      }
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      const state: ImportSourceState = {
        type: "bigquery",
        totalRows: data.totalRows,
        headers: data.headers,
        preview: data.preview,
        mappings: data.mappings,
        bqDataset,
        bqTable,
      };
      setParseResult(state);
      setError("");
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      setError(err.message);
      setParseResult(null);
    },
  });

  const handleFileChange = useCallback(
    (selectedFile: File | null) => {
      if (!selectedFile) return;
      setFile(selectedFile);
      setParseResult(null);
      setError("");
      csvParseMutation.mutate(selectedFile);
    },
    [csvParseMutation]
  );

  const handleDrop = useCallback(
    (e: React.DragEvent) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const droppedFile = e.dataTransfer.files?.[0];
      if (droppedFile?.name.endsWith(".csv")) {
        handleFileChange(droppedFile);
      } else {
        setError("Please drop a .csv file");
      }
    },
    [handleFileChange]
  );

  const isLoading = csvParseMutation.isPending || bqPreviewMutation.isPending;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">Select Import Source</h2>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
          Choose where to import product data from.
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Source Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        {/* CSV Card */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            setSourceType("csv");
            setParseResult(null);
            setError("");
          }}
          className={`rounded-lg border-2 p-6 text-left transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
            sourceType === "csv"
              ? "border-brand bg-brand/10"
              : "border-border hover:border-border"
          }`}
        >
          <FileSpreadsheet className="h-8 w-8 mb-3 text-muted-foreground" />
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-foreground">CSV Upload</h3>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
            Upload a CSV file from your computer
          </p>
        </button>

        {/* BigQuery Card */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            setSourceType("bigquery");
            setParseResult(null);
            setError("");
          }}
          className={`rounded-lg border-2 p-6 text-left transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
            sourceType === "bigquery"
              ? "border-brand bg-brand/10"
              : "border-border hover:border-border"
          }`}
        >
          <Database className="h-8 w-8 mb-3 text-muted-foreground" />
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-foreground">BigQuery</h3>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
            Import directly from BigQuery
          </p>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* CSV Upload Zone */}
      {sourceType === "csv" && (
        <div
          onDragOver={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
          onDrop={handleDrop}
          onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
          className="border-2 border-dashed rounded-lg p-8 text-center cursor-pointer transition-colors hover:border-brand hover:bg-brand/8"
        >
          <input
            ref={fileInputRef}
            type="file"
            accept=".csv"
            className="hidden"
            onChange={(e) => handleFileChange(e.target.files?.[0] ?? null)}
          />
          {csvParseMutation.isPending ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
              <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 animate-spin text-muted-foreground/70" />
              <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                Parsing CSV...
              </span>
            </div>
          ) : parseResult?.type === "csv" ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
              <CheckCircle className="h-8 w-8 text-emerald-500" />
              <span className="text-sm font-medium">
                {parseResult.fileName}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {parseResult.totalRows.toLocaleString()} rows &middot;{" "}
                {parseResult.headers.length} columns
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                Click or drop to replace
              </span>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
              <Upload className="h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground/70" />
              <span className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                Drag & drop or click to browse
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                .csv files only, max 10MB
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* BigQuery Config */}
      {sourceType === "bigquery" && (
        <div className="space-y-4 max-w-md">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="text-sm font-medium">Dataset</label>
            <Input
              value={bqDataset}
              onChange={(e) => setBqDataset(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="1o8Hub"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="text-sm font-medium">Table</label>
            <Input
              value={bqTable}
              onChange={(e) => setBqTable(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Master"
            />
          </div>
          <Button
            onClick={() => bqPreviewMutation.mutate()}
            disabled={bqPreviewMutation.isPending || !bqDataset || !bqTable}
          >
            {bqPreviewMutation.isPending ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-1 animate-spin" />
                Loading Preview...
              </>
            ) : (
              "Preview"
            )}
          </Button>

          {parseResult?.type === "bigquery" && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-emerald-600">
              <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4" />
              {parseResult.totalRows.toLocaleString()} rows &middot;{" "}
              {parseResult.headers.length} columns
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Error */}
      {error && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-red-600">
          <XCircle className="h-4 w-4 flex-shrink-0" />
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Preview Table */}
      {parseResult && parseResult.preview.length > 0 && (
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-sm font-medium mb-2">
            Preview (first {parseResult.preview.length} rows)
          </h3>
          <div className="border rounded-lg overflow-x-auto max-h-64">
            <table className="text-xs w-full">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-muted/50 border-b">
                  {parseResult.headers.slice(0, 10).map((h) => (
                    <th key={h} className="px-2 py-1.5 text-left font-medium whitespace-nowrap">
                      {h}
                    </th>
                  ))}
                  {parseResult.headers.length > 10 && (
                    <th className="px-2 py-1.5 text-left font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                      +{parseResult.headers.length - 10} more
                    </th>
                  )}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {parseResult.preview.map((row, i) => (
                  <tr key={i} className="border-b">
                    {parseResult.headers.slice(0, 10).map((h) => (
                      <td key={h} className="px-2 py-1 whitespace-nowrap max-w-[200px] truncate">
                        {row[h] || ""}
                      </td>
                    ))}
                    {parseResult.headers.length > 10 && (
                      <td className="px-2 py-1 text-muted-foreground">...</td>
                    )}
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Next Button */}
      <div className="flex justify-end">
        <Button
          onClick={() => parseResult && onComplete(parseResult)}
          disabled={!parseResult || isLoading}
          className="bg-brand text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover"
        >
          Next: Column Mapping
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useSession } from "next-auth/react";
import {
  CommandDialog,
  CommandEmpty,
  CommandGroup,
  CommandInput,
  CommandItem,
  CommandList,
  CommandSeparator,
} from "@/components/ui/command";
import {
  Package,
  Users,
  Search,
  LayoutTemplate,
  DollarSign,
  GitCompare,
  BarChart3,
  CalendarDays,
  Activity,
  Shield,
  Sparkles,
  FileSpreadsheet,
} from "lucide-react";

type SearchResults = {
  products: Array<{
    id: string;
    asin: string | null;
    sku: string | null;
    itemName: string | null;
    summarizedTitle: string | null;
    clientIdCode: string | null;
    mainImageUrl: string | null;
  }>;
  clients: Array<{
    id: number;
    clientIdCode: string;
    clientName: string | null;
    clientStatus: string;
  }>;
  seoProjects: Array<{
    id: string;
    name: string;
    status: string;
    currentPhase: string;
    clientIdCode: string | null;
  }>;
};

const NAV_ITEMS = [
  { label: "Client Summary", href: "/", icon: Users },
  { label: "Sales Summary", href: "/sales-summary", icon: DollarSign },
  { label: "A+ Content", href: "/aplus", icon: LayoutTemplate },
  { label: "SEO Manager", href: "/seo", icon: Search },
  { label: "Amazon Sync", href: "/amazon-sync", icon: GitCompare },
  { label: "Reports", href: "/reports", icon: BarChart3 },
  { label: "Calendar", href: "/calendar", icon: CalendarDays },
  { label: "Activity", href: "/activity", icon: Activity },
  { label: "AI Config", href: "/admin/ai", icon: Sparkles, admin: true },
  { label: "Team Management", href: "/admin/users", icon: Shield, admin: true },
];

export function CommandPalette() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [results, setResults] = useState<SearchResults | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const isAdmin = session?.user?.role === "admin";

  // Cmd+K / Ctrl+K shortcut
  useEffect(() => {
    const down = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "k" && (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey)) {
        e.preventDefault();
        setOpen((prev) => !prev);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", down);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", down);
  }, []);

  // Debounced search
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!query || query.length < 2) {
      setResults(null);
      return;
    }

    const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`);
        if (res.ok) {
          setResults(await res.json());
        }
      } catch {
        // silently fail — user sees empty state
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }, 250);

    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [query]);

  const navigate = useCallback(
    (href: string) => {
      setOpen(false);
      setQuery("");
      setResults(null);
      router.push(href);
    },
    [router]
  );

  const hasResults =
    results &&
    (results.products.length > 0 ||
      results.clients.length > 0 ||
      results.seoProjects.length > 0);

  return (
    <CommandDialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(v) => {
        setOpen(v);
        if (!v) {
          setQuery("");
          setResults(null);
        }
      }}
      title="Search 1o8Hub"
      description="Search products, clients, SEO projects, or navigate to a page."
    >
      <CommandInput
        placeholder="Search products, clients, pages..."
        value={query}
        onValueChange={setQuery}
      />
      <CommandList>
        {loading && (
          <div className="py-6 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Searching...
          </div>
        )}

        {!loading && query.length >= 2 && !hasResults && (
          <CommandEmpty>No results found.</CommandEmpty>
        )}

        {/* Search results */}
        {results && results.products.length > 0 && (
          <CommandGroup heading="Products">
            {results.products.map((p) => (
              <CommandItem
                key={p.id}
                value={`product-${p.asin}-${p.sku}-${p.itemName}`}
                onSelect={() => navigate(`/products/${p.id}`)}
              >
                {p.mainImageUrl ? (
                  // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
                  <img
                    src={p.mainImageUrl}
                    alt=""
                    className="h-6 w-6 rounded object-cover shrink-0"
                  />
                ) : (
                  <Package className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" />
                )}
                <div className="flex flex-col min-w-0">
                  <span className="truncate text-sm">
                    {p.summarizedTitle || p.itemName || p.asin || "Untitled"}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate">
                    {[p.asin, p.sku, p.clientIdCode].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </CommandItem>
            ))}
          </CommandGroup>
        )}

        {results && results.clients.length > 0 && (
          <CommandGroup heading="Clients">
            {results.clients.map((c) => (
              <CommandItem
                key={c.id}
                value={`client-${c.clientIdCode}-${c.clientName}`}
                onSelect={() => navigate(`/clients/${c.clientIdCode}`)}
              >
                <Users className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" />
                <div className="flex flex-col min-w-0">
                  <span className="truncate text-sm">
                    {c.clientName || c.clientIdCode}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {c.clientIdCode} · {c.clientStatus}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </CommandItem>
            ))}
          </CommandGroup>
        )}

        {results && results.seoProjects.length > 0 && (
          <CommandGroup heading="SEO Projects">
            {results.seoProjects.map((s) => (
              <CommandItem
                key={s.id}
                value={`seo-${s.name}-${s.clientIdCode}`}
                onSelect={() => navigate(`/seo/${s.id}`)}
              >
                <Search className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" />
                <div className="flex flex-col min-w-0">
                  <span className="truncate text-sm">{s.name}</span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {s.currentPhase} · {s.status}
                    {s.clientIdCode ? ` · ${s.clientIdCode}` : ""}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </CommandItem>
            ))}
          </CommandGroup>
        )}

        {/* Navigation — always shown */}
        {(!query || query.length < 2) && (
          <>
            <CommandGroup heading="Navigate">
              {NAV_ITEMS.filter((item) => !item.admin || isAdmin).map(
                (item) => (
                  <CommandItem
                    key={item.href}
                    value={`nav-${item.label}`}
                    onSelect={() => navigate(item.href)}
                  >
                    <item.icon className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" />
                    <span>{item.label}</span>
                  </CommandItem>
                )
              )}
            </CommandGroup>
          </>
        )}
      </CommandList>
    </CommandDialog>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/layout/header.tsx

"use client";

import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { useSession } from "next-auth/react";
import { useQuery, useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { MessageSquareText, UserPlus, ImagePlus, X as XIcon, Search, Rocket } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { UserMenu } from "./user-menu";
import { ThemeToggle } from "./theme-toggle";
import { SidebarTrigger } from "@/components/ui/sidebar";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

const SECTION_OPTIONS = [
  "Products",
  "A+ Content",
  "SEO Manager",
  "Amazon Sync",
  "Publishing",
  "Portal",
  "Reports / Export",
  "Admin",
  "Other",
];

function guessSection(pathname: string): string {
  if (pathname.startsWith("/products")) return "Products";
  if (pathname.startsWith("/aplus")) return "A+ Content";
  if (pathname.startsWith("/seo")) return "SEO Manager";
  if (pathname.startsWith("/amazon-sync")) return "Amazon Sync";
  if (pathname.startsWith("/publish")) return "Publishing";
  if (pathname.startsWith("/portal")) return "Portal";
  if (pathname.startsWith("/reports") || pathname.startsWith("/export")) return "Reports / Export";
  if (pathname.startsWith("/admin")) return "Admin";
  return "Other";
}

export function Header() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const isAdmin = session?.user?.role === "admin";
  const pathname = usePathname();

  const [reportOpen, setReportOpen] = useState(false);
  const [section, setSection] = useState("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [screenshot, setScreenshot] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const handleFile = useCallback((file: File) => {
    if (!file.type.startsWith("image/")) return;
    if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      toast.error("Screenshot too large (max 5MB)");
      return;
    }
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => setScreenshot(reader.result as string);
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  }, []);

  const { data: pendingData } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["pending-users-count"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/admin/pending-users");
      return res.json() as Promise<{ count: number }>;
    },
    enabled: isAdmin,
    refetchInterval: 30_000,
  });

  const pendingCount = pendingData?.count ?? 0;

  const { data: issuesData } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["open-issues-count"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/issue-reports?count=open");
      return res.json() as Promise<{ count: number }>;
    },
    enabled: isAdmin,
    refetchInterval: 30_000,
  });

  const openIssues = issuesData?.count ?? 0;

  const reportMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (data: { section: string; description: string; screenshotUrl?: string }) => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/issue-reports", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(data),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to submit report");
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success("Feedback submitted — thank you!");
      setDescription("");
      setSection("");
      setScreenshot(null);
      setReportOpen(false);
    },
    onError: () => toast.error("Failed to submit feedback"),
  });

  return (
    <header className="shrink-0 z-40 flex h-14 items-center justify-between px-5 bg-background text-foreground">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <SidebarTrigger />
        <button
          onClick={() => document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "k", metaKey: true }))}
          className="hidden md:flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md border border-border bg-muted/50 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground transition-colors"
        >
          <Search className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          <span>Search...</span>
          <kbd className="pointer-events-none ml-1 inline-flex h-5 select-none items-center gap-0.5 rounded border border-border bg-background px-1.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-medium text-muted-foreground">
            <span className="text-xs">⌘</span>K
          </kbd>
        </button>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        {isAdmin && (
          <div
            className="hidden md:flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5 text-muted-foreground bg-muted/50 text-xs font-mono"
            title={`Deploy: ${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_DEPLOY_URL_SLUG}\nCommit: ${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_DEPLOY_COMMIT}\nBuilt: ${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME}`}
          >
            <Rocket className="h-3 w-3" />
            <span className="text-muted-foreground/50">deploy</span>
            <span>{process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_DEPLOY_URL_SLUG === "local" ? "local" : process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_DEPLOY_URL_SLUG?.slice(0, 9)}</span>
            <span className="text-muted-foreground/50">·</span>
            <span className="text-muted-foreground/50">commit</span>
            <span>{process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_DEPLOY_COMMIT}</span>
            <span className="text-muted-foreground/50">·</span>
            <span className="text-muted-foreground/70">
              {process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME
                ? new Date(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME).toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "numeric", hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" })
                : "—"}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
        {isAdmin && openIssues > 0 && (
          <Link
            href="/admin/issues"
            className="relative flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5 text-red-500 bg-red-500/10 hover:bg-red-500/20 transition-colors text-xs font-medium"
            title={`${openIssues} open feedback item${openIssues > 1 ? "s" : ""}`}
          >
            <MessageSquareText className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span>{openIssues} open</span>
          </Link>
        )}
        {isAdmin && pendingCount > 0 && (
          <Link
            href="/admin/users"
            className="relative flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5 text-amber-500 bg-amber-500/10 hover:bg-amber-500/20 transition-colors text-xs font-medium"
            title={`${pendingCount} pending access request${pendingCount > 1 ? "s" : ""}`}
          >
            <UserPlus className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span>{pendingCount} pending</span>
          </Link>
        )}
        <Dialog
          open={reportOpen}
          onOpenChange={(open) => {
            setReportOpen(open);
            if (open) setSection(guessSection(pathname));
          }}
        >
          <DialogTrigger asChild>
            <button
              className="rounded-md p-2 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted transition-colors"
              title="Send feedback"
              aria-label="Send feedback"
            >
              <MessageSquareText className="h-4 w-4" />
            </button>
          </DialogTrigger>
          <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
            <DialogHeader>
              <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <MessageSquareText className="h-4 w-4 text-brand" />
                Send Feedback
              </DialogTitle>
            </DialogHeader>
            <form
              onSubmit={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                if (!section || !description.trim()) return;
                reportMutation.mutate({
                  section,
                  description: description.trim(),
                  ...(screenshot ? { screenshotUrl: screenshot } : {}),
                });
              }}
              className="space-y-4 pt-2"
            >
              <div>
                <label className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground block mb-1.5">
                  Section
                </label>
                <select
                  value={section}
                  onChange={(e) => setSection(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-9 rounded-md border border-border bg-background px-3 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand/50"
                >
                  <option value="">Select section...</option>
                  {SECTION_OPTIONS.map((s) => (
                    <option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground block mb-1.5">
                  Description
                </label>
                <textarea
                  value={description}
                  onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Share your feedback, report a bug, or suggest an improvement..."
                  rows={4}
                  className="w-full rounded-md border border-border bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand/50 resize-none"
                />
              </div>
              {/* Screenshot */}
              <div>
                <label className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground block mb-1.5">
                  Screenshot <span className="text-muted-foreground/60 font-normal">(optional — paste or upload)</span>
                </label>
                {screenshot ? (
                  <div className="relative rounded-md border border-border overflow-hidden">
                    {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
                    <img src={screenshot} alt="Screenshot preview" className="w-full max-h-40 object-contain bg-muted/30" />
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setScreenshot(null)}
                      className="absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 rounded-full bg-background/80 p-1 hover:bg-background transition-colors"
                    >
                      <XIcon className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div
                    onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                    onPaste={(e) => {
                      const file = Array.from(e.clipboardData.items)
                        .find((item) => item.type.startsWith("image/"))
                        ?.getAsFile();
                      if (file) handleFile(file);
                    }}
                    onDrop={(e) => {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      const file = e.dataTransfer.files[0];
                      if (file) handleFile(file);
                    }}
                    onDragOver={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
                    tabIndex={0}
                    className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 h-20 rounded-md border border-dashed border-border text-muted-foreground hover:border-brand/50 hover:text-foreground cursor-pointer transition-colors text-xs"
                  >
                    <ImagePlus className="h-4 w-4" />
                    <span>Click, drag, or paste (Ctrl+V)</span>
                  </div>
                )}
                <input
                  ref={fileInputRef}
                  type="file"
                  accept="image/*"
                  className="hidden"
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
                    if (file) handleFile(file);
                    e.target.value = "";
                  }}
                />
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-1">
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => setReportOpen(false)}
                >
                  Cancel
                </Button>
                <Button
                  type="submit"
                  size="sm"
                  disabled={!section || !description.trim() || reportMutation.isPending}
                  className="bg-brand text-black hover:bg-brand/90"
                >
                  {reportMutation.isPending ? "Submitting..." : "Submit Report"}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
        <ThemeToggle />
        <UserMenu />
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Suspense } from "react";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { SidebarProvider } from "@/components/ui/sidebar";
import { AppSidebar } from "@/components/layout/app-sidebar";
import { Header } from "@/components/layout/header";
import { PortalShell } from "@/components/layout/portal-shell";
import { CommandPalette } from "@/components/layout/command-palette";

export function LayoutRouter({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const pathname = usePathname();

  // Portal routes get a clean client-facing layout
  if (pathname.startsWith("/portal")) {
    return (
      <Suspense>
        <PortalShell>{children}</PortalShell>
      </Suspense>
    );
  }

  // Auth routes and public calculator get no chrome
  if (pathname.startsWith("/auth") || pathname.startsWith("/calculator")) {
    return <>{children}</>;
  }

  // Internal routes get sidebar + header
  return (
    <SidebarProvider>
      <a
        href="#main-content"
        className="sr-only focus:not-sr-only focus:fixed focus:top-2 focus:left-2 focus:z-[100] focus:rounded-md focus:bg-brand focus:px-4 focus:py-2 focus:text-brand-foreground focus:font-medium focus:shadow-lg"
      >
        Skip to main content
      </a>
      <Suspense>
        <AppSidebar />
      </Suspense>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[-1] ambient-bg" />
      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col w-full overflow-hidden relative z-10 glass-panel">
        <Header />
        <main id="main-content" className="flex-1 overflow-auto px-6 pb-6 lg:px-10 lg:pb-10">
          {children}
        </main>
      </div>
      <CommandPalette />
    </SidebarProvider>
  );
}

function PortalSidebar() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  const user = session?.user;
  const isAdmin = user?.role === "admin";
  const previewClient = isAdmin ? searchParams.get("client") : null;
  const clientCode = previewClient || user?.clientIdCode;
  const clientName = isAdmin
    ? previewClient
      ? CLIENT_NAMES[previewClient] || previewClient
      : "Admin Preview"
    : clientCode
      ? CLIENT_NAMES[clientCode] || clientCode
      : "Client Portal";
  const allowedSections = user?.allowedSections ?? [];

  const clientParam = previewClient ? `?client=${previewClient}` : "";

  const visibleNav = PORTAL_NAV.filter(
    (item) => item.permission === null || canAccess(item.permission, allowedSections, isAdmin)
  );

  function isItemActive(item: NavItem): boolean {
    if (item.children) {
      return item.children.some((child) => pathname.startsWith(child.href));
    }
    return item.href === "/portal"
      ? pathname === "/portal"
      : pathname.startsWith(item.href);
  }

  return (
    <Sidebar>
      <SidebarHeader className="px-4 py-4">
        <Link href={`/portal${clientParam}`} className="flex items-center gap-3.5 group">
          {/* eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element */}
          <img
            src="/logo.png"
            alt="1o8 Agency"
            width={48}
            height={48}
            className="rounded-lg transition-transform group-hover:scale-105 shadow-[0_2px_10px_-4px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] dark:shadow-[0_2px_12px_-4px_rgba(255,255,255,0.1)]"
          />
          <span className="text-4xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter leading-tight transition-colors">
            <span className="text-sidebar-foreground font-bold">1o8</span><span className="text-[#2563eb]">Portal</span>
          </span>
        </Link>
      </SidebarHeader>

      <SidebarContent>
        <SidebarGroup>
          <SidebarGroupLabel className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-muted-foreground/70">
            Navigation
          </SidebarGroupLabel>
          {isAdmin && (
            <div className="px-2 mb-1">
              <Link
                href="/"
                className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors py-1"
              >
                <ArrowLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                <span>Back to Hub</span>
              </Link>
            </div>
          )}
          <SidebarGroupContent>
            <SidebarMenu>
              {visibleNav.map((item) => {
                const isActive = isItemActive(item);

                if (item.children) {
                  return (
                    <Collapsible key={item.id} defaultOpen={isActive} className="group/collapsible">
                      <SidebarMenuItem>
                        <CollapsibleTrigger asChild>
                          <SidebarMenuButton
                            isActive={isActive}

                                : ""
                            }
                          >
                            <item.icon className="h-4 w-4" />
                            <span>{item.title}</span>
                            <ChevronRight className="ml-auto h-4 w-4 transition-transform group-data-[state=open]/collapsible:rotate-90" />
                          </SidebarMenuButton>
                        </CollapsibleTrigger>
                        <CollapsibleContent>
                          <SidebarMenuSub>
                            {item.children.map((child) => {

                              return (
                                <SidebarMenuSubItem key={child.id}>
                                  <SidebarMenuSubButton
                                    asChild

                                  >
                                    <Link href={`${child.href}${clientParam}`}>

                              );
                            })}

                      asChild

                      className={
                        isActive
                          ? "relative before:absolute before:left-0 before:top-1/2 before:-translate-y-1/2 before:h-5 before:w-[3px] before:rounded-r-full before:bg-[#2563eb] text-[#2563eb] bg-[#2563eb]/10"
                          : ""
                      }
                    >
                      <Link href={`${item.href}${clientParam}`}>
                        <item.icon className="h-4 w-4" />

            </SidebarMenu>

      </SidebarContent>

    </Sidebar>
  );

function PortalHeader() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const user = session?.user;
  const isAdmin = user?.role === "admin";
  const previewClient = isAdmin ? searchParams.get("client") : null;
  const clientCode = previewClient || user?.clientIdCode;
  const clientName = isAdmin
    ? previewClient
      ? CLIENT_NAMES[previewClient] || previewClient
      : "Admin Preview"
    : clientCode
      ? CLIENT_NAMES[clientCode] || clientCode
      : "Client Portal";

  const initials = (user?.name ?? user?.email ?? "?")
    .split(" ")
    .map((n) => n[0])
    .join("")
    .toUpperCase()
    .slice(0, 2);

  return (
    <header className="shrink-0 z-40 flex h-14 items-center justify-between px-5 bg-background text-foreground">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <SidebarTrigger />
        <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-lg bg-[#2563eb]/10 text-[#2563eb] px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold tracking-wide">
          {clientName}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <ThemeToggle />
        <DropdownMenu>
          <DropdownMenuTrigger className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 hover:bg-muted/60 outline-none transition-colors">
            <Avatar className="h-7 w-7">
              <AvatarImage src={user?.image ?? undefined} alt={user?.name ?? ""} />
              <AvatarFallback className="text-xs bg-[#2563eb]/10 text-[#2563eb]">
                {initials}
              </AvatarFallback>
            </Avatar>
            <span className="text-sm font-medium hidden sm:inline">
              {user?.name ?? user?.email}
            </span>
          </DropdownMenuTrigger>
          <DropdownMenuContent align="end" className="w-56">
            <DropdownMenuLabel>
              <div className="flex flex-col">
                <span>{user?.name}</span>
                <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">
                  {user?.email}
                </span>
              </div>
            </DropdownMenuLabel>
            <DropdownMenuSeparator />
            <DropdownMenuItem onClick={() => signOut({ callbackUrl: "/auth/signin" })}>
              <LogOut className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
              Sign out
            </DropdownMenuItem>
          </DropdownMenuContent>
        </DropdownMenu>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}

export function PortalShell({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  useEffect(() => {
    document.title = "1o8 Portal";
    return () => { document.title = "1o8 Hub"; };
  }, []);

  return (
    <SidebarProvider>
      <PortalSidebar />
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[-1] ambient-bg" />
      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col w-full overflow-hidden relative z-10 glass-panel">
        <PortalHeader />
        <main className="flex-1 overflow-auto px-6 pb-6 lg:px-10 lg:pb-10">
          {children}
        </main>
      </div>
    </SidebarProvider>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Fragment, useState } from "react";
import { useSession } from "next-auth/react";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Upload, Loader2, CheckCircle, Clock, ChevronRight, ChevronDown, ArrowRight } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

import {
