import { toast } from "sonner";

type PublishInfo = {
  totalProducts: number;
  dirtyProducts: number;
};

type ChangeLogEntry = {
  field: string;
  oldValue: string | null;
  newValue: string | null;
  changedBy: string;
  changedAt: string;
};

type DirtyProduct = {
  id: string;
  asin: string | null;
  sku: string | null;
  changeLog: ChangeLogEntry[];
};

type HistoryEntry = {
  id: number;
  publishedBy: string;
  publishedAt: string;
  rowsPublished: number;
  dirtyCount: number;
  jobId: string | null;
};

export function PublishButton() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [expandedRows, setExpandedRows] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

  const isAdmin = session?.user?.role === "admin";
  const canPublish = isAdmin || (session?.user?.allowedSections ?? []).includes("publish");

  const toggleRow = (id: string) => {
    setExpandedRows((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const { data: info } = useQuery<PublishInfo>({
    queryKey: ["publish-info"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/publish");
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch");
      return res.json();
    },
    enabled: canPublish,
    refetchInterval: 30_000,
  });

  const { data: dirtyProducts } = useQuery<DirtyProduct[]>({
    queryKey: ["products", "dirty-summary"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/products?isDirty=true&pageSize=100");
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch");
      const data = await res.json();
      return data.data;
    },
    enabled: canPublish && open,
  });

  const { data: recentHistory } = useQuery<HistoryEntry[]>({
    queryKey: ["publish-history", "recent"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/publish/history?limit=3");
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch");
      return res.json();
    },
    enabled: canPublish && open,
  });

  const publishMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/publish", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ mode: "incremental" }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Publish failed");
      }
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      toast.success(
        `Published ${data.rowsPublished} products to BigQuery (Job: ${data.jobId})`
      );
      setOpen(false);
      setExpandedRows(new Set());
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["publish-info"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["products"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["publish-history"] });
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => {
      toast.error(error.message);
    },
  });

  if (!canPublish) return null;

  const dirtyCount = info?.dirtyProducts ?? 0;

  return (
    <>
      <Button
        variant="ghost"
        size="sm"
        className="relative gap-1.5"
        onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
      >
        <Upload className="h-4 w-4" />
        <span className="hidden sm:inline text-sm">Publish</span>
        {dirtyCount > 0 && (
          <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 flex h-4 min-w-4 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-orange-500 px-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-white animate-pulse-glow">
            {dirtyCount}
          </span>
        )}
      </Button>

      <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-lg">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Upload className="h-5 w-5" />
              Publish to BigQuery
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              {dirtyCount > 0
                ? `${dirtyCount} changed product${dirtyCount !== 1 ? "s" : ""} will be sent via incremental MERGE`
                : "No pending changes to publish"}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          {/* Changed products list with inline change details */}
          {dirtyProducts && dirtyProducts.length > 0 && (
            <div className="max-h-64 overflow-y-auto border rounded-md">
              <table className="w-full text-xs">
                <thead className="bg-muted sticky top-0">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="w-6 px-2 py-1.5" />
                    <th className="text-left px-3 py-1.5 font-medium">ASIN</th>
                    <th className="text-left px-3 py-1.5 font-medium">SKU</th>
                    <th className="text-right px-3 py-1.5 font-medium">Edits</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {dirtyProducts.map((p) => {
                    const isExpanded = expandedRows.has(p.id);
                    const changes = p.changeLog ?? [];
                    return (
                      <Fragment key={p.id}>
                        <tr
                          className="border-t cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50"
                          onClick={() => changes.length > 0 && toggleRow(p.id)}
                        >
                          <td className="px-2 py-1.5">
                            {changes.length > 0 &&
                              (isExpanded ? (
                                <ChevronDown className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground" />
                              ) : (
                                <ChevronRight className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground" />
                              ))}
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-1.5 font-mono">{p.asin || "—"}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-1.5 font-mono">{p.sku || "—"}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-1.5 text-right">
                            <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px]">
                              {changes.length}
                            </Badge>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                        {isExpanded && changes.map((c, i) => (
                          <tr key={`${p.id}-${i}`} className="bg-muted/20">
                            <td />
                            <td colSpan={3} className="px-3 py-1 text-[11px]">
                              <span className="font-medium">{c.field}</span>
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground mx-1.5">:</span>
                              <span className="text-red-600/80 font-mono">
                                {truncate(c.oldValue, 30) || <span className="italic text-muted-foreground">empty</span>}
                              </span>
                              <ArrowRight className="inline h-3 w-3 mx-1 text-muted-foreground" />
                              <span className="text-green-600/80 font-mono">
                                {truncate(c.newValue, 30) || <span className="italic text-muted-foreground">empty</span>}
                              </span>
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        ))}
                      </Fragment>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Recent history */}
          {recentHistory && recentHistory.length > 0 && (
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
                <Clock className="h-3 w-3" /> Recent publishes
              </p>
              <div className="space-y-1">
                {recentHistory.map((h) => (
                  <div
                    key={h.id}
                    className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground bg-muted rounded px-2 py-1"
                  >
                    <span>{new Date(h.publishedAt).toLocaleString()}</span>
                    <span>{h.rowsPublished} rows &middot; {h.dirtyCount} changed</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} disabled={publishMutation.isPending}>
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              onClick={() => publishMutation.mutate()}
              disabled={dirtyCount === 0 || publishMutation.isPending}
            >
              {publishMutation.isPending ? (
                <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
              ) : (
                <CheckCircle className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
              )}
              Confirm Publish
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </>
  );
}

function truncate(value: string | null, max: number): string {
  if (!value) return "";
  return value.length > max ? value.slice(0, max) + "..." : value;
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useSession } from "next-auth/react";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import {
  RefreshCw,
  Loader2,
  CheckCircle,
  Clock,
  AlertCircle,
  Zap,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Popover,
  PopoverContent,
  PopoverTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/popover";
import { toast } from "sonner";

type SyncStatus = {
  pendingChanges: number;
  totalProducts: number;
  lastSync: {
    publishedBy: string;
    publishedAt: string;
    rowsPublished: number;
    jobId: string | null;
    dirtyCount: number;
  } | null;
  pendingEditors: string[];
};

function timeAgo(dateStr: string): string {
  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(dateStr).getTime();
  const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
  if (minutes < 1) return "just now";
  if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m ago`;
  const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h ago`;
  const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
  return `${days}d ago`;
}

export function SyncStatusButton() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  const isAdmin = session?.user?.role === "admin";
  const canSync =
    isAdmin || (session?.user?.allowedSections ?? []).includes("publish");

  const { data: status, isLoading } = useQuery<SyncStatus>({
    queryKey: ["sync-status"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/sync/status");
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch sync status");
      return res.json();
    },
    enabled: !!session,
    refetchInterval: 30_000,
  });

  const syncMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (mode: "incremental" | "full") => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/sync/trigger", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ mode }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Sync failed");
      }
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      if (data.synced === 0) {
        toast.info("No pending changes to sync");
      } else {
        toast.success(
          `Synced ${data.synced} product${data.synced !== 1 ? "s" : ""} to BigQuery`
        );
      }
      setOpen(false);
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["sync-status"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["products"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["publish-history"] });
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => {
      toast.error(error.message);
    },
  });

  if (!session) return null;

  const pending = status?.pendingChanges ?? 0;
  const lastSyncTime = status?.lastSync?.publishedAt;

  return (
    <Popover open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <PopoverTrigger asChild>
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
          className="relative gap-1.5"
          aria-label={`BigQuery sync${pending > 0 ? ` — ${pending} pending` : ""}`}
        >
          <RefreshCw
            className={`h-4 w-4 ${syncMutation.isPending ? "animate-spin" : ""}`}
          />
          <span className="hidden sm:inline text-sm">Sync</span>
          {pending > 0 && (
            <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 flex h-4 min-w-4 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-brand px-1 text-[10px] font-bold text-black">
              {pending}
            </span>
          )}
        </Button>
      </PopoverTrigger>
      <PopoverContent align="end" className="w-80 p-0">
        <div className="px-4 py-3 border-b">
          <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold">BigQuery Sync</h4>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
            Changes auto-sync every hour
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="px-4 py-3 space-y-3">
          {/* Pending changes */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
              {pending > 0 ? (
                <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-brand" />
              ) : (
                <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-500" />
              )}
              <span>
                {pending > 0
                  ? `${pending} pending change${pending !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`
                  : "All synced"}
              </span>
            </div>
            {pending > 0 && status?.pendingEditors && status.pendingEditors.length > 0 && (
              <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                by {status.pendingEditors.slice(0, 2).map((e) => e.split("@")[0]).join(", ")}
                {status.pendingEditors.length > 2 && ` +${status.pendingEditors.length - 2}`}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Last sync */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <Clock className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            {lastSyncTime ? (
              <span>
                Last sync {timeAgo(lastSyncTime)} &middot;{" "}
                {status!.lastSync!.rowsPublished} rows &middot;{" "}
                {status!.lastSync!.publishedBy === "system/cron"
                  ? "auto"
                  : status!.lastSync!.publishedBy.split("@")[0]}
              </span>
            ) : (
              <span>No syncs yet</span>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Sync Now button */}
          {canSync && (
            <div className="flex gap-2 pt-1">
              <Button
                size="sm"
                className="flex-1 gap-1.5"
                disabled={pending === 0 || syncMutation.isPending}
                onClick={() => syncMutation.mutate("incremental")}
              >
                {syncMutation.isPending ? (
                  <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
                ) : (
                  <Zap className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                )}
                Sync Now
              </Button>
              {isAdmin && (
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="outline"
                  className="gap-1.5"
                  disabled={syncMutation.isPending}
                  onClick={() => syncMutation.mutate("full")}
                >
                  Full Sync
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </PopoverContent>
    </Popover>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useTheme } from "next-themes";
import { Moon, Sun } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export function ThemeToggle() {
  const { theme, setTheme } = useTheme();
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => setMounted(true), []);

  if (!mounted) {
    return (
      <Button variant="ghost" size="icon-sm" className="text-muted-foreground">
        <Sun className="h-4 w-4" />
      </Button>
    );
  }

  const isDark = theme === "dark";

  return (
    <Button
      variant="ghost"
      size="icon-sm"
      onClick={() => setTheme(isDark ? "light" : "dark")}
      className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors"
      title={isDark ? "Switch to light mode" : "Switch to dark mode"}
      aria-label={isDark ? "Switch to light mode" : "Switch to dark mode"}
    >
      {isDark ? (
        <Sun className="h-4 w-4" />
      ) : (
        <Moon className="h-4 w-4" />
      )}
    </Button>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useSession } from "next-auth/react";
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  XCircle,
  Upload,
  FileText,
  MessageSquare,
  Clock,
  Loader2,
} from "lucide-react";

interface ActivityEvent {
  id: number;
  section: string;
  action: string;
  status: string;
  message: string | null;
  resourceLabel: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
  userName: string | null;
}

function eventIcon(action: string, status: string) {
  if (status === "error") return <XCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-red-500" />;
  if (action.includes("upload")) return <Upload className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-blue-500" />;
  if (action.includes("comment")) return <MessageSquare className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-amber-500" />;
  if (action.includes("approved") || action.includes("live")) return <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-500" />;
  if (action.includes("publish")) return <FileText className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-purple-500" />;
  return <Clock className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />;
}

function relativeTime(dateStr: string): string {
  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(dateStr).getTime();
  const mins = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
  if (mins < 1) return "just now";
  if (mins < 60) return `${mins}m ago`;
  const hours = Math.floor(mins / 60);
  if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h ago`;
  const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
  if (days < 30) return `${days}d ago`;
  return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleDateString();
}

export function ActivityFeed() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();

  const isAdmin = session?.user?.role === "admin";
  const previewClient = isAdmin ? searchParams.get("client") : null;
  const clientParam = previewClient ?? session?.user?.clientIdCode;

  const { data, isLoading, isError } = useQuery<{ events: ActivityEvent[] }>({
    queryKey: ["portal-activity", clientParam],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const url = isAdmin && previewClient
        ? `/api/portal/activity?client=${previewClient}`
        : `/api/portal/activity`;
      const res = await fetch(url);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load activity");
      return res.json();
    },
    enabled: !!clientParam,
    refetchInterval: 60000,
  });

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 py-8 text-xs text-muted-foreground justify-center">
        <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" />
        Loading activity...
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (isError) return null;

  const events = data?.events ?? [];

  if (events.length === 0) {
    return (
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground text-center py-6">
        No recent activity for your products.
      </p>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-0">
      {events.slice(0, 20).map((event) => (
        <div
          key={event.id}
          className="flex items-start gap-3 py-2.5 px-1 border-b border-border last:border-0"
        >
          <div className="mt-0.5 shrink-0">
            {eventIcon(event.action, event.status)}
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <p className="text-sm leading-snug">
              {event.message ?? event.action}
            </p>
            {event.resourceLabel && (
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate mt-0.5">
                {event.resourceLabel}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground shrink-0 mt-0.5">
            {relativeTime(event.createdAt)}
          </span>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useSession } from "next-auth/react";
import {
  Collapsible,
  CollapsibleContent,
  CollapsibleTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/collapsible";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/tooltip";
import {
  Package,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronRight,
  Check,
  Minus,
  Circle,
} from "lucide-react";
import {
  useCategoryDefinition,
  type CategoryAttributeData,
  type CategoryGroupData,
} from "@/hooks/use-category-definition";
import { CategoryUpload, CategoryUploadButton } from "./category-upload";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import type { Product } from "@/lib/db/schema";

type FilterType = "all" | "required" | "conditional" | "matched" | "unmatched" | "filled" | "empty";

interface AmazonCategoryAttributesProps {
  productType: string;
  product: Product;
  clientIdCode?: string;
  marketplaceId?: string;
  excludeFields?: Set<string>;
  excludeGroups?: Set<string>;
}

interface GroupStats {
  total: number;
  required: number;
  conditional: number;
  optional: number;
  matched: number;
  filled: number;
}

function computeGroupStats(attrs: CategoryAttributeData[]): GroupStats {
  let required = 0, conditional = 0, optional = 0, matched = 0, filled = 0;
  for (const a of attrs) {
    if (a.requirement === "Required") required++;
    else if (a.requirement === "Conditionally Required") conditional++;
    else optional++;
    if (a.bibleFieldMatch) matched++;
    if (a.currentValue) filled++;
  }
  return { total: attrs.length, required, conditional, optional, matched, filled };
}

export function AmazonCategoryAttributes({
  productType,
  product,
  clientIdCode,
  marketplaceId,
  excludeFields,
  excludeGroups,
}: AmazonCategoryAttributesProps) {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const isAdmin = session?.user?.role === "admin";
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<FilterType>("all");

  const { definition, groups, isLoading } = useCategoryDefinition(
    productType,
    clientIdCode,
    product.id,
    marketplaceId
  );

  // Pre-filter excluded fields and groups
  const baseGroups = useMemo(() => {
    let filtered = groups;
    if (excludeGroups && excludeGroups.size > 0) {
      const exLower = new Set([...excludeGroups].map((g) => g.toLowerCase()));
      filtered = filtered.filter((g) => !exLower.has(g.name.toLowerCase()));
    }
    if (!excludeFields || excludeFields.size === 0) return filtered;
    // Build a lowercase lookup for case-insensitive matching
    const excludeLower = new Set<string>();
    for (const f of excludeFields) excludeLower.add(f.toLowerCase());
    return filtered
      .map((g) => ({
        ...g,
        attributes: g.attributes.filter((a) => {
          // Check Hub field match
          if (a.bibleFieldMatch && excludeFields.has(a.bibleFieldMatch)) return false;
          // Also check the Amazon attribute name (strip marketplace/index suffixes, normalize)
          const amzBase = a.amazonFieldName.replace(/\[.*$/, "").replace(/#.*$/, "").toLowerCase();
          if (excludeLower.has(amzBase)) return false;
          if (excludeLower.has(amzBase.replace(/[\s_-]/g, ""))) return false;
          if (a.localLabel) {
            const labelNorm = a.localLabel.replace(/[\s_-]/g, "").toLowerCase();
            if (excludeLower.has(labelNorm)) return false;
          }
          return true;
        }),
      }))
      .filter((g) => g.attributes.length > 0);
  }, [groups, excludeFields, excludeGroups]);

  // Overall stats
  const overall = useMemo(() => {
    const all = baseGroups.flatMap((g) => g.attributes);
    return computeGroupStats(all);
  }, [baseGroups]);

  // Filter groups
  const filteredGroups = useMemo(() => {
    if (filter === "all") return baseGroups;

    return baseGroups
      .map((group) => ({
        ...group,
        attributes: group.attributes.filter((attr) => {
          switch (filter) {
            case "required":
              return attr.requirement === "Required";
            case "conditional":
              return attr.requirement === "Conditionally Required";
            case "matched":
              return !!attr.bibleFieldMatch;
            case "unmatched":
              return !attr.bibleFieldMatch;
            case "filled":
              return !!attr.currentValue;
            case "empty":
              return attr.bibleFieldMatch && !attr.currentValue;
            default:
              return true;
          }
        }),
      }))
      .filter((g) => g.attributes.length > 0);
  }, [groups, filter]);

  if (!clientIdCode) return null;

  return (
    <Collapsible defaultOpen={false}>
      <CollapsibleTrigger className="flex items-center justify-between w-full px-4 py-2.5 bg-card rounded-lg hover:bg-muted transition-colors">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Package className="h-4 w-4 text-brand" />
          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-white">
            Amazon Category: {productType}
          </span>
          {definition && (
            <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0">
              {overall.filled}/{overall.matched} filled
            </Badge>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {definition && (
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {definition.totalAttributes} attrs
            </span>
          )}
          <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground/70" />
        </div>
      </CollapsibleTrigger>
      <CollapsibleContent className="mt-2">
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-card p-4 space-y-4">
          {isLoading ? (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Skeleton className="h-4 w-48" />
              <Skeleton className="h-20 w-full" />
            </div>
          ) : !definition ? (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                No category report uploaded for {productType}.
              </p>
              {isAdmin && <CategoryUpload clientIdCode={clientIdCode} />}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              {/* ── Overall summary ── */}
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {/* Stats row */}
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-xs">
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                      {definition.totalAttributes} attributes
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-red-400 font-medium">
                      {overall.required} Required
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-amber-400 font-medium">
                      {overall.conditional} Conditional
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                      {overall.optional} Optional
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-border">|</span>
                    <span className="text-emerald-400">
                      {overall.matched} mapped
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-brand">
                      {overall.filled} filled
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  {isAdmin && (
                    <CategoryUploadButton clientIdCode={clientIdCode} />
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Coverage bars */}
                <div className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  <CoverageBar
                    label="Hub field mapping"
                    filled={overall.matched}
                    total={overall.total}
                    color="bg-emerald-500"
                  />
                  <CoverageBar
                    label="Required fields filled"
                    filled={overall.filled}
                    total={overall.matched}
                    color="bg-brand"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* ── Filter chips ── */}
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                {(
                  [
                    ["all", "All", null],
                    ["required", "Required", overall.required],
                    ["conditional", "Conditional", overall.conditional],
                    ["matched", "Mapped", overall.matched],
                    ["unmatched", "Unmapped", overall.total - overall.matched],
                    ["filled", "Filled", overall.filled],
                    ["empty", "Empty", overall.matched - overall.filled],
                  ] as const
                ).map(([key, label, count]) => (
                  <button
                    key={key}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setFilter(key)}
                    className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
                      filter === key
                        ? "bg-brand text-white"
                        : "bg-muted text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {label}
                    {count !== null && (
                      <span className="ml-1 opacity-70">{count}</span>
                    )}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* ── Groups (Template tab order) ── */}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                {filteredGroups.map((group) => (
                  <GroupSection key={group.name} group={group} />
                ))}
                {filteredGroups.length === 0 && (
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-4">
                    No attributes match the current filter.
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </CollapsibleContent>
    </Collapsible>
  );
}

// ─── Group section ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

function GroupSection({ group }: { group: CategoryGroupData }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const stats = useMemo(() => computeGroupStats(group.attributes), [group.attributes]);

  return (
    <div className="rounded-md border border-border/50 overflow-hidden">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
        className="flex items-center gap-3 w-full px-3 py-2 text-left hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors"
      >
        {open ? (
          <ChevronDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
        ) : (
          <ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
        )}
        <span className="text-sm font-medium flex-1 min-w-0 truncate">
          {group.name}
        </span>

        {/* Inline stats */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] shrink-0">
          {stats.required > 0 && (
            <span className="text-red-400">{stats.required}R</span>
          )}
          {stats.conditional > 0 && (
            <span className="text-amber-400">{stats.conditional}C</span>
          )}
          <span className="text-emerald-400">{stats.matched}/{stats.total}</span>
          {/* Mini coverage bar */}
          <div className="w-12 h-1.5 bg-muted rounded-full overflow-hidden">
            <div
              className="h-full bg-emerald-500 rounded-full"
              style={{ width: stats.total > 0 ? `${(stats.matched / stats.total) * 100}%` : "0%" }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </button>

      {open && (
        <div className="border-t border-border/50">
          {/* Column headers */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_auto_auto_auto] gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/60 font-medium uppercase tracking-wider border-b border-border/30">
            <span>Label / Amazon Field</span>
            <span className="w-16 text-center">Level</span>
            <span className="w-24 text-center">Hub Match</span>
            <span className="w-20 text-center">Value</span>
          </div>
          {group.attributes.map((attr) => (
            <AttributeRow key={attr.amazonFieldName} attr={attr} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ─── Attribute row ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

function AttributeRow({ attr }: { attr: CategoryAttributeData }) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const hasValue = !!attr.currentValue;
  const hasMatch = !!attr.bibleFieldMatch;

  return (
    <div className="border-b border-border/20 last:border-0">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setExpanded(!expanded)}
        className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_auto_auto_auto] gap-2 items-center w-full px-3 py-1.5 text-left hover:bg-muted/20 transition-colors"
      >
        {/* Label + Amazon field */}
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <div className="text-xs truncate">{attr.localLabel}</div>
          <div className="text-[10px] text-orange-400/50 font-mono truncate">
            {attr.amazonFieldName}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Requirement */}
        <div className="w-16 flex justify-center">
          <RequirementBadge requirement={attr.requirement} />
        </div>

        {/* Hub match */}
        <div className="w-24 flex justify-center">
          {hasMatch ? (
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-emerald-400 truncate max-w-full">
              <Check className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" />
              <span className="truncate">{attr.bibleFieldMatch}</span>
            </span>
          ) : (
            <Minus className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground/30" />
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Current value indicator */}
        <div className="w-20 flex justify-center">
          {hasMatch ? (
            hasValue ? (
              <TooltipProvider>
                <Tooltip>
                  <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-emerald-400">
                      <Circle className="h-2 w-2 fill-emerald-400" />
                      Filled
                    </span>
                  </TooltipTrigger>
                  <TooltipContent side="left" className="max-w-xs">
                    <p className="text-xs break-words">{attr.currentValue}</p>
                  </TooltipContent>
                </Tooltip>
              </TooltipProvider>
            ) : (
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/50">
                <Circle className="h-2 w-2" />
                Empty
              </span>
            )
          ) : (
            <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/30">—</span>
          )}
        </div>
      </button>

      {/* Expanded details */}
      {expanded && (
        <div className="px-3 pb-3 pt-1 ml-3 border-l-2 border-border/30 space-y-1.5 text-xs">
          {attr.description && (
            <p className="text-foreground/70">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground font-medium">Description: </span>
              {attr.description}
            </p>
          )}
          {attr.example && (
            <p>
              <span className="text-muted-foreground font-medium">Example: </span>
              <span className="font-mono text-foreground/60">{attr.example}</span>
            </p>
          )}
          {attr.validValues && attr.validValues.length > 0 && (
            <div>
              <span className="text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                Valid values ({attr.validValues.length}):
              </span>
              <div className="mt-1 max-h-24 overflow-y-auto flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                {attr.validValues.map((v) => (
                  <span
                    key={v}
                    className="inline-block px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-muted rounded text-[10px] text-foreground/60"
                  >
                    {v}
                  </span>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {hasMatch && hasValue && (
            <p className="text-foreground/70">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground font-medium">Current value: </span>
              <span className="break-words">{attr.currentValue}</span>
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function CoverageBar({
  label,
  filled,
  total,
  color,
}: {
  label: string;
  filled: number;
  total: number;
  color: string;
}) {
  const pct = total > 0 ? Math.round((filled / total) * 100) : 0;
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
        <span className="text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
        <span className="tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
          {filled}/{total}{" "}
          <span className="text-muted-foreground/60">({pct}%)</span>
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="h-1.5 bg-muted rounded-full overflow-hidden">
        <div
          className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all ${color}`}
          style={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function RequirementBadge({ requirement }: { requirement: string }) {
  switch (requirement) {
    case "Required":
      return (
        <Badge
          variant="outline"
          className="text-[11px] px-1 py-0 border-red-500/50 text-red-400"
        >
          Req
        </Badge>
      );
    case "Conditionally Required":
      return (
        <Badge
          variant="outline"
          className="text-[11px] px-1 py-0 border-amber-500/50 text-amber-400"
        >
          Cond
        </Badge>
      );
    case "Recommended":
      return (
        <Badge
          variant="outline"
          className="text-[11px] px-1 py-0 border-blue-500/50 text-blue-400"
        >
          Rec
        </Badge>
      );
    default:
      return (
        <Badge
          variant="outline"
          className="text-[11px] px-1 py-0 border-border text-muted-foreground/50"
        >
          Opt
        </Badge>
      );
  }
}

// ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function relativeTime(dateStr: string): string {
  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(dateStr).getTime();
  const mins = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
  if (mins < 1) return "just now";
  if (mins < 60) return `${mins}m ago`;
  const hrs = Math.floor(mins / 60);
  if (hrs < 24) return `${hrs}h ago`;
  const days = Math.floor(hrs / 24);
  return `${days}d ago`;
}

function StatusIcon({ status }: { status: DiffStatus }) {
  switch (status) {
    case "match":
      return <Check className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-500" />;
    case "mismatch":
      return <X className="h-4 w-4 text-red-500" />;
    case "bible_only":
      return <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4 text-brand" />;
    case "amazon_only":
      return <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4 text-orange-500" />;
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

// ─── Truncatable text ───────────────────────────────────────────────

function TruncatedText({ text, limit = 200 }: { text: string; limit?: number }) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  if (text.length <= limit) {
    return <span className="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words">{text}</span>;
  }
  return (
    <span className="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words">
      {expanded ? text : text.slice(0, limit) + "..."}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setExpanded(!expanded)}
        className="ml-1 text-brand hover:underline text-xs"
      >
        {expanded ? "Show less" : "Show more"}
      </button>
    </span>
  );
}

export function AmazonComparison({
  productId,
  product,
}: AmazonComparisonProps) {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const isViewer = session?.user?.role === "viewer";
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<FilterStatus>("all");
  const [historyOpen, setHistoryOpen] = useState(false);

  // Auto-trigger comparison (use cache)
  const compareMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (forceRefresh: boolean = false) => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${productId}/compare`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ forceRefresh }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Comparison failed");
      }
      return res.json() as Promise<{
        comparison: ComparisonResult;
        cached: boolean;
      }>;
    },
  });

  const comparison = compareMutation.data?.comparison ?? null;
  const cached = compareMutation.data?.cached ?? false;

  // History query
  const { data: historyData } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["comparison-history", productId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/products/${productId}/compare/history?limit=10`
      );
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch history");
      return res.json() as Promise<{ history: HistoryEntry[] }>;
    },
    enabled: historyOpen,
  });

  // Filter diffs
  const filteredDiffs = useMemo(() => {
    if (!comparison) return [];
    return comparison.diffs.filter((d) => {
      if (d.status === "both_empty") return false;
      if (filter === "all") return true;
      return d.status === filter;
    });
  }, [comparison, filter]);

  // Group by category
  const grouped = useMemo(() => {
    const groups: Record<string, FieldDiff[]> = {};
    for (const diff of filteredDiffs) {
      const cat = diff.category;
      if (!groups[cat]) groups[cat] = [];
      groups[cat].push(diff);
    }
    return groups;
  }, [filteredDiffs]);

  // Counts for filter chips
  const counts = useMemo(() => {
    if (!comparison) return { all: 0, mismatch: 0, bible_only: 0, amazon_only: 0 };
    const nonEmpty = comparison.diffs.filter((d) => d.status !== "both_empty");
    return {
      all: nonEmpty.length,
      mismatch: nonEmpty.filter((d) => d.status === "mismatch").length,
      bible_only: nonEmpty.filter((d) => d.status === "bible_only").length,
      amazon_only: nonEmpty.filter((d) => d.status === "amazon_only").length,
    };
  }, [comparison]);

  // No ASIN → show message
  if (!product.asin) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-lg bg-card p-6 text-center">
        <AlertCircle className="h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground mx-auto mb-2" />
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground/70">
          This product has no ASIN. Assign an ASIN to compare with Amazon.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Initial state — not yet compared
  if (!compareMutation.data && !compareMutation.isPending && !compareMutation.isError) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-lg bg-card p-6 text-center">
        <Scale className="h-8 w-8 text-brand mx-auto mb-3" />
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground/80 mb-4">
          Compare your Hub data against what&apos;s live on Amazon for{" "}
          <span className="font-mono text-brand">{product.asin}</span>
        </p>
        <Button
          onClick={() => compareMutation.mutate(false)}
          disabled={isViewer}
          className="bg-brand hover:bg-brand-hover text-brand-foreground"
        >
          Compare with Amazon
        </Button>
        {isViewer && (
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2">
            Editors and admins can run comparisons.
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Loading
  if (compareMutation.isPending) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-lg bg-card p-6 text-center">
        <Loader2 className="h-8 w-8 text-brand mx-auto mb-3 animate-spin" />
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground/80">
          Fetching data from Amazon SP-API...
        </p>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
          This may take a few seconds.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Error
  if (compareMutation.isError) {
    const errMsg = compareMutation.error.message;
    const isCredsMissing = errMsg.includes("No SP-API credentials");
    const isNotFound = errMsg.includes("not found on Amazon");
    const isAccessDenied = errMsg.includes("access denied");
    return (
      <div className="rounded-lg bg-card p-6 text-center">
        <AlertCircle className={`h-8 w-8 mx-auto mb-3 ${isCredsMissing ? "text-brand" : "text-red-500"}`} />
        <p className="text-sm text-red-400 mb-1">
          {errMsg}
        </p>
        {isCredsMissing && (
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3">
            Ask an admin to configure SP-API credentials for this client.
          </p>
        )}
        {isNotFound && (
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3">
            The ASIN may be incorrect or the product may not be listed in this marketplace.
          </p>
        )}
        {isAccessDenied && (
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3">
            The SP-API credentials may be expired or lack permissions. Check the admin settings.
          </p>
        )}
        {!isCredsMissing && (
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => compareMutation.mutate(false)}
            className="border-border text-muted-foreground/80 hover:text-white"
          >
            Try Again
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Results
  if (!comparison) return null;
  const matchColor = getMatchColor(comparison.overallMatch);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-3 rounded-lg bg-card px-4 py-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <div>
            <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Hub vs Amazon &mdash;{" "}
              <span className="font-mono">{comparison.asin}</span>
            </div>
            <div
              className="text-2xl font-bold"
              style={{ color: matchColor }}
            >
              {comparison.overallMatch}% match
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground/70">
          {comparison.fetchedAt && (
            <span>
              {cached ? "Cached" : "Fetched"}{" "}
              {relativeTime(comparison.fetchedAt)}
            </span>
          )}
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => compareMutation.mutate(true)}
            disabled={compareMutation.isPending || isViewer}
            className="border-border text-muted-foreground/80 hover:text-white"
          >
            <RefreshCw
              className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1 ${compareMutation.isPending ? "animate-spin" : ""}`}
            />
            Refresh
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filter chips */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {(
          [
            { key: "all" as FilterStatus, label: "All" },
            { key: "mismatch" as FilterStatus, label: "Mismatches" },
            { key: "bible_only" as FilterStatus, label: "Hub Only" },
            { key: "amazon_only" as FilterStatus, label: "Amazon Only" },
          ] as const
        ).map((chip) => (
          <button
            key={chip.key}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setFilter(chip.key)}
            className={`text-xs px-3 py-1 rounded-full transition-colors ${
              filter === chip.key
                ? "bg-brand text-brand-foreground font-medium"
                : "bg-card text-muted-foreground/70 hover:text-foreground/80"
            }`}
          >
            {chip.label} ({counts[chip.key]})
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Diff cards grouped by category */}
      <div className="space-y-4">
        {Object.entries(grouped).map(([category, diffs]) => (
          <div key={category}>
            <h4 className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground mb-2">
              {CATEGORY_LABELS[category] ?? category}
            </h4>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {diffs.map((diff) => {
                if (diff.category === "images") {
                  return <ImageDiffCard key={diff.bqName} diff={diff} />;
                }
                if (diff.category === "price") {
                  return <PriceDiffCard key={diff.bqName} diff={diff} />;
                }
                return <TextDiffCard key={diff.bqName} diff={diff} />;
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
        {filteredDiffs.length === 0 && (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-4">
            {filter === "all"
              ? "All fields are empty on both sides."
              : "No fields match this filter."}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* History section */}
      <div className="rounded-lg bg-card">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setHistoryOpen(!historyOpen)}
          className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full px-4 py-2.5 text-left hover:bg-muted transition-colors rounded-lg"
        >
          {historyOpen ? (
            <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          ) : (
            <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          )}
          <span className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground/80">
            Comparison History
          </span>
        </button>
        {historyOpen && (
          <div className="px-4 pb-3 space-y-1.5">
            {!historyData?.history?.length ? (
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground py-2">No history yet.</p>
            ) : (
              historyData.history.map((entry, i) => {
                const prev = historyData.history[i + 1];
                const trend =
                  prev != null
                    ? entry.overallMatch > prev.overallMatch
                      ? "up"
                      : entry.overallMatch < prev.overallMatch
                        ? "down"
                        : null
                    : null;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={entry.id}
                    className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground/70 py-1"
                  >
                    <span>
                      {new Date(entry.fetchedAt).toLocaleDateString()}
                    </span>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span
                        className="font-medium"
                        style={{
                          color: getMatchColor(entry.overallMatch),
                        }}
                      >
                        {entry.overallMatch}% match
                      </span>
                      {trend === "up" && (
                        <TrendingUp className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-500" />
                      )}
                      {trend === "down" && (
                        <TrendingDown className="h-3 w-3 text-red-500" />
                      )}
                      <span className="text-muted-foreground">
                        {entry.mismatchedFields} mismatches
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import {
  Collapsible,
  CollapsibleContent,
  CollapsibleTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/collapsible";
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertTriangle,
  Info,
  Minus,
  RefreshCw,
  ChevronDown,
  ExternalLink,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useAmazonLive } from "@/hooks/use-amazon-live";
import { getProductFieldValue } from "@/lib/product-mapper";
import {
  RAINFOREST_FIELD_MAP,
  FIELD_GROUPS,
  getByPath,
  type RainforestFieldMapping,
} from "@/lib/rainforest-field-map";
import type { Product } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import type { RainforestProduct } from "@/types/rainforest";

// ─── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface AmazonLiveComparisonProps {
  asin: string;
  catalogProduct: Product;
}

type RowStatus = "match" | "mismatch" | "amazon_only" | "both_empty";

interface ComparisonRow {
  label: string;
  hubValue: string | null;
  liveValue: string | null;
  status: RowStatus;
  isImage?: boolean;
}

// ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function normalize(val: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (val == null) return null;
  const s = val
    .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, "")
    .replace(/[\u200B\u200C\u200D\uFEFF]/g, "")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();
  return s.length === 0 ? null : s;
}

function compareValues(hub: string | null, live: string | null): RowStatus {
  const hubNorm = normalize(hub);
  const liveNorm = normalize(live);
  if (!hubNorm && !liveNorm) return "both_empty";
  if (!hubNorm && liveNorm) return "amazon_only";
  if (hubNorm && !liveNorm) return "both_empty";
  if (hubNorm!.toLowerCase() === liveNorm!.toLowerCase()) return "match";
  return "mismatch";
}

function relativeTime(timestamp: number): string {
  const diff = Date.now() - timestamp;
  const mins = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
  if (mins < 1) return "just now";
  if (mins < 60) return `${mins}m ago`;
  const hrs = Math.floor(mins / 60);
  if (hrs < 24) return `${hrs}h ago`;
  return `${Math.floor(hrs / 24)}d ago`;
}

function str(val: unknown): string | null {
  if (val == null) return null;
  if (typeof val === "string") return val || null;
  if (typeof val === "number") return String(val);
  if (typeof val === "boolean") return val ? "Yes" : "No";
  return null;
}

function extractLiveValue(
  live: RainforestProduct,
  mapping: RainforestFieldMapping
): string | null {
  const { rainforestPath, label } = mapping;

  // Special cases that need custom formatting
  if (label === "Fulfillment") {
    const fba = live.buybox_winner?.fulfillment?.is_fulfilled_by_amazon;
    if (fba == null) return null;
    return fba ? "FBA" : "MF (3P)";
  }
  if (label === "Is Prime") {
    if (live.buybox_winner?.is_prime == null) return null;
    return live.buybox_winner.is_prime ? "Yes" : "No";
  }
  if (label === "Rating") {
    return live.rating != null ? `${live.rating} \u2B50` : null;
  }
  if (label === "Review Count") {
    return live.ratings_total != null
      ? live.ratings_total.toLocaleString()
      : null;
  }
  if (label === "BSR #1" || label === "BSR #2") {
    const idx = label === "BSR #1" ? 0 : 1;
    const rank = live.bestsellers_rank?.[idx];
    if (!rank) return null;
    return `#${rank.rank.toLocaleString()} in ${rank.category}`;
  }
  if (label === "A+ Content") {
    if (!live.a_plus_content) return null;
    return live.a_plus_content.has_a_plus_content ? "Yes" : "No";
  }
  if (label === "Brand Story") {
    if (!live.a_plus_content) return null;
    return live.a_plus_content.has_brand_story ? "Yes" : "No";
  }
  if (label === "Variants") {
    const v = live.variants;
    if (!v || v.length === 0) return null;
    return `${v.length} variant${v.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`;
  }
  if (label === "Image Count") {
    return live.images_count != null ? String(live.images_count) : null;
  }
  if (label === "Video Count") {
    return live.videos_count != null ? String(live.videos_count) : null;
  }
  if (label === "Amazon's Choice") {
    return live.amazons_choice?.badge_text ?? null;
  }
  if (label === "Price") {
    return live.buybox_winner?.price?.raw ?? null;
  }
  if (label === "Availability") {
    const avail = live.buybox_winner?.availability;
    if (!avail) return null;
    return typeof avail === "string" ? avail : avail.raw ?? null;
  }

  // Generic dot-path resolution
  const val = getByPath(live as unknown as Record<string, unknown>, rainforestPath);
  return str(val);
}

function extractHubValue(
  product: Product,
  mapping: RainforestFieldMapping
): string | null {
  if (!mapping.catalogKey) return null;

  const val = getProductFieldValue(product, mapping.catalogKey);
  if (val == null || val === "") return null;

  // Format price with $ prefix if it's the price field
  if (mapping.label === "Price") return `$${val}`;
  return val;
}

function buildRows(
  product: Product,
  live: RainforestProduct
): ComparisonRow[] {
  return RAINFOREST_FIELD_MAP.map((mapping) => {
    const hubValue = extractHubValue(product, mapping);
    const liveValue = extractLiveValue(live, mapping);

    // For images, compare presence not URLs
    if (mapping.isImage) {
      const hubHas = !!hubValue;
      const liveHas = !!liveValue;
      return {
        label: mapping.label,
        hubValue,
        liveValue,
        status: hubHas && liveHas ? "match" : !hubHas && liveHas ? "amazon_only" : !hubHas && !liveHas ? "both_empty" : "match",
        isImage: true,
      };
    }

    // For price comparison, compare numeric values
    if (mapping.label === "Price") {
      const hubNum = hubValue ? hubValue.replace(/[$,]/g, "") : null;
      const liveNum = live.buybox_winner?.price?.value?.toString() ?? null;
      return {
        label: mapping.label,
        hubValue,
        liveValue,
        status: compareValues(hubNum, liveNum),
      };
    }

    return {
      label: mapping.label,
      hubValue,
      liveValue,
      status: compareValues(hubValue, liveValue),
    };
  });
}

// ─── Status Icon ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function StatusIcon({ status }: { status: RowStatus }) {
  switch (status) {
    case "match":
      return <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500 shrink-0" />;
    case "mismatch":
      return <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-500 shrink-0" />;
    case "amazon_only":
      return <Info className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-400 shrink-0" />;
    case "both_empty":
      return <Minus className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground/50 shrink-0" />;
  }
}

const ROW_BG: Record<RowStatus, string> = {
  match: "",
  mismatch: "bg-yellow-50/5",
  amazon_only: "",
  both_empty: "",
};

// ─── Image cell ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function ImageCell({ src }: { src: string | null }) {
  if (!src) return <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">&mdash;</span>;
  return (
    <img
      src={src}
      alt=""
      className="h-20 w-20 object-contain rounded border border-border"
    />
  );
}

// ─── Comparison Row ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

function ComparisonRowComponent({ row }: { row: ComparisonRow }) {
  return (
    <div
      className={`grid grid-cols-[140px_1fr_1fr] gap-3 items-start px-3 py-2 rounded ${ROW_BG[row.status]}`}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 pt-0.5">
        <StatusIcon status={row.status} />
        <span className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">
          {row.label}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="text-xs text-white break-words whitespace-pre-wrap min-w-0">
        {row.isImage ? (
          <ImageCell src={row.hubValue} />
        ) : (
          row.hubValue || <span className="text-muted-foreground/50">&mdash;</span>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="text-xs text-white break-words whitespace-pre-wrap min-w-0">
        {row.isImage ? (
          <ImageCell src={row.liveValue} />
        ) : (
          row.liveValue || <span className="text-muted-foreground/50">&mdash;</span>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ─── Section group ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

function SectionGroup({
  title,
  rows,
}: {
  title: string;
  rows: ComparisonRow[];
}) {
  if (rows.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <Collapsible defaultOpen>
      <CollapsibleTrigger className="flex items-center justify-between w-full px-3 py-1.5 hover:bg-muted/30 rounded transition-colors">
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
          {title}
        </span>
        <ChevronDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground/50" />
      </CollapsibleTrigger>
      <CollapsibleContent>
        <div className="space-y-0.5 mt-1">
          {rows.map((row) => (
            <ComparisonRowComponent key={row.label} row={row} />
          ))}
        </div>
      </CollapsibleContent>
    </Collapsible>
  );
}

// ─── Summary badge ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

function SummaryBadge({ rows }: { rows: ComparisonRow[] }) {
  const matches = rows.filter((r) => r.status === "match").length;
  const mismatches = rows.filter((r) => r.status === "mismatch").length;
  const amazonOnly = rows.filter((r) => r.status === "amazon_only").length;

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs">
      {matches > 0 && (
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-green-500">
          <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3" />
          {matches} matching
        </span>
      )}
      {mismatches > 0 && (
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-amber-500">
          <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3" />
          {mismatches} difference{mismatches !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
        </span>
      )}
      {amazonOnly > 0 && (
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-blue-400">
          <Info className="h-3 w-3" />
          {amazonOnly} missing
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ─── Variant Switcher ───────────────────────────────────────────────

function VariantSwitcher({
  variants,
  currentAsin,
  onSelect,
}: {
  variants: RainforestProduct["variants"];
  currentAsin: string;
  onSelect: (asin: string) => void;
}) {
  if (!variants || variants.length <= 1) return null;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 border-t border-border">
      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mr-1">Variants:</span>
      {variants.map((v) => (
        <button
          key={v.asin}
          onClick={() => onSelect(v.asin)}
          className={`text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded border transition-colors ${
            v.asin === currentAsin
              ? "border-brand bg-brand/10 text-brand"
              : "border-border text-muted-foreground hover:text-white hover:border-muted-foreground"
          }`}
        >
          {v.title || v.asin}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

// ─── Main Component ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function AmazonLiveComparison({
  asin,
  catalogProduct,
}: AmazonLiveComparisonProps) {
  const [enabled, setEnabled] = useState(false);
  const [activeAsin, setActiveAsin] = useState(asin);

  const { data, isLoading, isError, error, refetch, dataUpdatedAt } =
    useAmazonLive(activeAsin, enabled);

  const rows = data ? buildRows(catalogProduct, data) : [];

  // Group rows by section
  const groupedRows = FIELD_GROUPS.reduce(
    (acc, group) => {
      acc[group] = rows.filter(
        (row) =>
          RAINFOREST_FIELD_MAP.find((m) => m.label === row.label)?.group ===
          group
      );
      return acc;
    },
    {} as Record<string, ComparisonRow[]>
  );

  function handleFetch() {
    setEnabled(true);
    if (dataUpdatedAt > 0) {
      refetch();
    }
  }

  function handleVariantSelect(variantAsin: string) {
    setActiveAsin(variantAsin);
    setEnabled(true);
  }

  if (isError && !isLoading) {
    toast.error(
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to fetch live data"
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-card overflow-hidden">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-[140px_1fr_1fr] gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 border-b border-border bg-muted/30">
        <div />
        <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-brand uppercase tracking-wider">
          1o8 Hub
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span
            className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider"
            style={{ color: "#FF9900" }}
          >
            Amazon Live
          </span>
          {data && (
            <a
              href={`https://www.amazon.com/dp/${activeAsin}`}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-white transition-colors"
            >
              <ExternalLink className="h-3 w-3" />
            </a>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Variant switcher */}
      {data?.variants && data.variants.length > 1 && (
        <VariantSwitcher
          variants={data.variants}
          currentAsin={activeAsin}
          onSelect={handleVariantSelect}
        />
      )}

      {/* Content */}
      <div className="p-3">
        {/* Not yet fetched */}
        {!enabled && !data && (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 py-8">
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Compare Hub data against the live Amazon listing
            </p>
            <Button onClick={handleFetch} variant="outline" size="sm">
              <RefreshCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1.5" />
              Fetch Live Data
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Loading */}
        {isLoading && (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {Array.from({ length: 8 }).map((_, i) => (
              <div
                key={i}
                className="grid grid-cols-[140px_1fr_1fr] gap-3 px-3 py-2"
              >
                <Skeleton className="h-4 w-24" />
                <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full" />
                <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full" />
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Error */}
        {isError && !isLoading && (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 py-8">
            <p className="text-sm text-red-400">
              {error instanceof Error
                ? error.message
                : "Failed to fetch live data"}
            </p>
            <Button onClick={() => refetch()} variant="outline" size="sm">
              <RefreshCw className="h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1.5" />
              Retry
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Results */}
        {data && !isLoading && (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {/* Summary bar */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <SummaryBadge rows={rows} />
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                {dataUpdatedAt > 0 && (
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    Last fetched: {relativeTime(dataUpdatedAt)}
                  </span>
                )}
                <Button
                  onClick={() => refetch()}
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="sm"
                  className="h-7 px-2 text-xs"
                >
                  <RefreshCw
                    className={`h-3 w-3 mr-1 ${isLoading ? "animate-spin" : ""}`}
                  />
                  Refresh
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Grouped rows */}
            {FIELD_GROUPS.map((group) => (
              <SectionGroup
                key={group}
                title={group}
                rows={groupedRows[group]}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/products/bulk-edit-dialog.tsx
================================================
"use client";

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { ChevronsUpDown, Check, Loader2, AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import {
  Popover,
  PopoverContent,
  PopoverTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/popover";
import {
  Command,
  CommandInput,
  CommandList,
  CommandEmpty,
  CommandGroup,
  CommandItem,
} from "@/components/ui/command";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { useColumnAttributes } from "@/hooks/use-column-attributes";
import { inferFieldType } from "@/lib/column-utils";
import type { ColumnAttribute } from "@/lib/db/schema";

interface BulkEditDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  selectedIds: Set<string>;
  onSuccess: () => void;
  clientFilter?: string;
}

export function BulkEditDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  selectedIds,
  onSuccess,
  clientFilter,
}: BulkEditDialogProps) {
  const [pickerOpen, setPickerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedAttr, setSelectedAttr] = useState<ColumnAttribute | null>(
    null
  );
  const [newValue, setNewValue] = useState("");

  const { groups, isLoading: attrsLoading } = useColumnAttributes(
    clientFilter || undefined
  );

  // Flatten groups into a structure for the picker
  const fieldOptions = useMemo(() => {
    const result: { group: string; attrs: ColumnAttribute[] }[] = [];
    for (const group of groups) {
      const attrs: ColumnAttribute[] = [];
      for (const subgroup of group.subgroups) {
        attrs.push(...subgroup.attributes);
      }
      if (attrs.length > 0) {
        result.push({ group: group.name, attrs });
      }
    }
    return result;
  }, [groups]);

  const fieldType = selectedAttr ? inferFieldType(selectedAttr) : "text";
  const count = selectedIds.size;

  const mutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/products/bulk", {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          productIds: Array.from(selectedIds),
          field: selectedAttr!.generalLabel,
          bqName: selectedAttr!.bigqueryLabel,
          value: newValue,
        }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Bulk edit failed");
      }
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      toast.success(`Updated ${data.updated} products`);
      if (data.failed > 0) {
        toast.warning(`${data.failed} products failed to update`);
      }
      resetState();
      onSuccess();
      onOpenChange(false);
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => {
      toast.error(error.message);
    },
  });

  function resetState() {
    setSelectedAttr(null);
    setNewValue("");
    setPickerOpen(false);
  }

  function handleOpenChange(open: boolean) {
    if (!open) resetState();
    onOpenChange(open);
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-lg">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>
            Bulk Edit &mdash; {count} product{count !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
          </DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Select a field and enter the new value to apply to all selected
            products.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          {/* Field Picker */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="text-sm font-medium">Field</label>
            <Popover open={pickerOpen} onOpenChange={setPickerOpen}>
              <PopoverTrigger asChild>
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  role="combobox"
                  aria-expanded={pickerOpen}
                  className="w-full justify-between font-normal"
                >
                  {selectedAttr
                    ? selectedAttr.generalLabel
                    : "Select a field..."}
                  <ChevronsUpDown className="ml-2 h-4 w-4 shrink-0 opacity-50" />
                </Button>
              </PopoverTrigger>
              <PopoverContent className="w-[400px] p-0" align="start">
                <Command>
                  <CommandInput
                    placeholder="Search fields..."
                  />
                  <CommandList>
                    <CommandEmpty>
                      {attrsLoading ? "Loading..." : "No fields found."}
                    </CommandEmpty>
                    {fieldOptions.map((group) => (
                      <CommandGroup key={group.group} heading={group.group}>
                        {group.attrs.map((attr) => (
                          <CommandItem
                            key={attr.id}
                            value={attr.generalLabel}
                            onSelect={() => {
                              setSelectedAttr(attr);
                              setNewValue("");
                              setPickerOpen(false);
                            }}
                          >
                            <Check
                              className={`mr-2 h-4 w-4 ${
                                selectedAttr?.id === attr.id
                                  ? "opacity-100"
                                  : "opacity-0"
                              }`}
                            />
                            <span className="truncate">
                              {attr.generalLabel}
                            </span>
                            {attr.bigqueryLabel &&
                              attr.bigqueryLabel !== attr.generalLabel && (
                                <span className="ml-auto text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate">
                                  {attr.bigqueryLabel}
                                </span>
                              )}
                          </CommandItem>
                        ))}
                      </CommandGroup>
                    ))}
                  </CommandList>
                </Command>
              </PopoverContent>
            </Popover>
          </div>

          {/* Value Input */}
          {selectedAttr && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <label className="text-sm font-medium">New Value</label>
              {fieldType === "textarea" ? (
                <Textarea
                  placeholder={`Enter new ${selectedAttr.generalLabel}...`}
                  value={newValue}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewValue(e.target.value)}
                  rows={3}
                />
              ) : (
                <Input
                  type={fieldType === "url" ? "url" : fieldType === "number" ? "number" : "text"}
                  placeholder={`Enter new ${selectedAttr.generalLabel}...`}
                  value={newValue}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewValue(e.target.value)}
                />
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Warning */}
          {selectedAttr && (
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-md border border-brand/30 bg-brand/10 p-3 text-sm text-brand">
              <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
              <span>
                This will overwrite the current value of{" "}
                <strong>{selectedAttr.generalLabel}</strong> on{" "}
                <strong>{count}</strong> product{count !== 1 ? "s" : ""}. This
                cannot be undone.
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => handleOpenChange(false)}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button
            disabled={!selectedAttr || mutation.isPending}
            onClick={() => mutation.mutate()}
            className="bg-brand text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover"
          >
            {mutation.isPending ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-1 animate-spin" />
                Applying...
              </>
            ) : (
              `Apply to ${count} Product${count !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`
            )}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/products/category-upload.tsx
