"use client";

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Upload, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

interface CategoryUploadProps {
  clientIdCode: string;
  onSuccess?: () => void;
}

export function CategoryUpload({ clientIdCode, onSuccess }: CategoryUploadProps) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [dragOver, setDragOver] = useState(false);

  const uploadMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (file: File) => {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("file", file);
      formData.append("clientIdCode", clientIdCode);

      const res = await fetch("/api/category-definitions", {
        method: "POST",
        body: formData,
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        throw new Error(data.error || "Upload failed");
      }

      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      toast.success(
        `Uploaded ${data.productType}: ${data.summary.total} attributes parsed, ${data.matchCount} matched to Hub`
      );
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["category-definition"] });
      onSuccess?.();
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      toast.error(`Upload failed: ${err.message}`);
    },
  });

  const handleFile = useCallback(
    (file: File) => {
      if (!file.name.endsWith(".xlsm") && !file.name.endsWith(".xlsx")) {
        toast.error("Please upload an .xlsm or .xlsx file");
        return;
      }
      uploadMutation.mutate(file);
    },
    [uploadMutation]
  );

  const handleDrop = useCallback(
    (e: React.DragEvent) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      setDragOver(false);
      const file = e.dataTransfer.files[0];
      if (file) handleFile(file);
    },
    [handleFile]
  );

  const handleInputChange = useCallback(
    (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      const file = e.target.files?.[0];
      if (file) handleFile(file);
      // Reset input so same file can be re-uploaded
      e.target.value = "";
    },
    [handleFile]
  );

  return (
    <div
      className={`rounded-lg border-2 border-dashed p-6 text-center transition-colors ${
        dragOver
          ? "border-brand bg-brand/5"
          : "border-border hover:border-muted-foreground/30"
      }`}
      onDragOver={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setDragOver(true);
      }}
      onDragLeave={() => setDragOver(false)}
      onDrop={handleDrop}
    >
      {uploadMutation.isPending ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
          <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-brand" />
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Parsing category report...
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
          <Upload className="h-6 w-6 text-muted-foreground" />
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Drop a Category Listing Report (.xlsm) here, or{" "}
            <button
              type="button"
              className="text-brand hover:underline"
              onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
            >
              browse
            </button>
          </p>
          <input
            ref={fileInputRef}
            type="file"
            accept=".xlsm,.xlsx"
            className="hidden"
            onChange={handleInputChange}
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Compact upload button for header re-upload */
export function CategoryUploadButton({
  clientIdCode,
  onSuccess,
}: CategoryUploadProps) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const uploadMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (file: File) => {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append("file", file);
      formData.append("clientIdCode", clientIdCode);

      const res = await fetch("/api/category-definitions", {
        method: "POST",
        body: formData,
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        throw new Error(data.error || "Upload failed");
      }

      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      toast.success(
        `Re-uploaded ${data.productType}: ${data.summary.total} attributes, ${data.matchCount} matched`
      );
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["category-definition"] });
      onSuccess?.();
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      toast.error(`Upload failed: ${err.message}`);
    },
  });

  return (
    <>
      <Button
        variant="ghost"
        size="sm"
        className="h-6 px-2 text-xs"
        disabled={uploadMutation.isPending}
        onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
      >
        {uploadMutation.isPending ? (
          <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin mr-1" />
        ) : (
          <Upload className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
        )}
        Re-upload
      </Button>
      <input
        ref={fileInputRef}
        type="file"
        accept=".xlsm,.xlsx"
        className="hidden"
        onChange={(e) => {
          const file = e.target.files?.[0];
          if (file) uploadMutation.mutate(file);
          e.target.value = "";
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/products/completeness-card.tsx
================================================
"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";
import {
  calculateCompleteness,
  getScoreColor,
  getScoreLabel,
  type CompletenessBreakdown,
} from "@/lib/completeness";
import type { Product, ColumnAttribute } from "@/lib/db/schema";

interface CompletenessCardProps {
  product: Product;
  clientIdCode: string;
  attributes: ColumnAttribute[];
}

function BreakdownBar({
  label,
  data,
  delay = 0,
}: {
  label: string;
  data: CompletenessBreakdown;
  delay?: number;
}) {
  if (data.total === 0) return null;
  const pct = Math.round((data.filled / data.total) * 100);
  const color = getScoreColor(pct);
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground w-28 shrink-0 text-right">
        {label}
      </span>
      <div className="flex-1 flex items-center gap-2">
        <div className="flex-1 h-2 bg-muted/60 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
          <div
            className="h-full rounded-full animate-bar-fill"
            style={{
              width: `${pct}%`,
              backgroundColor: color,
              animationDelay: `${delay}ms`,
            }}
          />
        </div>
        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground w-16 shrink-0 tabular-nums">
          {data.filled}/{data.total}
        </span>
        <span className="text-xs font-medium w-10 shrink-0 tabular-nums" style={{ color }}>
          {pct}%
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function MissingFieldsList({
  title,
  fields,
  onFieldClick,
}: {
  title: string;
  fields: string[];
  onFieldClick: (label: string) => void;
}) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);

  if (fields.length === 0) return null;

  const displayFields = expanded ? fields : fields.slice(0, 6);
  const hasMore = fields.length > 6 && !expanded;

  return (
    <div>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setExpanded(!expanded)}
        className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1.5 hover:text-foreground transition-colors"
      >
        {expanded ? (
          <ChevronDown className="h-3 w-3" />
        ) : (
          <ChevronRight className="h-3 w-3" />
        )}
        {title} ({fields.length})
      </button>
      {(expanded || fields.length <= 6) && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 ml-4">
          {displayFields.map((label) => (
            <button
              key={label}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onFieldClick(label)}
              className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-muted/80 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] text-foreground/80 hover:bg-brand/15 hover:text-brand cursor-pointer transition-colors"
            >
              {label}
            </button>
          ))}
          {hasMore && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setExpanded(true)}
              className="text-[11px] text-brand hover:text-brand-hover transition-colors"
            >
              +{fields.length - 6} more
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function CompletenessCard({
  product,
  clientIdCode,
  attributes,
}: CompletenessCardProps) {
  const score = useMemo(
    () => calculateCompleteness(product, attributes, clientIdCode),
    [product, attributes, clientIdCode]
  );

  const color = getScoreColor(score.score);
  const label = getScoreLabel(score.score);
  const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * 14;
  const dashArray = `${(score.score / 100) * circumference} ${circumference}`;

  const handleFieldClick = (fieldLabel: string) => {
    const el =
      document.getElementById(`field-${fieldLabel}`) ||
      document.getElementById(fieldLabel);
    if (el) {
      el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
      el.classList.add("ring-2", "ring-brand/60");
      setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove("ring-2", "ring-brand/60"), 2000);
    }
  };

  if (score.totalRequired === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-border/60 bg-card text-card-foreground p-5 space-y-4 card-glow">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-muted-foreground font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)]">
          Product Readiness &mdash; {clientIdCode}
        </h3>
      </div>

      {/* Main score with animated ring */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-5">
        <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center">
          <svg className="w-[72px] h-[72px] -rotate-90" viewBox="0 0 36 36">
            <circle
              cx="18" cy="18" r="14"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              className="text-muted/50"
              strokeWidth="2.5"
            />
            <circle
              cx="18" cy="18" r="14"
              fill="none"
              stroke={color}
              strokeWidth="2.5"
              strokeDasharray={dashArray}
              strokeLinecap="round"
              className="animate-ring-fill"
              style={{
                filter: `drop-shadow(0 0 6px ${color}40)`,
              }}
            />
          </svg>
          <span
            className="absolute text-lg font-bold tabular-nums animate-fade-up"
            style={{ color, animationDelay: "0.3s" }}
          >
            {score.score}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span className="text-xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)]" style={{ color }}>
            {label}
          </span>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
            {score.filledRequired} of {score.totalRequired} required fields
            filled
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Breakdown bars with staggered animation */}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <BreakdownBar label="Required" data={score.breakdown.required} delay={200} />
        <BreakdownBar label="Cond. Required" data={score.breakdown.conditionallyRequired} delay={400} />
        <BreakdownBar label="Recommended" data={score.breakdown.recommended} delay={600} />
      </div>

      {/* Missing fields */}
      {(score.missingRequired.length > 0 ||
        score.missingConditionallyRequired.length > 0) && (
        <div className="space-y-2 pt-3 border-t border-border/40">
          <MissingFieldsList
            title="Missing Required"
            fields={score.missingRequired}
            onFieldClick={handleFieldClick}
          />
          <MissingFieldsList
            title="Missing Cond. Required"
            fields={score.missingConditionallyRequired}
            onFieldClick={handleFieldClick}
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/products/create-product-dialog.tsx
================================================
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";

type ClientEntry = { clientIdCode: string; count: number; activeCount: number };

const MARKETPLACES = [
  "amazon.com",
  "amazon.ca",
  "amazon.co.uk",
  "amazon.de",
  "amazon.co.jp",
] as const;

interface CreateProductDialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
}

export function CreateProductDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
}: CreateProductDialogProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();

  const [clientIdCode, setClientIdCode] = useState("");
  const [asin, setAsin] = useState("");
  const [sku, setSku] = useState("");
  const [marketplace, setMarketplace] = useState("");

  const { data: clients = [] } = useQuery<ClientEntry[]>({
    queryKey: ["clients"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/clients");
      if (!res.ok) return [];
      return res.json();
    },
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  const mutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/products", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ asin, sku, clientIdCode, marketplace }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Failed to create product");
      }
      return res.json() as Promise<{ id: string }>;
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      toast.success("Product created");
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["products"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["clients"] });
      resetState();
      onOpenChange(false);
      router.push(`/products/${data.id}`);
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => {
      toast.error(error.message);
    },
  });

  function resetState() {
    setClientIdCode("");
    setAsin("");
    setSku("");
    setMarketplace("");
  }

  function handleOpenChange(open: boolean) {
    if (!open) resetState();
    onOpenChange(open);
  }

  const asinValid = asin.trim().length === 10;
  const canSubmit =
    asinValid && sku.trim() && clientIdCode && marketplace && !mutation.isPending;

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>New Product</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Enter the minimum fields to create a product. You can fill in the
            rest on the detail page.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="text-sm font-medium">Client</label>
            <Select value={clientIdCode} onValueChange={setClientIdCode}>
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue placeholder="Select a client..." />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {clients.map((c) => (
                  <SelectItem key={c.clientIdCode} value={c.clientIdCode}>
                    {c.clientIdCode}
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="text-sm font-medium">ASIN</label>
            <Input
              placeholder="e.g. B0XXXXXXXXX"
              value={asin}
              maxLength={10}
              onChange={(e) => setAsin(e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
            />
            {asin && asin.trim().length !== 10 && (
              <p className="text-xs text-red-500">ASIN must be exactly 10 characters ({asin.trim().length}/10)</p>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="text-sm font-medium">SKU</label>
            <Input
              placeholder="e.g. MY-SKU-001"
              value={sku}
              onChange={(e) => setSku(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label className="text-sm font-medium">Marketplace</label>
            <Select value={marketplace} onValueChange={setMarketplace}>
              <SelectTrigger>
                <SelectValue placeholder="Select marketplace..." />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {MARKETPLACES.map((m) => (
                  <SelectItem key={m} value={m}>
                    {m}
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => handleOpenChange(false)}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button
            disabled={!canSubmit}
            onClick={() => mutation.mutate()}
            className="bg-brand text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover"
          >
            {mutation.isPending ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-1 animate-spin" />
                Creating...
              </>
            ) : (
              "Create Product"
            )}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function formatUnit(unit: string): string {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {
    inches: "in", centimeters: "cm", millimeters: "mm",
    feet: "ft", meters: "m", pounds: "lb", kilograms: "kg",
    grams: "g", ounces: "oz", milligrams: "mg",
    "cubic inches": "cu in", "cubic centimeters": "cc", "cubic feet": "cu ft",
    "cubic meters": "cu m", "fluid ounces": "fl oz", gallons: "gal",
    liters: "L", milliliters: "mL", pints: "pt", quarts: "qt",
  };
  return map[unit.toLowerCase()] ?? unit;
}

/** Normalize stored unit value to match dropdown option casing */
function normalizeUnit(stored: string, options: readonly string[]): string {
  if (!stored) return "";
  const match = options.find((o) => o.toLowerCase() === stored.toLowerCase());
  return match ?? stored;
}

  ) => void;

/* ── Visual dimension card ───────────────────────────────────── */

function DimensionCard({
  category,
  product,
  readOnly,
  onSave,
  onFieldSaved,
}: {
  category: (typeof CATEGORIES)[number];
  product: Product;
  readOnly: boolean;
  onSave: (bqName: string, value: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  onFieldSaved?: (bqName: string, label: string, oldValue: string, newValue: string) => void;
}) {
  const Icon = category.icon;
  const dims = category.dims;
  const spatialDims = dims.filter((d) => d.kind === "length");

  const populated = dims.filter((d) => {
    const v = getProductFieldValue(product, d.bqName);
    return v != null && v !== "";
  }).length;

  return (
    <div className={`rounded-lg border p-3 ${category.accent}`}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1.5">
        <Icon className={`h-4 w-4 ${category.color}`} />
        <span className={`text-xs font-semibold ${category.color}`}>
          {category.label}
        </span>
        <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground ml-auto tabular-nums">
          {populated}/{dims.length}
        </span>
      </div>
      <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mb-2 leading-tight">
        {category.description}
      </p>

      {/* 3D box visual for L×W×H */}
      {spatialDims.length === 3 && (
        <div className="flex items-end justify-center gap-1 mb-2">
          <BoxVisual
            l={getProductFieldValue(product, spatialDims[0].bqName) ?? ""}
            w={getProductFieldValue(product, spatialDims[1].bqName) ?? ""}
            h={getProductFieldValue(product, spatialDims[2].bqName) ?? ""}
            unit={getProductFieldValue(product, spatialDims[0].unit ?? "") ?? ""}
          />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Input fields */}
      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        {dims.map((dim) => {
          const unitVal = dim.unit ? getProductFieldValue(product, dim.unit) ?? "" : "";
          return (
            <DimInput
              key={dim.bqName}
              dim={dim}
              value={getProductFieldValue(product, dim.bqName) ?? ""}
              unit={unitVal}
              unitBqName={dim.unit}
              readOnly={readOnly}
              onSave={onSave}
              onFieldSaved={onFieldSaved}
            />
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ── 3D box visual ───────────────────────────────────────────── */

function BoxVisual({
  l,
  w,
  h,
  unit,
}: {
  l: string;
  w: string;
  h: string;
  unit: string;
}) {
  const hasValues = l || w || h;
  const unitShort = unit ? ` ${formatUnit(unit)}` : "";

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 80 70" className="w-16 h-14 mb-1" aria-hidden>
        <polygon
          points="40,5 75,20 75,50 40,35"
          className="fill-muted/30 stroke-muted-foreground/30"
          strokeWidth="0.8"
        />
        <polygon
          points="40,35 75,50 40,65 5,50"
          className="fill-muted/20 stroke-muted-foreground/30"
          strokeWidth="0.8"
        />
        <polygon
          points="5,20 40,5 40,35 5,50"
          className="fill-muted/40 stroke-muted-foreground/40"
          strokeWidth="0.8"
        />
        <line x1="2" y1="20" x2="2" y2="50" className="stroke-muted-foreground/50" strokeWidth="0.6" />
        <text x="0" y="37" className="fill-muted-foreground text-[7px]" textAnchor="middle">H</text>
        <line x1="5" y1="53" x2="40" y2="68" className="stroke-muted-foreground/50" strokeWidth="0.6" />
        <text x="22" y="65" className="fill-muted-foreground text-[7px]" textAnchor="middle">W</text>
        <line x1="43" y1="68" x2="78" y2="53" className="stroke-muted-foreground/50" strokeWidth="0.6" />
        <text x="60" y="65" className="fill-muted-foreground text-[7px]" textAnchor="middle">L</text>
      </svg>

      {hasValues ? (
        <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
          {l || "—"} × {w || "—"} × {h || "—"}{unitShort}
        </span>
      ) : (
        <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/50">No dimensions</span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ── Dimension input row ─────────────────────────────────────── */

function DimInput({
  dim,
  value,
  unit,
  unitBqName,
  readOnly,
  onSave,
  onFieldSaved,
}: {
  dim: DimField;
  value: string;
  unit: string;
  unitBqName?: string;
  readOnly: boolean;
  onSave: (bqName: string, value: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  onFieldSaved?: (bqName: string, label: string, oldValue: string, newValue: string) => void;
}) {
  const unitOptions = dim.kind === "weight" ? WEIGHT_UNITS
    : dim.kind === "volume" ? VOLUME_UNITS
    : dim.kind === "count" ? ([] as readonly string[])
    : LENGTH_UNITS;
  const [localValue, setLocalValue] = useState(value);
  const [localUnit, setLocalUnit] = useState(() => normalizeUnit(unit, unitOptions));
  const [saveState, setSaveState] = useState<"idle" | "saving" | "saved" | "error">("idle");
  const debounceRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => { setLocalValue(value); }, [value]);
  useEffect(() => { setLocalUnit(normalizeUnit(unit, unitOptions)); }, [unit, unitOptions]);

  const doSave = useCallback(
    async (bqName: string, label: string, oldVal: string, newVal: string) => {
      if (newVal === oldVal) return;
      setSaveState("saving");
      try {
        await onSave(bqName, newVal || null);
        onFieldSaved?.(bqName, label, oldVal, newVal);
        setSaveState("saved");
        setTimeout(() => setSaveState("idle"), 1500);
      } catch {
        setSaveState("error");
        toast.error(`Failed to save ${label}`);
        setTimeout(() => setSaveState("idle"), 2000);
      }
    },
    [onSave, onFieldSaved]
  );

  const handleValueChange = (newVal: string) => {
    setLocalValue(newVal);
    if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
    debounceRef.current = setTimeout(() => doSave(dim.bqName, dim.label, value, newVal), 600);
  };

  const handleUnitChange = (newUnit: string) => {
    setLocalUnit(newUnit);
    if (unitBqName) {
      doSave(unitBqName, `${dim.label} Unit`, unit, newUnit);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5" id={`field-${dim.bqName}`}>
      <label className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-medium">
        {dim.label}
      </label>
      {readOnly ? (
        <span className="text-xs text-foreground/80 tabular-nums">
          {value || "—"}{unit ? ` ${formatUnit(unit)}` : ""}
        </span>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <input
            type="text"
            inputMode="decimal"
            value={localValue}
            onChange={(e) => handleValueChange(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === "Enter") {
                if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
                doSave(dim.bqName, dim.label, value, localValue);
              }
            }}
            placeholder="0"
            className="h-6 px-1.5 text-xs tabular-nums rounded border border-border bg-field-bg text-field-text focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand w-20"
          />
          {unitBqName && (
            <select
              value={localUnit}
              onChange={(e) => handleUnitChange(e.target.value)}
              className="h-6 px-1 text-[10px] rounded border border-border bg-field-bg text-field-text focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand flex-1 min-w-0"
            >
              <option value="">— select unit —</option>
              {unitOptions.map((u) => (
                <option key={u} value={u}>{u}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          )}
          {saveState === "saving" && <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />}
          {saveState === "saved" && <Check className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-500 shrink-0" />}
          {saveState === "error" && <X className="h-3 w-3 text-destructive shrink-0" />}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ── Small metadata field ────────────────────────────────────── */

function MetaField({
  label,
  bqName,
  value,
  readOnly,
  onSave,
  onFieldSaved,
}: {
  label: string;
  bqName: string;
  value: string;
  readOnly: boolean;
  onSave: (bqName: string, value: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  onFieldSaved?: (bqName: string, label: string, oldValue: string, newValue: string) => void;
}) {
  const [localValue, setLocalValue] = useState(value);
  const [saveState, setSaveState] = useState<"idle" | "saving" | "saved" | "error">("idle");
  const debounceRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => { setLocalValue(value); }, [value]);

  const doSave = useCallback(
    async (newVal: string) => {
      if (newVal === value) return;
      setSaveState("saving");
      try {
        await onSave(bqName, newVal || null);
        onFieldSaved?.(bqName, label, value, newVal);
        setSaveState("saved");
        setTimeout(() => setSaveState("idle"), 1500);
      } catch {
        setSaveState("error");
        toast.error(`Failed to save ${label}`);
        setTimeout(() => setSaveState("idle"), 2000);
      }
    },
    [bqName, label, value, onSave, onFieldSaved]
  );

  const handleChange = (newVal: string) => {
    setLocalValue(newVal);
    if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
    debounceRef.current = setTimeout(() => doSave(newVal), 600);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5" id={`field-${bqName}`}>
      <label className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-medium">
        {label}
      </label>
      {readOnly ? (
        <span className="text-xs text-foreground/80">
          {value || <span className="text-muted-foreground/50">—</span>}
        </span>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <input
            type="text"
            value={localValue}
            onChange={(e) => handleChange(e.target.value)}
            className="h-6 px-1.5 text-xs rounded border border-border bg-field-bg text-field-text focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand w-full"
          />
          {saveState === "saving" && <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />}
          {saveState === "saved" && <Check className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-500 shrink-0" />}
          {saveState === "error" && <X className="h-3 w-3 text-destructive shrink-0" />}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useRef } from "react";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useSession } from "next-auth/react";
import {
  Popover,
  PopoverContent,
  PopoverTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/popover";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { MessageSquare, Send, Check, RotateCcw, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import type { FieldComment } from "@/lib/db/schema";

type Props = {
  productId: string;
  bqName: string;
  fieldLabel: string;
  commentCount?: { total: number; open: number };
};

type Filter = "all" | "open" | "resolved";

export function FieldComments({
  productId,
  bqName,
  fieldLabel,
  commentCount,
}: Props) {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<Filter>("all");
  const [newComment, setNewComment] = useState("");
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const isViewer = session?.user?.role === "viewer";
  const isAdmin = session?.user?.role === "admin";

  const hasComments = commentCount && commentCount.total > 0;
  const openCount = commentCount?.open ?? 0;

  const { data, isLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["field-comments", productId, bqName],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/products/${productId}/comments?field=${encodeURIComponent(bqName)}`
      );
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch comments");
      return res.json() as Promise<{
        comments: FieldComment[];
        counts: { total: number; open: number; resolved: number };
      }>;
    },
    enabled: open,
  });

  const addMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (comment: string) => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${productId}/comments`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ bqName, comment }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to add comment");
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      setNewComment("");
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ["field-comments", productId, bqName],
      });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["product", productId] });
    },
  });

  const actionMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      commentId,
      action,
    }: {
      commentId: number;
      action: "resolve" | "reopen" | "delete";
    }) => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${productId}/comments`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ commentId, action }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to update comment");
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
        queryKey: ["field-comments", productId, bqName],
      });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["product", productId] });
    },
  });

  const filteredComments = (data?.comments ?? []).filter((c) => {
    if (filter === "open") return !c.resolved;
    if (filter === "resolved") return c.resolved;
    return true;
  });

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    if (!newComment.trim()) return;
    addMutation.mutate(newComment.trim());
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      handleSubmit();
    }
  };

  return (
    <Popover open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <PopoverTrigger asChild>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="relative inline-flex items-center shrink-0 p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-muted transition-colors"
          title={
            hasComments
              ? `${openCount} open comment${openCount !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`
              : "Add comment"
          }
        >
          <MessageSquare
            className="h-3.5 w-3.5"
            style={{ color: hasComments ? "var(--brand)" : "#9ca3af" }}
            fill={hasComments ? "var(--brand)" : "none"}
          />
          {hasComments && openCount > 0 && (
            <span className="absolute -top-1.5 -right-1.5 flex items-center justify-center min-w-[14px] h-[14px] rounded-full bg-brand text-[9px] font-bold text-brand-foreground px-0.5 leading-none">
              {openCount}
            </span>
          )}
        </button>
      </PopoverTrigger>
      <PopoverContent
        align="start"
        side="bottom"
        className="w-96 max-h-96 flex flex-col p-0 bg-card border-border text-white"
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="px-3 pt-3 pb-2 border-b border-border">
          <h4 className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground/80 truncate">
            Comments: {fieldLabel}
          </h4>
          {/* Filter tabs */}
          <div className="flex gap-1 mt-2">
            {(["all", "open", "resolved"] as const).map((tab) => (
              <button
                key={tab}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setFilter(tab)}
                className={`text-[11px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full capitalize transition-colors ${
                  filter === tab
                    ? "bg-brand text-brand-foreground font-medium"
                    : "text-muted-foreground/70 hover:text-foreground/80"
                }`}
              >
                {tab}
                {tab === "open" && data?.counts
                  ? ` (${data.counts.open})`
                  : tab === "resolved" && data?.counts
                    ? ` (${data.counts.resolved})`
                    : ""}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Comment list */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-3 py-2 space-y-2 min-h-0">
          {isLoading ? (
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground text-center py-4">
              Loading...
            </p>
          ) : filteredComments.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground text-center py-4">
              No {filter !== "all" ? filter : ""} comments yet
            </p>
          ) : (
            filteredComments.map((c) => (
              <div
                key={c.id}
                className={`text-xs rounded-md p-2 ${
                  c.resolved
                    ? "bg-card/50 opacity-60"
                    : "bg-card"
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <span className="font-medium text-muted-foreground/80 truncate">
                    {c.authorName || c.author}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground shrink-0">
                    {new Date(c.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-1 text-foreground/80 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words">
                  {c.comment}
                </p>
                {c.resolved && (
                  <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                    Resolved by {c.resolvedBy}
                  </p>
                )}
                {/* Actions */}
                {!isViewer && (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 mt-1.5">
                    {c.resolved ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() =>
                          actionMutation.mutate({
                            commentId: c.id,
                            action: "reopen",
                          })
                        }
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/70 hover:text-white transition-colors"
                      >
                        <RotateCcw className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
                        Reopen
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() =>
                          actionMutation.mutate({
                            commentId: c.id,
                            action: "resolve",
                          })
                        }
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/70 hover:text-emerald-400 transition-colors"
                      >
                        <Check className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
                        Resolve
                      </button>
                    )}
                    {(c.author === session?.user?.email || isAdmin) && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() =>
                          actionMutation.mutate({
                            commentId: c.id,
                            action: "delete",
                          })
                        }
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/70 hover:text-red-400 transition-colors ml-1"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
                        Delete
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Input */}
        {!isViewer && (
          <div className="border-t border-border px-3 py-2 flex items-center gap-2">
            <input
              ref={inputRef}
              type="text"
              value={newComment}
              onChange={(e) => setNewComment(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
              placeholder="Add a comment..."
              className="flex-1 bg-card border border-border rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-white placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand"
            />
            <Button
              size="sm"
              onClick={handleSubmit}
              disabled={!newComment.trim() || addMutation.isPending}
              className="h-7 w-7 p-0 bg-brand hover:bg-brand-hover text-brand-foreground"
            >
              <Send className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </PopoverContent>
    </Popover>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import {
  CommandDialog,
  CommandInput,
  CommandList,
  CommandEmpty,
  CommandGroup,
  CommandItem,
} from "@/components/ui/command";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Search, Star, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";
import { getProductFieldValue } from "@/lib/product-mapper";
import type { EnrichedAttribute } from "@/hooks/use-column-attributes";
import type { Product } from "@/lib/db/schema";

type QuickFilter = "all" | "empty" | "required" | "missing";

interface FieldSearchProps {
  product: Product;
  clientIdCode?: string;
  attributes: EnrichedAttribute[];
  onSelectField: (bqName: string, referenceGroup: string) => void;
}

export function FieldSearch({
  product,
  clientIdCode,
  attributes,
  onSelectField,
}: FieldSearchProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<QuickFilter>("all");

  // Cmd+K / Ctrl+K
  useEffect(() => {
    const down = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "k" && (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey)) {
        e.preventDefault();
        setOpen((prev) => !prev);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", down);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", down);
  }, []);

  // Reset filter when opening
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) setFilter("all");
  }, [open]);

  // Pre-compute field value presence + requirement level
  const enriched = useMemo(() => {
    return attributes.map((attr) => {
      const bqName = attr.bigqueryLabel || attr.generalLabel;
      const val = getProductFieldValue(product, bqName);
      const filled =
        val !== null && val !== undefined && String(val).trim() !== "";
      const req = clientIdCode
        ? (attr.clientRequirements as Record<string, string>)?.[clientIdCode] ||
          null
        : null;
      const isRequired =
        req === "Required" || req === "Conditionally Required";
      return { attr, bqName, filled, req, isRequired };
    });
  }, [attributes, product, clientIdCode]);

  // Counts for filter buttons
  const counts = useMemo(() => {
    let empty = 0;
    let required = 0;
    let missing = 0;
    for (const e of enriched) {
      if (!e.filled) empty++;
      if (e.isRequired) required++;
      if (e.isRequired && !e.filled) missing++;
    }
    return { all: enriched.length, empty, required, missing };
  }, [enriched]);

  // Apply quick filter
  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    switch (filter) {
      case "empty":
        return enriched.filter((e) => !e.filled);
      case "required":
        return enriched.filter((e) => e.isRequired);
      case "missing":
        return enriched.filter((e) => e.isRequired && !e.filled);
      default:
        return enriched;
    }
  }, [enriched, filter]);

  // Group by referenceGroup
  const grouped = useMemo(() => {
    const groups: Record<
      string,
      typeof filtered
    > = {};
    for (const entry of filtered) {
      const group = entry.attr.referenceGroup || "Other";
      if (!groups[group]) groups[group] = [];
      groups[group].push(entry);
    }
    return groups;
  }, [filtered]);

  const isMac =
    typeof navigator !== "undefined" &&
    /Mac|iPhone|iPad/.test(navigator.userAgent);

  return (
    <>
      <Button
        variant="outline"
        size="sm"
        onClick={() => setOpen(true)}
        className="gap-2 text-muted-foreground"
      >
        <Search className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
        <span className="hidden sm:inline">Find field...</span>
        <kbd className="pointer-events-none hidden sm:inline-flex h-5 items-center gap-0.5 rounded border bg-muted px-1.5 font-mono text-[10px] font-medium text-muted-foreground">
          {isMac ? "\u2318" : "Ctrl+"}K
        </kbd>
      </Button>

      <CommandDialog
        open={open}
        onOpenChange={setOpen}
        title="Field Search"
        description="Search across all product fields"
      >
        <CommandInput placeholder={`Search ${counts.all} fields...`} />

        {/* Quick filters */}
        <div className="flex gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 border-b">
          {(
            [
              { key: "all" as const, label: "All", count: counts.all, danger: false },
              { key: "empty" as const, label: "Empty", count: counts.empty, danger: false },
              { key: "required" as const, label: "Required", count: counts.required, danger: false },
              { key: "missing" as const, label: "Missing Req.", count: counts.missing, danger: true },
            ]
          ).map((f) => (
            <button
              key={f.key}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setFilter(f.key)}
              className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
                filter === f.key
                  ? "bg-brand text-brand-foreground"
                  : f.danger
                    ? "bg-muted text-red-500 hover:bg-red-500/10"
                    : "bg-muted text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent"
              }`}
            >
              {f.label}
              <span className="tabular-nums">({f.count})</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <CommandList className="max-h-[400px]">
          <CommandEmpty>No fields match.</CommandEmpty>
          {Object.entries(grouped).map(([group, entries]) => (
            <CommandGroup key={group} heading={group}>
              {entries.map((entry) => (
                <CommandItem
                  key={entry.attr.generalLabel}
                  value={`${entry.attr.generalLabel} ${entry.bqName} ${entry.attr.specificLabel || ""}`}
                  onSelect={() => {
                    onSelectField(
                      entry.attr.generalLabel,
                      entry.attr.referenceGroup
                    );
                    setOpen(false);
                  }}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full gap-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
                      {entry.attr.isEssential && (
                        <Star className="h-3 w-3 text-brand fill-brand shrink-0" />
                      )}
                      <span className="truncate">
                        {entry.attr.generalLabel}
                      </span>
                      {entry.attr.specificLabel &&
                        entry.attr.specificLabel !==
                          entry.attr.generalLabel && (
                          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate">
                            ({entry.attr.specificLabel})
                          </span>
                        )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                      <span
                        className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${entry.filled ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-muted-foreground/30"}`}
                      />
                      {entry.req &&
                        entry.req !== "Not Required" &&
                        entry.req !== "Optional" && (
                          <span
                            className={`text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-medium ${
                              entry.req === "Required"
                                ? "bg-red-500/15 text-red-600"
                                : entry.req === "Conditionally Required"
                                  ? "bg-orange-500/15 text-orange-600"
                                  : "bg-blue-500/15 text-blue-600"
                            }`}
                          >
                            {entry.req === "Conditionally Required"
                              ? "Cond."
                              : entry.req}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      <ChevronRight className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground" />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </CommandItem>
              ))}
            </CommandGroup>
          ))}
        </CommandList>
      </CommandDialog>
    </>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useMemo, useCallback } from "react";
import {
  Edit3,
  Trash2,
  ArrowLeftRight,
  Maximize2,
  ImagePlus,
  Image as ImageIcon,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/tooltip";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { getProductFieldValue } from "@/lib/product-mapper";
import { ImageUrlDialog } from "./image-url-dialog";
import { ImageLightbox } from "./image-lightbox";
import type { Product } from "@/lib/db/schema";

/** The 9 image slots in order */
const IMAGE_SLOTS = [
  { bqName: "MainImageURL", label: "Main" },
  { bqName: "OtherImageURL1", label: "Image 2" },
  { bqName: "OtherImageURL2", label: "Image 3" },
  { bqName: "OtherImageURL3", label: "Image 4" },
  { bqName: "OtherImageURL4", label: "Image 5" },
  { bqName: "OtherImageURL5", label: "Image 6" },
  { bqName: "OtherImageURL6", label: "Image 7" },
  { bqName: "OtherImageURL7", label: "Image 8" },
  { bqName: "OtherImageURL8", label: "Image 9" },
] as const;

type Props = {
  product: Product;
  readOnly: boolean;
  onSave: (bqName: string, value: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  onFieldSaved?: (
    bqName: string,
    label: string,
    oldValue: string,
    newValue: string
  ) => void;
};

export function ImageGallery({
  product,
  readOnly,
  onSave,
  onFieldSaved,
}: Props) {
  const [selectedIdx, setSelectedIdx] = useState(0);
  const [editSlot, setEditSlot] = useState<(typeof IMAGE_SLOTS)[number] | null>(
    null
  );
  const [lightboxIdx, setLightboxIdx] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [swapMode, setSwapMode] = useState<number | null>(null);

  // Resolve image URLs for each slot
  const slotData = useMemo(() => {
    return IMAGE_SLOTS.map((slot) => {
      const url = getProductFieldValue(product, slot.bqName) || "";
      return { ...slot, url };
    });
  }, [product]);

  const filledCount = slotData.filter((s) => s.url).length;
  const selectedSlot = slotData[selectedIdx];
  const displayUrl = selectedSlot?.url || "";

  // All filled image URLs for lightbox navigation
  const filledImages = useMemo(
    () => slotData.filter((s) => s.url).map((s) => ({ url: s.url, label: s.label })),
    [slotData]
  );

  const handleEditUrl = useCallback(
    async (url: string) => {
      if (!editSlot) return;
      const oldVal = getProductFieldValue(product, editSlot.bqName) || "";
      const newVal = url.trim() || null;
      await onSave(editSlot.bqName, newVal);
      onFieldSaved?.(editSlot.bqName, editSlot.label, oldVal, newVal ?? "");
      toast.success(`Saved ${editSlot.label}`);
      setEditSlot(null);
    },
    [editSlot, product, onSave, onFieldSaved]
  );

  const handleClear = useCallback(
    async (idx: number) => {
      const slot = slotData[idx];
      if (!slot.url) return;
      const oldVal = slot.url;
      await onSave(slot.bqName, null);
      onFieldSaved?.(slot.bqName, slot.label, oldVal, "");
      toast.success(`Cleared ${slot.label}`, {
        action: {
          label: "Undo",
          onClick: async () => {
            await onSave(slot.bqName, oldVal);
            onFieldSaved?.(slot.bqName, slot.label, "", oldVal);
            toast.info(`Restored ${slot.label}`);
          },
        },
        duration: 5000,
      });
    },
    [slotData, onSave, onFieldSaved]
  );

  const handleSwap = useCallback(
    async (targetIdx: number) => {
      if (swapMode === null || swapMode === targetIdx) {
        setSwapMode(null);
        return;
      }
      const slotA = slotData[swapMode];
      const slotB = slotData[targetIdx];
      // Swap URLs between two slots
      await onSave(slotA.bqName, slotB.url || null);
      await onSave(slotB.bqName, slotA.url || null);
      onFieldSaved?.(slotA.bqName, slotA.label, slotA.url, slotB.url);
      onFieldSaved?.(slotB.bqName, slotB.label, slotB.url, slotA.url);
      toast.success(`Swapped ${slotA.label} and ${slotB.label}`);
      setSwapMode(null);
    },
    [swapMode, slotData, onSave, onFieldSaved]
  );

  const handleThumbnailClick = useCallback(
    (idx: number) => {
      if (swapMode !== null) {
        handleSwap(idx);
      } else {
        setSelectedIdx(idx);
      }
    },
    [swapMode, handleSwap]
  );

  // Find the lightbox index for the currently selected filled image
  const openLightbox = useCallback(() => {
    if (!displayUrl) return;
    const idx = filledImages.findIndex((img) => img.url === displayUrl);
    setLightboxIdx(idx >= 0 ? idx : 0);
  }, [displayUrl, filledImages]);

  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-card text-card-foreground overflow-hidden">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-2.5 border-b border-border">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <ImageIcon className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          <span className="text-sm font-medium">Images</span>
        </div>
        <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs tabular-nums">
          {filledCount}/{IMAGE_SLOTS.length}
        </Badge>
      </div>

      <div className="p-4">
        <div className="flex gap-4">
          {/* Thumbnail grid */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1.5 shrink-0">
            {slotData.map((slot, idx) => (
              <TooltipProvider key={slot.bqName} delayDuration={300}>
                <Tooltip>
                  <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleThumbnailClick(idx)}
                      className={`relative h-16 w-16 rounded border overflow-hidden cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                        swapMode !== null
                          ? swapMode === idx
                            ? "border-brand ring-2 ring-brand scale-105"
                            : "border-dashed border-border hover:border-brand"
                          : idx === selectedIdx
                            ? "border-brand ring-1 ring-brand"
                            : "border-border hover:border-border"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {slot.url ? (
                        <img
                          src={slot.url}
                          alt={slot.label}
                          className="h-full w-full object-cover"
                          onError={(e) => {
                            (e.target as HTMLImageElement).style.display =
                              "none";
                          }}
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <div className="h-full w-full flex items-center justify-center bg-muted/50">
                          <ImagePlus className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground/80" />
                        </div>
                      )}
                      {/* Slot number overlay */}
                      <span className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 bg-black/50 text-white text-[9px] px-1 leading-relaxed rounded-tl">
                        {idx === 0 ? "M" : idx + 1}
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  </TooltipTrigger>
                  <TooltipContent side="bottom" className="text-xs">
                    {slot.label}
                    {swapMode !== null && swapMode !== idx && " (click to swap)"}
                  </TooltipContent>
                </Tooltip>
              </TooltipProvider>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Main image display */}
          <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col">
            <div className="relative flex-1 flex items-center justify-center bg-muted/50 rounded-lg min-h-[260px] border border-border">
              {displayUrl ? (
                <>
                  <img
                    src={displayUrl}
                    alt={selectedSlot.label}
                    className="max-h-[280px] max-w-full object-contain cursor-zoom-in"
                    onClick={openLightbox}
                  />
                  {/* Fullscreen button */}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={openLightbox}
                    className="absolute top-2 right-2 p-1.5 rounded bg-black/40 text-white hover:bg-black/60 transition-colors"
                  >
                    <Maximize2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </button>
                </>
              ) : (
                <div className="text-center text-muted-foreground/70">
                  <ImagePlus className="h-8 w-8 mx-auto mb-1.5" />
                  <p className="text-xs">No image</p>
                  {!readOnly && (
                    <Button
                      variant="outline"
                      size="sm"
                      className="mt-2 text-xs"
                      onClick={() => setEditSlot(IMAGE_SLOTS[selectedIdx])}
                    >
                      Add URL
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Action buttons */}
            {!readOnly && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-2">
                <TooltipProvider delayDuration={300}>
                  <Tooltip>
                    <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                      <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        className="h-7 text-xs gap-1"
                        onClick={() =>
                          setEditSlot(IMAGE_SLOTS[selectedIdx])
                        }
                      >
                        <Edit3 className="h-3 w-3" />
                        Edit URL
                      </Button>
                    </TooltipTrigger>
                    <TooltipContent>Edit image URL</TooltipContent>
                  </Tooltip>
                </TooltipProvider>

                <TooltipProvider delayDuration={300}>
                  <Tooltip>
                    <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                      <Button
                        variant={swapMode !== null ? "default" : "outline"}
                        size="sm"
                        className={`h-7 text-xs gap-1 ${
                          swapMode !== null ? "bg-brand text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover" : ""
                        }`}
                        onClick={() =>
                          setSwapMode(
                            swapMode !== null ? null : selectedIdx
                          )
                        }
                      >
                        <ArrowLeftRight className="h-3 w-3" />
                        {swapMode !== null ? "Cancel swap" : "Swap"}
                      </Button>
                    </TooltipTrigger>
                    <TooltipContent>
                      {swapMode !== null
                        ? "Click another slot to swap"
                        : "Swap images between slots"}
                    </TooltipContent>
                  </Tooltip>
                </TooltipProvider>

                {displayUrl && (
                  <TooltipProvider delayDuration={300}>
                    <Tooltip>
                      <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                        <Button
                          variant="outline"
                          size="sm"
                          className="h-7 text-xs gap-1 text-red-500 hover:text-red-600 hover:bg-red-500/10"
                          onClick={() => handleClear(selectedIdx)}
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="h-3 w-3" />
                          Clear
                        </Button>
                      </TooltipTrigger>
                      <TooltipContent>Remove this image</TooltipContent>
                    </Tooltip>
                  </TooltipProvider>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Slot label + URL preview */}
            <div className="mt-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground/70 truncate">
              <span className="font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                {selectedSlot.label}
              </span>
              {displayUrl && (
                <span className="ml-1.5">{displayUrl}</span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Edit URL dialog */}
      <ImageUrlDialog
        open={editSlot !== null}
        onOpenChange={(open) => !open && setEditSlot(null)}
        slotLabel={editSlot?.label ?? ""}
        currentUrl={
          editSlot
            ? getProductFieldValue(product, editSlot.bqName) || ""
            : ""
        }
        onSave={handleEditUrl}
      />

      {/* Lightbox */}
      {lightboxIdx !== null && filledImages.length > 0 && (
        <ImageLightbox
          images={filledImages}
          initialIndex={lightboxIdx}
          onClose={() => setLightboxIdx(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/products/image-lightbox.tsx

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { X, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";

type Props = {
  images: { url: string; label: string }[];
  initialIndex: number;
  onClose: () => void;
};

export function ImageLightbox({ images, initialIndex, onClose }: Props) {
  const [currentIdx, setCurrentIdx] = useState(initialIndex);

  const goNext = useCallback(() => {
    setCurrentIdx((i) => (i + 1) % images.length);
  }, [images.length]);

  const goPrev = useCallback(() => {
    setCurrentIdx((i) => (i - 1 + images.length) % images.length);
  }, [images.length]);

  // Keyboard navigation
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      switch (e.key) {
        case "Escape":
          onClose();
          break;
        case "ArrowRight":
          goNext();
          break;
        case "ArrowLeft":
          goPrev();
          break;
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", handleKey);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKey);
  }, [onClose, goNext, goPrev]);

  // Prevent body scrolling
  useEffect(() => {
    const prev = document.body.style.overflow;
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = prev;
    };
  }, []);

  const current = images[currentIdx];
  if (!current) return null;

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] bg-black/90 flex items-center justify-center"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      {/* Close button */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onClose}
        className="absolute top-4 right-4 z-10 p-2 rounded-full bg-card/10 text-white hover:bg-card/20 transition-colors"
      >
        <X className="h-5 w-5" />
      </button>

      {/* Image counter */}
      <div className="absolute top-4 left-4 z-10 text-white/70 text-sm">
        {currentIdx + 1} / {images.length}
        <span className="ml-2 text-white/50">{current.label}</span>
      </div>

      {/* Previous button */}
      {images.length > 1 && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            goPrev();
          }}
          className="absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-10 p-2 rounded-full bg-card/10 text-white hover:bg-card/20 transition-colors"
        >
          <ChevronLeft className="h-6 w-6" />
        </button>
      )}

      {/* Main image */}
      <img
        src={current.url}
        alt={current.label}
        className="max-h-[90vh] max-w-[90vw] object-contain select-none"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
        draggable={false}
      />

      {/* Next button */}
      {images.length > 1 && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            goNext();
          }}
          className="absolute right-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-10 p-2 rounded-full bg-card/10 text-white hover:bg-card/20 transition-colors"
        >
          <ChevronRight className="h-6 w-6" />
        </button>
      )}

      {/* Thumbnail strip */}
      {images.length > 1 && (
        <div className="absolute bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-10 flex gap-2">
          {images.map((img, idx) => (
            <button
              key={idx}
              type="button"
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                setCurrentIdx(idx);
              }}
              className={`h-12 w-12 rounded border-2 overflow-hidden transition-all ${
                idx === currentIdx
                  ? "border-white scale-110"
                  : "border-white/30 opacity-60 hover:opacity-100"
              }`}
            >
              <img
                src={img.url}
                alt={img.label}
                className="h-full w-full object-cover"
              />
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/products/image-url-dialog.tsx

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import {
  Loader2,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertCircle,
  ImageOff,
} from "lucide-react";

type PreviewState = "idle" | "loading" | "valid" | "invalid";

type Props = {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  slotLabel: string;
  currentUrl: string;
  onSave: (url: string) => Promise<void>;
};

export function ImageUrlDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  slotLabel,
  currentUrl,
  onSave,
}: Props) {
  const [url, setUrl] = useState(currentUrl);
  const [previewState, setPreviewState] = useState<PreviewState>("idle");
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const debounceRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  // Reset state when dialog opens
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) {
      setUrl(currentUrl);
      setPreviewState(currentUrl ? "loading" : "idle");
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }, [open, currentUrl]);

  // Debounced URL validation via image load test
  const validateUrl = useCallback((testUrl: string) => {
    if (!testUrl.trim()) {
      setPreviewState("idle");
      return;
    }
    setPreviewState("loading");
    const img = new Image();
    img.onload = () => setPreviewState("valid");
    img.onerror = () => setPreviewState("invalid");
    img.src = testUrl;
  }, []);

  const handleUrlChange = useCallback(
    (newUrl: string) => {
      setUrl(newUrl);
      if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
      debounceRef.current = setTimeout(() => validateUrl(newUrl), 500);
    },
    [validateUrl]
  );

  // Cleanup timer
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  const handleSave = useCallback(async () => {
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await onSave(url);
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }, [url, onSave]);

  const handleKeyDown = useCallback(
    (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Enter" && !saving) {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleSave();
      }
    },
    [saving, handleSave]
  );

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-lg">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Edit {slotLabel} URL</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Enter an image URL. A live preview will confirm the image loads
            correctly.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="space-y-4">
          {/* URL input */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="image-url" className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              Image URL
            </Label>
            <div className="relative">
              <Input
                id="image-url"
                type="url"
                placeholder="https://images-na.ssl-images-amazon.com/..."
                value={url}
                onChange={(e) => handleUrlChange(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
                className="pr-8"
                autoFocus
              />
              <div className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2">
                {previewState === "loading" && (
                  <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin text-muted-foreground/70" />
                )}
                {previewState === "valid" && (
                  <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
                )}
                {previewState === "invalid" && (
                  <AlertCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-red-500" />
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Live preview */}
          <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/50 flex items-center justify-center min-h-[200px] overflow-hidden">
            {previewState === "valid" && url ? (
              <img
                src={url}
                alt="Preview"
                className="max-h-[200px] max-w-full object-contain"
              />
            ) : previewState === "loading" ? (
              <div className="text-center text-muted-foreground/70">
                <Loader2 className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin mx-auto mb-1" />
                <p className="text-xs">Loading preview...</p>
              </div>
            ) : previewState === "invalid" ? (
              <div className="text-center text-red-400">
                <ImageOff className="h-6 w-6 mx-auto mb-1" />
                <p className="text-xs">Failed to load image</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center text-muted-foreground/80">
                <ImageOff className="h-6 w-6 mx-auto mb-1" />
                <p className="text-xs">Enter a URL to preview</p>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <DialogFooter>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
            disabled={saving}
          >
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleSave}
            disabled={saving}
            className="bg-brand text-brand-foreground hover:bg-brand-hover"
          >
            {saving ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin mr-1" />
                Saving...
              </>
            ) : (
              "Save"
            )}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/products/impact-card.tsx

"use client";

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { TrendingUp, TrendingDown, Clock, BarChart3, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

interface DeltaValue {
  absolute: number;
  percentage: number | null;
}

interface ImpactData {
  status: "no_baseline" | "pending" | "ready";
  before: { avgDailyUnits: number | null; avgDailyRevenue: number | null; avgDailySessions: number | null } | null;
  after: { avgDailyUnits: number | null; avgDailyRevenue: number | null; avgDailySessions: number | null } | null;
  delta: { units: DeltaValue | null; revenue: DeltaValue | null; sessions: DeltaValue | null } | null;
  daysRemaining: number | null;
  liveAt: string | null;
}

function DeltaDisplay({ label, delta }: { label: string; delta: DeltaValue | null }) {
  if (!delta) return null;

  const isPositive = delta.percentage !== null ? delta.percentage > 0 : delta.absolute > 0;
  const Icon = isPositive ? TrendingUp : TrendingDown;
  const color = isPositive ? "text-emerald-600" : "text-red-500";

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between py-1.5">
      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
      <span className={`flex items-center gap-1 text-sm font-medium ${color}`}>
        <Icon className="h-3 w-3" />
        {delta.percentage !== null
          ? `${delta.percentage > 0 ? "+" : ""}${delta.percentage}%`
          : `${delta.absolute > 0 ? "+" : ""}${delta.absolute}`}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

export function ImpactCard({ productId }: { productId: string }) {
  const { data, isLoading, isError } = useQuery<ImpactData>({
    queryKey: ["product-impact", productId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${productId}/impact`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load impact data");
      return res.json();
    },
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-card p-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" />
          Loading impact data...
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (isError || !data) {
    return null; // Silently hide on error — non-critical component
  }

  if (data.status === "no_baseline") {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-card p-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
          <BarChart3 className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          <span className="text-sm font-medium">Content Impact</span>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          No impact baseline recorded yet. Mark A+ content as &ldquo;live&rdquo; to start tracking.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (data.status === "pending") {
    const progress = data.daysRemaining !== null ? Math.round(((14 - data.daysRemaining) / 14) * 100) : 0;

    return (
      <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-card p-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
          <Clock className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-500" />
          <span className="text-sm font-medium">Content Impact</span>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-2">
          Tracking in progress — {data.daysRemaining} day{data.daysRemaining !== 1 ? "s" : ""} remaining
        </p>
        <div className="h-1.5 rounded-full bg-muted overflow-hidden">
          <div
            className="h-full rounded-full bg-amber-500 transition-all"
            style={{ width: `${progress}%` }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // status === 'ready'
  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-card p-4">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
        <BarChart3 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-500" />
        <span className="text-sm font-medium">Content Impact</span>
      </div>
      <div className="divide-y divide-border">
        <DeltaDisplay label="Units/day" delta={data.delta?.units ?? null} />
        <DeltaDisplay
          label="Revenue/day"
          delta={
            data.delta?.revenue
              ? {
                  ...data.delta.revenue,
                  absolute: Math.round(data.delta.revenue.absolute / 100), // cents → dollars
                }
              : null
          }
        />
        <DeltaDisplay label="Sessions/day" delta={data.delta?.sessions ?? null} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
