"use client";

import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight, ExternalLink, Loader2, Check, X } from "lucide-react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { getProductFieldValue } from "@/lib/product-mapper";
import type { Product } from "@/lib/db/schema";

const STATUS_OPTIONS = [
  "Active",
  "Inactive",
  "Incomplete",
  "Out of Stock",
  "Closed",
  "Discontinued",
];

const STATUS_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  Active: "bg-emerald-700 text-emerald-100 border-emerald-600",
  Inactive: "bg-zinc-600 text-zinc-200 border-zinc-500",
  Closed: "bg-red-700 text-red-100 border-red-600",
  Discontinued: "bg-orange-700 text-orange-100 border-orange-600",
  Incomplete: "bg-yellow-700 text-yellow-100 border-yellow-600",
  "Out of Stock": "bg-purple-700 text-purple-100 border-purple-600",
};

/** Field definitions in the requested order */
const FIELDS: {
  bqName: string;
  label: string;
  type: "text" | "url" | "computed" | "status";
  width?: string;
}[] = [
  { bqName: "Status", label: "Status", type: "status" },
  { bqName: "UUID", label: "UUID", type: "computed" },
  { bqName: "ASIN", label: "ASIN", type: "text", width: "w-48" },
  { bqName: "SKU", label: "SKU", type: "text", width: "w-48" },
  { bqName: "SummarizedTitle", label: "Summarized Title", type: "computed" },
  { bqName: "AmazonPDPURL", label: "Amazon URL", type: "url" },
  { bqName: "WebsitePDPURL", label: "Website URL", type: "url" },
  { bqName: "ClientIDCode", label: "Client ID Code", type: "text", width: "w-48" },
  { bqName: "Marketplace", label: "Marketplace", type: "text", width: "w-48" },
  { bqName: "Country", label: "Country", type: "text", width: "w-48" },
  { bqName: "IntentwiseID", label: "Intentwise ID", type: "text", width: "w-48" },
];

type Props = {
  product: Product;
  readOnly: boolean;
  onSave: (bqName: string, value: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  onFieldSaved?: (
    bqName: string,
    label: string,
    oldValue: string,
    newValue: string
  ) => void;
  expanded?: boolean;
  onExpandedChange?: (expanded: boolean) => void;
};

export function ListingIdentitySection({
  product,
  readOnly,
  onSave,
  onFieldSaved,
  expanded: controlledExpanded,
  onExpandedChange,
}: Props) {
  const [internalExpanded, setInternalExpanded] = useState(true);
  const expanded =
    controlledExpanded !== undefined ? controlledExpanded : internalExpanded;

  const populatedCount = FIELDS.filter((f) => {
    const val = getProductFieldValue(product, f.bqName);
    return val != null && val !== "";
  }).length;

  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-card text-card-foreground">
      <button
        onClick={() => {
          const next = !expanded;
          setInternalExpanded(next);
          onExpandedChange?.(next);
        }}
        className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 w-full px-4 py-2.5 text-left hover:bg-muted/50 transition-colors"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
          {expanded ? (
            <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
          ) : (
            <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
          )}
          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-section-title">
            Listing Identity
          </span>
        </div>
        <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs shrink-0 tabular-nums">
          {populatedCount}/{FIELDS.length}
        </Badge>
      </button>

      {expanded && (
        <div className="border-t border-border px-4 py-2 space-y-0">
          {FIELDS.map((field) => {
            const value = getProductFieldValue(product, field.bqName) ?? "";

            if (field.type === "status") {
              return (
                <StatusField
                  key={field.bqName}
                  label={field.label}
                  bqName={field.bqName}
                  value={value}
                  readOnly={readOnly}
                  onSave={onSave}
                  onFieldSaved={onFieldSaved}
                />
              );
            }

            if (field.type === "url") {
              return (
                <UrlField
                  key={field.bqName}
                  label={field.label}
                  bqName={field.bqName}
                  value={value}
                  readOnly={readOnly}
                  onSave={onSave}
                  onFieldSaved={onFieldSaved}
                />
              );
            }

            if (field.type === "computed") {
              return (
                <ComputedField
                  key={field.bqName}
                  label={field.label}
                  value={value}
                />
              );
            }

            return (
              <EditableField
                key={field.bqName}
                label={field.label}
                bqName={field.bqName}
                value={value}
                readOnly={readOnly}
                onSave={onSave}
                onFieldSaved={onFieldSaved}
                width={field.width}
              />
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Status field with color chip dropdown */
function StatusField({
  label,
  bqName,
  value,
  readOnly,
  onSave,
  onFieldSaved,
}: {
  label: string;
  bqName: string;
  value: string;
  readOnly: boolean;
  onSave: (bqName: string, value: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  onFieldSaved?: (bqName: string, label: string, oldValue: string, newValue: string) => void;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const handler = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target as Node)) setOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handler);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handler);
  }, [open]);

  const handleSelect = async (newVal: string) => {
    if (newVal === value) {
      setOpen(false);
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await onSave(bqName, newVal || null);
      onFieldSaved?.(bqName, label, value, newVal);
      toast.success(`${label} updated`);
    } catch {
      toast.error(`Failed to update ${label}`);
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
      setOpen(false);
    }
  };

  const colors = STATUS_COLORS[value] ?? "bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border";

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 py-0.5" id={`field-${bqName}`} ref={ref}>
      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground shrink-0 w-32 truncate">
        {label}
      </span>
      <div className="relative">
        <button
          type="button"
          disabled={readOnly || saving}
          onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          <span
            className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium ${colors} ${
              !readOnly ? "cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80" : ""
            }`}
          >
            {saving ? (
              <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin mr-1" />
            ) : null}
            {value || "—"}
          </span>
          {!readOnly && (
            <ChevronDown className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground" />
          )}
        </button>

        {open && (
          <div className="absolute top-full left-0 z-50 mt-1 rounded-md border border-border bg-popover shadow-md py-1 min-w-[140px]">
            {STATUS_OPTIONS.map((opt) => (
              <button
                key={opt}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs hover:bg-muted transition-colors text-left"
                onClick={() => handleSelect(opt)}
              >
                <span
                  className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium ${
                    STATUS_COLORS[opt]
                  }`}
                >
                  {opt}
                </span>
                {opt === value && <Check className="h-3 w-3 ml-auto" />}
              </button>
            ))}
            <div className="border-t border-border my-1" />
            <button
              className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full px-3 py-1.5 text-xs hover:bg-muted transition-colors text-left text-muted-foreground"
              onClick={() => handleSelect("")}
            >
              None
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** URL field — displays as clickable link + editable */
function UrlField({
  label,
  bqName,
  value,
  readOnly,
  onSave,
  onFieldSaved,
}: {
  label: string;
  bqName: string;
  value: string;
  readOnly: boolean;
  onSave: (bqName: string, value: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  onFieldSaved?: (bqName: string, label: string, oldValue: string, newValue: string) => void;
}) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [localValue, setLocalValue] = useState(value);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setLocalValue(value);
  }, [value]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (editing) inputRef.current?.focus();
  }, [editing]);

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (localValue === value) {
      setEditing(false);
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await onSave(bqName, localValue || null);
      onFieldSaved?.(bqName, label, value, localValue);
    } catch {
      toast.error(`Failed to update ${label}`);
      setLocalValue(value);
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
      setEditing(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 py-0.5" id={`field-${bqName}`}>
      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground shrink-0 w-32 truncate">
        {label}
      </span>
      {editing ? (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 flex-1 min-w-0">
          <input
            ref={inputRef}
            type="url"
            value={localValue}
            onChange={(e) => setLocalValue(e.target.value)}
            onBlur={handleSave}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === "Enter") handleSave();
              if (e.key === "Escape") {
                setLocalValue(value);
                setEditing(false);
              }
            }}
            className="flex-1 min-w-0 h-6 px-1.5text-xs rounded border border-border bg-field-bg text-field-text focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand"
            disabled={saving}
          />
          {saving && <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0 flex-1">
          {value ? (
            <a
              href={value}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              className="text-xs text-blue-500 hover:underline truncate"
            >
              {value}
            </a>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/50">—</span>
          )}
          {value && (
            <a
              href={value}
              target="_blank"
              rel="noopener noreferrer"
              className="shrink-0 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
            >
              <ExternalLink className="h-3 w-3" />
            </a>
          )}
          {!readOnly && (
            <button
              onClick={() => setEditing(true)}
              className="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground ml-1"
            >
              edit
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Computed (read-only) field — adapts to content size */
function ComputedField({
  label,
  value,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 py-0.5" id={`field-${label === "UUID" ? "UUID" : label === "Summarized Title" ? "SummarizedTitle" : label}`}>
      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground shrink-0 w-32 truncate">
        {label}
      </span>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
        <span className="text-xs text-foreground/80 font-mono truncate">
          {value || <span className="text-muted-foreground/50">—</span>}
        </span>
        <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-[10px] leading-none font-medium border whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 bg-violet-500/15 text-violet-400 border-violet-500/30">
          Auto
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Editable text field with inline editing */
function EditableField({
  label,
  bqName,
  value,
  readOnly,
  onSave,
  onFieldSaved,
  width,
}: {
  label: string;
  bqName: string;
  value: string;
  readOnly: boolean;
  onSave: (bqName: string, value: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  onFieldSaved?: (bqName: string, label: string, oldValue: string, newValue: string) => void;
  width?: string;
}) {
  const [localValue, setLocalValue] = useState(value);
  const [saveState, setSaveState] = useState<"idle" | "saving" | "saved" | "error">("idle");
  const debounceRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setLocalValue(value);
  }, [value]);

  const doSave = useCallback(
    async (newVal: string) => {
      if (newVal === value) return;
      setSaveState("saving");
      try {
        await onSave(bqName, newVal || null);
        onFieldSaved?.(bqName, label, value, newVal);
        setSaveState("saved");
        setTimeout(() => setSaveState("idle"), 1500);
      } catch {
        setSaveState("error");
        toast.error(`Failed to save ${label}`);
        setTimeout(() => setSaveState("idle"), 2000);
      }
    },
    [bqName, label, value, onSave, onFieldSaved]
  );

  const handleChange = (newVal: string) => {
    setLocalValue(newVal);
    if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
    debounceRef.current = setTimeout(() => doSave(newVal), 600);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 py-0.5" id={`field-${bqName}`}>
      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground shrink-0 w-32 truncate">
        {label}
      </span>
      {readOnly ? (
        <span className="text-xs text-foreground/80">
          {value || <span className="text-muted-foreground/50">—</span>}
        </span>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
          <input
            type="text"
            data-field-bq={bqName}
            value={localValue}
            onChange={(e) => handleChange(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === "Enter") {
                if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
                doSave(localValue);
              }
            }}
            className={`h-7 px-2 text-xs rounded border border-border bg-field-bg text-field-text focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand ${
              width ?? "flex-1 min-w-0"
            }`}
          />
          {saveState === "saving" && (
            <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
          )}
          {saveState === "saved" && (
            <Check className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-500 shrink-0" />
          )}
          {saveState === "error" && (
            <X className="h-3 w-3 text-destructive shrink-0" />
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { Settings2 } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Popover,
  PopoverContent,
  PopoverTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/popover";
import {
  Command,
  CommandEmpty,
  CommandGroup,
  CommandInput,
  CommandItem,
  CommandList,
} from "@/components/ui/command";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { useColumnAttributes, type EnrichedAttribute } from "@/hooks/use-column-attributes";
import {
  REQUIREMENT_COLORS,
  REQUIREMENT_SHORT_LABELS,
  type RequirementLevel,
} from "@/lib/constants";

type Props = {
  clientCode?: string;
  selectedAttrs: EnrichedAttribute[];
  onSelectedChange: (attrs: EnrichedAttribute[]) => void;
};

export function ProductColumnPicker({
  clientCode,
  selectedAttrs,
  onSelectedChange,
}: Props) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const { groups, isLoading } = useColumnAttributes(clientCode);

  const selectedKeys = useMemo(
    () => new Set(selectedAttrs.map((a) => a.generalLabel)),
    [selectedAttrs]
  );

  // Flat list for lookup by generalLabel
  const allAttrs = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, EnrichedAttribute>();
    for (const group of groups) {
      for (const sub of group.subgroups) {
        for (const attr of sub.attributes) {
          map.set(attr.generalLabel, attr);
        }
      }
    }
    return map;
  }, [groups]);

  const toggle = (attr: EnrichedAttribute) => {
    if (selectedKeys.has(attr.generalLabel)) {
      onSelectedChange(
        selectedAttrs.filter((a) => a.generalLabel !== attr.generalLabel)
      );
    } else {
      onSelectedChange([...selectedAttrs, attr]);
    }
  };

  const count = selectedAttrs.length;

  return (
    <Popover open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <PopoverTrigger asChild>
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="gap-1.5">
          <Settings2 className="h-4 w-4" />
          Columns
          {count > 0 && (
            <Badge
              variant="secondary"
              className="ml-0.5 h-5 min-w-[20px] px-1 text-xs bg-brand text-brand-foreground"
            >
              {count}
            </Badge>
          )}
        </Button>
      </PopoverTrigger>
      <PopoverContent className="w-[340px] p-0" align="end">
        <Command>
          <CommandInput placeholder="Search attributes..." />
          <CommandList className="max-h-[320px]">
            <CommandEmpty>
              {isLoading ? "Loading attributes..." : "No attributes found."}
            </CommandEmpty>
            {groups.map((group) => (
              <CommandGroup key={group.name} heading={group.name}>
                {group.subgroups.flatMap((sub) =>
                  sub.attributes.map((attr) => {
                    const isSelected = selectedKeys.has(attr.generalLabel);
                    const req = (attr.clientRequirement || "") as RequirementLevel;
                    const shortLabel = REQUIREMENT_SHORT_LABELS[req];
                    const colorClass = REQUIREMENT_COLORS[req];
                    return (
                      <CommandItem
                        key={attr.generalLabel}
                        value={attr.generalLabel}
                        onSelect={() => toggle(attr)}
                        className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        <span
                          className={`flex h-4 w-4 items-center justify-center rounded border ${
                            isSelected
                              ? "bg-brand border-brand text-brand-foreground"
                              : "border-muted-foreground/40"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {isSelected && (
                            <svg width="10" height="10" viewBox="0 0 10 10">
                              <path
                                d="M1.5 5L4 7.5L8.5 2.5"
                                stroke="currentColor"
                                strokeWidth="1.5"
                                fill="none"
                              />
                            </svg>
                          )}
                        </span>
                        <span className="flex-1 truncate text-xs">
                          {attr.generalLabel}
                        </span>
                        {shortLabel && colorClass && (
                          <span
                            className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-1.5 py-0 text-[10px] font-medium leading-4 ${colorClass}`}
                          >
                            {shortLabel}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </CommandItem>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </CommandGroup>
            ))}
          </CommandList>
        </Command>
        {count > 0 && (
          <div className="border-t p-2 flex justify-between items-center">
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {count} column{count !== 1 ? "s" : ""} selected
            </span>
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              className="h-7 text-xs"
              onClick={() => onSelectedChange([])}
            >
              Clear all
            </Button>
          </div>
        )}
      </PopoverContent>
    </Popover>
  );
}

/**
 * Find the common prefix/suffix between two strings and return segments
 * so only the changed middle part can be highlighted.
 */
function diffHighlight(
  oldStr: string,
  newStr: string
): { old: { prefix: string; changed: string; suffix: string }; new: { prefix: string; changed: string; suffix: string } } {
  let prefixLen = 0;
  const minLen = Math.min(oldStr.length, newStr.length);
  while (prefixLen < minLen && oldStr[prefixLen] === newStr[prefixLen]) {
    prefixLen++;
  }

  let suffixLen = 0;
  while (
    suffixLen < minLen - prefixLen &&
    oldStr[oldStr.length - 1 - suffixLen] === newStr[newStr.length - 1 - suffixLen]
  ) {
    suffixLen++;
  }

  const prefix = oldStr.slice(0, prefixLen);
  const oldChanged = oldStr.slice(prefixLen, oldStr.length - suffixLen);
  const newChanged = newStr.slice(prefixLen, newStr.length - suffixLen);
  const suffix = oldStr.slice(oldStr.length - suffixLen);

  return {
    old: { prefix, changed: oldChanged, suffix },
    new: { prefix, changed: newChanged, suffix },
  };
}

type ProductWithComments = Product & {
  _commentCounts?: Record<string, { total: number; open: number }>;

async function fetchProduct(id: string): Promise<ProductWithComments> {
  const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${id}`);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch product");
  return res.json();

export function ProductDetailForm({ productId }: Props) {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const isReadOnly = session?.user?.role === "viewer";
  const [showAll, setShowAll] = useState(false);
  const [activeRequirementFilters, setActiveRequirementFilters] = useState<Set<RequirementLevel>>(new Set());

  const { data: product, isLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["product", productId],
    queryFn: () => fetchProduct(productId),
  });

  // Fetch column attributes enriched with client-specific requirements
  const clientCode = product?.clientIdCode || undefined;
  const { groups, byGeneralLabel, isLoading: attrsLoading } =
    useColumnAttributes(clientCode);

  // Fetch Amazon category definition for this product's productType
  const { groups: categoryGroups } = useCategoryDefinition(
    product?.productType || undefined,
    clientCode,
    productId,
    product?.marketplace || undefined
  );

  // Build lookup: bibleFieldMatch (generalLabel) → AmazonFieldMeta
  const amazonMetaByField = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, AmazonFieldMeta>();
    for (const group of categoryGroups) {
      for (const attr of group.attributes) {
        if (attr.bibleFieldMatch) {
          map.set(attr.bibleFieldMatch, {
            amazonFieldName: attr.amazonFieldName,
            localLabel: attr.localLabel,
            requirement: attr.requirement,
            description: attr.description,
            example: attr.example,
            validValues: attr.validValues,
          });
        }
      }
    }
    return map;
  }, [categoryGroups]);

  // Session edit tracking
  const [fieldEdits, setFieldEdits] = useState<Map<string, FieldEdit>>(
    new Map()
  );

  const onFieldSaved = useCallback(
    (bqName: string, fieldLabel: string, oldValue: string, newValue: string) => {
      setFieldEdits((prev) => {
        const next = new Map(prev);
        next.set(bqName, {
          bqName,
          label: fieldLabel,
          oldValue,
          newValue,
          savedAt: new Date(),
        });
        return next;
      });
    },
    []
  );

  const revertMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${productId}/revert`, {
        method: "POST",
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const error = await res.json();
        throw new Error(error.error || "Failed to revert");
      }
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["product", productId] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["products"] });
      setFieldEdits(new Map());
      toast.success(`Reverted ${data.reverted} field(s) to original values`);
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      toast.error(err.message);
    },
  });

  const saveMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      bqName,
      value,
      field,
    }: {
      bqName: string;
      value: string | null;
      field: string | null;
    }) => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${productId}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ field, value, bqName }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const error = await res.json();
        throw new Error(error.error || "Failed to save");
      }
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["product", productId] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["products"] });
    },
  });

  const handleSave = useCallback(
    async (bqName: string, value: string | null): Promise<void> => {
      // Enforce ASIN must be exactly 10 characters
      if ((bqName === "ASIN" || bqName === "ParentASIN") && value != null && value.length !== 10) {
        toast.error("ASIN must be exactly 10 characters");
        throw new Error("ASIN must be exactly 10 characters");
      }
      const coreDef = CORE_COLUMNS.find((c) => c.bqName === bqName);
      await saveMutation.mutateAsync({
        bqName,
        value,
        field: coreDef?.coreField ?? null,
      });
    },
    [saveMutation]
  );

  // Section expansion tracking (for jump-to-field)
  const [expandedSections, setExpandedSections] = useState<Set<string>>(
    new Set()
  );
const handleSectionExpandedChange = useCallback(
    (sectionName: string, expanded: boolean) => {
      setExpandedSections((prev) => {
        const next = new Set(prev);
        if (expanded) next.add(sectionName);
        else next.delete(sectionName);
        return next;
      });
    },
    []
  );

  const handleSelectField = useCallback(
    (bqName: string, referenceGroup: string) => {
      // Expand the target section
      setExpandedSections((prev) => {
        const next = new Set(prev);
        next.add(referenceGroup);
        return next;
      });

      // Wait for DOM update, then scroll and focus
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        setTimeout(() => {
          // Try the field input first (for SEO fields that use bqName directly)
          const inputEl = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
            `[data-field-bq="${bqName}"]`
          );
          // Fall back to the wrapper div
          const wrapperEl = document.getElementById(`field-${bqName}`);
          const targetEl = inputEl || wrapperEl;

          if (targetEl) {
            targetEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
            // Focus the input — inputEl is already the input/textarea,
            // otherwise query inside the wrapper
            const input =
              inputEl ??
              wrapperEl?.querySelector<HTMLElement>("input, textarea");
            if (
              input instanceof HTMLInputElement ||
              input instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement
            ) {
              input.focus();
            }
            // Gold ring highlight
            const ringTarget = wrapperEl || targetEl;
            ringTarget.classList.add("ring-2", "ring-brand", "rounded-md");
            setTimeout(
              () =>
                ringTarget.classList.remove(
                  "ring-2",
                  "ring-brand",
                  "rounded-md"
                ),
              2000
            );
          }
        }, 150);
      });
    },
    []
  );

  const handleToggleRequirement = useCallback((level: RequirementLevel) => {
    setActiveRequirementFilters((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(level)) {
        next.delete(level);
      } else {
        next.add(level);
      }
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  // Compute requirement breakdown for this client
  const requirementBreakdown = useMemo(() => {
    if (!clientCode) return {};
    const breakdown: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const attr of byGeneralLabel.values()) {
      const req = attr.clientRequirement || "";
      if (req && req !== "Not Required") {
        breakdown[req] = (breakdown[req] || 0) + 1;
      }
    }
    return breakdown;
  }, [byGeneralLabel, clientCode]);

  // Filter logic: requirement chip filters + "relevant only" mode
  const isFieldRelevant = useCallback(
    (attr: EnrichedAttribute, fieldValue: string | null): boolean => {
      const req = (attr.clientRequirement || "") as RequirementLevel;

      // If requirement chip filters are active, only show matching fields
      if (activeRequirementFilters.size > 0) {
        return activeRequirementFilters.has(req);
      }

      if (showAll) return true;
      // If requirement is empty or "Not Required" AND value is empty, hide it
      if ((req === "" || req === "Not Required") && (!fieldValue || fieldValue === "")) {
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    },
    [showAll, activeRequirementFilters]
  );

  // Count visible vs total columns
  const columnCounts = useMemo(() => {
    if (!product) return { visible: 0, total: 0 };
    let visible = 0;
    let total = 0;
    for (const attr of byGeneralLabel.values()) {
      total++;
      const val = getProductFieldValue(product, attr.generalLabel);
      if (isFieldRelevant(attr, val)) visible++;
    }
    return { visible, total };
  }, [product, byGeneralLabel, isFieldRelevant]);

  if (isLoading || attrsLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <Skeleton className="h-8 w-64" />
        <Skeleton className="h-[400px] w-full" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!product) {
    return <p className="text-muted-foreground">Product not found.</p>;
  }

  const commentCounts = product._commentCounts ?? {};
  const commentTotalOpen = Object.values(commentCounts).reduce(
    (sum, c) => sum + c.open,
    0
  );
  const commentFieldCount = Object.values(commentCounts).filter(
    (c) => c.open > 0
  ).length;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Back button + badges */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 sticky top-0 z-30 bg-background py-2 -mx-6 px-6 lg:-mx-10 lg:px-10 -mt-4 border-b border-border">
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" asChild className="shrink-0">
          <Link href={product.clientIdCode ? `/products?client=${product.clientIdCode}` : "/products"}>
            <ArrowLeft className="mr-1 h-4 w-4" />
            Back
          </Link>
        </Button>
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" asChild className="shrink-0">
          <Link href={`/aplus/${product.id}`}>
            <LayoutTemplate className="mr-1 h-4 w-4" />
            A+ Content
          </Link>
        </Button>
        {product.asin && (
          <Badge variant="outline" className="font-mono shrink-0">
            {product.asin}
          </Badge>
        )}
        {product.sku && (
          <Badge variant="outline" className="font-mono shrink-0 max-w-[200px] truncate">
            {product.sku}
          </Badge>
        )}
        <VarietyPackBadge productId={productId} />
        {product.isDirty && (
          <>
            <Link href="/publish">
              <Badge
                variant="default"
                className="shrink-0 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-90"
                style={{ backgroundColor: "var(--brand)", color: "var(--brand-foreground)" }}
              >
                Unsaved changes
              </Badge>
            </Link>
            {!isReadOnly && (
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                size="sm"
                className="shrink-0 text-destructive hover:text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10 text-xs h-7 gap-1"
                disabled={revertMutation.isPending}
                onClick={() => {
                  if (confirm("Discard all unpublished changes and restore original values?")) {
                    revertMutation.mutate();
                  }
                }}
              >
                <Undo2 className="h-3 w-3" />
                {revertMutation.isPending ? "Reverting..." : "Discard"}
              </Button>
            )}
          </>
        )}
        {isReadOnly && (
          <Badge variant="secondary" className="shrink-0">Read-only</Badge>
        )}
        <div className="ml-auto shrink-0">
          <FieldSearch
            product={product}
            clientIdCode={clientCode}
            attributes={[...byGeneralLabel.values()]}
            onSelectField={handleSelectField}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Amazon PDP-style hero with integrated image gallery */}
      <ProductPdp
        product={product}
        productId={productId}
        readOnly={isReadOnly}
        onSave={handleSave}
        onFieldSaved={onFieldSaved}
      />

      {/* Listing Identity | Product Identity | Variations — top row */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 items-start">
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <ListingIdentitySection
            product={product}
            readOnly={isReadOnly}
            onSave={handleSave}
            onFieldSaved={onFieldSaved}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="min-w-0">
          <ProductIdentitySection
            product={product}
            readOnly={isReadOnly}
            onSave={handleSave}
            onFieldSaved={onFieldSaved}
          />
        </div>
        <div className="min-w-0 space-y-4">
          <VariationSection
            product={product}
            readOnly={isReadOnly}
            onSave={handleSave}
            onFieldSaved={onFieldSaved}
          />
          {clientCode && (
            <CompletenessCard
              product={product}
              clientIdCode={clientCode}
              attributes={[...byGeneralLabel.values()]}
            />
          )}
          <ImpactCard
            clientIdCode={clientCode}
            productId={productId}
            limit={3}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Variety Pack Composition */}
      <VarietyPackSection product={product} readOnly={isReadOnly} />

      {/* Amazon Category Attributes */}
      {product.productType && (
        <AmazonCategoryAttributes
          productType={product.productType}
          product={product}
          clientIdCode={clientCode}
          marketplaceId={product.marketplace || undefined}
          excludeFields={DIMENSIONS_SECTION_FIELDS}
          excludeGroups={EXCLUDE_CATEGORY_GROUPS}
        />
      )}

      {/* Hub vs Amazon Comparison */}
      {product.asin && (
        <Collapsible defaultOpen={false}>
          <CollapsibleTrigger className="flex items-center justify-between w-full px-4 py-2.5 bg-card rounded-lg hover:bg-muted transition-colors">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Scale className="h-4 w-4 text-brand" />
              <span className="text-sm font-medium text-white">
                Hub vs Amazon
              </span>
            </div>
            <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground/70" />
          </CollapsibleTrigger>
          <CollapsibleContent className="mt-2">
            <AmazonComparison productId={productId} product={product} />
          </CollapsibleContent>
        </Collapsible>
      )}

      {/* Hub vs Amazon Live (Rainforest) */}
      {product.asin && (
        <Collapsible defaultOpen={false}>
          <CollapsibleTrigger className="flex items-center justify-between w-full px-4 py-2.5 bg-card rounded-lg hover:bg-muted transition-colors">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Globe className="h-4 w-4" style={{ color: "#FF9900" }} />
              <span className="text-sm font-medium text-white">
                Amazon Live Check
              </span>
            </div>
            <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground/70" />
          </CollapsibleTrigger>
          <CollapsibleContent className="mt-2">
            <AmazonLiveComparison asin={product.asin} catalogProduct={product} />
          </CollapsibleContent>
        </Collapsible>
      )}

      {/* Dirty fields summary bar */}
      {fieldEdits.size > 0 && (
        <div className="sticky top-0 z-20 flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-border bg-card text-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Check className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-400" />
            <span>
              <strong>{fieldEdits.size}</strong> field
              {fieldEdits.size !== 1 ? "s" : ""} saved this session
            </span>
          </div>
          <Popover>
            <PopoverTrigger asChild>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-brand hover:underline"
              >
                <Eye className="h-3 w-3" />
                View changes
              </button>
            </PopoverTrigger>
            <PopoverContent
              align="start"
              className="w-[32rem] max-h-96 overflow-y-auto p-4"
            >
              <h4 className="text-sm font-medium mb-3">
                Changes this session
              </h4>
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {[...fieldEdits.values()]
                  .sort(
                    (a, b) => b.savedAt.getTime() - a.savedAt.getTime()
                  )
                  .map((edit) => {
                    const oldV = edit.oldValue || "";
                    const newV = edit.newValue || "";
                    const isEmpty = !oldV && !newV;
                    const isNew = !oldV && newV;
                    const isCleared = oldV && !newV;
                    const diff =
                      !isEmpty && !isNew && !isCleared
                        ? diffHighlight(oldV, newV)
                        : null;

                    return (
                      <div
                        key={edit.bqName}
                        className="text-xs border-b border-border pb-3 last:border-0"
                      >
                        <span className="font-medium text-foreground/80">
                          {edit.label}
                        </span>
                        <div className="mt-1 space-y-1 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words">
                          {isNew ? (
                            <div>
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground/70">(empty) &rarr; </span>
                              <span className="bg-emerald-600 text-white rounded-sm px-0.5">
                                {newV}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          ) : isCleared ? (
                            <div>
                              <span className="bg-red-600 text-white line-through rounded-sm px-0.5">
                                {oldV}
                              </span>
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground/70"> &rarr; (empty)</span>
                            </div>
                          ) : diff ? (
                            <>
                              <div className="text-muted-foreground">
                                {diff.old.prefix}
                                <span className="bg-red-600 text-white rounded-sm px-0.5">
                                  {diff.old.changed}
                                </span>
                                {diff.old.suffix}
                              </div>
                              <div className="text-muted-foreground">
                                {diff.new.prefix}
                                <span className="bg-emerald-600 text-white rounded-sm px-0.5">
                                  {diff.new.changed}
                                </span>
                                {diff.new.suffix}
                              </div>
                            </>
                          ) : null}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
              </div>
            </PopoverContent>
          </Popover>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Comment summary bar */}
      <CommentSummary totalOpen={commentTotalOpen} fieldCount={commentFieldCount} />

      {/* Requirement summary + filter toggle */}
      {clientCode && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg border border-border bg-card text-card-foreground px-4 py-3">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 min-w-0">
            <span className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground shrink-0">
              {clientCode}
            </span>
            <RequirementSummary
              breakdown={requirementBreakdown}
              activeFilters={activeRequirementFilters}
              onToggle={handleToggleRequirement}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 shrink-0">
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground whitespace-nowrap">
              {columnCounts.visible}/{columnCounts.total} columns
            </span>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Switch
                id="show-all"
                checked={showAll}
                onCheckedChange={setShowAll}
              />
              <Label htmlFor="show-all" className="text-xs cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap text-foreground/80">
                Show all
              </Label>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Dimensions & Shipping — visual layout */}
      <DimensionsSection
        product={product}
        readOnly={isReadOnly}
        onSave={handleSave}
        onFieldSaved={onFieldSaved}
      />

      {/* Data-driven sections by reference group */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        {groups.map((group) => {
          // Skip groups already rendered above
          if (group.name === "Variations") return null;
          if (group.name === "Listing Identity") return null;
          if (group.name === "Dimensions & Weight") return null;

          // Count populated and total visible fields for this group
          let totalVisible = 0;
          let populatedVisible = 0;

          for (const subgroup of group.subgroups) {
            for (const attr of subgroup.attributes) {
              if (SEO_SECTION_FIELDS.has(attr.generalLabel) || IMAGE_SECTION_FIELDS.has(attr.generalLabel) || LISTING_IDENTITY_FIELDS.has(attr.generalLabel) || PRODUCT_IDENTITY_FIELDS.has(attr.generalLabel) || DIMENSIONS_SECTION_FIELDS.has(attr.generalLabel) || attr.subgroup === "Variation") continue;
              const val = getProductFieldValue(product, attr.generalLabel);
              if (!isFieldRelevant(attr, val)) continue;
              totalVisible++;
              if (val != null && val !== "") populatedVisible++;
            }
          }

          if (totalVisible === 0) return null;

          return (
            <ProductSection
              key={group.name}
              title={group.name}
              count={totalVisible}
              populatedCount={populatedVisible}
              defaultExpanded={DEFAULT_EXPANDED_GROUPS.has(group.name)}
              expanded={
                expandedSections.has(group.name) ? true : undefined
              }
              onExpandedChange={(exp) =>
                handleSectionExpandedChange(group.name, exp)
              }
            >
              {group.subgroups.map((subgroup) => {
                // Filter and sort attributes within subgroup
                const visibleAttrs = subgroup.attributes.filter((attr) => {
                  if (SEO_SECTION_FIELDS.has(attr.generalLabel) || IMAGE_SECTION_FIELDS.has(attr.generalLabel) || LISTING_IDENTITY_FIELDS.has(attr.generalLabel) || PRODUCT_IDENTITY_FIELDS.has(attr.generalLabel) || DIMENSIONS_SECTION_FIELDS.has(attr.generalLabel) || attr.subgroup === "Variation") return false;
                  const val = getProductFieldValue(product, attr.generalLabel);
                  return isFieldRelevant(attr, val);
                });

                if (visibleAttrs.length === 0) return null;

                // Sort: populated first, then by masterRow
                const sorted = [...visibleAttrs].sort((a, b) => {
                  const aVal = getProductFieldValue(product, a.generalLabel);
                  const bVal = getProductFieldValue(product, b.generalLabel);
                  const aHas = aVal != null && aVal !== "" ? 0 : 1;
                  const bHas = bVal != null && bVal !== "" ? 0 : 1;
                  if (aHas !== bHas) return aHas - bHas;
                  return a.masterRow - b.masterRow;
                });

                return (
                  <ProductSubgroup
                    key={subgroup.name || "__default__"}
                    name={subgroup.name}
                  >
                    {sorted.map((attr) => (
                      <ProductField
                        key={attr.generalLabel}
                        bqName={attr.generalLabel}
                        label={attr.generalLabel}
                        value={getProductFieldValue(product, attr.generalLabel)}
                        fieldType={inferFieldType(attr)}
                        readOnly={isReadOnly}
                        onSave={handleSave}
                        onFieldSaved={onFieldSaved}
                        isEssential={attr.isEssential}
                        labelDetails={attr.labelDetails}
                        requirementLevel={
                          (attr.clientRequirement as RequirementLevel) || undefined
                        }
                        maxLength={getFieldMaxLength(attr)}
                        options={getSelectOptions(attr)}
                        productId={productId}
                        commentCount={commentCounts[attr.generalLabel]}
                        amazonMeta={amazonMetaByField.get(attr.generalLabel) ?? null}
                        computed={COMPUTED_FIELDS.has(attr.generalLabel)}
                      />
                    ))}
                  </ProductSubgroup>
                );
              })}
            </ProductSection>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import Link from "next/link";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { Fragment, useMemo, useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { PackageOpen } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";

type FamilyMember = {
  id: string;
  asin: string | null;
  sku: string | null;
  parentSku: string | null;
  parentAsin: string | null;
  parentageLevel: string | null;
  clientIdCode: string | null;
  marketplace: string | null;
  status: string | null;
  brandName: string | null;
  itemName: string | null;
  summarizedTitle: string | null;
  listPrice: string | null;
  mainImageUrl: string | null;
  isDirty: boolean;
  variations: Record<string, string> | null;
  variationGroup: string | null;
  varietyPackItemCount?: number;
  vpFlavors?: string[] | null;
};

type FamilyResponse = {
  parent: FamilyMember | null;
  children: FamilyMember[];
  currentId: string;
  variationTheme: string | null;
};

const TH = "px-2 py-1.5 text-left text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground";

const EDITABLE_FIELDS: Record<string, { field: string | null; bqName: string }> = {
  Flavor: { field: null, bqName: "Flavor" },
  Size: { field: null, bqName: "Size" },
  Color: { field: null, bqName: "Color" },
  Style: { field: null, bqName: "Style" },
  variationGroup: { field: "variationGroup", bqName: "VariationGroup" },
};

function InlineCell({
  value,
  productId,
  fieldKey,
  onSaved,
}: {
  value: string | null;
  productId: string;
  fieldKey: string;
  onSaved: () => void;
}) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [editValue, setEditValue] = useState(value ?? "");
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (editing && inputRef.current) {
      inputRef.current.focus();
      inputRef.current.select();
    }
  }, [editing]);

  const commit = useCallback(async () => {
    setEditing(false);
    const newVal = editValue.trim() || null;
    if (newVal === (value ?? null)) return;
    const mapping = EDITABLE_FIELDS[fieldKey];
    if (!mapping) return;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${productId}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ field: mapping.field, value: newVal, bqName: mapping.bqName }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Save failed");
      onSaved();
    } catch {
      toast.error("Failed to save");
    }
  }, [editValue, value, fieldKey, productId, onSaved]);

  if (editing) {
    return (
      <input
        ref={inputRef}
        className="font-mono text-[9px] w-full bg-field-bg text-field-text border border-field-border rounded px-1 py-0.5 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand"
        value={editValue}
        onChange={(e) => setEditValue(e.target.value)}
        onBlur={commit}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === "Enter") commit();
          if (e.key === "Escape") {
            setEditValue(value ?? "");
            setEditing(false);
          }
        }}
      />
    );
  }

  const display = value?.replace(/\s*\(Pack\s+of\s+\d+\)\s*/gi, " ").trim() ?? null;

  return (
    <span
      className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] bg-muted text-foreground/80 whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer hover:ring-1 hover:ring-brand/30"
      onClick={() => {
        setEditValue(value ?? "");
        setEditing(true);
      }}
    >
      {display || <span className="text-muted-foreground/40">—</span>}
    </span>
  );
}

export function ProductFamily({
  productId,
  colCount,
}: {
  productId: string;
  colCount: number;
}) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const { data, isLoading } = useQuery<FamilyResponse>({
    queryKey: ["product-family", productId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${productId}/family`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch family");
      return res.json();
    },
  });

  const invalidate = useCallback(() => {
    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["product-family", productId] });
    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["products"] });
  }, [queryClient, productId]);

  const attrCols = useMemo(() => {
    if (!data) return { flavor: false, size: false, color: false, style: false };
    const children = data.children;
    return {
      flavor: children.some((c) => c.variations?.Flavor || c.vpFlavors?.length),
      size: children.some((c) => c.variations?.Size),
      color: children.some((c) => c.variations?.Color),
      style: children.some((c) => c.variations?.Style),
    };
  }, [data]);

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <tbody>
        <tr>
          <td colSpan={colCount} className="px-2 py-2">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <Skeleton className="h-5 w-full" />
              <Skeleton className="h-5 w-full" />
            </div>
          </td>
        </tr>
      </tbody>
    );
  }

  if (!data || data.children.length === 0) return null;

  const hasGroups = data.children.some((c) => c.variationGroup);
  let orderedChildren = data.children;
  const groupBoundaries = new Map<number, { group: string; count: number }>();

  if (hasGroups) {
    const groups = new Map<string, FamilyMember[]>();
    const ungrouped: FamilyMember[] = [];
    for (const child of data.children) {
      if (child.variationGroup) {
        const list = groups.get(child.variationGroup) ?? [];
        list.push(child);
        groups.set(child.variationGroup, list);
      } else {
        ungrouped.push(child);
      }
    }
    // Add VP products to groups matching their included flavors
    const vpChildren = data.children.filter((c) => c.vpFlavors?.length);
    for (const vp of vpChildren) {
      for (const [groupName, members] of groups) {
        if (members.some((m) => m.id === vp.id)) continue; // already in this group
        const gLower = groupName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g, "");
        const matchesFlavor = vp.vpFlavors!.some((f) => {
          const plain = f.replace(/^\d+×\s*/, ""); // strip "2× " prefix
          const fLower = plain.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g, "");
          if (fLower === gLower) return true;
          // Match abbreviation (first 3 letters of each word)
          const initials = plain.split(/\s+/).map((w) => w.slice(0, 3).toLowerCase()).join("");
          return initials === gLower;
        });
        if (matchesFlavor) members.push(vp);
      }
    }
    const sorted = [...groups.entries()].sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b));
    orderedChildren = sorted.flatMap(([, members]) => members).concat(ungrouped);

    let currentGroup = "";
    let groupStart = 0;
    let groupCount = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < orderedChildren.length; i++) {
      const g = orderedChildren[i].variationGroup || "";
      if (g !== currentGroup) {
        if (currentGroup) groupBoundaries.set(groupStart, { group: currentGroup, count: groupCount });
        currentGroup = g;
        groupStart = i;
        groupCount = 1;
      } else {
        groupCount++;
      }
    }
    if (currentGroup) groupBoundaries.set(groupStart, { group: currentGroup, count: groupCount });
  }

  const totalCols = 7 + (attrCols.flavor ? 1 : 0) + (attrCols.size ? 1 : 0) + (attrCols.color ? 1 : 0) + (attrCols.style ? 1 : 0);

  return (
    <>
      <colgroup>
        <col style={{ width: "90px" }} />
        <col style={{ width: "120px" }} />
        <col />
        <col style={{ width: "110px" }} />
        <col style={{ width: "140px" }} />
        <col style={{ width: "100px" }} />
        <col style={{ width: "36px" }} />
        {attrCols.flavor && <col style={{ width: "110px" }} />}
        {attrCols.size && <col style={{ width: "110px" }} />}
        {attrCols.color && <col style={{ width: "90px" }} />}
        {attrCols.style && <col style={{ width: "90px" }} />}
        <col style={{ width: "80px" }} />
      </colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr className="border-b border-border/60 bg-muted/40">
          <th className={TH}>ASIN</th>
          <th className={TH}>SKU</th>
          <th className={TH}>Title</th>
          <th className={TH}>Var ID</th>
          <th className={TH}>Group</th>
          <th className={TH}>Theme</th>
          <th className={`${TH} text-center`} title="Variety Pack">VP</th>
          {attrCols.flavor && <th className={TH}>Flavor</th>}
          {attrCols.size && <th className={TH}>Size</th>}
          {attrCols.color && <th className={TH}>Color</th>}
          {attrCols.style && <th className={TH}>Style</th>}
          <th className={TH}>Parentage</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
      {orderedChildren.map((child, idx) => {
        const boundary = groupBoundaries.get(idx);
        const variationId = child.variations?.["VariationID"] ?? null;
        const theme = child.variations?.["VariationThemeName"] ?? null;
        const flavor = child.variations?.Flavor ?? null;
        const size = child.variations?.Size ?? null;
        const color = child.variations?.Color ?? null;
        const style = child.variations?.Style ?? null;
        const isVP = (child.varietyPackItemCount ?? 0) > 0;

        return (
          <Fragment key={child.id}>
            {boundary && (
              <tr className="bg-indigo-50/60 dark:bg-indigo-950/20">
                <td colSpan={totalCols} className="py-1 px-4">
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400">
                    {boundary.group}
                  </span>
                  <span className="ml-1.5 text-[10px] text-indigo-400 dark:text-indigo-500">
                    ({boundary.count})
                  </span>
                </td>
              </tr>
            )}
            <tr className="border-b border-border/40 bg-zinc-50/50 dark:bg-zinc-800/50 hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors">
              <td className="px-2 py-1">
                <Link href={`/products/${child.id}`} className="font-mono text-xs text-amber-700 dark:text-brand hover:underline whitespace-nowrap">
                  {child.asin || "—"}
                </Link>
              </td>
              <td className="px-2 py-1 overflow-hidden">
                <span className="font-mono text-xs truncate block">{child.sku || "—"}</span>
              </td>
              <td className="px-2 py-1 overflow-hidden">
                <span className="font-mono text-xs line-clamp-2 break-words">
                  {child.itemName || child.summarizedTitle || "—"}
                </span>
              </td>
              <td className="px-2 py-1">
                <span className="font-mono text-xs whitespace-nowrap">{variationId || "—"}</span>
              </td>
              <td className="px-2 py-1">
                <InlineCell value={child.variationGroup} productId={child.id} fieldKey="variationGroup" onSaved={invalidate} />
              </td>
              <td className="px-2 py-1">
                <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground whitespace-nowrap">{theme || "—"}</span>
              </td>
              <td className="px-2 py-1 text-center">
                {isVP && (
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-[8px] font-bold bg-brand-vp/15 text-brand-vp border border-brand-vp/30" title={child.vpFlavors?.join(", ") ?? "Variety Pack"}>
                    <PackageOpen className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
                  </span>
                )}
              </td>
              {attrCols.flavor && (
                <td className="px-2 py-1">
                  {isVP && child.vpFlavors?.length ? (
                    <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                      {child.vpFlavors.map((f, i) => (
                        <span key={i} className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] bg-brand-vp/10 text-brand-vp whitespace-nowrap">{f}</span>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <InlineCell value={flavor} productId={child.id} fieldKey="Flavor" onSaved={invalidate} />
                  )}
                </td>
              )}
              {attrCols.size && (
                <td className="px-2 py-1">
                  <InlineCell value={size} productId={child.id} fieldKey="Size" onSaved={invalidate} />
                </td>
              )}
              {attrCols.color && (
                <td className="px-2 py-1">
                  <InlineCell value={color} productId={child.id} fieldKey="Color" onSaved={invalidate} />
                </td>
              )}
              {attrCols.style && (
                <td className="px-2 py-1">
                  <InlineCell value={style} productId={child.id} fieldKey="Style" onSaved={invalidate} />
                </td>
              )}
              <td className="px-2 py-1">
                <span className="font-mono text-xs whitespace-nowrap">{child.parentageLevel || "—"}</span>
              </td>
            </tr>
          </Fragment>
        );
      })}
      </tbody>
    </>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/products/product-field.tsx

"use client";

import { useState, useCallback, useRef, useEffect, memo } from "react";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/tooltip";
import { Star, HelpCircle, Loader2, Check, X } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import type { FieldType } from "@/lib/column-registry";
import type { RequirementLevel } from "@/lib/constants";
import { REQUIREMENT_COLORS, REQUIREMENT_SHORT_LABELS } from "@/lib/constants";
import { FieldComments } from "./field-comments";

type FieldSaveState = "idle" | "saving" | "saved" | "error";

export type AmazonFieldMeta = {
  amazonFieldName: string;
  localLabel: string;
  requirement: string;
  description: string | null;
  example: string | null;
  validValues: string[] | null;
};

type Props = {
  bqName: string;
  label: string;
  value: string | null;
  fieldType: FieldType;
  readOnly: boolean;
  onSave: (bqName: string, value: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  onFieldSaved?: (
    bqName: string,
    label: string,
    oldValue: string,
    newValue: string
  ) => void;
  isEssential?: boolean;
  labelDetails?: string | null;
  requirementLevel?: RequirementLevel;
  maxLength?: number | null;
  options?: string[] | null;
  productId?: string;
  commentCount?: { total: number; open: number };
  amazonMeta?: AmazonFieldMeta | null;
  computed?: boolean;
};

export const ProductField = memo(function ProductField({
  bqName,
  label,
  value,
  fieldType: fieldTypeProp,
  readOnly: readOnlyProp,
  onSave,
  onFieldSaved,
  isEssential,
  labelDetails,
  requirementLevel,
  maxLength,
  options: optionsProp,
  productId,
  commentCount,
  amazonMeta,
  computed,
}: Props) {
  const readOnly = readOnlyProp || !!computed;
  // Amazon valid values override field options when present
  const amazonHasValues = amazonMeta?.validValues && amazonMeta.validValues.length > 0;
  const options = amazonHasValues ? amazonMeta!.validValues : optionsProp;
  const fieldType = amazonHasValues && !optionsProp ? "select" as FieldType : fieldTypeProp;
  const savedValue = value ?? "";
  const [localValue, setLocalValue] = useState(savedValue);
  const [saveState, setSaveState] = useState<FieldSaveState>("idle");
  const [previousValue, setPreviousValue] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const debounceRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const savedTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const undoRef = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null);
  const focusedRef = useRef(false);

  // Sync local value when the prop changes from outside (e.g. query refetch)
  // but only if the field is not currently focused (user is typing)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!focusedRef.current) {
      setLocalValue(value ?? "");
    }
  }, [value]);

  // Cleanup timers on unmount
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
      if (savedTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(savedTimeoutRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  const doSave = useCallback(
    async (newValue: string) => {
      const trimmed = newValue.trim() || null;
      const currentSaved = value ?? null;
      if (trimmed === currentSaved) return;

      setSaveState("saving");
      if (savedTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(savedTimeoutRef.current);

      try {
        const oldVal = currentSaved ?? "";
        setPreviousValue(oldVal);
        await onSave(bqName, trimmed);
        setSaveState("saved");
        onFieldSaved?.(bqName, label, oldVal, trimmed ?? "");

        // Show undo toast
        const undoFn = async () => {
          setLocalValue(oldVal);
          setSaveState("saving");
          try {
            await onSave(bqName, oldVal || null);
            setSaveState("saved");
            onFieldSaved?.(bqName, label, trimmed ?? "", oldVal);
            savedTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(
              () => setSaveState("idle"),
              2000
            );
            toast.info(`Reverted ${label}`);
          } catch {
            setSaveState("error");
          }
        };
        undoRef.current = undoFn;

        toast.success(`Saved ${label}`, {
          action: { label: "Undo", onClick: () => undoRef.current?.() },
          duration: 5000,
        });

        savedTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(
          () => setSaveState("idle"),
          2000
        );
      } catch {
        setSaveState("error");
        toast.error(`Failed to save ${label}`);
      }
    },
    [bqName, label, value, onSave, onFieldSaved]
  );

  const handleRetry = useCallback(() => {
    doSave(localValue);
  }, [doSave, localValue]);

  const handleChange = useCallback(
    (newVal: string) => {
      setLocalValue(newVal);
    },
    []
  );

  const handleFocus = useCallback(() => {
    focusedRef.current = true;
  }, []);

  const handleBlur = useCallback(() => {
    focusedRef.current = false;
    if (debounceRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
      debounceRef.current = null;
    }
    const trimmed = localValue.trim() || null;
    if (trimmed !== (value ?? null)) {
      doSave(localValue);
    }
  }, [localValue, value, doSave]);

  const handleKeyDown = useCallback(
    (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === "Enter" && fieldType !== "textarea") {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (debounceRef.current) {
          clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
          debounceRef.current = null;
        }
        doSave(localValue);
        // Move focus to next field
        const inputs = document.querySelectorAll<
          HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement
        >("[data-field-input]");
        const arr = Array.from(inputs);
        const idx = arr.indexOf(e.currentTarget as HTMLInputElement);
        if (idx >= 0 && idx < arr.length - 1) {
          arr[idx + 1].focus();
        }
      }
      if (e.key === "Escape") {
        e.preventDefault();
        setLocalValue(savedValue);
        if (debounceRef.current) {
          clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
          debounceRef.current = null;
        }
        (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).blur();
      }
    },
    [fieldType, localValue, savedValue, doSave]
  );

  const isTextarea = fieldType === "textarea";
  const isSelect = fieldType === "select" && options && options.length > 0;
  const showRequirement =
    requirementLevel && requirementLevel !== "Not Required";
  // Amazon requirement shown when no Hub requirement exists
  const amazonReq = amazonMeta?.requirement;
  const showAmazonReq = amazonReq && !showRequirement && amazonReq !== "Optional";
  const isDirty = localValue !== savedValue;
  const isOverLimit = maxLength != null && localValue.length > maxLength;
  const showCharCount =
    fieldType === "text" || fieldType === "textarea";
  // Tooltip content: Amazon description takes priority, falls back to labelDetails
  const tooltipText = amazonMeta?.description || labelDetails;

  // Save state indicator
  const saveIndicator = (
    <div className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-10">
      {saveState === "saving" && (
        <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin text-muted-foreground/70" />
      )}
      {saveState === "saved" && (
        <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
      )}
      {saveState === "error" && (
        <TooltipProvider>
          <Tooltip>
            <TooltipTrigger asChild>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleRetry}
                className="cursor-pointer"
              >
                <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-red-500" />
              </button>
            </TooltipTrigger>
            <TooltipContent side="top">
              Save failed. Click to retry.
            </TooltipContent>
          </Tooltip>
        </TooltipProvider>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div id={`field-${bqName}`} className="grid gap-1.5 min-w-0">
      {/* Label row */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
        <Label
          htmlFor={bqName}
          className="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate min-w-0 shrink"
          title={label}
        >
          {label}
        </Label>
        {computed && (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-[10px] leading-none font-medium border whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 bg-violet-500/15 text-violet-400 border-violet-500/30">
            Auto
          </span>
        )}
        {isEssential && (
          <Star className="h-3 w-3 text-amber-500 fill-amber-500 shrink-0" />
        )}
        {showRequirement && (
          <span
            className={`inline-flex items-center rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-[10px] leading-none font-medium border whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 ${REQUIREMENT_COLORS[requirementLevel]}`}
          >
            {REQUIREMENT_SHORT_LABELS[requirementLevel]}
          </span>
        )}
        {showAmazonReq && (
          <span
            className={`inline-flex items-center rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-[10px] leading-none font-medium border whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 ${
              amazonReq === "Required"
                ? "bg-red-500/15 text-red-400 border-red-500/30"
                : amazonReq === "Conditionally Required"
                  ? "bg-orange-500/15 text-orange-400 border-orange-500/30"
                  : "bg-blue-500/15 text-blue-400 border-blue-500/30"
            }`}
          >
            {amazonReq === "Required"
              ? "AMZ Req"
              : amazonReq === "Conditionally Required"
                ? "AMZ Cond"
                : "AMZ Rec"}
          </span>
        )}
        {tooltipText && (
          <TooltipProvider>
            <Tooltip>
              <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                <HelpCircle className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground/70 cursor-help shrink-0" />
              </TooltipTrigger>
              <TooltipContent side="top" className="max-w-sm">
                <p>{tooltipText}</p>
                {amazonMeta?.example && (
                  <p className="mt-1 text-muted-foreground">
                    Example: <span className="font-mono">{amazonMeta.example}</span>
                  </p>
                )}
              </TooltipContent>
            </Tooltip>
          </TooltipProvider>
        )}
        {productId && (
          <FieldComments
            productId={productId}
            bqName={bqName}
            fieldLabel={label}
            commentCount={commentCount}
          />
        )}
      </div>
      {/* Secondary label row: Amazon field name */}
      {amazonMeta && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-0.5 -mt-0.5">
          <span className="text-[10px] text-orange-400/60 font-mono truncate max-w-full" title={amazonMeta.amazonFieldName}>
            AMZ: {amazonMeta.localLabel}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      {readOnly ? (
        <p className="text-sm min-h-[36px] py-2 px-3 rounded-md bg-muted text-muted-foreground border border-border break-words overflow-hidden">
          {value || <span className="text-muted-foreground/70">&mdash;</span>}
        </p>
      ) : isSelect ? (
        <div className="relative">
          <Select
            value={localValue || "__empty__"}
            onValueChange={(v) => {
              const newVal = v === "__empty__" ? "" : v;
              setLocalValue(newVal);
              if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
              doSave(newVal);
            }}
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="bg-field-bg text-field-text border-field-border focus:ring-brand">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Select..." />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="__empty__">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">None</span>
              </SelectItem>
              {options!.map((opt) => (
                <SelectItem key={opt} value={opt}>
                  {opt}
                </SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
          {saveIndicator}
        </div>
      ) : isTextarea ? (
        <div
          className={`relative${isDirty ? " border-l-2 border-brand pl-2" : ""}`}
        >
          <textarea
            id={bqName}
            data-field-input
            data-field-bq={bqName}
            value={localValue}
            onChange={(e) => handleChange(e.target.value)}
            onFocus={handleFocus}
            onBlur={handleBlur}
            onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
            rows={3}
            className="flex min-h-[80px] w-full rounded-md border border-field-border bg-field-bg text-field-text px-3 py-2 pr-8 text-sm ring-offset-background placeholder:text-gray-400 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-brand focus-visible:ring-offset-2"
          />
          {saveIndicator}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div
          className={`relative${isDirty ? " border-l-2 border-brand pl-2" : ""}`}
        >
          <Input
            id={bqName}
            data-field-input
            data-field-bq={bqName}
            type={
              fieldType === "url"
                ? "url"
                : fieldType === "number"
                  ? "number"
                  : "text"
            }
            value={localValue}
            onChange={(e) => handleChange(e.target.value)}
            onFocus={handleFocus}
            onBlur={handleBlur}
            onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
            className="bg-field-bg text-field-text border-field-border pr-8 focus-visible:ring-brand"
          />
          {saveIndicator}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Character count */}
      {!readOnly && showCharCount && (
        <div className="flex justify-between">
          <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/70">
            {localValue.length} chars
          </span>
          {maxLength != null && (
            <span
              className={`text-[11px] ${isOverLimit ? "text-red-400 font-medium" : "text-muted-foreground/70"}`}
            >
              {maxLength - localValue.length} remaining
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

"use client";

import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight, Loader2, Check, X } from "lucide-react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { getProductFieldValue } from "@/lib/product-mapper";
import type { Product } from "@/lib/db/schema";

/** Fields in the requested order */
const FIELDS: {
  bqName: string;
  label: string;
  type: "text" | "computed";
  width?: string;
}[] = [
  { bqName: "BrandName", label: "Brand Name", type: "text", width: "w-48" },
  { bqName: "Manufacturer", label: "Manufacturer", type: "text", width: "w-48" },
  { bqName: "ProductIdType", label: "Product ID Type", type: "text", width: "w-48" },
  { bqName: "ProductId", label: "Product ID", type: "text", width: "w-48" },
  { bqName: "ProductType", label: "Product Type", type: "text", width: "w-48" },
  { bqName: "ItemTypeKeyword", label: "Item Type Keyword", type: "text", width: "w-48" },
  { bqName: "FeedProductType", label: "Feed Product Type", type: "text", width: "w-48" },
  { bqName: "ParentageLevel", label: "Parentage Level", type: "text", width: "w-48" },
