];

type Props = {
  product: Product;
  readOnly: boolean;
  onSave: (bqName: string, value: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  onFieldSaved?: (
    bqName: string,
    label: string,
    oldValue: string,
    newValue: string
  ) => void;
  expanded?: boolean;
  onExpandedChange?: (expanded: boolean) => void;
};

export function ProductIdentitySection({
  product,
  readOnly,
  onSave,
  onFieldSaved,
  expanded: controlledExpanded,
  onExpandedChange,
}: Props) {
  const [internalExpanded, setInternalExpanded] = useState(true);
  const expanded =
    controlledExpanded !== undefined ? controlledExpanded : internalExpanded;

  const populatedCount = FIELDS.filter((f) => {
    const val = getProductFieldValue(product, f.bqName);
    return val != null && val !== "";
  }).length;

  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-card text-card-foreground">
      <button
        onClick={() => {
          const next = !expanded;
          setInternalExpanded(next);
          onExpandedChange?.(next);
        }}
        className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 w-full px-4 py-2.5 text-left hover:bg-muted/50 transition-colors"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
          {expanded ? (
            <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
          ) : (
            <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
          )}
          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-section-title">
            Product Identity
          </span>
        </div>
        <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs shrink-0 tabular-nums">
          {populatedCount}/{FIELDS.length}
        </Badge>
      </button>

      {expanded && (
        <div className="border-t border-border px-4 py-2 space-y-0">
          {FIELDS.map((field) => {
            const value = getProductFieldValue(product, field.bqName) ?? "";

            if (field.type === "computed") {
              return (
                <div
                  key={field.bqName}
                  className="flex items-center gap-3 py-0.5"
                  id={`field-${field.bqName}`}
                >
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground shrink-0 w-32 truncate">
                    {field.label}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-foreground/80 font-mono truncate">
                    {value || <span className="text-muted-foreground/50">—</span>}
                  </span>
                </div>
              );
            }

            return (
              <EditableField
                key={field.bqName}
                label={field.label}
                bqName={field.bqName}
                value={value}
                readOnly={readOnly}
                onSave={onSave}
                onFieldSaved={onFieldSaved}
                width={field.width}
              />
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Editable text field with inline editing */
function EditableField({
  label,
  bqName,
  value,
  readOnly,
  onSave,
  onFieldSaved,
  width,
}: {
  label: string;
  bqName: string;
  value: string;
  readOnly: boolean;
  onSave: (bqName: string, value: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  onFieldSaved?: (bqName: string, label: string, oldValue: string, newValue: string) => void;
  width?: string;
}) {
  const [localValue, setLocalValue] = useState(value);
  const [saveState, setSaveState] = useState<"idle" | "saving" | "saved" | "error">("idle");
  const debounceRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setLocalValue(value);
  }, [value]);

  const doSave = useCallback(
    async (newVal: string) => {
      if (newVal === value) return;
      setSaveState("saving");
      try {
        await onSave(bqName, newVal || null);
        onFieldSaved?.(bqName, label, value, newVal);
        setSaveState("saved");
        setTimeout(() => setSaveState("idle"), 1500);
      } catch {
        setSaveState("error");
        toast.error(`Failed to save ${label}`);
        setTimeout(() => setSaveState("idle"), 2000);
      }
    },
    [bqName, label, value, onSave, onFieldSaved]
  );

  const handleChange = (newVal: string) => {
    setLocalValue(newVal);
    if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
    debounceRef.current = setTimeout(() => doSave(newVal), 600);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 py-0.5" id={`field-${bqName}`}>
      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground shrink-0 w-32 truncate">
        {label}
      </span>
      {readOnly ? (
        <span className="text-xs text-foreground/80">
          {value || <span className="text-muted-foreground/50">—</span>}
        </span>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
          <input
            type="text"
            data-field-bq={bqName}
            value={localValue}
            onChange={(e) => handleChange(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === "Enter") {
                if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
                doSave(localValue);
              }
            }}
            className={`h-6 px-1.5 text-xs rounded border border-border bg-field-bg text-field-text focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand ${
              width ?? "flex-1 min-w-0"
            }`}
          />
          {saveState === "saving" && (
            <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
          )}
          {saveState === "saved" && (
            <Check className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-500 shrink-0" />
          )}
          {saveState === "error" && (
            <X className="h-3 w-3 text-destructive shrink-0" />
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

type FamilyMember = {
  id: string;
  asin: string | null;
  sku: string | null;
  parentSku: string | null;
  parentAsin: string | null;
  parentageLevel: string | null;
  clientIdCode: string | null;
  marketplace: string | null;
  status: string | null;
  brandName: string | null;
  itemName: string | null;
  summarizedTitle: string | null;
  listPrice: string | null;
  mainImageUrl: string | null;
  isDirty: boolean;
  variations: Record<string, string> | null;
};

type FamilyResponse = {
  parent: FamilyMember | null;
  children: FamilyMember[];
  currentId: string;
  variationTheme: string | null;
};

// ── Helpers ──

const VARIATION_META_KEYS = new Set([
  "VariationThemeName",
  "VariationID",
  "ParentageLevel",
  "parentage_level",
]);

function findDistinguishingKey(children: FamilyMember[]): string | null {
  if (children.length < 2) return null;
  const allKeys = new Set<string>();
  for (const child of children) {
    if (!child.variations) continue;
    for (const k of Object.keys(child.variations)) {
      if (!VARIATION_META_KEYS.has(k)) allKeys.add(k);
    }
  }
  for (const key of allKeys) {
    const values = new Set<string>();
    for (const child of children) {
      const val = child.variations?.[key];
      if (val) values.add(val);
    }
    if (values.size > 1) return key;
  }
  return null;
}

function getVariationLabel(
  member: FamilyMember,
  distinguishingKey: string | null,
  theme: string | null
): string {
  if (!member.variations) return member.asin || "—";
  if (distinguishingKey && member.variations[distinguishingKey]) {
    return member.variations[distinguishingKey];
  }
  if (theme) {
    const keys = [theme, `${theme}Name`, `${theme}Map`];
    for (const key of keys) {
      if (member.variations[key]) return member.variations[key];
    }
  }
  return member.asin || "—";
}

function formatPrice(raw: string | null): string | null {
  if (!raw) return null;
  const num = parseFloat(raw.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, ""));
  if (isNaN(num)) return raw;
  const dollars = Math.floor(num);
  const cents = Math.round((num - dollars) * 100)
    .toString()
    .padStart(2, "0");
  return `${dollars}.${cents}`;
}

// ── PdpCollapsible ──

function PdpCollapsible({
  title,
  defaultOpen = false,
  children,
}: {
  title: string;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(defaultOpen);
  return (
    <div className="border-b border-[var(--pdp-border)] last:border-b-0">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}
        className="flex w-full items-center justify-between px-6 py-3 text-left hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors"
      >
        <span className="text-sm font-bold text-[var(--pdp-text)]">{title}</span>
        {open ? (
          <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 text-[var(--pdp-secondary-text)] shrink-0" />
        ) : (
          <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 text-[var(--pdp-secondary-text)] shrink-0" />
        )}
      </button>
      {open && <div className="px-6 pb-4">{children}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Component ──

type Props = {
  product: Product;
  productId: string;
  readOnly?: boolean;
  onSave?: (bqName: string, value: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  onFieldSaved?: (
    bqName: string,
    label: string,
    oldValue: string,
    newValue: string
  ) => void;
};

export function ProductPdp({ product, productId, readOnly, onSave, onFieldSaved }: Props) {
  // Fetch family for variation selectors
  const { data: family } = useQuery<FamilyResponse>({
    queryKey: ["product-family", productId],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${productId}/family`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch family");
      return res.json();
    },
  });

  // ── Field values ──
  const title = product.itemName || "Untitled Product";
  const price = formatPrice(product.listPrice);
  const size = getProductFieldValue(product, "Size");
  const brandName = product.brandName;

  // Bullet points
  const bullets = useMemo(() => {
    const items: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
      const val = getProductFieldValue(product, `DetailedBulletPoint${i}`);
      if (val) items.push(val);
    }
    return items;
  }, [product]);

  // Product description
  const productDescription = getProductFieldValue(product, "ProductDescription");

  // Concise bullet points
  const conciseBullets = useMemo(() => {
    const items: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
      const val = getProductFieldValue(product, `ConciseBulletPoint${i}`);
      if (val) items.push(val);
    }
    return items;
  }, [product]);

  // Key features
  const keyFeatures = useMemo(() => {
    const items: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 1; i <= 5; i++) {
      const val = getProductFieldValue(product, `KeyFeature${i}`);
      if (val) items.push(val);
    }
    return items;
  }, [product]);

  // Item details
  const itemDetails = useMemo(() => {
    const rows: { label: string; value: string }[] = [];
    const specFields: [string, string][] = [
      ["Brand Name", "BrandName"],
      ["Manufacturer", "Manufacturer"],
      ["Item Weight", "ItemWeight"],
      ["Package Weight", "PackageWeight"],
      ["Item Dimensions", "ItemDimensions"],
      ["Package Dimensions", "PackageDimensions"],
      ["ASIN", "ASIN"],
      ["UPC", "UPC"],
      ["EAN", "EAN"],
      ["Model Number", "ModelNumber"],
      ["Part Number", "PartNumber"],
      ["Country of Origin", "CountryOfOrigin"],
      ["Material", "Material"],
      ["Number of Items", "NumberOfItems"],
      ["Unit Count", "UnitCount"],
      ["Ingredients", "Ingredients"],
      ["Allergen Information", "AllergenInformation"],
    ];
    for (const [label, bqName] of specFields) {
      const val = getProductFieldValue(product, bqName);
      if (val) rows.push({ label, value: val });
    }
    return rows;
  }, [product]);

  // Variation theme & children
  const variationTheme = family?.variationTheme || null;
  const children = family?.children || [];
  const hasVariations = children.length > 0;
  const distinguishingKey = useMemo(
    () => findDistinguishingKey(children),
    [children]
  );

  // Top highlights
  const topHighlights = useMemo(() => {
    const rows: { label: string; value: string }[] = [];
    const fields: [string, string][] = [
      ["Brand", "BrandName"],
      ["Product Type", "ProductType"],
      ["Item Type", "ItemTypeKeyword"],
      ["Feed Product Type", "FeedProductType"],
    ];
    for (const [label, bqName] of fields) {
      const val = getProductFieldValue(product, bqName);
      if (val) rows.push({ label, value: val });
    }
    if (variationTheme) {
      const currentChild = children.find((c) => c.id === productId);
      if (currentChild) {
        const val = getVariationLabel(currentChild, distinguishingKey, variationTheme);
        if (val && val !== currentChild.asin) {
          rows.splice(1, 0, { label: variationTheme, value: val });
        }
      }
    }
    if (size) rows.push({ label: "Size", value: size });
    return rows;
  }, [product, variationTheme, children, productId, distinguishingKey, size]);

  // ── Image Gallery State ──
  const slotData = useMemo(() => {
    return IMAGE_SLOTS.map((slot) => {
      const url = getProductFieldValue(product, slot.bqName) || "";
      return { ...slot, url };
    });
  }, [product]);

  const filledCount = slotData.filter((s) => s.url).length;
  const [selectedIdx, setSelectedIdx] = useState(0);
  const [editSlot, setEditSlot] = useState<(typeof IMAGE_SLOTS)[number] | null>(null);
  const [lightboxIdx, setLightboxIdx] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [swapMode, setSwapMode] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const selectedSlot = slotData[selectedIdx];
  const displayUrl = selectedSlot?.url || "";

  const filledImages = useMemo(
    () => slotData.filter((s) => s.url).map((s) => ({ url: s.url, label: s.label })),
    [slotData]
  );

  const handleEditUrl = useCallback(
    async (url: string) => {
      if (!editSlot || !onSave) return;
      const oldVal = getProductFieldValue(product, editSlot.bqName) || "";
      const newVal = url.trim() || null;
      await onSave(editSlot.bqName, newVal);
      onFieldSaved?.(editSlot.bqName, editSlot.label, oldVal, newVal ?? "");
      toast.success(`Saved ${editSlot.label}`);
      setEditSlot(null);
    },
    [editSlot, product, onSave, onFieldSaved]
  );

  const handleClear = useCallback(
    async (idx: number) => {
      if (!onSave) return;
      const slot = slotData[idx];
      if (!slot.url) return;
      const oldVal = slot.url;
      await onSave(slot.bqName, null);
      onFieldSaved?.(slot.bqName, slot.label, oldVal, "");
      toast.success(`Cleared ${slot.label}`, {
        action: {
          label: "Undo",
          onClick: async () => {
            await onSave(slot.bqName, oldVal);
            onFieldSaved?.(slot.bqName, slot.label, "", oldVal);
            toast.info(`Restored ${slot.label}`);
          },
        },
        duration: 5000,
      });
    },
    [slotData, onSave, onFieldSaved]
  );

  const handleSwap = useCallback(
    async (targetIdx: number) => {
      if (!onSave || swapMode === null || swapMode === targetIdx) {
        setSwapMode(null);
        return;
      }
      const slotA = slotData[swapMode];
      const slotB = slotData[targetIdx];
      await onSave(slotA.bqName, slotB.url || null);
      await onSave(slotB.bqName, slotA.url || null);
      onFieldSaved?.(slotA.bqName, slotA.label, slotA.url, slotB.url);
      onFieldSaved?.(slotB.bqName, slotB.label, slotB.url, slotA.url);
      toast.success(`Swapped ${slotA.label} and ${slotB.label}`);
      setSwapMode(null);
    },
    [swapMode, slotData, onSave, onFieldSaved]
  );

  const handleThumbnailClick = useCallback(
    (idx: number) => {
      if (swapMode !== null) {
        handleSwap(idx);
      } else {
        setSelectedIdx(idx);
      }
    },
    [swapMode, handleSwap]
  );

  const openLightbox = useCallback(() => {
    if (!displayUrl) return;
    const idx = filledImages.findIndex((img) => img.url === displayUrl);
    setLightboxIdx(idx >= 0 ? idx : 0);
  }, [displayUrl, filledImages]);

  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-[var(--pdp-border)] bg-[var(--pdp-bg)] text-[var(--pdp-text)] overflow-hidden font-ember">
      <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row">
        {/* ── Left: Image Gallery ── */}
        <div className="lg:w-[420px] shrink-0 p-4 flex flex-col">
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <ImageIcon className="h-4 w-4 text-[var(--pdp-secondary-text)]" />
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--pdp-text)]">Images</span>
            </div>
            <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] tabular-nums px-1.5 py-0">
              {filledCount}/{IMAGE_SLOTS.length}
            </Badge>
          </div>

          {/* Main image */}
          <div className="relative flex-1 flex items-center justify-center bg-[var(--pdp-bg)] min-h-[300px] rounded-md border border-[var(--pdp-border)]">
            {displayUrl ? (
              <>
                <img
                  src={displayUrl}
                  alt={title}
                  className="max-h-[340px] max-w-full object-contain cursor-zoom-in"
                  onClick={openLightbox}
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={openLightbox}
                  className="absolute top-2 right-2 p-1.5 rounded bg-black/40 text-white hover:bg-black/60 transition-colors"
                >
                  <Maximize2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                </button>
              </>
            ) : (
              <div className="text-center text-[var(--pdp-secondary-text)]">
                <ImagePlus className="h-8 w-8 mx-auto mb-1.5 opacity-50" />
                <p className="text-xs">No image</p>
                {!readOnly && onSave && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="mt-2 inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium rounded border border-[var(--pdp-border)] text-[var(--pdp-secondary-text)] hover:bg-gray-100 transition-colors"
                    onClick={() => setEditSlot(IMAGE_SLOTS[selectedIdx])}
                  >
                    Add URL
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Thumbnail strip */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-3">
            {slotData.map((slot, idx) => (
              <TooltipProvider key={slot.bqName} delayDuration={300}>
                <Tooltip>
                  <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleThumbnailClick(idx)}
                      className={`relative h-10 w-10 rounded border overflow-hidden cursor-pointer transition-all shrink-0 ${
                        swapMode !== null
                          ? swapMode === idx
                            ? "border-orange-400 ring-2 ring-orange-400 scale-105"
                            : "border-dashed border-[var(--pdp-border)] hover:border-orange-500/30"
                          : idx === selectedIdx
                            ? "border-orange-400 ring-1 ring-orange-400"
                            : "border-[var(--pdp-border)] hover:border-orange-500/30"
                      }`}
                    >
                      {slot.url ? (
                        <img
                          src={slot.url}
                          alt={slot.label}
                          className="h-full w-full object-cover"
                          onError={(e) => {
                            (e.target as HTMLImageElement).style.display = "none";
                          }}
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <div className="h-full w-full flex items-center justify-center bg-[var(--pdp-border)]">
                          <ImagePlus className="h-3 w-3 text-[var(--pdp-secondary-text)] opacity-50" />
                        </div>
                      )}
                      <span className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 bg-black/50 text-white text-[8px] px-0.5 leading-relaxed rounded-tl">
                        {idx === 0 ? "M" : idx + 1}
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  </TooltipTrigger>
                  <TooltipContent side="bottom" className="text-xs">
                    {slot.label}
                    {swapMode !== null && swapMode !== idx && " (click to swap)"}
                  </TooltipContent>
                </Tooltip>
              </TooltipProvider>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Edit controls */}
          {!readOnly && onSave && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 h-6 px-2 text-[10px] font-medium rounded border border-[var(--pdp-border)] text-[var(--pdp-secondary-text)] hover:bg-gray-100 transition-colors"
                onClick={() => setEditSlot(IMAGE_SLOTS[selectedIdx])}
              >
                <Edit3 className="h-3 w-3" />
                Edit
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 h-6 px-2 text-[10px] font-medium rounded border transition-colors ${
                  swapMode !== null
                    ? "bg-orange-500 text-white border-orange-500 hover:bg-orange-600"
                    : "border-[var(--pdp-border)] text-[var(--pdp-secondary-text)] hover:bg-gray-100"
                }`}
                onClick={() => setSwapMode(swapMode !== null ? null : selectedIdx)}
              >
                <ArrowLeftRight className="h-3 w-3" />
                {swapMode !== null ? "Cancel" : "Swap"}
              </button>
              {displayUrl && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 h-6 px-2 text-[10px] font-medium rounded border border-[var(--pdp-border)] text-red-500 hover:bg-red-50 transition-colors"
                  onClick={() => handleClear(selectedIdx)}
                >
                  <Trash2 className="h-3 w-3" />
                  Clear
                </button>
              )}
              <span className="ml-auto text-[10px] text-[var(--pdp-secondary-text)] truncate">
                {selectedSlot.label}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* ── Right: Product Details ── */}
        <div className="flex-1 p-6 border-l border-[var(--pdp-border)] space-y-4 min-w-0">
          {/* Title */}
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-normal leading-snug text-[var(--pdp-text)]">
            {title}
          </h1>

          {/* Brand */}
          {brandName && (
            <p className="text-sm">
              Visit the{" "}
              <span className="text-[var(--pdp-link)]">{brandName} Store</span>
            </p>
          )}

          <hr className="border-[var(--pdp-border)]" />

          {/* Price */}
          {price && (
            <span className="text-[28px] font-normal text-[var(--pdp-text)] leading-none">
              ${price}
            </span>
          )}

          {/* Variation Selectors */}
          {hasVariations && variationTheme && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <p className="text-sm text-[var(--pdp-text)]">
                <span className="font-bold">{variationTheme}:</span>{" "}
                {getVariationLabel(
                  children.find((c) => c.id === productId) || children[0],
                  distinguishingKey,
                  variationTheme
                )}
              </p>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                {children.map((child) => {
                  const isCurrent = child.id === productId;
                  const label = getVariationLabel(child, distinguishingKey, variationTheme);
                  return (
                    <Link
                      key={child.id}
                      href={`/products/${child.id}`}
                      className={`flex flex-col items-start rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 text-xs transition-colors min-w-[80px] ${
                        isCurrent
                          ? "border-[var(--pdp-link)] bg-[var(--pdp-link)]/15 shadow-sm"
                          : "border-[var(--pdp-border)] hover:border-[var(--pdp-link)] bg-[var(--pdp-bg)]"
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span className={`font-medium ${isCurrent ? "text-[var(--pdp-link)]" : "text-[var(--pdp-text)]"}`}>
                        {label}
                      </span>
                      {child.listPrice && (
                        <span className="text-[var(--pdp-secondary-text)] mt-0.5">
                          ${formatPrice(child.listPrice)}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </Link>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Size */}
          {size && (
            <div>
              <p className="text-sm text-[var(--pdp-text)]">
                <span className="font-bold">Size:</span> {size}
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          <hr className="border-[var(--pdp-border)]" />

          {/* About this item */}
          {bullets.length > 0 && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-[var(--pdp-text)]">
                About this item
              </h3>
              <ul className="list-disc pl-5 space-y-1.5">
                {bullets.map((bp, i) => (
                  <li key={i} className="text-sm text-[var(--pdp-text)] leading-relaxed">
                    {bp}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ── Below-the-fold sections ── */}
      <div className="border-t border-[var(--pdp-border)]">
        {topHighlights.length > 0 && (
          <PdpCollapsible title="Top Highlights" defaultOpen>
            <table className="w-full text-sm">
              <tbody>
                {topHighlights.map(({ label, value }) => (
                  <tr key={label} className="border-b border-[var(--pdp-border)] last:border-0">
                    <td className="py-1.5 pr-4 text-[var(--pdp-secondary-text)] font-medium whitespace-nowrap align-top w-[140px]">
                      {label}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-1.5 text-[var(--pdp-text)]">{value}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </PdpCollapsible>
        )}

        {productDescription && (
          <PdpCollapsible title="Product Description" defaultOpen>
            <p className="text-sm text-[var(--pdp-text)] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-line">
              {productDescription}
            </p>
          </PdpCollapsible>
        )}

        {keyFeatures.length > 0 && (
          <PdpCollapsible title="Key Features">
            <ul className="list-disc pl-5 space-y-1.5">
              {keyFeatures.map((kf, i) => (
                <li key={i} className="text-sm text-[var(--pdp-text)] leading-relaxed">
                  {kf}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </PdpCollapsible>
        )}

        {conciseBullets.length > 0 && (
          <PdpCollapsible title="Concise Bullet Points">
            <ul className="list-disc pl-5 space-y-1.5">
              {conciseBullets.map((cb, i) => (
                <li key={i} className="text-sm text-[var(--pdp-text)] leading-relaxed">
                  {cb}
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </PdpCollapsible>
        )}

        {itemDetails.length > 0 && (
          <PdpCollapsible title="Item Details">
            <table className="w-full text-sm">
              <tbody>
                {itemDetails.map(({ label, value }) => (
                  <tr key={label} className="border-b border-[var(--pdp-border)] last:border-0">
                    <td className="py-1.5 pr-4 text-[var(--pdp-secondary-text)] font-medium whitespace-nowrap align-top w-[180px]">
                      {label}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-1.5 text-[var(--pdp-text)] break-words">{value}</td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </PdpCollapsible>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Edit URL dialog */}
      {onSave && (
        <ImageUrlDialog
          open={editSlot !== null}
          onOpenChange={(open) => !open && setEditSlot(null)}
          slotLabel={editSlot?.label ?? ""}
          currentUrl={
            editSlot
              ? getProductFieldValue(product, editSlot.bqName) || ""
              : ""
          }
          onSave={handleEditUrl}
        />
      )}

      {/* Lightbox */}
      {lightboxIdx !== null && filledImages.length > 0 && (
        <ImageLightbox
          images={filledImages}
          initialIndex={lightboxIdx}
          onClose={() => setLightboxIdx(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";

type Props = {
  title: string;
  count: number;
  populatedCount: number;
  defaultExpanded: boolean;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  /** Controlled expanded state — overrides internal state when provided */
  expanded?: boolean;
  /** Called when the user toggles the section */
  onExpandedChange?: (expanded: boolean) => void;
};

export function ProductSection({
  title,
  count,
  populatedCount,
  defaultExpanded,
  children,
  expanded: controlledExpanded,
  onExpandedChange,
}: Props) {
  const [internalExpanded, setInternalExpanded] = useState(defaultExpanded);

  const isExpanded =
    controlledExpanded !== undefined ? controlledExpanded : internalExpanded;

  const toggle = () => {
    const next = !isExpanded;
    setInternalExpanded(next);
    onExpandedChange?.(next);
  };

  return (
    <div className="border border-border rounded-lg bg-card text-card-foreground">
      <button
        onClick={toggle}
        className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-3 text-left hover:bg-muted/50 transition-colors"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
          {isExpanded ? (
            <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
          ) : (
            <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
          )}
          <span className="font-medium truncate text-section-title">{title}</span>
        </div>
        <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs shrink-0 tabular-nums">
          {populatedCount}/{count}
        </Badge>
      </button>
      {isExpanded && (
        <div className="border-t border-border px-4 py-4 overflow-hidden">
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {children}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

type Props = {

export function ProductSubgroup({ name, children }: Props) {
  if (!name) {
    // No subgroup label — just render the fields in a grid
    return (
      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 [&>*]:min-w-0">
        {children}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground border-b border-border pb-1 truncate">
        {name}
      </h4>
      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 [&>*]:min-w-0">
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { ColumnDef } from "@tanstack/react-table";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ArrowUpDown, Circle, PackageOpen } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";
import type { EnrichedAttribute } from "@/hooks/use-column-attributes";
import type { RequirementLevel } from "@/lib/constants";
import { inferFieldType } from "@/lib/column-utils";

const STATUS_STYLES: Record<string, string> = {
  active: "bg-status-active/15 text-status-active border-status-active/30",
  inactive: "bg-status-inactive/15 text-status-inactive border-status-inactive/30",
  closed: "bg-status-closed/15 text-status-closed border-status-closed/30",
  discontinued: "bg-status-discontinued/15 text-status-discontinued border-status-discontinued/30",
  incomplete: "bg-status-incomplete/15 text-status-incomplete border-status-incomplete/30",
  "out of stock": "bg-status-oos/15 text-status-oos border-status-oos/30",
  suppressed: "bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-400 border-rose-500/30",
};

function StatusBadge({ status }: { status: string }) {
  const style = STATUS_STYLES[status.toLowerCase()] ?? "bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-border";
  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-1.5 py-0 text-[10px] font-medium whitespace-nowrap ${style}`}>
      {status}
    </span>
  );
}

export type ProductRow = {
  id: string;
  asin: string | null;
  sku: string | null;
  clientIdCode: string | null;
  marketplace: string | null;
  country: string | null;
  status: string | null;
  brandName: string | null;
  itemName: string | null;
  summarizedTitle: string | null;
  listPrice: string | null;
  mainImageUrl: string | null;
  parentageLevel: string | null;
  parentSku: string | null;
  parentAsin: string | null;
  variationId: string | null;
  variationGroup: string | null;
  variations: Record<string, string | undefined> | null;
  isDirty: boolean;
  updatedAt: string;
  varietyPackItemCount?: number;
  vpFlavors?: string[] | null;
  _completenessScore?: number | null;
  _amazonMatch?: number | null;
  _amazonFetchedAt?: string | null;
  _raw?: Record<string, string>;
};

export type SaveFieldFn = (
  productId: string,
  field: string | null,
  bqName: string,
  value: string | null
) => void;

// Field mapping: accessor key → { field (core DB column or null for JSONB), bqName }
const FIELD_MAP: Record<string, { field: string | null; bqName: string }> = {
  sku: { field: "sku", bqName: "SKU" },
  clientIdCode: { field: "clientIdCode", bqName: "ClientIDCode" },
  brandName: { field: "brandName", bqName: "BrandName" },
  itemName: { field: "itemName", bqName: "ItemName" },
  status: { field: "status", bqName: "Status" },
  variationId: { field: null, bqName: "VariationID" },
  variationGroup: { field: "variationGroup", bqName: "VariationGroup" },
  variationTheme: { field: null, bqName: "VariationThemeName" },
  parentageLevel: { field: "parentageLevel", bqName: "ParentageLevel" },
};

function SortableHeader({
  column,
  label,
}: {
  column: { getToggleSortingHandler: () => ((event: unknown) => void) | undefined };
  label: string;
}) {
  return (
    <Button
      variant="ghost"
      size="sm"
      className="-ml-3 h-8"
      onClick={column.getToggleSortingHandler()}
    >
      {label}
      <ArrowUpDown className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
    </Button>
  );
}

const STATUS_OPTIONS = ["Active", "Inactive", "Incomplete", "Out of Stock", "Closed", "Discontinued"];
const PARENTAGE_OPTIONS = ["Parent", "Child", "Standalone"];

function SelectCell({
  value,
  productId,
  accessorKey,
  onSave,
  options,
  renderValue,
}: {
  value: string | null;
  productId: string;
  accessorKey: string;
  onSave: SaveFieldFn;
  options: string[];
  renderValue?: (v: string) => React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null);
  const menuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [pos, setPos] = useState<{ top: number; left: number }>({ top: 0, left: 0 });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    function handleClickOutside(e: MouseEvent) {
      if (
        menuRef.current && !menuRef.current.contains(e.target as Node) &&
        triggerRef.current && !triggerRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)
      ) {
        setOpen(false);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClickOutside);
  }, [open]);

  const handleOpen = useCallback(() => {
    if (triggerRef.current) {
      const rect = triggerRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      setPos({ top: rect.bottom + 2, left: rect.left });
    }
    setOpen(true);
  }, []);

  const commit = useCallback(
    (newVal: string | null) => {
      setOpen(false);
      if (newVal !== (value ?? null)) {
        const mapping = FIELD_MAP[accessorKey];
        if (mapping) {
          onSave(productId, mapping.field, mapping.bqName, newVal);
        }
      }
    },
    [value, accessorKey, productId, onSave]
  );

  return (
    <>
      <span
        ref={triggerRef}
        className="cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80"
        onClick={handleOpen}
      >
        {value ? (renderValue ? renderValue(value) : value) : "—"}
      </span>
      {open && (
        <div
          ref={menuRef}
          className="fixed z-[9999] min-w-[130px] bg-popover border border-border rounded-md shadow-lg py-1 text-xs"
          style={{ top: pos.top, left: pos.left }}
        >
          {options.map((opt) => (
            <button
              key={opt}
              type="button"
              className={`block w-full text-left px-2.5 py-1.5 hover:bg-muted cursor-pointer ${opt === value ? "bg-muted font-medium" : ""}`}
              onClick={() => commit(opt)}
            >
              {renderValue ? renderValue(opt) : opt}
            </button>
          ))}
          <button
            type="button"
            className="block w-full text-left px-2.5 py-1.5 hover:bg-muted cursor-pointer text-muted-foreground"
            onClick={() => commit(null)}
          >
            None
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

function EditableCell({
  value,
  productId,
  accessorKey,
  onSave,
  className,
}: {
  value: string | null;
  productId: string;
  accessorKey: string;
  onSave: SaveFieldFn;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [editValue, setEditValue] = useState(value ?? "");
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (editing && inputRef.current) {
      inputRef.current.focus();
      inputRef.current.select();
    }
  }, [editing]);

  const commit = useCallback(() => {
    setEditing(false);
    const newVal = editValue.trim() || null;
    if (newVal !== (value ?? null)) {
      const mapping = FIELD_MAP[accessorKey];
      if (mapping) {
        onSave(productId, mapping.field, mapping.bqName, newVal);
      }
    }
  }, [editValue, value, accessorKey, productId, onSave]);

  if (editing) {
    return (
      <input
        ref={inputRef}
        className="font-mono text-xs w-full bg-field-bg text-field-text border border-field-border rounded px-1 py-0.5 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand"
        value={editValue}
        onChange={(e) => setEditValue(e.target.value)}
        onBlur={commit}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === "Enter") commit();
          if (e.key === "Escape") {
            setEditValue(value ?? "");
            setEditing(false);
          }
        }}
      />
    );
  }

  const hasWrap = className?.includes("line-clamp") || className?.includes("break-words");

  return (
    <span
      className={`font-mono text-xs block cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted rounded px-1 py-0.5 -mx-1 -my-0.5 ${hasWrap ? "" : "truncate"} ${className ?? ""}`}
      onClick={() => {
        setEditValue(value ?? "");
        setEditing(true);
      }}
    >
      {value || "—"}
    </span>
  );
}

function VariationEditableCell({
  value,
  productId,
  bqName,
  onSave,
}: {
  value: string | null;
  productId: string;
  bqName: string;
  onSave: SaveFieldFn;
}) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [editValue, setEditValue] = useState(value ?? "");
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (editing && inputRef.current) {
      inputRef.current.focus();
      inputRef.current.select();
    }
  }, [editing]);

  const commit = useCallback(() => {
    setEditing(false);
    const newVal = editValue.trim() || null;
    if (newVal !== (value ?? null)) {
      onSave(productId, null, bqName, newVal);
    }
  }, [editValue, value, bqName, productId, onSave]);

  if (editing) {
    return (
      <input
        ref={inputRef}
        className="font-mono text-xs w-full bg-field-bg text-field-text border border-field-border rounded px-1 py-0.5 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand"
        value={editValue}
        onChange={(e) => setEditValue(e.target.value)}
        onBlur={commit}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === "Enter") commit();
          if (e.key === "Escape") {
            setEditValue(value ?? "");
            setEditing(false);
          }
        }}
      />
    );
  }

  const display = value?.replace(/\s*\(Pack\s+of\s+\d+\)\s*/gi, " ").trim() ?? null;

  return (
    <span
      className="text-xs text-foreground cursor-pointer hover:text-brand transition-colors"
      onClick={() => {
        setEditValue(value ?? "");
        setEditing(true);
      }}
    >
      {display || "—"}
    </span>
  );
}

export function getColumns(
  canEdit: boolean,
  onSave?: SaveFieldFn
): ColumnDef<ProductRow>[] {
  return [
    {
      id: "isDirty",
      accessorKey: "isDirty",
      header: "",
      meta: { width: "20px" },
      cell: ({ row }) =>
        row.original.isDirty ? (
          <Circle className="h-2 w-2 fill-orange-500 text-orange-500" />
        ) : null,
    },
    {
      accessorKey: "asin",
      header: ({ column }) => <SortableHeader column={column} label="ASIN" />,
      meta: { width: "100px" },
      cell: ({ row }) => (
        <Link
          href={`/products/${row.original.id}`}
          className="font-mono font-bold text-xs text-brand hover:underline whitespace-nowrap"
        >
          {row.original.asin || "—"}
        </Link>
      ),
    },
    {
      accessorKey: "sku",
      header: ({ column }) => <SortableHeader column={column} label="SKU" />,
      meta: { width: "130px" },
      cell: ({ row }) =>
        canEdit && onSave ? (
          <EditableCell
            value={row.original.sku}
            productId={row.original.id}
            accessorKey="sku"
            onSave={onSave}
            className="text-foreground"
          />
        ) : (
          <span className="font-mono text-xs truncate block text-foreground">{row.original.sku || "—"}</span>
        ),
    },
    {
      accessorKey: "status",
      header: "Status",
      meta: { width: "80px" },
      cell: ({ row }) =>
        canEdit && onSave ? (
          <SelectCell
            value={row.original.status}
            productId={row.original.id}
            accessorKey="status"
            onSave={onSave}
            options={STATUS_OPTIONS}
            renderValue={(v) => <StatusBadge status={v} />}
          />
        ) : row.original.status ? (
          <StatusBadge status={row.original.status} />
        ) : (
          "—"
        ),
    },
    {
      accessorKey: "itemName",
      header: "Title",
      meta: { width: "280px", maxWidth: "280px" },
      cell: ({ row }) =>
        canEdit && onSave ? (
          <EditableCell
            value={row.original.itemName || row.original.summarizedTitle}
            productId={row.original.id}
            accessorKey="itemName"
            onSave={onSave}
            className="text-foreground !whitespace-normal line-clamp-3 break-words"
          />
        ) : (
          <span className="text-xs text-foreground line-clamp-3 break-words">
            {row.original.itemName || row.original.summarizedTitle || "—"}
          </span>
        ),
    },
    {
      accessorKey: "variationId",
      header: ({ column }) => <SortableHeader column={column} label="Var ID" />,
      meta: { width: "90px" },
      cell: ({ row }) =>
        canEdit && onSave ? (
          <EditableCell
            value={row.original.variationId}
            productId={row.original.id}
            accessorKey="variationId"
            onSave={onSave}
            className="text-foreground"
          />
        ) : (
          <span className="font-mono text-xs truncate block text-foreground">{row.original.variationId || "—"}</span>
        ),
    },
    {
      accessorKey: "variationGroup",
      header: "Group",
      meta: { width: "100px" },
      cell: ({ row }) => {
        const val = row.original.variationGroup;
        if (!val) return <span className="text-foreground">—</span>;
        if (canEdit && onSave) {
          return (
            <EditableCell
              value={val}
              productId={row.original.id}
              accessorKey="variationGroup"
              onSave={onSave}
              className="text-brand-group"
            />
          );
        }
        return (
          <span className="text-xs font-mono text-brand-group">{val}</span>
        );
      },
    },
    {
      id: "variationTheme",
      header: "Theme",
      meta: { width: "80px" },
      cell: ({ row }) =>
        canEdit && onSave ? (
          <EditableCell
            value={row.original.variations?.VariationThemeName ?? null}
            productId={row.original.id}
            accessorKey="variationTheme"
            onSave={onSave}
            className="text-foreground"
          />
        ) : (
          <span className="font-mono text-xs truncate block text-foreground">{row.original.variations?.VariationThemeName || "—"}</span>
        ),
    },
    {
      id: "vp",
      header: () => <span title="Variety Pack">VP</span>,
      meta: { width: "40px" },
      cell: ({ row }) =>
        (row.original.varietyPackItemCount ?? 0) > 0 ? (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded px-1 py-0.5 text-[8px] font-bold bg-brand-vp/15 text-brand-vp border border-brand-vp/30" title={`${row.original.varietyPackItemCount} pack items`}>
            <PackageOpen className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />
          </span>
        ) : null,
      enableSorting: false,
    },
    {
      id: "flavor",
      header: "Flavor",
      meta: { width: "120px" },
      cell: ({ row }) => {
        const isVP = (row.original.varietyPackItemCount ?? 0) > 0;
        const vpFlavors = row.original.vpFlavors;
        if (isVP && vpFlavors?.length) {
          return (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
              {vpFlavors.map((f, i) => (
                <span key={i} className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] bg-brand-vp/10 text-brand-vp whitespace-nowrap">{f}</span>
              ))}
            </div>
          );
        }
        const value = row.original.variations?.Flavor ?? null;
        if (canEdit && onSave) {
          return (
            <VariationEditableCell
              value={value}
              productId={row.original.id}
              bqName="Flavor"
              onSave={onSave}
            />
          );
        }
        return <span className="text-xs text-foreground">{value || "—"}</span>;
      },
      enableSorting: false,
    },
    {
      id: "size",
      header: "Size",
      meta: { width: "80px" },
      cell: ({ row }) => {
        const value = row.original.variations?.Size ?? null;
        if (canEdit && onSave) {
          return (
            <VariationEditableCell
              value={value}
              productId={row.original.id}
              bqName="Size"
              onSave={onSave}
            />
          );
        }
        return <span className="text-xs text-foreground">{value || "—"}</span>;
      },
      enableSorting: false,
    },
    {
      accessorKey: "parentageLevel",
      header: "Parentage",
      meta: { width: "70px" },
      cell: ({ row }) =>
        canEdit && onSave ? (
          <SelectCell
            value={row.original.parentageLevel}
            productId={row.original.id}
            accessorKey="parentageLevel"
            onSave={onSave}
            options={PARENTAGE_OPTIONS}
          />
        ) : (
          <span className="font-mono text-xs truncate block text-foreground">{row.original.parentageLevel || "—"}</span>
        ),
    },
  ];
}

// Keep a static export for backward compat (read-only)
export const columns: ColumnDef<ProductRow>[] = getColumns(false);

// ── Requirement dot colors (hex for inline styles in headers) ──────
const REQ_DOT_COLORS: Record<RequirementLevel, string> = {
  Required: "#ef4444",
  "Conditionally Required": "#f97316",
  Recommended: "#3b82f6",
  Optional: "#a1a1aa",
  "Not Required": "#71717a",
  "": "transparent",
};

/**
 * Build dynamic columns from user-selected column attributes.
 * Each reads its value from `row.original._raw?.[attr.bigqueryLabel]`.
 */
export function getDynamicColumns(
  selectedAttrs: EnrichedAttribute[],
  canEdit?: boolean,
  onSave?: SaveFieldFn,
): ColumnDef<ProductRow>[] {
  return selectedAttrs.map((attr) => {
    const bqLabel = attr.bigqueryLabel || attr.generalLabel;
    const fieldType = inferFieldType(attr);
    const isWide = fieldType === "textarea";
    const req = (attr.clientRequirement || "") as RequirementLevel;
    const dotColor = REQ_DOT_COLORS[req] || "transparent";

    return {
      id: `dyn_${bqLabel}`,
      accessorFn: (row: ProductRow) => row._raw?.[bqLabel] ?? null,
      header: () => (
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1 whitespace-nowrap text-xs font-medium">
          {dotColor !== "transparent" && (
            <span
              className="inline-block w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full flex-shrink-0"
              style={{ backgroundColor: dotColor }}
              title={req}
            />
          )}
          {attr.generalLabel}
        </span>
      ),
      meta: { width: isWide ? "200px" : "120px" },
      enableSorting: false,
      cell: ({ row }: { row: { original: ProductRow } }) => {
        const value = row.original._raw?.[bqLabel] ?? null;
        if (canEdit && onSave) {
          return (
            <DynamicEditableCell
              value={value}
              productId={row.original.id}
              bqName={bqLabel}
              onSave={onSave}
            />
          );
        }
        return (
          <span className="font-mono text-xs truncate block">
            {value || "\u2014"}
          </span>
        );
      },
    } satisfies ColumnDef<ProductRow>;
  });
}

/** Inline editable cell for dynamic (rawColumnValues) columns. */
function DynamicEditableCell({
  value,
  productId,
  bqName,
  onSave,
}: {
  value: string | null;
  productId: string;
  bqName: string;
  onSave: SaveFieldFn;
}) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [editValue, setEditValue] = useState(value ?? "");
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (editing && inputRef.current) {
      inputRef.current.focus();
      inputRef.current.select();
    }
  }, [editing]);

  const commit = useCallback(() => {
    setEditing(false);
    const newVal = editValue.trim() || null;
    if (newVal !== (value ?? null)) {
      // field=null tells the PUT handler this is a JSONB/rawColumnValues field
      onSave(productId, null, bqName, newVal);
    }
  }, [editValue, value, bqName, productId, onSave]);

  if (editing) {
    return (
      <input
        ref={inputRef}
        className="font-mono text-xs w-full bg-field-bg text-field-text border border-field-border rounded px-1 py-0.5 outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand"
        value={editValue}
        onChange={(e) => setEditValue(e.target.value)}
        onBlur={commit}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === "Enter") commit();
          if (e.key === "Escape") {
            setEditValue(value ?? "");
            setEditing(false);
          }
        }}
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <span
      className="font-mono text-xs truncate block cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted rounded px-1 py-0.5 -mx-1 -my-0.5"
      onClick={() => {
        setEditValue(value ?? "");
        setEditing(true);
      }}
    >
      {value || "\u2014"}
    </span>
  );
}

export const selectColumn: ColumnDef<ProductRow> = {
  id: "select",
  header: ({ table }) => (
    <Checkbox
      checked={table.getIsAllPageRowsSelected()}
      onCheckedChange={(value) => table.toggleAllPageRowsSelected(!!value)}
      aria-label="Select all"
    />
  ),
  cell: ({ row }) => (
    <Checkbox
      checked={row.getIsSelected()}
      onCheckedChange={(value) => row.toggleSelected(!!value)}
      aria-label="Select row"
    />
  ),
  enableSorting: false,
  enableHiding: false,
  meta: { width: "40px" },
};

"use client";

import { useState, useCallback, useMemo, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useSession } from "next-auth/react";
import {
  useReactTable,
  getCoreRowModel,
  getSortedRowModel,
  flexRender,
  SortingState,
  RowSelectionState,
} from "@tanstack/react-table";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { getColumns, getDynamicColumns, selectColumn, type ProductRow, type SaveFieldFn } from "./product-table-columns";
import { ProductTableToolbar } from "./product-table-toolbar";
import { ProductColumnPicker } from "./product-column-picker";
import { BulkEditBar } from "./bulk-edit-bar";
import { BulkEditDialog } from "./bulk-edit-dialog";
import { CreateProductDialog } from "./create-product-dialog";
import { CLIENT_NAMES } from "@/lib/constants";
import type { EnrichedAttribute } from "@/hooks/use-column-attributes";
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

type ClientEntry = { clientIdCode: string; count: number; activeCount: number };

async function fetchClients(): Promise<ClientEntry[]> {
  const res = await fetch("/api/clients");
  if (!res.ok) return [];
  return res.json();
}

type ProductsResponse = {
  data: ProductRow[];
  pagination: {
    page: number;
    pageSize: number;
    total: number;
    totalPages: number;
  };
};

async function fetchProducts(params: URLSearchParams): Promise<ProductsResponse> {
  const res = await fetch(`/api/products?${params.toString()}`);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch products");
  return res.json();
}

export function ProductTable() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [client, setClient] = useState(searchParams.get("client") || "");
  const [marketplace, setMarketplace] = useState("");
  const [statuses, setStatuses] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set(["Active"]));
  const [isDirty, setIsDirty] = useState("");
  const [sorting, setSorting] = useState<SortingState>([]);
  const [debouncedSearch, setDebouncedSearch] = useState("");
  const [includeInactive, setIncludeInactive] = useState(false);

  // Bulk edit state
  const [bulkMode, setBulkMode] = useState(false);
  const [rowSelection, setRowSelection] = useState<RowSelectionState>({});
  const [allSelectedIds, setAllSelectedIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [editDialogOpen, setEditDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [createDialogOpen, setCreateDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [extraColumns, setExtraColumns] = useState<EnrichedAttribute[]>([]);

  const userRole = session?.user?.role;
  const canEdit = userRole === "admin" || userRole === "editor";

  // Save mutation for inline editing
  const saveMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async ({
      productId,
      field,
      bqName,
      value,
    }: {
      productId: string;
      field: string | null;
      bqName: string;
      value: string | null;
    }) => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${productId}`, {
        method: "PUT",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ field, value, bqName }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Save failed");
      }
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: () => {
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["products"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["publish-info"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["completeness"] });
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => {
      toast.error(`Failed to save: ${error.message}`);
    },
  });

  const handleSave: SaveFieldFn = useCallback(
    (productId, field, bqName, value) => {
      saveMutation.mutate({ productId, field, bqName, value });
    },
    [saveMutation]
  );

  // Sync client filter from URL when navigating from sidebar
  const urlClient = searchParams.get("client") || "";
  useEffect(() => {
    setClient(urlClient);
    setPage(1);
  }, [urlClient]);

  const handleSearchChange = useCallback((value: string) => {
    setSearch(value);
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
      setDebouncedSearch(value);
      setPage(1);
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
  }, []);

  const handleStatusToggle = useCallback((status: string) => {
    setStatuses((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(status)) {
        next.delete(status);
      } else {
        next.add(status);
      }
      return next;
    });
    setPage(1);
  }, []);

  const statusParam = useMemo(() => [...statuses].join(","), [statuses]);

  const params = useMemo(() => {
    const p = new URLSearchParams();
    p.set("page", String(page));
    p.set("pageSize", "50");
    if (debouncedSearch) p.set("search", debouncedSearch);
    if (client) p.set("client", client);
    if (marketplace) p.set("marketplace", marketplace);
    if (statusParam) p.set("status", statusParam);
    if (isDirty) p.set("isDirty", isDirty);
    if (sorting.length > 0) {
      p.set("sortBy", sorting[0].id);
      p.set("sortOrder", sorting[0].desc ? "desc" : "asc");
    }
    if (includeInactive) p.set("includeInactive", "true");
    if (extraColumns.length > 0) p.set("fields", "all");
    return p;
  }, [page, debouncedSearch, client, marketplace, statusParam, isDirty, sorting, includeInactive, extraColumns.length]);

  const { data: clientsData = [] } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["clients"],
    queryFn: fetchClients,
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  const clientCodes = useMemo(() => clientsData.map((c) => c.clientIdCode), [clientsData]);

  const { data, isLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["products", params.toString()],
    queryFn: () => fetchProducts(params),
  });

  const rawTableData = useMemo(() => data?.data ?? [], [data?.data]);

  // Fetch completeness scores when a client filter is active
  const productIds = useMemo(() => rawTableData.map((p) => p.id), [rawTableData]);
  const { data: completenessData } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["completeness", client, productIds],
    queryFn: async () => {
      if (!client || productIds.length === 0) return null;
      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/products/completeness?client=${encodeURIComponent(client)}&productIds=${productIds.join(",")}`
      );
      if (!res.ok) return null;
      return res.json();
    },
    enabled: !!client && productIds.length > 0,
    staleTime: 60 * 1000,
  });

  // Merge completeness scores + rawColumnValues into table data
  const tableData = useMemo(() => {
    return rawTableData.map((row) => {
      const enriched: ProductRow = { ...row };
      if (completenessData?.scores) {
        const score = completenessData.scores.find(
          (s: { productId: string; score: number }) => s.productId === row.id
        );
        enriched._completenessScore = score?.score ?? null;
      }
      // Attach raw column values for dynamic columns
      const rawRow = row as ProductRow & { rawColumnValues?: Record<string, string> };
      if (rawRow.rawColumnValues) {
        enriched._raw = rawRow.rawColumnValues;
      }
      return enriched;
    });
  }, [rawTableData, completenessData]);

  const baseColumns = useMemo(
    () => getColumns(canEdit, canEdit ? handleSave : undefined),
    [canEdit, handleSave]
  );

  const dynamicColumns = useMemo(
    () =>
      extraColumns.length > 0
        ? getDynamicColumns(extraColumns, canEdit, canEdit ? handleSave : undefined)
        : [],
    [extraColumns, canEdit, handleSave]
  );

  // Filter out dynamic columns where no row has data (hide empty variation columns)
  const populatedDynamicColumns = useMemo(() => {
    if (dynamicColumns.length === 0 || tableData.length === 0) return dynamicColumns;
    return dynamicColumns.filter((col) => {
      // Extract the BigQuery label from the column id (format: "dyn_{bqLabel}")
      const colId = (col as { id?: string }).id;
      if (!colId?.startsWith("dyn_")) return true;
      const bqLabel = colId.slice(4);
      return tableData.some((row) => {
        const val = row._raw?.[bqLabel];
        return val != null && val !== "" && val !== "—";
      });
    });
  }, [dynamicColumns, tableData]);

  const tableColumns = useMemo(
    () => {
      const cols = bulkMode ? [selectColumn, ...baseColumns] : baseColumns;
      return populatedDynamicColumns.length > 0 ? [...cols, ...populatedDynamicColumns] : cols;
    },
    [bulkMode, baseColumns, populatedDynamicColumns]
  );

  // Sync cross-page selections: when rowSelection changes, merge into allSelectedIds
  const handleRowSelectionChange = useCallback(
    (updaterOrValue: RowSelectionState | ((old: RowSelectionState) => RowSelectionState)) => {
      setRowSelection((prev) => {
        const next = typeof updaterOrValue === "function" ? updaterOrValue(prev) : updaterOrValue;

        setAllSelectedIds((prevIds) => {
          const newIds = new Set(prevIds);
          // Get current page row IDs
          const pageRowIds = tableData.map((r) => r.id);

          for (const id of pageRowIds) {
            if (next[id]) {
              newIds.add(id);
            } else {
              newIds.delete(id);
            }
          }
          return newIds;
        });

        return next;
      });
    },
    [tableData]
  );

  // When page changes, restore rowSelection from allSelectedIds for visible rows
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!bulkMode) return;
    const restored: RowSelectionState = {};
    for (const row of tableData) {
      if (allSelectedIds.has(row.id)) {
        restored[row.id] = true;
      }
    }
    setRowSelection(restored);
  }, [tableData, bulkMode, allSelectedIds]);

  // When bulk mode is turned off, clear all selection state
  const handleBulkModeChange = useCallback((enabled: boolean) => {
    setBulkMode(enabled);
    if (!enabled) {
      setRowSelection({});
      setAllSelectedIds(new Set());
      setEditDialogOpen(false);
    }
  }, []);

  // After successful bulk edit
  const handleBulkEditSuccess = useCallback(() => {
    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["products"] });
    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["publish-info"] });
    setAllSelectedIds(new Set());
    setRowSelection({});
    setBulkMode(false);
    setEditDialogOpen(false);
  }, [queryClient]);

  const table = useReactTable({
    data: tableData,
    columns: tableColumns,
    getCoreRowModel: getCoreRowModel(),
    getSortedRowModel: getSortedRowModel(),
    onSortingChange: setSorting,
    onRowSelectionChange: handleRowSelectionChange,
    enableRowSelection: bulkMode,
    getRowId: (row) => row.id,
    state: { sorting, rowSelection },
    manualSorting: true,
  });

  const pagination = data?.pagination;
  const rows = table.getRowModel().rows;

  // Build client group separator indices for the flat table
  const clientGroupStarts = useMemo(() => {
    const starts = new Map<number, { client: string; count: number }>();
    if (rows.length === 0) return starts;

    let currentClient = rows[0].original.clientIdCode || "";
    let groupStartIdx = 0;
    let groupCount = 1;

    for (let i = 1; i < rows.length; i++) {
      const rowClient = rows[i].original.clientIdCode || "";
      if (rowClient !== currentClient) {
        starts.set(groupStartIdx, { client: currentClient, count: groupCount });
        currentClient = rowClient;
        groupStartIdx = i;
        groupCount = 1;
      } else {
        groupCount++;
      }
    }
    starts.set(groupStartIdx, { client: currentClient, count: groupCount });

    return starts;
  }, [rows]);

  const toolbarRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const selectedCount = allSelectedIds.size;

  const colCount = table.getAllColumns().length;

  return (
    <div className={selectedCount > 0 ? "pb-16" : ""}>
      {/* Sticky toolbar */}
      <div ref={toolbarRef} className="sticky top-0 z-30 bg-background pb-3 border-b mb-0 pt-4">
        <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter mb-1">
          <span className="text-foreground font-bold">Product</span><span className="text-brand">Catalog</span>
        </h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-3">View, edit, and manage products across all clients.</p>
        <ProductTableToolbar
          search={search}
          onSearchChange={handleSearchChange}
          client={client}
          onClientChange={(v) => { setClient(v); setPage(1); }}
          marketplace={marketplace}
          onMarketplaceChange={(v) => { setMarketplace(v); setPage(1); }}
          statuses={statuses}
          onStatusToggle={handleStatusToggle}
          clientCodes={clientCodes}
          isDirty={isDirty}
          onIsDirtyChange={(v) => { setIsDirty(v); setPage(1); }}
          onClearFilters={() => {
            setSearch("");
            setDebouncedSearch("");
            setClient("");
            setMarketplace("");
            setStatuses(new Set());
            setIsDirty("");
            setIncludeInactive(false);
            setPage(1);
          }}
          bulkMode={bulkMode}
          onBulkModeChange={handleBulkModeChange}
          canEdit={canEdit}
          onCreateProduct={() => setCreateDialogOpen(true)}
          includeInactive={includeInactive}
          onIncludeInactiveChange={(v) => { setIncludeInactive(v); setPage(1); }}
          columnPickerSlot={
            <ProductColumnPicker
              clientCode={client || undefined}
              selectedAttrs={extraColumns}
              onSelectedChange={setExtraColumns}
            />
          }
        />
      </div>

      {/* Flat table layout */}
      {isLoading ? (
        <div className="space-y-2 mt-4">
          {Array.from({ length: 8 }).map((_, i) => (
            <Skeleton key={i} className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg" />
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : rows.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="text-center py-16 text-muted-foreground text-sm">No products found.</div>
      ) : (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900/50 overflow-x-auto mt-4">
          <table className="w-full text-xs">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-stone-100 dark:border-zinc-800 text-left">
                {table.getHeaderGroups()[0].headers.map((header) => {
                  const meta = header.column.columnDef.meta as { width?: string; maxWidth?: string } | undefined;
                  return (
                    <th
                      key={header.id}
                      className="px-3 py-2.5 font-bold text-brand whitespace-nowrap"
                      style={{ width: meta?.width, maxWidth: meta?.maxWidth }}
                    >
                      {header.isPlaceholder ? null : flexRender(header.column.columnDef.header, header.getContext())}
                    </th>
                  );
                })}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {rows.map((row, idx) => {
                const clientGroup = clientGroupStarts.get(idx);
                const fragments = [];
                if (clientGroup) {
                  fragments.push(
                    <tr key={`client-${clientGroup.client}`} className="border-b border-stone-100 dark:border-zinc-800">
                      <td colSpan={colCount} className="px-3 py-2">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-brand">
                            {CLIENT_NAMES[clientGroup.client] || clientGroup.client || "No Client"}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{clientGroup.client}</span>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">({clientGroup.count})</span>
                          <div className="flex-1 h-px bg-border" />
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                }
                fragments.push(
                  <tr
                    key={row.id}
                    className={cn(
                      "border-b border-stone-50 dark:border-zinc-800/50 transition-colors",
                      "hover:bg-stone-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800/50"
                    )}
                  >
                    {row.getVisibleCells().map((cell) => {
                      const meta = cell.column.columnDef.meta as { width?: string; maxWidth?: string } | undefined;
                      return (
                        <td
                          key={cell.id}
                          className="px-3 py-2"
                          style={{ width: meta?.width, maxWidth: meta?.maxWidth }}
                        >
                          {flexRender(cell.column.columnDef.cell, cell.getContext())}
                        </td>
                      );
                    })}
                  </tr>
                );
                return fragments;
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Pagination */}
      {pagination && pagination.total > pagination.pageSize && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-3">
          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
            {pagination.total} products &middot; Page {pagination.page} of {pagination.totalPages}
          </span>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="ghost"
              disabled={page <= 1}
              onClick={() => setPage(page - 1)}
              className="h-7 w-7 p-0 text-muted-foreground"
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </Button>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="ghost"
              disabled={page >= pagination.totalPages}
              onClick={() => setPage(page + 1)}
              className="h-7 w-7 p-0 text-muted-foreground"
            >
              <ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Bulk Edit Bar */}
      <BulkEditBar
        selectedCount={selectedCount}
        onClear={() => {
          setAllSelectedIds(new Set());
          setRowSelection({});
        }}
        onEditField={() => setEditDialogOpen(true)}
      />

      {/* Create Product Dialog */}
      <CreateProductDialog
        open={createDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setCreateDialogOpen}
      />

      {/* Bulk Edit Dialog */}
      <BulkEditDialog
        open={editDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setEditDialogOpen}
        selectedIds={allSelectedIds}
        onSuccess={handleBulkEditSuccess}
        clientFilter={client}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import type { RequirementLevel } from "@/lib/constants";
import { REQUIREMENT_COLORS } from "@/lib/constants";

type Props = {
  breakdown: Record<string, number>;
  activeFilters: Set<RequirementLevel>;
  onToggle: (level: RequirementLevel) => void;
};

const DISPLAY_ORDER: RequirementLevel[] = [
  "Required",
  "Conditionally Required",
  "Recommended",
  "Optional",
];

const CHIP_LABELS: Partial<Record<RequirementLevel, string>> = {
  "Conditionally Required": "Cond.Req",
};

export function RequirementSummary({ breakdown, activeFilters, onToggle }: Props) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
      {DISPLAY_ORDER.map((level) => {
        const count = breakdown[level] || 0;
        if (count === 0) return null;
        const isActive = activeFilters.has(level);
        return (
          <button
            key={level}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onToggle(level)}
            className={`inline-flex items-center rounded px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium border transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              isActive
                ? `${REQUIREMENT_COLORS[level]} ring-2 ring-offset-1 ring-current`
                : `${REQUIREMENT_COLORS[level]} opacity-60 hover:opacity-100`
            }`}
          >
            {count} {CHIP_LABELS[level] || level}
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
