"use client";

import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import { ChevronDown, ChevronRight, Loader2, Check, X } from "lucide-react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { getProductFieldValue } from "@/lib/product-mapper";
import type { Product } from "@/lib/db/schema";

const THEME_OPTIONS = [
  "COLOR_NAME",
  "SIZE_NAME",
  "STYLE_NAME",
  "FLAVOR_NAME",
  "COLOR_NAME/SIZE_NAME",
  "SIZE_NAME/COLOR_NAME",
  "FLAVOR_NAME/SIZE_NAME",
  "SIZE_NAME/STYLE_NAME",
  "SIZE/COLOR",
  "SIZE/FLAVOR",
  "PATTERN_NAME",
];

/** Map theme value → which attribute fields it enables */
const THEME_FIELD_MAP: Record<string, Set<string>> = {
  COLOR: new Set(["Color"]),
  COLOR_NAME: new Set(["Color"]),
  ColorName: new Set(["Color"]),
  SIZE: new Set(["Size"]),
  SIZE_NAME: new Set(["Size"]),
  SizeName: new Set(["Size"]),
  STYLE_NAME: new Set(["Style"]),
  FLAVOR_NAME: new Set(["Flavor"]),
  Flavor: new Set(["Flavor"]),
  PATTERN_NAME: new Set(["Color"]),
  "COLOR_NAME/SIZE_NAME": new Set(["Color", "Size"]),
  "SIZE_NAME/COLOR_NAME": new Set(["Color", "Size"]),
  "SIZE/COLOR": new Set(["Color", "Size"]),
  "color-size": new Set(["Color", "Size"]),
  "FLAVOR_NAME/SIZE_NAME": new Set(["Flavor", "Size"]),
  "SIZE/FLAVOR": new Set(["Flavor", "Size"]),
  "Flavor-Size": new Set(["Flavor", "Size"]),
  "FlavorName-SizeName": new Set(["Flavor", "Size"]),
  "SIZE_NAME/STYLE_NAME": new Set(["Size", "Style"]),
  "stylename-color": new Set(["Style", "Color"]),
  "itemform-sizename": new Set(["Size"]),
};

/** Fields that get dimmed when not matching the theme */
const THEME_CONTROLLED = new Set(["Color", "Flavor", "Size", "Style"]);

/** All variation fields in display order */
const FIELDS: {
  bqName: string;
  label: string;
  width?: string;
}[] = [
  { bqName: "VariationID", label: "Variation ID", width: "w-48" },
  { bqName: "VariationThemeName", label: "Theme Name" },
  { bqName: "VariationProduct", label: "Variation Product", width: "w-48" },
  { bqName: "ChildRelationshipType", label: "Child Rel. Type", width: "w-32" },
  { bqName: "Color", label: "Color", width: "w-32" },
  { bqName: "Flavor", label: "Flavor", width: "w-32" },
  { bqName: "Size", label: "Size", width: "w-32" },
  { bqName: "Style", label: "Style", width: "w-32" },
];

type Props = {
  product: Product;
  readOnly: boolean;
  onSave: (bqName: string, value: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  onFieldSaved?: (
    bqName: string,
    label: string,
    oldValue: string,
    newValue: string
  ) => void;
};

export function VariationSection({
  product,
  readOnly,
  onSave,
  onFieldSaved,
}: Props) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(true);

  const populatedCount = FIELDS.filter((f) => {
    const val = getProductFieldValue(product, f.bqName);
    return val != null && val !== "";
  }).length;

  const themeName = getProductFieldValue(product, "VariationThemeName") ?? "";
  const enabledFields = THEME_FIELD_MAP[themeName];

  const isDimmed = useCallback(
    (bqName: string): boolean => {
      if (!THEME_CONTROLLED.has(bqName)) return false;
      if (!themeName || !enabledFields) return false;
      return !enabledFields.has(bqName);
    },
    [themeName, enabledFields]
  );

  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-card text-card-foreground">
      <button
        onClick={() => setExpanded(!expanded)}
        className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 w-full px-4 py-2.5 text-left hover:bg-muted/50 transition-colors"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
          {expanded ? (
            <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
          ) : (
            <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
          )}
          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-section-title">
            Variations
          </span>
        </div>
        <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs shrink-0 tabular-nums">
          {populatedCount}/{FIELDS.length}
        </Badge>
      </button>

      {expanded && (
        <div className="border-t border-border px-4 py-2 space-y-0">
          {FIELDS.map((field) => {
            const value = getProductFieldValue(product, field.bqName) ?? "";
            const dimmed = isDimmed(field.bqName);

            if (field.bqName === "VariationThemeName") {
              return (
                <ThemeField
                  key={field.bqName}
                  label={field.label}
                  bqName={field.bqName}
                  value={value}
                  readOnly={readOnly}
                  onSave={onSave}
                  onFieldSaved={onFieldSaved}
                />
              );
            }

            return (
              <div
                key={field.bqName}
                className={dimmed ? "opacity-30" : ""}
              >
                <EditableField
                  label={field.label}
                  bqName={field.bqName}
                  value={value}
                  readOnly={readOnly || dimmed}
                  onSave={onSave}
                  onFieldSaved={onFieldSaved}
                  width={field.width}
                />
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Theme dropdown field */
function ThemeField({
  label,
  bqName,
  value,
  readOnly,
  onSave,
  onFieldSaved,
}: {
  label: string;
  bqName: string;
  value: string;
  readOnly: boolean;
  onSave: (bqName: string, value: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  onFieldSaved?: (bqName: string, label: string, oldValue: string, newValue: string) => void;
}) {
  const [saveState, setSaveState] = useState<"idle" | "saving" | "saved" | "error">("idle");

  const handleChange = useCallback(
    async (newVal: string) => {
      const trimmed = newVal === "__empty__" ? "" : newVal;
      if (trimmed === value) return;
      setSaveState("saving");
      try {
        await onSave(bqName, trimmed || null);
        onFieldSaved?.(bqName, label, value, trimmed);
        setSaveState("saved");
        setTimeout(() => setSaveState("idle"), 1500);
      } catch {
        setSaveState("error");
        toast.error(`Failed to save ${label}`);
        setTimeout(() => setSaveState("idle"), 2000);
      }
    },
    [bqName, label, value, onSave, onFieldSaved]
  );

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 py-0.5" id={`field-${bqName}`}>
      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground shrink-0 w-32 truncate">
        {label}
      </span>
      {readOnly ? (
        <span className="text-xs text-foreground/80">
          {value || <span className="text-muted-foreground/50">—</span>}
        </span>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
          <Select
            value={value || "__empty__"}
            onValueChange={handleChange}
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="h-6 px-1.5 text-xs rounded border border-border bg-field-bg text-field-text focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand w-48">
              <SelectValue placeholder="Select..." />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="__empty__">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">None</span>
              </SelectItem>
              {THEME_OPTIONS.map((opt) => (
                <SelectItem key={opt} value={opt}>
                  {opt}
                </SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
          {saveState === "saving" && (
            <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
          )}
          {saveState === "saved" && (
            <Check className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-500 shrink-0" />
          )}
          {saveState === "error" && (
            <X className="h-3 w-3 text-destructive shrink-0" />
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Editable text field with inline editing — saves on blur/Enter */
function EditableField({
  label,
  bqName,
  value,
  readOnly,
  onSave,
  onFieldSaved,
  width,
}: {
  label: string;
  bqName: string;
  value: string;
  readOnly: boolean;
  onSave: (bqName: string, value: string | null) => Promise<void>;
  onFieldSaved?: (bqName: string, label: string, oldValue: string, newValue: string) => void;
  width?: string;
}) {
  const [localValue, setLocalValue] = useState(value);
  const [saveState, setSaveState] = useState<"idle" | "saving" | "saved" | "error">("idle");
  const focusedRef = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!focusedRef.current) {
      setLocalValue(value);
    }
  }, [value]);

  const doSave = useCallback(
    async (newVal: string) => {
      if (newVal === value) return;
      setSaveState("saving");
      try {
        await onSave(bqName, newVal || null);
        onFieldSaved?.(bqName, label, value, newVal);
        setSaveState("saved");
        setTimeout(() => setSaveState("idle"), 1500);
      } catch {
        setSaveState("error");
        toast.error(`Failed to save ${label}`);
        setTimeout(() => setSaveState("idle"), 2000);
      }
    },
    [bqName, label, value, onSave, onFieldSaved]
  );

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 py-0.5" id={`field-${bqName}`}>
      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground shrink-0 w-32 truncate">
        {label}
      </span>
      {readOnly ? (
        <span className="text-xs text-foreground/80">
          {value || <span className="text-muted-foreground/50">—</span>}
        </span>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
          <input
            type="text"
            data-field-bq={bqName}
            value={localValue}
            onChange={(e) => setLocalValue(e.target.value)}
            onFocus={() => { focusedRef.current = true; }}
            onBlur={() => {
              focusedRef.current = false;
              doSave(localValue);
            }}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === "Enter") doSave(localValue);
              if (e.key === "Escape") {
                setLocalValue(value);
                (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).blur();
              }
            }}
            className={`h-6 px-1.5 text-xs rounded border border-border bg-field-bg text-field-text focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand ${
              width ?? "flex-1 min-w-0"
            }`}
          />
          {saveState === "saving" && (
            <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
          )}
          {saveState === "saved" && (
            <Check className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-500 shrink-0" />
          )}
          {saveState === "error" && (
            <X className="h-3 w-3 text-destructive shrink-0" />
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { PackageOpen, Plus, Trash2, ChevronDown, ExternalLink } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Collapsible,
  CollapsibleContent,
  CollapsibleTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/collapsible";
import type { Product } from "@/lib/db/schema";

type PackItem = {
  id?: string;
  includedProductId: string | null;
  includedAsin: string | null;
  includedSku: string | null;
  includedTitle: string | null;
  includedImage: string | null;
  flavor: string | null;
  size: string | null;
  color: string | null;
  style: string | null;
  customLabel: string | null;
  units: number;
};

type SiblingProduct = {
  id: string;
  asin: string | null;
  sku: string | null;
  itemName: string | null;
  summarizedTitle: string | null;
  mainImageUrl: string | null;
  flavor: string | null;
  size: string | null;
  color: string | null;
  style: string | null;
};

async function fetchPackItems(productId: string): Promise<PackItem[]> {
  const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${productId}/variety-pack`);
  if (!res.ok) return [];
  return res.json();
}

async function fetchSiblings(productId: string): Promise<SiblingProduct[]> {
  const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${productId}/siblings`);
  if (!res.ok) return [];
  return res.json();
}

async function savePackItems(productId: string, items: PackItem[]): Promise<void> {
  const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${productId}/variety-pack`, {
    method: "PUT",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      items: items.map((it) => ({
        includedProductId: it.includedProductId || null,
        flavor: it.flavor || "",
        size: it.size || "",
        color: it.color || "",
        style: it.style || "",
        customLabel: it.customLabel || "",
        units: it.units,
      })),
    }),
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to save");
}

export function VarietyPackSection({
  product,
  readOnly,
}: {
  product: Product;
  readOnly: boolean;
}) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const productId = product.id;

  const [items, setItems] = useState<PackItem[] | null>(null);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [showSiblingPicker, setShowSiblingPicker] = useState(false);

  const { data: savedItems = [], isLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["variety-pack", productId],
    queryFn: () => fetchPackItems(productId),
  });

  const { data: siblings = [] } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["product-siblings", productId],
    queryFn: () => fetchSiblings(productId),
    enabled: editing || savedItems.length > 0,
  });

  // Use local state when editing, otherwise use server data
  const displayItems = editing && items !== null ? items : savedItems;

  const saveMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () => savePackItems(productId, items || []),
    onSuccess: () => {
      toast.success("Variety pack saved");
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["variety-pack", productId] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["product", productId] });
      setEditing(false);
      setItems(null);
    },
    onError: () => toast.error("Failed to save variety pack"),
  });

  function startEditing() {
    setItems([...savedItems]);
    setEditing(true);
  }

  function cancelEditing() {
    setItems(null);
    setEditing(false);
    setShowSiblingPicker(false);
  }

  function addFromSibling(sib: SiblingProduct) {
    const v = (sib as Record<string, unknown>) || {};
    setItems((prev) => [
      ...(prev || []),
      {
        includedProductId: sib.id,
        includedAsin: sib.asin,
        includedSku: sib.sku,
        includedTitle: sib.itemName || sib.summarizedTitle,
        includedImage: sib.mainImageUrl,
        flavor: (v.flavor as string) || null,
        size: (v.size as string) || null,
        color: (v.color as string) || null,
        style: (v.style as string) || null,
        customLabel: null,
        units: 1,
      },
    ]);
    setShowSiblingPicker(false);
  }

  function addCustom() {
    setItems((prev) => [
      ...(prev || []),
      {
        includedProductId: null,
        includedAsin: null,
        includedSku: null,
        includedTitle: null,
        includedImage: null,
        flavor: null,
        size: null,
        color: null,
        style: null,
        customLabel: null,
        units: 1,
      },
    ]);
  }

  function removeItem(idx: number) {
    setItems((prev) => (prev || []).filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
  }

  function updateItem(idx: number, field: keyof PackItem, value: string | number) {
    setItems((prev) =>
      (prev || []).map((it, i) => (i === idx ? { ...it, [field]: value } : it))
    );
  }

  // Available siblings (not already in pack, not the product itself)
  const usedIds = new Set(
    displayItems.filter((it) => it.includedProductId).map((it) => it.includedProductId)
  );
  const availableSiblings = siblings.filter(
    (s) => s.id !== productId && !usedIds.has(s.id)
  );

  if (isLoading) return null;
  if (savedItems.length === 0 && !editing) {
    // Show a small "Define as variety pack" button
    if (readOnly) return null;
    return (
      <Collapsible defaultOpen={false}>
        <CollapsibleTrigger className="flex items-center justify-between w-full px-4 py-2.5 bg-card rounded-lg hover:bg-muted transition-colors">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <PackageOpen className="h-4 w-4 text-brand-vp" />
            <span className="text-sm font-medium text-white">Variety Pack</span>
          </div>
          <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground/70" />
        </CollapsibleTrigger>
        <CollapsibleContent className="mt-2 rounded-lg border border-border bg-card p-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3">
            Define what items are included in this variety pack product.
          </p>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => {
              startEditing();
              addCustom();
            }}
            className="text-xs"
          >
            <PackageOpen className="h-3 w-3 mr-1.5" />
            Define as Variety Pack
          </Button>
        </CollapsibleContent>
      </Collapsible>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Collapsible defaultOpen={savedItems.length > 0}>
      <CollapsibleTrigger className="flex items-center justify-between w-full px-4 py-2.5 bg-card rounded-lg hover:bg-muted transition-colors">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <PackageOpen className="h-4 w-4 text-brand-vp" />
          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-white">Variety Pack</span>
          <Badge className="rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold bg-brand-vp/15 text-brand-vp border-brand-vp/30">
            {displayItems.length} item{displayItems.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
          </Badge>
        </div>
        <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground/70" />
      </CollapsibleTrigger>
      <CollapsibleContent className="mt-2 rounded-lg border border-border bg-card">
        <div className="p-4 space-y-3">
          {/* Items table */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {displayItems.map((item, idx) => (
              <div
                key={item.id || `new-${idx}`}
                className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/30 p-3"
              >
                {/* Image thumbnail */}
                <div className="shrink-0 w-10 h-10 rounded border border-border bg-background flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden">
                  {item.includedImage ? (
                    <img
                      src={item.includedImage}
                      alt=""
                      className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <PackageOpen className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground/40" />
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 space-y-2">
                  {/* Title / ASIN row */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    {item.includedAsin && (
                      <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-brand shrink-0">
                        {item.includedAsin}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    <span className="text-xs text-foreground/80 truncate">
                      {item.includedTitle || item.customLabel || "Custom item"}
                    </span>
                    {item.includedProductId && (
                      <a
                        href={`/products/${item.includedProductId}`}
                        target="_blank"
                        rel="noopener noreferrer"
                        className="shrink-0"
                      >
                        <ExternalLink className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground hover:text-brand transition-colors" />
                      </a>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Attribute fields */}
                  {editing ? (
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-2">
                      <FieldInput
                        label="Flavor"
                        value={item.flavor || ""}
                        onChange={(v) => updateItem(idx, "flavor", v)}
                      />
                      <FieldInput
                        label="Size"
                        value={item.size || ""}
                        onChange={(v) => updateItem(idx, "size", v)}
                      />
                      <FieldInput
                        label="Color"
                        value={item.color || ""}
                        onChange={(v) => updateItem(idx, "color", v)}
                      />
                      <FieldInput
                        label="Style"
                        value={item.style || ""}
                        onChange={(v) => updateItem(idx, "style", v)}
                      />
                      <FieldInput
                        label="Units"
                        value={String(item.units)}
                        onChange={(v) => updateItem(idx, "units", parseInt(v) || 1)}
                        type="number"
                      />
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                      {item.flavor && <AttrChip label="Flavor" value={item.flavor} />}
                      {item.size && <AttrChip label="Size" value={item.size} />}
                      {item.color && <AttrChip label="Color" value={item.color} />}
                      {item.style && <AttrChip label="Style" value={item.style} />}
                      <AttrChip label="Units" value={String(item.units)} />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Delete button */}
                {editing && (
                  <button
                    onClick={() => removeItem(idx)}
                    className="shrink-0 p-1 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500 transition-colors"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Action buttons */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-1">
            {!editing && !readOnly && (
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={startEditing} className="text-xs">
                Edit
              </Button>
            )}
            {editing && (
              <>
                {/* Add sibling picker */}
                {showSiblingPicker ? (
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="rounded-lg border border-brand-vp/30 bg-background p-2 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto space-y-1">
                      {availableSiblings.length === 0 ? (
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground px-2 py-1">
                          No siblings available
                        </p>
                      ) : (
                        availableSiblings.map((sib) => (
                          <button
                            key={sib.id}
                            onClick={() => addFromSibling(sib)}
                            className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full text-left px-2 py-1.5 rounded hover:bg-brand-vp/10 transition-colors"
                          >
                            <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-brand shrink-0">
                              {sib.asin || "—"}
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-xs text-foreground/80 truncate">
                              {sib.itemName || sib.summarizedTitle || "—"}
                            </span>
                          </button>
                        ))
                      )}
                      <button
                        onClick={() => setShowSiblingPicker(false)}
                        className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground px-2 py-1"
                      >
                        Cancel
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Button
                      variant="outline"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={() => setShowSiblingPicker(true)}
                      className="text-xs"
                    >
                      <Plus className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
                      Add Sibling
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      variant="outline"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={addCustom}
                      className="text-xs"
                    >
                      <Plus className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
                      Custom Item
                    </Button>
                    <div className="flex-1" />
                    <Button
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={cancelEditing}
                      className="text-xs"
                    >
                      Cancel
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      onClick={() => saveMutation.mutate()}
                      disabled={saveMutation.isPending}
                      className="text-xs bg-brand-vp hover:bg-brand-vp/80 text-black"
                    >
                      {saveMutation.isPending ? "Saving..." : "Save"}
                    </Button>
                  </>
                )}
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </CollapsibleContent>
    </Collapsible>
  );
}

function FieldInput({
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
  type = "text",
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  type?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div>
      <label className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wide">
        {label}
      </label>
      <input
        type={type}
        value={value}
        onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
        className="w-full rounded border border-border bg-background px-2 py-1 text-xs text-foreground placeholder-muted-foreground/60 focus:border-brand-vp focus:outline-none"
        min={type === "number" ? 1 : undefined}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

/** Small badge for the product header — shows "Variety Pack" when items exist */
export function VarietyPackBadge({ productId }: { productId: string }) {
  const { data: items = [] } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["variety-pack", productId],
    queryFn: () => fetchPackItems(productId),
  });

  if (items.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <Badge className="shrink-0 rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold bg-brand-vp/15 text-brand-vp border-brand-vp/30">
      <PackageOpen className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
      Variety Pack
    </Badge>
  );
}

function AttrChip({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px]">
      <span className="text-muted-foreground">{label}:</span>
      <span className="font-medium">{value}</span>
    </span>
  );
}

"use client";

import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { ReactNode, useState } from "react";

export function QueryProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [queryClient] = useState(
    () =>
      new QueryClient({
        defaultOptions: {
          queries: {
            staleTime: 30 * 1000,
            gcTime: 15 * 60 * 1000,
            refetchOnWindowFocus: false,
          },
        },
      })
  );

  return (
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>
  );
}

"use client";

import { SessionProvider as NextAuthSessionProvider } from "next-auth/react";
import { ReactNode, useEffect } from "react";
import { useSession } from "next-auth/react";
import { usePathname, useRouter } from "next/navigation";

function SessionSync() {
  const { data: session, update } = useSession();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const router = useRouter();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!session?.user?.email) return;

    // Fetch the DB-resolved role and update the client session
    fetch("/api/auth/session-sync")
      .then((res) => res.json())
      .then((data) => {
        if (data.user) {
          const needsUpdate =
            data.user.role !== session.user.role ||
            JSON.stringify(data.user.allowedSections ?? []) !==
              JSON.stringify(session.user.allowedSections ?? []) ||
            data.user.clientIdCode !== session.user.clientIdCode;
          if (needsUpdate) {
            update({
              role: data.user.role,
              allowedSections: data.user.allowedSections ?? [],
              clientIdCode: data.user.clientIdCode ?? null,
            });
          }
          // Redirect pending users to registration page
          if (data.user.role === "pending" && !pathname.startsWith("/auth/register")) {
            router.replace("/auth/register");
          }
          // Redirect client users to portal if they landed on an internal page
          if (data.user.role === "client" && !pathname.startsWith("/portal")) {
            router.replace("/portal");
          }
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, [session?.user?.email]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  return null;
}

export function SessionProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <NextAuthSessionProvider>
      <SessionSync />
      {children}
    </NextAuthSessionProvider>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import {
  Search,
  FileSpreadsheet,
  FileText,
  Download,
  Loader2,
  Filter,
  Columns3,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";

const DATASET = "1o8Hub";

type PreviewResult = {
  columns: string[];
  allColumns: string[];
  rows: string[][];
  totalRows: number;
  clientColumn: string | null;
  statusColumn: string | null;
};

type QueryBody = {
  dataset: string;
  table: string;
  clients?: string[];
  statuses?: string[];
  selectedColumns?: string[];
  format: "preview" | "xlsx" | "pdf";
  limit?: number;
};

async function queryBQ(body: QueryBody): Promise<PreviewResult | Blob> {
  const res = await fetch("/api/export/bq/query", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: "Request failed" }));
    throw new Error(err.error || "Query failed");
  }
  if (body.format === "preview") return res.json();
  return res.blob();
}

function extractUniqueValues(
  preview: PreviewResult,
  columnName: string | null
): string[] {
  if (!columnName) return [];
  const colIdx = preview.columns.indexOf(columnName);
  if (colIdx < 0) return [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const result: string[] = [];
  for (const row of preview.rows) {
    const val = row[colIdx];
    if (val && !seen.has(val)) {
      seen.add(val);
      result.push(val);
    }
  }
  return result.sort();
}

type Props = {
  tableId: string;
  numRows: number;
  columnCount: number;
  showClientExport?: boolean;
};

export function BqTablePanel({
  tableId,
  numRows,
  columnCount,
  showClientExport,
}: Props) {
  const [previewData, setPreviewData] = useState<PreviewResult | null>(null);
  const [selectedClients, setSelectedClients] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [selectedStatuses, setSelectedStatuses] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [selectedColumns, setSelectedColumns] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [showFilters, setShowFilters] = useState(false);
  const [showColumnPicker, setShowColumnPicker] = useState(false);
  const [columnSearch, setColumnSearch] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const buildQueryBody = useCallback(
    (format: "preview" | "xlsx" | "pdf"): QueryBody => ({
      dataset: DATASET,
      table: tableId,
      clients: selectedClients.length > 0 ? selectedClients : undefined,
      statuses: selectedStatuses.length > 0 ? selectedStatuses : undefined,
      selectedColumns:
        selectedColumns.length > 0 ? selectedColumns : undefined,
      format,
      limit: format === "preview" ? 50 : undefined,
    }),
    [tableId, selectedClients, selectedStatuses, selectedColumns]
  );

  const previewMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: () =>
      queryBQ(buildQueryBody("preview")) as Promise<PreviewResult>,
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      setPreviewData(data);
      setError(null);
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      setError(err.message);
      setPreviewData(null);
    },
  });

  const downloadMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (format: "xlsx" | "pdf") =>
      queryBQ(buildQueryBody(format)) as Promise<Blob>,
    onSuccess: (blob, format) => {
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `${DATASET}_${tableId}.${format}`;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    },
    onError: (err: Error) => {
      setError(err.message);
    },
  });

  const handleClientExport = useCallback(() => {
    window.open(`/api/export?client=ALL`, "_blank");
  }, []);

  const toggleItem = useCallback(
    (item: string, setter: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string[]>>) => {
      setter((prev) =>
        prev.includes(item) ? prev.filter((c) => c !== item) : [...prev, item]
      );
    },
    []
  );

  const availableClients = previewData
    ? extractUniqueValues(previewData, previewData.clientColumn)
    : [];
  const availableStatuses = previewData
    ? extractUniqueValues(previewData, previewData.statusColumn)
    : [];
  const allColumns = previewData?.allColumns ?? [];
  const filteredColumns = columnSearch
    ? allColumns.filter((c) =>
        c.toLowerCase().includes(columnSearch.toLowerCase())
      )
    : allColumns;
  const hasFilters = previewData?.clientColumn || previewData?.statusColumn;
  const activeFilterCount = selectedClients.length + selectedStatuses.length;

  return (
    <div className="bg-muted/20 border-t px-6 py-4 space-y-4">
      {/* Quick stats + actions bar */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">
          {numRows.toLocaleString()} rows
        </Badge>
        <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">
          {columnCount} columns
        </Badge>

        <div className="flex-1" />

        <Button
          size="sm"
          variant="outline"
          className="gap-1.5"
          disabled={previewMutation.isPending}
          onClick={() => previewMutation.mutate()}
        >
          {previewMutation.isPending ? (
            <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
          ) : (
            <Search className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          )}
          Preview
        </Button>
        <Button
          size="sm"
          className="gap-1.5"
          disabled={downloadMutation.isPending}
          onClick={() => downloadMutation.mutate("xlsx")}
        >
          {downloadMutation.isPending ? (
            <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />
          ) : (
            <FileSpreadsheet className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          )}
          XLSX
        </Button>
        <Button
          size="sm"
          variant="outline"
          className="gap-1.5"
          disabled={downloadMutation.isPending}
          onClick={() => downloadMutation.mutate("pdf")}
        >
          <FileText className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          PDF
        </Button>
        {showClientExport && (
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="outline"
            className="gap-1.5"
            onClick={handleClientExport}
          >
            <Download className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            Client CSV
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Error */}
      {error && (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-500/30 bg-red-500/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-400">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Loading */}
      {previewMutation.isPending && !previewData && (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Skeleton className="h-6 w-full" />
          <Skeleton className="h-48 w-full" />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Preview results */}
      {previewData && (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          {/* Column picker + Filters toggles */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
            {allColumns.length > 0 && (
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowColumnPicker((v) => !v)}
                className="text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              >
                <Columns3 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Columns
                {selectedColumns.length > 0 && (
                  <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] ml-1">
                    {selectedColumns.length}/{allColumns.length}
                  </Badge>
                )}
              </button>
            )}
            {hasFilters && (
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowFilters((v) => !v)}
                className="text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-colors"
              >
                <Filter className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                Filters
                {activeFilterCount > 0 && (
                  <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] ml-1">
                    {activeFilterCount}
                  </Badge>
                )}
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Column picker panel */}
          {showColumnPicker && (
            <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card p-3 space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <Input
                  placeholder="Search columns..."
                  value={columnSearch}
                  onChange={(e) => setColumnSearch(e.target.value)}
                  className="max-w-xs h-7 text-xs"
                />
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  {selectedColumns.length > 0 && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setSelectedColumns([])}
                      className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground flex items-center gap-1"
                    >
                      <X className="h-3 w-3" />
                      Clear
                    </button>
                  )}
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setSelectedColumns([...allColumns])}
                    className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                  >
                    All
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-4 md:grid-cols-5 gap-1 max-h-[180px] overflow-y-auto">
                {filteredColumns.map((col) => (
                  <label
                    key={col}
                    className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50 rounded px-1.5 py-0.5"
                  >
                    <Checkbox
                      checked={selectedColumns.includes(col)}
                      onCheckedChange={() =>
                        toggleItem(col, setSelectedColumns)
                      }
                      className="h-3 w-3"
                    />
                    <span className="truncate" title={col}>
                      {col}
                    </span>
                  </label>
                ))}
              </div>
              {selectedColumns.length > 0 && (
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="outline"
                  className="h-7 text-xs gap-1"
                  disabled={previewMutation.isPending}
                  onClick={() => previewMutation.mutate()}
                >
                  {previewMutation.isPending ? (
                    <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" />
                  ) : (
                    <Search className="h-3 w-3" />
                  )}
                  Apply
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Filters panel */}
          {showFilters && hasFilters && (
            <div className="rounded-lg border bg-card p-3 space-y-3">
              {previewData.statusColumn && (
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-xs font-medium">Status</span>
                    {selectedStatuses.length > 0 && (
                      <button
                        onClick={() => setSelectedStatuses([])}
                        className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground flex items-center gap-1"
                      >
                        <X className="h-3 w-3" />
                        Clear
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                    {availableStatuses.map((s) => (
                      <label
                        key={s}
                        className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50 rounded px-2 py-1"
                      >
                        <Checkbox
                          checked={selectedStatuses.includes(s)}
                          onCheckedChange={() =>
                            toggleItem(s, setSelectedStatuses)
                          }
                          className="h-3 w-3"
                        />
                        {s}
                      </label>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
              {previewData.clientColumn && (
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-xs font-medium">Client</span>
                    {selectedClients.length > 0 && (
                      <button
                        onClick={() => setSelectedClients([])}
                        className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground flex items-center gap-1"
                      >
                        <X className="h-3 w-3" />
                        Clear
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-4 md:grid-cols-5 gap-1">
                    {availableClients.map((c) => (
                      <label
                        key={c}
                        className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50 rounded px-2 py-1"
                      >
                        <Checkbox
                          checked={selectedClients.includes(c)}
                          onCheckedChange={() =>
                            toggleItem(c, setSelectedClients)
                          }
                          className="h-3 w-3"
                        />
                        <span className="truncate">{c}</span>
                      </label>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant="outline"
                className="h-7 text-xs gap-1"
                disabled={previewMutation.isPending}
                onClick={() => previewMutation.mutate()}
              >
                {previewMutation.isPending ? (
                  <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" />
                ) : (
                  <Search className="h-3 w-3" />
                )}
                Apply filters
              </Button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Data table */}
          <div className="rounded-lg border overflow-hidden">
            <div className="overflow-x-auto max-h-[400px] overflow-y-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-xs">
                <thead className="bg-muted/50 sticky top-0">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="px-3 py-1.5 text-left font-medium text-muted-foreground w-10">
                      #
                    </th>
                    {previewData.columns.map((col) => (
                      <th
                        key={col}
                        className="px-3 py-1.5 text-left font-medium text-muted-foreground whitespace-nowrap"
                      >
                        {col}
                      </th>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-border">
                  {previewData.rows.map((row, i) => (
                    <tr key={i} className="hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors">
                      <td className="px-3 py-1 text-muted-foreground">
                        {i + 1}
                      </td>
                      {row.map((cell, j) => (
                        <td
                          key={j}
                          className="px-3 py-1 max-w-[200px] truncate"
                          title={cell}
                        >
                          {cell}
                        </td>
                      ))}
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
            {previewData.rows.length < previewData.totalRows && (
              <div className="px-3 py-1.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground bg-muted/30 border-t">
                Showing {previewData.rows.length} of{" "}
                {previewData.totalRows.toLocaleString()} rows
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Fragment, useState } from "react";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { History, ChevronRight, ChevronDown, ArrowRight } from "lucide-react";

type ChangeEdit = {
  field: string;
  oldValue: string | null;
  newValue: string | null;
};

type ChangeEntry = {
  asin: string | null;
  sku: string | null;
  edits: ChangeEdit[];
};

type HistoryEntry = {
  id: number;
  publishedBy: string;
  publishedAt: string;
  rowsPublished: number;
  jobId: string | null;
  dirtyCount: number;
  changes: ChangeEntry[] | null;
};

function truncate(value: string | null, max: number): string {
  if (!value) return "";
  return value.length > max ? value.slice(0, max) + "..." : value;
}

export function PublishHistory() {
  const [expandedRows, setExpandedRows] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());

  const toggleRow = (id: number) => {
    setExpandedRows((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const { data: entries, isLoading } = useQuery<HistoryEntry[]>({
    queryKey: ["publish-history"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/publish/history");
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch publish history");
      return res.json();
    },
  });

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <History className="h-5 w-5" />
          Publish History
        </CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>
          Log of all publishes to BigQuery. Click a row to see what changed.
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {isLoading ? (
          <Skeleton className="h-[200px] w-full" />
        ) : !entries || entries.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground py-8 text-center">
            No publishes yet.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead className="w-8" />
                <TableHead>Date</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Published By</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">Rows</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="text-right">Changes</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Job ID</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {entries.map((entry) => {
                const isExpanded = expandedRows.has(entry.id);
                const hasChanges = entry.changes && entry.changes.length > 0;
                return (
                  <Fragment key={entry.id}>
                    <TableRow
                      className={hasChanges ? "cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50" : ""}
                      onClick={() => hasChanges && toggleRow(entry.id)}
                    >
                      <TableCell className="w-8 px-2">
                        {hasChanges &&
                          (isExpanded ? (
                            <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                          ) : (
                            <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                          ))}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="whitespace-nowrap">
                        {new Date(entry.publishedAt).toLocaleString()}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{entry.publishedBy}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right font-mono">
                        {entry.rowsPublished.toLocaleString()}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right font-mono">
                        {entry.dirtyCount}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground max-w-[200px] truncate">
                        {entry.jobId || "—"}
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                    {isExpanded && hasChanges && (
                      <TableRow>
                        <TableCell colSpan={6} className="p-0">
                          <div className="bg-muted/30 border-t px-6 py-3 space-y-3">
                            {entry.changes!.map((product, pi) => (
                              <div key={pi}>
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                                  <span className="text-xs font-medium">
                                    {product.asin || "—"}
                                  </span>
                                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-mono">
                                    {product.sku || "—"}
                                  </span>
                                  <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px]">
                                    {product.edits.length} edit{product.edits.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
                                  </Badge>
                                </div>
                                <div className="space-y-0.5 ml-2">
                                  {product.edits.map((edit, ei) => (
                                    <div key={ei} className="text-[11px] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                      <span className="font-medium min-w-0">{edit.field}</span>
                                      <span className="text-muted-foreground">:</span>
                                      <span className="text-red-600/80 font-mono">
                                        {truncate(edit.oldValue, 40) || <span className="italic text-muted-foreground">empty</span>}
                                      </span>
                                      <ArrowRight className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
                                      <span className="text-green-600/80 font-mono">
                                        {truncate(edit.newValue, 40) || <span className="italic text-muted-foreground">empty</span>}
                                      </span>
                                    </div>
                                  ))}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        </TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    )}
                  </Fragment>
                );
              })}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

"use client";

import { Fragment, useState } from "react";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/tooltip";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import {
  Upload,
  CheckCircle,
  AlertTriangle,
  Loader2,
  ChevronRight,
  ChevronDown,
  ArrowRight,
  Undo2,
} from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useSession } from "next-auth/react";

type PublishInfo = {
  totalProducts: number;
  dirtyProducts: number;
};

type ChangeLogEntry = {
  field: string;
  oldValue: string | null;
  newValue: string | null;
  changedBy: string;
  changedAt: string;
};

type DirtyProduct = {
  id: string;
  asin: string | null;
  sku: string | null;
  brandName: string | null;
  summarizedTitle: string | null;
  isDirty: boolean;
  changeLog: ChangeLogEntry[];
  updatedAt: string;
};

function TruncatedValue({ value, max = 60 }: { value: string | null; max?: number }) {
  const display = value ?? "";
  if (display.length <= max) {
    return <span className="font-mono text-xs">{display || <span className="text-muted-foreground italic">empty</span>}</span>;
  }
  return (
    <TooltipProvider>
      <Tooltip>
        <TooltipTrigger asChild>
          <span className="font-mono text-xs cursor-help">
            {display.slice(0, max)}...
          </span>
        </TooltipTrigger>
        <TooltipContent side="bottom" className="max-w-sm">
          <p className="text-xs whitespace-pre-wrap break-all">{display}</p>
        </TooltipContent>
      </Tooltip>
    </TooltipProvider>
  );
}

export function PublishReview() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [confirmed, setConfirmed] = useState(false);
  const [publishMode, setPublishMode] = useState<"incremental" | "full">("incremental");
  const [expandedRows, setExpandedRows] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [revertingId, setRevertingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [revertingField, setRevertingField] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const canEdit = session?.user?.role === "editor" || session?.user?.role === "admin";

  const toggleRow = (id: string) => {
    setExpandedRows((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const { data: info, isLoading: infoLoading } = useQuery<PublishInfo>({
    queryKey: ["publish-info"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/publish");
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch publish info");
      return res.json();
    },
  });

  const { data: dirtyProducts, isLoading: productsLoading } = useQuery<DirtyProduct[]>({
    queryKey: ["products", "dirty"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/products?isDirty=true&pageSize=100");
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch dirty products");
      const data = await res.json();
      return data.data;
    },
  });

  const publishMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/publish", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ mode: publishMode }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Publish failed");
      }
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      toast.success(
        `Published ${data.rowsPublished} products to BigQuery (${data.mode}, Job: ${data.jobId})`
      );
      setConfirmed(false);
      setExpandedRows(new Set());
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["publish-info"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["products"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["publish-history"] });
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => {
      toast.error(error.message);
    },
  });

  const handleRevert = async (productId: string) => {
    if (!confirm("Discard all changes for this product and restore original values?")) return;
    setRevertingId(productId);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${productId}/revert`, { method: "POST" });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Failed to revert");
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      toast.success(`Reverted ${data.reverted} field(s)`);
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["publish-info"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["products"] });
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Revert failed");
    } finally {
      setRevertingId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleRevertField = async (productId: string, bqName: string) => {
    const key = `${productId}:${bqName}`;
    setRevertingField(key);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${productId}/revert-field`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ bqName }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Failed to revert field");
      }
      toast.success(`Reverted ${bqName}`);
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["publish-info"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["products"] });
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Revert failed");
    } finally {
      setRevertingField(null);
    }
  };

  const handleRevertAll = async () => {
    if (!dirtyProducts?.length) return;
    if (!confirm(`Discard changes for all ${dirtyProducts.length} product(s)?`)) return;
    setRevertingId("__all__");
    let reverted = 0;
    for (const p of dirtyProducts) {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${p.id}/revert`, { method: "POST" });
        if (res.ok) reverted++;
      } catch { /* continue */ }
    }
    toast.success(`Reverted ${reverted} product(s)`);
    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["publish-info"] });
    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["products"] });
    setRevertingId(null);
  };

  if (infoLoading) {
    return <Skeleton className="h-[300px] w-full" />;
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Summary Card */}
      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <Card>
          <CardHeader className="pb-2">
            <CardDescription>Total Products</CardDescription>
            <CardTitle className="text-3xl">{info?.totalProducts ?? 0}</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardHeader className="pb-2">
            <CardDescription>Changed Products</CardDescription>
            <CardTitle className="text-3xl text-orange-500">
              {info?.dirtyProducts ?? 0}
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardHeader className="pb-2">
            <CardDescription>Target Table</CardDescription>
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-mono">
              amazon-data-461918.1o8Hub.Master
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Dirty Products List */}
      {(info?.dirtyProducts ?? 0) > 0 && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <CardTitle>Changed Products</CardTitle>
                <CardDescription>
                  These products have been modified since the last publish. Click a row to see field-level changes.
                </CardDescription>
              </div>
              {canEdit && (dirtyProducts?.length ?? 0) > 0 && (
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  className="shrink-0 text-destructive hover:text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10 gap-1"
                  disabled={revertingId !== null}
                  onClick={handleRevertAll}
                >
                  <Undo2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  {revertingId === "__all__" ? "Reverting..." : "Discard All"}
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {productsLoading ? (
              <Skeleton className="h-[200px] w-full" />
            ) : (
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead className="w-8" />
                    <TableHead>ASIN</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>SKU</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Brand</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Title</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Changes</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Last Modified</TableHead>
                    {canEdit && <TableHead className="w-20" />}
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {(dirtyProducts ?? []).map((p) => {
                    const isExpanded = expandedRows.has(p.id);
                    const changes = p.changeLog ?? [];
                    return (
                      <Fragment key={p.id}>
                        <TableRow
                          className="cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50"
                          onClick={() => changes.length > 0 && toggleRow(p.id)}
                        >
                          <TableCell className="w-8 px-2">
                            {changes.length > 0 &&
                              (isExpanded ? (
                                <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                              ) : (
                                <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                              ))}
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell>
                            <Link
                              href={`/products/${p.id}`}
                              className="font-mono text-blue-600 hover:underline"
                              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                            >
                              {p.asin || "—"}
                            </Link>
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="font-mono">{p.sku || "—"}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell>{p.brandName || "—"}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="max-w-[200px] truncate">
                            {p.summarizedTitle || "—"}
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell>
                            <Badge variant="secondary">
                              {changes.length} edit{changes.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
                            </Badge>
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                            {new Date(p.updatedAt).toLocaleString()}
                          </TableCell>
                          {canEdit && (
                            <TableCell>
                              <Button
                                variant="ghost"
                                size="sm"
                                className="h-7 text-xs text-destructive hover:text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10 gap-1"
                                disabled={revertingId !== null}
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                  e.stopPropagation();
                                  handleRevert(p.id);
                                }}
                              >
                                {revertingId === p.id ? (
                                  <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" />
                                ) : (
                                  <Undo2 className="h-3 w-3" />
                                )}
                                Discard
                              </Button>
                            </TableCell>
                          )}
                        </TableRow>
                        {isExpanded && changes.length > 0 && (
                          <TableRow>
                            <TableCell colSpan={canEdit ? 8 : 7} className="p-0">
                              <div className="bg-muted/30 border-t px-6 py-3">
                                <table className="w-full text-xs">
                                  <thead>
                                    <tr className="text-muted-foreground">
                                      <th className="text-left py-1 pr-4 font-medium">Field</th>
                                      <th className="text-left py-1 pr-4 font-medium">Old Value</th>
                                      <th className="text-left py-1 pr-4 font-medium" />
                                      <th className="text-left py-1 pr-4 font-medium">New Value</th>
                                      <th className="text-left py-1 pr-4 font-medium">Changed By</th>
                                      <th className="text-left py-1 pr-4 font-medium">Time</th>
                                      {canEdit && <th className="text-left py-1 font-medium w-16" />}
                                    </tr>
                                  </thead>
                                  <tbody>
                                    {changes.map((c, i) => {
                                      const fieldKey = `${p.id}:${c.field}`;
                                      // Show discard only on the first row for each field
                                      const isFirstForField = changes.findIndex((x) => x.field === c.field) === i;
                                      return (
                                        <tr key={i} className="border-t border-border/50">
                                          <td className="py-1.5 pr-4 font-medium">{c.field}</td>
                                          <td className="py-1.5 pr-4 text-red-600/80">
                                            <TruncatedValue value={c.oldValue} />
                                          </td>
                                          <td className="py-1.5 pr-4">
                                            <ArrowRight className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground" />
                                          </td>
                                          <td className="py-1.5 pr-4 text-green-600/80">
                                            <TruncatedValue value={c.newValue} />
                                          </td>
                                          <td className="py-1.5 pr-4 text-muted-foreground">
                                            {c.changedBy}
                                          </td>
                                          <td className="py-1.5 pr-4 text-muted-foreground">
                                            {new Date(c.changedAt).toLocaleString()}
                                          </td>
                                          {canEdit && (
                                            <td className="py-1.5">
                                              {isFirstForField && (
                                                <button
                                                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-destructive hover:text-destructive/80 disabled:opacity-50"
                                                  disabled={revertingField !== null}
                                                  onClick={() => handleRevertField(p.id, c.field)}
                                                >
                                                  {revertingField === fieldKey ? (
                                                    <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" />
                                                  ) : (
                                                    <Undo2 className="h-3 w-3" />
                                                  )}
                                                </button>
                                              )}
                                            </td>
                                          )}
                                        </tr>
                                      );
                                    })}
                                  </tbody>
                                </table>
                              </div>
                            </TableCell>
                          </TableRow>
                        )}
                      </Fragment>
                    );
                  })}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Publish Action */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Upload className="h-5 w-5" />
            Publish to BigQuery
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            {publishMode === "incremental"
              ? `Incremental publish: only the ${info?.dirtyProducts ?? 0} changed product(s) will be sent via MERGE.`
              : `Full publish: replaces the entire BigQuery table with all ${info?.totalProducts ?? 0} products (WRITE_TRUNCATE).`}
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="flex items-center gap-3">
          {!confirmed ? (
            <>
              <Button
                onClick={() => {
                  setPublishMode("incremental");
                  setConfirmed(true);
                }}
                disabled={(info?.dirtyProducts ?? 0) === 0}
              >
                <AlertTriangle className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                {(info?.dirtyProducts ?? 0) === 0
                  ? "No changes to publish"
                  : `Publish ${info?.dirtyProducts} change${(info?.dirtyProducts ?? 0) !== 1 ? "s" : ""}`}
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => {
                  setPublishMode("full");
                  setConfirmed(true);
                }}
                disabled={(info?.dirtyProducts ?? 0) === 0}
              >
                Full Publish (all rows)
              </Button>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Button
                variant="destructive"
                onClick={() => publishMutation.mutate()}
                disabled={publishMutation.isPending}
              >
                {publishMutation.isPending ? (
                  <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                ) : (
                  <CheckCircle className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                )}
                Confirm {publishMode === "full" ? "Full " : ""}Publish
              </Button>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => setConfirmed(false)}
                disabled={publishMutation.isPending}
              >
                Cancel
              </Button>
            </>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
