"use client";

import { Fragment, useState } from "react";
import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import {
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/card";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/tooltip";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import {
  Zap,
  RefreshCw,
  CheckCircle,
  AlertCircle,
  Clock,
  Loader2,
  ChevronRight,
  ChevronDown,
  ArrowRight,
  Undo2,
  Database,
  HardDrive,
} from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useSession } from "next-auth/react";
import { BqTablePanel } from "./bq-table-panel";

type BqTableInfo = {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  numRows: number;
  numBytes: number;
  columnCount: number;
  lastModified: string | null;
  createdAt: string | null;
  affectedBySync: boolean;
};

type BqTablesResponse = {
  dataset: string;
  tables: BqTableInfo[];
};

type SyncStatus = {
  pendingChanges: number;
  totalProducts: number;
  lastSync: {
    publishedBy: string;
    publishedAt: string;
    rowsPublished: number;
    jobId: string | null;
    dirtyCount: number;
  } | null;
  pendingEditors: string[];
};

type ChangeLogEntry = {
  field: string;
  oldValue: string | null;
  newValue: string | null;
  changedBy: string;
  changedAt: string;
};

type DirtyProduct = {
  id: string;
  asin: string | null;
  sku: string | null;
  brandName: string | null;
  summarizedTitle: string | null;
  isDirty: boolean;
  changeLog: ChangeLogEntry[];
  updatedAt: string;
};

function TruncatedValue({
  value,
  max = 60,
}: {
  value: string | null;
  max?: number;
}) {
  const display = value ?? "";
  if (display.length <= max) {
    return (
      <span className="font-mono text-xs">
        {display || (
          <span className="text-muted-foreground italic">empty</span>
        )}
      </span>
    );
  }
  return (
    <TooltipProvider>
      <Tooltip>
        <TooltipTrigger asChild>
          <span className="font-mono text-xs cursor-help">
            {display.slice(0, max)}...
          </span>
        </TooltipTrigger>
        <TooltipContent side="bottom" className="max-w-sm">
          <p className="text-xs whitespace-pre-wrap break-all">{display}</p>
        </TooltipContent>
      </Tooltip>
    </TooltipProvider>
  );
}

function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (bytes === 0) return "0 B";
  const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
  const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024));
  return `${(bytes / Math.pow(1024, i)).toFixed(i === 0 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[i]}`;
}

function timeAgo(dateStr: string): string {
  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(dateStr).getTime();
  const minutes = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
  if (minutes < 1) return "just now";
  if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m ago`;
  const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h ago`;
  const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
  return `${days}d ago`;
}

export function SyncDashboard() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [expandedRows, setExpandedRows] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [expandedTables, setExpandedTables] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [revertingId, setRevertingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [revertingField, setRevertingField] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const canEdit =
    session?.user?.role === "editor" || session?.user?.role === "admin";
  const isAdmin = session?.user?.role === "admin";

  const toggleRow = (id: string) => {
    setExpandedRows((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const toggleTable = (id: string) => {
    setExpandedTables((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const { data: status, isLoading: statusLoading } = useQuery<SyncStatus>({
    queryKey: ["sync-status"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/sync/status");
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch sync status");
      return res.json();
    },
    refetchInterval: 15_000,
  });

  const { data: bqTables, isLoading: tablesLoading } =
    useQuery<BqTablesResponse>({
      queryKey: ["sync-bq-tables"],
      queryFn: async () => {
        const res = await fetch("/api/sync/tables");
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch BQ tables");
        return res.json();
      },
      refetchInterval: 60_000,
    });

  const { data: dirtyProducts, isLoading: productsLoading } = useQuery<
    DirtyProduct[]
  >({
    queryKey: ["products", "dirty"],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/products?isDirty=true&pageSize=100");
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch dirty products");
      const data = await res.json();
      return data.data;
    },
  });

  const syncMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: async (mode: "incremental" | "full") => {
      const res = await fetch("/api/sync/trigger", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ mode }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Sync failed");
      }
      return res.json();
    },
    onSuccess: (data) => {
      if (data.synced === 0) {
        toast.info("No pending changes to sync");
      } else {
        toast.success(
          `Synced ${data.synced} product${data.synced !== 1 ? "s" : ""} to BigQuery`
        );
      }
      setExpandedRows(new Set());
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["sync-status"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["products"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["publish-history"] });
    },
    onError: (error: Error) => {
      toast.error(error.message);
    },
  });

  const handleRevert = async (productId: string) => {
    if (
      !confirm(
        "Discard all changes for this product and restore original values?"
      )
    )
      return;
    setRevertingId(productId);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${productId}/revert`, {
        method: "POST",
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Failed to revert");
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      toast.success(`Reverted ${data.reverted} field(s)`);
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["sync-status"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["products"] });
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Revert failed");
    } finally {
      setRevertingId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleRevertField = async (productId: string, bqName: string) => {
    const key = `${productId}:${bqName}`;
    setRevertingField(key);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${productId}/revert-field`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ bqName }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json();
        throw new Error(err.error || "Failed to revert field");
      }
      toast.success(`Reverted ${bqName}`);
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["sync-status"] });
      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["products"] });
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Revert failed");
    } finally {
      setRevertingField(null);
    }
  };

  const handleRevertAll = async () => {
    if (!dirtyProducts?.length) return;
    if (
      !confirm(`Discard changes for all ${dirtyProducts.length} product(s)?`)
    )
      return;
    setRevertingId("__all__");
    let reverted = 0;
    for (const p of dirtyProducts) {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/products/${p.id}/revert`, {
          method: "POST",
        });
        if (res.ok) reverted++;
      } catch {
        /* continue */
      }
    }
    toast.success(`Reverted ${reverted} product(s)`);
    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["sync-status"] });
    queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["products"] });
    setRevertingId(null);
  };

  if (statusLoading) {
    return <Skeleton className="h-[300px] w-full" />;
  }

  const pending = status?.pendingChanges ?? 0;
  const lastSync = status?.lastSync;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Status Cards */}
      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-4">
        <Card>
          <CardHeader className="pb-2">
            <CardDescription>Sync Status</CardDescription>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xl">
              {pending > 0 ? (
                <>
                  <AlertCircle className="h-5 w-5 text-brand" />
                  <span className="text-brand">{pending} pending</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <CheckCircle className="h-5 w-5 text-emerald-500" />
                  <span className="text-emerald-500">All synced</span>
                </>
              )}
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardHeader className="pb-2">
            <CardDescription>Last Sync</CardDescription>
            <CardTitle className="text-xl">
              {lastSync ? timeAgo(lastSync.publishedAt) : "Never"}
            </CardTitle>
            {lastSync && (
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                {lastSync.rowsPublished} rows &middot;{" "}
                {lastSync.publishedBy === "system/cron"
                  ? "auto"
                  : lastSync.publishedBy.split("@")[0]}
              </p>
            )}
          </CardHeader>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardHeader className="pb-2">
            <CardDescription>Total Products</CardDescription>
            <CardTitle className="text-3xl">
              {status?.totalProducts ?? 0}
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardHeader className="pb-2">
            <CardDescription>Schedule</CardDescription>
            <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm">
              <Clock className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
              Every hour
            </CardTitle>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
              Auto-syncs dirty products via MERGE
            </p>
          </CardHeader>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Sync Actions */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <RefreshCw className="h-5 w-5" />
            Manual Sync
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            Trigger a sync immediately instead of waiting for the next scheduled
            run.
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Button
            className="gap-1.5"
            disabled={pending === 0 || syncMutation.isPending}
            onClick={() => syncMutation.mutate("incremental")}
          >
            {syncMutation.isPending ? (
              <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
            ) : (
              <Zap className="h-4 w-4" />
            )}
            {pending === 0
              ? "No changes to sync"
              : `Sync ${pending} change${pending !== 1 ? "s" : ""} now`}
          </Button>
          {isAdmin && (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              className="gap-1.5"
              disabled={syncMutation.isPending}
              onClick={() => syncMutation.mutate("full")}
            >
              <RefreshCw className="h-4 w-4" />
              Full Sync (all rows)
            </Button>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* BQ Dataset Tables */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Database className="h-5 w-5" />
            BigQuery Tables
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            {bqTables?.dataset ?? "Loading..."} &mdash; click any table to
            preview, filter, and export data
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {tablesLoading ? (
            <Skeleton className="h-[160px] w-full" />
          ) : !bqTables?.tables?.length ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground py-4 text-center">
              No tables found
            </p>
          ) : (
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead className="w-8" />
                  <TableHead>Table</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">Rows</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">Size</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">Columns</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Last Modified</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {bqTables.tables.map((t) => {
                  const isTableExpanded = expandedTables.has(t.id);
                  return (
                    <Fragment key={t.id}>
                      <TableRow
                        className={`cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50 ${
                          t.affectedBySync && pending > 0
                            ? "bg-brand/5"
                            : ""
                        }`}
                        onClick={() => toggleTable(t.id)}
                      >
                        <TableCell className="w-8 px-2">
                          {isTableExpanded ? (
                            <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                          ) : (
                            <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                          )}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <HardDrive className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
                            <span className="font-mono text-sm font-medium">
                              {t.id}
                            </span>
                            {t.type === "VIEW" && (
                              <Badge
                                variant="outline"
                                className="text-[10px] py-0"
                              >
                                VIEW
                              </Badge>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="text-right font-mono text-sm">
                          {t.numRows.toLocaleString()}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="text-right text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          {formatBytes(t.numBytes)}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="text-right text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          {t.columnCount}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          {t.lastModified ? timeAgo(t.lastModified) : "—"}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          {t.affectedBySync && pending > 0 ? (
                            <Badge className="bg-brand/15 text-brand border-brand/30 text-[10px] gap-1">
                              <AlertCircle className="h-3 w-3" />
                              {pending} pending
                            </Badge>
                          ) : (
                            <Badge
                              variant="outline"
                              className="text-[10px] text-emerald-500 border-emerald-500/30 gap-1"
                            >
                              <CheckCircle className="h-3 w-3" />
                              Synced
                            </Badge>
                          )}
                        </TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                      {isTableExpanded && (
                        <TableRow>
                          <TableCell colSpan={7} className="p-0">
                            <BqTablePanel
                              tableId={t.id}
                              numRows={t.numRows}
                              columnCount={t.columnCount}
                              showClientExport={t.id === "Master"}
                            />
                          </TableCell>
                        </TableRow>
                      )}
                    </Fragment>
                  );
                })}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Pending Changes List */}
      {pending > 0 && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <CardTitle>Pending Changes</CardTitle>
                <CardDescription>
                  These changes will be synced to BigQuery on the next scheduled
                  run. Click a row to see field-level changes.
                </CardDescription>
              </div>
              {canEdit && (dirtyProducts?.length ?? 0) > 0 && (
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  className="shrink-0 text-destructive hover:text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10 gap-1"
                  disabled={revertingId !== null}
                  onClick={handleRevertAll}
                >
                  <Undo2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  {revertingId === "__all__" ? "Reverting..." : "Discard All"}
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            {productsLoading ? (
              <Skeleton className="h-[200px] w-full" />
            ) : (
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead className="w-8" />
                    <TableHead>ASIN</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>SKU</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Brand</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Title</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Changes</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Last Modified</TableHead>
                    {canEdit && <TableHead className="w-20" />}
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {(dirtyProducts ?? []).map((p) => {
                    const isExpanded = expandedRows.has(p.id);
                    const changes = p.changeLog ?? [];
                    return (
                      <Fragment key={p.id}>
                        <TableRow
                          className="cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50"
                          onClick={() =>
                            changes.length > 0 && toggleRow(p.id)
                          }
                        >
                          <TableCell className="w-8 px-2">
                            {changes.length > 0 &&
                              (isExpanded ? (
                                <ChevronDown className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                              ) : (
                                <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                              ))}
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell>
                            <Link
                              href={`/products/${p.id}`}
                              className="font-mono text-blue-600 hover:underline"
                              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                            >
                              {p.asin || "—"}
                            </Link>
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="font-mono">
                            {p.sku || "—"}
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell>{p.brandName || "—"}</TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="max-w-[200px] truncate">
                            {p.summarizedTitle || "—"}
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell>
                            <Badge variant="secondary">
                              {changes.length} edit
                              {changes.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
                            </Badge>
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                            {new Date(p.updatedAt).toLocaleString()}
                          </TableCell>
                          {canEdit && (
                            <TableCell>
                              <Button
                                variant="ghost"
                                size="sm"
                                className="h-7 text-xs text-destructive hover:text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10 gap-1"
                                disabled={revertingId !== null}
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                  e.stopPropagation();
                                  handleRevert(p.id);
                                }}
                              >
                                {revertingId === p.id ? (
                                  <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" />
                                ) : (
                                  <Undo2 className="h-3 w-3" />
                                )}
                                Discard
                              </Button>
                            </TableCell>
                          )}
                        </TableRow>
                        {isExpanded && changes.length > 0 && (
                          <TableRow>
                            <TableCell
                              colSpan={canEdit ? 8 : 7}
                              className="p-0"
                            >
                              <div className="bg-muted/30 border-t px-6 py-3">
                                <table className="w-full text-xs">
                                  <thead>
                                    <tr className="text-muted-foreground">
                                      <th className="text-left py-1 pr-4 font-medium">
                                        Field
                                      </th>
                                      <th className="text-left py-1 pr-4 font-medium">
                                        Old Value
                                      </th>
                                      <th className="text-left py-1 pr-4 font-medium" />
                                      <th className="text-left py-1 pr-4 font-medium">
                                        New Value
                                      </th>
                                      <th className="text-left py-1 pr-4 font-medium">
                                        Changed By
                                      </th>
                                      <th className="text-left py-1 pr-4 font-medium">
                                        Time
                                      </th>
                                      {canEdit && (
                                        <th className="text-left py-1 font-medium w-16" />
                                      )}
                                    </tr>
                                  </thead>
                                  <tbody>
                                    {changes.map((c, i) => {
                                      const fieldKey = `${p.id}:${c.field}`;
                                      const isFirstForField =
                                        changes.findIndex(
                                          (x) => x.field === c.field
                                        ) === i;
                                      return (
                                        <tr
                                          key={i}
                                          className="border-t border-border/50"
                                        >
                                          <td className="py-1.5 pr-4 font-medium">
                                            {c.field}
                                          </td>
                                          <td className="py-1.5 pr-4 text-red-600/80">
                                            <TruncatedValue
                                              value={c.oldValue}
                                            />
                                          </td>
                                          <td className="py-1.5 pr-4">
                                            <ArrowRight className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground" />
                                          </td>
                                          <td className="py-1.5 pr-4 text-green-600/80">
                                            <TruncatedValue
                                              value={c.newValue}
                                            />
                                          </td>
                                          <td className="py-1.5 pr-4 text-muted-foreground">
                                            {c.changedBy}
                                          </td>
                                          <td className="py-1.5 pr-4 text-muted-foreground">
                                            {new Date(
                                              c.changedAt
                                            ).toLocaleString()}
                                          </td>
                                          {canEdit && (
                                            <td className="py-1.5">
                                              {isFirstForField && (
                                                <button
                                                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-destructive hover:text-destructive/80 disabled:opacity-50"
                                                  disabled={
                                                    revertingField !== null
                                                  }
                                                  onClick={() =>
                                                    handleRevertField(
                                                      p.id,
                                                      c.field
                                                    )
                                                  }
                                                >
                                                  {revertingField ===
                                                  fieldKey ? (
                                                    <Loader2 className="h-3 w-3 animate-spin" />
                                                  ) : (
                                                    <Undo2 className="h-3 w-3" />
                                                  )}
                                                </button>
                                              )}
                                            </td>
                                          )}
                                        </tr>
                                      );
                                    })}
                                  </tbody>
                                </table>
                              </div>
                            </TableCell>
                          </TableRow>
                        )}
                      </Fragment>
                    );
                  })}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useSession } from "next-auth/react";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { FileSpreadsheet, FileText, Download, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

type ClientEntry = {
  clientIdCode: string;
  clientName: string;
};

async function fetchClients(): Promise<ClientEntry[]> {
  const res = await fetch("/api/clients");
  if (!res.ok) return [];
  return res.json();
}

export function ReportForm() {
  const { data: session } = useSession();
  const role = session?.user?.role;

  const { data: clients = [], isLoading: loadingClients } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["clients"],
    queryFn: fetchClients,
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  });

  const [selectedClient, setSelectedClient] = useState("");
  const [format, setFormat] = useState<"xlsx" | "pdf">("xlsx");
  const [fromDate, setFromDate] = useState(() => {
    const d = new Date();
    d.setDate(d.getDate() - 30);
    return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  });
  const [toDate, setToDate] = useState(
    () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)
  );
  const [downloading, setDownloading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (role !== "admin") {
    return (
      <div className="text-center py-12 text-muted-foreground">
        Only admins can generate reports.
      </div>
    );
  }

  const handleDownload = async () => {
    if (!selectedClient) return;
    setDownloading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const params = new URLSearchParams({
        client: selectedClient,
        format,
        from: fromDate,
        to: toDate,
      });
      const res = await fetch(`/api/reports/client?${params}`);
      if (!res.ok) {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: "Download failed" }));
        throw new Error(err.error || "Download failed");
      }
      const blob = await res.blob();
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `${selectedClient}_report_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.${format}`;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Download failed");
    } finally {
      setDownloading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-xl space-y-6">
      {/* Client selector */}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <label className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground/80">Client</label>
        {loadingClients ? (
          <div className="h-10 rounded-md border bg-muted/50 animate-pulse" />
        ) : (
          <select
            value={selectedClient}
            onChange={(e) => setSelectedClient(e.target.value)}
            className="flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-border bg-card text-foreground px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
          >
            <option value="">Select a client...</option>
            {clients.map((c) => (
              <option key={c.clientIdCode} value={c.clientIdCode}>
                {c.clientName || c.clientIdCode}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Format toggle */}
      <div className="space-y-2">
        <label className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground/80">Format</label>
        <div className="flex gap-3">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setFormat("xlsx")}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
              format === "xlsx"
                ? "border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400"
                : "border-border bg-card text-muted-foreground hover:border-border"
            }`}
          >
            <FileSpreadsheet className="h-5 w-5" />
            XLSX Spreadsheet
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setFormat("pdf")}
            className={`flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
              format === "pdf"
                ? "border-red-500 bg-red-500/10 text-red-400"
                : "border-border bg-card text-muted-foreground hover:border-border"
            }`}
          >
            <FileText className="h-5 w-5" />
            PDF Report
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Date range */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <label className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground/80">
            Changes From
          </label>
          <input
            type="date"
            value={fromDate}
            onChange={(e) => setFromDate(e.target.value)}
            className="flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-border bg-card text-foreground px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
          />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <label className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground/80">
            Changes To
          </label>
          <input
            type="date"
            value={toDate}
            onChange={(e) => setToDate(e.target.value)}
            className="flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-border bg-card text-foreground px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Info card */}
      <div className="rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/50 p-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground space-y-1">
        <p>
          The report includes product counts, readiness scores, recent changes
          within the date range, and field coverage analysis.
        </p>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/70">
          {format === "xlsx"
            ? "XLSX has separate sheets for Summary, Products, Recent Changes, and Field Coverage."
            : "PDF includes branded pages with summary stats, product table, field coverage, and change log."}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Download button */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleDownload}
        disabled={!selectedClient || downloading}
        className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-6 py-3 text-sm font-medium bg-brand text-brand-foreground transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed hover:bg-brand-hover"
      >
        {downloading ? (
          <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
        ) : (
          <Download className="h-4 w-4" />
        )}
        {downloading ? "Generating Report..." : "Download Report"}
      </button>

      {error && (
        <div className="rounded-md border border-red-500/30 bg-red-500/10 p-3 text-sm text-red-400">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/seo/ai-cost-tracker.tsx

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";

const PRICING = {
  "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001": { input: 0.8, output: 4.0 },
  "claude-sonnet-4-20250514": { input: 3.0, output: 15.0 },
  "claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929": { input: 3.0, output: 15.0 },
  "claude-opus-4-6": { input: 15.0, output: 75.0 },
  default: { input: 0.8, output: 4.0 },
};

interface AIUsage {
  input_tokens: number;
  output_tokens: number;
  model?: string;
}

interface AICostTrackerProps {
  isRunning: boolean;
  usage: AIUsage | null;
  startTime: number | null;
  error?: string;
}

export default function AICostTracker({ isRunning, usage, startTime, error }: AICostTrackerProps) {
  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isRunning || !startTime) { setElapsed(0); return; }
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setElapsed(Math.floor((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000));
    }, 100);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [isRunning, startTime]);

  const estimateCost = (u: AIUsage): number => {
    const model = u.model || "default";
    const rates = PRICING[model as keyof typeof PRICING] || PRICING.default;
    return (u.input_tokens / 1_000_000) * rates.input + (u.output_tokens / 1_000_000) * rates.output;
  };

  if (isRunning) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border border-amber-700/30 bg-amber-950/30 px-3 py-2">
        <span className="inline-block h-2 w-2 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-amber-500" />
        <div className="text-xs">
          <span className="font-bold text-amber-400">Processing</span>
          <span className="ml-2 font-mono text-muted-foreground">{formatTime(elapsed)}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-red-900/30 bg-red-950/20 px-3 py-2">
        <span className="inline-block h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-red-400" />
        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-red-400">Failed</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (usage) {
    const cost = estimateCost(usage);
    const totalTokens = usage.input_tokens + usage.output_tokens;

    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4 rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/50 px-3 py-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <svg className="h-3 w-3 text-muted-foreground" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" strokeWidth={1.5} stroke="currentColor">
            <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M9.813 15.904 9 18.75l-.813-2.846a4.5 4.5 0 0 0-3.09-3.09L2.25 12l2.846-.813a4.5 4.5 0 0 0 3.09-3.09L9 5.25l.813 2.846a4.5 4.5 0 0 0 3.09 3.09L15.75 12l-2.846.813a4.5 4.5 0 0 0-3.09 3.09Z" />
          </svg>
          <div className="text-[10px]">
            <span className="font-mono text-muted-foreground">{totalTokens.toLocaleString()}</span>
            <span className="text-muted-foreground/60"> tok</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground/60">
          {usage.input_tokens.toLocaleString()}↑ {usage.output_tokens.toLocaleString()}↓
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-400">${cost.toFixed(4)}</span>
        </div>
        <svg className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-400" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" strokeWidth={2} stroke="currentColor">
          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="m4.5 12.75 6 6 9-13.5" />
        </svg>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return null;
}

function formatTime(seconds: number): string {
  if (seconds < 60) return `${seconds}s`;
  const mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  const secs = seconds % 60;
  return `${mins}m ${secs}s`;
}

export default function AIGeneratingButton({
  isGenerating,
  onClick,
  label,
  disabled = false,
  className = "",
  size = "md",
}: AIGeneratingButtonProps) {
  const [msgIdx, setMsgIdx] = useState(0);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [dots, setDots] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isGenerating) { setMsgIdx(0); setProgress(0); setDots(0); return; }
    const msgTimer = setInterval(() => setMsgIdx(i => (i + 1) % GENERATING_MESSAGES.length), 2600);
    const progressTimer = setInterval(() => setProgress(p => Math.min(p + Math.random() * 2.5, 92)), 350);
    const dotsTimer = setInterval(() => setDots(d => (d + 1) % 4), 450);
    return () => { clearInterval(msgTimer); clearInterval(progressTimer); clearInterval(dotsTimer); };
  }, [isGenerating]);

  const sizeClasses = size === "sm"
    ? "px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs"
    : size === "lg"
    ? "px-8 py-3 text-sm"
    : "px-5 py-2.5 text-sm";

  if (isGenerating) {
    return (
      <div className={`relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden ${sizeClasses} ${className}`}
        style={{ background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #c84b31 0%, #e8602a 50%, #d4522e 100%)", minWidth: "220px" }}
      >
        <div
          className="absolute inset-0 transition-all duration-500 ease-out origin-left"
          style={{ background: "rgba(0,0,0,0.25)", transform: `scaleX(${1 - progress / 100})`, transformOrigin: "right" }}
        />
        <div
          className="absolute inset-0 opacity-30"
          style={{
            background: "linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.4) 50%, transparent 100%)",
            animation: "shimmer 1.6s ease-in-out infinite",
            backgroundSize: "200% 100%",
          }}
        />
        <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center gap-2.5">
          <ClaudeIcon className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-white animate-spin" style={{ animationDuration: "2s" } as React.CSSProperties} />
          <div className="flex flex-col items-start leading-none">
            <span className="font-bold text-white text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wide">Claude is working</span>
            <span className="text-white/70 text-[10px] truncate max-w-[180px]">
              {GENERATING_MESSAGES[msgIdx]}{"·".repeat(dots + 1)}
            </span>
          </div>
          <span className="ml-auto font-mono text-white/60 text-[10px] shrink-0">{Math.round(progress)}%</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <button
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      className={`group relative flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-white active:scale-[0.98] transition-all duration-150 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed overflow-hidden ${sizeClasses} ${className}`}
      style={{ background: "linear-gradient(135deg, #c84b31 0%, #e8602a 50%, #d4522e 100%)" }}

  );

export function AvatarCircle({ name, image, size = 24 }: { name: string | null; image: string | null; size?: number }) {
  const initials = (name ?? "?")
    .split(" ")
    .map((n) => n[0])
    .join("")
    .toUpperCase()
    .slice(0, 2);

  return image ? (
    // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element
    <img
      src={image}
      alt={name ?? ""}
      width={size}
      height={size}
      className="rounded-full object-cover"
      style={{ width: size, height: size }}
    />
  ) : (
    <div
      className="rounded-full bg-stone-300 dark:bg-zinc-700 flex items-center justify-center text-[9px] font-bold text-white"
      style={{ width: size, height: size }}
    >
      {initials}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import Link from "next/link";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import StepNav from "@/components/seo/step-nav";

// ── Section header context ───────────────────────────────────
export interface SectionHeaderConfig {
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  steps: { key: string; label: string }[];
  currentStep: string;
  onStepClick: (key: string) => void;
  completedSteps: Set<string>;
  isApproved?: boolean;
}

const SectionHeaderCtx = createContext<{
  config: SectionHeaderConfig | null;
  setConfig: (c: SectionHeaderConfig | null) => void;
}>({ config: null, setConfig: () => {} });

export function useSectionHeader(config: SectionHeaderConfig) {
  const { setConfig } = useContext(SectionHeaderCtx);
  const callbackRef = useRef(config.onStepClick);
  callbackRef.current = config.onStepClick;
  const configRef = useRef(config);
  configRef.current = config;

  const stableOnStepClick = useCallback((key: string) => callbackRef.current(key), []);

  // Serialize collections into stable strings to avoid infinite re-render loops
  const completedKey = [...config.completedSteps].sort().join(",");
  const stepsKey = config.steps.map(s => s.key).join(",");

  useEffect(() => {
    setConfig({ ...configRef.current, onStepClick: stableOnStepClick });
    return () => setConfig(null);
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [setConfig, stableOnStepClick, config.title, config.subtitle, config.currentStep, completedKey, config.isApproved, stepsKey]);
}

// ── localStorage helpers ─────────────────────────────────────
export interface ProjectState {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  brand_name: string;
  s1_approved_at: string | null;
  s2_approved_at: string | null;
  s3_approved_at: string | null;
  s4_approved_at: string | null;
  s5_approved_at: string | null;
  s6_approved_at: string | null;
  section_locks: Record<string, string>;
}

function defaultState(projectId: string): ProjectState {
  return {
    id: projectId,
    name: "Untitled Project",
    brand_name: "Brand",
    s1_approved_at: null,
    s2_approved_at: null,
    s3_approved_at: null,
    s4_approved_at: null,
    s5_approved_at: null,
    s6_approved_at: null,
    section_locks: {},
  };
}

export function getProjectState(projectId: string): ProjectState {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return defaultState(projectId);
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(`seo_project_state_${projectId}`);
    if (raw) return { ...defaultState(projectId), ...JSON.parse(raw) };
  } catch {}
  return defaultState(projectId);
}

export function saveProjectState(projectId: string, state: Partial<ProjectState>) {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  const current = getProjectState(projectId);
  localStorage.setItem(`seo_project_state_${projectId}`, JSON.stringify({ ...current, ...state }));
}

export function approvePhase(projectId: string, phase: "s1" | "s2" | "s3" | "s4" | "s5" | "s6") {
  const state = getProjectState(projectId);
  const key = `${phase}_approved_at` as keyof ProjectState;
  if (!state[key]) {
    saveProjectState(projectId, { [key]: new Date().toISOString() });
  }
}

export function lockSection(projectId: string, sectionKey: string) {
  const state = getProjectState(projectId);
  const locks = { ...(state.section_locks || {}) };
  locks[sectionKey] = new Date().toISOString();
  saveProjectState(projectId, { section_locks: locks });
}

export function isSectionLocked(projectId: string, sectionKey: string): boolean {
  const state = getProjectState(projectId);
  return !!state.section_locks?.[sectionKey];
}

// ── Phase definitions ────────────────────────────────────────
const PHASES = [
  { id: "S1", label: "Intake", path: "intake" },
  { id: "S2", label: "Keywords", path: "keywords" },
  { id: "S3", label: "Reviews", path: "reviews" },
  { id: "S4", label: "Rufus", path: "rufus" },
  { id: "S5", label: "COSMO", path: "cosmo" },
  { id: "S6", label: "SEO Content", path: "seo" },
];

type PhaseStatus = "locked" | "active" | "completed" | "approved";

function getActiveSectionFromPath(pathname: string): string {
  const segments = pathname.split("/");
  const last = segments[segments.length - 1];
  const known = ["intake", "keywords", "reviews", "rufus", "cosmo", "seo"];
  return known.includes(last) ? last : "intake";
}

function deriveCurrentPhase(state: ProjectState): string {
  const order = ["s1", "s2", "s3", "s4", "s5", "s6"] as const;
  for (let i = order.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const key = `${order[i]}_approved_at` as keyof ProjectState;
    if (state[key]) {
      const nextIdx = i + 1;
      return nextIdx < order.length ? order[nextIdx].toUpperCase() : "S7";
    }
  }
  return "S1";
}

// ── Top pipeline nav bar ─────────────────────────────────────
function PipelineNav({
  projectId,
  projectState,
  currentPhase,
  activeSection,
  mounted,
  sectionHeader,
}: {
  projectId: string;
  projectState: ProjectState;
  currentPhase: string;
  activeSection: string;
  mounted: boolean;
  sectionHeader: SectionHeaderConfig | null;
}) {
  const getStatus = (phaseId: string): PhaseStatus => {
    const key = `${phaseId.toLowerCase()}_approved_at` as keyof ProjectState;
    if (projectState[key]) return "approved";
    if (phaseId === currentPhase) return "active";
    const phaseIdx = PHASES.findIndex((p) => p.id === phaseId);
    const currentIdx = PHASES.findIndex((p) => p.id === currentPhase);
    if (phaseIdx < currentIdx) return "completed";
    return "locked";
  };

  return (
    <div className="sticky top-0 z-30 border-b border-border bg-background px-6 lg:px-10">
      {/* SEO Manager header */}
      <div className="py-4 mb-2 border-b border-border/50">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <h1 className="text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-[family-name:var(--font-geist-sans)] tracking-tighter">
            <span className="text-foreground font-bold">SEO</span><span className="text-brand">Manager</span>
          </h1>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2">Amazon Listing Optimization &mdash; RUFUS &amp; COSMO System</p>
      </div>
      {/* Project breadcrumb */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between py-2 border-b border-border/50">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Link href="/seo" className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground/80 transition-colors">
            ← SEO Projects
          </Link>
          <span className="text-muted-foreground/40">/</span>
          <div>
            <span className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground">
              {mounted ? projectState.name : "Loading…"}
            </span>
            {mounted && projectState.brand_name && (
              <span className="ml-2 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{projectState.brand_name}</span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Phase nav */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 py-2 overflow-x-auto">
        {PHASES.map((phase, i) => {
          const status = mounted ? getStatus(phase.id) : "locked";
          const isActive = phase.path === activeSection;
          const isLocked = status === "locked";

          return (
            <Link
              key={phase.id}
              href={isLocked ? "#" : `/seo/${projectId}/${phase.path}`}
              className={cn(
                "flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-all",
                isActive && "bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-300 ring-1 ring-amber-500/30",
                !isActive && status === "approved" && "text-emerald-400 hover:bg-muted",
                !isActive && status === "active" && "text-foreground/80 hover:bg-muted",
                !isActive && status === "completed" && "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted",
                isLocked && "text-muted-foreground/60 cursor-not-allowed pointer-events-none opacity-50"
              )}
              onClick={(e) => isLocked && e.preventDefault()}
            >
              <span className={cn(
                "flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[9px] font-extrabold",
                status === "approved" && "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400",
                status === "active" && isActive ? "bg-amber-500 text-background" : status === "active" ? "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400" : "",
                status === "completed" && "bg-muted/70 text-muted-foreground",
                status === "locked" && "bg-muted text-muted-foreground/60"
              )}>
                {status === "approved" ? "✓" : i + 1}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground mr-0.5">{phase.id}</span>
              {phase.label}
              {i < PHASES.length - 1 && (
                <span className="ml-2 text-muted-foreground/40">›</span>
              )}
            </Link>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* Section header + step chips */}
      {sectionHeader && (
        <div className="border-t border-border/50 pt-3 pb-3">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-foreground mb-1">{sectionHeader.title}</h2>
          {sectionHeader.subtitle && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3">{sectionHeader.subtitle}</p>}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
            {sectionHeader.steps.map((s, i) => {
              const isCurrent = s.key === sectionHeader.currentStep;
              const isCompleted = sectionHeader.completedSteps.has(s.key);
              const isClickable = isCompleted || isCurrent || !!sectionHeader.isApproved;
              return (
                <button
                  key={s.key}
                  onClick={() => isClickable && sectionHeader.onStepClick(s.key)}
                  disabled={!isClickable}
                  className={cn(
                    "flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-bold transition-all",
                    isCurrent && "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 ring-1 ring-amber-500/30",
                    !isCurrent && (isCompleted || sectionHeader.isApproved) && "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-500/15 cursor-pointer",
                    !isCurrent && !isCompleted && !sectionHeader.isApproved && "bg-muted text-muted-foreground/60 cursor-not-allowed"
                  )}
                >
                  <span className={cn(
                    "flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[8px] font-extrabold",
                    isCurrent && "bg-amber-500 text-background",
                    !isCurrent && (isCompleted || sectionHeader.isApproved) && "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400",
                    !isCurrent && !isCompleted && !sectionHeader.isApproved && "bg-muted/70 text-muted-foreground/60"
                  )}>
                    {isCompleted || (sectionHeader.isApproved && !isCurrent) ? "✓" : i + 1}
                  </span>
                  {s.label}
                  {i < sectionHeader.steps.length - 1 && (
                    <span className={cn("ml-1 h-px w-4 shrink-0", isCompleted || sectionHeader.isApproved ? "bg-emerald-500/30" : "bg-border")} />
                  )}
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── ProjectShell ─────────────────────────────────────────────
export default function ProjectShell({
  projectId,
  children,
}: {
  projectId: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const [projectState, setProjectState] = useState<ProjectState>(() => defaultState(projectId));
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch(`/api/seo/projects/${projectId}`)
      .then((r) => r.json())
      .then((data) => {
        if (data && !data.error) {
          const localState = getProjectState(projectId);
          const merged = {
            ...localState,
            name: data.name || localState.name,
            brand_name: data.brand_name || localState.brand_name,
            s1_approved_at: data.s1_approved_at || localState.s1_approved_at,
            s2_approved_at: data.s2_approved_at || localState.s2_approved_at,
            s3_approved_at: data.s3_approved_at || localState.s3_approved_at,
            s4_approved_at: data.s4_approved_at || localState.s4_approved_at,
            s5_approved_at: data.s5_approved_at || localState.s5_approved_at,
            s6_approved_at: data.s6_approved_at || localState.s6_approved_at,
          };
          saveProjectState(projectId, merged);
          setProjectState(merged);
        } else {
          setProjectState(getProjectState(projectId));
        }
      })
      .catch(() => setProjectState(getProjectState(projectId)))
      .finally(() => setMounted(true));
  }, [projectId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = () => {
      setProjectState({ ...getProjectState(projectId) });
    };
    window.addEventListener("project_state_updated", handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("project_state_updated", handler);
  }, [projectId]);

  const activeSection = getActiveSectionFromPath(pathname || "");
  const currentPhase = mounted ? deriveCurrentPhase(projectState) : "S1";
  const [sectionHeader, setSectionHeader] = useState<SectionHeaderConfig | null>(null);

  return (
    <SectionHeaderCtx.Provider value={{ config: sectionHeader, setConfig: setSectionHeader }}>
      <div className="-mx-6 lg:-mx-10 min-h-[calc(100vh-3.5rem)]">
        <PipelineNav
          projectId={projectId}
          projectState={projectState}
          currentPhase={currentPhase}
          activeSection={activeSection}
          mounted={mounted}
          sectionHeader={sectionHeader}
        />
        <div key={activeSection} className="px-6 lg:px-10 pb-6">{children}</div>
      </div>
    </SectionHeaderCtx.Provider>
  );
}

    expect(container.innerHTML).toBe("");
  });

    const { container } = render(<QualitySparkline scores={[]} />);
    expect(container.innerHTML).toBe("");
  });

    const { container } = render(<QualitySparkline scores={[80, 85, 90]} />);
    const svg = container.querySelector("svg");
    expect(svg).toBeInTheDocument();
    const polyline = container.querySelector("polyline");
    expect(polyline).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(polyline?.getAttribute("points")).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it("renders a dot on the latest value", () => {
    const { container } = render(<QualitySparkline scores={[70, 80]} />);
    const circle = container.querySelector("circle");
    expect(circle).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("has accessible label with trend direction", () => {
    render(<QualitySparkline scores={[70, 80, 90]} />);
    // Scores are reversed: oldest first [90, 80, 70] → newest is 70
    // Wait, scores come in newest→oldest: [70, 80, 90]
    // Reversed for display: [90, 80, 70]
    // data[0]=90, data[last]=70, so label is "90 → 70"
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/Quality trend: 90 → 70/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("accepts custom width and height", () => {
    const { container } = render(
      <QualitySparkline scores={[60, 80]} width={100} height={30} />
    );
    const svg = container.querySelector("svg");
    expect(svg?.getAttribute("width")).toBe("100");
    expect(svg?.getAttribute("height")).toBe("30");
  });
});

FILE: src/components/seo/quality-sparkline.tsx
================================================
"use client";

interface QualitySparklineProps {
  /** Quality scores ordered newest → oldest. At least 2 needed to draw a line. */
  scores: number[];
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
}

/**
 * Tiny inline SVG sparkline for quality score trends.
 * Green when trend is up, red when down, amber when flat.
 */
export function QualitySparkline({
  scores,
  width = 64,
  height = 20,
}: QualitySparklineProps) {
  if (scores.length < 2) return null;

  // Reverse so oldest is first (left) and newest is last (right)
  const data = [...scores].reverse();
  const min = Math.min(...data);
  const max = Math.max(...data);
  const range = max - min || 1;
  const padY = 2;

  const points = data.map((val, i) => {
    const x = (i / (data.length - 1)) * width;
    const y = padY + ((max - val) / range) * (height - 2 * padY);
    return `${x.toFixed(1)},${y.toFixed(1)}`;
  });

  const trend = data[data.length - 1] - data[0];
  const color =
    trend > 2 ? "var(--color-emerald-500, #10b981)" :
    trend < -2 ? "var(--color-red-500, #ef4444)" :
    "var(--color-amber-500, #f59e0b)";

  return (
    <svg
      width={width}
      height={height}
      viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${height}`}
      className="inline-block"
      aria-label={`Quality trend: ${data[0]} → ${data[data.length - 1]}`}
    >
      <polyline
        points={points.join(" ")}
        fill="none"
        stroke={color}
        strokeWidth={1.5}
        strokeLinecap="round"
        strokeLinejoin="round"
      />
      {/* Dot on the latest value */}
      <circle
        cx={width}
        cy={parseFloat(points[points.length - 1].split(",")[1])}
        r={2}
        fill={color}
      />
    </svg>
  );
}

"use client";

interface Step {
  key: string;
  label: string;
}

interface StepNavProps {
  steps: Step[];
  currentStep: string;
  onStepClick: (key: string) => void;
  completedSteps: Set<string>;
  isApproved?: boolean;
  title?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
}

export default function StepNav({ steps, currentStep, onStepClick, completedSteps, isApproved, title, subtitle }: StepNavProps) {
  return (
    <div className="sticky z-10 -mx-6 lg:-mx-10 px-6 lg:px-10 pt-3 pb-3 mb-3 bg-background border-b border-border/50" style={{ top: "var(--pipeline-nav-h, 0px)" }}>
      {title && (
        <>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-foreground mb-1">{title}</h1>
          {subtitle && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3">{subtitle}</p>}
        </>
      )}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
      {steps.map((s, i) => {
        const isCurrent = s.key === currentStep;
        const isCompleted = completedSteps.has(s.key);
        const isClickable = isCompleted || isCurrent || !!isApproved;

        return (
          <button
            key={s.key}
            onClick={() => isClickable && onStepClick(s.key)}
            disabled={!isClickable}
            className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-bold transition-all ${
              isCurrent
                ? "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 ring-1 ring-amber-500/30"
                : isCompleted || isApproved
                ? "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-500/15 cursor-pointer"
                : "bg-muted text-muted-foreground/60 cursor-not-allowed"
            }`}
          >
            <span className={`flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[8px] font-extrabold ${
              isCurrent
                ? "bg-amber-500 text-background"
                : isCompleted || isApproved
                ? "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400"
                : "bg-muted/70 text-muted-foreground/60"
            }`}>
              {isCompleted || (isApproved && !isCurrent) ? "✓" : i + 1}
            </span>
            {s.label}
            {i < steps.length - 1 && (
              <span className={`ml-1 h-px w-4 shrink-0 ${isCompleted || isApproved ? "bg-emerald-500/30" : "bg-border"}`} />
            )}
          </button>
        );
      })}
      </div>
    </div>

FILE: src/components/seo/manager/bulk-action-bar.tsx
================================================
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";

interface BulkActionBarProps {
  selectedCount: number;
  onApprove: () => Promise<void>;
  onExport: () => Promise<void>;
  onReassign: (userId: string) => Promise<void>;
  onClear: () => void;
  team: Array<{ id: string; name: string | null; email: string }>;
}

export function BulkActionBar({
  selectedCount,
  onApprove,
  onExport,
  onReassign,
  onClear,
  team,
}: BulkActionBarProps) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showReassign, setShowReassign] = useState(false);
  const [exportProgress, setExportProgress] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (selectedCount === 0) return null;

  async function handleAction(action: string, fn: () => Promise<void>) {
    setLoading(action);
    try {
      await fn();
    } catch {
      // Error handled by parent
    }
    setLoading(null);
    setExportProgress(null);
  }

  return (
    <div
      role="toolbar"
      aria-label={`Bulk actions for ${selectedCount} selected projects`}
      className="fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 border-t border-stone-200 bg-white shadow-lg dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-900 pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]"
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-3 max-w-screen-xl mx-auto">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <span className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground">
            {selectedCount} selected
          </span>
          <button
            onClick={onClear}
            className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground underline"
          >
            Clear
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {exportProgress && (
            <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mr-2">{exportProgress}</span>
          )}

          <button
            onClick={() => handleAction("approve", onApprove)}
            disabled={!!loading}
            className="rounded-lg border border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-100 disabled:opacity-50 transition-colors dark:border-emerald-500/30 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400"
          >
            {loading === "approve" ? "Approving..." : "Approve"}
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => handleAction("export", onExport)}
            disabled={!!loading}
            className="rounded-lg border border-stone-300 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-foreground hover:bg-stone-50 disabled:opacity-50 transition-colors dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
          >
            {loading === "export" ? "Exporting..." : "Export All"}
          </button>

          <div className="relative">
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowReassign(!showReassign)}
              disabled={!!loading}
              className="rounded-lg border border-stone-300 bg-white px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-foreground hover:bg-stone-50 disabled:opacity-50 transition-colors dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
            >
              Reassign
            </button>
            {showReassign && (
              <div className="absolute bottom-full right-0 mb-2 w-52 rounded-lg border border-stone-200 bg-white shadow-xl py-1 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900">
                {team.map((m) => (
                  <button
                    key={m.id}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setShowReassign(false);
                      handleAction("reassign", () => onReassign(m.id));
                    }}
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 text-xs text-left text-foreground hover:bg-stone-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
                  >
                    {m.name || m.email}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClear}
            className="rounded-lg border border-stone-300 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:bg-stone-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
            title="Cancel selection"
          >
            &#10005;
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  it("shows skeleton pulse when preview is null and phase is S6+", () => {

    const pulses = container.querySelectorAll(".animate-pulse");
    expect(pulses.length).toBe(3);
  });

  it("renders title, bullet, and description when preview is provided", () => {
    render(
      <ContentPreview
        preview={{
          title: "Test Title",
          bullet1: "Bullet one text",
          description: "Product description here",
        }}
        phase="S6"
      />
    );
    expect(screen.getByText("Test Title")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("Bullet one text")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("Product description here")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("skips empty fields in preview", () => {
    render(
      <ContentPreview
        preview={{ title: "Only Title", bullet1: "", description: "" }}
        phase="S6"
      />
    );
    expect(screen.getByText("Only Title")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText("B1:")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText("Desc:")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

"use client";

interface ContentPreviewProps {
  preview: { title: string; bullet1: string; description: string } | null;
  phase: string;
}

export function ContentPreview({ preview, phase }: ContentPreviewProps) {
  if (!preview) {
    const phaseNum = parseInt(phase.replace("S", ""), 10);
    if (phaseNum < 6) {
      return (
        <div className="mt-3 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/60 italic">
          No content yet &mdash; complete S6 to generate
        </div>
      );
    }
    return (
      <div className="mt-3">
        <div className="h-3 w-3/4 rounded bg-stone-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 animate-pulse mb-1.5" />
        <div className="h-3 w-1/2 rounded bg-stone-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 animate-pulse mb-1.5" />
        <div className="h-3 w-2/3 rounded bg-stone-100 dark:bg-zinc-800 animate-pulse" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="mt-3 space-y-1">
      {preview.title && (
        <p className="text-xs text-foreground leading-snug">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground mr-1.5">Title:</span>
          <span className="line-clamp-1">{preview.title}</span>
        </p>
      )}
      {preview.bullet1 && (
        <p className="text-xs text-foreground/80 leading-snug">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground mr-1.5">B1:</span>
          <span className="line-clamp-1">{preview.bullet1}</span>
        </p>
      )}
      {preview.description && (
        <p className="text-xs text-foreground/70 leading-snug">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground mr-1.5">Desc:</span>
          <span className="line-clamp-1">{preview.description}</span>
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { render, screen, fireEvent } from "@testing-library/react";
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from "vitest";
import { DiffModal } from "./diff-modal";
import type { SeoVersion } from "@/lib/seo-types";

function makeVersion(num: string, fields: Record<string, string>): SeoVersion {
  return {
    seoVersionNumber: num,
    seoCategory: "Standard",
    seoStatus: "Current",
    seoDocUrl: null,
    fields,
    populatedCount: Object.keys(fields).length,
  };
}

describe("DiffModal", () => {
  it("shows 'No differences found' when versions are identical", () => {
    const v1 = makeVersion("1", { Title: "Same" });
    const v2 = makeVersion("2", { Title: "Same" });
    render(<DiffModal v1={v1} v2={v2} onClose={vi.fn()} />);
    expect(screen.getByText("No differences found between these versions.")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("highlights added and removed text when versions differ", () => {
    const v1 = makeVersion("1", { Title: "Old Title Here" });
    const v2 = makeVersion("2", { Title: "New Title Here" });
    render(<DiffModal v1={v1} v2={v2} onClose={vi.fn()} />);
    expect(screen.getByText("Title")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText(/1 field changed/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("shows version numbers in header", () => {
    const v1 = makeVersion("3", { Title: "A" });
    const v2 = makeVersion("4", { Title: "B" });
    render(<DiffModal v1={v1} v2={v2} onClose={vi.fn()} />);
    expect(screen.getByText(/v3/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText(/v4/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("calls onClose when close button is clicked", () => {
    const onClose = vi.fn();
    const v1 = makeVersion("1", { Title: "A" });
    const v2 = makeVersion("2", { Title: "B" });
    render(<DiffModal v1={v1} v2={v2} onClose={onClose} />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByText("Close"));
    expect(onClose).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("calls onClose when clicking the backdrop", () => {
    const onClose = vi.fn();
    const v1 = makeVersion("1", { Title: "A" });
    const v2 = makeVersion("2", { Title: "B" });
    const { container } = render(<DiffModal v1={v1} v2={v2} onClose={onClose} />);
    // Click the backdrop (outermost div)
    const backdrop = container.firstChild as HTMLElement;
    fireEvent.click(backdrop);
    expect(onClose).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("does not close when clicking inside the dialog", () => {
    const onClose = vi.fn();
    const v1 = makeVersion("1", { Title: "A" });
    const v2 = makeVersion("2", { Title: "B" });
    render(<DiffModal v1={v1} v2={v2} onClose={onClose} />);
    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("dialog"));
    expect(onClose).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("shows count of unchanged fields", () => {
    const v1 = makeVersion("1", { Title: "A", Bullet1: "Same" });
    const v2 = makeVersion("2", { Title: "B", Bullet1: "Same" });
    render(<DiffModal v1={v1} v2={v2} onClose={vi.fn()} />);
    expect(screen.getByText(/1 unchanged/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

FILE: src/components/seo/manager/diff-modal.tsx
================================================
"use client";

import { useMemo } from "react";
import { diffWords } from "diff";
import type { SeoVersion } from "@/lib/seo-types";

interface DiffModalProps {
  v1: SeoVersion; // older
  v2: SeoVersion; // newer
  onClose: () => void;
}

function DiffField({ label, oldVal, newVal }: { label: string; oldVal: string; newVal: string }) {
  const parts = useMemo(() => diffWords(oldVal, newVal), [oldVal, newVal]);
  const hasChanges = parts.some((p) => p.added || p.removed);

  if (!hasChanges) return null;

  return (
    <div className="mb-3">
      <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground mb-1">{label}</p>
      <div className="text-xs text-foreground leading-relaxed">
        {parts.map((part, i) => {
          if (part.added) {
            return (
              <span key={i} className="bg-emerald-100/50 underline decoration-emerald-500 dark:bg-emerald-500/10">
                {part.value}
              </span>
            );
          }
          if (part.removed) {
            return (
              <span key={i} className="bg-red-100/50 line-through decoration-red-500 text-red-600/70 dark:bg-red-500/10 dark:text-red-400/70">
                {part.value}
              </span>
            );
          }
          return <span key={i}>{part.value}</span>;
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function DiffModal({ v1, v2, onClose }: DiffModalProps) {
  const fieldNames = Object.keys(v2.fields);
  const changedFields = fieldNames.filter(
    (f) => (v1.fields[f] || "") !== (v2.fields[f] || "")
  );
  const unchangedCount = fieldNames.length - changedFields.length;

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/40 dark:bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div
        role="dialog"
        aria-labelledby="diff-title"
        className="w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[80vh] overflow-y-auto rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl dark:border-zinc-700 dark:bg-zinc-900 md:mx-4"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <h3 id="diff-title" className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground">
            v{v1.seoVersionNumber} &#8594; v{v2.seoVersionNumber}
          </h3>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors text-lg leading-none"
          >
            &times;
          </button>
        </div>

        {changedFields.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">No differences found between these versions.</p>
        ) : (
          <>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mb-4">
              {changedFields.length} field{changedFields.length !== 1 ? "s" : ""} changed
              {unchangedCount > 0 && ` · ${unchangedCount} unchanged`}
            </p>
            {changedFields.map((f) => (
              <DiffField
                key={f}
                label={f}
                oldVal={v1.fields[f] || ""}
                newVal={v2.fields[f] || ""}
              />
            ))}
          </>
        )}

        <div className="flex justify-end mt-4">
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="rounded-lg border border-stone-300 px-4 py-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:bg-stone-50 dark:border-zinc-700 dark:hover:bg-zinc-800"
          >
            Close
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/seo/manager/export-history.tsx
================================================
"use client";

interface ExportInfo {
  export_count: number;
  last_exported_at: string;
  last_url: string | null;
}

interface ExportHistoryProps {
  exportInfo: ExportInfo | null;
}

function relativeDate(dateStr: string): string {
  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(dateStr).getTime();
  const days = Math.floor(diff / 86400000);
  if (days === 0) return "today";
  if (days === 1) return "yesterday";
  if (days < 30) return `${days}d ago`;
  return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleDateString();
}

export function ExportBadge({ exportInfo }: ExportHistoryProps) {
  if (!exportInfo || exportInfo.export_count === 0) {
    return (
      <span className="rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[8px] font-bold bg-stone-100 text-stone-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500"
        aria-label="Never exported"
      >
        Never exported
      </span>
    );
  }

  return (
    <span
      className="rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[8px] font-bold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400"
      aria-label={`Last exported ${relativeDate(exportInfo.last_exported_at)}, ${exportInfo.export_count} total exports`}
    >
      Exported &#10003; {relativeDate(exportInfo.last_exported_at)}
    </span>
  );
}

export function ExportHistory({ exportInfo }: ExportHistoryProps) {
  if (!exportInfo || exportInfo.export_count === 0) {
    return (
      <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/50 italic">Never exported</p>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-1">
      <p className="text-[10px] text-foreground">
        <span className="font-bold">{exportInfo.export_count}</span> export{exportInfo.export_count !== 1 ? "s" : ""}
        {" "}&middot; Last: {relativeDate(exportInfo.last_exported_at)}
      </p>
      {exportInfo.last_url && (
        <a
          href={exportInfo.last_url}
          target="_blank"
          rel="noopener noreferrer"
          className="text-[10px] text-brand hover:text-brand-hover underline"
        >
          Open latest export &#8599;
        </a>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
