FILE: src/components/seo/manager/version-timeline.tsx
================================================
"use client";

import { useState, useCallback } from "react";
import type { SeoVersion } from "@/lib/seo-types";

interface VersionTimelineProps {
  projectId: string;
  asin: string;
  sku: string;
  onCompare: (v1: SeoVersion, v2: SeoVersion) => void;
}

export function VersionTimeline({ projectId, asin, sku, onCompare }: VersionTimelineProps) {
  const [versions, setVersions] = useState<SeoVersion[] | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const loadVersions = useCallback(async () => {
    if (versions) {
      setExpanded(!expanded);
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/seo/versions?asin=${encodeURIComponent(asin)}&sku=${encodeURIComponent(sku)}`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load");
      const data = await res.json();
      setVersions(data.versions || []);
      setExpanded(true);
    } catch {
      setError("Failed to load versions");
    }
    setLoading(false);
  }, [asin, sku, versions, expanded]);

  return (
    <div>
      <button
        onClick={loadVersions}
        className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors flex items-center gap-1"
      >
        <span className={`transition-transform ${expanded ? "rotate-90" : ""}`}>&#9656;</span>
        Versions{versions ? ` (${versions.length})` : ""}
        {loading && <span className="text-muted-foreground/50 ml-1">Loading...</span>}
      </button>

      {error && (
        <p className="text-[10px] text-red-500 mt-1">
          {error}{" "}
          <button onClick={loadVersions} className="underline">retry</button>
        </p>
      )}

      {expanded && versions && (
        <div className="mt-2 space-y-1.5">
          {versions.length === 0 && (
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/50 italic">No versions in BQ yet</p>
          )}
          {versions.map((v, i) => (
            <div
              key={v.seoVersionNumber}
              className="rounded-lg border border-stone-200 bg-stone-50 px-3 py-2 dark:border-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800/30"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-foreground">
                    v{v.seoVersionNumber}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                    {v.populatedCount} fields &middot; {v.seoCategory}
                  </span>
                  <span className={`rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[8px] font-bold ${
                    v.seoStatus === "Current"
                      ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400"
                      : "bg-stone-100 text-stone-500 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-500"
                  }`}>
                    {v.seoStatus}
                  </span>
                </div>
                {i < versions.length - 1 && (
                  <button
                    onClick={() => onCompare(versions[i + 1], v)}
                    className="text-[10px] font-bold text-brand hover:text-brand-hover transition-colors"
                  >
                    Compare &#8596;
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { AlertDialog as AlertDialogPrimitive } from "radix-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button"

function AlertDialog({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Root>) {
  return <AlertDialogPrimitive.Root data-slot="alert-dialog" {...props} />
}

function AlertDialogTrigger({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Trigger>) {
  return <AlertDialogPrimitive.Trigger data-slot="alert-dialog-trigger" {...props} />
}

function AlertDialogPortal({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Portal>) {
  return <AlertDialogPrimitive.Portal data-slot="alert-dialog-portal" {...props} />
}

function AlertDialogOverlay({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Overlay>) {
  return (
    <AlertDialogPrimitive.Overlay
      data-slot="alert-dialog-overlay"
      className={cn(
        "data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[state=closed]:fade-out-0 data-[state=open]:fade-in-0 fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/50",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function AlertDialogContent({
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Content>) {
  return (
    <AlertDialogPortal>
      <AlertDialogOverlay />
      <AlertDialogPrimitive.Content
        data-slot="alert-dialog-content"
        className={cn(
          "bg-background data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[state=closed]:fade-out-0 data-[state=open]:fade-in-0 data-[state=closed]:zoom-out-95 data-[state=open]:zoom-in-95 fixed top-[50%] left-[50%] z-50 grid w-full max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)] translate-x-[-50%] translate-y-[-50%] gap-4 rounded-lg border p-6 shadow-lg duration-200 outline-none sm:max-w-lg",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </AlertDialogPrimitive.Content>
    </AlertDialogPortal>
  )
}

function AlertDialogHeader({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="alert-dialog-header"
      className={cn("flex flex-col gap-2 text-center sm:text-left", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function AlertDialogFooter({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="alert-dialog-footer"
      className={cn(
        "flex flex-col-reverse gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function AlertDialogTitle({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Title>) {
  return (
    <AlertDialogPrimitive.Title
      data-slot="alert-dialog-title"
      className={cn("text-lg leading-none font-semibold", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function AlertDialogDescription({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Description>) {
  return (
    <AlertDialogPrimitive.Description
      data-slot="alert-dialog-description"
      className={cn("text-muted-foreground text-sm", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function AlertDialogAction({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Action>) {
  return (
    <AlertDialogPrimitive.Action
      className={cn(buttonVariants(), className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function AlertDialogCancel({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof AlertDialogPrimitive.Cancel>) {
  return (
    <AlertDialogPrimitive.Cancel
      className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline" }), className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

export {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogOverlay,
  AlertDialogPortal,
  AlertDialogTitle,
  AlertDialogTrigger,
}

"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { XIcon } from "lucide-react"
import { Dialog as DialogPrimitive } from "radix-ui"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

function Dialog({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Root>) {
  return <DialogPrimitive.Root data-slot="dialog" {...props} />
}

function DialogTrigger({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Trigger>) {
  return <DialogPrimitive.Trigger data-slot="dialog-trigger" {...props} />
}

function DialogPortal({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Portal>) {
  return <DialogPrimitive.Portal data-slot="dialog-portal" {...props} />
}

function DialogClose({
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Close>) {
  return <DialogPrimitive.Close data-slot="dialog-close" {...props} />
}

function DialogOverlay({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Overlay>) {
  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Overlay
      data-slot="dialog-overlay"
      className={cn(
        "data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[state=closed]:fade-out-0 data-[state=open]:fade-in-0 fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function DialogContent({
  className,
  children,
  showCloseButton = true,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Content> & {
  showCloseButton?: boolean
}) {
  return (
    <DialogPortal data-slot="dialog-portal">
      <DialogOverlay />
      <DialogPrimitive.Content
        data-slot="dialog-content"
        className={cn(
          "bg-background data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=closed]:animate-out data-[state=closed]:fade-out-0 data-[state=open]:fade-in-0 data-[state=closed]:zoom-out-95 data-[state=open]:zoom-in-95 fixed top-[50%] left-[50%] z-50 grid w-full max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)] translate-x-[-50%] translate-y-[-50%] gap-4 rounded-lg border p-6 shadow-lg duration-200 outline-none sm:max-w-lg",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
        {showCloseButton && (
          <DialogPrimitive.Close
            data-slot="dialog-close"
            className="ring-offset-background focus:ring-ring data-[state=open]:bg-accent data-[state=open]:text-muted-foreground absolute top-4 right-4 rounded-xs opacity-70 transition-opacity hover:opacity-100 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:outline-hidden disabled:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4"
          >
            <XIcon />
            <span className="sr-only">Close</span>
          </DialogPrimitive.Close>
        )}
      </DialogPrimitive.Content>
    </DialogPortal>
  )
}

function DialogHeader({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="dialog-header"
      className={cn("flex flex-col gap-2 text-center sm:text-left", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function DialogFooter({
  className,
  showCloseButton = false,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  showCloseButton?: boolean
}) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="dialog-footer"
      className={cn(
        "flex flex-col-reverse gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
      {showCloseButton && (
        <DialogPrimitive.Close asChild>
          <Button variant="outline">Close</Button>
        </DialogPrimitive.Close>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

function DialogTitle({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Title>) {
  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Title
      data-slot="dialog-title"
      className={cn("text-lg leading-none font-semibold", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function DialogDescription({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof DialogPrimitive.Description>) {
  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Description
      data-slot="dialog-description"
      className={cn("text-muted-foreground text-sm", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

export {
  Dialog,
  DialogClose,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogOverlay,
  DialogPortal,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
}

import type { LucideIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

interface EmptyStateProps {
  icon?: LucideIcon;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  action?: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

export function EmptyState({
  icon: Icon,
  title,
  description,
  action,
  className,
}: EmptyStateProps) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12 text-center",
        className
      )}
    >
      {Icon && (
        <Icon className="h-10 w-10 text-muted-foreground/40 mb-3" />
      )}
      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">{title}</p>
      {description && (
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/70 mt-1 max-w-sm">
          {description}
        </p>
      )}
      {action && <div className="mt-4">{action}</div>}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/ui/loading-placeholder.tsx

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

interface LoadingPlaceholderProps {
  count?: number;
  height?: string;
  className?: string;
}

export function LoadingPlaceholder({
  count = 1,
  height = "h-56",
  className,
}: LoadingPlaceholderProps) {
  return (
    <>
      {Array.from({ length: count }).map((_, i) => (
        <div
          key={i}
          className={cn(
            "rounded-xl border bg-accent animate-pulse",
            height,
            className
          )}
          style={{ animationDelay: `${i * 100}ms` }}
        />
      ))}
    </>
  );
}

          "bg-background data-[state=open]:animate-in data-[state=closed]:animate-out fixed z-50 flex flex-col gap-4 shadow-lg transition ease-in-out data-[state=closed]:duration-300 data-[state=open]:duration-500",
          side === "right" &&
            "data-[state=closed]:slide-out-to-right data-[state=open]:slide-in-from-right inset-y-0 right-0 h-full w-3/4 border-l sm:max-w-sm",
          side === "left" &&
            "data-[state=closed]:slide-out-to-left data-[state=open]:slide-in-from-left inset-y-0 left-0 h-full w-3/4 border-r sm:max-w-sm",
          side === "top" &&
            "data-[state=closed]:slide-out-to-top data-[state=open]:slide-in-from-top inset-x-0 top-0 h-auto border-b",
          side === "bottom" &&
            "data-[state=closed]:slide-out-to-bottom data-[state=open]:slide-in-from-bottom inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-auto border-t",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
        {showCloseButton && (
          <SheetPrimitive.Close className="ring-offset-background focus:ring-ring data-[state=open]:bg-secondary absolute top-4 right-4 rounded-xs opacity-70 transition-opacity hover:opacity-100 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:outline-hidden disabled:pointer-events-none">
            <XIcon className="size-4" />
            <span className="sr-only">Close</span>
          </SheetPrimitive.Close>
        )}
      </SheetPrimitive.Content>
    </SheetPortal>
  )
}

function SheetHeader({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="sheet-header"

}

"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"
import { PanelLeftIcon } from "lucide-react"
import { Slot } from "radix-ui"

import { useIsMobile } from "@/hooks/use-mobile"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
import { Separator } from "@/components/ui/separator"
import {
  Sheet,
  SheetContent,
  SheetDescription,
  SheetHeader,
  SheetTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/sheet"
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton"
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/tooltip"

const SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME = "sidebar_state"
const SIDEBAR_COOKIE_MAX_AGE = 60 * 60 * 24 * 7
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH = "16rem"
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH_MOBILE = "18rem"
const SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON = "3rem"
const SIDEBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT = "b"

type SidebarContextProps = {
  state: "expanded" | "collapsed"
  open: boolean
  setOpen: (open: boolean) => void
  openMobile: boolean
  setOpenMobile: (open: boolean) => void
  isMobile: boolean
  toggleSidebar: () => void
}

const SidebarContext = React.createContext<SidebarContextProps | null>(null)

function useSidebar() {
  const context = React.useContext(SidebarContext)
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useSidebar must be used within a SidebarProvider.")
  }

  return context
}

function SidebarProvider({
  defaultOpen = true,
  open: openProp,
  onOpenChange: setOpenProp,
  className,
  style,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  defaultOpen?: boolean
  open?: boolean
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void
}) {
  const isMobile = useIsMobile()
  const [openMobile, setOpenMobile] = React.useState(false)

  // This is the internal state of the sidebar.
  // We use openProp and setOpenProp for control from outside the component.
  const [_open, _setOpen] = React.useState(defaultOpen)
  const open = openProp ?? _open
  const setOpen = React.useCallback(
    (value: boolean | ((value: boolean) => boolean)) => {
      const openState = typeof value === "function" ? value(open) : value
      if (setOpenProp) {
        setOpenProp(openState)
      } else {
        _setOpen(openState)
      }

      // This sets the cookie to keep the sidebar state.
      document.cookie = `${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_NAME}=${openState}; path=/; max-age=${SIDEBAR_COOKIE_MAX_AGE}`
    },
    [setOpenProp, open]
  )

  // Helper to toggle the sidebar.
  const toggleSidebar = React.useCallback(() => {
    return isMobile ? setOpenMobile((open) => !open) : setOpen((open) => !open)
  }, [isMobile, setOpen, setOpenMobile])

  // Adds a keyboard shortcut to toggle the sidebar.
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (
        event.key === SIDEBAR_KEYBOARD_SHORTCUT &&
        (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)
      ) {
        event.preventDefault()
        toggleSidebar()
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown)
    return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown)
  }, [toggleSidebar])

  // We add a state so that we can do data-state="expanded" or "collapsed".
  // This makes it easier to style the sidebar with Tailwind classes.
  const state = open ? "expanded" : "collapsed"

  const contextValue = React.useMemo<SidebarContextProps>(
    () => ({
      state,
      open,
      setOpen,
      isMobile,
      openMobile,
      setOpenMobile,
      toggleSidebar,
    }),
    [state, open, setOpen, isMobile, openMobile, setOpenMobile, toggleSidebar]
  )

  return (
    <SidebarContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
      <TooltipProvider delayDuration={0}>
        <div
          data-slot="sidebar-wrapper"
          style={
            {
              "--sidebar-width": SIDEBAR_WIDTH,
              "--sidebar-width-icon": SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON,
              ...style,
            } as React.CSSProperties
          }
          className={cn(
            "group/sidebar-wrapper has-data-[variant=inset]:bg-sidebar flex h-svh w-full",
            className
          )}
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
        </div>
      </TooltipProvider>
    </SidebarContext.Provider>
  )
}

function Sidebar({
  side = "left",
  variant = "sidebar",
  collapsible = "offcanvas",
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  side?: "left" | "right"
  variant?: "sidebar" | "floating" | "inset"
  collapsible?: "offcanvas" | "icon" | "none"
}) {
  const { isMobile, state, openMobile, setOpenMobile } = useSidebar()

  if (collapsible === "none") {
    return (
      <div
        data-slot="sidebar"
        className={cn(
          "bg-sidebar text-sidebar-foreground flex h-full w-(--sidebar-width) flex-col",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    )
  }

  if (isMobile) {
    return (
      <Sheet open={openMobile} onOpenChange={setOpenMobile} {...props}>
        <SheetContent
          data-sidebar="sidebar"
          data-slot="sidebar"
          data-mobile="true"
          className="bg-sidebar text-sidebar-foreground w-(--sidebar-width) p-0 [&>button]:hidden"
          style={
            {
              "--sidebar-width": SIDEBAR_WIDTH_MOBILE,
            } as React.CSSProperties
          }
          side={side}
        >
          <SheetHeader className="sr-only">
            <SheetTitle>Sidebar</SheetTitle>
            <SheetDescription>Displays the mobile sidebar.</SheetDescription>
          </SheetHeader>
          <div className="flex h-full w-full flex-col">{children}</div>
        </SheetContent>
      </Sheet>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div
      className="group peer text-sidebar-foreground hidden md:block"
      data-state={state}
      data-collapsible={state === "collapsed" ? collapsible : ""}
      data-variant={variant}
      data-side={side}
      data-slot="sidebar"
    >
      {/* This is what handles the sidebar gap on desktop */}
      <div
        data-slot="sidebar-gap"
        className={cn(
          "relative w-(--sidebar-width) bg-transparent transition-[width] duration-200 ease-linear",
          "group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:w-0",
          "group-data-[side=right]:rotate-180",
          variant === "floating" || variant === "inset"
            ? "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[calc(var(--sidebar-width-icon)+(--spacing(4)))]"
            : "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-(--sidebar-width-icon)"
        )}
      />
      <div
        data-slot="sidebar-container"
        className={cn(
          "fixed inset-y-0 z-10 hidden h-svh w-(--sidebar-width) transition-[left,right,width] duration-200 ease-linear md:flex",
          side === "left"
            ? "left-0 group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:left-[calc(var(--sidebar-width)*-1)]"
            : "right-0 group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:right-[calc(var(--sidebar-width)*-1)]",
          // Adjust the padding for floating and inset variants.
          variant === "floating" || variant === "inset"
            ? "p-2 group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-[calc(var(--sidebar-width-icon)+(--spacing(4))+2px)]"
            : "group-data-[collapsible=icon]:w-(--sidebar-width-icon)",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        <div
          data-sidebar="sidebar"
          data-slot="sidebar-inner"
          className="bg-sidebar group-data-[variant=floating]:border-sidebar-border flex h-full w-full flex-col group-data-[variant=floating]:rounded-lg group-data-[variant=floating]:border group-data-[variant=floating]:shadow-sm"
        >
          {children}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

function SidebarTrigger({
  className,
  onClick,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof Button>) {
  const { toggleSidebar } = useSidebar()

  return (
    <Button
      data-sidebar="trigger"
      data-slot="sidebar-trigger"
      variant="ghost"
      size="icon"
      className={cn("size-7", className)}
      onClick={(event) => {
        onClick?.(event)
        toggleSidebar()
      }}
      {...props}
    >
      <PanelLeftIcon />
      <span className="sr-only">Toggle Sidebar</span>
    </Button>
  )
}

const sidebarMenuButtonVariants = cva(
  "peer/menu-button flex w-full items-center gap-2 overflow-hidden rounded-md p-2 text-left text-sm outline-hidden ring-sidebar-ring transition-[width,height,padding] hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 active:bg-sidebar-accent active:text-sidebar-accent-foreground disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 group-has-data-[sidebar=menu-action]/menu-item:pr-8 aria-disabled:pointer-events-none aria-disabled:opacity-50 data-[active=true]:bg-sidebar-accent data-[active=true]:font-medium data-[active=true]:text-sidebar-accent-foreground data-[state=open]:hover:bg-sidebar-accent data-[state=open]:hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground group-data-[collapsible=icon]:size-8! group-data-[collapsible=icon]:p-2! [&>span:last-child]:truncate [&>svg]:size-4 [&>svg]:shrink-0",

      },
      size: {
        default: "h-9 text-sm",
        sm: "h-8 text-xs",
        lg: "h-12 text-sm group-data-[collapsible=icon]:p-0!",
      },
    },

    },
  }

function SidebarMenuButton({
  asChild = false,
  isActive = false,
  variant = "default",
  size = "default",
  tooltip,
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"button"> & {
  asChild?: boolean
  isActive?: boolean
  tooltip?: string | React.ComponentProps<typeof TooltipContent>
} & VariantProps<typeof sidebarMenuButtonVariants>) {
  const Comp = asChild ? Slot.Root : "button"
  const { isMobile, state } = useSidebar()

  const button = (
    <Comp
      data-slot="sidebar-menu-button"
      data-sidebar="menu-button"
      data-size={size}
      data-active={isActive}
      className={cn(sidebarMenuButtonVariants({ variant, size }), className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )

  if (!tooltip) {
    return button
  }

  if (typeof tooltip === "string") {
    tooltip = {
      children: tooltip,
    }
  }

  return (
    <Tooltip>
      <TooltipTrigger asChild>{button}</TooltipTrigger>
      <TooltipContent
        side="right"
        align="center"
        hidden={state !== "collapsed" || isMobile}
        {...tooltip}
      />
    </Tooltip>
  )
}

function SidebarMenuSubButton({

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import type { RainforestProduct } from "@/types/rainforest";

async function fetchAmazonLive(asin: string): Promise<RainforestProduct> {
  const res = await fetch(`/api/amazon-live?asin=${encodeURIComponent(asin)}`);
  if (!res.ok) {
    const body = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
    throw new Error(body.error || `Request failed (${res.status})`);
  }
  const { product } = await res.json();
  return product;
}

export function useAmazonLive(asin: string | null, enabled: boolean) {
  return useQuery<RainforestProduct>({
    queryKey: ["amazon-live", asin],
    queryFn: () => fetchAmazonLive(asin!),
    enabled: enabled && !!asin,
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000,
    retry: false,
  });
}

"use client";

import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";

interface CategoryAttributeData {
  localLabel: string;
  amazonFieldName: string;
  description: string | null;
  example: string | null;
  requirement: string;
  validValues: string[] | null;
  bibleFieldMatch: string | null;
  currentValue: string | null;
  sortOrder: number;
}

interface CategoryGroupData {
  name: string;
  attributes: CategoryAttributeData[];
}

interface CategoryDefinitionData {
  id: number;
  clientIdCode: string;
  productType: string;
  marketplaceId: string;
  totalAttributes: number;
  requiredCount: number;
  conditionalCount: number;
  optionalCount: number;
  uploadedBy: string;
  uploadedAt: string;
}

interface CategoryDefinitionResponse {
  definition: CategoryDefinitionData | null;
  groups: CategoryGroupData[];
}

export type { CategoryAttributeData, CategoryGroupData, CategoryDefinitionData };

async function fetchCategoryDefinition(
  productType: string,
  clientIdCode: string,
  productId?: string,
  marketplaceId?: string
): Promise<CategoryDefinitionResponse> {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({ clientIdCode });
  if (productId) params.set("productId", productId);
  if (marketplaceId) params.set("marketplaceId", marketplaceId);

  const res = await fetch(
    `/api/category-definitions/${encodeURIComponent(productType)}?${params}`
  );
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch category definition");
  return res.json();
}

export function useCategoryDefinition(
  productType?: string,
  clientIdCode?: string,
  productId?: string,
  marketplaceId?: string
) {
  const { data, isLoading, error } = useQuery({
    queryKey: [
      "category-definition",
      productType,
      clientIdCode,
      productId,
      marketplaceId,
    ],
    queryFn: () =>
      fetchCategoryDefinition(
        productType!,
        clientIdCode!,
        productId,
        marketplaceId
      ),
    enabled: !!productType && !!clientIdCode,
    staleTime: 10 * 60 * 1000, // 10 minutes
  });

  return {
    definition: data?.definition ?? null,
    groups: data?.groups ?? [],
    isLoading,
    error,
  };
}

FILE: src/hooks/use-column-attributes.ts
================================================
"use client";

import { useMemo } from "react";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import type { ColumnAttribute } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import type { RequirementLevel } from "@/lib/constants";

export type EnrichedAttribute = ColumnAttribute & {
  clientRequirement?: RequirementLevel;
};

export type SubgroupData = {
  name: string;
  attributes: EnrichedAttribute[];
};

export type GroupData = {
  name: string;
  subgroups: SubgroupData[];
  totalFields: number;
};

async function fetchAttributes(
  clientCode?: string
): Promise<EnrichedAttribute[]> {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (clientCode) params.set("client", clientCode);
  const res = await fetch(`/api/attributes?${params}`);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to fetch column attributes");
  return res.json();
}

export function useColumnAttributes(clientCode?: string) {
  const { data: attributes = [], isLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey: ["column-attributes", clientCode || "all"],
    queryFn: () => fetchAttributes(clientCode),
    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000, // 5 minutes
  });

  const groups = useMemo(() => {
    const groupMap = new Map<string, Map<string, EnrichedAttribute[]>>();

    for (const attr of attributes) {
      const groupName = attr.referenceGroup || "Other";
      const subgroupName = attr.subgroup || "";

      if (!groupMap.has(groupName)) {
        groupMap.set(groupName, new Map());
      }
      const subgroupMap = groupMap.get(groupName)!;
      if (!subgroupMap.has(subgroupName)) {
        subgroupMap.set(subgroupName, []);
      }
      subgroupMap.get(subgroupName)!.push(attr);
    }

    // Convert to sorted array structure
    const result: GroupData[] = [];
    for (const [groupName, subgroupMap] of groupMap) {
      const subgroups: SubgroupData[] = [];
      let totalFields = 0;

      for (const [subName, attrs] of subgroupMap) {
        // Already sorted by masterRow from the API
        subgroups.push({ name: subName, attributes: attrs });
        totalFields += attrs.length;
      }

      // Sort subgroups: empty name first, then alphabetical
      subgroups.sort((a, b) => {
        if (a.name === "" && b.name !== "") return -1;
        if (a.name !== "" && b.name === "") return 1;
        return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
      });

      result.push({ name: groupName, subgroups, totalFields });
    }

    // Listing Identity always first
    result.sort((a, b) => {
      if (a.name === "Listing Identity") return -1;
      if (b.name === "Listing Identity") return 1;
      return 0;
    });

    return result;
  }, [attributes]);

  const byGeneralLabel = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, EnrichedAttribute>();
    for (const attr of attributes) {
      map.set(attr.generalLabel, attr);
    }
    return map;
  }, [attributes]);

  return { groups, byGeneralLabel, attributes, isLoading };
}

FILE: src/hooks/use-mobile.ts

import * as React from "react"

const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768

export function useIsMobile() {
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState<boolean | undefined>(undefined)

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const mql = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`)
    const onChange = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    }
    mql.addEventListener("change", onChange)
    setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", onChange)
  }, [])

  return !!isMobile
}

FILE: src/hooks/use-outside-click.test.ts
================================================
import { renderHook, act } from "@testing-library/react";
import { describe, it, expect, vi } from "vitest";
import { useOutsideClick } from "./use-outside-click";

describe("useOutsideClick", () => {
  it("calls handler when clicking outside the ref element", () => {
    const handler = vi.fn();
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useOutsideClick(handler));

    // Simulate attaching the ref to a DOM element
    const inside = document.createElement("div");
    document.body.appendChild(inside);
    Object.defineProperty(result.current, "current", {
      value: inside,
      writable: true,
    });

    // Click outside
    act(() => {
      document.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent("mousedown", { bubbles: true }));
    });
    expect(handler).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);

    // Click inside — should NOT trigger
    act(() => {
      inside.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent("mousedown", { bubbles: true }));
    });
    expect(handler).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);

    document.body.removeChild(inside);
  });

  it("does not call handler when disabled", () => {
    const handler = vi.fn();
    renderHook(() => useOutsideClick(handler, false));

    act(() => {
      document.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent("mousedown", { bubbles: true }));
    });
    expect(handler).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

FILE: src/hooks/use-outside-click.ts
================================================
import { useEffect, useRef, type RefObject } from "react";

/**
 * Calls `onOutsideClick` when a mousedown occurs outside `ref`.
 * Pass `enabled = false` to suspend listening.
 */
export function useOutsideClick<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLElement>(
  onOutsideClick: () => void,
  enabled = true,
): RefObject<T | null> {
  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    function handleClick(e: MouseEvent) {
      if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        onOutsideClick();
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener("mousedown", handleClick);
    return () => document.removeEventListener("mousedown", handleClick);
  }, [onOutsideClick, enabled]);

  return ref;
}

FILE: src/lib/ai-config.server.ts
================================================
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// AI Configuration — server-only DB functions
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { seoSettings } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { AI_DEFAULTS, type AiFeatureKey, type AiFeatureConfig } from "@/lib/ai-config";

type AiConfigMap = Partial<Record<AiFeatureKey, Partial<AiFeatureConfig>>>;

// In-memory cache with 60s TTL
let cachedConfig: AiConfigMap | null = null;
let cacheTimestamp = 0;
const CACHE_TTL_MS = 60_000;

/** Load the full AI config map from DB (with cache) */
export async function loadAiConfig(): Promise<AiConfigMap> {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (cachedConfig && now - cacheTimestamp < CACHE_TTL_MS) {
    return cachedConfig;
  }

  try {
    const [row] = await db
      .select({ value: seoSettings.value })
      .from(seoSettings)
      .where(eq(seoSettings.key, "ai_config"))
      .limit(1);

    if (row?.value) {
      cachedConfig = JSON.parse(row.value) as AiConfigMap;
    } else {
      cachedConfig = {};
    }
    cacheTimestamp = now;
    return cachedConfig;
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

/** Get the resolved config for a specific AI feature (defaults merged with overrides) */
export async function getAiFeatureConfig(key: AiFeatureKey): Promise<AiFeatureConfig> {
  const overrides = await loadAiConfig();
  const defaults = AI_DEFAULTS[key];
  const override = overrides[key];

  return {
    ...defaults,
    ...override,
    label: defaults.label,
    route: defaults.route,
  };
}

/** Invalidate the in-memory cache (call after saving) */
export function invalidateAiConfigCache() {
  cachedConfig = null;
  cacheTimestamp = 0;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// AI Configuration — client-safe constants (no DB imports)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export interface AiFeatureConfig {

// ── Calculation Engine ──────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface CalculatorInputs {
  category: ProductCategory;
  isApparel: boolean;
  isDangerousGoods: boolean;
  sellingPlan: "Professional" | "Individual";
  itemPrice: number;
  shippingCharge: number;
  lengthIn: number;
  widthIn: number;
  heightIn: number;
  weightLb: number;
  selectedAddons: string[];
  peakPeriod: "JAN-SEP" | "OCT-DEC";
  storageUtilizationWeeks: number;
  avgInventoryUnits: number;
  estimatedMonthlySold: number;
  unitsToInbound: number;
  inboundPlacement: "Minimal Shipment Splits" | "Partial Shipment Splits" | "Amazon Optimized Splits";
  inboundRegion: "West" | "Central" | "East";
  removalUnits: number;
  disposalUnits: number;
  miscCost: number;
  cogs: number;
  promotionsCost: number;
  feeDiscounts: number;
  taxesOnFees: number;
}

export interface CalculatorResult {
  // Dimensions
  dimensionalWeightLb: number;
  shippingWeightLb: number;
  shippingWeightOz: number;
  sizeTier: SizeTier;
  sortedDims: { longest: number; median: number; shortest: number };
  lengthPlusGirth: number;

  // FBA breakdown
  fba: {
    salesPrice: number;
    referralFee: number;
    referralFeeRate: number;
    fixedClosingFee: number;
    variableClosingFee: number;
    digitalServicesFee: number;
    totalAmazonFees: number;
    fbaFulfillmentFee: number;
    serviceAddonsCost: number;
    totalFulfillmentCost: number;
    monthlyStorageCostPerUnit: number;
    storageCostPerUnitSold: number;
    totalStorageCost: number;
    inboundFeePerUnit: number;
    totalInboundFee: number;
    inboundShippingPerUnit: number;
    removalFeePerUnit: number;
    disposalFeePerUnit: number;
    totalRemovalDisposalFee: number;
    removalDisposalCostPerUnitSold: number;
    totalOtherCosts: number;
    costPerUnit: number;
    netProfit: number;
    netMargin: number;
  };

  // Merchant breakdown
  merchant: {
    salesPrice: number;
    referralFee: number;
    fixedClosingFee: number;
    variableClosingFee: number;
    digitalServicesFee: number;
    totalAmazonFees: number;
  };

  subscriptionFee: number;
}

export function calculate(inputs: CalculatorInputs): CalculatorResult {
  const { lengthIn, widthIn, heightIn, weightLb } = inputs;

  // Sort dimensions
  const dims = [lengthIn, widthIn, heightIn].sort((a, b) => b - a);
  const [longest, median, shortest] = dims;
  const lengthPlusGirth = longest + 2 * (median + shortest);
  const unitWeightOz = weightLb * 16;
  const dimensionalWeightOz = (lengthIn * widthIn * heightIn) / 139 * 16;
  const dimensionalWeightLb = dimensionalWeightOz / 16;

  // Determine size tier
  const sizeTier = determineSizeTier(longest, median, shortest, unitWeightOz, dimensionalWeightOz, lengthPlusGirth);

  // Shipping weight depends on tier
  const useDW = sizeTier !== "Small standard-size" && sizeTier !== "Extra Large 150+ lb";
  const shippingWeightOz = useDW ? Math.max(unitWeightOz, dimensionalWeightOz) : unitWeightOz;
  // Amazon rounds shipping weight up to nearest 0.25 lb (4 oz)
  const swOzRounded = Math.ceil(shippingWeightOz / 4) * 4;
  const shippingWeightLb = swOzRounded / 16;

  // Referral fee
  const { rate, minFee, variableClosingFee } = getReferralFeeInfo(inputs.category, inputs.itemPrice);
  const referralFeeCalc = inputs.itemPrice * rate;
  const referralFee = Math.max(referralFeeCalc, minFee);
  const fixedClosingFee = inputs.sellingPlan === "Individual" ? 0.99 : 0;

  const totalAmazonFees = referralFee + fixedClosingFee + variableClosingFee;

  // FBA Fulfillment fee
  const fbaFulfillmentFee = getFBAFulfillmentFee(sizeTier, swOzRounded, inputs.isApparel, inputs.isDangerousGoods);

  // Service add-ons
  const serviceAddonsCost = inputs.selectedAddons.reduce((sum, id) => {
    const addon = SERVICE_ADDONS.find((a) => a.id === id);
    return sum + (addon?.cost ?? 0);
  }, 0);

  const totalFulfillmentCost = fbaFulfillmentFee + serviceAddonsCost;

  // Storage cost
  const storageSizePST = sizeTier.includes("standard") ? "standard" : "oversize";
  // Amazon rounds volume to 3 decimal places
  const volumeCuFt = Math.round(((lengthIn * widthIn * heightIn) / 1728) * 1000) / 1000;
  const monthlyStorageCostPerUnit = getMonthlyStorageCost(
    storageSizePST,
    inputs.peakPeriod,
    inputs.storageUtilizationWeeks,
    inputs.isDangerousGoods,
    volumeCuFt
  );
  const storageCostPerUnitSold =
    inputs.estimatedMonthlySold > 0
      ? (monthlyStorageCostPerUnit * inputs.avgInventoryUnits) / inputs.estimatedMonthlySold
      : 0;

  // Inbound fee
  const locationMap = {
    "Minimal Shipment Splits": "Single",
    "Partial Shipment Splits": "Two-Three",
    "Amazon Optimized Splits": "Four+",
  } as const;
  const locationType = locationMap[inputs.inboundPlacement];
  const inboundFeePerUnit =
    locationType === "Four+"
      ? 0
      : getInboundFee(sizeTier, swOzRounded, locationType, inputs.inboundRegion);
  const totalInboundFee = inboundFeePerUnit * inputs.unitsToInbound;
  const inboundPerUnitSold = inputs.estimatedMonthlySold > 0
    ? totalInboundFee / (inputs.estimatedMonthlySold > 0 ? inputs.unitsToInbound : 1)
    : inboundFeePerUnit;

  // Removal and disposal
  const removalDisposalRates = REMOVAL_DISPOSAL_RATES[sizeTier] ?? { removal: 0, disposal: 0 };
  const removalFeePerUnit = removalDisposalRates.removal;
  const disposalFeePerUnit = removalDisposalRates.disposal;
  const totalRemovalDisposalFee = (removalFeePerUnit * inputs.removalUnits) + (disposalFeePerUnit * inputs.disposalUnits);
  const removalDisposalCostPerUnitSold = inputs.estimatedMonthlySold > 0
    ? totalRemovalDisposalFee / inputs.estimatedMonthlySold
    : 0;

  // Other costs
  const totalOtherCosts = inputs.miscCost + inputs.cogs - inputs.feeDiscounts + inputs.taxesOnFees;

  // Net calculation
  const costPerUnit = totalAmazonFees + totalFulfillmentCost + storageCostPerUnitSold + inboundPerUnitSold + inputs.promotionsCost + removalDisposalCostPerUnitSold + totalOtherCosts;
  const netProfit = inputs.itemPrice - costPerUnit;
  const netMargin = inputs.itemPrice > 0 ? netProfit / inputs.itemPrice : 0;

  // Subscription fee
  const subscriptionFee = inputs.sellingPlan === "Professional" ? 39.99 : 0;

  // Merchant fulfillment (only Amazon fees, no FBA costs)
  const merchantSalesPrice = inputs.itemPrice + inputs.shippingCharge;
  const merchantReferralCalc = merchantSalesPrice * rate;
  const merchantReferralFee = Math.max(merchantReferralCalc, minFee);

  return {
    dimensionalWeightLb,
    shippingWeightLb,
    shippingWeightOz: swOzRounded,
    sizeTier,
    sortedDims: { longest, median, shortest },
    lengthPlusGirth,
    fba: {
      salesPrice: inputs.itemPrice,
      referralFee,
      referralFeeRate: rate,
      fixedClosingFee,
      variableClosingFee,
      digitalServicesFee: 0,
      totalAmazonFees,
      fbaFulfillmentFee,
      serviceAddonsCost,
      totalFulfillmentCost,
      monthlyStorageCostPerUnit,
      storageCostPerUnitSold,
      totalStorageCost: storageCostPerUnitSold,
      inboundFeePerUnit: inboundPerUnitSold,
      totalInboundFee,
      inboundShippingPerUnit: 0,
      removalFeePerUnit,
      disposalFeePerUnit,
      totalRemovalDisposalFee,
      removalDisposalCostPerUnitSold,
      totalOtherCosts,
      costPerUnit,
      netProfit,
      netMargin,
    },
    merchant: {
      salesPrice: merchantSalesPrice,
      referralFee: merchantReferralFee,
      fixedClosingFee,
      variableClosingFee,
      digitalServicesFee: 0,
      totalAmazonFees: merchantReferralFee + fixedClosingFee + variableClosingFee,
    },
    subscriptionFee,
  };
}

// ── Lookup helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

function determineSizeTier(
  longest: number,
  median: number,
  shortest: number,
  unitWeightOz: number,
  dimensionalWeightOz: number,
  lengthPlusGirth: number
): SizeTier {
  // Check small standard first
  if (unitWeightOz <= 16 && longest <= 15 && median <= 12 && shortest <= 0.75) {
    return "Small standard-size";
  }
  // Large standard: use max(uw, dw) for weight check
  const lsWeight = Math.max(unitWeightOz, dimensionalWeightOz);
  if (lsWeight <= 320 && longest <= 18 && median <= 14 && shortest <= 8) {
    return "Large standard-size";
  }
  // Large Bulky
  const lbWeight = Math.max(unitWeightOz, dimensionalWeightOz);
  if (lbWeight <= 800 && longest <= 59 && median <= 33 && shortest <= 33 && lengthPlusGirth <= 130) {
    return "Large Bulky";
  }
  // Extra Large tiers by weight
  const xlWeight = Math.max(unitWeightOz, dimensionalWeightOz);
  const xlWeightLb = xlWeight / 16;
  if (xlWeightLb <= 50) return "Extra Large 0-50 lb";
  if (xlWeightLb <= 70) return "Extra Large 50+-70 lb";
  if (xlWeightLb <= 150) return "Extra Large 70+-150 lb";
  return "Extra Large 150+ lb";
}

function getReferralFeeInfo(category: string, price: number) {
  const match = REFERRAL_FEE_TABLE.find(
    ([cat, pMin, pMax]) => cat === category && price >= pMin && price < pMax
  );
  if (!match) {
    return { rate: 0.15, minFee: 0.3, variableClosingFee: 0 };
  }
  return { rate: match[3], minFee: match[4], variableClosingFee: match[5] };
}

function getFBAFulfillmentFee(
  sizeTier: SizeTier,
  shippingWeightOz: number,
  isApparel: boolean,
  isDG: boolean
): number {
  const match = FBA_FULFILLMENT_TABLE.find(
    ([tier, swMin, swMax]) => tier === sizeTier && shippingWeightOz > swMin && shippingWeightOz <= swMax
  );
  // Fallback: get last row for the tier
  const row = match ?? FBA_FULFILLMENT_TABLE.filter(([t]) => t === sizeTier).pop();
  if (!row) return 0;

  const [, , , feeReg, feeApp, feeDG, aboveOz, extraReg, extraApp, extraDG] = row;
  const baseFee = isDG ? feeDG : isApparel ? feeApp : feeReg;

  if (aboveOz > 0 && shippingWeightOz > aboveOz) {
    const extraOz = shippingWeightOz - aboveOz;
    // Surcharge is per 4oz increment for standard, per 1lb (16oz) for oversize
    const isStandard = sizeTier.includes("standard");
    const extraRate = isDG ? extraDG : isApparel ? extraApp : extraReg;
    if (isStandard) {
      return baseFee + extraRate * Math.ceil(extraOz / 4);
    }
    return baseFee + extraRate * Math.ceil(extraOz / 16);
  }

  return baseFee;
}

function getMonthlyStorageCost(
  pst: string,
  peakPeriod: string,
  utilizationWeeks: number,
  isDG: boolean,
  volumeCuFt: number
): number {
  if (isDG) {
    const rate = DG_STORAGE_RATES[peakPeriod]?.[pst] ?? 0;
    return rate * volumeCuFt;
  }

  const match = STORAGE_FEE_TABLE.find(
    ([p, surMin, surMax, , , , peak, type]) =>
      p === pst &&
      peak === peakPeriod &&
      type === "Non-Dangerous goods" &&
      utilizationWeeks >= surMin &&
      utilizationWeeks < surMax
  );

  const rate = match ? match[5] : 0;
  return rate * volumeCuFt;
}

function getInboundFee(
  sizeTier: SizeTier,
  shippingWeightOz: number,
  locationType: "Single" | "Two-Three",
  region: "West" | "Central" | "East"
): number {
  const match = INBOUND_FEE_TABLE.find(
    ([tier, wMin, wMax, loc]) =>
      tier === sizeTier &&
      shippingWeightOz > wMin &&
      shippingWeightOz <= wMax &&
      loc === locationType
  );

  if (!match) {
    const fallback = INBOUND_FEE_TABLE.filter(
      ([tier, , , loc]) => tier === sizeTier && loc === locationType
    ).pop();
    if (!fallback) return 0;
    const [, , , , east, central, west] = fallback;
    return pickRegion(east, central, west, region);
  }

  const [, , , , east, central, west] = match;
  return pickRegion(east, central, west, region);
}

function pickRegion(east: number, central: number, west: number, region: "West" | "Central" | "East"): number {
  if (region === "East") return east;
  if (region === "Central") return central;
  return west;
}

import type { Product } from "@/lib/db/schema";

export type CompareMode = "exact" | "normalized" | "numeric" | "boolean" | "count";

export interface SyncField {
  field_name: string;
  label: string;
  field_group: string;
  bqName?: string; // BQ column name for write-back (only fields with catalog mapping)
  getRainforestValue: (p: RainforestProduct) => string | null;
  getCatalogValue: (row: Product) => string | null;
  compareMode: CompareMode;
}

function str(v: unknown): string | null {
  if (v == null) return null;
  if (typeof v === "string") return v || null;
  if (typeof v === "number") return String(v);
  if (typeof v === "boolean") return v ? "true" : "false";
  return null;
}

export const SYNC_FIELD_GROUPS = [
  "Content",
  "Images & Media",
  "Pricing & Availability",
  "Performance",
  "Logistics",
] as const;

/**
 * Compare two values using the specified mode.
 * Returns the discrepancy status.
 */
export function compareFieldValues(
  catalogValue: string | null,
  amazonValue: string | null,
  mode: CompareMode
): "match" | "mismatch" | "missing_in_catalog" | "missing_in_amazon" {
  const catNorm = normalize(catalogValue);
  const amzNorm = normalize(amazonValue);

  if (!catNorm && !amzNorm) return "match"; // both empty = match
  if (!catNorm && amzNorm) return "missing_in_catalog";
  if (catNorm && !amzNorm) return "missing_in_amazon";

  switch (mode) {
    case "exact":
      return catNorm === amzNorm ? "match" : "mismatch";
    case "normalized":
      return catNorm!.toLowerCase().trim() === amzNorm!.toLowerCase().trim()
        ? "match"
        : "mismatch";
    case "numeric": {
      const catNum = parseFloat(catNorm!);
      const amzNum = parseFloat(amzNorm!);
      if (isNaN(catNum) || isNaN(amzNum)) return catNorm === amzNorm ? "match" : "mismatch";
      return catNum === amzNum ? "match" : "mismatch";
    }
    case "boolean":
      return catNorm!.toLowerCase() === amzNorm!.toLowerCase() ? "match" : "mismatch";
    case "count":
      return catNorm === amzNorm ? "match" : "mismatch";
    default:
      return catNorm === amzNorm ? "match" : "mismatch";
  }
}

function normalize(val: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (val == null) return null;
  const s = val
    .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, "")
    .replace(/[\u200B\u200C\u200D\uFEFF]/g, "")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();
  return s.length === 0 ? null : s;
}

/**
 * Compute all discrepancies for a product + Rainforest snapshot.
 */
export function computeDiscrepancies(
  product: Product,
  rainforestProduct: RainforestProduct
): Array<{
  field_name: string;
  field_group: string;
  catalog_value: string | null;
  amazon_value: string | null;
  status: "match" | "mismatch" | "missing_in_catalog" | "missing_in_amazon";
}> {
  return SYNC_FIELDS.map((field) => {
    const catalogValue = field.getCatalogValue(product);
    const amazonValue = field.getRainforestValue(rainforestProduct);
    const status = compareFieldValues(catalogValue, amazonValue, field.compareMode);
    return {
      field_name: field.field_name,
      field_group: field.field_group,
      catalog_value: catalogValue,
      amazon_value: amazonValue,
      status,
    };
  });
}

// A+ Content File Naming & Folder Structure Utilities
//
// Generates standardized file names and Google Drive folder paths
// for A+ Content image and video assets.
//
// Naming convention (clientIdCode is always the root):
//   VARIATION: {cid}_V{##}_M{#}_{typeCode}_{slot}_{device}_IMG.png
//   GROUP:     {cid}_V{##}G{##}_M{#}_{typeCode}_{slot}_{device}_IMG.png
//   ASIN:      {cid}_V{##}_{ASIN}_M{#}_{typeCode}_{slot}_{device}_IMG.png
//
// Folder tree under client root:
//   {cid}-Graphics/{cid}-A+/PA+/{scopeFolder}/v{##}/

import { APLUS_MODULE_SPECS, type AplusModuleType } from "./aplus-module-specs";

// ─── Constants ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  background_image_text: "PBIT",
  comparison_table_1: "PCT1",
  comparison_table_2: "PCT2",
  comparison_table_3: "PCT3",
  dual_images_text: "PDIT",
  four_images_text: "PFIT",
  full_image: "PFI",
  full_video: "PFV",
  hotspots_1: "PHS1",
  hotspots_2: "PHS2",
  navigation_carousel: "PNC",
  qa: "PQA",
  regimen_carousel: "PRC",
  simple_image_carousel: "PSIC",
  single_image_text: "PSIT",
  technical_specifications: "PTS",
  text: "PTXT",
  video_image_carousel: "PVIC",
  video_text: "PVT",
};

 * e.g., hotspot_image item 3 → "PAN3", slide_image item 1 → "PAN1"

  hotspot_image: "PAN",

// ─── Types ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type AplusScopeType = "ASIN" | "VAR" | "GRP";
export type AplusDevice = "DV" | "MV";
export type AplusPlatform = "SC" | "VC";

export interface AplusScope {
  type: AplusScopeType;
  /** For ASIN: the ASIN. For GRP/VAR: parent ASIN (or clientIdCode). */
  identifier: string;
  /** Group number (1-99), only for GRP scope */
  groupNumber?: number;
  /** Specific ASIN, only for ASIN scope */
  asin?: string;
}

export interface AplusContext {
  clientIdCode: string;
  marketplace: string;
  platform: AplusPlatform;
  scope: AplusScope;
  version: number;
}

// ─── Helper functions ────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Zero-pad a number to 2 digits */
function pad2(n: number): string {
  return n.toString().padStart(2, "0");
}

/** Format version for filenames: V01, V02 (zero-padded) */
function fmtVersion(n: number): string {
  return `V${pad2(n)}`;
}

/**
 * Build the scope segment for filenames and folder names.
 *
 * - VAR:  V01           (version only — covers all ASINs)
 * - GRP:  V01G01        (version + group number)
 * - ASIN: V01_B0DCLWMB4Y (version + specific ASIN)
 */
export function buildScopeSegment(
  version: number,
  scopeType: AplusScopeType,
  asin?: string,
  groupNumber?: number,
): string {
  const v = fmtVersion(version);
  switch (scopeType) {
    case "VAR":
      return v;
    case "GRP":
      return `${v}G${pad2(groupNumber ?? 1)}`;
    case "ASIN":
      return `${v}_${asin ?? "UNKNOWN"}`;
    default:
      return v;
  }
}

/**
 * Get the scope folder name (used as subfolder under PA+/).
 * Same as buildScopeSegment — the folder IS the scope segment.
 */
export function getScopeFolderName(
  version: number,
  scopeType: AplusScopeType,
  asin?: string,
  groupNumber?: number,
): string {
  return buildScopeSegment(version, scopeType, asin, groupNumber);
}

/**
 * Get the full Google Drive folder path for an A+ version.
 *
 * clientIdCode already includes platform+marketplace (e.g. "DRC_SC_US").
 * Returns: "{cid}/{cid}-Graphics/{cid}-A+/PA+/{scopeFolder}/"
 */
export function getAplusFolderPath(ctx: AplusContext): string {
  const cid = ctx.clientIdCode;
  const scopeFolder = getScopeFolderName(
    ctx.version,
    ctx.scope.type,
    ctx.scope.asin,
    ctx.scope.groupNumber,
  );

  return `${cid}/${cid}-Graphics/${cid}-A+/PA+/${scopeFolder}`;
}

/**
 * Get the file slot key for a fixed (non-repeatable) image slot.
 * Maps from the internal spec key (e.g., "main_image") to the file key (e.g., "main").
 */
export function getFixedSlotKey(moduleType: AplusModuleType, specSlotKey: string): string {
  const mapping = SLOT_KEY_MAP[moduleType];
  if (mapping && mapping[specSlotKey]) {
    return mapping[specSlotKey];
  }
  // Fallback: use the spec key as-is (shouldn't happen with proper mapping)
  return specSlotKey;
}

/**
 * Get the file slot key for a repeatable group image at a given index.
 * e.g., ("hotspot_image", 3) → "PAN3"
 */
export function getRepeatableSlotKey(repeatableImageKey: string, itemIndex: number): string {
  const prefix = REPEATABLE_SLOT_PREFIXES[repeatableImageKey];
  if (!prefix) {
    return `${repeatableImageKey}${itemIndex}`;
  }
  return `${prefix}${itemIndex}`;
}

/**
 * Generate a complete image filename.
 *
 * Convention by scope:
 *   VAR:  {cid}_V{##}_M{#}_{typeCode}_{slot}_{device}_IMG.png
 *   GRP:  {cid}_V{##}G{##}_M{#}_{typeCode}_{slot}_{device}_IMG.png
 *   ASIN: {cid}_V{##}_{ASIN}_M{#}_{typeCode}_{slot}_{device}_IMG.png
 */
export function generateImageFilename(
  clientIdCode: string,
  version: number,
  scopeType: AplusScopeType,
  modulePosition: number,
  moduleType: AplusModuleType,
  slotKey: string,
  device: AplusDevice,
  asin?: string,
  groupNumber?: number,
): string {
  const typeCode = MODULE_TYPE_CODES[moduleType];
  const scopeSeg = buildScopeSegment(version, scopeType, asin, groupNumber);
  return `${clientIdCode}_${scopeSeg}_M${modulePosition}_${typeCode}_${slotKey}_${device}_IMG.png`;
}

/**
 * Generate a video filename.
 *
 * Format: {cid}_{scopeSegment}_M{#}_{typeCode}_VIDEO.mp4
 */
export function generateVideoFilename(
  clientIdCode: string,
  version: number,
  scopeType: AplusScopeType,
  modulePosition: number,
  moduleType: AplusModuleType,
  asin?: string,
  groupNumber?: number,
): string {
  const typeCode = MODULE_TYPE_CODES[moduleType];
  const scopeSeg = buildScopeSegment(version, scopeType, asin, groupNumber);
  return `${clientIdCode}_${scopeSeg}_M${modulePosition}_${typeCode}_VIDEO.mp4`;
}

/**
 * Generate a video preview image filename.
 *
 * Format: {cid}_{scopeSegment}_M{#}_{typeCode}_PREV_{device}.png
 */
export function generateVideoPreviewFilename(
  clientIdCode: string,
  version: number,
  scopeType: AplusScopeType,
  modulePosition: number,
  moduleType: AplusModuleType,
  device: AplusDevice,
  asin?: string,
  groupNumber?: number,
): string {
  const typeCode = MODULE_TYPE_CODES[moduleType];
  const scopeSeg = buildScopeSegment(version, scopeType, asin, groupNumber);
  return `${clientIdCode}_${scopeSeg}_M${modulePosition}_${typeCode}_PREV_${device}.png`;
}

/**
 * Generate the full file path (folder + filename) for an image.
 */
export function generateImageFilePath(
  ctx: AplusContext,
  modulePosition: number,
  moduleType: AplusModuleType,
  slotKey: string,
  device: AplusDevice,
): string {
  const folder = getAplusFolderPath(ctx);
  const filename = generateImageFilename(
    ctx.clientIdCode,
    ctx.version,
    ctx.scope.type,
    modulePosition,
    moduleType,
    slotKey,
    device,
    ctx.scope.asin,
    ctx.scope.groupNumber,
  );
  return `${folder}/${filename}`;
}

/**
 * Compute all filenames that need renaming when modules are reordered.
 *
 * @param oldOrder - Array of module positions in old order (e.g., [1, 2, 3])
 * @param newOrder - Array of module positions in new order (e.g., [3, 1, 2])
 * @param filesByPosition - Map of old position → array of filenames at that position
 *
 * Returns: Array of { oldFilename, newFilename } pairs
 */
export function computeReorderRenames(
  oldOrder: number[],
  newOrder: number[],
  filesByPosition: Map<number, string[]>,
): Array<{ oldFilename: string; newFilename: string }> {
  const renames: Array<{ oldFilename: string; newFilename: string }> = [];

  for (let newPos = 0; newPos < newOrder.length; newPos++) {
    const oldPosition = newOrder[newPos];
    const newPosition = newPos + 1;

    if (oldPosition === newPosition) continue;

    const files = filesByPosition.get(oldPosition) || [];
    for (const oldFilename of files) {
      const newFilename = oldFilename.replace(
        /_M(\d+)_/,
        `_M${newPosition}_`,
      );
      if (oldFilename !== newFilename) {
        renames.push({ oldFilename, newFilename });
      }
    }
  }

  return renames;
}

// ─── APP TRACKER Row Generation ─────────────────────────────────────
//
// Generates all tracker rows for a module type, matching the spreadsheet
// naming convention.

export type TrackerRowType = "text" | "image";

export interface TrackerRow {
  /** Full generated file name / reference */
  fileName: string;
  /** MODULE */
  type: "MODULE";
  /** M */
  typeAbbr: "M";
  /** Full module type name (PREMIUMSIMPLEIMAGECAROUSEL) */
  modType: string;
  /** Module type abbreviation (PSIC) */
  modTypeAbbr: string;
  /** Module position number */
  modNumber: number;
  /** TEXTFIELD name (HEADLINE, BODY TEXT, etc.) */
  textField: string;
  /** TEXFIELD ABBR (HEAD, BODY, BUTT, etc.) */
  textFieldAbbr: string;
  /** Panel number (empty for GEN) */
  panelNumber: number | null;
  /** GROUP: INDIVIDUAL, DESKTOP VERSION, MOBILE VERSION */
  group: string;
  /** GROUP ABBR: empty, DV, MV */
  groupAbbr: string;
  /** IMAGE type (empty for text, IMG for images) */
  image: string;
  /** IMAGE NUMBER (empty typically) */
  imageNumber: string;
  /** Whether this is a text field row or image row */
  rowType: TrackerRowType;
}

/** Map of human-readable text field names */
const TEXT_FIELD_NAMES: Record<string, string> = {
  HEAD: "HEADLINE",
  SUBH: "SUBHEADLINE",
  BODY: "BODYTEXT",
  BUTT: "BUTTON TEXT",
  ASIN: "ASIN",
  ALTE: "ALT TEXT",
  AIIP: "AI IMAGE PROMPT",
  IMDE: "IMAGE DESCRIPTION",
  OVLY: "OVERLAY TEXT",
  NAVT: "NAVIGATION TEXT",
  QUES: "QUESTION",
  ANSW: "ANSWER",
  METR: "METRIC",
  MTYP: "METRIC TYPE",
  SPEC: "SPECIFICATION",
  DEFN: "DEFINITION",
  VHER: "HERO VALUE",
  VAL1: "PRODUCT 1 VALUE",
  VAL2: "PRODUCT 2 VALUE",
  VAL3: "PRODUCT 3 VALUE",
  VAL4: "PRODUCT 4 VALUE",
  VAL5: "PRODUCT 5 VALUE",
  VAL6: "PRODUCT 6 VALUE",
  HD1: "HEADLINE PRODUCT 1",
  BD1: "BODY PRODUCT 1",
  HD2: "HEADLINE PRODUCT 2",
  BD2: "BODY PRODUCT 2",
  HD3: "HEADLINE PRODUCT 3",
  BD3: "BODY PRODUCT 3",
};

function makeTrackerRow(
  filePrefix: string,
  modNumber: number,
  modTypeAbbr: string,
  modType: string,
  scope: "GEN" | "PAN",
  panelNumber: number | null,
  fieldAbbr: string,
  group: string,
  groupAbbr: string,
  image: string,
  imageNumber: string,
  rowType: TrackerRowType,
): TrackerRow {
  const scopePart = scope === "GEN" ? "GEN" : `PAN${panelNumber}`;
  const fileName = `${filePrefix}_M${modNumber}_${modTypeAbbr}_${scopePart}_${fieldAbbr}_${groupAbbr}${image}${imageNumber}`;

  return {
    fileName,
    type: "MODULE",
    typeAbbr: "M",
    modType,
    modTypeAbbr,
    modNumber,
    textField: TEXT_FIELD_NAMES[fieldAbbr] || fieldAbbr,
    textFieldAbbr: fieldAbbr,
    panelNumber,
    group,
    groupAbbr,
    image,
    imageNumber,
    rowType,
  };
}

/**
 * Generate all APP TRACKER rows for a given module type and position.
 * Produces text field rows (GEN + PAN) and image rows (PAN DV/MV).
 *
 * filePrefix is the {cid}_{scopeSegment} portion (e.g. "DRC_SC_US_V01" or "DRC_SC_US_V01G01").
 */
export function generateTrackerRows(
  clientIdCode: string,
  version: number,
  scopeType: AplusScopeType,
  modulePosition: number,
  moduleType: AplusModuleType,
  asin?: string,
  groupNumber?: number,
  panelCount?: number,
): TrackerRow[] {
  const spec = APLUS_MODULE_SPECS[moduleType];
  if (!spec) return [];

  const typeCode = MODULE_TYPE_CODES[moduleType];
  const typeName = MODULE_TYPE_NAMES[moduleType];
  const scopeSeg = buildScopeSegment(version, scopeType, asin, groupNumber);
  const filePrefix = `${clientIdCode}_${scopeSeg}`;
  const rows: TrackerRow[] = [];

  // 1) GEN (module-level) text fields
  for (const tf of spec.textFields) {
    const abbr = TEXT_FIELD_ABBRS[tf.key] || tf.key.toUpperCase().slice(0, 4);
    rows.push(makeTrackerRow(
      filePrefix, modulePosition, typeCode, typeName,
      "GEN", null, abbr, "", "", "", "", "text",
    ));
  }

  // 2) Fixed image slots (module-level, not in repeatable group)
  for (const img of spec.imageSlots) {
    // Desktop
    rows.push(makeTrackerRow(
      filePrefix, modulePosition, typeCode, typeName,
      "GEN", null, "DV", "DESKTOP VERSION", "DV", "IMG", "", "image",
    ));
    // Mobile (if has mobile size)
    if (img.mobileSize) {
      rows.push(makeTrackerRow(
        filePrefix, modulePosition, typeCode, typeName,
        "GEN", null, "MV", "MOBILE VERSION", "MV", "IMG", "", "image",
      ));
    }
    // Image metadata
    rows.push(makeTrackerRow(filePrefix, modulePosition, typeCode, typeName, "GEN", null, "ALTE", "", "", "", "", "text"));
    rows.push(makeTrackerRow(filePrefix, modulePosition, typeCode, typeName, "GEN", null, "AIIP", "", "", "", "", "text"));
    rows.push(makeTrackerRow(filePrefix, modulePosition, typeCode, typeName, "GEN", null, "IMDE", "", "", "", "", "text"));
  }

  // 3) Repeatable group panels
  if (spec.repeatableGroup) {
    const rg = spec.repeatableGroup;
    const count = panelCount ?? rg.minItems;

    for (let p = 1; p <= count; p++) {
      // Panel text fields
      for (const field of rg.fields) {
        const abbr = TEXT_FIELD_ABBRS[field.key] || field.key.toUpperCase().slice(0, 4);
        rows.push(makeTrackerRow(
          filePrefix, modulePosition, typeCode, typeName,
          "PAN", p, abbr, "INDIVIDUAL", "", "", "", "text",
        ));
      }

      // Panel image (if has image in repeatable group)
      if (rg.image) {
        // Image metadata fields
        rows.push(makeTrackerRow(filePrefix, modulePosition, typeCode, typeName, "PAN", p, "ALTE", "INDIVIDUAL", "", "", "", "text"));
        rows.push(makeTrackerRow(filePrefix, modulePosition, typeCode, typeName, "PAN", p, "AIIP", "INDIVIDUAL", "", "", "", "text"));
        rows.push(makeTrackerRow(filePrefix, modulePosition, typeCode, typeName, "PAN", p, "IMDE", "INDIVIDUAL", "", "", "", "text"));
      }
    }

    // Image rows for panels (separate section, like in the spreadsheet)
    if (rg.image) {
      for (let p = 1; p <= count; p++) {
        // Desktop version
        rows.push(makeTrackerRow(
          filePrefix, modulePosition, typeCode, typeName,
          "PAN", p, "DV", "DESKTOP VERSION", "DV", "IMG", "", "image",
        ));
        // Mobile version (if has mobile size)
        if (rg.image.mobileSize) {
          rows.push(makeTrackerRow(
            filePrefix, modulePosition, typeCode, typeName,
            "PAN", p, "MV", "MOBILE VERSION", "MV", "IMG", "", "image",
          ));
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // 4) Video files (for video modules)
  if (spec.hasVideo) {
    rows.push(makeTrackerRow(
      filePrefix, modulePosition, typeCode, typeName,
      "GEN", null, "VIDEO", "", "", "VID", "", "image",
    ));
    rows.push(makeTrackerRow(
      filePrefix, modulePosition, typeCode, typeName,
      "GEN", null, "DV", "DESKTOP VERSION", "DV", "PREV", "", "image",
    ));
    rows.push(makeTrackerRow(
      filePrefix, modulePosition, typeCode, typeName,
      "GEN", null, "MV", "MOBILE VERSION", "MV", "PREV", "", "image",
    ));
  }

  return rows;
}

// Premium A+ Content Module Type Specifications
//
// These are the 19 Amazon Premium A+ module types.
// Standard (Basic) A+ types are deferred to a future milestone.
//
// Each spec defines: text fields shown, image slots with dimensions,
// and optional repeatable groups (Q&A pairs, comparison rows, etc.).

export const APLUS_MODULE_TYPES = [
  "background_image_text",
  "comparison_table_1",
  "comparison_table_2",
  "comparison_table_3",
  "dual_images_text",
  "four_images_text",
  "full_image",
  "full_video",
  "hotspots_1",
  "hotspots_2",
  "navigation_carousel",
  "qa",
  "regimen_carousel",
  "simple_image_carousel",
  "single_image_text",
  "technical_specifications",
  "text",
  "video_image_carousel",
  "video_text",
] as const;

export type AplusModuleType = (typeof APLUS_MODULE_TYPES)[number];

// ─── Field spec types ───────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface TextFieldSpec {
  /** DB column key (headlineText, subheadlineText, bodyText, overlayText) */
  key: "headlineText" | "subheadlineText" | "bodyText" | "overlayText";
  /** Display label */
  label: string;
  /** Render as textarea */
  multiline?: boolean;
  /** Textarea rows (default 2) */
  rows?: number;
  /** Character limit shown in UI */
  maxLength?: number;
  /** Helper hint below input */
  hint?: string;
}

export interface ImageSize {
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

export interface ImageSlotSpec {
  /** Stored in customLabel column */
  key: string;
  /** Display label */
  label: string;
  /** Desktop image dimensions (px) */
  desktopSize: ImageSize;
  /** Mobile image dimensions (px) — optional, some slots are same */
  mobileSize?: ImageSize;
}

export interface RepeatableFieldSpec {
  /** DB key for this field within the repeatable item */
  key: string;
  label: string;
  multiline?: boolean;
  rows?: number;
  maxLength?: number;
  hint?: string;
}

export interface RepeatableImageSpec {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  desktopSize: ImageSize;
  mobileSize?: ImageSize;
}

export interface RepeatableGroupSpec {
  /** Label for the group (e.g. "Q&A Pair", "Hotspot") */
  label: string;
  /** Singular item label (e.g. "Question", "Step") */
  itemLabel: string;
  minItems: number;
  maxItems: number;
  /** Text fields per repeatable item */
  fields: RepeatableFieldSpec[];
  /** Image per repeatable item (optional) */
  image?: RepeatableImageSpec;
}

/** Layout item — controls the render order of fields in the module card */
export type LayoutItem =
  | { type: "textField"; fieldKey: TextFieldSpec["key"] }
  | { type: "imageSlot"; slotKey: string }
  | { type: "repeatableGroup" };

export interface ModuleSpec {
  /** Human-readable display name */
  label: string;
  /** Short description shown in picker */
  description: string;
  /** Which module-level text fields to show */
  textFields: TextFieldSpec[];
  /** Image slots with dimension specs */
  imageSlots: ImageSlotSpec[];
  /** Whether this module includes a video upload */
  hasVideo?: boolean;
  /** Repeatable content groups (Q&A, hotspots, comparison rows, etc.) */
  repeatableGroup?: RepeatableGroupSpec;
  /**
   * Explicit field ordering for the card UI.
   * If omitted, defaults to: textFields → imageSlots → repeatableGroup.
   * Allows interleaving (e.g. Headline → Image → Body text).
   */
  layout?: LayoutItem[];
}

/** Compute layout order — uses explicit layout if defined, else default order */
export function getModuleLayout(spec: ModuleSpec): LayoutItem[] {
  if (spec.layout) return spec.layout;
  const items: LayoutItem[] = [];
  for (const f of spec.textFields) items.push({ type: "textField", fieldKey: f.key });
  for (const s of spec.imageSlots) items.push({ type: "imageSlot", slotKey: s.key });
  if (spec.repeatableGroup) items.push({ type: "repeatableGroup" });
  return items;
}

// ─── Module specs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const APLUS_MODULE_SPECS: Record<AplusModuleType, ModuleSpec> = {
  // ── Background Image with Text ──────────────────────────────────
  background_image_text: {
    label: "Premium Background Image with Text",
    description: "Full-width background image with subheadline, headline and body text overlay",

FILE: src/lib/auth-db.ts

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { users } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { auth } from "@/lib/auth";
import { canAccess } from "@/lib/permissions";

/**
 * Get the current session with the user's DB role resolved.
 * Only call from Node.js runtime (API routes, server components) — NOT from middleware.
 */
export async function getAuthSession() {
  const session = await auth();
  if (!session?.user?.email) return null;

  // Look up or create the user in DB
  let dbUser = await db
    .select()
    .from(users)
    .where(eq(users.email, session.user.email))
    .limit(1)
    .then((rows) => rows[0] ?? null);

  if (!dbUser) {
    // Auto-create user on first sign-in as pending (requires admin approval)
    const [created] = await db
      .insert(users)
      .values({
        email: session.user.email,
        name: session.user.name ?? null,
        image: session.user.image ?? null,
        role: "pending",
      })
      .returning();
    dbUser = created;
  } else {
    // Update name/image if changed
    if (
      dbUser.name !== session.user.name ||
      dbUser.image !== session.user.image
    ) {
      await db
        .update(users)
        .set({
          name: session.user.name ?? dbUser.name,
          image: session.user.image ?? dbUser.image,
        })
        .where(eq(users.email, session.user.email));
    }
  }

  session.user.id = dbUser.id;
  session.user.role = dbUser.role;
  session.user.allowedSections = dbUser.allowedSections ?? [];
  session.user.clientIdCode = dbUser.clientIdCode ?? null;

  return session;
}

/**
 * Check if the current session user can access a given section.
 * Supports hierarchical department-based permissions.
 */
export function canAccessSection(
  session: { user: { role: string; allowedSections?: string[] } },
  section: string
): boolean {
  return canAccess(
    section,
    session.user.allowedSections ?? [],
    session.user.role === "admin",
  );
}

FILE: src/lib/auth.ts
================================================
import NextAuth from "next-auth";
import Google from "next-auth/providers/google";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { users } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";

export const { handlers, signIn, signOut, auth } = NextAuth({
  providers: [
    Google({
      clientId: process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID!,
      clientSecret: process.env.GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET!,
    }),
  ],
  pages: {
    signIn: "/auth/signin",
  },
  callbacks: {
    async jwt({ token, account, profile, trigger, session: updateData }) {
      // On initial sign-in, store basic info and resolve DB role immediately
      if (account && profile?.email) {
        token.email = profile.email;
        token.name = profile.name;
        token.picture = profile.picture;

        // Resolve role from DB at sign-in time so middleware has correct role
        const dbUser = await db
          .select({ id: users.id, role: users.role, clientIdCode: users.clientIdCode, allowedSections: users.allowedSections })
          .from(users)
          .where(eq(users.email, profile.email))
          .limit(1)
          .then((rows) => rows[0] ?? null);

        if (dbUser) {
          token.dbId = dbUser.id;
          token.role = dbUser.role;
          token.clientIdCode = dbUser.clientIdCode;
          token.allowedSections = dbUser.allowedSections;
        } else {
          token.role = "pending";
        }
      }
      // When client calls update() with new role/sections, persist in the token
      if (trigger === "update" && updateData?.role) {
        token.role = updateData.role;
      }
      if (trigger === "update" && updateData?.allowedSections) {
        token.allowedSections = updateData.allowedSections;
      }
      if (trigger === "update" && updateData?.clientIdCode !== undefined) {
        token.clientIdCode = updateData.clientIdCode;
      }
      return token;
    },

    async session({ session, token }) {
      if (token.email) {
        session.user.email = token.email as string;
        session.user.name = token.name as string;
        session.user.image = token.picture as string;
      }
      session.user.role = (token.role as "viewer" | "editor" | "admin" | "client" | "pending" | "prospect") ?? "viewer";
      session.user.allowedSections = (token.allowedSections as string[]) ?? [];
      session.user.clientIdCode = (token.clientIdCode as string | null) ?? null;
      if (token.dbId) {
        session.user.id = token.dbId as string;
      }
      return session;
    },
  },
});

/**
 * BigQuery client and publish functionality.
 *
 * Matches the existing cloud function behavior:
 * - All columns are STRING type
 * - Uses WRITE_TRUNCATE (full table replace)
 * - Target: amazon-data-461918.1o8Hub.Master
 */
import { BigQuery, type TableField } from "@google-cloud/bigquery";
import { db } from "./db";
import { master } from "./db/schema";
import { mapProductToBqRow, type BqRow } from "./product-mapper";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { Readable } from "stream";

const PROJECT_ID = process.env.GCP_PROJECT_ID || "amazon-data-461918";
const DATASET = process.env.BQ_DATASET || "1o8Hub";
const TABLE = process.env.BQ_TABLE || "Master";
const STAGING_TABLE = `${TABLE}_Staging`;
const FULL_TABLE = `${PROJECT_ID}.${DATASET}.${TABLE}`;
const FULL_STAGING_TABLE = `${PROJECT_ID}.${DATASET}.${STAGING_TABLE}`;

function getBigQueryClient(): BigQuery {
  if (process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL && process.env.GCP_PRIVATE_KEY) {
    // Handle private key format: Vercel may store with literal \n or real newlines
    let privateKey = process.env.GCP_PRIVATE_KEY;
    // Replace literal \n (escaped) with real newlines
    privateKey = privateKey.replace(/\\n/g, "\n");
    // If the key was JSON-stringified (wrapped in extra quotes), unwrap it
    if (privateKey.startsWith('"') && privateKey.endsWith('"')) {
      privateKey = JSON.parse(privateKey);
    }

    return new BigQuery({
      projectId: PROJECT_ID,
      credentials: {
        client_email: process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL,
        private_key: privateKey,
      },
    });
  }
  return new BigQuery({ projectId: PROJECT_ID });
}
