/**
 * Publish all products to BigQuery.
 *
 * 1. Reads all products from PostgreSQL
 * 2. Maps each to a flat BQ row (all 972 STRING columns)
 * 3. Loads into BigQuery with WRITE_TRUNCATE (full replace)
 * 4. Resets is_dirty and updates last_published_at
 */
export async function publishToBigQuery(): Promise<{
  rowsPublished: number;
  jobId: string;
}> {
  const bigquery = getBigQueryClient();

  // 1. Read all products
  const allProducts = await db.select().from(master);

  if (allProducts.length === 0) {
    throw new Error("No products to publish");
  }

  // 2. Map to flat BQ rows
  const bqRows: BqRow[] = allProducts.map(mapProductToBqRow);

  // 3. Build schema from the keys of all rows (all STRING)
  const allKeys = new Set<string>();
  for (const row of bqRows) {
    for (const key of Object.keys(row)) {
      if (key.trim()) allKeys.add(key);
    }
  }

  const schemaFields: TableField[] = Array.from(allKeys).map((name) => ({
    name,
    type: "STRING",
  }));

  // Ensure all rows have all keys
  const normalizedRows = bqRows.map((row) => {
    const normalized: BqRow = {};
    for (const key of allKeys) {
      normalized[key] = row[key] ?? "";
    }
    return normalized;
  });

  // 4. Load into BigQuery with WRITE_TRUNCATE
  // Create NDJSON stream and pipe to BigQuery via createWriteStream
  const table = bigquery.dataset(DATASET).table(TABLE);
  const ndjson = normalizedRows.map((r) => JSON.stringify(r)).join("\n");
  const stream = Readable.from([ndjson]);

  const writeStream = table.createWriteStream({
    sourceFormat: "NEWLINE_DELIMITED_JSON",
    writeDisposition: "WRITE_TRUNCATE",
    schema: { fields: schemaFields },
  });

  const jobId = await new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => {
    stream
      .pipe(writeStream)
      .on("complete", (job) => {
        resolve(job.id ?? "unknown");
      })
      .on("error", (err) => {
        reject(err);
      });
  });

  // 5. Reset dirty flags
  const now = new Date();
  await db
    .update(master)
    .set({
      isDirty: false,
      lastPublishedAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
    })
    .where(eq(master.isDirty, true));

  return {
    rowsPublished: allProducts.length,
    jobId,
  };
}

/**
 * Publish only dirty products to BigQuery using a staging table + MERGE.
 *
 * 1. Reads dirty products from PostgreSQL
 * 2. Maps them to flat BQ rows
 * 3. Loads into a staging table with WRITE_TRUNCATE
 * 4. Runs a MERGE query to update/insert into the main table
 * 5. Resets is_dirty and updates last_published_at on published products
 */
export async function publishDirtyToBigQuery(): Promise<{
  rowsPublished: number;
  jobId: string;
}> {
  const bigquery = getBigQueryClient();

  // 1. Read only dirty products
  const dirtyProducts = await db
    .select()
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.isDirty, true));

  if (dirtyProducts.length === 0) {
    throw new Error("No dirty products to publish");
  }

  // 2. Map to flat BQ rows
  const bqRows: BqRow[] = dirtyProducts.map(mapProductToBqRow);

  // 3. Build schema from row keys (all STRING)
  const allKeys = new Set<string>();
  for (const row of bqRows) {
    for (const key of Object.keys(row)) {
      if (key.trim()) allKeys.add(key);
    }
  }

  const schemaFields: TableField[] = Array.from(allKeys).map((name) => ({
    name,
    type: "STRING",
  }));

  // Normalize rows so all have the same keys
  const normalizedRows = bqRows.map((row) => {
    const normalized: BqRow = {};
    for (const key of allKeys) {
      normalized[key] = row[key] ?? "";
    }
    return normalized;
  });

  // 4. Load dirty rows into staging table with WRITE_TRUNCATE
  const stagingTable = bigquery.dataset(DATASET).table(STAGING_TABLE);
  const ndjson = normalizedRows.map((r) => JSON.stringify(r)).join("\n");
  const stream = Readable.from([ndjson]);

  const writeStream = stagingTable.createWriteStream({
    sourceFormat: "NEWLINE_DELIMITED_JSON",
    writeDisposition: "WRITE_TRUNCATE",
    schema: { fields: schemaFields },
  });

  const loadJobId = await new Promise<string>((resolve, reject) => {
    stream
      .pipe(writeStream)
      .on("complete", (job) => {
        resolve(job.id ?? "unknown");
      })
      .on("error", (err) => {
        reject(err);
      });
  });

  // 5. Build and run MERGE query
  const columnNames = Array.from(allKeys);
  const updateClauses = columnNames
    .map((col) => `T.\`${col}\` = S.\`${col}\``)
    .join(", ");
  const insertColumns = columnNames.map((col) => `\`${col}\``).join(", ");
  const insertValues = columnNames
    .map((col) => `S.\`${col}\``)
    .join(", ");

  const mergeQuery = `
    MERGE \`${FULL_TABLE}\` T
    USING \`${FULL_STAGING_TABLE}\` S
    ON T.SKU = S.SKU
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
      UPDATE SET ${updateClauses}
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
      INSERT (${insertColumns})
      VALUES (${insertValues})
  `;

  const [mergeJob] = await bigquery.createQueryJob({ query: mergeQuery });
  await mergeJob.getQueryResults();
  const mergeJobId = mergeJob.id ?? loadJobId;

  // 6. Clean up staging table
  try {
    await bigquery
      .dataset(DATASET)
      .table(STAGING_TABLE)
      .delete();
  } catch {
    // Non-critical — staging table cleanup failure shouldn't fail publish
    console.warn("Failed to delete staging table, will be overwritten next time");
  }

  // 7. Reset dirty flags on published products
  const now = new Date();
  const dirtyIds = dirtyProducts.map((p) => p.id);
  for (const id of dirtyIds) {
    await db
      .update(master)
      .set({
        isDirty: false,
        lastPublishedAt: now,
        updatedAt: now,
      })
      .where(eq(master.id, id));
  }

  return {
    rowsPublished: dirtyProducts.length,
    jobId: mergeJobId,
  };
}

/**
 * Run a parameterized SELECT query against BigQuery and return typed rows.
 */
export async function queryBigQuery<T = Record<string, string>>(
  sqlQuery: string,
  params?: Record<string, string>
): Promise<T[]> {
  const bigquery = getBigQueryClient();
  const [job] = await bigquery.createQueryJob({
    query: sqlQuery,
    params,
  });
  const [rows] = await job.getQueryResults();
  return rows as T[];
}

const AAC_TABLE = `${PROJECT_ID}.${DATASET}.AAC`;

/**
 * Update a single field in the BQ AAC table for a given ClientIDCode.
 * Uses DML UPDATE so only the specific cell is changed.
 */
export async function updateAacFieldInBigQuery(
  clientIdCode: string,
  field: string,
  value: string
): Promise<void> {
  const bigquery = getBigQueryClient();

  // Get the column type so we can cast correctly
  const [metadata] = await bigquery.dataset(DATASET).table("AAC").getMetadata();
  const col = metadata.schema?.fields?.find(
    (f: { name: string }) => f.name === field
  );
  const colType = col?.type?.toUpperCase() ?? "STRING";

  let setExpr: string;
  if (value === "" || value == null) {
    setExpr = `\`${field}\` = NULL`;
  } else if (colType === "FLOAT64" || colType === "FLOAT" || colType === "NUMERIC" || colType === "BIGNUMERIC" || colType === "INT64" || colType === "INTEGER") {
    // BQ metadata returns FLOAT/INTEGER but SQL needs FLOAT64/INT64
    const sqlType = colType === "FLOAT" ? "FLOAT64" : colType === "INTEGER" ? "INT64" : colType;
    setExpr = `\`${field}\` = SAFE_CAST(@value AS ${sqlType})`;
  } else if (colType === "BOOL" || colType === "BOOLEAN") {
    setExpr = `\`${field}\` = SAFE_CAST(@value AS BOOL)`;
  } else {
    setExpr = `\`${field}\` = @value`;
  }

  const query = `UPDATE \`${AAC_TABLE}\` SET ${setExpr} WHERE ClientIDCode = @clientIdCode`;
  const [job] = await bigquery.createQueryJob({
    query,
    params: { value, clientIdCode },
  });
  await job.getQueryResults();
}

/**
 * Insert a new client row into the SEO AAC BigQuery table.
 * Called when a client is registered via the Hub so it appears in the SEO manager.
 */
export async function insertClientToBigQuery(
  clientIdCode: string,
  clientName: string,
  clientStatus: string = "Active"
): Promise<void> {
  const bigquery = getBigQueryClient();
  const query = `
    INSERT INTO \`${AAC_TABLE}\` (ClientIDCode, ClientName, ClientStatus)
    VALUES (@clientIdCode, @clientName, @clientStatus)
  `;
  const [job] = await bigquery.createQueryJob({
    query,
    params: { clientIdCode, clientName, clientStatus },
  });
  await job.getQueryResults();
}

/**
 * Fetch all SEO versions for a given ASIN + SKU from the BQ SEO table.
 */
export async function getSeoVersions(
  asin: string,
  sku: string
): Promise<BqRow[]> {
  const sql = `
    SELECT *
    FROM \`${PROJECT_ID}.${DATASET}.SEO\`
    WHERE ASIN = @asin AND SKU = @sku
    ORDER BY SEOVersionNumber
  `;
  return queryBigQuery<BqRow>(sql, { asin, sku });
}

/**
 * Fetch a specific SEO version row from BQ.
 */
export async function getSeoVersion(
  asin: string,
  sku: string,
  seoVersionNumber: string,
  seoCategory: string
): Promise<BqRow | null> {
  const sql = `
    SELECT *
    FROM \`${PROJECT_ID}.${DATASET}.SEO\`
    WHERE ASIN = @asin AND SKU = @sku
      AND SEOVersionNumber = @seoVersionNumber
      AND SEOCategory = @seoCategory
    LIMIT 1
  `;
  const rows = await queryBigQuery<BqRow>(sql, {
    asin,
    sku,
    seoVersionNumber,
    seoCategory,
  });
  return rows[0] ?? null;
}

/**
 * Get publish info (count of dirty master).
 */
export async function getPublishInfo(): Promise<{
  totalProducts: number;
  dirtyProducts: number;
}> {
  const allProducts = await db
    .select({ id: master.id, isDirty: master.isDirty })
    .from(master);
  const dirtyCount = allProducts.filter((p) => p.isDirty).length;
  return {
    totalProducts: allProducts.length,
    dirtyProducts: dirtyCount,
  };
}

/**
 * Match Amazon category attributes to Hub column attributes.
 *
 * Strategies applied in order (first match wins):
 * 1. Exact label match (case-insensitive)
 * 2. Normalized match (strip spaces/hyphens/underscores)
 * 3. Static known mappings (hardcoded correspondences)
 * 4. Base name extraction (strip marketplace/language/index suffixes)
 */

import type { ParsedCategoryAttribute } from "./category-report-parser";
import type { ColumnAttribute } from "./db/schema";

/** Hardcoded mappings: Amazon base field name → Hub generalLabel */
const KNOWN_MAPPINGS: Record<string, string> = {
  item_name: "ItemName",
  brand: "BrandName",
  brand_name: "BrandName",
  bullet_point: "BulletPoint1",
  "bullet_point#1": "BulletPoint1",
  "bullet_point#2": "BulletPoint2",
  "bullet_point#3": "BulletPoint3",
  "bullet_point#4": "BulletPoint4",
  "bullet_point#5": "BulletPoint5",
  generic_keyword: "GenericKeywords",
  generic_keywords: "GenericKeywords",
  product_description: "ProductDescription",
  main_product_image_locator: "MainImageUrl",
  main_image_url: "MainImageUrl",
  item_type_keyword: "ItemTypeKeyword",
  feed_product_type: "FeedProductType",
  product_type: "ProductType",
  recommended_browse_nodes: "RecommendedBrowseNodes",
  platinum_keywords: "PlatinumKeywords",
  contribution_sku: "SKU",
  list_price: "ListPrice",
  parentage_level: "ParentageLevel",
  child_parent_sku_relationship: "ParentSKU",
  external_product_id: "ASIN",
  item_weight: "ItemWeight",
  item_length: "ItemLength",
  item_width: "ItemWidth",
  item_height: "ItemHeight",
  package_weight: "PackageWeight",
  package_length: "PackageLength",
  package_width: "PackageWidth",
  package_height: "PackageHeight",
  manufacturer: "Manufacturer",
  country_of_origin: "CountryOfOrigin",
  model_number: "ModelNumber",
  part_number: "PartNumber",
  color: "Color",
  size: "Size",
  material: "Material",
};

/**
 * Match parsed Amazon category attributes to Hub column attributes.
 * Returns a Map of amazonFieldName → generalLabel.
 */
export function matchHubFields(
  attributes: ParsedCategoryAttribute[],
  columnAttributes: ColumnAttribute[]
): Map<string, string> {
  const matches = new Map<string, string>();

  // Build lookup structures for Hub columns
  const byLabelLower = new Map<string, string>();
  const byNormalized = new Map<string, string>();

  for (const col of columnAttributes) {
    byLabelLower.set(col.generalLabel.toLowerCase(), col.generalLabel);
    byNormalized.set(normalize(col.generalLabel), col.generalLabel);
  }

  for (const attr of attributes) {
    // Strategy 1: Exact label match (case-insensitive)
    const exactMatch = byLabelLower.get(attr.localLabel.toLowerCase());
    if (exactMatch) {
      matches.set(attr.amazonFieldName, exactMatch);
      continue;
    }

    // Strategy 2: Normalized match
    const normalizedLabel = normalize(attr.localLabel);
    const normalizedMatch = byNormalized.get(normalizedLabel);
    if (normalizedMatch) {
      matches.set(attr.amazonFieldName, normalizedMatch);
      continue;
    }

    // Strategy 3: Static known mappings using base name
    const baseName = extractBaseName(attr.amazonFieldName);
    const knownMatch = KNOWN_MAPPINGS[baseName];
    if (knownMatch && byLabelLower.has(knownMatch.toLowerCase())) {
      matches.set(attr.amazonFieldName, knownMatch);
      continue;
    }

    // Also try with index suffix for bullet points etc.
    const baseWithIndex = extractBaseNameWithIndex(attr.amazonFieldName);
    const knownMatchIdx = KNOWN_MAPPINGS[baseWithIndex];
    if (knownMatchIdx && byLabelLower.has(knownMatchIdx.toLowerCase())) {
      matches.set(attr.amazonFieldName, knownMatchIdx);
      continue;
    }

    // Strategy 4: Base name → normalized match against Hub labels
    const normalizedBase = normalize(baseName);
    const baseMatch = byNormalized.get(normalizedBase);
    if (baseMatch) {
      matches.set(attr.amazonFieldName, baseMatch);
      continue;
    }
  }

  return matches;
}

/** Remove spaces, hyphens, underscores → lowercase */
function normalize(str: string): string {
  return str.replace(/[\s\-_]/g, "").toLowerCase();
}

/**
 * Extract base field name from Amazon field name:
 * "item_name[marketplace_id=ATVPDKIKX0DER][language_tag=en_US]#1.value" → "item_name"
 * "bullet_point[marketplace_id=ATVPDKIKX0DER][language_tag=en_US]#3.value" → "bullet_point"
 * "::listing_status" → "listing_status"
 */
function extractBaseName(fieldName: string): string {
  // Remove leading "::"
  let name = fieldName.replace(/^::/, "");
  // Remove bracketed parameters
  name = name.replace(/\[.*?\]/g, "");
  // Remove #N.value / #N.name / etc.
  name = name.replace(/#\d+\..*$/, "");
  return name.trim();
}

/**
 * Extract base name preserving the index number:
 * "bullet_point[...]#3.value" → "bullet_point#3"
 */
function extractBaseNameWithIndex(fieldName: string): string {
  let name = fieldName.replace(/^::/, "");
  name = name.replace(/\[.*?\]/g, "");
  // Keep #N but remove .value/.name etc.
  name = name.replace(/(#\d+)\..*$/, "$1");
  return name.trim();
}

/**
 * Parser for Amazon Category Listing Report XLSM files.
 *
 * Expected sheets:
 * - "Data Definitions": rows with group headers (col A only) and
 *   attribute rows (cols B–F: field name, local label, description, example, requirement)
 * - "Valid Values": rows where col B = "Label - [ PRODUCT_TYPE ]" and cols C+ = allowed values
 * - "Template": row 3 = groups, row 5 = Amazon API field names → extract product type from field names
 */

import * as XLSX from "xlsx";

export interface ParsedCategoryAttribute {
  amazonFieldName: string;
  localLabel: string;
  groupName: string;
  description: string;
  example: string;
  requirement: string; // "Required" | "Conditionally Required" | "Optional" | "Recommended"
  validValues: string[];
  sortOrder: number;
}

export interface ParsedCategoryReport {
  productType: string;
  marketplace: string;
  attributes: ParsedCategoryAttribute[];
  summary: {
    total: number;
    required: number;
    conditional: number;
    optional: number;
  };
}

/**
 * Parse a Category Listing Report XLSM buffer into structured data.
 */
export function parseCategoryReport(buffer: ArrayBuffer): ParsedCategoryReport {
  const wb = XLSX.read(buffer, { type: "array" });

  const attributes = parseDataDefinitions(wb);
  const validValuesMap = parseValidValues(wb);
  const { productType, marketplace } = parseTemplate(wb, attributes);

  // Merge valid values into attributes by matching local label
  for (const attr of attributes) {
    const values = validValuesMap.get(attr.localLabel.toLowerCase());
    if (values) {
      attr.validValues = values;
    }
  }

  const summary = {
    total: attributes.length,
    required: attributes.filter((a) => a.requirement === "Required").length,
    conditional: attributes.filter(
      (a) => a.requirement === "Conditionally Required"
    ).length,
    optional: attributes.filter(
      (a) => a.requirement === "Optional" || a.requirement === "Recommended"
    ).length,
  };

  return { productType, marketplace, attributes, summary };
}

/**
 * Parse the "Data Definitions" sheet.
 * Row 1: header text, Row 2: column labels, Row 3+: data.
 * Group headers: col A has a value, col B is empty.
 * Attribute rows: col B has the amazon field name.
 */
function parseDataDefinitions(
  wb: XLSX.WorkBook
): ParsedCategoryAttribute[] {
  const ws = wb.Sheets["Data Definitions"];
  if (!ws) throw new Error('Sheet "Data Definitions" not found');

  const rows: unknown[][] = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(ws, { header: 1 });
  const attributes: ParsedCategoryAttribute[] = [];
  let currentGroup = "";
  let sortOrder = 0;

  // Skip rows 1 (header text) and 2 (column labels), start at row 3 (index 2)
  for (let i = 2; i < rows.length; i++) {
    const row = rows[i];
    if (!row || row.length === 0) continue;

    const colA = cellStr(row[0]);
    const colB = cellStr(row[1]);

    if (colA && !colB) {
      // Group header row — clean up group name
      // e.g. "Reference Group - This group contains..." → "Reference Group"
      // e.g. "Offer (US) - (Sell on Amazon)..." → "Offer (US)"
      currentGroup = colA.split(" - ")[0].trim();
      continue;
    }

    if (colB) {
      // Attribute row
      attributes.push({
        amazonFieldName: colB,
        localLabel: cellStr(row[2]) || colB,
        groupName: currentGroup,
        description: cellStr(row[3]),
        example: cellStr(row[4]),
        requirement: normalizeRequirement(cellStr(row[5])),
        validValues: [],
        sortOrder: sortOrder++,
      });
    }
  }

  return attributes;
}

/**
 * Parse the "Valid Values" sheet.
 * Group header rows: col A non-empty, col B empty.
 * Value rows: col B = "Local Label - [ PRODUCT_TYPE ]", cols C+ = allowed values.
 * Returns a map of lowercase(localLabel) → string[].
 */
function parseValidValues(wb: XLSX.WorkBook): Map<string, string[]> {
  const ws = wb.Sheets["Valid Values"];
  if (!ws) return new Map();

  const rows: unknown[][] = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(ws, { header: 1 });
  const map = new Map<string, string[]>();

  for (const row of rows) {
    if (!row) continue;
    const colB = cellStr(row[1]);
    if (!colB) continue;

    // Extract label from "Local Label - [ PRODUCT_TYPE ]" pattern
    const labelMatch = colB.match(/^(.+?)\s*-\s*\[/);
    const label = labelMatch ? labelMatch[1].trim() : colB.trim();

    // Collect values from col C onward
    const values: string[] = [];
    for (let c = 2; c < row.length; c++) {
      const v = cellStr(row[c]);
      if (v) values.push(v);
    }

    if (values.length > 0) {
      map.set(label.toLowerCase(), values);
    }
  }

  return map;
}

/**
 * Parse the "Template" sheet to extract product type and marketplace.
 * Row 3 (index 2) = groups, Row 5 (index 4) = Amazon API field names.
 * Product type from field names like "product_type#1.value" or from
 * Valid Values labels like "[ SAUCE ]".
 * Marketplace from field names like "marketplace_id=ATVPDKIKX0DER".
 */
function parseTemplate(
  wb: XLSX.WorkBook,
  attributes: ParsedCategoryAttribute[]
): { productType: string; marketplace: string } {
  let marketplace = "ATVPDKIKX0DER"; // default US marketplace
  let productType = "";

  // Try to extract marketplace from attribute field names
  for (const attr of attributes) {
    const mpMatch = attr.amazonFieldName.match(/marketplace_id=([A-Z0-9]+)/);
    if (mpMatch) {
      marketplace = mpMatch[1];
      break;
    }
  }

  // Try to extract product type from Valid Values sheet labels
  const vvSheet = wb.Sheets["Valid Values"];
  if (vvSheet) {
    const vvRows: unknown[][] = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(vvSheet, {
      header: 1,
    });
    for (const row of vvRows) {
      if (!row) continue;
      const colB = cellStr(row[1]);
      if (!colB) continue;
      const ptMatch = colB.match(/\[\s*([A-Z_]+)\s*\]/);
      if (ptMatch && ptMatch[1].trim()) {
        productType = ptMatch[1].trim();
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  // Fallback: try Template sheet row 5 for product_type field
  if (!productType) {
    const tmpl = wb.Sheets["Template"];
    if (tmpl) {
      const tmplRows: unknown[][] = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(tmpl, {
        header: 1,
      });
      // Row 4 (index 3) = local labels, check for "Product Type"
      if (tmplRows[3]) {
        for (let c = 0; c < tmplRows[3].length; c++) {
          if (cellStr(tmplRows[3][c]) === "Product Type") {
            // Check if there's a value in row 6+ (data rows)
            for (let r = 5; r < tmplRows.length; r++) {
              const val = cellStr(tmplRows[r]?.[c]);
              if (val) {
                productType = val.toUpperCase();
                break;
              }
            }
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  if (!productType) {
    productType = "UNKNOWN";
  }

  return { productType, marketplace };
}

function cellStr(val: unknown): string {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return "";
  return String(val).trim();
}

function normalizeRequirement(raw: string): string {
  if (!raw) return "Optional";
  const lower = raw.toLowerCase();
  if (lower === "required") return "Required";
  if (lower.includes("conditional")) return "Conditionally Required";
  if (lower === "recommended") return "Recommended";
  return "Optional";
}

/**
 * Aggregates all data needed for a client report:
 * product counts, completeness scores, recent activity, and field coverage.
 */
import { db } from "./db";
import {
  master,
  columnAttributes,
  activityLog,
  aac,
} from "./db/schema";
import { eq, sql, and, gte, lte, desc } from "drizzle-orm";
import { calculateCompleteness, getScoreBucket } from "./completeness";
import { getProductFieldValue } from "./product-mapper";
import type { Product, ColumnAttribute } from "./db/schema";

export interface FieldCoverageEntry {
  fieldLabel: string;
  requirementLevel: string;
  filledCount: number;
  totalCount: number;
  fillRate: number;
}

export interface RecentChange {
  asin: string | null;
  sku: string | null;
  itemName: string | null;
  fieldLabel: string;
  oldValue: string | null;
  newValue: string | null;
  changedBy: string;
  changedAt: string;
  editType: string;
}

export interface ProductScore {
  asin: string | null;
  sku: string | null;
  itemName: string | null;
  status: string | null;
  score: number;
  missingRequired: string[];
  missingConditionallyRequired: string[];
}

export interface ClientReportData {
  clientIdCode: string;
  clientName: string;
  generatedAt: string;
  dateRange: { from: string; to: string };
  summary: {
    totalProducts: number;
    activeProducts: number;
    averageScore: number;
    distribution: {
      ready: number;
      good: number;
      incomplete: number;
      poor: number;
    };
  };
  products: ProductScore[];
  recentChanges: RecentChange[];
  fieldCoverage: FieldCoverageEntry[];
}

export async function aggregateClientReport(
  clientIdCode: string,
  from: Date,
  to: Date
): Promise<ClientReportData> {
  // 1. Fetch client name
  const clientRow = await db
    .select({ clientName: aac.clientName })
    .from(aac)
    .where(eq(aac.clientIdCode, clientIdCode))
    .limit(1);
  const clientName = clientRow[0]?.clientName || clientIdCode;

  // 2. Fetch all products for this client
  const productList = await db
    .select()
    .from(master)
    .where(eq(master.clientIdCode, clientIdCode));

  // 3. Fetch column attributes
  const attrs = await db.select().from(columnAttributes);

  // Pre-filter relevant attributes for this client
  const relevantAttrs = attrs.filter((a: ColumnAttribute) => {
    const reqs = a.clientRequirements as Record<string, string> | null;
    const level = reqs?.[clientIdCode];
    return level && level !== "Not Required" && level !== "Optional";
  });

  // 4. Calculate completeness scores
  const distribution = { ready: 0, good: 0, incomplete: 0, poor: 0 };
  let totalScore = 0;

  const productScores: ProductScore[] = productList.map(
    (product: Product) => {
      const result = calculateCompleteness(
        product,
        relevantAttrs,
        clientIdCode
      );
      totalScore += result.score;
      distribution[getScoreBucket(result.score)]++;
      return {
        asin: product.asin,
        sku: product.sku,
        itemName: product.itemName,
        status: product.status,
        score: result.score,
        missingRequired: result.missingRequired,
        missingConditionallyRequired: result.missingConditionallyRequired,
      };
    }
  );

  const activeCount = productList.filter(
    (p) => p.status?.toLowerCase() === "active"
  ).length;

  const averageScore =
    productList.length > 0
      ? Math.round(totalScore / productList.length)
      : 0;

  // 5. Fetch recent activity in date range
  const activityRows = await db
    .select({
      asin: activityLog.asin,
      sku: activityLog.sku,
      itemName: activityLog.itemName,
      fieldLabel: activityLog.fieldLabel,
      oldValue: activityLog.oldValue,
      newValue: activityLog.newValue,
      changedBy: activityLog.changedBy,
      changedAt: activityLog.changedAt,
      editType: activityLog.editType,
    })
    .from(activityLog)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(activityLog.clientIdCode, clientIdCode),
        gte(activityLog.changedAt, from),
        lte(activityLog.changedAt, to)
      )
    )
    .orderBy(desc(activityLog.changedAt))
    .limit(500);

  const recentChanges: RecentChange[] = activityRows.map((r) => ({
    asin: r.asin,
    sku: r.sku,
    itemName: r.itemName,
    fieldLabel: r.fieldLabel,
    oldValue: r.oldValue,
    newValue: r.newValue,
    changedBy: r.changedBy,
    changedAt: r.changedAt.toISOString(),
    editType: r.editType,
  }));

  // 6. Calculate field coverage across all products
  const fieldCoverage: FieldCoverageEntry[] = [];
  const totalProducts = productList.length;

  if (totalProducts > 0) {
    // Build a map of bqName → attribute for relevant fields
    const attrByBqName = new Map<string, ColumnAttribute>();
    for (const attr of relevantAttrs) {
      const bqName = attr.bigqueryLabel || attr.generalLabel;
      attrByBqName.set(bqName, attr);
    }

    // Also include Recommended fields
    const allRelevantAttrs = attrs.filter((a: ColumnAttribute) => {
      const reqs = a.clientRequirements as Record<string, string> | null;
      const level = reqs?.[clientIdCode];
      return level && level !== "Not Required";
    });

    for (const attr of allRelevantAttrs) {
      const bqName = attr.bigqueryLabel || attr.generalLabel;
      const reqs = attr.clientRequirements as Record<string, string> | null;
      const level = reqs?.[clientIdCode] || "Unknown";

      // Count how many products have this field filled
      let filledCount = 0;
      for (const product of productList) {
        const value = getProductFieldValue(product, bqName);
        if (
          value !== null &&
          value !== undefined &&
          String(value).trim() !== ""
        ) {
          filledCount++;
        }
      }

      fieldCoverage.push({
        fieldLabel: attr.generalLabel,
        requirementLevel: level,
        filledCount,
        totalCount: totalProducts,
        fillRate: Math.round((filledCount / totalProducts) * 100),
      });
    }

    // Sort by requirement level priority, then fill rate ascending
    const levelOrder: Record<string, number> = {
      Required: 0,
      "Conditionally Required": 1,
      Recommended: 2,
      Optional: 3,
    };
    fieldCoverage.sort((a, b) => {
      const la = levelOrder[a.requirementLevel] ?? 9;
      const lb = levelOrder[b.requirementLevel] ?? 9;
      if (la !== lb) return la - lb;
      return a.fillRate - b.fillRate;
    });
  }

  return {
    clientIdCode,
    clientName,
    generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    dateRange: { from: from.toISOString(), to: to.toISOString() },
    summary: {
      totalProducts,
      activeProducts: activeCount,
      averageScore,
      distribution,
    },
    products: productScores,
    recentChanges,
    fieldCoverage,
  };
}

/**
 * Column Registry — Central definition of all product columns.
 *
 * This file is initially generated by scripts/generate-column-registry.ts
 * from the BigQuery schema, then manually reviewed and adjusted.
 *
 * Each column definition controls:
 * - Where it's stored in the DB (core column or which JSONB blob)
 * - What group it belongs to in the UI
 * - Its display label and field type for the edit form
 *
 * @deprecated The product detail view now uses column_attributes for grouping,
 * field types (via inferFieldType), and labels. CORE_COLUMNS is still used by
 * product-mapper.ts and the PUT handler for identifying core DB fields.
 */

export type FieldType = "text" | "textarea" | "url" | "number" | "select";

export type ColumnDef = {
  /** Original BQ column name (exactly as it appears in BigQuery) */
  bqName: string;
  /** Human-readable label for the UI */
  label: string;
  /** Column group ID (matches COLUMN_GROUPS) */
  group: string;
  /** Form field type */
  fieldType: FieldType;
  /** If stored as a core DB column, the Drizzle field name; otherwise null (stored in JSONB) */
  coreField: string | null;
  /** Select options (for fieldType: "select") */
  options?: string[];
};

  return [...CORE_COLUMNS, ...JSONB_COLUMNS];

  return getAllColumns().filter((c) => c.group === groupId);

  return getAllColumns().find((c) => c.bqName === bqName);
}

export function getBqNameToGroupMap(): Map<string, string> {
  const map = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const col of getAllColumns()) {
    map.set(col.bqName, col.group);
  }
  return map;
}

/**
 * Utility functions for column attribute metadata.
 */

import type { ColumnAttribute } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import type { FieldType } from "@/lib/column-registry";

/**
 * Fields that should render as a <Select> with predefined options.
 * Keyed by bigqueryLabel (BQ column name).
 */
const SELECT_FIELD_OPTIONS: Record<string, string[]> = {
  Status: [
    "Active",
    "Inactive",
    "Incomplete",
    "Out of Stock",
    "Closed",
    "Discontinued",
  ],
  ParentageLevel: ["Parent", "Child", "Standalone"],
};

/**
 * Get predefined select options for a column attribute, if any.
 */
export function getSelectOptions(attr: ColumnAttribute): string[] | null {
  const bqLabel = attr.bigqueryLabel || "";
  return SELECT_FIELD_OPTIONS[bqLabel] ?? null;
}

/**
 * Infer form field type from column attribute metadata.
 * Uses bqDataType + label heuristics to pick the best input type.
 */
export function inferFieldType(attr: ColumnAttribute): FieldType {
  // Select fields with predefined options
  if (attr.bigqueryLabel && SELECT_FIELD_OPTIONS[attr.bigqueryLabel]) {
    return "select";
  }

  const label = (attr.generalLabel || "").toLowerCase();
  const dataType = (attr.bqDataType || "STRING").toUpperCase();

  // URL detection
  if (
    label.includes("url") ||
    label.includes("image") ||
    label.includes("link")
  ) {
    return "url";
  }

  // Number detection
  if (
    dataType === "FLOAT" ||
    dataType === "INTEGER" ||
    dataType === "NUMERIC" ||
    dataType === "INT64" ||
    dataType === "FLOAT64"
  ) {
    return "number";
  }

  // Textarea detection — long text fields
  if (
    label.includes("description") ||
    label.includes("bullet") ||
    label.includes("keyword") ||
    label.includes("feature") ||
    label.includes("note") ||
    label.includes("detail")
  ) {
    return "textarea";
  }

  return "text";
}

/**
 * Get the maximum character length for a field, if known.
 * Checks column_attributes.labelMaxOptions first, then falls back to
 * Amazon-known defaults based on the field label.
 */
export function getFieldMaxLength(attr: ColumnAttribute): number | null {
  if (attr.labelMaxOptions && /^\d+$/.test(attr.labelMaxOptions.trim())) {
    return parseInt(attr.labelMaxOptions.trim());
  }
  const label = (attr.generalLabel || "").toLowerCase();
  if (label.includes("item_name") || label === "itemname") return 200;
  if (label.includes("bullet") || label.includes("keyfeature")) return 500;
  if (
    label.includes("generickeyword") ||
    label.includes("generic_keyword") ||
    label.includes("search_term") ||
    label.includes("platinumkeyword")
  )
    return 250;
  if (label.includes("description")) return 2000;
  return null;
}

/**
 * Product completeness score calculation.
 *
 * Evaluates how many Required and Conditionally Required fields are populated
 * relative to a product's client requirements.
 */
import { getProductFieldValue } from "./product-mapper";
import type { Product, ColumnAttribute } from "./db/schema";

export interface CompletenessBreakdown {
  filled: number;
  total: number;
}

export interface CompletenessScore {
  /** 0–100 percentage */
  score: number;
  /** Total required + conditionally required fields for this client */
  totalRequired: number;
  /** Number of required + cond. required fields that have a non-empty value */
  filledRequired: number;
  /** Breakdown by requirement level */
  breakdown: {
    required: CompletenessBreakdown;
    conditionallyRequired: CompletenessBreakdown;
    recommended: CompletenessBreakdown;
  };
  /** Missing required field labels */
  missingRequired: string[];
  /** Missing conditionally required field labels */
  missingConditionallyRequired: string[];
}

export function calculateCompleteness(
  product: Product,
  attributes: ColumnAttribute[],
  clientIdCode: string
): CompletenessScore {
  const required: CompletenessBreakdown = { filled: 0, total: 0 };
  const conditionallyRequired: CompletenessBreakdown = { filled: 0, total: 0 };
  const recommended: CompletenessBreakdown = { filled: 0, total: 0 };
  const missingRequired: string[] = [];
  const missingConditionallyRequired: string[] = [];

  for (const attr of attributes) {
    const clientReqs = attr.clientRequirements as Record<string, string> | null;
    const level = clientReqs?.[clientIdCode];

    if (!level || level === "Not Required" || level === "Optional") continue;

    // Check if the field has a non-empty value
    const bqName = attr.bigqueryLabel || attr.generalLabel;
    const value = getProductFieldValue(product, bqName);
    const isFilled =
      value !== null && value !== undefined && String(value).trim() !== "";

    if (level === "Required") {
      required.total++;
      if (isFilled) required.filled++;
      else missingRequired.push(attr.generalLabel);
    } else if (level === "Conditionally Required") {
      conditionallyRequired.total++;
      if (isFilled) conditionallyRequired.filled++;
      else missingConditionallyRequired.push(attr.generalLabel);
    } else if (level === "Recommended") {
      recommended.total++;
      if (isFilled) recommended.filled++;
    }
  }

  const totalRequired = required.total + conditionallyRequired.total;
  const filledRequired = required.filled + conditionallyRequired.filled;
  const score =
    totalRequired > 0
      ? Math.round((filledRequired / totalRequired) * 100)
      : 100;

  return {
    score,
    totalRequired,
    filledRequired,
    breakdown: { required, conditionallyRequired, recommended },
    missingRequired,
    missingConditionallyRequired,
  };
}

export function getScoreColor(score: number): string {
  if (score >= 90) return "#10b981"; // emerald-500
  if (score >= 70) return "#FAC800"; // brand yellow
  if (score >= 50) return "#f97316"; // orange-500
  return "#ef4444"; // red-500
}

export function getScoreLabel(score: number): string {
  if (score >= 90) return "Ready";
  if (score >= 70) return "Good";
  if (score >= 50) return "Incomplete";
  return "Poor";
}

export function getScoreBucket(
  score: number
): "ready" | "good" | "incomplete" | "poor" {
  if (score >= 90) return "ready";
  if (score >= 70) return "good";
  if (score >= 50) return "incomplete";
  return "poor";
}

/**
 * Computed Fields — Fields auto-calculated from other product fields.
 *
 * UUID = ASIN_SKU_ClientIDCode
 * SummarizedTitle = VariationProduct|Style|Flavor|Color|Size (non-empty parts joined with |)
 * AmazonPDPURL = https://www.amazon.com/dp/{ASIN}
 */

/** Set of BQ column names that are computed and should be read-only */
export const COMPUTED_FIELDS = new Set(["UUID", "SummarizedTitle", "AmazonPDPURL"]);

/** BQ column names that, when changed, trigger recomputation */
const UUID_DEPS = new Set(["ASIN", "SKU", "ClientIDCode"]);
const ASIN_DEPS = new Set(["ASIN"]);
const SUMMARIZED_TITLE_DEPS = new Set([
  "VariationProduct",
  "Style",
  "Flavor",
  "Color",
  "Size",
]);

/** Map of core field prop names to their BQ equivalents (for UUID deps) */
const CORE_TO_BQ: Record<string, string> = {
  asin: "ASIN",
  sku: "SKU",
  clientIdCode: "ClientIDCode",
};

/**
 * Returns which computed fields need recomputing after a field change.
 * Accepts either a bqName ("ASIN") or a coreField name ("asin").
 */
export function getTriggeredComputedFields(
  changedBqName: string,
  changedCoreField?: string | null
): string[] {
  const triggered: string[] = [];
  const bq = changedBqName;
  const coreBq = changedCoreField ? CORE_TO_BQ[changedCoreField] : undefined;

  if (UUID_DEPS.has(bq) || (coreBq && UUID_DEPS.has(coreBq))) {
    triggered.push("UUID");
  }
  if (ASIN_DEPS.has(bq) || (coreBq && ASIN_DEPS.has(coreBq))) {
    triggered.push("AmazonPDPURL");
  }
  if (SUMMARIZED_TITLE_DEPS.has(bq)) {
    triggered.push("SummarizedTitle");
  }
  return triggered;
}

export function computeUUID(
  asin: string | null,
  sku: string | null,
  clientIdCode: string | null
): string {
  return [asin || "", sku || "", clientIdCode || ""].join("_");
}

export function computeAmazonPdpUrl(asin: string | null): string {
  if (!asin || asin.trim() === "") return "";
  return `https://www.amazon.com/dp/${asin}`;
}

export function computeSummarizedTitle(
  variationProduct: string | null,
  style: string | null,
  flavor: string | null,
  color: string | null,
  size: string | null
): string {
  return [variationProduct, style, flavor, color, size]
    .filter((p) => p != null && p.trim() !== "")
    .join("|");
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Google Drive REST client
// — Built on shared gcp-auth.ts token caching
// — No googleapis dependency: raw fetch only
// — All methods include supportsAllDrives=true
// — GOOGLE_SHARED_DRIVE_ID is read at call time (not module init)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { getAccessToken } from "@/lib/gcp-auth";

// ── Constants ────────────────────────────────────────────────

const DRIVE_BASE = "https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3";
const UPLOAD_BASE = "https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3";
const DRIVE_SCOPE = "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive";

// ── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface DriveFile {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  mimeType: string;
  size?: string;
  createdTime?: string;
  parents?: string[];
}

export interface DriveFileList {
  files: DriveFile[];
  nextPageToken?: string;
}

// ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

function driveToken(): Promise<string> {
  return getAccessToken([DRIVE_SCOPE]);
}

/** Read GOOGLE_SHARED_DRIVE_ID at call time — never at module init */
function sharedDriveId(): string {
  const id = process.env.GOOGLE_SHARED_DRIVE_ID?.trim();
  if (!id) {
    throw new Error(
      "GOOGLE_SHARED_DRIVE_ID environment variable is not set. " +
      "Add it to your environment before calling Drive methods."
    );
  }
  return id;
}

async function checkResponse(res: Response, context: string): Promise<void> {
  if (!res.ok) {
    const text = await res.text().catch(() => "(could not read response body)");
    throw new Error(`Drive API error in ${context} (${res.status} ${res.statusText}): ${text}`);
  }
}

// ── driveClient ───────────────────────────────────────────────

export const driveClient = {
  /**
   * Create a folder in Google Drive.
   * @param name - Folder name
   * @param parentDriveId - Parent folder or shared drive ID
   */
  async createFolder(name: string, parentDriveId: string): Promise<DriveFile> {
    const token = await driveToken();
    const res = await fetch(`${DRIVE_BASE}/files?supportsAllDrives=true`, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        name,
        mimeType: "application/vnd.google-apps.folder",
        parents: [parentDriveId],
      }),
    });
    await checkResponse(res, "createFolder");
    return res.json() as Promise<DriveFile>;
  },

  /**
   * List files in the shared drive matching a query.
   * Always scoped to the shared drive (corpora=drive, includeItemsFromAllDrives=true).
   * @param query - Drive query string (e.g. "'folderId' in parents and trashed=false")
   * @param pageToken - Optional pagination token
   */
  async listFiles(query: string, pageToken?: string): Promise<DriveFileList> {
    const token = await driveToken();
    const driveId = sharedDriveId();
    const params = new URLSearchParams({
      q: query,
      supportsAllDrives: "true",
      includeItemsFromAllDrives: "true",
      corpora: "drive",
      driveId,
      fields: "files(id,name,mimeType,size,createdTime),nextPageToken",
    });
    if (pageToken) params.set("pageToken", pageToken);

    const res = await fetch(`${DRIVE_BASE}/files?${params}`, {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
    });
    await checkResponse(res, "listFiles");
    return res.json() as Promise<DriveFileList>;
  },

  /**
   * Get file metadata by ID.
   * @param fileId - Drive file or folder ID
   * @param fields - Comma-separated fields to return (defaults to id,name,mimeType,size,createdTime,parents)
   */
  async getFile(fileId: string, fields?: string): Promise<DriveFile> {
    const token = await driveToken();
    const resolvedFields = fields || "id,name,mimeType,size,createdTime,parents";
    const res = await fetch(
      `${DRIVE_BASE}/files/${encodeURIComponent(fileId)}?supportsAllDrives=true&fields=${encodeURIComponent(resolvedFields)}`,
      { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } }
    );
    await checkResponse(res, "getFile");
    return res.json() as Promise<DriveFile>;
  },

  /**
   * Permanently delete a file or folder.
   * @param fileId - Drive file or folder ID
   */
  async deleteFile(fileId: string): Promise<void> {
    const token = await driveToken();
    const res = await fetch(
      `${DRIVE_BASE}/files/${encodeURIComponent(fileId)}?supportsAllDrives=true`,
      {
        method: "DELETE",
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
      }
    );
    // DELETE returns 204 No Content on success
    if (!res.ok && res.status !== 204) {
      await checkResponse(res, "deleteFile");
    }
  },

  /**
   * Move a file from one folder to another.
   * @param fileId - Drive file ID
   * @param newParentId - Destination folder ID
   * @param oldParentId - Source folder ID (required by Drive API to remove old parent)
   */
  async moveFile(
    fileId: string,
    newParentId: string,
    oldParentId: string
  ): Promise<DriveFile> {
    const token = await driveToken();
    const params = new URLSearchParams({
      addParents: newParentId,
      removeParents: oldParentId,
      supportsAllDrives: "true",
    });
    const res = await fetch(
      `${DRIVE_BASE}/files/${encodeURIComponent(fileId)}?${params}`,
      {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({}),
      }
    );
    await checkResponse(res, "moveFile");
    return res.json() as Promise<DriveFile>;
  },

  /**
   * Rename a file in Google Drive.
   * @param fileId - Drive file ID
   * @param newName - New file name
   */
  async renameFile(fileId: string, newName: string): Promise<DriveFile> {
    const token = await driveToken();
    const res = await fetch(
      `${DRIVE_BASE}/files/${encodeURIComponent(fileId)}?supportsAllDrives=true`,
      {
        method: "PATCH",
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ name: newName }),
      }
    );
    await checkResponse(res, "renameFile");
    return res.json() as Promise<DriveFile>;
  },

  /**
   * Upload a file using multipart upload.
   * @param name - File name in Drive
   * @param parentId - Parent folder ID
   * @param buffer - File content as Buffer
   * @param mimeType - Content MIME type (e.g. "image/jpeg")
   */
  async uploadFile(
    name: string,
    parentId: string,
    buffer: Buffer,
    mimeType: string
  ): Promise<DriveFile> {
    const token = await driveToken();
    const metadata = JSON.stringify({ name, parents: [parentId] });
    const boundary = "----driveupload" + Date.now();
    const body = Buffer.concat([
      Buffer.from(
        `--${boundary}\r\nContent-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8\r\n\r\n${metadata}\r\n` +
        `--${boundary}\r\nContent-Type: ${mimeType}\r\n\r\n`
      ),
      buffer,
      Buffer.from(`\r\n--${boundary}--`),
    ]);

    const res = await fetch(
      `${UPLOAD_BASE}/files?uploadType=multipart&supportsAllDrives=true`,
      {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
          "Content-Type": `multipart/related; boundary=${boundary}`,
        },
        body,
      }
    );
    await checkResponse(res, "uploadFile");
    return res.json() as Promise<DriveFile>;
  },

  /**
   * Ping the shared drive by creating and immediately deleting a test folder.
   * Verifies that credentials and drive access are correctly configured.
   */
  async ping(): Promise<{ ok: true; driveId: string }> {
    const driveId = sharedDriveId();
    const testName = `__ping_test_${Date.now()}__`;
    const folder = await driveClient.createFolder(testName, driveId);
    await driveClient.deleteFile(folder.id);
    return { ok: true, driveId };
  },
};

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Shared Drive upload helpers
// — buildFileName: deterministic, collision-resistant naming
// — buildAplusFileName: SOP-compliant A+ Content naming
// — resolveUploadFolder: finds or creates ASIN subfolder on demand
//   with race-condition safety via unique index + onConflictDoNothing
// — resolveAplusFolder: creates full PA+/scope/version hierarchy
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { driveFolders } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { driveClient } from "@/lib/drive-client";
import { eq, and } from "drizzle-orm";
import {
  MODULE_TYPE_CODES,
  buildScopeSegment,
  getFixedSlotKey,
  getRepeatableSlotKey,
  type AplusDevice,
  type AplusPlatform,
  type AplusScopeType,
} from "@/lib/aplus-file-naming";
import type { AplusModuleType } from "@/lib/aplus-module-specs";

// ── MIME → extension map ──────────────────────────────────────

const MIME_TO_EXT: Record<string, string> = {
  "image/jpeg": "jpg",
  "image/jpg": "jpg",
  "image/png": "png",
  "image/gif": "gif",
  "image/webp": "webp",
  "image/svg+xml": "svg",
  "video/mp4": "mp4",
  "video/quicktime": "mov",
  "video/webm": "webm",
  "application/pdf": "pdf",
  "application/msword": "doc",
  "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document": "docx",
  "text/plain": "txt",
  "text/csv": "csv",
};

function extFromMime(mimeType: string): string {
  const mapped = MIME_TO_EXT[mimeType.toLowerCase()];
  if (mapped) return mapped;
  // Fallback: extract subtype (e.g. "image/webp" → "webp")
  const sub = mimeType.split("/")[1] ?? "bin";
  // Normalize "jpeg" to "jpg"
  return sub === "jpeg" ? "jpg" : sub;
}

// ── buildFileName ──────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface BuildFileNameOptions {
  clientIdCode: string;
  asin?: string | null;
  folderType: string;
  imageSlot?: string | null;
  mimeType: string;
}

/**
 * Build a deterministic, collision-resistant file name.
 * Convention: {clientIdCode}_{ASIN}_{folderType}_{slot}_{unix_ts}.{ext}
 *
 * - asin: "noa" placeholder if not provided
 * - imageSlot: "0" placeholder if not provided
 * - timestamp: seconds since epoch (not milliseconds)
 *
 * Example: ABC_B08XYZ_aplus_01_1710000000.jpg
 */
export function buildFileName(opts: BuildFileNameOptions): string {
  const { clientIdCode, asin, folderType, imageSlot, mimeType } = opts;
  const asinPart = asin?.trim() || "noa";
  const slotPart = imageSlot?.trim() || "0";
  const ts = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  const ext = extFromMime(mimeType);
  return `${clientIdCode}_${asinPart}_${folderType}_${slotPart}_${ts}.${ext}`;
}

// ── resolveUploadFolder ────────────────────────────────────────

export interface ResolveUploadFolderOptions {
  clientIdCode: string;
  folderType: string;
  asin?: string | null;
}

export interface ResolvedFolder {
  id: string;
  driveFolderId: string;
}

/**
 * Resolve the target Drive folder for an upload.
 *
 * 1. Look up the base typed folder (e.g. "aplus") for the client.
 *    Returns null if not found — client not onboarded.
 * 2. If no ASIN provided, return the base folder directly.
 * 3. Check for an existing ASIN subfolder by path.
 * 4. If found, return it.
 * 5. If not found, create it in Drive and insert a DB row.
 *    Uses onConflictDoNothing() to handle concurrent creation.
 *    On conflict, re-fetches the existing row.
 */
export async function resolveUploadFolder(
  opts: ResolveUploadFolderOptions
): Promise<ResolvedFolder | null> {
  const { clientIdCode, folderType, asin } = opts;

  // Step 1: Find the base typed folder for this client
  const baseFolders = await db
    .select({
      id: driveFolders.id,
      driveFolderId: driveFolders.driveFolderId,
      path: driveFolders.path,
    })
    .from(driveFolders)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(driveFolders.clientIdCode, clientIdCode),
        eq(driveFolders.folderType, folderType)
      )
    )
    .limit(1);

  let baseFolder = baseFolders[0] ?? null;

  // Auto-create the typed folder if it doesn't exist but the client root does
  if (!baseFolder) {
    const clientRootRows = await db
      .select({
        id: driveFolders.id,
        driveFolderId: driveFolders.driveFolderId,
        path: driveFolders.path,
      })
      .from(driveFolders)
      .where(
        and(
          eq(driveFolders.clientIdCode, clientIdCode),
          eq(driveFolders.folderType, "client")
        )
      )
      .limit(1);

    const clientRoot = clientRootRows[0] ?? null;
    if (!clientRoot) return null; // No client root at all — truly not onboarded

    // Build intermediate folders: client root → Graphics → A+ Content (for aplus type)
    // Convention: displayName for Drive + path, dbName = "{clientIdCode}_{displayName}"
    const foldersToCreate =
      folderType === "aplus"
        ? [
            { displayName: "Graphics", dbName: `${clientIdCode}_Graphics`, type: "graphics" },
            { displayName: "A+ Content", dbName: `${clientIdCode}_A+ Content`, type: "aplus" },
          ]
        : [{ displayName: folderType, dbName: `${clientIdCode}_${folderType}`, type: folderType }];

    let parentDriveId = clientRoot.driveFolderId;
    let parentPath = clientRoot.path;
    let parentDbId = clientRoot.id;

    for (const level of foldersToCreate) {
      const levelPath = `${parentPath}/${level.displayName}`;

      // Check if this level already exists
      const existingRows = await db
        .select({ id: driveFolders.id, driveFolderId: driveFolders.driveFolderId, path: driveFolders.path })
        .from(driveFolders)
        .where(eq(driveFolders.path, levelPath))
        .limit(1);

      if (existingRows[0]) {
        parentDriveId = existingRows[0].driveFolderId;
        parentPath = existingRows[0].path;
        parentDbId = existingRows[0].id;
        continue;
      }

      // Create in Drive (prefixed name, e.g. "C23_SC_US_Graphics")
      const driveFolder = await driveClient.createFolder(level.dbName, parentDriveId);

      // Insert DB row with race-condition safety
      const inserted = await db
        .insert(driveFolders)
        .values({
          clientIdCode,
          driveFolderId: driveFolder.id,
          folderType: level.type,
          path: levelPath,
          parentFolderId: parentDbId,
          name: level.dbName,
        })
        .onConflictDoNothing()
        .returning({ id: driveFolders.id, driveFolderId: driveFolders.driveFolderId, path: driveFolders.path });

      if (inserted[0]) {
        parentDriveId = inserted[0].driveFolderId;
        parentPath = inserted[0].path;
        parentDbId = inserted[0].id;
      } else {
        const refetched = await db
          .select({ id: driveFolders.id, driveFolderId: driveFolders.driveFolderId, path: driveFolders.path })
          .from(driveFolders)
          .where(eq(driveFolders.path, levelPath))
          .limit(1);
        if (!refetched[0]) return null;
        parentDriveId = refetched[0].driveFolderId;
        parentPath = refetched[0].path;
        parentDbId = refetched[0].id;
      }
    }

    baseFolder = { id: parentDbId, driveFolderId: parentDriveId, path: parentPath };
  }

  // Step 2: No ASIN → return base folder
  if (!asin?.trim()) {
    return { id: baseFolder.id, driveFolderId: baseFolder.driveFolderId };
  }

  const asinTrimmed = asin.trim();
  const asinPath = `${baseFolder.path}/${asinTrimmed}`;

  // Step 3: Check for existing ASIN subfolder
  const existingRows = await db
    .select({ id: driveFolders.id, driveFolderId: driveFolders.driveFolderId })
    .from(driveFolders)
    .where(eq(driveFolders.path, asinPath))
    .limit(1);

  // Step 4: Found existing ASIN subfolder — return it
  if (existingRows[0]) {
    return existingRows[0];
  }

  // Step 5: Create ASIN subfolder in Drive
  const driveFolder = await driveClient.createFolder(
    `${clientIdCode} - ${asinTrimmed}`,
    baseFolder.driveFolderId
  );

  // Step 6: Insert DB row — onConflictDoNothing handles race condition
  const inserted = await db
    .insert(driveFolders)
    .values({
      clientIdCode,
      driveFolderId: driveFolder.id,
      folderType: "asin",
      path: asinPath,
      parentFolderId: baseFolder.id,
      name: `${clientIdCode} - ${asinTrimmed}`,
    })
    .onConflictDoNothing()
    .returning({ id: driveFolders.id, driveFolderId: driveFolders.driveFolderId });

  // Step 7: If insert succeeded, return new row; else re-fetch (concurrent creation won the race)
  if (inserted[0]) {
    return inserted[0];
  }

  // Re-fetch the row that won the race
  const refetchedRows = await db
    .select({ id: driveFolders.id, driveFolderId: driveFolders.driveFolderId })
    .from(driveFolders)
    .where(eq(driveFolders.path, asinPath))
    .limit(1);

  return refetchedRows[0] ?? null;
}

// ── A+ Content SOP naming ──────────────────────────────────────

/** Zero-pad a number to 2 digits */
function pad2(n: number): string {
  return n.toString().padStart(2, "0");
}

export interface BuildAplusFileNameOptions {
  clientIdCode: string;
  version: number;
  scopeType: AplusScopeType;
  modulePosition: number;
  moduleType: AplusModuleType;
  /** The file slot key (e.g. "MAIN", "BG", "COMP3", "SL2") */
  slotKey: string;
  device: AplusDevice;
  /** true = video file (.mp4), false = image (.png) */
  isVideo?: boolean;
  /** Specific ASIN — required for ASIN scope */
  asin?: string;
  /** Group number — required for GRP scope */
  groupNumber?: number;
}

/**
 * Build an SOP-compliant A+ Content filename.
 *
 * Images:
 *   VAR:  DRC_SC_US_V01_M3_PSIC_PAN1_DV_IMG.png
 *   GRP:  DRC_SC_US_V01G01_M3_PSIC_PAN1_DV_IMG.png
 *   ASIN: DRC_SC_US_V01_B0DCLWMB4Y_M3_PSIC_PAN1_DV_IMG.png
 *
 * Videos: DRC_SC_US_V01_M3_PFV_VIDEO.mp4
 */
export function buildAplusFileName(opts: BuildAplusFileNameOptions): string {
  const { clientIdCode, version, scopeType, modulePosition, moduleType, slotKey, device, isVideo, asin, groupNumber } = opts;
  const typeCode = MODULE_TYPE_CODES[moduleType];
  const scopeSeg = buildScopeSegment(version, scopeType, asin, groupNumber);
  const prefix = `${clientIdCode}_${scopeSeg}_M${modulePosition}`;

  if (isVideo) {
    return `${prefix}_${typeCode}_VIDEO.mp4`;
  }

  return `${prefix}_${typeCode}_${slotKey}_${device}_IMG.png`;
}

export interface ResolveAplusFolderOptions {
  clientIdCode: string;
  marketplace: string;
  platform: AplusPlatform;
  scopeType: AplusScopeType;
  version: number;
  contentType?: "PA+" | "BA+";
  /** Specific ASIN — for ASIN scope */
  asin?: string;
  /** Group number — for GRP scope */
  groupNumber?: number;
}

/**
 * Resolve (find or create) the full A+ folder hierarchy in Drive.
 *
 * Hierarchy (under existing client root folder):
 *   Graphics/
 *     A+ Content/
 *       PA+/
 *         {scopeFolder}/
 *           (files go here — no version subfolder, version is in the scope segment)
 *
 * DB name convention: "{clientIdCode}_{DisplayName}" (e.g. "C23_SC_US_Graphics")
 * Drive folder name + path: uses display name only (e.g. "Graphics")
 *
 * Scope folder examples:
 *   VAR:  V01
 *   GRP:  V01G01
 *   ASIN: V01_B0DCLWMB4Y
 */
export async function resolveAplusFolder(
  opts: ResolveAplusFolderOptions
): Promise<ResolvedFolder | null> {
  const {
    clientIdCode,
    scopeType,
    version,
    contentType = "PA+",
    asin,
    groupNumber,
  } = opts;

  const scopeFolder = buildScopeSegment(version, scopeType, asin, groupNumber);

  // Build the folder chain (each level depends on the parent)
  // Drive name uses "{clientIdCode}_{DisplayName}" convention; path uses just the display name
  const folderChain = [
    { name: clientIdCode, displayName: clientIdCode, type: "client" },
    { name: `${clientIdCode}_Graphics`, displayName: "Graphics", type: "graphics" },
    { name: `${clientIdCode}_A+ Content`, displayName: "A+ Content", type: "aplus" },
    { name: `${clientIdCode}_${contentType}`, displayName: contentType, type: "aplus-tier" },
    { name: `${clientIdCode}_${scopeFolder}`, displayName: scopeFolder, type: "aplus-scope" },
  ];

  // Start from the client's base folder in Drive
  const clientRootRows = await db
    .select({
      id: driveFolders.id,
      driveFolderId: driveFolders.driveFolderId,
      path: driveFolders.path,
    })
    .from(driveFolders)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(driveFolders.clientIdCode, clientIdCode),
        eq(driveFolders.folderType, "client")
      )
    )
    .limit(1);

  const clientRoot = clientRootRows[0] ?? null;
  if (!clientRoot) {
    return null;
  }

  // Walk / create each level of the hierarchy
  let currentParentDriveId = clientRoot.driveFolderId;
  let currentPath = clientRoot.path;
  let currentDbId = clientRoot.id;

  // Skip the first level (client root) since it already exists
  for (let i = 1; i < folderChain.length; i++) {
    const level = folderChain[i];
    // Path uses displayName (e.g. "Graphics"), DB name uses full name (e.g. "C23_SC_US_Graphics")
    const levelPath = `${currentPath}/${level.displayName}`;

    // Check if this level exists
    const existingRows = await db
      .select({
        id: driveFolders.id,
        driveFolderId: driveFolders.driveFolderId,
        path: driveFolders.path,
      })
      .from(driveFolders)
      .where(eq(driveFolders.path, levelPath))
      .limit(1);

    if (existingRows[0]) {
      currentParentDriveId = existingRows[0].driveFolderId;
      currentPath = existingRows[0].path;
      currentDbId = existingRows[0].id;
      continue;
    }

    // Create folder in Drive (prefixed name, e.g. "C23_SC_US_PA+")
    const driveFolder = await driveClient.createFolder(
      level.name,
      currentParentDriveId
    );

    // Insert DB row with race-condition safety
    const inserted = await db
      .insert(driveFolders)
      .values({
        clientIdCode,
        driveFolderId: driveFolder.id,
        folderType: level.type,
        path: levelPath,
        parentFolderId: currentDbId,
        name: level.name,
      })
      .onConflictDoNothing()
      .returning({
        id: driveFolders.id,
        driveFolderId: driveFolders.driveFolderId,
        path: driveFolders.path,
      });

    if (inserted[0]) {
      currentParentDriveId = inserted[0].driveFolderId;
      currentPath = inserted[0].path;
      currentDbId = inserted[0].id;
    } else {
      // Race condition: another request created it first — re-fetch
      const refetched = await db
        .select({
          id: driveFolders.id,
          driveFolderId: driveFolders.driveFolderId,
          path: driveFolders.path,
        })
        .from(driveFolders)
        .where(eq(driveFolders.path, levelPath))
        .limit(1);

      if (!refetched[0]) return null;
      currentParentDriveId = refetched[0].driveFolderId;
      currentPath = refetched[0].path;
      currentDbId = refetched[0].id;
    }
  }

  return { id: currentDbId, driveFolderId: currentParentDriveId };
}

const RESEND_API_URL = "https://api.resend.com/emails";

interface EmailParams {
  to: string;
  subject: string;
  html: string;
}

/**
 * Send an email via Resend API.
 * Requires RESEND_API_KEY env var.
 * Falls back silently if not configured (logs warning).
 */
export async function sendEmail({ to, subject, html }: EmailParams): Promise<boolean> {
  const apiKey = process.env.RESEND_API_KEY;
  if (!apiKey) {
    console.warn("[email] RESEND_API_KEY not set — skipping email");
    return false;
  }

  try {
    const res = await fetch(RESEND_API_URL, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        from: process.env.RESEND_FROM_EMAIL || "1o8 Hub <noreply@1o8.agency>",
        to: [to],
        subject,
        html,
      }),
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.text();
      console.error("[email] Resend error:", res.status, err);
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[email] Failed to send:", err);
    return false;
  }
}

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { adminEventLog } from "@/lib/db/schema";

type LogEventParams = {
  userEmail?: string | null;
  userName?: string | null;
  section: string;
  action: string;
  status?: "success" | "error" | "warning";
  resourceType?: string;
  resourceId?: string;
  resourceLabel?: string;
  message?: string;
  detail?: Record<string, unknown>;
  durationMs?: number;
};

/**
 * Fire-and-forget event logger. Writes to admin_event_log.
 * Never throws — errors are silently logged to console.
 */
export function logEvent(params: LogEventParams): void {
  const row = {
    userEmail: params.userEmail ?? null,
    userName: params.userName ?? null,
    section: params.section,
    action: params.action,
    status: params.status ?? "success",
    resourceType: params.resourceType ?? null,
    resourceId: params.resourceId ?? null,
    resourceLabel: params.resourceLabel ?? null,
    message: params.message ?? null,
    detail: params.detail ?? null,
    durationMs: params.durationMs ?? null,
  };

  db.insert(adminEventLog)
    .values(row)
    .execute()
    .catch((err) => {
      console.error("[event-logger] Failed to write event:", err.message);
    });
}

/**
 * Firecrawl integration for Amazon product scraping.
 * Uses Firecrawl's scrape API to extract structured data from Amazon product pages,
 * then maps the result to RainforestProduct shape for compatibility.
 */

import type { RainforestProduct } from "@/types/rainforest";

const FIRECRAWL_API_URL = "https://api.firecrawl.dev/v1/scrape";

interface FirecrawlScrapeResponse {
  success: boolean;
  data?: {
    markdown?: string;
    metadata?: {
      title?: string;
      description?: string;
      ogImage?: string;
      [key: string]: unknown;
    };
    extract?: Record<string, unknown>;
  };
  error?: string;
}

const AMAZON_PRODUCT_SCHEMA = {
  type: "object" as const,
  properties: {
    title: { type: "string" as const },
    brand: { type: "string" as const },
    price: { type: "number" as const },
    price_raw: { type: "string" as const },
    availability: { type: "string" as const },
    rating: { type: "number" as const },
    ratings_total: { type: "number" as const },
    feature_bullets: { type: "array" as const, items: { type: "string" as const } },
    main_image_url: { type: "string" as const },
    images_count: { type: "number" as const },
    categories: { type: "array" as const, items: { type: "string" as const } },
    bestseller_rank_1: { type: "string" as const },
    bestseller_category_1: { type: "string" as const },
    bestseller_rank_2: { type: "string" as const },
    bestseller_category_2: { type: "string" as const },
    is_prime: { type: "boolean" as const },
    manufacturer: { type: "string" as const },
    dimensions: { type: "string" as const },
    weight: { type: "string" as const },
    date_first_available: { type: "string" as const },
    parent_asin: { type: "string" as const },
    has_a_plus_content: { type: "boolean" as const },
    has_brand_story: { type: "boolean" as const },
    recent_sales: { type: "string" as const },
    variant_asins: { type: "array" as const, items: { type: "string" as const } },
    ingredients: { type: "array" as const, items: { type: "string" as const } },
    subscribe_and_save_discount: { type: "string" as const },
    unit_price: { type: "string" as const },
  },
};

/**
 * Scrape an Amazon product page via Firecrawl and return a RainforestProduct-compatible object.
 */
export async function scrapeAmazonProduct(
  asin: string,
  amazonDomain: string = "amazon.com"
): Promise<{ product: RainforestProduct; creditsUsed: number }> {
  const apiKey = process.env.FIRECRAWL_API_KEY;
  if (!apiKey) {
    throw new Error("FIRECRAWL_API_KEY not configured");
  }

  const productUrl = `https://www.${amazonDomain}/dp/${asin}`;

  const response = await fetch(FIRECRAWL_API_URL, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      url: productUrl,
      formats: ["extract"],
      extract: {
        schema: AMAZON_PRODUCT_SCHEMA,
        prompt: "Extract Amazon product listing data including title, brand, price, bullets, images, ratings, BSR, availability, dimensions, and variant information.",
      },
    }),
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(45000),
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    const errText = await response.text().catch(() => "Unknown error");
    throw new Error(`Firecrawl API returned ${response.status}: ${errText}`);
  }

  const result: FirecrawlScrapeResponse = await response.json();

  if (!result.success || !result.data?.extract) {
    throw new Error(result.error || "Firecrawl extraction failed");
  }

  const ext = result.data.extract;

  // Map Firecrawl extracted data to RainforestProduct shape
  const product: RainforestProduct = {
    asin,
    title: str(ext.title),
    brand: str(ext.brand),
    parent_asin: str(ext.parent_asin) ?? undefined,
    manufacturer: str(ext.manufacturer) ?? undefined,
    main_image: ext.main_image_url ? { link: String(ext.main_image_url) } : undefined,
    images_count: num(ext.images_count),
    feature_bullets: Array.isArray(ext.feature_bullets)
      ? ext.feature_bullets.map(String)
      : undefined,
    feature_bullets_count: Array.isArray(ext.feature_bullets)
      ? ext.feature_bullets.length
      : undefined,
    rating: num(ext.rating),
    ratings_total: num(ext.ratings_total),
    dimensions: str(ext.dimensions) ?? undefined,
    weight: str(ext.weight) ?? undefined,
    first_available: ext.date_first_available
      ? { raw: String(ext.date_first_available), utc: "" }
      : undefined,
    categories_flat: Array.isArray(ext.categories)
      ? ext.categories.join(" > ")
      : str(ext.categories) ?? undefined,
    bestsellers_rank: buildBsrArray(ext),
    buybox_winner: buildBuybox(ext),
    a_plus_content: {
      has_a_plus_content: ext.has_a_plus_content === true,
      has_brand_story: ext.has_brand_story === true,
    },
    recent_sales: str(ext.recent_sales) ?? undefined,
    variants: Array.isArray(ext.variant_asins)
      ? ext.variant_asins.map((a: unknown) => ({
          asin: String(a),
          title: "",
          is_current_product: String(a) === asin,
          link: `https://www.${amazonDomain}/dp/${a}`,
        }))
      : undefined,
    ingredients: Array.isArray(ext.ingredients)
      ? ext.ingredients.map(String)
      : undefined,
  };

  return { product, creditsUsed: 1 };
}

function str(v: unknown): string | undefined {
  if (v == null || v === "") return undefined;
  return String(v);
}

function num(v: unknown): number | undefined {
  if (v == null) return undefined;
  const n = Number(v);
  return isNaN(n) ? undefined : n;
}

function buildBsrArray(
  ext: Record<string, unknown>
): { rank: number; category: string; link: string }[] | undefined {
  const ranks: { rank: number; category: string; link: string }[] = [];

  const rank1 = parseInt(String(ext.bestseller_rank_1 ?? "").replace(/[#,]/g, ""));
  if (!isNaN(rank1) && ext.bestseller_category_1) {
    ranks.push({ rank: rank1, category: String(ext.bestseller_category_1), link: "" });
  }

  const rank2 = parseInt(String(ext.bestseller_rank_2 ?? "").replace(/[#,]/g, ""));
  if (!isNaN(rank2) && ext.bestseller_category_2) {
    ranks.push({ rank: rank2, category: String(ext.bestseller_category_2), link: "" });
  }

  return ranks.length > 0 ? ranks : undefined;
}

function buildBuybox(ext: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const price = num(ext.price);
  if (price == null) return undefined;

  return {
    price: {
      symbol: "$",
      value: price,
      currency: "USD",
      raw: str(ext.price_raw) ?? `$${price.toFixed(2)}`,
    },
    unit_price: ext.unit_price
      ? { symbol: "$", value: 0, currency: "USD", raw: String(ext.unit_price) }
      : undefined,
    availability: {
      type: ext.availability ? "string" : "unknown",
      raw: str(ext.availability) ?? "",
    },
    fulfillment: {
      type: "",
      is_fulfilled_by_amazon: false,
      is_sold_by_amazon: false,
      is_fulfilled_by_third_party: false,
      is_sold_by_third_party: false,
    },
    is_prime: ext.is_prime === true,
    subscribe_and_save: ext.subscribe_and_save_discount
      ? { base_discount_percentage: 0, base_price: { symbol: "$", value: 0, currency: "USD", raw: "" } }
      : undefined,
  };
}

// Shared number formatters for sales/analytics tables

export function fmtCurrency(n: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (n == null) return "\u2014";
  const formatted = Math.abs(n).toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  return n < 0 ? `-$${formatted}` : `$${formatted}`;
}

export function fmtInt(n: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (n == null) return "\u2014";
  return Math.round(n).toLocaleString();
}

export function fmtPct(n: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (n == null) return "\u2014";
  return n.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }) + "%";
}

export function fmtDec(n: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (n == null) return "\u2014";
  return n.toLocaleString(undefined, { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Shared GCP service account auth helper
// — Extracts JWT pattern from seo-manager/export-gdoc
// — In-memory token cache with 50-min TTL (tokens expire at 60 min)
// — No googleapis dependency: raw fetch + Node.js crypto only
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import crypto from "crypto";

// ── Token cache ──────────────────────────────────────────────

interface CachedToken {
  token: string;
  expiresAt: number; // epoch ms
}

// Keyed by scopes string (sorted scopes joined by " ")
const tokenCache = new Map<string, CachedToken>();

const TOKEN_TTL_MS = 50 * 60 * 1000; // 50 minutes

// ── Private key parsing (tries every format) ─────────────────

function parsePrivateKey(raw: string): crypto.KeyObject {
  // Step 1: replace escaped newlines
  const cleaned = raw.replace(/\\n/g, "\n");

  // Try as-is first (already valid PEM)
  try { return crypto.createPrivateKey(cleaned); } catch (_) {}

  // Extract raw base64 content
  const b64 = cleaned
    .replace(/-----BEGIN [A-Z ]+-----/g, "")
    .replace(/-----END [A-Z ]+-----/g, "")
    .replace(/\s+/g, "");

  const wrap = (h: string) => {
    const lines = b64.match(/.{1,64}/g) || [];
    return `-----BEGIN ${h}-----\n${lines.join("\n")}\n-----END ${h}-----\n`;
  };

  // Try PKCS#8 PEM
  try { return crypto.createPrivateKey(wrap("PRIVATE KEY")); } catch (_) {}
  // Try PKCS#1 PEM
  try { return crypto.createPrivateKey(wrap("RSA PRIVATE KEY")); } catch (_) {}
  // Try DER PKCS#8
  try { return crypto.createPrivateKey({ key: Buffer.from(b64, "base64"), format: "der", type: "pkcs8" }); } catch (_) {}
  // Try DER PKCS#1
  try { return crypto.createPrivateKey({ key: Buffer.from(b64, "base64"), format: "der", type: "pkcs1" }); } catch (_) {}

  // All failed — include diagnostics
  throw new Error(
    `Cannot parse GCP private key. len=${raw.length}, ` +
    `starts="${raw.substring(0, 40)}", ` +
    `hasLiteralBackslashN=${raw.includes("\\n")}, ` +
    `hasRealNewline=${raw.includes("\n")}, ` +
    `b64len=${b64.length}`
  );
}

// ── Google OAuth2 via manual JWT (RS256) ─────────────────────

function createJWT(
  email: string,
  privateKey: crypto.KeyObject,
  scopes: string[]
): string {
  const header = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ alg: "RS256", typ: "JWT" })).toString("base64url");
  const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
  const claims: Record<string, unknown> = {
    iss: email,
    scope: scopes.join(" "),
    aud: "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token",
    iat: now,
    exp: now + 3600,
  };
  const payload = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(claims)).toString("base64url");
  const input = `${header}.${payload}`;
  const signer = crypto.createSign("RSA-SHA256");
  signer.update(input);
  const signature = signer.sign(privateKey, "base64url");
  return `${input}.${signature}`;
}

// ── Public API ────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Returns a valid Google OAuth2 access token for the given scopes.
 * Credentials are read from process.env at call time (not at module init).
 * Token is cached for 50 minutes (tokens expire at 60 min).
 *
 * @param scopes - Array of OAuth2 scope URLs
 */
export async function getAccessToken(scopes: string[]): Promise<string> {
  const cacheKey = [...scopes].sort().join(" ");
  const now = Date.now();

  // Return cached token if still valid
  const cached = tokenCache.get(cacheKey);
  if (cached && cached.expiresAt > now) {
    return cached.token;
  }

  // Read env at call time — never at module init
  const email = process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL?.trim();
  const rawKey = process.env.GCP_PRIVATE_KEY?.trim();

  if (!email || !rawKey) {
    throw new Error(
      `GCP credentials not configured. Missing: ${[!email && "GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL", !rawKey && "GCP_PRIVATE_KEY"].filter(Boolean).join(", ")}`
    );
  }

  const privateKey = parsePrivateKey(rawKey);
  const jwt = createJWT(email, privateKey, scopes);

  const res = await fetch("https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
    body: `grant_type=urn%3Aietf%3Aparams%3Aoauth%3Agrant-type%3Ajwt-bearer&assertion=${jwt}`,
  });

  if (!res.ok) {
    const text = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`GCP token exchange failed (${res.status}): ${text}`);
  }

  const data = await res.json();
  if (!data.access_token) {
    throw new Error(`GCP token exchange returned no access_token: ${JSON.stringify(data)}`);
  }

  // Cache the token
  tokenCache.set(cacheKey, {
    token: data.access_token as string,
    expiresAt: now + TOKEN_TTL_MS,
  });

  return data.access_token as string;
}
