/**
 * Revenue Attribution — snapshot capture helpers.
 *
 * Captures before/after sales metrics from Redshift when content changes go live.
 *
 *   content edit ──► captureBeforeSnapshot() ──► 14 days ──► captureAfterSnapshot()
 *                    (14-day avg before)                     (14-day avg after)
 */
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { master, contentImpactSnapshots } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq, and } from "drizzle-orm";
import { queryRedshift } from "@/lib/redshift";
import { logEvent } from "@/lib/event-logger";

const RS_SCHEMA = "intentwise_ecommerce_graph";
const RS_TABLE = `"${RS_SCHEMA}"."account_summary"`;

interface RedshiftAvg {
  avg_units: string;
  avg_revenue: string;
  avg_sessions: string;
}

async function fetch14DayAvg(asin: string): Promise<Record<string, number>> {
  const rows = await queryRedshift<RedshiftAvg>(`
    SELECT
      ROUND(AVG(ordered_units)) AS avg_units,
      ROUND(AVG(ordered_revenue) * 100) AS avg_revenue,
      ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(mobile_app_sessions, 0) + COALESCE(browser_session, 0))) AS avg_sessions
    FROM ${RS_TABLE}
    WHERE report_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 14
      AND report_date < CURRENT_DATE
      AND asin = '${asin.replace(/'/g, "''")}'
  `);

  if (rows.length === 0) {
    return {};
  }

  const row = rows[0];
  return {
    avgDailyUnits: row.avg_units ? parseInt(row.avg_units, 10) : 0,
    avgDailyRevenue: row.avg_revenue ? parseInt(row.avg_revenue, 10) : 0,
    avgDailySessions: row.avg_sessions ? parseInt(row.avg_sessions, 10) : 0,
  };
}

/**
 * Capture a BEFORE snapshot when content is marked 'live' or edited.
 * Best-effort — never throws. Errors are logged and swallowed.
 */
export async function captureBeforeSnapshot(productId: string): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const [product] = await db
      .select({
        asin: master.asin,
        clientIdCode: master.clientIdCode,
      })
      .from(master)
      .where(eq(master.id, productId))
      .limit(1);

    if (!product?.asin) {
      console.warn("[impact] No product/ASIN found for", productId);
      return;
    }

    const metrics = await fetch14DayAvg(product.asin);

    await db.insert(contentImpactSnapshots).values({
      productId,
      asin: product.asin,
      clientIdCode: product.clientIdCode ?? "unknown",
      changeType: "aplus_update",
      changeSummary: "A+ content marked as live",
      changeCount: 1,
      changedBy: "system",
      beforeMetrics: metrics,
      status: "pending_after",
    });

    logEvent({
      section: "impact",
      action: "snapshot:before",
      status: metrics.avgDailyUnits !== undefined ? "success" : "warning",
      resourceType: "product",
      resourceId: productId,
      resourceLabel: product.asin,
      message: metrics.avgDailyUnits !== undefined
        ? `Before snapshot: ${metrics.avgDailyUnits} units/day, $${((metrics.avgDailyRevenue ?? 0) / 100).toFixed(2)} rev/day`
        : "Before snapshot captured with no sales data",
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("[impact] Failed to capture before snapshot:", error instanceof Error ? error.message : error);
    logEvent({
      section: "impact",
      action: "snapshot:before",
      status: "error",
      resourceType: "product",
      resourceId: productId,
      message: `Snapshot capture failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : "unknown error"}`,
    });
  }
}

/**
 * Capture an AFTER snapshot for a pending_after snapshot.
 * Called by the daily cron. Best-effort — never throws.
 */
export async function captureAfterSnapshot(snapshotId: number, asin: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const metrics = await fetch14DayAvg(asin);

    await db
      .update(contentImpactSnapshots)
      .set({
        afterMetrics: metrics,
        afterSnapshotAt: new Date(),
        status: "complete",
      })
      .where(
        and(
          eq(contentImpactSnapshots.id, snapshotId),
          eq(contentImpactSnapshots.status, "pending_after")
        )
      );

    logEvent({
      section: "impact",
      action: "snapshot:after",
      status: metrics.avgDailyUnits !== undefined ? "success" : "warning",
      resourceType: "snapshot",
      resourceId: String(snapshotId),
      resourceLabel: asin,
      message: metrics.avgDailyUnits !== undefined
        ? `After snapshot: ${metrics.avgDailyUnits} units/day, $${((metrics.avgDailyRevenue ?? 0) / 100).toFixed(2)} rev/day`
        : "After snapshot captured with no sales data",
    });

    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("[impact] Failed to capture after snapshot:", error instanceof Error ? error.message : error);
    logEvent({
      section: "impact",
      action: "snapshot:after",
      status: "error",
      resourceType: "snapshot",
      resourceId: String(snapshotId),
      message: `After snapshot failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : "unknown error"}`,
    });
    return false;
  }
}

FILE: src/lib/impact-snapshots.ts
================================================
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { contentImpactSnapshots, salesSummaryCache } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { and, eq, lte, isNull } from "drizzle-orm";

const MAX_CACHE_AGE_MS = 12 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 12h — looser than sales cache since we just need a recent snapshot

export interface SalesMetricsSnapshot {
  [key: string]: number;
  product_sales: number;
  ad_spend: number;
  ad_revenue: number;
  ordered_units: number;
  ordered_revenue: number;
  glance_view_byasin: number;
  ad_impressions: number;
  ad_clicks: number;
}

/**
 * Extract client-level sales metrics from the most recent sales summary cache.
 * Returns null if no recent cache entry exists.
 */
async function getClientMetricsFromCache(
  clientIdCode: string
): Promise<SalesMetricsSnapshot | null> {
  // Find the most recent summary cache entry
  const rows = await db
    .select({ data: salesSummaryCache.data, updatedAt: salesSummaryCache.updatedAt })
    .from(salesSummaryCache)
    .where(eq(salesSummaryCache.cacheType, "summary"))
    .orderBy(salesSummaryCache.updatedAt)
    .limit(5);

  for (const row of rows.reverse()) {
    const age = Date.now() - new Date(row.updatedAt).getTime();
    if (age > MAX_CACHE_AGE_MS) continue;

    const data = row.data as { clients?: Array<{ clientIdCode: string; current?: Record<string, number> }> };
    if (!data?.clients) continue;

    const client = data.clients.find((c) => c.clientIdCode === clientIdCode);
    if (!client?.current) continue;

    const m = client.current;
    return {
      product_sales: m.product_sales ?? 0,
      ad_spend: m.ad_spend ?? 0,
      ad_revenue: m.ad_revenue ?? 0,
      ordered_units: m.ordered_units ?? 0,
      ordered_revenue: m.ordered_revenue ?? 0,
      glance_view_byasin: m.glance_view_byasin ?? 0,
      ad_impressions: m.ad_impressions ?? 0,
      ad_clicks: m.ad_clicks ?? 0,
    };
  }

  return null;
}

/**
 * Create an impact snapshot when content changes are made.
 * Tries to fill "before" metrics from the sales cache immediately.
 */
export async function createImpactSnapshot(params: {
  clientIdCode: string;
  productId?: string;
  asin?: string;
  changeType: "product_edit" | "aplus_update" | "bulk_edit";
  changeSummary: string;
  changeCount: number;
  changedBy: string;
}): Promise<void> {
  const beforeMetrics = await getClientMetricsFromCache(params.clientIdCode);

  await db.insert(contentImpactSnapshots).values({
    clientIdCode: params.clientIdCode,
    productId: params.productId ?? null,
    asin: params.asin ?? null,
    changeType: params.changeType,
    changeSummary: params.changeSummary,
    changeCount: params.changeCount,
    changedBy: params.changedBy,
    changedAt: new Date(),
    beforeMetrics: beforeMetrics ?? undefined,
    beforeSnapshotAt: beforeMetrics ? new Date() : null,
    status: beforeMetrics ? "pending_after" : "pending_before",
  });
}

/**
 * Called during sales dashboard loads to fill missing snapshots.
 * - Fill "before" for pending_before snapshots (recent changes without cached data at creation time)
 * - Fill "after" for pending_after snapshots where the impact window has elapsed
 */
export async function fillPendingSnapshots(
  clientIdCode: string,
  currentMetrics: SalesMetricsSnapshot
): Promise<void> {
  const now = new Date();

  // 1. Fill "before" for snapshots that didn't have cache at creation time
  const pendingBefore = await db
    .select({ id: contentImpactSnapshots.id })
    .from(contentImpactSnapshots)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(contentImpactSnapshots.clientIdCode, clientIdCode),
        eq(contentImpactSnapshots.status, "pending_before")
      )
    );

  for (const row of pendingBefore) {
    await db
      .update(contentImpactSnapshots)
      .set({
        beforeMetrics: currentMetrics,
        beforeSnapshotAt: now,
        status: "pending_after",
      })
      .where(eq(contentImpactSnapshots.id, row.id));
  }

  // 2. Fill "after" for snapshots past their impact window
  const windowCutoff = new Date(now.getTime() - 14 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

  const pendingAfter = await db
    .select({ id: contentImpactSnapshots.id })
    .from(contentImpactSnapshots)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(contentImpactSnapshots.clientIdCode, clientIdCode),
        eq(contentImpactSnapshots.status, "pending_after"),
        lte(contentImpactSnapshots.changedAt, windowCutoff)
      )
    );

  for (const row of pendingAfter) {
    await db
      .update(contentImpactSnapshots)
      .set({
        afterMetrics: currentMetrics,
        afterSnapshotAt: now,
        status: "complete",
      })
      .where(eq(contentImpactSnapshots.id, row.id));
  }
}

FILE: src/lib/import-mapper.ts

/**
 * Auto-mapping logic for matching source column headers (CSV or BigQuery)
 * against known column_attributes entries.
 */
import type { ColumnAttribute } from "./db/schema";

export interface ColumnMapping {
  sourceHeader: string;
  bqName: string | null;
  generalLabel: string | null;
  confidence: "exact" | "partial" | "unmapped";
}

function normalize(s: string): string {
  return s.toLowerCase().replace(/[_\s\-]/g, "");
}

export function autoMapColumns(
  sourceHeaders: string[],
  attributes: ColumnAttribute[]
): ColumnMapping[] {
  return sourceHeaders.map((header) => {
    const norm = normalize(header);

    // 1. Exact match on bigqueryLabel
    const exactBq = attributes.find(
      (a) => a.bigqueryLabel && normalize(a.bigqueryLabel) === norm
    );
    if (exactBq) {
      return {
        sourceHeader: header,
        bqName: exactBq.bigqueryLabel,
        generalLabel: exactBq.generalLabel,
        confidence: "exact" as const,
      };
    }

    // 2. Exact match on generalLabel
    const exactGeneral = attributes.find(
      (a) => normalize(a.generalLabel) === norm
    );
    if (exactGeneral) {
      return {
        sourceHeader: header,
        bqName: exactGeneral.bigqueryLabel,
        generalLabel: exactGeneral.generalLabel,
        confidence: "exact" as const,
      };
    }

    // 3. Contains match (only if the normalized strings are >= 4 chars to avoid false positives)
    if (norm.length >= 4) {
      const partial = attributes.find((a) => {
        const normBq = a.bigqueryLabel ? normalize(a.bigqueryLabel) : "";
        const normGen = normalize(a.generalLabel);
        return (
          (normBq.length >= 4 && (normBq.includes(norm) || norm.includes(normBq))) ||
          (normGen.length >= 4 && (normGen.includes(norm) || norm.includes(normGen)))
        );
      });
      if (partial) {
        return {
          sourceHeader: header,
          bqName: partial.bigqueryLabel,
          generalLabel: partial.generalLabel,
          confidence: "partial" as const,
        };
      }
    }

    // 4. No match
    return {
      sourceHeader: header,
      bqName: null,
      generalLabel: null,
      confidence: "unmapped" as const,
    };
  });
}

/**
 * Hierarchical permission resolution for department-based access control.
 *
 * Supports both flat ("seo") and dot-notation ("design.aplus") grants.
 * A department-level grant (e.g., "design") automatically includes all
 * subsections (e.g., "design.aplus", "design.files").
 */

/** All departments and their subsections */
export const DEPARTMENTS = {
  seo: {
    label: "SEO",
    subsections: {
      seo: { label: "SEO Manager" },
    },
  },
  design: {
    label: "Design",
    subsections: {
      brandstory: { label: "Brand Story" },
      aplus: { label: "A+ Content" },
      "listing-images": { label: "Listing Images" },
      storefront: { label: "Storefront" },
      files: { label: "Files" },
    },
  },
  timeline: {
    label: "Timeline",
    subsections: {
      timeline: { label: "Project Timeline" },
    },
  },
  ppc: {
    label: "PPC",
    subsections: {
      sales: { label: "Sales Summary" },
    },
  },
  catalog: {
    label: "Catalog",
    subsections: {

    },
  },

      reports: { label: "Reports" },
      portal: { label: "Client Portal" },
    },
  },
} as const;

export type DepartmentId = keyof typeof DEPARTMENTS;

/**
 * Check if a user can access a section.
 *
 * Resolution order:
 * 1. Admin bypasses all checks
 * 2. Department-level grant ("design") → access to all subsections
 * 3. Subsection-level grant ("design.aplus") → access to that subsection only
 * 4. Legacy flat grant ("aplus") → backward compatible, maps to subsection
 */
export function canAccess(
  section: string,
  allowedSections: string[],
  isAdmin: boolean,
): boolean {
  if (isAdmin) return true;

  // Direct match (flat legacy or department-level)
  if (allowedSections.includes(section)) return true;

  // Check if it's a dot-notation request (e.g., "design.aplus")
  if (section.includes(".")) {
    const [dept] = section.split(".");
    // Department-level grant covers all subsections
    if (allowedSections.includes(dept)) return true;
    // Exact subsection match
    if (allowedSections.includes(section)) return true;
    return false;
  }

  // Check if a department-level grant covers this flat section name
  // e.g., user has "design" → can access "aplus" (which is design.aplus)
  for (const [deptId, dept] of Object.entries(DEPARTMENTS)) {
    if (section in dept.subsections) {
      if (allowedSections.includes(deptId)) return true;
      if (allowedSections.includes(`${deptId}.${section}`)) return true;
    }
  }

  return false;
}

/**
 * Bidirectional mapping between BigQuery flat rows and the app's hybrid DB schema.
 *
 * BQ flat row (972 STRING columns) ↔ App schema (core cols + JSONB blobs + raw)
 */

import { CORE_COLUMNS, getAllColumns } from "./column-registry";
import { COLUMN_GROUPS } from "./column-groups";
import type { NewProduct, Product } from "./db/schema";

/** A flat row from BigQuery — all values are strings */
export type BqRow = Record<string, string>;

/**
 * Map of group ID → JSONB DB field name (for groups stored in JSONB blobs).
 */
const groupToDbField: Record<string, string> = {};
for (const group of COLUMN_GROUPS) {
  if (group.dbField) {
    groupToDbField[group.id] = group.dbField;
  }
}

/**
 * Map a BigQuery flat row to the app's product schema for DB insertion.
 */
export function mapBqRowToProduct(row: BqRow): NewProduct {
  const product: Record<string, unknown> = {};

  // 1. Map core columns
  for (const col of CORE_COLUMNS) {
    if (col.coreField && row[col.bqName] !== undefined) {
      product[col.coreField] = row[col.bqName] || null;
    }
  }

  // 2. Build categorized JSONB blobs
  const jsonbBlobs: Record<string, Record<string, string>> = {};
  const allColumns = getAllColumns();
  const bqNameToCol = new Map(allColumns.map((c) => [c.bqName, c]));

  for (const [bqName, value] of Object.entries(row)) {
    const colDef = bqNameToCol.get(bqName);

    if (!colDef) {
      // Unknown column → goes to "other" blob
      if (!jsonbBlobs["otherAttributes"]) jsonbBlobs["otherAttributes"] = {};
      if (value) jsonbBlobs["otherAttributes"][bqName] = value;
      continue;
    }

    // Skip core columns (already mapped above)
    if (colDef.coreField) continue;

    // Find which JSONB blob this group maps to
    const dbField = groupToDbField[colDef.group];
    if (dbField) {
      if (!jsonbBlobs[dbField]) jsonbBlobs[dbField] = {};
      if (value) jsonbBlobs[dbField][bqName] = value;
    }
  }

  // 3. Assign JSONB blobs to product
  for (const [dbField, blob] of Object.entries(jsonbBlobs)) {
    if (Object.keys(blob).length > 0) {
      product[dbField] = blob;
    }
  }

  // 4. Store the complete raw row for zero-data-loss guarantee
  product.rawColumnValues = row;

  // 5. Set defaults for change tracking
  product.isDirty = false;
  product.changeLog = [];

  return product as NewProduct;
}

/**
 * Map a product from the app's DB schema back to a BigQuery flat row.
 * Uses rawColumnValues as the base, then overlays any changes from core cols + JSONB blobs.
 */
export function mapProductToBqRow(product: Product): BqRow {
  // Start with raw values as base (guarantees all 972 columns are present)
  const row: BqRow = { ...(product.rawColumnValues ?? {}) };

  // Overlay core column values (may have been edited)
  for (const col of CORE_COLUMNS) {
    if (col.coreField) {
      const value = (product as Record<string, unknown>)[col.coreField];
      if (value !== undefined && value !== null) {
        row[col.bqName] = String(value);
      }
    }
  }

  // Overlay JSONB blob values (may have been edited)
  const jsonbFields = [
    "contentSeo",
    "variations",
    "packaging",
    "targetAudience",
    "fulfillment",
    "productAttributes",
    "nutritionSupplements",
    "complianceSafety",
    "images",
    "dimensionsWeight",
    "otherAttributes",
  ] as const;

  for (const field of jsonbFields) {
    const blob = (product as Record<string, unknown>)[field] as
      | Record<string, string>
      | null
      | undefined;
    if (blob) {
      for (const [bqName, value] of Object.entries(blob)) {
        row[bqName] = value;
      }
    }
  }

  return row;
}

/**
 * Get a single field value from a product, checking core fields first, then JSONB blobs.
 */
export function getProductFieldValue(
  product: Product,
  bqName: string
): string | null {
  // Check core columns first
  const coreDef = CORE_COLUMNS.find((c) => c.bqName === bqName);
  if (coreDef?.coreField) {
    const val = (product as Record<string, unknown>)[coreDef.coreField];
    return val != null ? String(val) : null;
  }

  // Check JSONB blobs
  const jsonbFields = [
    "contentSeo",
    "variations",
    "packaging",
    "targetAudience",
    "fulfillment",
    "productAttributes",
    "nutritionSupplements",
    "complianceSafety",
    "images",
    "dimensionsWeight",
    "otherAttributes",
  ] as const;

  for (const field of jsonbFields) {
    const blob = (product as Record<string, unknown>)[field] as
      | Record<string, string>
      | null
      | undefined;
    if (blob && bqName in blob) {
      return blob[bqName] ?? null;
    }
  }

  // Fall back to raw
  return product.rawColumnValues?.[bqName] ?? null;
}

/**
 * Set a single field value on a product. Returns an updated partial product.
 */
export function setProductFieldValue(
  product: Product,
  bqName: string,
  value: string | null
): Partial<Product> {
  const updates: Record<string, unknown> = {};

  // Check if it's a core column
  const coreDef = CORE_COLUMNS.find((c) => c.bqName === bqName);
  if (coreDef?.coreField) {
    updates[coreDef.coreField] = value;
    return updates as Partial<Product>;
  }

  // Find which JSONB blob it belongs to
  const allColumns = getAllColumns();
  const colDef = allColumns.find((c) => c.bqName === bqName);
  const groupId = colDef?.group ?? "other";
  const dbField = COLUMN_GROUPS.find((g) => g.id === groupId)?.dbField ?? "otherAttributes";

  if (dbField) {
    const currentBlob =
      ((product as Record<string, unknown>)[dbField] as Record<string, string>) ?? {};
    updates[dbField] = {
      ...currentBlob,
      ...(value != null ? { [bqName]: value } : {}),
    };
    // Remove key if value is null
    if (value == null) {
      const blob = { ...currentBlob };
      delete blob[bqName];
      updates[dbField] = blob;
    }
  }

  return updates as Partial<Product>;
}

/**
 * Resolve a dot-notation path on an object.
 * e.g. getByPath(obj, "buybox_winner.price.raw") -> obj.buybox_winner.price.raw
 */
export function getByPath(obj: Record<string, unknown>, path: string): unknown {
  const parts = path.split(".");
  let current: unknown = obj;
  for (const part of parts) {
    if (current == null || typeof current !== "object") return undefined;
    current = (current as Record<string, unknown>)[part];
  }
  return current;
}

/**
 * Simple in-memory rate limiter for API routes.
 * Works per-serverless-instance on Vercel (not globally shared),
 * but provides per-request protection against rapid abuse.
 * Upgrade to @upstash/ratelimit + Redis for distributed rate limiting.
 */

const rateMap = new Map<string, { count: number; resetAt: number }>();

// Clean up stale entries every 5 minutes
if (typeof setInterval !== "undefined") {
  setInterval(() => {
    const now = Date.now();
    for (const [key, val] of rateMap) {
      if (val.resetAt < now) rateMap.delete(key);
    }
  }, 5 * 60 * 1000);
}

export interface RateLimitResult {
  success: boolean;
  remaining: number;
  resetAt: number;
}

/**
 * Check rate limit for a given identifier.
 * @param identifier - Unique key (e.g., user email or IP)
 * @param limit - Max requests in the window
 * @param windowMs - Time window in milliseconds (default 60s)
 */
export function checkRateLimit(
  identifier: string,
  limit: number,
  windowMs: number = 60_000
): RateLimitResult {
  const now = Date.now();
  const entry = rateMap.get(identifier);

  if (!entry || entry.resetAt < now) {
    rateMap.set(identifier, { count: 1, resetAt: now + windowMs });
    return { success: true, remaining: limit - 1, resetAt: now + windowMs };
  }

  entry.count++;
  if (entry.count > limit) {
    return { success: false, remaining: 0, resetAt: entry.resetAt };
  }

  return { success: true, remaining: limit - entry.count, resetAt: entry.resetAt };
}

/**
 * Amazon Redshift (Intentwise) client for Sales Summary v2.
 *
 * Uses the `pg` library since postgres.js has compatibility issues
 * with Redshift's catalog (missing b.typarray column).
 *
 * Connection: analytics.intentwise.com:5439/data_platform
 * Schema: intentwise_ecommerce_graph
 */
import { Pool, PoolClient } from "pg";

let pool: Pool | null = null;

function getPool(): Pool {
  if (pool) return pool;

  const host = process.env.REDSHIFT_HOST;
  const port = parseInt(process.env.REDSHIFT_PORT || "5439", 10);
  const database = process.env.REDSHIFT_DATABASE;
  const user = process.env.REDSHIFT_USER;
  const password = process.env.REDSHIFT_PASSWORD;

  if (!host || !database || !user || !password) {
    throw new Error(
      "Missing Redshift env vars: REDSHIFT_HOST, REDSHIFT_DATABASE, REDSHIFT_USER, REDSHIFT_PASSWORD"
    );
  }

  pool = new Pool({
    host,
    port,
    database,
    user,
    password,
    ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: false },
    max: 5,
    idleTimeoutMillis: 15000,
    connectionTimeoutMillis: 30000,
    query_timeout: 90000,
  });

  // Reset stale pool on connection errors
  pool.on("error", (err) => {
    console.error("[Redshift] Pool error, resetting:", err.message);
    pool = null;
  });

  return pool;
}

/**
 * Run a raw SQL query against Redshift and return typed rows.
 * Retries once on connection failure (stale pool in serverless).
 */
export async function queryRedshift<T = Record<string, unknown>>(
  query: string
): Promise<T[]> {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 2; attempt++) {
    let client: PoolClient | null = null;
    try {
      const p = getPool();
      client = await p.connect();
      const result = await client.query(query);
      client.release();
      return result.rows as T[];
    } catch (error) {
      if (client) {
        try { client.release(true); } catch { /* ignore */ }
      }
      const msg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
      console.error(`[Redshift] Query failed (attempt ${attempt + 1}):`, msg);
      // On first failure, reset pool and retry (stale connection)
      if (attempt === 0) {
        pool = null;
        continue;
      }
      return [];
    }
  }
  return [];
}

/**
 * Generate a PDF report from ClientReportData using jspdf + jspdf-autotable.
 */
import { jsPDF } from "jspdf";
import autoTable from "jspdf-autotable";
import type { ClientReportData } from "./client-report";

const BRAND_GOLD = "#FAC800";
const BRAND_DARK = "#565454";

function getScoreColor(score: number): string {
  if (score >= 90) return "#10b981";
  if (score >= 70) return BRAND_GOLD;
  if (score >= 50) return "#f97316";
  return "#ef4444";
}

export function generatePdf(data: ClientReportData): Buffer {
  const doc = new jsPDF({ orientation: "landscape", unit: "mm", format: "a4" });
  const pageWidth = doc.internal.pageSize.getWidth();

  // ── Header ──
  doc.setFillColor(BRAND_DARK);
  doc.rect(0, 0, pageWidth, 22, "F");

  doc.setTextColor(BRAND_GOLD);
  doc.setFontSize(18);
  doc.text("1o8 Agency", 14, 14);

  doc.setTextColor(255, 255, 255);
  doc.setFontSize(12);
  doc.text(`Client Report: ${data.clientName}`, 70, 14);

  doc.setFontSize(8);
  doc.setTextColor(200, 200, 200);
  doc.text(
    `Generated ${new Date(data.generatedAt).toLocaleDateString()} | Range: ${new Date(data.dateRange.from).toLocaleDateString()} – ${new Date(data.dateRange.to).toLocaleDateString()}`,
    pageWidth - 14,
    14,
    { align: "right" }
  );

  let y = 30;

  // ── Summary Section ──
  doc.setTextColor(BRAND_DARK);
  doc.setFontSize(14);
  doc.text("Summary", 14, y);
  y += 8;

  // Summary cards
  const cardWidth = 55;
  const cards = [
    { label: "Total Products", value: String(data.summary.totalProducts) },
    { label: "Active Products", value: String(data.summary.activeProducts) },
    { label: "Avg. Readiness", value: `${data.summary.averageScore}%` },
    { label: "Recent Changes", value: String(data.recentChanges.length) },
  ];

  cards.forEach((card, i) => {
    const x = 14 + i * (cardWidth + 6);
    doc.setFillColor(245, 245, 245);
    doc.roundedRect(x, y, cardWidth, 18, 2, 2, "F");
    doc.setFontSize(8);
    doc.setTextColor(120, 120, 120);
    doc.text(card.label, x + 4, y + 6);
    doc.setFontSize(16);
    doc.setTextColor(BRAND_DARK);
    doc.text(card.value, x + 4, y + 15);
  });
  y += 24;

  // Distribution row
  const distItems = [
    { label: "Ready", count: data.summary.distribution.ready, color: "#10b981" },
    { label: "Good", count: data.summary.distribution.good, color: BRAND_GOLD },
    { label: "Incomplete", count: data.summary.distribution.incomplete, color: "#f97316" },
    { label: "Poor", count: data.summary.distribution.poor, color: "#ef4444" },
  ];
  doc.setFontSize(9);
  distItems.forEach((item, i) => {
    const x = 14 + i * 50;
    doc.setTextColor(item.color);
    doc.text(`${item.label}: ${item.count}`, x, y);
  });
  y += 10;

  // ── Products Table ──
  doc.setTextColor(BRAND_DARK);
  doc.setFontSize(14);
  doc.text("Products", 14, y);
  y += 4;

  const productBody = data.products
    .sort((a, b) => a.score - b.score)
    .slice(0, 100)
    .map((p) => [
      p.asin || "—",
      p.sku || "—",
      (p.itemName || "—").slice(0, 60),
      p.status || "—",
      `${p.score}%`,
      String(p.missingRequired.length),
    ]);

  autoTable(doc, {
    startY: y,
    head: [["ASIN", "SKU", "Item Name", "Status", "Score", "Missing"]],
    body: productBody,
    theme: "striped",
    styles: { fontSize: 7, cellPadding: 2 },
    headStyles: {
      fillColor: BRAND_DARK,
      textColor: [255, 255, 255],
      fontSize: 8,
    },
    columnStyles: {
      0: { cellWidth: 28 },
      1: { cellWidth: 35 },
      2: { cellWidth: 100 },
      3: { cellWidth: 18 },
      4: { cellWidth: 18, halign: "center" },
      5: { cellWidth: 18, halign: "center" },
    },
    didParseCell(hookData) {
      if (hookData.section === "body" && hookData.column.index === 4) {
        const score = parseInt(String(hookData.cell.raw).replace("%", ""));
        if (!isNaN(score)) {
          hookData.cell.styles.textColor = getScoreColor(score);
          hookData.cell.styles.fontStyle = "bold";
        }
      }
    },
  });

  // ── Field Coverage Table (new page) ──
  if (data.fieldCoverage.length > 0) {
    doc.addPage();

    // Header on new page
    doc.setFillColor(BRAND_DARK);
    doc.rect(0, 0, pageWidth, 22, "F");
    doc.setTextColor(BRAND_GOLD);
    doc.setFontSize(18);
    doc.text("1o8 Agency", 14, 14);
    doc.setTextColor(255, 255, 255);
    doc.setFontSize(12);
    doc.text("Field Coverage", 70, 14);

    const coverageBody = data.fieldCoverage.slice(0, 150).map((f) => [
      f.fieldLabel,
      f.requirementLevel,
      `${f.filledCount}/${f.totalCount}`,
      `${f.fillRate}%`,
    ]);

    autoTable(doc, {
      startY: 30,
      head: [["Field", "Requirement", "Filled/Total", "Fill Rate"]],
      body: coverageBody,
      theme: "striped",
      styles: { fontSize: 7, cellPadding: 2 },
      headStyles: {
        fillColor: BRAND_DARK,
        textColor: [255, 255, 255],
        fontSize: 8,
      },
      columnStyles: {
        0: { cellWidth: 100 },
        1: { cellWidth: 45 },
        2: { cellWidth: 35, halign: "center" },
        3: { cellWidth: 30, halign: "center" },
      },
      didParseCell(hookData) {
        if (hookData.section === "body" && hookData.column.index === 3) {
          const rate = parseInt(String(hookData.cell.raw).replace("%", ""));
          if (!isNaN(rate)) {
            hookData.cell.styles.textColor = getScoreColor(rate);
            hookData.cell.styles.fontStyle = "bold";
          }
        }
      },
    });
  }

  // ── Recent Changes Table (new page) ──
  if (data.recentChanges.length > 0) {
    doc.addPage();

    doc.setFillColor(BRAND_DARK);
    doc.rect(0, 0, pageWidth, 22, "F");
    doc.setTextColor(BRAND_GOLD);
    doc.setFontSize(18);
    doc.text("1o8 Agency", 14, 14);
    doc.setTextColor(255, 255, 255);
    doc.setFontSize(12);
    doc.text("Recent Changes", 70, 14);

    const changeBody = data.recentChanges.slice(0, 200).map((c) => [
      new Date(c.changedAt).toLocaleDateString(),
      c.asin || "—",
      c.fieldLabel,
      (c.oldValue || "—").slice(0, 40),
      (c.newValue || "—").slice(0, 40),
      c.changedBy,
    ]);

    autoTable(doc, {
      startY: 30,
      head: [["Date", "ASIN", "Field", "Old Value", "New Value", "By"]],
      body: changeBody,
      theme: "striped",
      styles: { fontSize: 7, cellPadding: 2 },
      headStyles: {
        fillColor: BRAND_DARK,
        textColor: [255, 255, 255],
        fontSize: 8,
      },
    });
  }

  // Return as Buffer
  const arrayBuffer = doc.output("arraybuffer");
  return Buffer.from(arrayBuffer);
}

/**
 * Generate an XLSX workbook from ClientReportData using SheetJS.
 */
import * as XLSX from "xlsx";
import type { ClientReportData } from "./client-report";

export function generateXlsx(data: ClientReportData): Buffer {
  const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();

  // ── Sheet 1: Summary ──
  const summaryRows = [
    ["Client Report"],
    [],
    ["Client", data.clientName],
    ["Client Code", data.clientIdCode],
    ["Generated", new Date(data.generatedAt).toLocaleString()],
    [
      "Date Range",
      `${new Date(data.dateRange.from).toLocaleDateString()} – ${new Date(data.dateRange.to).toLocaleDateString()}`,
    ],
    [],
    ["Product Summary"],
    ["Total Products", data.summary.totalProducts],
    ["Active Products", data.summary.activeProducts],
    ["Average Readiness Score", `${data.summary.averageScore}%`],
    [],
    ["Score Distribution"],
    ["Ready (≥90%)", data.summary.distribution.ready],
    ["Good (70–89%)", data.summary.distribution.good],
    ["Incomplete (50–69%)", data.summary.distribution.incomplete],
    ["Poor (<50%)", data.summary.distribution.poor],
    [],
    ["Recent Changes", data.recentChanges.length],
  ];
  const summaryWs = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(summaryRows);
  // Set column widths
  summaryWs["!cols"] = [{ wch: 30 }, { wch: 40 }];
  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, summaryWs, "Summary");

  // ── Sheet 2: Products ──
  const productHeaders = [
    "ASIN",
    "SKU",
    "Item Name",
    "Status",
    "Score",
    "Missing Required",
    "Missing Cond. Required",
  ];
  const productRows = data.products.map((p) => [
    p.asin || "",
    p.sku || "",
    p.itemName || "",
    p.status || "",
    p.score,
    p.missingRequired.join(", "),
    p.missingConditionallyRequired.join(", "),
  ]);
  const productsWs = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet([productHeaders, ...productRows]);
  productsWs["!cols"] = [
    { wch: 14 },
    { wch: 20 },
    { wch: 50 },
    { wch: 10 },
    { wch: 8 },
    { wch: 60 },
    { wch: 60 },
  ];
  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, productsWs, "Products");

  // ── Sheet 3: Recent Changes ──
  if (data.recentChanges.length > 0) {
    const changeHeaders = [
      "Date",
      "ASIN",
      "SKU",
      "Item Name",
      "Field",
      "Old Value",
      "New Value",
      "Changed By",
      "Type",
    ];
    const changeRows = data.recentChanges.map((c) => [
      new Date(c.changedAt).toLocaleString(),
      c.asin || "",
      c.sku || "",
      c.itemName || "",
      c.fieldLabel,
      c.oldValue || "",
      c.newValue || "",
      c.changedBy,
      c.editType,
    ]);
    const changesWs = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet([
      changeHeaders,
      ...changeRows,
    ]);
    changesWs["!cols"] = [
      { wch: 20 },
      { wch: 14 },
      { wch: 20 },
      { wch: 40 },
      { wch: 30 },
      { wch: 30 },
      { wch: 30 },
      { wch: 25 },
      { wch: 8 },
    ];
    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, changesWs, "Recent Changes");
  }

  // ── Sheet 4: Field Coverage ──
  if (data.fieldCoverage.length > 0) {
    const coverageHeaders = [
      "Field",
      "Requirement Level",
      "Filled",
      "Total",
      "Fill Rate",
    ];
    const coverageRows = data.fieldCoverage.map((f) => [
      f.fieldLabel,
      f.requirementLevel,
      f.filledCount,
      f.totalCount,
      `${f.fillRate}%`,
    ]);
    const coverageWs = XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet([
      coverageHeaders,
      ...coverageRows,
    ]);
    coverageWs["!cols"] = [
      { wch: 40 },
      { wch: 25 },
      { wch: 10 },
      { wch: 10 },
      { wch: 12 },
    ];
    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, coverageWs, "Field Coverage");
  }

  // Write to buffer
  const buf = XLSX.write(wb, { type: "buffer", bookType: "xlsx" });
  return Buffer.from(buf);
}

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { salesSummaryCache } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { and, eq } from "drizzle-orm";

const MAX_AGE_MS = 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 6 hours

export async function getCachedData<T>(
  cacheType: string,
  cacheKey: string,
): Promise<T | null> {
  const rows = await db
    .select({ data: salesSummaryCache.data, updatedAt: salesSummaryCache.updatedAt })
    .from(salesSummaryCache)
    .where(
      and(
        eq(salesSummaryCache.cacheType, cacheType),
        eq(salesSummaryCache.cacheKey, cacheKey),
      ),
    )
    .limit(1);

  if (rows.length === 0) return null;

  const row = rows[0];
  const age = Date.now() - new Date(row.updatedAt).getTime();
  if (age > MAX_AGE_MS) return null;

  return row.data as T;
}

export async function setCachedData(
  cacheType: string,
  cacheKey: string,
  data: unknown,
): Promise<void> {
  await db
    .insert(salesSummaryCache)
    .values({
      cacheType,
      cacheKey,
      data: data as Record<string, unknown>,
      updatedAt: new Date(),
    })
    .onConflictDoUpdate({
      target: [salesSummaryCache.cacheType, salesSummaryCache.cacheKey],
      set: {
        data: data as Record<string, unknown>,
        updatedAt: new Date(),
      },
    });
}

export function buildSummaryCacheKey(start: string, end: string): string {
  return `${start}|${end}`;
}

export function buildInventoryCacheKey(
  start: string,
  end: string,
  accountIds: string,
): string {
  const sorted = accountIds.split(",").map((s) => s.trim()).sort().join(",");
  return `${start}|${end}|${sorted}`;
}

export function buildDailyCacheKey(
  start: string,
  end: string,
  accountIds: string,
): string {
  const sorted = accountIds.split(",").map((s) => s.trim()).sort().join(",");
  return `daily|${start}|${end}|${sorted}`;
}

export function buildSnsCacheKey(accountIds: string): string {
  const sorted = accountIds.split(",").map((s) => s.trim()).sort().join(",");
  return `sns|${sorted}`;
}

// Shared utility — builds the SEO Manager config prompt block to inject
// into every Claude API call as the authoritative rules layer.
//
// Sources (in priority order):
//   1. seo-pipeline-config.ts — code-level rules (always present)
//   2. DB seo_settings.config_doc — optional project-level overrides
//
// Usage:
//   const configBlock = await getConfigDocBlock();
//   systemPrompt = configBlock + "\n\n" + routeSpecificPrompt;

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { seoSettings } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { buildConfigPromptBlock } from "@/lib/seo-pipeline-config";

// DB override char limit to avoid excessive token usage.
const DEFAULT_DB_CHAR_LIMIT = 4000;

let dbCache: { value: string; fetchedAt: number } | null = null;
const CACHE_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000; // 5 min in-process cache

async function fetchDbOverrides(): Promise<string> {
  try {
    const rows = await db
      .select({ value: seoSettings.value })
      .from(seoSettings)
      .where(eq(seoSettings.key, "config_doc"))
      .limit(1);
    return rows[0]?.value ?? "";
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}

/**
 * Returns a ready-to-prepend system prompt block containing:
 *   1. The pipeline config rules (from seo-pipeline-config.ts)
 *   2. Any DB-stored project overrides (from seo_settings.config_doc)
 *
 * Always returns at least the pipeline config — never an empty string.
 */
export async function getConfigDocBlock(dbCharLimit = DEFAULT_DB_CHAR_LIMIT): Promise<string> {
  // 1. Pipeline config (always present, generated from code)
  const pipelineBlock = buildConfigPromptBlock();

  // 2. DB overrides (optional, project-specific)
  const now = Date.now();
  if (!dbCache || now - dbCache.fetchedAt > CACHE_TTL_MS) {
    const value = await fetchDbOverrides();
    dbCache = { value, fetchedAt: now };
  }

  const dbDoc = dbCache.value.trim();
  if (!dbDoc) return pipelineBlock;

  const truncated = dbDoc.length > dbCharLimit
    ? dbDoc.slice(0, dbCharLimit) + "\n\n[...project overrides truncated for token budget...]"
    : dbDoc;

  return pipelineBlock + "\n\n=== PROJECT-LEVEL OVERRIDES ===\n" + truncated + "\n=== END PROJECT OVERRIDES ===";
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// seo-docx-builder.ts — Builds the OUT_SEO .docx buffer
// Drive upload is handled separately in the route file.
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import {
  Document, Packer, Paragraph, TextRun, Table, TableRow, TableCell,
  AlignmentType, BorderStyle, WidthType, ShadingType, Footer, PageNumber,
} from "docx";

const ORANGE = "E8602A", DARK = "333333", MID = "666666", LIGHT = "F7F7F7", GREEN = "16A34A", RED = "DC2626";
const cb = { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 1, color: "DDDDDD" };
const borders = { top: cb, bottom: cb, left: cb, right: cb };

const gap = (pts = 120) => new Paragraph({ children: [new TextRun("")], spacing: { after: pts } });

const bodyP = (text: string, color = DARK, size = 22) =>
  new Paragraph({ children: [new TextRun({ text, size, font: "Arial", color })], spacing: { after: 80 } });

const metaP = (label: string, value: string, warn = false) =>
  new Paragraph({
    children: [
      new TextRun({ text: `${label}: `, bold: true, size: 19, font: "Arial", color: MID }),
      new TextRun({ text: value || "—", size: 19, font: "Arial", color: warn ? RED : value ? DARK : "AAAAAA" }),
    ],
    spacing: { after: 60 },
  });

const headingP = (text: string, level: number) =>
  new Paragraph({
    children: [new TextRun({ text, bold: true, font: "Arial", size: level === 1 ? 38 : 27, color: level === 1 ? ORANGE : DARK })],
    spacing: { before: level === 1 ? 480 : 360, after: 120 },
    ...(level === 1 ? { border: { bottom: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 8, color: ORANGE, space: 1 } } } : {}),
  });

const asinHeader = (asin: string, product: string, level: string, attrs: string) => {
  const isParent = level.toLowerCase() === "parent";
  return [
    new Paragraph({
      children: [
        new TextRun({ text: asin, bold: true, size: 24, font: "Courier New", color: ORANGE }),
        new TextRun({ text: `   ${isParent ? "PARENT" : "CHILD"}`, bold: true, size: 18, font: "Arial", color: isParent ? "1D4ED8" : "7C3AED" }),
        ...(product ? [new TextRun({ text: `   ${product}`, size: 22, font: "Arial", color: DARK })] : []),
      ],
      spacing: { before: 480, after: 80 },
      border: { bottom: { style: BorderStyle.SINGLE, size: 3, color: "EEEEEE", space: 1 } },
    }),
    ...(attrs ? [bodyP(attrs, MID, 19)] : []),
    gap(80),
  ];
};

const bRow = (num: number, label: string, text: string, chars: number, lo: number, hi: number) => {
  const warn = chars > 0 && (chars < lo || chars > hi);
  const cc = warn ? RED : chars > 0 ? GREEN : MID;
  return new TableRow({ children: [
    new TableCell({ borders, width:{size:500,type:WidthType.DXA}, shading:{fill:LIGHT,type:ShadingType.CLEAR},
      margins:{top:80,bottom:80,left:100,right:100},
      children:[new Paragraph({alignment:AlignmentType.CENTER,children:[new TextRun({text:String(num),bold:true,size:18,font:"Arial",color:MID})]})] }),
    new TableCell({ borders, width:{size:1300,type:WidthType.DXA}, shading:{fill:LIGHT,type:ShadingType.CLEAR},
      margins:{top:80,bottom:80,left:120,right:120},
      children:[new Paragraph({children:[new TextRun({text:label,bold:true,size:18,font:"Arial",color:MID})]})] }),
    new TableCell({ borders, width:{size:6800,type:WidthType.DXA}, margins:{top:80,bottom:80,left:120,right:120},
      children:[new Paragraph({children:[new TextRun({text:text||"— not generated —",size:20,font:"Arial",color:text?DARK:"BBBBBB"})]})] }),
    new TableCell({ borders, width:{size:760,type:WidthType.DXA}, shading:{fill:LIGHT,type:ShadingType.CLEAR},
      margins:{top:80,bottom:80,left:80,right:80},
      children:[new Paragraph({alignment:AlignmentType.CENTER,children:[new TextRun({text:chars?`${chars}c`:"",size:17,font:"Courier New",color:cc})]})] }),
  ]});
};

const bTable = (rows: TableRow[]) => new Table({ width:{size:9360,type:WidthType.DXA}, columnWidths:[500,1300,6800,760], rows });

export interface DocxRow {
  asin: string; parentage: string; product: string;
  flavor: string; style: string; color: string; size: string;
  title: string; titleC: number;
  d1: string; d1c: number; d2: string; d2c: number; d3: string; d3c: number; d4: string; d4c: number; d5: string; d5c: number;
  c1: string; c1c: number; c2: string; c2c: number; c3: string; c3c: number; c4: string; c4c: number; c5: string; c5c: number;
  ct1: string; ct1c: number; ct2: string; ct2c: number; ct3: string; ct3c: number; ct4: string; ct4c: number; ct5: string; ct5c: number;
  kf1: string; kf1c: number; kf2: string; kf2c: number; kf3: string; kf3c: number; kf4: string; kf4c: number; kf5: string; kf5c: number;
  desc: string; descC: number;
  backend: string; backendB: number;
}

export async function buildDocxBuffer(rows: DocxRow[], brand: string, today: string): Promise<Buffer> {
  const children: any[] = [];

  children.push(gap(240));
  children.push(new Paragraph({ alignment:AlignmentType.CENTER, spacing:{after:80},
    children:[new TextRun({text:"1o8 Marketplace SEO",size:52,bold:true,font:"Arial",color:ORANGE})] }));
  children.push(new Paragraph({ alignment:AlignmentType.CENTER, spacing:{after:80},
    children:[new TextRun({text:"OUT_SEO — Amazon Listing Content Optimization",size:30,font:"Arial",color:MID})] }));
  children.push(new Paragraph({ alignment:AlignmentType.CENTER, spacing:{after:360},
    children:[new TextRun({text:`${brand}  ·  ${rows.length} ASINs  ·  ${today}`,size:22,font:"Arial",color:MID})] }));
  children.push(new Paragraph({
    border:{bottom:{style:BorderStyle.SINGLE,size:10,color:ORANGE,space:1}},
    children:[new TextRun("")], spacing:{after:480},
  }));

  for (const r of rows) {
    const attrs = [r.flavor,r.style,r.color,r.size].filter(Boolean).join("  ·  ");
    children.push(...asinHeader(r.asin, r.product, r.parentage, attrs));

    children.push(headingP("B1 — Title", 2));
    children.push(bodyP(r.title||"— not generated —", r.title?DARK:"BBBBBB"));
    children.push(metaP("Characters", `${r.titleC} / 200`, r.titleC>200||(r.titleC>0&&r.titleC<190)));
    children.push(gap(200));

    children.push(headingP("B2 — Bullet Points", 2));
    children.push(bodyP("Detailed  (390–400 chars)", MID, 19));
    children.push(bTable([bRow(1,"DBP1",r.d1,r.d1c,390,400),bRow(2,"DBP2",r.d2,r.d2c,390,400),bRow(3,"DBP3",r.d3,r.d3c,390,400),bRow(4,"DBP4",r.d4,r.d4c,390,400),bRow(5,"DBP5",r.d5,r.d5c,390,400)]));
    children.push(gap(100));
    children.push(bodyP("Concise  (190–200 chars)", MID, 19));
    children.push(bTable([bRow(1,"CBP1",r.c1,r.c1c,190,200),bRow(2,"CBP2",r.c2,r.c2c,190,200),bRow(3,"CBP3",r.c3,r.c3c,190,200),bRow(4,"CBP4",r.c4,r.c4c,190,200),bRow(5,"CBP5",r.c5,r.c5c,190,200)]));
    children.push(gap(100));
    children.push(bodyP("Content  (90–100 chars)", MID, 19));
    children.push(bTable([bRow(1,"ContBP1",r.ct1,r.ct1c,90,100),bRow(2,"ContBP2",r.ct2,r.ct2c,90,100),bRow(3,"ContBP3",r.ct3,r.ct3c,90,100),bRow(4,"ContBP4",r.ct4,r.ct4c,90,100),bRow(5,"ContBP5",r.ct5,r.ct5c,90,100)]));
    children.push(gap(100));
    children.push(bodyP("Key Features  (40–50 chars)", MID, 19));
    children.push(bTable([bRow(1,"KFBP1",r.kf1,r.kf1c,40,50),bRow(2,"KFBP2",r.kf2,r.kf2c,40,50),bRow(3,"KFBP3",r.kf3,r.kf3c,40,50),bRow(4,"KFBP4",r.kf4,r.kf4c,40,50),bRow(5,"KFBP5",r.kf5,r.kf5c,40,50)]));
    children.push(gap(200));

    children.push(headingP("B3 — Product Description", 2));
    children.push(bodyP(r.desc||"— not generated —", r.desc?DARK:"BBBBBB"));
    children.push(metaP("Characters", `${r.descC} / 1200`, r.descC>1200||(r.descC>0&&r.descC<1000)));
    children.push(gap(200));

    children.push(headingP("B4 — Backend Search Terms", 2));
    const backendWarn = r.backendB > 500;
    children.push(new Table({ width:{size:9360,type:WidthType.DXA}, columnWidths:[9000,360], rows:[
      new TableRow({ children: [
        new TableCell({ borders, width:{size:9000,type:WidthType.DXA}, margins:{top:80,bottom:80,left:120,right:120},
          children:[new Paragraph({children:[new TextRun({text:r.backend||"— not generated —",size:20,font:"Arial",color:r.backend?DARK:"BBBBBB"})]})] }),
        new TableCell({ borders, width:{size:360,type:WidthType.DXA}, shading:{fill:LIGHT,type:ShadingType.CLEAR},
          margins:{top:80,bottom:80,left:80,right:80},
          children:[new Paragraph({alignment:AlignmentType.CENTER,children:[new TextRun({text:r.backendB?`${r.backendB}B`:"",size:17,font:"Courier New",color:backendWarn?RED:r.backendB>0?GREEN:MID})]})] }),
      ]}),
    ]}));
    children.push(gap(400));
  }

  const footerPara = new Paragraph({
    alignment: AlignmentType.CENTER,
    children: [
      new TextRun({ text:`${brand}  ·  1o8 Marketplace SEO  ·  Page `, size:16, font:"Arial", color:"AAAAAA" }),
      new TextRun({ children:[PageNumber.CURRENT], size:16, font:"Arial", color:"AAAAAA" }),
      new TextRun({ text:" of ", size:16, font:"Arial", color:"AAAAAA" }),
      new TextRun({ children:[PageNumber.TOTAL_PAGES], size:16, font:"Arial", color:"AAAAAA" }),
    ],
  });

  const doc = new Document({
    styles: { default: { document: { run: { font:"Arial", size:22, color:DARK } } } },
    sections: [{
      properties: { page: { size:{width:12240,height:15840}, margin:{top:1080,right:1080,bottom:1080,left:1080} } },
      footers: { default: new Footer({ children:[footerPara] }) },
      children,
    }],
  });

  return await Packer.toBuffer(doc) as Buffer;
}

// Generates the text block injected into every Claude system prompt

/**
 * Returns the full config as a structured prompt block.
 * Inject this at the top of every Claude system prompt.
 */
export function buildConfigPromptBlock(): string {
  const lines: string[] = [];

  lines.push("=== 1o8 SEO PIPELINE — AUTHORITATIVE RULES ===");
  lines.push("");

  // Character limits
  lines.push("## CHARACTER & BYTE LIMITS (STRICT — NEVER EXCEED)");
  for (const [field, limit] of Object.entries(CHAR_LIMITS)) {
    const label = field.replace(/_/g, " ").replace(/\b\w/g, c => c.toUpperCase());
    lines.push(`- ${label}: ${limit.min}-${limit.max} ${limit.unit}`);
  }
  lines.push("");

  // Keyword tiers
  lines.push("## KEYWORD TIER DISTRIBUTION");
  for (const [tier, cfg] of Object.entries(KEYWORD_TIERS)) {
    const max = cfg.maxCount === Infinity ? "unlimited" : String(cfg.maxCount);
    lines.push(`- ${tier} (${cfg.label}): ${cfg.minCount}-${max} keywords → ${cfg.primaryLocation}, ${cfg.matchType} match`);
  }
  lines.push("");
  lines.push("## TIER → CONTENT SECTION MAPPING");
  for (const [section, tiers] of Object.entries(TIER_TO_SECTION)) {
    lines.push(`- ${section}: ${tiers.join(", ")}`);
  }
  lines.push("");

  // Bullet structure
  lines.push("## BULLET STRUCTURE");
  lines.push(`- ${BULLET_CONFIG.count} bullets × ${BULLET_CONFIG.versions.length} versions (${BULLET_CONFIG.versions.join(", ")})`);
  lines.push(`- Format: ${BULLET_CONFIG.format}`);
  for (const [bullet, purpose] of Object.entries(BULLET_CONFIG.purposes)) {
    const stage = BULLET_CONFIG.buyer_stages[bullet as keyof typeof BULLET_CONFIG.buyer_stages];
    lines.push(`  - ${bullet}: ${purpose} [${stage}]`);
  }
  for (const rule of BULLET_CONFIG.rules) {
    lines.push(`  - RULE: ${rule}`);
  }
  lines.push("");

  // Title rules
  lines.push("## TITLE RULES");
  lines.push(`- Allowed: ${TITLE_CONFIG.allowed_chars}`);
  lines.push(`- Hyphen: ${TITLE_CONFIG.hyphen_rule}`);
  for (const rule of TITLE_CONFIG.structure) {
    lines.push(`- ${rule}`);
  }
  lines.push(`- Keywords: ${TITLE_CONFIG.keyword_rule}`);
  lines.push("- No filler phrases");
  lines.push("");

  // Description rules
  lines.push("## DESCRIPTION RULES");
  lines.push("- NO colons allowed");
  lines.push(`- Style: ${DESCRIPTION_CONFIG.style}`);
  lines.push(`- Buyer journey: ${DESCRIPTION_CONFIG.buyer_journey}`);
  lines.push(`- Keywords: ${DESCRIPTION_CONFIG.keyword_placement}`);
  lines.push("- Never copy existing content verbatim");
  lines.push("");

  // Backend rules
  lines.push("## BACKEND SEARCH TERMS");
  lines.push(`- Sets: ${BACKEND_CONFIG.sets.join(", ")}`);
  lines.push(`- Format: ${BACKEND_CONFIG.format}`);
  lines.push(`- Allowed tiers: ${BACKEND_CONFIG.allowed_tiers.join(", ")} ONLY`);
  for (const p of BACKEND_CONFIG.prohibited) {
    lines.push(`- PROHIBITED: ${p}`);
  }
  lines.push("- No repetition across sets");
  lines.push("");

  // COSMO
  lines.push("## COSMO RELATIONSHIPS");
  lines.push(`- Exactly ${PROCESSING_LIMITS.cosmo_rows} rows required`);
  lines.push(`- Types: ${COSMO_RELATIONSHIP_TYPES.join(", ")}`);
  lines.push(`- PDP sections: ${PDP_SECTIONS.join(", ")}`);
  lines.push(`- Usage explanation: max ${PROCESSING_LIMITS.cosmo_usage_max_words} words`);
  lines.push(`- Notes: max ${PROCESSING_LIMITS.cosmo_notes_max_words} words`);
  lines.push("- Every row must trace to a keyword, review insight, or Rufus answer");
  lines.push("- NEVER include competitor names");
  lines.push("- No blank fields — use 'Not Applicable' where needed");
  lines.push("");

  // Compliance
  lines.push("## COMPLIANCE — NEVER VIOLATE");
  lines.push("### Restricted words/phrases (triggers CRITICAL flag):");
  lines.push(COMPLIANCE.restricted_words.map(w => `"${w}"`).join(", "));
  lines.push("");
  lines.push("### Structural rules:");
  for (const rule of COMPLIANCE.structural_rules) {
    lines.push(`- ${rule}`);
  }
  lines.push("");
  lines.push("### Quality rules:");
  for (const rule of COMPLIANCE.quality_rules) {
    lines.push(`- ${rule}`);
  }
  lines.push("");

  // Buyer journey
  lines.push("## BUYER JOURNEY MAP");
  for (const [section, stage] of Object.entries(COMPLIANCE.buyer_journey_map)) {
    lines.push(`- ${section.replace(/_/g, " ")}: ${stage}`);
  }
  lines.push("");

  lines.push("=== END PIPELINE RULES ===");

  return lines.join("\n");
}

// ── 15 VALIDATION HELPERS ────────────────────────────────────

/** Check if a string is within character limits for a given field */
export function validateCharLimit(
  value: string,
  field: keyof typeof CHAR_LIMITS
): { valid: boolean; length: number; min: number; max: number; unit: string } {
  const limit = CHAR_LIMITS[field];
  const length = limit.unit === "bytes"
    ? new TextEncoder().encode(value).length
    : value.length;
  return {
    valid: length >= limit.min && length <= limit.max,
    length,
    min: limit.min,
    max: limit.max,
    unit: limit.unit,
  };
}

/** Check a string against restricted words list */
export function findRestrictedWords(text: string): string[] {
  const lower = text.toLowerCase();
  return COMPLIANCE.restricted_words.filter(word =>
    lower.includes(word.toLowerCase())
  );
}

/** Validate title characters */
export function validateTitleChars(title: string): { valid: boolean; invalid_chars: string[] } {
  const invalid: string[] = [];
  for (const char of title) {
    if (!TITLE_CONFIG.allowed_chars_regex.test(char) && !invalid.includes(char)) {
      invalid.push(char);
    }
  }
  return { valid: invalid.length === 0, invalid_chars: invalid };
}

/** Check for word repetition (>2x per element) */
export function findRepeatedWords(text: string, maxRepetitions = 2): string[] {
  const words = text.toLowerCase().match(/\b\w+\b/g) ?? [];
  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const word of words) {
    counts.set(word, (counts.get(word) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  return [...counts.entries()]
    .filter(([, count]) => count > maxRepetitions)
    .map(([word]) => word);
}

/** Check if colons are used correctly (only in bullet headers) */
export function validateColonUsage(
  text: string,
  fieldType: "title" | "description" | "bullet"
): { valid: boolean; message?: string } {
  const hasColon = text.includes(":");
  if (fieldType === "title" && hasColon) {
    return { valid: false, message: "Colons not allowed in titles" };
  }
  if (fieldType === "description" && hasColon) {
    return { valid: false, message: "Colons not allowed in descriptions" };
  }
  if (fieldType === "bullet" && hasColon) {
    // Colon should only appear once, after the ALL CAPS header
    const colonIndex = text.indexOf(":");
    const header = text.slice(0, colonIndex);
    if (header !== header.toUpperCase()) {
      return { valid: false, message: "Colon must follow ALL CAPS header" };
    }
    // Only one colon allowed
    if ((text.match(/:/g) ?? []).length > 1) {
      return { valid: false, message: "Only one colon allowed per bullet (after header)" };
    }
  }
  return { valid: true };
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// SEO Skill Runner — Orchestrates /seo skill analysis at pipeline stages
//
// Skills:
//   1. S0 Competitive Analysis — pre-pipeline, feeds into S2-S6
//
// Post-S6 validation and GEO readiness are now part of the
// premium audit in /api/seo/claude/seo-audit (merged in S6.6).
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { seoSettings, seoProjects, seoAsins } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";
import { logEvent } from "@/lib/event-logger";

// ── Skill config check ────────────────────────────────────────

interface SkillConfig {
  s0_competitive: boolean;
}

export async function getSkillConfig(): Promise<SkillConfig> {
  const defaults: SkillConfig = { s0_competitive: false };
  try {
    const [row] = await db
      .select({ value: seoSettings.value })
      .from(seoSettings)
      .where(eq(seoSettings.key, "skill_config"))
      .limit(1);
    if (row?.value) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(row.value);
      return { ...defaults, ...parsed };
    }
  } catch { /* use defaults */ }
  return defaults;
}

// ── Claude API helper ─────────────────────────────────────────

async function callClaude(systemPrompt: string, userPrompt: string, maxTokens = 4096): Promise<string> {
  const apiKey = process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY;
  if (!apiKey) throw new Error("Missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY");

  const res = await fetch("https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "x-api-key": apiKey,
      "anthropic-version": "2023-06-01",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      model: "claude-haiku-4-5-20251001",
      max_tokens: maxTokens,
      system: systemPrompt,
      messages: [{ role: "user", content: userPrompt }],
    }),
  });

  if (!res.ok) {
    const errText = await res.text();
    throw new Error(`Claude API ${res.status}: ${errText}`);
  }

  const data = await res.json();
  return data.content?.[0]?.text || "";
}

/** Extract JSON from Claude response (handles markdown fences) */
function extractJson<T>(text: string): T {
  const cleaned = text.replace(/```(?:json)?\s*/gi, "").replace(/```/g, "").trim();
  const start = cleaned.indexOf("{");
  if (start === -1) throw new Error("No JSON object in response");

  let depth = 0;
  let end = -1;
  let inString = false;
  let escape = false;
  for (let i = start; i < cleaned.length; i++) {
    const ch = cleaned[i];
    if (escape) { escape = false; continue; }
    if (ch === "\\") { escape = true; continue; }
    if (ch === '"') { inString = !inString; continue; }
    if (inString) continue;
    if (ch === "{") depth++;
    else if (ch === "}") { depth--; if (depth === 0) { end = i; break; } }
  }
  if (end === -1) throw new Error("No complete JSON object in response");
  return JSON.parse(cleaned.slice(start, end + 1));
}

// ── Save result to seoSettings ────────────────────────────────

async function saveSkillResult(key: string, value: unknown, userEmail: string) {
  await db
    .insert(seoSettings)
    .values({
      key,
      value: JSON.stringify(value),
      updatedBy: userEmail,
    })
    .onConflictDoUpdate({
      target: seoSettings.key,
      set: {
        value: JSON.stringify(value),
        updatedAt: new Date(),
        updatedBy: userEmail,
      },
    });
}

// ── Load project data helpers ─────────────────────────────────

async function loadProjectIntake(projectId: string) {
  const [project] = await db.select().from(seoProjects).where(eq(seoProjects.id, projectId)).limit(1);
  const asins = await db.select().from(seoAsins).where(eq(seoAsins.projectId, projectId));
  return { project, asins };
}

// SKILL: S0 Competitive Analysis

export interface CompetitiveResult {
  runAt: string;
  brandName: string;
  asinCount: number;
  competitorCount: number;
  positioning: {
    strengths: string[];
    weaknesses: string[];
    opportunities: string[];
  };
  keywordGaps: { keyword: string; competitorUsing: string; priority: "high" | "medium" | "low" }[];
  contentRecommendations: string[];
  overallScore: number; // 0-100
}

export async function runCompetitiveAnalysis(
  projectId: string,
  userEmail: string,
): Promise<CompetitiveResult> {
  const startTime = Date.now();

  const { project, asins } = await loadProjectIntake(projectId);
  if (!project) throw new Error("Project not found");

  const brandName = project.brandName || "";
  const competitors = (project.competitors as { name: string; url: string }[]) || [];

  const asinList = asins.map(a => ({
    asin: a.asin,
    title: ((a.existingContent as any)?.item_name) || "",
    bullets: ((a.existingContent as any)?.bullet_points) || [],
    parentage: a.parentageLevel,
    variation: a.variationProduct,
  }));

  const systemPrompt = `You are a competitive intelligence analyst for Amazon product listings.
Analyze the brand's product listings against competitor information to identify positioning gaps,
keyword opportunities, and content strategy recommendations.

Return ONLY a valid JSON object with this exact structure:
{
  "positioning": {
    "strengths": ["strength 1", "strength 2", ...],
    "weaknesses": ["weakness 1", ...],
    "opportunities": ["opportunity 1", ...]
  },
  "keywordGaps": [
    { "keyword": "...", "competitorUsing": "competitor name", "priority": "high|medium|low" }
  ],
  "contentRecommendations": ["recommendation 1", ...],
  "overallScore": <0-100>
}

Score meaning: 0-40 = weak competitive position, 40-70 = moderate, 70-100 = strong.
Provide 3-5 items per category. Focus on actionable insights.`;

  const userPrompt = `Analyze competitive positioning for:

Brand: ${brandName}
Products (${asinList.length} ASINs):
${asinList.slice(0, 5).map(a => `- ${a.asin}: ${a.title} (${a.parentage})`).join("\n")}

Competitors:
${competitors.length > 0
    ? competitors.map(c => `- ${c.name}: ${c.url}`).join("\n")
    : "No competitors listed — analyze based on product category and common competitors."}

Existing content samples:
${asinList.slice(0, 2).map(a => `${a.asin}:\n  Title: ${a.title}\n  Bullets: ${(a.bullets || []).slice(0, 3).join(" | ")}`).join("\n")}

Return ONLY valid JSON.`;

  const response = await callClaude(systemPrompt, userPrompt);
  const analysis = extractJson<Omit<CompetitiveResult, "runAt" | "brandName" | "asinCount" | "competitorCount">>(response);

  const result: CompetitiveResult = {
    runAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    brandName,
    asinCount: asinList.length,
    competitorCount: competitors.length,
    ...analysis,
  };

  await saveSkillResult(`competitive:${projectId}`, result, userEmail);

  logEvent({
    userEmail,
    section: "seo",
    action: "skill:competitive",
    status: "success",
    message: `Competitive analysis completed for ${brandName}`,
    detail: { projectId, score: result.overallScore, gaps: result.keywordGaps.length },
    durationMs: Date.now() - startTime,
  });

  return result;
}

      .select({ value: seoSettings.value })
      .from(seoSettings)
      .where(eq(seoSettings.key, `competitive:${projectId}`))
      .limit(1);

  } catch { return null; }
}

/**
 * Bidirectional sync between BigQuery and Supabase.
 *
 * Direction: BQ wins on conflict (BQ is source of truth).
 * Tables: AAC (clients), Attributes (column registry)
 * Products sync handled separately by /api/cron/sync-bq (dirty-flag publish).
 */
import { BigQuery } from "@google-cloud/bigquery";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { aac, columnAttributes, adminEventLog } from "@/lib/db/schema";
import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";

const PROJECT_ID = process.env.GCP_PROJECT_ID || "amazon-data-461918";

function getBigQueryClient(): BigQuery {
  if (process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL && process.env.GCP_PRIVATE_KEY) {
    let privateKey = process.env.GCP_PRIVATE_KEY;
    privateKey = privateKey.replace(/\\n/g, "\n");
    if (privateKey.startsWith('"') && privateKey.endsWith('"')) {
      privateKey = JSON.parse(privateKey);
    }
    return new BigQuery({
      projectId: PROJECT_ID,
      credentials: {
        client_email: process.env.GCP_CLIENT_EMAIL,
        private_key: privateKey,
      },
    });
  }
  return new BigQuery({ projectId: PROJECT_ID });
}

// ── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface SyncTableResult {
  table: string;
  inserted: number;
  updated: number;
  skipped: number;
  errors: string[];
  durationMs: number;
}

export interface SyncResult {
  tables: SyncTableResult[];
  totalDurationMs: number;
  triggeredBy: string;
}

// ── AAC Sync (BQ → Supabase) ──────────────────────────────────────────

async function syncAAC(): Promise<SyncTableResult> {
  const start = Date.now();
  const result: SyncTableResult = {
    table: "aac_clients",
    inserted: 0,
    updated: 0,
    skipped: 0,
    errors: [],
    durationMs: 0,
  };

  try {
    const bq = getBigQueryClient();
    const [rows] = await bq.query({
      query: `SELECT * FROM \`${PROJECT_ID}.1o8BibleApp.AAC\``,
      location: "us-west1",
    });

    for (const row of rows) {
      const clientIdCode = (row.ClientIDCode || "").trim();
      const clientStatus = (row.ClientStatus || "").trim();
      const clientName = (row.ClientName || "").trim();

      if (!clientIdCode) {
        result.skipped++;
        continue;
      }

      // Build raw data (all columns as strings)
      const rawData: Record<string, string> = {};
      for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(row)) {
        rawData[key] = val != null ? String(val) : "";
      }

      const powerbiUrl = (row.PowerBIDashboardURL || "").trim() || null;

      try {
        const [existing] = await db
          .select({ id: aac.id })
          .from(aac)
          .where(eq(aac.clientIdCode, clientIdCode))
          .limit(1);

        if (existing) {
          await db
            .update(aac)
            .set({
              clientStatus,
              clientName: clientName || null,
              powerbiEmbedUrl: powerbiUrl,
              rawData,
              updatedAt: new Date(),
            })
            .where(eq(aac.id, existing.id));
          result.updated++;
        } else {
          await db.insert(aac).values({
            clientIdCode,
            clientStatus,
            clientName: clientName || null,
            powerbiEmbedUrl: powerbiUrl,
            rawData,
          });
          result.inserted++;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        result.errors.push(
          `${clientIdCode}: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`
        );
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    result.errors.push(
      `BQ query failed: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`
    );
  }

  result.durationMs = Date.now() - start;
  return result;
}

// ── Attributes Sync (BQ → Supabase) ───────────────────────────────────

const CLIENT_CODES = [
  "C23_SC_US", "DRE_SC_US", "DRC_SC_US", "CHE_SC_US", "CHE_VC_US",
  "GOO_SC_US", "PRO_SC_US", "PUR_SC_US", "FRE_SC_US", "GAF_SC_US",
  "HOT_SC_US", "WHI_SC_US", "TRT_SC_US", "TRS_SC_US", "DRW_SC_US",
  "BNU_SC_US", "BRA_SC_US", "POO_SC_US", "SPL_SC_ES", "GLO_SC_US",
  "ROY_SC_US", "PKN_SC_US",
];

async function syncAttributes(): Promise<SyncTableResult> {
  const start = Date.now();
  const result: SyncTableResult = {
    table: "column_attributes",
    inserted: 0,
    updated: 0,
    skipped: 0,
    errors: [],
    durationMs: 0,
  };

  try {
    const bq = getBigQueryClient();
    const [rows] = await bq.query({
      query: `SELECT * FROM \`${PROJECT_ID}.1o8BibleApp.Attributes\` ORDER BY CAST(MasterAttributeRow AS INT64)`,
      location: "us-west1",
    });

    for (const row of rows) {
      const generalLabel = (row.GeneralLabel || "").trim();
      if (!generalLabel) {
        result.skipped++;
        continue;
      }

      const clientReqs: Record<string, string> = {};
      for (const client of CLIENT_CODES) {
        const val = (row as Record<string, string>)[client];
        if (val && val.trim()) {
          clientReqs[client] = val.trim();
        }
      }

      const values = {
        masterRow: parseInt(row.MasterAttributeRow) || 0,
        generalLabel,
        specificLabel: row.SpecificLabel || null,
        bigqueryLabel: row.BigqueryLabel || null,
        bqDataType: row.BQDataType || "STRING",
        labelDetails: row.LabelDetails || null,
        labelMaxOptions: row.LabelMaxOptions || null,
        referenceGroup: row.ReferenceGroup || "",
        subgroup: row.Subgroup || "",
        isEssential: row.Essential === "true",
        clientRequirements: clientReqs,
      };

      try {
        const [existing] = await db
          .select({ id: columnAttributes.id })
          .from(columnAttributes)
          .where(eq(columnAttributes.generalLabel, generalLabel))
          .limit(1);

        if (existing) {
          await db
            .update(columnAttributes)
            .set(values)
            .where(eq(columnAttributes.id, existing.id));
          result.updated++;
        } else {
          await db.insert(columnAttributes).values(values);
          result.inserted++;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        result.errors.push(
          `${generalLabel}: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`
        );
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    result.errors.push(
      `BQ query failed: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`
    );
  }

  result.durationMs = Date.now() - start;
  return result;
}

// ── Main sync orchestrator ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export async function syncAllTables(
  triggeredBy: string,
  tables?: string[]
): Promise<SyncResult> {
  const start = Date.now();
  const results: SyncTableResult[] = [];

  const syncAll = !tables || tables.length === 0;

  if (syncAll || tables?.includes("aac_clients")) {
    console.log("[Sync] Starting AAC sync...");
    const r = await syncAAC();
    results.push(r);
    console.log(`[Sync] AAC done: ${r.inserted}i/${r.updated}u/${r.skipped}s in ${r.durationMs}ms`);
  }

  if (syncAll || tables?.includes("column_attributes")) {
    console.log("[Sync] Starting Attributes sync...");
    const r = await syncAttributes();
    results.push(r);
    console.log(`[Sync] Attributes done: ${r.inserted}i/${r.updated}u/${r.skipped}s in ${r.durationMs}ms`);
  }

  const totalDurationMs = Date.now() - start;

  // Log to admin event log
  const totalInserted = results.reduce((s, r) => s + r.inserted, 0);
  const totalUpdated = results.reduce((s, r) => s + r.updated, 0);
  const totalErrors = results.reduce((s, r) => s + r.errors.length, 0);

  await db
    .insert(adminEventLog)
    .values({
      userEmail: triggeredBy,
      userName: triggeredBy,
      section: "sync",
      action: "sync:tables",
      status: totalErrors > 0 ? "warning" : "success",
      resourceType: "sync",
      resourceId: "bq-to-supabase",
      resourceLabel: `Synced ${results.map((r) => r.table).join(", ")}`,
      message: `${totalInserted} inserted, ${totalUpdated} updated, ${totalErrors} errors`,
      detail: { results },
      durationMs: totalDurationMs,
    })
    .catch(() => {});

  return { tables: results, totalDurationMs, triggeredBy };
}

import { clsx, type ClassValue } from "clsx"
import { twMerge } from "tailwind-merge"

export function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]) {
  return twMerge(clsx(inputs))
}

/**
 * Upgrade an Amazon product image URL to a higher resolution.
 * Amazon CDN URLs contain sizing suffixes like `._SL75_`, `._SX300_`, `._AC_SL1500_`.
 * This replaces those with `._SL500_` for crisp display at common UI sizes.
 * Non-Amazon URLs are returned unchanged.
 */
export function hiResAmazonImg(url: string | null | undefined, size = 500): string {
  if (!url) return "";
  if (!url.includes("media-amazon.com") && !url.includes("images-amazon.com")) return url;
  // Replace Amazon sizing suffix (e.g., ._SL75_. or ._AC_SL1500_.) with desired size
  return url.replace(/\._[A-Z]{2,}[\d,_]+_\./, `._SL${size}_.`);
}

FILE: src/lib/db/index.ts

import { drizzle } from "drizzle-orm/postgres-js";
import postgres from "postgres";
import * as schema from "./schema";

const connectionString = process.env.DATABASE_URL!;

// Prevent connection pool exhaustion during HMR in development.
// Each hot-reload re-executes this module, creating a new postgres client.
// Without caching on globalThis, old connections leak and Supabase's pooler
// limit is quickly reached, causing all queries to hang.
const globalForDb = globalThis as unknown as { pgClient: ReturnType<typeof postgres> };

const client =
  globalForDb.pgClient ??
  postgres(connectionString, {
    prepare: false,
    ssl: "require",
    max: 10,
    idle_timeout: 20,
    connect_timeout: 30,
    max_lifetime: 60 * 5, // recycle connections every 5 min to avoid stale pooler connections
  });

if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production") {
  globalForDb.pgClient = client;
}

export const db = drizzle(client, { schema });

/**

 * Validates the CASE-based key mapping without requiring a DB connection.

/** Mirrors the SQL CASE logic from 0020_variation_group_and_normalize.sql */
function normalizeVariationKeys(
  input: Record<string, string>
): Record<string, string> {
  const keyMap: Record<string, string> = {
    variationid: "VariationID",
    variationproduct: "VariationProduct",
    variationthemename: "VariationThemeName",
    childrelationshiptype: "ChildRelationshipType",
    color: "Color",
    size: "Size",
    flavor: "Flavor",
    style: "Style",
  };

  const result: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(input)) {
    const normalized = keyMap[key.toLowerCase()] ?? key;
    result[normalized] = value;
  }
  return result;
}

describe("normalizeVariationKeys", () => {
  it("normalizes lowercase keys to PascalCase", () => {
    const input = { color: "Red", size: "Large", flavor: "Vanilla" };
    const result = normalizeVariationKeys(input);
    expect(result).toEqual({ Color: "Red", Size: "Large", Flavor: "Vanilla" });
  });

  it("normalizes camelCase variationId to VariationID", () => {
    const input = { variationId: "CLIENT01_00" };
    const result = normalizeVariationKeys(input);
    expect(result).toEqual({ VariationID: "CLIENT01_00" });
  });

  it("preserves already-correct PascalCase keys", () => {
    const input = {
      VariationID: "CLIENT01_00",
      Color: "Blue",
      Size: "Medium",
      VariationThemeName: "Size/Color",
    };
    const result = normalizeVariationKeys(input);
    expect(result).toEqual(input);
  });

  it("preserves unknown keys unchanged", () => {
    const input = {
      Color: "Red",
      Scent: "Lavender",
      Material: "Cotton",
      CustomDimension: "XYZ",
    };
    const result = normalizeVariationKeys(input);
    expect(result).toEqual({
      Color: "Red",
      Scent: "Lavender",
      Material: "Cotton",
      CustomDimension: "XYZ",
    });
  });

  it("handles mixed casing across all known keys", () => {
    const input = {
      variationid: "V001",
      variationproduct: "Footies",
      variationthemename: "Size/Color",
      childrelationshiptype: "Variation",
      color: "Red",
      size: "Large",
      flavor: "Vanilla",
      style: "Classic",
    };
    const result = normalizeVariationKeys(input);
    expect(result).toEqual({
      VariationID: "V001",
      VariationProduct: "Footies",
      VariationThemeName: "Size/Color",
      ChildRelationshipType: "Variation",
      Color: "Red",
      Size: "Large",
      Flavor: "Vanilla",
      Style: "Classic",
    });
  });

  it("handles empty object", () => {
    expect(normalizeVariationKeys({})).toEqual({});
  });

  it("deduplicates when both cases exist (last wins, matching SQL behavior)", () => {
    // If both "color" and "Color" exist, both map to "Color" — last one wins
    const input = { color: "Red", Color: "Blue" };
    const result = normalizeVariationKeys(input);
    expect(result.Color).toBe("Blue");
    expect(Object.keys(result)).toEqual(["Color"]);
  });
});
